quests.name: 10th Birthday ArchFiend Helm
quests.description: Loyal members of Nulgath's Nation, take heed! You are the deadliest partiers to stalk the land of Lore. I've crafted a gift to help you celebrate. Lightguard Paladings in /noxustower stole the gift I'd planned to give you. Slay them until you find a Dire Gift Box. Complete my quest to see if the helm you seek is inside.
quests.requirements_note: Must have 10th Anniversary Nulgath Pet in inventory.

quests.name: 10th Birthday Paragon Helm
quests.description: My Undead Legion warriors like to /party as hard as any living hero, and I crafted a gift to help you celebrate. Lightguard Paladins in /noxustower stole the gift I'd planned to give you. Slay them until you find a Bony Gift Box. Complete my quest to see if the helm you seek is inside.
quests.requirements_note: Must have 10th Anniversary Paragon Pet in inventory.

quests.name: 13th Frost Collection Chest Badge
quests.description: The normally bright magic of the holidays has been tainted with the darkness of Frostval the 13th, and the cold hearts of the Snow Golems in the /northlands have turned into dark icy diamonds. Defeat one of them to keep it as a souvenir of the double holiday, and you'll be rewarded with the Frostval 2019 collection character page badge.

items.name: Frostval the 13th Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Shadow Essences
quests.description: Deeper in the fortress, beyond this passage, there are creatures of pure shadow. Capture their essence in this jar, and then bring it back here. Miko will use her light to banish it, and that will weaken the Shadow's hold on all of the beings in the fortress.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Throne Room ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'A Head has Woken' quest. | Must have completed the ' Find the Throne Room ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: New Recruits
quests.description: Now that the shadow is weaker in strength, fight Jaaku's remaining samurai. Most of them are only loyal by force — just like I was. Hopefully, some of them will come to their senses and join our fight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Throne Room ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'A Head has Woken' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadow Heads
quests.description: Now that you've removed some of the threat, I will let you through to the rest of the fortress. There, you will find my remaining 7 heads, deep in a healing slumber. Feed each of them some of the juice from your kappa friends' heads - it will keep them subdued while you fight the shadows that emerge from them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Throne Room ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'A Head has Woken' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Head has Woken
quests.description: All this commotion has awoken one of my heads - one that is still under the shadow's control! Subdue it before it wakes the others - or worse!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Throne Room ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'A Head has Woken' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Please Fix Me
quests.description: The journey here was long, and your body is already starting to unravel. Bring me the shadows of the beings you kill, and I will use them to stitch you back together again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Down Dethrix ' quest.

quests.name: Get the Slime
quests.description: You know where the armor you seek is kept, but it remains out of your reach… until you break the spell that hides it. I can help with that. Kill the slimes near the tower, and pull from them their life-giving cores. Collect 8 of them, and bring them to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reach for the Heart
quests.description: I will need the heart of a powerful enemy to act as a catalyst. The horc, Yargol Magebane, is the strongest creature in the vicinity. His will have to do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get More Shadows
quests.description: The bonds that hold you together grow weak again. Gather more shadows, and I will reinforce them. But this time, only bring me the most potent ones you find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Garen's Key
quests.description: They've got the tower locked down, and it looks like you'll have to go through all of them to get what you came for! Garen holds the key to the first door. Take it from him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Selby's Key
quests.description: Guardian Selby holds the key to the third floor. Take it from her, and open the door.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get Rid of Bolton
quests.description: Guardian Bolton is the last thing standing between you and the power you need to save your true love. Kill him, and take your prize.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Siphon the Power (Farming)
quests.description: It takes much energy for me to operate in your world, and I am a mere extension of my Master's will. When he arrives in your world, the very sky will grow dark from all the power he requires. But my needs are simple. Slay 10 of the Dungeon Guards and bring me their lifeforce.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Dethrix ' quest.

quests.name: Juice for a Tonic (Farming)
quests.description: I can make myself a tonic to help with this headache and lingering fatigue, but I'll need a good reagent. Bring me some Imp Juice from the imps out in the tunnel. Don't think too hard about it, just do it, ok?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Dethrix ' quest.

quests.name: Dark Doomblade
quests.description: Sepulchure's DoomBlade is a weapon of death, destruction, and DOOOOOOOM! But if you want to make it even darker, I can help you. Slay Dethrix and bring me 13 Doom Seals from the Elite Dungeon Guards and I will use their power to enhance the appearance of your sword. I also require a Shard of Darkness. I sense one in an odd shop in Battleon town.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Sepulchure's Undead DoomBlade in inventory.

quests.name: Monstrous DoomBlade
quests.description: Sepulchure's DoomBlade is a weapon of death, destruction, and DOOOOOOOM! But if you want to make it even more monstrous, I can help you. Slay Dethrix and bring me a vial of his Monster Blood… if you are lucky enough to obtain it. I also require a Shard of Darkness. I sense one in an odd shop in Battleon town.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Sepulchure's Undead DoomBlade in inventory.

quests.name: Body, Soul and, Domination
quests.description: Body, Soul and, Domination - the three components of a god. Become as close to one as possible by claiming the body of the Titanic Doomknight from /titanattack and the plating of the complete Doomknight Armor from /valleyofdoom. Some see the mind and the soul as one, so harvest meat from Brainmatter in /brainmeat. Finally, seek the creature that holds dominion over Fear in /underrealm and break off its bones.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 40. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Of the Same Cloak
quests.description: You and I will learn from those who came before you- and those who will come after you. Collect blades and finery that were fashioned with Doom. They will be ground into the base material of your regalia.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 40. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Refracted Light
quests.description: Paladins, the servants of Light who have the ability to harm the Shadows. Cull their numbers and learn their weaknesses. Seek out those who have been marred by Shadowflame in /shadowoff, the fallen fiends in /fiendshard, the lost lights in /legionarena, the Goldhammer from /noxustower, and the chaotic flicker of Chaorrupted Artix in /chaoslab. Lay them low.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 40. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Life Carve
quests.description: The first path Doom took to achieve supremacy was through the domination of the elements. In order to hunt your prey, you must first understand it. Journey across Lore and hunt down the traces of the Orbs Sepulchure once coveted. You will find them with Sek Duat in /wanders, Extreme Noxus from /lightguardwar, Bandit Drakath from /eternalchaos, Entropy from /quibblehunt, Protosatorium in /crashsite, Aisha's Drake from /northlands, Kathool in /deepchaos, Ultra Drakonnan in /drakonnan, and Zeuster in /battlefowl.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 40. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Soul Fracture
quests.description: I once believed there was something special about Sepulchure. Explore the path he took, and face those who played a role in his destiny - His former companion Alteon in /ultraalteon, the usurper Gravelyn in /ebilcorphq, King of Delusion Dethrix the First in /ebondungeon, the broken tool Drakath in /ultradrakath, the draconic fusion in /shadowstrike, and a fragment of the Doom that colored Sepulchure's unlife in /shadowvoid.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 40. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Doom Spikes
quests.description: The Shadowscythe and their rulers decorate themselves in spikes fashioned from the fangs of powerful foes. You will do the same. Create spikes with the fangs of Xyfrag in /voidxyfrag, the Nerfkitten in /voidnerfkitten, the Doomkitten in /doomkitten, the Voice in the Sea from /seavoice, and the Deadly Duo from /InfernalArena.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 40. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Necrotic Blade
quests.description: Your blade will be meant for you and only you. There are other creations of Doom of great fame that can be learned from. Bring them to me so they can be turned into the foundation of your glory.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 40. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unleash Doom
quests.description: You will sit atop a throne of Shadow and Doom, and an army as vast as the sea will kneel at your feet. Best we begin to make that army. Hunt the Inquisitors and take their bones from /citadelruins, retrieve refined metal from the robotic creatures in /deltavcore, slay the dragons in /etherwardes and take their skin, and acquire the Paladin Slayer's skulls from Chaos Vordred in /necrocavern.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 40. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shared Taste
quests.description: The Blue Mage teleported you to Mount Albedo, and purposely separated the party. Best find them quickly. The Doves are as feral as the Ravens were on Maleno. Vermin in white robes. I'm used to those. Disperse them so we may go on our way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sal Volatile ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Ablutio
quests.description: Like Maleno, Mount Albedo has its own Elementals. They're Fiamme's kin, burned by the same flames that make the mortals suffer so. Their properties are different…and are offensive to my - our - sensibilities. Smother them until they are no more. Yes, yes, I am merely making a suggestion.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sal Volatile ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Physical Conflagration
quests.description: When mortals are set alight by Maleno's flames, they burn forever. The same happens with Albedo's fire, but there's more. The white inferno is causing this mountain's matches to…transform. Push them away without being transformed yourself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sal Volatile ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Quiet Aftermath
quests.description: We have left the photonegative forests behind us, and happened across a settlement. Consult familiar faces to relieve your confusion, and investigate those astral lions. Their properties are…dreamlike. A projection, of sorts.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sal Volatile ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Solva Et Coagula
quests.description: A Mountain Spirit waits at the center of the settlement. Albedo isn't hers, but the original masters…are long dead. You must wish to speak to her about your missing companions. That Crystal Prima won't allow you to. Destroy it…and take its sigil.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sal Volatile ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rosenkreutz
quests.description: Consult the woman from Somorah. I am eager to learn more about the ceremony we must undergo to meet Aiwass, the being from beyond the stars. The Albedo Elementals must be a part of it. Take them apart to retrieve their Prima Materia.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sal Volatile ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Synchophant Symbiote
quests.description: Within the Mausoleum are Albedo Matches who are different from the others. They'll get in the way of our ceremony if they're left to mindlessly lumber around. Shall I guide your blade? No? But of course. Your skill is already unmatched. Ha.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sal Volatile ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tria Prima
quests.description: The ceremony involves marrying three alchemical sigils. You already have the Salt Sigil. The Mercury Prima and Sulfur Prima are inside the chamber divided in two. They must become one…become whole.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sal Volatile ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chymical Fusion
quests.description: Flowers bloomed from the fused sigils, and we are to offer them to Aiwass' sarcophagus. Do you notice the scroll in that room? I sense a presence watching. Its anticipation is palpable.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sal Volatile ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ipsissimus
quests.description: Aiwass dreams in their sarcophagus. The scent of these perfected flowers has opened their mind. We will enter, my True Doomknight. We will confront Aiwass, and judge what it has to show us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sal Volatile ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Al vel Legis
quests.description: The Stranger clinging to your shadow is completely incapacitated. It's honestly pathetic. While they go through an existential crisis, you plan to gather materials from the Mercury Prima and Sulfur Prima. Aiwass' dream may have more to offer as well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ipsissimus ' quest.

quests.name: Al vel Legis (Legend)
quests.description: The Stranger clinging to your shadow is completely incapacitated. It's honestly pathetic. While they go through an existential crisis, you plan to gather materials from the Mercury Prima and Sulfur Prima. Aiwass' dream may have more to offer as well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ipsissimus ' quest.

quests.name: Plans for Frostval
quests.description: First things first! We should talk to Syrrus and Blizzy to see what they have planned for Frostval. Also, I heard Blizzy saying that the local wildlife took apart his snowglobe and are hiding it from him! Go get the pieces back and bring them to me. If I can fix it, it will be the first Frostval present ever given in Cryostorm!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Karok! ' quest.

quests.name: Find the Missing Presents
quests.description: The wildlife here must be getting into the Frostval spirit as well! Unfortunately, I don't think they get the idea. They have hidden the presents around Cryostorm! Take a look around and see if you can find them all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: More Gifts
quests.description: We should make some more presents for the villagers! We should look around for some stuff that will really brighten their day! You could get some Cloth from the Arctic Wolves to make capes for the children so they can pretend to be Heroes, some Fur from the Mammoths to make coats for the adults, and some Bells from the Glacial Elementals to fill this place with some music!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Warmth for the Small
quests.description: Although most of us are used to the frigid air of the Tundra, the newborns and children are not! Let's get some fur from the Arctic Wolves for some blankets to not only warm them up but also show them what Frostval is all about!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cut Down the Tree
quests.description: Blizzy told me the most important part of Frostval is to have a big, nice tree to decorate. I know the perfect tree! If you head to the upper level of the town you will find it. Be careful, though! There is a pack of Arctic Wolves that guard it. You will have to take care of them before you can get the tree!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Decorate the Tree
quests.description: Dang it! Those creatures have taken our stuff, again! This time, they took all our decorations! Defeat these monsters and get all of the tree decorations back. It won't be Frostval without a decorated tree.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Ice StarStone
quests.description: Uh oh! Syrrus's StarStone for the top of the tree is missing! I heard some of the townspeople talking… They said the Behemoth has it… Hero… I think we should just leave it alone. The Behemoth isn't something you want to mess with!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: War Medal Quest
quests.description: The Frostspawn army is flooding through Cryostorm. Please help us defeat them or all is lost.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Ice StarStone ' quest.

quests.name: Mega War Medal Quest
quests.description: The Frostspawn army is flooding through Cryostorm. Please help us defeat them or all is lost.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Ice StarStone ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Karok
quests.description: Alright Hero. This is it. It's time to take Cryostorm back! Head to the Temple and we will stop Karok, once and for all! Let's show him what happens what a group of heroes can truly do!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either of the previous quests. Note: This quest can also be found from Abel in Cryostorm Tundra .

quests.name: Trade for Glacial Crystals (Farming Quest)
quests.description: Hello, Hero! I think if I were given enough Ice energy, I could create Glacial Crystals that you could use to purchase "cool" gear from my shop! I'll need 5 Ice Chips from Glacial Trolls, 5 Ice Wisps from Frostspawn Trolls, 5 Ice Cores from Glacial Elementals, and 5 Ice Gems from the Behemoth.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Ultra Karok ' quest.

quests.name: Trade for Glacial Crystals (Farming Quest)
quests.description: Hello, Legendary Hero! I think if I were given enough Ice energy, I could create Glacial Crystals that you could use to purchase "cool" gear from my shop! I'll need 5 Ice Chips from Glacial Trolls, 5 Ice Wisps from Frostspawn Trolls, 5 Ice Cores from Glacial Elementals in /cryostorm, and 5 Ice Gems from the Behemoth in /cryostorm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Ultra Karok ' quest.

quests.name: Trade for More Glacial Crystals (Farming Quest)
quests.description: Hello, Hero! I think if I were given enough Ice energy, I could create Glacial Crystals that you could use to purchase "cool" gear from my shop! I'll need 5 Arctic Fragments from Glacial Trolls, 5 Polar Scales from Frostspawn Trolls, 5 Ice Gems from the Behemoth, and Karok's Frigid Exaltation Essence.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Ultra Karok ' quest.

quests.name: Trade for More Glacial Crystals (Farming Quest)
quests.description: Hello, Legendary Hero! I think if I were given enough Ice energy, I could create Glacial Crystals that you could use to purchase "cool" gear from my shop! I'll need 3 Arctic Fragments from Glacial Trolls, 3 Polar Scales from Frostspawn Trolls, 3 Ice Gems from the Behemoth in /cryostorm, and Karok's Frigid Exaltation Essence.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Ultra Karok ' quest.

quests.name: Take it Down
quests.description: The Frostspawn Horror needs to be defeated or all is lost! We will never get to Karok in time.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Keep Going! ' quest.

quests.name: Fight For Karok!
quests.description: Defeat 10 of Kezeroth's frozen minions to get World Ender Medals and raise the War Meter!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take it Down ' quest.

quests.name: (Mega) Fight For Karok!
quests.description: Defeat enough of Kezeroth's frozen minions to get 5 Mega World Ender Medals and raise the War Meter!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take it Down ' quest.

quests.name: What is THAT?
quests.description: Karok and Kezeroth are getting away! We'll have to defeat this beast quickly if we're to have a chance of catching up to them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take it Down ' quest.

quests.name: Cold Open
quests.description: You would think with the Avatars being as old as they are, they could come up with some crazy trials. I think they are just old fashioned, because Kyanos wants you to beat up some Frosted Banshees, Frozen Undead, and Ice Symbiotes.

quests.name: Frost Fight
quests.description: Next on the list is defeating a few Spirits of Ice, shattering some Ice Crystals, and banishing some Frigid Spirits!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Freeze Frame
quests.description: Now it's time for you to face some of the hardest elementals this dungeon has to offer! Take out any Living Ice, Crystalized Elemental, and Frozen Demon you come across because they'll be trying to do the same to you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Glace's Trial
quests.description: It wouldn't be a true trial if you didn't fight off against Kyanos's first Champion of Ice! Glace is crazy strong so I hope you are ready! She has had all this time to prepare! Good luck!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Abel's Trial
quests.description: This is it! I've wanted to test my newfound strength as an Envoy with you for a while! You were the one who taught what it means to be a Hero! Let's give it our all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Final Trial
quests.description: You beat monsters, elementals, a Champion, and even me! You are already worthy in my eyes, but there is one more trial ahead. You've got this, Hero!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Basic Ingredients
quests.description: In order to get started, we'll need some basic materials! Luckily, everything that was used to make my gear is found right here in the Ice Plane! Start off with some of the weaker monsters in the area and find what we need!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Final Trial ' quest.

quests.name: Cool Flavor
quests.description: Now that you have the basics, we can start adding extra for some flavor! Let's move on to the mid-level monsters for some better materials!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Final Trial ' quest.

quests.name: Chilled to Perfection
quests.description: To really strengthen your gear, we need to get it as cold as possible! The strongest elementals in the dungeon will be enough it's temperature down enough!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Final Trial ' quest.

quests.name: Icing on the Cake
quests.description: The last thing you'll need to finish up your gear is some special blessings from the higher beings in the Ice Plane! Face off against us again and we'll be happy to give it to you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Final Trial ' quest.

quests.name: Cold Hearted
quests.description: The dreaded Karok the Fallen had an affinity to ice that allowed him to freeze things with his touch and channel his ice magic. If you can gather the materials, we can create a reagent that allows us to do the same. We'll need Ice Needles from /icestormarena, a Northern Crown from /snowmore, and some Ice Diamonds from /kingcoal. Remember, we'll also need Karok's Fallen Scythe of Vengeance in order to make it work…

quests.name: Cold Blooded
quests.description: This next step will need a little more attunement to Glacera and the Plane of Ice. Collect the Frostslayer from Enfield in /iceplane, gather Glacial Crystals from Super-Charged Karok in /cryowar, and Necrotic Orbs adorned with Ice Spikes and Splinters from monsters in /frozenlair.

quests.name: Ice See You
quests.description: We're ready! Take the things you've learned and the materials you've gathered, and combine them with two powerful conduits in order to channel that power.

quests.name: Defense of Embersea
quests.description: You made it! I've been helping the Icewings hold the line and keep their fortress intact. Galanoth was here but he ran up ahead. Before you go to him, could you take out 10 of the Living ShadowFlames? That will let me focus on helping these others.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' ShadeFire Colonel Clash ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Chilling Conflict
quests.description: I don't fully understand the nature of these Frozen Fire elementals, but I can see the effect they have on the Onslaught Knights. They're chilling them to the bone! That should make it easier for you to take out 10 of them. Then move on to tackle their leader.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' ShadeFire Colonel Clash ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: General Dismay
quests.description: Aaah! You've cleared the way to their leaders. These ShadeFire Generals might be made of fire and darkness, but their hearts are colder than Kyanos'! Take out the three Generals. They've already done too much damage here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' ShadeFire Colonel Clash ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Fallen Friend
quests.description: This… this is the centaur you've told me about? I can't believe he's become so corrupted. But don't worry! You've freed people from the ShadowFlame corruption before, you said. You can do it again! We just need to… pacify… him first.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' General Dismay ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Fire Fighting
quests.description: If you'd like to train against Tydarius's forces, we'd gladly welcome the help! Maybe I can procure some gear for you in the meantime. Go collect ShadowFlame Tags from the common soldiers, and then some Corrupted Badges from the leaders. They break pretty easily, so you might not always find one!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Fallen Friend ' quest.

quests.name: Battle Abyssal Guards
quests.description: My Master is waiting for you at the top of the Midnight Mountain. But only the strongest are permitted to face him. Battle 13 of his Abyssal Guards to prove your worth.

quests.name: Battle the Underbeasts
quests.description: My Master waits at the top of the Midnight Mountain… but many will never reach that far. Battle 13 of the Underbeasts which live in my lair. Survive them, and you may be strong enough to face my Mater.

quests.name: Defeat the Devourer of Souls
quests.description: Generals in the Undead Legion must find their own feasts. My Master has been waiting for you. I am hungry, but he is… STARVING. He wishes to consume only the strongest of heroes. Your strength will feed him well.

quests.name: Gifts of the Cryomancer
quests.description: Becoming Hollowborn has given me the opportunity to do things I never could before, and I plan to seize this chance and make the most of our meeting, maybe we could help each other. I need Shards from the Ice Crystals in /icedungeon and ShadowLord Auras for… well… no need for you to know right now. But if you bring me some, I'll give you a pretty cool reward.

quests.name: Ice Nine
quests.description: The path to Guwio is filled with Frost Monsters which will make it difficult to travel to other towns to get supplies for the winter. If you can defeat Snow Golems this will help clear the way for travelers. Bring back 9 Ice Cubes to show that the path is a little bit safer.

quests.name: Ice Wyrms
quests.description: You know what is even worst than Snow Golems? Frost Wyrm Riders - and the path ahead is filled with them. If you could get rid of 4 Frost Wyrm Riders this would make the path ahead much easier to travel. Frost Wyrm Riders are harder to defeat, so if you bring me back 4 Wyrm's Spikes I'll reward you handsomely.

quests.name: Chasing After A Girl
quests.description: The snowfall is so heavy that the path seems to endlessly change no matter which direction you *think* you're headed in. What we need is some spell to help lead the right path…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Anything but Common ' quest.

quests.name: Tracking Down Nythera
quests.description: Great! Now that you have a Chaos Positioning Spell, the path to Nythera should reveal itself! Go back through the forest and find that purple mage. She just needs a friend to talk to right now to help clear her head.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Searching for Splinters
quests.description: When Nythera took flight, strange Void fragments showered down all over the Frozen Northlands. Maybe if you collect enough of these Void Splinters… you can somehow craft a working portal to The Void?? It's worth a shot… right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bang, Smash, BOOM
quests.description: In order for our fireworks to be the most spectacular, we'll need to pack the tubes full of shattered Gem Shards. Start the night off with a bang; run around and smash some of those floating Chaos Gemeralds.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Returning the Gifts ' quest.

quests.name: Fire and Fuses
quests.description: One of the best parts about fireworks is the smell in the area. Sulfur, explosions, the crackling energy and excitement. We'll need Saltpeter and Fuses to make sure our fireworks explode as intended. Those annoying Fire Imps and Water Goblins must have something that would help us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Returning the Gifts ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Light up the Night
quests.description: We're going to light up the night. The final things we need are the different coloring agents — chemicals I can use to make sure the finale is brighter than anything we've ever seen! The Frost King will have the gold, you can get the silver from the Holidrake. The Water Draconian will have the blue, Nythera the Chaos dragon the indigo, and the red? Well, you'll have to battle Santy Claws for that.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Returning the Gifts ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Bright Lights Festival Rewards
quests.description: We filled the sky with colorful stars, and the shining faces of our villagers tell me the festival was a success! To show my appreciation, I want to give you a gift! Bring me any Fallen Stars the monsters in this area might drop and I'll craft you a thank you gift to show my appreciation!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Light up the Night ' quest.

quests.name: Cathedral of Time
quests.description: I can't go into the Cathedral with you, but I'll be able to talk to you using the various Data Stations contained within it. Use the Light Portal to transport yourself into the Cathedral of Time, and then talk to me using Data Station Aion. Just look for the small, floating droid in the room that the portal drops you off in.

quests.name: Coffee for the Mind
quests.description: First, we need to get me in shape. That means more coffee! The lady inside the coffee shop in /vendorbooths refuses to sell me any more cups due to "health concerns", so we have to do this ourselves. First, gather coffee beans from the imps all around the shop. Over in /artistalley there is a realm guardian beside me. In his realm, there are poisonous snake-like monsters - they will be a great source of the tasty poison. We should probably get the antidote, too… just in case. I think I remember hearing something about burned trails and vines.

quests.name: Ectoplasm for the Body
quests.description: Without having my accessories active, my strength is greatly reduced and I just don't have the strength to move everything that Secretteller needs. I will need some ectoplasm to fuel my accessories. This dimension is a bit different, so I have trouble catching the stray ectoplasm from the air myself. How about you get me some? Bring me some Refined Ectoplasm from the Doomwood Ectomancers, and a bit of Ektorax's Ectoplasm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Secretteller's Building Materials
quests.description: Secretteller told me he can get most of the stuff he needs by himself, but needs our help with gathering the things he needs a huge quantity of. Wood can be easily gathered from Doomwood Treeants. Iron can be found in the factory in /extinction, and big iron bolts can be obtained from the Dwakels in /crashsite. Also, some cake as a snack would be nice too, don't you think? A girl named Xeven told me about the cake in /portalmaze. If you can get the wood, iron, bolts and cake that would be great! ST is relying on us, so let's do our best!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Deadly Dedication of a Hero
quests.description: Hey, Hero - I am usually used to fighting with a weapon and right now I don't have one. Would you be so kind and help me create a super stron strong one, pretty please?! With a proper ecto weapon, I'll be able to defend myself against all the scary unknown monsters from this dimension and look super cool while doing so! Secretteller made a list of materials I could find useful and then promptly decided to teleport me away before telling me where to find them. So good luck with the unfair scavenger hunt, Hero! It is officially your problem now, not mine. See you later!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Melody of Cuteness
quests.description: Ugh, the smell… Love is in the air! Someone in close proximity to us is using Heroes Heart Day gear… and I really dislike that holiday. It's just not … ecto enough! How about we treat ourselves a bit? Let's create some lovely ecto gear out of that pink and red gear that those lovers of Heroes Heart day love to wear.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Secretteller's Building Materials' quest.

quests.name: Day of the Fools
quests.description: Hey, Hero, do you know which month is the best one of them all? No matter what you answer, I'm going to pretend you said April. Why? Because that's what month the coffee lady said it was… And that was REALLY good coffee. Because of that coffee, I totally have the energy to give you this quest for insanely cursed gear. Got it?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Secretteller's Building Materials' quest.

quests.name: The Queen of Envy
quests.description: Confront the Queen of Envy!

quests.name: Combat Practice
quests.description: I've been practicing a lot lately, and I think I'm getting much better! Come on, spar with me! I bet I can beat you now!

quests.name: Round 2
quests.description: Ok, you know what - I wasn't ready that time. Let me put my armor on, and we'll try that again!

quests.name: Third Time's A Charm
quests.description: I'm not giving up! I always seem to do better with a scythe… I'm dropping this practice sword and trading it out for something longer!

quests.name: Nulgath's Recognition (Badge Quest)
quests.description: (gives Character Page badge) Fiends will not answer to anyone but Nulgath or his most trusted Generals… unless they become corrupted. Master received word that one of his DreadFiends in /originul is considering switching sides. Destroy him, and Master will reward you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Adimogde (Pet) in your inventory.

quests.name: 99th Birthday
quests.description: We're tasked with guarding the shore from the Dragon's army, but the Yokai are causing a disturbance. It seems these Tsukumogami recently began to move, and are acting out because they were left outside. We'll quell them, and make sure they won't cause a fire.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pearl of my Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Red and Blue
quests.description: The situation on land is beginning to escalate. Haku Village is being harassed by the Mountain Oni - Yokai that revel in wanton death and destruction. Slay the Oni, and find Haruki. He is of Oni blood, and may know why his brethren are here despite the presence of the Isles' warriors.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pearl of my Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cold Sunshower
quests.description: I shouldn't have let my Granddaughter and Baoyu leave so quickly. The Yokai are acting suspiciously. It must have something to do with the Dragon's return. I heard that Yue found a Memo that Baoyu left behind. Read that Memo and capture the Tsukumogami. I have a hunch.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pearl of my Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Inari Boom
quests.description: Confront all the villagers spreading rumors about the Great Yokai Spirit. I'll dispel the sorcery those Fox Spies are using to disguise their ears and tails. We need to reveal their schemes before they whip Haku Village into a frenzy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pearl of my Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cui Niao
quests.description: I've received a report that a man washed up on the beach, and that he's being attacked by draconic sea creatures. The locals call them Nagami, but they could be aquatic dragons from Zakhvatchik's army. Quickly, save that man from the so-called Nagami, and find out where he's from.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pearl of my Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: King Sojobo
quests.description: The Yokai are working with the Dragons. Even if they are at odds with the people of the Isles, it's demoralizing to see them join with a monster that wants to turn our home into a fiery wasteland. Please rid the village of Fox Spies and Nagami, and drive off the Dai Tengu before it strikes again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Divine Derision ' quest.

quests.name: Swab the Deck
quests.description: Dat blasted Bounty Hunter was always so short sighted. He disabled the main production line, but ne'er bothered t' destroy the maintenance droids! It seems they 'ave brought the factory back t' an operational status. Which means we'll 'ave t' swab the deck 'n take care of the new security.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bring Them In ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Raise the Sails
quests.description: Ye make a great distraction! While security was focused on ye, I slipped by 'n scouted the place out. I 'ave a hunch as t' where the treasure be. We be lookin' fer the plans t' a droid prototype dat ne'er formally began production. Where better t' stash 'em than the Research 'n Development Division! The problem be the division be without power 'n the door can't be moved. Get me the security key from one o' the Bodyguard Droids 'n we can restore power from the control cabin.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bring Them In ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Onward!
quests.description: I can hear the credits pourin' into me hands as we speak. Get t' the control cabin 'n insert the security key t' restore the power, 'n be careful o' the bodyguard droids dat be monitorin' the panel!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bring Them In ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Batten Down the Hatches
quests.description: Good news! We found the plans. Bad news. Our intelligence was wrong about the prototype ne'er bein' produced. Ye'll 'ave t' take dat thing down in order t' snag the plans!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bring Them In ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Droid Astern
quests.description: I knew 'twas too good t' be true, dat Obliterator Droid be standin' back up! Get back in thar 'n show it wha' ye're made o'!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Batten Down the Hatches ' quest.

quests.name: Droid Astern (Legend)
quests.description: I knew 'twas too good t' be true, dat Obliterator Droid be standin' back up! Get back in thar 'n show it wha' ye're made o'!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Batten Down the Hatches ' quest.

quests.name: Take to the Skies
quests.description: One can never tell where an owl will strike. They cling the treetops but on just as ferocious on the forest floor. Hop from branch to branch in hope of surveying the entire Dragon Den.

quests.name: Ready to Pounce
quests.description: If a tree falls in a forest and nobody's around, an owl still hears it. Gather up extra earlobes from the Cave Creepers and I'll construct quite the hearing device. This way you can hear talk about Rivensylth's location same as your chaotic spirit animal.

quests.name: What a Hoot
quests.description: The combined might of the Earth Titan's forces will surely overpower you if you face them alone. I've laced these tree-traps with an almost irresistible hypnotic honey, lay enough around Dragon's Den and you may stand a chance.

quests.name: Shroom Spreading
quests.description: While you were galavanting off placed tree-traps I witnessed a valuable trait of the Dragon Den mushroom. After a Draklet bumped into the shroom's head, a little powder erupted and the Draklet started going crazy. Maybe we can use this mushroom defense mechanism to our advantage.

quests.name: Protect the Nest
quests.description: At the rate of our progress through the lands, I fear an offensive from the creatures around there. Tap into the sap trees around here and gather some straw from the Grizzly Bear in pines so we can improve our defenses.

quests.name: Night in Shining Armor
quests.description: Based on the work we have done, I have come to a conclusion as to where Rivensylth is located. Instead of continuing out sly and crafty approach, I just want you to clear the path to where I'm positive the dragon be located. Don't show any mercy.

quests.name: Finding Rivensylth
quests.description: Our work has brought us far. Go forward and locate the stone that will summon Rivensylth. She has aged since Nevanna first found her egg.

quests.name: Zero Tolerance for Nature
quests.description: Rivensylth must be freed, and Avada must be defeated.

quests.name: Story Time (Farming Quest)
quests.description: Your work here is done, but you're always welcome to stay and learn more about our culture. Recover 3 stolen storybooks and you might learn something.

quests.name: Soul Searching
quests.description: The Underworld Souls linger in these dark depths, currently awaiting judgment. They need your help to find their final resting place. Help 8 Underworld Souls achieve enlightenment and I will give you a Golden Bough that will open the chambers to the Guilty Joys.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Fotia's Quest .

quests.name: Chamber of Grief
quests.description: Are you ready to defeat the first Guilty Joy? Enter the Chamber of Grief and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy. Return to me once you have completed your mission.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chamber of Anxiety
quests.description: Anxiously awaiting victory against the second Guilty Joy? Enter the Chamber of Anxiety and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chamber of Disease
quests.description: Can you defeat the third Guilty Joy? Enter the Chamber of Disease and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chamber of Old Age
quests.description: Old Age haunts us all. Can you defeat the fourth Guilty Joy? Enter the Chamber of Old Age and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chamber of Fear
quests.description: There is nothing to fear but Fear itself. Enter the Chamber of the Fear and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chamber of Hunger
quests.description: Hungry for a challenge? Enter the Chamber of Hunger and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chamber of Death
quests.description: The next Guilty Joy is dying to meet you. Enter the Chamber of Death and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chamber of Agony
quests.description: You have almost defeated all the Guilty Joys… and now you must defeat the next Guilty Joy. Enter the Chamber of Agony and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chamber of Sleep
quests.description: This is not time to rest! Enter the Chamber of Sleep and defeat the monstrous personification of this final Guilty Joy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: IMPressive
quests.description: These lands are infested with Underworld Imps. Scout these parts and defeat every Underworld Imp that crosses your path. Return to me when you retrieve 6 Underworld Imp Fangs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Charon's Quests .

quests.name: The Raven's Loss
quests.description: In the Vale of Mourning, souls are doomed to an eternity of sorrow, reflecting their sad mortal life. Perhaps you could influence the Mourners' afterlife if you shared a bit of happiness? Collect 8 Asphodel Flowers from the Ravens and return them to me once you have finished your mission.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Power of Flowers
quests.description: Thanks to Flitterifie and rickyb20.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Previously called "A Bouquet of Blessing" and before "The Power of Flowers" .

quests.name: The Time for Judgment
quests.description: You have proven yourself to me. But now you must prove yourself to the 3 Dishonorable Judges of the Underworld! Head past the Vale of Mourning to the Plane of Judgment and await your trial. Good luck.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Judged on Performance
quests.description: Prove your worth to Judge Rhadamanthys! Show him how mighty of a hero or villain you truly are!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Judged on Undead Legion Standards
quests.description: Prove your worth to Judge Minos! Show him how closely you adhere to Dage's Undead Legion Standards.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Judged on Allegiance to Dage
quests.description: The Final Judgment is now! Prove your worth to Judge Aeacus by showing him your allegiance to Dage the Dark Lord. Brute strength will conquer all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Challenged Allegiance to Dage
quests.description: The Final Judgment is now! Prove your worth to Judge Aeacus by showing him your allegiance to Dage the Dark Lord. Brute strength will conquer all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defend Against the Scorned
quests.description: Scorn has been here, and changed the allegiance of the Blade Masters. Take out 10 of them to clear your path to Dage's Throne room.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Judged on Allegiance to Dage ' quest.

quests.name: The Key to Discovery
quests.description: With Protocol 333 in place, you'll need to discover the hidden path to Dage's Throne room. The first step to that is finding the Key you'll need. The Seneschal's Assistant will have more information for you… if you can find him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Judged on Allegiance to Dage ' quest.

quests.name: Locate the Compass Stone
quests.description: If you're going to put together the pieces of the map you need to find the rest of your way through the palace, first you'll need the Compass Stone. Pieces have been hidden in the Palace (and at least one has been stolen by a monsteR).
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Judged on Allegiance to Dage ' quest.

quests.name: Create the Dark Fortress Map
quests.description: to create the Dark Fortress Map, you'll need to merge the Compass Stone with the 3 Map Pieces you recovered. Do that, and you'll be able to continue on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Judged on Allegiance to Dage ' quest.

quests.name: Quest for the Room of Rune-ation
quests.description: Hunt through the Fortress to find one of the symbols on the map; it will lead you to the Room of Rune-ation. Once inside, take the rune you find there. You'll need it for what comes next.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Judged on Allegiance to Dage ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Underworld Guardian
quests.description: All that stands between you and Dage the Evil is a giant, 3-headed, VERY angry, enchanted ragebeast. Defeat Grrberus, Guardian of the Underworld, to pass beyond.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Judged on Allegiance to Dage ' quest.

quests.name: The First Map Piece
quests.description: One of the map pieces is always entrusted to a DoomKnight, but Scorn has enchanted them. Recover it, quickly - I can feel her rage rising!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Judged on Allegiance to Dage ' quest.

quests.name: The Second Map Piece
quests.description: One of the map pieces if always entrusted to a member of the Undead Infantry, but Scorn has enchanted them, too. She must have been planning this for ages… I fear what else she has in store for us!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Judged on Allegiance to Dage ' quest.

quests.name: The Final Map Piece
quests.description: One of the map pieces is always entrusted to an Undead Legend, but Scorn has enchanted them. It is the final piece of the map you need in order to unlock the next part of your journey!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Judged on Allegiance to Dage ' quest.

quests.name: Scorn the Defenders
quests.description: It looks like Scorn has left some surprise in your path - take out the Scorned Knights, Twisted Warriors, and Leeched Legends to reach Dage the Evil!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Judged on Allegiance to Dage ' quest.

quests.name: Corrupted DoomKnights
quests.description: The Legion DoomKnights in Dage's Fortress have been corrupted! Take out 7 of them to return them to the Darkness so they cannot infect the rest of Dage's minions.

quests.name: Broken Blades and Backs
quests.description: Whatever is corrupting the minions of the Undead Legion have taken over the Undead Infantry, as well1 Bring me back 7 Broken Blades to shows that you've cleared out the threat they pose.

quests.name: Sigils of the Dark One
quests.description: The Undead Legends are some of Dage's finest warriors. They are entrusted to carry his seals of approval and the sigils that mark a warrior worth recruiting. Recover 7 of the sigils and I will reward you well!

quests.name: AFK Quest
quests.description: *No description*
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Gore-Made for This ' quest. Notes:

items.name: YOU... DID... NOTHING! Character Page Badge

quests.name: Interview the Troops
quests.description: Now that I know you can be trusted, you have work to do for the Silent Sentinels. Go around the Tower and talk to the troops. See if you can find any clue about who the traitor is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Stone Cold Monster ' quest.

quests.name: The Drop Spot
quests.description: From what the other others said, Baxter has a drop spot somewhere inside the tower. The trooper overhead him talking about a Guardian Blade. Check every sword hanging in the tower for Baxter's drop spot. If we can find it then it might help us track him down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Spider's Gem
quests.description: It seems that you need a rare Spider Gem to activate the teleporter. Check the Spiders in Eastern Greenguard forest. the Spider Gems are rare but you may find one on them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Enemies on the Other Side
quests.description: Whatever you find on the other side of that portal will be guarded. Capture as many of the enemy as you can and bring them back here for questioning. The upstairs Teleporter is waiting for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get Some Answers
quests.description: Whoever trained those Strange Knights trained them well. They haven't said a word. Maybe you'll have more luck getting them to talk. We've rigged the Teleporter to take you to a hidden area of the tower. Enter the Teleporter and get some answers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Recovery of Stolen Goods
quests.description: While the Silent Sentinels take a look at the Strange Knights construction, you should head back through the Teleporter to the cavern. Take back as many of the supplies as you can. Report to me when you're done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Face the Traitor!
quests.description: It appears that the Strange Knights bore the mark of a group called the Jus Divinum. Our only hope of learning more is bringing the traitor Baxter back alive. Head to the cavern one last time and defeat Baxter! Be careful, he is a trained Guardian.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Agitated Orb Quest
quests.description: Agitated Orbs need to eat, too, you know. Bring me 5 irradiated socks from the monsters in the forge and I'll tell you what Cysero's Secret REALLY is. I'm nice like that

quests.name: 2nd Agitated Orb Quest
quests.description: Agitated Orbs don't exist on irridated socks alone, y'know. All that wool n' stuff makes us thirsty! Bring me 10 Moglinberries from the shrubs in the /cellar and this time I PROMISE I'll tell you what Cysero's Secret REALLY is. Really. Honest.

quests.name: Ritual Greed
quests.description: The disgraced warrior saw his punishment coming, and has corrupted his former brothers in arms to distract us. Please free the Pesugihan Boar from the sway of this dark sorcery!

quests.name: Dark Dance
quests.description: The disgraced warrior is cornered at the end of the hall! Defeat and expel him from Wentira! Be wary- he has dabbled in Santet, a form of dark sorcery that causes pain and death. Bring me his spear as proof that you have completed your test.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Boarish Audacity
quests.description: That disgraced warrior is a persistent one! I had hoped he would learn from the shame of being made to leave Wentira, but he keeps returning with more corrupted warriors. I must ask that you expel them again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Pirate Collection Badge
quests.description: I be needin' more purple and greens in my diet. Bring me a Chaos Kelp Salad. Ye'll find it if you slay enough of the Chaos Kelp in /LagunaBeach.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Ahoyrion Quest Pet in your inventory.

items.name: Chaos Pirate Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Dog Days
quests.description: I first began to notice my father acting oddly when he sent his most loyal ninja and samurai to go ransack a village who could not pay their taxes after he raised them unreasonably high. My father would never cause his people that kind of hardship. Go to Hachiko Tower in town (to the right from here) and question 5 ninja and 5 samurai then return to me with their answers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Dragonkoi Tournament .

quests.name: Faceless Threat
quests.description: You have to defeat those faceless Nopperabo yokai, and find out what they have done with the soldiers that they have replaced! Search Hachiko Tower and find the Samurai Nopperabo for clues. Return to me when you find something.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Zodiac Puzzle Key
quests.description: You may have noticed that the roof is locked. That's my fault. I used to go play on the roof as a child so my father had it locked and had the Zodiac Puzzle Key split into 4 pieces. Search the Ninja Nopperabo and Samurai Nopperabo until you find all 4 pieces of the Puzzle Key, then return to me with the 4 pieces! Look at the walls, and in front of the doors to get clues as to which rooms you need to enter for the pieces. The Ninja Nopperabo and Samurai Nopperabo inside the rooms will have the keys - the ones in the halls are there to slow down your quest. Hurry, our soldiers are in danger!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rescue!
quests.description: There, the key is finished. Hurry, our soldiers must be waiting for you on the roof. Take care, hero… if they could have escaped by now then they would have. Something is keeping a close eye on them up there and whatever it is, it won't be happy to see you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Previously called "DT" .

quests.name: Jinmenju Tree
quests.description: Since my father is under the control of the Chaos Shogun… then that means other Yokai have probably fallen under the same spell. This must be stopped! Head north through the bamboo forest to the First Shrine of Jinmenju, the Tree with human-faced fruit, and search for any clues. Return to me if you find anything that may be of importance.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rescue! ' quest.

quests.name: Yokai Bandits
quests.description: Without its fruit, the Jinmenju Tree will surely die, throwing the lifecycle of all Yokai off balance, ending in biological disaster. And since my Father is under the control of the Chaos Shogun, it will be up to you to find the Jinmenju Fruit… and the culprit. Go back through the bamboo forest and "interrogate" any suspicious Yokai. Return to me when you find the Jinmenju Fruit or any valuable information.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Fiery Fiend
quests.description: Hero, take this Paper Talisman with you. It will not only bring you good luck, but it will also help protect you against the Yokai responsible for hoarding all of the Jinmenju Fruit. The culprit will be most powerful, and a tough brute to kill at that. I believe Wanyudo — also known as the SoulTaker — is the one you are looking for. Be careful when around this fiery fiend.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dumpster Diving
quests.description: The Tsukumo-Gami have never caused much trouble—until now. The Chaos Shogun must have put a spell on these Yokai, making them even more enraged about being tossed out in the first place. Rummage through these lands and pay tribute to the Tsukumo-Gami Shrine. Return to me once you have done so.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Fiery Fiend ' quest.

quests.name: Reduce, Respawn, Recycle
quests.description: The best way to show the Tsukumo-Gami that Humans still care is to recycle every one of them! It's a dirty job, but somebody has to do it. Go back through the junkyard and collect a few of each wild Tsukumo-Gami. After doing so, we can clean them up and resell them for a nominal fee! I'm sure this will make the Tsukumo-Gami feel important once more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Hunt for the Hag
quests.description: Did you happen to run across Onibaba in your travels? Onibaba is the Mountain Hag who lives in these parts. She is extremely hostile and vicious, even without the Chaos Shogun's influence (which has undoubtedly made her even more crazed). The only way to ensure a safe haven for the Tsukumo-Gami is to defeat the Mountain Hag. Bring me back a Fresh Liver that will let me know of your success… and don't try to remove yours in exchange.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Big Bad Yokai
quests.description: Are you up for a challenge, Hero? The only way to ensure a safe haven for the friendly Yokai—and the entire population of Akiba—is to hunt down the 3 toughest Yokai on the Island: the DaiTengu, SoulTaker, and Onibaba. Bring back a Talisman from each battle, proving your success, and I shall award you royally. This mission is only suitable for a few select Members. I wish you the best of luck.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Hunt for the Hag ' quest.

quests.name: Potion Pandamonium
quests.description: Are you up for another challenge? I learned about a potion that can turn a person into a panda. It might sound weird, BUT pandas are incredibly strong. It might be useful for you in your fight against chaos. We'll need some essence from the Bamboo Wisps in /Bamboo, some fur from an Ice Bear in /BattlegroundB - since pandas are pretty hard to find around Lore, and a bit of guidance from one of the captured witches in /Citadel, since I'll need some experienced help with making sure nothing goes wrong with the potion.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Hunt for the Hag ' quest.

quests.name: Su-she
quests.description: Have you ever had sushi, Hero? Well let me tell you—it's delicious! Kappa Maki rolls are my favorite food, and it just so happens that the Yokai here have all the ingredients needed to make some. The only problem is… I don't remember the recipe! Talk to the Kappa and Funa-yurei near the river and see if they will help you out. They might not give the recipe up without a fight, so prepare yourself ahead of time!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Hunt for the Hag ' quest.

quests.name: Kappa Cuisine
quests.description: Now that we have the recipe, we need to gather the ingredients before perfecting the perfect Kappa Maki roll. Gather the following ingredients from the local Yokai: 6 Dried Nori Leafs, 1 Fresh Cucumber, and 3 Bundles of Sumeshi. Head on over to the Funa-yurei Shrine when you have collected everything. There you can make a Kappa Maki sushi roll! Come back to me when you're finished so we can "sample" your hard work!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hisssssy Fit
quests.description: Hero, there is a horrible creature that haunts the riverbed—a threat much worse than the Kappa and Funa-yurei combined. Slithering just beneath the water's surface is a half snake, half woman known as Nure Onna. She has haunted the delta for centuries, preying on everything which crosses her path. Please, confront the Nure Onna and defeat her so that no one else falls victim to her ruthless motives. Bring me back a patch of the Nure Snake Skin to prove that the river is safe once again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat O-dokuro
quests.description: O-dokuro must be defeated or the rift cannot be closed! Go defeat O-dokuro!
quests.requirements_note: Must have defeated Neko Mata (Monster) in Yokai Graveyard . Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Lost Celebration Items
quests.description: Someone broke into our warehouse and stole the items for our new year celebration. We sent a guard to Battleon to retrieve the items. Please help him find them. If you bring them back here, I may even give you one of the red envelopes used in our festivities for good fortune. These envelopes are actually worth money if you take them to Obaasan.

quests.name: Small Red Envelope
quests.description: This is a good envelope, I'll reward you with 300 gold.

quests.name: Medium Red Envelope
quests.description: This is a good envelope, I'll reward you with 600 gold.

quests.name: Large Red Envelope
quests.description: Wow, you are a very lucky person. I'll reward you with 1200 gold.

quests.name: Crafting the Emblem of Longevity
quests.description: The Black Tortoise's spirit is in danger! The only way to free him is by obtaining the Emblem of Longevity. Because the Tortoise represents the north and winter, you mus travel to the Frozen Northlands in order to create this sacred emblem. Collect Icy Amulets from the Snow Golems and Water Amulets from the Frostwyrm Riders if you hope to rescue the embodiment of longevity. Hurry back when you have these items so I can create the Emblem for you!

quests.name: The Black Tortoise's Spirit
quests.description: You have the Emblem of Longevity, right? Now is the time! Follow my directions to the Black Tortoise's home and free him of the chaorrupted Nian spirit!
quests.requirements_note: Must own Emblem of Longevity .

quests.name: Crafting the Emblem of Righteousness
quests.description: The White Tiger's spirit is in danger! The only way to free him is by obtaining the Emblem of Righteousness. Because the Tiger represents the west, autumn, and metal, you must journey into Vasalkar's Lair to create this sacred emblem. You must gather Metl Amulets from Bronze Draconians and Wind Amulets from the Golden Draconians if you hope to rescue the embodiment of righteousness and observation. Hurry back when you have these items so i can create the Emblem for you!

quests.name: The White Tiger's Spirit
quests.description: You have the Emblem of Righteousness, right? Now is the time! Follow my directions to the White Tiger's home and free him of the chaorrupted Nian spirit!
quests.requirements_note: Must own Emblem of Righteousness .

quests.name: Crafting the Emblem of Knowledge
quests.description: The Red Bird's spirit is in danger! The only way to free him is by obtaining the Emblem of Knowledge. The Red Bird is a symbolic representation of south, summer, and fire. You mus travel deep within Mount Mafic to create this sacred emblem. Collect Fiery Amulets from the Living Fires and Red Amulets from the Scoria Serpents if you hope to rescue the embodiment of knowledge. Hurry back when you have these items so I can create the Emblem for you!

quests.name: The Red Bird's Spirit
quests.description: You have the Emblem of Knowledge, right? Now is the time! Follow my directions to the Red Bird's home and free him of the chaorrupted Nian spirit!
quests.requirements_note: Must own Emblem of Knowledge .

quests.name: Crafting the Emblem of Good Luck
quests.description: The Blue Dragon's spirit is in danger! But you need the Emblem of Good Luck before his spirit can be free! As the guardian of the easr and representing spring, you must travel to the Yokai River so that you can create this sacred emblem. Bring back Aqua Amulets from the blue Kappa Ninjas and Amulets of Rain from that wretched Nure Onna if you hope to save the embodiment of good luck and fortune.

quests.name: The Blue Dragon's Spirit
quests.description: In order to free the great Blue Dragon's spirit, you need to have not just Emblem of Good Luck, but the others as well: Longevity. Righteousness, and Knowledge. Only when you have these four Emblems can you finally free the Blue Dragon from the clutches of the chaorrupted Nian spirit! Please hurry!
quests.requirements_note: Must own Emblem of Good Luck , Emblem of Longevity , Emblem of Righteousness , and Emblem of Knowledge .

quests.name: Red Envelope Hunt
quests.description: I hid a lucky red envelope inside one of the lanterns. There's a *small* chance you'll find one when you break them open. If you do, bring it to me and I'll reward you with one of the pieces of the Lusè gongji armor set!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Too Hot to Handle? ' quest.

quests.name: Decoration Preparation
quests.description: You're just in time to help us gather the decorations. The Yokai are notorious for stealing them each year. You should be able to recover the colored paper from the Tsukumo-Gami and Onibaba in the Junkyard.

quests.name: Tanabata Tree of Wishes
quests.description: The Star Festival is also called Tanabata, and one of our most beautiful decorations are the Tanabata trees. Gather bamboo poles from the /bamboo forest, and if you see any whisps, bring them, too. They will light the lanterns.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Write a Wish Upon a Star
quests.description: This year feels… special. I want to write seven wishes, to make sure my desires rise straight to the sky. In their excitement, my maids did not refill my inkwell. You should be able to get some from Ninja Nopperabo in the Hachiko Hotel. Hurry, please, there is much left to do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Festival of Stars
quests.description: The wishes are written. It's time to finish decorating! Place the Tanabata trees around town, hang the decorations, and set up the feast tables.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The First Wish
quests.description: Talk with Sora to Hoshi, the Dark Chronomancer, and headmistress of DragonRune Hall, where young mages learn about mana manipulation and spell-crafting. The first of my seven wishes is there. She may be able to help us locate the rest of them, as well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Second Wish
quests.description: The second wish is located on Beleen's Dream Island. Talk to Sir Racha there. He should be able to help you locate it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Third Wish
quests.description: The third wish is located in the Cave of Wanders. Talk to Zhoom, the Master Ranger, there. He should be able to help you locate it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Fourth Wish
quests.description: The fourth wish is located in the Temple of the Sisterhood of Dishpan Hands. Talk to Cleric Joy. She should be able to help you locate it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Fifth Wish
quests.description: The fifth wish is located in the SkyTower Aegis. Talk to Ithuriel, the Celestial Realm Messenger, there. He should be able to help you locate it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Sixth Wish
quests.description: The sixth wish is located in the Librarium. Talk to Maya, the LoreMaster, there. She should be able to help you locate it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Seventh Wish
quests.description: The seventh wish is located in Vasalkar's Lair. Talk to Galanoth, the DragonSlayer, there. He should be able to help you locate it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clear Water to Clear Skies
quests.description: Before we can send our 1,000 cranes up into the sky, we must clear out the Funa-Yurei and Kappa Ninja cluttering up the river. The vengeful ghosts and yokai would not want to see anyone happy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dye-ing to Reunite ' quest. Note: These quests cannot accessed after completing the ' Slay Uji No Hashihime ' quest.

quests.name: 1,000 Cranes to 1,000 Wishes
quests.description: Villagers and members of the court are all along the river, placing cranes. Please, my friend, take some and put them into the river, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dye-ing to Reunite ' quest. Note: These quests cannot accessed after completing the ' Slay Uji No Hashihime ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Star Festival Gift
quests.description: Through the festival is over, there are still so many wishes left to make and hopes to nourish. Bring me light from the Fallen Stars and I will use it to make you a special gift.

quests.name: Shadow Medals
quests.description: Jaaku's samurai attack the gates of Akiba! We must fight them back. Bring me the medals they carry so I can keep track of how many we have slain.

quests.name: We Need Supplies
quests.description: I can heal our wounded allies with a salve, but I will need some reagents. Bring me the spores from the Reishi in the forest, and some pollen from the Kijimuna.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Help the Samurai
quests.description: Come with me into the field, and help me heal our wounded samurai. Focus first on those who have already fallen. They need our help the most.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Arrows for Archers
quests.description: Our archers are running low on arrows! Jaaku's samurai have been harvesting the arrows from their fallen. Fight them, and get them back!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when War Meter reached 25%.

quests.name: Fix the Arrows
quests.description: Some of the arrows you brought back had broken shafts. If you bring me some slender stalks from the Bamboo Treants in the forest nearby, we can use them to craft new ones.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when War Meter reached 25%.

quests.name: Empowered Shadow Medallions
quests.description: I sense that some of Jaaku's Shadow samurai have been empowered… by something dark. Bring me their empowered medallions. I may be able to discern what is affecting Jaaku and his men if I study them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when War Meter reached 50%.

quests.name: Advice from the Spirits
quests.description: The energy emanating from these medallions is so strange. I will need to ask the spirits for advice. Walk with me, and let's talk with the ancestral spirits of Yokai. We will find most of them in the woods, away from the fighting.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Fight the Shadows
quests.description: To fight shadow, we need light. I can use the glowing caps of the Reishi to empower my own abilities. Bring me as many as you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when War Meter reached 75%.

quests.name: Bamboo for Tea
quests.description: Did you know bamboo is restorative, both physically and spiritually? If I had some bamboo leaf tea, I really think that would help me stay centered while I'm working with those glow caps. Would you mind bringing me a few leaves to brew?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when War Meter reached 75%.

quests.name: Defeat the Beast
quests.description: Jaaku hid behind an army, and now he hides behind that beast! It must be what is empowering him - what the spirits sensed. If we slay it. he will no longer pose a threat, and will be swiftly dealt with. We must strike now!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when War Meter reached 100%.

quests.name: Get the Medallions
quests.description: Jaaku has left, but some of his samurai still remain. We must drive them out. Bring me their medallions when you defeat them, and I will reward you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when War Meter reached 100%.

quests.name: Tea for Me
quests.description: If we're to go after Jaaku and his army, we will need to be prepared. Bring me some Reishi caps to empower my light magic, some Kijimuna pollen to aid with healing… and some bamboo leaves so I can have my tea and stay calm through all of this crap.
