quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when War Meter reached 100%.

quests.name: Get Rid of Kame
quests.description: What a little jerk! I really don't want to fight him, but our time is short. We must defeat Jaaku, and he is standing in our way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Beast ' quest.

quests.name: For the Road
quests.description: It's a long way to Jaaku's fortress, and we'll need some food for the road! Gather some Moglinberries from the nearby bushes, and some Reishi Caps from the local fungus.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Battle for the Shinrin Do ' quest.

quests.name: Goryuken
quests.description: Whenever this Onryo appears, all of these Goryo come it! That is what Koro has told us. Banish as many as you can find, so that Koro's village can have a respite from them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Burn the Bones ' quest.

quests.name: Feel the Heat
quests.description: Now, we must focus on the Onryo itself. If we are going to confront it, we'll need to protect ourselves from its icy attacks. If you bring me the ingredients,l can make a potion that will ward off the chill. I'll need some Spectral Heat from the Kosenjobi, and a jar of Wasabi from Kyo.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Burn the Bones ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get Some Fur
quests.description: I've made a paste from the wasabi and the spectral heat you brought me. I just need something to maintain it… something that is of both the physical world and the Yokai. Some tufts of fur from the Abumi Guchi should do nicely. We can soak it in the wasabi paste, and wear it around our necks.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Burn the Bones ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Howl-ing For You!
quests.description: Now that we're protected, we can confront the Onryo. He seems to have gone back into hiding, though his Goryo still attack the village. But I know a way to make him show himself! First, defeat the Inugami and bring me its howl. This will lead us to where he hides.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Burn the Bones ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eyes on the Prize
quests.description: The Inugami's howl will be useless if we cannot see into the spirit world. Luckily, I have a solution for that, too! Gather some of the Ghost Flowers that grow around the village. I will also need 4 intact Spirit Eyes, from any of the local Yokai - two for each of us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Burn the Bones ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reveal the Trail
quests.description: I've made an incense from the Ghost Flowers and the Spirit Eyes you brought me. It will let us see pieces of the spirit world otherwise hidden to us. Light it, and then follow the trail it leaves.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Burn the Bones ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the Onryo
quests.description: This Onryo's pain and sorrow breaks my heart, but our first duty is to the people of this valley. We must protect them. And that means we must destroy this ghost.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Burn the Bones ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Calm the Spirits
quests.description: We now know that my light powers can calm restless spirits. And there are so many restless spirits here! If you fight them just enough to weaken them, they will be more susceptible to my healing. It may not work on all of them, but it is still worth it to try.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Onryo ' quest.

quests.name: Disarm the Samurai
quests.description: The fortress is guarded by many of Jaaku's Shadow Samurai. Knock them out and take their weapons so that they no longer pose a threat to us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Onryo ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Throne Room
quests.description: Jaaku's throne room is at the top part of the fortress. Scout inside the first floor and try to find a way up.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Onryo ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get to the Roof
quests.description: Quickly! We must get up to the roof and try to calm him down! I'll meet you up there
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Onryo ' quest. | Must have completed the ' A Head has Woken '. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find Jaaku!
quests.description: We cannot let them get away! Grapple onto Orochi's back, and fight your way to Jaaku.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Onryo ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat Jaaku!
quests.description: This has to end now, one way or the other. Defeat Jaaku and save Yokai!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Onryo ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Shake a Tailfeather
quests.description: I can make a special incense that will take us into Zhu's mind; into whatever dream he is having. From there, we can help him find his way out. First, bring me a few of the longest tail feathers you can find - there are some red chickens nearby that have nice ones. I will use those for the sticks. You can find them behind Kunoichi's shop.

quests.name: Get Incensed
quests.description: Now, I need the proper fragrance. This recipe requires Lingzhi Oil, which can be harvested from the Lingzhi nearby. Bring me some.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Smell that Smell
quests.description: Now, light the incense on fire, and we will be transported into Zhu's dream… into his mind.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Decorations - Paper Lanterns
quests.description: What's a festival without decorations? The Frostvale moglins have added their own flair, but we need to add ours, too! Unfortunately, our supply of paper lanterns is running low. If you look in the /junkyard, you might be able to find some that others have thrown away… though they might not come willingly!

quests.name: Decorations - Light Them Up
quests.description: Great! Now, obviously we need to light them, but, well… candles tend to set things on fire. There are certain yokai who dwell in a dark grove. They have a lovely blue flame which does not actually burn. Maybe you can convince some of them to help us out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Decorations - Streamers
quests.description: I had streamers set up, but those darn turtle-shelled ninjas ran back to their boat with all of them! I guess they thought they'd make good headbands or something. Please help me get them back before they sail away with them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Time to Decorate
quests.description: Well, I think we have everything we need. Now we can decorate! Help me make sure the whole city looks beautiful!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Nekomimi's Gift
quests.description: Maybe you can help me gather some gifts for my friends? Nekomimi really loves the sound of dorei bells. Sometimes I hear a soft tinkling sound while I'm near the Yokai graveyard, like little ghostly bells. Perhaps you could find something for her there?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mitsu Bishi's Gift
quests.description: Mitsu Bishi's favorite drinking set was recently broken, and I'd like to find him a new one. A nice bamboo set, perhaps - four cups and a carafe. That would be much sturdier than pottery, don't you think? I'm not sure where you would find such a thing, but perhaps creatures in a place somewhere with a lot of bamboo would know.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kunoichi's Gift
quests.description: Kunoichi loves good sushi, and fishwing sashimi is her favorite! We have plenty of rice and vinegar, but we've run out of fishwing filets. Could you get me some? We want them to stay fresh, so head to the dock, but beware -- pirates were spotted in the area.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kage's Gift
quests.description: Kage loves tea. There is one that he particularly likes, but it's hard to find. I've only ever seen it served in hotels, and it seems to be very popular with ninja.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dinner Time
quests.description: Before everyone gets here, we're going to need to make sure we can feed them. I'm thinking seafood.. but something sizeable. A nice, big seafood steak. A meal fit for a shark, if you will.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fireworks
quests.description: No festival is complete without fireworks! In Akiba, we make fireworks from a particular kind of Yokai energy - a kind that only comes from the undead. The bigger the skeleton, the bigger the boom. And we're going to need something ENORMOUS for this celebration.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Search for Gifts
quests.description: Hello, my friend! I've done something that I hope you'll thing is a lot of fun. I've wrapped up a bunch of secret gifts and hidden them on monsters here in town and in /hachiko, /bamboo and /yokaiboat. Find some and bring them back to me, and we'll see what's inside!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Grime Time
quests.description: These Hyosubei that have come here with Shimazu are fouling our families' graves. Kill them, and wash off the grime they've left behind.

quests.name: Stolen Offerings
quests.description: These Wandering Onryo have stolen the offerings people left on their families' graves. Please get them back, and replace them on the graves they were stolen from.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Summoning
quests.description: We've cleaned up the graveyard, but Shimazu has still not shown his face. These yokai carry gold coins with them that they use to summon him into the living world. Collect enough and we might be able to do the same.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the Demon
quests.description: It worked - he's here! Please, help me defeat Shimazu so that our graveyard will be free of these spirits!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Token of My Appreciation
quests.description: I see there are still few stray spirits wandering the graveyard. Defeat them and bring me the coins they carry, and I'll give you a nice reward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gather Offerings
quests.description: Mahou is old and temperamental. If we want him to listen to us, it will help to bring him a gift. Traditionally, an offering of white blossoms, juicy cherries, and fresh truffles would be welcome. The truffles you'll get from wandering Reishi. The rest you can pick from the trees.

quests.name: Deliver the Gift
quests.description: Bring our gift to Mahou. You will find him at his house, on top of the hill to the west.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find Bingwen
quests.description: There's a local musician named Bingwen who claims he can use his magic pipes to get rid of vermin. He lives in a cottage just outside of town. Please, find him and ask for his help!

quests.name: Catch Some Rats
quests.description: What a mess! I don't even know where to start. See if you can catch some of these little rats, maybe, while I try to get my head on straight again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the the ' Meet me at the Palace ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Make Some Traps
quests.description: They're really hard to catch, aren't they? Maybe we need to try trapping them instead. Rats eat… eggs, right? You'll find some Red Chickens near the river. Get some of their eggs, and then lay down some traps, using them as bait.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Those Rats are Mean
quests.description: We can focus on those bigger, meaner rodents now that the little ones have been handled. I don't think they're as fast, so you can just, you know, beat them up… right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: EEEEK
quests.description: Have you seen what kind of horrifying vermin we're infested with? Some of the nastiest ones have been terrorizing the poor villagers! Please, you have to rescue them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Smoke them Out
quests.description: It's time to take the palace back! That nasty Hinezumi has it locked from the inside, so we're going to have to choke him out. Bring me some spores from the wandering Lingzhi and some smoke from the Fiery Lanterns. I'm going to make a smoke bomb and toss it in the window.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Hinezumi!
quests.description: We did it! We've smoked those rodents out of my palace! Or at least forced them to open the door. Quickly, get inside and fight Hinezumi before the smoke clears!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Challenge Lu Niu
quests.description: Well, here he is, the one I was talking about earlier challenging locals to fight. Do try to not be too rough on him, will you? I don't think he knows what he's quite in for.

quests.name: The 8 Heads of Orochi
quests.description: Did you happen to collect any fallen scales from Orochi? Legend has it that a master swordsman achieved enlightenment and inner peace by slaying the 8-headed serpent thousands of times … somehow. In any case, the scales of dragons and other legendary serpents can be used for many things, including weapons and armor.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Jaaku ' quest.

quests.name: Nope-perabo
quests.description: We can't even get close to the camp without these Nopperabo foot soldiers in our way! Try to take a few out so we can get closer to the camp and see where they are holding the Etokoun!

quests.name: Intel Processor
quests.description: While we know where the camp is, we will need to figure out what kind of defences it has and the best way to get in. Interrogate some of the Yokai in the area and see if they will speak… Wait… Can Nopperabo speak without mouths?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Scout Out
quests.description: Now that we have the intel, we can safely scout the Yokai's camp. Go ahead and see if you can locate their leader and where the Etokoun is being kept. Feel free to take out any of the Yokai on your way there, but I wouldn't engage their boss just yet!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Re-info-source-ments
quests.description: The Yokai Ox Spirit noticed you scouting its camp! It is sending reinforcements to stop you from getting to the Etokoun. We have to fight off the Golden Ox Guards it is sending your way if we need to reach the Etokoun.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Yokai Ox Spirit
quests.description: The last step to getting the Etokoun in our possession, defeating the Yokai Ox Spirit! You got this!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Etokoun Captured
quests.description: The Etokoun isn't ready to be captured again! You are going to have to prove your worth to it! You are going to have to face it in combat before we can get our chance to capture it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Hungry for Oxen
quests.description: If we are keeping the Etokoun in captivity then the least we can do is feed it. There should still be some oxen lingering about, so try gathering some meat from them!

quests.name: Night Falls (Daily Bonus)
quests.description: I want to study the origins of the fallen god that the Knight of the Solstice Moon took their divinity from. Defeat the Hollow Midnight, and return a piece of it to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50.

quests.name: Dawn Breaks (Daily Bonus)
quests.description: The Priestess of the Midnight Sun won her divinity from a now fallen god. Defeat the Hollow Solstice so I can learn more about what this god used to be.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50.

quests.name: Frozen Cycle (Daily Bonus)
quests.description: At the peak of the Ascension Eclipse, you'll face the Ascended Midnight and Ascended Solstice. Defeat them, and sneak me a piece of their material shadows without the Knight or the Priestess noticing.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 80.

quests.name: Eclipse Ascension Badge
quests.description: Like the Knight and the Priestess, you too have claimed the heavens! Bring me Hollowed Remains from any of the Eclipse Ascent Dungeons, and I will reward you with a character page badge.

quests.name: All Hands Report
quests.description: The Wuji fleet sent snakes and strange humanoid ghouls to infest our ship! Ignore them for now. I need you to look for the others, and to report back about what our current situation is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Salty Roots ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Starving Ghosts
quests.description: Yue's trying to lead the passengers up the mast, but the Needle Mouths are chasing after her. None of them are combatants, so please defeat the Needle Mouths to keep them safe!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Salty Roots ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sudden Striker
quests.description: Below deck, Baoyu and his Serpent Warriors are protecting the clerics as they heal the most affected passengers. Quicksilvers, the mercury snakes that slipped into our ship, are inhibiting their efforts. Exterminate them! I'll continue to help with my purification magic.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Salty Roots ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Onmyoji Maiden
quests.description: The ship is clear of invaders! Lord Brentan had his knights dress as pirates to join our crew, and he's making a path towards the cave. We'll hide the passengers there. Talk to Brentan to get his report, and take this paper talisman from me. Place it on the cave's sacred rope.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Salty Roots ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Proper Parley
quests.description: Admiral Zheng's Imperial Warriors are on the island! Defeat and round them up! Lord Brentan will pretend to be our hostage, and you will threaten to kill him if the Wuji fleet doesn't leave us be. We'll give them a moity foine poirate showing! Ah, still not a pirate accent?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Salty Roots ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hunger Pains
quests.description: Admiral Zheng was able to break through the seal because he's my blood relative, and he even destroyed it to allow his minions in! The Needle Mouths are in the cave! They can't die, but we can break them until they can't cause more harm!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Salty Roots ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Terror-cotta Warriors
quests.description: The Wuji Imperial Warriors are rushing into the cave, and my pirate crew's having trouble holding them back. You and I are going to force them out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Salty Roots ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Indoor Fireworks
quests.description: This cave has a back exit, but we can't let the Wuji warriors follow us out. I have a last resort. Place these crates of explosives at these specific spots in the cave.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Salty Roots ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sons of Biscuit Eaters
quests.description: I hear him! The Admiral is in the caves ordering a full rush! Hold the line, ya scallywags! Show the Needle Mouths and Imperial Warriors the kind of salt yer made of!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Salty Roots ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pearl of my Heart
quests.description: Admiral Zheng has arrived, daring to take us prisoner in front of the shrine where his grandchild rests in death. We will not let him have us! My friend, we must defeat him and save the people of Yokai!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Salty Roots ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dream of the Mists
quests.description: My Great Grandfather needed some time alone with his grandson, enshrined in Takarajima's cave. He asked if you would have time to spar with him and his men. Would you humor him for a spell? It would raise their spirits.

quests.name: Tail End
quests.description: Yiren is organizing the Wuji Descendants. Two of them are waiting outside at the Mikoto Shrine. Find them, and relay his instructions. This will seal the Mikoto Shrine's mirror, and prevent Koschei from escaping. I've sent Shikigami to guard them, but they will need to be tamed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Corrupted Protector ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Thousand Hills
quests.description: Half of the seal is in place, but the other half needs your attention. Relay Yiren's instructions to Kana and Li. The Snake Shikigami with them will need to be pacified as well. They're confused, and won't follow my commands because they don't recognize me as Ai No Miko yet.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Corrupted Protector ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mount and Land and Skies
quests.description: With the seal in place, all that needs to be done is to unify the rest of the Descendants' innate magic. Shi Wa Lam and Baoyu are waiting for you to relay Yiren's instructions to them. Be on your guard. Koschei has sensed our activities, and sent her Dragonling Puppets to stop you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Corrupted Protector ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Distant Shores
quests.description: Alas, the Descendants of the Jade Ox Prince is missing. It will put more burden on the others, but I trust their strength. Yue and Ramona are waiting for you to give them Yiren's instructions. The Dark Zmey are stalking them. Stop them before Ai No Miko's relatives are harmed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Corrupted Protector ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Taizi
quests.description: The Descendant of the Jade Mouse Princess is waiting for you to relay Yiren's instructions. He is the rebellious sort, but is skilled despite his youth. The Dragonlings and Zmey are fighting him. Help Chen wipe out the last of Koschei's puppets.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Corrupted Protector ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Begrudged Oni
quests.description: We've completed as much of the ritual as we are able to. Now it's time to let Yiren know. He's stationed to the south of this cave, where the spirits of deceased Yokai begin their path to reincarnation. Cut the strings blocking the way forward, and pacify the Oni Spirits lingering nearby.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Corrupted Protector ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Linking Discord
quests.description: I've asked my Shikigami to survey the path ahead. Find him. He has gone to where his fellow spirits will drift, reincarnate, and forget about him. He'll need you to keep the Spirits from resisting the flow. Their lingering outrage will only serve to help Koschei by obstructing us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Corrupted Protector ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Yokai's Cycle
quests.description: Koschei is nearby. She has run out of puppets, but her mere presence is causing the spirits of the Realm to become frenzied. Please, pacify them. If they stray too far in the confusion, the Yokai will never be able to reincarnate.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Corrupted Protector ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kojutsu
quests.description: Ai the edge of the path to reincarnation is a guardian meant to protect the cycle of the Yokai Realm. The role is currently held by an Inugami, and Koschei's influence is causing them to lash out violently. Pacify them, so that they can herd the Yokai to their rightful place.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Corrupted Protector ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

location.name: Chairman Platinum's Evolving Environmental Art Gallery

quests.name: Glaring Errors
quests.description: Can you identify all the errors left behind in this gallery by the EbilCorp AI Blender? AI Oh No Miko has her eye on you, so best keep yours peeled.

location.name: Chairman Platinum's Evolving Environmental Art Gallery

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pull the Plug ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

items.name: Art-ificially Ebil Creator Character Page Badge

quests.name: Glorified Pest Control
quests.description: The tour of Diauhtla begins with us learning about its customs. Before this was a bustling vacation town, it was a hunter's outpost. Wreaths decorated with owl feathers and fox fur were a heartfelt gift back in the day. Because of how dangerous the wildlife was, the present signified that you wanted to protect the giftee. Part of the fun in crafting is getting the materials. You'll find foxes and owls all over the place!

quests.name: Mingling Sights
quests.description: Hanging up lights, ornaments, and wreaths is an essential Frostval activity. Usually, I provide guests with my own decorations but the wreaths you and Alina made are beautiful! May I have the honor of hanging them on the walls of the inn? And with how many you made, we can share them with the townspeople. If you head east, you'll find Lief the Cafe owner. He loves chatting and he'll love your wreaths!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sore Long Faces
quests.description: Oof, Rolith and his team are still having trouble with fixing his sled. Last I saw, his horses were galloping around the starting line. The Tundra Steeds aren't usually this ornery but they might be holding the sled crash against him. Poor Rolith always keeps his chin up when his whole team is neck deep in trouble. I think he would appreciate us rounding up his horses, and you'll get to see the view of the mountain range!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eggcellent Trade
quests.description: Oh dear, the foxes are starting up trouble again. They're mischievous little fellows, stealing the wood planks Rolith's team needs to rebuild their sled. They just want to play, or to exchange the DIY supplies for some snacks. Here, I boiled a carton of eggs. Playfight with the foxes for long enough, and they'll accept the trade. Hmm, maybe I should offer this sort of experience to other visitors.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Homemade Stars
quests.description: The racers are ready to go, and participants would like you to have the honor of lighting their torches. Those torches are able to burn so bright and be seen from the top of the mountain because they're fueled by owl feathers. We found out how flammable they were the hard way when a member of my staff got a candle too close to a wreath. So collect feathers, light the torches, and I'll be on the sidelines watching you send the racers off.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Missing Lion
quests.description: As part of our tradition, we have a lion that goes from door to door looking for lettuce that is hanging from the front of our houses and stores. The lion then eats the lettuce and scatters the leaves symbolizing a fresh start for the new year and the spread of good luck. Our lion was lion-napped and, by the foot prints left behind, it seems like Ninja Nopperabo have something to do with it. You may find Ninja Nopperabo in Hachiko's Hotel. Please get our Lion back!

quests.name: Head of Lettuce
quests.description: Besides retrieving our lion we also need to find our heads of lettuce. See, without the heads of lettuce we won't be able to bring good fortune to our homes and business, because the lion won't have anything to eat and scatter around. We know that Kappa Ninjas like to eat lettuce and, judging by the trail they left behind, they were headed to the Yokai River. Can you find 3 heads of lettuce before the Kappa have a chance to eat them?

quests.name: Bad Spirit Away
quests.description: A new year can't be complete without fireworks. The Fireworks loud noise will keep bad spirits away. Skello Kitties being as mischievous as they are, detest the sound of fireworks and, according to the trail of bones that was left behind we can assume they were the ones that took our fireworks. The Skello Kitties can be found in the Yokai Graveyard. Please find 4 fireworks and bring them back.

quests.name: Goat Gone Wild
quests.description: Something happened to all the goats and wolves! They're all purple now, and they have tentacles. I want to go home, but I'm scared they'll hurt me. Can you make it safe for me? Please?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What's That I Hear? ' quest.

quests.name: Creepy Eyes
quests.description: Those flying eyeballs can see me if I leave the bushes. Can't they? Please, make them go away!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What's That I Hear? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find My Parents
quests.description: I hope my parents are ok. Can you help me find them? My home is not too far from here. I'll meet you there!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What's That I Hear? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Drive Them Back
quests.description: We have to drive back these invaders! Most of these people can't fight, and they won't stand a chance. But they're no match for us! Kill as many Infernal Knights as you can. Come back and we'll see who got the most!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Clear the Way ' quest.

quests.name: Calm the Yokai
quests.description: The presence of these Infernal fiends is making our Yokai go crazy! Help me subdue them so they won't do any more damage.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Clear the Way ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get the Supplies
quests.description: These invaders have been stealing our supplies, hoping to weaken us. Without them, we don't stand much of a chance! The Abumi Guchi are hoarding crates of our food, and the Infernal Knights have stolen our weapons. Bring back as many as you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Clear the Way ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Nether Warlock
quests.description: There's a powerful Nether Warlock, that has been terrorizing the far side of town. He's pretty strong, but together we can take him. Come on, let's go!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Clear the Way ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gather the Shadows
quests.description: We must prepare for war. Our magi can use Shadow Oil to empower their spells. Go back to the /valleyofdoom and collect as much as you can from the shadowy creatures there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have watched the ' The Wedding ' cutscene.

quests.name: Journey Through the Dark Night
quests.description: Tara went inside the forge, and started skimming a book left behind on that table. Could you ask her to read it to me? I don't remember if I'm literate, but I liked all the stories she told me about your adventures. Did you know she wrote them down?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chymerical Ash ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Lunar Caustic
quests.description: Dahlia shot off as soon as the forge's doors opened. Tara's pointing down the western hall. It smells smokey, which means there are Maleno Elementals around. We should clear that side, and see what Dahlia's doing. The Elementals aren't bothering her. If she's not human, is she one of them?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chymerical Ash ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Like Water and Lithium
quests.description: I ticked Warlic off pretty bad. He went down the eastern hall to deal with the Draconians that broke into the forge. They came to help that Dragon claim it as their lair. Think Warlic would be less angry if we talked and got rid of the Draconians together?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chymerical Ash ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Shadows Lengthen in...
quests.description: The guardian of Maleno, Admin B, said the room containing the flames is locked. That's…weird. The key should be in one of the other rooms, so try pushing yourself up against their doors. While you're doing that…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chymerical Ash ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blithe Hospitality
quests.description: I told Tara about the key. She thinks it's a trap. Like, a surprise that's going to hurt us. Wait, of course you'd already know what that is. I'm going to help her prepare in case it is a trap while you clear out the last of the Elementals and Draconians.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chymerical Ash ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sal Volatile
quests.description: There's nothing we can do but destroy the Dragon, inside Maleno's flames, and hope that Admin B is going to seal the forge. They told us the Fire Dragon's name was Idalion the Elegant. Remember? Tara doesn't like hurting Dragons so it's up to us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chymerical Ash ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Argyria
quests.description: Volgritian and I need to get scanned, which is taking a while. Should it be this long? We can't seal Maleno's flame until it's done, so why not take this chance and use it? Alchemic materials from the Elementals and Dragons should be enough to get something started.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sal Volatile ' quest.

quests.name: Argyria (Legend)
quests.description: Volgritian and I need to get scanned, which is taking a while. Should it be this long? We can't seal Maleno's flame until it's done, so why not take this chance and use it? Alchemic materials from the Elementals and Dragons should be enough to get something started.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sal Volatile ' quest.

quests.name: Lost Admin Privileges
quests.description: Jaania disappeared, and all of the Turrets and Droids went crazy again! We can't get through to the forge if - Who's Jaania? You still don't remember her being here? Don't worry, I'll tell you everything after we trash these gizmos!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mental Barrier ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Conscious Unconsciousness
quests.description: The thing that chased you on Mount Maleno's lurking in the center of Forge Albedo. I promise I won't take the flames until Warlic says it's okay, so let's take your stalker down. And then do it a third time if we need to, 'cause that's supposed to be the charm. Right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mental Barrier ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Candidus Sol
quests.description: I shouldn't stay in the Sanctuary. It's safer for me to be here, where I can't hurt anyone by accident. You want to stay with me? R-really? It's dangerous with all the Turrets, Doids, and the Flames of Albedo's remnants. We'd need to get rid of them first.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Conscious Unconsciousness ' quest.

quests.name: Candidus Sol (Legend)
quests.description: I shouldn't stay in the Sanctuary. It's safer for me to be here, where I can't hurt anyone by accident. You want to stay with me? R-really? It's dangerous with all the Turrets, Doids, and the Flames of Albedo's remnants. We'd need to get rid of them first.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Conscious Unconsciousness ' quest.

quests.name: Pet-ty Plumbing Problems
quests.description: It takes a certain type of person to fix plumbing, and I am not that person. My animals, though, are in dire need of a drink, and all the pipes are clogged! Or bent, or broken or, or… I don't know! Find me 12 new pipes and 1 Bronze Washer from an Octo so the Skyguard's plumber will have something with which to work!

quests.name: Dogs and Cogs
quests.description: Even robodogs made up of cogs and bits and bolts need to play sometimes! But I am woefully short of toys now that I'm working for the Skyguard. They aren't much given for to play. Can you bring me some robodoggie toys? They'd like sticks and… hmm, furry squeaky toys if you can find them!

quests.name: SteamOcto Ahoy!
quests.description: Recently a host of strange creatures have appeared in the Hover-base. At first, the Skyguard thought they were friendly, and set me to taming the creatures. However, they began to attack as soon as I came near. The recruits think they are spies for some nefarious villain, but I disagree. Help me capture 8 SteamOcto's so that I can continue my efforts to tame them.

quests.name: Alina's Go-Go Potion
quests.description: This is supposed to be the happiest day of our lives. They don't tell you that it's also the most exhausting. We're both so exhausted that we're sleeping on our feet but if I had some coffee beans and soil from the /farm I could make some energy potions with the extracted caffeine and B12!

quests.name: From The Heart
quests.description: Rolith and I agreed not to buy each other wedding gifts… so I plan on making him one but I need your help gathering the materials! I will need a Default Sword from /yulgar's weapon shop, a Perfect Chaotic Fang from the wolves in /forestchaos and some 5 perfect crystals from Leatherwings in /pines!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hard Water
quests.description: We NEED to question Silvertree, and that means we're going to have to cross that river. It's full of healthy minerals, but far too deep for us to wade across. I need 7 stone reagents from the Amethyst Golems to activate my Petrification Potion to turn the water to stone. That'll be much gneiss-er to cross.

quests.name: Raising the Stakes
quests.description: Silvertree isn't usually so secretive. He's always hosting parties and playing up his popularity. I can't imagine him wanting to keep anyone out of his mansion unless he had something to hide. Fortunately, I know a way past this barrier. Once you collect enough flowers, you can use my Dandelion Draft and the portcullis' bars will float right up!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Stop! Potion Time.
quests.description: Much like those pendulum blades about to cut us off, Raoul always did go back and forth between more powerful patrons. My Temporal Solidification Potion will freeze those blades in place! We'll need a clock's mechanism and something cold for it to work, though, like 7 Frigid Frogdrake horns.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Inscrutable Motivation
quests.description: There he is! But… he's in a spell-trance. Who knows what he's about to do, or why! Quick, gather up some of his potions and reagents. If we're lucky, there's enough there to make my signature draught, a Potion of Inscrutable Mutation. It'll interrupt his current working, and… finesse him into telling us what we need to know.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Paradise is Not So Nice
quests.description: Raoul was always a scholar and a finagler, getting someone else to fight his battles for him. I’m not surprised he's summoned one of his creations to fight for him now. But I'm determined to get the answers I seek, and the little bird who's going to tell me is cowering behind this creature!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Poison Creation
quests.description: The forest is dense, and we'll need to clear a path quickly. To make a Vegetal Decay Draught, I'll need 8 drops of Traitor Knight's Sweat, 5 Toxic Gallstones from the marsh lurkers, 3 bunches of Nightrage Weed, and 3 handfuls of Cyanidic Soil. They should all be found near here, but most people don't know how to look.

quests.name: Vegetal Decay
quests.description: Apply the Vegetal Decay Draught three times to each tree that needs to be moved. It is my hope that once we've cleared enough trees, we'll find where Rolith and the Knights are being kept. You'll need to return to me to get each new dose of the Draught. And bring me a Toxic Gallstone. Don't ask why.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Recycle, Rebuild, Rescue
quests.description: How can ANYONE who claims to fight for Good do this to an innocent family? We must help them! The Traitor Knights should have nails, and the Treeants will have vines. All you'll need to do is bring back enough items to help rebuild Jenna's home! I need 6 unbent nails and 6 sturdy vines, and don't forget some wood from the barricade. Then rebuild the cottage!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Corrosive Philtre
quests.description: I cannot fathom BURNING someone who will not do as you ask. At least my poisons kill quickly. Free 15 Burning Loyalists and collect embers from their fire. With the pure rainwater you'll find in the buckets by Jenna's home, and the Krialo Moss I've got, we're going to free those Knights from the fort!

quests.name: Loyalty Rewarded, Wounds Salved
quests.description: I've got a salve made from the Aniseseed Pulp applied to those Cloths from the Traitor Knights. Finish freeing the last 10 Burning Knights and apply the salve to them. They will be alright.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Storm the Fort
quests.description: I need you to slay the Traitorous Knights guarding the gate while I finish preparing the Corrosive Philtre. I believe there's only the 8 of them, so you should finish them easily. Once you do, apply the Philtre to the gate and we'll be able to enter. Don't drink any!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Termination Tonic
quests.description: Take out the 11 Traitorous Knights in the camp. They're all Lionfang's men now. I will need 11 drops of Enraged Blood and then, with the other ingredients I have, you'll make a Termination Tonic. With that, we can make them all pay for what they've done!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Burn ALL the Things!
quests.description: Now that you have the Termination Tonic, pour it on EVERYTHING - the tents, the supplies, all of it! They deserve to have nothing left! And here… *pour* now your weapon is coated with the Tonic. When you go to battle Xavier, it will… help him understand what he's done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Return The Potion To Cysero
quests.description: No, really. I REALLY don't want to know what Cysero needs a growth potion for. It's bad enough he used up all of my spider eyes and blaze creams for one of this muffin recipes. Just take him this potion and… good luck.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Speak to Alina ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Dragon Shinobi Tokens
quests.description: So far, all of those costumes have helped us prevent mass panic, but eventually people are going to notice that BattleCon is full of monsters. We have to keep everyone safe! Bring me goo from the monsters in the lab, and nuggets from the monsters in BattleCon. I will give you a Dragon Shinobi Token in return!

quests.name: Dragon Shinobi Tokens for Legends
quests.description: As a Legend, you are a little bit stronger than the average player. Goo and nuggets are one thing, but if you can bring me actual GUNK and CHUNKS, I will gladly give you two Dragon Shinobi tokens instead of one.

quests.name: Trade for the Butterfly Sapphire
quests.description: The Butterfly Sapphire is an alchemical creation! I actually make it from the same flowers I use in my tea: Butterfly Bloom! They grow on the Trollola Plants in /bloodtusk. Bring me enough for a gem - and some extra for my tea! - and I'll make you one.

quests.name: Anniversary Badge
quests.description: Happy Anniversary, Hero! Cysero crafted a special event badge for you, but the Frogzard swallowed it. Defeat him and get it back and you'll see the badge appear on your character page.

items.name: Eternal Birthday Hero Character Page Badge

quests.name: Rooted Remedy
quests.description: Ingrid lives on her own and it doesn't look like she receives many visitors. I don't think the townsfolk are being mean-spirited. Ingrid likely refuses them entry because she feels like a pity case. With that in mind, would you please collect some herbs from the snowfield? We can ask her for advice about making herbal medicine, and then help her with some chores in return. That way, we'll naturally get to know her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Homemade Stars ' quest.

quests.name: No Lasso Rodeo
quests.description: The tea was piping hot but refreshing! I'm full of energy. Aina's gifts aren't going to chop, mince, and pan fry themselves. I'll take care of the cooking and how about you take care of some yard work? A few of the Tundra Steeds were left behind by the other racers. They're big animals clopping around, and I'm worried they'll trample Ingrid or damage her house. Wrangle them up and I'll give you an extra serving of stew.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Homemade Stars ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Gift of Faith
quests.description: Ingrid was looking through her drawers for owl feathers and fox fur, but her stores are bare. She didn't ask us to help but I can tell she's disappointed. If it isn't going to give you stomach cramps, could you run out and grab some? In the meantime, I'll distract her and you can sneak the supplies into a different drawer when you come back. I wonder what she needs them for.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Homemade Stars ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Together from Afar
quests.description: It's getting dark enough to see the torchlights darting about on the mountains. We should head back to Aina for our restaurant reservation but…I wonder if we could get an extra seat for Ingrid? She might refuse but it's worth asking. She smiled when we were sharing stories, and I don't want to leave her alone on a night when everyone's with their families. Let's talk to Aina about it and find some horses to pull a sled to get Ingrid there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Homemade Stars ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Intruder From the Stars
quests.description: It's taking all of my willpower to hold myself back from charging into the mountains. But while I was panicking, Ingrid disappeared! She left behind two wreaths, one for me and you. There's a note that thanked us, and said goodbye. I had a terrible feeling about this so I went farther east to the foot of the Mountain. There, growling in the dark, was an enraged monster! Please, we need to defeat it so we can find Ingrid!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Homemade Stars ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Trick for the Eyes
quests.description: More of those Vaderix are emerging from the woods! We need to fight them off or else they'll be on our tail the entire hike! All the noise we're going to make will alert the townspeople, but Aina said she'll take care of that. She knows a few magic tricks that will hide us from their sight. We can even collect some supplies before we leave. Feathers for tinder and horse hair to make something warm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Intruder From the Stars ' quest.

quests.name: Encroaching Frost
quests.description: We need you to scout the mountain, but don't stray too far yet. At this elevation during the night, frostbite is going to chew off your fingers and nose. While you're exploring, take as many feathers as you can carry from the Mountain Owls. I'll gather more branches, and we'll use both to keep the fire going. I heard hooting while we were hiding so the owls should be close by.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Intruder From the Stars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Horse Vision
quests.description: So you found some Tundra Steeds while you were scouting the area? Some of them might have belonged to the racers! The horses must be spooked by whatever caused their sleds to go missing. It'll be difficult on this terrain but could you please lead some of them back to the campfire? If I'm able to recognize any of them, that would mean the other racers could be nearby.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Intruder From the Stars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Frigid Mirage
quests.description: The horses you found were milling about further ahead on flat ground. They have good sense so that might be a safer place to carry Ingrid. Talk to Ingrid and Aina while you warm up by the fire. I'll prepare our supplies for the move. Oh? Did you spot something else while you were exploring? A glowing torch all by itself? Hmm, it could have been left by the mob but we should investigate it in case it has something to do with the racers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Intruder From the Stars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hiding Cavities
quests.description: Like you said before, we shouldn't jump to any conclusions. Not when we're stuck up here and essentially lost. There's no motive, and I'm worried that Ingrid will be affected if we kick up a fuss. For now, let's corral the owls and horses around us. They're agitated by something, and the Tundra Steeds keep trying to go back to the top of the slope. Hmm, they're poking their noses at that pile of snow. Let's take a look there too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Intruder From the Stars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cosmic Interference
quests.description: Rolith and the other racers are stuck in that cave with…are those more Vaderix? They look smaller, and aren't the same color as the one you fought at the foot of the mountain. Could they be newer hatchlings? We'll figure that out later. Save the racers first! Quick, let's help them fight off the Juvenile Vaderix and make sure they're okay!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Intruder From the Stars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cold Resistance
quests.description: While Ingrid leads us out of the mountains, we need to eliminate any Vaderix we come across. They'll hound us the entire way back if we don't get them first. I also want to know why these Juvenile Vaderix look so different from the adult green one you fought at the foot of the mountain. Could the bandits have done something to the Vaderix to make them stronger?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Intruder From the Stars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bandits of Summer
quests.description: I can see moonlight filtering through the gaps in the trees. We're almost out of the woods! Ingrid says that she's beginning to recognize the landscape better. But that doesn't mean we'll be safe. If we're lucky and caught up to the bandits from the Neverglades, then we'll be in for a fight. Rolith and the others will back you up but don't let them clobber the bandits too hard. I'd like to have a nice chat with a couple of them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Intruder From the Stars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Avalanche of Wings and Feelers
quests.description: The bandits are already in the city but they've only just arrived. We aren't too late! Based on what the captured footmen said, their plans have already fallen apart and they can barely control their Vaderix. It's up to us to keep the situation from dissolving into chaos. We'll eliminate the Vaderix, and apprehend the Bandits. They'll go from the frigid mountains straight into a cold prison cell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Intruder From the Stars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bargain Bin Bounty
quests.description: The leader of the bandits from the Neverglades is on his way, and he's frothing at the mouth. I guess we all did ruin what was likely months of planning. Tsk tsk, he wasted his Frostval on something so rotten! Rolith said his name is Fletcher, and the bounty on his head could buy us a used bathtub. Not a big name but take care all the same. With how angry he is, it's going to take more than one beat-down to get him to give up.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Intruder From the Stars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Vaderix Requiem
quests.description: In front of the Snowview Inn is a fully grown Vaderix. It didn't hatch on that comet you were talking about. That huge roach was born on the mountains, in our atmosphere, and adapted to become the apex predator of its new surroundings - is what Aina is reading from her notes. If she wanted, she could be an incredible narrator for theater plays. You're the Hero of this Frostval drama and it's up to you to take the final monster down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Intruder From the Stars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Turkey Alternative
quests.description: There are still stray Vaderix left roaming the streets and snowbanks. Aina's asking us to help out with cleaning up Diauhtla. She said that there was a gourmet dinner in it for us if we help out. The chefs are working with her to come up with new recipes made with ‘sustainable ingredients.' Rolith and I want to give it a try. Let's clean up the rest of the Vaderix and have another party!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Vaderix Requiem ' quest.

quests.name: Brewing a Void-Walking Potion
quests.description: You need a potion to travel through the Void? I can help make it, but it'll mostly require some rare alchemy reagents. First, we'll need some Dried Slime. You definitely know where to get that. Next, we'll need some Light Apples. These only exist in the Plane of Light, so I'm not sure how we'll be able to get them. Next, we'll need Spider Venom. The spiders around Brightoak have the perfect venom for this. Finally, we'll need a Crystal of Void-Walking. I heard from Lim awhile back that another mad scientist has it in his secret lab… but I don't recall his name.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Void Gem in your inventory to accept this quest.

quests.name: Free Advertising
quests.description: Ah, hello there! I'm not sure why, but my business hasn't exactly been booming as of late. Perhaps it's because people are always coming and going here in Dreadrock. I'll need to find a way to attract new clientele…would you mind going around and advertising my shop to the locals? A good place to start would be the faction recruiters on the other side of town. It wouldn't hurt to clear some of the monsters you see on the way back, either - they're bad for business.

quests.name: Supply Run
quests.description: It seems a few thieves have run off with my supplies. If you would, please get them back to me as soon as possible. You'll probably find them on some of the locals around here.

quests.name: Pisces Alpherg
quests.description: In the light of Lore's day, the Astravians see me as a light that blesses the land. The First King warned me that it would change in the shadow of night. They would no longer think so well of me. As your ancestors arrived to receive the throne, one by one, they proved him right. Activate the portal, and gaze upon my true form - your origin.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pisces Alrescha ' quest.

quests.name: Pisces Ishtar
quests.description: Asking for you to defeat me would be unfair. To pass my test, you need only to survive. I have reached my hand out to you, as I have with our bloodline. Know that even though you are my kin, your life will be forfeit if you fail. Now, fight me to your last or return to my embrace.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pay Homage to Caladbolg
quests.description: As a devout follower of the Undead Legion, it is a privilege to pay homage to the Altar of Caladbolg. Your donation of 5 Legion Tokens and 1 soul shard from a skeletal warrior in /underworld will earn you eternal respect from The Dark Lord.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Legion Titan in your inventory.

Altar Of the Hollowborn Caladbolg's Ques.name: Altar Of the Hollowborn Caladbolg's Quests

quests.name: Pay Homage to Caladbolg (Again)
quests.description: As a devout follower of the Hollowborn, it is a privilege to pay homage to the Hollowborn Altar of Caladbolg. Your donation of 5 Legion Tokens and 1 Hollow Soul may earn you eternal respect from The First Hollowborn.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Caladbolg and Altar Of the Hollowborn Caladbolg in your inventory.

quests.name: How Much For One Rib?
quests.description: I have a true challenge for you. Bring me a Dark Unicorn Rib from the beastly monster unicorn known as Binky. In return I will reward you with Hollow Souls. I might possibly offer you an even more rare reward if I find your performance pleasing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Altar Of the Hollowborn Caladbolg in your inventory.

quests.name: Can I Axe You a Question
quests.description: Our Master wishes to bring more Undead into MystCroft! As he wishes, so must we do. But all of our axes are broken. Without those, we cannot chop down the Dead End sign. Please, Hero, kill monsters until you have 15 metal shards so we can forge a new axe!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Skullberry Picking ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Don't Forge-t
quests.description: Take the Metal shards you gathered to the Forge! Click on the Forge to fire it up (push-button smithing is Cysero's latest innovation!) and your metal will become an all-metal ax!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Skullberry Picking ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Undead End in Sight
quests.description: Now that you've gotten an axe, head on down the path to the Dead End. Chop that sign down so that all the Undead can start filtering into Baron Luca's forest. You should put up and Undead End sign too, to warn any travelers what they can expect there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Monstrous Appetite ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Stellar Dynamics
quests.description: Ugh, this is so annoying. Other stars snuck inside the cave! They must have figured us out - I mean, they must have seen how lucky we were having you to help us get home! Give these Astral Spirits a good punt and send them back into space!

quests.name: Hokey Horoscope
quests.description: How did that Astromancer lady get inside the cave? She's not supposed to be here! Tell Kylokos to give us some space! She's over there admiring the paintings we made of Suzaku and Genbu. Hmm…You should go admire them too ~
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tokaki
quests.description: Little tiger cubs chased after us from the cosmos. Don't mind them! They're just ankle biters made from our stardust. I guess scampering tripping hazards would be dangerous for someone with legs, so shoo them off. They'll only hate you for a couple of decades.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ekie
quests.description: The purple lady got inside the cave too! Tell her it's okay to steal our self-portrait, and that picture of that ugly blue noodle Seiryuu. Make sure to show it off and put it somewhere high! We'll visit it after we finish being alone with you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Subaru
quests.description: The Byakko Cubs and Astral Spirits are crowding the cave. We don't have any breathing room to talk with you, and our cool paintings are going to get messed up! Clear them out for us, pretty please with sparkles on top ~
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kagasuki
quests.description: This was supposed to be a cave, not a rave! It's lit like a sunny day from all the visiting stars. Even further inside are lights from Rigel. We'll save our special talk for later. We need to make the Rigel Strays leave!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Amefuri
quests.description: The Lunar Hazes are seeping in. They have a habit of bothering me specifically, so it'd be so nice if you could kill them! Wreck them! Hurt them, and ignore the walls. Definitely ignore the stuff on the walls. Erm…that wasn't supposed to be here…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tatara
quests.description: The Champion of Nature's staring at that very unimportant and meaningless picture on the wall. Did she get left behind by the purple lady? You should grab her before she gets lost again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Toroki
quests.description: We aren't too far from the end of the cave. That's where the Lunar Hazes and Rigel Strays are trickling in from. They're all so greedy for attention! Make them wait their turn! Or… you could not give them a turn at all, ehehe ~
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Komokuten
quests.description: Oops! I fell out by accident! Hey, help me back to Byakko and we'll have a real one-on-one duel! As our original self, we'll win for sure! When we do, you'll make us the Tiger of Space! No more stalling, and no interruptions! Fight us!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pure Bai
quests.description: Eventually, the stars of Suzaku, Genbu, and stupid, idiot, ugly Seiryuu are going to want some personal time with you too. We have to take advantage of the time we have! Play a little more with us and the cubs!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Komokuten ' quest.

quests.name: Feeding the Frozen Flame
quests.description: The Fotia Elementals feed off the Frozen Flame's soul. By defeating these Elementals, we can help restore power and strength to the Frozen Flame. Return to me after you have defeated 4 Fotia Elementals.

quests.name: Fire for the Frozen Flame
quests.description: Just like the Fotia Elementals, the Fotia Spirits thrive off the Frozen Flame's soul. We can help make the Frozen Flame stronger by sacrificing Fotia Spirits. After you have defeated 5 Fotia Spirits, the Frozen Flame will burn brighter!

quests.name: Lore Cores
quests.description: The lava shows no signs of slowing down; what we need now are Fire Cores! Fire Cores are legendary auras that some Fotia creatures contain. Capture 7 Fire Cores from the Fotia Spirits and Fotia Elementals to pay more respect to the Frozen Flame.

quests.name: Volcanic Exploration
quests.description: Hmm… the volcano still shows signs of erupting! Perhaps we need additional Cores found within the Femme Fatalities? Engage in friendly competitive sparing against the Femme Cult Worshipers near the volcano, and retrieve 6 Lava Cores from them! Hurry!

quests.name: Retrieve the Ancient Artifact: Fire Staff
quests.description: As the Frozen Flame is an ancient relic herself, the Fire Staff that the Skeletal Fire Magi uses dates back centuries. The Fire Staff might contain an ancient power that the Frozen Flame can harness. Travel to /join portalundead, /join battleundera, and /join darkoviagrave to find the Fire Staff!

quests.name: Retrieve the Ancient Artifact: Ice Orb
quests.description: Much like the Fire Staff, the ancient Ice Orb Staff that the Skeletal Ice Magi use dates back centuries. If we can combine the Ice Orb's power with the Fire Staff, then perhaps the Frozen Flame will be able to stop the Fotia Volcano from erupting! Head to /join swordhavenundead, and /join battleundera to get the Ice Orb Staff from a Skeletal Ice Mage!

quests.name: This Guy's on Her Side
quests.description: What does the Frozen Flame and the Archfiend Nulgath have in common? A mutual hatred towards Dage the Evil! If you can retrieve 50 Archfiend's Favor from the /join Underworld, then perhaps the Frozen Flame will burn brighter than ever and save the Isle of Fotia from the Volcano! Please make haste!

quests.name: Star Light, Star Bright
quests.description: Would you help me, if you have time? Defeat Light Elementals and bring me the Light Particles you find after they dissipate.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Corrupted Light ' quest.

quests.name: Rip Space
quests.description: The room that the Nation's Casters are occupying used to be where I was trained in combat. Odd cracks have formed on the ground, and the Casters are conducting some sort of ritual. Are they causing that? We need to get them to tell us before we continue on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Where the Heart is ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Permanent Record
quests.description: The Nation Outriders are guarding what used to be my bedroom. They're under strict orders from the Blood Void to keep us out. Carnage must have found Carcano! Beat the Outriders down! They wouldn't have it any other way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Where the Heart is ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blood and Water
quests.description: The pig pen's a lot quieter now. Oh, that's what my brother and I called this room when we were trapped here. Is my memory still clear, or am I forgetting anything? Take a look at the drawings on the wall, and at that notebook on my brother's old bed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Where the Heart is ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Family Feud
quests.description: The clash between the forces of the Nation and the Paladins of the Lightguard are reaching a frenzy. Argh, they're all so blinded by bloodlust that they're lashing out at anyone, even their own! We need to stop them before the floor caves in.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Where the Heart is ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Twisted Helix
quests.description: Carnage, the Fiend leading the Nation Outriders, is charging into the Eastern Wing! He's caught the traitor's scent. We need to get to Carcano and the dying star first! Don't let Carnage get ahead of us! And if I look like I'm about to kill him, stop me before it's too late.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Where the Heart is ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Snake Ears
quests.description: The Shard isn't just twisting space - it's mutating anything that gets close to it. Void Fangs were sent to help Carnage, likely because they're so monstrous already that the Shard wouldn't affect them immediately. They'll try to stop us if we don't take them down first.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nation Code ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Faustian Leftovers
quests.description: Spirits of some sort are being manifested by the Shard. They may look like ghosts, but they aren't lost souls. They're wisps or scraps of what used to be alive. We need to fight the hostile ones, but there are others that just mutter to themselves. It wouldn't hurt to eavesdrop.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nation Code ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Broken Lives
quests.description: We're catching up to Carnage. I can see his trail of breadcrumbs. It's the pages he ripped out of his old notebook. Ugh, the Hushed specters and the Void Fangs are fighting! Help me get them out of the way so I can retrieve the pages! They'll lead us right to that meathead!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nation Code ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Call of the Fiend
quests.description: I know where Carnage is. Go to the farthest end of this island, and jump off the ledge. If you want to get in his head, read his notebook. Then, we'll force him to tell the truth. Whatever his plans are - Huh? You hear something trying to get your attention? Is it safe to speak to it?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nation Code ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Famiglia di Carcano
quests.description: My brother and I have a temporary truce. We'll head back to the edge of the island, and jump off the ledge on the other side. That's where we're going to destroy the Shard and Carcano. You quieted the specters, so Nulgath is going to be able to watch. We'll give him a show.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nation Code ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gathering Power
quests.description: So you want the armor of the Arch Doomknight? That is a highly valuable and powerful artifact I'm afraid I can't give it away so easily. Bring me what I need and I will see if it is sufficient enough as to me this set my last memento of an old friend and to the shadowscythe a highly powerful artifact. You can find dragon energy from Lair and Human Souls of value can be found in Noxus Tower.

quests.name: Death's Door
quests.description: Death holds a very important role in the balance of all things and his power over life is one to be feared. If you can get me a fraction of his power and souls he's collected over the years then I will see fit to allow you to continue. He won't give them to you willingly so be prepared for a fight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaotic Lords
quests.description: The chaos lords hold great power, a power that took out Sepulchure, so I must ask of you to obtain a piece of each of the lords and some of their power. Not only for revenge but because these powers are unlike any other in lore and I wish to study them to aid in my personal research.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Means to an End
quests.description: For your final task I will need you to bring me immense amounts of doom energy. The Arch Doomknight armor that Sepulchure empowered may have lost its once great spark but the energy to replace what was lost is still needed now that he is gone. If you bring me these catalysts of energy I will let you have the reward you seek as this will be the means to an end.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nightmarish Collection
quests.description: Deep in the shadows, the Queen's creatures stalk under the waves. But they have not yet taken down one of the most powerful of Eldritch gods… Kathool! Defeat him in the /deepchaos map to unlock the Ancient Nightmares character page badge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Ancient Nightmare's Pet (0 AC) in your inventory.

quests.name: Trailblazer
quests.description: Thanks for coming for us but until Xan takes his monsters and leaves our town, we're trapped here. I think it might be safe enough for us to make a dash back to our parents if you get rid of 12 of the fire monsters. Let me know when the coast is clear.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Miller's Key ' quest.

quests.name: Fire Brigade Of One
quests.description: You took care of a lot of Xan's monsters but now the fires raging through town are getting out of control. We have a well but the monsters have stolen the bucket! See if you can find our towns only bucket on one of the remaining monsters.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fire Control
quests.description: Now that you have the bucket you'll be able to put out the fires. You'll have to do it once bucket of water at a time. Refill your bucket at the well in town then click on each fire you see until they are all out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Andesi's Family Pendant
quests.description: I was hoping that it would be safe enough to get everyone back together but it's still too dangerous. You've been gone a long time. I want to get a message to my mom but I know she's freaking out. If you get the indent from my house, I'll put a small note in it and she'll know it's me. We live in number 26, near the well. Find the pendent please.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Signed, Seared, Delivered
quests.description: OK, all you need to do is deliver this to my mom, Scoria. Once she has it she will relax a little. We're just ride things out here. Don't worry. We'll be OK.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Or Maybe THIS Is True Love
quests.description: Of course I am thrilled to be out of here! But darling, how can I possibly leave without my sweet Gisele? I was heartbroken when she vanished, and I know I saw her reflected in a mirror when I was being taken to mine. You'll rescue her too, right? Just keep heading further in, and I know you'll find her mirror.

quests.name: Quest for the Jade Monkey
quests.description: The Jade Monkey was stolen centuries ago, and all my searching has led me here. I just KNOW those Gravediggers have stolen it, and I won't rest until it's MINE! Bring me any evidence of the monkey you can, and I will reward you handsomely!

quests.name: Hunt for the Silver Snakes
quests.description: Legend has it that the Silver Snakes were deities that displeased the Queen of Monsters. I would like to find evidence of their existence. They molt, so you should be able to find their scales or fangs. I expect the Gravediggers and infantrymen will have some for you.

quests.name: Battle for the Legion Staff
quests.description: A few days ago, I found a staff deep within the crypt-but after I took it, a Legion DoomKnight came out of nowhere and attacked me! I managed to get away, but dropped and broke the weapon somewhere inside. I'm busy hunting for more important relics at the moment, but you're more than welcome to head in there and recover the pieces from whoever may have picked them up.

quests.name: Lightning Up the Night
