quests.description: Hero, I fear for my element. If I am to be its custodian someday, I must protect it even now! But I am not strong enough. Please, separate the 100 99 spirits of the Air from the Earth's lightning where they are clashing inside the temple, and bring me a Breath from a Living Air!

quests.name: Will You Take Omom?
quests.description: My little friend, Omon, she has been with me since I was a young one in the clutch. I care for her, and she watches my back and plays Catch-the-tail to lighten my mood in these dark times. Some Living Air creature has stolen her. Please, get her back!

quests.name: The Molten Heart
quests.description: Though Kasuko has successfully repelled an intruder, he seeks reassurance that the will of humankind has not weakened. If you duel and defeat the dragon with your own strength of body and character, it will stop Kasuko from setting the nearby villages ablaze. You will have the respect of Kasuko, and I will arrange for your efforts to be properly honored.

quests.name: Forge the Blaze of Awe
quests.description: Kalayo senses great power in you, and wishes to continue dueling so he may hone his own claws. In turn, we will hone yours. If you gather Volcanic Essence from Kayalo, the scales of the great dragon in /gravestrike, the Molten Cores from monsters lurking in /battleundere, and Scrolls of Scorched Steel, we will turn your Blade of Awe into an eternal blaze.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Blade of Awe in your inventory.

quests.name: Forge the Blazing Light of Destiny
quests.description: Fire and Light are similar indeed, and I believe we can make your Blinding Light of Destiny blaze with brilliance. Kalayo wishes to continue dueling with you to hone his claws, and will give you the Volcanic Essence needed to forge this weapon. Our craftsmen will also need the scales of the great dragon in /gravestrike, the Molten Cores from monsters lurking in /battleundere, and Scrolls of Scorched Steel.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Blinding Light of Destiny (Axe) in your inventory.

quests.name: Forge the Burning Sword of Doom
quests.description: That is a very dangerous sword, but I would rather it be in your hands than that of the unworthy. Pit that blade against Kalayo for Volcanic Essences, retrieve the scales of the great dragon in /gravestrike, Molten Cores from monsters lurking in /battleundere, a Flame Heart from Smoldur in /ashfallcamp, and Scrolls of Scorched Steel. We will take those materials and bathe your Sword of Doom in fire.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Necrotic Sword of Doom (Sword) in your inventory.

quests.name: Ruined Ruins
quests.description: So you're looking for the last piece of the Runix Cube? Ok, let's make a deal. I can't learn ANYTHING from these ruins with the Chaos Lord's minions crawling all over the place. You clear out… say… 8 gargoyles and I'll help ya. But I'll need to see proof.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Second Piece ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'You've Been Framed' quest.

quests.name: Energize!
quests.description: Good luck trying to find your way around this place. My notes tell me that there SHOULD be a teleporter around here. If you found it then you could probably find what you're looking for much more easily. See if you can find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Second Piece ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'You've Been Framed' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blueish Glow
quests.description: Hmmm. I think we can charge up the teleporter pad if we had enough power sources. The gargoyles are animated using a magic blue gem in the center of each gargoyle. If we had 10 Blue Gems we might be able to get it working.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Second Piece ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'You've Been Framed' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Quickdraw
quests.description: Time to test out the teleporter! I'm not sure where it will take you but whatever you find, I need you to make a quick sketch of it. I should be able to give you more information once I see your drawing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Second Piece ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'You've Been Framed' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Arm Yourself
quests.description: Ok, fine. That golem wants to play hardball… then I'm… I mean your just the hero to do it. I bet the piece of the Runix Cube is INSIDE that golem. Defeat the golem and bring me his Arm and we'll crack it open and see what's inside.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Second Piece ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'You've Been Framed' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: You've Been Framed
quests.description: OF COURSE! This is a piece of the frame from that moglin painting in the main hall! Try completing the frame and see what happens. We're close now…. I can feel it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Second Piece ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'You've Been Framed' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reduce, Respawn, Recycle
quests.description: You're a superhero, right? Nothing is more super than saving the planet—by recycling! Check the Trashcans and bring me 10 Recyclable Products.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed The Memory Challenge mini-game.

quests.name: Mind your Manners
quests.description: There are some mean bullies who keep beating people up! Won't you teach them a thing or two in manners? Show 8 Bullies the power of proper manners!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: FUNdraisers!
quests.description: Will you help me recover the Money for my fundraiser? I went door to door and selflessly asked for Fundraiser Donations, but the thugs and bullies stole all the donations!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Bully the Thug
quests.description: Yippie! You helped me—so I'll help you! The Boss is hiding at the very end of the Alleyway. Go take him out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Scratch Test
quests.description: Hi there! You'll never find better weapons than the ones I make – lightweight, yet strong and sharp as dragon's claws! Part of the reason they're so great is that I always try each one out on various minerals to test their strength. Want to help me out? Take this one to Earthstorm and give it a whirl!

quests.name: Stinging Dagger of Serpents
quests.description: Turn in a "War Prize!" to obtain the Stinging Dagger of Serpents! (Member Only)

quests.name: Dagger of Serpents!
quests.description: Turn in a "War Prize!" to obtain the Dagger of Serpents!

quests.name: Royal Blade of Thorns
quests.description: Turn in "War Prize!" to obtain the Royal Blade of Thorns! (Member Only)

quests.name: Blade of Thorns
quests.description: Turn in "War Prize!" to obtain the Blade of Thorns!

quests.name: Staff of the Burning Abyss
quests.description: Turn in "War Prize!" to obtain the Stinging Staff of the Burning Abyss! (Member Only)

quests.name: Pukasnooze vs the Moglurker
quests.description: Aspiring Pockey-Mogs champions! Your first battle is against: The Moglurker! Send in your Pukasnooze, and may the best Pockey-Mog prevail!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pockey-Chew ' quest.

quests.name: Pukasnooze vs Zaplin
quests.description: Ash and Aria, you won the last round, so you get to go in again! This time, your Pukasnooze is up against an electric Pockey-Mog: the Zaplin! Good luck!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pukasnooze vs Blood Moggot
quests.description: Time for Round 3! Can you keep up your winning streak? Only this battle against your opponent's Blood Moggot will tell!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pukasnooze vs Flamog
quests.description: Let's see how your Pukasnooze does against something a little… hotter! Your next opponent is Flamog, and he is on fire! Literally.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pukasnooze vs Vizally
quests.description: As the undefeated tournament champions, you're in for a special treat! Your next battle is up against Annie of Team Wreckit, and her best Pockey-Mog fighter, Vizally!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pukasnooze vs Toglin
quests.description: Your Pukasnooze may have beaten Annie's Vizally, but let's see how it does against Oakley's Toglin? Team Wreckit hasn't lost yet!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: They're Gonna Wreckit!
quests.description: You thought you could come in here and use your fake Pukasnooze to win our tournament and take all of our Pockey-Mogs? NOT COOL. Team Wreckit is gonna teach you a lesson!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Quest name parodies Wreck it Ralph's phrase, "I'm gonna wreck it!

quests.name: Tip Out
quests.description: My shift is just about over. But goodness me, my Tips are strewn all over the bar! Under the tables, beneath the chairs, ughm, they're everywhere! Can you do me a big favor and help collect my Tips for me? Just click on each golden coin you find around the bar and bring them back to me when no more tips can be found! Thanks, sugar!

quests.name: War Medal Turn-in
quests.description: Defeat opponents in the Black Hole Sun war to obtain 5 Black Hole Sun war medals. Turn these in to raise the war meter. Once the meter hits 100%, you'll unlock the war boss!

quests.name: Mega War Medal Turn-in
quests.description: Defeat opponents in the Black Hole Sun war to obtain 3 Mega Black Hole Sun war medals. Turn these in to raise the war meter. Once the meter hits 100%, you'll unlock the war boss!

quests.name: Bring the Pain
quests.description: The Black Hole Sun has come, and now it's time YOU bring the pain. Take out 5 of the Black Hole Sun's creatures and I'll craft a 4th Dimension Gem from the bursts of Black Light they shed.

quests.name: Reflection of Death
quests.description: The light from the Black Hole Sun passing through the 4th Dimensional Pyramid has created… something incredible! But also deadly. Take out the Reflecteract before it twists YOU into knots!

quests.name: Apocalyptic House Items
quests.description: Ground bonemeal is a VERY useful building material. Bring me a femur from the Undead Vikings in /graveyard and I will craft a piece of furniture for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Apocalyptic LichMoglin in your inventory.

quests.name: Sploosh Some Solars!
quests.description: Well, what are you waiting for? Grab a weapon and go sploosh some of those Solar Elementals!

quests.name: Sploosh Some Bigger Solars!
quests.description: Some of the emerging solar elementals are more powerful than the others. But you can't tell which are which just from looking at them! If you happen to sploosh some of the more powerful ones, let me know.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Curious Monkeys
quests.description: The gibbons who hang around the temple are very curious - and very naughty. They keep stealing our unused water balloons. See if you can get some of the back from them, ok? Our resources aren't unlimited, after all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Owwie!
quests.description: Exposure to all these solar elementals has left a lot of people sunburned! Think you could collect some Aloe Gel for me so I can help them ease the pain? You should be able to find plenty of Aloe plants in the jungle nearby.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Naughty Monkeys
quests.description: Those naughty monkeys have started stealing our water guns, too! If you can manage to get any of them back, we'd all be thankful.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Big One
quests.description: Oh, no! We were all having so much fun - but we made it angry! And now, it's going to destroy everything! Please, you have to stop it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ow, The Blisters
quests.description: Exposure to all these solar elementals has left a lot of people sunburned! Think you could collect some Aloe Gel for me so I can help them ease the pain? You should be able to find plenty of Aloe plants in the jungle nearby.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Even Naughtier Monkeys
quests.description: Those monkeys just like to steal everything, don't they? The temple staff are trying to clean up the mess left behind from the Solar Festival, but the monkeys keep taking our clean rags. Help me get them back?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: AQW Arcade
quests.description: Wait… this game only LOOKS broken! But it takes Twiggy Tokens. Defeat the Mascots to get the Tokens, and you'll be able to get a prize.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Scary Baby ' quest.

quests.name: Wayfarer Potion
quests.description: The creatures and plant life here should be enough for us to create a potion that will reveal the way for us. Would you collect some ingredients for me?

quests.name: The Path Revealed
quests.description: With the potion complete, we should be able to find our way to the voice that I keep hearing! There may be some beasts in our way, however. Help me clear them out… and find the source of that voice!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Summon Help
quests.description: I need you to summon a friend of mine. He can help us locate the portal to underworld, which we can investigate. Before you can summon our helper you need to collect : 1 Holy Water from the waterfalls, 10 Bright Flower Seeds from your Infernal Knights, and 1 Golden Grain from the Celestial Bird of Paradise.

quests.name: Power Up!
quests.description: Well done Hero! Now you will have to learn the summoning spell, be aware that this is not an easy spell and you will need a lot of power. Battle Celestial Birds of Paradise until you get 10 Potions from them. You can purchase Basic Guard Potions from Skira in /embersea and the Fallen Knights have the pieces of the spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Final Spell Fragment
quests.description: Amazing, we are almost there! The Spell notes that you retrieved are not complete yet. You will have to find the final piece, so that we can read the spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Map
quests.description: Hero, Ilahi Sama needs our help to locate the portal. He wants you to collect a Map of Lore, which the Infernal Knight has stolen, and he will also need a Map Decoder to understand the readings on the map. You can get the decoder from one of the Dwakels' machines in /crashsite… just press the red button!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reveal the Portal!
quests.description: We are getting closer! Ilahi Sama has found the portal to the Underworld and made it visible for all. Please find it and return for instructions once you have.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Investigate the Ruins
quests.description: Hero! Please investigate these ruins, I can sense the dark energy around this place, and my powers are weakened! Pick up nearby plants around the ruins so I can determine if any dark energy has affected them, and defeat 5 Underworld Dogs. Please be be careful.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Reveal the Portal! ' quest.

quests.name: Take out the Knights
quests.description: Please slay the Fallen Knights around this place, so they don't move closer to the villages. We must protect the people of Lore!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Clues
quests.description: Trust is in short supply among the members of the Infernal invasion. The Infernal Warlord doesn't even trust his underlings! The location of my brothers has been hidden from all - each of the members of the Infernal Army has a clue about the location. The minions are very strong, and they are the only ones who can tells us where my three brothers are! However it looks like they are not willing to share the information with us, without a battle! So please battle them and retrieve the 4 clues! Best of luck, Hero.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Recover the Cage Key!
quests.description: Hero, my brothers are caged deep within the /lostruins. Please go there and release them! Pick up a Cage Key from one the Fallen Knights, then annoint that Cage Key with Holy Oil from an Holy Angelfish (in the Dynamite Shop in /Fishing) and I will be right behind you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Protect Them
quests.description: This place is crowded with dark energy! I feel so weak! I do not have enough power to battle with you, and save my brothers. Please defeat 15 of the Infernal creatures and bring me 10 Potent Guard Potions from Skira in /embersea - I will hold onto those for my brothers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Break the Spell
quests.description: The Infernal Warlord has caged my brothers with a powerful spell! He needs to be defeated, but I can't help you, the dark energy has weakened me. We need to break that spell before we can rescue my brothers. Bring me 5 Brimstone-stained Gauntlets from the Fallen Knights, 3 Onyx Spikes from the Underworld Hound and 5 Infernal Crystals so that we can create a counter-spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Open the Cage
quests.description: The spell has been broken, so you will be able to open the cage door with the Annointed Cage Key. Please released my brothers from their prison!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Infernal Warlord
quests.description: Oh no! The Infernal Warlord himself has come to take command of the Infernal Army! We must defeat him so that he will no longer be able to call in reinforcements!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Celestial Realm at War
quests.description: Fight like you've never fought before! You must defeat the Infernal Warriors that have been streaming through the portal!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Infernal Warlord ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Diabolical Warlord!
quests.description: The defeat of the Infernal Warlord has done nothing except make him more powerful! Even though you have fought your way through waves uncounted of Infernal creatures, your most difficult battle yet awaits. Defeat the Diabolical Warlord so that we can put an end to this invasion once and for all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Quest can be accepted either on Screen 1 or Screen 7 of Lost Ruins War.

quests.name: Guardian of Spirits' Blade
quests.description: If only we had had these weapons where we were doing battle with the Infernal Warlords… My Brothers' weapons are more powerful than those found in Lore. We can create these weapons to use them against any future enemy! To create your own Angel of Spirits Blade, bring me 500 Trapped Spirits from the Fallen Knights in the Lost Ruins.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Celestial Realm at War ' quest.

quests.name: Avatar of Death's Scythe
quests.description: If only we had had these weapons where we were doing battle with the Infernal Warlords… My Brothers' weapons are more powerful than those found in Lore. We can create these weapons to use them against any future enemy! To create your own Avatar of Death's Scythe, bring me 500 Energy of Death from the Underworld Hounds in the Lost Ruins.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Celestial Realm at War ' quest.

quests.name: Spear of Time
quests.description: If only we had had these weapons where we were doing battle with the Infernal Warlords… My Brothers' weapons are more powerful than those found in Lore. We can create these weapons to use them against any future enemy! To create your own Spear of Time, bring me 500 Captured Time from the Infernal Imps in the Lost Ruins.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Celestial Realm at War ' quest.

quests.name: Clear the Invaders
quests.description: First things first - help me slay all of these infernal invaders! If we don't take them out now, they'll surely flank us later on when we're least expecting it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take out the Overseer ' quest.

quests.name: Find the Weapon
quests.description: Now we just need to find this weapon they've built! It is most likely at the very top of the spire. Let's go!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take out the Overseer ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What is THAT?
quests.description: What a… huge… unholy… infernal beast! I am glad you're here with me - I'm not sure either of us could defeat him on our own! Fight him with me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take out the Overseer ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Slork!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of the brutal dwarf giant, Slork! Defeat him to progress to the next level.

quests.name: Battle Azkorath!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of Azkorath, the Infernal Overseer! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Blessed Inquisitor!
quests.description: In this round, we will pit you against the Blessed Inquisitor - one of our most powerful Celestials! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Lich Ravager!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of the Lich Ravager! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Shurpu Ring Guardian!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of the Shurpu Ring Guardian! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Serepthys!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of the Serepthys, guardian of the tesseract! Defeat her to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Yaomo!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of Yaomo of Akiba! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Cerberus!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of Cerberus, the Infernal hound! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Infernal Warrior!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of the Infernal Warrior of Shadowfall Rise! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Infernal Warlord!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of the Infernal Warlord of the Lost Ruins! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Conquest!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of the Conquest, the third Horseman of the Underworld Void! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Infernal Warlord!' quest.

quests.name: Battle War!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of the War, the second Horseman of the Underworld Void! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Infernal Warlord!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Death!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of the Death, the fourth Horseman of the Underworld Void! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Infernal Warlord!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Famine!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of the Famine, the first Horseman of the Underworld Void! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Infernal Warlord!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Diabolical Warlord!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of the Diabolical Warlord of the Lost Ruins! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Infernal Warlord!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Ultra Undead Raxgore!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of Ultra Undead Raxgore, scourge of the Doom Vault! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Infernal Warlord!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Blessed Karok!
quests.description: In this round, we will pit you against the Blessed Karok - a Celestial Construct imbued with the power of Karok himself! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Infernal Warlord!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Kezeroth!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of Kezeroth, the World Ender! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Infernal Warlord!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Shadow Lord!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of the Shadow Lord, master of the Shadow Realm! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Infernal Warlord!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Desolich!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of Desolich, the reanimated corpse of Desoloth! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Infernal Warlord!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Queen of Hope!
quests.description: In this round, we will pit you against the Queen of Hope - one of our most powerful Celestials! Defeat her to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Desolich!' quest.

quests.name: Battle Malxas!
quests.description: In an effort to reproduce some of the most challenging battles from Lore's past, we have created a replica construct of Malxas, Lord of the Infernal Spire! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Desolich!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Blessed Gladius!
quests.description: In this round, we will pit you against the Queen of Hope - a Celestial construct imbued with the power of Gladius himself! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Desolich!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle High Celestial Priest!
quests.description: In this round, we will pit you against the High Celestial Priest - one of our most powerful Celestials! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Desolich!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Blessed Enfield!
quests.description: In this round, we will pit you against the Queen of Hope - a Celestial construct imbued with the power of the Enfield. Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Desolich!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Avatar of Spirits!
quests.description: In this round, we will pit you against the Avatar of Spirits- one of our most powerful Celestials! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Desolich!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Avatar of Time!
quests.description: In this round, we will pit you against the Avatar of Time - one of our most powerful Celestials! Defeat her to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Desolich!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Avatar of Life!
quests.description: In this round, we will pit you against the Avatar of Life - one of our most powerful Celestials! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Desolich!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Fallen Abezeth!
quests.description: In this round, we will pit you against the Fallen Abezeth - a powerful Infernal Lord we have captured for the purposes of this tournament! Defeat him to progress to the next level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Desolich!' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: FINAL FIGHT!
quests.description: Hero, are you ready to test the limits of your strength? If you can defeat our final challenger, you will complete the Celestial Tournament, and I will bestow upon you the title of Celestial Champion. Let me know when you are ready!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Battle Fallen Abezeth!' quest.

quests.name: Greenguard Champion Badge
quests.description: The Greenguard Dragon waits for you in his lair, ready to blast your helm off… if he can. Slay him for the GreenGuard Champion Badge in /greendragon, then return to me.

quests.name: Draconic Laurel Challenge
quests.description: The Greenguard Dragon was fierce, but well within your range. The Blessed Dragon is your next challenge. Defeat him to earn the Draconic Laurel!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Inquisitor Champion's Badge
quests.description: The Grand Inquisitor waits for you in his Citadel, eager to face you in combat. Such a stern, proud human could use a defeat or two, to learn humility. Defeat him to earn the Inquisitor Champion's Badge, then return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Grand Laurel Challenge
quests.description: You delivered a lesson in humility to the Grand Inquisitor… but will you learn it in turn from his Blessed Inquisitor counterpart? Defeat him to earn the Grand Laurel!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: SkyGuard Champion Badge
quests.description: Gladius is one of the SkyPirates ﬁercest warriors, and a challenge for any who would sail the clouds. Defeat him in /airship to earn the SkyGuard champion badge, then return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Aeriel Laurel Challenge
quests.description: You shot Gladius down handily, but how easily can you maneuver against him in his Blessed Gladius form?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fallen Champion Badge
quests.description: Heroes across Lore know about Karok; many have fallen to him in battle. Defeat Karok the Fallen in /northstar for the Fallen Champion badge, then return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ascension Laurel Challenge
quests.description: Karok the Fallen fell to your mighty skill, but Blessed Karok may outshine you. We won't know until you face him in the arena! Defeat Blessed Karok to earn the Ascension Laurel.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Seraphic Champion Badge
quests.description: Heroes across Lore will challenge; many will fail. Those who are victorious will face an invisible, but deadly, enemy after they win. For this reason, the penultimate challenge in your quest to earn the Golden Laurel of Victory is… the Queen of Envy. Defeat her in /envy for the Seraphic Champion badge and return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Golden Laurel Challenge
quests.description: In the Celestial Realm, we champion goodness, determination, spirit… and the creatures or humans who personify them. One common trait that all our champions possess is hope. The desire to do better, or be better. And that is why, as the final test, you must master… the Queen of Hope. Defeat her to earn the Golden Laurel.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Resonance
quests.description: Where do we go from here? We will need to find a way into the next layer of this pocket dimension. There is nothing here - but I can use that "nothing" to target a weak point and create a rift. I just need to collect its unique dimensional resonance. You can help with that, right?

quests.name: Tune it up!
quests.description: Ok! I've used the energy you collected to craft a few tuning spells. If we place them around the area, I should be able to pinpoint a spot where I can create a rift into the next level of the pocket dimension.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Explore the Ice Dimension
quests.description: If Arthelyn is here, we will locate her! Explore this dimension and see what sign of her you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tune it up! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once.

quests.name: Open the Next Dimension
quests.description: If she is not here, then we'll need to go a level deeper. Here, take these tuning spells with you. Fight the monsters here until they've become imbued with their frigid resonance, and then place them around the area. I'll use them to find another weak spot.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tune it up! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Explore the Sand Dimension
quests.description: We must see if this is where Arthelyn is being held. Explore this dimension and see what sign of her you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Open the Next Dimension ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once.

quests.name: Open the 3rd Dimension
quests.description: Nothing here, either. As before, take these tuning spells with you. Fight the monsters here until they've become imbued with their arid resonance, and then place them around the area. I'll use them to find another weak spot.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Open the Next Dimension ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Explore the Dark Dimension
quests.description: My friend, I am getting exhausted. We must find her soon. Explore this dimension and see what sign of Arthelyn you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Open the 3rd Dimension ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once.

quests.name: Open the 4th Dimension
quests.description: We must not give up hope. As before, take these tuning spells with you. Fight the monsters here until they've become imbued with their dark resonance, and then place them around the area. I'll use them to find another weak spot.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Open the 3rd Dimension ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find Arthelyn
quests.description: This is it. This is where Arthelyn is being kept - I can feel her as if she was standing next to me. We must fight out way through to her - no matter what stands in our way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Open the 4th Dimension ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'Defeat Arthelyn' quest.

quests.name: Get the Key
quests.description: Ivoliss is the only thing standing between us and Arthelyn! He will not keep us from her! Defeat him and take the key to Arthelyn's cell so that we can set her free.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Open the 4th Dimension ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'Defeat Arthelyn' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Free Arthelyn
quests.description: All there is to do now is to unlock the door to Arthelyn's cell and free her. Would you do the honors?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Open the 4th Dimension ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'Defeat Arthelyn' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Reach Arthelyn
quests.description: This world keeps shifting and changing - it is as if the dimension itself wants to keep Arthelyn here! We cannot let it stop us. We must fight through any enemies it throws at us until we reach her!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Open the 4th Dimension ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'Defeat Arthelyn' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Defeat Arthelyn
quests.description: We cannot give up now! We must fight Arthelyn and hope she will come to her senses. If we exhaust her body, her mind may be able to regain control.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Open the 4th Dimension ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'Defeat Arthelyn' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: LightCaster Class
quests.description: Are you ready to prove yourself? Bring me back the following items and I will trust you have the power to wield the LightCaster Class in all its glory! My Pure Light can only be obtained by defeating me in battle.

quests.name: Maligned Magus
quests.description: This Realm has created a stronger Infernal construct based on a familiar face, an Abyssal Mage bursting with destructive magical power. Bring the mage to their knees.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest.

quests.name: Reverent Revenger
quests.description: This Realm has created a stronger Infernal construct based on a potential future of yours as a reverent follower of Infernal flames. Defeated this false self and eradicate this possibility from existence.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Infernal Harbinger
quests.description: The Realm has created another version of you, based on an even stronger and darker future- one where you become a harbinger of destruction. Defeated this false self and eradicate this possibility from existence.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: First of the Fallen
quests.description: This Realm has created a stronger Infernal construct based on …a memory of mine. As much as it irks me, I must hold myself back and allow you the right to destroy this facsimile of the first fallen.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Infernal Warlord
quests.description: This Realm has created a final Infernal counterpart based on your potential future: as a Warlord scorching lore into a lump of charcoal. Defeat this false self, and eradicate this possibility from existence.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Abhorrent Aperitif
quests.description: This Realm has created an Infernal construct based on an Endless Maw, a creation of Evil that ravaged Lore during its dark days. Vanquish this newborn Infernal monster.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Touch of Death
quests.description: This realm has created an Infernal construct based on Rotfinger, a powerful independent undead creature. Vanquish the monster before it can wreak havoc on Lore anew.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dire Dreams
quests.description: This Realm has created an Infernal construct based on the fear of failure, Devourax. Vanquish it before it gains a corporeal form.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Festering Forest
quests.description: This Realm has created an Infernal construct based on an Aberrant Terror you faced deep in a forest infected by Chaos. Destroy it before its roots reach the surface.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Abominable Butchery
quests.description: This Realm has created an Infernal construct based on the Abominator, a creation of Evil that ravaged Lore in dark days. Vanquish this newborn Infernal monster.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Infernal Screech
quests.description: This Realm has created an Infernal construct based on the Chaos Beast known as the Harpy. Vanquish this creature just like you did when the Mirror began to crack.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Frosty Burns
quests.description: This Realm has created an Infernal construct based on Izotz, a powerful and noble guardian. Shatter this insult of a facsimile, and send the shards back to where they came from.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kramping Your Style
quests.description: This Realm has created an Infernal construct based on Krampus, the scourge of the snow lurking in the nightmares of children. Vanquish this monster so their dreams can have some reprieve.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defiled Destiny
quests.description: This Realm has created an Infernal construct based on Graveclaw the Defiler, a beast that was once a threat to Swordhaven and Shadowfall. Vanquish this monster to ensure that it does not rise again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Searing Snake Oil
quests.description: This Realm has created an Infernal construct based on the Chaos Beast known as the Naga Baas. Vanquish this creature just like you did at the blood-drenched ravine.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ambivalent Affection
quests.description: This Realm has created an Infernal construct based on Agape, the daughter of the gods of Love. Destroy this twisted form. It has no right to wear the name of selfless affection.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: From the Crux of Shadows
quests.description: This Realm has created an Infernal construct based on Apephryx, a monster that could devour Lore. Destroy it before it claims Lore for the Infernals in its stomach.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reviled Returner
quests.description: This Realm has created a cruel Infernal construct based on the bodies of lost loved ones. Put this poor pair to rest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reign of the Deer
quests.description: This Realm has created an Infernal construct based on the Zweinichthirsch from old and cold myths. Destroy the construct before it goes on to make more diabolical legends.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ars Infernum
quests.description: This Realm has created an Infernal construct based on the Key of Sholemoh, a lifeform that contains every Infernal Spell in existence. A copy of such a deadly and tempting creation is too dangerous to allow to exist.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unrepentant Culler
quests.description: This Realm has created an Infernal construct based on the Scythe of Azalith. Though it is not the original, a copy with a mind of its own can not be left to reap the innocent!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lord of the Scarred Barrens
quests.description: You have triumphed over all of the Infernal Arena's challenges, save for the final match. Now, the original Infernal Champion is manifesting on the battlegrounds - Na'al, the Lord of the Scarred Barrens. Face him, take his title, and bring the Infernals to their knees!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FINAL FIGHT! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Head Hunters
quests.description: Azalith's army is gathering, and they're making a beeline for you and me. Without Arthelyn, I'm the head of our forces, and they're looking to lop it off at the neck. Let's show them it won't be that easy.

quests.name: Azalith's Ambition
quests.description: True to her original name, Azalith has joined her vanguard on the frontlines. Do not mistake her bravery for ill-thought brashness. Being this close to her goal will fuel her strength. At the very least, we need to cast her back down.

quests.name: Unshackled Azalith
quests.description: You bested Azalith before, but that only makes her even stronger when she returns for revenge. I beg you, keep casting Azalith out of this realm until we find a way to defeat her once and for all.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 80.

quests.name: Unshackled Azalith (Daily)
quests.description: You bested Azalith before, but that only makes her even stronger when she returns for revenge. I beg you, keep casting Azalith out of this realm until we find a way to defeat her once and for all.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 80.

quests.name: Revoked Devotion
quests.description: As soon as the towers appeared to herald the return of Anethyx'o, Azalith's Infernals began climbing them. We need to stop their advance! You, Arthelyn, and I will ascend the nearest set of stairs, and cut down the Infernal Mages.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith Faced ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Reverence is Fear
quests.description: My Celestial brethren bravely defended our realm from Azalith's attack, but many disappeared the moment the towers erupted from the ground. They may have been swept up in the chaos. We must find them, and provide aid if needed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith Faced ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Incidental Fall
quests.description: The Infernal Malxas is preventing us from ascending the tower. He's a familiar face…I think? Wait, there's something wrong. I can sense it. Defeat Malxas and I'll figure out what's going on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith Faced ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Knight-Erratic
quests.description: Azalith's foot soldiers, the Infernal Knights, are farther ahead. That means we're catching up. I must set aside my dread for now. Defeat those Knights, and prevent them from sullying The Bright One's light!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith Faced ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Terrified Terrors
quests.description: Just like the Celestials lower down the tower, some of the Infernals are trying to hide. Could the pressure Arthelyn and I are feeling be affecting them as well? Help me investigate my fallen brethren crouching in the shadows.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith Faced ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eudaimonia
quests.description: Look. Are those things hybrids? No…They're Celestials stuck in the middle of transforming into Infernals. It must be Azalith's doing, but for some reason, they're stronger in this state. Pacify Maah-na and Akh-a before they bring the tower down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith Faced ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Giver and Redeemer
quests.description: There are feathers scattered all over the rooms and stairs. Would you please help me and Arthelyn collect them? My sister has suspicions about them and the transformations.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith Faced ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Losing the Cause
quests.description: What remains of Azalith's Mages are gathering. She must be near, and it'll be easier to confront her if she's alone. Cast the Mages down from the tower. I'll catch them and interrogate them for information.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith Faced ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Building Doubts
quests.description: The last of Azalith's Knights are blocking the way. Beyond them is their leader. I need to set aside all of my doubts, and save them for after we defeat my sister. Expel the Knights from this tower. I don't want anyone to interrupt the final confrontation.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith Faced ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Azalith the Disavowed
quests.description: We caught up to Azalith before she could reach The Bright One. All these doubts and fears must stop here. Please help me clip my sister's wings once and for all. Then, our vision and conscience will finally clear.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith Faced ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Celestial Dianoia
quests.description: To honor my sisters, I will rule the Celestial Realm forevermore. The Bright One may have retreated, but we must remain vigilant. Please help me better understand my Infernal side, as well as the ambitions of Anethyx'o's devotees.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Filial Impiety ' quest.

quests.name: Luctus in Perpetuum
quests.description: You met my past self, yes? Did I look different? It's been so long that I've forgotten who I used to be. To adjust to my new role, I must consolidate the image I have of myself. Please collect these reagents, and I'll share my wings with you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Filial Impiety ' quest.

items.name: Celestial of Mysteries Character Page Badge

quests.name: Your Garden
quests.description: We begin with a seed. Reach out to this fragment of us, and begin your personal journey. Where did you grow? What did you learn? Return to Oaklore, and take us with you. Defeat the very first foe you met, and continue from there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The World ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must be Level 80.

quests.name: Love and Loss
quests.description: You have endured several lifetimes' worth of joy and despair, feelings many like us envy deeply. Help us grow in your heart. Nurture us with love, and trample on us with loss. The Fool will only learn through experience.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The World ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dawn Before Dusk
quests.description: A journey isn't complete without mishaps. For you to transform, a part of you must die. Have you undergone such an experience? Show us. The fear of death is essential to the process of growth, yet it has evaded us time and time again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The World ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dusk Before Dawn
quests.description: Come catastrophe or the death of stars, tomorrow will arrive, even if the Sun refuses to rise. Show us your resolve to complete this journey, and realize your new self. In witnessing your rebirth, we will reach another awakening.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The World ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Endless Beginning, Final Ends
quests.description: Completion nears. The shell of your egg is cracking. The final step is challenging the remnants of your old self, committing them to memory, and realizing your new form.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The World ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

items.name: Arcana Invoker Class Character Page Badge

quests.name: Ancient Essential Magics
quests.description: To become a great mage one has to start with the basics. One has to know how to combine natural ingredients to make your own potion. Gather only the finest ingredients so you can create a very powerful potion. Go into the Guru forest and bring me 2 Leather Wing tails and a Trobble feather.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Mage (Rare) in your inventory.

quests.name: Ancient Glimpse of the Dark Side
quests.description: One thing is to be able to create ones own potion but to be master one's own spells, that is where true power lies. Of course one needs to acquire knowledge even in places non ordinary human dare cross. Go deep into the Marsh and fight the evil that resides there. (Bring me 1 Berserker tooth and 1 Witch hair to complete this quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 2 Mage (Rare) in your inventory.

quests.name: Ancient Undead Energy
quests.description: A mage must understand the forces that power both life and death in order to even begin the quest for deeper knowledge of the universe. Go to the graveyard and bring me Jack Sprat's and two of his undead minion's un-life forces
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 3 Mage (Rare) in your inventory.

quests.name: Ancient Mage Essence
quests.description: You have proven that you possess the skills necessary to be a true master of the art of wizardry. Recently, nearby Bludrut Keep has begun radiating an evil energy… which should provide you with an excellent opportunity to practice your skills as you gather ingredients I can use to further my research. Go explore the Keep, and return to me with the essences of the foul creatures that dwell within it… I believe 5 rock essences and 5 fire essences should suffice. (Bring back 5 rock essence and 5 fire essence to complete this quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 5 Mage (Rare) in your inventory.

quests.name: Essential Magics
quests.description: To become a great mage one has to start with the basics. One has to know how to combine natural ingredients to make your own potion. Gather only the finest ingredients so you can create a very powerful potion. Go into the Guru forest and bring me 2 Leather Wing tails and a Trobble feather.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Mage in your inventory.

quests.name: Glimpse of the Dark Side
quests.description: One thing is to be able to create ones own potion but to be master one's own spells, that is where true power lies. Of course one needs to acquire knowledge even in places non ordinary human dare cross. Go deep into the Marsh and fight the evil that resides there. (Bring me 1 Berserker tooth and 1 Witch hair to complete this quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 2 Mage in your inventory.

quests.name: Undead Energy
quests.description: A mage must understand the forces that power both life and death in order to even begin the quest for deeper knowledge of the universe. Go to the graveyard and bring me Jack Sprat's and two of his undead minion's un-life forces
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 3 Mage in your inventory.

quests.name: Mage Essence
quests.description: You have proven that you possess the skills necessary to be a true master of the art of wizardry. Recently, nearby Bludrut Keep has begun radiating an evil energy… which should provide you with an excellent opportunity to practice your skills as you gather ingredients I can use to further my research. Go explore the Keep, and return to me with the essences of the foul creatures that dwell within it… I believe 5 rock essences and 5 fire essences should suffice. (Bring back 5 rock essence and 5 fire essence to complete this quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 5 Mage in your inventory.

quests.name: Sorcerer Armor
quests.description: (For owners of the Sorcerer class) You have proven your worth - you are now a Warlord. Sometimes however, these skill are not what is called for, but the look always is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Sorcerer in your inventory.

quests.name: Perfect Practice
quests.description: Most aspiring Mages think they have to start with intense study, but you'll learn faster through application. Practice the basics in /forest, and test your spells against the Zardman Hunters and Grunts.

quests.name: Grateful Guru
quests.description: The greatest mages learn from multiple teachers. Explore /Guru and bring me some Trobble fluff and Leatherwing feathers. While you're there, help the Forest Witch and chat up the Potion Master. You'll broaden your horizons.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Magitech
quests.description: Many Mages stifle their potential by turning their nose up at anything outside their comfort zone. Test your limits, and investigate the contraptions the Dwakels utilize in /CrashSite. Learn everything that you can. I plan to put your knowledge to the test.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Trial by Fire
quests.description: Your final test will be to use everything you've learned against me. Take this as seriously as you would a duel. Train in the /Citadel, where cruel Inquisitors seek to destroy Mages like us. This trial by fire will prepare you to counter my spells.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Hex of Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says, if wielding the arcane is more your style. Lightly armored, Hex Voids are the mystic breeds in my legion. They can decimate my enemies with black magic, elements and curses.
quests.requirements_note: Sorcerer , Rank 10.

quests.name: Hex: The Indecisive Minion
quests.description: Bah, have you ever stuck with anything in your life? So you think you made a mistake trading in your Void status? To show how forgiving I am, I will allow you to trade me back your "Hex of Nulgath" armor and your "receipt of Nulgath" for the void armor. But this is a one time deal. Plus i require interest payment on top of that. x5 Diamonds of Nulgath".

quests.name: Hexing Staff
quests.description: For a small price I'll give you a magical staff to obliterate anyone.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 30.

quests.name: Hex Mask
quests.description: The head piece to your Hex of Nulgath armor is now manifested.

quests.name: Arcane Dark Caster Owners: Arcane Class Quest
quests.description: If you have the Arcane Dark Caster Armor, you can unlock the Arcane Dark Caster CLASS for free! (Bring Dage a golden bone from the Skeletal Warrior in /graveyard, and he'll give you the class)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Arcane Dark Caster Armor (AC) in your inventory.

quests.name: Arcane Dark Caster CLASS Owners: Armor Quest
quests.description: If you have the Arcane Dark Caster CLASS, you can unlock the Arcane Dark Caster Armor for free! (Bring Dage a golden bone from the Skeletal Warrior in /graveyard, and he'll give you the class)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Arcane Dark Caster with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory

quests.name: Dark Gunner Owners: Arcane Class Quest
quests.description: If you have the Shadowed Dark Gunner Armor, you can unlock the Arcane Dark Caster CLASS for free! (Bring Dage a golden bone from the Skeletal Warrior in /graveyard, and he'll give you the class)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Shadowed Dark Gunner (AC) in your inventory.

quests.name: ShadowCraft Owners: Arcane Class Quest
quests.description: If you created the Shadowcraft Dark Gunner Armor by merging your Arcane Dark Caster Armor, you can unlock the Arcane Dark Caster CLASS for free! (Bring Dage a golden bone from the Skeletal Warrior in /graveyard, and he'll give you the class)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Shadowcraft Dark Gunner in your inventory.

quests.name: Shadowy Dark Gunner Owners: Arcane Class Quest
quests.description: If you have the Shadowy Dark Gunner Armor, you can unlock the Arcane Dark Caster CLASS for free! (Bring Dage a golden bone from the Skeletal Warrior in /graveyard, and purchase a 1k AC token from the merge shop and he'll give you the class)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Shadowy Dark Gunner in your inventory.

quests.name: Get Those Souls!
quests.description: As the years march on, Dage's need for souls only increases. The more powerful the soul, the better he likes them, and Dragon souls are the BEST. If you can bring in this type of soul, you will be rewarded with Tokens!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Arcane Paragon Pet (Pet) .

quests.name: Even More Souls!
quests.description: As the years march on, Dage's need for souls only increases. The more powerful the soul, the better he likes them, and Dragon souls are the BEST. If you can bring in this type of soul, you will be rewarded with Tokens!

quests.name: Keep Soul Searching!
quests.description: As the years march on, Dage's need for souls only increases. The more powerful the soul, the better he likes them, and Dragon souls are the BEST. If you can bring in this type of soul, you will be rewarded with Tokens!

quests.name: Sell Those Souls!
quests.description: As the years march on, Dage's need for souls only increases. The more powerful the soul, the better he likes them, and Dragon souls are the BEST. If you can bring in this type of soul, you will be rewarded with Tokens!

quests.name: Hearts and Souls!
quests.description: As the years march on, Dage's need for souls only increases. The more powerful the soul, the better he likes them, and Dragon souls are the BEST. If you can get Dragon Souls AND Dragon Hearts, you will be amply rewarded!

quests.name: Hearts and Souls! (Member)
quests.description: As the years march on, Dage's need for souls only increases. The more powerful the soul, the better he likes them, and Dragon souls are the BEST. If you can get Dragon Souls AND Dragon Hearts, you will be amply rewarded!

quests.name: Hemophilia
quests.description: I am to give you a tour of the God of Fiends' innards. Blood is guaranteed. If you would please dispatch the Bloodfiends stalking us down the path, we can hurry this act to its conclusion.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Adimonde's Invitation ' quest.

quests.name: A Dash of Hope
quests.description: The Hushed stir once more. They sense that Adimonde selected some of them to 'regurgitate' in order to entertain you. Tear them down, dash their hopes, and toss them into the abyss below. They'll come to understand that it's a mercy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blood Cultivation
quests.description: Do you smell that? The stench of copper and iron…I believe I'm familiar with who Adimonde plans to reconstruct to entertain you. Go deeper, find the junction where all these veins bind into a crimson knot, and learn for yourself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Forever Fall
quests.description: I have a suggestion…a dangerous one. It'd be ideal if we could discuss this without the Hushed and Blood Fiends distracting us. Cut them down, and send them back into the abyss of the Fiend's Void.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hydrops Fetalis
quests.description: Adimonde wanted to show you the Blood Cocoon, and the ancient Archfiend growing inside it. I wonder…can you smash it, and stop him from being reborn? At the very least, you can slow down whatever plans the Fiend God has in motion.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Skimmed Off the Top
quests.description: Rodeleros…we'll find her through the spiral. Void Fangs lurk there, and complete solitude made them forget their loyalty to Nulgath. They've been inside the Fiend's Void for too long. Kill them. I doubt their creator will sense anything amiss.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sleeping Soldier
quests.description: Rodeleros is nearby, and it appears that her cocoon hasn't been completed yet. The Arachnids are scurrying about, looking for sustenance to weave more silk. Crush them, and look for anyone who knows about this third rebirthed Archfiend.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Espadachina
quests.description: The Crystalized Cocoon looks studier than the one before. Smash it, burn it, do whatever it takes to ruin Adimonde's plan for the Archfiend growing beneath the silk. It's worth a try, even if it only serves to annoy the Fiend God.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ingrained in Flesh
quests.description: …I can sense Adimonde's intentions. They're ripping through my flesh. Apologies. Eliminate the rest of the Void Fangs and Arachnid Seekers. I must prepare myself, and there's nothing I can do to resist it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: I Know, Therefore I Suffer
quests.description: Meet me inside the tower all the way at the edge. Adimonde kept my old library, and intends for us to fight there for…your amusement. I humbly ask for you to make it quick. If it seems like I'm not making an earnest resistance, know that I have no choice.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stomach Pump
quests.description: You are destined to leave his Void, but no one is destined to follow you. Even if they do make it across the threshold, it will be as corpses. Whether it's the Void Fangs, the Arachnid Seekers, or even myself - cast them back into Adimonde's realm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Know, Therefore I Suffer ' quest.

quests.name: Stomach Pump (Legend)
quests.description: You are destined to leave his Void, but no one is destined to follow you. Even if they do make it across the threshold, it will be as corpses. Whether it's the Void Fangs, the Arachnid Seekers, or even myself - cast them back into Adimonde's realm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Know, Therefore I Suffer ' quest.

quests.name: The Tale Never Dies
quests.description: Weberich, famous author of Sepulchure's tale, lingers here in the depths of the Necropolis. Restore his tools to him and perhaps he'll have another tale to tell! Bring him 5 vials of Shadow Ink from imps, 1 Inkstone from the Shadowstones, and hunt for his quill and 3 parchments!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Blinded by the Darkness ' quest

quests.name: Lion Hunting
quests.description: Scout Onslaught Tower and see if you can find Archlord Lionfang. I don't imagine this will be that simple but the fates have been with us so far. Search every room and return to me for further instruction.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Really, VERY VERY TOXIC! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Secret Of The Death Fog
quests.description: The Golden Onslaught soldiers are not affected by the Death Fog. We have to find out how they are blocking the effect. Search 8 of the soldiers and keep your eyes open for anything unusual.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Really, VERY VERY TOXIC! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Key To Survival
quests.description: Every living Golden Onslaught Soldier in here is carrying, somewhere on their person, a Death Fog Protection Amulet. Do what you must to recover at least 4 Amulets.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Really, VERY VERY TOXIC! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Tools
quests.description: Archlord Lionfang's field alchemy skills are well known by the Shadowscythe Army. This Death Fog is an interesting creation but we can neutralize the effects with the amulets. I will need several alchemical reagents to chance how they function. Search the tower and bring me 8 alchemical reagents.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Really, VERY VERY TOXIC! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Talent
quests.description: The amulets are almost ready to neutralize the effect of the Death Fog for anyone in range, but their power needs to be amplified. Take these to Empress Gravelyn and ask her cast a darkness enchant on them, then bring them back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Really, VERY VERY TOXIC! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Local Locale
quests.description: The amulets are fully powered but for them to protect everyone in the area, you will need to place them in four key locations through the tower. I have drawn you a map. Make sure that you have placed all 4 amulets exactly where they need to be and return here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Really, VERY VERY TOXIC! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Who Holds The Key?
quests.description: Now that the Death Fog has been neutralized, it is safe for us to free the captives. The key to the dungeon must be around Onslaught Tower somewhere. Search 6 of the soldiers and return if you find anything.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Really, VERY VERY TOXIC! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Leave No Rug Unturned
quests.description: The key to the dungeon must have been hidden somewhere in the tower by the soldiers. Search every room until you find where the dungeon key is hidden and bring is back here as soon as you can!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Really, VERY VERY TOXIC! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tame The Lion
quests.description: Now that you have the key all that remains is freeing the heroes of Battleon and King Alteon. In the name of the Great Truce, in the name of Empress Gravelyn… Archlord Lionfang of the Golden Onslaught must fall!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Really, VERY VERY TOXIC! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: How Much Sharper Than Lion's Tooth?
quests.description: In our conquest of the tower we have claimed the Archlord's personal armor cache. Bring me one of the teeth from the great lion that he rides and I might be persuaded to reward you with one of his special armor pieces.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame The Lion ' quest.

quests.name: Fear An Ignorant Man More Than A Lion.
quests.description: In searching the tower, the Shadowscythe troops have uncovered a trunk of Lionfang's personal dress armor and weapons for formal occasions. Many of the troops would like to claim these items as the spoils of war. Bring me one of his lion's claws and I might decide to give them to you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame The Lion ' quest.

quests.name: Blood and Ashes
quests.description: First, we need a tincture. A tincture made of blood and ash… of life and death. The blood, you'll get from any of the invading forces. The ash, you'll take from the flames.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Blight On Us All ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Drink and Fight
quests.description: Drink the tincture, and you'll feel it changing you. Don't worry, it's only temporary. But while you're under its effects, you'll be able to extract the essence of time from any living thing. You'll need a lot. Go get it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Blight On Us All ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Oooommm
quests.description: I won't lie, this next part is probably gonna suck. Anoint yourself with the Essence of Time. Burn this incense I've made from it. And then meditate - the best place is on these pillows. You're gonna feel a little queasy, and you'll be dizzy for awhile. But… if you're strong enough, it will work.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Blight On Us All ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Shadows Recede
quests.description: Hey, Hero, mind making yourself useful while you’re still here? Go defeat some more of Malgor’s troops, it seems like not all of them got the memo.

quests.name: SMASH a Path
quests.description: There are too many of these Shadow creatures for me to think straight! Put them on ice so I can come up with a plan!

quests.name: Cold Open the Portal
quests.description: This "Dragon Gate" of yours seems like it will do the trick. It looks like we'll need to calibrate it to my world. The essence of these Shadow Creatures should do the trick! Bring me the essence of their specific locations and I should be able to pinpoint my Earth.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: VolcaNO Thank You
quests.description: It looks like Super Death is repeating his Trials from before. We'll have to fight our way through four areas before we get to his Shadow Realm. First up, the Volcano! Take out these Igneous Crabs so we can get a move on!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Return to Cinder
quests.description: The Cinder Bender was the boss monster Super Death sent last time! It seems just as dangerous as before! Get ready to SMASH your way through it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Hottica
quests.description: Oh no! It's my Arch Nemesis, Hottica! She has been taken over by Super Death! Do we really have to save her? No, you're right… But don't think I like the idea of saving her!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Liquidate Liberate
quests.description: These Slime Collectors have gobbled up these mall patrons! We have to free them! Make sure you don't hit them while you're attacking!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Lord of the Mall
quests.description: The Slime Lord upstairs is in complete control of all the Slime monsters in the area. We aren't getting anywhere with him in our way! Take him out so we can free whoever is in that Slime cocoon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Electina
