quests.description: The next captive you're going to face is Electina, the Electricity Heroine! She's a force to be reckoned with! I have no doubt you'll be able to break her free of Super Death's control!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Carpool Lane
quests.description: Here in Trader Town, it's a complete dump! It's in the future though! At least I hope this is the future and not the present! Things are looking pretty grim! But let's not think about that now! We got Riders coming this way!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The BlasterMaster
quests.description: The BlasterMaster looks like a huuuuge pain! Wait… Which one is the BlasterMaster? The big one or the one with the cat mask? Ehh, doesn't matter! Take them both on so we can get into that dome and save another hero!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: General Smash
quests.description: Uh oh, General Smash is next! He's a hero but he can be a little… "much" at times. Now that he's under Super Death's control, I think I'm just going to stay out of the blast radius! Good luck!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Left In-giRuins
quests.description: Ingiru is such an interesting place! So much history, mystery, and adventure! Not to mention that these frozen mountain tops really put me in my element! This is the final trial before we reach the Shadow Realm! Let's take out these Cave Yeti and get a move on!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Rock Me Khali May-eus
quests.description: It's Khali May, Guardian of Ingiru! Someone must have glued her back together or something because we destroyed her last time! Guess we'll just have to SMASH our way through her and see who lies ahead!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Charries
quests.description: It just had to be Charries! I don't really care for his whole bunnies-shtick! Like what's so evil about bunnies?! Let's just hurry and beat him up, then get out of here so I don't have to listen to him ramble on and on about all his pet rabbits!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Shadow Realm Cleansing
quests.description: First things first, we need to clear out a lot of these Shadow Monsters! Keep fighting until their numbers get small enough to have some breathing room!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Forging the Shadow Key
quests.description: It looks like we'll need to make a special Key to get into Super Death's room. Each of the 4 Shadow Monsters in this area should have the parts we need!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Charge the Key
quests.description: Go back and fight the Heroes and Villains we already faced and absorb the remaining energy inside them to completely free them from Super Death's control and charge the Shadow Key!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Super Death
quests.description: We have to be careful… Super careful! Super Death has powers you couldn't even imagine! I'm pretty sure he even has the power to give himself even more powers! It won't be easy, but we've beaten him before, and with you, we can beat him again!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: HeroSmashing
quests.description: Let's give you the true HeroSmash experience! No, I'm not talking about flying! I'm talking about fighting monsters! Wait, you do that in your world too? Well… I already had this planned so you get to do it the HeroSmash way! …No! You don't get superpowers either!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Super Death ' quest.

quests.name: Super Deadly Trials
quests.description: Super Death wants to watch you do his Trials again since he thought it was a game the first time… Just humor him, I think he's kind of lonely.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Super Death ' quest.

quests.name: Find Riddrug
quests.description: Head east again, but once you're past the gate, go down into the valley. That's where all the dragons are fighting. There's a Drakel out there who might be willing to help you with the second half of your job.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Stop Fightin' ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: World Wide Web
quests.description: My fellow Arachnids and I are currently constructing a massive web that we hope will one day span across the entire world. This may seem sill to some, but this web would allow every Arachnid in the world to communicate with one another. It would allow us to better understand the world around us with hopes of living in a peaceful society one day. Won't you help us achieve this dream? Collect 4 bundles of Interweb from our enemies: the Dreadspiders!

quests.name: Cocoon of Doom
quests.description: The Toxic Souleaters have been dubbed as such due to their aggressive lifestyle. But as of late, they have become drastically worse. Instead of eating only enough to survive, the Souleaters are now killing for the fun of it. This is not the way Arachnids should act. Wipe out as many Toxic Souleaters as you can and collect 10 Doom Cocoons from their grasp. Only then will they learn that gluttony is NOT the Arachnid way!

quests.name: A Web of Lies
quests.description: Have you seen the Toxic and Burning Souleaters? These Arachnids were once our ally, believe it or not. But then their outlook changed once Gressil took over. He told these spiders a web of lies and convinced them to rebel against the Arachnomancers… and anyone who sided with our kind. Their species grow stronger every day, and we have no choice but to eliminate the Souleaters before things spin out of control. Bring me back 8 Souleater Abdomens so that I may think you accordingly.

quests.name: Tyrantula
quests.description: A long, long time ago, the Arachnids lived together in harmony. We used to make beautiful, symmetric webs that would reflect our peaceful, symmetric lives. But the rise of Gressil changed that. This tyrant tarantula always showed an intense hatred towards the Arachnids and their carefree way of life. He became obsessed with absolute power and eventually destroyed our once peaceful lifestyle. Please, hero, you must defeat Gressil untill he surrenders! Only then can the Arachnids look forward to a promising future once more!

quests.name: Sticky Situation
quests.description: Our war with Gressil has taken a toll on my fellow Arachnomancers and our arachnid allies. Bring me 8 bundles of spider silk from any of the enemy spiders in Twlight, and I can use it to bind their wounds. I'll need the stickiest silk you can find, so it will hold.

quests.name: Understaffed
quests.description: We've gained some allies against Gressil and his loyalists, but they will need to be armed before they can help us fight. Battle Gressil's dreadspiders and confiscate their bone staffs — our new combatants can fight with those.

quests.name: Soul-ar Power
quests.description: Gressil gains power from each soul that his souleaters consume. Defeat the Toxis Souleaters and the Burning Souleaters, and free the souls from their control

quests.name: Insert Brain Pun Here
quests.description: Some Arachnomancers have theorized that Gressil may be keeping his followers loyal via mind control. Collect brain stems from a Dreadspider, a Toxic Souleater and a Burning Souleater. If we compare enough samples we should be able to help us determine if this is true.

quests.name: Soul Food
quests.description: This is not common knowledge, but Gressil himself is a souleater, too. He consumes the souls of each Arachnomancer he kills. Please, defeat him, and free the soul of one of these brave Arachnomancers.

quests.name: A Sample of Twilight
quests.description: The Dreadspider Army is at it again! A new tunnel has been formed just beyond Gressil's nest, leading to who knows where. Explore this passageway and bring me 3 Tunnel Samples from the creatures you find within so that I can take into account any new threats.

quests.name: None Shall Remain!
quests.description: I need to keep the wonderful realm of Twilight Vampire & Lycan free… and I can, with your help! Monsters from the Graveyard are seeking shelter in the Mausoleum, and it is only a matter of time before other Darkovian creatures do the same… like glittering Vamps and buff Lycans. Hunt down 10 Rattlebones and bring me their remains. All of their remains. That way , scavengers will never find the entrance to this sacred place…

quests.name: Breaking Prawn
quests.description: Deep within the tunnels rests a foul creature, one that even Gressil would bow to. It goes by the name of Cadaverous Creeper, and when you see it, you will understand why. This prawn cannot be taken down solo—you will need the aid of other Arachnomancers if you wish to defeat this great beast. Bring me the Creeper's Head to prove your sucess.

quests.name: Arach-kids
quests.description: Dreadspiders are infesting this cave, and their webs are going to prevent us from reaching their wretched creation. Break open their carapaces, and release the souls trapped inside.

quests.name: Arachnosapien
quests.description: Trapped within the Abaddon's Carapace are human souls, if I were to guess. Those muffled screams…This creature is a Dreadspider creation that will curse us all. Cut it down, and break it open. They cannot be allowed to exist.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Timely Meating
quests.description: Business was booming awhile ago… but I can't sell what I don't have! I have run completely out of meat, and if I don't get any soon, I will have to close my shop. But, if a certain hero would, like, get me some more, then maybe I can give that certain someone a prime cut in exchange! I need 10 Top Loin Steaks from Safiria's Lycans, 10 Chicken Drumettes from Chaos Chickens, and 10 pieces of Sliced Bacon from wolves on Skullcrusher Mountain. Hurry!

quests.name: Pet Food Delivery
quests.description: Hi there! Say, maybe you can help me out. My delivery of hay from the Farm is late, and all my animal friends are getting hungry. I'd go get it myself, but the last time I left these guys alone, they wandered into town and it took me DAYS to round them up again. I'm not sure exactly where you might find my hay, but I hear that scarecrows are made from bundles of hay… (Return to Aria in the Battleon Pet Shop once you have 5 bundles of hay.)

quests.name: Starving Pets
quests.description: This is a disaster! Almost all of my pet supplies have been sent to the pet shop in Swordhaven! I can't leave these guys alone or they'll start eating each other. Could you go get some food for me? 10 Rat Ears would be great, and Yulgar's basement is crawling with Greenrats! (Return to Aria in the Battleon Pet Shop once you have all 10 Rat Ears.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Picky Eaters
quests.description: Thanks for the help but things are still insane around here. Some of the pickier eaters won't touch the rat ears. Maybe you could go get some fish from the Zardmen Fishers and River Fishmen by the river. They probably won't give them up without a fight. I think 5 fish will do. (Return to Aria in the Battleon Pet Shop once you have all 5 Fish.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Missing Crate
quests.description: Excellent! Now that everyone has a full belly I can concentrate on the missing pets! A crate of trobbles never made it off the delivery ship. I think that Shark Bait, leader of the fishmen, must have the crate on him. You'll find him on the ship in Lolosia! (Return to Aria in the Battleon Pet Shop with the Trobble Crate.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wilderness
quests.description: Oh NO! The crate is empty and I have so many orders to fill! Say, could you capture a wild trobble for me? Don't worry, I'll train it…I just need you to catch it for me, The Guru Wetlands are the the only place that I know of around where you can find wild trobbles. (Return to Aria in the Battleon Pet Shop with the Wild Trobble.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Trobble Bath
quests.description: Ew! This wild trobble has all kinds of sticky swamp goop on him! There is only one thing that I know of that can clean out trobble fur and feathers and that's a slime based shampoo. I'll need 10 jars of Slick Slime. You should be able to find some slimes near the pizza shop in Swordhaven. (Return to Aria in the Battleon Pet Shop with 10 Jars of Slick Slime.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Home Sick
quests.description: The trobble seems to be dying of homesickness! Deep in the Marsh there is an powerful undead named Soulseeker. His robes will be full of musty swamp spores and fungus that will remind our trobble of home! He's dangerous so I'd bring a few friends, but be quick… the trobble is fading fast! (Return to Aria in the Battleon Pet Shop with the Musty Robes.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Animal Army for Aria
quests.description: I can't just sit here when Grams is in Danger! Help me build an animal army so that I can got after her! If you don't, I'll just run off and do it myself! If you'll help, bring me 3 captured wolves, 5 captured wereboars, and 2 captured spiders.

quests.name: Find Food in Greenguard West
quests.description: My baby red dragon is hungry! I need you to bring back 3 chunks of Frogzard meat from Greenguardwest to feed my pets!

quests.name: Spider Snacks in GreenGuard East
quests.description: My brown wolf LOVES spider snacks. Go to Greenguardeast and bring me 3 Spider Snacks!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slime Soup in Swordhaven
quests.description: My Slime needs soup to stay slick. Go to Swordhaven and slay slimes for 2 bowls of Slime Soup.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: SneevSnax in Boxes
quests.description: Sneevils LOVE snacking. Slay the 4 sneevils guarding my pet snacks in Boxes, then return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Meaty Bones in Graveyard
quests.description: All my pets love gnawing on bones. Go to Graveyard and slay Skeletal Vikings for 5 Meaty Bones.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cheese in the Sewer
quests.description: Green rats love green cheese, and the only place to get it is in the sewer. Go to the Sewer and slay Frogdrakes for 3 pieces of stolen cheese!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Toe Jam in Shadowfall
quests.description: The Skeletons in Shadowfall make the best Toe Jam. Slay Skeletal Warriors for Toe Jam jars and bring it back to me. My pets love a sweet treat!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spy-ce Cream in Mobius
quests.description: All animals love a sweet treat every now and then. Slay 4 Chaos Spy-es for Spy-ce Cream!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dew Drops in Faerie Forest
quests.description: Young fairies can get mighty thirsty. Bring me 6 Dew Drops from the Chainsaws Sneevils in the Faerie Map!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tesseract Gems in Cornelis
quests.description: Baby Gargoyles feed on Tesseract Gems. You can find 4 of them on the Gargoyles in Cornelis. Hurry, Hero!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Turtle Meat in Dwarfhold Keep
quests.description: If I'm going to raise strong pets, I need to feed them healthy food. Bring me 4 pieces of Turtle Meat and 3 bowls of Turtle Soup from the Red Shell Turtles in the Pines area!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wisteria in ForestChaos
quests.description: Chaorrupted Wolves in the Forestchaos map have the wisteria petals I need to heal my pets. Slay 1 Chaorrupted Wolf to bring me the petals.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Supplies in ChaosMarsh
quests.description: Chaos Spiders steal so much of my pet supplies. Bring me 1 spool of Spider Silk and 4 boxes of Cake from the Chaos Spiders in ChaosMarsh!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rice Milk in Hachiko
quests.description: All kittens need milk! Bring me 3 bottles of Rice Milk from the Ninja Nopperabo in Hachiko!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tasty Treats in Bamboo Forest
quests.description: My birds love the treats from the Bamboo Forest! Slay the Tanuki there and return with 5 Bamboo Twigs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bat-bones in Darkovia Graveyard
quests.description: Who doesn't love a good crunchy snack? Bring me 5 Bat-bone casseroles from the Albino Bats in Darkoviagrave!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Main Meal in Safiria
quests.description: A hearty meal is just what my pets need! Bring me 5 Maggot Meals from the Blood Maggots in Safiria's castle!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kibble in Lycan Ridge
quests.description: All pets love kibble… especially the kind Direwolves eat! Slay 4 Direwolves in Lycan for their kibble!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tune-a Fish in Mythsong
quests.description: Birds and beasts love music… and fish! Slay 6 Tune-a Fish for their Fillets in Mythsong!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rock Lobsters in Stairway
quests.description: For a gourmet meal, I like to feed my creatures Rock Lobster. But I can only get them in Stairway. Slay 3 Rock Lobsters for Rock Lobster meat!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Zard Stew in Orchestra
quests.description: My pets love singing for their supper… and they love supper that sings! Bring me 3 bowls of Zard Stew from the Mozards in Orchestra.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Seed Crystals in Arcangrove
quests.description: Many of my pets are magical, and they need magic food! Bring me 6 Seed Crystals from the Seed Spitters in Arcangrove!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Snows Cones in Northlands
quests.description: A frosty meal on a hot day is tasty stuff! Bring me 3 Freezerburnt Wyrms and 5 Snow Cones from the Frostwyrm Riders in the Northlands.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dessert in Sandsea
quests.description: I must have dessert from the desert! Bring me 4 jars of Cactus Jelly from the Creepers in the Sandsea!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ectoplasm in Doomwood
quests.description: Doomwood Ectomancers carry ectoplasm puree, a salve I use for my pets. Please slay 5 Doomwood Ectomancers for 5 jars of Ectoplasm Puree!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sandwiches in Doomhaven
quests.description: Skeletal Soldiers carry the tastiest tongue sandwiches into battle, and I want some to feed my pets! Slay Skeletal Soldiers in /Swordhavenundead, /BattleunerA or /Doomhaven and return to me with their Tongue Sandwiches.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Boar Bits in Bloodtusk
quests.description: Horcs love a good bit of boar for dinner, and so do my pets! Bring me back 2 Boar Bits from the Horc Boar Scouts in Bloodtusk!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Watery Soup in Etherstorm
quests.description: Sick pets need bland food, so bring me back 5 bowls of watery soup from the Fish Wings in Waterstorm!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sneak Spit in TheSpan
quests.description: Sneak Spit and Shadowscythe Bits are rare treats for my pets! Go to TheSpan and bring back 1 Sneak Spit and 4 Shadowscythe Bits from the creatures there!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bloodtears in Blackhorn Tomb
quests.description: In Blackhorn Tomb, the Restless Undead weep bloodtears, and it makes a great medicine for my pets. Slay 2 Restless Undead in Blackhorn for Bloodtears!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Strange Golden Egg
quests.description: Your golden egg smells… strange, Hero. But I know what will open it! Kill the Marsh Smell-Os in the /chaosmarsh and Marsh Lurkers in /marsh to bring me 3 Fumes and 3 Tears.

quests.name: Slimy Golden Egg
quests.description: Your golden egg feels… slimy, Hero. But I know what will open it! Kill the Slimes in the /swordhaven and Slimeskulls in /temple to bring me 3 Goo and 3 Oozes.

quests.name: Moving Golden Egg
quests.description: Your golden egg is… rustling, Hero. But I know what will open it! Kill the Wisteria in /guru and Treeants in the /doomwood to bring me 3 Roots and 3 Leaves.

quests.name: Cracking Golden Egg
quests.description: Your golden egg is… cracking, Hero. But I know what will open it! Kill the Vultragons in the /mountainpath and Red Birds in /creatures to bring me 3 Feathers and 3 Talons.

quests.name: Strange Platinum Egg
quests.description: Your platinum egg smells… strange, Hero. But I know what will open it! Kill the Marsh Smell-Os in the /chaosmarsh and Marsh Lurkers in /marsh to bring me 3 Fumes and 3 Tears.

quests.name: Slimy Platinum Egg
quests.description: Your platinum egg feels… slimy, Hero. But I know what will open it! Kill the Slimes in the /swordhaven and Slimeskulls in /temple to bring me 3 Goo and 3 Oozes.

quests.name: Moving Platinum Egg
quests.description: Your platinum egg is… rustling, Hero. But I know what will open it! Kill the Wisteria in /guru and Treeants in the /doomwood to bring me 3 Roots and 3 Leaves.

quests.name: Cracking Platinum Egg
quests.description: Your platinum egg is… cracking, Hero. But I know what will open it! Kill the Vultragons in the /mountainpath and Red Birds in /creatures to bring me 3 Feathers and 3 Talons.

quests.name: Wait for Cabdury
quests.description: My friend Cabdury the Rabbit is coming to town on Wednesday. Once he arrives, he will give you a quest for the Hammer you need! If you want, you can check with General Porkon in /orctown to see if he's left a message for me.

quests.name: Platinum Egg Hammer
quests.description: To hatch and egg you've got to BREAK some eggs! Head to /uppercity in Dwarfhold and crack open the Chaos Eggs there. ONE of the eggs you break open will have the hammer you need, but you may need to keep at it for a while!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Platinum Egg in inventory.

quests.name: Golden Egg Hammer
quests.description: To hatch and egg you've got to BREAK some eggs! Head to /uppercity in Dwarfhold and crack open the Chaos Eggs there. ONE of the eggs you break open will have the hammer you need, but you may need to keep at it for a while!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Golden Egg (Misc) (Legend) in inventory.

quests.name: Moglin Companions
quests.description: Twilly, Zorbak, and Twig want to journey alongside you, Hero! But before they can leave for your adventures, you'll need to make sure you've got enough MEALs (Moglin Emergency Accessory Luggage) packed away. Battle the Frogzards in Willowcreek or Nexus and bring me back 3 hunks of Frogzard meat and I'll whip a MEAL right up!

quests.name: Where's Twilly?!?
quests.description: Someone stole Twilly! I heard him call for help, and then -- nothing! Please, you have to help me find him! There must be clues around here somewhere!

quests.name: Through the Yulgar Portal!
quests.description: I didn't see where she went, but… she uses portals, you say? There's a portal over there. If you hurry, you might be able to catch her!

quests.name: Gotta Snatch 'em all!
quests.description: If you're able to catch one, you can have your very own Mogzard pet! The PockeyMogs tend to stay close to home. Look for their closest monster relative and you may just find one!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.name: Gotta Snatch 'em all!
quests.description: If you're able to catch one, you can have your very own Fishlin pet! The PockeyMogs tend to stay close to home. Look for places where they might seem to fit in! (Think water for the Fishlin)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.name: Gotta Snatch 'em all!
quests.description: If you're able to catch one, you can have your very own Groglin pet! The PockeyMogs tend to stay close to home. Look for their closest monster relative and you may just find one!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.description: If you're able to catch one, you can have your very own Mogdrake pet!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.description: If you're able to catch one, you can have your very own Mogcicle pet! The PockeyMogs tend to stay close to home. Look for their closest monster relative and you may just find one!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.name: Gotta Snatch 'em all!
quests.description: If you're able to catch one, you can have your very own Bubblin pet! The PockeyMogs tend to stay close to home. Look for their closest monster relative and you may just find one!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.name: Gotta Snatch 'em all!
quests.description: If you're able to catch one, you can have your very own Vizally pet! The PockeyMogs tend to stay close to home. Look for their closest monster relative and you may just find one!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.name: Gotta Snatch 'em all!
quests.description: If you're able to catch one, you can have your very own Toglin pet!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.name: Gotta Snatch 'em all!
quests.description: If you're able to catch one, you can have your very own Mucklin pet!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.name: Gotta Snatch 'em all!
quests.description: If you're able to catch one, you can have your very own Blood Moggot pet! The PockeyMogs tend to stay close to home. Look for their closest monster relative and you may just find one!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.name: Gotta Snatch 'em all!
quests.description: If you're able to catch one, you can have your very own Moglurk pet! The PockeyMogs tend to stay close to home. Look for their closest monster relative and you may just find one!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.name: Gotta Get PockeyChew!
quests.description: Wow, you're sure good at getting Pockey-mogs! There's one more Pockey-mogs that I think you're going to want to get, but it's going to be hard! Travel all over Lore to get a lot of Pockey pucks in order to be able catch PockeyChew! I should be able to hold one here for you to try to catch when you get back!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' They're Gonna Wreckit! ' quest.

quests.name: Sledge-a-tarian
quests.description: No! What did they do to all the pretty animals?! So much gore! I can't bear to look at it. Please, make it all go away!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' TOO PINK! ' quest.

quests.name: Find Lucky!
quests.description: Oh, no! Lucky is missing! I turned my back and she was just… gone! Please, help me find her! She kept trying to run off after the monsters here, so maybe some of them will give us some clues where she went. Examine the landscape, too - if you see anything out of the ordinary, let me know!

quests.name: Gather a Scouting Party
quests.description: I've been hearing a few people around the camp whispering about spotting Kolyaban - in the same area that Lucky disappeared from! They're talking about organizing a scouting party, and I'd like to be part of it.

quests.name: Bad Dog
quests.description: Please don't hurt Lucky! It's not her fault that his happened to her! If you can just knock her out… if we can catch her and bring her back to camp.. maybe I can find a way to heal her. Please, we have to help her!

quests.name: Contain the Pollen
quests.description: Tera has covered the area ahead of us in poisonous pollen - does she really think that's going to stop me? Bring me some Haleﬂowers from the Blossoming Treeants. I think I can use them to create a protective barrier for us all.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Reach the Top ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Pass Through the Pollen
quests.description: That pollen will be no trouble for us now! Meet me on the other side of the pollinated area - and destroy any big clouds of pollen you see on the way!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Reinvigorate the Sprout
quests.description: Thanks to ShatteredReality.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Up We Go!
quests.description: Alright, let's get out of here! Meet me at the top of the beanstalk!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Grow a Bridge
quests.description: You see that, in the distance? That's the Orb of Nature. We'll have to get across these branches to get to it. If you bring me some Fungal Spores from the Myconids up here, I'll use them to grow fungal bridges between the branches. You'll just need to tell me where you want them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Take Down Terrane
quests.description: If the Avatar of Nature wants me to prove myself in battle, then I will. I'm not a strong ﬁghter myself… but with my abilities, I might be. I guess that's the point, isn't it?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mouth of a Home
quests.description: Right off the bat, we have piles of suspicious slime sliding around the entrance. Dad said he was using them to clean the floors. Then he spaced out and said they're used for cooking. Yeah, we should mop them up and dump them outside.

quests.name: Windpipe Hallway
quests.description: The entire hotel should be booked full, but the halls are so quiet. How about we knock on each of the guest room doors, and see if anyone's around to chat? I think I saw Valencia, her dad, and one of Aurelio Voltaire's cute critter friends around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Maceration
quests.description: My head really hurts. It felt like something grabbed my head, and stuck a hot iron into my skull. Suddenly, I saw a red flash, and a dark figure scurrying down the hall. It looked…alien and freaky. Hurry and catch it! That thing might try to attack my dad!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cryophobia ' quest.

quests.name: Mockingbird
quests.description: I want to help Mom and Dad clean up the hotel. Would you mind giving me a hand? We'll give you extra portions at dinner! I'm so excited! I don't think I've ever tried my mom's cooking before.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Maceration ' quest.

quests.name: Drosanthemum
quests.description: The search for the Great Dragon of Nature is going to start easy, because Maedoc and the other Druids have our first lead. The Fae folk witnessed the Dragon's birth. Find a Fairy named Dew Drop, and the Tree of Life.

quests.name: String of Turtles
quests.description: Dew Drop mentioned that the grouchy Red Shells knew the legend we're looking for. That's a species of turtle, but even with my knack for understanding animals, I don't know where we would find them. If the Great Dragon of Nature was there, then maybe it's some kind of forest?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Aconite
quests.description: Our next keyword is the Cloister! Have you been there before? Or rather, have you met the Cloister? Find them, and get rid of the pests bothering her. The Karasu keep gobbling up her fruits. We'll hear her voice more clearly without all the cawing too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blood Red Carnations
quests.description: The trail's about to go cold. Only the dead can continue this tale. Luckily, I was just reading up on other people who went on this same search. Their graves are in a dark forest, but 'need to be avoided' because of a blood maggot invasion. Watch the skies and pay attention to the clue the Cloister gave us, or else we won't find anything.

quests.name: Cottongrass
quests.description: The clue from the graves gave us a new lead! Argento said that a member of his Dragonlord Order went missing a long time ago. Only his Dragon came back. They joined an expedition through a place with blinding snow. If I'm right and it's also considered a forest, we need to catch some golems.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hebeloma Aminophilum
quests.description: This is where things get really hard. I found traces of black snow, but I have no idea where it's from. We just need to find at least one of the expeditioner's who went looking for the Great Dragon of Nature before us. A journal would be amazing! Maybe we'll even find critters I can communicate with.

quests.name: Annual Mercury
quests.description: The clues we found so far make it clear that the Great Dragon of Nature's family loved her despite what happened. Maybe we can catch her trail again if we look into her brother. Metal Dragons, huh? Will lizards work? Even snakes? If you happen to find metal snakes during your adventures, bring them back here! I'll talk to them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gorshka Maika
quests.description: Zakhvatchik was a name mentioned by the Quicksilver, and they said his corpse is the Great Dragon of Nature's plaything now. I don't know where this Dragon is, but finding him means reaching our goal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Alchemilla
quests.description: We're so close, I can hear the Great Dragon of Nature's voice in my ears. Her name…you'll find her beyond Zakhvatchi's corpse, lurking deep in the Yokai's well of life. Her latest toy, the carcass of a goddess, holds the final clue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Arianne Vivaldi
quests.description: The Great Dragon of Nature is named Koschei Yaga. She is trapped in a state of decay, spreading death and strife wherever she goes. I know the location of her den now. Valencia's ready to collect her artifact, and I want to learn more about her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: People and Scarecrows
quests.description: The Great Dragon of Water is named Hyonix, and the descendants of her last Dragonlord are farmers. Some freaky Scarecrows are giving their friends trouble, and they asked us to help take care of it…Oh, they didn't give me a location. I mean, it shouldn't be that hard to find.

quests.name: Dolphins and Sharks
quests.description: According to Sinclair's descendants, he and Demien met Hyonix on the coast. Pirates were attacking her, and Demien bravely came to her rescue while Sinclair hid behind a rock. Know of a pirate dock somewhere? Maybe the Fish have stories they passed down too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragons and Lizards
quests.description: The Fishmen said that after Hyonix was rescued by Demien, she left to find a gift for him. A Merdraconian Pearl. It'd help if you could bring some back. Do you know a place where they school together? I think they're somewhere near Arcangrove…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Water and Oil
quests.description: The Merdraconians' account mentioned the Riverwalker family, who wrote down all of Dragonlord Demien and Hyonix's exploits. Let's find a member who's still alive, and do them a favor in exchange for their help. I'm sure they need to get a few creeps and crawlies off their back… I mean, doesn't everyone?

quests.name: Black Silk and White Fleece
quests.description: Pirates were scared of Hyonix and Dragonlord Demien, but something happened, and it gave them their confidence back. What did the Riverwalker's Archive say again? Did it specify which pirates went looking for revenge? If they were already hunting Hyonix, maybe they have clues we can use.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sunlight and Moonbeams
quests.description: We need four special keys to unlock Hyonix's chest. They aren't necessarily metal keys, but items of significance. "His body sank where the sea bathes in sunlight." Does that make sense to you? A place in the sea, bathed in Sunlight. I think I've been there before.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Midnight and Noon
quests.description: We need four special keys to unlock Hyonix's chest. They aren't necessarily metal keys, but items of significance. What do you think of when a body falls into midnight? Maybe this involves ghosts? Wraiths? That's not too bad. My dad's inn has to get vacuumed for ghosts all the time.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lie and Truth
quests.description: We need four special keys to unlock Hyonix's chest. They aren't necessarily metal keys, but items of significance. What do you think of when the sea falls into the abyss? If we need seawater from that far down, is there a place that's already there?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Odette and Odile
quests.description: This is going to be the hardest part of our search, getting the blood of Hyonix. That's the final key to her treasure chest. But, we have no idea where she is. Do you know of any relatives? I know Great Dragon Eggs don't hatch unless the original dies, but that's all we have to go off of.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hyonix's Treasure Chest
quests.description: The chest's four locks can be opened with specific keys. They likely won't be typical metal keys, but items of significance to the Great Dragon of Water and her last Dragonlord.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sinclair and Demien
quests.description: If you have all the keys needed to open Hyonix's Treasure Chest, take what's inside and accept my quest. We'll be able to find Hyonix, or at least something she holds very dear.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Grassroots Opinion
quests.description: Akriloth isn't exactly a mystery, but Dragonrune Hall is interested in learning what other Dragons think of him. The idea is that we're looking for general opinions that may lead us to, uh…his fans. Know any Dragons nearby? Maybe in Greenguard forest?

quests.name: Flame War
quests.description: That Green Dragon said we should ask Fire Elementals about Akriloth. They're both related to Lady Fiamme, right? It'll be interesting to hear what they have to say. I think the nearest Fire Elementals we can get our hands on are in that Keep dad always told me to stay away from.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ashes Reignited
quests.description: We have several voices that claim they've always been against Akriloth, but I'm surprised we haven't found a fanatic yet. The Elementals we talked to said that there were loyalists hiding out in someone's lair. That's not very smart. We're going to find them in no time.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Feldspar Silica
quests.description: Akriloth's Generals are still out there. They didn't follow the Great Dragon of Fire just for his strength. There's another reason, and 'even molten stone will remember.' I don't know how we'll get literal fire and rocks to talk to us. Uh, know any nice golems?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Convective Conversation
quests.description: It turns out that getting fire and rocks to talk isn't so hard. We're being pointed towards 'lava where Lady Fiamme's name is lauded the most.' Have you been to a place like that before? Maybe there's a lava equivalent of Living Fire over there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spicy Chicken
quests.description: Lady Fiamme and Akriloth's Dragon Generals believed and relied on him heavily, partly because the Titan and old Champions of Fire were…chickens. Do you know what the Titan of Fire is? Is it a literal chicken or what? We could at least get a little more insight from finding it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Akriloth's Inferno
quests.description: You noticed that some of the Titan's old battle scars came from Akriloth proving his might to Fiamme, but there was likely another Dragon with him. Who would he trust to have his back? A partner? Perhaps more? This could lead us to Akriloth's surviving generals.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Scattered Embers
quests.description: After Akriloth's defeat, his egg was taken, and the Elementals took more interest in us humans. Let's ask them to help us find Akriloth's remaining Generals. You saved them from Malgor during that war. Why not refresh their memory to get them talking?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tempered Restraint
quests.description: Akriloth's surviving Generals might have a blood relation with his mate. We need someone who can track them down, and that's the greatest Dragonslayer in Lore. Think he could help us? He's the Champion of Fire now, so why not meet up with him where you used to train together?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Extinct Volcano
quests.description: The Great Dragon of Fire is dead, and his egg was taken away. His Generals are still alive, and we're going to meet them. Let's see if grudges are burning holes through their chests.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragonlord Dreams
quests.description: The Great Dragon of Energy was apparently a showstopper. He flaunted his power wherever he went, and people fought to be his Dragonlord. The Elves were noted to be the most fixated on him. Hmm, the few I know of are the Drow…despite their ties to Chaos. Think that'll be a problem?

quests.name: Background Noise
quests.description: Hopeful Elven Dragonlords that wanted to partner with Volgritian would hire the Drow in secret to get rid of the competition. The de-Chaosed Drow said a few of the assassins 'upstairs' are descended from those killers. I'm sure they'd be willing to brag about their great-great-great-grandparents' work.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Manticore Prince
quests.description: According to the Assassin's Records, Volgritian waged a one-Dragon war against Manticores. Apparently he fought seven at once, and they were the pets of an arrogant prince. Where did that prince live? If that place still exists, there must be people guarding it. They could know something.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Solid Clouds
quests.description: If we could get our hands on Volgritian's scales, we could compare them to other samples to find a clear trail. Problem is, the ones we know are his got swept into the clouds. Where would a storm gather that's close to the Manticore Prince's home? It should be nearby.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Electric Rivalry
quests.description: I had the scholars appraise those scales, and there was an exact match from somewhere else! The site of a Draconic duel on a mountain range where perpetual storms rage. Why are they being so secretive? Did Volgritian duel someone? We should find them, and any witnesses if possible.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Dragon's Dignity
quests.description: Something happened to Volgritian, and it led to his disappearance. His prideful rivals may have had something to do with it. Outside of the Dragon we just investigated, are there any other Energy or self-proclaimed Storm Dragons out there that would have loved to take Volgritian's place?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Show Horse
quests.description: Based on what we learned, did Volgritian disappear because of Lord Haeos? Valasarian's interview didn't say anything about the Drow, but he did mention Elves across the sea. I heard some of them met Queen Victoria in Greenguard, but at someplace other than Swordhaven. Where would that be?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Elemental Executioners
quests.description: The Elves said that the Energy Elementals agreed that the descendants of Lord Haeos' favorite Champion deserve to own Volgritian. They're currently 'among the yew trees.' I think we'll have to head across the sea to find those… and some Elementals to interview.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pride's Grave
quests.description: An Elven King tried to force Volgritian to become his Dragon steed, and he retaliated by crushing the guy's head. Haeos and the Energy Elementals punished Volgritian…It can't go on like this. We need to find the Great Dragon of Energy, and…What? Do you already know where he was trapped?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: King of the Tempest
quests.description: Volgritian said that he's willing to meet us! Haha, I'm suddenly all nervous. This is my first time meeting one of the Greats face to face. Please, lead the way!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Molting to Revive
quests.description: My Dragonlord's berserk state of mind is emanating an aura that is attracting black wyverns. Their presence will make it difficult to contain him, but they seem to be related to the Hollowborn as well. Examining their scales could help us.

quests.name: Dragon's Despair
quests.description: My Dragonlord's mind has been broken by despair, and he is lost in an eternal, mindless rampage. I beg you, please defeat him. It may calm him down, and bring him back to his senses.

quests.name: Studying the Bard
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Bard's rejuvenating composition, O'Carolan's Reel. The Bruise Brothers may have a copy - they've been known to play it on occasion. To fully understand how bards use this ability, try to get some lo-fi recordings of it - from a music pirate, maybe?
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 15.

quests.name: Studying the Berserker
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Berserker's retaliatory ability, Blood For Blood. Many Horcs are berserkers, so one of them may have what I need - perhaps the Sellsword in /Sandport? Bring back a couple of Rage Potions, too - the Horc Warriors often carry them - so we can truly feel what it's like.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 20.

quests.name: Studying the Blood Ancient
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Blood Ancient's life-stealing ability, Regeneration. Sanguine, in Lycan Ridge, has been known to carry a scroll detailing it. Bring back some Vials of O-Negative to practice with, too - Albino Bats are a good source for it.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 15.

quests.name: Studying the Blood Titan
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Blood Titan's self-sacrificing skill, Blood Thief. Of course, no one knows more about that than the Blood Titan himself, in East Greenguard Forest! I've heard the trick to this ability's slowing effect involves the venom of spiders. You should be able to find some in the surrounding woods.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 20.

quests.name: Studying the DragonSlayer
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the DragonSlayer's Dragon-targeting ability, Bane of Scales. The info I need was recorded by Galanoth himself, but has been stolen by the Red Dragon in Vasalkar lair. To help us understand this skill better, bring me some of the most unbreakable scales you can find from the Draconians there.

quests.name: Studying the Healer
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Healer's iconic restorative ability, Healing Word. While not our ally, the Chaosweaver Cleric in /chaosweb has knowledge of this skill as well. Some Potions of Intellect will help us practice it - you should be able to get some from the Chaosweaver Magi in /ravenloss nearby.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 25.

quests.name: Studying the Legendary Hero
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Legendary Hero's devastating attack, Legendary Crater. To gain this knowledge you'll need to visit a different crater - the one that formed when the /comet hit near the Guardian Tower. The monster it brought with it will have what you need.

quests.name: Studying the Mage
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Mage's protective spell, Arcane Shield. This one, you'll have to travel to the Mirror Realm to find - seek out Evil Archmage Brentan in Lightovia Cave. To practice it, we'll need a few good wands, too. Nethermages carry some exceptionally well-made ones - wherever they may be found.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50.

quests.name: Studying the Ninja
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Ninja's stunning skill, Shadowburn. For this one, you'll want to turn to the shadows themselves. Find the Fragment of Doom in the Shadow Void, and you'll get what we seek. We'll need a few Motes of Shadow to really get it right - you should be able to get some from the Shadowfiends nearby.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50.

quests.name: Studying the Ranger
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Ranger's targeting skill, Mark for Death. And where would you learn about this skill but from Death himself? Hunt him down in either /shadowattack or /underrealm. To truly understand this class, we''ll need some gunpowder, too. The best source for that is Pachelbel's Cannons, wherever you may find them.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 40.

quests.name: Studying the Rogue
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Rogue's deadly finishing move, Opportunity's Strike. This skill works alongside poison, so in order to fully understand it we'll need some poisoned daggers to practice with. Drow Assassins often carry them. D'wain Jonsen utilizes the poison of a scorpion mixed with the sneakiness of a Rogue - he has the Scroll that you require.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 15.

quests.name: Studying the Oracle
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Oracle's unpredictable ability, Group Divination. We will want a few divining crystals as well. Dimensional Crystals work well for this. You can find them in /yasaris and in /whitehole. Sekt in the /fourdpyramid will be holding on to the Scroll containing the Group Divination knowlege.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 45.

quests.name: Studying the Thief of Hours
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Thief of Hours' timebending skill, Sonic Piledriver. The data we need has been lost to Lore… but it still exists inside the Cathedral of Time. You'll need to fight the Incarnation of 2016 to find it, though! We'll need a few Spacetime Anomalies to get this one right. Unfortunately, the best source of those is Timewraiths. But you can survive a few of those, right?
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 45.

quests.name: Studying the Warrior
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Warrior's defensive stance, On Guard. For this one, you'll need to battle through the Celestial Arena - it's in the possession of the Infernal Warrior. To master this one, we'll want a few good shields as well. Go to /onslaughttower and take them from the Golden Warriors.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 20.

quests.name: Gather Flowers
quests.description: As Attar says, if we want Rangda to show herself, we'll need to lure her with the offer of a gift. Flowers of seven forms—this is what she loves the most. Gather some flowers from the bushes nearby… be sure to get a nice mix.

quests.name: Purify the Tuyul
quests.description: We can use my Celestial power to lure Rangda closer. Fight her Tuyul and I will use my power to purify them. You will bring me their purified auras.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Create a Barrier ' quest.

quests.name: Give an Offering
quests.description: Kill as many evil spirits as you can manage… hopefully that will help us get Rangda's attention. Then, place this offering for her at the main gate. It's the flowers you plucked before… as well as the auras you helped me purify.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat Rangda
quests.description: Rangda is here, and BOY is she mad! Now’s our chance, friend—we’ve got to fight her NOW! We can’t allow her to harm anyone else.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Widow's Wail
quests.description: We'd like to commemorate the battle between good and evil, and tell the story of your fight with Rangda through a ceremonial dance! To do that…we'll have to get you to reenact her defeat. I'm sure she's still angry enough to appear before us again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Rangda ' quest.

quests.name: Nusantara Defender Medali
quests.description: The people of Nusantara are grateful for all that you've done, my friend, and would like to show our thanks. If you are able to defeat the three deadliest foes in our land, I can craft a special Medali award for you to display.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Rangda ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Arlette's Birthday Quest
quests.description: So, Hero! It may be my birthday but that doesn't mean I don't have something prepared for you! Celebrate the day with me. I love collecting old celestial artifacts, be it from the Celestials themselves or the Infernals. Sometimes they have leftover magic that may put others in harm should they stumble upon them. If you find any at the /celestialrealm, they would make a lovely gift! I'll be sure to give YOU a gift too!

quests.name: Undead Assault (Storyline)
quests.description: The army of the undead swarms the streets of Swordhaven. They are being dropped out of the giant flying castle above the city! Protect the people of Swordhaven by slaying 10 skeletal soldiers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Artix's Defense Quests .

quests.name: Skull Crusher Mountain (Storyline)
quests.description: The Skeletal Ice Mages are trying to break the castle walls with their ice magic! Give them the cold shoulder… battle Skeletal Ice Mages and bring me back 8 Frozen Bone Heads. Maybe we can use them to put out some fires!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Artix's Defense Quests .

quests.name: The Undead Giant (Storyline)
quests.description: The undead army of darkness has sent a Undead Giant to smash open the gates of the castle. We are the only means of defense between the undead and the castle. Defeat the Undead Giant before he succeeds and bring me back his Undead Giant's Sword to boost the morale of the townsfolk!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Artix's Defense Quests .

quests.name: Bony Battalion
quests.description: The Undead have overrun DoomWood and are closing in on Lightguard Keep! The bony battalions, led by skeletal sergeants, must be driven back if the town is to stay safe! Bring back proof that you've faced our foes skull-on!
quests.requirements_note: Must go to Lightguard Keep first, watch the cutscene upon joining, and complete any quests from either Axe , Brute , De'gree or Lady Speedstyk in order to access the following quests. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Warrior Rez-queue
quests.description: We are not sure where all of the Paladins have disappeared to, but in their absence, the Keep's soldiers have been valiantly battling the Undead! Unfortunately, our warriors are being beaten back, and some have fallen. Please, Hero, rescue them before the Undead can get to the wounded!
quests.requirements_note: Must go to Lightguard Keep first, watch the cutscene upon joining, and complete any quests from either Axe , Brute , De'gree or Lady Speedstyk in order to access the following quests. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bone-tired Backup
quests.description: I've just received word that there is a lone warrior guarding the clearing at the end of the upper-hand path. Waves of Undead are attempting to bury him! Can you help him defend this vital vantage point?
quests.requirements_note: Must go to Lightguard Keep first, watch the cutscene upon joining, and complete any quests from either Axe , Brute , De'gree or Lady Speedstyk in order to access the following quests. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reconnaissance Route
quests.description: Relay messengers from the front have sent word that they have seen our worst nightmare in action. Undead Paladins! Hero, please, to put an end to our fears, make your way SOUTH through the fighting to see if these horrors - perhaps our fallen warriors - have actually had their Light extinguished.
quests.requirements_note: Must go to Lightguard Keep first, watch the cutscene upon joining, and complete any quests from either Axe , Brute , De'gree or Lady Speedstyk in order to access the following quests. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fight Against Shadowed Light
quests.description: We CANNOT leave the animated bodies of our slain in the hands of the Undead. Even if they are fighting against us! Please, Hero, liberate the Undead Paladin. He- he would want to be free!
quests.requirements_note: Must go to Lightguard Keep first, watch the cutscene upon joining, and complete any quests from either Axe , Brute , De'gree or Lady Speedstyk in order to access the following quests. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Camouflage: Skelly-Style
quests.description: It has been decided. To easily move behind enemy lines, you will need to go undercover and place a transport rune. To know your enemy, you must BECOME your enemy! Ha! No, we're not going to kill you, Hero. But you will need to make an Undead-costume to feel just like one of those numbskulls.
quests.requirements_note: Must go to Lightguard Keep first, watch the cutscene upon joining, and complete any quests from either Axe , Brute , De'gree or Lady Speedstyk in order to access the following quests. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: De(ad)ception
quests.description: It's all up to you now, Hero! Now that you're my Undead slave, you have no choice but to serve me! May the Darkness be with you and the Light be never at your back. (Takes place in /doomundead - you must go there to do the quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must go to Lightguard Keep first, watch the cutscene upon joining, and complete any quests from either Axe , Brute , De'gree or Lady Speedstyk in order to access the following quests. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can also be found in DoomUndead .

quests.name: A New Recruit
quests.description: Before you go, head to Ol' Spice in /lightguard and get a cup of his Blessed Coffee of the Right Guard. It will give you added protection against the undead you will face. I know you can handle yourself, but I'd feel terrible if you were turned into a lich while you were doing a favor for me.

quests.name: Well of Knowledge
quests.description: There is a trial every Celestial must go through. They must visit the Well of Knowledge to find out their purpose. There will be many battles on your quest to locate the Well, so be prepared!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Path Revealed ' quest.

quests.name: Gather the Artifacts
quests.description: The Well does not give its knowledge freely. First, you must gather sacrificial artifacts to activate its power. There should be one representing every creature you've seen in this Realm, as well as one representing the Realm itself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Path Revealed ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Oh Well, Oh Well Guardian
quests.description: The Well holds one final test. The Well Guardian, a construct created by the Bright One to hold the purpose of every Celestials creation. Prove your worth to it and it shall reveal your purpose to you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Path Revealed ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Infernal Commands
quests.description: These Infernals are taking commands from Azalith herself. They should know where she is, so let us retrieve intel on her location.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Path Revealed ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Forward Unto Azalith' quest.

quests.name: Forward Unto Azalith
quests.description: Azalith’s forces will not let us easily approach her. We must fight our way through if we wish to confront her!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Path Revealed ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Azalith Faced
quests.description: There she is! We are not prepared to face her, but we must! Give it your all, Hero!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Path Revealed ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Wretched Limbo
quests.description: Aranx has been taken by The Bright One, but we must prepare ourselves before we attempt a rescue. Temper your blade against the Infernal Knights, Maah-na, Akh-a, and Azalith.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith the Disavowed ' quest.

quests.name: Bright Paladin Presents
quests.description: Welcome to your 15th Anniversary party, Hero! To celebrate 15 years of your epic achievements, victories, and adventures, I have commissioned 4 new weapons for you. But that cake smells SO GOOD… I cannot remember where I put your gifts. Please bring me a slice of cake, a fork, and a bottle of Holy Wasabi (from the Birthday Cake) to help me remember.

quests.name: Soulless Paps
quests.description: I would love to show you inside the Skull Dome, but we have to wade past the Photoghoulphers first! Please go ahead and slay them before they snap pictures of us trying to nap again.

quests.name: Vanquished from the Premises
quests.description: Our dressing room is on the left, past all of the plaque-caked teeth - and the Necroupies that Brain Matter sent to mess with us. Do your bodyguarding thing and shut those sour fans out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clear Space, Clear Mind
quests.description: Alina and Zhoom are excited to see you again! They are holding out in the dressing room on the far left. While we head there, we should clean up all the trash the Necroupies left behind.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rusty Metal
quests.description: We are going to head over to the Brain Matter's dressing room to ask them to get their fans to stop stalking us. Their dressing room is all the way to the right, but we will need to defeat the Armored Zombies blocking the way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Concert Crush
quests.description: Is that a tidal wave coming towards us? No, it is a crush of Photoghoulphers and Necroupies stampeding towards us! Stop them before they turn us into the DeadPCs!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hashtag Dead Ugly
quests.description: We could not convince Brain Matter to stop their fans from attacking us, so we will have to forge through it during the concert! Please escort our band inside the arena, and keep those Photoghoulphers at bay!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ghoulish Fan Culture
quests.description: The final concert clash is about to start, and we need to get to our stage on the left side of the arena as fast as possible. The Necroupies are already there, so do your bodyguarding thing and kick them out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: No Honor Among Rockers
quests.description: Brain Matter is on the second stage, but it looks like Larryn and Bellum are out in the crowd! This could be our chance to make this a clean clash! Go over there and convince them to call their raving fans off of us any way you can!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Musical Altercations
quests.description: Look! Brain Matter's drummer and guitarist just hopped off the stage to talk to their fans! Oh, wait, nevermind… they're just coming over here to rearrange our faces. We need you to head over to the right side of the arena to keep them in their lane!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lacking Brain Substance
quests.description: When Brain Matter said 'form up', they meant it extremely literally! They have fused into a giant brain, and sucked us into some kind of neural pocket dimension! The NPCs can not fight during the concert, so we are counting on you to give this massive mind a serious concussion!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Revive the Encore
quests.description: The crowds are demanding an encore, and we can not just let the stage stay empty! We need to call on you again to keep what remains of Brain Matter from interrupting our performance! Take out that giant half- a-brain!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lacking Brain Substance ' quest.

quests.name: Undead Invasion
quests.description: Greetings and salutations! The city is overrun with undead. I think the Doom Knight Sepulchure is behind the invasion. (At least that is what he said on the homepage.) They picked the wrong town to mess with! It is time to push them out of the city. Defeat undead minions to earn Slayer Medals. Bring back 20 and I will have your next quest ready for you! (Return to Artix in the Swordhaven Inn with 20 Slayer Medals.)

quests.name: Defend the Gates
quests.description: More undead are trying to push through the front gates. There is a really big one with them too! We need to hold them off. Take some friends with you and defend the bridge at all costs. Defeat the big one and bring back his weapon to boost the morale of the town! (Return to Artix in the Swordhaven Inn with the weapon.)

quests.name: Undead Slaying!
quests.description: If there is one thing all Paladins must be good at, it is slaying the undead! Go to the Graveyard and turn the enemies you find there into nothing more than piles of bones. Bring me 20 Graveyard Tokens to prove your might and I will give your next quest on the path to become a Paladin

quests.name: Evil Must Be Stopped!
quests.description: One of a Paladin's most serious missions is to protect the innocent from evil! Journey to the Marsh and the perils of evil there. Return 2 Marsh Lurker's Eyes to me for your reward.

quests.name: I Heal Good!
quests.description: Paladins must utilize the magical powers of healing in much the same way as Healers themselves do. Search for a werewolf and bring me back his Regenerative Aura to help us learn more about healing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Undead Assault (Storyline)
quests.description: The army of the undead swarms the streets of Swordhaven. They are being dropped out of the giant flying castle above the city! Protect the people of Swordhaven by slaying 5 Skeletal Soldiers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Enter The Gates ' quest.

quests.name: Skull Crusher Mountain (Storyline)
quests.description: The Skeletal Ice Mages are trying to break the castle walls with their ice magic! Give them the cold shoulder… battle Skeletal Ice Mages and bring me back 6 Frozen Boneheads. Maybe we can use them to put out some of the fires!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Undead Giant (Storyline)
quests.description: The army of darkness has sent an Undead Giant to smash open the gates of the castle. We are the only means of defense between the undead and the castle. Defeat the Undead Giant before he succeeds and bring me back his Undead Giant's Sword to boost the morale of the townsfolk!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Curve Bladed Polearm
quests.description: Turn in your Defender Prize for a new amazing item! Defender Prize drop during war events.

quests.name: Infantry Pole Axe
quests.description: Turn in your Defender Prize for a new amazing item! Defender Prize drop during war events.

quests.name: Infantry Blade
quests.description: Turn in your Defender Prize for a new amazing item! Defender Prize drop during war events.

quests.name: Pactagonal Armet
quests.description: Turn in your Defender Prize for a new amazing item! Defender Prize drop during war events.

quests.name: Red Eye Staff
quests.description: Turn in your Defender Prize for a new amazing item! Defender Prize drop during war events.

quests.name: Yellow Eye Staff
quests.description: Turn in your Defender Prize for a new amazing item! Defender Prize drop during war events.

quests.name: Defender's Winged Armet
quests.description: Turn in your Defender Prize for a new amazing item! Defender Prize drop during war events.

quests.name: Pactagonal Defender's Crested Armet
quests.description: Turn in your Defender Prize for a new amazing item! Defender Prize drop during war events.

quests.name: Undead Trooper Guard
quests.description: Turn in your Defender Prize for a new amazing item! Defender Prize drop during war events.

quests.name: Infantry Helm
quests.description: Turn in your Defender Prize for a new amazing item! Defender Prize drop during war events.

quests.name: Undead Infantry Armor
quests.description: Turn in your Boss Prize for a new amazing item! Battle prizes drop during war events.

quests.name: Undead Infantry Guard
quests.description: Turn in your Boss Prize for a new amazing item! Battle prizes drop during war events.

quests.name: Skeletal Mage
quests.description: Turn in your Boss Prize for a new, amazing item! You can obtain this from any of the Lich bosses here.

quests.name: The First 6 Chapters
quests.description: Ahhhhhhh! PINK!! There is pink everywhere!! We have to stop Beleen and her army of pink-ites. Hero… you must reassemble the ancient book which can stop this madness. Battle Ghosts until you have found the first 6 missing chapters.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Giant Brain Slime Prime ' quest.

quests.name: The Last 6 Chapters
quests.description: You have survived thus far. But make haste, Hero… you must find the next 6 chapters of the ancient book. Battle *shudder* Pink Skeletal Soldiers until you collect them all. The fate of the world lies with you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Glossary
quests.description: We have all of the chapters, but we need the glossary to make sense of these strange magical words. Saying the wrong ones could make Beleen's army of pink monsters even stronger… and pinker! Venture into the back room and find the Glossary from whatever has it hostage.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cover Me
quests.description: Alright… we just need the cover of the ancient book. Then we can cast the spell and stop the pink evil once and for all! This will be very dangerous though. You will have to battle *looks down grimly at his chainsaw* the PINK HAND in the other room. That monster is keeping a grip on the cover… you may have to defeat him a few times to get him to drop it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: MoglinRider Daimyo
quests.description: Only a few heroes on Lore are capable of convincing a Moglin to ride atop a dog… but I think YOU can do it! We just need enough Battle Puppy treats. And you know what THEY love… BONES! Bring me 10 Undead Heads from the Skeletal Warriors in /graveyard and I bet Daimyo will let a moglin ride him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Daimyo (Pet) in inventory to accept. Note: Previously Legend only.

quests.name: Legion Armored Daimyo
quests.description: May the Legion guide you, because I certainly won't. My price is far too high for a Hero like you.To make his Daimyo's Legion Armor, you will need: 15 Souls of the Destroyed from the Dark Elementals in the ruins, and the Black Metal Armor item (battle the Black Knight in Greenguard), and the 4 Shadow Serpent Essences. You will also need a Daimyo pet, (only available in Battleon on his birthday)! Once you have them, open my merge shop!

quests.name: Descent into Darkness
quests.description: To enter the depths of the Necropolis, blood, sweat and bones are required. For each Skeletal Bellhop you slay, you'll descend one floor lower. Kill 10 Bellhops on this first foray into the darkness.

quests.name: To be continued next week...
quests.description: The Secret Order of Undead Slayers will continue the exciting task of reforging the Blinding Light of Destiny next week… complete this quest and you will have not to wait.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Golden Armored Daimyo
quests.description: Daimyo, my fierce Battle-Pomeranian, is ready to level up!To make his Golden Armor, you will need:1 Golden Scarab Pet from Sandsea, 15 Hearts of Flame from Living Fires and The Black Metal Armor item (battle the Black Knight in Greenguard)! You will also need a Daimyo pet. (only available in Battleon on his birthday)! Once you have them, open my merge shop!

quests.name: Undead Assault
quests.description: Just like you remembed, the army of the undead swarms the streets of Swordhaven. They are being dropped out of the giant flying castle above the city! Protect the people of Swordhaven by slaying 10 Skeletal Soldiers.

quests.name: Skull Crusher Mountain
quests.description: The Skeletal Ice Mages are trying to break the castle walls with their ice magic! Give them the cold shoulder… battle Skeletal Ice Mages and bring me back 8 Frozen Boneheads. Maybe we can use them to put out some of the fires!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Previously called "Skull Crusher Mount-again" .

quests.name: The Undead Giant
quests.description: You took the Undead Giant down before, and you can do it once more! It is the only thing standing between you and the castle. If you're going to save the King again, you'll need to beat it! Defeat the Undead Giant before he succeeds and bring me back his Undead Giant's Sword to boost the morale of the townsfolk!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Previously called "The Re-dead Giant" .

quests.name: Keep the Area Clear
quests.description: Zombies are all around us, my friend! Defeat 3 of them so that we can help Gravelyn face her destiny!
quests.requirements_note: Must have watched the Battlezom cutscene.

quests.name: Defeat Zombie Dragons
quests.description: They are coming right for us! The dragons Zombie Galanoth had for lunch are here to snack on you, Hero! You will need to defeat 3 of them before they destroy Battleon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Your Fallen Friends
quests.description: If we are going to save Zombie Cysero, Alina, Rolith, and Zhoom, we will need to subdue them first. Defeat each of your friends so that we can save them later.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Long Unlive the King!
quests.description: Zombie King Alteon must be defeated if we are to have any hope of returning him to life. Head to the second room inside the in and take down your King!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dark Sepulchure Must be Slain!
