quests.description: It is time to face your Darkest foe… in his Darkest armor! Slay Sepulchure for the Good of all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hunt for the Brutal Intruder
quests.description: It is always good to begin at the beginning. Search the rooms closest to the Lobby for any obvious intruders besides BrutalCorn. Come back and tell me what you've seen.

quests.name: Brutal Detection Desired
quests.description: No one expects a BrutalCorn attack! That is why we must place Brutal Detection Devices throughout the Lab. Put them in the War Room, the Lobby, at the beginning of the hallway, and at the end of the hallway.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Silence the Green Screamers
quests.description: Since you are here hunting BrutalCorn, I would be grateful if you could take out some of the intruders from the LAST invasion. There are 7 Green Screamers left in the Green Screen room.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Soundbooth of Horrors
quests.description: I have another favor to ask, Hero. While I guard the Lobby from more invaders, please clear out 13 of the Soundbooth Horrors blasting Warlic's audio recordings or we'll NEVER get that Critical Hits vol 2 CD recorded
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Skeletons in the Server Closet
quests.description: It is time we cleaned out the closet. Take out the 5 skeletons hiding in our server closet… and maybe you'll learn the secret of the Lag Monster.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Server Gremlags
quests.description: Maybe we have not found the hiding place of the Lag Monster, but when you cleaned the server closet, we found many server gremlins! They cannot be helping the lag; take out 8 of the gremlins!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Window Slayer
quests.description: I GOT A NEW AXE! Getting new weapons is one of my most favorite things. And what better way to practice our Windowslaying skills than by knocking out ALL the windows in the Lab?! Destroy 15 just for fun!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gamer Fuel
quests.description: I have just received word that MORE invaders have been spotted! Or… NOT spotted, which is the problem! Cysero says he can smell invisible invader ninjas stealing our lunch! Find the invisible ninjas and bring back the snacks!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Key to Doom
quests.description: Hero… I have some serious news. The Room of Gloom is the ONLY place left BrutalCorn could be… and the Rabid Server Hamster is the keeper of the key. (It is the safest place to hide it!) Defeat the hamster to get the key and get in that room!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: UltraBrutal Battle
quests.description: To save the Lab (and the members of the AE Team), you must defeat BrutalCorn!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chunin Tokens
quests.description: We have got a lot of cleaning up to do now that the party has REALLY started. I will tell you what… bring me some Ebil Fragments from defeated EbilCorp Monsters and I will give you a Chunin Token!

quests.name: Chunin Tokens for Members
quests.description: As a Member you are a little bit stronger than the average player. I think you can probably bring me entire Ebil Chunks from the EbilCorp Monsters without getting too much Ebil all over your nice clean armor.

quests.name: Just In Time
quests.description: I do no why Alina and Rolith are here but they ARE here. We need to find them, I am afraid they might be in trouble. Search Time Portal, find our friends and protect them from anything that might want to do them harm!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Missing Happy Couple ' quest.

quests.name: Saving Time
quests.description: If we are going to free Alina and Rolith then we are going to have to buy them some time. You will have to gather Silver Minutes from Silver Ephemerites and Golden Hours from Golden Ephemerites. See if you can get them a whole extra day!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Break Time!
quests.description: Now that you have gotten Alina and Rolith some time, you've got to shatter the hourglass of their own fears and anxieties. Once you do that they will be able to get married!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: I Guess We DO Need Steenkin' Badges
quests.description: Oh no, hero — did you see that? One of those skeletal ravers just stole your con badge! You had better get it back quickly, before they kick you out of the convention!

quests.name: Con Kit
quests.description: Now, back to putting together our "con kit"! We cannot enter the convention until we collect all of the things we need to survive it! See what you can get from these Cosplay Zombies — what a great excuse to slay some undead!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: BrutalCorn Barrier
quests.description: Get ready, Hero! The most brutal boss EVER is blocking the way into the convention, and none of are getting inside until he's defeated. That's right — you are going to fight BRUTALCORN!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Badge Signing
quests.description: One of the best parts of any convention is collecting autographs from all of your favorite celebrities. Come on hero - we are going to visit all of the game tables and get everyone to sign our badges!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Con Rot
quests.description: Did you hear someone sniffle? We can not allow BattleCon to be infested with Con Rot! Those Con Crudlings are the source of the infection. We must stop them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'BrutalCorn Barrier' quest.

quests.name: Buzz-Killer: Caffeine Overload
quests.description: We will not be able to cross through this hall until these awful Caffeine Imps have been dealt with! Put them to sleep so they will not be able to steal our energy!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'BrutalCorn Barrier' quest.

quests.name: Lights Out for Ravers
quests.description: Oh no! Those Raver Skellies have stolen everyone's glow necklaces! You know what that means - it is time to battle some undead!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'BrutalCorn Barrier' quest.

quests.name: Silent but Undeadly
quests.description: Phew! After a few hours in a tightly packed and poorly ventilated area, the convention really starts to stink! If we defeat the Battle Odor, we can get the con smelling fresh again!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'BrutalCorn Barrier' quest.

quests.name: Cosplay Zombies On Parade
quests.description: I do not like the number of zombies that are at this con! What do you say, hero? Will you help me clean up the area to keep the con-goers safe?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Badge Signing' quest.

quests.name: Find the Unholy Wasabi
quests.description: There's something fishy about these cursed artifacts, Hero! You'd best question the mistress of maki rolls, Tasanee in Fangblock Sushi. Maybe she's seen something that could tell us about the Unholy Wasabi!

quests.name: Find Cysero's Doom Sock
quests.description: Well, Hero… Cysero is one of my best friends, but I cannot lie -sometimes his socks are… ripe. Gross is a better word. And if his sock has been cursed, then I do not even WANT to think what it smells like, or where it ended up. Probably in a sewer somewhere… or buried in muck.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Recover Cursed ChickenCow Claw
quests.description: You found Cysero's Doom sock! That was not an easy task. I think you're up to hunting the third artifact now. A whisper in my dreams said it was in the stars… high above our heads. And that Cysero's dreams would lead us there. But I do not know what that means.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find Zorbak's Haunted Staff
quests.description: I nearly got MAULED trying to get back here in time to meet you after patrolling Northpoine, Hero. To find Zorbak's Haunted Staff, you should head into Doomwood and question him… or one of his creatures. That may help.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Dragon Khan's Corrupt Scepter
quests.description: The Dragon Khan resides in Akiba when he is not traveling to tournaments around Lore. I would question one of his samurai to see what they know.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Locate Sir Ver's Power Button
quests.description: LOL! I am not surprised that Sir Ver's power button has been cursed! You should hunt around the Secret Underground Lab for clues about that… slay some monsters or windows there, for good measure.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Gravefang
quests.description: Gravefang MUST NOT find Death's Hourglass before we can free Yurei! Defeat him in battle to drive him away so you can continue hunting for the HourGlass.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can also be accessed at Gravefang (Location) .

quests.name: Recover Death's Hourglass
quests.description: The hourglass… has been here all along?! But that does not make sense! We are going to need to uncover this mystery, hero, and to do that… You will need to find the Hourglass! Go see if Yurei is still by the well. If she is, come back here and you will be able to retreive the hourglass.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: 1st Contact
quests.description: Think there is Undead on that Space Station? You just bet Artix 10,000 gold that there is. Teleport over to the first room of the Space Station and find proof!

quests.name: SO SLAY WE ALL!
quests.description: Artix says, "SPACE ZOMBIES! It is time for us to get to work! Slay the undead… and be certain to take their guns… In case they get back up O_o. SO SLAY WE ALL!"
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Starship Troopers
quests.description: Scraps of paper have been found with strange writings upon them. "Bandit" "Canadian Interjection" "Up in the air" and "Telling falsehoods". Many ideas have been thrown around as to what this all could mean. Interrogate the troopers to see if they remember anything!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Takai Me On
quests.description: Artix says, "You need to take the long hall to get to the center of the Space Station. It is HEAVILY guarded by automated turrets… and some sort of alien!?"
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: We are the HORG!
quests.description: "WE ARE THE HORG. RESISTANCE IS IMPOSSIBLE. PREPARE TO BE ASSIMILATED!"
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fix the Holodeck
quests.description: Artix says, "There are too many of them… but I have a crazy plan. For it to work, you will have to fix the Holodeck and bring it online."
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gorn in 60 Seconds
quests.description: Welcome to the Holodeck Combat Simulation! Help Captain Kirkland build a cannon. Battle Dra'gorns to collect a Bamboo tube, some Black Powder, and pointed Diamonds to construct it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Captain Kirkland
quests.description: Captain Kirkland: *Speaking over dramatically* I… spilled… my coffee… on… my new… Captain's shirt! Can… you get…. me… a new… one?. How about… a RED one! It… will… impress… all the green…. space babes. (Return to the S.S. Paladin to either buy or use the Replicator to create a Red Space Paladin Shirt.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cowboys vs Alienz
quests.description: NEW! Presenting Holodeck historical fact recreation. This is a simulation of the read duel at the O.K Corral between cowboys and Aliens. NOTE: We have armed the holograms with real lasers that will kill you if you are hit. Learning is fun! Thank you for choosing Holodeck by EbilCorp (™)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Recover J6's Head!
quests.description: Artix says, "WAIT! Sensors are detecting that the android known as J6 is there in the Holodeck's O.K. Coral… well, his head is. Duel every monster in there until you find J6's head!" (15% drop)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Titanic II
quests.description: NEW! Welcome to the Holodeck vacation mode. Please obtain "Heart of the Galaxy" to continue before the ship sinks and you drown. To simulate a realistic demise, if the ship is submerged underwater, you will be teleported outside the Space Station into the empty void of space. Have a great vacation! Thank you for choosing Holodeck by EbilCorp(™)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Holo-Yulgar's
quests.description: NEW! Welcome to Holodeck's "FANTASY RPG" program. This is a faithful recreation of the historic original Yulgar's Inn. EbilCorp scientists have enabled PvM (Player vs Moglin) combat so that test subjects can finally achieve their life long dream of beating the original giant feed and football shaped head Twilly up and steal his poorly drawn leaf.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Holodeck Survival Rate
quests.description: Ebilcorp(TM) Holodeck prides itself on a super low 1% survival rate! Due to your extraordinary performance, you have thrown off our curve. Please stand still as our laser turrets disintegrate you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Space Paladin Survivors!?
quests.description: How is this possible? Artix said no life forms were detected on the Space Station. Talk to all six of the Space Paladins and figure out what is going on!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Trouble with Trobbles
quests.description: Oh no! The Trobbles are getting into the circuitry… and they are multiplying like CRAZY! Defeat 12 Trobbles.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: THEY LIVE!
quests.description: Artix says, "Careful! Those Trobbles were actually turrets. You are still on the Holodeck!" Take out 5 Turrets."
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: AlienZ
quests.description: Artix says, "I am detecting LOTS of alien life forms! They are all around you, and in the ceiling. Where is Sigourney Weaver when you need her!?"
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: DO NOT OPEN - Space Door Codes
quests.description: Artix says, "Do you see a door that says DO NOT OPEN? We need to open it! The code to open the door was split up and given to five crew men. You will have to battle the undead cyborgs and find all five pieces of the Space Door Code.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Search for Spork
quests.description: Artix says, "Head to the mess hall. You should see a bunch of chairs and tables there. Try to find some Space Sporks… we can test them to see if they were contaminated with anything that would have caused the crew to get Space Madness."
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Crew Cut
quests.description: Artix says, "You are getting close to the command bridge! The enemy forces will be strongest here."
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Restore Life Support
quests.description: The best way to weaken the evil undead… is to restore life support! The automated healing systems will start 'healing' the undead… which is about the meanest thing you can do to them if you think about it."
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: DREAD SPACE BOSS
quests.description: Artix, "What *IS* that thing!? It is part undead.. part alien… and completely fused in with the ships computer systems. Oh no! It looks like it just figured out about the TOP SECRET cargo that is hidden in the final room of the ship. You MUST defeat that Cyborg Brain Beast Monster!"
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: DREADER SPACE!!!
quests.description: Defeat the TRUE FORM of the creature that took over the Space Station! Whatever it is… it is clever. It poisoned the crew with tainted food giving them space madness, then lured two separate forms of aliens onboard to wreck the place searching for the Top Secret Cargo. At least it did not find the SELF DESTRUCT BUTTON.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pink Stinks!
quests.description: Have you smelled Slimes? They are already stinky to begin with… but now that Beleen has turned them pink, they are ruining nostrils and eyeballs everywhere! Please squash those Slimes before someone gets seriously hurt… or slimy. ALSO! Take down those Pink Bows that Beleen left all around town. It is killing the real estate value.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Paladin in Peril ' quest.

quests.name: Rats, RATS!
quests.description: Swordhaven's mousetrap budget got cut, and now the Sewer is infested with Beleen's Chaos-infused Rats. If you thought Slimes smell foul… get a whiff of those things. Wait, on second thought… do not do that. Just defeat enough rats to thin their numbers to prevent the Chaos outbreak from spreading.

quests.name: AdventureQuest Worm
quests.description: Woah, you saw WHAT down there?! A cute version of Grumble? *shudder* No one can handle this much cuteness. It MUST be stopped! Put the suffering beast out of his misery and bring back whatever he leaves behind — it could be a clue.

quests.name: UnBEARable Sight
quests.description: That fluffy monstrosity is a clue: Beleen is on the hunt to collect more Pink Teddy Bears. Pinewood is to the north of Swordhaven, home to some of the fiercest… and fluffiest… bears in all of Lore. They do not stand a chance against Chaos Queen Beleen. Hero, can I count on you to go check out Pinewood Forest and bring back proof?

quests.name: Too Much Pink in Pinewood!
quests.description: GAAH! There is just too much PINK in Pinewood! You must fight off the pinkness by removing all the Pink Bows from Monsters and cutting down those Pink Bushes. Bring back your proof of your un-pinked triumphs.

quests.name: Kill Sparkletooth
quests.description: A knight's worst nightmare has come to fruition: Beleen has transformed the grizzly TwistedTooth into the pink and purple and *gulp* sparkly SparkleTooth! I cannot be within 9000 feet of that beast, so it is up to YOU to defeat it!

quests.name: The Citadorable Plot
quests.description: WOAH. Those plans you found… they show Citadel being transformed into Citadorable! There still might be time to save Citadel… but we have to move FAST. Please, travel to Citadel and see if you can find ANYTHING out of the ordinary… like, say, a giant Rainbow or something. Whatever you find… you may want to talk to them!

quests.name: Obtain the DragonStar Radar
quests.description: To begin our search, we will need something that can track the energy signature of the Z Crystals. Talk to Warlic in /Battleontown, Rayst in Arcangrove, and Sora to Hoshi at Dragonrune Hall to see if they can whip something up.

quests.name: Find the First DragonStar Crystal
quests.description: According to the radar, the first DragonStar Crystal is located somewhere far beneath the waves. See if you can use the radar to pinpoint its exact location. Perhaps one of the local monsters might have it?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Second DragonStar Crystal
quests.description: The next DragonStar Crystal appears to be deep in the territory once owned by Maximillian Lionfang… Please use the radar once more to find out where it is located.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Third DragonStar Crystal
quests.description: The third DragonStar Crystal seems to be located near an area of great heat. We should put the radar to use once more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Fourth DragonStar Crystal
quests.description: The fourth DragonStar Crystal is…hmm?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Fifth DragonStar Crystal
quests.description: We are almost halfway done! According to the radar, the fifth crystal is located deep in the Etherstorm Wastes, surrounded by very similar energy signatures. It seems we must search among crystals to find the crystal we seek!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Sixth DragonStar Crystal
quests.description: The sixth DragonStar Crystal seems to be located somewhere on Dragon Koi Island, in what seems to be a forest. I hear that none of their trees resemble anything here in Greenguard.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Raid the Bandits
quests.description: It seems we were not the first to arrive. These Desert Wolf Bandits are well-known for their sandy shenanigans, but the allure of the Z Crystals must have lead them here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: HAMmer the Fabled Oinklong
quests.description: What an odd creature…I am sure Cysero would love to study it, but we do not have the time. Defeat this monster so we may move closer to our goal!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Great Horccolo
quests.description: Another obstacle stands in our way…but be careful, Hero. This Horc seems different from any we have encountered before.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eliminate the Legion Cyborgs
quests.description: Oh no…even the LEGION is interested in the power of the Z Crystals! We cannot allow Dage to get his sinister Dage-hands all over that wish!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pulverize Majic Guu
quests.description: This creature…could it be the Dragon Road's true guardian? I do not know what kind of powers it may have, but do not let it intimidate you, Hero!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cleaning up the Guu
quests.description: Oh no…by defeating the guardian, it seems we triggered its hidden failsafe! Unless we clean up this ENTIRE gooey mess, we will not be able to proceed forward!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Super Dragon Twig!
quests.description: The Z Crystals have corrupted Twig, and now he intends to have ALL the fish and ice cream in the world! As his friends, we must stop him together!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hyperbolic Training Session
quests.description: The high altitude and intense gravity of this location makes it a GREAT place to train! Defeat these monsters again in order to bring your power levels to greater heights!

quests.name: Gather Energy Beans
quests.description: To keep our endurance up, we should look for a source of sustenance. I hear there is a local bean that packs a LOT of energy into just one little bite! A few of them should keep us revitalized.

quests.name: Defeat Perfect Beiza!
quests.description: Uh-oh…it looks like Beiza is back, and he is NOT in a happy mood. But I am confident that you can take him down!

quests.name: Deep in the Darkest Night
quests.description: You should start by scouting out the area. No one has ever found this weapon, but if the legends are true then we are not the first to hunt for this weapon. We might be able to learn from those who quested before us. Be on the lookout for any evidence of dead heroes and anything they might have left here that could be useful.

quests.name: When There is no Spark of Hope
quests.description: Do you hear that? GHOULS!!!!! Deal with them quickly. We do not want any other undead hearing this and rushing our way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Horde Token I in your inventory.

quests.name: Points of Light
quests.description: After reading a little of this journal it looks like getting this weapon will not be as easy as I had hoped. The zombie hunters camped in there for days and still did not manage to find it. If we hang around here too long we will draw the attention of too many zombies for us to handle. Take these holy wards and cover our tracks to prevent zombie hoards from sneaking up behind us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Horde Token II in your inventory.

quests.name: Piercing the Darkness
quests.description: Take a look at this 'We just lost James and Geordie. The zombies breached the front door of the temple. They covered the gap and fought off the first few valiantly but were taken off guard when armored Zombie Knights appeared. I mourn for my friends, but I can't help but wonder who, or what, is organising them'. There is a more detailed description of the battle but it is pretty bleak. In my experience a horde that big always leaves a few behind. Go through the temple and clear out any zombies and armored zombies that you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Horde Token III in your inventory.

quests.name: They are Not in a Forest
quests.description: We've never seen zombies equipped for battle like this before. We need to figure out who… or what… is organizing these zombies. Something much stronger than a regular necromancer is behind his. Kill any undead in the area and see if you can find missing pages of the journal. Hopefully it can shed some light on what is behind this.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Horde Token IV in your inventory.

quests.name: Holy Dragon Teeth
quests.description: Can you feel the power of darkness weighing down on us the longer we are here? If you cannot you will soon. The zombie slayers before us felt it too, but they came prepared. "The holy dragon teeth we used to help us defeat the dragon are strong. But even they cannot hold off the power of the Darkness and the Curse at once" We don't have a curse so the Holy dragon teeth will be plenty. Search the Zombie knights for them. We only need two.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Horde Token V in your inventory.

quests.name: Don't Breathe
quests.description: The green mist floating around is used to turn people into zombies. I have seen the aftermath of it before… it turned everyone in my village into zombies. There is no point wiping out the hoard if more zombies can be easily created. Give the mist a few sprays of this Holy Wasabi Spray Can. The mist will still hang around but do not worry, it will be harmless. Also see if you can find any more pages while you are out there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Horde Token VI in your inventory.

quests.name: Hold Back the Horde
quests.description: I need time to read through these pages and figure out where the weapon is. While I do that go deal with the horde. All of your running and fighting has attracted them. If you do not keep them under control we will be swarmed in no time. Focus on the Ghouls and Zombies since they will be most likely to overwhelm us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Horde Token VII in your inventory.

quests.name: Rune Hoarders
quests.description: This looks important! "We placed down runes we had found scattered through the temple and as the inner doors opened I thought the end was near. The weapon that could save us was within our grasp but as we approached Daniel and Sam argued over who would wield it. Suddenly Henry was struck down by the dragon and the other fell to it as we ran" Now we know where the weapon… and the dragon are. The runes probably held by the undead so get hunting.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Horde Token VIII in your inventory.

quests.name: The Second Slaying
quests.description: The only thing we have to do now is defeat the zombie dragon that controls the horde. We can finish the job those zombie slayers started long ago. Once we defeat him I will take the weapon and clear this place of undead and you can go help someone else… so I can have more undead to myself!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Horde Token IX in your inventory.

quests.name: Horde Zombie Slayer
quests.description: To truly prove your might, go to the left and kill 100 Zombies. If you prove your worth to me, I will give you a character page badge!

quests.name: SMUH
quests.description: I have been told by members of the AQWorlds Team that UltraBrutalcorn has evolved… again. Now he is just not Ultra but Super Mega Ultra! Battle him (if you dare) to get the Super Mega Ultra Horn and I will reward you handsomely!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' UltraBrutal Battle ' quest

quests.name: Legendary Paladin's Vow
quests.description: Repeat after me: I vow I am a loyal member of the Paladin Order.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Paladin (Class) with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory. Note: Disappears after completing the ' A Strong Base ' or 'Silver Paladin's Vow' quests.

quests.name: Legendary Paladin's Oath
quests.description: Repeat after me: I will strive to do Good, always, wherever and whenever I can.

quests.name: Legendary Paladin's Pledge
quests.description: Repeat after me: I will use my power, strength, skill, and knowledge in the service of the Eternal Order of Paladins for now and in many futures to come.

quests.name: Aptitude Test
quests.description: Before you progress from the ranks of Paladin to ArchPaladin, you must pass a small aptitude test challenging your valor, magic, and spirit among other things. Defeat the Colossal Primarch in /gravechallenge to prove your prowess in battle, conquer the ethereal Unending Avatar in /timevoid to show your proficiency with spells to prove your steadfast resolve.

quests.name: Silver Paladin's Vow
quests.description: Repeat after me: I vow I am a loyal member of the Paladin Order.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Silver Paladin with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory. Note: Disappears after completing the ' A Strong Base ' or 'Legendary Paladin's Vow' quests.

quests.name: Silver Paladin's Oath
quests.description: Repeat after me: I will strive to do Good, always, wherever and whenever I can.

quests.name: Silver Paladin's Pledge
quests.description: Repeat after me: I will use my power, strength, skill, and knowledge in the service of the Eternal Order of Paladins for now and in many futures to come.

quests.name: Aptitude Test
quests.description: Before you progress from the ranks of Paladin to ArchPaladin, you must pass a small aptitude test challenging your valor, magic, and spirit among other things. Defeat the Colossal Primarch in /gravechallenge to prove your prowess in battle, conquer the ethereal Unending Avatar in /timevoid to show your proficiency with spells to prove your steadfast resolve.

quests.name: A Strong Base
quests.description: Greetings, hero! So, you would like to rise to the rank of ArchPaladin? I must warn you, the road to acquire such great power is a long and arduous one. Because you have not yet trained as a Paladin, you must learn what it means to stand among our ranks before moving up the hierarchy. Before that though, you will need to find an armor to wear! The Stone Paladin in /temple was known for his impregnable defense, so his armor will act as the perfect base. Once you retrieve that, find the Exalted Paladin Seal from my shop to fuse the armor with the power of an Archpaladin.

quests.name: Proof of Valor
quests.description: Paladins are required to have the strength to stand against evil, particularly the undead. This list contains some of world's most dangerous incarnations of evil; slay them and return with a trophy from each to prove your conquest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest or the ' Legendary Paladin's Vow ' or ' Silver Paladin's Vow ' quests. Note: Disappears after completing the ' Silver Paladin's Oath ' or ' Legendary Paladin's Oath ' quests.

quests.name: Mastering the Arcane
quests.description: Normally, Paladins learn healing magic first and then progress to more difficult types of offensive magic once they have more stable control over their mana.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest or the ' Legendary Paladin's Oath ' or ' Silver Paladin's Oath ' quests. Note: Disappears after completing the ' Legendary Paladin's Pledge ' or ' Silver Paladin's Pledge ' quests.

quests.name: For Those Who Have Fallen
quests.description: Before I teach you the secret arts of the ArchPaladins, there is one more task you must complete. Many young Paladins strive to one day become ArchPaladins, only to have their dreams snuffed by evil as they are slain in battle. Pay homage to the Paladins who gave their lives in service. Create a funeral pyre with an Eternal Flame from Amia the Cult Leader. Find Sacred feathers from the Birds of paradise in the /manor and burn the shoelaces of seventy seven Doomwood Soldiers. Then, bring me a Holy Hand Grenade from the Good Rep Shop prove your commitment to righteousness.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest or the ' Legendary Paladin's Pledge ' or ' Silver Paladin's Pledge ' quests. Note: Disappears after completing one of the ' Aptitude Test ' quests.

quests.name: Commandment
quests.description: Alright, it is finally time to learn the skills necessary to become an ArchPaladin! Commandment, the first skill, utilizes combination of royal swordplay and a magical enhancement to repress your foe's strength. Find the Radiant Blade Enhancement from the Good Lieutenants in /alliance. You must also possess a spirit of vindication to use this skill, as a weak will can be easily overcome. Battle the Grand Inquisitor to understand it. And observe the Painadin Overlord's skill in /brightfall, as well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest or one of the ' Aptitude Test ' quests.

quests.name: Hymn of Light
quests.description: ArchPaladins use magic with greater proficiency than regular paladins, so you will need to get a Divine Elixir from Xavier Lionfang in the /poisonforest. Then, learn a special healing skill exclusive to our ranks - Acolyte's Healing Word - by getting the Acolyte's Braille from the Chaos Healers. Then keep the chaos inside Ultra Alteon at bay and return with a Prayer of Salvation. Most importantly, you must remember that an ArchPaladin's heal is only as strong as the purity of their spirit - learn about Innocence from the doves in /skytower.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Righteous Seal
quests.description: Magic is tricky and you aren't yet attuned to holy magic. Unfortunately, the only way to attune yourself to magic is by exposure; battling the Golden Casters in /onslaughttower will help you gain Attunement. To perform the spell, you'll need craft a Scroll of Ethereal Slumber. You'll also need to learn how to release elemental mana energy from your fists, and the easiest way to learn this is through pyromancy. The Shurpu Ring Guardian's fists of fire are a good example. Pettivox in the /palace can help you with a Ring of Mana Transposition.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sacred Magic: Eden
quests.description: I unfortunately cannot teach you the final ArchPaladin skill, as every ArchPaladin must develop their own sacred magic technique. You will need:
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: THE HORROR!
quests.description: Artix gibbers something about pink ice cream and gestures toward the rather horrifying ice cream monsters that appear to be closing in on you. It seems like he wants you to destroy them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Artix's Fears ' quest.

quests.name: TOO PINK!
quests.description: Whew! I am feeling a little better now, but I still cannot open my eyes all the way - this pink is BLINDING! Can you find a way to get rid of it?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cheers to you, and souvenirs!
quests.description: It is hard to believe it's been EIGHT years that you have been battling on Lore! But it is true… or you would not be here. This calls for a souvenir or three! Bring me 8 AQW Hero Tokens from the Chest in Yulgar's Inn (in the /nostalgiaquest map) and I will give you a choice of souvenir!

quests.name: Treeants for Wood
quests.description: We are not quite finished with the fortifications around Battleon, but we have run out of wood! Could you get us some more? The sturdiest wood comes from Treeants, which you can find at the /farm or in the /poisonforest. Keep in mind: the Treeants in the /poisonforest are stronger, which makes them much more likely to have the kind of wood we need.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Grab the Growth ' quest.

quests.name: Sand sounds better than Litter...
quests.description: Next, we will need to surround Battleon with sandbags to keep the toxic flood out. This is kind of gross, but I think our best bet is to fill them with “sand” from the Litter Elementals in Litter Beach, in Ziri’s Flying /Baconcat Fortress! Bring back as much as you can carry.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Grab the Growth ' quest.

quests.name: Waves of Mutilation
quests.description: The creatures just keep coming! This does not seem like their full force, based on reports Lord Brentan sent. If this IS just the first wave of invaders, we are going to need a lot more manpower. While you are here, my friend, buy me some time to fortify these barricades. Take out 10 of the monsters nearby.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sand sounds better than Litter... ' quest.

quests.name: Decimate the Horde
quests.description: This undead horde is hyper-focused on attacking Captain Rhubarb and his crew! Help me take out a wave of them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat The Void Champion ' quest.

quests.name: Douse with Flames
quests.description: WHOA! These undead just will not stay down - something keeps reanimating them! I will try to figure out what is causing it. In the meantime, we will need to put out some of the Dark Fires they have set near the shoreline!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Grenades of AWE
quests.description: I know what will keep these liches down - my new specialty, GRENADES OF AWE! Will you help me make some? Bring me some gunpowder from the Red Betty, and some Bone Shrapnel from any of the undead minions in the area.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Final Ingredient
quests.description: I just need ONE LAST THING before I can create my Grenades of Awe - HOLY WASABI! You will need to go to /Lightguard to find it - Ol' Spice always has some, but you may need to do him a favor before he will hand it over.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Count Not to Four
quests.description: My Grenades of Awe are ready to use! Throw them at Gorgorath's undead minions on the ship and watch them explode in a burst of Paladin light!

quests.name: Talk to Captain Rhubarb
quests.description: Not even my paladin-infused, anti-undead Grenades of Awe are stopping these guys! I will have to think about this some more. While I am doing that, maybe you should talk to Captain Rhubarb and see if he has any ideas!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Navigate the Maze
quests.description: This graveyard is so full of bones, we will not be able to simply walk up to its gates! We will need to navigate the maze of bones to find out way there. Be sure to extinguish any Dark Fires, and slay any Bone Dragonlings, that you ﬁnd on your way.

quests.name: Get a Clue
quests.description: Where do you think Gorgorath is keeping the Jewel of the Undying? Her servants, the Bone Terrors, might know! Fight them until you find some sort of clue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Heart of a Dracolich
quests.description: It looks like the Jewel of the Undying is being kept in a hidden lower level of the castle. To reach it, we need to open a door. To open the door, we need 3 glowing, stone dracolich hearts. There are three Bone Wyverns roaming the halls. They most likely have the hearts we need.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Open the Door
quests.description: According to that map we found, you'll have to place those 3 Dracolich Hearts into the wall above a locked door. If we do it in the right order, the door will open, and lead us into a cellar where Gorgorath's valuables are kept. This is where the Jewel will be. So, first things first: let's get that door open! Click on the 3 spaces to place the Dracolich Hearts!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find the Jewel
quests.description: The Jewel of the Undying is somewhere in this cellar. With it, we may just stand a chance at beating this dragon! Search the room until you find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get to the Lair
quests.description: According to our map, there's an exit on the other side of the cellar. If we go out that way, it will lead us to Gorgorath's lair. The way will surely be guarded, so get ready for a fight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Unlock the Door
quests.description: The door to Gorgorath's lair is being guarded - by a dark, shadowy ghost of a dragon! Defeat it so that we can get inside!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Slay Gorgorath
quests.description: The moment of our glory is upon us! Come on - if we fight this beast together, she will not stand a chance!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bright Paladin Presents
quests.description: Welcome to your 15th Anniversary party, Hero! To celebrate 15 years of your epic achievements, victories, and adventures, I have commissioned 4 new weapons for you. But the cakes smells SO GOOD… I cannot remember where I put your gifts. Please bring me a slice of cake, a fork, and a bottle of Holy Wasabi (from the Birthday Cake in /Birthday or Slayer Cake in the next room over… >_>) to help me remember.

quests.name: War Medal Turn In
quests.description: Waves of wea-PUN-ized monsters are heading for Battleon. Fight back against this onslaught of PUN-ishment by slaying 5 of our op-PUN-nents.

quests.name: Mega War Medal Turn In
quests.description: Waves of wea-PUN-ized monsters are heading for Battleon. Fight back against this onslaught of PUN-ishment by slaying 5 of our op-PUN-nents.

quests.name: Query the Oracle
quests.description: Puns are the Paladin Order's official, most-favorite form of humor. To attack us with them is the lowest form of insult. We must find out more about who — or what — is doing this. And why. See what our op-pun-nents have to say.

quests.name: Reforging the Blinding Light
quests.description: To reforge the Blinding Light of Destiny and create other weapons infused with pure light… we are first going to need what remains of the original battleaxe. Can you find the Blinding Light of Destiny's Handle? (Obtained from one of the DoomWood Part 1 Endings)

quests.name: Secret Order of Undead Slayers
quests.description: The weapons we are going to forge are for battling the evil undead. So… there is something I have been wanting to ask you for a long time. Would you… like to join the Secret Order of Undead Slayers? Simply present your Bone Grinder Medal (Obtained from Arryd after defeating 100 undead waves in DoomWood Part 1.) and I will make it official!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Essential Essences
quests.description: Now that you are an initiate of the Secret Order of Undead Slayers, I am going to let you in on a little secret: deep beneath Battleon lives an onslaught of Undead. Some of the Undead harness a strange, mystic soul called "Undead Essence." We must study this! Travel into these dangerous depths and recover 25 Undead Essences. I would like to take a whack at them and see if there is anything hiding within…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bust some Dust
quests.description: What a discovery! Since the Undead are not really alive… but are not dead, either… that means they still have a spirit. We need to do everything we can to free their Spirit Orbs! I bet Bone Dust from the Undeads are full of Spirit Orbs. Try checking the Undead that patrol the Swordhaven Graveyard and Battleunder and collect whatever Bone Dust you find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Loyal Follower
quests.description: Spirit Orbs need to be set free… that is the only way for them to finally rest. As part of the Secret Order of Undead Slayers, it is our duty to help these Spirits find that eternal resting place. Gather 100 Spirit Orbs and a Celestial Compass from an Ephemerite and return them to me so that I can send them to the afterlife. After-after life? I am not sure where Undead Spirit Orbs go…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mine Crafting
quests.description: Reforging weapons infused with pure light is going to take A LOT of metal. I tried rocking out on the guitar with Zhoom but… that is not the metal we were looking for. We need to harvest metal deposits from Raw Ore. Search all over Lore for beasts affiliated with stones, rocks, crystals, metals, earth, and golems. They should be full of Raw Ore deposits… which is a good thing, because we will need 30 of them! Also, we will need an Axe of the Prospector from a Balboa to mine the metal out of the Raw Ore. Good luck, prospective prospecting paladin!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Loyal Follower ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Pious Platinum Enchantment
quests.description: Now that we have collected raw metal, we can begin to enchant it with righteous power. But we are going to need the proper materials. Gather 25 Undead Energy from Lore…s skeletal and Undead minions. Additionally, we will also need 5 Spirit Orbs and 25 Paladaffodils for the enchantment to take affect. The Paladaffodils bloom on plant and tree-like monsters all over Lore, like Wisteria, Treeants, and Marsh Trees. When you have found everything, we can combine them with the raw metal and the enchantment will be complete! Good luck!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mine Crafting ' quest.

quests.name: Almighty Aluminum of Destiny
quests.description: Things are looking great so far! We have Spirit Orbs and Enchanted Metals… and our next step now is to forge them together! Once forged, the metal will become stronger than ever before, both physically and spiritually. Items of ''Blinding Light’’ can only be created with ‘‘Metals of Destiny,’’ and the only forge hot enough to craft these metals resides in the Dwarfhold Mountains. Tell Geopetal, the Rock Dweller, that I sent you and I am sure she will forge us those Metals of Destiny!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed one of the ' ... Enchantment ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Basic Weapon Kit Construction
quests.description: Hero, we are SO CLOSE to making items of "Blinding Light!" We just need to make a Basic Weapon Kit. You ready? Cysero gave me a list of everything we need:
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed at least one ' '... of Destiny ' quest.

quests.name: Advanced Weapon Kit Construction
quests.description: In order to make advanced versions of "Blinding Light" items, we are going to need a more advanced weapon kit. The Tier 2 Versions—the "Bright" upgrades—can be found in my Merge shop, but first we will need an Advanced Weapon Kit. Here is what we need:
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ultimate Weapon Kit Construction
quests.description: YEEESS! The time has come to make Blinding Light weapons! Hero, the Ultimate Weapon Kit is required to make items of "Blinding Light"…and by using these Tier 3 weapons… we might be able to restore the Blinding Light of Destiny to its full glory! We have to try! Here is what we need:
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Finding Fragments with Blinding Blade
quests.description: After my Blinding Light of Destiny was destroyed, the pieces were scattered all over Lore… and only weapons of Blinding Light can hope to find these shards! With your Blinding Blade of Destiny, hunt down every Undead monster and try to recover 10 Blinding Light Fragments. The stronger the Undead, the greater chance at finding a shard. And maybe… if we are REALLY lucky… one of these shards might contain the super rare Blinding Aura required for forging the Blinding Light of Destiny back together! Good luck hero—I have full faith in you!

quests.name: Finding Fragments with Blinding Broadsword
quests.description: After my Blinding Light of Destiny was destroyed, the pieces were scattered all over Lore… and only weapons of Blinding Light can hope to find these shards! Good luck hero—I have full faith in you!

And maybe… if we are REALLY lucky… one of these shards might contain the super rare Blinding Aura required for forging the Blinding Light of Destiny back together! Good luck hero—I have full faith in you!

Good luck hero—I have full faith in you!

quests.name: The Blinding Light of Destiny
quests.description: This is it, hero! You have found bits and pieces of my Blinding Light of Destiny… but it is going to take a lot of Orbs and Auras to restore it to its former glory. Once you have collected everything on the list, we can reforge my almighty battle axe once more! You can do it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed one of the ' Finding Fragments with ... ' quest.

items.name: Get Your Blinding Light of Destiny

quests.name: Retrieve your Blinding Light of Destiny
quests.description: Hero! It would be an honor if you would wield my axe throughout your adventures. What? You.. got rid of my axe and now you want it back?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Blinding Light of Destiny ' quest in order to access this quest.

items.name: Get Your Blinding Light of Destiny

quests.name: A Newer, Shinier Axe
quests.description: Welcome back! I got a special treat for those who already have the Blinding Light of Destiny. If you want a new, slicker design, it won't take as long as building one that's for sure. It will just alter its appearance a little! You can find the Refined Metal at /Extinction on the Cyworgs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Blinding Light of Destiny ' quest. | Must have Blinding Light of Destiny (Axe) in your inventory.

quests.name: A Newer, Shinier Axe
quests.description: Welcome back! I got a special treat for those who already have the Blinding Light of Destiny. If you want a new, slicker design, it won't take as long as building one that's for sure. It will just alter its appearance a little! You can find the Refined Metal at /Extinction on the Cyworgs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Blinding Light of Destiny ' quest. | Must have Ascended Light of Destiny in your inventory.

quests.name: A Real Battle-Hardened Pup
quests.description: Hello, Hero! What brings you back to the doom and gloom of the Necropolis? I think it might be time for the battle puppy himself to see the world of lore! Sadly I can't really take him for I am always too busy getting the usual undead requests. YOU, however, are well travelled throughout the lands. If you can bring me some heirlooms, I might be willing to lend you Daimyo. I can assure you he is battle ready! If you have trouble finding the chaos lycans, I hear /safiria ‘s castle is overrun by them currently.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Daimyo (Pet) in inventory to accept.

quests.name: Darkness in Swordhaven
quests.description: Thank goodness you are here, my friend! This army came out of nowhere, but with your help and that of these elementals, we will save Swordhaven! Take out 7 ShadowFire Tigers and 7 ShadeFire Elementals while I plot our next move.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Major Malfunction ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Extinguish the Flames
quests.description: It is a shame we aren't facing the Undead… my axe is not nearly as effective against the Living ShadowFlame as it is against armies of the Undead. Clear out 10 of these creatures so we can reach their leader.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Major Malfunction ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: ShadeFire Colonel Clash
quests.description: Tyndarius and Malgor have lead so many astray, but we can't leave them here to wreak havoc. Defeat the ShadeFire Colonel directing these forces so we can save the town.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Major Malfunction ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Infernal Destruction
quests.description: You'll need to enter the Infernal Spire to find Aranx. While you look for him, slay as many Infernals as you can find. Each one you take down is one more that does not make it into our realm!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Diabolical Warlord! ' quest.

quests.name: Gone Without A Trace
quests.description: You've seen no sign of Aranx? Surely that can't be true! Take a closer look - there must be something in the Spire that will tell us where he went. Search every room… and every infernal you see! (Quest available once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Diabolical Warlord! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Helzekiel
quests.description: This does not look good! Hero, we must get to him before it's too late! See if you can find one of the leaders of this invasion. They may be able to tell you where he is… though you may need to pound it out of them first.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Diabolical Warlord! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get the Keys
quests.description: Oh, no! All those feathers and silk we found… they weren't just from Aranx. These beasts have been capturing everyone who has come in here to fight them! We must free them! Wreak vengeance on any infernals you find in here - and see if any of them have the keys to these cells!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Diabolical Warlord! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Free the Captives
quests.description: Quickly, use the keys you found to unlock all of these cells and free the Celestial captives!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Diabolical Warlord! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Energy Needed
quests.description: The Celestials you freed are too weakened to escape - it looks like someone was draining their Celestial Energy! You'll have to get it back. Surely if it has been taken, then these Dungeon Fiends must have it! Once you have recovered a few samples of Celestial Energy, give one to each of the captive Celestials. (Quest available once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Diabolical Warlord! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Interrogate the Jailer
quests.description: We rescued many people, but there's still been no sign of Aranx! He must be here somewhere. Find Garvodeus the Jailer, the Infernal in control of this dungeon. If anyone has answers, it will be him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Diabolical Warlord! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get the Code
quests.description: It looks like we've found the factory where they're creating their Celestial weapon. We have to shut it all down! See if you can get the override code from one of these Fallen Knights - and make sure you destroy every Infernal you see!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Diabolical Warlord! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Enter the Code
quests.description: Now - find the control console, and enter the override code to shut the system down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Diabolical Warlord! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Smash It Up
quests.description: If we can't override the production machinery, there's only one thing left to do - smash it all to bits! Oh, how I wish I could be there doing this with you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Diabolical Warlord! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Take out the Overseer
quests.description: The Overseer should be in that room up ahead. Defeating him will make it even more difficult for them to get this system running again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Diabolical Warlord! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Deposit Depot
quests.description: Dage the Evil needs Obsidian Rocks for his Soul Forge. Collect Obsidian Deposits from lava and fire creatures from all over Lore. When you have 8 Deposits, hand them over to me and I'll craft you Obsidian Rocks. I will pay you well.

quests.name: Souldier
quests.description: Dage needs Undead Legion soldiers to obtain Solidified Souls. Search all over Lore for Undead, zombie, and ghostly monsters that drop Shards of a Soul. After 8 Shards of a Soul have been collected, I will give you Solidefied Souls and a bounty of Gold and Experience.

quests.name: Coliseum Combatants
quests.description: Want Legion Tokens? Fine, Undead Warrior Champion. I'll give you some… if you can prove your worth. Defeat the combatants of Battleon's Battle Coliseum and bring me their weapons: Lord Brentan's Regal Blade, Roderick's Chaotic Bane, Knight of Thorns' Sword, Platinum of Johann Wryce, and Khai Khaldun's Scimitar. Even when defeated, don't expect these bad boys to give up their weapons willingly. I wouldn't… but then again I'd never let myself be defeated…

quests.name: Beginning the Final
quests.description: MORE Legion Tokens? Someone's greedy. I like that. Here's the deal, Undead Warrior Champion: defeat Desoloth the Final, and bring me Desoloth's Bane. Oh yes, that is pure evil… but the rotten apple doesn't fall far from the Undead Legion tree…

quests.name: Protect the Plague Sufferers
quests.description: With sick people throughout Pyrewatch Peak, we cannot have monsters roaming the tunnels! Clear them out to protect the plague sufferers, and bring me fire-starting tools from the Lavazards, Caustocrush, and Coal Creepers to help drive the monsters out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Salve to Soothe ' quest.

quests.name: Ease the Ill
quests.description: With Embersea's shipment of medicine destroyed, we're entirely out of Feverbane elixir, and we cannot contact Feverfew temple for more, now that the Onslaught has destroyed our signal mirrors. But we CAN make something to ease them… I hope. Bring me 5 Baneberry blossoms from the mountainside, 3 pieces of Wickskin root from Lavazards, 2 vials of Living Lava blood, and 3 lumps of Zard Marrow.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Salve to Soothe ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defend Pyrewatch Peak
quests.description: Our worst fears have been realized! The Firestorm Onslaught have flanked the Peak, and are coming at us from the south! Take out 10 of the invaders to buy us time to move the sick!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Salve to Soothe ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Signal Fire
quests.description: We've GOT to get ahold of Embersea and Feverfew Falls to let them know the Onslaught have reached this far. But those Coalsuckers stole our signal mirrors. Bring me 1 jar of Polish, 1 Cloth, 8 Stand Legs, and 4 Reflectors from the Firestorm invaders and tigers so we can rebuild them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Salve to Soothe ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spreading Like Wildfire
quests.description: Excellent! All the parts to rebuild the mirrors are here. You know what to do - go around to the mirror platforms and rebuild them, then I'll direct the first signal to Feverfew Falls' temple!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Salve to Soothe ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per log in.

quests.name: A Fresh Breath of Life
quests.description: If you are going to subdue Desoloth, we must steal the very air from his lungs. As like calls to like, you must bring me 10 Breaths of Life from the Wind Elementals and Living Air monsters.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fire In My Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Where Air You?
quests.description: You have shown yourself skilled by now, Hero, but can you see what isn't there? The very air? Where do you think my temple lies? It is not so obvious. Below the ground, under the sand. If you would understand, seek my temple where dragons cannot fly.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fire In My Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Invading Your (Sacred) Space
quests.description: I jest, to be sure, Hero! You could not invade this sacred realm if I had not given you leave to be here. Or… so I thought before Desoloth arrived. HIM, I fear. You… you will help. Collect 10 samples of the air in the indicated Sacred Spaces. You will learn soon enough what it is for.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fire In My Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: There's Magic Every-Air
quests.description: You see the crystals all around my temple? I store magic in them. But now, now they must be released, and aggressively. It will tinge the magic with your emotion. Break 12 of the crystals on the wall to release their Airther. From the King Crystal, I will need you to waken my Air Spirit Guide.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fire In My Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragon's Fire Blossom to be Found
quests.description: The fire in his heart must be extinguished, blown out. Wshhht! Like so. But he is strong, so strong. The strongest of all, perhaps. But you, you are stronger, no? As I do, so it will be done. I need Caustic Pollen from Sulfur Imps and you should gather Fire Blossom Petals. Bring them all… to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fire In My Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Space Between
quests.description: I seek the space between… between the wicked lies… I tell… my dragons I fear for them! And me. Do not let my fickle, fuddled words confuse you. You must not let Desoloth destroy us all! The Space Between, retrieve it from the Energy Tornado. It is the last physical spell component I need.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fire In My Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Burning Question
quests.description: You must go to Hs'Sakar, High Priest of Fire, and retrieve the formula which will help make this spell complete. Take your time, go slowly, for the road is dangerous. Talk only to him, and once you have your answer, /rest, then make your way back here. Then we shall see what is to become of us all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fire In My Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Visceral Memory
quests.description: ﻿We were made aware of Seabase Undine very recently. It would have remained a secret from us, but there are Shadows Viscera in the /MidnightZone that are very similar to the enemy the Queen tasked us with destroying. If time permits, honored Hero, would you bring me samples?

quests.name: Boneless
quests.description: ﻿﻿The Lightguard's duty is to eradicate the undead. I heard that Necro Adipocere were spotted in the /AbyssalZone of Seabase Undine. Though I hate to bother you, my Paladins have never seen these abominations. If you could bring us specimens, I'll teach them how to combat them.

quests.name: Astral Hanzo Orb Quest
quests.description: If you would reap the rewards of the Blood Hanzo Orb, prove your battle prowess. Spill the blood of Big Jack Sprat, the DreadSpider, Dark Makais, and Rattlebones.

quests.name: The Shadowscythe Needs YOU!
quests.description: You're here for the recruitment drive, eh? Well, thanks for the interest, but we're looking for STRONG heroes. Real tough fighters. We're going to be going up against the Queen's army, you know.

quests.name: Show Me More, Shadow-Noob
quests.description: You did well, but that first round was just to weed out the weak. A real Shadowscythe champion can take on even the toughest Legion and Nation scum - I mean fighters. Right. We're working together now. Defeat the Veterans in the Arena - Legion Fenrir and Carnage!

quests.name: For the Shadowscythe!
quests.description: We weren't expecting anyone to make it this far, but we set up an arena full of the very best Legion and Nation volunteers we could find, just in case. Go kick their Elite butts! Defeat Legion Cannons, Paragons, Minotaur of War and Crag and Bamboozle!

quests.name: Gravelyn Likes Your Style
quests.description: You're showing a lot of potential, Prospect – maybe you're even good enough to become Gravelyn's right-hand Hero! Want to show her what you're made of? Head into the arena and prove yourself by defeating the Shadow Destroyer!!!

quests.name: Shadowscythe Recruits: Embrace the Shadow
quests.description: The Darkness gifted Empress Gravelyn with these Shadow Seals and Gems of Superiority. Each of the Nation warriors in this arena carries a Shadow Seal and each Legion warrior possesses a Gem of Superiority. Best them for a chance to recover 25 seals and 1 Gem, then return to me for your reward!

quests.name: Shadowscythe Loyalty Rewarded
quests.description: Loyal members of the Shadowscythe like you have proven themselves worthy of even greater rewards. Relics of defeated, powerful enemies can be used to create strong magic. Bring me the remains of your defeated foes and I'll reward you.

quests.name: Locate Kezeroth
quests.description: Somewhere there should be a chasm… if we can find THAT, we should find the entrance to where Kezeroth waits.

quests.name: Chronoton Detection
quests.description: We must determine just how long these snow golems have been here. Slay 10 of them to collect the living snow. The chronoton-reading they give off will tell us how long they've existed… and how long this area has lain undisturbed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Core Knowledge
quests.description: The snow golems have lived here for many years. Now we must see how long the area itself has been here. Collect 6 ice cores to test the land's age.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Temporal Revelation
quests.description: Use Athon's pocket watch to reveal the chasm. But stand back, we cannot know what could emerge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Before the Darkest Hour
quests.description: We must locate Kezeroth's temple. Once at its entrance, we can begin our descent into darkness. Stay strong, Hero, our quest is only just beginning!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: Auto turn-in.

quests.name: Mana for the Magi
quests.description: The magi are running out of mana for casting! If we let the pressure off of The Beast he will regenerate his heath! Quickly run to /swordhaven and collect Potent Dried Slime from the slimes there! We can make fast mana potions out of those!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sword Of Hope ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Gathering Spell Components
quests.description: The mage corps are running low on spell components for the huge fireball spell. We need you to run to /volcano or /mobius and collect Magic Embers from the Fire Imps there and return quickly!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sword Of Hope ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Looking for Loggers
quests.description: We're running low on the special fire-resistant wood that we need to make the ballista bolts! If you go to /poisonforest or /farm you can find some Treeants and turn them into Large Logs!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sword Of Hope ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Ballista Cables
quests.description: The Ballistas can't handle being fired this rapidly. It's wearing out the rope. See if you can find some taut rope on the Horcs in /orctown. Their rope is very tough!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sword Of Hope ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Arrowheads for Archers
quests.description: The Kappa Ninja spend a lot of time in the waters of /yokaiboat and /yokairiver. They often find and collect iron nuggets washed down the river to use in their arrowheads. That will be the best place to search for new arrowheads for our fletchers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sword Of Hope ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Fetching Fletching Feathers
quests.description: There is a bird called the Red Bird which you can find in /creatures. The feathers from this magical animal will help give our arrows the fiery magic that they need to hurt The Beast Quetzal!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sword Of Hope ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: A Little Warmth and Light
quests.description: Since Kezeroth has taken Ice Rise Keep over, the creatures of the north have been drawn here. Place some torches around the keep to give us some light and warmth…
quests.requirements_note: Must have defeated Quetzal by doing the quests in Battlefield.

quests.name: Behind Locked Doors
quests.description: The World Ender will have take up residence in Ice Rise Keep's throne room, or perhaps the great hall. See if you can locate him in this dreary disaster of a ruin.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Lost key
quests.description: I have no idea where the key might be if it is even still here. Search the monsters here. Maybe one of them can provide a clue to the location of a key if one exists.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Uncovering Pages Of The Past
quests.description: The guard's journal has been torn in half. The monsters have the other half, no doubt. See if you can find the missing pages on the creatures who have come here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: We Know Where To Look
quests.description: There are still some pages missing. You must have missed them when you are searching the monsters. Double your efforts and find the well-hidden pages so we can get the complete story.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: A Terrible Hiding Place
quests.description: The guard says that he hid the spare key in his footlocker. It's the safest place he could think of. The poor man must have been scared out of his senses. Search Ice Rise Keep for the guard's footlocker and retrieve the key to the throne room!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Face Kezeroth
quests.description: Have you readied yourself for this battle? I'm not sure how this will turn out but we have made it further than I thought we would. I believe in you, Hero. Let's go face Kezeroth the World Ender!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: Auto turn-in.

quests.name: BONUS CHALLENGE: Ultra Kezeroth
quests.description: Evil takes many forms. Kezeroth is defeated but his Ultra form still remains as a challenge to overcome. Defeat this creature, if you can and reap the glory of victory.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Face Kezeroth ' quest.

quests.name: Undying Fealty
quests.description: Did someone leave this sword here? It feels.. Unnaturally hungry for souls. I should try feeding it some of these-
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dante to Beatrice ' quest. | Must be Level 80.

quests.name: Defeat the Minions
quests.description: Rangda has not yet appeared, but her minions have! Fight them, and take their tongues. With these, I will "interrogate" them about their Queen's whereabouts.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Gather Flowers ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'Create a Barrier' quest.

quests.name: Create a Barrier
quests.description: Take these Spears of Mindbreaking. Dip them in the blood of the Leyak, and then place them in a semi-circle around the main gate. The Leyak won't be able to cross the barrier they create. This will buy us some time, and ensure they cannot harm anyone else.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Gather Flowers ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'Create a Barrier' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Baleful Babysitting
quests.description: I heard that poachers are trying to capture the Tuyul and Leyak to sell as pets. For a number of reasons- a huge number, actually- that is terrible and incredibly offensive on all levels. Are they stupid? Whatever the case, we need to banish the Tuyul and Leyak before they're taken where they'l do terrible harm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Rangda ' quest.

quests.name: Out of Time
quests.description: The Time Wraiths here exist only to serve as our tools. Several have refused to follow orders and need to be dealt with. Can I trust you to do what needs to be done?

quests.name: Time to Mess with ChronoLords
quests.description: In /portalmazec, there are a group of ChronoLords stationed. To truly prove your worth, go there and face them. Show them the might of the Corrupted Chronomancers!

quests.name: Persisting Wishes
quests.description: Welcome to our family's tomb. More specifically, our tomb as it is in the future. I retreated here, but the living Min'et from your present managed to send you after me. She won't get off my back, not even in death. In the next room over, you'll see that she colluded with a nechronomancer to reanimate her body should I 'cause problems' after she passed. What a nuisance. Put that corpse down before it inadvertently helps the Maw.

quests.name: The Undo Limit
quests.description: The reason why I decided to hide in my family's tomb as it is in the future was to, hopefully, confuse the Maw. It would mistake the remains in here for the real me. By the looks of it, my trick is working! Huh, the Retrograde Maw is so young that it could make this kind of slip up. Eventually it's going to sense that I'm still here to raise havoc, so destroy it while it's still distracted!

quests.name: Stealing Augold's Assets
quests.description: Ugh. I may be more successful and reliable than my brother, but I cannot deny his popularity. His success is stealing my customers! Therefore, I have a job for you: sabotage his bank. He keeps two treasure chests near his vault in /battleontown that contain a tremendous amount of gold. I want you to retrieve those chests for me, along with two Chest Keys to help unlock them. You should be able to get the keys from Warden Elfis in /dwarfprison.

quests.name: Extra Protection
quests.description: There's no place I'd rather do business than here in Dreadrock. However, I can't deny that it's a dangerous city. A strong hero such as yourself should be able to provide me with some extra security. *Persuade" some of the Crag and Bamboozles in /Shadowblast Arena to guard my bank vaults. Let them know that they still owe me quite a bit of money…though a little rough-housing wouldn't hurt.

quests.name: Make a Donation
quests.description: While I appreciate the help you've been giving me, nothing is more valuable than a generous donation of gold! You'll find a Donation Receipt in Deathgore's shop - and for a low price, at that. When you're ready to donate, bring it here.

quests.name: More Food
quests.description: We weren't expecting a third mouth a feed, and will need some more food for the journey ahead of us. Will you help us? The goats and wolves have been chaorrupted, but their milk and meat are still fine.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find My Parents ' quest.

quests.name: Clear the Way
quests.description: We are ready to leave town, but a vicious chaorrupted bear blocks our path! Slay it for us so that we can get to safety.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find My Parents ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Who Screamed?
quests.description: These woods have an echo - and that makes it hard to tell where that scream came from. We're going to have to check all of the buildings until we find an answer. Start with the Black Knight's cabin - those guys have always seemed kinda sketchy to me.

quests.name: Check the Other Cabin
