quests.description: It looks like Shrade's return has awakened a lot of restless spirits in these woods! Check the Dark Makai cabins next, and if you see any of those ghosts, put them to rest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Check the Staff Building
quests.description: Machete slashes… and a torn camp counselor's uniform? Shrade has definitely been here, and it sounds like one of his victims was staff! See what you can find in the Staff Building - and take care of any ghosts you find in there!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: What are They Looking For?
quests.description: The stolen boat is docked out in the middle of the lake, but it doesn't look like anyone is actually ON it. Maybe they took a dive? Get out to the boat, and then follow the rope down to the bottom of the lake. See what you find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Cysero was Right!
quests.description: Ha! So there ARE fish people at the bottom of Lake Gonnagetcha! Ten points to Cysero. I wonder what clues we can get from THEM? Why don't you "have a chat" with them and see what they offer up.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest may be repeated so long as 'Explore the Black Knight's Cabin' isn't completed.

quests.name: Explore the Black Knight's Cabin
quests.description: The key to the Black Knights cabin! This is all coming full circle. Unlock the cabin door, and then go in and see what you can find in there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get Through the Mirror
quests.description: We've got to find out what's behind this wall! There's only one problem - that hole is WAY too small for some of us to wriggle through. Smash a bigger hole in the mirror, and then meet me on the other side.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Rescue the Campers
quests.description: We've got to get these kids out of here, and fast! Those cultists are sure to have the keys - get them, and then unlock those cages and get the kids to safety!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Stop the Ringleader
quests.description: The woman in red seems to be the ringleader here. Once we've stopped her, maybe she can shed some light on what exactly is going on, here… and lead us to Shrade himself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat Shrade!
quests.description: Can you believe it? Shrade is REAL! I mean, I knew this all along, of course. But now we have proof! Now's your chance to be a hero, Hero - and go down in history as the one who ended the threat of Shrade!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Revitalize the Camp
quests.description: This would be a great place to take creepy kids who love spooky stories. If this camp were cleaned up just a bit, we could really breathe new life into it. What do you say, Hero?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tired of Gremlins
quests.description: Ugh. My car's not too bad off, but I'm still going to need to fix this flat tire before we can get moving again. I'll need a jack, an air pump, and something to patch that tire with. You can probably get them off those auto gremlins roaming the area.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shrade! ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the final quest.

quests.name: I Don't Mean To Be CRUDE
quests.description: Dang, these oil elementals have sucked the gas right out of my car! We'll have to get it back from them. I'll need at least 6 gallons to get us out of here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shrade! ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the final quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: When I Say Jump...
quests.description: Looks like I'm going to need to jump my car to get it running again. I know that huge auto gremlin has some - I saw him stuff them into his pack. Get them from him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shrade! ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the final quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Energizing!
quests.description: Unfortunately, there aren't any working cars down here to attach those cables to. But never fear - I have an idea! Capture the Energy Elemental that's roaming the area, and we'll use it to jump my car!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shrade! ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the final quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cabin in the Woods
quests.description: So, what do you think? Is this cabin safe, or are we about to walk into a den full of serial killers? Well, there's only one way to find out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shrade! ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the final quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Base-ic Solution
quests.description: The basement is the best place to hide out until the threat has passed - but it's locked! I suspect one of those monster outside has stolen the key. See if you can find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shrade! ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the final quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Surprise!
quests.description: Alright, let's unlock that door. Then we'll go downstairs and look around to make sure the basement is secure.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shrade! ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the final quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: First Aid Supplies
quests.description: First things first - we'll need to get some medical supplies for Marybeth. Bandages, ointment and such. I saw their first aid kit open on the ground, and that makes me think these monsters have stolen the supplies. Get them back!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shrade! ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the final quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wood for Trap?
quests.description: We'll need some plywood to build that trap Marybeth was talking about. Luckily, their backyard is crawling with Treeants! You know what to do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shrade! ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the final quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tool Time
quests.description: We're also going to need a hammer and a box of nails. I bet you can find both of those things in the tool shed out back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shrade! ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the final quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Obstacle Course
quests.description: Oh no! You'd better run back to the basement - fast! Slow Shrade down while you go by dropping obstacles in his path! Talk to Voltaire when you get there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shrade! ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the final quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Barricades!
quests.description: He's HERE?! Looks like we won't be building a trap just yet - board up these windows and doors so we can keep him OUT!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shrade! ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the final quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Take Him Out!
quests.description: I would have been disappointed if this hadn't culminated in a dramatic conflict between good and evil. You fight, I'll film! Go get him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shrade! ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the final quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Too Many Zombies!
quests.description: There are way too many zombies on this ship! We'd better get rid of them before we head down below. Otherwise they might steal it and sail off without us!

quests.name: Fishbone
quests.description: We'd better find a couple of intact Fishbones before we head down! It's sort of like a wishbone, but it gives you good luck underwater. What? It's a thing! We'll get them from these fishwings, of course.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Down you go!
quests.description: Aright, we're all set! Let's head down to the shipwreck. I'll meet you down there!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Shoo, Fish
quests.description: This shipwreck has a ton of merdraconians squatting in it! That must be why the old crew was so desperate to take our ship. We'd better shoo them out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shocking
quests.description: Some of the old ship's crew is still here, too. Unfortunately, well… they're zombies. We've gotta find some way to talk to them! I bet a shock from those electric eel tails will jump start their brains again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Zappy Zappy
quests.description: Now, let's find someone who's willing to talk to us about this mess! Head back to the ship and attach these tails to the zombies' heads until one of them decides to be helpful. …You might have to rough them up a little first. It can be hard to get zombies to cooperate.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: That Zombie's Mad!
quests.description: Looks like that cranial jumpstart doesn't last very long - and now that zombie's MAD! Oh, well. Guess you'd better beat him up again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Picky
quests.description: Alright, so - locked room in the cargo hold, huh? We're going to need some lockpicks to take care of that. Those merdraconians look like hoodlums to me. I bet they'd have some.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Very Picky
quests.description: Alright, we have the lockpicks. Now go pick that lock! (You've got at least a couple ranks in Rogue, right?) I can't wait to see what we find back there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Having a BLAST
quests.description: So, you got the door unlocked, but it's still jammed shut? Alright, then we'll just have to blast it open with some Explosive Electricity from those electric eels. (What do you mean, is that even possible? This is a game! Don't overthink it.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the Sea Witch!
quests.description: Well, I guess we're fighting a sea witch now! You can handle that, though. It's no problem, right? …Right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spectral Energy
quests.description: We're going to need a lot of energy to deal with this mess! In our current, ghostly form, that means only one thing: spectro-plasm! Luckily, I see a lot of it floating around this ship.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Sea Witch! ' quest.

quests.name: Ugh, Ghosts!
quests.description: Not all of these spooky sailors are our friends! Some of them seem to know what we're up to, and they're not happy about it. We'd better do something about it before they stab us in the back. Or in the front.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Sea Witch! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Curses
quests.description: Hey, it looks like you found a clue on one of those ghostly sailors… some kind of tiny, blue, shining orb. It looks like a piece of… a curse! See if you can find any more of them. They could be anywhere, so leave no stone unturned.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Sea Witch! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fishwing Oil
quests.description: Now, let's see if we can find a way to destroy these little bits of curse. The only place we didn't find any of it was on those ghostly fishwings. They must be the key! Get me some of their fish oil. I want to try something out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Sea Witch! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Test the Oil
quests.description: Let's see what this stuff does! I've set up a little table, here, where we can run some experiments. Collect some Ghostly Fish Oil from the bottle on the table, and then drip some onto the small piece of Curse on the far left, and let's see what happens.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Sea Witch! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Scale it Up
quests.description: The fish oil was a good start, but something is still missing. Maybe it's their scales! Gather some for me, and we'll see what those do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Sea Witch! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Test the Scales
quests.description: Now, let's test this out! Collect the Fish Oil and the scales, and then test on the second glob of Curse!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Sea Witch! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Sharp Fishbones
quests.description: Oh, what the heck? Humor me, Hero. Fight those Fishwings again, and this time bring me back a few nice, sharp fishbones.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Sea Witch! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Final Test
quests.description: Alright, let's try this one last time. First the fish oil. Then the scales. And THEN, stab it with one of those fishbones. Collect all three items from the table, and then click on the right hand orb!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Sea Witch! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get Through the Seawraiths
quests.description: Those two Seawraiths are just past that door, blocking the way down into the hold. We're not going to let them keep us out, though, are we?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Sea Witch! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get to the Treasure Room
quests.description: The layout looks pretty similar to the sunken ship, don't you think? I bet we need to get to that treasure room. That's where Hargoyle was when he set it off to begin with. Looks like we're going to need to fight our way through a whole slew of monsters to get there, though!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Sea Witch! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Open the Door
quests.description: The door is jammed, just like it was in the real ship. Well… it worked before! Blow it open with electricity! …Ghostly electricity.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Sea Witch! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Destroy the Curse!
quests.description: So, this thing is the curse, right? This terrifying, malformed, glowing sea witch? And if we kill it, we'll stop being ghosts? I vote we stab it with a fishbone.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Sea Witch! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Milk and Cookies
quests.description: Lesson one: Always leave milk and cookies for Santa! I heard some of our moglin friends say that the Sneevil Toymakers in /factory like them, too, Maybe you can convince them to share some?

quests.name: Nom Noms
quests.description: It would be nice to leave something for his reindeer too, don't you think? They've got to be hungry from all that flying they do. How about some of the Sweet Snow Carrots that grow around here? Pick me a few big ones.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Strong Friends
quests.description: What we need now is a big tree for all the presents to go under. There are some nice ones in /snowyvale, but they're too big for us to carry. Maybe you could convince some of those Polar Golems to help?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Light Bright
quests.description: We can't just leave our tree undecorated! You see all those Frostvale Sprites flitting around? I bet they'd make great Frostval lights. Catch us some - enough to cover the tree.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: No, The OTHER Tinsel
quests.description: We should string some tinsel onto the tree, too. I don't know where we could buy any, but I bet we can make some out of shards of ice! I bet you could get some from the monsters in /alpine. We're gonna need a lot.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Finishing Touch
quests.description: Every holiday tree needs a ton of glass baubles hung on its branches for no apparent reason! I actually DID bring a box of those with me, also for no apparent reason. But the Frost Makai have stolen them! Get them back for me, will you?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Feather of Crow
quests.description: The first ingredient in any proper spell is, of course, Feather of Crow. I see some birds around here that kinda look like Snow Crows. We'll try some feathers from those and see how they work.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tail of 'Newt'
quests.description: As everyone knows, another "must-have" ingredient is Tail of Newt. You don't really have newts around here though, do you? Oh well - the Frost Togs in /coldwindvalley are probably close enough.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: And A Red Fuzzy Hat
quests.description: And now for the finishing touch: one red, fuzzy, warm winter hat! I think I know just where to get one. Your friends mentioned a Santy Claws? In /northlandlight, was it? Why don't we just… borrow his?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Minions!
quests.description: If we're going to get out of here, we're going to have to fight our way through a LOT of minions first. You'd better get started!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: High Spirits
quests.description: Look at all these spirits roaming around in here. Do you think they're the people who Krampus trapped in here before us? I wonder if there's a way to free them. I guess you could fight them and see if that works. That's how it usually goes, right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Smashing!
quests.description: There's a spot in here where the glass is deeply cracked, as if someone had already been trying to break through. We might be able to smash it if we keep hitting it. That nice, shiny weapon of yours should do the trick.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get Hacking
quests.description: Alright, I get it. We messed up! But I think we can agree that we both had an equal role in this disaster. Luckily, one of us still has a nice, sharp weapon that can PROBABLY get us out of it. Well? Go! Get hacking!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: So Many Monsters
quests.description: This entire town is crawling with monsters! Normally, I like a good scare. But something tells me these things are NOT going to be much fun! We've gotta get rid of them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Hacking ' quest.

quests.name: Not Everything Changed
quests.description: It seems like not everything in town has changed. Don't you think that's strange? See what you can find that's still the same, aside from us. Whatever those things are… they might be the key.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Hacking ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Destroy it!
quests.description: Uh oh - collecting all those items hasn't gone unnoticed! The town seems to have unleashed some kind of dark energy at us. I'm thinking we'd better destroy it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Hacking ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'YOU are here?' quest.

quests.name: Spy Skulls
quests.description: The town itself seemed to know that we'd made that discovery… but how? Do you think those Snow Skulls are spying on us? We'd better confiscate their eyes just in case.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Hacking ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get The Keys
quests.description: The entire time we've been here… have you seen any of our friends? I'm getting a little worried. I'm hoping they're holed up in some of these houses, but they're all locked. I saw one of those Living Frost monsters drop a key. Maybe you can find some more?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Hacking ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: YOU are here?
quests.description: Now that we've got some keys, let's take a peek inside these houses and see if we can find someone… ANYONE.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Hacking ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: More Energy
quests.description: Ok, ok. I think I have an idea. What if we collect a bunch of this Dark Energy… and try to change it back into whatever it was before?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Hacking ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Test Time' quest.

quests.name: Soak Them
quests.description: If these "Santa" objects got this stuffs attention last time… I wonder what would happen if we completely immersed them in it? Let's find out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Hacking ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Test Time
quests.description: It worked! We've turned these little chunks of nightmare back into… Frostval Energy? Look how cool and frosty and blue it is! We'll use it to restore everyone back to their original selves. Although, they may not be so willing at first… you might have to force it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Hacking ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get Krampus
quests.description: He wants a fight, huh? Well, I'm not scared of that goat-legged miscreant! Why, you ask? Because I know YOU'RE going to kick his butt. Go get him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Hacking ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Souls
quests.description: The surrounding area was filled with the bones of those who had come before. These unfortunate souls had made it through… hadn't they? Maybe THEIR souls were what Dage needed. Would they give him the insight he was missing?

quests.name: The Blackened Heart
quests.description: Three artifacts - won from three guardians. Fiends from the other side. The first, a blackened heart, torn from the chest of the Enigma's creator, transformed by his dark intentions. He had to find it… fight its guardian… and claim it for himself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Ancient Athame
quests.description: The second artifact Dage needed to procure was an Ancient Athame - a ritual knife that had been used to cut the hand of the Enigma's creator and open the pathway to another realm. It, too, was somewhere in these caverns, waiting to be found.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Withered Hand
quests.description: Third, and finally, the hand that the Athame had cut, severed from the creator's body once the portal had opened. Dage would not stop now. He was determined to find this last artifact, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Bones
quests.description: Dage turned his attention back to the Bones of the Doomed. They had all attempted to solve the Enigma before. They would be able to tell him what had to be done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Puzzle
quests.description: Dage knew what to do… all that was left now was to solve the Enigma and find out what mysteries it offered.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Slasher Medals
quests.description: Dage wasn't about to give up without a fight. Shrade silently retreated from the front lines, manipulating his minions from the shadows. Dage did the same, gathering medals from the bodies of the fallen.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Puzzle ' quest.

quests.name: Mega Slasher Medals
quests.description: The war waged on. Both sides took losses, but for every soldier who fell, another rose in their place. Shrade sent his more powerful allies into the battle, then; monsters who hit harder, but fell harder, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Puzzle ' quest. | Must have completed either the previous or ' Legion Medals ' quest. Note: Unlocked when the war meter reached 25%.

quests.name: Bladehands
quests.description: As the battle continued, it became clear that they would need to defang the other side… literally. Dage sent his troops to fight the Bladehands, and bring back their bladed fingers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Puzzle ' quest. | Must have completed either the previous or ' Mega Legion Medals ' quest. Note: Unlocked when the war meter reached 75%.

quests.name: Defeat Shrade
quests.description: The final battle was upon them. Dage gathered his allies, and prepared to confront Shrade and his army of bogeymen.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Puzzle ' quest. | Must have completed either the previous or ' Jagged Canines ' quest. Note: Unlocked when the war meter reached 100%.

quests.name: Legion Medals
quests.description: Shrade wasn't about to give up without a fight. Dage silently retreated from the front lines, manipulating his minions from the shadows. Shrade did the same, gathering medals from the bodies of the fallen.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Puzzle ' quest.

quests.name: Mega Legion Medals
quests.description: The war waged on. Both sides took losses, but for every soldier who fell, another rose in their place. Dage sent his more powerful allies into the battle, then; minions who hit harder, but fell harder, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Puzzle ' quest. | Must have completed either the previous or ' Slasher Medals ' quest. Note: Unlocked when the war meter reached 25%.

quests.name: Jagged Canines
quests.description: As the battle continued, it became clear that they would need to defang the other side… literally. Shrade sent his troops to fight the Legion Maws, and bring back their jagged canines.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Puzzle ' quest. | Must have completed either the previous or ' Mega Slasher Medals ' quest. Note: Unlocked when the war meter reached 75%.

quests.name: Defeat Dage
quests.description: The final battle was upon them. Shrade gathered his allies, and prepared to confront Dage and his invading forces.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Puzzle ' quest. | Must have completed either the previous or ' Bladehands ' quest. Note: Unlocked when the war meter reached 100%.

quests.name: Creepy Undead Monkey Quest
quests.description: Every dark carnival needs a terrifyingly adorable mascot. This little critter will bite the hand that feeds him… and then bite your face… He's so CUTE when he's hungry! If you think you can handle the horror of this hungry, hungry hominid, bring back dark delights to tempt him. Good luck!

items.name: Creepy Undead Monkey On Your Back

quests.name: That Cake is a Lie
quests.description: I can't believe a giant monster cake is trying to kill me! Isn't this just my luck? Kick its frosting, hero!

quests.name: Get the Cupcakes
quests.description: I should've known - the cupcakes I made have turned into ravenous fiends, too! But this time, we won't waste them. When you smash them, try to save the frosting. I'm thinking a sugar rush will help us all wake up and get away from this nightmare.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wash it Down
quests.description: That frosting is SO SWEET! I really need something to wash it down with, don't you? Good thing we've got a lot of punch. Go get us some drinks, eh?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Freezer Key
quests.description: Ugh, these drinks are way too warm. I have a freezer full of ice, but I seem to have misplaced the key. One of the monsters must have stolen it! I don't know which one, but if you can find it, we can cool off.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ice it Up
quests.description: Well, it looks like the ice in the freezer has turned into monsters, too. Because of course it has. Chip some off for us so we can make the punch nice and cold, like it should be.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: I Scream, You Scream!
quests.description: Whoof, I'm feeling so tired from all of this fighting. Aren't you? I think we need more sugar! There was ice cream in the freezer, too, right? Yeah… bring me that.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clear the Hallway
quests.description: My bedroom is down that hall… that dark hall, full of monsters. We'll have to fight our way through it to get there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sleepytime Gear
quests.description: I can't sleep like this! I need my pajamas… my Deady Bear… and a nice cup of chamomile tea. Do you think these monsters have stolen my stuff? Or did I just misplace it all? Either way, you've gotta help me find it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Too Bright
quests.description: It's way too bright in here. Those spooky lanterns are mostly harmless, but I can't sleep with all this light! You don't have to hurt them, just take their flames away.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What's That Under my Bed?
quests.description: Ugh, the monster under my bed is making SO much noise. Can you make it quiet down so I can try to sleep?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Talk to Memet
quests.description: You know Memet… you guys are friends, right? Go talk to her. See if you can get her motivated.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Why Can't I Sleep? ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Try Coffee
quests.description: So she won't get out of bed, huh? Maybe we should bring her some coffee. That should put some pep in her step. Those Eye Wyrms look pretty twitchy. I bet they have some.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Why Can't I Sleep? ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Put Out the Embers
quests.description: The flames outside keep getting closer, and some of the embers have started to blow over with the wind. We'd better put out the fires they've started before they burn this whole place down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Why Can't I Sleep? ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kibble for Nibbles
quests.description: Back to the moglin problem. Sometimes when I'm feeling bad, comfort food helps. But what does she even like? Nightmare kibble? See if you can find some to bring to her. Any of the roaming nightmares could be carrying it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Why Can't I Sleep? ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Board up the Windows
quests.description: Man, this storm is getting worse and worse. Come on, help me board up the windows before it blows them in! Those Cyclones have torn up a lot of buildings… see if you can pull any sturdy boards out of them. While you're at it, maybe you can find a box of nails, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Why Can't I Sleep? ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Energy Needed
quests.description: I'm going to need a lot of raw material to get this project started. Since we're in a dream, I'm thinking that means dream energy… or, more specifically, nightmare energy. Collect it from any of the wandering nightmares you find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Why Can't I Sleep? ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Audition the Wyrms
quests.description: We're also going to need a solid cast for this show we're putting on. I bet some of these nightmares are aspiring actors! The Eye Wyrms seem pretty sentient. See if you can convince any to help.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Why Can't I Sleep? ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Killer Beats
quests.description: Next, we'll need a good soundtrack. Do you hear how those Nightmare Maws keep clacking their teeth? Some of them have had some killer beats… pun intended!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Why Can't I Sleep? ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stop the Storm
quests.description: Ok, this is going to take a while to finish. Fend off the storm while I get to work. That will buy us some time.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Why Can't I Sleep? ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lighten the Despair
quests.description: I get the feeling nightmare anxiety is worse than the normal kind. We'd better get rid of it fast, before it devours us all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Why Can't I Sleep? ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the ' Infiltrate the Mermaids ' quest.

quests.name: Murderbug Medal
quests.description: Ok, look. I know giant, murderous insects don't REALLY carry around war medals, but that's what you guys expect, right? So bring me some Murderbug Medals. Bring one from every bug you kill. In dreams, you can do anything.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lighten the Despair ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed though the War Meter after completing the 'Fire Tornado' quest.

quests.name: Mega Murderbug Medal
quests.description: Oh, did you find some MEGA Murderbug Medals? Man, that's great. That means you must have beaten up some really tough ones. I'll mark those down on the tally.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lighten the Despair ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed though the War Meter after completing the 'Fire Tornado' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Elemental Medal
quests.description: Wind, rain, and fire. I guess this time, Elemental Medals is what you need! Let's get rid of this terrible weather, and try to save the planet… I mean, our Harvest Feast.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lighten the Despair ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed though the War Meter after completing the 'Fire Tornado' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mega Elemental Medal
quests.description: Hey, how about some Mega Elemental Medals? Whenever you fight off an extra-nasty cyclone or fire, you'll get one. Too bad it's so hard to tell which ones are going to end up being the worst…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lighten the Despair ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed though the War Meter after completing the 'Fire Tornado' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fire Tornado
quests.description: This is it, hero. If we're going to save the Harvest Feast… and maybe all of Lore… we've got to take on a gigantic… possibly sentient… Fire Tornado. Tell me honestly, is this the weirdest thing you've fought?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lighten the Despair ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed though the War Meter after completing the 'Fire Tornado' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: The Flies
quests.description: When Deadfly was summoned, a swarm of Grave Flies came with him. They're destroying everything—and everyone! We have to get rid of them.

quests.name: Dem Bones
quests.description: Most of the Shadowscythe's skeletal minions were able to fight the flies off. But a few of them look like they need a little help. Collect their bones so they can be put back together.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gather the Reagents
quests.description: According to Emily's research, there is a way we can send Deadfly back to the Underworld. A ritual we can perform. But we'll need a few reagents. Harvest some Rotting Marrow from the Skeletal Minions—don't worry, they'll grow it back!—and a handful of Spider Lilies.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rip it Out
quests.description: We're also going to need a still-beating heart. Not many of those around this place unless you want to use yours… or maybe mine! But there is one more. The Gutripper may be undead, but its musty heart is still technically beating.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Steal the Wands
quests.description: Just one more thing—some good, Undead, Dark Magic! Let's just borrow a few wands from the Skeletal Mages and use those. I'm sure they won't mind.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get to Emily
quests.description: Emily has gone back into her research lab. Let's bring these reagents to her!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: More of the Flies
quests.description: We have to find Emily fast, before Deadfly does any harm to her. Gather a few of the remaining Grave Flies. I think I know how to use them to find where they are.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Follow the Swarm
quests.description: So, those flies you collected? You see how they're buzzing? So desperate to get loose. So that's what we're going to do. Set them loose. They'll return to their master, and all we have to do is follow.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find Emily
quests.description: So… that's where Deadfly took Loremaster Emily. Some kind of dungeon, from the look of it. I wonder why? It looks like it's heavily guarded, so you're going to have to fight your way inside. I'll meet you there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Deadfly
quests.description: We've brought everything we need to send Deadfly back where he came from! I'll start putting together the ritual. I just need you to hold him off to buy me some time.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gossip Time
quests.description: First, we're going to need to find out where this Commander Rotfinger is. Interrogate a few Skeletal Minions and see if anyone knows where to find him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Souls for Offering
quests.description: Well, hero, we've got a problem: Rotfinger is already dead! But his soul still exists in the Underworld. And that means… we've gotta get into the Underworld. Gather a few fresh souls from the Skeletal Mages. If we bring them to the portal, it may just open for us… as long as Dage is pleased with our offering
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clue by 8
quests.description: A guy like Rotfinger isn't going to blend into the background, not even down here. He's sure to have made a big splash. Talk to some of the wandering Underworld Souls and see if you can find any possible clues.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Souls for Offering ' quest.

quests.name: Cloth n' Coal
quests.description: It sounds like Rotfinger has had a hard time getting over Deadfly, too. Hero, I have just the plan to draw him out. Gather a few scraps of cloth from the Blademasters, and a few chunks of Ghastly Coal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Souls for Offering ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Bait the Hook
quests.description: I've used the cloth and coal you brought me to make a few… shall we say, provocative banners. We're going to use them as bait. Pass them out to some of the loitering Underworld Souls, and then kick back and wait.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Souls for Offering ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Rotfinger's Reckoning
quests.description: Ha! I knew it would work! Those pro-Deadfly banners made Rotfinger angry enough to show himself. Find him, Hero, and make him regret what he's done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Souls for Offering ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Underworld Home Renovations
quests.description: The underworld is just my style, and Rotfinger has just what I need for my gothic lair. Would you be able to get a few parts from him for me?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rotfinger's Reckoning ' quest.

quests.name: Shop of Vandalized Horrors
quests.description: I would have loved to saunter out of Mysterious Johnson's fascinating boutique with Alejandro under my lapel. What a shame. We'll have to settle for escaping with our limbs attached. The cursed artifacts won't make that easy. You're going to have to dismantle them first.

quests.name: Browsing for a Way Out
quests.description: Perfect, we finally have some breathing room. A quick exit's next on the shopping list. I have a feeling it won't be as simple as jumping out the front door. You're free to check and disappoint yourself but perhaps you'd find better use directing your energy towards investigating the shop. Look for a way out. I'm sure Johnson the Mysterious has an escape hatch somewhere.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Key for Free
quests.description: I thought about rolling up our sleeves and breaking the lock, but it could pile a second curse on the one we already have. Then we'll have to do things the polite gentlemanly or proper lady-ly way. Search for a key to unlock the basement door.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Rampaging Desk Jockey
quests.description: Crafty and gutsy of the shopkeep to use a Desk Mimic as furniture. He'd be putting his fingers at risk every time he needed another pot of ink. And now, I'm putting you at risk by asking that you fight the Desk Mimic and grab the Basement Key. Now now, you're an expert at this! A well executed heimlich maneuver should make it cough up the key.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Steeped in Porcelain
quests.description: If it weren't for this dire situation, I would find this evil spirit's penchant for adopting his owner's likes to be adorable. He came to enjoy tea parties during his time under Sally's roof. Putting a party together will lure Alejandro out. Let's grab a table, some chairs, and a tea set. Some of these should be displayed in the open, while others might be in the grips of those cursed artifacts.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Stuffy Guests
quests.description: The manual asks that we have guests over for the tea party. According to the steps, their willingness to join does not matter. Let's skip over that detail seeing as we don't have any neighbors in this realm. I did catch a glimpse of some fuzzy creatures having a romp in the shop. Invite them over. And by invite, I mean knock them unconscious and drag them back here. Sally said she'll figure it out from there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Snotty Crumbs
quests.description: Alejandro is going to turn his nose up at a tea party with an empty table. We need to boil up a fresh pot of tea and serve a plate of cookies. As for the ingredients…You've seen what happens when a person gets possessed. They sweat slime and ectoplasm out of every pore. Objects are no different. Gather slime and ectoplasm from the shop's fine cursed residents.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Wobbly Rune Writing
quests.description: The table's in place, party guests sitting up straight, and the tea's piping hot! What remains are the trap runes. Six of them in the general area. Copy them exactly as they are in the manual, place them down, and hope Sally's sketching skills are better than her penmanship.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Broken Sights
quests.description: Opera glasses aren't just for squinting at the dots on the stage. If I happen to hear a howl in the night, I tend to turn my lenses towards the noise. To better protect myself, and not out of morbid fascination of course. Alejandro has taken to using them to watch his own back. Smash them so we can have the advantage of surprise.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Teddy Tailor
quests.description: Alejandro's going to have a harder time seeing us coming. Why not have him welcome us instead? He enjoyed the company of the guests as the tea party so surely, he'd love to have them over again. Skin a couple of the live ones, and I'll sew them into a costume. A bow tie would finish the ensembles nicely. You can find those on the curios.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Immaterial Dowsing
quests.description: Thanks to Alejandro's magical temper, we're in a realm that wobbles the senses. It isn't immediately apparent but you need to be in tip top shape to run that doll down. Collect spirit gems from the denizens of the basement. It'll attune you to the atmosphere and allow you to follow the trails Alejandro left.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Be Our Bait Guest
quests.description: Sally seemed frustrated over the first attempt to trap Alejandro. She wrangled monsters to make a new tea party trap while you busied yourself. All you need to do now is pull out a chair and take a seat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Pint-Sized Poltergeist
quests.description: You were the perfect bait to lure Alejandro in! Now reach over and give the doll a throttling. I'd say that fighting someone a quarter of your size is a lot harder than tussling with someone taller. Especially if you don't want to touch them given the way you might feel about how Alejandro looks. Well, steel your stomach and take him down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Chilblain
quests.description: Candy Claws is searching the astern hallway on the first floor, but the Cold Apparitions are causing a ruckus. Give the gentle Gargoyle a hand by clearing the way. He needs room to fly!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Maceration ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Fool's Gold
quests.description: I heard shouting coming from upstairs. Someone is attacking Miss Valencia, and I believe it's the simulacrum of her distant father! Come now, we must rush to her aid!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Maceration ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Acid Reflux
quests.description: Rooms 1 to 4 are locked shut, and we're out of keys. This is going to need something a lot more caustic than elbow grease. Gather up the puddles of acid slithering around the halls, and use them to melt everyone's locks. Remember to wear gloves!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Maceration ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Here of Free Will?
quests.description: You valiantly rescued everyone upstairs, but Candy Claws has yet to return! I fear he may be menaced by the hotel guests that have already fallen victim to the cold. He must be in the dining room down the east hall. Save him, before it's too late!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Maceration ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the ' Fie Fie ' quest.

quests.name: Arrived by Compulsion?
quests.description: Candy Claws warned us that someone separated Aria from the fake Lark. She's in the room next to the dining hall. We shouldn't trust that they have the young lady's best interest at heart. Rescue Aria, and free her once and for all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Maceration ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Empty Nest
quests.description: Aria came back to her senses! She said that the thing wearing her mother's face took her father upstairs to the room in the center of the hotel. That must be the heart and pulse of this living building are hidden. The time has come to silence this place for good.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Maceration ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ensemble's Conclusion
quests.description: The hotel's going to be taken down to prevent wandering explorers from getting trapped inside. I'm not one to make others clean my stage for me, so let's lend a helping hand. It's in the Frostval Spirit!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Empty Nest ' quest.

quests.name: Heartless Monsters
quests.description: Taking our constitutions into account, we'd both die of awkwardness overdose if you fight the fellow chasing us. A quick escape is in order. Let's treat ourselves to a brisk jog through the cemetery, and dispatch the Zombies that get in our way.

quests.name: Heart Throb
quests.description: So I was right after all! They're actually carving hearts out of Zombies to send as grotesque presents! Those Hearty Gifts have minds of their own, and are just as Undead as the Zombies. It's best we beat them before they give us both a heart attack.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Love in Every Form
quests.description: Hm, aren't those gallantly crimson fellows Love Knights in Big Daddy's service? They've taken your mistaken admirer's side in this debacle. There must have been a misunderstanding, but you'll need to clear it up with blades and bludgeons.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Love's Call
quests.description: That fellow you gave the Snugglegram to by accident must have been a big shot. Every grave is cracking open, and warriors are heeding his call. They must be really itching to stretch their legs if they'd return from the dead to grab your ankles.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eat Your Heart Out
quests.description: Let's duck into the next corner for a breather. We'll have to clear out the Zombies and Hearts, but that shouldn't be too hard given they're too busy eating each other to see us coming.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Undead Wing-Liches (and Wing-Cutie)
quests.description: Well, that escalated quickly. Heroes Heart Day is going to be dead in the ground if we don't sort out the Shadowscythes' personal lives. Are there other members of the Empress' entourage around? Maybe they can convince her to handle this quietly.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Deranged Duty
quests.description: We can't expect help from the peanut gallery. What now? Ah! We should ask Big Daddy, the foremost expert on love, to bring clarity to this miscommunication. We'll have to fight our way through the Knights and Warriors to find him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Dead and the Restless
quests.description: Curiosity killed the cat, but finding out brought it back. Mind sating my curiosity and breathing some life into the graves? I want to take a closer look at them. If our big, pushy problem came back from the dead, maybe our solution will too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Work Obligations
quests.description: Mr. Vaioh, despite his extended absence, must have an Evil amount of influence in the Empire. An Illusionist who looks far more skilled than her brutish contemporaries is coming to capture you for her mentor. Keep your wits about you, now!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Does Your Heart Quiver?
quests.description: Well, if it isn't the man of the hour. General Vaioh's finally caught up to us. It'd feel better if he was here to kill us. Defeating him won't stop Gravelyn from obliterating Heroes Heart Day, but it'll feel great! Then, we can get back to Big Daddy, and settle this for good.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Return to Sender
quests.description: Friday the 13th isn't over, and feelings don't pass the same way Heroes Heart Day does. How about we pat the grave dirt down over General Vaioh and Zio one last time?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Does Your Heart Quiver? ' quest.

quests.name: Return to Sender (Legend)
quests.description: Friday the 13th isn't over, and feelings don't pass the same way Heroes Heart Day does. How about we pat the grave dirt down over General Vaioh and Zio one last time?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Does Your Heart Quiver? ' quest.

quests.name: Dorian
quests.description: This isn't our first time sneaking out but, I've never chaperoned you outside of the capital before. Look at you, all bright eyed like the fresh meat that shows up at the knights' training grounds. Let's not go too crazy. How about we chat up someone in town? Look, there's a kid playing outside his house. Try to be casual, treat him like another adult. We're outside the castle so we'll drop formalities. Haha, nervous? You'll get used to it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mahapadma ' quest.

quests.name: Hypophrygian
quests.description: Loshe figured out we were from the capital because of how nice our clothes are. The bandits can tell too. That's what I get for taking you shopping. You drag me into a boutique and I get mistaken for being bougie. Let's get rid of these pests discreetly. Them and their dogs. Hmm, I'm getting a bad feeling from this.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mahapadma ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Ionian
quests.description: We've spent too much time in the village. Loshe said that the shapeshifter had been taken today. If we're fast enough, we can catch up to them in the forest. I wish our maps weren't so outdated. The capital doesn't pay enough attention to remote villages to keep them up to date. And of course, the path is hidden by the foliage. Let's scout ahead carefully, and make note of markers. That way, I won't get executed for losing the Prince in the woods.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mahapadma ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Lydian
quests.description: Look at these layabouts. The bandits were taking their time, lounging in the woods having a breather. I'll count that as lucky for us. We'll go through them one by one and shake them down for information. You know how I love to pounce on someone with their head in the clouds, or buried in a book. Pay attention if you don't want a scare.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mahapadma ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Mixolydian
quests.description: Found them! And someone's already rearranged their faces and limbs, ouch. That must have hurt, considering whoever did this also pried open the bars of that cage with their bare hands. The kid escaped, hopefully unscathed. We need to find them before the bats swarm. All this ruckus riled them up. I can see why Astravians don't take vacations to Eridani often. My ears…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mahapadma ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Hypomixolydian
quests.description: What were the Eridani villagers afraid of? Tripping over the poor kid. I guess there was a real danger of that when they were kicking him. Let's get his side of the story and treat his wounds. In the meantime, could you scout ahead? I'd do it myself but the kid's a hugger. Stay hidden and don't take risks. I'm giving the bandages I was saving for you to the kid.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mahapadma ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Locrian
quests.description: The bandits up ahead must have sensed that something was wrong. Great, and none of the sleepyheads around us are conscious. Is it too late to wake one of them up to lie about everything being fine? I'll work on that and you can handle the dogs that got sent our way. Hurts to have to fight them. I know Titania would be devastated. He's a real dog lover. Huh? You have a plan? Sure, I'll help you catch some bats.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mahapadma ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Aeolian
quests.description: Did you just ask the kid to hug me and cry if I tried to leave you behind with them? You know I can't leave weepy kids alone! Including you. I'm not letting you into that cave alone! It'll gobble you up! Don't get me wrong, you got the guts. But, a real fight without me to help you is a lot different from one in a closed arena…Ugh, at least put together a disguise and take them by surprise.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mahapadma ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Troubadour
quests.description: The Outsider did make it in first! Wow, literally mopped the floor with the bandits. There's more of them on the ground than there is dirt. Hm…She seems angry. I think it's because you're dressed like a bandit. Quick, tell her you're a concerned noble in disguise! That's not really a lie. Ah…made it worse did it? Stall then! Defend yourself, and I'll run over as fast as possible!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mahapadma ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Pastorela
quests.description: I'll be calling in the Prince's guard to clean up the leftovers. But, if you're not ready to go back to the Capital just yet, I'm sure they'd appreciate having less work to do. We'll knock down a few more bandits so the Eridani villagers can sleep at night. You and I can get to know Suki better too. I think the best way to go about that is with a spar. I think we're on the same page with that.

quests.name: Fungi for a Fun Guy
quests.description: The antidotes and poisons shrooms offer are endless. I've mastered flowers, but need more in my arsenal to take on the Queen of Monsters. Gather a colony of Monstrous Spores to study. I need at least one spore kept alive for closer inspection.

quests.name: Rose By Any Other Name
quests.description: A foe never expects beauty to pack a punch. I mutated the Treeant's concealed upper branches years ago to sprout roses in hopes of impressing a certain lady druid. After that successful Hero Heart's Day, I saw the power of a Rose's thorns. Take out Bright Treeants and return to me with a bunch and I'll let you in on a Greywhorl family secret.

quests.name: Corruption of Elfhame
quests.description: I'm thankful you've arrived, so much is at stake. The future of Birghtoak depends on us getting the Celestial Horn of Balance back and activating the Guardian Statue. The Queen has corrupted this region and Brightoak will be next if we don't work fast! Examine what's left of Elfhame and begin your extermination of the Ruin Stalkers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the ' Cut the Rose ', ' Purifying the Grove ' or ' Zero Tolerance for Nature ' quest.

quests.name: Restoring Nature
quests.description: There has been a dire disruption of peace between wildlife and Elfhame's people. In order to restore the balance of nature, I will need some ingredients to create a restoration potion. Purchase Bastet's Water of Life in /sandsea (Make sure to buy more than one… we will need multiple potions to save this land), recover four Herbal Remedies from Wolfwoods and three Bright Ores from Bright Treeants in /brightoak. This potion might just be what we need!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the ' Cut the Rose ', ' Purifying the Grove ' or ' Zero Tolerance for Nature ' quest.

quests.name: Unlock the Guardian's First Rune
quests.description: The mouth of the Guardian Statue HAS to be opened or else we may NEVER stop the poison seeping into the World Tree! You will have to activate four runes located on various areas on the statue's legs. Once you've cleared the are and restored some of the nature in Elfhame, the rune will activate.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the ' Cut the Rose ', ' Purifying the Grove ' or ' Zero Tolerance for Nature ' quest.

quests.name: Gnome Sweet Gnome
quests.description: The Ruin Dweller gnomes prevent us from getting what we need done! Eliminate this creature's threat in Elfhame, and then travel to /mudluk and speak with Paddylump - his elixir will help us clear the are of those wretched gnomes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the ' Cut the Rose ', ' Purifying the Grove ' or ' Zero Tolerance for Nature ' quest.

quests.name: Unlock the Guardian's Second Rune
quests.description: The second rune located on the statue's right arm is far more decayed than the 1st rune on the leg. We need a stronger restoration of nature to activate this rune. Be sure to rid the area Gnome Wolfriders in the area or they will never let you restore the arm in piece.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the ' Cut the Rose ', ' Purifying the Grove ' or ' Zero Tolerance for Nature ' quest.

quests.name: I Know kaRATe
quests.description: Much like the gnomes, the Ratawampus pose the same threat to our efforts. Your task is simple - take them down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the ' Cut the Rose ', ' Purifying the Grove ' or ' Zero Tolerance for Nature ' quest.

quests.name: Unlock the Guardian's Third Rune
quests.description: Time is running out and we still have two more tunes to activate. Clear the Ratawampus' from the area so that the third runes, located on the statue's torso, can be unlocked. The corruption of the Queen of Monsters is even stronger here, so you'll need more Restoration of Nature potion than before.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the ' Cut the Rose ', ' Purifying the Grove ' or ' Zero Tolerance for Nature ' quest.

quests.name: Unlock the Guardian's Fourth Rune
quests.description: The fourth and last rune will require the largest number of Restoration Potions, so get to work. Every minute we spend out here reduces our change of keeping Brightoak safe. You will have to put in your best effort to restore nature to unlock the fourth rune and clear the Ruin Stalkers that are preventing the rune's activation. We need more restoration of nature now than ever for a chance to break through Elfhame's corruption.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the ' Cut the Rose ', ' Purifying the Grove ' or ' Zero Tolerance for Nature ' quest.

quests.name: Unlocking the Guardian's Mouth
quests.description: All four of the runes have been activated. The puzzle to open the Guardian's Mouth is the final obstacle. Solve it and we can confront the spirit!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the ' Cut the Rose ', ' Purifying the Grove ' or ' Zero Tolerance for Nature ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Guardian Spirit
quests.description: Although I was not able to retrieve the Celestial Horn of Balance, I know what needs to be done. For all of Brightoak, you must defeat the Guardian spirit and restore balance to Elfhame!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the ' Cut the Rose ', ' Purifying the Grove ' or ' Zero Tolerance for Nature ' quest.

quests.name: Don't Hold Back
quests.description: The very first opponents you'll encounter in the Arena should be easily manageable for someone of your standing. These Dark Legion Guards, Sergeants, and Gladiators are no more than grunts. Just like rowdy children, this bunch needs to be taught how to behave. Show me what you can do.

quests.name: They Just Won't Learn
quests.description: The next round of warriors are stronger than your typical Legion members; they are the Legion's deadliest malcontents - Paladins, Undead Legends, and Blade Masters who have forgotten what loyalty means. They are a troublesome group, and this isn't the first time they been here. I think they actually enjoy the fighting and pain. Feel free to not show them any mercy. I actually think they prefer it that way too.

quests.name: Test Your Might
quests.description: I am sure Dage would be grateful for your help teaching his wildest warriors discipline. You deserve a reward, and battles against some of the Legion's finest. The stronger your opponents, the more likely it is that they'll have what you need to get new gear from me

quests.name: First Class Entertainment
quests.description: You know, many in the legion already have a miniature assistant to help them out when it comes to getting the Legion Tokens Dage likes so much. Some poor souls don't seem to have one. I usually help out with that. I can't lie, I love a good show. What better way to be entertained than watch someone throw their life away for a few measly tokens? Say, Hero, wanna take part in it? I placed something that belongs to me on the Undead Rider. A brooch. Retrieve my brooch and I will hand you a generous amount of tokens. Sound simple enough?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to The King ' quest.

quests.name: Worthy of the Blade
quests.description: I will teach you the ways of The Blade Master, but I need proof that you can withstand the training. Travel all across Lore and find me the things I need to craft something to serve as an example of your skill. Survive and return in one piece, and I will reward you.

quests.name: Head Hunter
quests.description: A Darkblood colleague of mine has his sights set on you. I mentioned you the last time we met, and he's willing to give his gear to a brother-in-arms. Prove yourself by defeating the Colossal Primarch in /BossChallenge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have SoulKeeper Blade in your inventory.

quests.name: Gone But not Forgotten
quests.description: The vast majority of the Order might be missing, but they haven't been forgotten! We will honor them whether they are here or not, and to do that, we can't just leave their weaponry lying in the dust or in an enemy's hands. Collect the swords on the ground and the axes that the Undead have looted and return them to me.

quests.name: Hole-y Armor Patching
quests.description: Part of a Paladin's protection comes from their Armor. So you can imagine what happens when they don a hole-y armor - their defenses go down! We need to make sure all the spare armors is in perfect condition. In case they come back. Find me armor-fixing components so the armorers can get to work!

quests.name: Palladinum Paladin Parts
quests.description: There's this substance, Palladinum, known only to our Warriors. We mix it with our Blessed Water to make a coating for weaponry. But I have a feeling that Ectoplasm would do… interesting things to it. I'd like to experiment. Bring me 1 of Blessed Water from the fountain, 2 globs of Ectoplasmic Goo, and 4 beams of light from the windows! (Quest can only be done once per login)

quests.name: Up to the Highest Heights
quests.description: Let's go kill our fright! Our fear of the highest heights! I hear monsters roaring. Up at the atmosphere, come, I will take you there. Let's go… go kill our fright!

quests.name: High-sterical
quests.description: You should laugh in the face of your fears, but for some people, a fear of heights is hardly funny business. They are being mocked by Fear Munchers and Banished Banshees who have no sympathy for them. Collect 6 Fear Muncher teeth and record 4 Banshee wails to prove they'll never mock again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Elevation Sensation
quests.description: As if it were'nt bad enough to be so hig up, Banished Banshee and Cloaked Fiends don't even touch the ground! Can you take them higher, to a place where Terrorkind can see? That it's not right to frighten people, who only want to live their dreams? Elevate 5 Banished Banshee and 5 Cloaked Fiends.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Altitude Adjustment
quests.description: These Cloaked Fiends and Abandoned Dollys think their ability to terrify makes them cunning, crafty, and definitely high and mighty. They really need an altitude adjustment! Give 3 Cloaked Fiends and 5 Abandoned Dollys a reality check!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Conquer Vertigo
quests.description: It's not easy to be afraid of heights. Think of all the things it prevents a person from doing: climbing mountains, having their bedroom on the second floor, and- if it get REALLY bad- just standing up! For everyone who is afraid of the heights, face Vertigo, and stand up for their fear!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: No Matter How Dark the Night
quests.description: A wise man once told me, "No matter how dark the night, somehow the sun rises once again and all shadows are chased away." Bring me the beans of sunlight that 5 Banished Banshees and 4 Fear Muncher are hiding away.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Conquer Vertigo quest.

quests.name: The Dark (K)Nights
quests.description: I heard a rumor that 8 Cloaked Fiends are amassing into a corps of Dark Knights. You can't let them congregate, If they form into a such phalanx, they'll be unstoppable. They'll rule the night and people afraid of the dark will have no place to hide from their fears!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Something, Something Dark Side
quests.description: Ooooh, bother! I had another warning for you about the terrors of the dark. It went… argh, I wish I could remember. It was about something, something… Dark side. And it had to do with Banished Banshees and Abandoned Dollys. Just to be safe, slay 6 Banished Banshees and 5 Dollys and if I remember it later, we won't have to worry
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: Name is a direct reference to the Family Guy TV trilogy series "Something, Something, Dark Side".

quests.name: One Little Candle
quests.description: Remember, it is better to light one little candle than to curse the darkness. But why stop at just one? Lets really lights this place up! Place 10 lit candles around the map

quests.name: Conquer Nyctox
quests.description: The dark is nothing to fear. What is IN the dark might be scary to some people, but the dark itself holds no power. Shine the light of truth on Nyctox: show the world that there no reason to be afraid of the dark. Or of Nyctox.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Death Be Not Pround
quests.description: There's a chance Death might not be pround of this dark, twisted land, but Thanatops, the manifestation of the fear of death, certainly is! Explore his realm and see just what kind of a tormented landscape he calls home.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Conquer Nyctox quest

quests.name: What Fear Makes
quests.description: A wise people many leagues from here have a saying:
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Little Death
quests.description: You must not fear. Fear Munchers are the mind-killers. Face your fear, if you feel it at all. Permit it to pass over you and throughout you, and only you will remain. Bring me 8 Munched Mind-Killers to show that others will not need to be afraid any longer
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Terrify the Terrorkind
quests.description: The Terrorkind have frightened so many of BattleOn's citizens into thinking their death draws closer. That is not right! Show those malicious manifestation minions what it is like to know the fear of death. Terrify 2 Cloaked Fiends, 3 Abandoned Dollys, 3 Banished Banshees, and 2 Fear Munchers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Conquer Thanatops
quests.description: Everyone is afraid to die at one point or another. It's conquering that fear that makes a person brave. But you, you are a Hero. You mastered that fear long ago. Show Thanatops that he has no power over you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Azal
quests.description: You…I know you. YOU are the one who is responsible for THIS! YOU are the one who chained me to this fate. This life. The agony I suffered. I will crush you and use your bones to pick my teeth. Come "hero" you will be the last fight I personally enjoy.

quests.name: Fallen Feathers
quests.description: Well, well. Aranx isn't the only Celestial that Anethyx'o took control of. I recognize the Infernal Pegasi guarding the path to The Bright One's throne. They were guardians that were forcibly transformed. Destroy them. It'll be a mercy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith the Disavowed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Seven Heavens
quests.description: W-what is this? The Bright Dominions further up the tower are Infernals that reverted back to their Celestial forms. How could this even be possible? Bring them to me. This has to be some sort of joke.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith the Disavowed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Omniscient Judgement
quests.description: We're being spied on. Do you notice that the tower is growing eyes? The Bright One's gaze is upon us, and I rather value my privacy. I don't know why Arthelyn thought that being watched was comforting. Search the tower, and close those eyes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith the Disavowed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rapturous Ascent
quests.description: The Infernal Pegasi and Bright Dominions are taking formation. Someone has taken command of them. Clip their wings, break their horns, and shatter their defenses. Drench this tower in black and gold blood.
