quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith the Disavowed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Broken Stoicism
quests.description: There, in front of that golden effigy. That is the Arthelyn of the present. She is nothing more than a fallen husk, puppeted by the greater will of The Bright One. This isn't anything like my Infernals. I can't stand to look at this. Take her down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith the Disavowed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bitter Blessing
quests.description: Our confrontation with Anethyx'o nears, and I can tell that they are anticipating us. New Eudae are appearing, caught in between their Celestial and Infernal forms. Free them from The Bright One's will, and bring them silence.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith the Disavowed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Life and Spirits
quests.description: Despite Aranx's plight, his fellow Celestials have chosen to remain loyal to Anethyx'o. The Avatars of Life and Spirits have been sent to take our heads. We will cast them down, and I will revel in their shame.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith the Disavowed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: On Your Time
quests.description: I was wondering where the third of the Celestial Avatars was. Only the Avatar of Time remains in our path…and The Bright One's hold on them is stronger than it was with the others. Hmm, you seem incensed. I won't get in your way. Cast this pretender down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith the Disavowed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rapid Metanoia
quests.description: The last of the Eudae stand between us and The Bright One's throne. With them gone, Anethyx'o will have no choice but to face our wrath. Come. We will end this on our terms, and free our fates.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith the Disavowed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Filial Impiety
quests.description: I sense that Aranx's transformation into an Infernal is complete. We will defeat him, but The Bright One is our true adversary. Once we fight Aranx to a standstill, you'll meet my maker, and I'll bring my brother back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azalith the Disavowed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Journal Entry 1
quests.description: This cell is cramped. You can hear the screams and moans of the other celestials trapped. All of us are aware of one thing. We must suffer until Aranx can arrive. He will surely save us. All we need is to have faith. Until then all we can do is keep the Imps out of our cells.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Azal the Infernal's Quest ' quest.

quests.name: Journal Entry 15
quests.description: They let us out sometimes. While the logic says to attack and escape, we're bound by dampening chains and cuffs. Our magic and our strength are being drained. They tell us this is our new life. They tell us Aranx won't be coming for us. The Hero hasn't come. Do we wait for them? Of course we do. They will come for us. But for now, food is extremely scarce. The Imps are the only source of food. But we have to catch them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Journal Entry 56
quests.description: A chance. There's a chance. A guard was caught off guard. We took it. He looked new. There was hesitation in him. He hesitated in everything, really. That's fine. We took advantage of that hesitation. Odd though, was that a hint of white in its wings? No matter.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Journal Entry 77
quests.description: We learned the truth. The Rookie Guard was a Celestial. They dressed him as one of their own and sent him out there as a guard. We…We killed one of our own? And so savagely..so horrendously… Is that why they laughed and didn't interfere that day? What are we doing? We can't be forgiven now. Just eat. Forget. Don't remember. Food will take the mind off things.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Journal Entry 151
quests.description: These infernal pests are starting to taste good. Maybe that's just familiarity kicking in. Maybe my mind is trying to make the best out of a situation. It's fine though. The one Celestial on the other side of my cell keeps taking more than his share of food. If he keeps taking more food, things will not look good for him. Doesn't he remember to share? I'm taking him out tonight in the hall when no one's looking.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Journal Entry 324
quests.description: The other Celestials seem scared of me. Why? I'm one of them aren't I? Why are they treating me as if I'm some rabid dog. Why do they look at me like that? What are they thinking when they look at me? Oh well. More food for me. I'll have to take it from another Celestial during the night. They aren't sharing their portions.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Journal Entry 583
quests.description: I don’t know how long I been here. The only "dates" I have are the number of entries I’ve written. I wonder, is this for myself? Is this for the Hero to find? Is this for proof of the suffering I endured for that Aranx? Why am I writing these? There doesn't seem to be a point in this. There doesn’t seem to be a point in anything anymore. I’m gonna try something risky. There’s a Guard with a hound of some sort with him. I’m gonna try and take them out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Journal Entry 600
quests.description: I don't know where they took me. I was in more chains and I was blindfolded. They had me laying down somewhere. A table? It was something, that's all I can tell now from how long I been here. But the pain I felt. The absolute mortifying pain. Were they clipping my wings? It was like part of me was being chipped away and filled in with something else. I have to leave. I will die here. They aren't going to come for me. Survive. That's all I need to do. Just survive for now. The hounds here are alone and weak. They can be a good meal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Journal Entry 826
quests.description: I can walk out of my cell more freely now than before. The Infernals don't seem to be on guard. In fact they…talk? With me. Like I'm one of their own… Why do I feel so familiar with them? They're telling me things they shouldn't. My wings look darker. Maybe all the dust finally seeped in and started to make them seem darker. Since they don't care, I'll just steal what rations I can from the wandering Celestials.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Journal Entry 1000
quests.description: I got into a fight with some of the Infernals. In this state, I lost, of course. But some of their demonic blood got into my open wounds. There's a big change in me. I HAVE to leave tonight. I will leave tonight. I must defeat the Guard Captain in order to make my escape into Dreadrock…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Poor Baby
quests.description: MAMA! Y u hurt Mama? *sniff* Make better? Pls Pinkmeat Notfood? (Yara says: Defeat lavarock for the Dragonsboon Ore and Lava Mages for Burnwort. Prick your finger on that stone over there for the “life essence” we need – “sanguis vitae”)

quests.name: FlameTongue's Treasure
quests.description: Baby Dragon not sure you can be trusted to look after him. Prove you can by slaying Uriax, Akriloth and Drakonnan.

quests.name: Dedicated Denial of Resources Attack
quests.description: Gruh, those Horcs. Always watching, waiting for us to let our defenses down. Then BOOM, they'll strike, burn us out of our homes. But not if they've got to focus on feeding themselves! Then we'll be safe for awhile. Take out 7 Vultures, 5 Boars, and 3 Rhisons. That'll keep them out hunting, and not attacking!

quests.name: Trolls of War
quests.description: Eh, you, Hero. You'll appreciate my newest song. I'm sure you've heard it around town. Called "Trolls of War," made to stir these young Trolls into a fightin' mood! Can't play it just now, got no instruments. They're all out for repairs. Can you bring me 7 Drum Leathers from Boars and 10 Vulture Talon Rattles?

quests.name: Gentle Muse, Breathe Life into my Art!
quests.description: A Troll's got to pay his way in this town as long as the Elders are in charge, and there's no way I'd rather do that than play. But all THEY want are gentle songs. And to do that, I need new strings. BAH. Any of the monsters will have what I need. Just bring me back 15 Uncured Harp Strings and I'll owe you a mug of Berry Juice.

quests.name: Fight the Darkness
quests.description: You must find Jinella and Raskar. They are in /Darkoviaforest. On your way, Battle the bats in Darkoviagrave who spy for the Vampires. We cannot take the chance they will reveal our plan.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nocturan Adept Battle ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

Bag of Gems Quest Cape's Quest.name: Bag of Gems Quest Cape's Quest

quests.name: Frostval 2020 Collection
quests.description: Have a holly jolly Frostval, hero! We need another crystal for our bag of gems. Bring me a crystal from the Ice Crystals in the /icedungeon zone and I will give you a character page badge to display!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Bag of Gems Quest Cape in your inventory.

quests.name: Camping Out
quests.description: If we are to spend the night in the Marsh, the first thing we will need is a fire. A fire will provide light and warmth, both of which will assist in keeping the foul marsh creatures at bay while I work. Venture forth into the Marsh and bring back some lumber from the native trees, but beware the foul creatures that call this Marsh home. (Bring back 8 pieces of lumber to complete this quest)

quests.name: Something in the Water
quests.description: The Undead have always been drawn to this Marsh, and no one have ever been able to figure out why. My research, however, suggests that it has something to do with the Marsh Lurkers who make their home here. I suspect that they somehow alter the chemistry of the water to make it poisonous to the living, but irresistable to the Undead. The answer is so close… I just need another 10 Lurker Glands to continue my research. (Return with 10 Lurker Glands to complete this quest)

quests.name: Hair, Tooth and Bone
quests.description: My research is progressing well thus far; however, there are forces that are disrupting my power. Somewhere in this marsh there are three very powerful creatures: a Dark With, and Undead Beserker, and something only known as a Soulseeker. I believe that some form of mystic aura binds these three creatures together. If you can, bring me a sample from each: a lock of hair, a tooth and a finger bone. By studying these items, I hope to define the nature of the force that binds them. (Return with a Witch Hair, Beserker Tooth, and Finger Bone to complete this quest)

quests.name: Ruined Plans
quests.description: An orc named Thrax Ironhide has been searching around the ancient ruins which lie deep within the heart of the marsh. He's got some sort of treasure map that he never lets out of his sight. If you can get his map from him maybe he'll just… go home. Please, stop him before he ruins the… uh… ruins. (Return to Bal Gravestorm in the Marsh with Thrax's Treasure Map.)

quests.name: Unreadable Map
quests.description: That Thrax Ironhide is very clever for an Orc. He actually coded the map so it would be unreadable. To decode his map it would take me ages without the decoder. Can you bring me back the Map Decoder? Thrax never goes anywhere without it… (Bring back the Map Decoder to complete the quest.)

quests.name: BallyCool's Generosity Coins
quests.description: I want to thank you for being such a kind Hero by giving you two free Generosity Coins to spend in the Merge Shop! I left them over by the Frogzard in /Battleontown, so you miiiiight just need to defeat it to get your coins back. Happy Frostval!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chilly's Participation Quest 2024 ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Diamond Exchange
quests.description: (This quest subject to change)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragonslayer Reward ' quest to access these quests. Note: These quests can only be accessed by the owner of the pet.

quests.name: Supplies to Spin The Wheel of Chance
quests.description: Nulgath requires relics of power. Chaos infests the lands and the chaorrupted items are what he seeks. Bring me a cursed relic of chaos and you can spin my wheel!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragonslayer Reward ' quest to access these quests. Note: These quests can only be accessed by the owner of the pet. | Must be Level 10.

quests.name: The Assistant
quests.description: Lore has had many revolutions and many wars. There are unique items from these wars to be found, and I'm interested. Bring me War-Torn Memorabilia from Yulgar's Armor Shop, and you can spin my wheel!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragonslayer Reward ' quest to access these quests. Note: These quests can only be accessed by the owner of the pet.

quests.name: Voucher Item: Twin Blade of Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says your voucher will get you the "Twin Blade of Nulgath". This weapon is for blade masters. Your enemy will tremble at the mere sight of you dual wielding this weapon. Redeem your purchase here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragonslayer Reward ' quest to access these quests. Note: These quests can only be accessed by the owner of the pet.

quests.name: Bamboozle vs Drudgen
quests.description: Bamboozle says, so this Drudgen got a promotion I hear. I guess it's time I step up my game. I know of another valuable resource if you're willing to act as the muscle. Bring me some Tainted Cores and I'll trade you a chaos item so you can spin the wheel.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragonslayer Reward ' quest to access these quests. Note: These quests can only be accessed by the owner of the pet.

quests.name: The Poisonous Deal
quests.description: You want more? More Tainted Gems and Dark Crystal Shards to hoard for Master Nulgath's most desired rewards? Then prove you deserve it. Bring us the Bone Axe, 2 of the Archfiend's Blood Gems, and 30 bags of dirt. Crag loves dirt. Bring them back to us for your reward, and don't you dare complain that it isn't enough! If Master Nulgath wouldn't go easy on you, then why should we?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragonslayer Reward ' quest to access these quests. Note: These quests can only be accessed by the owner of the pet. | Must have Tainted Claymore in your inventory.

quests.name: The Refreshing Deal
quests.description: You want more? More gems and totems to hoard for Master Nulgath's most desired rewards? Then prove you deserve it. Bring us the Dragon Bone Hammer, 2 of the Archfiend's Blood Gems, and 30 bags of dirt. Crag loves dirt. Bring them back to us for your reward, and don't you dare complain that it isn't enough! If Master Nulgath wouldn't go easy on you, then why should we?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragonslayer Reward ' quest to access these quests. Note: These quests can only be accessed by the owner of the pet. | Must have Purified Claymore of Destiny in your inventory.

quests.name: Star of the Sandsea
quests.description: Ah, the Star of the Sandsea! A gem so beautiful it's worthy of worship, but you may have to wander for a while before you find it.

quests.name: Ice Diamond
quests.description: The Ice Diamond is big, beautiful, and ice-cold. But I bet you guessed that from the name! A gemstone fit for a king, but you may need to find some coal to warm it up first.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dark Bloodstone
quests.description: As dark as a bag full of type O-negative, but it's not fit for any vampire to drink. It's said that these gems are created, not mined, but you'd have to ask a Lore Keeper about that.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Doomstone
quests.description: An unstable gem with the potential to cause a lot of PAIN! Ironically, you won't find it in the shadows… you'll have to go to where it's bright. Or maybe try looking in the mirror?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Void Opal
quests.description: You'll have to get this one before you run out of time. Or into it? I can never remember - the possibilities are unending. Whatever. Just go! And don't come slithering back until you've got it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mana Crystal
quests.description: The hunt for the perfect Mana Crystal has sent many an adventurer on a downward spiral! You may have to dig deep for it, so don't give up after the first try.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Songstone
quests.description: The mythic Songstone! The epic stone of rock. You'll have a hard time getting one without the help of a rock star, or even just a bard. I wonder where you could find one of those?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Butterfly Sapphire
quests.description: I heard this thing is magical… some kinda iron into gold type thing! I dunno, though - I never got properly schooled on it. Maybe someone who does that kinda thing would know more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Understone
quests.description: A rare gem formed in the depths below Lore from the petrified bodies of the Undead. Is that what you think of when you hear the word 'undead… - pretty gemstones? Yeah, me neither. Be warned - you may need to find someone to help you craft it once you've gathered enough raw material. Perhaps a paladin?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rainbow Moonstone
quests.description: A true product of the earth, though its appearance is quite stormy. So many colors swirling together in one stone! Some say it's forged in dragon's fire, but if that was the case… how would we ever get them?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Time Quartz
quests.description: The Time Quartz - a gemstone that has seen the entire span of the planet's life. Surely it's kept by a being just as immortal as it is. If you can't seem to find it… maybe drink a time potion and try again! I hear they sell them at the Inn.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Papers Please
quests.description: Yue said there were strange birds flying around the ship's mast? I'll take a look, but could I ask you for a favor while I make the climb? A rough patch of waves caused the ship to tilt and scatter some of my paperwork. Would you please gather them for me?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Hoo Wants a Cracker ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: King and Coral Snakes
quests.description: All hands on deck, we have a situation! Can I get you to help me do a roll call? Read the scroll you helped me put together and check through our ranks of Warriors and Pirates. If there are inconsistencies, then that means you've found a spy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Hoo Wants a Cracker ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Horizon's Green Flash
quests.description: Our location has been discovered, but we're not sure who exactly is on our tail. We'll head back up to the mast for another look. The owls are still up there and Empress Ai No Miko asked that they be captured.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Hoo Wants a Cracker ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Art of Resilience
quests.description: I didn't want to burden you with menial tasks, so I took care of most of this year's major preparations myself- but now, the Empress and Yue are encouraging me to decorate the red envelopes we'll be giving out. Would you go to /Zhu and collect plum blossoms for me to use as inspiration?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Elixir of the Moon ' quest.

quests.name: Lucky Red
quests.description: The Hong Bao envelopes we'll be giving out to the people of Yokai are empty, so they'll have to fill them with gifts on their own. As such, the actual contents of their New Year's gifts vary- but most people tend to prefer finding Gold inside. If you're looking to give out some, there's a lot of gold you can get from the Merdraconians and Lobthulhu from /Shipwreck.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Elixir of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Palm Soot
quests.description: I got a bit carried away with decorating the envelopes, and used up all of the ink. Fortunately, I know how to get more. On the Isles, we make our ink from pine soot- but let's make the next batch special. The Lava Guardians of /BurningBeach have charcoal that we can render into soot. We can burn it down into soot, and turn them into ink sticks.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Elixir of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hong of the West
quests.description: The preparations for this year's blessings are all done, and thanks to your help, we've been able to finish everything far ahead of schedule. All that's left for me to do is remove a nagging thought from my head. I hate to ask you for such a troublesome favor, but would you please get me a scale from Smoldur in /Ashfallcamp?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Elixir of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Baihong Guan Ri
quests.description: I wanted to get the Hong out of my mind by painting it- but my innate magic caused the drawing to come to life! If the double-headed dragon escapes, there's no telling how much trouble it could cause. I saw it escape to the north… please, help me finally put that beast to rest- both inside and outside of my thoughts!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Elixir of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tense Reunion
quests.description: Yiren took some of the others into the Yokai Realm to do some preliminary scouting. Talk to the other descendants gathered here. It'll help them prepare when it's their turn to enter the portal. We need everyone on board to rescue Ai No Miko.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Head Kukol'nyy ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Kimon
quests.description: Haruki's calling on you from the otherside of the Mikoto Shrine's mirror. It's time to go, so ready your weapon. The Oni that were slain in the war are already manifesting in the Yokai Realm. We can't exactly kill them again, but we'll banish their spirits elsewhere.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Head Kukol'nyy ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Strings of Fate
quests.description: Ai No Mikoto asked that we help the denizens of the Yokai Realm pass on peacefully. To do that, we'll need incense from the Kitsune Spirits, and to remove the impurities in the area- primarily the red strings still tied around the Dragonlings and Lord Kitsune's remaining essence.

quests.name: I Can't Touch This
quests.description: I'd be honored to help Drakath, but unfortunately I can't create the enchantment he needs without a body. The life force of living beings can help me become stronger, and luckily this swamp is full of nasty monsters that no one will miss.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Undead Artix Returns! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Nope, Still a Ghost
quests.description: The life force made me stronger, but I still can't interact with the real world yet. The RedDeath Moglins use Boneweed to control the Swamp Wraiths. Collect some and bring it to me. Then grind it to powder and burn it as an incense. Its smoke will help me solidify.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Undead Artix Returns! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: First We Need a Beacon...
quests.description: Right, so. The first part of our enchantment will be a spirit beacon - it will draw both Xangs' spirits into the mirror. Purified water is what we need, but all we have is a swamp. If you can find some reasonably clean swamp water, I'll see how my purification spell works on it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Undead Artix Returns! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Light It Up
quests.description: Now, we need a strong light to combine with the purified water to complete the beacon. The fire leeches here emit a flame that water doesn't douse. Their flame glands should be just what we need.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Undead Artix Returns! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: ...Next We Need a Trap
quests.description: Once we've drawn the spirits through the mirror, we need to keep them trapped on the other side. Reddeath Swamp is infested with giant spiders - their webbing would make a good base for such a trap. Make sure it's nice and sticky.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Undead Artix Returns! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: For Spirits, Not People
quests.description: Since we're trapping spirits with this enchantment, we'll need to coat the webbing you collected with ectoplasm. You can get some from the Swamp Wraiths, but only bring me the most viscous samples you can find. Otherwise, it won't stick to the webbing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Undead Artix Returns! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Still Too Fragile
quests.description: This is looking good, but the white twins' spirits are strong, and I'm afraid it won't hold them. Gather some spectral energy from the wraiths in the swamp; that will help me strengthen both the webbing and the spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Undead Artix Returns! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Being Solid Is Cool
quests.description: As long as you're still here! The effects of that monstrous life force you brought me earlier won't last forever. If you happen to find some more, I'd be happy to take it off your hands.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' For Spirits, Not People ' quest.

quests.name: Spider Bites Are Not Cool
quests.description: Now that I'm reasonably solid, those Grim Widows are making me nervous. Their poison can't kill me, but a bite still hurts! Thin out their numbers, would you? Bring me their legs for proof, and I'll reward you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' For Spirits, Not People ' quest.

quests.name: Barnabas Castle Quest
quests.description: If you wish to live in a castle like this, you will need to bring me the items I require from the Graveyard: Bony Viking Helm, Tongue of Sprat, Powdered Warrior Heart.
quests.requirements_note: Must have the Barnabus Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Blood Moon Token
quests.description: Sometimes, the only way to defeat your enemy is to BECOME him. Or, as the Pyromancer say, fight fire WITH fire. Bring me a Moon Stone from the Lycan Guard and a vial of Black Blood from the Black Unicorn and I will give you a Blood Moon Token.

quests.name: Blood Moon For Members
quests.description: Sometimes, the only way to defeat your enemy is to BECOME him. Or, as the Pyromancer say, fight fire WITH fire. Bring me a Moon Stone from the Lycan Guard and a vial of Black Blood from the Black Unicorn and I will give you a Blood Moon Token.

quests.name: Sailor of the Celestial Skies
quests.description: 've heard tales o' a legendary pirate who used t' sail through th' celestial realms. I didn' used t' reckon he was real, but his magical trophy sword was found in an icy lich's tomb. Maybe if we follow th' rest o' th' legend, we can find his other treasures. I'll even split it 1:9 wit' ye! I got a trail leadin' t' a demonic warlord at th' helm o' an army in /lostruinswar.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 80.

items.name: Celestial Pirate Commander Character Page Badge

quests.name: Jules' Rules of Cool
quests.description: 'Ello, 'ello, 'ero! You! You will be 'aving a fine 'ead of 'air once I'm done with you! But to complete the masterpiece I see taking shape before my eyes, I will need one simple thing. A teeny little leather top 'at adorned with Harpy feathers! Bring me leather from Sky Pirate Draconians and the feathers from Harpies.

quests.name: Warlord of the Hair
quests.description: Surrounded by Warlords, and none of them take care of their 'air! If only I had one Skyguard recruit to take under my wing, to train up as the Warlord of the 'Air, I would be so 'appy! Perhaps I can entice one to train with me, if you will help. I will need to style their 'air into a most becoming fasion. Please bring me the copper from 10 SteamOcto's.

quests.name: Missing Servant
quests.description: Before you venture back to the Cauldron Sisters and Cysero's Forge Kitchen, I need you to find a very special minion of mine. This little imp has gone missing! I tackled her to restrain her…for her own safety…but she escaped. Find her, and bring her to me and I will reward you handsomely.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Undead End in Sight ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Mostly Dead Makes Trouble
quests.description: The ghouls which will soon come through my Undead End will make perfect servants. I just need to make sure they're completely dead! Mostly-dead ghouls just cause trouble. Bring me the heads of 13 completely dead Ghouls!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Undead End in Sight ' quest. Note: Once you have completed the ' Missing Servant ' quest you will NOT be able to do/turn in these quests until you have Luca's Signet in your inventory!

quests.name: MY Servants are only Food for ME!
quests.description: Forest monsters are killing my servants! Take down 10 of them to show that you've cleared out the latest infestation. Then my servants can sleep peacefully.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Undead End in Sight ' quest. Note: Once you have completed the ' Missing Servant ' quest you will NOT be able to do/turn in these quests until you have Luca's Signet in your inventory!

quests.name: Dark Moglinster DOOM
quests.description: Those hairy moglinsters always creep in and scare my servants! Take out a whole herd of them - that's 10 Moglinsters - so that they remain untainted by fear. I like my servants happy, healthy, and fat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Undead End in Sight ' quest. Note: Once you have completed the ' Missing Servant ' quest you will NOT be able to do/turn in these quests until you have Luca's Signet in your inventory!

quests.name: A Sweet Treat
quests.description: Even I like sweets sometimes. Bring me the heads of 12 Sugarrush Ghouls that I may feast on dessert-treats after my nightly meal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Undead End in Sight ' quest. Note: Once you have completed the ' Missing Servant ' quest you will NOT be able to do/turn in these quests until you have Luca's Signet in your inventory!

quests.name: Vote for Baron
quests.description: Slay Rekshar 10 times in a row to prove that the Nyx Aetema is the strongest faction… and that I am the right ruler for Darkovia's vampires! Show that his endurance and strength are the greatest!

quests.name: Give Rapaxi a Message
quests.description: Rapaxi of the Umbral Legion has no idea with whom he clashes… or that I have YOU on my side! Go to him. Defeat him in battle. Show him the power of my greatest ally… and I will reward you handsomely!

quests.name: What's for Desert?
quests.description: A Sandsea delicacy is taking the sweet Prickly Pears from Cactus Creepers and combining them with a bushel of Sand Flowers. These flavors complement one another for a tasty and healthy treat! Search the Oasis for 13 Sand Flowers and 3 Prickly Pears that the Cactus Creepers produce so I can cook up a Sandsea favorite!

quests.name: Porter-Inn Steaks
quests.description: Ever had Bupers Camel Steak? It is… an acquired taste… but serves as a Sandsea delicacy. By taking Robust Camel Steak and grilling them with Palm Plant Fronds, you get a unique taste quite unlike anything else. You have to try it! Bring back 8 Bupers Camel Steaks and 7 Palm Plant Fronds while I start preparing the grill.

quests.name: Delectable Desert Desserts
quests.description: My shipment of imported sweets hasn't arrived and I'm running low on ingredients for making desserts. Want to do some traveling? I'll pay you very well if you come back successful! Here's the list of what I need:

quests.name: Oil Spills
quests.description: Gah! I'm desperately low on cooking oils! How can a chef cook without the basics!? Help me out again by fetching the following oils found all over lore:

quests.name: The Scarab Sandwich
quests.description: If there is one food that that best defines the Sandsea, it would be my famous Scarab Sandwich. Most of the ingredients can be found locally but what really makes the sandwich legendary is hard to come by. Here's the recipe… good luck finding the last one!

quests.name: Lore Style Surf and Turf
quests.description: Can't decide between meat or fish as your entree? Why not have the best of both worlds on your plate! The Lore Style Surf and Turf features:

quests.name: The Land of Monsters
quests.description: Monsters have scared away everyone! Explore Terra da Festa and report back to me with your findings. Oh, and bring me a Mapinguiari Foot… for luck!

quests.name: Battle and the Beasts
quests.description: Now that you have seen all the monsters, it is time to beat them up! Defeat two monsters of every type and come back to me when the job is done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Festooned in Feathers
quests.description: The monsters have stolen all the Carnaval Feathers! Collect 12 Carnaval Feathers from the monsters and bring them back to me. Hurry—Carnaval will begin shortly, and we need those fantastic feathers!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mask your Emotions
quests.description: These monsters really want to ruin Carnaval, don't they? We will show them! Beat up the baddies until you find 10 more Carnaval Headdresses. The Terra da Festa dancers need Headdresses to dance down the Sambódromo!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Crafting the Carranca
quests.description: Carrancas are wooden sculptures used to ward off evil spirits. So let's make one to scare away all the monsters before Carnaval begins! We will need 5 Pieces of Wood from the Terra Trees, 2 Fangs from the Boiúna, Cuco's Claw for carving, Mulher de Branco's Hair, and a Horse Tail Paint Brush from Mula Sem Cabeça. Good luck!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Party Like a BOSS!
quests.description: Carnaval is about to begin! Take the Carranca to the Sambódromo Arch and defeat the beast who is the ultimate party crasher! If you can defeat him, then Carnaval can begin. Best of luck! Battle on, hero!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gather the Flames
quests.description: We won't be able to find our way through Boitata's lair without some kind of light. The Mula Sem Cabeca can help us. Catch their flames in these jars and bring it back to me.

quests.name: Branching Out
quests.description: Now we need something that can hold a flame. Maybe some nice, thick pieces of bamboo.See what you can find on those Bamboo Treeants.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Torch the Torches
quests.description: Let's use these torches to light up the beach out here before we go into Boitata's lair. The people here will need to be able to see if they're going to get this place ready for a party!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Explore Boitata's Lair
quests.description: Now, let's head into Boitata's lair and take a look around. Explore it thoroughly and see what you can find. And be sure to light some torches along the way so I can follow behind you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Destroy the Growth
quests.description: Boitata will not get better until we've destroyed that dark growth you found. Come back to me when it is done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Reduce the Darkness
quests.description: Boitata's lair is full of darkness elementals. We must get rid of them so that they cannot continue to infect him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Grab a Tailfeather
quests.description: I may be able to create a talisman that will help draw the darkness out of Boitata. But I'll need something that could be hard to get - a tailfeather from Belo Passaro. Maybe if you ask really nicely, he'll give you one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Scales for Feathers
quests.description: We'll need to attune Belo's feather to Boitata so that the talisman will properly work. Go to where he is sleeping and collect some of his fallen scales.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Time for Fire
quests.description: Now, we need something to target the darkness specifically. The flames of the Mula Sem Cabeca are kept ablaze by their ever-burning embers. Bring me some of those.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Shot in the... Dark
quests.description: Now, just go back inside and set our talisman down in front of Boitata. Here's hoping it works!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reduce the Shadow
quests.description: It looks like Boitata DID manage to expel the source of his infection - it's that disgusting Infectious Shadow! Get rid of it so it can't continue to spread.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Light Him Up
quests.description: We HAVE to get the rest of that darkness out of Boitata! I still have one of those Ever-Burning Sparks left from before. We just need to find a way to get INSIDE him. Go to the surface and fight him. I will make my move when the time is right.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Saci Do What he Wants
quests.description: Regardless if you believe in fairy tales or not, the local stories and folklore here, well.. They're all here. You'll see Saci holding a spoon right now. I think that spoon belongs to a woman named Nastácia. He probably has her other cookware on him. It's best we get it back. Knowing our luck, he probably doesn't even have all of them on him.. We'll have to trap him. You remember how to do that, right?

quests.name: Undying Rage
quests.description: Hey Hero, so there's this ghoul in the forest and… it might sound crazy but… it might very well be Corpo-Seco. I know we were just talking about him in folklore but I did say there's been sightings in the forest, no? Would you uhh, go take care of that? Bring me something as proof so I know it's been dealt with.

quests.name: Can Ya Smell What Cuca's Cooking?
quests.description: So friend, I can call you friend now after everything yes? A few locals told me children have wandered into the forest and they haven't returned yet. I hate to think the stories are real BUT on the slight chance they are.. Can we go look inside and see if we can find them? I don't have a very good feeling about this.

quests.name: Save Them
quests.description: Monsters are rampaging through the festival grounds! Help me get everyone to safety!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Grime Time ' quest.

quests.name: Skeleton Party
quests.description: Hordes of skeletal dancers have risen from their graves to party with the Bicho Papao! We've got to get them back in the ground where they belong, or the party will be ruined!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Grime Time ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Monstrous Feathers
quests.description: And did you see what's happened to everyone's costumes? The feathers have come to life and turned into monsters of their own! You'd better get them back, or everyone will have to dance naked!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Grime Time ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Remove the Mask
quests.description: Oh, this is a disaster! The Bicho Papao -Diego!- is destroying everything! We have to get that mask off! It's the only way poor Diego will ever be himself again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Grime Time ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Necklace for Me
quests.description: I've heard legends about a beautiful, spirit bead necklace that was broken and scattered here long ago. If you can help me try and recover the shards of the necklace, I'm sure I can be the center of attention for the next Carnaval! I'll help you get some of the Carnaval outfits if you do! Any of the monsters here might have pieces of it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Remove the Mask ' quest.

quests.name: Elemental Balance
quests.description: Most elementals will keep to themselves. There are some though, that are very aggressive and will attack anything or anyone on sight. They will sometimes uproot rare plants when attacking. Take a walk through the Amazon if you like and see if any elementals attack you. I'm sure you'll be fine.

quests.name: Bandits and Treasure Hunters
quests.description: The Amazon is vast and beautiful but that also brings trouble. Bandits come to hide out in the dense vegetation. Most are just looking to make an easy fortune. They uproot everything in their path to find something of value, leaving destruction in their path. If you find anyone out there damaging the land, be sure to teach them that the Amazon is beautiful but also dangerous. Scare them out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Plants be Spooky
quests.description: While it is beautiful, some of the vegetation seems to be…invasive. Normally, you'll never find seed spitters around here, but there seems to be some roaming around. Do you think you could help remove some? It would be greatly appreciated.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Test of Will
quests.description: You have been a great help friend. Iara is very pleased with your efforts. She would like to meet you. Go to the end of the path, and find the whirlpool in the lake. She lives at the bottom of it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ultra Iara
quests.description: Legends say that Iara in her prime was far more powerful than she is now, and that only the strongest of wills could weather her test. Friend, are you up for the challenge?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Test of Will ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per day.

quests.name: Beat the Dire Groglurk!
quests.description: Head to /bosschallenge and take on the Dire Groglurk - I promise it will be MUCH easier with my help!

quests.name: Beat the Mutated Void Dragon!
quests.description: Head to /bosschallenge and take on the Mutated Void Dragon - I promise it will be MUCH easier with my help!

quests.name: Beat the Underbeast!
quests.description: Head to /ravenloss and take on the Underbeast - I promise it will be MUCH easier with my help!

quests.name: Beat the Manticore!
quests.description: Head to /venomvaults and take on the Manticore - I promise it will be MUCH easier with my help!

quests.name: Beat Binky!
quests.description: Head to /doomvault and take on Binky the Unicorn - I promise it will be MUCH easier with my help!

quests.name: Beat the Bracken Kraken!
quests.description: Head to /vampirates and take on the Bracken Kraken - I promise it will be MUCH easier with my help!

quests.name: Prove Your Worth
quests.description: Do not let these wedding crashers insult Adam… or stop the wedding! Defeat 8 Silver Knights to save the wedding!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Just a FEW More Monsters... ' quest.

quests.name: The Knight is Dark
quests.description: And these battles are full of terror! Defeat 8 Black Knights to make sure the wedding continues!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Most Brutal Battle
quests.description: There is nothing more brutal than an interrupted wedding… and BrutalCorn is ready to make sure Adam and Michelle NEVER get married! Take him down to keep the ceremony going!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Ebilcorp Ninja Nightmare
quests.description: Zhoom don't like them ninjas, and neither do the Bridal Party! While the Groomsmen and Bridesmaids defend Adam and Michelle, YOU take down 8 Ebilcorp Ninjas!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: EbilCorp Drones: On!
quests.description: Chairman Platinum activated his robotic drones! Disassemble 8 drones to make sure he cannot track any of the guests after the wedding!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: EbilCorp Overshadow(scythe)d
quests.description: Chairman Platinum will stop at nothing to stop the wedding! Defeat 10 Ebilcorp Shadowscythe monsters to thwart the Chairman's plans!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Ebilcorp CEOverkill
quests.description: There is NO WAY Chairman Platinum can stop the wedding with you around! Take down the Chairman to keep the wedding running smoothly.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Protect the Cake!
quests.description: If the ninjas eat the cake, there will be none for the guests! Slay 12 of the ninjas to ensure there is food at the reception!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Bellhop and They Don't Stop
quests.description: These bellhops want to help you check out… permanently! Send 12 of them packing instead!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Dork Knight Rising
quests.description: Out of the night, the wyverns rise to attack! Defeat 8 of the Nightwyvern minions and prevent Michelle from being stolen!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: Quest name is a parody of the movie The Dark Knight Rises.

quests.name: Iron Hero... RUSTED!
quests.description: The Iron Hero is famous for his meticulous plots. Find the plans to discover his weakness!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Crush the Wedding Crasher
quests.description: Iron is strong, but YOU are stronger! Defeat 8 Iron Heroes to crush the wedding crushers once and for all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Hats Off to You
quests.description: Little-known fact: Bellhops get the strength to carry those heavy bags from super-reinforced magical Bellhop hats. Steal 5 hats to increase your power and reduce theirs!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: This Boss is a Real Drag(on)!
quests.description: Don't give up now, Hero, the wedding is JUST about to continue! Take on the Hotel Manager before he can shut the wedding down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Eye See Victory!
quests.description: They can't hit you if they can't SEE you! Put the lights out for 10 of these Flying Eyeballs!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Eye Love Battle
quests.description: Whenever you look at Adam and Michelle, you can see the love in their eyes… and so can these Jimmy "the Eye" Heart! Blind his hatred by gathering 6 of his eye hearts.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Bonus Ending: Brutal Battles
quests.description: Battle Brutalcorn until you receive the Brutal Gauntlet to unlock the "OMG WHAT?!?!" bonus ending!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Eye Love Battle' quest (see above).

quests.name: Bonus Ending: Smell of Victory
quests.description: Defeat the hotel manager until you receive the Red Wedding Rose to unlock the Evil bonus ending!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Bonus Ending: Don't Push the Button
quests.description: Defeat Chairman Platinum until you receive the Ebil Button to unlock the Chaos bonus ending!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Groundhorc's Day
quests.description: General Porkon in the Horc Fort has stolen Philip, the weather predicting Groundhog! That pig-headed general doesn't understand that if Philip doesn't at least LOOK at his shadow winter will NEVER END! If you rescue him I can give you one of these GROUNDHORC DAY ONLY seasonal rares! Please go to the Horc Fort and rescue Philip!

Beach Scavenger Zorbak Quest Pet's Quest.name: Beach Scavenger Zorbak Quest Pet's Quest

quests.name: Scorching Summer Badge
quests.description: If you can't stand the heat… defeat the Solar Elementals! Defeat any Solar Elemental in-game to unlock the Scorching Summer collection chest character page badge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Scorching Summer Collection Chest and Beach Scavenger Zorbak Quest Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Sneak and Survey
quests.description: The "good" warrior fights his way through the fray making every enemy aware of his might. You are not that empty headed. Reach the end of the Dragon's den but make not a soul aware of our presence.

quests.name: Finding Weakness
quests.description: The Earth Titan's minions will not give up Rivensylth's location willingly. Take this time to learn every creature's weakness so we capitalize on their insecurities.

quests.name: Swiper Yes Swiping
quests.description: A single spider is hard enough to deal with, let their eggs hatch and we have an army on our hands. Go find any expecting Cave Spiders and make our a little easier.

quests.name: Sly Trickster
quests.description: Use the foxes bad rap to your advantage. Cause a little mischief between the Draklets and Mushrooms by beating up one and blaming it on the other.

quests.name: Courage Means Crazy
quests.description: You chose the evil animal alignment for a reason. You realize that barging in guns ablaze is no way to save Rivensylth. Surprise and destroy Earth Titan Minions until one spills the beans on their leader.

quests.name: Outfox Cave Creepers
quests.description: Rivensylth is near. Now all that stands between us and him are these pesky little Cave Creepers. Clear the path to the dragon.

quests.name: Finding the Dragon
quests.description: Aren't you glad you chose the path of evil? Instead of wasting time embracing nature, we just did what had to be done and now here we are at the very edge of Rivensylth's lair. I'm proud of what we've accomplished - find the stone that will summon Rivensylth.

quests.name: Cut the Rose
quests.description: *grumbles* Just when you think you've finished, there always has to someone else to delay the victory. Avada poses a threat to the continued prosperity of Brightoak and she must be stopped.

quests.name: Extra Credit (Farming Quest)
quests.description: Your work here is done, but you're always welcome to stay and learn more about our culture. Recover 3 stolen storybooks and you might learn something.

quests.name: Dungeons & DOOMFights
quests.description: We're in Dungeons & DoomKnights… the newest of our videogame worlds, and -- Oh no! You can see the Death of Games' influence is already starting to creep into our game universe. You'll need to take out all these 8-Bit undead so we can pass through the portal to the next game world.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Mr Ded ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: AQ3Destruction
quests.description: Phew! We survived the digital destruction and now we're in… O_O an entirely new world with a whole extra dimension. This must be AdventureQuest 3D… and the disintegration has spread even further. Hurry, kill the 3D monsters so we can get to the next world… FAST!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Mr Ded ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: OverSoul Under Attack
quests.description: There are many worlds in our game universe, and many realms and timelines. The Death of Games' corruption is reaching into them ALL! Look at what's happened to the OverSoul. We're running out of time. Slay all the creatures here so we can reach the next portal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Mr Ded ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: HeroSmashed
quests.description: I need a Hero… to SMASH this Death of Games guy in the FACE! Look at what he's done to the world of HeroSmash. Based on how quickly and far the Death of Games' corruption is spreading, we're running out of time. Kill the Riders, Blaster Master, and Super Death so we can reach him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Mr Ded ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: EpicDuel vs DoG
quests.description: This world is WAY too Epic to let the Death of Games destroy it. We can't stop now, or even slow down. Kill the Cyber Hunters and God of War so we can keep moving forward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Mr Ded ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: AQWorlds At Risk
quests.description: It's kind of mindblowing to think that we're HERE in this version of our world at the same time as we're ALSO in the larger game world. But we can't let ourselves get distracted… the disintegration of our world grows worse with each game we travel through. Defeat these iconic AQWorlds monsters so we can reach the Death of Games as quickly as possible!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Mr Ded ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: MechQuest For Glory
quests.description: 5,000 years before the DragonFable universe, the MechQuest world was thriving. We CAN restore it to its former glory… but first we have to stop the Death of Games. Take out these mecha, then continue on to the boss fight ahead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Mr Ded ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: DragonFables & Lore
quests.description: O_O The rich world and lore of DragonFable have been almost entirely destroyed by the Death of Games! We're almost out of time! If he disintegrates our game worlds completely… I don't how how we would reboot the servers. We've got to take out the monsters the enemies ahead of us and MOVE MOVE MOVE!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Mr Ded ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: AdventureQuest for Victory
quests.description: We've reached as far back into our game universe as we can go… the original AdventureQuest from 2002. We have just a bit farther to go. You can DO THIS, Hero! Don't let the Death of Games become a Deus ex Machina. Take out this last round of enemies and let's get to the final boss fight!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Mr Ded ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle On... FOREVER!
quests.description: OMG, the Death of Games just KILLED the AQWORLDS GAME SERVER! Take him down NOW, then we can restore the future of AdventureQuest Worlds.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Mr Ded ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Twilly's Treasure Pile
quests.description: Twilly and Twilly and Twilly want you to have the BEST 20th anniversary event EVER! That's why they've loaded up this pile of treasure and with all sorts of reward gear. Complete this quest to get your very own house item version of Twilly's Treasure Pile, plus even more rewards.

quests.name: I'm Hungry
quests.requirements_note: Must have Beetle General Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Metamorphosis
quests.description: What? Your Void Beetle General is evolving!

quests.name: Still Hungry
quests.requirements_note: Must have Beetle Warlord Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Pink-a-licious-Prowl
quests.description: I think Pink Coral is absolutely beautiful, but it sure is hard to come by— specially since I can't breathe underwater. And Amaranth Flowers are sooo gorgeous, sooo pink, and have a unique history: they've been used in Ancient Temple rituals for centuries! Hint: monsters will drop the items… but it's up to you to figure out which ones! Bring me 3 Pink Corals and 5 Amaranth Flowers, and I'll give you 10 Fuchsia Dyes for your hard work. Good luck —I know you can figure it out =D

quests.name: Pink Petal Power!
quests.description: I lovelovelove flower petals! Especially Puce and Rose Petals! But one Chaorrupted spider has stolen ALL the Puce Petals. I wonder what Forest it could be hiding in…? And there's only one monster man enough to carry a Rose, so I bet that's where you can find Rose Petals! Remember: monsters will drop these items…but it's up to you to figure out which ones! Using these hints, bring me Puce Petals and Rose Petals, and I'll give you 5 Magenta Dyes for your hard work. Good luck!

quests.name: Flowers for the Pink Gal
quests.description: Awwweee! You wanna bring me flowers? *blush!* How thoughtful! Some of my favorite are the super hot pink Fandango Flowers and Lotus Flowers. I heard that Fandango Flowers are grown on Cacti while a certain species of spider grows Lotus Flowers on their back. But where to find them? You're ganna have to beat up baddies to find 'em, duh! Bring me 5 Fandango Flowers and 4 Lotus Flowers and I'll reward you with 8 Fuchsia Dyes and 3 Magenta Dyes!

quests.name: Dyeing for a Challenge
quests.description: You ready for a challenge, Member? Carmine is a super-duper bright pink pigment produced by shelled insects. I wonder what creepy crawly you can find Carmine Pigments from? I also LOVE the beautiful Cerise Flower. It's pretty rare and valuable, considering it only grows on 1 type of spooky woodland tree. And last but not least, I want an Anthurium Flower. This jungle flower only grows in tropical regions, so you might have to travel to paradise in order to find one! Remember that all these items can be found from monsters around the world! Good luck =D

quests.name: Dyeing for Gemstones
quests.description: Heya Member, want 50 Fuchsia Dye? Okay… but this quest is a toughie! Have you seen the Garnet Gem? It's a beautiful deep pink gemstone protected by an ancient being. The protector of that stone sure knows how to keep the Garnet a secret! I also want some Spinel Gems. Just like Garnets, ancient guardians protect Spinel Gems. But the baddies who guard Spinels are stone-cold killers—and I hope that they won't ruin you during your hunt! Come back to me when you have obtained 2 Garnet Gems and 6 Spinel Gems! And remember, these items will drop from monsters, so happy hunting and good luck!

quests.name: Defeat the Chaos Dragon
quests.description: There is music that I can hear that no-one else can. I think it has something to do with all this purple… If you can defeat the Chaos Dragon, maybe you will be able to hear it too! Go look for it on the /castleroof.

quests.name: Drearia On Demand
quests.description: Alright, I need you to scope out the whole area and take notes of all the monster species. Bring back your findings while I go grab some water for our next quest.

quests.name: Plant a Little Seed and Nature Grows
quests.description: All that fur on Makais and Rats must collect some pretty interesting stuff. Amongst many unspeakable things clinging on their fur, I am only interested in obtaining Plant Seeds. can you grab me 5 Clusters of Seeds from those little furry guys?

quests.name: A Key Discovery
quests.description: One of these monsters is bound to have a key to that gate. I mean, they keep all that Gold somewhere… so maybe a Key will drop too! Find the Key, and then you will be able to open the door!

quests.name: Creepy House... Yay!
quests.description: I'm having second thoughts about entering that house. Can you go check it out first and, um, make sure there are no scary rats waiting to pounce? K thx!

quests.name: Sparkling Books
quests.description: Woah! A bookcase that sparkles??? CRAZY! Go click it and see what happens!

quests.name: Plant a Little Seed and Nature Grows
quests.description: All that fur on Makais and Rats must collect some pretty interesting stuff. Amongst many unspeakable things clinging on their fur, I am only interested in obtaining Plant Seeds. can you grab me 5 Clusters of Seeds from those little furry guys?

quests.name: Rats, RATS!
quests.description: Swordhaven's mousetrap budget got cut, and now the Sewer is infested with Beleen's Chaos-infused Rats. If you thought Slimes smell foul… get a whiff of those things. Wait, on a second thought… do not do that. Just defeat enough rats to thin their numbers to prevent the Chaos outbreak from spreading.

quests.name: AdventureQuest Worm
quests.description: Woah, you saw WHAT down there?! A cute version of Grumble? *shudder* No one can handle this much cuteness. It MUST be stopped! Put the suffering beast out of his misery and bring back whatever he leaves behind — it could be a clue.

quests.name: Kill Sparkletooth
quests.description: A knight's worst nightmare has come to fruition: Beleen has transformed the grizzly TwistedTooth into the pink and purple and *gulp* sparkly SparkleTooth! I cannot be within 9000 feet of that beast, so it is up to YOU to defeat it!

quests.name: Fluffy Clouds
quests.description: Since Beleen loves cute and cuddle things, she will NOT be able to resist the adorableness factor of the Beleen Pony… but we need to make it SUPER fluffy. Harvest the area's Fluffy Clouds so we can craft the fur coat of our Beleen Pony.

quests.name: Super Model Makai Hair
quests.description: My notorious Dark Makai minions have turned adorable… and as much as it PAINS me to see them in this horrific state, I must admit that their hair is *ulp* super model material. I need you to gather enough Silky Makai Hair so that we can craft the Beleen Pony's mane and tail

quests.name: Squeaky Business
quests.description: Alright— the Beleen Pony is nearly complete. All we need now is to make it squeaky. As you know, NO ONE can resist fun squeaky toys… especially in Pony-form. So all those Pink Rats scurrying around are PERFECT for adding the final touch (erm, squeak) to the Beleen Pony.

quests.name: Fluffy Clouds
quests.description: Since Beleen loves cute and cuddle things, she will NOT be able to resist the adorableness factor of the Beleen Pony… but we need to make it SUPER fluffy. Harvest the area's Fluffy Clouds so we can craft the fur coat of our Beleen Pony.

quests.name: Super Model Makai Hair
quests.description: My notorious Dark Makai minions have turned adorable… and as much as it PAINS me to see them in this horrific state, I must admit that their hair is *ulp* super model material. I need you to gather enough Silky Makai Hair so that we can craft the Beleen Pony's mane and tail

quests.name: Squeaky Business
quests.description: Alright— the Beleen Pony is nearly complete. All we need now is to make it squeaky. As you know, NO ONE can resist fun squeaky toys… especially in Pony-form. So all those Pink Rats scurrying around are PERFECT for adding the final touch (erm, squeak) to the Beleen Pony.

quests.name: The Best Costumes Need the Best Fabric
quests.description: Obviously we can't go to a dance like this without the MOST fabulous dresses anyone's ever seen! I just need the perfect materials to sew them from. What do you think using the spectral silk that these Eerie Apparitions are wearing? That appropriately spooky, don't you think?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Monster Data ' quest.

quests.name: Accessorize!
quests.description: Now, we need to add some kind of eerie details. Hey, what about those flowers that are growing out there? The ones that look like they've made of bone? Those would be perfect!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Pay the Cover Charge
quests.description: The first thing we need to do is buy admittance to Chateau Swaggy. It costs an arm and a leg, but… I saw Vordred paying you a lot of gold to help turn himself pink, so I'm sure you can afford it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' CH-CH-CH-INCHILLA (AND SLIME) ' quest.

quests.name: Get Some Clues
quests.description: We got into the Chateau, but of course Swaggy's nowhere to be seen. It couldn't be that easy! Talk to as many patrons as you can. Someone's got to know something about where he is!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' CH-CH-CH-INCHILLA (AND SLIME) ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The VIP Lounge
quests.description: So, Swaggy likes to entertain privately… in a place not everyone has access to… that's near the Stargazing Room? Isn't it obvious, my lovely? He must be in the VIP Lounge! We'll have to get a VIP Pass from an Important Guest to access it. Well, I suppose we'll really need THREE.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' CH-CH-CH-INCHILLA (AND SLIME) ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get Past the Bouncer
quests.description: Our moment has arrived! All we need to do is show theses passes to the bouncer at the door, and we'll be in!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' CH-CH-CH-INCHILLA (AND SLIME) ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pinky the Unicorn???
quests.description: I am speechless. Speechless. Tame this glorious pink unicorn that's blocking our path to Swaggy and his golden arrows! And then give it to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' CH-CH-CH-INCHILLA (AND SLIME) ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find The Source
quests.description: Alright, my lovely little partner in crime! In order to actually start helping control this, we need to find where they are actually coming from! I think a good place to start are the Fishwings. Smelly, intrusive, they need to go. Get to it, I'll wait here in case something else comes our way.

quests.name: Search and Rescue
quests.description: On our way, we should keep a lookout for any stragglers trapped by monsters. Plus, it's just good practice to help people in need. Lotta novice heroes usually forget why they are even heroes. We aren't novice heroes.

quests.name: Monstrous Findings
quests.description: Some of the Puddles in this area are glowing. Glowing puddles is not a good sign at all. Be on the lookout for any kind of elemental monsters around here.

quests.name: One Angry Crab
quests.description: When I first heard about these rumors, I didn't actually think they were true. Whatever the case, we need to make sure this thing can't get into the town or we're in for some real trouble. Time for you to do what you do best. I'll make sure everyone finds their way to safely.

quests.name: Clean Air is Good Air
quests.description: Some of the Fishwings are scouring around the area. Obviously we can't have Fishwings flying around like they own the place. Make sure to clean up the place so it's nice and pretty.

quests.name: The Savior Of the People
quests.description: The streets may be clean but the sea most definitely isn't. There's been a surge in the number of people seeing more Sirens lurking about. Let's go clear them out for them.

quests.name: Legendary Cleaning
quests.description: Hay Hero, do you happen to be a Legend around these parts? If so I have a task just for you! While the other heroes focus on one task, I say why not do both? Should be not a problem for you, right?

quests.name: Feeling Crabby
quests.description: That rumor about the crab being true after all still just creeps me out. Can you go out and make sure it doesn't come anywhere near here? I'd rather not see it again.

quests.name: The White Gift Box
quests.description: You know, I love the little Cutie Makais that live in Pastelia. But what I do NOT love is when they steal my gift supplies! I saw it take off with the white box for one of my diamonds. Bring it back, pretty please?

quests.name: The Blush Gift Box
quests.description: I love sparkly, shiny things, so I understand why one of the Dwarfhold dwarves might have wanted some of mine. I'm sure he was disappointed when he found that all he got was a Blush Box I was going to put one of my diamonds in! I bet you'll find it near one of their Gemralds.

quests.name: The Pink Gift Box
quests.description: There's nothing prettier than sunlight glinting off the crystalline monsters in Earthstorm, you know? But I really can't let that Amethite keep the Pink Box it carried off. Would you be able to get it back for me?

quests.name: The Rose Gift Box
quests.description: I know dragons love treasure, so it only makes sense that a purple-y pink dragon would snatch a rose-colored box thinking it held a similar treasure. But I NEED THAT BOX! Please pry it from Stalagbite's cold, chaotic claws.

quests.name: The Cerise Gift Box
quests.description: You know what's even better than a handful of sparkly things? An ENTIRE BUILDING made of them. Which is why I know you won't mind heading into the Castle of Glass to recover my Cerise Box from Chihuly.

quests.name: The Ruby Gift Box
quests.description: You know I love pink. And what's pinker than pink? RED. Rubies are one of my favorite gemstones, and this one is heart shaped. I'm sure that's why the Heart Elementals in Beleensdream stole the box it will come in. I would, if I were them!

quests.name: The Purest Gifts
quests.description: Dragons love treasure, you know? I do, too. But I love GIVING treasure to my favorite people. Goregold, the Dragon of Greed, NEVER would. He's the one who took ALL 6 of the gems I was going to give this Hero's Heart Day. Please get them back for me. I need them to make gifts and Hero's Heart Day is almost here!

quests.name: The Dancing Dead
quests.description: I can't believe this is happening! Hero, we've got to get those zombies out of the street and away from the townspeople! We can't let this get any worse than it already is.

quests.name: Rats n' Goo
quests.description: We're gonna have to clean up this mess up if I ever want to work in this town again! Shoo off the rats that have come out to feed on the… ugh, I don't even want to say it… and mop up the piles of… of zombie goo.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get a Clue
quests.description: What could have caused this… weirdly dancer-specific zombification? We're gonna have to find out. And we're gonna do it by fighting those Zombie Dancers and seeing if we can find any clues.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find Lim
quests.description: We gotta find Lim! Of course he's here, too. Don't look so surprised! This kind of party brings everyone in.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Ask Around
quests.description: We should talk to the other people in the castle and see if they've seen anything, you know, suspicious. Surely someone has to know something, right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Go Tell Beleen ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Zombie Invasion
quests.description: Oh no! The zombies have started to invade the castle! They must know that we're onto them - and now they're trying to stop us! Come on, we've got to get rid of them before they get to the King and Queen.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Castle Zombies
quests.description: Something fishy is definitely happening here - some of the castle's servants have turned against us! But who are they working for?? WHOSE MINIONS ARE THESE? Oh well - for now, just make them stop attacking us!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Warn the King and Queen
quests.description: Man, we've got to warn the King and Queen about this - especially now that we know that whoever's doing this has gotten to the castle staff! They should still be in the throne room.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Monstrous Guards!
quests.description: Who were these - the castle guards? I guess it must be spreading. We've got to get the king and queen out of here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: It's Salvaza!
quests.description: Aw, no, not Salvaza! She was such an icon! I guess you never can trust the sexy ones. Or is that the quiet ones? I can never keep it straight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sweet Summer Treats
quests.description: It can get REALLY hot out in this sun. I think people are getting sun-sick and hallucinating. Why else would they think they're being attacked by dessert? Dispel the fever-dream food and help everyone chill out.

quests.name: Volley Baller
quests.description: You know some of the greatest summer athletes are beach volleyballers, right? Right! I've seen some really SWEET matches right here on this very beach. So tell ya what: you bring me some gum-balls to munch on from the MMMirage and I'll reward you with enough gear to form your own beach volleyball team!

quests.name: Bold Bacon Burglar
quests.description: BACON! The Baconcatzard stole my bacon! Isn't that cannibalism? Anyways, can you get it back? K thx!

quests.name: Break that Heart
quests.description: No wonder all our spells kept going wrong—we had an angry cupid intentionally messing everything up! I guess I shoulda left love to the experts. Luckily, we've got a battle expert here to… hee hee… break that heart!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Very... heart-y ' quest.

quests.name: Heart-vesting
quests.description: Heya! You like pink? Well I have just the gear for you, or I would if I had the dye needed to make it. Bring me some hearts from the Mood Slimes and lug the Stolen Heart over here and I'll be able to make the most purist, most pinkest dye ever!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Break that Heart ' quest.

quests.name: Festive Festa Floats
quests.description: I need your help making Carnaval floats! This should be really fun—but challenging! I need 5 Festive Feathers from Cuco, 3 Float Thingumajigs from Terra da Festa monsters, 5 wood planks from Terra Trees, and 2 White Streamers from the Lady in White. Bring everything back and Cysero and I can help make floats for Carnaval. Good luck, hero!

quests.name: Silky Smooth
quests.description: I want to make us some fun costumes for the celebration! Collect some Spidersilk from the Spiders in /greenguardeast for me! We gotta look good to feel good, am I right?!

quests.name: Birds of Some Feathers
quests.description: I'm seeing feathers EVERYWHERE! We need some too! Could you pluck some feathers from the local Lobisomen for me? They seem like they have plenty to spare!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: People Paint
quests.description: All the colorful body paint looks sooooo fun! Can we get some pleeeeeease? I think the Mapinguari in the area always have some on them! Can you ask nicely for me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shiny Jewels
quests.description: You know I'm a sucker for anything shiny! And the jewels on some of these costumes a soooo pretty! We need some! Now! And we have to have the best ones around! I know the perfect place! The Gilded Crystal Undead in /shipwreck will have the shiniest of all the shiny jewels!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Crushing Crashers
quests.description: Some of the local monsters are trying to kill our mood! Let's return the favor by KILLING THEM! Hahahaha! Just kidding! But maybe just getting them to back off would be nice!
