quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: All That Glitters
quests.description: Everyone knows a good party needs glitter! And those Mula Sem Cabeça nearby look like they poop the stuff! Go and test my theory!!!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Every Party Has A Pooper
quests.description: Man, these creatures need to lighten up! Its Carnival after all! Go help them cheer up!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: If You Like Empanadas
quests.description: I was looking up how to make empanadas and it says you can use chicken OR beef! Ugh, I can't choose… I know! How about both! Go get us some Chickencow Meat from /battleontown!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Purple Drink
quests.description: You can't have good food and not have a good drink to go with it! I'm going to make my special Beleen's Purple Slime Juice! Fetch me some from the Purple Slime in /cellar and I'll make a drink that knocks you on your butt!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hit The Lights
quests.description: The last thing we need are some super bright lights that make the night look like daytime! I think the Reishi in /shinringrove will be the perfect lights to do just that!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bad-tleon
quests.description: It all happened so fast that I haven't had time to fully examine all the damage that's been done. Since I am much too busy standing here, I'll need you to go and explore the town to fully assess the extent of the sadness.

quests.name: Hello Darkness My Old Fiend
quests.description: Here I thought Chaos Lords were bad… but whatever vile fiend did this darkness stunt is SO much worse! …Besides, Chaos baddies were kind of pink, which is pretty awesome, teehehe! But nevermind that – back to the matter at hand: perpetual sadness is where I draw the line, so go out there and rid the darkness with brute force, my fab friend!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Knock Knock, You's There
quests.description: I know all the townsfolk are scared, but if you tell them you're here to help, maybe they will let go of the darkness that is currently consuming them..? Knock on each door in Battleon and let 'em know you want to help them; some might not be home, but hopefully others will open their doors for you and, ideally, open their hearts to your genuine kindness.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Befriend a Friend
quests.description: Oh, our poor Battleon neighbors! Darkness has overtaken them, sapping their spirits – and fashionable color palette – of all hope and happiness! You've been such a great friend to me, so I KNOW you can use your superpower of friendship to befriend others too! Go talk to everybody here and try your best to befriend them. Good luck – I believe in you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Darkness Distress
quests.description: Oh dear – what's this?! The darkness is in fact spreading… and fast! It's seeping east into Greenguard and leeching through the forest! Hurry – go explore Green… er /greyguard and report back with your discoveries!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Your New FF
quests.description: You need to find a FF (a Forest Friend) NOW! Go befriend anybody you'd like in /greyguard in order to make your new FF happy while slowing the spread of vile darkness.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Enguard Greenguard
quests.description: Yikes… you're saying that even more darkness monsters have appeared?! There's no time to dally or delay… you know what needs to be done: slay away and save the day!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Not all is Well
quests.description: Well, well, well… it seems not all is well inside that well. So we must confront whatever darkness is down there! Aaaand by 'we' I mean 'you' because the last time I went down a well, I got covered in green slime sludge and that's positively impossible to get out of my pretty pink getup, ya know. So… yaaay, thanks SO much for volunteering to go down into the dark depths of the deep well for me! *hugs*
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gather the Goods
quests.description: Now that odious Odium has been defeated, it's time to become friends with everyone here! Defeat all those icky monsters and be sure to gather up everything they drop! Remember, each person might have personal likes and dislikes… so you don't want to give them something they don't like! Take your time, figure out who likes what. They will only reward you something once per day, so once they've given you something, it's time to move on!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Not all is Well ' quest.

quests.name: Sad, Lost and Lonely Penguin
quests.description: Did ya see that poor little penguin??? That poor little guy is so sad. Or happy? Or is he just confused. I dunno. How 'bout you go make him your friend. I'm sure you'll get a reward out of it! (Gives Char Page Badge once he is at Max Friend Level.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Not all is Well ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Heart of the Cards
quests.description: Hey Hero! Recently, Big Daddy gave me a few special decks of cards. If you'd like a deck of cards, I'd love to give you one. But can you do a few things for me first pretty please?

quests.name: Frevo's Dancers Need Feathers!
quests.description: Hello! Welcome to Terra de Festa! I have a friend who is in need of some brightly colored Cuco feathers for the Carnaval celebration. Could you gather some and bring them to him? You can find him by heading down the ramp, and then to the left.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Batista's Quests .

quests.name: Just a Little Snack
quests.description: What I've really been craving is a nice bushel of bamboo leaves. Will you bring me some? You can get them from the Bamboo Treeants wandering the forest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Reduce the Darkness ' quest.

quests.name: No Gilding, Only Gelt
quests.description: One of the traditions of our village is to give children a golden branch along with their Frostval gifts. IF they have been good all year. If not, they get silver branches! Hah! But… the Krimplers stole ALL the Frostval branches I'd gilded. Took me DAYS to paint them all. Get them back and I'll reward you handsomely.

quests.name: Belsnicklings be Tricksy
quests.description: My little Belsnicklings are tricksy folks! If they show up at your door, they may toss you candy, but if you're not quick enough to catch it, they'll slash at you with switches! Try your luck, and see which YOU get!

quests.name: Sounds Like Cysero
quests.description: You, there. You're hunting information? Find the strange mage that's hidden himself in the backalleys. He's drawing all the misery eels to him for some mad reason. It's putting the townfolk on edge. As odd a mage as he seems to be, he's bound to have bit of knowledge to help.

quests.name: Beefing Up Conn
quests.description: I swear, that beanpole needs more flesh on his bones. The hard part is… we feed him constantly! Conn eats so much that it is nearly impossible to keep food in Heartsease! Please help us stock the larder so he can gain some weight. I think Marsh Grass, Sweet Cheese Chunks, Fruit and Fish will do nicely.

quests.name: Biscuits and a Side of Bacon
quests.description: There is nothing better in the morning than fresh backed biscuits and bacon! In order to get both Nevery and Conn awake and thinking in the morning this is a must breakfast. Please help me gather bacon, flour, eggs, and water.

quests.name: A Stronger Truncheon
quests.description: You know, if Conn keeps getting himself in trouble, I will need a more durable truncheon. Crowe's minions are everywhere and aggressive, not easily beaten. Think you can get me the materials to make a new truncheon? I need 2 really good, hardy pieces of wood and some metal for reinforcement.

quests.name: The Wizard's Apprentice's New Clothes
quests.description: You know, it isn't enough that Conn eats everything in the larder, but he is also growing so much that I have to make more and more clothes for him. He needs to slow down. I can only knit so fast. I need more material, so please get me some soft spun Glow worm silk and Midnight Blue Dye.

quests.name: Repairing Heartsease
quests.description: Nevery left for a long time, though to be fair he was kicked out and barred from returning. But no one was around to keep his home in top condition. Nevery's realized we need to make repairs and that falls on me. I need 10 Polished Glass, 10 Wood Planks, 15 Nails and 5 Bolts of Cloth to get this place looking decent.

quests.name: Calm the Deer
quests.description: Where I'm from, deer are an endangered species. It's extremely important to pay attention to their wellbeing, or else there may be none left. Over in /DeerHunt, the Deer seem scared about something. Can you help calm them down?

quests.name: Carefree Drifters
quests.description: I don't often visit the pedestal's room. It used to teleport the Alutians to the surface so they could hunt crabs, but was broken during the attack so no one could escape. It's not that being here makes me sad, it's just that the room is very haunted. I…can't handle ghosts. I won't be much help if I huddled in the corner screaming my head off. Could I trouble you to help me shoo them away?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Honeyed Apologies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Bone Bites
quests.description: My herd's gotten loose again. They're what I call Bone Crustaceans, and I've been rearing them ever since I was imprisoned. The Alutians used to keep them as a food source for their young ones. Nowadays, I've been feeding them mineral enriched clay so they won't chew on…what remains of the Alutians. Would you lend a hand wrangling a few? I'll whip you up a meal. Think of it as a consolation prize for coming so far.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Honeyed Apologies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Lost Generation
quests.description: The Crustaceans broke into the main Nursery again! It's where the Alutians would keep their eggs safe. After Rheum repelled their invasion of the land, Lord Tremblor was still furious. He wanted us to make sure the Alutians would never invade again. To that end, the warriors of Rheum attacked the city, and crushed the eggs first…Would you please help me clean the eggshells and lead the Crustaceans back into the hall?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Honeyed Apologies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tender Temple
quests.description: See the statue in the back wall of the Nursery? That is Lady Neso. It must have been damaged during the invasion. Lord Tremblor would not wish such poor treatment on her visage. I can't restore the statue but I routinely clean it. You'll help? Thank you! Ah, the Jellyfish are becoming agitated. They get that way whenever my mood picks up. We'll need to fight them off so they won't distract us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Honeyed Apologies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cast Away Buds
quests.description: Oh dear, you're guests but I've run you ragged. Come and take a breather in my room. It used to receive visiting parents but I've laid a few blankets down for us to sit on. Just shoo the jellies off, and while you're there, you'll see Ox and his wife, Fraise. Or rather, the dolls I've made of them. Please don't look so alarmed! I only needed a few faces to talk to so I could stay sane. Once we're settled in, I'll finish telling my story.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Honeyed Apologies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Current Catching
quests.description: Alutea was built where the currents can easily carry you back and forth from the surface. Problem is, our gangly human bodies won't catch the currents as easily as the fins of the Alutians. Ah, of course Captain Rhubarb would know a thing or two about navigation. Then we'll collect the ropes and cloth needed to create his contraption. There should be supplies scattered about the Nursery.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Honeyed Apologies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Silent Sea
quests.description: Now comes the difficult part. The doors to the outside aren't sealed but everything beyond is underwater. There are Water Elementals that act as guards, stationed here by Lady Neso. They wouldn't attack you but because I am escaping, they will do everything in their power to stop us. We'll need to fight them off and let Rhubarb read the currents. That way, we won't get thrown deeper into the marine trench.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Honeyed Apologies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hay! Bale Already!
quests.description: I kept my trap shut because it sounded so silly…but can we go back and take Oxali and Fraise with us? The dolls in my room, I mean. I know I just said we don't have a lot of time but I'm going to weep if I leave them behind! They kept me company so long, I can't just abandon them. What's with that "harharhar!" Rhubarb? But, you'll really go back and get them? Thank you! We'll clear the critters too. They're not happy about me leaving.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Honeyed Apologies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Abyss to Sun
quests.description: Centuries have passed, the Empire of Rheum has declined, and the Avatars speak to us no more. This will be the first time I will set foot on land in ages. It's time to leave. We must ascend to the highest point in the Nursery, and ride the currents upwards. There is no sign of the last Alutian but the elementals will surely make one last push to drag me down. Let's forge ahead and fight off the elementals.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Honeyed Apologies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ebbing Grudges
quests.description: The Alutians used to have long sparkling tails and you could hear their songs as you drifted into the depths. Their remaining child would have no memory of that. Lady Neso tried to soothe their grudges and loneliness by transforming them into a beast that could tear through stone. They were stuck in the ruins as long as I was, and will return if we don't subdue them. We will fight them together, and turn them towards the horizon.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Honeyed Apologies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Celestial Spoils: Djinn Warrior
quests.description: I promised a merchant in Etherstorm that I would collect the mystical esssence of the elemental spirits here. Help me, and I will share the spoils of my recent wandering.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Blessing of the Guardian ' quest.

quests.name: Effervescent Elixir
quests.description: I started working on an elixir that is able to… never mind. You don't need to know. I'll just tell you what to beat up. Defeat some Toxic Souleaters in /Deadmoor, some Infected Scientists in /MoonLab, and an antler from the Zweinichthirsch in /DeerHunt.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Blessing of the Guardian ' quest.

quests.name: Galactic Omniblade Series
quests.description: A blade with the strength to save the galaxy… or destroy it. Once you have the Galactic Omniknight Blade 1.0, you can begin the quest for the Galactic OmniBlade series. In order to power up the blade, I will need 5 powerpacks from the Undead Space Warriors in /dreadspace. Return next year to get another. You can only get one blade from this quest per year.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Galactic OmniKnight Blade 1.0 in your inventory Note: This quest can only be completed once per month.

quests.name: Hide and Seek
quests.description: So, I bet you want to know what you're starting to look for, huh. Well, I hidden a few items on a few gross newbie level monsters. I'm sure you'll be able to figure out what i mean. I mean, they are rather slimy. Some of them are rather fluffy as well.

quests.name: Debt Collection
quests.description: So uh, Hero. I'm in a bit of a snag. You see, I owe a collector of sorts a lot of gold. The problem is, he swindled me first. So if you could go "deal" with that IOU, that would be a really great birthday gift from you to me.

quests.name: Bido's Favor
quests.description: Hero, since I'M the one making YOU the gift, free of charge, you need to make sure I stay hydrated. You can't just expect me to work without something to eat or drink, do you? You aren't that cruel. So here's what I want. I want something green to drink and orange to eat, if you haven't noticed, those are the colors of my eyes. I'm sure you can use your hero smarts to provide me with the best possible meal to eat while I work.

items_required.name: Piece of Gell Oh No Perfectly Slushied

quests.name: Little Science Experiment
quests.description: So hero, since you're here I wanna let you in on a little secret. You know the scary big guy named Nulgath? if you don't he's one of the most fiercest fiends ever seen. His hear is all cool but I kinda wanna mess with one. I DO have one of his swords here BUT…I kinda wanna mess with it. Let's say you and I do a little experiment ye? You gather some reagents that he frequently uses or crafting his gear and ;ets see if we can add a little twist to it.

quests.name: Another Science Experiment
quests.description: So hero, that last science experiment seemed to have worked pretty good, right? I have a Fiendish Blood Blade here from the Groglurk down in Bludrut Keep, and it's crying out for some twisting up. Gather some more reagents and let's see what we can do with this one!

quests.name: For the Crater Good
quests.description: As you walk closer to the crater, you hear numerous whispers asking you to bring a bunch of items to it. Will you take this mysterious quest? What will happen if you bring the items to the crater?

quests.name: In The Mood
quests.description: First things first, baby! I need to you to go to clear out the forest of some pesky Mood Slimes. They're all pink and rosy until it absorbs you and starts to digest your arms. Bad for tourism. Bring me 5 Mood Slime Rings as proof!

quests.name: Hedge Trimming
quests.description: Don't you think my assistants did a great job decorating the forest? Well not everyone agrees. Especially the Love Shrubs (who also got decorated). Let those bully bushes know that BIG DADDY is in charge now. Bring me 8 Love Twigs to show me the job is done!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bear Hugs
quests.description: The Huggy-Bears have to be the grumpiest residents of the Forest of Infinite Terror. People come here to see huge, warm, fuzzy, cuddly beary-wearkins and they find those guys. If someone doesn't put them in their place, we'll get bad travel reviews! Bring me 4 Tufts of Huggy-Bear Fur to let me know you've shown them the light.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stoopid Kewpid
quests.description: I'm a pretty likable guy, Baby… but there's no pleasing some people. Deep down inside the Wishing Well in the forest lives a guy called Kewpid. He used run the Love business but he couldn't stand up to the competition. Rather than taking defeat like a good sport he tries to ruin a lot of my best laid plans. Go deliver a message to him. Tell him to "take it like a cherub!". Come back when you've defeated him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unconditional
quests.description: She's turned into a monster with two heads. Deep down, that's what love is to her. I know, we need to beat Agape but go easy on my own heart, alright? Just scare her off and Big Daddy will take care of the rest of his family drama. Phew, good thing our folks aren't here. They always take Agape's side.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Four Princesses ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Separation Anxiety
quests.description: I used to pick up after my twin sis a lot, even when she started figuring out how to walk. Love the party, love the clean up a lot less. There aren't any natural creatures rompin' these peaks anymore. Better to clean out Agape's paper butterflies and wax dolls so nature can heal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Unconditional ' quest.

quests.name: Transformative Medicine
quests.description: Did you know that Samba wants to use wolfmen in the parade? Let me tell you, baby, it was hard to convince them to participate… but it'll all be worth it if we can reverse this curse. Have a dance-off with the Lobisomen nearby, and collect any claw pieces that get chipped. We can use the transformative nature of their bodies to change Naipi and Taruba back to normal!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Costume Check ' quest.

quests.name: Rocked My Life
quests.description: Naipi never asked for M'Boi's attention, you know- she only wanted to look in the river. I think it'd be best if we free her first. Go find the rock she was transformed into, and bring a pack of molted snake skins with you. It seems gross, but a snake losing their skin is another type of transformation. It'll help… just trust me on this one, baby.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Costume Check ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reaching Palm Fronds
quests.description: Taruba reached out to Naipi in his last moments as a human, and was transformed into a palm tree, frozen in that pose. He'll finally be reunited with his beloved after we lift his curse! Bring me a few chipped fangs from the Lobisomen, and we'll write a new ending to this love story.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Costume Check ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: That's M'Boi
quests.description: We've been caught red-handed, but it's already done. Naipi and Taruba are free to be together for the rest of their lives. All that's left is to get M'Boi off of their backs. Samba and I are giving you the honor of diving into the river to give him some tough love.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Costume Check ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Live Decor
quests.description: There's Mnemo's first infraction! Those Rosey Moths were snatched from their natural habitat! If they get loose, they'll become an invasive species and cause massive damage to the environment. Catch them, and make sure they're comfy!

quests.name: A Past Storm
quests.description: Looks like you and Big Daddy were late to the party. Warlic and Nythera showed up to investigate the Tunnel of Love first. Now Warlic's a handsome man but he's looking a little too hot, and Nythera seems grouchy. Why don't you chat both of them up?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Employee Sniping
quests.description: What in the fresh heartthrob heck? Those are my Love Knights! I sent them ahead to scout the Tunnel out for us! They forgot I was the bossman, and they think Mnasty Mnemo's their guy! Knock some sense back into them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Auntie Celeste
quests.description: What a ravishing surprise! The lovely Lady Celestia decided to pay the Tunnel a visit too. She looks a tad concerned, and it's every Hero's duty to help the distressed. Mind asking the Priestess how she and her Dragons are doing?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Cold Reception
quests.description: According to the fine lady, the Tunnel messed with Galanoth real bad. He forgot that not all Dragons are out to turn him into a charred meatball! Worse, he thinks you're one of them. You're going to have to fight and hogtie him somewhere safe.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lethal Lethe
quests.description: Notice the glowing hole in the wall? The one that's spewing out water like a fountain? I think that's a portal, and we need to take a detour. If you find anyone inside, be friendly and have a talk! They might know what's going on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Missing Orpheus
quests.description: Oh, boy. The Underworld's Mourners aren't happy about us barging in on their suffering session- but then again, when are they ever happy? I feel bad for them, but we need to finish this investigation uninhibited-like. Gently toss them back into the Lethe.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mentor and Student
quests.description: We found what's causing visitors to lose their memories, so let's go deeper to make sure there aren't any other freaky surprises. Speaking of freaks - I mean, fine gentlemen - would you look at that! Nulgath and Dage. Ask what they're up to!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rosy Hues
quests.description: Mnemo stuffed even more Moths and Knights in the tunnel. We're at the home stretch, so the faster we clean everyone out, the quicker everyone can go back to enjoying Heroes Heart Day!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Oubliable
quests.description: Remember when I asked how visitors lost their memories in the water if they were all in boats? Here's our answer. A monster at the end of the Tunnel of Love grabs them and drags them in. Give this Oubliette a taste of its own medicine, and drag it out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ce N'est Rien!
quests.description: While I would love to tear this cheap boat ride apart, we need to be real careful about it. Those river rapids ain't a joke. Get my Love Knights and those Rosey Moths out of there. Use some elbow grease if you have to. Same with the Oubliette.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Oubliable ' quest.

quests.name: Empty Fealty
quests.description: I'm surprised your men decided to follow you past Dreadhaven's moat. If I were them, I'd have half a mind to sell you out to the new King for a pardon. But it'd take a lot more than your head for Alteon to forgive their crimes. They don't have a loyal bone in their body, but they're ruthless if nothing else. Track them down and drag a few back. Show me what a Prince is capable of while you're at it.

quests.name: Bitter Sweet-Talker
quests.description: Fancy speech won't get you far living rough like me. That said, it could be handy if you plan to negotiate with your men. What's the word for it? Right, charisma. We'll see if you have any. Try talking to Edward. He's feared by the other bandits. But actually having gold to pay him would sweeten your words. It'll be you and me robbing some nice folks on the road. Take their gold, and show the bandits it's worth it to follow your lead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fake It Till You Make It
quests.description: It's been a few weeks since we started to toughen you up. We've barely made any progress. Not surprising considering how your pa stunted your growth. Having a soft bed, and harsh words from your own father makes for a bad combination. You'll cut my head off, you say? Tell that to the knights coming our way. A fair number of them used to fight for Dethrix I. Now they're hunting you under Alteon's banner.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Decimation
quests.description: Seems like Alteon was more forgiving than we thought. The former Knights of King Dethrix recognized some of their compatriots among the team sent to hunt you. It's putting ideas in their heads. I listened in on a few schemers. Single them out and make an example of them. Royals do know how to put on a show, so go on. Show me how you punish traitors.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Warning Beacon
quests.description: Another gaggle of knights are after us. A crook like me is a nuisance to the crown, but you. They'll kill you on sight because of what's in your blood. Just being alive is a threat to the new Kingdom. That'll inspire even the greenest squires to chase your tail. It'll be annoying to constantly be chased night and day. Had that problem myself for a while. So, here's an idea. Follow my lead and force these knights into the Town Hall close by.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Strategy and Utility
quests.description: This isn't a smart idea, but there's no use trying to reason once your mind gets set on skinning a fool. Fine fine, I'll go along so you won't die and duck out of your end of the bargain. Reignolds' tower is up ahead. We have a greater advantage in the trees, so have your men make a ruckus to lure his knights out. We'll put a dent in their numbers before letting ourselves in.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Runaway
quests.description: The rest of the bandits are uneasy. Reignolds' tower is made of glass like a greenhouse, but it's close to freezing instead of humid. Like I said, we'll be cautious and take a look around. Have the men scout upstairs and in the cellar. If you run into anything, don't go attacking it just yet. We need to know who and what we're dealing with. Reignolds' daughter should be in the building. She might know something.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Make-Up Artist
quests.description: I thought it was strange for Reignolds to have so many servants and knights. He's not rich or someone as important as a Duke. Based on what his daughter said, he's skilled at keeping dead things looking fresh. These dull eyed servants aren't barely able to stand because they're tired. They're actually undead. We need to get rid of them before their master starts giving them orders.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Piercing the Veil
quests.description: Wasn't the chamber at the top of the tower locked? He's barricaded himself there and it'll take time for the other bandits to break the lock. I wonder if Reignolds can see through the eyes of his undead minions. Calling me paranoid? Paranoia is what's going to keep you alive when I'm gone. Stop scowling, and butcher the undead servants shambling around. It'll be a good warm up before facing Reignolds.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Any Means Necessary
quests.description: Lord Reignolds being a snob and coward is what kept us alive. If you want to kill him, focus. Don't get distracted and don't lose your head. Desperation drives men wild. At worst, Reignolds won't see a way out of this and decide he'll jump into death's waiting arms. Drakath, you have to survive. Prioritize your survival above all else. Don't let that mage take you down with him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pay the Piper
quests.description: Hey, yo, you can't expect me to provide my services without being paid! There's a gang of lin kuei - shadowy assassins - living in the forest near my pad. I bet they have some money you can "borrow".
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Bingwen ' quest.

quests.name: Pieces of Pipes
quests.description: There may be one more tiny little problem. I don't actually have my bagpipes! I took them apart to clean and oil them, and those naughty little Lingzhi and Xingzhi stole all the pieces. Maybe you can find them and bring them back to me?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Oil it up
quests.description: Nah, man… I'm not ready to go just yet. I still have to oil my bagpipes, remember? Unfortunately, those nasty sprites spilled my stash of bamboo oil when they stole my pipes. You can get me some more from the wandering Bamboo Treeants.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get Me an Audience
quests.description: What musician can perform without an audience? Get out there and talk to everyone you can find in Akiba. Tell them to get ready for the best piping they've ever heard! Here, I've even written you a helpful script to use!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Meet Me at the Palace
quests.description: So were they excited? Man, I can't wait for this! Meet me in front of the palace, okay? I'll be right there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Bitterfrost Dragon's Treasure
quests.description: To unlock the Fangs of Bitterfrost polearm, you must recover the Gilded Claws and Fangs from his eons-old ancestor, Frostfang! Slay the Snow Golems in the Northlands for Gilded Claws and Water Draconians for Gilded Fangs in Kingcoal to recover them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Bitterfrost Dragonkin .

quests.name: Stop the Juice Thieves
quests.description: Those goshdarn Dark Makai keep stealing all my Moglinberry Juice, and now the tap's running dry! Go into the cellar and get rid of all those juice thieves, would you?

quests.name: Special Lunch
quests.description: What? You came here for LUNCH? That's too bad, because I just ran out of, like, EVERYTHING. But if you bring me some ingredients, I'll make my special bento box for you! Get me some Moglinberries - you can steal them back from those Dark Makai. And I'll need some Sour Apples from those Mean Old Treeants. And, last but not least, one of the Juice Boxes that the Drakel Bandits carry!

quests.name: Practice makes Perfect Bottle
quests.description: So you wanna help me find a Perfect Bottle, huh? It ain't ganna be easy— they don't call it *perfect* for nothing. William Picket over there has a Perfect Bottle for barter, but will only trade it for 100 Broken Bottles that have been thrown away. It's ridiculous, I know, but if you need my help, I need yours first. Search through enough Trash Cans until you find 100 Broken Bottles and trade them in for William Picket's Perfect Bottle. But if you're lucky enough, you might even find a Perfect Bottle amongst the trash…

quests.name: Thistle Do Nicely
quests.description: Owing pets is a big responsibility. You have to care for them, play with them, clean up after them, and remember to feed them! My lovely companions are running low on food but I certainly can't leave my shop… But you look good and able to! The Seed Spitters in the area feed off the Thistles that my pets absolutely love. Retrieve 5 thistles from those carnivorous plants and I'll award you greatly!

quests.name: Pleased to Meat You
quests.description: My pets have a very delicate palate. They enjoy a wide variety of fodder from thistle to yogurt and even Gorillaphant meat. Since you did such a great job before… I bet you will have no problem bringing back 8 Lore-Strip Gorillaphant Steaks. You know where to find them…

quests.name: Miraculous Reunion
quests.description: "Our Hero's friends split up, moving quickly to look for more of those suspicious gifts." Why don't you cover the courtyard? Talk to the guests there, and tell them about the situation. As for the Vaughn Knights…They want to spar? What, like, now?

quests.name: Emergency Management
quests.description: "Galanoth gathered a team to search the west wing of Castle Whistler, but they ran into some trouble." House Granville's Knights are keeping Artix and a kid named Hans from helping with the search. They're being rather mean, so be mean right back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Noble Character
quests.description: "The hosts of the Frostval Gala acted quickly and efficiently, ignoring the complaints of their peers." Lady Song and Lord Henry are taking care of the east wing. Let's ask if they need another pair of hands. Those Noelle Knights need some directions, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

items_required.name: Talk to Lady Song and Lord Henry

quests.name: Breaking Bread
quests.description: "It was almost over. The guests had been escorted to safety. All that was left were the stray gifts." There should only be a couple left. Be on the lookout, because your friends are looking for you. Tara and Serenity are over there, excited to chat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Poacher and the Stag
quests.description: "Just as our Hero was about to enter the parlor, the Vaughn Knights and Granville Knights started to squabble. Petty fights waste so much time, but breaking them up wouldn't take long." Are you on peacekeeping duty? Man, you have to do everything around here. It's a lot of work being so reliable.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Knights Unsung
quests.description: "Those who were struck by the Queen's doomed arrows rose as her Unsung Knights. They glared at our Hero with deep hatred, and readied their blades." You'll have to fight them, but "our Hero will defeat them quickly and easily."
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Silver Spoon Fed
quests.description: "The Unsung claims its partner, and the Queen's Nobles are hunted like stray sheep. Our Hero courageously shields them from the arrows, saving their lives-" But it'd be nice if they could flee in the right direction. You'll have to give them hints.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Like-Minded Enemies
quests.description: "Galanoth was recovering from the Unsung Queen's barrage of arrows, but he was surrounded by Beasts." I got winded tweaking his lines, so could you save him the old-fashioned way? We both know Galanoth's hardy, but let's make sure he's okay.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Heroic Entrance
quests.description: "Sensing our Hero's approach. The Unsung Knights and Beasts formed a wall, blocking them off from the balcony. Our Hero charged, ramming through them with gusto!" Go ahead! Put your whole body into it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: I'm With You in the Dark
quests.description: "The Unsung's Queen turns towards our Hero as the doors fly open. They made it just in time. She nocks another arrow, and aims it at their neck." She'll attempt to fly away. Do everything you can to keep her here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lost the Bookmark
quests.description: "Our Hero and their companions let Serenity down gently, and set off for the…" Shoot, I overdid it. Just need to refocus and pinpoint the location of The Unsung…If I could get a good look at some of its traces…

npc.name: I'm With You in the Dark

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I'm With You in the Dark ' quest.

quests.name: Lost the Bookmark (Legend)
quests.description: "Our Hero and their companions let Serenity down gently, and set off for the…" Shoot, I overdid it. Just need to refocus and pinpoint the location of The Unsung…If I could get a good look at some of its traces…

npc.name: I'm With You in the Dark

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I'm With You in the Dark ' quest.

quests.name: Fade in from Black
quests.description: "Our Hero's search party found the Draconic Necropolis. Its graves were hidden in stone, guarded by The Unsung's minions. Our Hero demonstrated that there was nothing to fear by slaying the beasts climbing the cliff." That's your cue!

npc.name: I'm With You in the Dark

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I'm With You in the Dark ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Hyping Up
quests.description: "Our Hero's search party was troubled by their enthralled comrades. The Unsung were forcing them to attack their friends. Calm and collected, our Hero demonstrated how they could be subdued, and brought back to their senses." And look cool doing it.

npc.name: I'm With You in the Dark

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I'm With You in the Dark ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Little Buddies
quests.description: "Our Hero ordered the search party to secure the Necropolis' perimeter while they went inside to meet up with Galanoth. There, they found -" Dracolich babies. I guess you have to fight them, but…that hit a bit of a sore spot.

npc.name: I'm With You in the Dark

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I'm With You in the Dark ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Selective Memory
quests.description: "The Unsung lurked in the center of the Necropolis behind a sealed gate. Our Hero searched the western hall to find a way to undo the seal." Look for anything that stands out while you dispel the Doom Figments over there.

npc.name: I'm With You in the Dark

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I'm With You in the Dark ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Old Painless
quests.description: "The Dracolich known as Blain raked the floor of his prison with broken claws. Blain wished to destroy the humans who humiliated him in life. Our Hero prepared themselves, ready to strike." You know what to do!

npc.name: I'm With You in the Dark

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I'm With You in the Dark ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Peeved and Peckish
quests.description: "Half of the gate's seal was broken. Our Hero made their way to the eastern hall to deal with the rest." This time, there are Mages waiting for you. You'll take them down easily. Considering the rule of symmetry, there could be another clue too.

npc.name: I'm With You in the Dark

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I'm With You in the Dark ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Machetes at Dawn
quests.description: "The Dracolich Sole awaited our Hero's challenge. Having already met the Unsung in combat, it wished for an even greater battle." It's just one Dracolich left. Then, the gate's seal will break!

npc.name: I'm With You in the Dark

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I'm With You in the Dark ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lowlife Poachers
quests.description: "The two Dracoliches were put to rest, which meant that our Hero was ready to face the Unsung…but something was bugging them." Really? What is it? Huh…alright. Backtrack through the Necropolis to find those spear tips and fur patches.

npc.name: I'm With You in the Dark

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I'm With You in the Dark ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Serene Meditation
quests.description: "Our Hero valiantly cut down the Unsung's Warriors, giving Queen Victoria and Serenity time to gather their bearings." But, could you do me another favor and check on Serenity? I just want to make sure she'll be okay…

npc.name: I'm With You in the Dark

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I'm With You in the Dark ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Right to Choose
quests.description: Galanoth and Victoria are prepared. The Unsung is lurking behind the curtains. It's time to pull them back, and make them face the music. "One way or another, the Shadow will have to see the light." Ugh, still cheesy.

npc.name: I'm With You in the Dark

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I'm With You in the Dark ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unsung Heroes
quests.description: "The Unsung's influence still lingers in the Necropolis. Our Hero plucked the arrows from the dead, and the tomb went silent once more." Sorry to bother you again, but it's just the dregs left. Can't leave any leftovers for bottom feeders like Noxus to scavenge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Right to Choose ' quest.

quests.name: Unsung Heroes (Legend)
quests.description: "The Unsung's influence still lingers in the Necropolis. Our Hero plucked the arrows from the dead, and the tomb went silent once more." Sorry to bother you again, but it's just the dregs left. Can't leave any leftovers for bottom feeders like Noxus to scavenge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Right to Choose ' quest.

quests.name: Unsung Heroes (Dragonlord)
quests.description: "The Unsung's influence still lingers in the Necropolis. Our Hero plucked the arrows from the dead, and the tomb went silent once more." Sorry to bother you again, but it's just the dregs left. Can't leave any leftovers for bottom feeders like Noxus to scavenge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Right to Choose ' quest. | Must have Dragonlord (Class) in your inventory.

quests.name: Quench the Flames
quests.description: The Onslaught has invaded the temple and kidnapped the sick! And many who weren't. We cannot stand for this, but… we are priests and mages, not warriors. We need your help to drive out the Firestorm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accepted after completing the 'Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright' quest.

quests.name: Through Fog and Flame
quests.description: I… I don't feel so well. This fog… it's making me so dizzy. If we're going to save the temple, you've got to dispell the fog. I can cast a spell to disperse it, but I'll need a Dispersion Draught. I keep them inside the locked chest in the armory. Bring it back to me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accepted after completing the 'Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Restore the Lady of Waters
quests.description: Those heathens - those CRETINS - they shattered the our statue of Mother of Waters! She who gives life… has been demolished. Some of the monsters ran away with the pieces, but others are lying around. Please, find them so we can rebuild it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accepted after completing the 'Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rumors and Smoke
quests.description: When they attacked, they were in and out as fast as a brushfire. They hit us, grabbed our people, and left. We MUST get them back; the SeaSinger knows what will be done to them! See what you can learn from the monsters here. You may also find helpful information in the scrolls. I hope.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accepted after completing the 'Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dam the Flood
quests.description: You will need to go, I know, but before you do, I beseech you - help us defend what's left of the temple before the Onslaught returns! Board up the windows and doors where you can, and I will begin casting the defense spells.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accepted after completing the 'Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Salvage Mission
quests.description: We can't know for certain the monsters were telling us the truth about where our people are. But if you bring me items they're drops, I can use them as Location Keys. .. as long as we can recover the Locatrix Animus. It must be on the floor around here somewhere!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accepted after completing the 'Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fear the Fog
quests.description: The fog has returned! We need to dispell it again. It's stronger this time. I can feel myself succumbing faster! I am out of prepared Dispersion Draught, but I should be able to make more. Bring me the ingredients on this list.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accepted after completing the 'Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Where There's Smoke...
quests.description: Good! That worked as well as I'd hoped. NOW we need to burn out the mage casting this! There has got to be a mage working for the Firestorm nearby. Find him, and we'll finish this!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accepted after completing the 'Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Firin' This Guy
quests.description: Defeat the Blazebinder to prevent him from sending more poisonous fog into the temple!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accepted after completing the 'Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blessings of the Lady
quests.description: I am surprised the latest offerings to the Lady survived the attack. Take them with you, please, I'm sure she'd want you to have them fuel your search!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accepted after completing the 'Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Parting the Waters
quests.description: If you're going to leave - and you must - the best way is through the Deadsea Caverns. To enter them, though, I must raise the waters. I'll need the following items in order to cast the spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accepted after completing the 'Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Power to Heal
quests.description: This temple is known for the power of its healing medicines. Before you go, will you help us restock? It will also let you take some with you, for the kidnapped. Bring me the Herbalist Manual from the Locked Chest, take the Saltwater Powder from the Vase nears the Statue, and get 2 bottles of Undine Effluvia.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accepted after completing the 'Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Deadsea Caverns
quests.description: To reach the exit and start you on the journey to Phoenixrise Gate, we need to pass through the Deadsea Caverns. It is dangerous, but not more than you can handle. I know that with you by my side, taking out monsters, we will be safe.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accepted after completing the 'Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Open the Floodgates
quests.description: To take down the shield over the exit, we'll need to work together. I'll activate the spell, and then you'll need to complete the sequences to trigger the key.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accepted after completing the 'Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright
quests.description: The only thing standing between you and rescuing our people is THAT furry behemoth. Take him down and go get our people!!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest. Note: These quests cannot be accepted after completing the 'Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stuff for Dummies
quests.description: First things first, friend - Kyger is going to need some target dummies to practice on! You will need to gather some wood from the local treeants, and a few clumps of dry grass.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Light Of Destiny ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Build the Dummies
quests.description: I have marked out some good spots for Kyger's target dummies with my ghostly energy. Build them where you see the glowing arrows, and then clear out the monsters in the area so it will be safe.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Light Of Destiny ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle the Dummies
quests.description: It is time for Kyger to learn to fight! Make sure Kyger is at your side, and fight the target dummies so he can help and learn.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Light Of Destiny ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lesson 1: Bravery
quests.description: Now it is time for Kyger's first real lesson - a hero must be BRAVE. Take him with you and fight some slimes so that he can build his courage.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Light Of Destiny ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lesson 2: Armor
quests.description: Now that Kyger is starting to fight, he is going to need some protection. If you fight the monsters in these woods, you are sure to find some armor they stole from fallen adventurers!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Light Of Destiny ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lesson 3: Protection
quests.description: Kyger is well protected now, so I think it is time for something a little more challenging. Help him fight some Crypthackers. It will be good for him to hone his skills while protecting his people.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Light Of Destiny ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lesson 4: Gather Intelligence
quests.description: You found something interesting on one of those Crypthackers. It looks like there may be a hidden nest of undead somewhere in this forest! See if you can find any more clues on the other Deadtech in the area. Maybe we can find out where it is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Light Of Destiny ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lesson 5: Demolition
quests.description: I think I might know where those undead are hiding out. But you will need to be prepared! Gather some acidic ooze from the local slimes, and some pieces of explosive tech from the NecroDrones. We will use them to build an undead-slaying bomb.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Light Of Destiny ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lesson 6: Searching
quests.description: You will find the undead in a cave in the western part of the forest, hidden behind thick shrubbery. Search the woods until you find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Light Of Destiny ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Never Give Up
quests.description: It is time! Help Kyger test his skills against Sir Kut. Fighting a former Pactagonal Knight will give him the confidence he needs to defeat the High Technolich. Remember, never give up… and BATTLE ON!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Light Of Destiny ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the ' Get the Axe ' quest.

quests.name: Moglin Popsicles
quests.description: Blizzy is grateful that you saved him from Frosty…but his friends…are in trouble! They were captured by someone…or something…and encased in ice, like a moglin popsicle! Please free the other 8 moglins that live in this town and bring them back safe.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Scary Snow Men ' quest.

quests.name: Crystal Spiders
quests.description: Wow, you are very strong! Thank you for saving Blizzy's friends! Did you see the scary spiders? They just started lurking in the cave…with their hungry eyes…and who knows when they may attack Frostvale! Please get rid of as many spiders as you can inside the cave. Bring Blizzy back 6 ice spider legs as proof of their extermination.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Scary Snow Men ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Fluffy Bears
quests.description: My friends that were rescued are still very cold from the ice they were trapped in. There are polar bears in the cave that have warm fluffy fur. My friends will be able to make blankets with their fur. The bears have so much fur they won't miss some! The thing is…they won't give the fur without a fight. Can you bring Blizzy 3 patches of fur from the Polar Bears?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Scary Snow Men ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Blue Eyed Beast
quests.description: Oh no! A FROST DRAGON? That's how my friends were captured! Blizzy did hear that Frost Dragons can be…moglactose intolerant. Please get rid of this beast! We want to go back to our peaceful lives and celebrate our big winter tradition again! Bring Blizzy back a scale from the Frost Dragon. This will be your proof that you have defeated the dragon and will be known as a great Hero! You might want to bring some friends.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Scary Snow Men ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Trouble Makers
quests.description: The great Frost Dragon has been defeated! Blizzy thought our village would be saved, until it was discovered that the Toy Factory has been overtaken by the devious sneevils! These mischief makers have built evil machines that convert our presents into coal. You beat spiders, bears, a horrible dragon and Frosty! The sneevils might be small, but don't overestimate them. Please defeat the sneevils and bring Blizzy back 8 of their tools. This will stop them from making any more evil machines that destroy our presents.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Blue Eyed Beast ' quest.

quests.name: Bad Ice Cream
quests.description: Blizzy didn't think that the sneevils would be doing all of their devious work on their own. There are scary snowmen working for the sneevils that seem to be enchanted. There is some sort of magic in their hats that makes them do these evil deeds for the sneevils. Please go to the Toy Factory and overpower the snowmen and take their mind controlling hats so they return to normal! Bring Blizzy back 5 of their snow hats. That way, it can be discovered what kind of magic was used, 'cause Blizzy wants his own snowmen.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Blue Eyed Beast ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Greedy Sneevil
quests.description: Blizzy has figured out who is the mastermind behind everything that has happened in Frostvale. It's the one and only Ebil Sneezer, the greediest of all sneevils! He is wrapping coal as presents to trick everyone and then keeping the real presents for himself! How could someone be so ebil! Let's ruin his plans by putting a frown on his face! Defeat Ebil Sneezer and bring Blizzy back his magic wand so we can send the sneevils away and take over Frostvale once more! Us Frost Moglins won't stand to be made to look ebil in the eyes of Battleon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Blue Eyed Beast ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadow Figure
quests.description: Blizzy just received some dire news! Ebil Sneezer wasn't the mastermind behind the unwelcome things that have happened in Frostvale after all! There is another sinister figure hiding in the shadows…scheming all this…but for what purpose? A FrostScythe has been found in the area…a DragonMaster! Defeat the FrostScythe and bring back his notebook so the Frost Moglins can find out more about his master plans.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Blue Eyed Beast ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hidden in the Snow
quests.description: I found some weird weapons hidden in the snow. If you'd like them, then I can give you one as long as you help continue to protect Frostval this season. Your choice on the weapon too!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Blue Eyed Beast ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shaking the Globes
quests.description: Before we can talk to Garaja we need to make sure that none of these snow globes are the one that holds the Spirit and our gifts! Get a Globe Detector from a Snow Golem, then shake 10 Snow Globes and come back to Blizzy when you're done!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Major Moglin's Quests and spoken to Blizzy in Frostvale .

quests.name: A Demonstration
quests.description: Garaja has locked himself in here. He's just scared and trying to protect himself. We can't talk our way in. We need to show Garaja that you can fight. Defeat 10 Snow Golems and return here when you're done!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Major Moglin's Quests and spoken to Blizzy in Frostvale . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hearts of Ice
quests.description: Before we get to Garaja I need to ask a favor of you. Garaja uses Enchanted Ice Cores to animate his snowmen soldiers. We could use their magic back in Frostvale to make some really amazing gifts. See if you can find 6 Hearts of Ice and bring them to Blizzy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Major Moglin's Quests and spoken to Blizzy in Frostvale . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Garaja
quests.description: The path to Garaja is clear! You have to get to him and find out where Lionfang went. It's clear that he's afraid of us after what Lionfang did to him, so you'll need to overpower him before we can get any information. Let's GO!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Major Moglin's Quests and spoken to Blizzy in Frostvale . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Springing Traps
quests.description: *sniff sniff*. Do you smell what Blizzy smells? Steel, oil… TRAPS! You'll need to disarm the traps before you can do anything else. I think I can smell 10 traps… make sure you disarm all 10.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Garaja ' quest.

quests.name: Frost Lions
quests.description: Lionfang must have found some ancient magics here. I see a bunch of Frost Lions patrolling the grounds that he must have created. You have to thin the numbers before you can get to Lionfang. Destroy 10 Frost Lions and return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Garaja ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Onslaught Keyrings
quests.description: The trap door to the safe room is locked! One of the Golden Warriors must have the right key-ring but we don't have time to find out which. I guess you'll just have to grab them all. Get all 4 Onslaught Keyrings and bring them back here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Garaja ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Lionfang
quests.description: Ok, it looks like this key will unlock the safe room were Lionfang is hiding. Please be careful. HE could destroy the snow globe at any moment. You'll have to find a way to convince him to set it down before you can attack. Frostval is depending on you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Garaja ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: No More Moglin Munchies
quests.description: Those nasty Frost Lions keep attacking our home! Our friends try to hunt them down for us, but the lions always see them coming. I bet if they could wear Frost Lion pelts, they'd blend in better! Could you bring me 25 of them, Hero?

quests.name: Gravelyn's Most Dangerous Game
quests.description: Gravelyn asked me if we could help her. She's going to make a new game to train Undead. Please bring her 10 Mole Teeth and 5 Iced Boneheads.

quests.name: A Chilling Discovery
quests.description: Those Dead-ly Ice Elementals are storehouses for Dead Morice's power! If they were to harness it… there's no telling what they could do with it! Get fired up so you can toss them into the deep freeze!

quests.name: Cold to the Core
quests.description: Some of your friends accepted the ice venom more readily, and so have become frozen to their cores! You'll need to immobilize 50 of them and bring the Frostval Flame quite close for it to melt their hearts!

quests.name: Help Blizzy
quests.description: Unfortunately, Blizzy has no idea what happened to all our kids, so he's not so sure where to start. Let's ask the villagers if they've seen anything unusual lately! Maybe we'll find some sort of clue.

quests.name: Gather Ammunition
quests.description: Egret saw WHAT? A… a great, frosty beast with piercing blue eyes? That's what she said? I know a beast that fits that description, he even lives nearby - Ice Master Yeti!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Arm the Mob
quests.description: An angry mob need both pitchforks and torches. You can collect the torches from around the town. The pitchforks, you can get from the Scarecrows at the /farm. Be sure to get enough for everyone! (Available once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gather Bait
quests.description: Ice Master Yeti usually stays pretty deep in his cave, so we'll need to find a way to draw him out. A big meal of wolf meat should do the trick! Collect a big bucketful from the local Arctic Wolves.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bait the Trap
quests.description: Now, what we'll do is go inside the cave - you'll find it just up the hill outside the town - and lay the bait. When Ice Master Yeti comes out, we attack! We'll beat him up until he gives us back our kids.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Holly and Ice
quests.description: Blizzy can dispel the illusion that's hiding the tunnels leading down into Jalnar's lair. But first, he'll need some reagents! Head back toward the village and collect branches of Frostvale Holly. Then, collect some Elemental Ice from Snow Golems in and around the cave.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Check out the Cave ' quest.

quests.name: Open the Passageway
quests.description: Ok, Blizzy's all done! Take these candles and light them in different parts of the cave. They will clear away the shadowy illusion and reveal the truth.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Explore the Cave
quests.description: Now that we can see everything Jalnar was trying to hide, let's explore the area and see what you can find. See how deep it goes, see if you can find anything interesting, and then come back to tell Blizzy all about it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Clear out the Caves
quests.description: Hmm, so you went all the way in, but you still couldn't find the kids - or Jalnar himself? Blizzy's going to have to think about this some more. While he does that, why don't you clear out some of those frosty baddies? Make it safer for all of us when we go further in.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gather Crystals
quests.description: It's SO DARK down here! But look, those Winter Shrooms are bioluminescent. Collect some Luminous Crystals from them, and we'll use them to light up the room!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Is That an Exit?
quests.description: Do you see it? Look down in that chasm - there's a hole. If we could reach it, we might be able to get to the center of the lair. To where he's keeping the kids. Collect some of the Ice Spitters' Icy Vines, and some Frozen Shards from the Ice Elementals. Blizzy has an idea.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Climb Down
quests.description: Blizzy has made a ladder for you out of the vines and shards. Use it to reach the first plateau. And be careful - there might be monsters waiting for us!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Kids
quests.description: Blizzy has made another bridge with the rest of the vines and shards. It should be large enough to get to us to the other side. Meet Blizzy over there!!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Guards
quests.description: The Children won't be safe until we've slain all of these… chilly… wolf things that are guarding them! Defeat as many as you can.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Free the Kids
quests.description: Now to free the kids! Hurry! The cages are made of ice. Smash them and set the children free!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once.

quests.name: Creepy, Nasty Elf
quests.description: "Jingles" has finally shown himself! Kick his butt, hero! Kick his butt!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once.

quests.name: Creepy, Nasty Giant
quests.description: Aaaah! Nobody told Blizzy that Jalnar could do THIS!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Source
quests.description: Everything gets worse near the hills to the west. It's so bad, we can't even climb the path to the top! But YOU could. You're strong. Go up there and see if you can find the source of… of… whatever this is.

quests.name: Try the Door
quests.description: The house looks abandoned. Maybe you should go inside and look around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Key
quests.description: The door seems to be locked, but it looks like no one's been here for years. Maybe there's a key nearby.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Howard's Grief
quests.description: Get rid of the scary monster, hero! Blizzy is too small to fight this thing!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return to Blizzy ' quest.

quests.name: War Preparation
quests.description: If we want to stand a chance against the Plane of Monsters, then we'll have to be ready. Chop down Treeants to collect wood for barricades, then harvest the flames of some Wisps for flaming arrows. Finally, shave some ice off the Chillybones so that we have tips for the spear ends.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Howard's Grief ' quest.

quests.name: Monster Gems
quests.description: When you destroy a monster in our realm, they leave behind a tiny gem—their connection to the Plane of Monsters. If we gather enough of them, we can use their energy to heal the rift! Bring back as many as you can, hero!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Howard's Grief quest.

quests.name: Mega Monster Gems
quests.description: These small gems are super helpful, but have you found any really, really big ones? If you do, they'll help us get our town back even faster. Bring them back here if you come across any, please!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Howard's Grief quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Oh Heck!
quests.description: What the hecking heck! This is what this guy's kids have turned into? Toss them back into the rift before they destroy everything!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Howard's Grief quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest unlocked when the War Meter reached 75%.

quests.name: He's Ragin'
quests.description: Blizzy is gonna find somewhere to hide while you fight whatever Howard just turned into!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Howard's Grief quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Blood of Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says, if a low key occupation is more your style. Lightly armored, Blood Voids are a hunter breed in my army. They hide in the shadows and stalk their prey, attacking the enemy where they least expect it. They are unscrupulous but very skilled assassins of my legion.
quests.requirements_note: Assassin (Class) , Rank 10.

quests.name: Blood Blades
quests.description: For a small price I'll give you swords to cut through anyone.
quests.requirements_note: Level 30

quests.name: Hidden Edge
quests.description: Bring me back what I seek and the reward is yours. It may take you a few tries.

quests.name: Blood Guard
quests.description: The head piece of your blood of Nulgath armor is now manifested.

quests.name: BloodKnight Void Guards
quests.description: Nulgath the ArchFiend's BloodVoid Knights are used to hunt his unluckiest prey. They hide in the shadows, waiting until just the right moment to strike in his name. Take out 13 Legion Spies in the /ArchPortal and you can choose one of his guards to watch over your house.

quests.name: Memory #4 - Clear the Snow
quests.description: This terrible monster is making it snow so much, it's covered our entire village! It will take us awhile to unbury all of our houses. But maybe you could help some of our residents crawl back out? Look for the little snow piles, some of them are bound to be hiding someone who needs our help!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Activate the Spacetimebobulator ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Memory #4 - Fend off the Fiends
quests.description: This terrible frozen warlock is sending his frosty fiends down to destroy us! Please, help us fight them off!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Memory #4 - The Frozen Warlock
quests.description: Hurry, friends! We must attack this Frozen Warlock now! Let me know when you're ready, and I will take you to his cave.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hear No Evil
quests.description: Ooooh man, Hero. That music is KICKIN' but… something feels off to me. Maybe it's the dehydration or con rot, but I've got a baaaaaaaaddddd feeling about this music. Turn off the speakers, and we'll see if that helps.
quests.requirements_note: Must have played the ' Smack-A-Sheep mini-game. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Safe and (No) Sound
quests.description: The music is quieter now, but the band's still playing. I can feel the effect, but less now. That MUST mean it's the MUSIC affecting me. And look at the little dracs! They don't look so good… kind of hypnotized and… glowing? Glowing is NEVER EVER GOOD. You've got to put them to sleep so they can't listen to the music!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Through the Fire and Bones
quests.description: OH MAN! I think the band realized who turned the music down. Looks like you're about to be dragon FORCED into leaving the con early.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Quest name is a parody of Through the Fire and Flames by DragonForce .

quests.name: Treasure Hunt
quests.description: You did a GREAT job keeping the baby dracoliches safe… again! They are really lucky to have a protector like you. I bet they'd all agree you deserve any reward you can find! Why not hit all the Treasure Piles like Pinatas and see what rewards come out?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Through the Fire and Bones' quest.

quests.name: Re-Stolen Keys
quests.description: You'll need to close the gate behind you to prevent more chaorrupted enemies from getting in. Unfortunately, these chaorrupted rogues have stolen the gate keys. Get them back so we can lock the gate.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Recover Sepulchure's Cursed Armor! ' quest.

quests.name: Reagents of Chaos
quests.description: The chaorrupted mages on the bridge are channeling a spell that's preventing the gate from locking. If you destroy the reagents they are carrying, the spell will be broken and we'll be able to close off this bridge from our enemies.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Conscripted Chaorruption
quests.description: The chaos warriors on the bridge seem to have chaorrupted the locking mechanisms of this gate. When they are killed, their chaos energy should disperse, allowing us to lock the gate and secure the bridge.
