quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Tools of Chaos
quests.description: Rogues again! It looks like they've set a trap that will go off if we try to close the gate. Defeat the chaorrupted rogues, and take any rogues' tools you find. With them, we should be able to disarm the trap.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Disarmingly Roguish
quests.description: Now that you've got a full set of rogues' tools, we should be able to move forward. Use the tools to disarm the trap the rogues have set, and we'll be able to close and lock this gate.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Dock Blocked
quests.description: It looks like our enemies have formed a blockade on this bridge. A wall of skulls, and a magical barrier protecting it. Before you can continue, you'll need to defeat the mages and destroy their barrier.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Skull Smashing
quests.description: With the magical barrier gone, you should be able to destroy the blockade of skulls. Quickly! Our empress is waiting!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Destroy Chaorruption
quests.description: Shadowfall is under attack by…what is that thing? It looks like a manifestation of chaorruption itself! Neither Shadowfall nor Empress Gravelyn will be safe until that abomination is defeated!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Bonefire Wolf's House Quest
quests.description: Dage the Evil enchanted this undead werewolf to accompany you into battle. Complete its quest to defeat a Legion Gladiator in the /legionarena map and you'll be rewarded with a house complete with in-home bank functionality.
quests.requirements_note: Must have BoneFire Warlord's Wolf Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Dage's 2021 Collection Quest
quests.description: Dage the Evil enchanted this undead werewolf to accompany you into battle. Complete its quest to defeat a Legion Gladiator in the /legionarena map and you'll be rewarded with a house (with in-home bank functionality) and an exclusive character page badge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have BoneFire Wolf Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: It Pays To Be Prepared!
quests.description: Ye noticed the Scoundrels along the beach? Those thieves have their pockets bursting with stolen silver. I need you te go and liberate it from them. Bring it back here, and use our anvil te smelt it down. We'll turn it into bullets for our rifles, and blades for our cutlasses! We ARE about te be fighting werewolves, after all! (Quest available once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pirates be Stealthy! ' quest.

quests.name: A Bit O' Protein
quests.description: Some of our crew be feelin' a bit under the weather. They'd feel better with a bit o' blood in their systems! Would you mind sharing some of yours? No? Thought not. Alright then, collect it from the wild boars instead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pirates be Stealthy! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Meals on Wheels
quests.description: Now that ye've got the crew's meals collected… would ye mind delivering it to them, too? Ye'll be findin' them aboard my ship. Don't worry, they won't hurt ye - they know ye're mine now.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pirates be Stealthy! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Decoratin' Time!
quests.description: The Black Veil's crew likes to get into a celebratory mood for the Midnight Crown "competition". And that means decorations! First, I need ye te collect some empty bottles from the rapscallions along the beach. Bring 'em back here, and I'll tell ye what comes next.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pirates be Stealthy! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Catch Some Fireflies
quests.description: Now, I need you to go into the woods and collect some fireflies… then, come back here, and help me hang up our decor!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pirates be Stealthy! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Black Veil Courier Service
quests.description: I be havin' one more task for ye. Go into the woods, and pick a bouquet of nasturtium - they're the small, orange flowers growing low to the ground. Then, bring it to Flintfang, as a gift from me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pirates be Stealthy! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bring Me the Bounty of the Full Moon!
quests.description: The winner o' the Midnight Crown be the captain what has the biggest pile o' treasure at the end o' the battle! If ye be wantin' to help me out, ye can fight the Full Moon Pirates, and bring me the bounties they carry!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Black Veil Courier Service ' quest. Note: Quests can still be turned-in using the corresponding buttons on the top-right corner.

quests.name: Bring Me HUGE Bounties of the Full Moon!
quests.description: Some o' those Full Moon Pirates carry a larger bounty than usual - you might even say they have HUGE bounties! If ye find 3 o' these, bring 'em to me, and i'll add'em to me pile!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Black Veil Courier Service ' quest. Note: Quests can still be turned-in using the corresponding buttons on the top-right corner.

quests.name: The Cutlass of Awe
quests.description: Speakin' of treasure, many pirates have tried to forge the Cutlass of Awe, the greatest weapon a pirate can get. For the handle, Kurok o'er there has it. For the hilt, the one empowered by the Water Titan has it. For the blade, the captain of the Kaiju ship has it. To forge the pieces, Magma Blazebeard will have th'spell. None of 'em will give up their pieces without a few fights. Good luck!

quests.name: Security Breach
quests.description: So if wes wants to steal that Spaceship, wes needs to take out surveillance in the area. There be lotsa Robo Guards ‘nd Security Cams yuh can destroy, Boss!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Anita Siztance's Quests .

quests.name: No Sniffin’ Around
quests.description: Boss, wes started boarding up doors ‘nd windows, but wes tired. Wes no wants anyone to sees us stealin’ that Spaceship, so wes needs yuh to finish the job. Destroy 5 Robo Dogs so theys don’t be sniffin’ around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Key to Winning
quests.description: Now alls wes need is to find the Spaceship Key! We no knows who has the Key, but wes thinks it be somewhere in this area! Find the Key, Boss!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

npc.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Book One
quests.description: You open the book and read a story about a great hero going on a long journey. They went along and deflated many Togs everywhere, and defeated many Forest Furys in order to make potions. Then, the hero stormed a fiery fortress and defeated Drakonnan, with his power over the Fire Orb. After skipping some pages, you read about a Dragon Drakath?

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

npc.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Gather SwagBucks
quests.description: Swaggy's gone. He rode off into the sunset with that walking bag of bones. You like his place? Good. I don't. I'm sittin' here figuring out where I want to go next, now that I'm out of a job. I need to fund a trip to someplace exotic. You bring me things I can use, I give you things you want.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pinky the Unicorn??? ' quest.

quests.name: Time is Money
quests.description: … Silly mortal, did you really think I would just… HAND OVER such valuable objects to you just because you had gotten me from Master Archfiend? That's not how this will work. Go require acquire the things I need first. To give you such value, I need objects to do the summoning first.
quests.requirements_note: Must have the Bounty Hunter Blade Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Twin Blade
quests.description: …What? Don't… don't tell me you actually think you deserve a copy of myself to wield as a weapon. YOU? Wield ME? You don't have enough power to do that, Lowly Minion, but I might as well let you try and fail until you get it in your head. Collect me a few things from this land as well as a gem from an ugly fish who goes by the name of Kuro. You can find that…monstrosity living in the /river.
quests.requirements_note: Must have the Bounty Hunter Blade Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: New Worlds, New Opportunities
quests.description: Oooh, What an interesting realm my Master found. This land is rich in jewels you would find in..Nevermind that. Bring me some things I want to examine from this world. Maybe I'll hand over some of the things you people consider "valuable" Don't worry I'll tell you where to find these things for me. The Horns on the helmet adorned by the Cyclops Warlord in /faerie should do. The rest I'm sure you can figure it out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Bounty Hunter's Drone Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Identical Copies
quests.description: Wait, you're seriously called a "hero" in this dimension? HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! With THAT toothpick of a weapon?! And looking like THAT? AAAAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! Oh, you poor soul. I will help you, yes I will. Do you want my help? Yes, of course you do. Bring me these things I require from your world and we'll make a copy of myself that will make sure you do not embarass yourself. One of those time Travel Fairies in the /timevoid has a thing I need as well. Go fetch it for me. You'll know it when you get it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Bounty Hunter's Drone Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Beauty Comes At a Price
quests.description: The first vict- I mean naughty-doer is Scarletta. It shouldn't surprise you, should it? With everything she's done for eternal beauty, she deserves what's coming to her. Even though she technically did pay for it in the end, I think it's good to revisit her to make sure she's learned her lesson, don't you think?

quests.name: Bloody Skulls
quests.description: Skulls. SkullsskullsskullsSKULLS! Oh. Hello there, "Hero" Would you like to know the next person on our list? I think my screaming made it obvious but in case you didn't catch on, it's that overly grown skeleton, Vordred. Is he even a skeleton? We never have seen what he looks like under the armor… Or have you? I wonder what he looks like it we..removed some. One by one. Do you think it would hurt him? Would he.. cry about it like the souls inside those bones do? Let's see how long it takes. I wanna enjoy this. I heard you can find him inside /epicvordred.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Making The World a Cleaner Place
quests.description: Welcome back, my super sidekick! As enticing as it is to make the villains pay for being NAUGHTY, we must bring joy to the GOOD boys and girls in the world that may be less fortunate than us too! Here, I have a bag of freshly made candy that you can hand out in the /twilightslums to those nasty monsters - that'll make them NICER!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Big and Deadly
quests.description: Our next big target is REALLY big so make sure to grab your biggest axe! It says here any who enter the titan are doomed to become part of it. But that's exactly what we need to do. We're here for Dakka the Dire Dragon. We'll show him size doesn't mean everything! Let's head to /treetitanbattle and have some fun! Not sure what I mean? Better head to the /livingdungeon first then.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Hunting We Will Go
quests.description: Ya know, after tortu- I mean, insisting Dakka plays nice, we should explore some spoooooky forests new adventurers probably find themselves in. I heard there's a Lich in the forests of Darkovia who preys on INNOCENT SOULS! How do I know that? He wouldn't be decorated in so many skulls if it weren't true! If you listen reaaaalllyyyy closely, you can even hear them cry out in pain and agony! Let's go pay The Lich of the Stone in /darkoviaforest a visit and see who we can help.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Returning to Oblivion
quests.description: Ya know, I always wondered something. When people say the word "oblivion", what do they really mean? It can have so many meanings but everyone comes to the understanding. Some, not all, but some of the void creatures chose to throw their humanity away to become monsters. I say we return them to their oblivion. Shall we take a trip to the /underworld and really dish out punishment to the wicked? I won't be satisfied until they are completely broken.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Both Sides are Guilty
quests.description: Now that a small fraction of the Void has been dealt with, we must look at the Legion with the small magnifying glass! They too have nasty, awful followers who follow their Master's every whim. Have you SEEN what Dage has caused on the islands of Fotia?! In fact, I know 3 specific beings I can have a small "talking to". Let us make way to /judgement and have a talk with them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bait and Switch
quests.description: Ya know, I never did like the royalty type. Don't worry we aren't going to mess with the Swordhaven family. Not at this time anyway. No, this time we're finding a fake little princess. Creatures who use a visage of a princess to lure in unsuspecting heroes to be. Let's go get us a "princess" inside the /doomvault.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What Chaos Touches, We Destroy
quests.description: Our next location is deep inside the /orecavern. I'm sure you know what Chaos has done to the lands, what creatures have transformed into. Let us go take a visit to the Naga Baas, I heard she causes the local creatures trouble. What? We can save the animals too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Finale to Remember
quests.description: Wowie zowie, I can't believe we're almost done! The last big baddie that needs to face punishment is Lionfang himself. The man so righteous with good intention, he will do any evil to continue his path. How selfish, how arrogant. This one needs to be taught a lesson - go hunt him down in /stormtemple.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Continuing The Hunt
quests.description: Still up for punishing the wicked, are you? Don't worry, it won't be some big baddie. Maybe. It will be things even YOU can handle! Here you go, here's a list. Make sure you check it twice, then go after the Golden Warrior and Maximilian Lionfang in /goldenruins.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Finale to Remember ' quest.

quests.name: Retrieve Void Auras
quests.description: The Necrotic Sword of Doom requires many pieces, and many steps. In order to begin, you will need to learn the creation of Void Aura. Bring me 20 essences from each of the following monsters:
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 10 Evil .

quests.name: Gathering Unstable Essences
quests.description: Throughout Lore, you may encounter rare, unnatural creatures whose existence itself should not be. Since their presence defies the laws of nature, the essences that bind them to reality are inherently stronger than others. Search /reddeath, /neverworldb, and /doomwar for these monsters and bring me their essences; they may have the power to form a Void Aura.

quests.name: Commanding Shadow Essences
quests.description: If you use Sepulchre’s DoomKnight Armor as a catalyst, you should have the power to magnify shadow essences enough to fuse them into a Void Aura. Travel to the hidden /shadowrealmpast and gather 50 Empowered Essences from the monsters there. Before I can create the Void Aura, I require an additional 3 Malignant Essences from Sepulchure or the Shadow Lord to use as focal points for the smelting process.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Sepulchure's DoomKnight Armor in your inventory. Note: Previously Legend only.

quests.name: The Encroaching Shadows (Daily)
quests.description: You must be able to stand up to true power if you wish to possess true power. Find and face several strong foes, and return to me your proof of victory. Obtain a Glacial Pinion from the Icewing Warlord, three eyeballs from the strongest Hydra in Mobius Lake, and the viscera of a creature in the Void.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 75. Notes:

quests.name: Glimpse Into The Dark (Daily)
quests.description: "Hero", do you wish for power? Would you like a glimpse of what could be? I require a few things from powerful beings and beasts. Their power will help bring you closer to understanding the darkness. I require Kraken Doubloons from the Chaos Kraken, the axe of Graveclaw the Destroyer, and Ancient Trigoras' Horns.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 75. Notes:

quests.name: Find the Doom Blade's Blade
quests.description: You now know how to create the Void Aura, so we need to move on in the crafting process. The next thing we need to do is get the blade! Defeat Sepulchure's Chaorrupted armor to find the Blade Essence that I need to create that part of the Doom Blade.

quests.name: Find the Doom Blade's Hilt
quests.description: You have taken the first step along this path towards the creation of the Necrotic Sword of Doom. If you truly believe that you have the power to continue along this path, do not let me dissuade you. In order to create the base of the hilt, a massive amount of energy is needed, among other things.

quests.name: Create the Doom Blade's Aura
quests.description: You have mastered the collection of Void Aura, but that is not the only thing needed to create the Necrotic Sword of Doom. In order to imbue the sword with the power of Necromancy, we will need the Energized Aura of Necromance. This is not something that can be created in one step, however, so you must first gather all that is needed to create the Unenhanced Aura.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 10 Necromancer (AC) in your inventory.

quests.name: Create the Doom Blade's Aura
quests.description: You have mastered the collection of Void Aura, but that is not the only thing needed to create the Necrotic Sword of Doom. In order to imbue the sword with the power of Necromancy, we will need the Energized Aura of Necromance. This is not something that can be created in one step, however, so you must first gather all that is needed to create the Unenhanced Aura.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 10 Necromancer (Merge) in your inventory.

quests.name: Necrotic Sword of Doom Badge
quests.description: The darkness compelled you to join with it. And now, the world should know your true nature. Bring me Arcane Parchment from any Skeletal Warriors nearby, and I will reward you with a character page badge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Necrotic Sword of Doom (Sword) in your inventory.

items.name: Necrotic Sword of Doom Character Page Badge

quests.name: Mmm... Cake
quests.description: First, a favor for me. Beat up the waiters coming in from the kitchen and steal me some spiceroot cake. It's a special dessert - they only serve it to the most oldest and lofties of Sheevra. It's delicious, but I'm not supposed to have any.

quests.name: Catch the Sprites
quests.description: First, you're gonna need to capture some garden sprites. They have a great nose for uncovering the truth. Just catch 'em in these jars! They won't like it much, but they can't break out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spicy
quests.description: Alright, NOW, you gotta go get some moonpepper flakes. It's like catnip for these lil guys - stuff drives 'em wild! We use it as a spice, too, so the Kitchen Brownies will have some. Might have to convince them to give it to you, through!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Things are Getting Hairy
quests.description: This is gonna be the hard part. I need strands of hair from elder Sheevra, one for each sprite. They won't hand them to you freely, so you'll have to be sneaky about it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once.

quests.name: Let 'em Loose
quests.description: Now go let the sprites loose in the ballroom and see what happens!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once.

quests.name: Time To Think
quests.description: We've only just arrived and already my soldiers are jumping at shadows, LITERALLY. Kill 9 Nightmare Stalkers and help put them at ease. It'll make preparations go a lot easier.

quests.name: Know First, Then Do
quests.description: I've met with the other commangers, and while I think we'll avoid stepping on each other's toes, we're fighting a bit in the dark here. None of us has a very clear idea of what we're up against.

quests.name: Strange Magics
quests.description: There is strange magic in the air. Gather 10 Vials of Shadow Blood by killing Nightmare Stalkers and Abyssal Mages to let our mages try to discover what's behind it.

quests.name: Northpointe Incursions
quests.description: Hero, the attack has begun. The brunt of the fight is being handled by the alliance forces, but there are some squads getting by. Take a look around town and kill Fear Mongers and Grimspawn Blades I want their Blood Fangs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Northpointe Key I in your inventory.

quests.name: Vash Nerada
quests.description: Unstopped, shadows can take form. Let's make sure we stop them first! Kill Nightmare Stalkers and bring back 10 Shadow Tentacles as proof of your work.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Northpointe Key II in your inventory.

quests.name: Hit Them In The Face. Hard.
quests.description: The Pyromancer guild is telling us that they are running out of supplies. Luckily we can get more. Infernal Goblins are supposed to cry sulfur. Let's find out, if the rumors are false, at least there are fewer Infernal Goblins around. Try to bring in 10 Sulfur Tears to see if it can be done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Northpointe Key III in your inventory.

quests.name: Fear Itself
quests.description: Fear Imps have the ability to turn our troops into a fleeing stampede but there is a chance. If you can gather 7 Poisoned Claws, we can whip up enough Bravery Brew to give to our entire army.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Northpointe Key IV in your inventory.

quests.name: The Taste of their Own Poison
quests.description: Kill Nightmare Stalkers and Abyssal Mages to recover Intimidation Orbs. We should be able to turn their magic back on their own faces, use their own fear against them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Northpointe Key V in your inventory.

quests.name: The Name Of The Thing
quests.description: What's with Fear Imps and Fear Mongers? If they weren't named Fear whatever would they be as scary? Kill 10 of them while calling them Defenders and see what happens.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Northpointe Key VI in your inventory.

quests.name: Take out the Boss
quests.description: Thanks to all your work, and the alliance forces' defenses there is a chance. The leader of the attack, Goregrim stands relatively unguarded. He's daunting even on this own, but now's our chance. Bring him down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Northpointe Key VII in your inventory.

quests.name: Piles of Food
quests.description: Hero! I knew you had GOOD in your heart! Please help us win this foodfight. Go show those evildoers what Swordhaven strength is really all about and confiscate any piles of food they have on them.

quests.name: Mega Piles of Food
quests.description: Seems some of the forces of Evil have somehow gotten their bony hands on fresh mashed potatoes. We will…need that. I need you to intercept a few large stockpiles from them.

quests.name: Just Had to be Doom Knights
quests.description: It seems Gravelyn's forces brought out the bigger guns. Doom Knights have started appearing on the battleground. Those beings usually don't know when to hold back and I cannot think of having a soldier meet them out on the field. Go knock a few out so they are only unconscious.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Piles of Food' quest.

quests.name: Take Out the Commanders
quests.description: We're at the home stretch now! I can feel it. We've been gaining more ground to stopping this mess once and for all. Unfortunately though, it seems the Commanders have come out to make sure the job is done. You need to take them out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Delicious Looking Enemy
quests.description: So that's their secret weapon? Gotta say, Shadowfall improvising on such a Golem seems so wasteful. Really, they said we hoarded food yet they do this nonsense… Friend, usually we would have taken care of this already but this giant mess has already beat the stuffing out of a few of my men already. Take it out in the name of Swordhaven.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mental Damage Sponge
quests.description: Dage is brimming with confidence, and has taken his minions with him to march into Drakath's fortress. Let him. If there are any ambushes waiting, Dage can take it in the chin. For now, scout, and report back to us with anything suspicious. Victoria also wanted to talk to you, as did the Empress. I would rather you didn't speak with the Empress for very long…she's shirking her duties as Champion. Who does she think she is?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Avatar of Fire ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Scraping the Barrel
quests.description: We may be in crisis but Malgor's forces seem to be spread thin. Most are converging in Crownsreach but the rest are all across the continent spreading wanton havoc. It's forcing all of our allies to divide their attention to do damage control. While we search for a way to get the door open, I want to see who Malgor brought with him to steal the Queen of Monsters' Heart. Fight his minions and bring a few of them back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Avatar of Fire ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fractals
quests.description: The state of the undead and soldiers Malgor forced to fight for him are curious. He has control of the Mana Core and these fighters are bursting with magical energy. They should have been difficult to fight but are being torn to shreds by their own power. Their wounds…It's as if they're suffering from the same symptoms I'm experiencing but worse. There are similarly glowing fissures in the ground as well. Let's examine them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Avatar of Fire ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blind Retaliation
quests.description: Now that we've investigated this far, I can conclude that the mages by the fortress' entrance are keeping it sealed. They may have waited for Dage to enter, and emerged to lock him in. Defeat them and the door will be open to us. But, take great caution. The wounds down their chests…It's the excess mana they can't contain in their bodies bursting outwards. They could explode in your face if they're this overloaded with mana.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Avatar of Fire ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Deafening Silence
quests.description: The entrance to Crownsreach's fortress has been blown open. It's quiet. Far too quiet to assume that Dage swept the area of all enemies. There isn't hide nor hair of any chaos faction members either. That would be a welcome sight at any other time but not now. What could have happened here? Hurry, we must defeat the remainder of Malgor's enthralled minions and catch up to the ghoul.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Avatar of Fire ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stilled Mind
quests.description: The way to the halls on the right are clear, but what in the name of the Avatars is all this? You said this used to be someone's room? Then there's been major redecorating. Drakath converted it into some sort of study. It would not take a scholar to understand what he was researching but I want to take a closer look anyway. I would like you to help me, but if what you find is too gruesome, let me know and I'll take care of the rest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Avatar of Fire ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Volatile Nature
quests.description: The halls were a dead end. Let us make our way to the Throne Room. Those wisps… They're seeping out of the bodies of Malgor's minions. I can even hear them whispering. Wait - I recognise this. It's the mana Malgor enhanced his forces with. It's escaped their bodies. If we don't break them apart, they'll form into an impenetrable fog of energized mana! Dispel them or else we'll be blocked from going further!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Avatar of Fire ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Heartache
quests.description: Beyond the throne room is an altar. This must be where Drakath kept the Queen of Monsters' Heart. Chains, thick iron stakes, powerful magic seals…He loathed this heart instead of coveting it. But the heart's already gone and the room is infested with Malgor's mages. Defeat them and we'll forge our way through. I smell smoke coming from outside, he must be nearby!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Avatar of Fire ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clouded Vision
quests.description: According to this woman, Cemaros, Dage has stopped Malgor from making off with the Queen's Heart. She wants a private word with you. Everyone seems to…Just hurry and talk to her. I can see those frenzied mana whisps gathering outside. They might be seeping out of Warlic. He may end up like Malgor's other mages if we don't clear the mana and get to him soon.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Avatar of Fire ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Guilt Complex
quests.description: I understand if you want to berate me for going behind your back. We can both have at each other for keeping secrets after we stop Malgor from taking the heart. Dage is locked in combat with him, which leaves you to rescue Warlic. His magical abilities are beyond anyone's in Greenguard, perhaps in all of Lore. Defeat him and wrest our friend from Malgor's control!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Avatar of Fire ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Em-pathetic Connection
quests.description: The longer the Mana Core remains in its corrupted state, the more people will succumb to Shadowflame…or whatever else could be happening to the Core. My own symptoms are worsening and soon, I'll be comatose like the others. It is entirely possible that it can get worse beyond catatonia. We need to study Malgor's forces and how they're being affected. It's possible we can glean further information to help our situation.

quests.name: Cold Shells
quests.description: The minions of the Shadows are already here! Possessed sets of armor are stalking these woods, and it's only a matter of time before they come across innocents. We'll need to dismantle them before we can find the others.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Enigmatic Entity ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Equivalent Exchange
quests.description: The Snake Men that serve the invading Shadows have infiltrated the forest as well! They're gathering to feed! Fight them off, and look for any Elves that may need our help!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Enigmatic Entity ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mouth of the Snake Den
quests.description: We need to find the Empress, but the snake men and malevolent armors are pressuring my knights. Please help us thin their numbers, and report to Gravelyn about our current status.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Enigmatic Entity ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can also be found from Gravelyn (NPC) in Camlan Forest .

quests.name: Cocooned Gold
quests.description: There may be more we can learn by studying Camlan and its temple. Let's look for anything else Dryden's parents, Bellona and Sleih, were hiding from their son. The Metamorphosis Maw could have left clues behind as well.

quests.name: Break into the Timelock
quests.description: Time is running out! You've gotta stabilize the rift to buy more time to get Dage the Evil back to our world. For that, you've got to get INTO the timelock, then find and free Lycan Queen Safiria!

quests.name: Battle Dark ArchMage Brentan
quests.description: Before Dage the Evil invaded, Alteon sealed himself and two of his strongest warriors inside the timelock to protect the rift and safiria from you. If you're going to reach her, you'll have to take Brentan out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Duality Seal I in your inventory.

quests.name: Battle Cryomancer Drakonnan
quests.description: Before Dage the Evil invaded, Alteon sealed himself and two of his strongest warriors inside the timelock to protect the rift and safiria from you. If you're going to reach her, you'll have to take Cryomancer Drakonnan out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Duality Seal II in your inventory.

quests.name: Battle Alteon the Imbalanced
quests.description: Alteon knows what you can do, Hero, and he will stop at nothing to prevent you from destroying this rift, or his chance to rule the mirror realm! You'll need to take him out if you're going to get Lycan Queen Safiria out of here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Duality Seal III in your inventory.

quests.name: Call Forth the Light
quests.description: Dage the Good sees potential in everyone… even those who have sided with the Dark. Cleanse the creatures in the /overworld by bringing him 8 Dark Hearts and he will reward you with gold!

quests.name: Legion Quest: Overworld Free for All
quests.description: Glory in the name of Dage the Good, Bright Lord of the Overworld! Bring him 10 dark hearts from the monsters in /brightfortress and he will reward you with gold… and more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Legion Quest: Light vs Dark
quests.description: The day will come when Dage rules all… but will it be Dage the Good… or Dage the Evil? Help keep the balance in /brightfortress (for now) by bringing 10 Badges of Loyalty, 8 Badges of Corruption, and 6 Badges of Twisted Light Tokens from the monsters in BrightFortress!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Rolling Veins
quests.description: It's time we get back to business. We were kept in chains for so long that we've lost track of the mineral veins. Our mountain is unlike any other. Veins of precious minerals and metals grow and shift. It takes experience to track where they sprout and move. If you get us Gem Cores from the Gemralds and scoop some innards out of the Glow Worms, we'll show you how we prospect.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Dwarfhold Chaos Saga .

quests.name: No Business
quests.description: Vath must have made a good snack for Stalagbite, but the dragon could have stuck around to help themselves to the rest of his army. The Chaos Drows and Chaotic Draconians are squatting in the mountain, leaderless but destructive. We need to get rid of them, or render them harmless. Break the Drows' weapons and clip the Draconian's Wings. That'll make them easier to handle.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Dwarfhold Chaos Saga .

quests.name: A Brutal Mistake
quests.description: Harrumph. You'd think someone as upright as I am wouldn't be so forgetfull! Its my one failure, and I try to make sure no one knows about it, so I keep spare sets of the jail keys hidden around. But someone- or someTHING- stole one! Can you search behind the statues and on the undead for my extra set of keys? (Quest can only be done once per login)

quests.name: Get the Merch
quests.description: These undead monster have made a mess of the merch booth! Do me a solid and bring back all the merchandise they stole. DO NOT try to keep it all for yourself. I will know. I'll reward you with some awesome swag if you help me out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Bryce's Lucky Coin in your inventory.

quests.name: Grunge Grind
quests.description: After every concert, we're left with a venue that looks like a horde of Horcs blasted it into a sludge factory. It's a WRECK. Go clear out all the stragglers so the cleaning crew can come through in peace. Get'em out quick and I'll make it worth your while.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Bryce's Lucky Coin in your inventory.

quests.name: Bryce Platinum's Task
quests.description: Rock stars LOVE meeting their fans. But I've got to say, your arena has some really… grungy denizens. Monsters, even. I've got to think about the safety of the band, you know? And I need YOU to help. Take out 8 of the creatures waiting to tackle the talent and I'll make it worth your while.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Bryce's Lucky Coin in your inventory.

quests.name: As the Crow Flyers
quests.description: What kind of promoter doesn't have any flyers to give out? A terrible one! I had a big stack for this show, but I set 'em down for just a second and the wind blew 'em all away. As far as I can tell, the crows have 'em now. Get 'em back for me, will ya?

quests.name: Wake 'em Up!
quests.description: I tell you, these music fans are ZOMBIES! I know the show doesn't start for awhile, but we need to get them more excited! Go smack em around until they're ready to dance.

quests.name: Get Wired
quests.description: The box of wires for the speakers bounced off the cart as the roadies drove it over the Dwarfhold Mountains. If we're going to have sound, we need the tech! Slay Silver Elementals in the /towerofmirrors until you get 7 Silver Wires to help the sound crew.

quests.name: Juice It!
quests.description: We've got wires. We've got speakers and lights. What we don't have… is MORE POWER! Slay the Electric Men in /Mountain until you get x6 More Juice for the electricians.

quests.name: Snack Attack
quests.description: It takes a lot of stamina to put on a show like the one we're planning. That means… food for the talent, you know what I'm saying? Slay Enchanted Sushi in /artixpointe to get 13 pieces of Sushi!!! for the band. Then bring me 3 Special Energy Drinks from the Elite Guards in /lust so they have enough energy to perform.

quests.name: No Bootlegging Allowed
quests.description: You know what rips my buttons? Bootleggers. Security says they've seen Music Pirates in the area, and that's a real no-go in my book. Slay 13 Music Pirates in /arenaline to prevent them from making bootleg copies of the band's album.

quests.name: Get Inked
quests.description: It ain't a concert without merch. How else are you going to remember who you saw? Help Johnny Trax, our merch vendor, keep her products rolling out. Bring me 3 Ink Vials from the Coal Elemental in /junkhoard. We can use this for the darkest of black inks for our merch.

quests.name: Wear's the Goods?
quests.description: Johnny said she's expecting a larger-than-usual volume of Merch Sales. I know her cloth vendor usually heads to the /farm to get Fabric from the scarecrows. There's no reason you can't cut out the middleman and do the same. Bring back 6 pieces of fabric so she can keep the merch coming.

quests.name: More Killer Punch
quests.description: We made some KILLER punch for this party, but now it's all gone and we're gonna need more. But I'm missing the secret ingredient - Toxic Ooze from those Toxic Beasts! Bring me some and I'll pay ya.

quests.name: Canine Canines
quests.description: Ze only way to stop ze Werewolfs is to stop zem at the source. Ze gray wolves in Greengard, zhey are not a big threat..but still, zhey are part wolf, and must be exterminated. You never know when zey will turn into Werewolfs, so stop zhem before zhey can do ze transform! Bring to me 8 canine teeth from zhey Gray Wolfs so zat I know the deed is done!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Paw ' quest.

quests.name: Dog Gone Shame
quests.description: Zere has been ze storytelling of Chaorrupted Wolves living in ze Neverglades. Haz you ever been zere? Ze stories says zhat zhey live in ze Forest of Chaos and in ze Chaos Forest. If zis is true, zhen go out and bring me 5 Chaorrupted Barbs from zere spines. Ze less wolf population, ze better Darkovia vill become!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Paw ' quest.

quests.name: Bite is worse then their Bark
quests.description: Zhey call zhem Dire Wolves for a reason, human. Zese wolves reside just outside ze castle of Her Majesty. I knows zat you have confronted zhem already in ze forest…. so fighting zhem again should be not a problems. You bring to me 6 Dire Hair from zhose beasts, yes?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Paw ' quest.

quests.name: A Wolf's Tail
quests.description: Zhose Lycans are alvays causing ze Vampires trouble. You says vhat you is strongs enough to become one of us… so proves it! If you cans bring to me 5 Tails from ze Lycans everyday, zhen your hard vork will not go unnoticed!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Paw ' quest. Note: These quests can be completed once per day.

quests.name: A Twisted Mess
quests.description: If it iz not one vhing, it iz anothers. Ze head Lycan Knight… ze is known by Twisted Paw. You may thinks vhat you haz already killed him… but you are VRONG! Zhat Lycan… iz zomething else… zomething unnatural! Bring to me his Equipment so vat we ze Vampires may study ze power of Twisted Paw!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Paw ' quest. Note: These quests can be completed once per day.

quests.name: Dogfight
quests.description: 'Ave you noticed all ze lycans roaming Darkovia? Yez? Ze pack is growing straonger every day…and zey must be stopped! If you vant to become a true Vampire, then you vill go forth and take care of zis issue! Bring to be every Lycan DNA from every canine breed in ze Darkovian Lands. Zis includes ze DNA from Dire Wolves, Chaos Lycans, Lycans, Twisted Paw, and ze Lycan Knight. Zis is a tough task, buy you vill be awarded greatly if you are successful.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Paw ' quest. Note: These quests can be completed once per day.

quests.name: Follow Lady Solani
quests.description: You'd better hurry - Lady Solani is waiting for you. You'll find her in the halls, in front of a door that has been sealed for centuries.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lord Balax'el ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Candy Craze
quests.description: Mogloween would be my favourite time of year if it was more about candy then all the other spooky stuff. This year I haven't had a single piece of candy and I'm craving candy. I heard that inside these houses all the creatures are carrying candy with them. I would go in, but I'd rather not. Can you collect 20 pieces of candy for me? (Bring back 20 piecs of candy to complete the quest.)

quests.name: Chocolate Goodness
quests.description: Out of all the candy, chocolate is my favourite, but it is so much harder to find. Chocolate is very well-guarded by Pumpkinhead Fred and you have to fight them to get the chocolate. Can you search the Pumpkinhead Fred for 5 chocolates? (Bring back 5 chocolates to complete the quest.)

quests.name: Chocolate and Caramel Craving
quests.description: The BEST local chocolate candy comes from chickencows, of course. Toil sources her straight from Clucky Moo in /TwigsArcade. And her new favorite caramels are made from pumpkin brains. Try the Gourdos in /pie. Bring me back 10 Chocolate Candies and 10 Pumkin Caramels… and don't eat any on your on the way!

quests.name: Loads of Gummies and Lollies
quests.description: I don't know WHY Trouble loves gummies so much but she does. And her favorites are shaped like that creepy Baby doll in /TwigsArcade. Ick. She'll also want wagonloads of the Lollies that Myst Imps in /pie carry around, too. Bring me back 10 Gummy Babies and 10 Licked Lolliess… and make sure she doesn't see you while you're hunting around!

quests.name: Fizzies and Stickies and Gooies OH MY
quests.description: You might not know this, but I ALSO have a fewfavorite candies. The Ectoplasms in /TwigsArcade, the Free Samples in /Chromafection, and the Sugarrush Gouls here in the /CandyShop each have one of our favorites. I'll never say no to more GOO-dies, Sour Stickies or Fuzzy Fizzies. They are all the BEST!

quests.name: Strut My Stuff
quests.description: I've been ordered to sell you supplies for your house. I can do that. My otherself did it, so I can, too. Even though he's real and I'm not. If I'm going to build those items for you, I'll need 3 Cogs from the Ancient Chest in Time Library, 5 Tog Leg Bones, and the Scrap Metal from the Junk lying around town. Go now. Come back with resources.

quests.name: Piece of Cake
quests.description: What ya needs ta do is give him somethin' sweet that will reverse da flow of time. Where can ya get dat, you ask? Why, from da Cake In-between Time! You can find it in da /portalmaze.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Weird Gourmet ' quest.

quests.name: A Health Nut
quests.description: Now, with Twig, ya gots ta make sure he eats somethin' healthy, too. I never know what ta feed him, but you know who does? That's right! His granola counterpart in the Mirror Realm! Head ta /brightfortress and ask Granola Twig what he should have.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Weird Gourmet ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Lost Breadcrumbs
quests.description: My son went outside to play after breakfast. I told him to stay close but he must have wandered into the woods near the graveyard and got lost. He could still be out there, cold, hungry and alone. Or hurt! Please, find him. I don't have much but I'll give you my house if I have to.

quests.name: Dirty Laundry
quests.description: We're lucky my Caden didn't end up like Loshe's wife next door. After she was murdered, I saw Loshe throw her clothes out. But — no. It can't be… Would you mind investigating what's left of her clothes? The maggots might be using it for nesting.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: No Good Deed
quests.description: Before my father passed away, our food stores were filled to the brim. We dried our meats to keep them longer, but… there was something off about them. Father told me that someone he helped gave him directions to a good hunting ground. Maybe you'll have luck there, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kids These Days ' quest.

quests.name: A Worn Book's Cover
quests.description: Father often gave bread to the homeless wanderers that sleep in the town square. There aren't many anymore. They were the first to be executed after the murders started, save for this one addled old man my father liked. HE could be the one who gave my father those directions. No one else had heard of the place. Would you ask him WHY he did such a thing? I would, but I'm afraid I might lose control and hurt him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Egg Hunt - Backpack
quests.description: Turn in a Complete Set of Eggs and obtain the Backpack! If any players click on the Backpack, it will reveal a secret… including which monsters drop the 1% rare eggs for the Vorpal Bunny Quests.

quests.name: Egg Hunt - Vorpal Bunny
quests.description: Turn in a Complete Set of Eggs and obtain a Vorpal Bunny! Anyone who clicks on the Vorpal Bunny will receive quests to find the rare pieces of the rare Berzerker Bunny set! (Bunny is member-only but all players can click on it.)

quests.name: Eggsamine Zard Eggs
quests.description: I've given up hope to dye Dragon Eggs. It's just too dangerous—and not to mention it takes A LOT of vinegar just to dye one egg! But Zard eggs… now that's a bit more manageable and a bunch more safe. Travel the entire world and collect an egg from every Zard in Lore. And remember: only Females will drop an Egg, so keep huntin' until you get an Egg from every Zard on the list! Good Luck!

quests.name: Eggstreme Fishing
quests.description: Ever try to dye a fish egg? Well… neither have I! But since it's Grenwog, there is no better time to try! Travel the entire world and collect an egg from every fishy creature in Lore. And remember: only Females will drop an Egg, so keep huntin' until you get an Egg from every fish on the list! Good Luck!

quests.name: Eggscavating Dwakel Eggs
quests.description: Dwakels are a breed of Lizard, right? And since lizards lay eggs… so must Dwakels! I think…? Only one way to find out! Travel the entire world and collect an egg from every Dwakel in Lore. And remember: only Females will drop an Egg, so keep huntin' until you get an Egg from every Dwakel on the list! Good Luck!

quests.name: Eggstraordinary Bird Eggs
quests.description: I tried dying, Dragon Eggs. Zard Eggs. Fish Eggs. Dwakel Eggs. But nothing beats dying Bird Eggs for Grenwog! Travel the entire world and collect an egg from every bird in Lore. And remember: only Females will drop an Egg, so keep huntin' until you get an Egg from every bird on the list! Good Luck!

quests.name: Platinum Egg Hammer
quests.description: To hatch and egg you've got to BREAK some eggs! Head to /uppercity in Dwarfhold and crack open the Chaos Eggs there. ONE of the eggs you break open will have the hammer you need, but you may need to keep at it for a while!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Platinum Egg in inventory.

quests.name: Golden Egg Hammer
quests.description: To hatch and egg you've got to BREAK some eggs! Head to /uppercity in Dwarfhold and crack open the Chaos Eggs there. ONE of the eggs you break open will have the hammer you need, but you may need to keep at it for a while!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Golden Egg (Misc) (Legend) in inventory.

quests.name: Bring me the PINK Eggs!
quests.description: I lay resting against the tower in the shade of its trees, and pondered the effects of magic and Chaos on Lore.

quests.name: Bring me the GREEN Eggs!
quests.description: All these twists and turns make me dizzy, but not as dizzy as I'll be if I end up inside-out!

quests.name: Bring me the BLUE Eggs!
quests.description: Not everyone who hangs out at a mage's tower is actually a mage. Some of them are the people who help the mages recharge! They deserve Grenwog treats, too.

quests.name: Bring me the PURPLE Eggs!
quests.description: It's so easy to get lost in your dreams. The paths all look the same, but they all lead to the same place eventually.

quests.name: Bring me the MULTICOLORED Eggs!
quests.description: Everything you lose eventually ends up in a landfill spanning across time. I might have left an egg there, too.

quests.name: Classic Original
quests.description: Looks like the Grenwogs are boxing each other to decide who the leader of their colony should be. Join the fray and pick off the basic Grenwog. It's been a while since I've seen one of those.

quests.name: Sweet Buckteeth
quests.description: That Sugar Grenwog deeper into the warren's a bit more interesting than one of the original flavors. Let's cross that one off the list before it escapes, and starts giving dentists a reason to charge more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tastes Like Chicken
quests.description: Now lookie there, that's a Draconic Grenwog! Definitely a contender for the title of colony leader. We don't want hundreds of them bouncing around, so let's give it a clean ring-out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Jurassic Instinct
quests.description: A Jurassic Grenwog! Just look at that beauty. Forget everything else… we have to take it down before it passes those primal instincts to the next generation. Grenwogs having a bad day are a mess, I tell ya.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rapid Cycling
quests.description: I've never seen a Grenwog completely made of liquid before! Wait, that's not just water. It's an immortality elixir! If we have immortal Grenwogs running round, they'll fill the entire universe by next week! C'mon, we gotta wrangle this one now!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Seraphic Medals
quests.description: If you are going to stop Laken, we're going to have to get past his Seraphic army! For every one of them you kill, bring their Medals back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Guardian ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Mega Seraphic Medals
quests.description: Some of these Seraphic soldiers are particularly powerful, and you won't always be able to tell who they are from appearance alone. They'll be carrying larger medals, however. Bring me any that you find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Guardian ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Seraphic Commanders
quests.description: They're sending in the big guns, now! Those Seraphic Commanders pose a greater threat than the normal Soldiers do. We'll need to focus them down first. Take down any that you can find, and report back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Guardian ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Defeat Ada
quests.description: We've pushed back the bulk of the Seraphic forces, but now we have a new threat to contend with. Ada, the Order's top assassin, has entered the battlefield and now stands in our way. Deal with her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Guardian ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: We Must Defeat Him
quests.description: We've fought back the forces of the Seraphic Order, and now nothing stands in our way. If we are going to take Laken down, now is the time to act.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Guardian ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: The Cake is NOT a lie!
quests.description: s you go to cut a piece of the cake, it wavers in and out of existence, as if it is truly in-between time. Maybe if you gather some fragments of the nearby Time Wraiths, you can get it to stabilize.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Weird Gourmet ' quest. Note: Quest title is a direct reference to the Cake from Portal .

quests.name: Training With Dage
quests.description: Try your best, and we'll see how you measure up. Step through the doors, and face Dage.

quests.name: Darkness for Darkness' Sake
quests.description: If you want any of our Legion's gear, you're going to have to prove your dedication! Dage's Favor can be obtained from any of the fiends in /underworld, Obsidian Rocks can be obtained from the Soul Forge there as well, and Souls of Heresy can be obtained from Virgil's tasks in /sevencircleswar.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Power of the Undead Legion
quests.description: Now it's time to do battle with some of the Legion's greatest commanders! If you can earn the approval of the Legion Fiend Rider in /legionarena, the Lich Lord in /frozenlair, and Grrberus in /dagefortress, then we'll see about getting you some gear.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Necrotic Sword of the Underworld
quests.description: Dage's undead powers can be used to enchant your items. The Necrotic Sword of the Underworld will do 51% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold when equipped.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Power of the Undead Legion ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Empowered Caladbolg
quests.description: Dage's undead powers can be used to enchant your items. Empowered Caladbolg or Dual Empowered Caladbolg will do 51% more damage to all monsters when equipped.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Power of the Undead Legion ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Empowered Lich King
quests.description: Dage's undead powers can be used to enchant your items. Empowered Lich King will do 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Power of the Undead Legion ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Empowered Undead Champion
quests.description: Dage's undead powers can be used to enchant your items. Empowered Undead Champion will do 50% more damage to Undead monsters when equipped.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Power of the Undead Legion ' quest to access these quests. | Must be Level 80.

quests.name: Empowered Forge Spawn
quests.description: Dage's undead powers can be used to enchant your items. Empowered Bonfire Altar and Empowered Forge Spawn will do 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Power of the Undead Legion ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Empowered Paragon Plate
quests.description: Dage's undead powers can be used to enchant your items. Empowered Paragon Plate will do 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Power of the Undead Legion ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Empowered BladeMaster
quests.description: Dage's undead powers can be used to enchant your items. Empowered BladeMaster will do 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped. The Empowered Katanas will do 51% more damage to all monsters when equipped.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Power of the Undead Legion ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Empowered Dark Caster
quests.description: Dage's undead powers can be used to enchant your items. Empowered Dark Caster will do 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Power of the Undead Legion ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Empowered Prismatic Paragon
quests.description: Dage's undead powers can be used to enchant your items. Empowered Prismatic Paragon will do 35% more damage to all monsters and gives 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Power of the Undead Legion ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Sin of the Underworld
quests.description: Dage's undead powers can be used to enchant your items. The Sin of the Underworld will do 51% more damage to all monsters, and give 30% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Power of the Undead Legion ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Dage, Lord of the Undead Legion
quests.description: This time, Dage won't be holding back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Power of the Undead Legion ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per week.

quests.name: Hotheads
quests.description: Even in the middle of a battlefield, you should always look your best… and most intimidating! I can whip you up a hairstyle so fierce your foes will turn and run! Bring me 6 Pyradon scales, 3 Ash Piles from the Pyroclash, and 1 Lava Jewel from the Living Lava.

quests.name: Make a Marshmallow on a Stick
quests.description: Hi, I'm a talking campfire. Oh… what happened to your marshmallow on a Stick? …did you eat it? You know it can be used for beating up baddies…

quests.name: Roasted Marshmallow on a Stick
quests.description: Hi! I'm a talking Campfire, and if you have a Marshmallow on a Stick, I can magically transform it into a Roasted Marshmallow! Just make sure you UNEQUIP your Marshmallow on a Stick so you don't accidentally get burnt!

quests.name: Nuked Mallow
quests.description: Legend speaks of a Nuked Marshmallow capable of changing colors. But very few have ever seen it. No one knows of it's whereabouts, either.

quests.name: Foreign Body Aspiration
quests.description: I have some very practical gifts ready for gifting, but I took a tumble, and the boxes ran away. Gather the lost gift boxes up, and you can have what's inside. It's a good deal for good kids like you and Miss Aria.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Windpipe Hallway ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Wicker Magic
quests.description: Thanks to your friends, Greenguard's forces stopped attacking the rebels. That leaves Skye's Cailleacha, the mages who serve the Warden of the South. Fight them. They scare easily without the Warriors or Executors to protect them. Talk to Felix, too. He knows their leaders very well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Miserable Monsoon ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Maigh Eo
quests.description: Loughshine is home to forest spirits, including the Elder Yew. They're ancients feared by Queen Iona's army, but they stood back and let the rebels take shelter in their shade. The Yew are being burned by the spreading flames. Pain is sending them into enraged frenzies. We need to quell them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Miserable Monsoon ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Resentment Harbour
quests.description: The flames are spreading too quickly. Some of the Fianna would prefer burning to being captured by Iseul, but I can't let Mr. Kieran's dream end here. Please help us extinguish the flames, and check on Mr. Kieran, too. Loughshine is one of the only places where he and his family were happy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Miserable Monsoon ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wisened Yew
quests.description: Lady Celestia's healing magic is amazing! I suppose what would work on huge Dragon wounds would work three times as well on humans. Oh, that was meant to be a joke, but maybe…let's collect reagents from the Elder Yew and Callieacha. She could find use for them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Miserable Monsoon ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragonflare
quests.description: I think we found your friend the Dragonslayer. He ran away when fires began to engulf Loughshine. He was gruff, but helped keep the Fianna fed. That man's fire went out of control, so I don't think he meant to harm us. Will you talk to him? Felix and I will go with you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Miserable Monsoon ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shock Scatter
quests.description: Pressing East is our best chance at escape, but Skye's Executors have already arrived. That means Iseul is close by. I know how they work, and they do so quickly and efficiently. Defeat them before they can link up with the rest of their forces!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Miserable Monsoon ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Grace of Three
quests.description: Up ahead, there's a younger Yew we can hide the injured Fianna under. We need to clear out the Energy Elementals surrounding it. Ah…that means Lord Haeos continues to take Queen Iona's side. They really don't want us to get to that specific Yew. If you find anything of interest near that tree, let me know.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Miserable Monsoon ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Iubhair
quests.description: We need to prepare to escape, which means that we'll need to leave the injured rebels undefended for a time. Round them up, and lead them to the unburnt Yew Tree so they can take shelter under it. The Yew's shadow will hide them from the lightning.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Miserable Monsoon ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Parting the Clouds
quests.description: Greenguard's forces and the Fianna are getting into formation. We're going to break through the Executors and Energy Elementals to escape. You'll be leading the vanguard, and the rest of us will be right behind you! Find a route for us to the East.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Miserable Monsoon ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Arrester
quests.description: Queen Iona has sent her favorite daughter to prevent us from escaping. We need to get East! It won't be easy, and we will suffer losses, but we have to get past her! Felix and I will support you as best we can.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Miserable Monsoon ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Anvil Cloud
quests.description: Queen Victoria promised to keep the Fianna safe, but they aren't used to Skye. They're in Queen Iona's territory, putting them at a disadvantage. I can cast spells to make it harder for lightning to strike them. I'd just need materials from the Yew, the Elementals, and anything Iseul left behind.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Arrester ' quest.

quests.name: Turtle Power
quests.description: Well, what are ye waiting for? Board me ship and rid it of those weird ninjas!

quests.name: Setting Sail to Yokai
quests.description: Those crafty Kappas have stolen all of my Sail permits - without them, I cannot use the docks at Yokai Isle! I think the Kappa ninjas that stole the permits are in the bow of the ship - go get me a permit so that we can set sail.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Memoirs Of A Sailor
quests.description: Nobody will believe this. I'm going to need you to find all the pages of my Captain's Log so I have some kind of record of this to tell people. Goats will eat anything so you might need to check the goats for a few of the pages.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' SPOOOOOOON! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

items_required.name: Loose Pages of the Captain's Log

quests.name: Snare Some Goats
quests.description: If you're really serious about helping me then you're going to need to clear off some of the goats. Setting traps would be the simplest way. Those Chaos Goats are mean but not too bright. Regular old snares will work fine!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' SPOOOOOOON! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Keys To The Love Goat
quests.description: Those blasted goats ate my keys! I know normal goats have reputation to eat anything but… KEYS?! I need those keys otherwise I'm sunk!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' SPOOOOOOON! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Snares Shmares
quests.description: BLAST IT! The snares aren't working. Those twice-cursed goats are EATING THE TRAPS! You're going to need to go in there and take care of them the old fashioned way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' SPOOOOOOON! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: MEGA-GOAT!
quests.description: Most respectable goats have a goatherd to keep them in line but these goats all answer to the MEGA-GOAT! He's larger than the others and they seem to follow his lead. Take him out and the rest will be no problem!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' SPOOOOOOON! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: All Wet
quests.description: We get so much life from water, why not energy? I built a hydro-kinetic generator to convert the movement of water into clean energy but General Pollution's Chaos fumes have effected Kuro and Water Elementals tending the Wheel. They can get the wheel cleaned up and moving again if you can gather 4 Water Cores from the Water Elementals and a Chaotic Water Core From Kuro.

quests.name: Flame On
quests.description: Deep within Lore's Crust, Lava and heat flow through the planet like blood through veins. I developed a way to craw some of the heat out and convert it to clean geo-thermal energy. The Fire Elementals are the only ones who can resist the heat and open the geo-thermal check valves before the whole place blows sky high! If you can get 4 Fire Cores from the Fire Elementals and a Chaotic Fire Core From Thermax they will come to their senses!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Plant Matters
quests.description: I Developed a very fast growing weed that can be used to make renewable, clean biomagic. Unfortunately the Chaos fumes have corrupted the seeds and stone elementals tending the gardens! If you can get 4 Stone Cores from the Rock Elementals and a Chaotic Stone Core from the Stone Golem who leads them, they should be able to break free of the chaorruption.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Breaking Wind Turbines
quests.description: Energy gathered from wind turbines is one of the cleanest energy sources on Lore but General Pollution's Chaos fumes have caused several Chaos tentacles to clog up the wooden wind turbine I built. If you are able to gather 4 Wind Cores from the Wind Elementals and a Chaotic Wind Core from the Great Wind Elemental, we should be able to get the turbine going again!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Footprint
quests.description: The Hyper-slingshot is ready to go! You've GOT to get up there and STOP GENERAL POLLUTION from ruining Lore's Environment! Good Luck!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
quests.description: The contamination cleanup crew which was supposed to take care of the pollution in the area were chaorrupted. We need to continously purify them for the foreseeable future and for that, we'll need renewable help from the elements. Combine the powers of Earth, Fire, Wind, and Water, and little bit of your heroic Heart, to rectify the situation.

quests.name: Go Green like a Boss
quests.description: Although the regular elemental were decontaminated after the defeat of General Pollution, Thermak, Kuro, Stone Golem, and Ozone were too thoroughly corrupted. Hopefully by re-processing them (and by that we mean being defeated re-spawning), they will re-form cleansed. Collect Completely Chaorrupted Cores to show they have been recycled.

quests.name: Clean Up the Core
quests.description: Show Commodore Core that propaganda is NOT science, and his message is NOT welcome here.

quests.name: No More Chainsaws
quests.description: Chainsaw sneevils are cutting down the vines around the factory — we can't allow so many plants to be destroyed! Beat them up and take their chainsaws so they can't do any more damage.

quests.name: Cage Rage
quests.description: The factory workers have been trapping the local wildlife. Break open their cages and free as many animals as you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: Quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Factory Cleanup
quests.description: Whatever Totengeld is having his workers do in there — the toxic waste is already starting to build up! Find 8 of the biggest toxic waste piles and "clean them up". With your sword.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Find A Way In
quests.description: We've done all we can out here. We'll need to get inside the factory if we're going to shut this operation down. One of the Horc minions must have some kind of employee keycard. Find one and bring it to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: More Like DourDrank
quests.description: We have to get rid of Totengeld's PowerDrank before he can use it to control all of Lore! The Factory Sneevils are carrying boxes of the stuff to be shipped. Confiscate their cartons of PowerDrank before they leave the factory!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Days Without Incident: 0
quests.description: Now to shut down their production! Destroy all of the pressure valves on the pipes that run along the factory walls, and the machines will no longer work. If you also destroy the circuit boxes, it will be a long time before they're back in business.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: Quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Boot to the Head
quests.description: Totengeld's Horc Minions were expressing concern over the high levels of pollution the factory was producing… until they drank the PowerDrank! Give them a good boot to the head, and make them come back to their senses!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat CEO Totengeld
quests.description: All that's left to do now is confront the big boss and kick him out of this factory for good! Show him why you don't mess with Lore!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Plunder Me Some Booty!
quests.description: I don't know how t'fight a giant sea monster, but we can get these pirates' numbers whittled down! Bring me the booty they be carryin' so I can count how many ye've slain.

quests.name: Plunder Me Some HUGE Booty!
quests.description: Some o' these pirate be carryin' an even larger booty than usual - ye might even say it be a HUGE booty! More junk to put in Lolosia's treasure trunk means more resources to keep fightin' this here war!

quests.name: Call In An Airstrike!
quests.description: Th' Skyguard be needin' more cannonballs if they're goin' teh keep up their aerial attack! Pilfer some from the Kaiju Cannoneers, and we'll call in an airstrike!

quests.name: Call In The Mech!
quests.description: That huge hunk o'metal won't keep going for long - not without a steady supply o'fuel! Bring back some cans o'diesel from th' Ship Engineers aboard that kaiju. If ye can get… oh, let's say 5 o'them, that should be enough for a nice, strong attack.

quests.name: Keelhaul th' Cap'n
quests.description: We've fought our way back of that beast and onto the galleon what rests on its head. Th' path be clear to th' commander of this crew, Cap'n Kraylox! Defeat him, and the crew's control over the kaiju, Kathex, will be no more.

quests.name: Keelhaul Klashex
quests.description: You're our last hope! Defeat this bilge-sucking beastie before yer insides go kablooey!

quests.name: Find the Manifest
quests.description: That dragon started chasin' us after we collected this last treasure hoard, so maybe something we grabbed has gotten her attention. Best find th' cargo manifest so we can try to figure out what it was. While yer up there, scuttle as many o'those Undead Pirates as ye can. I know they won't be stayin' down for good, but they'll at least be down fer awhile.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed ' Talk to Captain Rhubarb ' quest.

quests.name: Get the Cargo Hold Key
quests.description: The Jewel of the Undying - now that sounds like somethin' an undead dragon'd be wantin' to steal! We'll be needin' t'get it out of the cargo hold. Only problem is, looks like some o' me men don't want to be sharin' the treasure with a dragon! They've mutineed, and locked us out of the hold! Teach em' 'em a lesson - and find me the cargo hold key!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Jewel
quests.description: Now, all we need t'do is go into th' cargo hold and figure out which o' these chests that Jewel of the Undying is hiding in! Look through 'em all 'til ye find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat Droghor the Screecher!
quests.description: Shiver me timbers! Slay that screechin' grave-lubber before he keelhauls us all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Gorgorath!
quests.description: Ye'll have to take this one out yerself! Those two are too busy fightin' each other te be much use!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Puff Those Fish
quests.description: We're gonna be down there under th' water awhile, so we'll need t'find a way to keep ourselves breathin'! Catch us some o' th' local pufferfish. We can use 'em like little canteens o' air!

quests.name: Question the Merdraconians
quests.description: I know we're at the right spot but…. there be no boat! Just this big coral reef. Maybe if we interrogate some o' these merdraconians they'll be able to point us in the right direction!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reveal the Ship
quests.description: Why, th ship be right under our noses - it's INSIDE that big coral reef! Get me some jellyfish stingers. We'll use 'em to zap away at the coral until we uncover that ship.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find the Way In
