quests.description: Now we've got te find a way into that sunken ship. Chip away at those barnacles until you find a place where ye can get inside.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Take Some Treasure
quests.description: Now that we've broken in, we can explore the ship and find that sunken treasure. The walls o' this ship are crusted with gold and gems. One of them's bound t'be the Heart o' the Sea! Bring me the biggest ones ye can find, and I'll take a look.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get Rid of the Grislytooth Pirates
quests.description: As ya may have noticed, this ship be filled t'the brim with merdraconian pirates! We have te make sure we get to the Heart o' the Sea before they do. Smack 'em around until they go away.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Interrogate the Pirates
quests.description: Did you hear what those scurvy curs were sayin'? Why, those pirates aren't after the treasure at ALL - they be HOARDIN' it! That means they know where it be hidden. Interrogate the First Mate, Quartermaster and Boatswain and see what you can get 'em to tell ye.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find the Hold
quests.description: Based on what those bilge rats were sayin' we haven't found what we're after because the REAL treasure is in th' ship's hold - and the entrance to the hold is hidden! It must be under some o' this barnacle growth. Go out and get some more jellyfish stingers - really BIG ones - then zap the barnacles 'til ye find it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get that Treasure!
quests.description: Well, what are ye waitin' for? Go get that treasure!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Take out Scurvyfins McKrill
quests.description: Well, it looks like Floyd's big mouth has gotten me into trouble yet again. We can't be havin' this big oaf eat me wee friend, so I guess we'll be havin' te pummel him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Grislyfang Doubloons
quests.description: These eel-face knaves be all over me ship! Fight them back, throw 'em overboard, and bring me their gold doubloons as proof!

quests.name: Stop the Wreckers, Fix the Ship
quests.description: Th' ship's gettin' torn up! Nab some supplies off o' these Grislyfang Wreckers so we can patch up all the damage. We'll need a hammer, some nails, and a few strong planks.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

items.name: Shaggy Vampire Commander's Top Hat + Locks

quests.name: Boil the Engineers
quests.description: There be a situation in the boiler room. Some o' the Grislyfang Crew's engineers have snuck inside, and that'll be gettin' explosive if ye don't put a stop to it soon! Get down there and get rid o' them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Grab the Gunpowder
quests.description: We can't be holdin' back - make them feel the full force o' our assault! Steal the gunpowder off o' the musketeers on that ship, and we'll use it to blow 'em out o' the water.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Saw THIS!
quests.description: Their ship and their troops be decimated. All that's left is te take on the captain! He can back down or he can walk the plank. Either way be find with me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Remove the Tentacles
quests.description: Those tentacles are about te drag us down! Tear them away from my ship!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ugh, Roaches
quests.description: Some kind o' disgustin' parasite is comin' off those tentacles and onto me ship - and the wee buggos are eatin' the wood. Get rid of them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gel the Jellyfish
quests.description: Well, bucko - this what I brought ye for! I know ye let that beastie make dinner out o' us!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: They Be Draconian
quests.description: It be looking like Captain Scalebeard left behind some Draconians to slow any pursuers down. I think ye can handle 'em!

quests.name: Pirate Pals
quests.description: What is a pirate without their trusty parrot?! Looks like these scaly-wags have some Wyverns as parrots! Take 'em out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Commandeer The Vessel
quests.description: It looks like the way to the only ship out of here be swarming with foes! Clear 'em out and board that boat!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: There Be Dragons
quests.description: These Dragon Pirates seem t'be stronger than those Draconians ye faced on shore. Still, they be no match for ye!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Man the Cannon
quests.description: These Gunners be no joke, Hero! Be careful when facing 'em. One stray cannonball could easily send ye to The Locker!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Boarding Party
quests.description: If we are t'save that Prime Water Dragon, we'll need t'board Scalebeard's ship! Take some of the planks they used to board our ship t'board *their* ship! Them Pirates and Gunner should have 'em!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Mates First
quests.description: Looks like Scalebeard is protecting himself with his best men! Don't worry! We'll take 'em out together!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Captain Scalebeard
quests.description: If we're t'free that Dragon, we're gonna have to face Scalebeard first!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Draconic Doubloons
quests.description: These Pirates got some interesting doubloons on 'em! How about ye take 'em off their hands and bring 'em to me. I'll see what booty I can reward ye for yer plunder!

quests.name: Dracon-you Not
quests.description: These Pirate Draconians still be in our way! Clear a path for us t'make it to the castle in one piece!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Captain Scalebeard ' quest.

quests.name: Fighting Pirates Is A Drag(on)
quests.description: The Dragon Pirates be a rougher crew fer sure! Take out this nasty lot so we can move forward!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Captain Scalebeard ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Prepping a Trap
quests.description: I don't believe we can take ‘em all if we're gonna make it in time! We need t'make booby traps if we're gonna take ‘em out! Plunder some supplies from the Pirates so we can get to booby-ing!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Captain Scalebeard ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Planting a Surprise
quests.description: With these supplies, we can really get the "drop" on our pirate friends! Plant some pitfalls to trap their overwhelmin' numbers so we can get to the King.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Captain Scalebeard ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Water Droppings
quests.description: It looks like these Water Elementals came up'n offa the Leviathanius. They be in our way so take ‘em out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Captain Scalebeard ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Titan Suckers
quests.description: It looks like them Leeches were latched t'the Leviathanius and sucked some of its power. They be tough, but they are the last line of defense Scalebeard has!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Captain Scalebeard ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: T' The Throne Room
quests.description: Not much further now! Take out the rest of the enemies in our way so we can reach King Zelgarius
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Captain Scalebeard ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get Past Scalebeard
quests.description: The only way to defeat the Water Titan is to get through Scalebeard… and he's going to be tougher now!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Captain Scalebeard ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Water Titan
quests.description: Our final battle is here! We have t'beat the Leviathanius and save the Dragonlands!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Captain Scalebeard ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Dragon King's Favor
quests.description: Those Water Elementals and Titan Leeches still be roaming the Capital. King Zelgarius has been askin' us to help ‘em clean up this mess. We'll have his favor if we succeed!

quests.name: Beach Cleanse
quests.description: Oi, a pirate don't clean up after makin' a ruckus on the beach. We leave the empty barrels of moglinberry juice where we dropped them. But Aunt Beryl said this patch o' sand here be like a paradise. Would warm a colder soul like mine if ye helped keep it that way by clearin' out the pests wit' me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ebbing Grudges ' quest.

quests.name: My Unfair Lady
quests.description: I wrote Captain Bellamy's name on the Queen's list meself. He and the crew of the Belladonna are sipping coconuts on a beach, thinkin' they be safe. We'll crash their party and collect the Belladonna Pirates before the tide scares 'em away.

quests.name: Bumbling Bellamy
quests.description: Captain Bellamy be callin' himself the "Robina the Hood" of the seas. A competent pirate lies, but bein' this obvious about stealing from the rich an' poor fer milk money be embarrassing. Throw Bellamy an' his greasy beard into the brig before I gut him meself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Verich City
quests.description: The crew of the Bourgeois, led by Captain Verich, are living it up in their private city. They almost be as rich as the crown, an' that makes other pirates green with somethin' other than scurvy! Best we get to huntin' the Bourgeois before they're netted by the competition.

quests.name: From the Top
quests.description: Captain Verich, holed up in his private pirate city, is about to suffer from success. Got a seat in the brig with his name on it. Give him a good fight. Need to respect a self-made corsair.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Technical Piracy
quests.description: This fish was hard to track. Captain Chamfer and his Pirated Tech sail in some sort of…submersible instead of a ship. The crew's as metal as J6, so yer free to hammer 'em into scrap! That'll leave more room in the brig.

quests.name: Subversive Sailor
quests.description: Captain Chamfer took control o' a Dwarfhold forge, an' made his metal crew and submersible there. He's on the Queen's list 'cause he rams his vessel into ships fer fun, including other pirate ships. It's time ye give him his due.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Plundered Souls
quests.description: Me crew be burning sage on the Red Betty's deck in preparation fer capturing the crew o' the Merry Celeste. It be a ghost ship manned by plundered souls. It sunk deep into the depths, which means it's time fer a swim.

quests.name: Salty Spirit
quests.description: Captain Haines and his ship, the Merry Celeste, drowned long ago. His spirit lost his taste for gold, and began plundering souls to add to his crew. We won't be layin' this ghost to rest. Duel Haines, and leave the rest to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nautical Narcissism
quests.description: Captain Mercurius named his ship and crew after himself. You'll understand when ye se the scurvy dog, but round up the rest of the Mercurius Pirates first. Don't go burning yer hard-earned sealegs on the sand while yer huntin'.

quests.name: Mercurious
quests.description: Captain Mercurius be a Dragon that can't be bothered to grow a hoard himself. He has his crew and co-captain do it for him. Har har har, let's see if he puts up a good fight before we muzzle him, or if he needs his Dragonsworn to pick up the slack!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Scurvy Most Wanted
quests.description: The Queen put out a mighty generous bounty on some of the worst pirates menacing the eastern coast. Throw 'em in the Red Betty's brig, and we'll drag them to Swordhaven to collect our gold!

quests.name: A Pirate's Stake
quests.description: We were sailin' against the wind, and came too late. The pirates have already taken the Queen, but a few stragglers got left behind in the hubbub. Grab those Punkstream Pirates and check if Tin Man still has their trail.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Scurvy Most Wanted ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Thalassalings
quests.description: The second Pirate Captain's scrubs are still loitering on the shore. They're…tryin' to eat the Knights scrambling after the Queen. Stop those Thalassarath Pirates before we need to cut'em open to save survivors.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Scurvy Most Wanted ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: No Tales
quests.description: That smell…coppery blood in salty water. The last Pirate Captain's crew is lingering in the red tide. Help me drag them in, and make' em sing a shanty about where the Queen is!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Scurvy Most Wanted ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Live on Punt
quests.description: We drew a lucky lot! Captain Wary, one of the pirates that attacked the Queen is…what she be doing? Who she be talkin' to? Spirits? Whatever it be, the lass be distracted! Grab 'er before she slips away like a scaleless fish!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Scurvy Most Wanted ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Growing Crew
quests.description: Captain Wary sold out her partners. We know where the other two are. Jump aboard the Red Betty. I'll sail ye to their hideout, and ye can take out the Thalassarath Pirates slinking about the sand.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Scurvy Most Wanted ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bloch-Head
quests.description: The scenery's lookin' worse than a whale beached fer four months. Shrubbery's growin' meat, which means Captain Bloch's close by. Take that walking seafood buffet down, and we'll be one step closer to rescuin' Robina.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Scurvy Most Wanted ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Right and Salty Death
quests.description: Tin Head says that with Bloch's intel, we 'ave the pirate ringleader 'dead to rights.' It's only the S.S. Phantom Pirates left. Let's make' em redder, send em to the locker, and let' em stew with their unfulfilled revenge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Scurvy Most Wanted ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slip 'n' Slide
quests.description: The S.S Phantom ship be haunting the bottom of a sinkhole. Teeter off the edge, an' you'll slam into the red waters the same way you'd splat on the rocks. We need some rope, and all that's available are…sinewy scraps.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Scurvy Most Wanted ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Red Sea Spurdog
quests.description: We 'ave the jump on the S.S. Phantom Blood's Captain. Squalus has the Queen and her Knight hostage! Arr, split 'im down the middle. I want a piece o' this groaning, moaning ghost meself!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Scurvy Most Wanted ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blood Bloom
quests.description: Blood be in the water, scallywags! The shark that originally ate Captain Squalus an' his crew's been possessed by his blood. Destroy the Phantom Jaws, and Squalus will become untethered from the plane of the living!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Scurvy Most Wanted ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cold Water for Red Stains
quests.description: Tin Man says there be stragglers swimming in the blood red sinkhole. Best we take care of the S.S. Phantom Blood's remaining crew and sharks before other scallywags smell opportunity. Har har har!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Blood Bloom ' quest.

quests.name: Cold Water for Red Stains (Legend)
quests.description: Tin Man says there be stragglers swimming in the blood red sinkhole. Best we take care of the S.S. Phantom Blood's remaining crew and sharks before other scallywags smell opportunity. Har har har!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Blood Bloom ' quest.

quests.name: Fiends in High Places
quests.description: Hero! An army of Sky Pirate Draconians have taken over the Phereless! The Skyguard cannot control this draconian onslaught by ourselves. We desperately need assistance! Take out 15 of those reptilian ruffians before things get TOO out of hand!

quests.name: A Whirled Wide Traveler
quests.description: The Phereless is powered by a steam motor found beneath Her main deck. If the Sky Pirates end up taking over the ship entirely… the amount of damage they could cause to Lore is incalculable. We must cut off power to the ship in case they succeed!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Boiler Spoiler
quests.description: Something is wrong down in the engine room. The boiler is clogged… but *something* is moving around down there. You don't think… from all the Gel-O-No… no no no no… no way… but maybe. Hurry back to the engine room and find out what's going on down there!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: This Fight Will Dragon
quests.description: The Sky Pirates have called in for reinforcements! For lack of a better name, a HUGE Sky Pirate Dragon is wreaking havoc on the Phereless. This monstrosity has given a whole new meaning to 'armed to the teeth.' It's got a weapon arsenal on its armor and…woah… a CANNON on its back?!?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Things Are Looking Up
quests.description: WE have the upper hand! Now is the time to fight with all our might! Gladius won't be too confident once the Skyguard have taken back our ship! Travel the Phereless once more and collect Medals of Dishonor from his minions that are slain by your hand. Hurry Hero—we CAN win this!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Don't Get Mad, Get Gladius
quests.description: This is it! The Sky Pirates are on the run and only one monster remains: Gladius. Not much is known about this fiend other than he (or she?) is the leader of the Sky Pirates. Not even the Skyguard can take him down. It is up to you brave hero! Arm yourself for battle!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Steamed Punks
quests.description: One of those rotten recruits has played a prank on me, and gotten all of my punks wet! I can't light fuses with wet, limp tinder! Can you gather cannonballs? The only place I know to get them right now is from the Sky Pirate Dragons still infesting my ship while I wait for my punks to dry out?

quests.name: The Mind Goggles
quests.description: Why yes, these are amazing googles. I need a back-up pair, though, in case anything should happen to them. Can you find me the material to make the glass for the lenses? We've got bags of sand lying around to mop up oil spills and I'll also need SteamOcto Tentacles to provide suction to hold the glass in, so bring me 7 of those.

quests.name: School's Out for the Invasion
quests.description: School's out for the invasion! School's out forever, because school's been blown to pieces! Out for summer, out for fall, the students might not go back at all, if we don't take down these invaders. Scout out the locations of all monsters and report back to me, Hero.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Don't Get Mad, Get Gladius ' quest.

quests.name: Chaobold Bullies
quests.description: The invader-instigator has flooded our fair halls with these chaos-tainted creatures, but this is the first I've heard of a new wave of mayhem-minded monsters stirring. Where are they coming from and… why? Interrogate 9 Chaobolds, 2 Sky Pirates, and collect 5 SkyGuard Academy history books to find out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Trip the Traps
quests.description: The enemies just keep coming! Even with the help of the new recruits, we're not able to hold them. The Academy is crossed by semi-automatic tripwires which will take the Chaobolds down. We just need to activate the sensors! There are 15 different tripewire activation spots hidden around the school, so look carefully.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Wreck the Warder
quests.description: I've seen these before. Imbunche guard the lairs of magicians-warlocks, wizards, witches, and the like. If one of these has been sent away from its post, it can only mean its Master is on the move. I don't know if a telephatic link between Master and minions exists, so to be on the safe side, render it unable to report!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Clean the Deck
quests.description: Well Hero, we need to fly but the Draconians here decided to drop by. Think you can help the crew by giving them a hand?

quests.name: Draconian Delivery
quests.description: Gladius had some reinforcements arrive. You'll need to take out the next batch of Draconians and get rid of their dragon. I know you can do it!

quests.name: Gladius and some Jelly
quests.description: Now that the underlings are defeated, there's just two main things remaining. Gladius and in the ship's boiler room, there is a rehydrated Gell Oh No. We need to take out both if we want to win this battle!

quests.name: Shocking Excitement
quests.description: Look at you! I must say, I'm rather impressed you were able to gather what you needed. Are you ready to become one of the SkyCharged Grenadiers?

quests.name: Extra Credit
quests.description: Now that the Draconian crew seems to be in shambles, we can scare off the rest. Knock a few out so the others flee in fear.

quests.name: Dealing With The Past
quests.description: Hero! Would you like a challenge? There lies a "version" of Exos where he is stronger than more powerful than before. If you can face him and defeat him, I will make sure you are rewarded handsomely!

quests.name: Bando de Penas
quests.description: Os monstros amedrontaram os pássaros da Terra da Festa e preciso que você viaje ao redor do mundo para encontrar penas decentes para serem usadas no Carnaval. Preciso de penas da Bird of Paradise em Manos, penas do Sola Phoenix em DreamNexus, penas do Mana Falcon em Elemental e penas do Tainted Emu em EtherWarGood ou EtherWarEvil. Você consegue!
quests.requirements_note: Must have used Paymentez .

quests.name: Construa um Amuleto
quests.description: Carnaval precisa de felicidade e sorte! Então vamos construír um amuleto Muiraquitã! Colete Argilas Verdes do Lagoon e Boiúna e então pegue o fogo da Mula Sem Cabeça para criar o amuleto.
quests.requirements_note: Must have used Paymentez . Note: This quest can only be done once a day.

quests.name: Wacky Winka's Candy Shop
quests.description: You have to see for yourself what's happened. Then you'll understand why we need you. Take a tour of the village and meet me by Wacky Winka's Candy Shop. I'll explain everything.

quests.name: Nougat-ta Save the Parents
quests.description: We can't have all these petrified parents wandering around town. They could hurt themselves. Can you get them somewhere safe, please? Whenever I try to make them move, they just shuffle away, staring and drooling.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chroma Kids
quests.description: Each of the adults you've rescued has something in common… their kids ALL visited Wacky Winka's Candy Shop after the Chromafactory thingamabob was installed. And now those kids are zonked-out zombies, too. We need to find out WHY!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once.

quests.name: Caramel Clues
quests.description: The adults have been clustered around the fre samples tables for DAYS while the kids just keep wandering the streets, staring at things. Until we know exactly what's happening, we've got to cut back on the candy calories for the entire town.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sweet, Sweet Proof
quests.description: We need to collect ALL the candy, so no one else accidentally eats it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once.

quests.name: Whacky Snacky
quests.description: It's time we talked to Wacky Winka himself, and see if there's anything HE can tell us. I don't want to see any more of my friends hurt.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once.

quests.name: Survival of the Deadliest
quests.description: Committing murder or claiming self defense, same things, just different afterthoughts. In the heat of battle, none of that matters, it is the enemy or your life. The Dark Makai are jaded, having long served as Nulgath's grunts. Many have fled Tercessuinotlim carrying with them the foul smell of rebellion. Make your first lesson in Makai survival a hands on experience and teach those terrors their place on the totem pole.

quests.name: What's a Knife Without Knowledge
quests.description: I can see why Nulgath has taken a liking to you, this fight puts a fire in your eyes. Before continuing to slay the Makai, it's time to learn what makes them tick. Bring back enough body fixtures to make me a frightening face mask.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Makai Backbone in your inventory.

quests.name: Search for the Scrolls
quests.description: windle travels all over Lore scamming heroes and stealing intel. A few trips back he told me all about these ancient scrolls he found on a Dark Makai. It seemed useless then, but now, this information could disrupt the whole rebellion.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Makai Funnybone in your inventory.

quests.name: Time is Money
quests.description: Simply an option quest for the lazy: If you don't wish to take the time to search monsters for the scrolls, then you may bribe Swindle for the exact location. Since he's got quite high standards, here's one of the few bribes he'll accept:

quests.name: Side By Side
quests.description: Looks like the scrolls reveal the Makai to be of moglin descent…Interesting, I wondered what could have tainted such a loveable species. As these creatures appear to be the Moglin's polar opposite, a few tests are needed to confirm their true nature. Grab me 10 Makai prisoners, and 1 Evil Moglin from BattleOff for good measure.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Scroll Key in your inventory.

quests.name: Chain Reaction
quests.description: The knowledge gained here could make or break the rebellion. Moglins most defining features are the ability of their hug's to heal, sugar induced candy crazes, and a disgustingly cute appearance. Let's see how the Dark Makai match up to these characteristics. Borrow a few chains from Dilligaf's swords in /join Underworld for some "completely humane" Makai testing. What's the worst that can happen?
quests.requirements_note: Must have Scroll Key in your inventory.

quests.name: An Inside Job
quests.description: I signed up to mentor a hero, not be slaughtered by a Makai horde. The only hope of stopping these beasts lies with Nulgath's loyal double-agent. Seek out the Dark Makai Verick deep down in the sewers for assistance.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Scroll Key in your inventory.

quests.name: Fairweather Elementals
quests.description: We stand in the Temple of Light's courtyard. The building itself is currently sealed by powerful light magic. Go down the Eastern path and see for yourself. The Impersonator left their dirty handprints all over the front doors when they arrived and blew through the Temple's initial defenses. On the way there, you'll run into the stragglers - Light Elementals. They'll think you're one of the invaders. Take them out or they'll be a nuisance.

quests.name: In Case of Emergency
quests.description: I assumed the paladins wandering the courtyard had broken through the front gate to meddle in our affairs. The members of the Nation surrounding the Temple reported that no one, save for you, has been allowed beyond the gate. Then what are they doing here? And why do they look like light bulbs with limbs? You and I will subdue these odd paladins. Perhaps that will serve to loosen the Temple's seal as well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blind Devotion
quests.description: The more elementals and paladins we defeat, the weaker the seal on the Temple's doors becomes. They are part of the spell that keeps the invaders trapped. Ha, the clerics feared the Imposter so much that they were willing to tether the lives of their own to the seal. Tch, the alliance is still active, so I can't use this as an excuse to slay them. Knocking the paladins unconscious and banishing the Elementals will have to suffice.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blessed Visage
quests.description: There was more than one seal. Beyond those arrogant fixtures depicting the Avatar of Light is the path to the Temple's inner sanctum. Currently, it's inaccessible, and the layout of the Temple is…unexpected. This looks nothing like the original Temple of Light. Jadzia, the Nation's Loremaster, has arrived under the orders of Master Nulgath. She has gone inside the temple. Go, speak with her and take a closer look at the Temple's fixtures.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Banging on Light's Door
quests.description: Though the behavior of the Light's followers will warrant surveillance, I will lead that task after the Imposter is eviscerated. The first seal crumbled after a sufficient amount of paladins and elementals were defeated. We will subdue them again, and see if the second seal will dissolve in the same manner. There seems to be no end to the Light's followers. What a nuisance.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Easy AND Breezy!
quests.description: I'm really fond of a particular weapon, you see? Some primitive reptilian has it and quite frankly, I'm a little jealous something so deadly is in its possession. I don't want the actual weapon, no. It's been tainted by them and their dirty hands. Just…blueprints. A copy. Go minion, go find it for me. What? You want a hint too? Hmm. Well they have tails, the weapon is kinda spiky, its wrapped all pretty in Masters writing. What? You want a NAME? That's not how this game will work, silly minion. Don't take too long, now!

quests.name: Disguises and a Ruse
quests.description: The squishy minion is back! You don't like being called a squishy minion? But that is what you are! Anywho, we aren't here to play THAT game. You are here to play mine! Now I will need a disguise of sorts. With a few rogue voids running around, you gotta conceal yourself somehow. There is a dark dungeon - a keep, one might say - descending into the earth, filled with creatures of all kinds. It has a few different levels, but what I seek is on the second floor. A creature's head can make for a really convincing mask, you know… Especially with those big, red beady eyes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Icky and Smelly
quests.description: Hello again, small minion! Are you back from your trip? I have more things for you to find. I'm sending you to a very large area, so by try not to get too lost! It's all wet, mucky and EW and I do not want to go there and ruin MY clothes. That's why I have you! You'll have to explore deep into it to find what I want. There lurks in this place a large, ugly, green monstrosity clad in armor and holding a chipped-looking sword. I want you to go get me some of his armor. That iron can be used for many devious things.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dress For the Occasion!
quests.description: Hello again, my little helper! You know, I been thinking, what I'm wearing looks kind of…dull, don't you think? I should look more…tacky. Yes, tacky. I should look more like YOU! Now don't get your feathers all ruffled, I meant that as a compliment! A compliment of the highest degree, I dare say! Hows about you go fetch me something fancy from a dresser. I don't care who you steal from or where you get it. No, that's a lie - I DO. I hear the resort is somewhat popular with your kind. Unfortunate about the overnight stays though. Hopefully you can survive!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Can't Play Games without A Lunch Break
quests.description: Fragile minion. you're back. Are you feeling peckish? Should we take a break? What? I'm not as heartless as those other voids you know. What an offensive assumption - you're lucky I'm NICE! Anywho, I was thinking… how about we share something to eat? Your kind needs to eat. no? Perfect! But uhh, I don't have any of those THINGS you mortals like to use for eating. so you'll need to go find me some. I hear there are some felines who have this…tool. That you humans use to eat. Do you want to go fetch one?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: She Needs a Hero
quests.description: Hero! Oooh, hero! I'm so glad you're here! You must do your JOB! Silly squishy minion, I don't ever and will never need YOUR help. Don't forget we're playing MY game and we're only playing because I'm BORED. Anywho, "hero", a princess needs rescuing. She's been holding out for a hero for awhile now. She's stuck inside a very confusing dungeon. Maybe you can find the pony inside and that can be your steed while you rescue your fair maiden?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest name is a parody of the song Holding Out for a Hero by Bonnie Tyler .

items_required.name: Your Princess is Not in this Castle

quests.name: Sun and Fun
quests.description: Hay Hero, are you "beach body ready"? I'm not calling you fat, it's just a question. Anyways, feel free to relax. Yes really. You can relax but you need to show me you actually CAN relax since you look so…Hmmm, I don't know how to describe it. Stiff? Boring? Something along those lines. You'll need to find some beach gear. I hear there's a nice beach you can find something to play with on your temporary vacation. A really round and colorful thing. I know - COLORS. Disgusting. But you clearly don't care about "disgusting", considering what you are…eh….wearing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Heebie Jeebies
quests.description: Look. I have a favor to ask you. I don't like bugs. I hate them. Absolutely most vile things to have ever existed. I want you to go take care of a very big creepy crawly. Just thinking about it gives me the shivers. Go squish it. yeah? I would do it myself. but you know, I hate to get my boots dirty just for a BUG. You'll find it a very damp and wet place. The area is covered in webs. You'll know it when you see it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A New Pet
quests.description: Minion, I cannot lie, for my poor soul is lonely and I need a companion. No, you stop that I don't want a living person, why do you have such twisted ideas? No, I want a dog. Not just any kind of dog though. I want a big white fluffy doggo. It is rather cold where he can be found, so do bundle up, its awfully cold outside.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spoiled Dragon
quests.description: So, little minion. There's this dragon. I'm not sum of your ever heard of the mysterious fourth wall, but someone at the Underground Lab LOVES this dragon. It gets spoiled, honestly. Everytime there's some sort of limited time item drop event, this thing gets it, and I have to wonder who is spoiling this dragon so much. Go get me a weapon, anything that tickles your fancy from it. Voids need love and attention, too, mysterious worker.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Unpredictable Element
quests.description: You see, minion, the chaos element intrigues me. There's so much to it that no one understands, but it holds a devastating secret. There is, or well, WAS, a staff. A very powerful sorcerer held it. A being of pure mana energy that had gained consciousness. It was there, minion. It could feel, have its own thoughts and goals but most importantly, IT WAS THERE. I want this kind of energy to play with, myself. Go get me some. I want to study it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spoiled Dragon ' quest.

quests.name: There, But Not There
quests.description: Minion, have you ever heard of monsters that are there but also NOT there at the same time? In existence but at the same time, nothing is there. I want to study this strange phenomenon and I hear there is a…creature? That does exist, but also does not at the same time. I want some of their residue. Do they even leave anything behind, for that matter? I guess we will find out. Report back to me when you have some findings. I hear there is a strange ship built that houses some of these…things. You just need to figure out how to make them appear for you. Good luck.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slaying Humble
quests.description: You know, for a hero, you aren't really that great Don't give me that sour look. You think everything comes easy? Think again, minion. There are beasts and monsters all over that you couldn't POSSIBLY defeat alone. Wanna prove to me you're a big strong hero? Deep underground where the dragons that have received Master's blessing lurk, a very old and very strong enemy lies wailing. I hope you have a plan to defeat him, 'hero' because I need a few pieces of his armor.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stylish and Trendy
quests.description: Alright Minion, for Master's birthday you need to look your absolute best. We need measurements. Hmm, maybe some dyes too. We need greens, some reds, you're also much…larger…than I thought, so we need stretchy material. You can find some dyes from off Swamp Lurkers and the other materials we need are from Swamp Frogdrake skins for their flexibility.

items.name: Red 'Are you sure this is Dye' Dye

quests.name: Sparkle, Sparkle
quests.description: Alright Minion, now I need some scraps of already made clothes. Don't look at me like that, it's not like im asking you to go beat up random civilians for their clothes. Monsters (like vampires) usually have clothing that have magical properties. Do you see how well they dress too? Like come on, they can learn to share. Here's a list of vampires. Go steal some of their clothes. Just make sure they are hidden after you knock them out so they aren't noticeable. Vampires sparkle in the sun and stealing their clothes, some poor sap will go blind if they don't have them on…

quests.name: Limited Quantity
quests.description: Alright little minion, you’ve been such a good little paprika in helping me make these pieces of clothing but… We need to get the word out. Very greedy. Y’all like to show off things you can’t get anymore. It’s like you’re asking to be mugged. People just LOVE the beach, y'know? They like to party no matter WHAT kind of creature is skulking around. Head over to /beachparty and stick a bunch of posters up on the Palm Treeants that are in the map. And by "stick a bunch of posters up" I mean "beat them up", of course. Just like Master would do!

quests.name: My Monster Can Beat Up Your Monster
quests.description: MINION! Can you BELIEVE there's this dragon who FORCES people to /lust after HER? Talk about ew and gross, what's her deal anyways?!. She doesn't deserve her followers at all! Let's make them change teams, yeah? I bet it'll be pretty easy. She's old. Scaly. Uuugggllyyy. Meanwhile on the other hand…Have you S E E N Master archfiend? Oooh, just thinking of him gives me the shivers. We must show those poor people the freedom of choice! Go show them the way the best way you can!

quests.name: Vase Case
quests.description: I handmade everything in my shop, my friend. It takes a great amount of skill and creativity to make my high-quality wares, ahhh yes? My specialty lies in elegant vases… but I'm all out of ceramic. Search around the Oasis Village and bring me back 9 Ceramic Vase Fragments. I also need 3 Vase Contents the Cactus Creepers stole.

quests.name: Oasis Ornaments
quests.description: The orders keep on coming in — business is booming my friend! But I am — ehhh — I am a little shorthanded…OH! Want to help me out again? I could really some Pieces of Oasis Jewelry and more Sandsea Cotton so I can keep my customers happy, yes? Yes! I am sure that the thieving desert creatures have what my friend is looking for.

quests.name: Enter the Castle of Bone
quests.description: Vaden says, "It all started the day the Hero was spotted outside my Castle of Bone… slaying my guards to find the Key to the door!"

quests.name: Slay Vaden's Undead Guards
quests.description: Vaden says, "Naturally, like any Death Knight worth his salt, I had guards positioned in the lobby in case of a situation like this. …Unfortunately, the Hero quickly slayed them, too."

quests.name: Destroyer in the Foyer
quests.description: Vaden says, "As the Hero continued hacking through everything in my foyer, I started to get agitated. Never before had my defenses been so thoroughly breached!"

quests.name: Help! I'm a Fallen Lord and I Can't Get Up!
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Hero entered Hall of Fallen Deathknights - this was sure to spell certain doom for our "favorite" adventurer! Again and again, the Hero defeated the former lords of the castle - only to come them come back to unlife and attack again!"

quests.name: Gem-nastics
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Hero was doomed- the Fallen Deathknights would never allow the living to pass! Well… not unless you knew how to appease them. You'd have to fight them and steal the glowing Necrogems that give them their power. Then you'd have to insert a gem into each of their crowns, embedded in the walls. But how could anyone ever figure that out?"

quests.name: Bone Appetit
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Hall of Fallen Deathknights lets out directly to my dining room. So what does this undead-slaying Hero do, but come busting in and KILL ALL OF MY WAITERS!"

quests.name: The Walking Bread
quests.description: Vaden says, "OK, so maybe my food WAS a little scary, if you're human. Giant chrysalises, wailing gourds, cackling undead bread. But did the Hero really have to steal a fork and burn it all?" (See if the Undead Knights know where it is!)

quests.name: Ghoul-ash
quests.description: Vaden says, "…and just to make sure everything was thoroughly destroyed, the Hero kept killing my ghoulish dinner guests until nothing but ash was left."
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Butcher
quests.description: Vaden says, "With the dining room in shambles, the Hero headed into the kitchen to confront… The Butcher."

quests.name: Lean Mean Undead Slaying Machine
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Hero entered the long double hall past the dining room, slaughtering everything in sight. I made a mental note - I would need to prepare for my battle with this impressive adversary!."

quests.name: Moar Loot
quests.description: Vaden says, "Ah, the Trophy Room — filled with souvenirs from my most powerful foes! The Hero didn't seem to care about my taxidemy collection, but anything gold? HAD to be pilfered."

quests.name: Putting Your Hands All over Everything
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Gallery's walls are lined with enchanted paintings. The appear as blank canvases, but when you touch them, images of the Castle's lord — that would be me — are revealed. Of course the Hero had to manhandle each one."

quests.name: Paladin Rock
quests.description: Vaden says, "Next, the Hero went into the Ballroom… stole a bunch of song request tickets from the Grateful Undead, found a pencil in the gallery… mugged Those 70s Zombies for their dance shoes… and requested a bunch of Paladin Rock from the DJ. I've never seen an undead Disco clear out so fast!."

quests.name: Do You Find This Humerus?
quests.description: Vaden says, "In the next hall, the Hero started destroying all of my undead minions and collecting all of their upper arm bones for… for… you know, i really have no idea. Who can understand why heroes do the things they do?"

quests.name: Vaden Says
quests.description: Vaden says, "Of course, my personal chambers are kept securely locked. No one could get in there unless they knew my special Simon code! Unfortunately, the Knights, Guards, and Warriors each kept a piece of it in their pockets…"

quests.name: The Dead King's Bedroom
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Hero, who had beaten every knight and guard in the castle, was now in my bedroom. And so was I! I was not ready for this confrontation! As i ran into the bathroom to hide, I realized i had accidentally left my helm on the bed. Of course, the Hero could not resist the temptation to grab it."

quests.name: Game of Porcelain Thrones
quests.description: Vaden says, "Unfortunately, my escape through the porcelain tunnel was not a clean one. The Hero took one look at the wet, brown splashes on the floor, and knew exactly where i'd gone."

quests.name: Teenage Mutant Sewer Turtles
quests.description: Vaden says, "The sewer beneath the castle was crawling with giant turtles, the descendants of pets flushed long ago. They ignored me and let me pass - they've gotten used to me using my secret escape route. But for the Hero, only way to get out was to battle them all."

quests.name: Adolescent Inhuman Samurai Reptiles
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Hero quickly realized these were not just any sewer turtles. They were Adolescent Inhuman Samurai Reptiles! Legendary warriors whose respect could only be earned by defeating them. One by one, the hero battled them, claiming their weapons as proof of defeat."

quests.name: Snuggles!
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Hero was free, but Snuggles the Torturer was not far behind! He'd have to be taken out if the Hero was to escape the torture chamber."

quests.name: Game of Bones
quests.description: Vaden says, "Being the book maggot that I am, I spent years collecting the perfect armors for my Library guards to wear — armors based on my favorite series, Game of Bones! My pride and jot. But to the Hero, they were just more loot to farm for. "

quests.name: Rot Tin Tin!
quests.description: Vaden says, "And then… *sniff*… no, i'm ok, I just need a moment… and then, the Hero SLAUGHTERED my beloved dracolich, Rot tin Tin!"

quests.name: Gold Digger
quests.description: Vaden says, "There's nothing an adventurer can resist more than gold. The Hero found my treasury, and wouldn't stop beating on my Golden Deathknight guards until all of my treasure had been snatched up!"

quests.name: Gotta Hand It To Ya
quests.description: Vaden says, "The hero pursued me through my Armory — you know, the room where i keep all my spare arms, It was my last line of defense. But one by one, my knights and warriors fell to the Hero's Blade."

quests.name: Vaden's Defeat
quests.description: Vaden says, "It was in my throne room that the Hero finally caught up to me. I knew I could not lose — there was too much at stake. I readied myself for our final fight."

quests.name: Where's Tiffany?
quests.description: Wow, this is surprisingly… empty. Where's Tiffany's mirror fantasy? For that matter… where is Tiffany? Better search the area and see if you can find her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Tower of Mirrors' Quests .

quests.name: Trapped!
quests.description: Ok, ok, you're trapped in the mirror… how are you gonna get out of here? ell, the obvious thing is to smash that mirror you came in through. If nothing else, it can't possibly make the situation any worse. You'll need to find a mallet in order to smash the mirror! (Quest available only once per login)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Tower of Mirrors' Quests . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: If At First You Don't Succeed...
quests.description: So, smashing the mirror attracts monsters to your location to keep you from getting out. If you keep doing this, maybe it'll eventually get the attention of one of those mirror knights. Smash the knight, and you get out of the mirror. Right? Right! Try it again! (Quest available only once per login)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Tower of Mirrors' Quests . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Try, Try Again
quests.description: Ok, either this is hopeless, or… it's hopeful! A hero never gives up! Smash that thing again! (Quest available once per login)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Tower of Mirrors' Quests . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Escape!
quests.description: Alright! Time to get your butt out of here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Tower of Mirrors' Quests . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Cat Ears?
quests.description: Uh-oh. It looks like Stellaria has left her… cat ears behind? You'd better try to catch up with her. This might be important!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Him Down ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Demolish De'Sawed FOR REAL
quests.description: De'Sawed is deceptive. I can admire that… when people aren't trying to use my mind to build a nightmare. Get him but good, Hero!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Kimberly's Quests .

quests.name: Blow Up Lore?!?!?
quests.description: No nitroglycerin sponge? No problem. There are plenty of other explosives you could use, but they might be hard to come across. You can blow up the Nexus, Arcangrove, or the Etherstorm Wastes, but only one area at a time!

quests.name: Kill 2016!
quests.description: Time to kick this year right in the… glitch! Bet you never thought you'd be saying THAT.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Portal Revealed ' quest.

quests.name: In Memoriam
quests.description: There are still so many angry spirits roaming my mausoleum, fueled by my grief. Please, would you help them calm down. like you did for me?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Keep Calm and Remember ' quest.

quests.name: Memento Mori
quests.description: The spirits are still causing so much mayhem - they‘re even stealing the mementos from the altars! Get the candles back from the Malevolent Wraiths and get the sugar skulls back from the Zombies!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Keep Calm and Remember ' quest.

quests.name: Ug
quests.description: Ug. (The strange cave man was pointing at a bone, I think he wants more bones.)

quests.name: Uga
quests.description: Uga. (The strange cave man was pointing at some raw meat, maybe he need some more food for his pet dino.)

quests.name: Ug Ug
quests.description: Ug Ug. (The strange cave man was pointing at the metal scraps on that dino, maybe he needs more of these strange mechanical parts. Certainly the Dinos will not mind if I borrow some.)

quests.name: Uga Ug
quests.description: Uga Ug. (The strange cave man was pointing at fragments of a bottle, perhaps I should get him some water. These beasts may have stolen his water bottles! Go recover a water bottle for him!)

quests.name: Hwoounga? Unf!
quests.description: Cave Man grunts at you and gestures frantically at some monkeys nearby. He seems to want you to retrieve something from them. Maybe they stole his banana?

quests.name: They're Firin' Their LAZORS
quests.description: Excellent! Now that you have the Flux Communicator, you can understand me! I daresay that young maiden has strapped giant LAZORS to those dinosaurs! I would gladly handle this myself, but I seem to have misplaced my time traveling equipment. Can I count on your help?

quests.name: Through the Jurassic Portal!
quests.description: You want to FOLLOW her? Oh, surely not! How dangerous she must be! Well, alright, if you insist. She went through that portal to the east.

quests.name: Punk Shadowfall
quests.description: OK, ok, so… *giggle* here's what I'm gonna have you do. You're going to go to /shadowfall, and beat up the Angry Zombies that are hanging out in the halls. Get a few big handfuls of zombie goo. You with me so far? Ok, and THEN… you're going to head to the throne room and slime Gravelyn with it. Ha!

quests.name: Punk Swordhaven
quests.description: You know what would really create some chaos? Sliming the ruler of Swordhaven! Go to Swordhaven /Castle and get a few big handfuls of ectoplasm from the Castle Wraiths. Then - sploosh! Right in the face with it! Bah hah hah!

quests.name: Tunnel this!
quests.description: The Chaos Tunneler! Somewhere in Crownsreach, there is a giant, chaorrupted, burrowing worm. No. I will not tell you where! If you can find it, and defeat it. I'll be impressed. Maybe even impressed enough to put in a good word with you to Drakath.

Ceremonial Void Blade of Nulgath's Quest.name: Ceremonial Void Blade of Nulgath's Quest

quests.name: Void Knight Sword Quest
quests.description: If you would reap the rewards of the Void Knight, prove your battle prowess. Spill the blood of Slugﬁt, the Aracara, Dark Makais, and Fire Imps. And do not forget to bring me the Aquamarine of Nulgath. The Crystallized Jellyfish in BattleunderC has one.

quests.name: Fire, Fear, and Pet Food
quests.description: Oh! GOOD, someone here to help me keep these animals under control! Normally, they're the sweetest things, but since the attacks and monsters started arriving, they've been madness itself. I can't leave to gather food for them or they'll riot. Please bring me 1 Fyresyn Wing, 3 Coal Creeper Legs, and 2 bags of Fire-Roasted Peanuts from the Storm Sentries.

quests.name: Ziri's Contract
quests.description: Ziri the Daimon is pretty powerful. I wonder what secrets he holds! I mean, he would be a great asset to my company! Mind helping me out? The Interview list is posted on the door to the board room.

quests.name: Alina's Contract
quests.description: Alina knows how to make some of the most powerful potions in the world! She will be a valuable resourc— influencer! Get her contract signed!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Victoria's Contract
quests.description: The kinda Queen of Swordhaven?! What a great influencer for my company! Get me that signed contract!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Nulgath's ...Contract?
quests.description: Nulgath?! As in the leader of the Nation?! Perfect! He's used to getting contracts signed but this will be a nice change of pace for him! Get his contract signed!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Dage's Contract
quests.description: Dage is here, too? His Legion's secrets will be a great addition! I mean, his Legion will be great followers!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Swaggy's Contract
quests.description: It's said Swaggy has knowledge of Grimskull's dungeons and all the treasures he has locked in them! It would be great for him to reveal, umm, "tell" us where they all are after we get his contract signed!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Cysero's Contract
quests.description: The Mad Magical Weaponsmith has connections all around Lore! And his weapons are powerful too! He'll make a great addition to my company!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Gravelyn's Contract
quests.description: Looks like the last influencer we have left is the Empress of the Shadowscythe herself! She would be the perfect addition to my team of informants— err, influencers!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Server Room Access
quests.description: My Goons will make sure you never escape here! Even if you do, you'll never stop me from keeping all of their secrets and their contracts binding them to me… and you'll never get the key from my Security! You'd need to get to the server to do that! Umm, actually, forget I said anything about the Server Room!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The M.C.P
quests.description: If you want to destroy those contracts, you'll have to destroy the M.C.P first! The Master Chairman Platinum, of course! (I may be evil but I'm not evil enough to steal the exact acronym from an 80s movie!)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Problem Exists Between Chairman and Keyboard
quests.description: Yes, yes, you've had your fun already. Run along now, "Hero", I've got some file backup recovery programs I need to run so I can get back those contr — I don't like that look on your face.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The M.C.P ' quest.

quests.name: Turning Traitor
quests.description: Those investors managed to turn some of my own Goons against me! Show them what happens when they betray Chairman Platinum!

quests.name: Bait and Switch
quests.description: These Fishmen would be much easier to take out in large groups. Try placing baited lures to get them all in one place.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fishman Flop
quests.description: These fishman are stinking up my EbilCorp tech. Get rid of them before they ruin my brand!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chief Fish Marketing Officer
quests.description: Kuro is a big fish in a little pond. Remind him how little he is in my ocean of a world!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slime Time
quests.description: Those slimes are tracking all kinds of fluids throughout my halls! Get rid of them this instant!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Keycard Access
quests.description: Sprat's office is locked! How annoying! But knowing him, he was probably stupid enough to give one of those Goons a key. Not much brain left in that skull head of his. Find it so we can get in there!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lay Offs
quests.description: There are too many enemies in our way to get to Sprat's office! Clear them out! We have a bone to pick with their boss!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Human Remains Officer
quests.description: "Big Jack" thinks he's a hotshot with my tech! Go prove him wrong!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Traitor Traps
quests.description: Those Traitors are really getting on my nerves. They are wasting too much time to fight! Let's just trap them instead. Go place some sandwiches in the halls. For whatever reason, those Goons love sandwiches.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Drones and Drones
quests.description: Well, now there's an army of Goons outside my door thanks to your brilliant sandwich idea! And those Battle Drones to deal with! Just take care of them already!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tech Collection
quests.description: I could really use some of that tech back. Scrap some of those Drones for me, will you? And be gentle with them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: General General
quests.description: Why does his title have so many "Generals" in it? It's getting repetitive! Try hitting him repetitively for me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Variety Is The Spice Of Life
quests.description: With all of the other bosses gone, I need you to clear out their remaining forces for me! Make sure you don't leave any behind!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Draconian Destruction
quests.description: Vasalkar brought a bunch of her tough Draconian buddies with her as extra muscle. Show her that was a mistake on her part!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Final Notice
quests.description: I'm done with all these trespassers in my building. Give them their final warning and escort them out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chief Immolation Officer
quests.description: Vasalkar, the Red Dragon, has greatly overstayed her welcome! I don't care if she was my top investor! No one overthrows Chairman Platinum!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Chairman's Gift
quests.description: You're still here? I thought you left a minute ago. I hope you weren't listening to my rambling. Regardless, I have some special EbilCorp tech for you for helping… I mean "working" with me. But you have to work for it of course.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chief Immolation Officer ' quest.

quests.name: Very Ebil Mech Dragon
quests.description: Before you ask, no, EbilCorp doesn't have any life insurance or accidental dismemberment coverage.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chief Immolation Officer ' quest.

quests.name: Need Blood
quests.description: I can make you something special, but I need something special from you first. Go deep into the underworld. Find the Blood Fiends. Being me their Fiend Blood. I crystallize it for you, and we use it to forge most powerful armor.

quests.name: Need Flame
quests.description: Frozen Pyromancer difficult to kill for good. But if you steal a little piece of his flame, over time, he become weaker and weaker. Fight him. Steal his flame. Bring it to me. I make you something nice with it.

quests.name: Need Soul
quests.description: You want nice loot from Dage? You know the drill: he needs a nice, shiny soul. In this case, what he needs is a shard of the Frozen Pyromancer's soul. Take a piece of his soul, if you can, and bring it back to me.

quests.name: Ascended Drakath Gear
quests.description: Bring me the holy wasabi from the Dread Stranglerfish in the Tower of Doom!

quests.name: Chaos Champion's Pet Quest
quests.description: The power of Chaos makes it MUCH easier to control a dragon… But power must be maintained. Harvest Chaos Energy from the Choarrupted Wolves in /forestchaos.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Chaos Champion's Dragon Pet in inventory.

quests.name: Defeat the 13th Lord of Chaos
quests.description: The 12 Lords of Chaos have been defeated, but now you must defeat the 13th Lord of Chaos. Do you have the strength to battle yourself?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the 12 Lords of Chaos! ' quest.

quests.name: TLaPD 2020 Collection Badge
quests.description: Battle the Fishwings in /pirates until a Chaorrupted Fish Eye Drops to unlock your Talk Like a Pirate Day 2020 Collection character page badge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Chaos Pirate Badge Pet in your inventory.

items.name: Chaos Alliance Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Defeat the 12 Lords of Chaos!
quests.description: You have defeated their beasts, but can you now run the gauntlet of the 12 Lords of Chaos? Defeat all of the Chaos Lords to complete this quest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Drakath! ' quest.

quests.name: Chaos Eye is Watching
quests.description: Chaos is ALWAYS watching… but it cannot be everywhere at once! Travel to the Forest of Chaos and the Chaos Marsh to find 13 new Chaorrupted Chaos Bears and Chaos Spiders.

quests.name: Defeat the ChaosWeaver Cleric
quests.description: It looks like our only option may be to attempt a truce with the Weaver Queen - but her Cleric won't let us past. Defeat him, hero, so we may seek an audience with her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chaos Weaver Castes ' quest.

quests.name: Tap that Cactus
quests.description: Like most wonders in this era, objects are powered by either magic or science. My piano right here is steam powered and requires water to operate. Unfortunately… we're kinda in the middle of a desert. So water is no the easiest thing to come by. Some of the Cacti in the area should have plenty. Take this Tap and check every Cacti in the area for Water. Also see if you can find an Old Water Filter in the Trash Can out back.

quests.name: Heart of the Sarge
quests.description: OH NOOOO. My YugiWOAH card collection was just stolen by a giant mushroom! Get my cards back for me and I'll give you some duplicates from the boxes I've opened!

quests.name: Sullen Souls Survival
quests.description: If you value your life, don't let the Sssullen Sssouls drag you into the River! Defeat sssix Sssullen Sssouls and quickly return to my boat. Or join them. Your call.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chamber of Sleep ' quest.

quests.name: Wrathful Souls Rage
quests.description: Thossse who are alwaysss angry become Wrathful Sssouls in the Underworld, doomed to fight one another for an eternity. If you do not wish to meet the sssame fate, defeat 5 Wrathful Sssouls and return to my boat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hydra Hospitality
quests.description: The Ssstyx Hydra is a hossspitable beassst. He never letsss anyone passss by without offering hisss formal greeting firssst. Ssslay the Ssstyx Hydra ssso that we may passs to the Ssstyx Riverbanksss.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dage's Guard Dog
quests.description: Dage's great guard dog goesss by the name Cerberusss. Thisss 3-headed hound will NOT let any mortal passss by unssscathed. Defeat Cerberusss, bring me hisss 3 headsss, and then you will be able to passss by the locked Palace gatesss.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blade to Rest
quests.description: Put 5 of the Fotia Spirits and 3 of the Underrealm Souls to rest… or they will haunt you forever!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Dage's Guard Dog' quest.

quests.name: Soul'd Out
quests.description: Free 5 of the Femme Cult Worshippers from the cult's chains… and lay Grief to rest. Her wailing is getting on my nerves.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Dage's Guard Dog' quest.

quests.name: Deathly Joys? BAH.
quests.description: Thossssse incarnationssss of human emotion get on my lassssst nerve. The sssspiritsssss of the Underworld ssssshould heed TRUE power. Slay them all… again and again and again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Dage's Guard Dog' quest.

quests.name: Follow the Pattern.. He Ne Ar Kr
quests.description: Unfortunately, the PTMs aren't QUITE ready yet. They weren't registering toxin levels correctly in my last test. If you can get me some more supplies while I work on it, I'll be able to get it fixed much faster. I'll need some Purified Xenon - the Dwakels at the /crashsite use it in their own technology, so you should be able to get it from them. While you're there, see if you can find me a miniature pressure chamber, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get a Monitor ' quest.

quests.name: The PTM is Ready!
quests.description: Ok, let's do a test run of this thing. Go ahead and grab a PTM from the box next to me. Then head east of here and get rid of some of the noxious clouds and toxic fumes that are starting to gather. I'll make sure the meter is working properly, based on the amount of exposure you've had, when you come back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: Save the Creatures
quests.description: Alright! Now that your PTM is fully functional, let's get you out there! There are a lot of forest creatures who have been sickened by Extriki's toxin. Try to save as many as you can. The flying ones… try to knock out, but not kill. And remember - keep an eye on your PTM! When it turns black, go back! In the meantime, I'll keep in contact with you through the PTM's com channel.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clear the Treeants
quests.description: If you head out a bit farther, you'll see some Toxic Treeants and fallen trees that are preventing us from going any further. Burn them down, destroy them any way you can. Clear a path for yourself, and the rest of the troops.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Save the Creatures ' quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: Excise the Infection
quests.description: Based on what Brentan's troops are telling me, there is a lot of infected wildlife out there that's too far gone to save. Put them out of their misery, and collect tissue samples from them. We may be able to use them to create an inoculation.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Root out the Plague
quests.description: The toxin is still spreading! Do what you can to keep it at bay. Burn as much of the blackened foliage as you can find - that should destroy any toxin that's still inside it. And take down some more of the Plague Spreaders, too. They can't continue spreading plague if they're not breathing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: I Said Yes, Yes, Yes
quests.description: Uh-oh! Looks like you've hit your limit on toxin exposure! Better come on back and let Warlic and Twilly take care of you! Talk to Twilly when you get here to detox.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: Rally the Mages
quests.description: I have a plan that, in theory, should let us get close enough to Extriki to fight and, hopefully, slay it. But I'll need a lot of magic power to pull it off. Head back to our camp near /therift, and rally all the mages you can find, then check the chests in camp to see if you can find any Mana Bombs for added power. Bring them back here to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Said Yes, Yes, Yes ' quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: Wisteria Hysteria
quests.description: If it wasn't already clear how close we are to Guru Forest, it surely is now. Extriki's toxin has reached as far as Wisteria, and it has made its way over here. The toxin actually seems to have made it stronger, and it's been doing a lot of damage to the remaining foliage and wildlife. Just… take care of it, please? And bring some friends with you. I expect it will be harder to defeat than it has been in the past.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Confront Extriki
quests.description: Alright… this is it. It's time to stop this monster from destroying Lore, once and for all. Move out to confront Extriki whenever you're ready. We've got your back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: Remove the Bile
quests.description: Ugh. Well, you guys sure didn't improve the situation any when you attacked Extriki. The area is completely covered in his toxic bile. Get rid of as much of it as you can - both the bile itself, and the noxious clouds coming off of it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Confront Extriki ' quest.

quests.name: Get the Plague (Crystal)
quests.description: You see how the Plague Spreaders have those green crystals growing on their backs? I'd like to study them. They might give us some insight into how we can stop these creatures - and this toxin - for good.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Confront Extriki ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Grab the Growth
quests.description: I'd also like to have Lim run some tests on the wildlife out here. Specifically, on the growths that are appearing on the animals after exposure to the Rift toxin. Not all of the animals have them, but they seem to be fairly common in the Infected Hares.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Confront Extriki ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Destroy the Zognax
quests.description: A larger and more… unique-looking monster has appeared from the Rift in the wake of Extriki's destruction. If we capture it, we may be able to get information out of it that will help us defeat Extriki. If you can defeat it, it may prove to be the key to winning this fight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sand Sounds better than Litter... ' quest.

quests.name: Eye Sp-eye
quests.description: See those Spyballs? They're watching us! They're recording everything we do, and playing it back for the Deathknight lords of the Castle of Bone. Needless to say, we cannot allow this. Battle the Spyballs and remove their cameras. Being on TV is fantastic, but Tower Network? No thank you. The ratings are terrible.

quests.name: Stone Cold
quests.description: Looks like this second toom is guarded by stone statues. Clever — stone is hard to destroy. But if you can manage to break the statues' stone hearts, then they won't get back up again! This isn't easy to do, so it may take a few tries before you've properly damaged them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slay 'Em All
quests.description: Alright, well, I wouldn't want to put too much pressure on you, but this room seems more your speed. All you have to do is take out the knights and guards that are blocking your way. Just…. slay a few undead. You can handle that, right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slay 'Em All Again
quests.description: Ok Hero. Same as last time. Just slay the Fallen Deathknights and Undead Warriors that are guarding this room. It isn't that hard, so I trust you'll be able to take care of this. Please don't prove me wrong.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Farming For Loot
quests.description: I did promise you loot, Hero, and now it's time to fulfill that promise. Collect the following: A Sp-eye Camera from the Spyballs, and Axe from the Fallen Deathknights, a shield from the Undead Warriors, a helm from the Undead Knights, and a skull from the Undead Guards. What? Don't look at me like that. It's all worth quite a lot. You'll thank me later.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Or... Not.
quests.description: Oh! Sorry if I tricked you. You don't actually get to keep all that stuff. You're going to place the items you just collected on the trophy plaques in the next room. That will open up the passage into the next part of the tower. (You may need to leave the room and come back before you can do this quest!)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mirror, Mirror
quests.description: Alright, alright, very straightforward. See these mirrors? I just need you to smash them.. No, I'm not telling you why. (You may need to leave the room ad come back before you can do this quest!)

quests.name: Bloody Scary
quests.description: Yes, you are correct. Smashing the mirrors summoned this terrifying ghost. Why didn't I tell you? Well, a good Hero has to be prepared for anything! So, show me that you're prepared!

quests.name: Just Nasty
quests.description: Ugh. I'd forgotten about these little bungtwaddlers. i used to find them in my kitchen crawling all over the meat. seeping their digestive acid all over it. Awful. Look, bone creepers are just nasty, so kill them please.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Scavenger Hunt
quests.description: The ghouls in here like to scavenge and hoard anything they can find - I'm pretty sure this is where all my personal belongings ended up after I became stuck in this castle. If you can get the keys from the ghouls, we can use them to open the chests in here and take a look.
