quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ghoul Booty
quests.description: Now I'll just need you to unlock all the treasure chests and see if any of my things are in there. I'd do it myself, but, y'know. Dead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed once .

quests.name: Flester's Guards
quests.description: We're almost there, Hero! The last task before the final fight. All you need to do is take out these Golden Knights that are guarding Flester the Silver's… well, it's not his throne room, since he's no longer a Lord. Guarding his… oh, it doesn't matter! Just slaughter them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Flester the Silver
quests.description: This is it, Hero. The moment you've been preparing for. Have you just been riding on my coattails… or can you handle this fight?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: They Know We're Coming
quests.description: No Spyballs in this tower -- I guess they got word we were coming and sent these Souldiers down in anticipation! This is an easy one, Hero -- just fight these guys and get them out of our way.

quests.name: Elitist Jerks
quests.description: Ugh, these Undead Golden Knights are such swanky jerks. They think being made of solid gold means they can scream at my staff over every minor infraction. Don't they know that's MY job? Confiscate their Undead Gold Cards -- let's see how entitled they are without that high credit limit!

quests.name: Loot, Hero!
quests.description: There's loot for you in here, Hero! No, really -- you get to keep it this time! If you smash the pots you'll be able to collect a ton of Rupees -- I mean gems -- from them! Also, if you fight the Skullspiders, you might find a piece of heart.

quests.name: Those Aren't Big Birds, Sweetheart
quests.description: This hall is full of bats! Better clear it out. They are probably vampires, so make sure you stake them after they go down. Staking a vampire can be hard, so you might have to try a few times before you succeed.

quests.name: The Nope Room
quests.description: The sign says NOPE, but do people listen? Of course they don't. A lot of the weaker undead in the castle -- ghouls and such -- used to go in there and get trapped in… in… *shudder*. You're strong, though. Go in there, won't you, and see if there's anyone you can set free.

quests.name: Arach-NO-phobia
quests.description: Oh no! When you unraveled those webs, you got the Bone Widow's attention! Quick, squish her!

quests.name: Library Infestation
quests.description: Oh no -- this library is where all my cookbooks ended up when I was brought here -- and it's infested with Book Maggots! They must have eaten my cookbooks! Squash them all and see how many pages you can recover. We may be able to salvage at least some of them.

quests.name: Creepy!
quests.description: More Bone Creepers! And look, this pile of bones must be all that's left of some of the people they've devoured. Those poor soul will be stuck here for as long as their bones remain! Collect vials of the creepers' acid, and use it to dissolve some of these skulls so that their ghosts can be set free. (You will need to leave the room and come back before using the acid on the skulls!)

quests.name: It's Not Like They Need Them Anymore
quests.description: More loot for you in this room, Hero! See? I'd never lead you astray! Steal the golden crowns from these statues, and consider your salary for this mission paid.

quests.name: Advanced Self Defense
quests.description: Oops… looks like your pilfering has made the Undead Knights and Guards in here angry with you. Show them you're not one to be messed with!

quests.name: Take A Mallet To 'Em
quests.description: Looks like Yurrod the Gold has his chamber protected by guardian statues. You'll have to destroy them so we can get in.

quests.name: Yurrod the Gold
quests.description: And now for the main course…. Yurrod the Gold! Go get him, Hero!

quests.name: Get my Stuff
quests.description: These undead rockgobblers keep stealing my stuff! They know that I can't stop them, since I don't have a body, and they are completely taking advantage! I don't know who took what, but I saw a Fallen Deathknight, an Undead Warrior, an Undead Knight, an Undead Guard and a Ghoul all rummaging through my things.

quests.name: In the Mix
quests.description: You may be wondering why I had you break those mirrors and summon that ghost earlier. It would have been so easy to just avoid her altogether. Well, I'll tell you: Bloody Scary Mix. She drops it, I need it. Well, not ME, but the people who have been running my restaurants in my absence. Get some for me, I'll have them come by and pick it up.

quests.name: Summer Reading
quests.description: It's boring, being stuck in the castle you died in for eternity. I could use some reading material. Get book pages from bookworms, and some skullspider silk and batwing leather to bind them.

quests.name: It's A Delicacy!
quests.description: Spider egg roe - the best topping to use on Grimskull sushi! What? You've never tried it? Well, trust me, it's divine. Get me some from the Bone Widow in the NOPE room. I'll have my employees come pick it up.

quests.name: My Final Recipe
quests.description: Well, you've defeated Vaden, Flester and Yurrod but don't think your job is done yet! I have one last recipe to create, but the ingredients are INSANE. You will have to travel throughout the /bonecastle to gather everything needed for my 5 Star Delight!

quests.name: Dolls' Hide and Seek
quests.description: "With twine, bind and bend sticks of elm into arms, legs, and a head. To let rest, stake to trees all over the woods. To wake and be freed, gather these friends together," so writes Viola the Vile. The next passage mentions that fresh chicken bones work even better for their smell. No chickens around but more than enough bones ripe for the picking. Go on, fetch!

quests.name: Arts and Crafts
quests.description: Make these dolls carefully. If you tie the twine knots too loose, the doll will fall apart. Too tight and you'll snap our materials! Bah, both you and my minio..minor little troupe aren't making any progress. Go talk to that Witch in the blue and yellow tent. Ask her to cast a spell on the children to do this busywork. Give those bone-heads a hard knock on the way over too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lemonade, Chewy Ice
quests.description: "The Forest's Spirit loves offerings of foreign delicacies. Dazzling in flavors, colours - and chewy. He'll get up faster if you gift him some chews." writes Russel the Riotous. My carnival offers many delights at the food stands. But they need restocking. We don't have ingredients from the outside but modifying the spell shouldn't matter. As long as it's chewy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Screams and Tag
quests.description: "I am called Viola the Vile in honour of my knowledge of fear. Allen shrieks at the sight of spiders, and the Forest's Spirit would wake to chase him alongside me." writes Viola. Screams are our next goal. That's why the coaster was constructed, but not enough children are lining up. Hmph, the clowns and the stains on the ground seem to be scaring them away.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Playful Teething
quests.description: "A wolf bit the Forest's Spirit and we waited for it to be smushed, but it was given many pats instead. Those little teeth are toothpicks to him, so we lured the rest of the pack here. Gather animals together to help wake him," writes Russel. That's why I brought out the petting zoo. Strange, none of them want to leave their cages. Toss them some grub.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Days Pass
quests.description: This passage is a mystery to me. "Banana slugs are better than candy gummies. Take sewing needles and pierce their sides to have him wake." writes Allen. I don't know what these banana slugs are but they aren't here. Bah, go hunt those fuzzy bugs for now. That witch will trade her needles for them. I must think on this conundrum.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pinned Bugs
quests.description: "Banana slugs are better than candy gummies. Take sewing needles and pierce their sides to have him wake. The sludge that spews out gives joy and wonderment to the Forest's Spirit." Positively psychotic! I see now. Over time, those slugs transformed into tape worms. Harvest the sludge and smear it all over the magic circles in the far right tent.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sweet Glue
quests.description: "I am Russel the Riotous, known for the might of my fury. I reduced the birch to mulch with my ax, practicing to fight the monsters at school. The sweet smell of the sap attracted the Forest's Spirit's curious gaze. Gather sap to wake him, as I did," the note says. You know what to do. The sap's red these days but it should smell the same.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Witch Soup
quests.description: "We first met the Forest's Spirit whilst stirring a witch's brew in a pit. It emerged from the soil and joined in on adding to our metal pot cauldron. He drank it and was merry. Mix a foul brew to get his attention," writes Viola. I talked to the witch and she agreed to mix a brew as long as I stayed out of her tent. Fine. I don't care about cheap workshops.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Written Promise
quests.description: "I spelled illustrious like that because I wanted it in my name, and I'll earn it in the future. If we get one. The warring Kings might drag the Forest's Spirit into their mess. If conflicts get too close, we'll use a seal to hide him. When children are gathered, he'll wake again," He's talking about my tent. Gather the children and get me extra ink to adjust the circles.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: All Fall Down
quests.description: "I had Keepers as did Russel and Allen. They are buried at the mouth of these woods. To wake the Forest's Spirit, the final step needed is to unearth the bones of its greatest enemies." Whoever these ‘Keepers' were must have been powerful to earn the Authors' spite. But this is it! Gather the remains and throw in a little extra in case.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Snow Turning Back!
quests.description: It looks like Dead Morice has power over more than just the poisoned ice zombies who were once your friends! You'll need to take out 10 Snow Golems and 10 Ice Elementals to reach him! While you journey, renew the spirit of the land by placing 10 wisps of Frostval's Flame around the area!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Forest Guardian Gauntlet ' quest.

quests.name: Venom in Your Veins
quests.description: Those coldhearted Ice Symbiotes… they were once your fwiends! You has to save all 20 in the area… without slaying them! To melt the ice around them, you'll need to force them to feel the burn of Frostval's Flame. Knock them out so they can get fired up for Frostval once they wake!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Forest Guardian Gauntlet ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Song of the Frozen Heart
quests.description: Dead Morice had so much magical potential. It is so sad that we Frostvale moglins didn't get to help him before his heart froze and turned so bitter! Now, to save Lore, you'll need to melt the ice in his soul! Out of the ice volcano… into the fire!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Forest Guardian Gauntlet ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Take a Break from Fighting
quests.description: People need something fun and cheewful to take their minds off our impending doom. Bwing me some Living Snow fwom the Polar Golems nearby, and some Elemental Icicles fwom the Glacial Elementals. I’m gonna use them to build snowmen!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take it Down ' quest.

quests.name: Who's That on the Mountain?
quests.description: I wooked up the mountain and I saw someone fighting some of the fwostspawn monsters. Let's go help them! Maybe they can hewp us defeat Kawok and Kezewoth!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take it Down ' quest.

quests.name: Yeti Witual
quests.description: The ancient yeti witual wequires a tuft of Mogwinster fur. As you may wemember, Mogwinsters are cweated when Mogwins are fed too much sugar. Witch Twuffles will do it weally fast! If you see any Candy Gobwins, they'll pwobabwy have some. It's their favowite. Take it fwom them and give it to any Mogwins you see.

quests.name: Get the Fur
quests.description: Now we just need to steal a few tufts of Mogwinster Fur. They pwobably won't want to just hand it over, though. They can be so unweasonable when they're sugar wushing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Vapor Needed
quests.description: Now we will need to soak the fur in ghostwy vapor to get it weady for the next pawt. There are pwenty of ghosts awond here, so that shouldn't be any twouble.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Trap the Flame
quests.description: After it's soaked for awhile, we have to set it on fire. No, we don't want to buwn it - we want it to never go out! That's why we have to use flame from the Will o' the Wisp. Catch it in this jar and bwing it back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Down the Well
quests.description: I know where it's hiding. At the bottom of the well, in the dawk, where no one can see it. It's time, hewo. It's time to go down there and face it. I'll meet you at the bottom.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Cweepie-cwawlie Time
quests.description: So many cweepy-cwawlies down here! Bats and spiders and eyeballs. They are all minions of… THAT… and they're here to stop us fwom weaching him! But we will not be stopped. We will slay them all.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gwoop Destruction
quests.description: Do you see that gloopy stuff? That is pure, congealed FEAR. He dwains it fwom his victims and takes its power. If we destwoy iy, we will weaken him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Seawch for Bubble
quests.description: Don't fowget - Bubble is still in here somewhere! Maybe behind some of these big spider webs. Clear them away and see if you can find her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be competed once .

quests.name: Free Bubble!
quests.description: We have to get Bubble out of thewe! She says the key is made of bone… like a skeleton key, I guess! One of the monsters must have it. Find it and then unlock her cage.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Echo... echo... echo
quests.description: We're surrounded by THAT - and not just because we're in his bowels! These… ECHOES… are going to give us a LOT of twouble. We're gonna have to stop them before they can stop us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gather Hope
quests.description: You may have seen them while you were slaying those echoes, hewo - the Blacklights. The source of his power. Kill them… and you kill THAT. The only thing that can destwoy them is HOPE. There is a lot of shattered hop in here - pieces from evewy kid he's taken. If you collect enough, we can make it stwong again,. We can use it against the Blacklights.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Bweak the Blacklights
quests.description: I wealize now that this was what was supposed to happen all along. The witual doesn't kill him. It bwings us HERE. It bwings us to the Blacklights. Bweak them, hewo! Bweak them with the vewy hope he stole fwom the west of us
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get Wid of THAT
quests.description: He's vulnerable now that the lights are gone! IF we destwoy him now, he will be gone for good!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chilly's Participation Quest 2025
quests.description: I want to help you and ALL the heroes of Lore have the merriest Frostval EVER. I'm here to help you get ready for the Frostval Gifting event! You'll need to complete my quest if you want to give or receive free ACs once the event begins on December 5th. Defeat the Zard in Battleontown to deliver a reminder to BE NICE while the event is happening. Three years ago, he tried bite me. :/

quests.name: Chilly's Participation Quest 2024
quests.description: I want to help you and ALL the heroes of Lore have the merriest Frostval EVER. I'm here to help you get ready for the Frostval Gifting event! You'll need to complete my quest if you want to give or receive free ACs once the event begins on December 6th. Defeat the Zard in Battleontown to deliver a reminder to BE NICE while the event is happening. Two years ago, he tried bite me. :/

quests.name: Chilly's Participation Quest 2023
quests.description: I want to help you and ALL the heroes of Lore have the merriest Frostval EVER. I'm here to help you get ready for the Frostval Gifting event! You'll need to complete my quest if you want to give or receive free ACs once the event begins on December 8th. Defeat the Zard in Battleontown to deliver a reminder to BE NICE while the event is happening. Last year, he bit me. :/

quests.name: Chilly's Participation Quest
quests.description: I want to help you and ALL the heroes of Lore have the merriest Frostval EVER. I'm here to help you get ready for the Frostval Gifting event! You'll need to complete my quest if you want to give or receive free ACs once the event begins on December 16th. Defeat the Zard in Battleontown to deliver a reminder to BE NICE while the event is happening. Last year, he bit me. :/

quests.name: Angriest Birds
quests.description: Everything happened so fast that I haven't had time to check in with my peeps; I don't know who is alright and who is… *bird gulp.* Explore the whole area, Human, and see which birds have become baddies and which ones remain friendly. Make haste and report back with your observations.

quests.name: Harms in Arms
quests.description: Flippin' finches, this is so much worse than I had hoped… but hope isn't enough to solve a problem. Action MUST be taken… and weapons MUST be taken too! Pry the weapons away from the BirdsWithHarms that you encounter. Fly back when you have found 4 different weapon types so that I may examine more closely.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Literal Arms Dealer
quests.description: This is super sus: all these weapons have the Duck Norris insignia carved into the handles. Perhaps Duck Norris could offer a clue… or maybe he's the culprit to blame! *Phfssssss, phfsssss!* Quickly, Human - go speak with Duck Norris in the Weapon Shop to find out more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fowl Farming Quest
quests.description: The Turkonians are in a FOWL mood after the death of their King. You'd better go help them calm down. Beak some heads and unruffle some feathers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Without Feather Ado ' quest.

quests.name: No Good Deed
quests.description: What do you care about our sorry little lives? Why are you even here? Are we entertainment to you? Well, I'll play no part. You want to help the girl? Find the house on the far east side of the village and end this comedy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Worn Book's Cover ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Time That Surpasses Death
quests.description: If you wish to join my Order, you must prove that you are strong enough to withstand our power. Seek out Mors Temporis in /portalmazec and show us what you are made of!

quests.name: Queen's Chaos Collection
quests.description: ARF ARF! Daimyo has traveled from the past alongside Iadoa to grant you a character page badge to help celebrate the 13th Birthday! Defeat a Time-Travel Fairy in the /chronohub to harvest a Chaotic Hour-glass and unlock a character page badge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Chronomancer's Loyal Quest Companion in your inventory.

items.name: Queen's Chaos Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Save Chuckles!
quests.description: YOU have been chosen by the Save Chuckles movement to convince DEATH to bring back Chuckles! Find DEATH on your map and speak to him — do not take no for an answer!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Chuckles Skull in your inventory.

quests.name: Chunin Armor
quests.description: (For owners of the Merge Shop version of Chunin Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a Chunin. There are times, however, when the skills of a ninja do not suit, however the look does. This is for those times.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Chunin (Merge) with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory.

quests.name: Chunin Armor
quests.description: (For owners of the AC version of Chunin Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a Chunin. There are times, however, when the skills of a ninja do not suit, however the look does. This is for those times.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Chunin (AC) with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory.

quests.name: Weapons Testing
quests.description: You! Want to test some new weapons for me? Down by the pit, where Malurach hangs out, you'll find some training dummies. Beat those up for awhile, and report back to me on how you did.

quests.name: I Need Energy
quests.description: I'm running low on Celestial energy, and I'll need more if I'm going to keep producing these weapons. I know there are some Celestials who think they've "infiltrated" our city - but they don't fool me, and I bet they won't fool you, either. Fight them, and bring their energy back to me.

quests.name: Need a Better Metal
quests.description: The Temple Guardians at /ravinetemple are made from a rare, very strong metal. I call it Fortifinium - I don't know what it's really called, and I'm not very creative with names. Anyway, I want to use it to forge stronger armor for our troops. Head over to the temple and get me some.

quests.name: On the Run to the Next Gig
quests.description: Oh, hero! The Lumberhorcs and fanboys are swarming Kaitlyn and Jesse! If we don't clear them out, Bride & Groom will not reach their gig on time.

quests.name: Silence From the Songbird?!
quests.description: The songbird has been stolen?! They can't perform without the songbird. It's one of the stars of their act!

quests.name: Break into Backstage
quests.description: You've come this far, don't let ANYTHING stop you from seeing the show now. Defeat two of the Security Guards to get backstage to BrideandGroom's latest performance!

quests.name: By the Power of the Moon
quests.description: Take out 10 locusts to clear the first wave of the swarm and let the moonlight shine through!

quests.name: Clear the Swarm
quests.description: Dispel the swarm of locusts to finally let the moon shine through, and we'll be able to power the ankh and start the show!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Treasure Hunters Attack!
quests.description: The ankh is powerful… and the shadow infernals are not the only creatures who want to possess it! Defeat 13 Treasure Hunters to protect the Ankh of Eternity.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Act 2 Completed' quest.

quests.name: Airship Sabotage
quests.description: If you're going to make the Treasure Hunters don't follow, you'll have to take drastic measures. While the crew is subdued, cut the rigging lines, dampen their gunpowder, and scatter their cannonballs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.*.

quests.name: Plague in the Pyramid
quests.description: If the swarm invades pyramid, your only known route back to the outside will be blocked. Clear out 12 of the locusts to prevent the airshaft from being blocked.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Act 3 Completed' quest.

quests.name: The Plaguebringer Appears
quests.description: The locusts must have been sent by the Plaguebringer to retrieve the Ankh? That explains why they have followed you here. Take out Nokris Plaguebringer and 3 more of his minions, and the locust threat will be… exterminated.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle to the Temple
quests.description: The death of the summoner has called all the locusts to their master's grave. The airshaft is no longer a viable exit. If we are going to escape and return to the Ankh to Rogue, we'll need to find another way out! Take out the Mummies and Treasure Hunters in your way as you battle to find an exit.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Treasure Hunter's Last Stand
quests.description: The most legendary treasure hunters and explorers were known to be tenacious - never giving up on the prize they sought. This Captain and his Treasure Hunters are as fierce as any of them, and you hold the artifact he seeks. Take out the Captain and we should be free of the last threat to the Ankh!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Apephyrx Rises
quests.description: The power of the Ankh, activated inside the temple, has summoned a being of immense power from beyond our world. It is… so… very… hungry! You must take out Apephryx before it devours our world!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Act 4 Completed' quest.

quests.name: Gather the Gold Debns
quests.description: Slay any monster in the area around the Cruxshadows ship for a chance to get a gold Debn. Get 6 to turn it in for a Glowing Pumpkinseed to use in the merge shop.

quests.name: 100 Mummy Massacre
quests.description: Take out 100 mummies in the temple to unlock the Mogloween Mummy Slayer badge!

quests.name: Gather the Gold Debns
quests.description: Slay any monster in the area around the Cruxshadows ship for a chance to get a gold Debn. Get 6 to turn it in for a Glowing Pumpkinseed to use in the merge shop.

quests.name: ULTRA Pumpkinseed Farming Quest
quests.description: If you want to become an Evolved Pumpkin Lord with certainty (rather than random monster farming), complete the Pumpkinseed quest to get Glowing Pumpkinseeds to create the Class! Slay Apephyrx for an Otherworld Sigil and you shall get your wish.

quests.name: Darkwave Khopesh
quests.description: Battle Apephryx for a chance to get the Shards of the Darkwave Khopesh, a weapon that grants you more damage against the undead plus gives you bonus XP and gold!

Classic Pirate Quibble Quest Pet's Quest.name: Classic Pirate Quibble Quest Pet's Quest

quests.name: 2021 Prime Chest Badge
quests.description: Avast! These undead pirates be wreakin' all sorts o' havoc on board. Slay 1 to send a message home to all th' rest, so they clear out and give th' deckhands room to work.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Classic Pirate Quibble Quest Pet in your inventory.

items.name: Prime Pirate Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Monstrous Future
quests.description: Ever since the explosions that shattered our continent, monster attacks have been on the rise. Our town keeps being invaded; please clear the area so the refugees stay safe!

quests.name: Compass Pointe
quests.description: We need to make sure all the refugees from the mainland are able to find their way here. We've been leaving compasses for them by the beaches, but we need to make more! I'll need 3 Chimera Scales, 3 metal Goblin teeth, and 3 strips of Wyvern leather, and

quests.name: Feed the Hungry
quests.description: We've got to feed all these refugees, and that's NOT an easy task when the land's in as much turmoil as it is. But we've got a lot of monsters in town, and now we've got YOU. Bring me 4 hunks of Wyvern meat and 4 grilled Chimera wings.

quests.name: Lodes of Gold
quests.description: Dwarfhold Mountains is the perfect place to hunt for gold! Unfortunately, it is currently overrun with Drow and Chaotic Draconians who steal everything from the imprisoned Dwarfs. The shiny, precious gold lodes happen to be the Chaotic Draconians' favorite. Find me one pristine Gold Lode and you will be rewarded handsomely for your troubles!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Enter The Gates ' quest.

quests.name: Gold Digger
quests.description: Deep beneath Battleon lies a series of complex, underground tunnels flooded with the Undead. Even though they might look the same, there is one particular Undead who harnesses the Gold Dust. Hunt down the undead Lich until you find this Gold Dust!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Enter The Gates ' quest.

quests.name: Fire Gem
quests.description: Fire Gems are extremely rare and valuable. If you find one while battling a Skeletal Fire Mage, please return it to me! In reward for your bravery and perseverance, I will enchant the power of the Fire Gem into a staff for you. You can find Fire Mages in battleundera.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Enter The Gates ' quest.

quests.name: Purely Elemental Knowledge
quests.description: If we are to ensure the health of the creatures of Lore, we need you to examine the purity of the elements. Journey to the /Lair to study the Dark and Golden Draconians, the Ruins of /Gilead for Elementals, the realm of /KingCoal for Ice Elementals, and the /Airstorm region of Etherstorm to see its Energy Tornado creatures.

quests.name: Animal vs Human?
quests.description: We must see what effect Chaorruption has on animal and human bodies. Visit /Bloodtuskwar and /Alliance where the Chaorruption is strongest. Bring us your reports of the following: Good and Evil humans, avians, mammals, and reptiles; you may need to study a number of examples before you have enough data.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Gateways to Chaos?
quests.description: We suspect that Drakath, the Champion of Chaos, has hidden gateways to his realm across Lore. We believe they are guarded by unique or powerful creatures, but need a champion of our own to best them. Help us in this, and I can reveal what our true purpose is to you. We believe they can be found in the following locations: /sewer, /boxes, /j6, /giant, /Shadowfall, and /orctown.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Nature of Chaos
quests.description: If you are to aid us in our fight to purify the Chaorruption on Lore, then there is much you need to know. Speak with each of my sisters here in the Temple to learn what we know about the nature of Chaos.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Chaos Theory
quests.description: There is an idea I have… No, even with as much as you know now, you should not know this yet. It is too dangerous! But please, slay Shadowscythe Pilots in /thespan and bring me back samples of their effluvia and plasma. I must test my idea.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Little Chaos Goes a Long Way
quests.description: We wish to study the course of Chaorruption over a creature's lifespan. We have a fully Chaorrupted Chaos Turtle and a newly Chaorrupted Water Dragon. You can see the turtle is far gone; his shell is fully tainted. The dragon shows little visible evidence, but the Chaorruption can be sensed by our Order. Slay them so we may investigate.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Dys-Geni-c Chaorruption?
quests.description: What must Chaos do to one not human, not animal? A creature from another realm? Find for me the most powerful and Chaorrupted Djinn in the /djinn lands, and see what Chaorruption has done its strength.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Purify The Crown
quests.description: Chaos isn't as infectious as it used to be, but a powerful grudge refuses to release the King's crown from its taint. That said, it's gold. Not organic matter. We could purify it with a concoction similar to the Tears of the Mother. To make it, we'll need to gather Chaos at its source.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Familial Blessing ' quest. | Must have Rank 10 Swordhaven .

quests.name: Key to the Tower
quests.description: If you are going to save the Princess, you've GOT to get into the Tower. It's locked, and I'm pretty sure one of these zards creatures stole the key. Defeat the Zards Undead Warriors until you recover the Tower Key.

quests.name: Time for a Dose
quests.description: Ok! We'll start by going out and dosing some of the "reshapen" creatures in the area with our original formula, and then tagging them so we can keep track of its effects as we work on it. I'm sure this won't be easy, so it may take you a few tries before you successfully dose and tag them. You'll find the Spiderwings flying around in the forest, and the Urstrix in the nearby cave.

quests.name: Comparing Samples
quests.description: Hmm, doesn't look like it's having much of an effect. Let's collect some samples from the creatures Kolyaban has changed, and then some more from their unaltered counterparts. You can find uncorrupted HootBears in /brightoak, and Leatherwings in /guru or /pines. Comparing them might help us figure out the direction we need to go in.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Examine the Foliage
quests.description: It might not be a bad idea to get some samples from the reshapen plants, too. Roots, fungus… whatever you can find. It will all give me valuable data.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Investigate the Goo
quests.description: Interesting. I'd also like to get hold of some of the toxic goo from these wandering extrikiti things. If I can see how the non-infected samples respond to pure Rift-matter, I may be able to better understand how to approach this. Don't worry - the toxicity of these lil guys is much weaker, so as long as you wear gloves, you should be fine!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Second Dose
quests.description: Ok, take this adjusted serum and dose the creatures you previously tagged. You'll need to make sure you dose the same ones, so you may end up fighting a few extras before you find them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Still Not Working
quests.description: Hmm. Well, that did solve part of the puzzle, but there's something else we're still missing. Let's take a look at some of the monsters that actually came from the rift. Go back to /therift and capture 3 Ravenous Parasites and 3 Plague Spreaders.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get the Final Ingredients
quests.description: Interesting - the biology of these reshapen creatures is similar to that of the Rift creatures, but it's not identical. What we need is a way to kill off the Rift parts while healing the body's natural form. I think I have an idea.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Doomkitten's Treasure
quests.description: SOMEWHERE in this town, there's an evil DOOMKITTEN in its secret lair. Where is that lair, you ask? No one knows! But if you can find it, I hear that kitten has a rare and special treasure. Bring it to me, and I'll give you a nice reward.

quests.name: Pop Goes the Makai
quests.description: Why must the Archfiend surround himself with such annoying creatures! We must take out these Dark Makai if we are going to be getting anywhere!

quests.name: Dispel Spell
quests.description: It looks like the local fiends put up a barrier keeping us from moving forward. If we collect enough of the Fiend Energy that is maintaining the sigils, we should be able to dispel them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dreadfiend Demolition
quests.description: These Dreadfiends are no match for your power, Master Dage, but that doesn't mean they are not in our way. Let's show them the might of the Legion and move forward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Graython Located
quests.description: We have to find Graython before the Archfiend does. Let's scout the area and see if we can find him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Graython
quests.description: It can not be helped, Master Dage. Graython has allied himself with the Archfiend. He must be eliminated before he can become a bigger threat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Island Sightseeing
quests.description: It's said that the Nuckelavee resides somewhere on this island, close to a haunted shore. Let's see if we can find this fabled shore. We might have to clear out the local wildlife as well. Something has them spooked.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lure Crafted
quests.description: If we are going to lure the Nuckelavee out, we are going to need an actual Lure. We should be able to make one out of Void Crystals carried by the Dreadfiends back in Graython's tunnels .
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lure Charged
quests.description: The Nuckelavee will only appear if there is a strong sense of demise nearby. That is what the Lure is for. We will have to collect souls of anything nearby until the Lure is fully charged.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Place the Lure
quests.description: Let's take the Lure to the shore and that should cause the Nuckelavee to appear.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Nuckelavee
quests.description: The Nuckelavee is a natural force of the Underworld. We must be careful, but if we can defeat it, we can convert it to the Legion and gain a powerful asset.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bloody the Fiends
quests.description: We must take this outpost and eliminate Smaras! Let's start by taking out the Bloodfiends!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unstable Energies
quests.description: I have an idea for once we are done with Smaras. Let's collect Unstable Void Energy from the Fiends here. I'll be able to use it to create bombs and we will demolish this outpost!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Plant the Bombs
quests.description: Let's find some of the structural keystones for us to place these bombs on. The Nation will have one less foothold when we are done with this place!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Those Infernal Fiends
quests.description: All that is left are the Infernal Fiends. Let's take them out and move on to Smaras! Victory belongs to the Legion!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Smaras
quests.description: Smaras is too valuable to the Archfiend to be kept alive. We must stop him right here and now!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Understanding Yokai
quests.description: How Yokai fit in the cycles of life and death are still relatively unknown. That mystery will give us an edge against the Archfiend but we must understand them to utilize it! Let's face some of these Funa-Yurei to get some insight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Covering Our Scent
quests.description: In the Yokai Realm, our souls stick out like sore thumbs. We have to try and mask our presence or we will never stop being hunted by the local Yokai. Let's collect some Energy from the Funa-Yurei and the earth around us to try and disguise ourselves.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Can't Escape the Shadows
quests.description: Hebimaru has sensed us! And he has sent his Shadows to take us out. We can't let them stop us! Let's take them out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Last of the Defenses
quests.description: Hebimaru has alerted more Yokai of our presence! We have no choice but to eliminate every last one until we reach him! Let's finish this, Master Dage!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Hebimaru
quests.description: I don't know what a shinigami is capable of but we have to be ready for anything! We must defeat Hebimaru and get him to join our cause!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Scorched Earth
quests.description: If we can take down more of Nulgath's outposts, then that should give us an advantage in the battle to come.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Hebimaru ' quest.

quests.name: Eternal Underworld Legacy Guards
quests.description: Slay a Legion Dreadmarch in /darkwarnation and a Void Fiend in /darkwarlegion to prove your worth once more to Dage the Evil and Nulgath the ArchFiend. You will be rewarded with house guards of your own! (This quest requires both the Dage and Nulgath 2022 birthday collection chests to unlock.)

quests.name: Nation Badges
quests.description: Those Nation members all carry Badges showing their allegiance to Nulgath. Defeat them and bring their Badges as proof of their demise.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Hebimaru ' quest.

quests.name: Mega Nation Badges
quests.description: Those Nation members all carry Mega Badges showing their allegiance to Nulgath. Defeat them and bring their Mega Badges as proof of their demise.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Hebimaru ' quest.

quests.name: A Nation Defeated
quests.description: I knew the ArchFiend couldn't stand to see his army defeated so easily. We've got bigger fiends headed our way now. Take out the Infernal and Dread Fiends he's sent out way. We'll show him what dread REALLY looks like.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Hebimaru ' quest. | Must have completed at least one the previous two quests. Note: This quest unlocked when the war meter reached 25%.

quests.name: ManSlayer? More Like ManSLAIN
quests.description: Pffft. You'd think a beast called a ManSlayer would be a challenge, right? I know, me too. But I've seen what you can do. Take out the ManSlayer Fiends so we can get this victory locked in right and tight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Hebimaru ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest unlocked when the war meter reached 50%.

quests.name: Defeat Dirtlicker
quests.description: What kind of name is Dirtlicker, anyway? He acts like it is a thing of honor! Let us show just how fitting the name is for him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Hebimaru ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest unlocked when the war meter reached 75%.

quests.name: Build Drakath's Armor
quests.description: This is one of the HARDEST quest in AQWorlds! Only the strongest, most-dedicated, bravest heroes will be able to complete this quest! It will require you to turn in some of the most valuable, hardest-to-obtain gear… but the reward will be worth it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Final Showdown! ' quest.

items.name: Drakath's Epic Armor Character Page Badge

quests.name: Drakath's Armor Badge
quests.description: So, you already have Drakath's Armor, (and the fancy badge in the Other tab of your Book of Lore) but you want to show the world with a character page badge? Well, now's your chance!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Final Showdown! ' quest. | Must have Original Drakath Armor in your inventory.

items.name: Drakath's Epic Armor Character Page Badge

quests.name: Bridge Over Troubled Wellmet
quests.description: We've GOT to get back to Cysero and Warlic, Hero. Rowan's already there. We'll need ALL our smarts if we're going to figure this out. I'll guard your back while you take on the monsters that have clogged up the Night Bridge. *mutter* Just wish I had m' locus magicalicus. Then I could help with MAGIC.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lock-Blocked ' quest.

quests.name: Focus on the Locus
quests.description: I can FEEL it calling to me, Hero. I just have to listen inside my head - and my heart - and it will lead me to itself. I'm going to scout ahead - back to the alley where we found Cysero - and see if I can find the general location. Find me when you've taken out all the monsters in the area. That way they won't interrupt our search.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Locus Located
quests.description: It's here, Hero, somewhere. The pull is SO strong! Help me search through the muck, boxes, and trash to find it. It's got to be buried amid all this trash, but I KNOW it's here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Focus on the Locus ' quest.

quests.name: Demented Deorysa
quests.description: Rowan told me guards reported that the door to Pettivox's Lab was left open after he stomed out in a frenzy. The deorysa are all up in a tizzy. It's not going to be easy to get past them to get back in the lab, but we're going to have to DO it! We'll need to take out the whole pack of 15 if I'm going to have time to server the link.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Traitor Takedown
quests.description: Keep Pettivox OUT of my way! I’m going to have to concentrate if I’m to do this without blowing us all the way back to the Twilight. This here’s some dangerous magic. But you know that. So leave me be to work!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest is hidden and auto-completes.

quests.name: Embero Spell
quests.description: Only the greatest of mages are able to perform this spell! I can teach it to you, but you're going to have to gather the spell components. Hard work makes the lesson stick! Find the following and bring them back:

quests.name: Pickpocketing 101
quests.description: My mother was the best pickpocket in all of the Twilight! And she taught me how to pickpocket when I was a young boy. The first step to picking a pocket is learning how to pick. And the easiest thing to pick is… your nose! Yep, it's gross, but as soon as you master nose picking, you will be ready to dip your hand into cleaner treasure troves. Find a monstrous lump of slimey nose boogers and pick through it until you uncover the Slimey Staff. Once you steal the Slimey Staff and bring it back to me, you will be ready to pick some pockets!

quests.name: Thieves are Lye-able
quests.description: My mother always said that you have to dress nice, have clean hands, and be well-kept so that no one suspects you of thievery. Let's get you cleanned up so that you can start pickpocketing real treasures! Collect 5 Vials of Acorn Oil from Acornets and then some Water from a Cactus Creeper that will act as a base for soap. Find a fragrant Wisteria Flower from Guru Forest so that we can make the soap smell good. And finally, you need to harvest 3 Lye Rocks from an Ore Balboa so that we can actually make some soap. Bring them back to me and I'll use my quick hands to craft some soap!

quests.name: Stainless Stealers
quests.description: My mother always said that if you look nice, people will perceive you as being a nice person. As a master pickpocket, you must be clean and tidy to make your clean getaway. Craft 3 bars of soap and then try your thievery against a ninja! Pick the pocket of a Ninja Nopperabo and swipe the Sai of Steel! Good Luck—-I know you can do it!

quests.name: Pick some Pockets to Plunder
quests.description: I think you're ready to pick some real pockets! Use what I have taught you to pick the pocket of the most notorious Bounty Hunter in all of Lore. What you find in his pocket will allow you to travel elsewhere, where another pocket can be picked. After that pocket is plundered, go steal a virtual chunk of Crystallized Dragon Breath! I could give you more details…buuuut… being vague is kind of what pickpockets do best! You can do it, hero!

quests.name: What You Seize is What You Get
quests.description: A skilled pickpocket can make off with as much loot as an armed robber—if you pick the right victim, that is. Look for someone who appears wealthy, preoccupied, and is foreign to the area. I hear the Grand Inquisitor has some serious treasures just waiting to be pickpocketed! Test your thievery against this gilded guard and see if you can swipe his Mace of the Grand Inquisitor! Use the skills I have taught you… and don't get caught!

quests.name: Benet's Biscuits
quests.description: A pickpocket's gotta eat! And biscuits are the best snack… or meal!…for any thief. Benet's Biscuits are absolutely irresistible, and I'm going to share the recipe with you! Here is what we need:

quests.name: A Gift Of Meat
quests.description: I have information about Wolfwing but you must earn the pack's respect before I will share my knowledge. You must present me with a gift of meat, and I will share with it my brothers and sisters. Our cousins, the Dire Wolves, have taken more than their share of game lately. Take 6 Hungs of Meat from them and return and honor me with your gift.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Paw ' quest.

quests.name: No Respect
quests.description: Werewolves respect strength. To further earn the respect of my pack you must defeat them in combat. Challenge and defeat 5 Lycans & 2 Lycan Knights, then return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Paw ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Vampire Knights
quests.description: The Queen has always sent her Vampire Knights into our lands to drive us out and take it for themselves, but these Vampire Knights stink of madness… of Chaos. Destroy 10 Chaos Vampire Knights to prove your loyalty to the pack.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Paw ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Sanguine
quests.description: Father Woods tells us that there is a Chaos Vampire General in his woods, twisting everything that he touches. Wolfwing must have sent this creature to keep our hands full while he… never mind. I will tell you if you complete this last task. Destroy Sanguine and return here with his Mask as proof.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Paw ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Best Way To Slay An Infernal
quests.description: If we confiscate some of the weapons these Infernals are wielding, we can use the to protect ourselves against this invading army. I know you to be a strong and capable hero - you will have no problem with this task.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I'm Not Lycan This Situation ' quest.

quests.name: A Dire Situation
quests.description: Our dire wolves are accustomed to fighting, but they are spooked by the fire. I need you to subdue them - tire them out and calm them down so that they can be rescued.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: I'd Lycan To Go Now
quests.description: This is as ready as we're going to get to make our escape. Go through the Ridge and let all of the Lycans know that we're preparing to head out. Once everyone is here, head to the east and get the back exit open.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Lord Balax'el
quests.description: This must be the Infernal Lord who is leading the invasion! Come, destroy him with me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Revenant Slayer
quests.description: Come one-shape! We will go into the catacombs first to clear the way for the others. We must go, quickly, before the Infernals fill the tunnels behind us!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Follow Lady Solani ' quest.

quests.name: Noddharath
quests.description: What fresh horror is this? Some kind of… MONSTER… is blocking the exit! Whatever that thing is, it's NOT a revenant, and it doesn't look like an Infernal, either.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Vampire Medals
quests.description: We MUST get into the ritual room and stop the Red Dawn Ritual. Each of the Vampires carries a crest somewhere on them. Bring them to me, and I will reward you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An End To This Threat ' quest.

quests.name: Mega Vampire Medals
quests.description: We MUST get into the ritual room and stop the Red Dawn Ritual. Each of the Vampires carries a crest somewhere on them. Bring them to me, and I will reward you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An End To This Threat ' quest.

quests.name: Blood Rage
quests.description: The magic of the Blood Moon grows stronger as it reaches the ritual hour. If you can recover the Ruby Crests the Blood Guardians wear, we may be able to learn more about their magical defenses.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An End To This Threat ' quest.

quests.name: A Drink for Solani
quests.description: The coffee here is great, but Solani needs a different kind of "hot drink"… if you know what I mean. Maybe you could "order some" from the "Baristas"?

quests.name: The Headless Horseman
quests.description: I sense you're looking for the true Headless Horseman, one-shape. I'm honored to help you summon the Horseman's armor. We need:
quests.requirements_note: Must have Oversoul's Headless Horseman in your inventory.

quests.name: The Horseman's Cape
quests.description: The cloak is not so difficult to make. We need:

quests.name: The Horseman's Head
quests.description: Surprisingly, the Headless Horseman does in fact have a head. To create it, we'll need the following:

quests.name: The Horseman's Axe
quests.description: To construct the Horseman's Axe, we need:
quests.requirements_note: Must have Headtaking Headless Horseman in your inventory.

quests.name: The Horseman's Second Axe
quests.description: It's much more complicated to summon the Headless Horseman's second cursed axe, because we'll need to perform a special incantation to do so. Luckily, all of the materials for it can be found near Mystcroft. Bring me the following:
quests.requirements_note: Must have Oversoul's Rusted Head Axe in your inventory.

quests.name: Buried Treasure
quests.description: You dig up a treasure chest. A message is carved into it. "One person's trash is another's treasure."
quests.requirements_note: Must have Deciphered Scroll in your inventory.

quests.name: Cornelis Reborn
quests.description: In order to unlock the Cornelis Family Chest and claim your rewards, you will need to earn the Cornelis Reborn Achievement Badge for your Book of Lore and your Character Page. Accept this quest and start collecting 100 Gargoyle Horns from the gargoyle monsters in Cornelis. Turn the quest in to get the Achievement and unlock the chest!

quests.name: Explication of Derp Volume VII
quests.description: I've misplaced my copy of "Derp: an Explication of the Conceptual Re-Engineering of the Societal Emphasis on Kawaii Culture, Volume VII" — oh, you've never read it? It's a MASTERFUL work, and my copy was signed by one of the foremost scholars on the subject. The Rainbow Derpicorn snatched it out of my hands while I was lollygagging last week. Recover it for me, and I'll reward you abundantly.

quests.name: The Green WeaponSnack
quests.description: I'm sure you've encountered Cysero, the Green WeaponSmith, in your travels through Battleon. It isn't common knowledge, but the man is a legend. A true gourmand and a baker beyond measure. But after a long day behind a hot forge, even HE needs to replenish his electrolytes… and I can make his favorite snack: PICKLES. You bring me the ingredients from the GardenQuest and if all goes well… you'll get a treat!

quests.name: Axe Marks the Spot
quests.description: Have you SEEN the Greenguard Dragon's treasure trove? Full of cool stuff… like an Axe strong enough to chop down that big tree over there. You can kindly ask him to give it to you… but chances are he'll attack you instead. Beat him up until he gives you the Fabled Chopper.

quests.name: Get Choppin'
quests.description: That tree is the only thing standing between you and a Fabled forest wonderland! If a tree falls in the Fable Forest… does it make a story? LAWLS.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Crag & Bamboozle Battle
quests.description: They want a piece of the action too!

quests.name: GRUMBLE, GRUMBLE...
quests.description: Crag no feel so good, ate too much dirt…Sorry for the mess in the cart. Crag no able to hold it in…

quests.name: Crag's Thirst
quests.description: *COUGH* So thirsty… Crag need something to wash down the shards and gems. Throat so dry, Water? No need water, water make cracks. Crag need lots of refreshing dirt! Crag trade valuable but bad tasting diamonds for lots of delicious dirt!

quests.name: Creator's Golden Gift
quests.description: To acknowledge your victories and support, we have a gift for you. Click the button below to get your very own Golden Item of Donated Awesomeness.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Creator's Arsenal in your inventory. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Crimson Captain's Blade Quest
quests.description: Yarrrr! A blade needs to be feed. and this one cravin' some bone marrow and fish blood. Bring me 3 globs of that thar' delicious Bone Marrow from th' Undead Pirates in the /pirates map, an' 3 cups o' Fish Blood from th' fishwings flyin' about.
quests.requirements_note: Must have either Crimson Captain's Blade Pet or Crimson Captain's Cutlass Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Crimson Hanzo Orb Quest
quests.description: If you would reap the rewards of the Crimson Hanzo Orb, prove your battle prowess. Spill the blood of Big Jack Sprat, the DreadSpider, Dark Makais, and Rattlebones.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Crimson Orb Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Recovering the Fangs of the Lion
quests.description: When the Fangs of the Lion shattered, its fragments scattered across Chiral Valley. You will need to recover all 5 of its pieces if we are to reform it. The fragments could be anywhere - in the Faerie Forest, or perhaps the Cornelis Ruins - and any monster might have them. Gather some friends, and see what you can find!

quests.name: Recovering the Claws of the Daeva
quests.description: The fragments of the Claws of the Daeva are scattered across Arcangrove. As before, we don't know exactly where they are, or what creatures might have them. You will need to search the entire area, from the Tower of Magic to the depths of Mount Maﬁc. Return to me when you have them all.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Recovering the Light of the Serpent
quests.description: Mythsong is where you'll ﬁnd the fragments of the Light of the Serpent. Are they in Mythsong City? In the Beehive? We don't know, so I can't tell you. But I have faith in you! You'll be able to ROCK this out in no time!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Recovering the Pike of the Shimmering Sands
quests.description: You'll be going deep into the Neverglades to collect the fragments of the Pike of the Shimmering Sands. Search through the forests, marshes and ruins until you have found them all.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Recovering the Reavers of the Gilded Sun
quests.description: The fragments of the Reavers of the Gilded Sun are scattered throughout the is|and of Yokai. Be sure to check across the water from Akiba, too - it's possible that some of the fragments were carried over on the ferry, or by pirates.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Potent Mana
quests.description: We have all of the weapon fragments. Only problem is - well. they're still shattered! If we had enough Potent Mana, we could use it to imbue the weapons with power and reform them. The life forces of certain powerful entities across Lore could provide such a thing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Break the Seal
quests.description: Now that we have all the weapons, it's time to break the seal holding the door closed. Use the weapons to activate the symbols that match them. Once all 5 symbols are activated, the door will open.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Armor of Zular
quests.description: We've broken the seal, but without the power of Zular, the Ancient Warden, we won‘t be able to stop Gedoz! Zular himself is long gone, but I still have his armor, and with your help, I can imbue it with his power. Collect Djinn's Essence from the Harpies and Lamias inside. and I will use them to empower the Armor of Zular.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gedoz, Geddout!
quests.description: With the Armor of Zular, you can now pass through the barrier into Gedoz' lair. Confront him, and defeat him, so that we can imprison him once more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Quest for Resources
quests.description: I have more weapons and armor I can offer you - l just need enough Unseen Essence to create them! You can get Unseen Essence from the Lamia and Harpies just inside the door. If you bring me their Potent Mana, I'll trade you some more Unseen Essence from my personal stash!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Trial of Water
quests.description: Your first test is the Trial of Water. Go through the door marked with the water sigil, and fight your way through the spirits that stand in your path. When you get to the end, challenge the Jaan al Bahar, and earn his blessing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Gedoz, Geddout! ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Trial of Air
quests.description: Next is the Trial of Air. As before, go through the door marked with the sigil of air, and test your agility against all who challenge you. If you can earn the blessing of the Jaan al Hawa, you will be able to move forward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Gedoz, Geddout! ' quest to access these quests. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Trial of Earth
quests.description: Your next test is the Trial of Earth. Go through the door marked with the sigil of earth. Test your strength against the sturdy spirits that guard the path. If you succeed, you will have earned the blessing of Jaan al Ard.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Gedoz, Geddout! ' quest to access these quests. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Trial of Fire
quests.description: You're almost there! Go through the door marked with the sigil of fire, and prove your resilience as you journey through the burning path! At the end, if you're worthy, you will earn the blessing of Jaan al Nair.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Gedoz, Geddout! ' quest to access these quests. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blessing of the Guardian
quests.description: The spirits have given their approval, but you must earn the approval of the Guardians as well! I've made an image of myself out of hard light. Defeat him, and you will have earned my blessing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Gedoz, Geddout! ' quest to access these quests. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Seal of the Elements
quests.description: He is from the seas, from the earth, from the skies.

quests.name: Seal of the Sanguine
quests.description: Armored so heavily, garnet and gold

quests.name: Seal of the Doomed
quests.description: Trapped in the vault, in the dark, full of dread

quests.name: Seal of Approval
quests.description: Have you found all three of the seals? Once you do, I will share my treasures with you!

quests.name: The Key of Smoke
quests.description: Crafted from the smoke of a dragon's breath, this key looks like burnt glass. Where can you find it? It would be cheating if I told you… but you'd better make sure you get to it before the DragonSlayers do!

quests.name: The Key of Flame
quests.description: From the flames of an island of fire. Kept by a creature made of the same. The molten ground keeps it hot, so be careful not to step in any lava.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Key of Mist
quests.description: Nothing creates a bank of mist like the warm waters of a swamp. And nothing creates a key of mist like a wandering swamp witch! I wonder where you could find one of those?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Key of Air
quests.description: Brave the storm and find the Key of Air! It contains a veritable cyclone of energy inside its small form. Energy that will help you open this treasure cache once you have it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Key of Earth
quests.description: An interesting key, this one - you have to pass through many other elements to reach it, and then take it from the stony, mossy earth itself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Key of Stone
quests.description: It may seem counterintuitive to head into a volcano when you're searching for a Key of Stone. But the landscape really is quite rocky! And so are the monsters inside it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Key of Water
quests.description: Deep under the sea, in the realm of strange fish and bioluminous plants, that's where you'll find this key. The one who holds it is the one who is a little different from all the rest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Key of Ice
quests.description: More purely elemental, you'll have to travel outside of Lore to find this one. Find the place where nothing exists but the cold itself, and retrieve this key from the steely bodies of its protectors.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Key of Sand
quests.description: Hidden inside a tomb - a very hot, very dry one. The dead things you find inside are dangerous… but they may also be a source of great treasure! Especially if you find this key on one of them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Key of Metal
quests.description: Metal can be such an uncomfortable thing… it feels so cold and dead. It's dreadful! If you find yourself trapped inside a big chunk of metal, far above the ground, then look for the biggest chunk of metal inside it. That's where it will be.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Key of Shadow
quests.description: No, it's not in Shadowfall. Sheesh! Do you really think I'd have you steal from Gravelyn? You were close, though - it's in a place that houses many lost treasures and keeps them safe. Who might have the key, but its strongest guardian?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Key of Light
quests.description: The keeper of your key is not your enemy, though she will fight you to give you a chance to prove your worth. She is royal and golden, and not quite of this world. I hear her sister is upset that she has this key… you might even say she is envious.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Potent Ruby
quests.description: Are you ready, my friend? Let's fight our way through the first floor and see what awaits us!

quests.name: Mystic Sapphire
quests.description: Defeating that beast has opened new paths for us… literally! Explore the second level of the palace and see what you find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Living Emerald
quests.description: Power and magic… what do you think we'll find on the third floor? Let's find out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ethereal Diamond
quests.description: Power, magic, life… I'm starting to get some ideas for how I could use these! We've unlocked another floor, so let's see what more it has to offer.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Open the Door
quests.description: Do you see the door behind the monster we just defeated? It has four chambers in it… chambers marked with the glyphs or power, magic, life, and spirit. The gems we found must be the key! Place them in the door and it will open for us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Zahad
quests.description: We're getting close to the top! That will be where the real treasure lies. Come, let's fight our way up there and claim it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Red Rival
quests.description: Prepare yourself to oust King Almoravid by collecting the flames of one of his rivals. The Jaan al Nair from /DjinnGuard will give them to you after you prove your strength. Defeat them in battle, and return here so I can use the flames with the right incantations.

quests.name: Pale Invocation
quests.description: Princess Amani knows spells that can strengthen your mind when you face off against King Almoravid. Seek out the Silver Elementals from the /TowerOfMirrors, and bring back as many of their tinctures as you can carry.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Moon's Self-Reflection
quests.description: The Djinn King Almoravid of the Night has never known rejection until now. He'll need to learn how to deal with the sting, and I'd like you to be his teacher. Please defeat him and save the wedding venue from being destroyed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Ninth Queen's Curse
quests.description: The spirit of a vengeful Sandsea Queen laid a curse on Pharaoh Zhoom. It'll turn him into a living mummy if we don't exorcize her. My engraved wards located Meresankh. She's hiding in the palace's inner chambers. Now, bring her peace.

quests.name: The Ninth Queen's Curse (Legend)
quests.description: The spirit of a vengeful Sandsea Queen laid a curse on Pharaoh Zhoom. It'll turn him into a living mummy if we don't exorcize her. My engraved wards located Meresankh. She's hiding in the palace's inner chambers. Now, bring her peace.

quests.name: Spare Parts
quests.description: If I'm gonna builds you a racer, we'll needs parts! De' Giant keeps his table filled with plastic food all the time, for some reason. See if you can find the parts we need in that mess: A pencil, cork, toilet paper roll, scissors, a can and a rubber ducky head. When yous got the parts, come talks to me again.

quests.name: Street Team
quests.description: Oh, hello! Are you here to see the show? We're still setting up and we could really use a hand, if you've got time to help! Would you mind putting these flyers up for us? Just pin them to the trees in the performance area!

quests.name: De-Pesting
quests.description: Before the show starts, we're going to want to shoo some of these rats and birds away. Otherwise they'll bother the audience and steal their food.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Earning That Guest Pass
quests.description: We're going on so soon, and there's still so much to get done! We still need to put up the speakers, tune our instruments and set up the lights!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Low On Caffeine
quests.description: I hate to ask for anything more! But… the band could really use some coffee. Reens was bringing us some from the Scarbucks in Northpointe, but she must have gotten held up. Could you find her and get our drinks?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Help Miranda
quests.description: Looks like Miranda needs someone to help calm her down! You'd better go take care of her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Follow the Footprints ' quest.
