quests.name: Chipped Tooth
quests.description: Hey! You there! Adventurer! There's a situation concerning explosions that I don't even have time to explain. I had ALMOST finished my latest design, and WHAM. *kablooey* My entire bone collection ground to dust. The skeletons in the graveyards have the last remaining ingredient for my latest necromantic glory! I need you to go and bring back 10 Chipped Teeth asap! (Return to Zorbak in Battleon with 10 Chipped Teeth)

quests.name: Funny Bone
quests.description: Psst. You, over there. Yeah you! You look like an enterprising sort. I have a bone to pick with Big Jack Sprat in the Cemetery! Every time I ALLLMOST finish my latest masterpiece, those skeletons come and steal pieces that I need. I'm down to ONE piece left, but I have to stay here and guard what I have. If you head on over there, beat Jack Sprat, and grab that bone for me… I'll see that you're handsomely rewarded. Maybe. (Return to Zorbak in Battleon with the last bone)

quests.name: The Ebil Sea
quests.description: All over the /Sandsea are hardened crystalized chunks of sand, which have more then likely been consumed by the creatures inhabiting the area. Bring back these chunks and EbilCorp will definately not pay us for our efforts… but we'll make them pay for it!

quests.name: The Gel-ous of the Forest
quests.description: … Collect Gel-ous Ore from /greenguardwest

quests.name: Strands of Deforestation
quests.description: … Collect Bamboo Strands from /bamboo

quests.name: Steel Shrapnel
quests.description: Metal Shrapnel not only works well as ammunition but it makes for great armored plating. I'll need iron and steel, as much as you can, from the Ebil monsters in /Orchestra.

quests.name: Taking Life from the Unliving
quests.description: Here, take this ionization trap with you. As you slay the undead in /doomhaven, it will draw their life force into the device. With the energy stored Ebi…we will be able to utilize that life force as an energy source for our ultimate weapon. Hehe! It'll be to die for.

quests.name: Recover Royal Gear
quests.description: Mehehehe! Do me a favor, Hero, and collect any of royal goodies laying around. The Princess dropped gear while she was captured by the dragon. I'll reward you… maybe!

quests.name: Zorbak's Legion: Chapter 1
quests.description: Meh, you remember what to do, right? You should. You love dragons. Slay 7 Zombie Dravir and 6 Zombie Togs to get the dragon eggs.

quests.name: Zorbak's Legion: Eggstreme Plan
quests.description: I need a dragon egg. You need to feel like a Hero. So. Go hero. Find me a dragon egg. I bet one of those Zombie Dravirs has stolen it! Do what you do.

quests.name: Zorbak's Legion: Drac Attack
quests.description: You wouldn't believe WHAT I had to do to raise these spirits and convince them to play along with this little charade for you. But now they are restless. Slay 5 spirits and 5 wisps to keep babies safe. AGAIN.

quests.name: Zorbak's Legion: Undead vs Undead
quests.description: Ahhh, undead. So easy to create, so easy to control. I like it when they get jealous. Means the brainwashing is holding… even without brains. But these are getting a bit TOO into the role, and now THEY are threatening the babies. Take out 5 of each to keep them safe.

quests.name: Zorbak's Legion: Tiny Terrors
quests.description: Meh. Here we are. Again. The finale. Relive your most heroic (and ANNOYING) moment. Defeat the Amityvale villagers and convince them to adopt babies. AGAIN. (Quest available once per login)

quests.name: Sneevilton Construction
quests.description: Mehehe! So YOU want to be a Sneeviltron? Pffft. I can't imagine WHY. Loud, clumsy, and obsessed with boxes. Meh. Well, if you WANT it… you'll need to slay the Sneeviltron in /boxes to get all the pieces of the armor.

quests.name: Take me to Pizza Hutch
quests.description: Pizza is good. Pizza with pineapple on it is better. Pizza with ALL things on it is best. Mehhehehehe. I want pizza. Go get me the ingredients and I'll make it worth your while.

quests.name: Zorbak's Secret Quest: NOT FOR YOU
quests.description: SERIOUSLY?! Did you not SEE the quest title? This quest is NOT for you. But… now that you're here, you might as well be useful. Bring me back the Dragonbone Key from Big Jack Sprat so I can get into my Dead Dragon Cave.

quests.name: Defeat Dread Klunk
quests.description: Your first challenge is to defeat the Horc boss lurking inside the tower. Fight your way through his Horc minions until you find him!

quests.name: Defeat Dread Arradia
quests.description: Lurking inside the tower is a dragon made of crystal. Fight through the crystalline monsters until you find him, and defeat him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Dread Moganth
quests.description: Past all of these elementals is a huge beast made of stone. Find and defeat him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Dread Kathool
quests.description: Is it an octopus? An old god? Either way, it's on the other side of all these fish who are swimming through the air in this giant tower. It must be defeated!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Creel
quests.description: What could be lurking at the top of this spire? You'll have to fight your way through all these nasties and find out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Dread Terror
quests.description: Past these hordes of undead monster is… another undead monster. But, a really big one! It's your duty as a monster hunter to defeat it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Dread Warrior
quests.description: There are a lot of chaos monsters here. You know what that means! Yep - there's something even worse on the other side of them! Find and defeat it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Dread Avatar
quests.description: I've heard rumors that past all these spirits is a huge, ethereal snake! How can any monster hunter pass up the chance to hunt down something like that?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Dread Fang
quests.description: What's that reptilian screeching up ahead? It sounds like some sort of huge dragon. Better fight through all of these icy nasties and find it! It's dragon slaying time!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Slugbutter
quests.description: Alright, this is it. Are you ready? Are you ready to find out what awaits you deep within the bowels of this tower? Fight your way through the underground marsh… and defeat whatever monster you discover.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Eternity Blade
quests.description: So, you want to hunt for the Eternity Blade, do you? All I can tell you is, it's rumored to be on one of the "boss" monsters somewhere in the Tower of Doom. You could find it on any of them, but the tougher the boss, the higher your chances of finding it will be.
quests.requirements_note: Must be at least Level 30.

quests.name: Reclaim The Spirits
quests.description: Trolls gather old stones for silly reasons. These lives be trapped in stone for ages for Trolls try to free them from they home. Collect 10 Burried Fossils and 3 Hidden Fossils so us can put back in ground!

quests.name: K'thurr Hocestra
quests.description: Music big part of Horc life. We sing to mountain spirit, sing when we happy, when we sad. Need some things to repair horcestra instruments. Zot need 15 Trollala Leaves, 10 Vulture Bones, and 1 flask River Water. You get for me?

quests.name: Zot's Zidar
quests.description: Me love music. Horc music not like any other music. To make real Horc music you need Zidar like mine. Me can make you one. Do job for me and me give you one as soon as me finish it. Gather 2 Gold Boar Teeth and 3 Iron Rhison jaws then bring to I.

quests.name: It Not Time Yet
quests.description: You want to learn eclipse tradition. Can be taught. But first, you work. You do task, help me. After, I help you, teach lore. Need Lemurphant Stones and Koalion Down-fur from crossroads. Lemurphant eats mountain skin, then leaves in piles. We use in rituals. Must polish with Koalion fur.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Troll Stink! ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Chaorruption Detection
quests.description: I am linked to mountain now. Bring me relics from each creature here. Fur, claws, tusk, stone bits… no matter. Just need to be part of them! I will read it, see if I can find a trace of hidden Chaorruption. Bring back 100 impressions. We see what the mountain show me.

quests.name: Lil' Red
quests.description: So you think you have what it takes to become a Shadowslayer? I want to believe you, really, I do — but I cannot put my full faith in someone who has yet to prove themselves to me. This is not the place nor the time for amateur adventurers… but I'll give ya one chance. Somewhere in Greenguard Forest resides a superior warrior known as Red Hunting Hood. She is an expert when it comes to hunting the creatures in those woods… and if you can convince her to lend you that Big Wolf Slaying Axe of hers, then you might have what it takes to help Darkovia out, afterall…

npc.name: His Bark is Worse Than His Blight

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' His Bark is Worse Than His Blight ' quest.

quests.name: A Dire Situation
quests.description: These lands are infested with carnivorous mammals known as Dire Wolves. Despite my best efforts to keep them at bay, the wolves keep multiplying, making safe travel impossible. An enemy of both the Lycan and the Vampire kin, the Dire Wolves need to be controlled one way… or another. You're going to be that other way; go forth and take out as many Dire Wolves as you can. Bring me back 8 Dire Pelts to prove that you were successful. Please hurry—we haven't much time…

npc.name: His Bark is Worse Than His Blight

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' His Bark is Worse Than His Blight ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Blood, Sweat, and Tears
quests.description: Throughout your travels in Lore, I am sure that you've seen some pretty gross things. But nothing can compare to the Blood Maggots that plague these lands. A single Blood Maggot can kill an Alpha Lycan, devouring more blood than any Vampire family buffet. They are ruthless killers and will not be easily stopped. Bring me 3 Vials of Blood, 2 Vials of Sweat, and 1 Vial of Tears from these ruthless maggots, proving to me that you gave it your all.

npc.name: His Bark is Worse Than His Blight

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' His Bark is Worse Than His Blight ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: What a Lich!
quests.description: Dire Wolves and Blood Maggots are nothing in comparison to the monstrosity lingering in the ancient Darkovian ruins. It is known by Lich of the Stone… a horrible arch lich empowered by the darkest force in Lore— the force known as Chaos. Its origin is unknown, and the longer it resides in Darkovia, the more dangerous it becomes. Defeat the Lich and bring me its book, the Necrompendium. Perhaps then we can both understand its motives… and perhaps then you will understand why I became a Shadowslayer in the first place…

npc.name: His Bark is Worse Than His Blight

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' His Bark is Worse Than His Blight ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Search and Report
quests.description: You won't be able to stop the Dragon's transformation until you gain access to Wolfwing's lair in the mountainside. Go investigate the Chaos Gate and see what you can find out. Return to me once you have checked it out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have defeated Edvard . Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Key is the Key!
quests.description: The Chaos Door requires a key. I spotted Wolfwing giving the key to one of his minions earlier but they all look the same to me. See if you can find the one that has the key. Return to me when you have found the Key of the Chaos Gate.
quests.requirements_note: Must have defeated Edvard . Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Secret Words
quests.description: Another layer of security! Wolfwing is the king of paranoia town, I guess. It has some sort of Chaos spell on it and it needs a password to activate the key! One of the Werepyre minions must know the password. Defeat werepyres until you find the password to activate the key!
quests.requirements_note: Must have defeated Edvard . Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dracowerepyre
quests.description: The key is glowing! It should work now. Get inside Wolfwing's Lair and stop him from transforming that dragon into the next Chaos Beast!
quests.requirements_note: Must have defeated Edvard . Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hounds and Infernals and Imp, Oh my!
quests.description: Well, ﬁrst things ﬁrst - there are a LOT of Infernals tearing up Doomwood! The ones wielding the Celestial weapons - the knights and other humanoids - seem to have moved on after the initial attack. But all these Hounds and Imps came through behind them, and aren‘t going away. Help me put a dent in their numbers. would you?

quests.name: Like Imps in A Pod
quests.description: The imps, or - I guess maybe the hounds, I don't know - seem to be leaving organic pods on the ground. They look like some sort of egg sac, or chrysalis. If we let them hatch, the forest will be even more overrun than it already is! We'll need to destroy them before the larvae emerge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Grievous Threat
quests.description: There's one more thing I need you to take care of. One of the stronger Infernals stayed behind when the others forged ahead, and it will need to be slain if we're to prevent further destruction You're just the hero for the job! Travel east as far as you can go, and you'll ﬁnd this Grievous Fiend.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Undead Investigation
quests.description: Ok, I can hold the fort here for now. But we need to ﬁgure out what‘s prompted this strange invasion! I know. I know - you don‘t think the Vampires are behind it. But that doesn't mean we shouldn't look into the situation over there! Head to Saﬁria‘s Castle and see if you can ﬁnd someone to talk to. Either we'll ﬁnd out they are responsible, or we‘ll be able to eliminate them as a suspect.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: To Banish A Banshee
quests.description: There's only one way to banish a banshee - make contact with it and find out what it wants! I heard the roadies say that they saw it in the rafters while they were setting up, so lets look for it there first.

quests.name: Remains of a Song: Fear
quests.description: The dance floor is full of vampires! If anyone has those missing songs, it must be them! Fight them until you find the remains of a song killed by fear.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Remains of a Song: Insecurity
quests.description: The most common death of all: a song that never sees the light of day because its composer worries that it isn't good enough. Finding the remains of a song killed by insecurity shouldn't be hard. I bet you can even find a few.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Remains of a Song: Envy
quests.description: A song killed by envy is constantly compared to songs written by other people, and judged harshly for not being the same. It shouldn't be hard to find one of these.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Remains of a Song: Greed
quests.description: Some songs get killed by greed - they're good songs, but they'll never be a hit single, so they get dropped from the album and forgotten. Every band has a few of these, though it's not always their choice to make the cuts. I'm sure that songbook had more than one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Unseeing
quests.description: It looks like those spooky boys were collecting dead songs for a powerful vampire called The Unseeing - and now that we've taken them all back, we've got his attention! Find him in the bleachers, and stop him before he drains all of these music fans!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: What Kills Fear?
quests.description: These lycans are going to tear through the crowd! You'd better stop them. Fight them until you find something strong enough to bring one of these songs back to life. What is it that helps you kill your fear?

quests.name: What Kills Insecurity?
quests.description: Keep going - we still have songs to resurrect! What is it that makes your insecurities melt away? Fight these lycans until you find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What Kills Envy?
quests.description: When you envy other people, what is it that reminds you of who you are? Keep fighting, and I…m sure you'll find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What Kills Greed?
quests.description: What about greed? When other people try to stop you because what you're doing isn't profitable enough… what carries you through anyway? Go out and find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Conquer Your Fears
quests.description: These lycans are NOT our friends - and now their leader has come to stop us! He's in the bleachers overlooking us all! With all your courage, passion, conviction and persistence, he doesn't stand a chance! Go get him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Stringing Along
quests.description: For the perfect "axe", we're going to need a set of perfect strings. I bet you can get some from, uhh… those stringwraiths.

quests.name: Whammy Time
quests.description: Next up, I need you to find me a whammy bar. Just the one should do. Get it from any of the ghosts floating around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Discordant Music' quest.

quests.name: Stay in Tune
quests.description: I just need one last thing: a set of tuning pegs. I saw some of the Ghostly Rockers carrying them around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Discordant Music' quest.

quests.name: Discordant Music
quests.description: It looks like our little project has NOT gone unnoticed - the Reaper of Dis Chord has come out to try and stop us! If we don't do something fast, those songs will be swept back into the underworld for good. He's in the bleachers - go get him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Play that Axe
quests.description: We've got the Axe of Song - time to show this ghost who's boss! Get up on stage and play her a guitar solo she'll never forget!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

items.name: Chained Mosh Pit Champion Character Page Badge

quests.name: Star of the Wild
quests.description: We have little time. We will need four star fragments that the Astrium have hidden for safety. With these we can hide the Sol and Luna again. The first fragment, the Star of the Wild is hidden on the monster Wisteria in the /guru forest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sol ' quest.

quests.name: Star of the Seas
quests.description: The next fragment is the Star of the Seas. You will find it hidden on the merdraconian, Marianus, in the /natatorium deep within Arcangrove.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Star of the Earth
quests.description: The next fragment is called the Star of the Earth. Deep inside the /pines near Dwarfhold, you will find a clan of Pine Trolls. One of the Pine Trolls will have this star hidden on him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Star of Flames
quests.description: The final fragment is called the Star of Flames. This will probably be the most difficult to obtain as it is hidden on a great Greenguard Dragon in the /greendragon cave in western Greenguard forest. Please, take care. We NEED this fragment to cast the spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Star of the Wild
quests.description: We have little time. We will need four star fragments that the Astrium have hidden for safety. With these we can hide the Sol and Luna again. The first fragment, the Star of the Wild is hidden on the monster Wisteria in the /guru forest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Luna ' quest.

quests.name: Star of the Seas
quests.description: The next fragment is the Star of the Seas. You will find it hidden on the merdraconian, Marianus, in the /natatorium deep within Arcangrove.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Star of the Earth
quests.description: The next fragment is called the Star of the Earth. Deep inside the /pines near Dwarfhold, you will find a clan of Pine Trolls. One of the Pine Trolls will have this star hidden on him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Star of Flames
quests.description: The final fragment is called the Star of Flames. This will probably be the most difficult to obtain as it is hidden on a great Greenguard Dragon in the /greendragon cave in western Greenguard forest. Please, take care. We NEED this fragment to cast the spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Black Friday Collection Chest Pet
quests.description: Head deep into the Underworld and take on the first Dark Makai you find. Bring me back on Dark Makai skull to unlock your Dark Holiday Collection character page badge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Midnight Mochi in your inventory.

items.name: 2019 Dark Holiday Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Musical Crystals
quests.description: The sounds of the rainforest whether from animal or weather, are inspiration for some of the greatest music. My people love music and I have learned the most beautiful music magic. Bring me 13 Tonal Crystals and 13 Music on the Breeze from Air Crystals, Living Air and Wind Elementals.

quests.name: We Didn't Start the Fire
quests.description: Outsiders! Always meddling where they are not wanted, bringing in things that do not belong! My people are already dwindling, yet they still come! They will regret the day they started this war! I will not rest until the forests of my home are drowned in their blood. Kill the Living Fires and the Sulfur Imps to harvest 15 seeds of Flaming Rage.

quests.name: Pay Homage to a Foreign God
quests.description: My home… Yes, theses are tears. Look long and understand the true pride of one's home and people! The carvings of the temple column makes my heart long for home. I shall bless it with lights. I need you to go out and capture 15 8 ball lightnings so I can create the lights to hang on it. Also 3 Breaths of Light from the Wind Elementals to make the lights dance!

quests.name: Clash to a Cure
quests.description: I have learned of the perfect weapon to bring home to my people. Know that you have brought me one step closer to gaining the freedom of my people. I seek out flaming tornados to send those outsiders running for their lives. Kill Living Fire and Living Air and bring back the components.

quests.name: Sulfur Pure
quests.description: I am back and I have learned something new, something wonderful. I've discovered a weapon to use to keep those outsider away. Sulfur can be made into a weapon of great power! Gather sulfuric fumes from the Sulfur Imps around here and bring it back to me.

quests.name: Remember Your Quest
quests.description: I overheard you talking to the rest of the village. You NEED to be focused on helping your friends. Get back to the Forge, but make sure there aren't any monsters left between here and Cysero's Forge-Kitchen to threaten your friends! *small smile* I… I hope you have some dessert for me! And watch out for that nasty Baron!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Missing Servant ' quest.

quests.name: Hunt for the Amulet
quests.description: I want to show you what happened here, but I cannot focus on that until I recover my Amulet. Hunt through Ravenscar until you find it!

quests.name: Do the 'do
quests.description: I didn't plan on being here or doing this… I don't think I have a choice. I'm a construct. But aaaaanywaaaay, I'm going to do my job right! And for that, I'm going to need 3 puffs of Fairy Glitter, 4 Tog Fangs, and 2 tins of Ghost Dust.

quests.name: Business is BOOMing
quests.description: Even golems need to defend themselves in a city like this. I don't know WHY our creator included these monsters, but they can hurt us as much as you. Soooo… I need hair gel-ignite! It will explode in their faces if I can make it right! Bring me 4 balls of Fairy Fluff, 2 drams of Sneak Spit Nitro, and 3 ounces of Spectre Petre!

quests.name: Chronomancing the Stone
quests.description: Au'eir has gone far into the past, and stolen the gnomon from the very first sundial. After bringing it back to the present, he has given it to the Rock Elemental in /bludrut for safekeeping.

quests.name: Hourglass Half Full
quests.description: After retrieving a piece from the first sundial, Au'eir moved forward in time and over to the Sandsea to get a bag full of TimeSand - the best sand in Lore for use in hourglasses. It has been hidden with a Bupers Camel in /sandsea - go and get it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Quartz Past Twelve
quests.description: The next item on Au'eir's list was a Vibration Quartz that was used to power a clock in the Hall of Chronomancers. It seems like he hid it somewhere in /undergroundlabb. Check anything that could pass off as quartz!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spring Forward a Few Minutes
quests.description: Au'eir has been busy! It looks like he has stolen some ChronoCorruptor Springs and given them to a Shadowscythe in /thespan. Locate them and bring them here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Nickel for Everytime That Happened
quests.description: If I had a nickel for every time Au'eir separated the nickel from a clock battery, I would have one nickel. Which isn't a lot, but it's weird that I would have one for something like that! It looks like he fused it with an Ore Balboa in /mountainpath. Do me a favor and separate from it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Back to the Present
quests.description: The last thing on our list is Periodic Plutonium that powered an atomic clock. It looks like Au'eir gave it to a Hydra that has since turned Radioactive! Go to /worldsoul and put it down to retrieve the Plutonium and we can finally put a stop to Au'eir's plan!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stop Au'eir
quests.description: This is it! Face off against Au'eir and stop him from summoning Chronocide!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Chronocide
quests.description: Chronocide threatens to destroy all of time before and after this year! Our only hope to save everything is to stop it here and now! Buy me some time, so that I can prepare to seal it away again!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Chronocide Prime
quests.description: Because we are in the Archipelago, Chronocide is bound to be stronger than when we fought it before! It's going to take all you've got to take it down this time!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Time Ritual (Misc) in your inventory.

quests.name: Fighting Phoenix Blades (Klunk)
quests.description: Show me your hard earned Crystal Phoenix Blade and I'll reward you with Phoenix Blades that fight for you! For a small price of course…
quests.requirements_note: Must have Crystal Phoenix Blade of Nulgath in your inventory.

items.name: Guardian Crystal Phoenix Blade of Nulgath

quests.name: Nulgath's Roulette of Misfortune
quests.description: Are the sneevils not giving you what you want? Oh boo-hoo, relics and trinkets are mere toys, what did you expect? Raw mana however, is something to be sought after. Bring me some Mana Energy from the Mana Golem and Charged Mana from the creatures in/elemental, and I'll let you spin MY wheel. I've narrowed its prizes down to the most valuable.

quests.name: Nulgath (Klunk)
quests.description: (This quest subject to change)

quests.name: Valoth Pet Quest
quests.description: This Mini Mecha Valoth creature wants to get back to his master. Go *ask* the Shadowscythe in /MQlesson zone for the Shadowscythe Ship Summoning token!
quests.requirements_note: Must own Mini Valoth Mech in your inventory. Note: Quests are available only to the owner.

quests.name: Feels like a Dream
quests.description: I need to find my William, but my head is full of fog. All I have is this torn piece of ticket. If I could find the other pieces, maybe I'd remember where William has gone.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Follow the Footprints ' quest OR the ' Quite the Problem ' quest at least once. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Give me a Ticket
quests.description: Now I have the left side of my ticket, and the right side. But I'm still missing the middle, you see? I can't read what it says. I think… I think I remember a bird snatching it out my hand. Maybe one of the crows has the rest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: For an Elephant Ride?
quests.description: It's a ticket for an elephant ride! Is that where I was supposed to meet William? Please, can you help me find where the elephants are?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Trainers
quests.description: No one's here! I don't understand. Maybe if you ask some of the elephant trainers, they'll be able to tell you where William went… What do you mean, you don't see them? They're right here! Go back out the way we came in, you'll see what I mean.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Tumblers!
quests.description: This piece of fabric you found… it doesn't look like the costumes the elephant trainers wear. Where have I seen it before? Oh… that's right! It looks like it came from the acrobat costumes! Maybe William is watching them perform. Go find them, I'll meet you there!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Head to the Midway
quests.description: Why did the acrobats attack us? Do you think they've kidnapped William! Yes… that must be what happened!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Balloons
quests.description: I'm grateful that you would assault people just to help me find my sweetheart. But I've remembered a bit more now, and I don't think they took him. We were playing a game… throwing darts at balloons to collect prize tickets. He was going to win a teddy bear for me. Let me watch you play for awhile… maybe it will help me remember more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Out of the Shadows
quests.description: We… finished playing the game. But he didn't win. My memory is getting cloudy again. Those shadows and imps are what's keeping me from remembering, I think. Why don't tehy want me to remember? Bring me their darkness and shadow. I'll shape it into something useful, instead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Follow the Footprints
quests.description: The shadows you brought me have become dark footprints, and they're heading east. Is that where we went after we finished playing games? We should follow them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Bright Idea
quests.description: Go to the Science Shop and speak to Cysero and Warlic. They will have figured out some way to balance you out. Please, let me know what they say.

quests.name: Spare Parts
quests.description: These evil little moglins have been testing the town's defenses for weeks now, using every kind of contraption imaginable. There must be some spare parts lying around town that Warlic and Cysero can use.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Power It Up
quests.description: Warlic has "batteries" on this list. The moglins use those to power all of their weapons and assault machines. I'm sure that you will be able to find several of them. All we need is 4 of them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Filthy Creatures
quests.description: Only one item left, a polarized magna-gem. Warlic has a crate of them but the moglins broke in and stole them to trade for machine parts. They might still have one or two. I'll help you look; whoever finds one first, bring it back here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Quiz the Locals
quests.description: Hero, we need to know where the Cockatrice has taken the Egg! Gravelyn the Good, Bardolph, and Warlic have already started hunting around the area. Go talk to them and see if they're found anything useful.

quests.name: Slay the Minions
quests.description: The Cockatrice has gathered a following of undead to guard it as it regains strength! Slay 8 Undead Minions until this dungeon falls silent!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: Free the Fallen
quests.description: It appears the Cockatrice is not intent on merely toying with souls -- it enthralls the spirits of our own fallen brethren so as to force them to fight us! Bring back 6 Last Oaths as proof of the Paladins' departure.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: Shining a Light
quests.description: In order to weaken the Cockatrice, we must allow light to enter this unhallowed place. If you can find a way to let light into the rooms of the dungeon and destroy the shadows (and their imps), I would be most grateful.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: Break the Doors Down
quests.description: Our moment of judgement is nearly at hand! Break down the doors leading into the main chamber so we can end this beast once and for all and rescue the Egg!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: The Best vs The Beast
quests.description: This is it, Hero. Face the Cockatrice on one-on-one combat and vanquish the monster from our land! I know you are capable of such a feat — the fate of both our worlds depends on your victory!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: Purifying the Undying
quests.description: Hero, the trace of darkness still lingers here and across the Mirror Realm. Bring me 1 Painadin Overlord's Axe, then go to /reddeath and collect 5 Grim Widow Mandibles, 8 Evil Moglin Chainsaws and 6 Fire Leech Hearts to purify, in order to help drive darkness away from these ruins and restore them to their former glory.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Go To Sleep
quests.description: The Cockatrice may be gone, but the haunted still lurk in the dungeon! Bring back 10 Minion Skulls and 3 Paladin Totems for me to send their souls to the Overworld.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed 'The Best vs The Beast' quest.

quests.name: Understanding the Shadows
quests.description: As a Legend, I ask you to explore the dark dungeon and find 1 Mantle of Shadow, 1 Shadow Serpent Scythe, 5 Midnight Claws, so as for us to gain a greater understanding of Darkness and learn how to combat it in the future.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed 'The Best vs The Beast' quest.

quests.name: Death after Death
quests.description: Slaying the undead is one battle - the hard part is ensuring that they stay down. Bring back 8 Undead Minion Weapons, 1 Find Claw and 5 Undead Paladin Helms as proof of your success in battle.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed 'The Best vs The Beast' quest.

quests.name: Heart of Servitude
quests.description: For your first task, you will need to serve those in need. Help the Deadmoor Spirit Mallora by defeating the banshee that plagues the Deadmoor Spirit, complete Polish's final quest in /citadelruins, learn the truth of Ravenscar from Mina's Ghost, and buy the Dreadrock Donation Receipt from Deathgore in /dreadrock. Finally, retrieve the Pristine Blades of Order armor from the Chaos Knight in /watchtower.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50.

quests.name: Spirit of Justice
quests.description: Rules exist to create order. When rules are broken, the offender faces punishment— either rehabilitation or vindication. Warden Elfis in /dwarfprison, Piggy Drake in /prison, Mysterious Stranger in /mysteriousdungeon, and Calico Cobby in /dreammaster have all imprisoned heroes under false pretenses. Show them the errors of their ways, and give them a taste of what justice ought to be!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Purification of Chaos
quests.description: I see you are still tainted by chaos. To purge what remains, defeat the Ultra Chaos Warlord in /chaosboss, the Chaorruption in /shadowgates, and collect 15 Chaoroots from defeating Lords of Chaos. Finally, to purify this drawn-out chaos, bring me 45 Purified Raindrops from the /stormtemple clouds above ThunderForge -- though Chaos Lord Lionfang will fight to stop you from collecting them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

items.name: Lord of Order Double Wings + Wrap (Quest)

quests.name: Steadfast Will
quests.description: Defeat the largest foes of your world to prove that you have what it takes to prevail against seemingly impossible odds. Obtain the Gaiazor's Cornerstone in /gaiazor, the Crystal of Dakka the Dire Dragon, a fragment from Andre's necklace, and the skull of Desolich. Once you have proven your strength of will, I will begin teaching you the techniques befitting a Lord of Order.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Strike of Order
quests.description: Hero, you have proven yourself worthy of learning the skills of a Lord of Order. The first skill, Strike of Order, uses the focused power of order to vanquish the forces of chaos. Bring me the weapons that defeated some of the most powerful beings in Lore and I will show you the power they hide within.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Harmony
quests.description: Study the energies of life from the Tree of Destiny in /elemental, learn harmony from Faust in /orchestra, and understand unity through teamwork by battling the Pactagonal Knights in /cathedral. Once you have done that, return to me with a Scroll of Enchantment from the Queen's Archsage in /goose and we will craft the spell together.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ordinance
quests.description: Lord of Order must oppose uprising against any figure of authority -- war, turmoil, revolution… all lead only to chaos. Suppress the war- bringing Drows in /wardwarf, Undead in /warundead, Horcs in /warhorc, and Weavers in /weaverwar. Then, I will show you a spell to strengthen you allies. Bring me the Strength of Resilience from Extriki in /extriki and an Acolyte's Braille from a Chaos Healer in /newfinale.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Axiom
quests.description: Some truths cannot be disputed -- laws that govern our world. Return when you understand the Law of Nature from the Guardian Spirit in /elfhame, Time from the Kathool in /deepchaos, Gravity from Shadowstone Support in /necrocavern, Relativity from the Reflecteract in /blackholesun, Conservation of Energy from Tonitru in /thunderfang, and the Law of Low Drop Rates from the Red Dragon in /lair (I hope you're patient for that one!).
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blessing of Order
quests.description: Gather 15 Weapon Imprints from Undead Raxgore, 5 Inversion Infusions from Serepthys, and a Lure of Order from Faith in /greenguardwest. This is a complicated spell that requires a particularly rare form of unstable mana energy, which is why you'll also need to acquire some from one of the most unstable entities your world has known: Ultra Xiang.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Final Challenge
quests.description: You are ready to become one of my Lords of Order, but now you must… defeat me in combat! Not this "me" though -- the OTHER me. Challenge and defeat the Champion of Chaos in /ultradrakath to complete your training, and accept your newfound strength as a Lord of Order!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

items.name: Lord of Order King Alteon's Morph
Lord of Order King Alteon's Crown

quests.name: Invasion!
quests.description: That invasion you came to warn us about? It's already started. Grab your weapon and help me fend them off!

quests.name: Rescue Needed
quests.description: I can hear people screaming for help. I'll hold the front here… can you see if you can find them and rescue them?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get their Intel
quests.description: It's concerning that some of these invading forces seem to already have intel on the Mirror Realm. Find out what they know, and if there's anything in writing, confiscate it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clue me in
quests.description: The things they knew… no outsider could have found all of this out so quickly. I hate having to admit this, but… I think they might be from HERE. Do some investigating and see what you can find out. Be sure to get clues from as many sources as you can.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: So Familiar
quests.description: The militia seems to be taking its orders from a handful of ShadowFlame Paladins lurking nearby. Something about their armor looks familiar… but I don’t want to jump to conclusions. Bring me a few pieces of it so I can confirm… or hopefully deny… my suspicions.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Protect the Light
quests.description: We must protect what little remains of Brightfall's light before it becomes corrupted by shadow. Collect what you can find and bring it back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' So Familiar ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Fend them Off
quests.description: We must protect Brightfall… and Gravelyn! Fend off as many of her corrupted former allies as you can.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' So Familiar ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get the Keys
quests.description: So far there's no sign of Gravelyn. The throne room is locked, and that may be where she's hiding… hopefully with what's left of her people. We have to get inside! Her guards have keys to the locks. If you can find five of them, we can unlock the door ourselves.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' So Familiar ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unlock the Door
quests.description: If we insert all five of the keys you found into the lock at the same time, the door will open.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' So Familiar ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Gravelyn
quests.description: No matter what she’s done, Gravelyn is still a friend. Try not to hurt her too badly.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' So Familiar ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Restoring Order
quests.description: Hero, the balance of light and dark has been drastically thrown off in Brightfall. I’d like to try restoring it to a stable state, before it becomes disastrous. Could you assist me in collecting some light and dark energies to use?

quests.name: The Situation
quests.description: We need to know more about the current situation, friend, if we want to win this battle. Fight the Militia and see what intel you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Gravelyn ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Study In Shadow
quests.description: I'd like to study the wands these Shadowflame Sorcerers use. I have a feeling they could give us an advantage in this war. Bring me some if you can. I only need a few.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Gravelyn ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Precision Strike
quests.description: If we want to cripple this army, we will have to take out its captains. We won't be able to tell who they are by sight, but once they're slain, we will know them by the tags they carry. Come back to me when you've found them all.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Gravelyn ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pants On Fire
quests.description: It's total chaos out there! All of these shadowy flames have caught the town on fire. Put them all out, and stop them from burning it all down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Gravelyn ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Scared of the Dark
quests.description: Shadowy traps have started to appear in the village, and people have gotten lost in them. Go inside the traps and rescue the trapped villagers. You may need to kill whatever is in there with them to set them free.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Gravelyn ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Go Bye-Bye
quests.description: We cannot let anyone else get trapped in those pits! Destroy the shadow traps so they can't take any more of our people.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Gravelyn ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Essential Oils
quests.description: Remember those wands I had you steal from the Shadowflame Sorcerers? I think we can use them to extract the shadow from these attacking beasts. If we can pull this off, we may not have to kill them all. See what you can do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Gravelyn ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What A Mess
quests.description: These rampaging beasts have done a TON of damage - and some of the civilians are trapped under the wreckage! Help me free them all.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Gravelyn ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Prosciutto!
quests.description: Those beasts are raiding the villages's supply of meat! We can't let these people go hungry on top of everything else. Please, help me bring back their food.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Gravelyn ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Blight On Us All
quests.description: That monster Xing has set loose is on the rampage - it’s going to kill everyone! If anyone here has a chance of stopping it, it’s you. Don’t worry, I’ve got your back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Gravelyn ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Unending Blight
quests.description: The Blight may be defeated, but it is not eliminated. Before it rises to power again, hero, do you think you could teach it a bit of a… lesson?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Blight On Us All ' quest.

quests.name: The Dragon
quests.description: Come on, hero. My Lords of Order will take care of the Shadowflame army. You and I will handle the dragon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return to Iadoa ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Craft a Better Defense
quests.description: If you are going to survive the battle against the Chaos Harpy, you'll need a very strong ward! Find Alina in the Battleon. She will give you the recipe for a Shriekward Potion!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Still Too Fragile ' quest.

quests.name: Reflect the Damage
quests.description: To make the Shriekward Potion which will protect you, collect 5 Reflective Fragments from the Shard Spinners from the Earthstorm realm for a chance at a Perfect Prism.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Still Too Fragile ' quest. | Must have completed the 'Craft a Better Defense' quest.

quests.name: Pure Chaos, Corrupted Blood
quests.description: To make the Shriekward Potion which will protect you, collect 5 Vials of Blood from the Chaorrupted creatures in the Bloodtusk war for a chance at an Unchaorrupted Sample.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Still Too Fragile ' quest. | Must have completed the 'Craft a Better Defense' quest.

quests.name: Enemies of a Feather Flock Together
quests.description: To make the Shriekward Potion which will protect you, journey to the Bloodtuskwar zone to collect 5 feathers from Vultragons for a chance at a Harpy Feather.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Still Too Fragile ' quest. | Must have completed the 'Craft a Better Defense' quest.

quests.name: Ward Off The Beast
quests.description: If you wish to survive your battle with the Chaos Harpy, you'll need to protect yourself against its shrieks. Turn in all 3 ingredients to Alina and you will receive a stack of 10 Shriekward Potions
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Still Too Fragile ' quest. | Must have completed the 'Craft a Better Defense' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Horror Takes Flight
quests.description: Battle the 2nd Beast of Chaos: the Harpy, to prevent it from terrorizing the innocent citizens of Lore!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Still Too Fragile ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once

quests.name: Good, Evil, and Chaos Battle!
quests.description: Battling a Chaos Lord who wants to kill AND save you will be tricky! Protect yourself and attack whenever the opportunity arises, or you'll be the first victim to fall to Chaos Lord Xiang!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Still Too Fragile ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once

quests.name: Slay the Wraiths
quests.description: Your time travel technique could use some work. The path you took through the space-time continuum has left an opening for Time Wraiths to come through. You know the danger they pose, do you not? Take responsibility for your error and slay them all.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Oooommm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Spacetime
quests.description: There's a lot of Spacetime Energy floating around now. Gather a good amount of it, and then use it to close the rift you've left.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Oooommm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find Khasaanda
quests.description: Find Khasaanda. She, too, will know that you're here… and she will understand why. With her guidance, I will be able to make a decision on where we go from here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Oooommm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be turned in from Mirror Khasaanda .

quests.name: Find the Heart
quests.description: This forest is under attack, infested with the undead minions of the Army of Evil. Slay them and bring me their hearts so I can be certain they will not come back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Khasaanda ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Ooh, That Smell
quests.description: Rid the forest of elemental evil. It has become so strong here… that only happens when the world is out of balance. Help me get rid of it - collect it from any evil monster, and bring it back to me so the forest may heal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Khasaanda ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: So Twisted
quests.description: Do you see how the world itself is becoming ill? The imbalance has made the forest and the trees within it twisted. Destroy the treeants that have been tainted with this evil.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Khasaanda ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Purifying Flames
quests.description: We must purify the remains of those tainted treeants by burning them in a cleansing fire. This will ensure that they do not taint the ground when they return to it. Collect Purified Oil from the treeants that haven't been corrupted yet. Then, pour it on the woodpile and light it on fire.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Khasaanda ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Return to Iadoa
quests.description: We should return to Iadoa now. I will let him know what I have seen, and what I believe we should do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Khasaanda ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be turned in to Mirror Iadoa .

quests.name: Padma
quests.description: Could I ask you a favor? La and Ti aren't finished teaching me how to read yet. Would you please read the names on Judgement's scroll for me? I'm curious about why some of them are crossed out with red and others are crossed out in white. Watch out for those hands trying to grab you while you're distracted.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kalasutra ' quest.

quests.name: Maharaurava
quests.description: Are you able to hear the music the Trumpeters are playing? They're calling sinners to be judged so only the guilty would be able to hear them. My music won't be able to drown them out so you'll have to smack some of them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kalasutra ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Raurava
quests.description: Judgement is also calling on the deceased Astravians to their duty as jurors. But to Darkon and the Scale, all Astravians are sinners. I think the roles are conflicting and making them run wild. Aah, one hit my guitar! Please help me shove them away!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kalasutra ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Avici
quests.description: Who are those humans and why are they allowed to be on Judgement's scroll? Oh no, you know them. Their names are among the deceased. Don't fall for it, they're not real! I'll play my music louder so you can't hear them. You have to move past these shades!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kalasutra ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

items_required.name: Head to the top of Judgement's Scroll

quests.name: Mahapadma
quests.description: When La sets her mind on a goal, there's no stopping her. But, I don't think she wants to raise a hand against you. Please don't hurt her either. We can stop and figure it out together!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kalasutra ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Storied Vow
quests.description: This was La's home, and she wanted to return so badly. I didn't know it was because she wanted to save all of the humans that lived here too. Maybe the Astravians would want the same. I want to make a landmark that'll be here even if everything else crumbles away.

quests.name: Between Two Worlds
quests.description: I'll be taking a stroll through the streets of Atlas like I did when King Zedek first took my hand. May we speak to Yara and Slaine before we go? I want to know their perspectives as we raise our blades at the same monster.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Prota Sparasso ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Exodus of Dust
quests.description: Atlas and the Legion are brutalizing each other. My former subjects believe that they have the upper hand. Let your attendants herald destruction, and show these Knights and Mages your wrath.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Prota Sparasso ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Impeccable Judgement
quests.description: The scholars who once welcomed me with false smiles are panicking, desperately turning to magic to save themselves. What remains of Ladon is nearby, struggling to hang on despite the loss of his body. Give them all what they deserve.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Prota Sparasso ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Koinà Tà Phílon
quests.description: The Legionnaires have brought an urgent message from General Rand. He asks that you visit him in the colosseum. He is guarding something of great importance that belongs to Dage the Evil. We must ensure that it is properly protected.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Prota Sparasso ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What Walks Ought to Crawl
quests.description: It's time to make our way back to the castle. Atlas' civilians and lions are prowling the streets. Their presence is binding the souls of the Legion. They stand when they ought to crawl. I beseech you, your Eminence. Rend these animals to dust.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Prota Sparasso ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Vene Vidi Vici
quests.description: The Legion's Crimson Rider awaits you at the gates to the castle. He is the Horseman of War, trampling on the bones of the weak. He was sloppy, and left some alive. Speak to War, and wipe the rest of his plate clean.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Prota Sparasso ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Exocannibalism
quests.description: Executioner Ladon's followers stole the bodies and strength of Draconians. They terrorized my companions before brutally taking their lives. They should die in terror, groveling at the feet of a true Dragon. Your Eminence, please…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Prota Sparasso ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Condemnatio Purgatorio
quests.description: The Legion has made good on their promise. Atlas' numbers are culled, and many are left without vessels. Their Sundered Souls are drifting through the castle's halls. Condemn them to wander forever lost, and do the same to the cowardly Citizens that remain.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Prota Sparasso ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Miserum Votum
quests.description: Atlas' final Princess stands in your way. I treated her like my own daughter, and she led me by the nose, knowing I was carrying her father's new vessel. Strike her down with divine retribution. Maleagant awaits beyond, still wearing Dage's armor.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Prota Sparasso ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dante to Beatrice
quests.description: General Slaine dragged Zedek out onto the roof of the castle. I hear him and Miss Yara trading blows. Your Eminence, there is no one left standing between Zedek and your divine judgement. I hope this hurts. I hope his pain lasts forever.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Prota Sparasso ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Oh Anima Effimera
quests.description: Before Atlas sinks into the depths of the sea, taking its foul deeds and memories with it…will you help me leave King Zedek and the dreams he ruined behind? I will not die, but I want to lay to rest what went unsaid.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dante to Beatrice ' quest.

quests.name: Three Water Chestnuts
quests.description: Have you ever had a water chestnut? They are a favorite delicacy among the citizens of Akiba. Myself included. I have been craving water chestnuts every since we last met… and I was hoping if you could go find me some? The Yokai River is just east of here, and the Kappa and Funa-yurei there should know where to get some succulent water chestnuts… if they don't already have some themselves. Bring me back 3 Bushels of Water Chestnuts and I will reward you handsomely.

quests.name: Rainbow Shards
quests.description: I'm always up fer a trade. Bring me 5 tuffs of Prismatic Rat Fur From the Rainbow Rats in the Rainbow area and I'll give ye a Rainbow Shard!

quests.name: Lucky Clovers
quests.description: Looking for a Lucky Clover or two? Or twelve? If you bring 1 single Clover Leaf from Lucky Harms in the Rainbow area, I will trade you for a Lucky Clover! (Quest is only available if you do not do Reclaim the Research in the same day)

quests.name: Rainbow Shards - Leprechauns Only
quests.description: Ah, ye have the original Leprechaun Class on ye? Alright, I have a special quest for ye! Bring me 1 single tuft of Prismatic Rat Fur from the Rainbow Rats in the Rainbow area and I'll give ye a Rainbow Shard!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Leprechaun in your inventory.

quests.name: Lucky Clovers - Leprechauns Only
quests.description: Always happy to see a Leprechaun at the fair. I have a special offer for ye. If you bring 1 single Clover Leaf from Lucky Harms in the Rainbow area, I'll might give ye 2 Lucky Clovers! (Quest is only available if you do not do Reclaim the Research in the same day)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Leprechaun in your inventory. Note: This quest can only be completed once per day.

quests.name: Get some Pelts
quests.description: Once we go into valley down below, it going to be COLD! Yetis have fur, but you don't - so we have to get you some. There Arctic Wolves just outside our cave. Their pelts would be perfect!

quests.name: Find the Sled
quests.description: It a long way down into the valley, so we have to go by sled. Grab a bag of supplies, then find the Wolf Sled and two Sled Wolves to pull it. After we have those things, we are ready to go!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: It's Sledding Time
quests.description: Now we take sled down into valley! We have to watch out for all the rocks and bushes on the way. Sled wolves won't avoid them on their own, so you have to show them where to go. When you are ready to go, the sled is outside the cave, and to the right.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Gather Peppers
quests.description: Wow! It sure a lot colder down here! Ice Spitters around the lake grow something called Snow Peppers. Despite cold-sounding-name, they very hot! If we eat some, their heat will keep us warm. Bring back 8 of them - that 4 for each of us. That should be enough!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wood for Moknak
quests.description: Chillbite supposed to live on other side of that frozen lake. It not very stable, so we have to use snowshoes to get across it. Moknak can make some, if you bring some sturdy wood. Maybe from Frozen Treeants that wander the area?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cross the Ice
quests.description: We should be able to get across lake now! Like Moknak mentioned before, it not very stable. If you step on a crack, then ice could break, and you end up in freezing, cold water. So, be careful!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Smash the Shards
quests.description: Chill Shards in this area are tiny pieces of Chillbite herself. If we smash enough of them, they reveal path that lead us to where she hiding. That how we'll find her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Make it to the Top
quests.description: Big cloud of frost is leading up that mountain! If we follow it, then we find Chillbite. Chillbite sure to be guarded by big hoard of Ice Golems, so we have to defeat them to make it all the way to top.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Chillbite!
quests.description: This is it! Together, you and Moknak will defeat Chillbite, so she can be born again in time for new year! If we successful, then we full-fledged members of the Yeti tribe! If we don't… well, Moknak not want to think about that.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clueless
quests.description: Me follow rumors from all across Lore to this marsh. Me think that once there was great Mudluk Village here but need proof. Look around. See if you find clues.

quests.name: Filling In The Puzzle
quests.description: Those relics were a good start. They tell a tale of an ancient Mudluk village in this area but story is broken. Me need more fragments to understand. See if monsters in this marsh have more Relics on them!

quests.name: The Eyes (and Teeth) Have It
quests.description: This am no story! This am some sort of schematic! Me not sure but me think, if us follow directions, it will make a kind of compass, murp! Will lead us directly to an ancient Mudluk Weapon! First we need 30 Marsh Lurker Eyes. Come back when U have them all!

quests.name: Halfway There
quests.description: Murp! It working! The compass is coming together. Us just need a few more parts to make compass work! Need more parts. Need Mossy Bones from undead in the marsh and a vial of Shadow Serpent Venom. Come back when U done and me will finish compass.

quests.name: Charge It
quests.description: Great, murp! All that the compass needs now is a charge then us can activate it! To charge U will need positive and negative energies that U can get from defeating Thrax Ironhide and the Lesser Groglurk.

quests.name: What Was That?!
quests.description: That not how most compasses work…and did U hear that big noise? Sounded like something BLEW UP! Go look around and see what U can find.

quests.name: The Mudluk Vault
quests.description: Us not find a weapon…U found a whole VAULT! Please, me have to know what is in there but it will not be safe until the Vault Guardian is gone. You must defeat the Marsh Vault Guardian and make the vault safe!

quests.name: Recovering Mudluk History
quests.description: The Guardian has been defeated! I have to know what's in there! Can U please go and get whatever you can from in there and bring it to I. Me have to get my forge ready!

quests.name: Tempered Scrap
quests.description: Collect 10 Scrap Metals from Undead Berzerkers and transform them into a Tempered Scrap.

quests.name: Crystalized Fernos Shard
quests.description: You can gather 3 Fernos Goo from the Lesser Groglurk and condense them into a Shard of Crystalized Fernos.

quests.name: Ghoul Fire
quests.description: Combine 5 Ghoul Sparks from Ghouls to create a Ghoul Fire.

quests.name: Vault Guardian Heart
quests.description: Get 1 Rough Guardian Knot from the Mudluk Vault Guardian and turn it into a Vault Guardian Heart.

quests.name: Sampling Sips
quests.description: It's been awhile, my friend, and I want to make sure you're as good of a Moglin Berry Juice connoisseur as you once were. Collect 5 of the finest Juice Samplings from the native Moglin Berry Juice Vines to prove your talents.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spook and the Book ' quest.

quests.name: Glow with the Flambeaux
quests.description: We shall journey into the city vaults -- but it is terribly dark and damp down there. We need something to light the way. Find the 2 flame Flambeaux from the Fire Performers in the streets.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nitre Fighter
quests.description: Blast! Nitre formations impede our path to the Amoglinado. Defeat 5 Nitre Elementals and knock down the giant Nitre Crystal wall.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spider Trouble
quests.description: Spiders -- why does it always have to be spiders? Get rid of these 8-legged fiends so that we may sample the finest Moglin Berry Juice known to mankind!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Coat of Harms
quests.description: What has happened here? My family's coat of arms has crumbled to pieces! Click on the pieces among all the bones to put it back together, and then we shall proceed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Break through the Wall
quests.description: What is hidden behind these walls? Could it the Cask of Amoglinado… or perhaps some other treasure? Break apart these walls until you find something.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Search the Bones
quests.description: How curious… that bone pile over there… you should check it out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Bone Terror
quests.description: Defeat the Guardian of the Amoglinado so that my story can be told. You won't be able to escape the book until you do!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Proto-Chaos Beast Battle!
quests.description: You are about to meet the first Proto-Chaos Beast. I do not know more. My Master will need to explain this to you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Akriloth Assault ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: ArcanRobe
quests.description: It takes more than a common needle and thread to craft such magical robes. Here in Arcangrove, the magi use the forces of nature to draw strength from everything… including their armor's stitching. The Seed Spitters in the area sometimes produce Arcane Thread, a great treasure amongst the magi. If you could bring me back 10 Spools of Arcane Thread, I could begin working on the newest mage robes.

quests.name: Ebony and Ivory Tusks
quests.description: You have seen the Gorillaphants in the area, have you not? These powerful beasts have massive tusks capable of ripping the inexperienced magi to shreds. For centuries, the magi have used their Tusks when forging magical weapons and staves, despite how hard it is to obtain them. Of I could just get 6 Gorillaphant Tusks, then I could start crafting new items for all the magi.

quests.name: Through the pass
quests.description: Head up into the mountains to see if you see can confirm that it is getting colder than usual. To do this, you will need to battle your way through the slowly closing mountain passes. If you can, bring back 10 Wolf Pelts so that we can examine them. If it is truly getting colder, the pelts should be thicker than before.

quests.name: Higher Passes
quests.description: The wolves pelts are definitely thicker than before. There are larger beasts than wolves roaming the mountains, but so few people return that we have not been able to get any information about them! Try to get as much information about these monsters as you can, and bring it back to me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Bears?
quests.description: The teeth, claw and pelts that you bought back from the higher passes suggest that the animal is a bear, but it is no bear that we have ever seen! The fur is silver and incredibly thick! See if you can find one of their dens to find out what makes them so special.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: In the Den
quests.description: Now that you have found the bears' den, go inside to see if you can find on them. This would seen to indicate that there are humans living up on the mountains with the bears! Try to find their settlement and get past their guards.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Camp
quests.description: There is an entire camp in the mountains, build around a series of hot springs? This must be how they have been able to survive, even though the weather is getting colder and colder. Perhaps the water in the springs will be able to release the cold from the Keep's stones. Speak to the inhabitants of the village to find out what they think.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Fire from the Hole
quests.description: The Drumlins think that the water from the springs will help thaw the Keeps stones. Unfortunately, the springs are guarded by one of their own, but the water has had an incredible effect on him! Defeat the Ice Drumlinster to get a sack of water.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

npc.name: The Gaol of Eternal Torment and Misery

quests.name: 2.0 No!
quests.description: Mort translation: "Mechabinky & Raxborg have received some upgrades, and are now stronger than ever! You're going to need some help if you want to take them down… hehehehe!"

npc.name: The Gaol of Eternal Torment and Misery

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Gaol of Eternal Torment and Misery ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per week.

quests.name: Drakath Faced
quests.description: You must face Drakath now. Confront him in order to learn the identity of the 13th Lord of Chaos. All of Lore is counting on you!

quests.name: Who is the 13th Lord of Chaos?
quests.description: Confront Drakath to find out who the final Lord of Chaos will be!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Feed Me
quests.description: Bring me a burning heart to feast upon. I may reward you.

quests.name: Let It Grow (Colder)
quests.description: Dage the Evil gives the most promising potential recruits incentives to join the Undead Legion at Frostval… but even THEY have to work for it! Slay Twisted Ice monsters in /FrozenTower and bring back 8 Frozen Life Essences.

quests.name: Legion Quest: Dark Knight of Frostval
quests.description: Twas the Dark Knight of Frostval, who decided to slay / Dage the Evil, believing the Legion's Lord was his prey. Bring back 10 Frozen Life Essences from the Twisted Ice Monsters in /frozentower so that Dage can forge a weapon to destroy him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Legion Quest: Coal for the Legion
quests.description: Good little heroes can expect presents on Frostval morning, but the warriors of the Undead Legion get a more… useful present - coal! They, in turn, gift it to Dage the Evil, to keep his forge fires burning. To thank them, Dage is most generous with the Legion Token rewards. Bring him 10 Giant Coal Lumps and 8 Small Coal Lumps from the monsters in /FrozenTower!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Stairway to Haven
quests.description: The stairway to Haven has been, like, swarmed with monsters! It's not safe to go back up there until some of those monsters are gone. Can you go take care of 4 Grateful Undead and 4 Rock Lobsters for me, mun?

quests.name: Rolling Stones
quests.description: You've heard the saying "A rolling stone gathers no moss"? Well, stationary stones gather LOTS! Those Rock Lobsters keep shifting the mossy stones holding the stairway together around while they are looking for pebbles to eat. We NEED those mossy stones or the Stairway will collapse! Can you get 5 Mossy Stones from the Rock Lobsters and return here?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Quest name is a parody of the band The Rolling Stones .

quests.name: Light My Fire
