quests.description: This information is highly classified. I need to know I can trust you before I tell you more. There are 10 Map Fragments hidden around Akiba. Find them all and I will tell you more….

quests.name: Shades Of Gray
quests.description: Now that you know the story I am relying on you to help me while I stay here and ensure the Emperor and Ai No Miko's protection. The map shows a ROCK near here is the cave entrance. Enter the caves beneath Akiba Palace and explore them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hiding In Shadows
quests.description: We must find a way to lure my shadow out of the darkness. Try defeating his Kage Nopperabo soldiers. Destroying 12 of these shades should get his attention. Let me know what affect it has.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fading Light
quests.description: So the coward still hides. Very well, we will use a more advanced ninja technique but it will take some preperation. I will need you to find a few scraps of the Shadow Cloth that the Kage Nopperabo weave their clothes from. I will only need 3 Shadow Cloth Scaps.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Candles in the Dark
quests.description: I have prepared these special candles to dispel the shadows. Place all 8 of them through the cave, then return here and I will recite the incantation to activate their magic. These should reveal any shadows hiding in the caves.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadow Battle!
quests.description: The candles magic have been released. My shadow should no longer be able to hide in the caves. Meet me in the cave. I will be right behind you but you will not see me. We will face my shadow together and remind him who his master is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tenacity Challenge
quests.description: You say you are a devoted follower of the Archfiend. But do you have the patience and determination required to prove it? I set you an endurance test. Speed and skill will help, but those with the determination to go the distance will find the REAL rewards! Slay 6 Ghastly Darkbloods in the Deathpits and 7 disloyal Bloodfiends in the Underworld, then return to me.

quests.name: Contender Challenge
quests.description: For those who have shown the tenacity and determination to complete my first challenge… the time has come for you to finish the second. You must take down the following three upstarts who would challenge my might. Retrieve 1 Blood Titan head, 1 Desterrat Moya Tentacle, and 1 Ssikari Heart. Return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have the Lesser Bloodbeacon Polearm Item in your inventory.

quests.name: Fighting Phoenix Blades
quests.description: Show me your hard earned Crystal Phoenix Blade and I'll reward you with Phoenix Blades that fight for you! For a small price of course…
quests.requirements_note: Must have Crystal Phoenix Blade of Nulgath in your inventory.

items.name: Guardian Crystal Phoenix Blade of Nulgath

quests.name: Nulgath's Roulette of Misfortune
quests.description: Are the sneevils not giving you what you want? Oh boo-hoo, relics and trinkets are mere toys, what did you expect? Raw mana however, is something to be sought after. Bring me some Mana Energy from the Mana Golem and Charged Mana from the creatures in/elemental, and I'll let you spin MY wheel. I've narrowed its prizes down to the most valuable.

quests.name: New Worlds, New Opportunities
quests.description: Oooh, What an interesting realm my Master found. This land is rich in jewels you would find in… but nevermind that. Bring me some things I want to examine from this world. Maybe I'll hand over some of the things you people consider “valuable". Don't worry, I'll tell you where to find these things for me. The Horns on the helmet adorned by the Cyclops Warlord, in /faerie should do. The rest I'm sure you can figure it out.

quests.name: Combat Style: Soulreaper of Nulgath
quests.description: You wish to learn how to wield your "Soulreaper of Nulgath" with more effectiveness? Your weapon will look the same but you'll swing it like an axe!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragonslayer Reward ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Combat Style: Taro's Manslayer
quests.description: You wish to learn how to dual wield "Taro's Manslayer". For a small price I'll teach you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragonslayer Reward ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Combat Style: Champion of Nulgath
quests.description: You wish to learn how to dual wield your "Champion of Nulgath". For a small price I'll teach you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragonslayer Reward ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Combat Style: Dragonbone Axe
quests.description: You wish to learn how to dual wield "Dragonbone Axe". For a small price I'll teach you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragonslayer Reward ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Combat Style: Tainted Claymore
quests.description: You wish to learn how to dual wield your "Tainted Claymore". For a small price I'll teach you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragonslayer Reward ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Combat Style: Purified Claymore of Destiny
quests.description: Haha! Polish is here? He's no threat to me! For a small price I'll teach you to dual wield his pathetic blade.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragonslayer Reward ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Combat Style: Betrayal Blade of Nulgath
quests.description: So, you think you can wield the Betrayal Blade, hah! You make me laugh. Go on your quest if you must.

quests.name: Combat Style: Dual Betrayal Blade
quests.description: You wish to learn how to dual wield "Betrayal Blade of Nulgath". For a small price I'll teach you.

quests.name: Combat Style: Dread Saw of Nulgath
quests.description: The Primal Dread Saw is no laughing matter. Prove your loyalty and I will consider teaching you.

quests.name: Combat Style: Dual Dread Saw
quests.description: You wish to learn how to dual wield "Dread Saw of Nulgath". For a small price I'll teach you.

items.name: Dual Primal Dread Saw of Nulgath
Dual Primal Dread Saw of Nulgath (Rare)

quests.name: Purchase Drudgen the Assistant
quests.description: Ahh… you wish to hire Drudgen. I've promoted him to part-time salesman for his hard work. He's very social and likes to help everyone around him. A very hard worker if not the brightest. He should be much more useful to you than he was before.

quests.name: Assistance of Nulgath
quests.description: I can see in your eyes you're irritated. Dealing with freeloaders and irritants. How dare they! Who are they to be allowed to win prizes from YOUR minion? Where's YOUR prize? How selfish of them! You're right to be annoyed hero. Lets teach them a lesson.

quests.name: Fired & Re-Hired
quests.description: If you're not satisfied with Crag & Bamboozle's work performance, you should fire them! If I'm not happy with a minions work. I send them to… well… that's not important. Drudgen will be happy to work for you again…. for a price.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 30.

quests.name: Nulgath's Prize
quests.description: I'm the cute one down here.. or as cute as we get in the mountains of Tercessuinotlim. Then those Dark Makai swarmed their way in and took over! Go and kill a few of them, and I'll follow you back to your house. I know where I'm appreciated!

quests.name: Nulgath's Prize (Badge Quest)
quests.description: (gives Character Page Badge)I'm the cute one down here.. or as cute as we get here in the mountains of Tercessuinotlim. Then those Dark Makai swarmed their way in and took over! Go and kill a few of them, and I'll follow you back to your house. I know where I'm appreciated!

quests.name: Contract With the Abyss
quests.description: Nulgath's contract is written in a language you don't understand. Are you sure you want to sign it?

quests.name: Supplies to spin The Wheel of Chance
quests.description: The Sneevils want unique items of power. Chaos infests the lands and chaorrupted items are what they seek. Find them a cursed Relic of Chaos, and you can spin their Wheel of Chance!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest. | Must be Level 10.

quests.name: Nulgath's Roulette of Misfortune
quests.description: Are the sneevils not giving you what you want? Oh boo-hoo, relics and trinkets are mere toys, what did you expect? Raw mana however, is something to be sought after. Bring me some Mana Energy from the Mana Golem and Charged Mana from the creatures in/elemental, and I'll let you spin MY wheel. I've narrowed its prizes down to the most valuable.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Totem of Nulgath
quests.description: My essence lingers on the creatures of this realm. Gather it from the Dark Makai roaming the caves and from the blade of Taro Blademaster, and I shall turn it into a relic of considerable power.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Bone Dust Reagent
quests.description: Skew needs many ingredients to practice his magic. Bone Dust from the undead in /battleunderb is something he requires. Bring him enough of it, and he'll reward you accordingly.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Cube Reagent
quests.description: Skew needs many ingredients to practice his magic. Cubes from the Sneevils in /boxes and Ice Cubes from the Snow Golems in /mountfrost are materials he requires. Bring him enough of each, and he'll fairly compensate you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Essence of Defeat Reagent
quests.description: Relics from defeated, powerful enemies can be used by Skew to create powerful magic. Bring him the remains of your defeated foes and he'll generously reward you with a much rarer gemstone.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Kiss the Void
quests.description: There are some who dare to defy me, and those who transgress will meet their fate within the void. Slay the Legion Fenrir defectors in /evilwarnul and gather their broken blades. Then, collect 80 Fragments of Chaos from the Chaos Gemralds in /blindingsnow and find a Tendurrr the Assistant willing to reforge the blades. If you're lucky, one of their attempts might be successful, HAHAHAHA!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest. | Must have Tendurrr The Assistant in your inventory. Note: Quest name is a direct reference to When Love Starts to Die by H.I.M.

quests.name: Juggernaut Items of Nulgath
quests.description: You have proven beyond a shadow of a doubt that you are both a loyal and powerful member of the Nation. As a reward for your service, I can offer you some of my most prized items of destruction… in exchange for a few reagents, of course. You'll also need to bring me the rune from an Undead Bruiser and one of my vouchers. At this point, you should know better than to ask why.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Demanding Items of Nulgath
quests.description: I have items of great power to give you, Minion but know this… everything has a price. If you have the required reagents and bring me a rune from a Legion Fenrir then one of these mighty blades can be yours.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Nulgath is Kind
quests.description: Be grateful Minion… I've decided to show you just how kind I am. A monstrous creature known as the Cadaverous Creeper has risen in the /Tunnels beneath Lore, and because great beasts retain great power, Ill support your efforts in killing it. Bring me a Blade and a Helm made from its corpse, and I'll empower them with my energy. Then, you can choose ONE of the items to keep for yourself!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: The Leery Contract
quests.description: Ahh… what do you have there mortal? One of my contracts? You must be a VERY lucky person. Care to make a deal? Good, Evil, Chaotic… your alignment doesn't matter to me. Just bring me a rune from an Undead Legend and sign the contract, and I'll give you a prize unlike anything you've seen before- and a sum of Gold for your troubles. What does the contract say, you ask? Does it really matter?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Impossible, Empowered Items of Nulgath
quests.description: So, you want ME to personally empower one of your items? Very well, Minion… but my services do not come cheap. I'll need a Godly Golden Dragon Axe, the blade of Abaddon and a few reagents… oh and one of my contracts! HAHAHA! GOOD LUCK!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Purchase Sword of Nulgath
quests.description: Bring me the appropriate vouchers and you can wield a most useful blade of mine. It will only fight for me but for you, it has other qualities.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: BloodBlade of Nulgath
quests.description: So, you like swords, do you? HAH. You have never SEEN a sword that can cleave a warrior in two like the Fiendish Blood Blade. but do you know what's even better than that? I have an even BETTER version, and can even turn it into a battle companion for you. The question is… what are you willing to give me in exchange?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Image of Nulgath
quests.description: Your servitude to me hasn't gone unnoticed. As a reward for your loyalty, I have for you… a blade in my image!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: "Kindness" of Nulgath
quests.description: Minion you WILL finish this quest. It will show you just how… kind… I can be to those who earn my favor- and how little I tolerate failure. Finish it, and claim your 'generous' reward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: The Perfect Pet
quests.description: Even followers of the Archfiend need battle companions. I can award you one who will be loyal, true, and ferocious… but you must first gather the reagents to create it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Terraforming
quests.description: Minion! I am granting you the power to add 1 Field Card from your Deck to your hand. If you didn't get my reference.. GET OUT OF MY SIGHT! You gave me your soul, and you were granted the power to fulfill my tasks and better serve your Master. But now, you need a home. A sanctum to return to, and regain your strength. FINE, Minion. Bring me the things I need, and we will provide you with what you ask for.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest. | Must have NUE Necronomicon in your inventory.

quests.name: Receipt of Nulgath
quests.description: What is it you seek, Minion? Power? Combat Styles? Void Breeds? Or…. what? You would like permission to finally learn how to forge my Gemstones? HAHAHA, such confidence! Were you not one of my favorite underlings, I would have thrown you to the Oversoul to feed the monsters there for even asking. Very well… bring me what I need, and perhaps I can enlist the Abyssal Revenue Services (ARS) to grant you a reward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Toxic CyberFiend Quest
quests.description: I see you possess an enhanced version of the Fiend of Nulgath. Hmm… IF you think you are worthy of owning the REST of the set, you will have to WORK for it! Bring me the reagents, and I will let you choose ONE item from the remaining set pieces.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest. | Must have CyberFiend (AC) in your inventory.

quests.name: Legendary Toxic CyberFiend Quest
quests.description: I see you possess an enhanced version of the Fiend of Nulgath. Hmm… IF you think you are worthy of owning the REST of the set, you will have to WORK for it! Bring me the reagents, and I will let you choose ONE item from the remaining set pieces.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest. | Must have CyberFiend (Legend) in your inventory.

quests.name: Combat Style: Soulreaper of Nulgath
quests.description: You wish to learn how to wield your "Soulreaper of Nulgath" with more effectiveness? Your weapon will look the same, but you'll swing it like an axe!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Combat Style: Taro's Manslayer
quests.description: You wish to learn how to dual wield Taro's Manslayers? For a small price, I'll teach you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Combat Style: Champion Blade
quests.description: You wish to learn how to dual wield the Champion Blade? For a small price I'll teach you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Combat Style: Dragonbone Axe
quests.description: You wish to learn how to dual wield a pair of Dragonbone Axes? For a small price, I'll teach you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Combat Style: Tainted Claymore
quests.description: You wish to learn how to dual wield the Tainted Claymore? For a small price, I'll teach you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Combat Style: Purified Claymore of Destiny
quests.description: Haha! Polish is here? He's no threat to me! For a small price, I'll teach you to dual wield his pathetic blade.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Surprise Test: Truth Revealed
quests.description: Battle one who should have remained loyal to you… but has gone over to Nulgath's side

quests.name: Final Exam: Your Own Worst Enemy
quests.description: Face the necromancer you think you are, and who you think to become. To truly master your power, you must master yourself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Paladin in Peril
quests.description: Now that Beleen has Chaos powers, where would she strike first? THIS IS TOO EASY! Artix is her number 1 target. You must go find him in Pink Swordhaven… Beleen has already been there. Click the button on my speech window and I will teleport you there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sparkling Books ' quest.

quests.name: Fluffy Clouds
quests.description: Since Beleen loves cute and cuddle things, she will NOT be able to resist the adorableness factor of the Beleen Pony… but we need to make it SUPER fluffy. Harvest the area's Fluffy Clouds so we can craft the fur coat of our Beleen Pony.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Cutie Makai's Quest .

quests.name: Super Model Makai Hair
quests.description: My notorious Dark Makai minions have turned adorable… and as much as it PAINS me to see them in this horrific state, I must admit that their hair is *ulp* super model material. I need you to gather enough Silky Makai Hair so that we can craft the Beleen Pony's mane and tail.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Squeaky Business
quests.description: Alright— the Beleen Pony is nearly complete. All we need now is to make it squeaky. As you know, NO ONE can resist fun squeaky toys… especially in Pony-form. So all those Pink Rats scurrying around are PERFECT for adding the final touch (erm, squeak) to the Beleen Pony.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Queen's Offering
quests.description: Now that the Beleen Pony is complete, we can lure Chaos Queen Beleen to US! Head on over to the Summoning Altar, and place the Beleen Pony there… and watch what happens!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Boss Fight Beleen!
quests.description: We summoned Beleen! TAKE THAT QUEEN DOWN!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Service to the Nation
quests.description: There's seemingly no end to Dage's army. FIGHT! Show loyalty to the Nation, and you shall be rewarded.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Dage the Lich ' quest.

quests.name: Nulgath, the Archfiend
quests.description: Face me if you're willing to throw your life away! (Click on Nulgath to begin.)
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 80. Note: This quest can only be completed once per week.

quests.name: Empowered Overfiend Blade
quests.description: Defeat me in combat and I'll unleash the full potential of your items! My Overfiend Blade will do 51% more damage to all monsters when equipped.

quests.name: Empowered Ungodly Reavers
quests.description: Defeat me in combat and I'll unleash the full potential of your items! My Ungodly Reavers will do 51% more damage to all monsters when equipped.

quests.name: Empowered Shadow Spear
quests.description: Defeat me in combat and I'll unleash the full potential of your items! My Shadow Spear will do 51% more damage to all monsters when equipped.

quests.name: Empowered Bloodletter
quests.description: Defeat me in combat and I'll unleash the full potential of your items! My Bloodletter will do 51% more damage to all monsters when equipped.

quests.name: Empowered Prismatic Manslayers
quests.description: Defeat me in combat and I'll unleash the full potential of your items! Taro's Prismatic Manslayer will do 51% more damage to all monsters when equipped.

quests.name: Empowered Legacy of Nulgath
quests.description: Defeat me in combat and I'll unleash the full potential of your items! The armor of my old form will do 35% more damage to all monsters and give 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped.

quests.name: Empowered Worshipper of Nulgath
quests.description: Defeat me in combat and I'll unleash the full potential of your items! The armor of my worshippers will do 35% more damage to all monsters and give 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped.

quests.name: Empowered Evolved Void Armors 1
quests.description: Defeat me in combat and I'll unleash the full potential of your items! The Evolved Void and Fiend armors will do 35% more damage to all monsters and give 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped.

quests.name: Empowered Evolved Void Armors 2
quests.description: Defeat me in combat and I'll unleash the full potential of your items! The Evolved Blood, Hex, and Shadow armors will do 35% more damage to all monsters and give 25% more gold/exp/rep/cp when equipped.

quests.name: Empowered Oblivion Blade
quests.description: Defeat me in combat and I'll unleash the full potential of your items! My Oblivion Blade will do 51% more damage to all monsters when equipped.

quests.name: Empowered Charged Oblivion Blade
quests.description: Defeat me in combat and I'll unleash the full potential of your items! My Oblivion Blade will do 51% more damage to all monsters when equipped.

quests.name: Empowered Charged Oblivion Blade (Rare)
quests.description: Defeat me in combat and I'll unleash the full potential of your items! My Oblivion Blade will do 51% more damage to all monsters when equipped.

quests.name: Words Bind
quests.description: I am also bound to my contracts. That is why they're so powerful. My word is law. Unless they have violated the terms of my contracts intentionally or through incompetence, I can not strike them. I sense that if I tear the doors down, the blowback will…There are Nation members beyond this door that have not broken their vows. Something has taken control of them. Look through the Temple's grounds again. Search for any hint of what it could be.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Banging on Light's Door ' quest.

quests.name: Doomed Darkness
quests.description: The identity of the Imposter is becoming clearer. You have found scraps of their shroud, tossed to the side. It's as if they found a new cloak. But, I am getting ahead of myself. There are markedly darker beasts skulking about the accessible rooms of the Temple, left behind by the Light and the Dark. I recognize these Doomed Beasts. Fight them for yourself and tell me what you can glean from them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Banging on Light's Door ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shady Costuming
quests.description: The trolls that have accompanied the Doomed Beasts are dead but not undead. I recognize them from the group Oblivion, a member of my Nation, was using to guard an important belonging of mine. His minions have surely been turned against him, and now they have their tusks pointed at you. Destroy them and look at what the Shadows have done to their bodies.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Banging on Light's Door ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Emperor's Shadow
quests.description: Bring me parts from the creatures overtaken by the Shadows. The same shades that were once the masters of the Shadowscythe and the Emperor. It seems that they, or a member of their collective, have given up on taking the Empire back through subterfuge. I will swathe myself in their essence and make the entity on the other side of this door believe that I am one of them. They will allow me to pry these doors open.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Banging on Light's Door ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Throat Sores
quests.description: The doors have flown open, and Oblivion is there waiting for us. The first insult against the Nation was the shattering of a Fiend Shard. The second was the theft of another. The third was the theft of a corpse; the corpse of a clone. One that Oblivion was guarding. He has been overtaken by a Shadow. Defeat him and rip that Shadow out of his throat. I wish to crush that shade under my heel.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Banging on Light's Door ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Enlightened Shadows
quests.description: The Shadows and Doom, are they one and the same or is there more beyond the first glance? Shadows can not exist without the Light after all. It is worth capturing and examining the creatures draped in both…substances. For now, I won't think of the Shadows or Doom as elements themselves. To me, they better resemble cave worms burrowing into the bowels of Darkness.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Throat Sores ' quest.

quests.name: Mindless Waste
quests.description: These Overdriven Paladins managed to get away from the Shadows and you. Get rid of these stragglers. They couldn't contain the light coursing through their veins, and it has burned away their minds. Not that they could differentiate us from their true foes. Ha, I suppose it wouldn't have mattered if they kept the faculties. We would have had to fight them regardless.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Throat Sores ' quest.

quests.name: Stone Proxy
quests.description: Our surroundings have changed drastically since you unsealed the doors. Night has only just fallen. Destroy the Doomed Trolls before they gain strength from the Shadows. Inspect the changes around the courtyard as well. Our foe has enough intelligence to concoct a swift invasion, but their motive remains unknown. Considering how they invaded the temple…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Throat Sores ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Deepness of Shadows...
quests.description: Upon entering the Temple, you noticed that the torches had been snuffed. You would think the absence of light would make the Doomed Beasts from the Plane of Darkness stronger, but remember what I said before. The Shadows and Doom are separate from the Darkness. Fight these Doomed Beasts for yourself and see. Examine the torches you're able to access as well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Throat Sores ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: ...Begets the Glare of the Light
quests.description: Beyond the inner doors of the Temple, where you found Oblivion, are the secrets that my imposter is looking for. The stairs to the upper floors are blocked, but I can sense my clone's corpse. It's in the depths of the Temple, beneath the pedestal which is all that remains of a once glorious statue. It is guarded by strange light elementals and…the stolen members of my Nation. Wipe out the enemies, and move the pedestal out of our way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Throat Sores ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Death Over Defeat
quests.description: Descend into the bowels of the Temple of Light. I can sense them, the struggles of the members of my Nation. I myself can not strike them. By default, each contract I forge stipulates that I can not harm a contractor unless they have violated the agreed terms through betrayal or incompetence. Take them down like you did with Oblivion and bring them to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Throat Sores ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: For a Brighter Tomorrow
quests.description: I am aware that you encountered Light Elementals when you first entered the courtyard. It seems that they had arrived after the invasion, whereas the Delirious Elementals were present when the Temple was first attacked. What Carnage said was true. Light Elementals of this variety rarely leave their plane or converse with mortals, even their own Champion. Defeat them and bring me anything of interest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Throat Sores ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Minions Anonymous
quests.description: The Paladins and Elementals were thorough in their own destruction. The skeleton of a library is up ahead. The Temple's leaders had the books burned and gave their followers spells that mangled their minds. If nothing else, the Light have great expertise in being annoyances. My imposter likely felt the same. Look around the remains of the Library for anything that managed to escape the flames.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Throat Sores ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Prephosphorus
quests.description: A Light Elemental, one that has retained its sanity, wishes to speak to us. It must have been guarding the pedestal beyond the burned library. Very well then. Speak with it and see if it is willing to divulge anything of use. Examine the pedestal for yourself and eliminate the rest of the Delirious Elementals. I have my own conclusions, but hearing this Astero attempt to mislead us will give me hints about its true intentions.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Throat Sores ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sunspotty
quests.description: Before you face the Worm that stole my clone's corpse, gather Delirious Elementals and my Infested Nation members. Astero will think that you are clearing the distractions, but bring them to me live. I will supplement my power with their bodies to feed into the pedestal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Throat Sores ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Feeding Time
quests.description: Trust is so very fragile and scarce among my ranks. It takes years to build, and can be destroyed in seconds. You may be wary of what I say and what I plan to do, but trust that we both want the same results. Trust the power of my contracts. Fight the Worm that infests my corpse's clone. While you face it in combat, I will open a portal and banish it from Lore.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Throat Sores ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sparkling Deception
quests.description: Until the sun rises and the paladins return, this Temple will be in my custody. Though ruined, the pedestal's functions are of great interest. It drains its victims until they die, and become unable to be raised from the dead. Bring me Elementals, Infested Nation, and whatever remains of the Worm. I can use the pedestal to drain them and study the effects. Consider cleaning out the temple a favor to the do gooders.

quests.name: Vanquish The Betrayers
quests.description: I've heard whispers that we have some pathetic traitors in our ranks. They're an embarrassment to me. Get rid of them. And remember, I won't tolerate failure.

quests.name: Void Knight Deal
quests.description: Void Knights are just one of my elite soldiers of war. I give them great power of my own to make them unstoppable. That's the sacrifice I make for my diciples. I'll give you the power of a Void Knight too. All I require is a small portion of your soul. Defeat Soulseeker and you'll be able to retrieve a transportable piece of your soul.

quests.name: Arcane Orb
quests.description: Nulgath tells you this orb holds the power to transform your "Void of Nulgath" to a different breed. Only those that possess, or share the orb have access to this transformation.

quests.name: Blood Orb
quests.description: Nulgath tells you this orb holds the power to transform your "Void of Nulgath" to a different breed. Only those that possess, or share the orb have access to this transformation.

quests.name: Primal Orb
quests.description: Nulgath tells you this orb holds the power to transform your "Void of Nulgath" to a different breed. Only those that possess, or share the orb have access to this transformation.

quests.name: Shadow Orb
quests.description: Nulgath tells you this orb holds the power to transform your "Void of Nulgath" to a different breed. Only those that possess, or share the orb have access to this transformation.

quests.name: Oblivion Blade of Nulgath
quests.description: I see the "Sword of Nulgath" has served you well. If you desire more power I can help you… for a price. But you already knew that, didn't you?

quests.name: Twisted Items of Nulgath
quests.description: If you prove our worth then you will earn my most impressive works. True, most of my more powerful items from the past are now unavailable. Lets just say they caused a bit more trouble than I anticipated. But I'm in the process of creating more items of destruction. Patience is a virtue.

quests.name: Dragonblade of Nulgath
quests.description: I have created a weapon of great power for you. Everything has a cost. Learn this… If you have the required reagents, this sword is yours.

quests.name: Spinal Tap of Nulgath
quests.description: Mortal, bring me a "Spinal Tap" dagger and I'll twist it's energy, giving you full dominion over it's power.

quests.name: Feed the Fiend Tokens
quests.description: You want to harness my power? You need to FEED the FIEND!

quests.name: Void Knight Deal (Temporary Quest)
quests.description: (This quest will be deleted June 4, 2010) Void Knights are just one of my elite soldiers of war. I give them great power of my own to make them unstoppable. That's the sacrifice I make for my disciples. I'll give you the power of a Void Knight too. All I require is a small portion of your soul. Defeat Soulseeker and you'll be able to retrieve a transportable piece of your soul.

quests.name: Blood Orb (Temporary Quest)
quests.description: (This quest will be deleted June 4, 2010) Miltonius tells you this orb holds the power to transform your "Void of Miltonius" to a different breed. Only those that possess, or share the orb have access to this transformation.

quests.name: Arcane Orb (Temporary Quest)
quests.description: (This quest will be deleted June 4, 2010) Miltonius tells you this orb holds the power to transform your "Void of Miltonius" to a different breed. Only those that possess, or share the orb have access to this transformation.

quests.name: Shadow Orb (Temporary Quest)
quests.description: (This quest will be deleted June 4, 2010) Miltonius tells you this orb holds the power to transform your "Void of Miltonius" to a different breed. Only those that possess, or share the orb have access to this transformation.

quests.name: Primal Orb (Temporary Quest)
quests.description: (This quest will be deleted June 4, 2010) Miltonius tells you this orb holds the power to transform your "Void of Miltonius" to a different breed. Only those that possess, or share the orb have access to this transformation.

quests.name: Yellow Snow Cone
quests.description: Ze King haz a very bad fever. Before medicating, we need to make zure he iz fully hydrated. Ice melts vhen it gets too warm, yez? Or, in this case, a fever. If you could collect 8 bundles of Shaved Ice and 2 bottles of Yellow Snow Syrup to make ze king a healthy, hydrating Snow Cone? Ze monsters in ze Frozen Northlands can provide you with what we need.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Aisha ' quest.

quests.name: Cool Down Items
quests.description: Bein! Now that ze King is full of antioxidants, ze time 'as come to destroy ze fever freezer burn! When ice goes bad, it will start building up zomething called 'freezer burn.' Zis is not good. We need to find some Cool Down items Items for ze King before he freezer burnz. Find me 5 Cool Down Items zat the monsters of ze Frozen Northlands use in battle!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Take a Chill Pill
quests.description: Ze King needs medication now. S'il vous plait, can you do me one more favor? Ze monsters of ze Frozen Northlands have stolen my last bottle of Chill Pills, and we must get it back for ze King's sake! Search all ze monsters in this area for my Chill Pill Bottle. One of zhose thieves must have it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ice Cold Heart (Charge the Fortress)
quests.description: Impatient much? Me too. Charging Aisha's fortress is the quickest way to end her reign. But if we charge in right now, the village will be vulnerable to a blindside ambush. Go into the Northlands and vanquish FrostWyrms in order to ensure the village's security. When you have collected 6 Hearts of Ice, we can move forward with our plan. And by "our plan" I mean "my plan."

quests.name: A Key Discovery (Charge the Fortress)
quests.description: With the Frost Golems out of the way, we need to find a way through the front door. Since you broke Aisha's last door, she has set up a more solid, complex entrance with higher security measures. There are strange fissures in the door if I recall correctly… maybe one of those monsters will have a key or something that can be used to open the door.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous or ' Element of Surprise ' quest.

quests.name: Forgery (Charge the Fortress)
quests.description: Go get another mysterious stone from one of the monsters, but this time put it in the forge and see if there is anything hidden inside. If something comes out, bring it back to me so we can set out next course of action. Hurry. I haven't got all day.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous or ' Interrogation ' quest.

quests.name: Forging Gemeralds (Charge the Fortress)
quests.description: Chaos Gemeralds fit into the door. This is how we are going to unlock the door. And then charge right in unannounced. Go fight some monsters until you have collected another 5 mysterious stones. Take them to the forge in town, extract the chaos gemeralds, and bring them back to me so I can brief you on your final mission.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous or ' Locked On Combinations ' quest.

quests.name: Break Down the Door (Charge the Fortress)
quests.description: You have the forged Gemerald Key… can you get through the door?

quests.name: Element Of Surprise (Sneak into Fortress)
quests.description: The element of surprise is far more powerful than any other magic element known to man. Sneaking through the back door to Aisha's fortress is a wise decision. However, you will need to find a code in order to solve the unique combination cipher. To get a better idea of what I am talking about, take this Carbon Parchment to the back gate and get me an imprint of the lock. We can then assess our next step to the plan.

quests.name: Interrogation (Sneak into Fortress)
quests.description: Now that we have a good idea of what the combination cipher looks like, it's time for us to gather up some clues. And by "us" I mean "you." I am positive that at least one of Aisha's minions knows the combination. "Interrogate" the monsters of the Frozen Northlands for any clues that might be of use to us. And I really mean "us" this time.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous or ' Ice Cold Heart ' quest.

quests.name: Locked On Combinations (Sneak into Fortress)
quests.description: Since you found that first combination number, there are bound to be others. This just may be our only hope to decoding that cipher at the back gate. Go back out and "interrogate" the monsters to find 3 more numbers!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous or ' A Key Discovery ' quest.

quests.name: Combo Breaker (Sneak into Fortress)
quests.description: Now that we have all the numbers for the combination, we just need to figure out what rune they represent. There has to be some sort of decoder out there… something that we can use to figure out the combination… There has to be something in the Frozen Northlands to help us figure it out. Search through the piles of snow monsters to see if any clues are buried deep within their inventories!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous or ' Forgery ' quest.

quests.name: Open the Door (Sneak into Fortress)
quests.description: You have the Rosetta Rune… can you open the door?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous or ' Forging Gemeralds ' quest. Note: Cannot be accessed after completing this or ' Break Down the Door ' quest.

quests.name: The Cave
quests.description: Well, you've made it into the cave. Are you tough enough to go on?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the ' Break Down the Door ' or ' Open the Door ' quest.

quests.name: Aisha's Minion
quests.description: You say your tough and sneaky enough to get to Aisha? Well, I don't believe you. Prove it! Defeat that Water Draconian over there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Aisha
quests.description: Oh sure, you defeated her minion, but are you tough enough to take on Aisha's Drake? I doubt it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Void Spell
quests.description: So, you and that Royal UndeadSlayer want MY help? Hmph, fine. It's going to cost you. I need a Chaos Gemerald Cluster. You don't need to know why. And bring me 5 Chaos Gemerald Shards for good measure. Again, don't ask. When you return, I suppose I can give you the Void Transport Spell you need.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Explore the Void Path ' quest.

quests.name: Girl Scouts
quests.description: Alright hero, listen up. I've never been in this cave and neither have you. You should probably scout the area to become familiar with your new surroundings. Explore this cave entirely and come back with your findings. From there, we can begin our next course of action.
quests.requirements_note: Must have watched the cutscene in Void Temple . Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeating the Defenders
quests.description: The cave is flooded with monsters. We need to eliminate the masses before mining the Paragon Jewel. And by "we" I really mean "you." Defeat 10 of these jewel defenders so you can mine a jewel without being bombarded by those devious creatures.
quests.requirements_note: Must have watched the cutscene in Void Temple . Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Picky about Picks
quests.description: Don't think for a second you can just hack and slash your way through the cave walls to mine a Jewel. This is the Void we're dealing with, and *normal* weapons won't work in this realm. What you need to do is find an Ahzite Pick. One of those cave monsters should have one… Only when you find this rare item will you be able to mine a Paragon Jewel.
quests.requirements_note: Must have watched the cutscene in Void Temple . Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Para-GONE Jewel
quests.description: No sign of Ryuuji… so let's go mine that Paragon Jewel! Hurry!
quests.requirements_note: Must have watched the cutscene in Void Temple . Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Digging Deeper
quests.description: After our latest defeat… oh, excuse me, *tie*… we can't let Ryuuji get that gauntlet. I don't even want him getting NEAR it. So let's set up some traps to make it even more difficult! I swear… half-dtragon men can be so stubborn… hmph. So anyway. Wanna get your hands dirty? Dig a few pitfalls so that if that elf oaf makes his way near the tomb… he'll fall right in! AHAAH!

quests.name: Ghastplasm is a Blast
quests.description: Now that the pitfalls have been dug, let's impede his path even more! I remember a magic recipe for creating a fog so thick and murky that not even dragons can see through it! What we need is Ghastplasm… and a lot of it. And the Void is the only place to find Ghastplasm—what luck. Collect 12 vials of Ghastplasm so we can concoct up a nice dense Void Fog.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Aghast over Ghastplasm
quests.description: Now that we have all this Ghastplasm, we can create a nice thick Void fog. It's really simple. All you have to do is place a few drops of the Ghastplasm in the locations I've already marked. I enchanted each spot with some magic sparkles so that you know where to put the Ghastplasm. Please hurry!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ab-ducts-tion
quests.description: I think one more trap should do it. No sign of Ryuuji…yet… but it's better to be safe than married. The Void Larva around here are pretty tame but can be a nasty enemy when provoked. And do you know the best way to do so other than double-clicking? …by spreading their duct scent! Yup. It's as gross as it sounds. And that's why I'm asking YOU to do it. Gather 6 Void Larva Ducts and ring them back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ducts Crossing
quests.description: Alright stinky, you know what you gotta do. Take those delightful Void Ducts and spread them all over the place. This will drive the Void Larva mad, sending them into an unstoppable frenzy. Not even a half-dragon would stand a chance against all those crazed Larva.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Scout Out the Void Dragon
quests.description: There is no explanation why I did it… I just… I'm sorry… okay okay… me apologizing isn't going to help the situation. Hero… if you're still willing to help… I could really use a friend right now… please, go scout out the Void Giant and see if you can find anything to give us an edge…

quests.name: Component Competitors
quests.description: I remember back when I was really young, Warlic taught me how to create a Banishing Stone! But it's not easy… and we don't have much time to create one… and not to mention we're gonna need to make four… so we had better get started before it's too late! First, I will need 4 Spell Components from the Void Elementals. I'd give you a lesson on what makes these Spell Components so valuable but we just don't have the time! Go!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: And more Component Competitors
quests.description: We need more Spell Components. But this time, from the Void Larva. The Larva produce a very rare and very unique Spell Components that we will need in order to create the Banishing Stones. It's not going to be easy finding them… but we really have no other option! Please….
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Brandishing the Banishing Stones
quests.description: Time is running out! Take these 4 Banishing Stones and place them in their key locations. Only then can Ryuuji and I begin to conjure up the proper Banishing Spell. Be careful and don't let the Void Giant see you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stall the Void Giant
quests.description: This is it. Hero… please… please be careful. And please know that no matter what happens… you will forever be honored as a hero. If you can stall the Void Giant ong enough… then Ryuuji and I can conjure up the Banishing Spell…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sign Nythera's Scroll
quests.description: I have a scroll listing the most important rules and guidelines for battling in AQWorlds. If you sign it, I'll give you an achievement badge *and* a reward (to encourage you to follow the rules)… all I am missing is my quill pen! It was stolen by that zard over there. Get it back for me, please?

items.name: Justice Squad Book of Lore Badge

quests.name: Ice Cold Killer
quests.description: This ice queen has sent her stolen minions in ahead of her, hoping to have them soften the land and the people living in it ahead of her. Bring me shards of their ice, and I'll fashion them into something you can craft some icy gear from. Boreas will thank you for freeing them from her clutches.

quests.name: Get Jacked
quests.description: The Frozensoul Queen has a second in command… Jack Frost. Take him down and bring me his frosted heart. What? I'm a void dragon. You were expecting warm and cuddly?

quests.name: Shatter the FrozenSoul Queen
quests.description: If you feel ready, you may face the queen herself. Extract her frozen soul, and I'll use it to craft you something special.

quests.name: Small Red Envelope
quests.description: This is a good envelope, I'll reward you with 300 gold.

quests.name: Medium Red Envelope
quests.description: This is a good envelope, I'll reward you with 600 gold.

quests.name: Large Red Envelope
quests.description: Wow, you are a very lucky person. I'll reward you with 1200 gold.

quests.name: Oblivion Blade of Fighting
quests.description: Your blade thirsts for souls. Take him to battle and quench his thirst.

quests.name: Nulgath's Roulette of Misfortune
quests.description: Are the sneevils not giving you what you want? Oh boo-hoo, relics and trinkets are mere toys, what did you expect? Raw mana however, is something to be sought after. Bring me some Mana Energy from the Mana Golem and Charged Mana from the creatures in/elemental, and I'll let you spin MY wheel. I've narrowed its prizes down to the most valuable.

quests.name: Nulgath
quests.description: (This quest subject to change)

quests.name: Phoenix Blade of Nulgath
quests.description: Bring me the "Phoenix Blade"mortal. It's an ancient blade fiercely guarded by dragon kind. It's legendary for it's eternal fire. This is the reason is why I use to create my Voids. As you can see, that kind of power is very useful. Bring one to me and in return I'll enthrall the blade with my own power, giving you dominion over it.

quests.name: The Weapon Parasite
quests.description: My supplier, Swindle, has come across an interesting parasitic creature that actually binds with weapons, giving it strange power.I’ve been experimenting with it’s abilities but I need more specimens. Bring me a “Parasitic Hacker”. For the specimen and a small payment of gems, I’ll give you an item I’ve successfully bound with the creature.

quests.name: Doom Worm Creepers
quests.description: Nulgath says, as you grow in power, many foes will look to strike you in the back. I can prevent this. Bring me "Doom Worm Creepers". They are not obedient creatures. But I can change that for a price. They will sit still and see all that you cannot see.

quests.name: The Dark Deal
quests.description: ( This quest can change )

quests.name: Voucher item: Champion of Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says your voucher will get you the "Champion Blade of Nulgath". Forged with the spirits of heroes past, you'll command the power of a 100 souls. redeem your purchase here. Quite an expensive item because of the amount of power you have over it.

quests.name: Diamonds of Nulgath Sale
quests.description: Note that these diamonds are quite exquisite and flawless on top of that. Your gold is would be well spent on this. All I need is your "Voucher of Nulgath".

quests.name: Archfiend Cloak
quests.description: Bring me a "Fiend Cloak of Nulgath" and I'll empower it, evolving it's power to an Archfiend! I'll need payment too.

quests.name: The Marks
quests.description: Don't waste my time! If you know what needs to be done, then handle it.

quests.name: Oblivion Blade of Fighting (Rare)
quests.description: Your blade thirsts for souls. Take him to battle and quench his thirst.

quests.description: Don't waste my time! If you know what needs to be done, then handle it.

quests.name: Willpower Extraction
quests.description: Minion, the connection between Lore and the Underworld is not as stable as you might presume. In the past, Master Nulgath has used Gravelyn as a conduit when he needed a way to manifest power at a higher level than his current state allows. If you wish to create a new and powerful subspecies of the Nation, you must first locate the proper magical materials, and meld them with our resources."
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest. | Must have Unidentified 13: " The Contract of Nulgath " in your inventory.

quests.name: Nulgath Demands Work
quests.description: Now that Master has taught you how to create the Malignant Essence, it's time to shape and apply it using Master's reagents. The power Gravelyn obtained from us can be shaped according to your will if you focus enough to bend it. And, if you are lucky, you may obtain a rare by-product of this reaction - the Essence of the Almighty Archfiend.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest. | Must have Unidentified 13: " The Contract of Nulgath " in your inventory.

quests.name: Enough DOOM for an Archfiend
quests.description: AH! The Essence of the Almighty Archfiend. It is so rare that Master Nulgath treats it like a chromosomal abnormality. Minion, you must mix it with essences from all of Lore. You have already come so far… but that does not mean we will make things easy for you. Prove to me - and Master- that you deserve your reward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: ArchFiend DoomLord Badge
quests.description: Doom is a powerful force- almost comparable to Master Nulgath's. Bring me a single shard of his essence, and I will reward you with a Badge for your Character page.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: A Dark Temptation
quests.description: You, there. Squishy one. Come here for a moment. No, no, I will not hurt you. Your world has 'heroes' of righteous Good known as Paladins, yes? Would you like to become one? Oh, but you wouldn't be the same anymore… for every step you take down this path, your view on the world will become a little bit darker. Tainted, even. You say you can fight it, but we both know how it will end. So… what will it be?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Deeper and Deeper into Darkness
quests.description: Back so soon, dear Minion? I told you that none could resist the call of the Void. Gather the following reagents, and I shall offer you something truly terrifying.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Sacrifice (BLoD Version)
quests.description: Your taste of the power the Abyss can provide is almost through, Minion. If you would hold on to it, something of equal value must be given in exchange…and to fully experience the shadows, one must banish the light. If you desire to do so, then bring me the legendary weapon known as the Blinding Light of Destiny - and the reagents we will need to fully infuse it with the Void's power.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest. | Must have Blinding Light of Destiny (Axe) in your inventory.

quests.name: Sacrifice (ALoD Version)
quests.description: Your taste of the power the Abyss can provide is almost through, Minion. If you would hold on to it, something of equal value must be given in exchange…and to fully experience the shadows, one must banish the light. If you desire to do so, then bring me the legendary weapon known as the Blinding Light of Destiny - and the reagents we will need to fully infuse it with the Void's power.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest. | Must have Ascended Light of Destiny in your inventory.

quests.name: Cyber Void Paladin Set
quests.description: Unlock all of the Cyber Void Paladin gear when you complete the Void Paladin armor set and retrieve 5 powerpacks from the Undead Space Warriors in /dreadspace. (This quest requires the Void Paladin armor, helm, katana cape, katana, and the Void Light of Destiny.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Feed the Fiend Tokens
quests.description: You want to harness my power? You need to FEED the FIEND!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Void Promotion
quests.description: Hello again, minion. Are you looking to serve as an Archfiend of the Abyss? The normal fare for achieving command is earning five Abyssal Stars during a military service of 20 to 30 centuries. Since you aren't going to live that long, how about we do this the old-fashioned way? Gather the reagents to forge a new contract with the five Abyssal Stars and… "convince" the current commander in /fiendshard to retire, and then I'll see what we can do about that "vacancy".
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract With the Abyss ' quest. | Must be Level 50.

quests.name: Going Through the Motions
quests.description: Master Nulgath has asked me to impart knowledge of the eras before his reign. Help me jog my memory about the Hushed and the Ettin. If the cold hasn't gotten to you, I'll limber up and fight you as Archfiend Oblivion again. That should be enough.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Remember to Breathe ' quest.

quests.name: Test Potential Traitors
quests.description: Anyone could be an agent of the Shadowscythe, from G.E.A.R.S. university student to a member of the royal house of Slugwrath! Battle the students in Mechtropolis to see if they carry ShadowScythe emblems!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Shadowscythe Detection Beacons ' quest.

quests.name: Boar's Feet in Salted-Butter Sauce
quests.description: Oh, oh my! I've had the BEST idea for a recipe! Quick, I'll need 7 Quarts of Rhison Milk, 1 vial of Rhison Tears, and 12 Boar's Feet. If you bring them back to me, I'll let you have a taste, and even teach you the recipe!

quests.name: Trollolola Terrine
quests.description: Tralalalala, I love to sing! In the Kitchen! Talalalalooo! ! Ooooh! Inspiration has struck! Bring me 15 Trollola Leaves, 10 Vulture Wings, and 1 flask of River Water. I will show you how to prepare the tastiest terrine this side of the ravine!

quests.name: Cooking Techniques: Practicuum
quests.description: If you want to be a chef, you have to cook, cook, COOK! And that means practicing your culinary techniques. So get out there and shred some Blue Trollola Blossoms, whip the stuffing out of 7 Vultures, and Beat until frothy 7 Rhison!

quests.name: Cornycopia
quests.description: Let's save the Harvest Feast with the power of cooking! First we need to know what ingredients we have to work with. Scout out the entire Cornycopia and bring me back a list

quests.name: Cooking Trauma
quests.description: Hurray! Now, it is time for you to learn how to cook. Let's start with something easy. Can you boil water? Grab that bucket of water over there and throw it in the oven.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Corn has Ears
quests.description: Shhhh… be vewy vewy quiet… even the Corn has ears! Defeat 8 Corn Stalkers and cook their ears into some awesome sounding "PopRock Corn!" Rock on!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: An Apple a Day
quests.description: An apple a day is supposed to be good for you - but this one's all wormy! Ewwww! Get 5 worms, and cook them into Oishii's special Wormcestershire sauce!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Whine n' Cheese
quests.description: I hate it when grapes go bad… all they do is whine! Get 8 whines out of these grapes, and take it back to Oishii. She'll teach you how to make a beautiful whine and cheese plate!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fruit of the Loot
quests.description: Oh no! The stove is missing a bolt, so it won't work! Without that, we'll never get the Harvest feast ready in time! I know there is a dorr with LOTS of bolts insides… and it will give one a prize if you beat the slot machines! Gather seeds from the rotten fruit, and get a bolt from that door! The Harvest feast depends on you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Turdraken
quests.description: Defeat the Turkdraken, and save the Harvest Feast! Take the Turdraken Giblets to Oishii and get ready to Party!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Scout the Cornycopia
quests.description: You really want to help me save the Harvest Feast with the power of cooking? Great! First we need to scout out the Cornycopia to the left and find out what we have to cook with… and by "we" I mean YOU! Go all the way inside and bring me back a list of ingredients.

quests.name: Unboiling Water
quests.description: Hurray! Now it is time for you to learn how to cook. Let's start with something easy. Can you boil water? I left a bucket of water outside of the Cornycopia. Bring it here and use the Hard Bake Oven to cook it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Corn has Ears
quests.description: Shhhh… be vewy vewy quiet… even the Corn has ears! No really, they do! Defeat 8 Corn Stalkers and cook their ears into some awesome-sounding "PopRock Corn!"
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: An Apple a Day
quests.description: An apple a day is supposed to be good for you - but the ones around here are all wormy! Ewwww! Hunt those Big Bad Apples and collect 5 worms from their rotten remains. Bring 'em and cook the worms in the Hard Bake Oven to make Oishii's special Wormcestershire sauce!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Whine n' Cheese
quests.description: I hate it when grapes go bad… all they do is whine! Get 8 whines out of these grapes and bring them back to my pampered chef's oven! I'll teach you how to make a beautiful whine and cheese plate.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fruit of the Loot
quests.description: Your cooking power is almost ready for the ultimate challenge. But first, you have to find a way through that strange door inside the Cornycopia! Use the seeds that drop from rotten fruit monsters to activate the door. Each try has a chance of earning you a key. If you get the key, bring it and ONE SEED back here right away!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Turdraken
quests.description: You have heard the legend of the Turdraken. And now the time has come to meet the fowl beast face-to-beak. Defeat the Turkdraken and save the Harvest Feast! Bring me back the Turdraken Giblets and get ready to party!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Oishii's Special Blend
quests.description: I can't believe the mess in here! There's no way I can finish cooking this turdraken without my special blend of harvest spices! I can't find it on the shelves, so it must be in one of the jars that got knocked to the floor. They all look the same, but if you bring them to me I can smell them to find the right blend.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Turdraken ' quest.

quests.name: Cornstalkerbread Stuffing
quests.description: You know what would make this feast great? Cornbread stuffing! But not just any cornbread - the best tasting corn comes from the Corn Stalkers wandering the harvest. I'll need both white and yellow corn to make the best stuffing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Super Special Chutney
quests.description: Cranberry Chutney is one of my favorite parts of the harvest meal! But I should add something extra to it this year, don't you think? I bet fruity chunks from Bad Apples and Grapes of Wrath would add some zest! But only bring me the best, freshest bits!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Oishii's Secret Ingredient
quests.description: Sneevils love to snack on a kind of jerky known as Sneevilbark. I have no idea what's in it, but it has the most wonderful meaty flavor! It would be the perfect thing to add to my gravy. Get me 12 Sneevilbark Sticks - the Sneevils loitering in front of my yard should have some.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Taking Out the Turdrakolich
quests.description: Now! I need one last favor. *Oishii smiles sweetly* I need you to take care of that horrible thing that keeps messing up my kitchen! The last time I saw it, it ran out back… I think it's still out there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Turdrakolich
quests.description: Why aren't you at the feast with everyone else? Are you still looking for more stuff to fight? Heroes, sheesh! Ok, go way back out and see if you can defeat Ultra Turdrakolich! Maybe then you'll be ready for dinner!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Restocking the Kitchen
quests.description: After all of this cooking, I'm in short supply of ingredients! Here's a list. Don't forget the Zard Sauce! You wouldn't believe how fast I go through that stuff.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Taking Out the Turdrakolich ' quest.

quests.name: Rage Medal Turn-in
quests.description: Slay the heroes in Battleontown to bring even MORE souls to Dage the Evil.

quests.name: Mega Rage Medal Turn-in
quests.description: Slay the heroes in Battleontown to bring even MORE souls to Dage the Evil.

quests.name: Reap the Harvest
quests.description: Oh no! Gourdello managed to steal the Sisters' magical cauldron! I can still cook up the rest of the elixir with their help, but who knows what'll happen in the meantime?

quests.name: The Root of the Problem
quests.description: You know what would go great with this potion? Some potatoes!

quests.name: A Straight Fire Mix
quests.description: Now we just need to heat the elixir up a bit more! But we're running low on kindle… do you think you could go outside and gather some vines from the zombies? Their spicy properties will make a great fuel source for the boiler!

quests.name: Slice & Spice
quests.description: It seems we'll need to gather a bit more of that spice from the zombies in order to finishing brewing the elixir! Could you please go and retrieve some more? We're almost done, I promise!

quests.name: The Spicy Gourdian
quests.description: While we're waiting for the elixir to finish up, we should try to locate Gourdello within his lab. That talking cauldron should be in there somwhere, too,… but we'll have to get past his security first. Defeat the PumpkinLord and Spiced Draconians to find Gourdello!

quests.name: Squash the OverGourd
quests.description: Unless we stop the OverGourd, the whole PLANET will be infected with pumpkin spice - and NO ONE will be able to resist! Rescue Myx and put an end to Gourdello's madness once and for all!

quests.name: Poor Unfortunate Soul
quests.description: First things ﬁrst - we have to see if we can help poor Andrew! He needs to remember who he is, and that he is loved! Gather his favorite game, his favorite meal, and a nice bouquet of flowers. Then, bring them to the altar his wife has set up for him. That should draw his spirit in, and hopefully calm it down.

quests.name: Maybe Hit A Little Harder?
quests.description: Well, he's here - but he sure isn't calm! I hate to say it, but you might have to beat him up a little to help him get rid of all that anger.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Relax And Smell The Flowers
quests.description: These malevolent wraiths keep appearing all over the place! We‘ll have to get them back to their senses, like you did with Andrew. First. you'll need to gather some flowers to use as an offering.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: I Said RELAX!
quests.description: Next. you‘re probably going to need to weaken them a little bit Don‘t hurt them - this isn't their fault, after all! Just ﬁght them until they're too tired to be angry anymore. Some of them might be tougher than others, so you may have to ﬁght them more than once.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Soothing Decoration
quests.description: Now, place the flowers on the altars the spirits’ families made for them. This will help them ﬁnd their way back to themselves, and remember they are loved.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Waking Dead
quests.description: It‘s getting worse - not only are all of these spirits angry, some of them are starting to get back into their bodies and crawi out of their graves! You'll have to destroy them to get the ghosts back out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dead Man DO tell Tales
quests.description: We‘ve gotta ﬁnd out what's causing this! Not all of the spirits have been affected yet. Talk to the benign spirits in the area - maybe one of them will know something that can help us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find the Crypt
quests.description: Based on what the ghosts are saying, it sounds like they are being affected by negative energy emanating from the large crypt in the back. Let‘s find it, and go inside.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Undeadslaying 101
quests.description: Eek! It's crawling with undead in here! You‘re gonna have to take some of them out before we can start investigating!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Like Finding A Tomb In A Cemetery
quests.description: Now. we just need to look around and try to ﬁgure out what's gone wrong down here. Investigate the graves inside the crypt - that should help us discover what spirit is doing this, and why.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Keep Calm And Remember
quests.description: Beating up the ghosts is NOT what this celebration is supposed to be about! Looks like she's leaving us no choice, though. Hurry, get in there and stop her before she brings this whole mausoleum down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: War Quest 1: Defense of Battleon!
quests.description: Defeat 10 of the Avomancer's creatures to get Defender Medals and raise the War Meter!

quests.name: War Quest 2: Mega Defense of Battleon!
quests.description: Defeat 5 of the Avomancer's creatures to get Mega Defender Medals and raise the War Meter!

quests.name: Gobbled Up!
quests.description: IF YOU don't take out the Avomancer's RAWRGobbler, there won't BE anything to eat at the Feast… or a town to feast IN!

quests.name: Magical Ladies
quests.description: Some of our friends from Battleon are already in the middle of rescuing the Moglins. Check on Aria and Tara, and fight off the Dianthus Fae giving them trouble! …Do you think any of those Fairies already ate?

quests.name: Baby Boo Pumpkins
quests.description: Some of the Fairies are pretending to be pumpkins! How cute- I mean, how devious! Harvest those tricky Fae, and check if Alina and Rolith need help. Aw, they must have skipped out on their own Harvest Fest dinner to rescue the Moglins!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Vegetarian Fricassee
quests.description: Here comes the hard part. Some of the Moglins were already eaten, which means we need to 'get them out' of the Dianthus Fae and Pumpkin Mimics. You could cut them open, or force them to upchuck. Your choice! And what a fun choice it is. *Wretches*
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: No Thoughts, Head Empty
quests.description: Twilly, wait! Stop! Don't go back! Ah! Are you seeing this? The Moglins we rescued are getting distracted by all the pretty colors and tasty food. Quick! Scoop them up and bring them back to me! I'll find a way to keep them from being recaptured.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fluid Displacement
quests.description: You saw Cysero and Yulgar? They're trying to save the Moglins stuck in a giant cauldron! Let's lend them a hand by fighting off the Hay Fever Sylphs! Achoo! Oof, they're already getting to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sir-Tainly Prepared
quests.description: Deeper into the forest now…I think we passed a magic threshold. Nythera and a Knight are already here! Maybe they have a plan to save the Moglins! Talk to them, and mush the Redcap Mushrooms getting in your way!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

items_required.name: Talk to Nythera and Sir Valence

quests.name: Main Entree
quests.description: Um, there's something looking at us from under the leaves. Are those…Bones. Oh no! OH NO - wait. Thank goodness, they're not Moglin bones. Just human ones. I wonder if we can learn anything by gathering them up.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Putrid Potpourri
quests.description: As far as I can tell, there aren't any Moglins this deep in the forest…that we can see. You know what that means. Slice the Sylphs and Redcaps open, or kick them until they hurl. Sorry I'm asking you to do this. It's bumming me out…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fairy Foray
quests.description: We've reached the throneroom, and the Fall Fae Queen's waiting for us! If we defeat her, I'm sure it'll end the feast! Let's ruin their harvest, and sit on their thrones to really rub it in!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fickle Feast
quests.description: It'd be a shame to let all this extra food go to waste. If you're not going to take some for the road, can you help me store some leftovers from the Hay Fever Sylphs and Redcaps? Ooh, while we're at it… I wonder if the Fall Fae Queen has anything else for us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fairy Foray ' quest.

quests.name: Holy Wasabi
quests.description: Holy Wasabi is the leanest, meanest, greenest flavoring around, and it packs a real punch when you're pounding on the Undead. The soldiers here love it, but I'm out of stock! Can you bring me back some some Blessed Water and some Dried Ectoplasm? It tastes just like Wasabi powder! (Quest can only be done once per login)

quests.name: Light Yogurt Ingredients
quests.description: To keep the Keep's Warrior's in tip-top shape, I stock only the finest, most nourishing, reduced-calorie consumables! The Light Yogurt is a favorite, but I'm out of the bacteria cultures and Tree-Sap sweetener to make more. Undead Soldiers and DoomWood Treants should have all I need!

quests.name: Holy Roast
quests.description: Blessed Coffee of the Lightguard? A very good choice, indeed! I'd love to make you a cup, but it's a popular item, and I've run out of beans. My exclusive roast requires exclusive beans - Pally Luwak, which can only be obtained for the Oasis Monkeys in the /sandsea. Don't ask - you don't want to know.

quests.name: Trade for the Ice Diamond
quests.description: You want the Ice Diamond, do you? Forging a new one will take a long time. But if you're willing to help me get a head start on it, I may be willing to make a trade. Bring me some Frozen Coal from the local Snow Golems. Enough to form a diamond as big as the original.

quests.name: Need Food
quests.description: We're almost out of food and water up here. Will you go out and get some for us? The Treeants have fruit we can eat, and the Shadowflame Scouts often carry canteens.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Delivery Time ' quest.

quests.name: A New Coat
quests.description: We hide by blending in. By camouflaging ourselves in the inky shadow that the imps leave behind. If we don't want them to find us, we're going to need a new coat. Normally I'd get it myself, but I'm in no shape to go outside. Think you can help?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bruise the Bruiser
quests.description: You have already done so much good since you've been here. I have one more to ask of you. The monsters you've dealt with so far have just been minions. If you take out the Shadowflame Bruiser. they'll scatter, and we will be safer… at least for awhile. It hides out by the old Coliseum.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.
