quests.name: Beat the Dire Groglurk!
quests.description: Head to /bosschallenge and take on the Dire Groglurk! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Beat the Mutated Void Dragon!
quests.description: Head to /bosschallenge and take on the Mutated Void Dragon! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Beat the Underbeast!
quests.description: Head to /ravenloss and take on the Underbeast! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Beat the Manticore!
quests.description: Head to /venomvaults and take on the Manticore! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Beat Binky!
quests.description: Head to /doomvault and take on Binky the Unicorn! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Beat the Hulking Castle Spider!
quests.description: Head to /bosschallenge and take on the Hulking Castle Spider! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: More Ore
quests.description: I'm running low on supplies, and my orders are starting to back up. Think you could help me out? I need some Arashtite ore - you can get that from the deathmoles in /orecavern. I could also use some Obsidian ore, which you can get from the living fire in /mafic.

quests.name: Checking Out the Competition
quests.description: It's always good to keep up to date on what your competition is doing! That's why I like to study the weapons of my enemies whenever I can - it lets me know what I'm up against, and what I have to do to stay competitive! Go to /legioncrypt, and collect some weapons from the Legion Doomknights and Undead Infantry. Then, go to /underworld and collect the blades of the Infernalfiends and Dreadfiends. Bring it all back to me when you're done.

quests.name: Testing My Metal
quests.description: I sell my weapons to all of the Seraphic Assassins in the city - quite a prestigious honor! Of course, this means I have to make sure my work is always top notch. They seem to love keeping their fighting skills honed, so maybe you could offer to duel them? And then report back to me on how well their blades did against yours.

quests.name: Opal Giftbox Quest
quests.description: Battle Santy Claws in the /northlandlight region. Bring me back an Opal Gift Bow and you'll be rewarded with even more presents!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Opal Giftbox Sneevil in your inventory.

quests.name: Unlocking the Chest
quests.description: This chest seems to be locked tight. No keys seem to fit on the lock. However, when you bring the Blade of Awe close to it, the chest shakes. It seems like the chest reacts to specific items?

quests.name: The Stolen Ritual
quests.description: My studies indicate that there was once a ritual to crete something called a Blood Ancient, which has all of the powers of a vampire but can give them to any creature with none of our weaknesses. With the Chaos Lycans attacking the castle they must have found it for me by now. Destroy Chaos Lycans untill you recover all 10 pages of the ritual then return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. Notes: These quests (other than the 'Ancient Vitae' quest) can only be completed once .

items_required.name: Page of the Blood Ancient Ritual

quests.name: A Pound Of Flesh
quests.description: This ritual was written in Vampire Blood, I can smell the age… the power… but it was hexed to be unreadable. I know a spell to break the hex but we will need Blood Maggot flesh to create the reagent. Gather 10 Pounds of Blood Maggot Flesh and return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. Notes: These quests (other than the 'Ancient Vitae' quest) can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blood Of The Ancients
quests.description: This… is no ritual. Once you drink the resulting concoction you will become a Blood Ancient! We could mke an army of Blood Ancients! It says that there are 4 Phylacteries hidden in this very castle which hold the blood of 4 ancient vampire warriors. Interrogate the Chaos Lycan to find out if they have already found these Phylacteries.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. Notes: These quests (other than the 'Ancient Vitae' quest) can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Phinding Phylacteries
quests.description: Now what we know where be missing Phylacteries are located, go retrieve them. I will begin preparing the concoction. It's a complex recipe, but I understand what must be done. Return me with 4 Phylacteries once you have found them all.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. Notes: These quests (other than the 'Ancient Vitae' quest) can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The First Phylactery
quests.description: Oh, the phylacteries are sealed with ancient magic. If we can locate the source, then breaking the spells should be simple enough. The first phylactery is marked with the Djinn's insignia. It is likely an ultra- powerful Djinn holds the magic we seek.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. Notes: These quests (other than the 'Ancient Vitae' quest) can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Second Phylactery
quests.description: The second phylactery is marked with an hourglass. Are there any Ultra-powerful Chronomancers you know of that could be in possession of ancient magic?
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. Notes: These quests (other than the 'Ancient Vitae' quest) can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Third Phylactery
quests.description: The third phylactery is marked with the Darkblood's insignia. Perhaps an Ultra-powerful foe in the Thunderforge area has seized the Darkblood's ancient magic.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. Notes: These quests (other than the 'Ancient Vitae' quest) can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Final Phylactery
quests.description: The final phylactery is marked with the insignia of a an Ancient three-headed Dragon. Are you prepared to face certain death in order to obtain its magic?
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. Notes: These quests (other than the 'Ancient Vitae' quest) can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ancient Vitae
quests.description: The Blood Ancient concoction WILL work. I know this to be true, and I will allow you to become a true Blood Ancient - but first, I will need you to bring me a small sample of blood from the Vampire Queen herself in /battledoom. From that and the other ancient blood samples, I will distill a single Ancient Vitae… then the power of the Blood Ancient will be yours!
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. Notes: These quests (other than the 'Ancient Vitae' quest) can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What We Need Is A Big Can Of Raid
quests.description: All these infernals - they‘re like cockroaches, and they need to be exterminated! Did you know. we can‘t even drink their blood? And those weapons of theirs burn like sunlight! Help me thin their numbers so we can have some hope of rescuing our queen,
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Undead Investigation ' quest.

quests.name: Trapped!
quests.description: The crisis isn‘t over yet - the Queen‘s castle is still burning with Celestial ﬁre, and Lady Solani is still trapped inside it! Obviously we can‘t enter the castle to rescue her - the ﬁre will quickly destroy us - so we need you to go in and ﬁnd her. And on your way. see if you can get that ﬁre under control.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Trade for the Dark Bloodstone
quests.description: A Dark Bloodstone? What do you want one of those for? I can craft it for you, but I'll need ten Blood Gems from you first. They form inside the bellies of the Blood Maggots.

quests.name: Bats Blood Rune
quests.description: The next step is to place several Blood Runes on each of the local monsters so we can find which of them have Legacy Vitae running through their veins from feasting on my kind. Go and place Blood Runes on 5 Albino Bats. You will need to defet them to place the runes. Return when you have accomplished this task.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Phinding Phylacteries ' quest.

quests.name: Maggots Blood Rune Placed
quests.description: Now you will need to place Blood Runes on 10 Blood Maggots. These creatures live almost entirely on the blood of Vampires so you will need to place more than you did on the bats. They should become a ready source of Legacy Vitae. Return when you are done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lycan Blood Rune Placed
quests.description: Now it begins to grow more difficult. You must defeat several Chaos Lycan and place Blood Runes on them, but they will not as cooperative as the others monsters. Several may die rather than allow themselves to be marked with a rune. Return when you have placed 10 Blood Runes on the Chaos Lycans.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Twisted Paw's Blood Rune Placed
quests.description: Only one creature left to mark. He has feasted on so many of us that he might be the greatest source of Legacy Vitae in the area which is why he MUST be marked. In the village below the castle, Twistedpaw awaits. Mark him with a single Blood Rune and we can begin gathering Legacy Vitae.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Beachin' Summer Badge
quests.description: You'll want to head to the /baconcatlair to slay one of them super-fancy cloud sharks. They swim up in the sky all year 'round. Not like the sharks on this here beach.
quests.requirements_note: Must have OtaQuibble Quest Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Berry Interesting
quests.description: Blast, I'm running low on raspberries again, and I just can't make my world-famous smoothies without them! Those greedy Pine Trolls keep picking the bushes empty to keep their belt pouches full. I'd be really grateful if you could get me some of those berries, and teach those trolls a lesson at the same time. Come back here with 8 BERRY POUCHES and there's some gold in it for ya!
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 20.

quests.name: Sneak Attack
quests.description: It appears that the Shard is deeper into this fortress. The Fiends guarding it don't know our intentions yet. Quietly take out some of these guards while we find where it's hidden.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Break their Muti-kneecaps ' quest.

quests.name: Fiend-terrogation
quests.description: "Nicely" ask these Fiends how to get that door open, though I don't think they'll answer us. We'll just have to knock the information out of them. Though some Fiends might not be so willing to tell us everything. Let's find the ones that will, then!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Break their Muti-kneecaps ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Key Difference Between Human and Fiend
quests.description: There are four pieces to this key. You'll have to search every Fiend in this area in order to locate all of the pieces. Let's hope the Key Fragments weren't with the ones you already defeated!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Break their Muti-kneecaps ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Unlock the Door
quests.description: I think the Fiends have finally caught on to our plan! We need to fight our way back to that door! Hurry!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Break their Muti-kneecaps ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Dirtlicking Guards
quests.description: Dirtlicker seems to have caught wind of our plan as well! If we are going to make it to the Fiend Shard, we're going to have to face him. But first, the Fiend Paladin and Void Knight guards stand in our way! Take them out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Break their Muti-kneecaps ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat Dirtlicker
quests.description: Dirtlicker has been busy behind Nulgath's back! He has communed with Adimonde and got a Fiend Shard himself! We have to shatter it if we have a chance of beating him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Break their Muti-kneecaps ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Destroy the Fiend Shard
quests.description: It doesn't look like you will catch a break from these Fiends. You will have to chip away at the Fiend Shard while fighting off those Fiends!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Break their Muti-kneecaps ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: De-shard the Shard
quests.description: We need to keep Nulgath's shard from regenerating. If it does that, my world remains in peril! Please continue defeating Nulgath's shard. It is not an easy task, but the rewards are worth it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy the Fiend Shard ' quest.

quests.name: The Swirling Abyss Gathers
quests.description: With some of the leftover remaining energy and the library at our disposal, we can probably create a “fiend” but more like a shell for you to wear! Think of it like a disguise of sorts. However, we will need to find reagents Nulgath likes to use when creating fiends before we begin with the helmets and capes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy the Fiend Shard ' quest.

quests.name: It Calls to You
quests.description: Now that we presumably got you some accessories, or maybe you just wanna jump right into the big part first and get it over with, this is where a big chunk of things will be used. This tome here has everything we need to get started. You can have a list too, I’ll be here when you’re ready to get started.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy the Fiend Shard ' quest.

quests.name: Toothy Smiles
quests.description: Mudluks not used to strangers. That why they hide in huts and swamp. U must win Mudluk trust first before you get Rod of Defiance. A gift be nice start. Mudluks love wear shiny Swamp Lurker Teeth. Bring Paddylump 10 Swamp Lurker Teeth and me give to village for you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Paddy Lump ' quest. Note: These quests can be only completed once .

quests.name: Slimy Cyrus
quests.description: Next thing U need do to prove yourself to Mudluks is help a needy villager. Slimy Cyrus is we best clothing maker. Slimy Cyrus need 5 Slimy Skins but her broke her leg and Paddylump be too busy guarding to hunt for she. You get 5 Slimy Skins from any swamp monster and bring them to Paddylump!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Paddy Lump ' quest. Note: These quests can be only completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest's name is a parody of Miley Cyrus .

quests.name: Lord Of The Fleas
quests.description: Next, help with Mudluk food shortage to prove U worthy to take Rod of Deiance, murp! Mudluks used to live on swamp bugs nasty frogdrakes eat them all! Help Mudluks gather bugs from new place! Gorillaphants furry hide COVERED with fleas! U bring Paddylump 12 HUGE fleas so us can start flea farm!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Paddy Lump ' quest. Note: These quests can be only completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Not The Best Idea
quests.description: Mudluks discover that it almost impossible to farm fleas. Terruble idea. Paddylup have better idea! U go hunt frogdrakes, so there be more yummy buggies for Mudluks! Need to keep swamp in balance so you not get rid of all of them, but take care of 12 frogdrakes and us should be OK, murp!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Paddy Lump ' quest. Note: These quests can be only completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gates and Guardians
quests.description: U finally ready to get Rod of Defiance, murp! First U must open gate. Mudluks very smart and tricky. U need to open gate by finding right combination of switch crystals around village, then when gate open… U have to fight guardian of the rod.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Paddy Lump ' quest. Note: These quests can be only completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Omnomnoms
quests.description: Murp burp! Mudluks be hungry again. We no want fleas. We want good nomnoms. U get spuchul foods for Paddylump and Paddylump gives U spuchul Reputation 'n stuff. Cloister Tree is full of Acornents and Karasu that haz delish noms. U bring Paddylump 15 Wiggly Worms and 10 MegaMites from bad Cloister baddies and U get quest complete!

quests.name: The Jade Spirit
quests.description: Do you have what it takes to prove yourself to Panlong? Then bring me the Spirit of a Dragon! Hidden deep within a forest cave is where to find the first. Guarding hoards of gold is the only thing he knows. Find this Dragon. Bring me his Jade Spirit. If successful, I will award you with a token of my appreciation. Good luck, mortal.

quests.name: The Crimson Spirit
quests.description: Do you have what it takes to prove yourself to Panlong? Then bring me the Spirit of a Dragon! There is a Dragon who slumbers inside a mountainous lair. His scales reflect his victim's bloodshed. Find this Dragon. Bring me his Crimson Spirit. I will award you with a token of my appreciation if successful. Good luck.

quests.name: The Magmas Spirit
quests.description: Do you have what it takes to prove yourself to Panlong? Then bring me the Spirit of a Dragon! Where magic and natural phenomenon meet is where you will find him. He protects a great treasure deep within his fiery hot chamber. Find this Dragon. Bring me his Magmas Spirit. If successful, I will award you with a token of my appreciation.

quests.name: The Cerulean Spirit
quests.description: Do you have what it takes to prove yourself to Panlong? Then bring me the Spirit of a Dragon! Symbolizing longevity, righteousness, knowledge, and good luck, this dragon was once a dear friend of Panlong. He lives just beyond the Phoenix nest. Find this Dragon. Bring me his Cerulean Spirit. Good luck, mortal, and I will award you if successful.

quests.name: The Scrawl Spirit
quests.description: Do you have what it takes to prove yourself to Panlong? Then bring me the Spirit of a Dragon! This beast is the mother of all Dragons-it is where every Dragon begins. Despite his stature, a great mortal should have no problem finishing him off. Find this dragon. Bring me his Scrawl Spirit. Upon completion, I will award you with a token of my appreciation.

quests.name: The Airborne Spirit
quests.description: Do you have what it takes to prove yourself to Panlong? Then bring me the Spirit of a Dragon! Take to the skies to hunt down this armored beast. Make sure to keep your guard up. Find this Dragon. Bring me his Airborne Spirit. If successful, I will award you with a token of my appreciation.

quests.name: The Lava Spirit
quests.description: Do you have what it takes to prove yourself to Panlong? Then bring me the Spirit of a Dragon! Insanity flows through his veins, fueling this fiery beast. The armor that he wears belonged to the Dragonhunters claimed by his unforgiving might. Find this Dragon. Bring me his Lava Spirit. I will give you a token of my appreciation if you return victorious.

quests.name: Research Material
quests.description: We will make this world bow before us. Dage wants you to gather their most advanced technology to study. Defeat some of the Cyborg Dogs for their circuit boards and Mad Scientists for blueprints within /laken. With those, we can further our plans.

quests.name: Suffering is Magic
quests.description: Bits and pieces are one component of conquering an area. Another is to disarm them entirely. It seems the resistance has a new toy for us to take as well. Take everything you can scavenge from them. The /laken map will be your playground for destruction.

quests.name: Those Poor, Lost Souls
quests.description: So some of our recruits, new and old, think they can actually just “leave”? I say let's make an example out of them. Go “fetch” those Legion Defectors for me in /envy. They have much more to fear than just death.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Paragon Dreadnaught Pet .

quests.name: Dreadnought's Quest
quests.description: For you, one who calls the Underworld home, I shall craft a land beyond compare. One that will skewer your enemies and slaughter the weak. All I ask is that you help cleanse this realm of Nulgath's minions. Slay 13 Infernal Fiends in the Underworld and I shall reward you.

quests.name: Undead Champion Initiation
quests.description: This is your trial round, Hero. Fail this, and you fail at becoming an Undead Champion. Got it? Your first - and easiest - mission is to take down the Black Knight of Greenguard Forest. The Knight has been Undead for quite some time yet refuses to join the Undead Legion… so it's up to YOU to show the Black Knight the Legion's true power.

quests.name: Mourn The Soldiers
quests.description: Undead Champions show no mercy. You must see to it that you do what you are told -- no questions asked. Your next mission is to scout out the entire world of Lore, destroying every dubbed Soldier you encounter. Hunt down the 4 specific Soldiers that the Legion has ordered to exterminate.

quests.name: Understanding Undead Champions
quests.description: The Legion does not tolerate failure. When one of our own kin betrays the Legion, the unfortunate gets stripped of his power and is sent to the deep caverns beneath Battleon to rot for eternity. If you do not wish meet the same fate, you simply must not fail. How hard is that demand to meet?

quests.name: Player vs Power
quests.description: The time has come for you to prove your power against fellow adventurers. Join a PvP battleground /bludrutbrawl and show your might against inferior race of Man by defeating anyone you find there - monster or other player. True Undead Champions know they possess great power and will not hold anything back. Only when you collected 200 Combat Trophies will you truly understand the power bestowed upon the Undead Legion.

quests.name: Fail to the King
quests.description: In Swordhaven, Good King Alteon is a symbol of all that is pure and good. He is well-guarded… and that must end! Go to him /Join prison and slay 25 of his Knights so that one day soon… you will be able to slay HIM!

quests.name: Obtain the Dark Caster Class
quests.description: Do you posses my very first Dark Caster armor? Ah, then you wish to serve my Legion as a Dark Caster. I will grant you this honor IF you bring what I crave. 200 Legion Tokens will prove your worthiness then obtain a Tasty Cookie from the Red Dragon in her lair…for my hunger knows no bounds.

quests.name: High Legion Champion
quests.description: If you would become the Legion's greatest Champion, you must slay Undead Champions to prove your battle prowess. Bring me the head of 13 Undead Champions in Battleunderb and 1 Undead Head from an Undead Giant.
quests.requirements_note: Must own High Legion Champion .

quests.name: Exalted Legion Champion
quests.description: If you would become the Legion's greatest Champion, you must slay Undead Champions to prove your battle prowess. Bring me the head of 13 Undead Champions in Battleunderb and 1 Undead Head from an Undead Giant.
quests.requirements_note: Must own Exalted Legion Champion (Armor) . Note: Only accessible in Underworld .

quests.name: Endurance Test
quests.description: Dance, puppet. I want to see you SWEAT. This quest WILL change at random. The more Evil you prove yourself to be, the better the rewards!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to The King ' quest. Note: Only accessible in Underworld .

quests.name: Dage's Black Box
quests.description: You want to know what's in the black box? Of course you do. You'll have to work for it. Slay the sneevils in the Boxes map until you find the note. Then follow the instructions.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to The King ' quest. Note: Only accessible in Underworld .

quests.name: Vampiric Essences
quests.description: Barely heard whispers are floating on the mists of the Underworld about a masquerade. Rumors are starting to rumble throughout Darkovia and the Underworld of vampires and fae, but nothing of substance has been discovered. We just cannot hear enough - the whispers are too soft… for now.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to The King ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Undead Legion's Fiendish Reward
quests.description: Exclusive quest for members of the Undead Legion.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Paragon Fiend's House Quest
quests.description: The warriors of the Undead Legion are the finest in the Underworld *and* across Lore. We hone our skills via constant, never-ending combat. For many, the Underworld Arena becomes their Eternal battlegrounds (when not serving Dage the Evil). To make it your home, defeat the Legion Paragon Fiend Rider in combat and take his key to the dome.

quests.name: Taking a Boat Trip
quests.description: Do you require a new piece of equipment to use? Is your blade getting dull? Or do you just prefer to have something finely made for once? Let us travel these lands. I will need Sullen and wrathful sounds found in the river /styx. Do not ask questions, retrieve these for me.

quests.name: Clear a Path
quests.description: I have heard in these lands named Fotia there is a resistance here against your Dage. It matters not which Dage, I will hear none of it. Take out some of the local creatures.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Time for Some Spring Cleaning
quests.description: It's still noisy in this particular area. Why is it that your Dage allowed this area to exist in the first place? Take them all out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Fueling Insanity
quests.description: So you're a pro at collecting rare monster drops, huh? Well prove it… if you've got what it takes. Prove your worth the Dark Lord of the Undead Legion by bringing me the Phoenix Blade, Dragon Wings, the Spine Gripper, and the Golden Crush Blade. In return, I will fork over 50 Legion Tokens…and possibly something else…if you're really lucky…

quests.name: Insanely Insane
quests.description: What drove the Dark Lord down the path of evil and insanity? Some say it was the hunt for the Phoenix Blade. Will you reach the same fate? There is only one way to find out. Bring me the Phoenix Blade and you will have a chance at earning 30 Legion Tokens—but I can make no promises. Maybe you'll get lucky and earn another prize… or maybe you'll wind up with nothing other than furious rage and insanity. Either way, this should be fun…

quests.name: Donation to the Dark Lord
quests.description: The Undead Legion is in need of donations. And you will be awarded for your contributions. Hand over your Legion Donation and 1 Darkness Core from an Infernal Fiend of Nulgath in /underworld and I will grant you 1 Legion Token.

quests.name: Embrace the Godly Mace
quests.description: The Dark Lord wishes to own a weapon of epic proportions. He has spoke of the Godly Mace of the Ancients and wants to add it to his arsenal. Anyone who can deliver this massive mace will be awarded handsomely. An inquisitor guard in the Citadel will show you where to find the mace.

quests.name: Overlord Overload
quests.description: The Dark Lord wishes to own a back item that enhances his already horrifying persona. He has mentioned the Tentacles of the Overlord and wants to add it to his wardrobe. Anyone who can deliver these terrifying tentacles will be awarded handsomely. A Doomwood Soldier will be able to give you a map to the Tentacles.

quests.name: Be the Shinobi
quests.description: The Dark Lord digs shadows. As if that's any news to you. The Dark Lord wants to recruit Shadow Shinobis to join the Undead Legion. So it looks like you've got another mission. Bring me the Shadow Shinobi AND a Shinobi Katana from the Ninaja Nopperabo and I will deliver them to the Dark Lord.

quests.name: A Shade of Shadow
quests.description: What Legion would be complete without an onslaught of Shadow minions? The Dark Lord wishes to recruit more Shadow minions and is in need of Shadow Weavers and Shadow Essence. Bring me the Shadow Weaver and the Essence from a Lesser Shadow Serpent and I will deliver them to the Dark Lord.

quests.name: Vampire Inspire
quests.description: The Vampiric family has inspired the Dark Lord. He wishes to recruit only the strongest Vampires to join the Undead Legion. Bring me a Vampire Emissary and the pledge from a Vampire Knight fighting in the /lycanwar and I will be sure to deliver it to the Dark Lord.

quests.name: He's Lycan the Recruits
quests.description: The Dark Lord has a new following of Shadow Weavers, Shadow Shinobis, and Vampire Emissaries. The only thing missing are Lycans! Only the strongest Lycans are hereby invited to join the Undead Legion. Bring me a Lycan Knight and the pledge from one of the Lycan Knights and I will be sure to deliver them to the Dark Lord.

quests.name: Taking a Boat Trip
quests.description: Do you require a new piece of equipment to use? Is your blade getting dull? Or do you just prefer to have something finely made for once? Let us travel these lands. I will need Sullen and wrathful sounds found in the river /styx. Do not ask questions, retrieve these for me.

quests.name: Clear a Path
quests.description: I have heard in these lands named Fotia there is a resistance here against your Dage. It matters not which Dage, I will hear none of it. Take out some of the local creatures.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Time for Some Spring Cleaning
quests.description: It's still noisy in this particular area. Why is it that your Dage allowed this area to exist in the first place? Take them all out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: HPBreaker
quests.description: I am currently suffering from a broken HP bar. And the quickest way to cure any broken HP Bar is to steal it from someone else! I don't necessarily want to get revenge… so I was wondering if you could do that for me? Go into Mythsong Canyon and break enough HP Bars until you obtain 4 Shattered HP Bars. Be careful out there-love is a battleground.

quests.name: Crit 'em with your best shot
quests.description: The Rock Lobsters and Grateful Undeads are coming ever closer to the city limits… which means they're getting closer to my shop! How can I run a business with those creatures scaring away my clientele? Exactly. Go out into the Canyon and fire away 4 Grateful Undeads and 4 Rock Lobsters if you want these lovely rewards!

quests.name: Help Control the Pet Population
quests.description: Lightovia is home to a pack of fearless werewolves ruled by Queen Safiria. If you hope to get the Crown of Blood, it is probably best you clear a path through those rabid mutts first. Defeat 10 War Lycans and show us that you are the top dog!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get the List! ' quest

quests.name: Impress the Queen
quests.description: You didn't have any trouble taking out the War Lycans… so let's up the challenge by defeating 10 War Lycan Knights! These mutts are much more vicious (and armored) than regular lycans, but if you can slay enough of them, then your great power will surely be noticed by Queen Safiria.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest

quests.name: A Gift of Silver
quests.description: In your world, Werewolves probably HATE silver, right? Well guess what, pal; they LOVE it here! Since you are one step away from meeting the Queen, you should probably stock-up on some silver so that she doesn't bite your head off—literally. Collect 10 Silver Talismans from War Lycans and Lycan Knights and bring it back to us so we can award you with gold and stuff.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest

quests.name: Crown of Blood
quests.description: Queen Safiria is waiting for you. She has the Crown of Blood that we need… and maybe (hopefully) if you ask nicely, she'll hand it over. Right? It's good to be optimistic! Good luck, hero.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest

quests.name: Ear-responsible
quests.description: The Nugget Man is resposinsible for distorting this once stinky farm into a chaotically stinky farm. He feeds his livestock Chaos Corn, which is not the most organic of feeds out there. As you can see, it has chaorrupted everything on these lands! Gather 10 ears of Chaos Corn and bring them back to us so we can… I dunno… make Chaos Corinfritters?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Crown of Blood' quest

quests.name: A Carton of Chaos
quests.description: What came first, the Chaos Chicken or the Egg? …we haven't figured that one out yet. While we contemplate this great mystery, go out and collect 12 Chaos Eggs from some Chickens. But we wouldn't recommend eating them… not until they've been scrambled with some bacon grease or something.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest

quests.name: Free the Poultry
quests.description: Yes! We seem to be winning! Nugget Man will surely recruit a chicken army (??) if we do not hurry. Before it's too late, free 10 Chaos Chickens and set them free! Nothing beats free-range poultry… mostly because normal chickens have no reason to engage in battle.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest

quests.name: Defeat Nugget Man
quests.description: Created from mechanically recovered meat and chaotic-foaming products, the Nugget Man is the fowlest threat that we have ever encountered. He lives — if you can recall it that — at the very end of the fields. Defeat the Nugget Man, get the Platinum Feather, and send him to his honey-mustard filled grave!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest

Pearl of Light Lantern Pet's Quest.name: Pearl of Light Lantern Pet's Quest

location.name: Pearl of Light Lantern Pet (0 AC)

quests.name: Pearl of Light Lantern
quests.description: Prove your worth, and you can have a copy of this lantern to keep in your house.

location.name: Pearl of Light Lantern Pet (0 AC)

quests.name: Pearly Orb's Quest
quests.description: Yar! Every fiendish pirate knows that if'n ye can't fight yer way out of a situation, you can usually bribe yer way out. Bring me 3 Pearly Scales from th' Fishman Soldiers in /pirates an' 3 sets of Shark Eyes from th' Sharkbait in Pirates.
quests.requirements_note: Quests are available only to owner.

items.name: Dual Breath of Oblivion Katanas (0 AC)

quests.name: Bait and Switch
quests.description: A couple of weeks ago, my tackle box was stuffed to the gills with my hand-made lures. But now, every time I cast one in, those blasted Fishmen yank it right off my line! I figure they owe me one. If I had a handful of their shiny scales, then I could make a whole new set of even BETTER lures… and it would teach them a little lesson about stealin' to boot! I think 15 scales would do just fine. (Return with 15 Fishman Scales to complete this quest)

quests.name: Restocking
quests.description: Any good fisherman knows not to overfish one spot but I guess no one ever taught the Zardmen and Fishmen that. They have just about fished this part of the river to death! If you can bring me some of the live fish that they have caught then I can release them upstream and start restocking the supply before they set off the whole balance of the river! I will only need 10 live fish to get started. (Return to Pete Noggle on the River with 10 Live Fish.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spear Sabotage
quests.description: Those Zardmen may fish mainly with nets, but they still do love their spears. While they've been busy haulin' in their nets, I've been sneakin' in and breakin' their spears to try and drive them away. I reckon that if you're willing to give me a hand, we can break enough spears between us to make 'em go back where they came from and think twice about comin' back where they aren't wanted. Let's see if breaking 5 more spears is enough to send 'em off for good! (Return with 5 broken spears to complete quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Retaliation
quests.description: The river used to be a nice, peaceful place to spend a day fishin'… until the Fishmen and their leader Kuro showed up! Now those blasted fishfolk have taken over the River, and they don't seem to like us Fishermen. Still, I'm bettin' that if we can scare off their leader, the rest of 'em will scramble home right quick. Just bring me back one of Kuro's tentacles and we'll prove to those Fishmen that we mean business! (Bring back a Kuro Tentacle to complete this quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fishing Bait
quests.description: Hmmm… I notice that whenever Kuro is around, the fish seem to go crazy. I bet that a piece of him would make for a mighty fine bait! If you lay your hands on a few of them Kuro tails, I may never need to go diggin' for worms again! (Bring back 3 Kuro's Tails to complete this quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Flood of Power
quests.description: Boy, I thought we had it bad…but I just heard that several of the surrounding fishing villages have been flooded! Survivors reported seeing a huge Water Elemental appear just before the flooding started. Those poor villagers don't stand a chance against an elemental…but I bet a Hero like you could make short work of him! Why don't you go hunt him down, and bring me back his Essence so we can prove to the villagers that it's safe to return home? (Return 1 Water Elemental Essence to complete this quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Draconic Love Potion
quests.description: Hi! I'm making a batch of love potions, but I don't have enough of some of the ingredients I need. If you're going to be traveling to Waterstorm, you could help me out! I need the eyes of 8 Marsh Lurkers, the warts from 5 Frogdrakes, and the musk from 3 Fishwings.

quests.name: Red Drake Energy Drink
quests.description: You look like you travel around a lot! Want to help me make some Red Energy Drake Potions? All I need are a few balls of lightning from the lightning balls in Airstorm, an Eye of the Storm from the Energy Tornado you'll find in the same area, and a few pinched of Imp Sulfur from the Sulfur Imps in Firestorm. Instant-pick-me-up!

quests.name: Sleepytime for Quoklets
quests.description: Quoklins are sensitive creatures. As such, we should use only the softest bedding in their enclosures. I've found that Trollola Leaves, from the Trollola Plants in /bloodtusk, works the best. Gather some for our precious babies, and spread it around the shop for them to lay on.

quests.name: Keeping Quoklets Warm
quests.description: We have to make sure our little fuzzbuckets stay warm enough - if they get too cold, they'll start to hibernate! All it really takes is a good heat rock. Bring me some good, solid stone from any earth elemental - you can find some in /gilead - and some Living Flame from the Living Fire in /mafic. I'll show you how to make one!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Food for Quoklins
quests.description: Finally, it's very important to feed your pet Quoklin the proper diet. They need Crunchy Foliage - which, luckily, you can get from the Treeants near our town. They also need some good Quality Hay, which you'll have to get from the Scarecrow at the /farm. And lastly, some Tasty Seeds, which can only be found on Seed Spitters! Find some in /Arcangrove. When you've gathered everything, come back and feed it to some of our growing quoklets!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Groundhorc's Day
quests.description: General Porkon in the Horc Fort has stolen Philip, the weather predicting Groundhog! That pig-headed general doesn't understand that if Philip doesn't at least LOOK at his shadow winter will NEVER END! If you rescue him I can give you one of these GROUNDHORC DAY ONLY seasonal rares! Please go to the Horc Fort and rescue Philip!

quests.name: Midas Touched
quests.description: Xergon's curse did a number on these pirates. Gold doesn't exactly float, so we've got a sunken ship on our hands. Looks like a clan of Merdraconians have already started exploring the wreck and fell victim to its corruption - go clear them out so they don't impede our invest-egg-ation.

quests.name: Clearing the Cargo hold
quests.description: Ignore the local wildlife, it's the corrupted pirate ship and crew you need to watch out for. These pirates are too blinded by their greed to leave the dragon egg alone.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Golden Scale (1) to access this quest.

quests.name: Au-Dacity to Attack
quests.description: The crew is on to our egg stealing shenanigans. We'd better arm ourselves in case of a counterattack. Bring me as many pirate pistols as you can carry!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Crystal Fragment to access this quest.

quests.name: Getting the Gauntlet
quests.description: An anti-Au gauntlet is needed to grab Xergon's egg. See what materials these corrupted monsters have hiding. With enough leather and anti-Au crystals, Xergon's egg in our grasp.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Powder Flask to access this quest.

quests.name: Against the Elements
quests.description: Livings Waters are the universal solvent of the animal kingdom, add a little gold corruption on top of that title and we have a beast we can't let be. Get evaporating hero!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Broken Anti-Au Crystal to access this quest.

quests.name: Gold Men Tell No Tales
quests.description: Xergon's egg turned these normal pirates into greedy guardians. Now that the curse ruined their lies, they will never let it out of their sights. Take out some Cursed Pirates and Gilded Crystal Undead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Flagon of Water to access this quest.

quests.name: Taking Sides
quests.description: The Merdraconian are beginning to understand their current predicament. If Captain Nubar and his corrupted crew can persuade the Merdraconian to their side, our expedition is dead in the water. Strike fear into the fish beasts and get them to join us!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Old Weapon to access this quest.

quests.name: Crystallized Crew
quests.description: A gold-corrupted crew is nothing without their greedy captain. A crew this loyal would rather have their bones ground before giving up the Captain's cabin key. If we can't find the key, maybe the brutes have something else to break down the door. Check those Crystallized Undead for a crowbar!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Shell to access this quest.

quests.name: Getting a Nubar of Gold
quests.description: I'm sure the gold and guilt of dooming his crew has driven Captain Nubar crazy, be careful when confronting him. Don't want my partner in crime sent to Davy Jones' Locker.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Crystallized Crowbar to access this quest.

quests.name: Killer Coral
quests.description: I don't know where the Trapdoor treasure-hold is hiding exactly. Don the anti-Au gauntlet you gathered materials for earlier and go find that treasure!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Trapdoor Key to access this quest.

quests.name: Driving for Xergon
quests.description: FLYING FISHFLAKES! I see why their ship was so bent out of shape. That THING is unnatural. We need to bring Lobthulhu a 3-course feast of pain or end up being the entrée ourselves.
quests.requirements_note: Must have What is THAT?! (Misc) to access this quest.

quests.name: Evaporating Enemy Angles
quests.description: Xergon's egg is ours but those it corrupted are dead set on wreaking havoc. They may seem impossible to contain, but we can't risk the corrupted Living Waters reaching the mainland!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Lobthulu Claw to access these quests.

quests.name: Nubar's Numbskulls
quests.description: The egg is ours and Nubar's crew still fights back. Teach the lot of them that we stole back Xergon fair and square!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Lobthulu Claw to access these quests.

quests.name: Golden Guys
quests.description: Xergon's curse has seemingly turned the brains of Captain Nubar and our Lobster friend solid gold. Why else would the duo be convinced they can still defeat us? Go let the golden guys know you are a fighter in mint condition!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Lobthulu Claw to access these quests.

quests.name: Black Friday 2022 Badge
quests.description: A note from Zorbak reads: "You want to get REALLY dark? Slay Cysero's Chickcow in Battleontown… and bring me the Rubber Ducky it will drop when you defeat it. I have… PLANS.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Pink Agitated Orb Quest in your inventory.

items.name: Black Friday 2022 Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Pirate King's Skull
quests.description: YARRR! If'n ye want to look like ME for eternity (an'lets be honest here, who wouldna?) then all ye need do is slay the Undead Pirates in /pirates until you get the following things: 1 Pirate Skull and 2 Rubies of DOOM. Bring me those, and I'll work my undead magic.

quests.name: Kick that Booty!
quests.description: The Blacksea crew no longer be mine - they're followin' Bloodbone now. We'll have to go through them to get him, an' I don't mind showing those turncoats that they chose the wrong side! Spare none! Kick ALL o' their… booties!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Break In! ' quest.

quests.name: We Need a Spell
quests.description: If these scurvy sea dogs want to use the shadows against me, then I'll just have to take them away from 'em! Find me some o' the Spell Reagents that the Blacksea Mages use… an' also a sufficiently compliant mage.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Light up the Shadows
quests.description: That mage ya brought back has proven to be plenty compliant after all! He's made us up some light spells we can use te rid this keep o'all the dark. Place one down in all o' the heavily shadowed areas you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get the Pitch
quests.description: Bloodbone still ain't shown his ugly face, so we'll have to draw him out. i have a plan. What I be needin' is a few globs o' pitch. Some o' those Privateers will be carryin' it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Light It Up
quests.description: Pitch be used for a lot o' things. Caulking the seams on a boat. Givin' things a good waterproof coating' And, most importantly, it be good for settin' ablaze. I've lobbed globs of it in strategic locations around the keep. Take a torch to 'em all.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get My Eye!
quests.description: We have that bilge rat right where we want him! Bring him down, and get my eye!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eyes on You
quests.description: The island be watchin' us! Kill them flyin' fisheyes before they can report back on us ta their master.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Goldun ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Behind the Tentacles
quests.description: I know we can't be seein' the whole island from here. If we clear out some o' this… tentacle mess… mayhap we'll reveal a path inward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Overwhelming Minions
quests.description: It be lookin' like the master o' this island has already been recruiting help! We shook loose a whole mess o' minions when we chopped through the overgrowth. Best fight ‘em back before we find ourselves overwhelmed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Ground Kelp?
quests.description: It be strange ta see an island form out o’ nowhere. Are ya as curious as I am to see what be underneath all o’ this? Dig inta the ground and see what it be made of… and maybe get some samples o’ those roamin’ kelp monsters, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Slug 'em!
quests.description: We be under siege again! Help me pound these writhin’ sea slugs inta the ground!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Platinum Twig Gift
quests.description: To thank you for your loyal support of AdventureQuest Worlds, the AdventureQuest Worlds developers have a gift for you. Click the button below to get a Golden Item of Digital Awesomeness.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Platinum Twig's Gift Pet in your inventory. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Platinum Twilly's Gift
quests.description: To thank you for your loyal support of AdventureQuest Worlds, the AdventureQuest Worlds developers have a gift for you. Complete the Chaos Realm Saga and acquire the Lore Champion Seal from the Achievement Tracker Shop. Click the button below to get a Golden Item of Digital Awesomeness.

quests.name: Platinum Zorbak's Gift
quests.description: To thank you for your loyal support of AdventureQuest Worlds, the AdventureQuest Worlds developers have a gift for you. Click the button below to get a Golden Item of Digital Awesomeness.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Platinum Zorbak's Gift Pet in your inventory. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Robo-Dorms
quests.description: Welcome to the Robo-Dorms! At the end of these halls, you'll find the first Beast that Alydriah captured: Bio Hazard. Like his name implies, you're going to want to protect yourself before you release him. Grab a spare HAZMAT suit from one of the lockers, and get a gas mask from one of the Lab Guards or Lance Guards.

quests.name: Free Bio Hazard!
quests.description: You'll need to unlock Bio Hazard's containment unit to set him free. One of the Lab Guards or Lance Guards should have a key. Once you've gotten the key, insert it into the control panel to unlock the cointainment unit.

quests.name: The Garden
quests.description: The Garden is where you'll find the laboratory's hottest Beast, Salamancer. He might be a little angry coming out of containment, so make sure you're prepared for the fire! The Heavy Lab Guards here will have the fire shield you need. Grab a few.

quests.name: Free Salamancer!
quests.description: Ready for some heat? Alright! Defeat the Lab Guards, Heavy Lab Guards and Lance Guards until you find one that has a key, and then use it on the control panel to release this precious darling.

quests.name: The Foundry
quests.description: Next up is the Bionic Bunny! He started out as a normal rabbit, but Alydriah's experiments gave him human intelligence and manual dextery. Now, he controls a powerful mech suit that can tear through almost anything! He may need a slight tune-up after being in containment for so long, so make sure you bring some oil and coolant when you go in to free him.

quests.name: Free the Bionic Bunny!
quests.description: Let's get this bunny out of here! Alright! Defeat the Heavy Lab Guards, Cyborgs and Monkakazi until you find one that has a key, and then use it on the control panel to set him free. And then get out of his way.

quests.name: The Reactor Core
quests.description: Alydriah has captured a baby yeti, and she's been keeping him here in the reactor core. Remember: he may be small, but that doesn't mean he's not dangerous" Bringing him some of his favorite snack should calm him down enough to keep you safe. The guards here should have some

quests.name: Free the Baby Yeti!
quests.description: First you'll need to find the right key, and then you'll need to use it on the Baby Yeti's control panel to open the containment unit and set him free. Or her. With yetis, it can be hard to tell.

quests.name: The Bridge
quests.description: I'm not sure where Kartherax came from, or even what it is - my best guess is that it's some sort of elder god. If we're going to release it - and we are! - you'll need to take some precautions to protect your mind. Otherwise, it will drive you mad. Get some psionic serum from the guards of the Bridge. If you find anything else that looks useful, take it with you as well.

quests.name: Free Kartherax!
quests.description: Are you ready? I can make no guarantees about this one. I hope everything goes well. Anyway, you know how this goes by now. Find the key, and let loose this eldritch horror.

quests.name: The Hive
quests.description: Ah, the Hive! This is where Alydriah is keeping her most recent aquisition, the Toxic Mantis. Like always, you'll need to fight your way to the containment room in order to free this majestic beast. Do her a favor, and collect some venom sacs from the Hive bugs before you go in! They may be poisonous to you, but to her they're like a jolt off caffeine. If you collect all of her eggs from the incubators they're stored in, you'll really get on her good side.

quests.name: Free the Toxic Mantis!
quests.description: This is the last one, Hero! Find the key, and then use it on the control panel to unlock the containment unit and set the Toxic Mantis free!

quests.name: Destroy the Hovership
quests.description: The only thing standing between these Beasts and their freedom is that hovership guard! Destroy it, and we can all go home. Well, not me. I live here. But everyone else can!

quests.name: Purified Claymore
quests.description: A dreadful shadow weaver by the name of Skew has the ability to curse items of his choosing. We must create weapons to counter this. Bring me a Warrior Claymore Blade so that I can purify it and enrich it with the power of Light!

quests.name: Iron Wing Helm Enchant
quests.description: Hero, bring me an "Ordinary Iron Wing Helm" and I'll enchant it with the power of Light. You can then use it in your fight against Miltonius Nulgath.
quests.requirements_note: Rank 6 Good .

quests.name: Cleansing of Spinal Tap
quests.description: Bring me a "Spinal Tap" dagger, 5 Dark Crystal Shards, and 1 Nulgath Rune 3 and I'll enchant it with the power of light to aid you in your fight.
quests.requirements_note: Rank 8 Good .

quests.name: Purified Claw
quests.description: Bring me the Claw of Nulgath and I'll enchant it for you.

quests.name: Get Ready to Amplify
quests.description: The door to the Citadel is magically sealed - which is strange, since it's been abandoned for ages! We'll need a large amount of magical power to break it open. There are some empty Mana Amplifiers laying on the ground out here. Find one, and fill it with siphoned mana from the Stray Mana and Mana Sprites wandering the area.

quests.name: Break the Seal
quests.description: Now, just take that newly-filled Mana Amp over to the door and use it to destroy the seal that's keeping it shut.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Clear out the Squatters
quests.description: Bad news, friend - the Citadel isn't so abandoned after all! It looks like some ex-Inquisitors have been squatting here. Fight off those Inquisitor Hobos so they won't impede our work!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Grab a Clue
quests.description: Someone is trying to revive the Inquisition? We can't allow that to happen! We must hurry and find a way to cure Murry so that he can help us stop it. I don't know where the tech we need is, but Murry might. Explore the area with him, and see if you can get some clues from these Inquisitors. Maybe something here will jog his memory.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Unlock the Door
quests.description: He seems to think something important is behind this door? Well, then let's beat down the Inquisitor Heavies that are guarding it and let's see what's inside.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Search the Labs
quests.description: Search the labs until you find the room where the other Murry is being kept! If we can get to the equipment in there, we can use it to siphon Murry's magic - that is to say, ME - back into him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Break Another Seal
quests.description: Another door inside one of the rooms was being held shut with a magical seal? Well, we know how to fix THAT, don't we? I see another Mana Amp over there, friend. All you need is some more siphoned mana from the Mana Sprites and Stray Mana outside. Fill it up all the way, and then go break the seal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Inspection Time
quests.description: It looks like there's another apparatus, like the one Enn'tröpy is keeping his Murry in, inside that room. Inspect it and make sure it's operational.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find the Parts
quests.description: It looks like we're going to need to find some of those missing parts if we're going to get this thing working again. You might find some of them down here in the lab, or you might find them with some of the Inquisitors.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Grand Inquisitor
quests.description: We wanted to prevent the new Inquisition from forming? Fighting the former Grand Inquisitor of the Mirror Realm is a good first step! Let's go!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Enn'tropy
quests.description: Enn'tröpy wants to fight us himself? Well, that's just fine! We were going to fight him anyway! Whatever it takes to stop him from unleashing this horror again!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Luck Boost
quests.description: If I want more luck, there's no surer way to get it than with Lucky Clovers! Say. I bet those Sneevilchauns will have some!

quests.name: Safe Space
quests.description: Maybeeee… maybe they don't feel SAFE with me! The best thing to help fix that is to find me some Oak Leaves. They can help make someone feel safe and brave. Those Lucky Treeants will have just what I need!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tricksy Gold
quests.description: Maybe if they won't come for a ride for free, I can PAY someone to come for a ride! Yeah, that's what I'll do!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: You Feel Lucky?
quests.description: Are you feeling lucky? ME TOO!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nightmares in the (Dream)Realm's Street
quests.description: The Aural Gem was removed by a twisted newcomer to this Realm. Its sonic cream shattered the gem into 15 whispers. The SkyPirates which have invaded Twilight's Threshold each ran away with one pieace. Regain them and place the whispers into the guide stone's proper resting place.

quests.name: Tortured Memories, Shattered Dreams
quests.description: In this Land, even weak Dreamers can damage interlopers. Creatures such as I've described shattered the Dream Gem and scattered its pieces through the Mind Maze. Some of them, I believe, held on to their pieces. Perhaps as souvenirs -or the hope- of a happier, gentler Dream. Find 15 shards and win back 5 Large Shards of the Dream Gem.

quests.name: Through the Gates of the Silver Portal
quests.description: Pass through the Portal, traveler. Be warned, though: while you were in the Maze, a creature affected by the Nightmare forced his way through. Its borrowed Dream-Magic overwhelmed this Portal's safeguards. It lies in wait for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sweet Dreamlands are Made Like This ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Hungry for a Recipe
quests.description: So, you're looking for my recipe for the Ultimate Elixir? Well, what's in it for me? You know, I'm rather hungry at the moment… why don't you go and fetch me 6 succulent fish tails from the River Fishmen at the river? If you can bring me those delectable tails, I might be willing to part with my recipe… (Bring back 6 Fishman's Tails to complete the quest).
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mixing Pot ' quest.

quests.name: Platinum Coin Turn-in
quests.description: If yer feeling lucky, battle the Pot o' Gold. Get 4 Platinum Coins and give'em to me for a chance to get one of the prizes below.

quests.name: Gold Coin Turn-in
quests.description: If yer feeling lucky, battle the Pot o' Gold. Get 5 Gold Coins and give'em to me for a chance to get one of the prizes below.

quests.name: Bronze Coin Turn-in
quests.description: If yer feeling lucky, battle the Pot o' Gold. Get 7 Bronze Coins and give'em to me for a chance to get one of the prizes below.

quests.name: Rainbow Coin Turn-in
quests.description: If yer feeling lucky, battle the Pot o' Gold. Get 8 Rainbow Coins and give'em to me for a chance to get one of the prizes below.

quests.name: Cut in Line
quests.description: Most people will wait until the Black Friday shop opens… but YOU know that the early bird gets the worm, and the quick hero gets the gear! Bring me 5 Shadows from Imps in Necrocavern, Coal from the Rock Elementals in Gilead, and a Doorbuster Mace from the Horcs in Sandport!

quests.name: VIP: Cut in Line
quests.description: Most people will wait until the Black Friday shop opens… but YOU know that the early bird gets the worm, and the quick hero gets the gear! Bring me 5 Shadows from Imps in Necrocavern, Coal from the Rock Elementals in Gilead, and a Doorbuster Mace from the Horcs in Sandport!

quests.name: Dinosaur Graveyard
quests.description: This looks like the perfect place for a dinosaur graveyard. There's just one problem… there's only one skeleton here! Slay 13 dinosaurs so that this can became a proper graveyard!

quests.name: Nest Stop, Home!
quests.description: Baby TerrorDOOMKills need meat, and lots of it! You'd better stock up a lot of fresh dino drumsticks because when these babies hatch, they're going to be HUNGRY! And if there's not a meal waiting, they're going to eat YOU. Kill 8 Fangbeasts and 7 Gigantosauruses for a Fangsgiving feast!

quests.name: Fiend of Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says, if a more straight forward and powerful approach is your style. Naturally armored, Void Fiends are a savage breed in my army. They are primal beasts that have no fear. Charging into the front lines of the enemy, they can thrash their ranks into disarray.
quests.requirements_note: Beast Warrior , Rank 10.

quests.name: Fiend Claws
quests.description: For a small price I'll give you claws to tear through anyone.
quests.requirements_note: Level 30

quests.name: Fiend Face
quests.description: The head piece for your Fiend of Nulgath armor is now manifested

quests.name: Let the Blood Flow
quests.description: You have proven to be one of my most loyal followers. I will reward you… once you complete a few more tasks for me. Bring me the following items, including the Rune 10 buried deep inside the Shadowstone Support, and you'll reap the rewards.

quests.name: Place the Beacons
quests.description: Place these beacons around the area, my power is too weakened right now to open a portal for you, these will fix that.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Nova Badge 10.0 to access this quest.

quests.name: Retrieve the Core
quests.description: I sense that Final has only made it so far as the entrance to my realm. If you agree to help me, I will take you there. Defeat him and return the Star Core to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Nova Badge 11.0 to access this quest.

quests.name: Become one with the Universe
quests.description: In order to prove your worth to me, you must defeat my Stars in combat. This will not be an easy task.
quests.requirements_note: Must have SuperNova Badge in order to access these quests.

quests.name: Becoming the Star Dominus
quests.description: To become the Star Dominus is no easy task. I require certain elements to build another armor set like this, bring me Bone Dust, PvP Trophies and the Life Essence from 125 Living Stars.
quests.requirements_note: Must have SuperNova Badge in order to access these quests.

quests.name: Becoming the Star Dominus
quests.description: To become the Star Dominus is no easy task. I require certain elements to build another armor set like this, bring me Bone Dust, PvP Trophies and the Life Essence from 125 Living Stars.
quests.requirements_note: Must have SuperNova Badge in order to access these quests.

quests.name: Your Hardest Task
quests.description: You must defeat me in my empowered form, over and over. TEST YOUR MIGHT!
quests.requirements_note: Must have SuperNova Badge in order to access these quests.

quests.name: Fantaisie-Impromptu
quests.description: Father does not have much time left. He could leave us in a matter of weeks if not days. I wish for my family to spend as much time with each other as possible. Would you share a few words with them? I apologize for asking this. This could be our last chance to have my father connect with you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Echoes ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Odile
quests.description: Taking a look outside on the streets, we can forget about calling this a breather. I was expecting to be able to talk to both parties but the soldiers are already assaulting the civilians! And do you smell that? It's smoke. They're burning something, and I have a feeling I know what it is. I've tried to order the soldiers to stop but they won't listen. We'll have to make them yield together.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Revolutionary Etude
quests.description: The smoke was coming from the smoldering remains of the printing presses. There's nothing to be done except replace them on the Royal Family's coin. But, the soldiers had moved on to ransacking homes to confiscate newspapers. They're creating a spectacle of burning them on the streets. I think it's meant to be a scare tactic. We need to douse the flames before the homes catch fire.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Tannhauser
quests.description: We need to calm the civilians as well. They were frightened by the violence and didn't recognize me. I'm sorry, I'm not used to this kind of wild confusion. If this were a crowd gathering for a music contest, I'd be able to sway the masses. We may need to subdue them if they lash out at us. Though, I'm not that worried. You brought me their newspaper in the first place. Let's calm the citizens down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Tzigane
quests.description: I've invited a representative of the involved citizens to speak with me. We'll meet them at the training grounds with Aurola and the others. We'll explain that you only mean well. There are a few soldiers lingering around. They may be waiting for us to leave before they try to menace the citizens again. You seem anxious. Perhaps giving those soldiers a talking to would help ease your nerves.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Ride of the Valkyrie
quests.description: Regulus has a good head on her shoulders. She handpicks the warriors that fight under her command. If it weren't for the views Astravians have against Outsiders, she'd pluck opposing knights off the battlefield. If you can defeat her in a fair fight, her soldiers would absolutely acknowledge you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Wedding March
quests.description: General Titania has the most experience and is the most eloquent speaker of the three. That's why he's such a good teacher. It's quite hard to believe if you've only seen him wreaking havoc on the battlefield. In reality, his heart is quite soft. Begin the duel. I know you'll have no trouble.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: From the New World
quests.description: This will be a bout between two best friends. Aurola has said time and time again that you inspire her. She's right to say so. We hope that we're good people, but we aren't perfect. Aurola and I, as progressive as we tried to be, were also of the mindset that Outsiders couldn't understand Astravian issues. You've opened our eyes to new possibilities. And now, you'll prove that you're fit to lead by defeating Aurola in a duel.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Mov.VII Aquarium
quests.description: I need to be with my father, but I'll come visit as soon as I can. You will rest, right? You've been staying up late studying Astravian literature. Reading by dim candle light will hurt your eyesight. That and the exhaustion won't do well for you or our home. Please, head straight to bed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Morning Mood
quests.description: I should be with my father and Drago, but I promise I'll come look for you. Why don't you take a break from your studies for the time being? Aurola and the others would be happy to have you join them. I'm sure they're dying for a rematch. Not to mention, it's become obvious that the soldiers need to be put through the wringer. Why not give them a few pointers before joining me for lunch?

quests.name: Ame no Murakumo
quests.description: My family and I will empower the Hanzamune blade. In your hands, it will cut down the Great Dragon of Nature's puppet, and return dominion of the Yokai Realm to me. With the words mother and father sung to help me sleep, I will lend you my power.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kojutsu ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Okiku
quests.description: One of my duties is to purify the spirits of Yokai, and usher them reincarnation. I am slowly analyzing the memories of the Great Yokai Spirit, but it will take time. May I ask for your help directing the Yokai as I learn? We need only to clear what remains of the Mikoto Puppet.

quests.name: Makeup Should Sparkle!
quests.description: Hero, I can't find my one true Princely love if I don't look my best! And now I'm out of ShimmerShine Powder. You simply MUST gather the ingredients so my maidservant can make more. I'll need 6 Violet Vampire Sparkles from Chaos Vampire Knights and 6 jars of Powdered Lycan Knight Claws from Darkovia. You can do that for me, can't you? *bats eyelashes*

quests.name: I Want the Perfect Pet!
quests.description: If I can't have a DRAGON for a pet, then I need something suitably… FIERCE! I know! Tame me a Tiger Leech. No one has one of THOSE for a pet! I think you can find them in the Mudluk Swamp.

quests.name: The Princess is NOT Amused
quests.description: Hero! One of these bonehead Knights thought he was falling in love with me. With ME! Can you believe it? He has NO idea what he is getting into! In my hurry to quell his attempts at wooing me, I accidentally signed my pseudonym. We can't have THAT falling into Father's hands! Please find the Knight and get my reply back!

quests.name: Find Princess Brittany!
quests.description: King Alteon's eldest daughter loves flowers and roaming around the castle. Search through Swordhaven and return her to King Alteon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed ' Find the Princesses! ' quest.

quests.name: Knee Bone's Connected to the Thigh Bone
quests.description: You have a desire to pass this class, and I want tenure. So we both have something we knee-d. But if I'm going to teach you bone-heads how to build an anatomically correct skeleton-minion, we'll need Boneset Blooms to bind the bones together. Bring back 6 blossoms! Well? Go! What are you waiting for?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Goals for Ghouls and Other Undead ' quest.

quests.name: Hip Bone's Connected to the Back Bone
quests.description: You students aren't hep to what's hip these days. You think we're all old curmudgeons. I'll tell you what's "hip," DOING YOUR WORK! So go out there and take apart some poor freshman's skeletal soldier-minions and bring back the parts so we can study what joins independent body parts together. Bring back hip bones and back bones. NOW!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Back Bone's Connected to the Neck Bone
quests.description: Boneset Blooms are excellent for binding disparate bones together. However, when you want to fix BROKEN bones that come into your Lab, or just hold whole bones together while setting them in place, you'll need splints. Kill 7 Treeants to get the splint-wood and gather 3 Bonemuncher collars to provide the material.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Silence is Ghoulden
quests.description: Undead are not, as a rule, allowed to talk. Many minions disregard this rule. Because there are so many minions, we ask that all students enforce this rule whenever possible. Remember - "If they aren't saying "ARREEOO", you know what to do!" Silence 10 Ghouls to demonstrate your ability to apply this school statute.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An IDeal Seal ' quest.

quests.name: Ghouls with Gall
quests.description: Ghouls are often among the most unruly of minions and are always wandering off when they should be attending to the tasks you've set them. They have some nerve (really, you should have removed all nerves during reanimation)! To summon them back to your side, place these 5 Ghoulstones around the school!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Goals for Ghouls and Other Undead
quests.description: In this New Age of Necromancy, pathetic people plead that we do not understand our minions. As if they have minds of their own! To placate these do-gooders, I advise you to at least make a token attempt to understand their desires. Bring back the Wishes of a Ghoul and the Dreams and Ambitions of Undead Soldiers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slip 'n Slimes
quests.description: If you're going to deconstruct slimes, you must IMMERSE yourselves in them! Embrace the slime! And what better way to do that than by playing with a Slip 'n Slime? Kill 5 slimes to get the Sheets of Slime, and bring back 5 slime-bubbles to make sure you have a GOO-d experience.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Back Bone's Connected to the Neck Bone ' quest.

quests.name: Sl-eye-me
quests.description: This lesson really touches on the core of deconstruction. You must observe and record slimes which have experienced near-total disassembling. Search out smooshed-slimes, which have had unfortunate encounters with other minions. FEEL their pain, see the haunting torment in their eyes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bones Over Brawn
quests.description: The saying goes - "Mind over matter" and "brains over brawn." But what do you do when your minions are mindless? Why, use their skulls as centerpieces in a new skullicious creation, of course! Bring me the heads of 6 soldiers, or you'll find YOURS taking their place.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sl-eye-me ' quest.

quests.name: Skullaton Shells
quests.description: To be truly creative, you must use diverse material or your art will stagnate! Today I want you to experience multiple mediums - skulls and shelleton shells. The Shelleton population grows too large, so we are also doing our fine school a service by culling 3. Gather 3 skulls, place and observe 3 shells, and take out 3 shelletons.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun's Quests.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun's Quests

quests.name: Eye for an Eye of the Old Gods
quests.description: Could you be the Hero the prophecy is talking about? There's only one way to find out! Find Sekt in his throne room, and fight him until he gives up the Eye of the Old Gods.

npc.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun (First Scrap)

quests.name: Hounded by History
quests.description: Ok… obviously this prophecy thinks you need to fight these Negastri Hounds. Guess you'd better do it. Could be important, right?

npc.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun (Second Scrap)

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Eye for an Eye of the Old Gods' quest (see above).

quests.name: Stand and De-Lever
quests.description: You're not sure why - but the prophecy says you need to pull the lever in the next room, too. Let's see what happens!

npc.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun (Second Scrap)

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Mummies vs Daddies
quests.description: The prophecy seems to think that gathering tesseract energy is crucial to your survival. Guess you'd better get some more canopic jars to store it in!

npc.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun (Third Scrap)

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' 4th Dimensional Teleport ' quest.

quests.name: The Tesseract
quests.description: Ok, so now you just need some tesseract energy. You know the Guardians of Anubyx have it, but it looks like these Negastri Hounds might be a good source of it, too.

npc.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun (Third Scrap)
