quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Another Mystery To Solve
quests.description: The prophecy also mentioned that sarcophagus you woke up in. Maybe you should go check it out? Just keep heading left until you reach it.

npc.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun (Third Scrap)

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Whose Skeleton Is This?
quests.description: …Ok, so you didn't quite make it to the sarcophagus. Let's try this again - hopefully there won't be any distractions this time.

npc.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun (Third Scrap)

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Fourth Scrap of the Prophecy
quests.description: The prophecy's all out of suggestions. As an experienced hero, you feel like you should keep heading left until you find something new. After all, you haven't been that way yet!

npc.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun (Fourth Scrap)

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Whose Skeleton Is This?' quest (see above). Notes:

dropped_by.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun (Scrap Four)

quests.name: Fighting in 4D
quests.description: Another hard light bridge! You're going to need to find a way to power it. You don't see any canopic jars nearby, but these sprites look like they're made of pure tesseract energy. Maybe if you catch a few you can just… shove them in there?

npc.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun (Fourth Scrap)

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lever-age
quests.description: The bridge has appeared! You should be able to pull the fourth lever now. Go try it out!

npc.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun (Fourth Scrap)

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once.

quests.name: 4D Goblins?
quests.description: The lever is broken - looks like you'll have to fix it. Maybe you could get some tools from the Tesseract Goblins nearby. Collect a few, then try the lever again.

npc.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun (Fourth Scrap)

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stone Sphynx Gems
quests.description: That writing scrawled on the bottom of the prophecy - black, black, white, black - could it be a code for the teleporter? Get 3 black gems and 1 white one from the stone sphynxes nearby, and then you can find out!

npc.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun (Fourth Scrap)

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Beam Me Up Scotty
quests.description: A new configuration of gems probably means the teleporter will take you to a different location. Put the gems in, and see where it goes.

npc.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun (Fourth Scrap)

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Sekt... Again
quests.description: The prophecy seems to think you should confront Sekt again now. Better head back to the throne room! With all the changes in the pyramid, doors will no longer take you back to the same place, and doors that were previously locked are now open! You'll know it when you see it!

npc.name: Prophecy of the Black Hole Sun (Fifth Scrap)

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Beam Me Up Scotty' quest (see above). Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Master of Your Craft
quests.description: Think you can take on our very own training grounds master? Fight a few rounds against him, and he can evaluate if you're worthy of his own armor or not!

quests.name: Serepthys, Please
quests.description: Serepthys, the Guardian of the Chamber of Yasaris won't give the Scepter and Flail to anyone but the Hero of the Prophecy. That's you! So, here's the plan: You'll go in and ask her to give them to you, and then you'll come back here and give them to me. She's just through that door to the north.

quests.name: The Hall of the Falcon
quests.description: Sigh. Alright, if this is how she wants to do it, then we'll have to play along. Let's start with the Falcon Guardian. Go through the door with the falcon hieroglyph on it, and explore the area inside it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Secrets and Whispers
quests.description: The Vortex Hawks are the servants of the Falcon Guardian. They may be able to reveal to us some of her secrets. Defeat them in battle, and see what they have to say.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Venom is the Key
quests.description: The venom is the key - that's what the Vortex Hawks are saying. I think you'll need collect some venom from the Sacred Serpents nearby.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Venom Is Your Wine
quests.description: "The venom is your wine". That has to mean something. That pedestal in the middle of the Falcon Guardian's rooms has a bowl on it that could be used as a drinking vessel. Try putting the Sacred Venom into it. Perhaps that will reveal what the Falcon wants?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Another Interpretation
quests.description: I have another idea, Hero. I think you're meant to do more than just fill the bowl with the venom. I think you're supposed to drink it. Hey, don't give me that look! You're the Prophesied Hero! You can handle a little snake venom. You'll just have to trust me on this.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Well, Go Get the Sac, Then!
quests.description: You saw what? You're… you're saying that when you drank the venom, a preserved venom sac appeared in the bowl? Well, what are you waiting for? Go get it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Hall of the Jackal
quests.description: Let's work on appeasing the jackal Guardian next. Go through the door with the jackal hieroglyph above it, and see what her rooms contain.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An Offering to the Falcon Guardian ' quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Cross the Chasm
quests.description: We're going to have get across that chasm somehow. Those hieroglyphs on the near side of it look like they might be code for activating a light bright. The Avatars of Anybyx should have the code - see if you can get it from them. I'd wager the standard Avatars have one half of the code, and the inverted Avatars have the second half.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Enter the Code
quests.description: Now you just need to go back that chasm and enter the code. Touch the hieroglyphs in the correct order to light them up. Remember: that code was baboon, jackal, falcon, human.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Look for the Offering
quests.description: Now that the bridge is open, you can go across it and see what's on the other side. Whatever you fine in there is probably going to be the offering we need to make for the Jackal Guardian. So if you see anything, be sure to grab it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Needs More Energy
quests.description: That spear dose sound like the offering we need, but if you can't remove it, then it's useless to us. You say it look "dead: compared to the ones the Avatars are carrying. Maybe we need to charge it up? See if you can get a vessal from one of the Avatars, and then fill it with Tesseract Energy from the Negastri Hounds.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Charge the Spear
quests.description: Now see if you can use this collected energy to charge the Spear. There is an indentation in the wall near it that your vessel will fit into. Once it's been charged, you should be able to retrieve the Spear.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Take the Offering
quests.description: Now that the Spear of Anubyx is charged, it will be the perfect offering. Pick up the charged spear and bring it to me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: The Hall of the Baboon
quests.description: Looks like the Baboon Guardian is the next one we need to appease. Go through the door with the baboon hieroglyph above it. and see what her area contains
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An Offering to the Jackal Guardian ' quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Phase In
quests.description: Something about this room… it seems out of phase with rest the pyramid. Collect some of the Dimensional Crystal that are floating around in there. We can use them to bring those rooms back into phase with ourselves.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What Will the Crystals do?
quests.description: This should be enough. Take these crystals into the room you found that had the door near the ceiling, and use them in there. Maybe that will reveal the way inside.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Charge those Platforms
quests.description: There has to be a way to make those platforms more solid, so you can walk on them and get to that door. They look like light bridges that haven't charged all the way… so, maybe if we charge them up,that will help. Get some tesseract energy from the nearby Tesseract Sprites, and use it to charge the platforms. (Quest can only be done once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Explore the secret Room
quests.description: Now you should be able to go through that door! I'm sure it will contain the offering we need for the Baboon Guardian.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Get More Crystals
quests.description: Empty?! How strange. But, the room felt a bit strange to you, you said? Maybe it's even further out of phase. Collect some more Dimensional Crystals, so you can see what they reveal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Charge the Pedestal
quests.description: Perfect! Take these crystals back to the hidden room and charge the pedestal. You should then be able to get the Crystal of Hatoth!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Hall of Humanity
quests.description: All that's left to do is appease the Human Guardian. Go Through the door with the Human hieroglyph above it, and scout out the area within.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An Offering to the Baboon Guardian ' quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Activate the Levers
quests.description: These rooms have a series of levers in them, but they seem to be stuck in place. Do you see the indentations in the wall beside them? They look like they should hold large gems. In fact… the fems in the headdresses of the Avatars of Serepthys lok like they're about the right size. Collect 4 of them — one for each lever. Then, place the gems in the open spots above the levers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pull the Levers
quests.description: The levers should be actived now. Let's pull them and see what happens!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Reveal the Paths
quests.description: The levers have revealed a series of alcoves, but… I have no idea how to reach them! Hmm. Serepthys said that the Human Guardian repesented ME. Maybe if we battle these… incorporeal versions of myself, we will gain the insight we need in order to continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Spirit Knife
quests.description: Aha! The Spirit Sight that has been granted to us by my ghostly selves has revealed a series of teleportation devices. They should allow us to travel to the alcoves above! Investigate the alcoves — there MUST be something hidden in one of them. Find it, and then come back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Battle Serepthys
quests.description: That treacherous Sphynx! We passed all of her tests, and she STILL won't let us into that chamber? Well, we didn't do all of that work just to be turned away now. If she wants a fight, we'll bring her one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An Offering to the Human Guardian ' quest.

quests.name: SkullCrusher Challenge
quests.description: Only the fiercest and most-skilled warriors have what it takes to complete the SkullCrusher Challenge… and I believe that's exactly the kind of Hero YOU are. Bring me the crushed skulls of the following monsters to prove yourself!

quests.name: One Brick at a Time
quests.description: You new here, neighbor? I can get you set up with your first portal- straight to Battleon. Get me some stuff so I can start putting one together for ya!

quests.name: Room with a View
quests.description: While I put together the frame, you can get a head start by grabbing some Magic Rocks from the Gemeralds or Amadeus in /dwarfhold. Next, ahh… get me a display from the big yellow metal man in /crashsite, and a Power Cable from the big red one there too. Finally, I'll also need a picture of Battleon- like the one the guy in /digitalmaintown carries around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Transportalation
quests.description: Great! Ya can see the place now. Next, we oughta set up the transportation network.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Your First Portal
quests.description: Good work, kiddo. Just a few final touches, and you'll be on your way to Battleon in no time! Don't worry about the future portals- just pay me a little extra and I can get all this done for ya.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Moglin Punter Achievement!
quests.description: It's Twilly Punting time! Get a score of 13 and earn an awesome character page badge (and Book of Lore Badge) to commemorate the day you kicked Twilly's butt!

quests.name: Punt Zorbak
quests.description: It's Friday the 13th, and you know what that means… It's Zorbak Punting time! Get a score of 13 and earn an awesome character page badge (and Book of Lore Badge) to commemorate the day you kicked Zorbak's butt!

quests.name: Flee the Flames
quests.description: If we're going to find the missing medicine, we'll need a clear road ahead of us! Take down 6 of the Fyreborn Tigers, 3 Caustocrush beasts, and 3 Lavazards.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Light the Flame ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Taste of their own Medicine
quests.description: The Firestorm Invaders have DESTROYED the last supply of Feverbane Elixir! Those monsters will be the death of us all… Take out 10 of the invaders to teach them a lesson and show that we are NOT weak!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Light the Flame ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Jarring Discovery
quests.description: All hope may not be lost! If we're lucky, there might be some elixir remaining in the jars the Firestorm Soldiers shattered. Collect them all, and we'll hope!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Light the Flame ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Push on to Pyrewatch
quests.description: The Firestorm warriors are EVERYWHERE! I fear for the safety of our friends in the watchtower. Let's give their guards a hand and take out some of these hotheads for them. And if you can, see if you find any hints about what they'll do next!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Light the Flame ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Friends of Pyrewatch Peak
quests.description: The guards say Firestorm Scouts have been attempting to sneak in, posing as friends. We must prove our loyalty by bringing back 6 Firestorm helms. It would be a kindness to clear out the Caustocrush, as well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Light the Flame ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Salve to Soothe
quests.description: We have been approved… but NOW we need to make you some a protective salve. Those born to this region are naturally able to withstand the heat, but you… well. Gather 5 Piles of Thermoss from the Shore and 5 Glowing Embers from the Living Lava and Lavazards.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Light the Flame ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pyrewatch Defender Badge
quests.description: Slay 100 Firestorm Warriors to get the Pyrewatch Defense Book of Lore badge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest.

quests.name: Feed a Fever
quests.description: The ill need to keep up their strength in order to survive the plague. We've got to make sure there's enough food for them, no matter what. Bring me 1 Caustrocrush Skull, 4 haunches of Zard meat, and 5 packets of Sagebreak powder.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest.

quests.name: Ward the Watchtower
quests.description: Feverfew's been attacked; I have no idea how many survivors - if any - are left. I suspect attacking the Peak was a diversion, while they attacked the temple, but we still need to be on our guard. Bring me 3 cloak scraps from any of the Firestorm invaders, 5 Fireweeds from the Fyresyn, and 1 Lava Jewel from a Living Lava.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spreading Like Wildfire ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat Phedra
quests.description: The coming of the Firestorm Onslaught, and the spread of fire and flame across the world has awakened the Phedra. The Queen of Monsters feeds on the terror the Phedra leaves in its wake. Defeat the Phedra in order to keep the Queen from gaining more strength, and help the people of Embersea regain their land!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Final Round: Tyndarius Tigermaster ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat Mega Tyndarius
quests.description: With the knowledge you've gained from Pyralis, you have defeated the Phedra. Only one thing remains before you can return the land of Embersea to peace - you must defeat Tyndarius in order to end the Onslaught!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Final Round: Tyndarius Tigermaster ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gather Phedra Feathers
quests.description: The Phedra is a powerful creature. Its feathers can be used to craft incredible items to aid in your battles against the Firestorm Onslaught. Defeat the Onslaught to gain the feathers!

quests.name: The Onslaught Fights On
quests.description: Even though Tyndarius has been defeated, the Onslaught battles on. Continue the fight to ensure the people of Embersea's freedom!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Mega Tyndarius ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Tyndarius
quests.description: Are you truly the strongest hero in Lore? If you thought battling Mega Tyndarius was difficult, just wait until you get a look at ULTRA Tyndarius! Do you have the skills to defeat him?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Mega Tyndarius ' quest.

quests.name: Suited to Shield
quests.description: Even the residual heat from inside the volcano can be deadly. Bring me 5 shark skins and 3 water goblin livers and my pyromancers will create a gel to help shield your armor and protect your skin.

quests.name: Through Fumes and Flame
quests.description: Excellent. You're ready to approach… but my scouts have spotted a pack of Lavazards. They thrive on the sulfurous fumes. Take them out, and the way will be clear.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fiamme's Fang
quests.description: We thought Fiamme's Fang was lost years ago, during the first Embersea Flame Wars. But the pyromancers say Phedra has kept it safe all these years. And we never knew! If you can defeat her, you may be able to recover it. Phedra still dwells in /Lavarun Altar.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: In Lava with Maladrite
quests.description: Maladrite is not without protectors. The lavaborn creatures of the island are drawn to her, and these elemental mages are no different. She's bound Lava Guardians to the heart of the volcano itself. Kill them and the path to her will be clear.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fahrenheit FEAR-51
quests.description: Her temper is hot. Her power is mighty. Defeat Maladrite, Storm Elemental, to protect the people of this island!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Quest name is a parody of the book Fahrenheit 451 .

quests.name: (Volca)No Trespassing
quests.description: It seems that Blazebeard himself was not the only one affected by the Magmanacles- he's gifted his crew with a fragment of their power, transforming them into living lava warriors! Our Pyromancy can't burn through their new magma-coated hide, so you'll have to help us by thinning the front lines with your blade.

quests.name: Piracy for Pyromancers
quests.description: It seems that the power of the Magmanacles has seeped not just into the pirates, but their weapons as well. If we could get our hands on some, we might be able to properly battle against Blazebeard's forces. Bring me their swords and guns so the Order and I can begin to return fire on the pirates, and help sustain our defense by stealing their supplies.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Canned Heat
quests.description: The pirates have been driven from the caverns, but they left us a few surprises- flame-powered explosives that they've set off inside the volcano. They've caused a cave-in to stop us from reaching Xanh Lá! Take more charges from the bombers, and use them to clear out the rubble. We must get through that cave!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Xua Ðoui
quests.description: Blazebeard may be gone, but it seems a few of his crew managed to stick around. The threat of another visit from Mother Dragon is stopping them from attacking, but that doesn't mean they can't try and steal our new treasures. Eliminate a few of the pirates after our emeralds, and we'll let you keep one for yourself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ha Long ' quest.

quests.name: Dragon Defender Farming Quest
quests.description: Aid the cause! Take out 3 DragonSlayers and 3 DragonSlayer Generals to help thin their ranks.

quests.name: Dragon Saver War Medal
quests.description: Aid the cause, Hero! Take out 5 dragonslayers to help save our dragonkin! Undead or not, we should not harm them!

quests.name: Mega Dragon Saver War Medal
quests.description: Aid the cause, Hero! Slay dragonslayers until you've got 3 Mega Medals to help save our dragonkin! Undead or not, we should not harm them!

quests.name: 2022 Calendar Collector
quests.description: Battle a Time Wraith in the Chronohub and return to me with a Quantum Gear. Once you do, I'll reward you with a signed house item poster.

quests.name: Your Lips Are Sealed
quests.description: I'm so sorry about Valen! He only reacts like this because he wants to protect me. But I know you can keep a secret, just like Twilly! I know you'll have to fight those Pactagonal Knights to escape, but… please don't hurt them!

quests.name: Through the Swordhaven Portal!
quests.description: You're looking for the dark elf girl? She sliced open a portal with her blades, and then disappeared through it! It's right over there.

quests.name: Learn from the Past
quests.description: In order to save Valen, I must understand him. I can send you into the memories of his past, and you can bring back to me what you learn there. With enough of his crystallized memories, I will gain the knowledge I need. You can get them from any monster you fight while in his memories.

quests.name: Till When?
quests.description: Large flocks of ravens have been stalking us ever since the trees started to block out the skies. They're flying low, and becoming rather aggressive. We need to thin their numbers, or their cawing is going to alert Skye's forces to our location. While we're on the subject, ask Caoimhe why they're staring at us. Is this normal?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Arrester ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Energetic Feud
quests.description: Even with the snow, I was wondering why the forests were so devoid of fauna outside of the birds. They were scared away by the Energy Elementals. The Plane of Energy itself is against us. We'll snuff out their sparks, and check with Felix to see if he has any insights about their behavior.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Arrester ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Glacial Seal
quests.description: Lord Brentan accompanied Lady Celestia on her investigation of the tunnel that leads to Naoise's Grave. With the camp secure, we should catch up to them, and see if they found anything that could help us. Despite the circumstances, I'm a little excited. This reminds me of old adventures.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Arrester ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Cold Wind Guides
quests.description: Tampering with the ice blocking the cave's entrance is whipping the Elementals into a frenzy. The ravens are swooping down to attack them, and we're going to get caught in between. Break up the fighting, and we'll try our luck at melting the barrier. It's definitely hiding something!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Arrester ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cold Callers
quests.description: There are Ice Elementals inside the cave, and they're hostile! This is clear proof that the Plane of Ice is on Skye's side. They must have blocked off the entrance. Come on. We'll crunch them up, and keep them from making another barrier.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Arrester ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Destinies Lost
quests.description: Lady Celestia hears Dragonlings near the cavern where the path splits into three. She's troubled by their presence, and wants us to find them. If this is a grave, what are babies doing in here? Are they the ones making the cave shake so much? Let's track them down, and bring them to the Priestess.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Arrester ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Of the Sorrows
quests.description: Iseul's here, but she's alone! Her Executors wanted to retreat because she was injured, so Iseul must have broken away to hunt us on her own. We have to incapacitate her. She's in the cavern with a huge skeleton. That must be Naoise…and a Dragonlord? His Dragonlord?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Arrester ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cold-Blooded Torture
quests.description: The roars are coming from the eastmost caverns, and they're crawling with Ice Elementals. What's causing all of this noise? Are they…attacking someone? We need to stop them before they cause a cave-in!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Arrester ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Echoing Cries
quests.description: The restless spirits of the Dragonlings are gathering around the giant imprisoned Dragon as well. They're latching on to the one adult Dragon they've ever seen. We should help lay them to rest. Just seeing these spirits is another form of torture for this poor Dragon.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Arrester ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragon's Seal
quests.description: The being trapped in the Eastmost caverns is Volgritian, the Great Dragon of Energy. Lady Celestia says he must have been rotting here for centuries! The Ice Elementals and Dragonlings caused Volgritian to start thrashing in a fit of rage. We need to calm him before attempting any sort of rescue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Arrester ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reactive Inductor
quests.description: Lady Celestia is slowly calming Volgritian's mind, but she needs our help to sever his chains. The Ice Elementals and Dragonlings are crawling all over him. I'll help you clear them out, and wrangle Volgritian to keep him still. That way, we're clear to remove the golden chains holding him down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragon's Seal ' quest.

quests.name: At Ease
quests.description: The smoke signals warned us about the rising Undead, and it won't be hard to find them. I can hear them shambling through the fields. Let's ease into this, and cut a few of the Undead Garde down to get a better look at what we're up against.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragon's Seal ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Greenguard Daisy
quests.description: Kieran says that the Hill of Lia is in the middle of a huge field of daisies. That sounds pretty nice, until you hear the shrieks of the Wraiths. It's odd - they're only chasing us away instead of trying to make us join them. Hmm, I see them carrying something in their hands. Let's take a closer look.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragon's Seal ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: True Nature
quests.description: The Undead are acting oddly docile, and only attack if we try to advance closer to the Hill of Lia. I caught sight of Lord Granville's forces engaging in combat with them, too. They won't even draw blood. Hmm, help me fight more of the Wraiths and Undead Garde. I need to confirm a theory.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragon's Seal ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Deafly Pride
quests.description: Over there, where the snow's beginning to melt! We've found Lord Granville, and thank goodness, Muusa's with him too. If she's here, her advice would help Lord Granville act with more tact. Let's warn them about Queen Iona's trap, and withdraw Greenguard's forces.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragon's Seal ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: King of Briars and Smoke
quests.description: Lord Granville isn't enthusiastic about it, but he'll withdraw his forces on my orders. As for us, we need to find Caoimhe, and a way to destroy Iona's trap. We're on the right track. Up ahead, a very powerful spirit was summoned to keep us from getting to the Hill of Lia. It's…King Duncan himself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragon's Seal ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Last Snowfall
quests.description: King Duncan's spirit has receded into the mist. I wonder if the Necromancer that summoned him intended for this to happen. His Undead Garde and Wraiths remain. We'll need to clear them to find what they were raised to hide. Be on the lookout for anything else suspicious.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragon's Seal ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spring Melt
quests.description: We're nearing the Hill of Lia, and it's surrounded by a lake! I see Henry on the shore with a boat. He ran off by himself to chase after Caoimhe, which means she must be near. We need to talk with Henry and find out what happened. Shatter the icy monsters surrounding him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragon's Seal ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Connla
quests.description: Lord Vaughn commandeered a boat that can ferry us across the water to the Hill of Lia. I see the Warden of the South's Cailleach waiting for us. They've guarded their lady in secret, and will not be forced from her side easily. Prepare to fight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragon's Seal ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dumha na nGiall
quests.description: Whatever Queen Iona was planning, the Hill of Lia is at the center of it. Clear the Cailleacha and Ice Guardians out so we can find Caoimhe. She's likely giving commands from the top of the Hill. Don't engage with her yet. Maybe we can convince her to stand down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragon's Seal ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Changeling
quests.description: Caoimhe…For now, we'll call her Warden Illaria of the South. She's dutifully fulfilling the wishes of her adopted mother, but I can tell she's troubled. We'll fight her, and separate her from that staff. Then, Kieran and I will convince Illaria to join the people who actually care for her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragon's Seal ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pushing Up Daisies
quests.description: Greenguard's forces will march west to the capital city of Skye. Though Illaria's command over the Undead has broken, they're still roaming the battlefield. Cut them down, and give them true rest. When this is over, we'll return their bones to their homeland.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Changeling ' quest.

quests.name: Needs of the Few
quests.description: The gates swung open for us, but we shouldn't let our guard down. Before we go deeper into the castle, talk to Lord Vaughn and clear out the Energy Elementals. I need to make sure the Capital won't burst into flames the moment we turn our backs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Changeling ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Lost and Numb
quests.description: It's freezing here, even inside the royal castle. Those Ice Guardians must be around, and now we know they're here to protect Abel. The stairs to the upper floors are blocked off, so maybe Abel doesn't know we're inside yet. Let's knock his Guardians down and get his attention.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Changeling ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Childhood Memories
quests.description: Muusa's in the castle? I'm sure I assigned Knights to guard her. Where did they go? Thank goodness Indradeep came to accompany her. These two would have more knowledge about Castle Gaheris. Let's ask them some questions, and keep an eye out for any more ice we can poke at.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Changeling ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Strangled Sobs
quests.description: Below the ground, where Queen Iona and her nobles feasted, were her children's living quarters. These 'kennels' are just dungeons! She made Indradeep and the others sleep in cells! We need to clear the Elementals and Guardians out of them so we can see what else Queen Iona's trying to hide.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Changeling ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Distant Care
quests.description: There, in the deepest corner of the dungeons, is a huge mass of Darkness! What is that? I…I see something wriggling inside. Someone's trapped! We have to get them out! I'll help you! The arrow…the arrow that Gravelyn sent me…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Changeling ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Minus K
quests.description: Just like I thought. The ice blocking the stairs to the upper floors has melted. Let's begin our ascent. Stronger Ice Elementals are waiting for us. These Glacial Crystals don't seem to want anyone getting to Abel, and will even act against his will.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Changeling ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Someone Else's Blood and Tears
quests.description: W-what are those things? Mages? Or Elementals? They're guarding the way up, too. We'll take them down, and see if there's anyone alive inside. Indradeep and his sisters survived Queen Iona's experiments…what if these were the siblings who couldn't make it?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Changeling ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Honor Thy Family
quests.description: Captain Rhubarb's at the top of the stairs! Hurry! We need to make sure he's unharmed! If he's free, and so close to the royal bed chambers, it could be Abel's doing. There isn't anyone else around. We can look for anything that could hint at Iona's contingency plans. Leave no stone unturned.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Changeling ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Life's Latest Lows
quests.description: I'm going to ask Captain Rhubarb to join the others outside of the castle. We'll take down the last of the Glacial Crystals and Elemental Hybrids. Abel has to be nearby, and I'd prefer to confront him in private. The way the snowstorms guided our path, how Iona's body is falling apart…he did this.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Changeling ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Vow of Misery
quests.description: Opposite of the royal chambers is the door to the balcony outside. Abel's there, sleeping in a chair, cradling some sort of crystal on his lap. He's being guarded by a huge Elemental. We won't be able to get to him unless we take it down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Changeling ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cloud Breaker
quests.description: There's no stopping Iona's transformation. We need to learn everything we can before we set out for the Hill of Lia Tara again. The Hybrids are failed attempts at becoming Champions. The Crystals and Thundersnow Storm are here for Abel. We could learn more if we take a closer look at them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Vow of Misery ' quest.

quests.name: Left Arm Artery
quests.description: If Tara's hunch is right, the Cold Apparitions and the things calling themselves "Brittany" and "Brentan" are the same. There's more to this process. Try to collect anything you can touch from the apparitions, and talk to my 'sister' and 'brother-in-law' to see if you can learn more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Left Arm Vein ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Phantom Pain
quests.description: I've had to shoot the things pretending to be Brentan and Brittany several times. Their movements are loud…and so are their screams. They keep reforming, and I need a moment to breathe. Can you shatter them for me?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sour Notes ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Familial Blessing
quests.description: Before we begin, we should ask for Tara's blessing. I doubt she'll disapprove of you gathering Dad's belongings, but she should know about it. Tara's back in Termina Temple next to that statue of our Mom, Lynaria.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tell-Tale Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Echo of the King
quests.description: My father was a true hero, and it feels wrong to let his regalia collect dust. They should be wielded to do good and protect the innocent. Please help me gather his crown, blade, mace, and armor.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tell-Tale Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Precious Rocks
quests.description: The tide is low and we're supposed to venture out into the newly uncovered sand, but the 'Pacification of the Sea Witch' isn't as big of a secret as I thought. Pirates have come to scavenge the beach, and the Captain says they're too ratty looking to be any member of his crew. I bet they're looking for the treasure too. We need to apprehend them, and check their pockets for anything they might have stolen from here.

quests.name: Fake Seagull Food
quests.description: While we were rounding up those pirates, I saw limbs on the beach. Not real ones. They're likely the remains of the straw dolls used in previous years. They're all rotted and gross looking from being waterlogged for so long. And yes, we are going to pick them up! I want to check if the "Sea Witch" is actually taking these things.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Summer Chill
quests.description: The 'Pacify the Sea Witch' Ritual requires the straw dolls to be placed in an area where the tide will eventually rise back up. Let's be cautious and take a look around before we get to work. I feel a chill and it's not from a brisk summer breeze. Rhubarb's saying he felt the same chill from the beds of Ghostly Eels that gather around shipwrecks. If you happen to see any, teach me how to get rid of them when there isn't a cleric on hand.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Committed to the Sea
quests.description: The townsfolk that made the straw dolls trusted us to finish the second half of their Ritual. It's easy, just slightly grim. We lay the dolls on their backs, and weigh them down with heavy stones in places on the beach where the tide will rise above their heads. That way, they'll symbolically drown and become gifts for the 'Sea Witch.' Make sure the pirates and eels don't mess with them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Briny Gelatin
quests.description: It isn't just eels poking at the straw dolls with their noses. Do you see those ghostly jellyfish? Tentacles are disgusting but these jellyfish are so pretty. It's like they're made out of the fancy lace my big sister used to sew with. If I didn't know that they'd sting me to heck, I'd want to grab them. Help me and Rhubarb fight them off. We don't want them bothering us while we finish off the rest of the Ritual.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sleeping with the Fishes
quests.description: Captain Rhubarb suggested that we start digging. With all of these ghosts lurking around, I think we all know what we're going to find. Straw dolls and scarecrows are meant to trick crows into thinking they're real humans after all. The Captain grabbed a few shovels from the cart. Take one and dig until the only thing you can see is sand.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Local Delicacies
quests.description: The town of Rheum was willing to sacrifice hundreds if not thousands of their own people before they resorted to trying to trick the 'Sea Witch' with straw dolls. I do know what the treasure is and it might be worth the price. But what sort of monster would make them conduct such a horrific ritual? There are ghostly sea creatures infesting the beach. Maybe we can learn more about the 'Witch' from investigating them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Myriad Andromeda
quests.description: There's a woman exploring the beach out there. She looks so fiery and regal! Definitely not a pirate but she's being menaced by them! Let's help her out! Then, we could have a little chat. She might know something about the Ritual, the Sea Witch, and the treasure we're looking for.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ebbing Grudge
quests.description: I did promise to finish the Ritual, and we could learn the last of the beach's secrets this way. The final step of the Ritual involves the pedestal at the edge of the tide. It's to pay our respects to the drowned and those who will be drowned. Could you and Rhubarb step on to the pedestal with me? Right at the very center. Afterwards…I'm not sure where to go from there. Maybe some more digging.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Honeyed Apologies
quests.description: There's a wraith guarding the pedestal! It smells earthy all of a sudden. Like the musky scent you would smell in the depths of a cavern. It's warding away the salty tide. Whoever this ghost is doesn't have a connection to the element of water. I'll save the conjecture for later. It's aiming to take out Captain Rhubarb, we need to stop it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stable Grounds
quests.description: That wraith guarding the pedestal was stronger than any of the other spirits lingering at the beach. They were also the only spirit that most resembled a human being. Let's take a closer look at the differences between all of them. We could learn a little more about what happened here all those centuries ago. Or eons. It's difficult to tack a date to the evidence we have on hand.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Honeyed Apologies ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Shade
quests.description: Before you give me your answer, defeat this Crystalline Shade. It may give you a clue, or at least some insight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Don't Fall ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Curve Bladed Polearm
quests.description: Turn in your Battle Prize for a new amazing item! Battle prizes drop during war events.

quests.name: Infantry Pole Axe
quests.description: Turn in your Battle Prize for a new amazing item! Battle prizes drop during war events.

quests.name: Infantry Blade
quests.description: Turn in your Battle Prize for a new amazing item! Battle prizes drop during war events.

quests.name: Pactagonal Armet
quests.description: Turn in your Battle Prize for a new amazing item! Battle prizes drop during war events.

quests.name: Defender's Winged Armet
quests.description: Turn in your Battle Prize for a new amazing item! Battle prizes drop during war events.

quests.name: Pactagonal Defender's Crested Armet
quests.description: Turn in your Battle Prize for a new amazing item! Battle prizes drop during war events.

quests.name: Undead Infantry Armor
quests.description: Turn in your Boss Prize for a new amazing item! Battle prizes drop during war events.

quests.name: Undead Infantry Guard
quests.description: Turn in your Boss Prize for a new amazing item! Battle prizes drop during war events.

quests.name: Savage Warlord Armor
quests.description: Turn in your Boss Prize for a new amazing item! Boss Prizes have a 10% chance to drop from war bosses.

quests.name: Aye for an Aye
quests.description: Ahoy, matey! Thar be an old say'n that goes somethin' like "an eye for an eye." We are pirates be known fer uphold'n principles'n such, so let's down the hatches 'nd show some mariner manners! Seize the Barbed Horror from a Swordhaven landlubber 'nd plunder the eyeballs from Chaos Sp-eyes 'nd Speyeders. When ye gots 'em all, make landfall back there 'nd ye will git ye hard-earned treasure!

quests.name: Skull and Crossed Bones
quests.description: Hoist the colors! Skull and Cross Bones be the pirate's mark! But me sorry black-spotted shiphands aint rigged fer battle. Will ye help an old seadog? Me wants to git me crew some Bone Dust 'nd the Skullface Mace. Scout the depths of Battleundera fer the dust, 'nd then follow ye nose to the sweetest-smelling lass in Doomwood fer the mace. With this here weaponry, me ship will be the most feared in all the seven seas!

quests.name: Off the Hook!
quests.description: We gots an anchor-sized problem on me ship: all me deckhands be loosing thar hands! Me crew be parting brass rags soon if me doesn't rig 'em with replacements. How's 'bout ye git 'em some hooks? Keep Ninja Nopperabo in ye sight and steal they Hook Sword, 'nd go find some Fishin' Hooks daggers from a lassie who aint afraid to git her feet wet. Deliver me these hooks 'nd ye will get ye reward!

quests.name: Booty and the Beast
quests.description: Blow me down! Me prized booty has gon' miss'n! Me bets it be the work o' them bilge-sucking Beasts. Always be aft'r the finest booty! Here be a list o' the scallywags responsible. Make 'em all walk the plank, sailor!

quests.name: A Pirate's Lunch For Me
quests.description: What be a pirate's favorite food? Peanut Butter Jelly Fish Sandwiches, o'course! And me be swabbin' Davy Jones' locker soon if me belly don't git grub. Smartly there landlubber - take me recipe and fetch a shipshape sandwich!

quests.name: Thee Seven C's!
quests.description: If ye wants to be the savviest pirate in all the seven seas, ye gots to pillage the toughest beasties that begin with the letter 'C'! This aint be a mission fer lily-livered landlubbers… ye gots to have ye wits 'n weaponry about ye! Plunder the Loot from these 'ere monsters, 'nd ye be the most renown Cap'n in al 'o Lore! Ye'll even git a shiny achievemente badge on ye Character Page to show how savvy of a pirate ye be!

quests.name: Legend: Glacera Ice Token
quests.description: THIS QUEST IS FOR AQW LEGENDS ONLY! If you wish to gain access to the Cyromancer Shop you will need Glaceran Ice Tokens. If you bring me a piece of Dark Ice from the FrostSpawn Invader, then I will craft it into tokens for you.

quests.name: Glacera Ice Token
quests.description: If you wish to gain access to the Cyromancer Shop you will need Glaceran Ice Tokens. If you bring me a piece of Dark Ice from the FrostSpawn Invader, then I will craft it into tokens for you.

quests.name: Follow Those Fairies!
quests.description: The time travel fairies are very protective of the routes they use while traveling. They have an arrangement with the creatures of the Void, and the Time-Travel Fairies pay them VERY well to keep the deal. You'll need to slay the ones you meet before they slay you in order to pass.

quests.name: Aerodu Assault
quests.description: The past can be a dangerous place to travel to, but even more so when you cross the timestreams. But if that's where the fairies went, it's where YOU should go, too. They may have left some items behind you can recover for the shop. You'll probably encounter the creatures they stole from, too, so… keep en eye out for loot AND attacks.

quests.name: Void Travel Battle
quests.description: In order to traverse the void, you must defeat the Void Guardians!.

quests.name: Lost to Entrophy?
quests.description: Ah, yes. The Fairies have brought me many excellent items from the DragonFable timeline. It is in your past, but still full of much you heroes desire. But what fortune! You've landed in the middle of the Entropy Dragon's attack on Willowshire. This beast should have premium Earth or Darkness items, if the fairies left you any to take.

quests.name: Void Travel Battle
quests.description: In order to traverse the void, you must defeat the Void Guardians!

quests.name: The Master Quest
quests.description: Funny, the fairies don't typically liberate items from this timeline. I think, being creatures of magic, the science and mecha energy make them uncomfortable. But you shouldn't have that problem, right? So. Good. Take what you can from the creatures here, and I'll make a pretty penny of it.

quests.name: Void Travel Battle
quests.description: In order to traverse the void, you must defeat the Void Guardians!

quests.name: Crystallize This
quests.description: Ah, now this is an interesting realm. After their last trip, the fairies noted this land - the OverSoul - was ripe for mining items from. I see signs they traveled here but… do you see them? No? Hmm. Troubling. Ah, well. While you are here, you should try to get one of the crystals out of the RougeFiend's gauntlet. Be careful, though - they are very fragile.

quests.name: Void Travel Battle
quests.description: In order to traverse the void, you must defeat the Void Guardians!

quests.name: Nauts and Double-crosses
quests.description: This is strange. Their trail leads here, but the fairies don't usually hit the same realm twice. See if you can find anything that might explain why you landed back in the AdventureQuest timeline, in… the Paxian Clan of Nautica, it looks like. And items to sell. Don't forget those.

quests.name: Void Travel Battle
quests.description: In order to traverse the void, you must defeat the Void Guardians!

quests.name: Key to the Cage
quests.description: Are… are those the Time-Travel Fairies?! Locked in a CAGE?! Those are my MEAL TICKET! I mean… my very valuable co-workers and item suppliers. That lying, thieving, sniveling, BLUE RABBIT. What does he have to say for himself?!

quests.name: Get the Key
quests.description: You've got to free the fairies, Hero. You should be able to find a key around here somewhere. Maybe that Clawg has one.

quests.name: A Void the Dricken
quests.description: Oh. This must be what Zorbak was talking about. He lured the Mother Dricken away so he could get at her babies. Pffft. Amateur. NOW he's let loose a giant, ANGRY Dricken, and she's been feeding on Void Energy for days. She'll be a fun one to take down. But… might have gear for you. Get to it.

quests.name: Time to Train
quests.description: Would you mind helping me out, Hero? It isn't every day that we get a fighter of your caliber in our Archipelago, and I have some young Pactagonal Knights want to become Chronomancers that need to be trained. You can find them in /portalmazec! Could you hop over there and put them through some drills for me? It would make all the difference! I'll even throw in some Time Pieces to sweeten the deal!

quests.name: Defender Medals
quests.description: Take out three of Galanoth's creatures to take the Lair.

quests.name: Mega Defender Medals
quests.description: Get a Mega Defender Medal from one of Galanoth's creatures to take the Lair.

quests.name: Magic and Mayhem
quests.description: Dragon mages are not so common in the Oversoul. Vasumar is… interested… in what they coul do to him. And better, FOR him. Bring me some of them, for study.And other reasons. Do not harm them, much.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed one of the previous quests.

quests.name: The Dragon Defender
quests.description: Adorable. It's like something out of a fairy-story. The angry dragonslayer makes peace with the dragon he fights, so they can work together to drive out a greater enemy. Pathetic. You may be human, but even YOU could take them out without breaking a sweat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Flame Dragon
quests.description: Lord Vasumar wants to meet you, to reward the hero who served him so well. But a word of advice… "talking" with Vasumar can feel a lot like combat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: 4 Trophy Prizes
quests.description: You gots 4 Racing Trophies? Picks any one of these prizes you wants! Jusr makes sure you know what you wants before you picks it. NO BACKSIES, pal!

quests.name: 20 Trophy Prizes
quests.description: You gots 20 Racing Trophies? Say, you must be pretty good! Picks any one of these prizes you wants! Jusr makes sure you know what you wants before you picks it. NO BACKSIES, pal!

quests.name: 50 Trophy Prizes
quests.description: You gots 50 Racing Trophies? Holy Schmolies, yer a natural! I've never seen anything like it! Picks any one of these prizes you wants! Jusr makes sure you know what you wants before you picks it. NO BACKSIES, pal!

quests.name: 100 Trophy Prizes
quests.description: You gots 100 Racing Trophies? Picks any one of these prizes you wants! Jusr makes sure you know what you wants before you picks it. NO BACKSIES, pal!

quests.name: 150 Trophy Prizes
quests.description: You gots 150 Racing Trophies? You're gonna be a LEGEND in the racing circut! Picks any one of these prizes you wants! Jusr makes sure you know what you wants before you picks it. NO BACKSIES, pal!

quests.name: Flight of Fancy
quests.description: The Floating Palace is kept aloft by ancient Djinn magics. I require 3 Roc Feathers, which are prized by the Harpies near the DjinnGate. Bring me 3 Roc Feathers and I will send a young Djinn Companion to travel with you.
quests.requirements_note: Must own Djinn Palace House in your house inventory.

quests.name: Slay the Red Dragon
quests.description: A dragon is a fearsome beast, one even the best Bountyhunter *cough* plans their attack ahead of time. Grab your guild mates and bring me back the Red Dragon's head. You'll find him in the Vasalkar/lair area. My contact in the Thieves Guild will pay VERY well for it!

quests.name: Defeat Capt. #00000Beard
quests.description: I don't like them pirates. They interfere with my bountyhunting. But this time it's not ME who has to deal with them. I'm sure you and your Guild-mates can take down Capt. #00000Beard and bring me back his Golden Pirate Loot. Head to /Lolosia and take the boat over to his ship to confront him.

quests.name: Defeat Nulgath
quests.description: Every good bountyhunter keeps an eye on a world's most dangerous opponents, and Nulgath definitely qualifies. Bring your Guild to take him down… if you CAN! If you can wrest away his Seal of Approval, the Master Thief will pay VERY well.

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Tibicenas
quests.description: I hope you've got an in-djinn-ious solution for this next mission, Hero, because you and your Guild crew are going to face down Ultra-Tibicenas in the /djinn realm. He's got a spare wish to grant, and my thief contact wants it.

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Carnax
quests.description: Time is on your side, Hero, but not for long, The Thief Master is impatient, and he desires the Eye of Ultra Carnax NOW! You'll find the beast in the /ultracarnax area, but you're going to need ALL your Guild-mates to take this create down!

quests.name: Slay Ultra Epic Vordred
quests.description: The ultimate trophy is… the shadow of Ultra Epic Vordred! (Doesn't sound like he's trying to compensate for something at all.) Battle this dark foe in the /vordredboss arena and rip off his shade. Return to me and you will be rewarded once I am.

quests.name: Free Daily Boost
quests.description: Legendary Heroes are some of Lore's most skilled and valued heroes. As our way of showing appreciation for you dedication, choose a free 1 hour boost every day you return to battle!

quests.name: DERP
quests.description: Derpicorns and Chickencows are ancient enemies. Slay the Sketchy Chickencow in Battleontown and the Rainbow Derpicorn will reward you with a character page badge to show its appreciation.

quests.name: Rainbow Rats
quests.description: The rats in this area have been affected by the cannon’s blast. The falling rainbow has turned them into Rainbow Rats! Defeat the rats and bring back 10 Rainbow Pellets as proof.

quests.name: Monochrome
quests.description: Monochrome the Dwakel hates color. ALL color. He has created the A.R.C (anti-rainbow cannon) to destroy all rainbows across Lore. Defeat Monochrome and bring back the key to the A.R.C - once you have that you'll be able to go and destroy the A.R.C for good!

quests.name: Destroy the A.R.C
quests.description: Now that you have the key, you will be able to destroy the Anti-Rainbow Cannon (A.R.C) that was used by Lucky Harms and Monochrome to destroy this rainbow. We need to make sure that this will never happen again!

quests.name: Frost that Lucky Harms!
quests.description: Lucky Harms, the Hork Warlord, is trying to destroy Roy G Biv! Without Roy, this rainbow will never come back… ever! Defeat Lucky Harms in battle and bring back his Top Hat so we can retrieve his 4-leaf Clover. Without it, he won't be "lucky" any more.

quests.name: Pot of Gold!
quests.description: Well, they say there's a pot of gold at the end of every rainbow… and there is! Roy G. Biv isn't interested in the Gold, but he does want his Pot back! You know how much those Sneevils love their containers!

quests.name: Shape of the Ship?
quests.description: Knew I could count on you. Here's the deal. My rival, Capt. 000000Beard, was due back in port a few days ago. His ship showed up but he's just bobbing there in the harbor like a cork. Take my pinnace to his ship and EXPLORE IT. Tell me what you find… especially if you find what his cargo is.

quests.name: Skeleton Crew, Skeleton Key
quests.description: So 000000Beard's ship has been taken over by the undead. What luck! If his cargo is in tact then we can salvage it and make a profit. 'Tis the law of the sea. But first we should find out what happened. One of the undead pirates will have the Key to the Captain's Quarters. See if you can find it and bring it back here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Dead Journal
quests.description: Should find out what happened to the crew if we can. Go into Capt. 000000Beard's Quarters and recover his Journal. Maybe his logs will tell us what happened. Then we can keep looking for his booty!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Sold Out!
quests.description: I knew that Capt. 000000Beard was a scallywag but you don't sell out your own crew! We have to stop him for the Alliance's sake! Maybe we can reverse the process. Get me some samples from the Undead Pirates and I'll get them examined. 10 Infected Bones should do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Abandon All Hope...
quests.description: Hopeless. My contacts say that we can't save 000000Beard's crew. That means that we're on our own. We HAVE to find where he Captain hid his deadly cargo. Search the Undead Pirates for some CLUE.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: In The Drink
quests.description: So the Plague Potion is in the barrels of that fruit drink in the hold. If I know Capt. 000000Beard the hold is locked tight as a drum and he's hidden the key on his Undead Pirates in pieces. Find all the fragments of the Hold Key and bring them here. I will assemble them for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Below Decks
quests.description: Now that you have the key you should be able to get into the ship's hold, but 000000Beard is a trig cully. He'll be waiting to stop you. Defeat Capt. 000000Beard if you can, then go into the hold and collect all the barrels of the drink you can find. Bring them back here for safe keeping.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Blow Stuff Up!
quests.description: Ok, the safest way to take care of this stuff is to get some gun powder and fuses. Gather 10 Gunpowder Casks, and take 10 Fuses from the Undead Pirates and bring them back here. I'll rig up a launch for you while you're gone.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Pack Of Spices
quests.description: Captain 000000Beard was a collector of a lot of things INCLUDING Tresure map Scraps. If you can bring me a single scrap from his collection I'll trade you this exotic Pack Of Spices. Won't see anything else like them in this part of Lore!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gold Ingot
quests.description: Collect 10 Gold Coins from the Undead Pirates and I will combine them into 1 Gold Ingot for you! You can find them on the Undead Pirates.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Blow Stuff Up!' quest.

quests.name: Bolt Of Silk
quests.description: Bring me 5 Silk Scraps and I'll combine them into a file Bolt of Silk for you! You can find them on the Undead Pirates.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Blow Stuff Up!' quest.

quests.name: A Second First Mate
quests.description: My last first mate's been put outta commission by the pirates of 000000Beard, curse him. I'm lookin' for a new one, you up for the job? If ye can prove yerself, ye can start immediately! Go get some revenge for me mate!

quests.name: Attack Naval Commanders
quests.description: Slay 30 Naval Commanders to turn in a Commander Token.

quests.name: Mega Attack Naval Commanders
quests.description: Slay 10 Pirates to turn in a MEGA Pirate Token

quests.name: More Blades More Battle
quests.description: I would be out ramming these invaders with my own horns if I was not needed here to make weapons for the Deathwatch and everyone else who would fight for the Darkblood. If you want to be useful, destroy some Chaonslaught Calvary and bring me their weapons. I will reward you.

quests.name: Hypnosis Caves
quests.description: You can't take care of others if you can't take care of yourself. The same saying goes for when you're undead. Just don't mention that I said this to the rest of the Legion, or they're going to scoff that it's pansy talk. I need the base for my usual 'memory repair' spell. That's what Lord Dage calls it. He developed it after he gained his first generals. You'll find the initial components from the makai and fiends in/darkfortress.

quests.name: Concussion Strengthener
quests.description: Laken was one of Lord Dage's most trusted Generals and Advisors, until the eventual falling out. Which is a sore shame. Laken didn't just have knowledge of the future, he was actually an expert in technology and biosynthetic reagents. The binding agent for the 'memory repair' spell was created by him. Maybe the Seraph Recruits over in /seraph still have some.

quests.name: Abyssal Spiral
quests.description: Have you been to /abysslair? That's where one of the newer generals trains and well, broods. He's always looking for challengers, but don't bother him today. For the 'memory repair spell, I need to get a hold of the guards and beasts. That mountain has special properties. If you spend enough time there, it imparts the essence of the abyss into your body. Ask nicely for samples, or not so nicely. Do what works.

quests.name: Languish in Limbo
quests.description: Now here's the hard part. Usually, Dage himself has his most trusted warriors sent to the /sevencircles to collect Ethos from the Limbo and Luxuria Guards. I'd rather take care of my headache problem in private this time. This may be contested amongst the Legion, but I think you're one of Dage's most trusted warriors. Could you go and retrieve the Ethos from the guards?

quests.name: Drowned in Lethe
quests.description: I'll need Wrath, Violence, and Treachery's Ethos from /sevencircleswar. Not from the guards. We need the stronger stuff from the beasts themselves. You know, I don't think these three things are necessarily 'evil.' If you feel wronged or see wrong doing, you deserve to feel wrath. And sometimes, there's no other choice but violence and treachery… Yeah, this is why the other Generals say I don't belong in the Legion.

quests.name: Super George Lowe-viathan
quests.description: Ah yes. The Super George Lowe-viathan. As the quest title suggests, this monster has been deviously buffed in HP, level, and attack power just for this special challenge fight. …it would have been nice if I had gotten *some* warning in advance but, you know…

quests.name: Vote for Rapaxi
quests.description: Slay 10 minions of the Nyx Aeterna to show that you believe the shadows and creatures of the night are best served by the Abyssal Legion. This is a wise decision.

quests.name: Give Luca a Message
quests.description: Sssso… the Baron seeks to overthrow ME and my Legion and claim the throne that is MINE?! No, no. Thisss will not do. Go. Defeat him. Show him that you are my ally, and that his power pales next to mine!

quests.name: Cleanse the Grove
quests.description: The animals of the grove have begun showing signs of corruption. This is MOST troubling… especially since - I - I can hardly say it, but… the song of the forest has been - silenced. *shudder* This CANNOT be a coincidence! Slay the Wolfwood, Hootbear, and Tainted Earth to bring me samples of the corruption.

quests.name: Survey the Landscape
quests.description: It's worse than we feared, Hero. And we don't have much time. The Horn of Protection MUST be recovered from the heart of the tree as soon as possible. But in order to do so, we'll need to clear a path. Make your way around the roots and scout the monsters Nevanna has sent after us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Guardian Spirit ' quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: Corruption in the Grove
quests.description: The Mutated Leeches are proving to be bigger obstacle than I expected. At this rate…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Perilous Supply Run
quests.description: Fending off Nevanna's troops is no question of strength; but unless we gather more supplies, Brightoak's people will suffer heavy causalities. let's see if we can't gather what we need from the enemy's own forces. Any of their monsters will do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Purify Wisterrora
quests.description: These Wisterrora are another result of the Queen's corruption. Thought we are short on time, we cannot leave them in their corrupted state. These creatures play a major role in the balance of our ecosystem. While the Queen of Monster's influence has began corrupting the orbs of purification I've places around the World Tree, they should still be strong enough to help purify Wisterrora. Please purify the orbs, and weaken the Wisterrora!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Arachnophobia
quests.description: Blast! The webs left behind by these Toxic Grove Spiders continue to impede our goal. Break all of the webs and defeat every spider that gets in our way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Brighten up your Day
quests.description: The damage wrought by Nevanna's troops is unforgivable. Should we lose, I fear for the safety of more than just our people.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse the Grove
quests.description: We must hurry, Hero. Please. These monsters are all that remain between us and the portal. Defeat them, along with anything that gets in our way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: X Marks the Spot
quests.description: The portal has to be here somewhere. I can sense it brimming with energy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: Defeat the Gaiazor
quests.description: Gaiazor awaits you, Hero. Defeat it, and the Horn of Protection will once again lend us its strength. BrightOak's fate rests in your hands.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Brightoak Bounty (Farming Quest)
quests.description: The battle is over, and Brightoak has been destroyed. The inhabitants of the forest remain tainted. We must purify as many of them as we can to reduce Nevanna's forces for the upcoming confrontation. Gather a Tainted Earth Core from on of the Tainted Earth beings and a Purified Sac from one of the Toxic Grove Spiders and I will reward you with Grove Seals.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Gaiazor ' quest.

quests.name: We Have Some Stragglers
quests.description: We have to make certain everyone was able to escape the world tree and reach the refugee camp we've set up. Most of our people have made it, but there are still far too many that I haven't seen. Please, find them and lead them to safety.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Gaiazor ' quest.

quests.name: Too Many Nasties
quests.description: This little area is as isolated as we can get, but the perimeter is crawling with corrupted abominations! Thin them out, and help me make sure everyone stays safe.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Ravinos Token I in your inventory.

quests.name: But...Our Stuff!
quests.description: Some of our people lost important personal items while they were fleeing — the monsters grabbed them right out of their hands. Normally I wouldn't bother you over mere material possesions, but these things are essential to ensuring our future.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Ravinos Token II in your inventory.

quests.name: Like One Of Those Toddler Gates
quests.description: We're safe for now, but who knows when the Queen's minions will come for us? Get me some roots from the Tree Golems, and some thorns from the Wisterroras. I'll put up a thorny barrier to help keep those monsters out of our camp.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Ravinos Token III in your inventory.

quests.name: It's Too Bad I'm Poisonous Now
quests.description: Some of our people were injured on their way here. We have medics who can attend to them, but they need supplies. We can use silk from the Grove Spiders in /Darkheart as gauze, but we'll need to get medicine from elsewhere, due to Brightoak's ever-spreading corruption. Bring me Trollola Nectar from the Trollola Plants in/ Bloodtusk Ravine, and Searbush from the Sulfur Imps in /Firestorm. We can use them to create a salve.

quests.name: Talk to Lapis
quests.description: The situation here is stable enough for now. I'd like to send you straight to Nevanna to smash that traitor's face into the ground, but Lapis Willowmist has asked to see you first.

quests.name: Defeat the Traitor
quests.description: Nevanna and her monstrous allies did so much damage while you were gone. We cannot allow any further destruction. Fight your way through the Queen's troops, and put an end to Nevanna and her corrupted Titan minion.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return to Ravinos ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Beast
quests.description: Nevanna is out of comission, but Gaiazor still attacks us! It's tragic that we must kill one of the Titans, but protecting Gaiazor is more important.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Into the Underglade
quests.description: You must go into the Underglade to find what you seek. The spirits below WILL try to stop you. It is unfortunate, but this means you must defeat them to continue. Do not worry, when they return to the earth, they will quickly be reborn from it again. You will not truly harm them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Talk to Ravinos ' quest.

quests.name: Clear the Spores
quests.description: As you can see, some corruption still remains below the surface of Brightoak. Get rid of any tainted Grove Spores you find down there. This will help you make up for the damage you are about to do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse the Walls
quests.description: Destroying those monsters helped a bit, but look at the cavern walls. Can you see the spot where the taint remains? Collect Essence of Nature from the Forest Spirits and Tree Nymphs, and spread it on those spots to cleanse them of the corruption.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: Expose the Entrance
quests.description: To go deeper into the Underglade, you will need to make your way into the Cave of Light. Unfortunately, there was a cave-in, and now it's being blocked by chunks of Blackened Earth. You'll need to remove it to continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: Gather the Glows
quests.description: The Cave of Light is named so because it is filled with Luminous Fungus. Beyond this cave, the caverns you will find yourself in are so dark you won't be able to see. Unless… you use the fungus to light your path! Collect a bushel of Luminous Fungus from the Cave Mushrooms in the Cave of Light. Only then will you be able to continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: More Corruption Revealed
quests.description: Oh no… the light from the Cave Mushrooms has revealed that the corruption runs deeper than we had thought! We must heal it! Collect Elemental Nature from the tree nymphs or forest spirits, and use it to restore the Corrupted Roots deep in the Underglade.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: The Goblin Threat
