quests.description: It looks like the area past the Cave of Light is infested with Twisted Goblins. Destroy as many as you can find. Hopefully, this will encourage Lunamoss to respond to you more favorably.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get an Offering
quests.description: It might not be a bad idea to bring Lunamoss an offering of some sort, before you ask for this favor. She is partial is gemstones. You may notice that the walls of these tunnels are rich with them. Chip away at them until you find a nice, gleaming one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Heart of the Glade
quests.description: I think you're ready to talk to Lunamoss now. I don't think she'll like what we're asking of her, but… all we can do is try. If anyone can get her to understand why the Heart of the Glade is so important, it is you. Get the Heart from her, and bring it to Victoria. She will be waiting for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: Troll Stink!
quests.description: We talk, but only after you wash. You go back to K'thurr village. Water in river there. Flowers on Trollola Plant. Use Scaly Skin Scrub from Chinchilizards around here. Then you be clean and stink-free.

quests.name: Mountain Protection
quests.description: You know when eclipse is now. But you not have protection of mountain spirit. Is dangerous to do ritual without blessing. Bring back 5 Chinchilizard Leather Thongs, 5 Ivory Tusks, and Jug of River Water and 3 rock from near village stairs. I explain later.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It Not Time Yet ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Clear Mind, Cleanse Spirit
quests.description: You need to focus if you going to summon Twins. Need incense to clear mind, cleanse spirit. Can't wash spirit with river water. Ha! Horc joke! You bring 10 fallen Trollola Blossom, 5 nuggets Lemurphant Musk, 4 Trollola Resin from plant, and Koalion fur for fire.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It Not Time Yet ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Be Horc Inside
quests.description: You sometimes act like a Horc. Is good, I say. But not enough. To do ritual, you must BE Horc inside! Think Horc, see Horc, talk Horc. Live Horc! You make totem, represent understanding of mountain spirit and importance. Need 5 fallen Trollola Blossoms, 3 Skin of Mountain, 5 Koalion Claws, 5 Lemurphant Tusks, 5 fallen Jungle Leaves.
quests.requirements_note: Must have answered She Who Answers questions. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Tainted Shadowed Soldiers
quests.description: Evil Soldiers made worse by Chaos taint! Take out 75 of them and I get Horc Weaponsmith to make you excellent trophy blade.

quests.name: Lycan Medals
quests.description: I'm going to need you to hold off Constantin's lycan army while I try to finish Count Maxius' ritual. Each of his soldiers carries a small medal that identifies their rank. Bring them to me, and I will reward you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An End To This Threat ' quest.

quests.name: Mega Lycan Medals
quests.description: While you're fighting Constantin's soldiers, you may run across some with particularly large medals. These are his higher-ranking wolves. Bring me their medals, and I'll give you an even larger reward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An End To This Threat ' quest.

quests.name: A Necessary Sacrifice
quests.description: Mages share a deep connection with nature. We draw our power from our surroundings and when the world is in balance, so are the magi. But there are times when sacrificing a friend allows for a greater good. The Seed Spitters have grown too big in numbers. I ask that you defeat 10 Seed Spitters and bring me their Roots to ensure that Arcangrove is not overrun by these populous plants.

quests.name: Gorillaphant Poaching
quests.description: The Magi have shared a strong connection with the Gorillaphant dating back to the era of DragonFable, We admire their great power, but fear it equally. The Gorillaphants in Arcangrove have started attacking the Magi more often than not, and so we must take out the most dangerous for our own well-being. Come back to me when you have slain 7 Gorillaphants.

quests.name: Observing the Observatory
quests.description: Something is amiss in the Observatory. Journey to the tallest branch of the Tower of Magic and record your findings. Come back to me if you find anything of interest.

quests.name: Ewa the Treekeeper
quests.description: The Druid settlement of Arcangrove is called The Cloister. The portal to the para-elemental plane gains its power from this sacred tree. Hurry; you must find Ewa the Treekeeper. Travel West of here until you reach The Cloister.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find Paddy Lump
quests.description: The First part of the Supreme Arcane Staff is called the Rod of Defiance. It was hidden in Mudluk Village. You must go to the village and speak with Paddylump, the Mudluk Spellhunter.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Wendigo Whereabouts ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Water You Waiting For--Find Nisse
quests.description: The next piece of the Supreme Arcane Staff is called the Runes of Riparian. They are protected somewhere under the water in the Merfolk safe haven known as The Natatorium. Seek out Nisse, the Mermaid Sage, and see if she can help.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Gates and Guardians ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find Umbra, the Master Shaman
quests.description: The Great Gilead was once thriving city of great magical achievement, but due to a terrible magical accident, it lies in ruins, deserted for more than a thousand years. It is now a place of study and quiet meditation for the spirit speaking Shamans. Seek out Master Shaman Umbra with hopes of obtaining the next piece of the Supreme Arcane Staff; the Wrap of Gilead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Deep End ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find Felsic the Magma Golem
quests.description: Your next mission will take you to the volcanic region of Mount Mafic. This fiery place is home to many powerful beasts who gain their strength from the volcano. Because of how dangerous the final piece of the Supreme Arcane Staff is — the Chaos Focus Gem — there is no better guardian than Mount Mafic herself. Travel to Mafic and seek out Felsic, the Magma Golem, if you truly believe you have enough responsibility (and HP) to complete the Supreme Arcane Staff.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guardian of the Gilead Wrap ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Obey Your Thirst for Adventure
quests.description: The para-elemental plane is unlike anything you have ever seen. This world is not part of your own, and the creatures here are composed of pure mana instead of bone and flesh. Defeat and capture 8 Mana Imps, for their entirety of their existence is made up of magic.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kindling Relationship ' quest.

quests.name: Captain Falcons
quests.description: Much like phoenixes of Lore, Mana Falcons are sacred and benevolent creatures. However, due to Ledgermayne's influence, the Falcons have turned to the side of chaos. In order to save these great beings, they must be reborn from their Astral Feathers. Defeat 5 Mana Falcons and collect their Astral Feathers!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Big, Bad and Baddest Bosses
quests.description: Although the bosses of Arcangrove live in the physical world, they absorb their mana from the para-elemental plane of magic. If you hope to reach the Mana Golem, you must retrieve Astral Orbs from each boss you encountered: Wendigo, Tiger Leech, Nessie, Mana Elemental, and the Mafic Dragon. Get the Orbs and return to me as quickly as you can. Good luck great hero.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Great Mana Golem
quests.description: I do not know if we are going to make it in time. If Ledgermanye awakens the legendary Mana Golem, it will absorb all of the mana out of this world…and ours. I hope there is still time… but hero, if the Golem awakens, you MUST defeat it for the sake of Lore!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Lord Ledgermayne
quests.description: Are you ready to fight Chaos Lord Ledgermayne? Make sure you are ready—there is no going back once you encounter the great Arcangrove Chaos Lord. Best of luck to you, hero.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Great Mana Golem ' quest.

quests.name: Rayst's Response
quests.description: The Druid settlement of Arcangrove is called The Cloister. The portal to the para-elemental plane gains its power from this ssacred tree. Hurry; you must find Ewa the Treekeeper. Travel West of here until you reach The Cloister.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Warlic's Letter to Rayst ' quest.

quests.name: Decipher the Scroll
quests.description: To make the counter-agent to decipher this scroll, I will need an Insight Tonic made in the Alchemy Academy, as well as 5 Arcangrove Seeds and 3 Burning Embers. (You will need Moglin Tears and Fish Oil to create the Tonic, or see if one of the monsters here drops it.)

quests.name: Your First Quest: Frogzards!
quests.description: Keep walking to your right (through Battleon) and you'll find the steps of a stone column, the Nexus. Frogzards have surrounded it, and now no one can get by. Slay 3 of the Frogzards to help people pass.

quests.name: Your Second Quest: Slimes!
quests.description: You would not think slimes could destroy a whole forest, but their slime trails poison tree roots! Walk through Battleon town and to the left to Greenguard Forest. Slay 4 slimes to protect the woods!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Your Third Quest: Spiders!
quests.description: Journey to /greenguardeast, the forests to the right of Battleon. There you will find deadly spiders! Slay 5 of them to protect the townspeople of Battleon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Your Fourth Quest: Wolves!
quests.description: Journey to /greenguardeast, the forests to the right of Battleon. There you will find ferocious wolves! Slay 5 of them to protect the townspeople of Battleon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Your Fifth Quest: Water Creature
quests.description: A vicious creature, the Kuro, lives in /river! It threatens any traveler who attempts to wade through it's home. Slay the Kuro to cleanse the river!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Vicious Wolves
quests.description: Wolves… vicious, terrible animals. A wolf once nearly destroyed my family but a woodcutter's ax put an end to him. Since then I have trained myself in the art of the hunt. If you would learn my way, bring to me 6 Wolf Pelts to demonstrate your worthiness.

quests.name: Slimes to the West, Slimes Everywhere
quests.description: Be careful where you tread, hero… Slimes are everywhere in this forest. These sickening creatures will engulf anything that they come across making it very dangerous for any who step into the shade here in Greenguard Forest. Bring me 6 Jars Of Ooze to show me that you are the hunter, and the slimes, your prey… and not the other way round.

quests.name: Scaly Menace
quests.description: Frogzards are very curious creatures indeed. These scaly menaces can be found in western Greenguard, and they are a plague on local farmers. They may be small but they can be very dangerous when cornered. Eliminate these pests and bring be 6 Frogzard Teeth as proof.

quests.name: Overgrown Spiders
quests.description: A good hunter knows that every creature has a place in the world. Spiders are normally helpful creatures that keep the insect population down. The spiders of Greenguard, however, are massive creatures that are more of a threat to livestock than mosquitoes. These creatures must not be allowed to thrive or we are all in danger. Slay 6 of the wicked thing and bring me their Fangs as proof.

quests.name: Dragon Might
quests.description: Of the four legendary beast of Greenguard Forest, the green dragon is by far the most powerful. If you wish to prove your might as a hunter, bring me one of the Dragon's Horns!

quests.name: Strange Gel
quests.description: The Gel-Oh-No may be the strangest looking of the four legendary beasts of Greenguard, but do not let that fool you… It is as deadly as any of the others! If you were to slay it, now only would it prove your worth as a hunter, it would also curb the slime infestation in the forest. Bring me its Slimy Remains!

quests.name: Terrifying Reptile
quests.description: The Basilisk is easily the most deadly of the four legendary beasts of Greenguard Forest. Its stare is as deadly as its venomous bite. No hunter would dare track this beast. Would you? Bring me the Basilisk's Tail as proof of its defeat.

quests.name: The Beast With Many Eyes!
quests.description: No one is certain where the Deathgazer came from, but it has taken its place as one of the four legendary beasts of Greenguard Forest. It has slain countless would-be hunters, because it is impossible to surprise due to its many eyes. If you would show your hunter's spirit, bring me the Deathgazer Eye!

quests.name: Can I Axe You Something?
quests.description: Woah, wait. You want to borrow my Big Wolf Slaying Axe? Hmm… you look trustworthy enough…kinda… but first, you'll need to do something for me. I am working on a bestiary and need information on the critters of Greenguard. Go through the forest and get me Documentation from the following monsters: Spider, Wolf, Slime, Frogzard, and Wereboar. If you are successful, then I will let you borrow my Axe. Deal?

quests.name: Mustard and Pretzel Root
quests.description: To begin your training in Alchemy, it is wise to start at the roots. Or, rather, the Pretzel Root. As a basic reagent in many Health Potions, this certain Root can be found on the Seed Spitters in the area. When combined with Mustard Seeds that the Gorillaphants cherish, I can stir up a nice batch of Potions for the magi in Arcangrove. Bring me 4 Pretzel Roots and 3 Batches of Mustard Seeds so I can get started!

quests.name: Thyme and a half
quests.description: Thyme is a medicinal herb used in many healing potions. Unfortunately, this reagent has become scarce since the Seed Spitters started sprouting up everywhere. I need at least 10 Bundles of Thyme in order to make the most basics of healing potions. I wish you good luck!

quests.name: Experiment 107: Elder's Blood Potion
quests.description: I have a little experimental potion I want to try out… but it's not going to be easy to make. And I can't guarantee on how it is going to turn out… But if you are a brave enough and strong enough… then it can be yours! I need you to slay 50 Gorillaphants so that I can gather the proper amounts of reagents. Good luck… and wish me luck, too!

quests.name: Experiment 231: Sparrow Blood Potion
quests.description: Alchemy experiments are fun! Especially when I have brave adventurers like YOU to test them out for me. I have an experimental potion in mind… but I need your help collecting the required reagents. The monsters in Arcangrove should have them all. Bring me 12 piles of DOOM Dirt, 17 Snapdrakes, and 30 Blood Lilies so I can concoct this potion!

quests.name: Experiment 808: Viper's Blood Potion
quests.description: Care to test out the Viper's Blood Potion? Well you can… as long as you help me gather the proper ingredients! Slay as many Arcangrove baddies until you find: 20 Jagged Cherries, 10 Shard Cabbages, 15 Joyshards, and 1 Sourpalm. Good luck on finding that last one—I haven't seen a Sourpalm in ages!

quests.name: Heal the World
quests.description: I want to make Northpointe a better place, and that starts with healthy people! For that, I'm going to need MANY more health potion ingredients! Bring me 4 of the Hot Peppers the Goblins love and 3 batches of Chimera-milk cheese.

quests.name: Sage Advice
quests.description: Sage is a medicinal herb in many healing potions. Unfortunately, this reagent has become scarce since the Grim Stalkers started eating the bees that pollinate the plats… AND the sage! I need at least 10 Bunches of Sage in order to make the most basics of healing potions. I wish you good luck!

quests.name: A Weird Gourmet
quests.description: I know someone who has experience with… well… weird things like this. He eats a lot of weird food, anyway… Bulbug is his name. You can find him in /thespan.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Potion Master ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Bring Me the Bounty of the Full Moon!
quests.description: The winner o' the Midnight Crown be the captain what has the biggest pile o' treasure at the end o' the battle! If ye be wantin' to help me out, ye can fight the Full Moon Pirates, and bring me the bounties they carry!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Black Veil Courier Service ' quest.

quests.name: Bring Me HUGE Bounties of the Full Moon!
quests.description: Some o' those Full Moon Pirates carry a larger bounty than usual - you might even say they have HUGE bounties! If ye find 3 o' these, bring 'em to me, and i'll add'em to me pile!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Black Veil Courier Service ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat Flintfang
quests.description: Yarrr! Our Captain CANNOT be abused like that. Go rescue Bonnie and bring her back safe!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Black Veil Courier Service ' quest. | Must have completed one of the previous quests.

quests.name: Vampire Pirate Medal
quests.description: Those scurvy curs are out for our throats! Show the Werewolves we're here for their necks, too! Arr, the Crimson Veil rules Midnight, and she'll be Queen of the Blood Testament Isles by sunrise!

quests.name: Mega Vampire Pirate Medal
quests.description: The Full Moon's crew don't know when to give up! I prefer our side of the Isles to be flea-free, if ye don't be mindin'. Keep it up, louts! The night and its blood belongs to Captain Bonnie!

quests.name: Siren's Pack
quests.description: Me crew wasn't just seein' things. There be ghost lights out on the water, and they've got claws worse than Flintfang's pack. Who are these Drowned Werewolves? Bring their hides to me. I want to know where they be comin' from.

quests.name: Bitterfang
quests.description: Flintfang's steppin' into our shores! Victory be at hand, an' the Lycan Captain knows it! He be just a feral animal, cornered and desperate! Put the beast down, and rub his nose in the loss!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous or the ' Bloodsong ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Find the Key! (Part One)
quests.description: To show your worth, you must find the key.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' To-Go Box ' quest.

quests.name: Find the Key! (Part Two)
quests.description: To show your worth, you must find the key.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' To-Go Box ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Key! (Part Three)
quests.description: You've made it so far, but in order to pass into Escherion's Sanctum Sanctorum, you must defeat the Gargoyle that he has charged with guarding the door…um!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' To-Go Box ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pumpkin-Flavoured Death
quests.description: My master wishes to analyze the sources of necrotic energy, your first target is set to this big amount located in /mogloween. Watch out, this source seems to be…alive.

quests.name: Thriller Trio
quests.description: Since phase 1 proved to be a success, you're good to go and find the remaining sources. This time, there are 3 very close to each other, bring all to me, if you please, the sources at /mogloweengrave, /candyshop. and /voltabolt.

quests.name: Over the Candycorn
quests.description: This is definitely a feisty one, try not to get lost around the stalks on /candycorn and bring me a sample of what is bumping in the night.

quests.name: The Pie is Also a Lie
quests.description: Next one is confusing me, the surroundings are distorting time and space, almost feel like home…anyway, ignoring the odd readings coming from this place, bring me the next sample at /pie.

quests.name: (Mad)Dollhouse
quests.description: This reading is very strong, but there is some interference, someone…or something nearby is emitting even stranger readings than last time, approach this individual with care, it's all converging at the /mirrormaze.

quests.name: It's Aliiiiiive!... Isn't it?
quests.description: By the third eye of Nak'Ur! This has to be the strongest reading so far! You MUST bring Master this sample, we will have so much material, I might have to serve two masters to fully read it! Hurry to /franken and bring it to me.

quests.name: Nevermore
quests.description: And we are down to the last sample, located at /wyvern and definitely the darkest one gauged yet. And once more, there is a source of unusual readings nearby. Another "friend" of yours?

quests.name: The Necronaut
quests.description: During the sampling process, I detected another source of necrotic energy…YOU! It is nothing to worry about, the energy is lingering on you instead of coming FROM you, but now the Master wants to "sample" it…personally. He is right beyond me, please be polite.

quests.name: Ultra Necronaut
quests.description: Before we leave this small planet, My master wishes to give it another try with the sampling process, he didn't tell me why, but I believe he just wants to have some more…fun.

quests.name: Winged Spies
quests.description: The Chaos Lord at Mobius has too many eyes at his disposal. With too many Chaos Sp-eyes around Mobius we won't be able to get far. Bring down 5 Chaos Sp-eyes and bring me back their wings so I can assign you the next task.

quests.name: Chaos Prisoners
quests.description: Just look at this town. Imagine trying to continue your life with your house inverted, twisted and turned inside out. Explore the houses in Mobius and get any information you can about the Chaos Lord.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: IMP-possible task
quests.description: Before we get the townsfolk to safety, we need to clear the path out of town. We'll protect them while you get rid of Escherion's imps. Bring us 5 Imp Teeth so we know the job is done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: You Can't Miss It!
quests.description: The Chaos Lord Escherion is responsible for all of this destruction. Off in the distance to the north you can see his inverted tower. Go investigate it and see if you can find a way inside the tower.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Far Sighted
quests.description: These cyclops raiders are one of our biggest problems. They seem to be looking for something so maybe you can make it harder for them to find it. Defeat the cyclopses and return with 5 Cyclops Contact Lenses.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slugfest
quests.description: Slugfit, the Imp General was left in command of Escherion's forces here in town. If you defeat him the Chaos Lord's forces will fall into…uh…chaos. But that's a good thing in this case. Return to us with his scalp as proof of his defeat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Some Assembly Required
quests.description: We've been trying to put the Runix Cube together all night but we just can't do it. If we can't assemble it then I doubt we'll be able to stop Escherion. Why don't you try it? Maybe you'll have better luck.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' You've Been Framed ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Teleporter Report
quests.description: The teleporter that leads to the tower is to the north. We've been watching Chaos Lord Escherion's army using it for a while. Go investigate and see if you can activate it from this side.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' You've Been Framed ' quest. Notes: | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Disguise!
quests.description: You need a disguise! You need to look like someone they would activate the teleporter for. Go get 8 Cloth Scraps from the Cyclops and we'll use our illusion and rune magic to craft a disguise for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' You've Been Framed ' quest. Notes: | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: To-Go Box
quests.description: What we need to do now, is to disguise your weapon. Go to the Faerie Forest and get 4 Cardboard Boxes from the Sneevils there. We should be able to use those as material components in the spell to hide your weapon.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' You've Been Framed ' quest. Notes: | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Escherion
quests.description: You've made it this far, now you must defeat Chaos Lord Escherion to free Chiral Valley!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Lake Hydra ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: The Black Goat in The Dark
quests.description: Looks like I'm your Watson, Detective Champ. How about we circle back to check on that mom and widower? They were worried about you so go and tell them you're doing swell. While you're at it, mind thinning the mobs of….people? I'll take one half and you can have the other.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' No Good Deed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Star Sinks into the Sea
quests.description: Thanks for making the town a bit quieter. That makes it a lot safer for that little girl and that guy on the street to come out of hiding. Why not check on them, too? I'll go make sure the others are… feeling better.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' No Good Deed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Gentlest Truth
quests.description: There goes the town. At least that means there's no one left to get angry at you for not burying the bodies. Oh. Wait. The MAYOR might get mad at us for skipping town. If he turned out anything like the others… he's probably looking for us. We should find him first.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' No Good Deed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Time Moves the Moon
quests.description: It's do or die, not like it's been anything but this. However you want to handle this, I got your back, champ. And remember, I never lie.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' No Good Deed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sweet Dreams Are Made of Teeth
quests.description: Time to put on your tooth fairy costume and go get me some teeth, Hero! Just beat them out of any monsters you run into. No time for questions, go GO!

quests.name: Drago, Tyrant of Astravia
quests.description: I'd say you have about 3 minutes until Judgement arrives. You'd better kick Drago's butt before then, or else it's game over for you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mahapadma ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per week.

quests.name: The Tower
quests.description: For Song, it's been one heartbreak after another. Just when she thinks she's found a home, she's kicked out for being a monster or it bursts into flames. And now it's all going to come crashing down again. I hate that we're making you do this but Song needs to see that the Scale isn't on the right track, and never has been. You'll have to fight her, but hold back a bit. She's not a fighter, she's just desperate.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Temptation, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Star
quests.description: The Fool's influence is weakening faster and faster, which means The World's picking up speed. The Nothingness eating up Lore is right behind us. We'll plummet through empty space before you get a chance to see Darkon. Go and push the Nothingness back! Punches and kicks worked pretty well. Don't think too much about it. I'll keep Fa and Ti from stopping you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Temptation, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Moon, Reversed
quests.description: Song won't back down. She stood back up to protect Darkon from you. Even though she's the smartest of us, deep down, Song knows this is wrong. But, she's still a kid scared of being alone again. I…I can't help you fight Song like this. Even if I had my full strength, I don't think I'd be able to raise my voice against her. Please, can you tucker her out?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Temptation, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Sun, Reversed
quests.description: Song…She's on her last legs. There's no way she can stop you, and she knows it. I feel it coming off of her in waves - hopelessness for the future. Champ, just one more time. Let her down gently so she can move on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Temptation, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Judgement
quests.description: This is between you and Darkon. I'll keep the rest of the Scale from interfering, not that any of us have the ability to get in between you two. We've all been through a lot, and made a crazy amount of mistakes along the way. If all Astravians are going to be judged, then it's our turn next. Go make Darkon face the music.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Temptation, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The World
quests.description: Is that the Primordial World up there? Everything, all of Darkon and the Scale's efforts, are coming full circle. A perfect Lore built on regret and resentment is on its way. I can't live like that. You'd have to make me. Darkon will force everyone to live his way if you don't stop him. Go on, champ! This is your story too. Work your magic like you always do and defeat Darkon. Save Lore!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Temptation, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

items.name: A Requiem for the Wicked Character Page Badge

quests.name: Clear Twilight's Edge
quests.description: Defeat the beasts in Twilight's Edge frame by frame to reach the portal.

quests.name: Cleanse Swordhaven
quests.description: Defend the Royal Family! Defeat 6 spiders in Swordhaven and talk to Sir Prise to get information on where Tomix may be hiding.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Clear Twilight's Edge ' quest.

quests.name: Cleanse Faerie Forest
quests.description: The ChaosWeavers have reached the Faerie forest! Do not let them defile this beautiful place! Defeat 6 spiders in Faerie Forest and talk to Dew Drop Fairie to get information another clue on where to find Tomix.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse DarkoviaGrave
quests.description: The Weavers have overrun the graveyard! Defeat 6 arysa in the Darkovia Graveyard and talk to Vannier to get information on where to find Tomix.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse Doomwood Forest
quests.description: They are all over the forest! Defeat 6 Weaver Hounds in Doomwood Forest and talk to Arryd to get information on where to find Tomix. then find Arryd. He is an experienced warrior, and may know where beasts like these would hide a prisoner.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse Firestorm
quests.description: These must be a special breed of ChaosWeavers to withstand the flames. Defeat 6 Weaver in Firestorm, and talk to then find Hs'Sakar to get information on where to find Tomix.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse Northlandlights
quests.description: Defeat 6 spiders in Northlandlights and talk to Adak to get information on where to find Tomix.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse Battleunder
quests.description: Defeat 6 Arysa in Battleon frame, talk to Yara to get information
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse Guru Forest
quests.description: Defeat 6 Weavers in Guru Forest and talk to the Forest Witch to get information on where to find Tomix.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse Sleuthhound Inn
quests.description: Defeat 6 Weavers in Sleuthhound Inn and talk to Scarlett Drew to get information on where to find Tomix.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse Battleon
quests.description: Defeat 6 spiders in Battleon and talk to Cleric Joy to get information on where to find Tomix.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Save the SoulWeaver
quests.description: You found Tomix! Now defeat the ChaosWeaver Warrior to free him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Slay the Spiderkin
quests.description: It's going to be a HARD fight once we head into Ravenloss. Practice your fighting techniques onto the ChaosWeavers in the Weaverwar Map!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Save the SoulWeaver ' quest.

quests.name: Chaos Weavers' Magic
quests.description: So, you'd like to know more about the magic used by the Chaos Weavers? Fight the Chaos Weaver Magi until you find one of the shimmering scrolls they carry. Bring it to me, and I will translate it for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Save the SoulWeaver ' quest.

quests.name: Legendary Heroes of the Chaos Weavers
quests.description: We think of the Chaos Weavers as our foes, and should. Those whom have conquered sing songs and tell stories to encourage those who have not fallen. The ChaosWeavers keep records of them. If you'd like to hear more, find a golden scroll, and I will translate it for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Weaver Tales and Legends
quests.description: Most of us don't think of Chaos Weaver as a particularly creative or artistic group, so many are surprised to learn that their storytellers are so highly valued. Would you like to read some of their tales? I saw a parchment scroll on our way here. Find it, somewhere in their museum, and bring it back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Weaving Rebellion
quests.description: Not all Chaos Weavers are content to follow the Weaver Queen. The Weaver Queen's Hounds keep lists of these rebels on tattered scrolls, and slay them on sight. If you'd like to learn more about them, bring me a tattered scroll for translation. You might still find some roaming twilight's edge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Weaver Tactics and Strategy
quests.description: In times of war, it's useful to learn about the tactics and strategies your enemies use. If you'd like to learn about the battle maneuvers of the Chaos Weavers, bring me on of their martial scrolls their warriors and knights carry.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Rulers of the Chaos Weavers
quests.description: Are you curious about the past rulers of the Chaos Weavers? The Chaos Weaver Knights carry gilded scrolls that detail their history. Bring one to me, and I'll translate it for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Fate and Saviors
quests.description: The Chaos Weavers have quite an interesting belief system. Would you like to learn about it? Much of it is detailed in the luminous scrolls the Chaos Weaver magi carry with them. Bring me one — I'll translate it and add the information to your Codex.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Nature of Chaos
quests.description: The Chaos Weavers have a deeper understanding than most of the nature of Chaos. Many of them carry shifting scrolls that detail this information. Bring me one, and I'll add the information to your Codex.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Weaver Tribes
quests.description: The Chaos Weavers we're dealing with here are only one tribe out of many that exist throughout the world. I saw silk scrolls strewn about on the ground as we traveled. If you're interested, find one and bring it to me for translation.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Weaver Castes
quests.description: What determines whether a chaos weaver will become a cleric, or a warrior, or a mage? Interestingly, and lot of information on this has been chronicled by Evolved Dreadspiders. Find one of the embellished scrolls they carry, and bring it to me if you want to learn more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Ravenloss Champion
quests.description: To prove your dominion over the Chaosweavers, defeat 100 ChaosWeavers (Knight or Magi) in battle. If you can do this, then you truly deserve the title Ravenloss Champion… and the Character Page badge, too!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Save the SoulWeaver ' quest.

quests.name: Seek the Tower
quests.description: Hero! You must seek out Syrrus in the Tower of Winds. He is the one who summoned you. You'll find the tower down the path to the right.

quests.name: A n-Ice Beginning
quests.description: The tower is locked? I bet one of those Polar Elementals stole the key. They are not very n-ice! (I pun to forget how cold I am…) Stay 10 of them to see if you can find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Search for Syrrus
quests.description: Now that you've got the key, you're going to want to talk to Syrrus, the Astromancer and Lord of the Tower of Winds! He has made contact with a VERY powerful mage, one who controls an army, and will come help us!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shot in the Dark
quests.description: Princess Victoria left to gather more medicinal herbs for you. We need to find her! The upper floor of the castle is infested with ghosts. If you feel well enough, we should lay them to rest. It'll make it easier to find our way around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Euterpe and Deer ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Sparkling Changeling
quests.description: The Ritualists know you're here, and they're coming upstairs. If they find the Princess, they'll surely use her to lure you out. We should step carefully, and cull their numbers without alerting them all. Watch how I move. The Princess was an efficient teacher.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Euterpe and Deer ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Silver Proof
quests.description: The ground is quite dirty, so please watch your step. Oh? I recognize these goblets. We had these in our main castle as well - Your Highness? You want me to help you gather all of them up? Of course! There should be more around here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Euterpe and Deer ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gilded Peace
quests.description: Gathering those goblets made the Revenants agitated, and the noise they're making is getting the attention of the Ritualists. If we work swiftly and quietly, we can take care of both without being found out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Euterpe and Deer ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Towards Reunion
quests.description: There's a commotion coming from outside. It's…the Princess' voice! Look! She climbed outside to get to the courtyard. There's a ghost attacking her! Or rather, this spirit is confused and swinging his sword wildly. We need to get down there!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Euterpe and Deer ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Servants Stay Unseen
quests.description: We'll have to climb down the far ledge if we want to delve deeper. The Princess scouted ahead and said she saw Undead, but no Ritualists. Did they retreat? We should lay those Ghostly Servants to rest, and look for anything the Ritualists left behind.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Euterpe and Deer ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Slaying of Sacred Deer
quests.description: I see why the Ritualists retreated. The knights you defeated all those years ago have risen to join my father… sans their heads. Seeing how some of the remaining doors in the castle are still locked, we should search these Headless Riders for keys.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Euterpe and Deer ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Light Protects You
quests.description: Your Highness, the Princess and I looked inside the locked room, and saw two shimmering figures made of Light. They don't have any specific shape and - what? Do you recognize them? Would it be safe for you to examine them?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Euterpe and Deer ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cure-All
quests.description: The medicine's effects are waning. We won't be able to face my father without your skill and strength. I can make another dose, but the Princess couldn't find enough herbs. The Riders and Ghosts may still have some from back when they were alive.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Euterpe and Deer ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Thronekeeper Vaughn
quests.description: Are we prepared? The Thronekeeper is in the castle's inner sanctum. He's stronger than he was in life. That enchanted armor is what's keeping him tethered to this plane. We'll destroy it, and banish my father. Just remember, magic has little effect on him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Euterpe and Deer ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rootless Lilies
quests.description: Before we leave, would I be able to collect a keepsake from Castle Bocklin? Oh, you'll help me? I am in your debt! What I'm looking for is an ancestral pendant that was never passed on. It should still be on the Thronekeeper.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Thronekeeper Vaughn ' quest.

quests.name: Rootless Lilies (Legend)
quests.description: Before we leave, would I be able to collect a keepsake from Castle Bocklin? Oh, you'll help me? I am in your debt! What I'm looking for is an ancestral pendant that was never passed on. It should still be on the Thronekeeper.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Thronekeeper Vaughn ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat The Red Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Torgat, the chosen champion of the Red Dragons? Ok… it's your funeral. Run into the valley, and I'll taunt him down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Riddrug ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat The Ice Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Fressa, the chosen champion of the Ice Dragons? Well, you were able to beat Torgat, so sure, why not. Run into the valley, and I'll taunt him her down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat The Undead Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Radroth, the chosen champion of the Undead Dragons? You're on a roll - let's give it a shot! Run into the valley, and I'll taunt him down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat The Water Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Nizex, the chosen champion of the Water Dragons? You sure you're up for another one so soon? Alright, alright. Run into the valley, and I'll taunt him down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat The Wind Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Tathu, the chosen champion of the Wind Dragons? Better be careful with this one, or you might get blown away! Run into the valley, and I'll taunt him her down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat The Yokai Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Lanshen, the chosen champion of the Yokai Dragons? Be warned: these dragons are normally really peaceful, but they also know how to fight. Run into the valley, and I'll taunt him her down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat The Green Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Ashax, the chosen champion of the Green Dragons? Hey, hey! I hear you're really experienced with this kind of dragon. Right? Run into the valley, and I'll taunt him down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat The Faerie Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Letori, the chosen champion of the Faerie Dragons? Don't underestimate this one. They may look like adorable little lunchbox stickers, but they can be deadly! Run into the valley, and I'll taunt him her down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat The Chaos Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Nayzol, the chosen champion of the Chaos Dragons? Ok, this is one dragon I really want to see you defeat. I don't want a Chaos Dragon for a king, so let's take him out of the running! Run Get yourself into the valley, and I'll taunt him down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat The Void Champion
quests.description: You know, I don't really want a Void Dragon king, either. I didn't think Zathas would be the last dragon standing, because I didn't actually expect you to get this far. But here we are. Take him out, and then… well, I guess the rest of us will figure something out about Maleth.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Survey the Territory
quests.description: Rabbits are a master of traversing the forest floor. They know who lives where and what threatens their journey. Become familiar with the entire Dragon Den so nothing catches you by surprise.

quests.name: Make a Game Plan
quests.description: If we're going to go looking for this dragon, we need a plan. Take notes on the surrounding area and make sure you study every shortcut and possible strategic weak points. You may have to get some information from local mushrooms on some good strategic areas.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Big Enough for Success
quests.description: Have you seen the beautiful waterfall around these parts? It's one of my favorite things about living in Brightoak - the stunning beauty of the nature is just simply captivating. In my free time I enjoy going to the waterfall and being alone with my thoughts, it helps clear my mind and allows me to motivate myself to be big enough for success. Maybe it can do the same for you. You've been working hard and it looks like you need a refreshing break.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Something to Gnaw On
quests.description: All of this hunting is surely making me hungry… an Arcornent's Shell from the /cloister and some hay from a Grizzly Bear in /pines should satisfy my hunger!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hare-y Situation
quests.description: We have a serious situation, hero… someone's stolen my special carrots. Not those cheap carrots you buy in Yulgar's Inn for a couple of gold, I'm talking about enhanced carrots that are found only in Brightoak. One of the enemies here must have taken it, fight them until they drop my carrot!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Escape Burrow
quests.description: We're almost there, I can smell it. Dig a few holes around the area so that we have a better idea on which direction we have to go. Also, a flashlight might help… unless I'm wrong, the mushrooms around these areas should drop one for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest at least once. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Hope Will Lead the Way
quests.description: The path of nature has led us to where we now stand. One doesn't have to be a bard to feel the presence of Rivensylth near by. Travel forward and locate the stone that will summon Rivensylth. She has aged since Nevanna first found her egg.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Purifying the Grove
quests.description: Avada is the final foe you must encounter before your task here is complete, hero. I do not doubt your heroic abilities, I know you will be able to defeat her. Go and save Rivensylth.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cleaning the Grove (Farming Quest)
quests.description: Your work here is done, but you're always welcome to stay and learn more about our culture. Recover 3 stolen storybooks and you might learn something.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Chaos Not Invited
quests.description: I've got good news and bad, Hero! The good news is… YOU are here! The bad news? The wedding invitations were stolen. Bring me back the last 8 invites from the Chaos Invaders as you take them down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' No, NOW We're Under Siege ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Better Letter Go!
quests.description: We've got to get these invitations out to the townspeople! Please deliver them to the following people:
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' No, NOW We're Under Siege ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Decor Rater
quests.description: My assistant tells me there aren't any BALLOONS in town yet! Did you see any?! … Oh. Oh my. Well, THAT is your next task! Decorate Swordhaven!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' No, NOW We're Under Siege ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cold Feet, Warm Heart
quests.description: Princess Brittany has a job for you! Bring back a Burning Coal Brazier from the Living Fire in Mount Mafic so Princess Brittany can tease Lord Brentan about not getting cold feet.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' No, NOW We're Under Siege ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos STILL Not Invited
quests.description: The Chaos Invaders are back! I've summoned the guards, but until they get here, please take care of ALL the invaders in the Chapel AND the reception area. We simply CANNOT have this wedding disrupted!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' No, NOW We're Under Siege ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Protect the Princesses
quests.description: We need to gather the resources to seal the chapel and protect the princesses! Go into the reception garden and gather 6 chairs. We'll use them to block the door!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' No, NOW We're Under Siege ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Seal the Chapel
quests.description: You'd better take wood from the reception hall chairs and pile it all in front of the chapel door. That way they can't get back in!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' No, NOW We're Under Siege ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Kills!
quests.description: Oh NO! Not the Justicar, too! Who will lead the courts if he's… ah, it is a sad, sad day in Swordhaven! Protect him from himself, Hero.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' No, NOW We're Under Siege ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Juice on the Loose!
quests.description: Glad you wanna help a partner out. I'm dying of thirst over here, and could really use more Moglinberry juice… and 3 Pints should do it! If I can *hic* recall correctly, there are a few beasties out there that love that Juice as much as me: Warden Elfis, the Drow prison guard inside Dwarfhold; that big bad Cyclops Warlord in Mobius; and Big Jack Sprat in the Graveyard near Swordhaven. And don't come back here without my 3 Pints of Moglinberry Juice! *hic*

quests.name: Unleash the Frostvale Barbarian
quests.description: The Barbarians of Frostvale are known for their Strength, Endurance, and Dexterity. Prove that you possess these traits, and you, too, can become a Frostvale Barbarian. Complete the Forest Guardian Gauntlet in /alpine, the Holly and Ice quest in Coldwind Valley, and the Defeat Karok quest in /northstar. Bring me the Sword of Hope, recover the Sassafras' War Helm from /battlefield, and get the Infernal Ice Heart from Vinara's shop in /battleontown.

quests.name: Get in the Holiday Spirit
quests.description: (Requires Obsidian ArchPaladin armor from Mysterious Dungeon) Artix the UndeadSlaying Paladin is getting into the Frostval Spirit, and the BEST way he can do that is free any last spirits trapped inside Vordred the PaladinSlayer. Bring back 12 Festive Spirits from any Vordred you encounter as you battle through Lore.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Obsidian ArchPaladin in your inventory.

quests.name: Save The Moglins!
quests.description: There's been a big problem with many moglins missing out on Frostval. Every year, there always seems to be a few missing, either trapped or missing somewhere. Can you find them and bring them back here? I know I saw some in /DarkWinter trying to stop the Legion, and some that were frozen over in /FrostvalNext.

quests.name: Robina's Quest
quests.description: Hello! I am Robina the Hood. *whispers* I have a bit of a problem. I lost my, um, back key to the castle. I think I accidentally put it on a monster when I was in the sewer. Could you get it back for me? (Return to Robina in the Swordhaven Inn with the Key.)

quests.name: Missing Boxes
quests.description: Hello, again! When the undead invaded we decided to save our belongings in boxes. These boxes suddenly began disappearing from our storage room. Can you go into the storage room and see where the boxes have gone, and if you find them, can you bring them back?

quests.name: Bug Blight
quests.description: I thought it was strange that the nearby corn was left untouched, but there's something very wrong with it. Let's inspect those cursed cobs for more clues, and talk to that local boy over there. Maybe he knows something about what's happened to this place.

quests.name: Struggle Soup
quests.description: You say that you can cook the corn as long as we remove the kernels' insides, and that the locusts could be used as ingredients? You must be an amazing chef! Let's find something you can cook with… a nice, sturdy cauldron should do the trick.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fetid Feast
quests.description: You want to invite the villagers to a feast? Good idea - that'll encourage them to come out, and hopefully, learn to share. Go ahead and gather the ingredients, and then set things up in the Town Hall: it's empty, so we'll use it as the venue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dire Disparity
quests.description: One of the villagers who came out to see the feast wants to talk to us. Miriam says their Mayor is acting strange and hoarding a huge amount of grain for himself. We should talk to her and see what she has to share.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Balancing Crumbs
quests.description: In times of famine, scales are used to measure grain, but the mayor has a surplus. The villagers say that he's a reasonable and kind man. He began acting strange after finding those golden scales. We're going to confiscate them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Harrowing Hike
quests.description: The monsters descending from the mountain are some sort of undead! We'll follow their tracks to find the source! Stay close to me and be careful!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Down the Grapevine
quests.description: There's a man nearby, Oishii, and I don't think it's the famine that's making him look skeletal. Wait… you want to talk to him? Alright, I guess, but I'll be right here in case he tries anything.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hungry Hive
quests.description: The locusts are using this cave as a hive! Now that we have a better idea about what we're up against, we can hunt them, and figure out a way to bring the whole nest down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Acrid Abundance
quests.description: This rider fellow claiming to be Famine itself is using this mountain as a hive for the monsters they've been summoning. He's the source of this supernatural blight! We'll cull his familiars, find him, and bring an end to this.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Keeper of the Scales
quests.description: We're facing off against the source of the famine; an evil summoner who believes that they are Famine itself. Time to kick him off his high horse! Help me if you can, but if things get bad, run.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Fowl Feast
quests.description: We've got even more guests on the way. We're going to need MORE FOOD! I've got to keep the peace here. Can you go out hunting and bring back fodder for the feast table? Meaty legs from the Tantalocusts, the grass from the Fear Gorta's backs, and of the spice Famine uses to scent his robes. Thank you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Keeper of the Scales ' quest.

quests.name: Robina's Quest
quests.description: Hello! I am Robina the Hood. *whispers* I have a bit of a problem. I lost my, um, back key to the castle. I think I accidentally put it on a monster when I was in the sewer. Could you get it back for me? (Return to Robina in the Swordhaven Inn with the Key.)

quests.name: Missing Boxes
quests.description: Hello, again! When the undead invaded we decided to save our belongings in boxes. These boxes suddenly began disappearing from our storage room. Can you go into the storage room and see where the boxes have gone, and if you find them, can you bring them back?

quests.name: Rescue Blizzy
quests.description: Oh no! Something terrible has happened! Blizzy the ice Moglin has been captured, and this could spell the end of Frostvale! Blizzy is the only one that can help the citizens of Battleon get through the frost barrier and enter Frostvale. Without Blizzy, Frostvale could be destroyed! Blizzy was captured by Frosty, the Snow Golem. I've tried to save Blizzy and was defeated and I'm all out of my special metal arrows. If you can, please gather some friends, defeat Frosty and bring back Blizzy safe and sound!

quests.name: Scary Snow Men
quests.description: Thank you for saving Blizzy! However, I'm still in a bit of a jam. Poor Blizzy is now terrified of snowmen and won't return to Frostvale. There are two Snow Golems left on the paths waving around their sharp swords of ice. You must be pretty tough since you bested Frosty. Defeat the two Snow Golems blocking the path and bring me their scarves as proof. The scarves will show Blizzy that it is safe to return to Frostvale.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Piercing Arrows!
quests.description: Frosty the Snow Golem keeps stomping around the paths here, making it dangerous for travelers to go to Frostvale! My arrows don't damage him at all, so I will need your help to make some special Frost Arrows! Please bring me back 5 pieces of Frosty Metal so I can make Frosty Metal arrows. In return I will give you this Frost Guard.

quests.name: Talk to the Knights (Storyline)
quests.description: How did all these elite undead get in here? We need to find out what is going on and find a way to stop them. Talk to 5 of the Knights and see if they know anything.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Undead Giant (Storyline) ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defend the Throne Room (Storyline)
quests.description: The elite undead are being dropped right out of the flying fortress!? .. and Sepulchure is in the castle now too!? We need to protect the throne room at all costs! Defeat 8 Skeletons and bring me their skulls to assure the safety of the King.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Undead Giant (Storyline) ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Horc Hacker
quests.description: Turn in your Defender Prize for a new amazing item! Defender Prize drop during war events.

quests.name: Horc Mangler
quests.description: Turn in your Defender Prize for a new amazing item! Defender Prize drop during war events.

quests.name: Horc Claw
quests.description: Turn in your Defender Prize for a new amazing item! Defender Prize drop during war events.

quests.name: Steel Chopper
quests.description: Turn in your Defender Prize for a new amazing item! Defender Prize drop during war events.

quests.name: Cyclops Warlord Helm
quests.description: Turn in your Boss Prize for a new helm to use as you battle.

quests.name: Massive Horc Cleaver
quests.description: Turn in your Boss Prize for a new weapon to use in battle.

quests.name: Savage Warlord Armor
quests.description: Turn in your Boss Prize for a new amazing item! Boss Prizes have a 10% chance to drop from war bosses.

quests.name: Horc Club
quests.description: Turn in your Boss Prize for a new weapon to use as you battle.

quests.name: Talk to the Knights
quests.description: How did all of these elite undead get in here? We need to find out what is going on and find a way to stop them. Talk to 5 of the Knights and see if they know anything.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Undead Giant ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defend the Throne Room
quests.description: The elite undead are being dropped right out of the flying fortress!? .. and Sepulchure is in the castle now too!? We need to protect the throne room at all costs! Defeat 12 Skeletons and bring me their skulls to assure the safety of the King.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Undead Giant ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Previously called "Once More the Defender" .

quests.name: Secure Shattersword Cavern
quests.description: We must make sure Graveclaw the Defiler cannot escape his prison! Place an enhancement spell on the 4 Security Orbs in this chamber, and slay 5 of the Forest Imps which keep breaking them!

quests.name: Shatter Fallen Warriors
quests.description: Stick and stones will break their bones… and that's just what we want! Slay 4 of the Fallen Warriors serving Graveclaw, or he'll turn them against US!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Corruption Cleansed
quests.description: These Dark Faeries… can't you feel it? Graveclaw used their magic to strengthen his corruption of the Caverns. Slay 5 of them to reduce the strength of the Defiler's taint!
quests.requirements_note: Must have complete previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Decimate the Defiler's Army
quests.description: Slay 10 of Graveclaw's minions! These Shattersword Prisoners and Fallen Warriors are no longer who they once here. I doubt they will even feel pain as they are slain.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Explosive Protection Poison
quests.description: I know a potionmistress back in Swordhaven. She taught me this recipe to prevent poisoning… but it may backfire! Gather 6 Nitrix Pollens from the Tubeflowers, 3 Fungal Fuses from the Glowing Mushroom, 4 Tendril Spores from the Blue Fairy Sentinel and slay 1 Fallen Warrior to get a Fling and Striker.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gravelyn's Stolen Soldiers
quests.description: Empress Gravelyn sent her warriors, mages, and rogues down into Shattersword Cavern to keep Graveclaw occupied… and his strength from coming back. He has stolen them, and now THEY are attacking that poor Elf! Slay 7 of Shattersword Prisoners to save her, and steal them back from Graveclaw!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hero vs Beast
quests.description: The time has come to finish the battle King Alteon began so many decades ago! Slay Graveclaw the Defiler, prevent him from attacking Swordhaven, and cleanse the land of his taint!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Purity Beats Corruption ' quest at least once.

quests.name: Unleash the Frostvale Barbarian
quests.description: The Barbarians of Frostvale are known for their Strength, Endurance, and Dexterity. Prove that you possess these traits, and you, too, can become a Frostvale Barbarian. Complete the Forest Guardian Gauntlet in /alpine, the Holly and Ice quest in Coldwind Valley, and the Defeat Karok quest in /northstar. Bring me the Sword of Hope, recover the Sassafras' War Helm from /battlefield, and get the Infernal Ice Heart from Vinara's shop in /battleontown.

quests.name: Get in the Holiday Spirit
quests.description: (Requires Obsidian ArchPaladin armor from Mysterious Dungeon) Artix the UndeadSlaying Paladin is getting into the Frostval Spirit, and the BEST way he can do that is free any last spirits trapped inside Vordred the PaladinSlayer. Bring back 12 Festive Spirits from any Vordred you encounter as you battle through Lore.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Obsidian ArchPaladin in your inventory.

quests.name: Defeat Rock Roc
quests.description: The Rock Roc has been commanded to finish you… but there's no way he can, right? Right? Go for it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Big Bada-Boom ' quest.

quests.name: Medicine Man
quests.description: We must get Madeline medicine. Find me a Mortar and Pestle, 1 Syringe, and 1 Gourd Medicine Vial. I believe I stored them in a Chest somewhere… but I do not remember where. I hope your strength is better than my memory…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Story Time! ' quest.

quests.name: Her Herbalism
quests.description: Modern medicine is not curing Madeline. Find a book on Herbology from my Bookcases, and then collect Berries, Leaves, and Flowers from the plants in the garden.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Extra-Sensory Siblings
quests.description: Madeline and I have always shared a supernatural bond—we are connected on a physical and spiritual level. And, I am hopeful, that perhaps the Ghosts of my ancestors might be able to provide supernatural remedies of sorts.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dr's House(of Crusher)Call
quests.description: Please, you must find Madeline and administer the medicines that you found. Administer 3 doses of medication to Madeline, who is lying in her bedroom.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spook and the Book
quests.description: Dear friend, I am restless. Search for a book in one of the bookcases to calm my nerves. You will know of the perfect book once you find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Prove Your Allegiance
quests.description: You CLAIM to be Evil enough to join my Undead Legion. You look… Good. Which means weak. The same goes for many of the denizen's of this realm. Prove yourself and your worth. Bring me a Good Will, Good Intention, Good Heart, Good Idea, and 5 instances of simple Goodness committed by one of the Underworld creatures.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Grind Out Goodness
quests.description: If you really want to be a TRUE member of my Legion, you'll need to show me that you are devoted to pure Evil. I suspect some of my minions may have Good left in them. Unacceptable. Bring me a Good Will, Good Intention, Good Heart, Good Idea, and 5 instances of simple Goodness committed by one of the Underworld creatures.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Lack of Four-sight
quests.description: Nulgath's bloodfiend warriors cannot fight if they cannot SEE! Bring me 100 Bloodfiend Eyes to prevent the Archfiend's Nation from advancing. Return and there will be a fiendishly-epic reward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Fuel for Fought
quests.description: Mortal! Do thou knowest the fuel that feeds our fellow gamers? Bright green like the magical life-giving mushroom, the Holy Soda is what grants gamers their power. If you wishest to obtain such immense amounts of radioactive energy, recover the Holy Soda Bottles and deliver them back to me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Ethan's Quests .

quests.name: In Ctrl of Controllers
quests.description: Being in control is one thing. Being in control of the almighty controller is another! Despite this talisman of ungodly power, controllers of wireless ancestry require chargers to give them their strength.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: To Form a Platform
quests.description: It would be most foolish of thou to believe that platform games come from midair. In fact, they come from WAY ABOVE midair. From the realm that is Arcadion. The Cobalt Blue Hedgehogs who flourish in this world possess the Platformer Essences in Which ALL games are created from. If you can taketh these essences from these beasts, then thou may have what it takes to become the wielder of the Winter-een-mas Crown!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Infamous Plumber
quests.description: Mortal, the time has cometh. You have reached the final stage. But the boss battle will not be set to Easy Mode. If thou defeats the almighty plumber of Arcadion, then the Winter-een-mas Crown shall be yours!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defend the Rats
quests.description: The Kittarians and Horcs are attacking the rats we were planning to use for practice! So instead, I think we'll use THEM for practice and free the rats. Your first task is to bring me a few pieces of cloth from as many Kittarians and Horcs as you can slay… I think 8 should do for a start. Now go forth and show me your fighting potential!

quests.name: Rats in the Cradle
quests.description: This is an outrage! The Kittarians and Horcs have gone too far! Now they are attacking the rats in their warrens, … even innocent children! Your next assignment is to search Noobshire and save as many of the baby rats as you can. You will be able to differentiate the babies by their golden color. And bring a hunk of Horc Cheese back for them to eat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Short in Spoons
quests.description: The Kittarian Mouse Eaters stole some spoons from Battleon and the chefs in the Mess Hall are complaining about the shortage of spoons! Your next task will be to bring back our stolen spoons. A word to the wise: The Kittarians are very tricky when it comes to hiding their things, so don't be surprised if you don't always find a spoon when you defeat one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Short in Forks
quests.description: The Kittarian Mouse Flayers have stolen some pitchforks from our farm and now our farmers are complaining that they can't properly harvest their crops! Your next task is to take the Kittarians down and recover what is ours; if the farmers can't harvest food I'll NEVER get my lunch! And I get cranky when I'm hungry!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Letter Interception
quests.description: Hmm… now that these Horcs have taken over our Training Grounds, they must be sending messages back to the main Horc Camp. Some Horc must be acting as a messenger and bringing progress reports back to General Porkon. Your next task is to find out which Horc has that letter. Take it away from him, and bring it back to me… I have plans of my own for spoiling their little incursion.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Not A Noob
quests.description: We definitely need to drive these Horcs away from Noobshire. The only way I can see to get rid of them is to take out the Horc Trainer. Without the trainer, the remaining Horc Trainees will be confused and lacking direction. Then it will be EASY for us to scare them away from Noobshire for good! So go get rid of the Horc Trainer, and bring me his horns as proof of your conquest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Missing King
quests.description: It seems that with all of the commotion going on in Noobshire, the King of the Rats has gone missing! Without their leader, the rats won't be able to restore order to their society! Locate the King Rat, so we can restore their peaceful society. Check the Horc Noobs for a clue to where he is!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Take Down
quests.description: That Horc Trainer appears to be VERY persistent… he's back, with a new group of Horc trainees. It's time for you to go out there and show him once and for all who is in charge around here! Defeat the Horc Trainer again, and bring me his pet rat as proof. His defeat should send a message to any Horcs who would even THINK of venturing back to Noobshire again!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fighting Exercise
quests.description: Every adventurer in the world of Lore needs to learn the basics of fighting if they want to make a living of this. Thankfully there are people like me to show you the ropes of the business … Of course we are going to require something in exchange, even from beginners. This is going to be an easy one so don't complain. Defeat an Orc Noob and bring me a piece of cloth, I want to make myself an Orc Flag! (Bring back a piece of cloth to Rolith to complete the quest.)

quests.name: Tougher Monsters
quests.description: You learn quick! That is always a plus for every adventurer. You know not everyone knows everything… urm, ok I may be mistaken about that one! Anyways the first quest was a taste of what you can accomplish. To make the real money and experience you have to take bigger risks. This next mission is going to be a little harder, but I will pay you more for it. Defeat the Orc Tutor Trainer and bring me his Horns, I want to see how the Orc Trainer looks bald, ha ha ha! (Bring back the Orc Trainer's Horns to Rolith to complete the quest.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Duke's Judgement
quests.description: AH! I completely forgot to speak to Alina's father, The Duke! I'm sorry to have to ask for this but I have to find Alina and help her however I can. Can you go speak to the Duke on my behalf? He probably hasn't yet left the /saloon to travel to the wedding yet. You can still catch him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' From The Heart ' quest.

quests.name: Tog Tamer
quests.description: I can't believe that I forgot to ask someone to be my ring bearer. Listen, I've dealt with Togs a LOT and I know that you can train them to carry something in a straight line very quickly. Head to /thespan and look see if you can train a tog to bear my wedding ring.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get Your Pinks Whiter
quests.description: Alina's. Wedding. Dress. Is. PINK! I know that Beleen had the best intentions but this dog will not hunt! I need you to get some cleaning supplies for me so I can get this dress back to white and fast! I'm going to need a Bottle of Oasis water, some Oxidizing Agent and 5 Lemons all from monsters (and pottery) in the /sandsea.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Quest to Slay Bone Berserker
quests.description: Well met, Hero! Thanks for lending a hand out here. Take out this last Undead Attacker while I get ready to lock the gate. Then we'll get you into the Keep!

quests.name: Lock-Blocked
