quests.description: Pettivox has become much sneakier in the last few months. His lab and office are magically sealed now by a combination spell. We've GOT to get in there, but it's rumored that tampering with the spell will cause GREAT damage to the intruder! I'll show you where it is, get this letter to my mother, then meet you back there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sending out a Stress-OS ' quest.

quests.name: Taking Notes
quests.description: I have the task of getting Conn up to speed in his studies. It's not an easy task, and as a wizards apprentice, he is expected to know a great deal. I need help getting his supplies, since he can be forgetful. Please collect 5 bags of Shadow Creeper fur, 5 Slime goo, 10 stacks of Marsh Tree bark, and 5 sets of Dread Spider legs.

quests.name: Those Blasted Misery Eels
quests.description: You cannot imagine what misery eels are like. Maybe you can, but that is beside the point. They hide in dark recesses, slither around your throat and their touch freezes you in place. Wizards can just conjure up defense, but me, I need something I can use. Get me 5 Bolts of light, 5 sets of Scorpion Eyes, and 10 jars of Mummy Glue.

quests.name: Boredom at the Ball
quests.description: My mother, as Duchess, must hold these gatherings of epic boredom. I hate them but one day I will have to hold the same things. In the meantime, I need something to entertain me. Please join Earthstorm and get me 10 Radiant Crystals, 10 Emerald Shards, and 10 Sapphire Shards.

quests.name: Just Because I'm Not a Wizard...
quests.description: Just because I'm not a wizards apprentice doesn't mean I can't learn the things they know! If anything, they should be happy I am trying to learn their world of knowledge. It will make me a better ruler for it! Help me get my books for the next session of classes: Book of Creature Features, Book of Water Spells, Usefulness of Stones, Magical Transactions, Duchal Duties, Lv 3.

quests.name: Studying for Life
quests.description: I'm to take my mother's place eventually, which means I need to know how to rule and do it well. 'I would learn the best from people who are in a position of authority. But, there is no way I am going to go venturing out to the Citadel to talk. Why don't you go interview the Inquisitor Captain, the Crusaders and the Grand Inquisitor for me!

quests.name: Being a Wizard's Best Friend
quests.description: Conn is a really good guy. He may be a bit rough around the edges, but that isn't his fault. I know my "friends" at the Academicos don't agree with me being friends with Conn, but who cares! Can you help me get things he may need? Get 10 Eternal Ice Shards, 10 Flaming Tongues, 10 Stone Sigils and 10 Queen Bee Wings.

quests.name: The Shoe's News
quests.description: The first thing a shoemaker needs is a measuring tape. Without that, there's no way we can make shoes to fit anyone! After that, we need our awl, a shoemaker's hammer and tacks.

quests.name: A Shoemaker's Work is Never Done
quests.description: Once we have the shoe formed, we need a sole knife in order to cut the base of the shoe, and then stretching pliers to make sure the leather is taut. After the show is made and tacked or glued together, the final thing needed is a burnishing cloth. The most important of all, though, is my tool bag!

quests.name: Ruby Giftbox Quest
quests.description: Battle Santy Claws in the /northlandlight region. Bring me back a Ruby Gift Bow and you'll be rewarded with even more presents!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Ruby Giftbox Sneevil in your inventory.

quests.name: Axe Them To Leave!
quests.description: We won't hold this army back if all we can do is fire off one shot at a time. With larger projectiles, our rogues can strike multiple enemies at once! They'll need 3 sharp axes for a coordinated attack. See if you can get some from the chaos prisoners in town.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An Ounce Of Prevention ' quest.

quests.name: Freeze 'Em Out!
quests.description: Our frost mages can summon an Ice Storm to freeze the ground, and any enemies that cross will stick to it like your tongue on a flagpole! For one storm, they'll need 3 frozen charms. Get them from the Chaos Mages near the armory.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An Ounce Of Prevention ' quest.

quests.name: Burn 'Em Up!
quests.description: Want to take 'em out even faster, soldier? Our fire mages can lob a fireball at a large group, and blast the entire area for catastrophic amounts of damage! If you want them to cast one, they'll need 3 flaming charms from the Chaos Mages near the armory.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An Ounce Of Prevention ' quest.

quests.name: Under Siege
quests.description: Get ready, soldiers! The armies are massing at the castle gate and are about to mount a huge attack! Hold them back - don't let them get through!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An Ounce Of Prevention ' quest. | Must have completed one of the three previous quests. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: No, NOW We're Under Siege
quests.description: That wasn't the last of it - looks like something big is coming! We've got to stop it before it reaches Swordhaven!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An Ounce Of Prevention ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Blazing Catalyst
quests.description: Within the lava pool you make out an insert. Here goes nothing.

quests.name: Bring Me the Bounty of the Black Veil!
quests.description: The winner o' the Midnight Crown be the captain what has the biggest pile o' treasure at the end o' the battle! If ye be wantin' to help me out, ye can fight the Black Veil Pirates, and bring me the bounties they carry!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Black Veil Courier Service ' quest.

quests.name: Bring Me HUGE Bounties of the Black Veil!
quests.description: Some o' those Black Veil pirates carry a larger bounty than usual - you might even say they have HUGH bounties! If ye find 3 o' these, bring 'em to me, and i'll add 'em to me pile!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Black Veil Courier Service ' quest.

quests.name: Bring Me HUGE Bounties of the Full Moon!
quests.description: Some o' those Full Moon Pirates carry a larger bounty than usual - you might even say they have HUGE bounties! If ye find 3 o' these, bring 'em to me, and i'll add'em to me pile!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Black Veil Courier Service ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat Flintfang
quests.description: Yarrr! Our Captain CANNOT be abused like that. Go rescue Bonnie and bring her back safe!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Black Veil Courier Service ' quest. | Must have completed one of the previous quests.

quests.name: Rutilans' Soul Harvest
quests.description: Getting back on topic, can you help me get some more soul energy? But just soul energy from other undead. Not you. This graveyard is pretty boring and I want to leave but I don't have the ability to do so. I need the remnants of energy from other undead so I can move around freely again.

quests.name: Sketchy Dead Parrot
quests.description: This parrot isn't dead! He's resting! Remarkable bird, the LoreLegion Blue, isn't it? Beautiful plumage! In order to prove that this bird ain't dead, we'll need to ask a distinguished doctor. Be sure to grab the Stunned Parrot from my Shop, you will need it for him to examine later.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Duck, Duck, Goose ' quest.

quests.name: Hoo Are You?
quests.description: Go see Doctor Hoo – he lives in the blue birdhouse shaped like a phonebooth. I'll send him a tweet so he knows to unlock the front door for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Down Feather Up to No Good
quests.description: I don't know what birdbrain sent you on this wild goose chase, but that down feather CLEARLY belongs to a turkey… and he rules all of the Bird Brethwren as our mighty king, Turking! You must inform Grandalf the Grey Parrot - he's the wise wizard who stands guard at the king's castle entrance, so he'll know what to do!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Owl Give You the Answer ' quest.

quests.name: Empty Eyes
quests.description: Oblivion returning to his original self is causing the Fiend's Void to stir in a peculiar way. The carcasses of dead animals are getting possessed, and creating these empty creatures. You'll join them if you don't fight back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Famiglia di Carcano ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Infectious Sleep
quests.description: The current Nation's Outriders are wandering the path ahead. Don't try to speak with them. The call of the Fiend's Void will be easier to handle if you strike them down and bury them in the snow. Careful. Their condition is contagious.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Famiglia di Carcano ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cadaveric Spasm
quests.description: Cover the bony spines with snow, and try not to let your gaze linger. The Tundra itself is turning into a Fiend, but the process will halt altogether if you don't acknowledge it. That frozen traveler, on the other hand…how curious. Take a look, would you?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Famiglia di Carcano ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nihil Scholars
quests.description: The survivors are huddling around candlelight just beyond the Lost Expeditioner. Their own Magi have succumbed to Oblivion's influence, and are rapidly emptying. Destroy them before they spread their emptiness to you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Famiglia di Carcano ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Id and Superego
quests.description: Ah, so you're already familiar with the only remaining survivors of the last hunting party that chased after Oblivion. Carnage and Jadzia are as lucid as you are. Talk to them, and see if they know how far along my former student is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Famiglia di Carcano ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sleepflying
quests.description: The younger members of the Nation have the right idea. This ritual area they prepared is keeping Oblivion's Void at bay. Gut the empty creatures, and place candles where they fall. This will help increase your focus.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Famiglia di Carcano ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle-Weary
quests.description: Cut the last of the Nation Outriders down. They're as dead as the animal bones sleeping in the snow. Purify the remains by following my exact instructions, or else their affliction will seep into your marrow too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Famiglia di Carcano ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Self-Destructive Spell
quests.description: Something is approaching, and it's attracted to the activities of the Oblivion Magi. Disrupt their spells, and strengthen our defenses. The frozen Expeditioner at the crossroads has some sort of protective aura. Fortify it with the ritual candles.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Famiglia di Carcano ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Allure of the Void
quests.description: Much like how Nulgath has followers like Carnage and the others, the Oblivion I knew had attendants. They sought oblivion…and found it. His Herald approaches, and you will need to resist its allure.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Famiglia di Carcano ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Dead City
quests.description: The Sol has been hidden by powerful Lunaris magic in the dead city. Walk along the edge of the lake to the north until you have located the city then return for your next quest.

quests.name: Grains of Chaos
quests.description: The Chaos Magic has made it possible to enter the city but the magic hiding the Sol must be broken. For this we will need power. Collect 10 grains of Chaos Sand from the Sp-eyes flying around the area.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Call of the Sun
quests.description: The Solaris Knights do use magic but it is fueled by the sun. We will need to amplify our spell to counteract the other magic. Place these 10 Solar Panels around the area in key locations to best reflect the sun towards the dead city. Return when your task is complete.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Shattered Past
quests.description: We need something to help the magic resonate. Solaris relics have littered this area since the area was destroyed. Many of the local monsters have taken to claiming them as pirzes. You must collect 20 Relic Fragments from the monsters to complete this spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Spoiler
quests.description: It looks like the Lunaris have an agent of their own trying to get to the artifacts too. It's a race then. We must slow them down. They have set up Shadow Collectors around the area. gather 10 Shadow Collectors before they can. it will put a wrench in the works.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Heart Of The Sun
quests.description: We need one more component in the spell… a heart. It can't be just any heart but the heart of a creature that has been saturated with Chaos. There is a beast near here called Slugfit. Return once you have taken Slugfit's Heart.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Sol
quests.description: Now the Sol's hiding place should be revealed! Quickly, go to the ruins of the city and search for a large orb of copper! Go quickly, before the magic hiding the Sol closes again!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Enter The Tomb
quests.description: The entrance to the tomb is locked by a gate, and the key has been stolen by the Frask. I could force it open, but we are on hallowed ground for the people of the Walsh, and as co-leader if the accord , I must avoid such such political problems.

quests.name: The Relic of Light Tome
quests.description: In the havoc of the Jir'abin monsters coming here, that vendor seems to have found the tome Zail mentioned. If you bring back five Diamond Scales of De'ther from a Shade, we will be able to buy the tome from the Tuuzuk Trader. We will need it if we are to find the Ring of Light.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Disarm the Traps
quests.description: This is strange. I heard from Daz that there are traps inside the tomb. They should not be here; perhaps they appeared with the monsters.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Missing Pages
quests.description: The Tome is missing several pages! Without them, our attempts to find the Ring of Light will end quickly.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Resonator Components
quests.description: The tome tells of some device, a Synvenic Void Resonator, which we must construct to go deeper into the tomb. Even stranger, the monsters here can provide all the needed components. It's almost as if the Tome was able to predict this! Gather the first of what we need from the Frask and Tomb Drifters!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: More Components Needed
quests.description: We need a few more base components to complete the Syvenic Void Resonator.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Final Components
quests.description: We something to stabilize the Syvenic Void Resonator. There is probably something in the vases that we will be able to use.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gain Entrance to the Vault
quests.description: With the Synvenic Void Resonator constructed, we should be able to gain access to the portion of the tomb that was revealed by the monster's presence here. The chamber is protected by a puzzle; see if you can solve it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Spirit
quests.description: I do not understand—is that the De'ther spirit? Perhaps he left behind some sort of echo or energy in his image for all of these years. It seems to act hostilely. We will need to disperse it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Jir'abin
quests.description: With the Ring of Light in our possession, we can battle Jir'abin. He has grown stronger with the Chaos Presence, but the Ring of Light's Magic will keep you safer as well. ⠀Go. We will back you up.

quests.name: Feeding Grounds
quests.description: Have you seen the village outside my castle? That is where I keep the herd. They normally go about their lives and when I feed I tend to leave the mortal alive to keep the blood flowing… but recently Blood Maggots have started cutting into my supply leaving my mortals completely drained. Defeat 8 Blood Maggots and bring me their denture as proof of their defeat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What a Lich! ' quest.

quests.name: Going Batty
quests.description: The Albino Bats that live in this area have been frightened by the Lycan invasion. I need you to knock some out and apply this soothing salve to them. You should only need to soothe 6 Albino Bats for the others to follow. Careful, the salve doesn't always work.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What a Lich! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Lycan Knights
quests.description: The Werewolf King has sent several of his Lycan Knights into my realm. I can only assume this is the latest attempt to take more of our land from us. Go out and defeat the Lycan Knights and bring me 4 Lycan Ears as trophies.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What a Lich! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Twisted Paw
quests.description: Twisted Paw is a particularly fierce Lycan Knight. I assume he is a general in the Werewolf King's army because none of my Vampire Knights have been able to get close enough to him to even wound him. I would like you to bring me Twisted Paw's Head.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What a Lich! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Squash the King
quests.description: As the sun set behind the howling moon, the Mystcroft pumpkin patch begins to shake! A huge monster bursts through the soil -- its body is the shape of a giant pumpkin, sprouting huge vines that grab nearby victims. The Great Pumpkin King is here… and TRICK -- he's here for your treats! Defeating him is the only way to gain access to my graveyard… so bring me back 1 Pwnkin seed to show me you victorious outcome!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Can't Have Enough ' quest.

quests.name: A Bone To Pick
quests.description: Have you spoken to Gravelyn recently? Just who does she think she is -- sending all of her leftover skeletons to MY graveyard?! Humph. This is unacceptable. Do you mind purging my lands of the Undead? It's the only way for the Cauldron sisters to get back to their Candy Shoppe, too! I need you to gather up 10 Skeletal Craniums from the bone-heads wandering about my graveyard. You can only get there by sneaking past the Great Pumpkin King!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Can't Have Enough ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest

quests.name: Were are the Wolves
quests.description: The spine-tingling howls that erupt when the full moon rises can only mean one thing: a Vampire's worst enemy. For ages, Vampires have struggled against Werewolves -- but now you can fight on behalf of us! Go into the graveyard and slay as many Werewolves as you can. Bring me back 6 vials of Slobber so I know the deed is done. The Cauldron Sisters are counting on you, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Can't Have Enough ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Killer, Chiller, Thriller here Tonight
quests.description: Something's lurking in the dark… in the moonlight, I saw a sight that stopped my heart. I tried to scream, but terror took the sound and as I froze, horror looked me right between the eyes -- I'm paralyzed! 'Cause it's the Thriller, Thriller Fright! And he's stopping all the Sisters from Myx'ing candy late at night! It's up to you -- brave Lore Knight -- to stop the Thriller in his tracks and collect his 1 Glove of White!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Can't Have Enough ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest's description is a parody of Thriller by Michael Jackson .

quests.name: Get Out
quests.description: First, you're going to have to get yourself out of this dark abyss. The darkness is going to try to stop you in ways you won't be able to predict, but if you can make it all the way to that light up there, you'll be home free.

quests.name: The Court of the King
quests.description: We've found Constantin, the Lycan king - and he's gone mad! If you want to get pass him, you're going to have to defeat him. And I'm NOT just saying that because we used to be moral enemies.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Hungry like the ... Lycan?
quests.description: You seem to have calmed Constantin's rabid frenzy, but he looks like he could lose it again at any moment. There must be something here that's affecting him. Talk to him, and see if you can find out what it is. We CAN'T risk having him lose his mind again!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Sounds of Music?
quests.description: My guess is that music is originating elsewhere, and being played in here through speakers that are distorting its sound. If we find and destroy all of the speakers, Constantin should be able to calm down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Killer Kitty
quests.description: What the heck did Court Maxius do to that cat?!? You're going to have to knock the poor thing out. But.. try not to hurt her too badly. I've known her for ages.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' No Surprise ' quest. Note: This quest can only be accepted on Screen 13.

quests.name: Blood Moon Token
quests.description: Sometimes, the only way to defeat your enemy is to BECOME him. Or, as the Pyromancer say, fight fire WITH fire. Bring me a Moon Stone from the Lycan Guard and a vial of Black Blood from the Black Unicorn and I will give you a Blood Moon Token.

quests.name: Blood Moon For Members
quests.description: Sometimes, the only way to defeat your enemy is to BECOME him. Or, as the Pyromancer say, fight fire WITH fire. Bring me a Moon Stone from the Lycan Guard and a vial of Black Blood from the Black Unicorn and I will give you a Blood Moon Token.

quests.name: Ghoul, Ghoul, Ghoul
quests.description: Looks like Count Maxius has his Ghoul Minions blocking the hallway to keep us from escaping! But that shouldn't be a problem for you, right? Defeat them all so we can make our escape.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Killer Kitty ' quest.

quests.name: Get Him!
quests.description: Looks like he's finally decided to show his face! Count Maxius won't be easy to defeat, but with our help, I know you can handle him. Don't worry we've got your back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Minions Everywhere
quests.description: Count Maxius is hiding behind more of his minions! I can't say I'm surprised. Defeat them all, then get ready for round 2.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Get Barnabus!
quests.description: The last time I saw Barnabus, he was a merge ghoul. I couldn't say how powerful he is now, but… it would be so embarrassing to get knocked out by a moglin, wouldn't it? Don't let that happen.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: An End To This Threat
quests.description: This is it! Put an end to this monster's reign of terror once and for all. Remember, we are all here to help you. All you have to do is ask.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Lycan Medals
quests.description: I'm going to need you to hold off Constantin's lycan army while I try to finish Count Maxius' ritual. Each of his soldiers carries a small medal that identifies their rank. Bring them to me, and I will reward you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An End To This Threat ' quest.

quests.name: Mega Lycan Medals
quests.description: While you're fighting Constantin's soldiers, you may run across some with particularly large medals. These are his higher-ranking wolves. Bring me their medals, and I'll give you an even larger reward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An End To This Threat ' quest.

quests.name: Blackened Incense
quests.description: Thanks to Barnabus, my work on the ritual is progressing well. However, i've run out of the incense I need to keep it going. Those Lunar Blazebinders should have some, too. Take it from them, and bring it to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An End To This Threat ' quest.

quests.name: Stop Constantin!
quests.description: My ritual is almost complete, but Constantin intends to stop me! Hold him off so that I can finish it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An End To This Threat ' quest.

quests.name: Fragment of Doom
quests.description: Man, this fragment of Sepulchure is NOT as helpful as the one Gravelyn's got in her sword! Are you even going to be able to defeat this thing? Well, no choice but to try!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dissolve the Chains ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Imbalanced
quests.description: Fight through Alteon's Imbalanced army! We have to protect Lightovia from their invasion!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fragment of Doom ' quest.

quests.name: Free the Lycans
quests.description: My Lycans will help us defend Lightovia, but first we must free them. Their cages look magical, which means the Imbalanced Mages will be the ones who have the keys. Find them, and then free my people.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fragment of Doom ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Cleanse the Land
quests.description: The Imbalanced are tainting Lightovia. It is physically affecting the land - and the people who live here. We must cleanse it of their filth.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fragment of Doom ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the Knights
quests.description: It's time to confront the Archmage… but he's content to let the king's minions do the fighting for him. We will have to draw him out. If we defeat enough Imbalanced Knights, he will have no choice but to face us himself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fragment of Doom ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat ArchMage Brentan
quests.description: And what will Alteon do without his right hand man to lead his army in his place? Let's find out, shall we?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fragment of Doom ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cotton Candy Sky
quests.description: So I will be the one venturing forth. It's been a while since I've had to prove my power. If you would please allow me a moment to take in my surroundings. Though the sun in this sky is fake, the warmth it gives is real. I have never felt such a sensation, or I may have forgotten it over the centuries. Where are you going? You want to catch butterflies?

quests.name: Sticking Your Neck Out
quests.description: Do you feel it? The infuriated gazes of the corpse and the bratty princess? Yes, I'm referring to Gravelyn and Sepulchure. I want to be rid of their company. Let's take the leftmost route. Normally, I would fly up the tower but you'd be lonely climbing the ladder by yourself. Instead, I'll turn into a bat and make myself comfortable in your pocket. That is unless, you'll offer your neck for me to cling to. I won't bite. Promise.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Melty Blood
quests.description: The view and this miniature pond garden would be beautiful if it weren't for these skeletal warriors. They seem incredibly out of place in Arcadia…because they're Shadowscythe! Ha! The Empress and former Emperor have resorted to foul play! They knew they couldn't compare to me. Let's make a game of defeating them as we ascend. Oh? Did you find something interesting hidden in those dusty bones?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Poincare Recurrence
quests.description: My skin feels like it's burning with a fever. There must be something in the water. It's beginning to make me see the future. Hm? You see it too? It's on the next level where the sky is dark. No stars. The moon has finally lost their light. I need to sit down. Lead me to that chair and please, shoo away the butterflies. I believe they're attracted to misery.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Steal the Steel
quests.description: The rebel Technocaster has reprogrammed a pack of our Technowolves and brought them with her to the past. We must stop them before they make it off of the ship and onto Lore! Dismantle them, and bring me any spare Seraphic Steel you can find. I'll craft it into plates for your armor.

quests.name: Get the Core
quests.description: It's time to take down that rebellious Technocaster once and for all! Be careful - she was one of my strongest allies before she went bad. Bring me the Energy Core from her armor, if you can get it. Once I've purified it, you can use it in your own.

quests.name: Scary Baby
quests.description: Alight, let's go. You fight her, I'll weaken her, Lim can trap her. I'm not going to let this overgrown baby threaten me any more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Smash the Wall ' quest.

quests.name: The Guest List
quests.description: Alrighty, Hero! For the first part of our little tea party, we'll need you to go retrieve the guests of honor! They don't know I invited them yet. That's why it's a SURPRISE tea party! Use that head of yours. If it's not working properly, I can always help fix it if you want too!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Grim Necromancer (Armor) in your inventory.

quests.name: Sugar, Spice and everything Nice
quests.description: HERO! WE HAVE A BIG PROBLEM. WE'RE OUT OF SNACKS! Don't look at me like that. Snacks are a STAPLE for sleepovers and tea parties! You will need to go out and get some refreshments and FAST. Vaden is chowing them down like it's nobody's business… Where does it even go with him?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Big Mean Meanie Pants
quests.description: HERO! HERO. Why is everyone so mean to me? IinvitedJackbutthenVORDREDgotjealousIthinkandhewonttalktomeandhecalledmemeannameslikeaFAILEDNECROMANCERandmadefunonmypinkstuffanditsnotmyfaultilikegirlythingsandundead! Hero, can you please go talk some sense into him?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: One Small Step
quests.description: Well, I guess you did help me with the tea party.. And I did say I'd help you learn more necromancy BUT… You're gonna have do me a few more small favors first.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Soft and Cuddly
quests.description: Say, I been thinking. Mr Twinkles might be getting lonely. I think he needs a friend! Don't you? Look at him. He may be a stuffed bear but he's not getting any younger. He's sad and lonely. I wanna get him some REAL bears to have fun with. Here's a list of some bears to get.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Big Mean Meanie Pants ' quest.

quests.name: Big Brute Guard
quests.description: Hero, I heard people call you a LEGEND. Is that true? So then "LEGEND" wannnaaa do me a favor? It should be easy peasy lemon squeezy for you! I want a guard. Look, you hero types always try to invade my space because I make friends. Thats mean. I need a friend who will protect ME! Simple right. Can you go get my Raxgore's helmet? He looks like he'd make a good new friend.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Big Mean Meanie Pants ' quest.

quests.name: O-(De)kay Cupid
quests.description: We need to find some eligible bachelors for all these ZomBabes! Check out the town and see if you can "convince" 5 lucky guys to date some of our singles.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mates near the Music ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Ghosting my Ex-Goulfiends
quests.description: Now it's time to be the wingman for all our introverted ZomBros. Hey now, don't judge these dead dudes; just because they're undead doesn't mean they're not shy. You know what to do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mates near the Music ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: You're Dead to Me
quests.description: Some undead have found their perfect match, but others are exceptionally picky, which is strange coming from someone with rotting flesh. Go talk to that ZomBro over there and see what kind of girl he is looking for.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mates near the Music ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Swipe Left 4 Rich Lich
quests.description: I ain't saying she's a gravedigger… but there's a certain type of undead ghoul that just really digs a rich lich, and I suspect Zombella might just be one of them. Go talk to her, then see if you can find her the zombie of her gold-digging dreams.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mates near the Music ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Real Grave Digger
quests.description: I have never met a more entitled bunch of Zombies in my life! That blonde ZomBabe over there has snubbed her decaying nose at every eligible corpse that has tried to win her heart… or whatever's left of it. Go talk to her and find out what will make her happy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mates near the Music ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Love of your Unlife
quests.description: You've been so busy helping me play matchmaker that you haven't even had time to find true love yourself! Go talk to the remaining single Zombies and see if you'd be a good fit for either of them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mates near the Music ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Ultimate Ghoul Fiend
quests.description: Hmm, it seems you're just as picky as the rest of the Zombies around here. No wonder why you're single. Fear not – for I have found the perfect person for you! She's actually multiple parts of different persons, since, you know, there's an onslaught of body parts strewn all over town and this is an E-10 game after all…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mates near the Music ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: In-Field Study
quests.description: The students are just about ready to present their projects, but we'll need a unique power source to bond Noxus' head to these bodies. Grab a basket of Shadowstones from /Necrocavern and we'll be ready for the slaughter.

quests.name: Technilliterate
quests.description: To the left of the classroom, we've set up the first project you'll be testing in combat! Show it your worst! The group of students working on it called it the "Noxborg." Ooh, that's not going to be pretty.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Odd Tastes
quests.description: The next project on the list is called "Noxore," and I can already hear Noxus screaming from the other room. I know it's probably going to be an F, but I need to know what they're doing to him. Have at it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: My Toxic Pony
quests.description: The students who created the "Noxustrian" said I'd love it. They're already binding Noxus' head to this horsepower-ed body, and I can't wait! Go on and give it a test run. Omigosh, I can hear it whinnying from here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hand-Me-Down
quests.description: Okay, that's enough kicking Noxus when he's already down. Ehe, I know he'd do the same to me if I was in the dumps. That's just how it works around here. This last project is something I made. Head all the way to the back and test it out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle Tested
quests.description: These invaders are interesting. I have not seen their style of armor before. I wish to see how well it stands up to our weapons and learn from it if I can. Go out and bring me helms from the Chaonslaught Warrior. If the heads are still in them… all the better.

quests.name: Dancin' Hair-Do's... and Hair-Don'ts
quests.description: Do you like my hair, daaaaahling? Yes, yes, I know you do. And I can make your coiffure just as full of life and movement as mine is! I just need 5 Boar Bristles and a Boar Bone for the comb and 10 Dyed Vulture Feathers to make the decorations!

quests.name: Samba, samba, samba-style!
quests.description: To make you a most diviiiiiine dance outfit, I'll need 3 Bolts of Cloth, which you can find on Boars. You should be able to find 3 Shiny Metal bits for decoration on the Rhison, and we can't forget the flowers! Bring me 10 fallen Red Trollola Blossoms. Their scent is so sweet!

quests.name: Decorate the Dance Academy
quests.description: I want the Dance Academy's decorations to sparkle as much as those on my dancers do! I want to go with a tribal, natural theme this time. So bring back 10 Geodes from the Crystal Rocks around the Plateau… oh! And 10 Rhison Tusks. They should complete the look nicely.

quests.name: Tango Tango Tango!
quests.description: You must have a special outfit, Hero, if you're going to TANGO! Bring me 10 Jungle Vulture feathers and 13 Bolts of Cloth from the Horc Boar Scout!

quests.name: Farm Frenzy
quests.description: Something CRAZY is going on at the farm… and that's coming from a Troll dressed up as a giant turkey! Hero, I need you to scout the farm and report your findings. Once you see for yourself what's going on, we can begin to figure out how to put an end to this farm frenzy!

quests.name: Wish on a Dish
quests.description: The Wishbones that roam the farm MUST know something! Well… since they had bird-brains when they were living, I doubt they will know anything in this current state… but we might find some answers after we defeat them! Cook up some Wishbones and pile on the clues that they drop. Bring me those leftovers!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Empty Dish in your temporary inventory.

quests.name: The Root of all Evil
quests.description: Potatoes are roots… and the root of all evil! Use that Burlap Sack and harvest come Chaos Potatoes from the farm. But don't let the Wishbones see what you're up to, or they might report back to their gobble guardian…! Defeat 5 more Wishbones so that your vegetable vengeance goes unnoticed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Burlap Sack in your temporary inventory.

quests.name: Home for the Holidays
quests.description: We have to set the humans free so that they can spend Harvest Day with their families. Now that you've found a Gravy Ladle. you can free the humans trapped in the gravy lagoon. But don't forget about the folks stuck in the chickens coops and the people neck-deep in soil! I'm sure they will give you plenty of thanks!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Gravy Ladle in your temporary inventory.

quests.name: Human-nequins
quests.description: The Wishbones might be dumb, but surely they'll notice all those people you set free. So let's create some human decoys! That Pile of Clothes they left behind will work great, but we'll need more materials. How about some Scarecrow Hats from Farm Scarecrows and Skeleton Frames from the Skeleton Warriors and Fighters in BattleUnderB. And for the final touch: 5 Breath of Life from the Living Air in Airstorm. That will bring them to life!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Pile of Clothes in your temporary inventory.

quests.name: Defeat then Eat!
quests.description: Take the TurKEY and unlock the barn doors. Whoever… or whatever… is hiding in the barn is the gobble guardian responsible for this Human-Harvest havoc. Defeat the foul villain responsible and restore the holiday spirit to Harvest Day!
quests.requirements_note: Must have TurKEY in your temporary inventory.

quests.name: Fowl Play
quests.description: It looks like that Chaorrupted Turkey ain't done cookin' yet! Can you defeat the Foulest Fowl of them all? Get your friends and have an epic Harvest Day feast! Just accept this Quest and click the "Challenge" button in my speech bubble. Stuff that bird-brain!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Turkey Leftovers in your inventory.

quests.name: Two Parades!
quests.description: I can't believe Yokai New Year and Carnaval were both scheduled to be here right here, right now! I know there's a way to work this all out, but right now everyone's too mad to even talk about it. Please, will you try to talk some sense into them? Take this lemonade to Fausto, the Carnaval emcee - he's at the end of the street all the way to the left. Maybe once he cools off he'll start thinking more clearly.

quests.name: Make those Munchies
quests.description: Hey! You're gonna help me find the perfect offering for the Sheevra, right? This'll be easy - it's just like when someone has you over for dinner and you bring them a plate of cookies to say thank you. What do you think spirits like to eat? Hmmm… what about those ghostly truffles that are growing out here? Everyone loves truffles! Oh! And I bet the Eerie Apparitions have some Truffle Puree, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Accessorize! ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Every Party Needs Drinks
quests.description: And of course, you can't go to a party without bringing something to drink! Maybe some sparkling goblin juice? Obviously we'd get that from the Grim Goblins skulking around out here. I always see them drinking it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bald Spots
quests.description: The theme we're going with is a worldwide samba! We're going to need materials from all over Lore. Let's start easy where I was born, in /bloodtusk. I always incorporate vibrant blue Jungle Vulture feathers and dyed Rhison fur into my costumes. I'm going to be stuck helping the other dancers practice, so could you bounce over to the ravine to grab those materials for me?

quests.name: Work Out Glow
quests.description: When I visited other schools of dance, I was blown away by how sparkly their costumes were. My new Dwarven friends were happy to show me how we could do the same by sharing their mining and gemcraft skills! In /dwarfhold, you'll find Gemralds and Glow Worms. I can begin sewing while you gather gem sequins and glow worm secretions. It sounds a little gross, but the glow is worth it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Burned Forevermore
quests.description: Most of the other schools of dance I went to visit had primarily human students and teachers. Truth be told, I felt a little nervous and out of place, but that melted away when we started to samba! The ladies from Fotia were one of the most interesting! The dances they shared were part of their rituals. Would you head to /fotia and collect fabric from the Fotia Spirits and Femme Worshippers?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Calm Sea and Prosperous Voyage
quests.description: There was an elf named Aquella that visited Bloodtusk for the Solar Festival. We became fast friends and taught each other different dances. Her moves were so graceful! It reminded me of sparkling waves. With sparkling in mind, I heard you can find Gilded Merdraconian scales and gold crystals from the Gilded Crystal Undead in /shipwreck. If you could visit and check if there's any left to collect, I'll give you a bear hug!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Cleanse
quests.description: We have all the materials we need to finish the costumes! But now, we're missing some people. There were Darkbloods that visited Bloodtusk before, but only under the cover of night. I totally understand their situation. Dancing with me is one thing, but revealing themselves to the other dancers is another. Maybe if you helped them clean up /falguard, they'd feel more welcome to join us?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fly the Standard
quests.description: Thank you for bouncing around from place to place for me! Oh, I wish I could've gone with you, but the other dancers and I finished our costumes! So all that's left is practice, practice, and more practice! May our Flag Bearer and Master of Ceremonies have the honor of dancing with you? Don't worry if you don't know the steps. Treat it like a duel! That's how we're going to tackle the Carnaval's competition!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Turkey Taker
quests.description: Hello! Are you here to help us prepare for the feast? Perfect! First and foremost, we're going to need a few more turkeys. Bring me a Foul Turkey from either /FoulFarm or the /FoulestFowl and as usual, the Turdraken in /Harvest. Also, get some wishbones from the Foul Wishbones in /FoulFarm so we can make some WISHES!

quests.name: A Boar-ing Job
quests.description: Next, we'll need some ham for a few new recipes that Oishii wants to try out. Capture a wereboar from /Grams and some rune Boars in /Trygve, and be sure to grab some Boar's Feet in Salted-Butter Sauce from Oishii's restaurant in /Bloodtusk as an appetizer.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Pineapple Slayer
quests.description: The last thing we'll need is some fresh pineapple. The freshest of them all come straight from the /Turdraken and the /Freakitiki bar!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Designer Scales
quests.description: My troupe and I will have to Samba our hearts out if we want any chance of catching M'Boi's eye- but wearing some fancy costumes in the process would probably help! I'm sure such a selfish snakey would be flattered to see an entire parade team dressed in his likeness. Borrow a few scales from the Boiuna, and I'll get accessorizing!

quests.name: Harpy-Pecked
quests.description: Don't be too shocked by all of the squawking… er, 'bird songs' in the air, Hero. A troupe of Harpies signed up for my school recently, and they're more than willing to share their feathers to make our outfits. The problem is, it wouldn't be healthy to just pluck them out. You'll need to help those birds shake a few feathers loose with a spirited dance spar!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dancer Incognito
quests.description: Big Daddy's a lot more careful than you might think! He made my troupe a set of enchanted masks that will hide our identities, just in case M'Boi decides that he wants revenge later. Unfortunately, he got a bit too into crafting them, and his passion brought them all to life! Would you mind making sure he's alright, and catching a few masks while you're down there? I'll have to refit the straps on them before our performance starts.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Costume Check
quests.description: One of the most important things a dancer can learn is that they have to know their audience- and as you might expect, a snake deity is a VERY tough crowd. Big Daddy and I are betting that M'Boi will scoff at us the minute we fall short of godly expectations, so it's important that we make sure nothing is out of place. We just did a final round of costume checks, and made a list of costume pieces we need to finish everything up. Think you can take care of them?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Waterfall Promenade
quests.description: Now that M'Boi's private Carnaval parade is over, we're gearing up to make the Yguasu River a proper venue! Wipe the sweat off your brow, and let's fill the falls with some song and dance! Help the dancers fix up their costumes, and when you're done, I'll be your promenading partner.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' That's M'Boi ' quest.

quests.name: A Tribute to the Waves
quests.description: Welcome back to Yguasu River! Can you help with preparing a tribute to the Queen of Waves? The Queen of Waves is the protector of women and the seas. It would mean a lot if you help out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' That's M'Boi ' quest.

quests.name: Sapphire Giftbox Quest
quests.description: Battle Santy Claws in the /northlandlight region. Bring me back a Sapphire Gift Bow and you'll be rewarded with even more presents!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Sapphire Giftbox Sneevil in your inventory.

quests.name: Vampire Medals
quests.description: We MUST get into the ritual room and stop the Red Dawn Ritual. Each of the Vampires carries a crest somewhere on them. Bring them to me, and I will reward you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An End To This Threat ' quest.

quests.name: Mega Vampire Medals
quests.description: We MUST get into the ritual room and stop the Red Dawn Ritual. Each of the Vampires carries a crest somewhere on them. Bring them to me, and I will reward you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An End To This Threat ' quest.

quests.name: Rise of the Frogdrake - XP Boost
quests.description: The Frogdrakes in Willowcreek have experienced a curious awakening today. It's as if something has made then more powerful, but it's nothing YOU can't handle. Take out a Frogdrake and it's certain you'll be rewarded with a boost to your XP!

quests.name: Skeletal Warrior Upsurge - Gold Boost
quests.description: Skeletal Warrior in the Graveyard have taken to robbing the dead! Their packs are stuffed with gold they didn't earn. Take one down, and you're sure to be rewarded with a Gold Boost! Give the rest back to the dead they came from.

quests.name: Slimiest Spring - Class Rank Boost
quests.description: Every four years in the Spring, Swordhaven slimes hold a competition amongst themselves to see who is the slimiest. The winner ranks up to "Sultan of Slime" for four years. The last Sultan wants you to take out one of his opponents and YOU will get their Rank Boots!

quests.name: Waiting for Rep with Baited Breath - Rep Boost
quests.description: Marsh Lurkers in the Marsh like to lure the heroes to them with the promise of gaining reputation. But on Leap Day, they carry Rep Boosts, hoping the promise of greatly increasing rep potential will bring even MORE heroes into their clutches. Kill a Marsh Lurker and this Boost will be yours!

quests.name: A Town Divided
quests.description: Thank you for helping! My son, Andesi, and the other kids are trapped in the Mill at the other end of town. The stone walls should protect them from the fire but we need to know that our kids are OK. Please go check on them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Level 20 ' quest.

quests.name: The Miller's Key
quests.description: It was smart of the kids to lock themselves in the mill, but the miller says that he dropped the key in confusion when Xan attacked. He saw one of the monsters pick it up but he's not sure which. Find the monster with the key and head straight to the mill. Tell my son not to worry. We'll be together soon.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Quest will be automatically turned in on Screen 11 of Basani .

quests.name: Signed, Seared, Delivered
quests.description: Is this our family pendent? And a note from Andesi inside?! Oh, thank you so much. I wouldn't have believed it. I'm so proud of my son.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Andesi's Quests . Note: This quest is accepted from Andesi .

quests.name: The Xan With The Plan
quests.description: I know that he's insane but Xan must WANT SOMETHING? I don't think he's just going to go away on his own. You are strong enough to face Xan. Defeat him and find out why he's come here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Cyser-no!
quests.description: As I was preparing for the Harvest Day Parade, my balloons suddenly became chaorrupted! I have no idea who is behind this, but we need to get these hot-aired hooligans under control. And fast. Pop 4 balloon Cyseros and come back to me when you've done it!

quests.name: Pink Balloon of Doom
quests.description: Nothing is quite as scary as a giant pink Beleen wreaking havoc above Lore. I think all Paladins would agree with me in this one. So it's going to be up to you to defeat this air head! Pop 4 Beleen Balloons and hurry back when (or if) you succeed!

quests.name: The Hundred Foot Tall Twilly
quests.description: The biggest threat remains. Literally. The giant Twilly balloon is the biggest and the baddest of all my chaorrupted balloons! In order to save the Harvest Festival Day Parade, you MUST stop and pop the Twilly balloon!

quests.name: Turtle Shells Pop Balloons
quests.description: As I was preparing for the Harvest Dat Parade, my balloons suddenly became chaorrupted! I have no idea who is behind this, but we need to get these hot-aired hooligans under control. Someone once told me that Red Turtle Shells are excellent at popping balloons. Apparently they never miss their target when thrown… or something. Find me 10 Red Turtle Shells somewhere in Lore and bring them back to me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cater To His Every Dish ' quest.

quests.name: Make things Pop with a Sentry Bot
quests.description: Another great way to make a balloon pop? Lazer Beams! The hovering Sentry Bots built by Dwakels can knock out a Harvest Day Balloon in one fatal swoop. Or um, whatever Sentry Bots do. Get me 2 Sentry Bots and bring them back so I can put them to work.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cater To His Every Dish ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Web Browsing for Balloons
quests.description: Once the Red Turtle Shells and Sentry Bots take care of the balloons, we will need a way to regain control of them before they float away. We will need the biggest and stickiest web in all of Lore. And there is one particular spider that is the biggest and meanest and nastiest of them all. Find him and bring me his web!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cater To His Every Dish ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Complete Airheads
quests.description: Now that we have everything we need to control the chaorrupted Harvest Day balloons, we can take matters into our own hands! Defeat 4 Balloon Cyseros and 4 Balloon Beleens and bring me back the deflated masses. I can always patch them up and make them as good as new!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cater To His Every Dish ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Final Pilgrimage
quests.description: You have traveled all over Lore and defeated all sorts of monsters. The time has come to complete your pilgrimage. Pop the giant balloon Twilly and bring me its head! …on second thought, don't do that. I need to reuse it after you've popped it… so just bring me Deflated Twilly!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cater To His Every Dish ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Souls for Controls
quests.description: These spy-drones look like they run on interdimensional energy. If I can get them to run on soul energy instead, I can get them under my control. But for that, I'm gonna need some souls. There are some Void Mages near Nibbleon who would make for willing donors.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Drones are a Drag ' quest.

quests.name: Investigation Time
quests.description: Let's try to get a better sense of where we are and who we're dealing with. Take this reconfigured Spy Drone with you - it will let you talk to me while you look around. Investigate the cave as thoroughly as you can, and tell me what you find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get Revenge
quests.description: These bots need to learn who's in charge here - me! Beat up as many of 'em as you can find. Smash them to bits! I will have my revenge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Key the Guards
quests.description: That teleportation pad you found - that's gotta be where they've taken Twilly. We have to find a way up there. We got the codes to open the cages from those guard drones. I bet they have the keys to the teleporter, too. Get two of 'em - one for each of us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Time to Teleport
quests.description: Alright, let's do this! Go stand on the teleportation pad and use the key. Let's see where it takes us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: GET HIM!
quests.description: So, moglin magic has been messing up his big plans? Well, this moglin's gonna mess 'em up eval more! Let's get him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sea King Collection Chest TLaPD 2018
quests.description: Yarrrr! Prove you can defeat a jellyfish and i'll reward you with the Sea King Collection character page badge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Sea King's Questing Jellyfish in your inventory.

items.name: Sea King’s Collection Chest Character Page Badge

quests.name: They've Gone Dark
quests.description: The Kalestri Worshipers were a very noble people in their homeland but these creatures have been corrupted by evil. Their sisters will want to know that you have discovered them. Go gather 8 Dark Medallions to prove that you have found them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Confront Duat ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Bad Doggies
quests.description: I have never seen the Kalestri Hounds before. I sense some dark connection to the cultists. They could be the source of the evil that has corrupted them. Destroy 10 of the hounds to make your search more safe AND help save the worshipers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Confront Duat ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Essentially Evil
quests.description: I can feel the evil bonds weakening, now is the time to strike them down…er… I mean free them. Defeat Worshipers and Hounds until you collected 10 Evil Essences. That should break the spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Confront Duat ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Loose Threads
quests.description: That should have broken the evil influence that has infected the Kalestri Worshipers but something is holding it together and we can't get to the Djinn until the path is clear. ITS A WEB! There must be some Lotus Spiders in here. You must destroy at least 10 of them to break the spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Confront Duat ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Seek The Treasure
quests.description: Now that the worshipers are free you can try to make your way through the maze and discover the treasure chamber that holds the Djinn! Once you have found it, return to me. I will break the spell of protection and you can get the lamp.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Confront Duat ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Black Plague
quests.description: Sigh. Good job, "Hero". You've unleashed the Black Plague. If you try to fight it, it will infect and slowly kill you. If you don't… well, it will still kill you, along with everything else in here… and on Lore. So, what's it going to be?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sekt... Again ' quest.

quests.name: Secrets of the Universe
quests.description: Knowledge is power, ESPECIALLY for a warrior. If you do not know your enemy, you cannot know their strengths and weaknesses. Recover the lost lecture pages from the ShadowScythe who took them, and the Lecture Globe will reveal vital knowledge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Flight into the Future ' quest.

quests.name: Prove Yourself
quests.description: Unfortunately, I cannot allow just anyone to enter Jingshen. Only the gentlest and most agile of heroes can travel through it without causing too much distress. If you can steal the bowl from a kappa ninja's head without spilling any of the water, I will know you are such a hero. Kappa Ninja can be found at the Yokai Ferry.

quests.name: Culling the Corruption
quests.description: Jingshen Forest, just east of here, is home to a great many nature spirits. Normally they are gentle beings, a source of growth and vitality. But recently something has corrupted their energy and made them… wrong. If you kill these corrupted spirits, they should revive without the corruption.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Core of the Problem
quests.description: Simply killing the corrupted spirits doesn't seem to be solving the problem. If you bring me some of their elemental cores, I may be able to determine the source of the problem. Cores from either Lingzhi or Xingzhi will do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Essentially Pure
quests.description: The source of the corruption still isn't clear. I will need to compare the corrupted cores with some samples from a pure, untainted forest. Go to Pinewood Forest in Dwarfhold, and gather the essences of the creatures living there. Your attunement with Jingshen Forest will allow you to see and collect them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Salve-ation
quests.description: I've made a purifying salve from the nature essences you collected from Pinewood Forest. If we disperse it throughout Jingshen Forest, that should help remove whatever this corruption is. Go into the woods and place samples of the salve on the ground. Be sure to spread them out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Not So Much
quests.description: That doesn't seem to have done much good, either. There's a more direct method we can try, but gathering the ingredients will take some time. First, I'll need you to go back to Pinewood Forest. The Pine Trolls who live there use a special blend of healing herbs. If you can collect 10 pouches of it, that should be enough.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Berry Sturdy
quests.description: The berries that grow on Treeants promote growth and hardiness. For the next ingredient, we'll need about 10 handfuls of them. You can find Treeants in the Poison Forest or at the Greenguard Farm, but be careful – they may not be happy about being harvested.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Oil of... what?
quests.description: Next, you'll need to travel to Faerie Forest in Chiral Valley and collect some Essential Oil of Faerie. You'll get it from the Chainsaw Sneevils, who have collected it from… well, best not to think about it. 10 vials of it should do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: No One Likes Taking Medicine
quests.description: I've crafted a tonic from the herbs, berries and oils you brought back. If the forest spirits drink it, it should cure them of their corruption. But no one really enjoys medicine, do they? You may need to rough them up a bit before they're willing to take it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nip it in the Bud
quests.description: The tonic worked – I watched the corruption vanish from the forest spirits! but it returned almost immediately. Something in the forest must be keeping the spirits in this impure state. Go back into the forest and fight the corrupted spirits until you've found some clues as to what could be causing this to happen.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Finding Yaomo
quests.description: Based on the clues you found, this is the work of a Yaomo – a type of malevolent spirit. It must be hiding somewhere within the forest. If you take one of the corrupted spirits' cores with you, you should be able to sense the entrance to his lair. Come back when you have found it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Sort of Like a Keycard
quests.description: So, you were able to find where the Yaomo's lair is, but you couldn't enter? It must be protected by some kind of ward. Fight the corrupted forest spirits and collect samples of the Yaomo's malevolent taint. If you have enough of it on you, you may be able to trick the ward into letting you pass.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Yaomo
quests.description: All that's left to do now is confront the Yaomo who's corrupting our forest and defeat him. Return to me when it has been done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mushroom Compost
quests.description: You've defeated the Yaomo, but the forest spirits won't heal on their own. Destroy 12 Lingzhi so their physical forms can return to the earth. When they regrow, they will be pure.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tainted Qi
quests.description: The corrupted Xingzhi will also need to be helped, but they don't have a physical form. Defeat them, and then collect their tainted Qi. This will help them to return more quickly in a purified form.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Defeat Yaomo' quest.

quests.name: Shushunned
quests.description: Much like the Xingzhi, the Shushen are lacking a physical form. In order to help them, we will need to dispel them after they are defeated. That this process may not always work, so you may have to battle them a few times before successfully dispelling their spirits.
quests.requirements_note: Must be at least Level 50 to accept these quests.

quests.name: Tainted Hearts
quests.description: The Hoku won't heal without our help. If you kill them and bring their corrupted hearts to me, I can attempt to purify them. Once that has been done, they should reform on their own without the taint.
quests.requirements_note: Must be at least Level 50 to accept these quests.

quests.name: Corrupt Collection
quests.description: In order to prevent this kind of corruption from happening again, it would be useful to study each type of nature spirit that was affected. Bring me samples from a Lingzhi, a Xingzhi, a Hoku, and a Shushen.
quests.requirements_note: Must be at least Level 50 to accept these quests.

quests.name: Cute Lil Devils
quests.description: The Mogui you see in the deeper parts of the woods may look adorable, but they're not meant to be there, and they're doing a lot of damage to the forest and its inhabitants. Defeat them, and collect the tiny stones they leave behind. If you bring them to me I can destroy the stones, and banish the Mogui they came from.
quests.requirements_note: Must be at least Level 50 to accept these quests.

quests.name: Little Ghosts
quests.description: The Jingshen Mogui look very similar to Shushen, and I suspect they may be what happens when Shushen become too tainted. If you can bottle samples of their ghostly mist, I'll be able to study it and determine whether my theory is correct.
quests.requirements_note: Must be at least Level 50 to accept these quests.

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Yaomo
quests.description: Are you truly the strongest hero in Lore? If you're up for the challenge, go into the deepest part of the woods. There you'll find an even crueler Yaomo. Go and defeat him, if you think you can.
quests.requirements_note: Must be at least Level 50 to accept these quests.

quests.name: Lava or Leave It
quests.description: It might not surprise you to know that DragonSlayers depend on some of the hottest materials known to man to craft our gear. Harvest Molten Lava from the Lava Rocks and be able to put it to good use.

quests.name: QuarterMaster's Supplies
quests.description: Lava Dragoblins are some of the most annoying creatures on Lore. They've waylaid the latest supply wagons, and that means I have no materials to craft gear.

quests.name: Suffering for Sulphur
quests.description: There are so many uses for sulphur — etching weaponry, making healing potions, preserving fruit… I can't list them all here. But suffice it to say, we use great quantities of it. The Sulphur Dracoliches are an excellent source of it.

quests.name: Ingots and Outguts
quests.description: You see those boxes back there? They're full of pieces and parts just waiting to be put together. And what don't I have? Iron. THE most basic component of pretty much everything. It's a good thing looting the Draconian Guards will replenish our supply. Oh. and if you come across any bile while fighting them, bring that hack. too. I combine it with sulphur. Mmm, mmm, stinky.

quests.name: Senna's Buns
quests.description: I make these special buns for the DragonSlayers before the start of any major hunt. Eating them gives you a temporary combat boost. I'm certain the creatures around here have stolen the crates from the last shipment. Help me them back and I will give you a few.

quests.name: Squeaky Toy
quests.description: We're taking the rightmost route. Think of the way you would hold a sack of flour. Held over the shoulder or under your arm. Which position will you be least likely to squirm in. I climb fast, and you will fall off if you try to cling to my back like you did with Gravelyn. You have three seconds before I choose for you. Then, I'll eviscerate the Vampire Queen's minions, if that is truly what they are.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Road Not Taken ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Vantablack
quests.description: We'll keep climbing the ladders dangling on the right. Ha, the moment I mentioned that the vampire minions were fake, the tourney's host dropped new toys into the arena. Recognize their armor? Or have I humiliated the Lightguard so thoroughly that no trace of them remains? Raise your weapon. I'm curious about the kind of warrior that gained my daughter's trust. But those scattered bones…are they real or waxen?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Road Not Taken ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Salt Bin
quests.description: I just noticed that there's a book here. Did you find others like it when you were escorted by Safiria and my daughter? …Do not read it. I need to fight off the fake Lightguard creations before we can move on. They're as overzealous as the originals. While I take care of them, keep your eyes on me. Not the book. I'm warning you. Do not read that book.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Road Not Taken ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Four Princesses
quests.description: I just returned from the next platform. You woke in time to watch me rip that illusion to shreds. That room, the throne, these crowns shouldn't exist. I would never allow it! Are there only Lightguard dolls to shatter? If I crush all of them, will a mannequin of Alteon be rolled out into the spotlight? I welcome another chance to destroy him. Don't touch me. Don't get in my way. This sham must be destroyed!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Road Not Taken ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Quest for the VIP Pass
quests.description: The NPCs LOVE to play for heroes of all classes, but they told me to look out for you, specially. They've got a VIP pass just for you, but… it was stolen! I can make another, I just need you to bring me the following: Secret Lyrics from the Mythsong Greatful Undead, the Knight's Album from the Black Knight in Greenguard west, and the Dragonbone Club from the Green Dragon.

quests.name: Platinum Album Shards
quests.description: Did you know, The NPC's last album went platinum? But then it was shattered when they moved into Yulgar's Inn. If you help me recover the shards, I'm sure they'll reward you with an item from their merch table! See if the Boxer Sneevils have any of the shards, then slay the Greenguard Slimes to bring me the glue I need to fix it.

quests.name: The Stick of Destiny
quests.description: Somewhere hidden deep within Lore is a magical tree upon which grows the Stick of Destiny. If you find the tree and harvest the stick, you will turn into a rocker of unparalleled ability!

quests.name: Punchergeist
quests.description: Have you ever ventured into the residential area? It's a melting pot of people from all over the Kingdom. Let's review our plan with Warlic and have you both take a look at the junction beyond the arch. Do mind that there are lingering spirits strolling about. They don't mean harm but like rough-housing with adventurers. If we spare a little time playing with the ghosts, they'll let us go on their way. Maybe they'll even give us candy.

quests.name: Party Town
quests.description: We should head down the road leading West first. That's where you'll find a lot of single-floor homes occupied by two or three bands of adventurers each. Though they're on the move all the time, everyone comes back on Mogloween to decorate their houses and throw wild parties. We'll knock on their doors and let them know what's going on. While we're at it, should we scare away those big green fellows? What are they?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sweet Mucus
quests.description: There's a cauldron and piles of pumpkins set up on the road. Wow, the cauldron's filled with molten candy! I'd say that's a little dangerous left unattended but very creative! Hmm, there's a slime looking substance smeared all over the decorations. I don't think that's part of the display. Let's investigate that. We'll have to push through the ghosts. They're enchanted by the Mogloween decor and swarming the cauldron.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Door to Door
quests.description: The West end is large but typically quiet. When an adventuring party returns home from a long journey, I make sure to visit them and drop off a cake to celebrate. But on Mogloween, everyone is back in town. They're all in danger! Walk past the cauldron and pumpkins to start trick or treating in /trickortreat. Circle back here when you're done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Crusted Compost
quests.description: With the West end taken care of, let's head up the North road from the junction. That's where long-term residents live. Their homes are a lot fancier. Some of them have third floors and a cellar just for moglinberry juice. We'll knock on their doors next. Hmm, their roads are usually clean, except I'm seeing a lot of squashed jack-o-lanterns. And they're moving…Would you please grab a few for me and Warlic?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Spot of Sludge
quests.description: Look there! I love throwing tea parties, and the house at the end of the street set up a table themed for Mogloween. This is such good inspiration for the inn's Fall menu. And just like the cauldron display over on the West end, there's slime on the furniture. I'll help clean it up and have Warlic check for any differences. The smell of the slime looks like it's affecting those big green monsters too. This time, what if we caught a few of them?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Messy Unrest
quests.description: We're at the final stretch! The other adventurers should have the rest of the North end covered. We'll head back to the junction and take the East road. And not a moment too soon. I'd be panicking if Warlic hadn't cast his spell. But, the ghosts and spirits on the road don't sense any urgency. That or the wild overgrown pumpkin vines in the East end are riling them up. We'll need to calm them down before we start knocking on doors.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Plain Monster
