quests.description: There's a young lady standing outside of her house. That's dangerous, she could get hurt by the restless spirits at the East end. We need to talk to her. She and her family visit the inn for meals often, so it won't be hard to convince her to leave town. But, there's a strange weeping creature nearby. It kind of looks like the animated pumpkins except, that's not mushy pumpkin rind. Is that creature made of…skin? We should catch them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Study Group
quests.description: Rhody's house is next door. I wouldn't normally recommend this but break the door down. Quietly, if possible. Carmelita told me that Rhody's a scholar by trade. He must have research notes laying around. It'd be safer to learn as much as you can about what he's doing before charging full tilt. If there are other monsters inside Rhody's house, give them a quiet knock on the head so he won't hear you coming.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Fruits of Labor
quests.description: According to Rhody's research notes, he's using a greater spirit of rot and decay as a mana battery to power his spell! She is named Madam Ester - a figure essential to the natural cycle of life and death. Though she's important, celebrations in her name have faded into obscurity. So she quietly enjoys Mogloween alone - until Rhody trapped her. Madam Ester is in a confused frenzy. If you defeat and calm her, we can set her free!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ghoul Gang
quests.description: Madam Ester would like to join in on the Mogloween festivities but I think she's misunderstanding the trick or treat part. If you defeat her or any of her attendants, the Decay Spirits, they'll award you with their own brand of candy. Madam Ester said that she'll hand out rewards for kicking the remaining Rotting Mounds too. Uhm you go ahead, I think I'll sit this one out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Fruits of Labor ' quest.

quests.name: Doorbells and Sleigh Bells
quests.description: Ready to start caroling? You can walk through town to access the different neighborhoods or join /caroling and we'll send you off on a sleigh to a neighbor's house. Do take care, you might run into a sneaky monster lurking on the lawn. Make sure they're not a pet, then fight them off before you ring the doorbell. The owner of the home will definitely appreciate the help and the song! If the monster happens to drop any gift wrapping supplies, bring those back and I'll trade you for them.

quests.name: Refreshment Retrieval
quests.description: Since I'm busy organizing the caroling and gift wrapping workshop, we needed extra hands in the kitchen. Chilly heard that I needed help and volunteered his moglin friends to handle making Cocoa and treats. They were on their way to deliver refreshments to the carolers but all the treats were stolen by a number of strange monsters! Could you help us get those treats back from the Krumpets, Frostval Deer, and the Delivery Wagon?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: An Offering to the Falcon Guardian
quests.description: The Falcon is the priest's stamina, and represent his resistance to poison and disease. She uses her venom to destroy his enemies. Bring her an offering that pays tribute to the role she plays.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Well, Go Get the Sac, Then! ' quest.

quests.name: An Offering to the Jackal Guardian
quests.description: The Jackal is the priest's ferocity, and represent her strength in battle. She defeats her enemies as a warrior does. She will require an offering that recognizes her fierceness in combat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take the Offering ' quest.

quests.name: An Offering to the Baboon Guardian
quests.description: The Baboon is the priest's armor, and represent his health. She protects him through healing and restoration. Her offering should pay respect to her gifts of regeneration and protection.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Charge the Pedestal ' quest.

quests.name: An Offering to the Human Guardian
quests.description: The Human is the priest's himself, and represent his own exaltation. She protects him by bestowing upon him the power of the gods. Her offering should prove that the wielder of the Scepter and Flail of Yasaris are worthy of their power.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Spirit Knife ' quest.

quests.name: Freeeessssssh Mmmmmmeat
quests.description: Ssssssssssoulsssssssss
quests.requirements_note: Must have Serpentine Larvae in inventory.

quests.name: Clear the Way
quests.description: Looks like there are some Skeletal Soldiers blocking the road to Battleon. Defeat these two skeletons and then come back to me with their axes as proof. Once I know the path is clear, you will be rewarded with GOLD and EXPERIENCE.

quests.name: Defeat the Lich
quests.description: The Lich Ravager is blocking the way to Battleon. Take him down to ensure Battleon's safety.
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest.

quests.name: Souls of the Legion
quests.description: For every soul our leader takes, he becomes stronger, and the Undead Legion becomes weaker. As you fight these Undead Legion minions, collect their souls. Future Dage must be at maximum strength if we are to emerge from this battle victorious.

quests.name: Robust Souls of the Legion
quests.description: All beings have a soul, but some are stronger, and more powerful, than others. A soul like this will imbue our Dark Lord with considerably more power. If you find any of these robust souls, bring them to me. They will greatly increase our chances of success.

quests.name: Souls of the Legion
quests.description: For every soul our leader takes, he becomes stronger, and the Undead Legion becomes weaker. As you fight these Undead Legion minions, collect their souls. Future Dage must be at maximum strength if we are to emerge from this battle victorious.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take out the Legionator ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Robust Souls of the Legion
quests.description: All beings have a soul, but some are stronger, and more powerful, than others. A soul like this will imbue our Dark Lord with considerably more power. If you find any of these robust souls, bring them to me. They will greatly increase our chances of success.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take out the Legionator ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Serve the Darkness
quests.description: I need to see death. SHOW ME. The darkness wills it. Travel around and spread death. I will watch…

quests.name: Guts and Glory
quests.description: All of my minions MUST be supremely skilled in battle. I cannot consider any that would fall to lesser liches or their pawns. Defeat my New Minions to prove yourself and test their ettle.

quests.name: Blood Harvest
quests.description: The Shadow Bats you see are my most loyal pets. They harvest the unwary, draining them of blood so I may feed at my leisure. Milk them of their latest deposits.

quests.name: The Final Test
quests.description: My fiercest minion, my prize - the Terror and Scourge of MystCroft - waits for you. Defeat it in battle and earn yourself a place by my side as my favored minion.

quests.name: Shadow of Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says, if infiltration is more your style. Shadow Voids are unmatched. They are beings of complete emptiness…
quests.requirements_note: Rogue (Rare) , Rank 10.

quests.name: Hex: The indecisive mission
quests.description: Bah, have you ever stuck with anything in your life? So you think you made a mistake trading in your Void status? To show how forgiving I am, I will allow you to trade me back you "Hex of Nulgath" armor and your "Receipt of Nulgath" for the Void armor. But this is a one time deal. Plus I require and interest payment on top of that. x5 "Diamond of Nulgath".

quests.name: Blood: The indecisive mission
quests.description: Bah, have you ever stuck with anything in your life? So you think you made a mistake trading in your Void status? To show how forgiving I am, I will allow you to trade me back you "Blood of Nulgath" armor and your "Receipt of Nulgath" for the Void armor. But this is a one time deal. Plus I require and interest payment on top of that. x5 "Diamond of Nulgath".

quests.name: Fiend: The indecisive mission
quests.description: Bah, have you ever stuck with anything in your life? So you think you made a mistake trading in your Void status? To show how forgiving I am, I will allow you to trade me back your "Fiend of Nulgath" armor and your "Receipt of Nulgath" for the Void armor. But this is a one time deal. Plus I require and interest payment on top of that. x5 "Diamond of Nulgath".

quests.name: Piercing Shadow
quests.description: For a small price I'll give you a spear to pierce through anyone.

quests.name: Shadow Guard
quests.description: The head piece for your Shadow of Nulgath armor is now manifested.

quests.name: It Calls Out
quests.description: *You hear some noises coming from the chest? It sounds like something is inside. It calls for more power…*

quests.name: It Wants Weapons
quests.description: *You hear the being from the chest call out again*
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: It Wants Fuel
quests.description: *You hear a demanding whisper from the chest.*
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dark Endurance
quests.description: The fact that you have delved this far into Bludrut Keep speaks much of your abilities. You may be the hero I have been waiting for all these years. Are you the one who can finally free me from this terrible curse? On this level dwell Wicked Witches and Shadow Serpents, who serve the Dark Elemental that rules this part of the dungeon. If you can prove yourself by slaying forty of their number, I will unlock the door that stands between you and this Dark monstrosity. (Bring back forty Dark Essences to complete this quest.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Water Thief Ghost's Quests .

quests.name: Heart of Darkness
quests.description: As I lay defeated at the feet of the Evil Elemental, I could not help but notice the pulsing glow from the bracelet dangling from his wrist. I can only surmise that this bracelet is the source of his dark power. If you can return to me with the bracelet, I am sure I can use its power to free my soul from its eternal imprisonment within this accursed Keep. ( Bring back the Dark Bracelet to complete this quest.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Water Thief Ghost's Quests . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: ShadowEater's Gift
quests.description: The shadows recognize your power ! To acknowledge all of your victories, I have a gift for you. Click the button below to get your very own Golden Item of Awesomeness.
quests.requirements_note: Must have ShadowEater Lanterns in your inventory. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Minion Morale
quests.description: All members of Noxus' and Vordred's army must, as a rule, wear Un-Dead Tags. Laid down before Vordred learned the "Detect Life" skill, this ordinance has been kept because it fosters a sense of solidarity among the ghoulish grunts. Steal 15 Un-Dead Tags in an attempt to wreck morale!

quests.name: Shadowfall is DOOMed
quests.description: Noxus is a pretty confident villain, what with his massive army of undead and a champion like Vordred. And, like all overconfident baddies, he LOVES to tell heroes what his plans are. See if you can find a copy of his "To Do List of DOOM" on one of his minions!

quests.name: Grave-lyn Danger
quests.description: With the undead overrunning Shadowfall, Gravelyn is in trouble! They would capture her in a heartbeat… if their hearts were still able to beat. It's hard to imagine Gravelyn as a prisoner, but just to be safe, better make sure you have a Skeleton Key to free her!

quests.name: ShadowFlame Dragon Orb Pet
quests.description: Slay 13 Shadow Imps in the ShadowLord's Keep to gather shadow energy and I will reward you.

quests.name: Mood Pendulum
quests.description: So who do you have besides Varga and Gravelyn's forces? Dead weight by the looks of it. Malgor did a number on Warlic, and Brentan's enjoying the fun mood swing stage of the Mana Affliction. They both want to talk to you so hurry up, we need to get moving. Hmm, I am curious about what Brentan is telling that glowing crevice on the wall. You think hallucinations are another symptom or is he actually hearing something?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guilt Complex ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Bug Issue
quests.description: Mind the mana seeping out of the walls on your way in. Malgor seared ShadowFlame into the stone of the Keep, which means even the building is suffering mana overbloat. The locust infestation was already bad enough. After they got a taste for slurping up mana, the critters started to eat imps and worked their way up to devouring mages for more juice. Swat them so we can make our way through unbothered.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guilt Complex ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Advanced Age
quests.description: I was outside for a day or two and the mess got even worse. You see those puddles on the floor? Don't touch them. I'll show you what happens if you do. Just grab a few of the imps but don't rough them up too hard. They tend to spray when they pop from Mana Affliction. Could be because they have smaller bodies than the mages.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guilt Complex ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: One Singularity
quests.description: Now that I think about it, what would happen if you touched the timestream puddles? I'll be honest with you, I didn't think about how you were going to close the portal once we got there. That's going above and beyond on my end. The portal room must be flooded by now. It's in your own best interest to see if interacting with that timey wimey sludge is going to put you in diapers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guilt Complex ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Canaries on Edge
quests.description: I'm going to have to put blackmailing you on hold. Of course the mages need to go and scream at every little thing that comes by on top of exploding. Malgor is busy fighting Drakath but he'll drop everything if he finds out you're here. Either he'll burst in to wring your neck or he's going to jump into the portal. You'll need to silence those mages. You've collected heads before. Does it matter if they come from human-shaped monsters?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guilt Complex ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Caution! Wet Floor
quests.description: If I show any more weakness, I bet you're going to cut me down on the spot. It's almost like I still have Malgor breathing down my back. I know I don't have much time but I really want to see Malgor get what's coming. So hurry up. The area ahead is flooded by the leakage from the Timestream. Only you can wade through and check what's up ahead. Tell me how the barrier's looking and if the Warfury's already there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guilt Complex ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reflection in the Puddle
quests.description: The slime-looking blobs slithering around are what I call the Mumblers. When the portal to the Timestream began to leak, some of the puddles gathered together to form into Mumblers. Not sure what they're saying but Malgor was too busy having a fit to listen. He went crazy trying to destroy them. Like with everything he does, Malgor wasn't successful. Mop them up so Gravelyn and I won't trip on them and fall in the puddles.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guilt Complex ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Meniscus Point
quests.description: I can tell when the others are on the brink of exploding. They've gone quiet, just like the mage that blew my arm off. I'd like to hold on to the rest of my limbs for as long as possible. It'll take time to fully tear the barrier down and an explosion or five would be pretty distracting. They won't blow up if you slay them first. You'd be doing them all a favor.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guilt Complex ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Distractions
quests.description: Mumblers and Locusts. They're swarming because of the dead imps and mages. I need to concentrate on the *cough* barrier. Keep them at bay. And don't go -urk- berserk over those dumb slimes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guilt Complex ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadowscythe Recruitement
quests.description: All good Shadowscythe supporters must bring more followers into the fold. Slay 13 Good Soldiers in the /alliance map to bring more undead into Gravelyn's army!

quests.name: Gravelyn's Loyal Retainer
quests.description: Those who follow the Shadowscythe are bound by honor, darkness, and loyalty. You have taken the first step towards becoming one of Empress Gravelyn's most loyal followers, but Chaos still treatens her! Defeat each of the Chaos Lorin turn to win her approval!

quests.name: Remnant of Will
quests.description: Around us are the sentient forces that collect in our bodies, and turn us into Hollowborn. Collect them for Dr. Neelo's studies. I'm curious about them as well…

quests.name: Stake Your Life
quests.description: I've bound the Vampire and broken its fangs, but don't expect it to go down easy. Ready your weapon, and aim to crush its heart. I'll be here to observe and take notes.

quests.name: Hollow Howl
quests.description: Though the Lycan is leashed, it isn't muzzled. Battle it as you would a free beast. I am here to supervise, and make note of any anomalies during your fight.

quests.name: Knee Jerk Reaction
quests.description: It's important to have rations while travelling, but you already know that. Get us some fresh meat. Do you think Yulgar has any surplus in the Cellar?

quests.name: Nice, But Not Quite
quests.description: You know what these supplies are missing? Rice! It's important to have a balanced diet and this diet is missing some rice. I can't seem to find any in these parts, but I'm sure you can figure something out. I'll bet they store some down in the castle tunnels…

quests.name: Alternative Solution
quests.description: I could go for some dairy. Only problem is… I'm lactose intolerant. I've been looking for a decent substitute, but none of them get me feeling it in my bones. They just don't provide enough Calcium. You wouldn't happen to know a rich source of Calcium? I hear there's a BIG source of it in the Yokai Isles.

quests.name: Compassion For A Companion
quests.description: There's something I need to ask of you, though I suppose I've been asking you of things this whole time. I need some ingredients to make an anaesthetic. I heard that there's a plague dragon in /sloth whose ooze can subdue an entire village, and there's a Killer Queen Bee in /beehive who can produce some knockout honey. If you must ask, it's for someone… important to me. I understand if you don't have the time, but I'd really appreciate it as a friend.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Chibi Eldritch Yume in your inventory.

quests.name: Lend an Ear
quests.description: It shames me to admit, but sleep is hard for me to come by these days. Rather, these terrible dreams torment me. If I could trouble you for some time, I'd like you to lend me an ear. Several ears actually. The ear of a Gorillaphant from Arcangrove, Sneevil from the Boxes, Dustbunny of Doom from a Terrarium, and a Drow from the Uppercity. That may well be what I need for some good rest.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50.

quests.name: The Voice from Yesterday
quests.description: Books are a collection of memories written by those who came before us. Their experiences, thoughts, and beliefs are all recorded on those delicate pages. There's some books I've been meaning to read. The titles I found interesting are: The Dark Book from Myrini StarEye's Magic Shop, Book of Monsters kept in the Back Room, Crimson BoneLord Tome held by the ghouls serving Count Maxius, and the Chronomancer's Opus from the Chronomancy Hub. If you could bring them to me I would be more than grateful to you.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50.

quests.name: Shadow Slayer Slayer
quests.description: My friend, I have something personal I must ask you. You're incredibly strong, aren't you? During your adventures you've fought against all kinds of opponents who threaten the balance of this world. Could you recall for me some of that strength when you faced some Shadow Slayers during the New Finale?
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dinner for Two
quests.description: If you want to fight, you've got to eat. But I'm afraid if we're to eat you'll have to fight. There's a lot of ingredients I'll need for this meal: Greenguard Dragon Ribs, Chickencow Wings, Shark Bait fillet, Big Bad Boar Sausages, Greenguard Basilisk Tail, Gell Oh No Jello, Deathgazer Takoyaki, and Kuro Geso Karaage. When you've gathered everything I'll prepare us a scrumptious feast.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Preparedness Awareness
quests.description: We should prepare ourselves for the potential threats we'll be facing. There'll be foes stronger and fiercer than before. You should get some potions as a precaution. Get 25 Health Potions, 25 Mana Potions, and 1 Medicinal Unguent. Reens at Arcangrove should be able to provide the potions you need. You'll have to pay a visit to the Chaos Dragon in /cleric for the unguent. It can be all the difference between victory and defeat.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Quality Tea Time
quests.description: After all the eating and speaking I feel we should brew some tea. I'll make you a special blend that my apprentice loves. Sleuthhound Inn serves rich tea leaves hidden deep within the premises. The Wisteria produces fragrant flowers. In the Hachiko Hotel, there is bitter matcha powder favored by the Nopperabos. The rare fruit from the Tree of Destiny truly enhances the tea's flavor. Most importantly we'll need to borrow tea cups from Yulgar's Table.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadowslayer Summoning Ritual
quests.description: "You wish to undergo training as a Shadowslayer? Most students aren't half as proactive as you when it comes to learning. Would you be interested in summoning? Believe it or not I happen to be knowledgeable when it comes to the extradimensional. I'll show you the ropes. Apart from the spells which you need to prepare at Dragonrune Hall, you should gather some rations together. Why do we need food for summoning? Consider it an offering to the person on the other side. I'd be pretty upset being abruptly summoned, but a nice meal might just tide them over."
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50.

quests.name: Get Out The Way
quests.description: Those accursed hunters are impeding our progress yet again! They claim we're getting in the way of their duty when they're actively hindering the extermination process. This is why I don't like working with untrustworthy factions. Let's just include them as part of our "extermination". Free of charge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Suspicious Minds ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Door Stuck
quests.description: This is quite the lavish tomb for an otherwise modest grave. They must really respect the founder. I hate to encroach on the village's traditions, but we'll be opening the tomb. Any stone left unturned could leave this problem unresolved. Looks like there's a seal over the door. The residual spiritual energies in the cemetery and some pristine finger bones from the ghouls should be enough to create a dispel sigil to undo it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Suspicious Minds ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nothing But A Hound Dog
quests.description: Looks like whoever set this summoning seal accounted for people trying to disable it. That's a Tindalian Hound, a rather strong beast to use as a simple guardian. We'll need to defeat the Tindalion Hounds if we're to disable this summoning seal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Suspicious Minds ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest name is a direct reference to the song Hound Dog by Big Mama Thornton .

quests.name: Coldest Regards
quests.description: Looks like the hunters have been expecting us. Now that we've found their secret, they want us to take it to our graves. Ain't happening! Let's teach them a lesson they'll remember!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Suspicious Minds ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: No Different From Prey
quests.description: Great work holding out. Only one last eyesore left to take care of. Looking at the state of their arm, they seem more like the monster they're meant to be. Let's wrap this up and complete our task.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Suspicious Minds ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadowslayer Summoning Ritual II
quests.description: Where did you even get that shard? That's a powerful relic in your possession, that Lunar Tear. The colors you see are aspects of the Moonlight. With the right reagents, we can construct a potent sigil from it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' No Different From Prey ' quest. | Must have Sparkly Shadowslayer Relic in your inventory.

quests.name: ShadowZard Guards
quests.description: Long unlive the Shadowscythe! To prove your dedication to the Shadowscythe Cause, defeat a Citadel Crusader in /lightguardwar and bring back their tabard as proof!
quests.requirements_note: Must have either ShadowZard Pet (AC) or ShadowZard Pet (Special) in your inventory.

quests.name: The Scythe's Edge
quests.description: There are newcomers to the city who are drunk on their power, causing all kinds of mayhem for our troops. If only they knew how fleeting power really is. Defeat the warriors that roam our cities…and show them the true strength of the Shadowscythe Empire.

quests.name: Forged in Blood
quests.description: Members of the Undead Legion have become …arrogant, ever since their victory against the Nation. I'm surprised the Empress didn't punish them for that unsanctioned squabble all those years ago. Losing the Abyssal General was a major blow to her morale…though I hear he stills assists her in backhanded ways. In any case: defeat 7 of the Legion Sentinels stationed around the city, and remind them who they truly work for.

quests.name: The Abyss Stares Back
quests.description: Hmm…Nulgath's Nation. With their leader gone, their units have fallen into disarray. And their contractors refuse to follow our orders. Defeat 10 Void Mercenaries and relinquish them from their contracts. They'll be much more useful to us once we bring them back from the dead.

quests.name: Vile Vanguard
quests.description: With the fortress tethered to the ground by the Legion ballistas, their infantry have swarmed the walls like bugs. Finding the throne empty, they've started to comb the halls looking for the Emperor. Some have even found their way here. We must defeat them before they catch wind of where your father is resting. I wish to look at their weaponry as well. The key to any battle is knowing your enemy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feeding Time ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Fell Fealty
quests.description: It seems the highly decorated of the Undead Legion have joined the search for the Emperor. Legion Dreadknights have invaded the hall. We will destroy them as we did the Dreadmarch. It's possible that, given time, what remains of the Emperor's loyal guards will hold until he can recover. Now then, Gravelyn, lead the charge. I was once a knight, and I wish to see what the knights of yore were capable of.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feeding Time ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Infestation Signs
quests.description: The Emperor's loyal warriors stand strong. I have received word from the others stationed around the fortress. The Legion has yet to locate the Emperor and are successfully being bottlenecked in the narrower of the halls. Dage the Evil is losing his best warriors en masse. We should do a scout of our hall for hidden enemies and other issues of note. Those claw marks on the walls are…curious.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feeding Time ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Banal Barage
quests.description: For a moment, I had hoped the Legion would withdraw because the losses they were taking would soon render a possible victory too costly. It seems that to the Legion's Lord, victory is worth any cost. So many Legionnaires are being sent into the fortress that they're trampling each other. On your order, the Emperor's guards will follow your lead, combat the Legion, and toss their remains out of the windows.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feeding Time ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bluebirds
quests.description: Birds of a feather do indeed flock together. The coward turncoats have decided to show their faces. Among the Legion ranks are 'Legion DoomKnights' who have betrayed the Shadowscythe to swear loyalty to the Lich. What a farce! These Shadowscythe Traitors are lower than dogs. They don't deserve death. Gravelyn, I advise that we capture them and deal with their treachery later.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feeding Time ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Anatomical Example
quests.description: The Shadowscythe Traitors have much to prove to their new master. They've monopolized the frontlines of the siege, and continue to swarm us. What are your thoughts on subduing these cowards and turning them into examples? This isn't the first time upstarts have thought themselves more clever than the Emperor. Take a look at the skeletons on the walls.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feeding Time ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bloodless Daisy
quests.description: Light is emerging from the dark. What in Lore… Dage the Evil has captured and enslaved Light Elementals to fight us. Beings of pure Light have the potential to maim a majority of our troops, allowing the Lich's forces to overtake the strong on sheer numbers alone! But, would this not prove dangerous for the Legion as well? Wait…one of their Generals is asking to speak to you. Is he…kneeling to you?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feeding Time ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadows of Espionage
quests.description: The siege has become more complicated than once thought. Traitors run amok, the Lord of the Legion is ailing, and his general risked themselves to warn us of something sinister lurking among the Elementals. On your orders, we will continue to defend the Emperor and take caution. Of note, the skirmishes have dislodged some of the bricks from the walls. I advise that we investigate them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feeding Time ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Foul Duke of Light
quests.description: Though we are besieged by the Legion, traitors, Light Elementals, and now spies, we must prioritize the worst threat. A higher Light Elemental under Dage the Evil's control has entered the hall. No doubt that Lich has located where the Emperor is. We must defeat this Elemental and check on your father's condition. We are quickly approaching a situation where retreat is our only option.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feeding Time ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Evil of Humanity
quests.description: Dage the Evil has found the Emperor. Haha…The Lich strode right by us. Despite all my boasts and disparaging of the Lich, I wasn't worth a glance. That Light Elemental maimed me… I can't even stand. Gravelyn, I beseech you, do all in your power to aid your father where I failed. Save him, buy him more time to heal, anything it takes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feeding Time ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Funeral Asters
quests.description: There is something different about these Light Elementals. Now that I think about it, this variety of elemental is rarely seen outside of their Plane. Yet, Rand says that the Legionnaires were able to catch them without trouble, and force them to do their bidding. I say we subdue the Elementals and see what their power can actually do to those aligned with Darkness. The traitors will serve as test subjects.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Evil of Humanity ' quest.

quests.name: Shadowplay
quests.description: My warriors and I are the most loyal of the Shadowscythe Empire. The Empire is and will always be the blade of the Empress. If she wishes for her best to stand guard at your temple, then it will be done. My warriors, however, question your importance to the Empire. It would do them well to test their blades against yours. I will spectate the sparring matches, and reel my warriors in if they start committing property damage.

quests.name: Spy Lights
quests.description: I did wonder if having my warriors and I guard at your temple was akin to bandaging a paper cut with a cast, but I stand corrected. Warlic's barrier had hidden our location but I was notified that paladins are combing the forest. Apparently they're calling it a 'routine patrol.' We're going to /lightguardwar. The Lightguard still lingers there, and we will interrogate them in disguise.

quests.name: Golden Ticket Tier 1
quests.description: So, have you collected 200 Golden Tickets yet? If so, you have come to the right place! Take a look at the fabulous prizes you can get for 200 Golden Tickets. So, waddya waitin' for? See anything that catches your eye?

quests.name: Golden Ticket Tier 2
quests.description: So, have you collected 500 Golden Tickets yet? If so, you have come to the right place! Take a look at the fabulous prizes you can get for 500 Golden Tickets. So, waddya waitin' for? See anything that catches your eye?

quests.name: Golden Ticket Tier 3
quests.description: So, have you collected 1000 Golden Tickets yet? If so, you have come to the right place! Take a look at the fabulous prizes you can get for 1000 Golden Tickets. So, waddya waitin' for? See anything that catches your eye?

quests.name: Golden Ticket Tier 4
quests.description: So, have you collected 2000 Golden Tickets yet? If so, you have come to the right place! Take a look at the fabulous prizes you can get for 2000 Golden Tickets. So, waddya waitin' for? See anything that catches your eye?

quests.name: Gain the Sight
quests.description: If more fairies you would like to see, it's four leaf clovers that you'll need! Fight Lucky Harms on the Rainbow Road, bring me 3 of the clovers he's borrowed.

quests.name: The Dark Taint
quests.description: Our war against the Drow has raged for years and years. But now they wage it through those creatures, innocent, who know not why their light's been spent. Save the Furies, cleanse the 'drakes, from a taint so dark it breaks and bleeds into their skin and bones. We'll keep them safe inside OUR homes.

quests.name: Gifts for the Queen
quests.description: It is only polite courtesy to bring your host a gift or three. My Lady Fair, the Queen, is kind and generous, and sharp of mind. If her favor you would win, these gifts you'll find, and bring within: Eggshells, milk, a rooster's crow. Cysero's Chickencow surely knows how we fairies prize them so! (Find his beast inside Cysero's Battleontown shop)

quests.name: Oak for Luck and Joy
quests.description: Oak for luck and oak for joy, and the fruit of the oak may be employed as cups or clothing or amulets. The oak is mighty, and we never forget to thank our greenclad guardians for all the gifts that they have born. Bring me 3 oak leaves and one acorn, and the Lady will have no cause for scorn.
quests.requirements_note: Faerie Court, Rank 5.

quests.name: Bracken, Bone, and Branch
quests.description: If we're going to storm the keep, we need to build out our weapons! Bring me Bone Leech fangs for arrows, Tree Branches for shafts, and Weeds for fletching.

quests.name: Break Braddok's Backbone
quests.description: Alright. There's a LOT of guards in this forest. If we're going to get to the keep, we've got to take them out. A squad of guards has 8 members. Let's get to it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stone of Binding
quests.description: We've got to find the Stone of Binding! Braddok wants it because it will put a spell on whoever it is used on. It'll help him enslave villages, and we have to stop that! It could be ANYWHERE in the forest… or anyone could have found it and picked it up. We have NO idea!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Break the Bone Fortress
quests.description: Alright. He's sent out more protection, and we've got to take them down! Defeat the Unbroken Minions, Warriors, and Bone Leeches to gain access to the Fortress.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: It's a TRAP! (No, really.)
quests.description: We have to face Braddok, and to do THAT, we've got to get into the dungeon. He's probably "interviewing" prisoners down there. He locks it, so we'll need to get the Dungeon Key from one of his guards.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Braddock Bonebreaker
quests.description: You don't REALLY think you can destroy him, right?! … Oh. You do. This'll be interesting to watch!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be accepted on Screen 9.

quests.name: Break Into the Hoard
quests.description: I guess you've earned the right to loot his hoard. The warriors had the same idea, so you'll need to take them out to get your prize.

quests.name: Hunt For Killek
quests.description: Killek sometimes goes off to find "snacks" — there are a lot of prisoners out in the swamp, and he's not above having a fourth (or fifth) meal. Hunt around the fortress and I'm sure you'll find them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Braddock Bonebreaker ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Chew the Dead
quests.description: Killek LOVES him some rotten, stanky, dead meat. But we've got a good number of undead hanging around. Take them out to get bones and scraps of flesh for the brew we're making.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Marsh Mash Pit
quests.description: To make this brew have an extra KICK, we're going to need muck from a Marsh Thing's underarea. *shudder* I don't envy you, but it will do the trick for us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ash Me No Questions
quests.description: The last thing we'll need is charcoal. You'll find that at the base of the pyres our Kidnapped Prisoners are attached to. They probably won't mind if you rescue them. They've suffered enough just having to smell Killek.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Killek Bonebreaker
quests.description: Oh… hunh. Looks like I needed more Marsh Muck. He doesn't seem too woozy. But I know you can handle him! Take out Killek and our last, biggest problem will be solved.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dapper Hats
quests.description: Leather. Leather hats, yes. But not just any leather. Something soft and supple like… Marsh Stalker hide, yes. Bring me some, won't you? It will make such dapper Hats. And maybe some silvery fins from fishwings… to decorate the brim. Off! To Waterstorm with you!

quests.name: Gone With The Wind
quests.description: I had SO many pretty hats to sell! But then the wind came, and blew them all away. You must get them back! My fancy party hat… stolen by an energy tornado! My classy bowler… absconded with by Living Air! My trendy fedora… swept away by some unworthy wind elemental! Go to Airstorm and find them for me, please?

quests.name: Knighty-Knight!
quests.description: So, what now? Hmm. Maybe if you found some more of those Knights, you could get some information out of them. After all, they HAVE to know the way through here, right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Never Go That Way! ' quest.

quests.name: I Yield!
quests.description: Stop! That's enough! Meet me back in the center of the maze, and I'll tell you what you need to know
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Torch Me
quests.description: First, you're going to want to get some torches. The Hedge Goblins you see wandering the maze have terrible eyesight, so they usually carry some with them for light. Come back when you've collected 12.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Light Em Up!
quests.description: Now, take these torches and use them to light all of the lanterns throughout the maze. Light the two in this room LAST.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: It's A Shard Knock Life
quests.description: Now for the mirror. When it broke, its shards were scattered throughout the maze. But like so many things here, they are enchanted - in order to collect them, you'll have to subdue them first! Some of them might get away on your first try, so you may have to fight a few of them more than once.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Minotaur in the Mirror
quests.description: Now all you have to do is out all of the pieces back together. Good luck with that.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Minotaur Prime
quests.description: All that's left now is to defeat the Minotaur Prime! It's probably going to kill you. But hey - maybe it won't! Either way, I'm in for a good show.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Through the Looking Glass
quests.description: Well - you did it. Path's open! What are you waiting for?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Kick His Glass!
quests.description: I never expected you to make it t his far! This has been entertaining, but you obviously I can't let you go any further. En garde!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Hit Reverse ' quest.

quests.name: What's Worse Than Minotaurs?
quests.description: You may have beaten me, but this isn't over yet! I've left a special surprise for you in the next room. This is your last chance to turn back! …but after that thrashing you gave me, I really hope you don't.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: This Is The Place, Right?
quests.description: Looks like you've almost made it to the Tower of Mirrors - the only thing standing between you and those kidnapped girls is this hedge maze! Better make sure you're on the right trail before you find yourself lost in here. Look for a clue that the captured damsels have been through here!

quests.name: Never Go That Way!
quests.description: Now that you know you're in the right place, you'd better start trying to find your way to the center! It looks like that's where the tower is. Probably ought to clear out some of these monsters, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: This Isn't Funny, Guys
quests.description: Ok, well… this looks pretty much exactly the same as the room you just left. Did Scarletta just punk you? Maybe if you go further in, you'll see something to help you figure out what's going on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Through the Looking Glass ' quest.

quests.name: It's NOTE the Same Maze!
quests.description: Now that you can read these notes, you can see that they are messages that the kidnapped girls have written to their families. Maybe you should try to find the rest. If you can't get them out, then their loved ones deserve to know what happened.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Monsters In Mazes
quests.description: It's probably a good idea to clear out some of the monsters in here as you go through the maze. After all, you don't want to end up cornered by a horde of minotaurs! To be sure you are in the correct area of the map, make sure the notes are readable, not reversed!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be found be from Shattered Knight (NPC) after completing the ' What's Worse Than Minotaurs? ' quest.

quests.name: Hit Reverse
quests.description: Now all you have to do is find your way out of here. Should be easy, right? After all, you already solved this puzzle in reverse!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Kick His Glass!
quests.description: I never expected you to make it t his far! This has been entertaining, but you obviously I can't let you go any further. En garde!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Hit Reverse ' quest.

quests.name: What's Worse Than Minotaurs?
quests.description: You may have beaten me, but this isn't over yet! I've left a special surprise for you in the next room. This is your last chance to turn back! …but after that thrashing you gave me, I really hope you don't.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Know the Nexus
quests.description: You must know the land before you can become comfortable battling in it. And, I fear, it is a battle you will face here! Discover the 4 islands which make up this section of the Dream-Nexus, a realm Khasaanda feels she can control.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Battle the Baas! (Troll) ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Secure a Route Home
quests.description: You cannot depend on Khasaanda to send us home once you are finished here. In this place, SHE reigns. Secure a route back to our world by activating the columns. You will need to gather the resources for me to prepare the activator. 2 each of Wyvern Scales, Wyvern Claws, Serpent Fangs, and Serpent Hair. Those last are rather rare…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Battle the Baas! (Troll) ' quest. Notes: | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: DreamDancers' Orbs
quests.description: Khasaanda has spoken of these orbs to me. They contain great power. It would be unwise to allow either Khasaanda or Drakath to tap this resource! Gather enough Aether to unlock them before Chaos can by collecting 11 flames and 10 flowers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Battle the Baas! (Troll) ' quest. Notes: | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Master the Flames
quests.description: You will need free access to the central island if you are to come out of this realm alive. The battle between Khasaanda and Drakath will take place there. Put out the flames; the only thing that will douse them is the liquid from the tears of 10 Solar Phoenixes and 5 drops of Phoenix Blood.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Battle the Baas! (Troll) ' quest. Notes: | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Choose: Khasaanda Confrontation?
quests.description: I fear you will wind up facing Khasaanda in battle, but I do not know how. I hope you will choose to be merciful if it comes to that, but I understand that you must battle Chaos wherever it appears.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Battle the Baas! (Troll) ' quest. Notes: | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Battle the Baas! (Horc) ' quest. Notes: | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Answer
quests.description: My answers come in the form of questions. If you can answer my riddle, you shall learn the direction your path must take.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Decipher the Scroll ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Blood Titan's Tribute
quests.description: The Blood Titan requires much energy in battle. If you wish to train as one, you will need to fight my master at full strength. First, obtain a phial from him, then fill it with the blood of the Titanic Drakath in /titandrakath, Desoloth in /desoloth, and Ultra Carnax in /ultracarnax.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50.

quests.name: Blood Titan's Challenge
quests.description: Your tribute has caused my master to grow in power. He awaits your challenge.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50.

quests.name: Wartime Kaidan
quests.description: My ancestor was a warrior poet. Maybe, if I wrote a poem that reminded our four-legged neighing problem of his original partner, it'll be easier to appease him. Start by seeing if the Nopperabo are still around at the site of the /YokaiWar.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lady Suzhen ' quest.

quests.name: Act of Loyalty
quests.description: The next battlefield we should visit is /ShogunWar, to recall the Shadow Samurai you fought there. These memories are more bitter, but raw emotions resonate more if the wounds are kept fresh.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lady Suzhen ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Natural Betrayal
quests.description: We should pay a visit to the site of /HakuWar next, and look for remnants of the Kitsune Spies and Dark Zmey. The Kitsune who participated in the battle have been catching a lot of flack from other Yokai. It's interesting.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lady Suzhen ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Coming Conflict
quests.description: This last trip is going to take us off of the Yokai Isles. Return to /ShadowBattleon, and show me what remains of the Ouro Spawn. The worries that plague my dreams are draped in shadow…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lady Suzhen ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chi Tu
quests.description: My poem is complete. You've marched through countless battlefields, and brought an end to every war. The fiery stallion, Red Hare, challenges you to quench his flames. Show him that the Heroes of today have outran the legends of the past.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lady Suzhen ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Chì tù (赤兔) means "Red Hare" in Chinese.

quests.name: Healing Crystals
quests.description: Hello, hero! My supply of healing crystals is getting low, and needs to be restocked. The crystals I need can be found in Earthstorm. Fight the gemstone golems you find there, and harvest shards of crystal from them. I'll need a good variety, so try to bring me some of everything!

quests.name: Balmblossom
quests.description: I've been doing some research for Master Healer Ll'Ara, and I've found that the blossoms that grow around town have very effective restorative properties! I'm trying out different salves and medicines they can be used in, so I'll need a good supply of them.

quests.name: Buy Tickets
quests.description: Insert Credits for Ticket, please!

quests.name: Taking a Boat Trip
quests.description: Do you require a new piece of equipment to use? Is your blade getting dull? Or do you just prefer to have something finely made for once? Let us travel these lands. I will need Sullen and wrathful sounds found in the river /styx. Do not ask questions, retrieve these for me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Shogun Dage Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Clear a Path
quests.description: I have heard in these lands named Fotia there is a resistance here against your Dage. It matters not which Dage, I will hear none of it. Take out some of the local creatures.

quests.name: Time for Some Spring Cleaning
quests.description: It's still noisy in this particular area. Why is it that your Dage allowed this area to exist in the first place? Take them all out.

quests.name: Taking a Boat Trip
quests.description: Do you require a new piece of equipment to use? Is your blade getting dull? Or do you just prefer to have something finely made for once? Let us travel these lands. I will need Sullen and wrathful sounds found in the river /styx. Do not ask questions, retrieve these for me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Shogun Paragon Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Clear a Path
quests.description: I have heard in these lands named Fotia there is a resistance here against your Dage. It matters not which Dage, I will hear none of it. Take out some of the local creatures.

quests.name: Time for Some Spring Cleaning
quests.description: It's still noisy in this particular area. Why is it that your Dage allowed this area to exist in the first place? Take them all out.

quests.name: A Healer's Wish
quests.description: Our first Tanzaku comes from a kind-hearted healer. They want to heal injured heroes with a new salve of their own design, but are too short to gather the reagents. If you can harvest the treants from NibbleOn, the Guardian Tree and Brightoak, as well as a Treant Leaf and the staff of a famous healer, we can help this kind soul's wish come true!

quests.name: A Fishy Wish
quests.description: This Tanzaku smells… peculiar. We'd best grant it quickly before the scent begins to spread. It appears to be a simple request: "FISH! Lots of FISH!" . Bring some of the finest Anglerfish Filets from the Natatorium, choice cuts of Shark Bait and Kuro, a basket of Fish Wings, and a whole fish from the Fishman Soldiers, and we shall give them a feast for the ages!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Villain's Wish
quests.description: My, we're escalating quickly.This Tanzaku contains a request for total control of the world! As you might imagine, this is FAR beyond our power… though if you bring me some enchanted essence from the Elementals in /Gilead and a full set of carving tools from the bandits of /poisonforest, I believe I can make a solution that will please everyone.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Child's Wish
quests.description: My, what a cute wish slip! Oh, and an adorable desire to match…. It seems that this young girl is making a wish for new friends. Er, sort of. Specifically, she'd like ‘supplies' to… build some? A strange request, but I'd hate to leave a child unhappy. Parts from some of Lore's fiercest skeletons and the bones of undead from across Lore should do quite nicely for her needs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Leader's Wish
quests.description: This next Tanzaku comes from one with titanic shoes to fill. As the new leader of his people, he seeks the strength to usher them into a bright future. Many of Embersea's remnants would be welcomed into his new alliance with open arms. Let us humble the Firestorm from /feverfew, /lavarun and the /fireforge, and leave them searching for his guidance!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Conqueror's Wish
quests.description: It appears that our next two individuals have written the exact same phrase on their slips: "Give me the power to overcome the one I despise." I can make two Doom Power Catalysts for them from the shells of Doom Overlords! Bring me undead souls from the /necrodungeon and essence from the creatures in /evilmarsh to empower our enigmatic evildoers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Survivor's Wish
quests.description: Here is an odd slip, Hero- from one who seeks peace for those lost, as well as for themselves. They miss the times where friends gathered in a grand symphony… but even though their heart is heavy, the song of Lore must continue. If you can recall your experiences with their allies from /AstraviaJudge and /TheWorld, I could perhaps write my own tune to aid them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Chaotic Wish
quests.description: This is the final wish left on the Tanabata… but something about it unnerves me. A fallen prince, rising only to fall again, seeks to learn from past failures. Records from the denizens of /transformation, /dreadforest, and /lagunabeach should serve his needs- but do not discover TOO much. This wish-maker's intentions are still unknown, after all…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Hero's Wish
quests.description: Surely you are entitled to one of your own? Go on, don't be shy! I just so happen to have one Tanzaku left. Write your wish, and I shall carry it to the heavens above when I depart for them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stonecold Defense
quests.description: Slay the Infernal Goblins and Lava Trolls to get the reagents you need to create the Stoneskin Elixir. If you don't, things may get too hot to handle!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright ' quest.

quests.name: Preying for a Good Offense
quests.description: These predators stand between you and rescuing the people of Embersea! Take out 3 Gargrowls, 2 Infernal Goblins, and 3 Lava Trolls!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Red Alert
quests.description: You want to reach the kidnapped villagers without being detected? Then you're going to need to set warning beacons. These are magicked to let us know if anyone tied to the Onslaught approaches.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Disguise Fur a Good Cause
quests.description: If you REALLY want to pass through the Fyreborn Caverns undetected, you'll need a disguise. I can craft you one, but I'll need resources from the Tigers, Lava Trolls, and Goblins to create it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hunt for the Stolen
quests.description: The kidnapped villagers have GOT to be here! We could make a detection device but… we're running out of time! Do you hear that roaring? It makes me nervous. Hunt through the area to find the missing villagers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Rescue Run
quests.description: You found them?! What are you waiting for… let's go get them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Recover the Remainder
quests.description: We are missing many of the kidnapped, still. I didn't want to take the time to do this before, but we'll need to create a scrying crystal to find the rest. Slay Pyrric Ursus monsters to get the crystal required to create a scrying glass. That's what we need!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rune Chances of a Backstab
quests.description: I just realized… the wards we placed to protect us from the Firestorm Onslaught will NOT stop attaacks from the cavern creatures. Place 7 protective runes to ward off attacks from behind. And slay those Infernal Goblin spies while you're at it. They give me the creeps.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clear out the Caverns
quests.description: The creatures of the Fyreborn Caverns are NOT happy to see us! Take out the attackers to make sure we reach the villagers safely.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Strengthen the Survivors
quests.description: We rescued the villagers, but they may not survive after all! It looks like Tyndarius left those who became ill. We need to make a restorative tonic to help them! Bring me the Sacred Flame, 3 Lava Runes, 4 Tiger Claws, and 1 Pyrric Gem to create potion to keep sick alive
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bridge to Salvation
quests.description: There's only a little further to go, according to the scrying tool! But those Lava Trolls are about to destroy the ONE path we need to take. Take out 7 of them to save bridge from being destroyed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Growling Pains
quests.description: The Gargrowls in the caverns are some of the most ferocious I've ever seen. And their favorite snack is … heroes like us! When they can't get that, they prefer the weak and sick. Easier to catch. Slay the Gargrowls to protect us all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Cinderclaw
quests.description: The LAST thing standing in the way of us reaching the rest of the kidnapped villagers is the terrorbeast, Cinderclaw the Ravenous!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Unlocking the Antechamber
quests.description: The gates to the Antechamber of the Exaltia Tower are sealed by a special elemental lock. You will need to gather the appropriate Elemental Essences of Fire and Ice to proceed into the Tower.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Ezrajal
quests.description: In the Antechamber waits Ezrajal, an Exalted tasked with protecting the entrance of the Exaltia Tower. You must defeat him if you wish to ascend the Tower and claim your prize at the end!

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unlocking the Reliquary
quests.description: The next floor of the Tower is the Reliquary. In order to access it, you will have to undo its elemental lock, much like before. This time, the gates are sealed with locks of Nature and Wind. Gather the Essences and proceed to the Tower's Reliquary.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Warden
quests.description: The Warden guards the Reliquary and all its contents. If you are to progress to the Tower's Apex, it must be dealt with.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unlocking the Apex
quests.description: The final gate keeps you from the Apex. You must collect the Energy and Water Essences that keep the gate sealed in order to face the Tower's final foe.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Engineer
quests.description: Atop the Tower's Apex stands the Engineer, protecting the fabled weapon used in The Final Stand of Ehr'Ishin. They will not go easily, but neither shall you.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ultra Ezrajal
quests.description: Before you stands a more challenging version of Ezrajal. Do you have what it takes to defeat him?

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Engineer ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once per day.

quests.name: Ultra Warden
quests.description: This is the strongest version of the Warden I could find throughout this multiverse's timelines! Can you defeat it?

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Engineer ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once per day. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest is also accessible in Ultra Warden (Location) .

quests.name: Ultra Engineer
quests.description: Is this the Engineer's true power, as the one who stands above all others? Defeat them to climb ever-higher!

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Engineer ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once per day. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest is also accessible in Ultra Engineer (Location) .

quests.name: Exalted Apotheosis
quests.description: Hero, I can't believe you've managed to recreate the legendary weapon of the Exalted! Bring me one Exalted Node, and I will award you with a character page badge.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Engineer ' quest. | Must have Exalted Apotheosis in your inventory. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Rescue the Knights
quests.description: We were guarding Sepulchure's cursed armor at the bottom of this crypt. But it was corrupted by the chaos…. It turned the other Knights into monsters! They were corrupted… chaos…. Chaorrupted! Go into the crypt, and defeat all of the knights so that we can back to Swordhaven for treatment!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Enter the Crypt ' quest.

quests.name: Enter the Gates
quests.description: The Skeletal Fire Mages are burning everything in sight. You must help protect the King! Slay 4 of these fireball hurling fiends and I will give you the key to get inside.

quests.name: Crabby Valentine
quests.description: AGGH! Beach Crabs everywhere! I know you're ready to find Beleen, but these crabby critters are being shellfish and want all the attention. So let's give them what they want -- your FULL attention during battle! Bring me 9 Crab Claws to thin this cast of crabs.

quests.name: Chinchillin'
quests.description: OH no, it looks like Beleen's chinchillas escaped! Trying to catch a Chinchilla is like trying to catch a squirrel on Red Bull (seriously). You'll need to wrangle 5 of these bouncy balls of fur before Beleen finds out I lost her pets. Please hurry!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Confectionary Wisdom
quests.description: We've got another problem: the bridge over Sriracha River melted away! (How does Beleen eat that stuff without dissolving?) Luckily, the Fortune Cookies *should* provide us an answer! Defeat enough Fortune Cookies to figure out how to cross the river.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Loony balloons
quests.description: Looks like we're going to need balloons to safety cross the Sriracha River. That stuff is so hot it burnt down a wooden bridge… I can only imagine what would happen if you stepped foot in it! Collect balloons from Balloon Animals and Balloon Trees, and then build the Balloon Bridge to cross the Sriracha River.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Disgruntled Draconians
quests.description: Okay, so I know Draconians are mean dragons… but Beleen, being Beleen, put giant bows on their heads. Not only do the Draconians looks silly, but they're also EXTREMELY angry. Quickly -- you'll need to defeat the Draconian swarm before they destroy Beleen's Dream Island!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Paws n' D'awwws!
quests.description: Beleen is at it again! This time she's put hair bows on Doomkittens. They will tear her to shreds if we fail to nip these cats in the bud. Defeat 6 of them to save Beleen from a flurry of cat scratches!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Power of Love... Elementals
quests.description: Beleen is looking for her true love, and she wants you to learn how to love… by breaking hearts? Don't ask me… she just told me to say that. Collect 7 Elemental Hearts from the Love Elementals and bring them to me so I can award you with gold and experience!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Red Velvet Cake Rope
quests.description: One does not simply cross the Red Velvet (Cake) Rope. You will need to find something from the Island monsters to construct a weapon powerful enough to get past the rope. Bring me back all the items from my list and let's see if we can cross that rope.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Legendary Cherry
quests.description: YES! Now that you have been admitted, you can climb the Red Velvet Cake Mountain and claim that crystallized cherry on top! Hurry and reach it -- because Beleen promised that whoever finds the Legendary Cherry WILL BE her Valentine!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Your Just Deserts
quests.description: This battle is not going to be a piece of cake. If Beleen is held captive beyond those doors, you MUST rescue her!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Slimes on a bridge
quests.description: If it's not one thing it's another - we finally get rid of all those undead, and NOW look what's coming back?

quests.name: Surrender, Frogzards!
quests.description: I bet you could convince a bunch of Frogzards to surrender if you show them you're not someone to mess with. Nightmare Carnax and the Frogzards go back years. Defeat Nightmare Carnax in /darkcarnax and some of the Frogzards will know not to cross paths with you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Discount Diploma ' quest.

quests.name: Surrender, Gorillaphants!
quests.description: I bet you can convince a bunch of Gorillaphants to surrender if you show them your strength. The Gorillaphants hate… salt??? Defeat the Salek Sprayer in /voidsalek and the Gorillaphants will bow down to your strength.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Discount Diploma ' quest.

quests.name: Surrender, Dragons!
quests.description: I bet you can convince a bunch of Dragons to surrender if you put down a monster even they shiver to think about. I hear that /Nerites is supposedly the child of the Great Dragon of Water. Defeating them should put you on the Dragons' radar.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Discount Diploma ' quest.

quests.name: Surrender, Frogzards! (Legend)
quests.description: I bet you can convince a bunch of Frogzards to surrender if you show them you're not someone to mess with. Nightmare Carnax and the Frogzards go back years. Defeat Nightmare Carnax in /darkcarnax and some of the Frogzards will know not to cross paths with you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Discount Diploma ' quest.

quests.name: Surrender, Gorillaphants (Legend)
quests.description: I bet you can convince a bunch of Gorillaphants to surrender if you show them your strength. The Gorillaphants hate… salt??? Defeat the Salek Sprayer in /voidsalek and the Gorillaphants will bow down to your strength.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Discount Diploma ' quest.

quests.name: Surrender, Dragons! (Legend)
quests.description: I bet you can convince a bunch of Dragons to surrender if you put down a monster even they shiver to think about. I hear that /Nerites is supposedly the child of the Great Dragon of Water. Defeating them should put you on the Dragons' radar.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Discount Diploma ' quest.

quests.name: Time to Get to Work
quests.description: When it comes to hunting down time creatures, we require many supplies to sustain our time travel. If you aren't busy, perhaps you could gather us a few that we will need on our next hunt! We will need some Time Dust from the local Ephemerites and some Chronocloth from some Time Wraiths.

quests.name: Time's Mirror
quests.description: In a Dark Dungeon in the Mirror Realm lies a creature that is known for its association to the Eternal Dragon. It is said that it is able to sense the powers of the Dragon in even the smallest traces. Could you retrieve me this creatures Brain so that we may use it to locate creatures that may use the Eternal Dragons power for evil?

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.name: Surveillance for Sir Valence
quests.description: Take a look around the Venom Vaults. I haven't seen any sign of Lionfang for a while but the halls are crawling with his Chaonslaught Soldiers. Be careful. Return once you have the lay of the land.

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Well Planned Getaway
quests.description: Always have your exits covered. When we get out of here we'll want as little opposition as possible so take out 6 of the Chaonslaught Warriors to make leaving as painless as possible when the time comes.

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Secrets Of The Mad Prince
quests.description: The mad prince who lives here had to have a way to safely train his pets. His journal is still inside the Venom Vaults somewhere. Find it and bring it back here. I will be able to translate it for you.

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Potion of Cleansing
quests.description: I see. the journal mentions a potion that was able to counteract the manticore poison, but he had to keep bathing in it to wash off the poison. The recipe for the potion has to be in there somewhere. Scour the grounds. Find it or else we're sunk.

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: You've Been Noticed
quests.description: You're not quite as stealthy as I am but I can't argue your results. Unfortunately the Chaonslaught Magi have noticed the potion recipe has gone missing. QUIETLY take out 6 of them and you'll have a much better chance of going unnoticed.

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Thorny Situations
quests.description: Now that you have a mage clove you should be able to pluck 5 venom Roses from around the Venom Vaults. We will need to use them in the Potion of Cleansing.

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Other Ingredients
quests.description: The Chaonslaught Magi will have all the other ingredients that we need for the potion but I don't think they will just hand them over. Secure 3 Spell Pouches however you can.

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Time For Supplies
quests.description: Now that we have all the ingredients we will have to be creative with getting the rest of the supplies. We need at least one Potion Vial, and I've seen the Warriors carrying a few potions on them. See if you can get an unbroken Potion Vial off of one of them!

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cooking Without Fire
