quests.description: We can't risk starting a fire to cook the potion up but the soldiers all usually carry some sort of magical heating element on them to keep them warm… we could use that. Search the Warriors and Magi until you find one of these Heating Elements.

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Introduction
quests.description: OK, the Potion of Cleansing is ready to be introduced into the water supply of the Venom Vaults. You'll need to find 3 chaorrupted lion-head fountains around the area and pour some of the potion into them. Get back here as soon as you're done.

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Courtyard Key
quests.description: The potion is making it's way into the water supply so you'd better be ready to attack. One of the soldiers will have a key to the courtyard gate. Find it… I will keep watch out here for Lionfang.

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Take Out The Chaos Manticore!
quests.description: You need to battle the Chaos Manticore now! Lionfang is headed this way. The manticore will poison you, just use the potion in the waterfall (Remove Poison Button) to keep the poison off of you as much as you can and defeat that beast before it can attack more innocents. Good luck, hero!

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Taint Spreads
quests.description: It is imperative we reach Scarsgarde Keep without beeing detected. Deadlicks' flying poison-eyes and guards grifs patrol the forest. We'll need to take them out if we have any hope of sneaking closer. Slay VenomWings, then put their tainted meat around the woods. That will take care of both.

quests.name: Beauty Twisted
quests.description: The Garde Grifs are relentless! Many of them refused to eat the tainted meat (not that I blamed them)… but now we need to attack the more directly. Take out the 7 closest Garde Grifs while I plan our next move.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Element of Surprise
quests.description: The best scenario would be for us to silently take out as many of the guards patrolling the woods as possible. That will let us sneak as close as we can to the keep. Get branches from the trees nearby, then lay traps in the arena. If luck and the Elemental Avatar are with us, we can trap most of them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: (Take the) Watch Out
quests.description: I fear an alarm may have been raised inside the Keep. They should not be this many Garde Watch and Pikeman patrolling at this hour. This deviates from their usual routine. Take out the Garde Watch and Pikeman nearby; they are come too close, and we cannot risk discovery.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: False Hoods
quests.description: Alright. Here's our best shot at breaching in Keep without challenge. We're going to need to BECOME members of the Scarsgrade Watch. Or, at least, pass for them. Take down members of the Watch to get a hood, scarf, tunic, leggings, boots and dagger
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pass for Real
quests.description: We COULD sneak in the back door, but I imagine they're on guard for that. I would be, if I were them. So we'll do the UNexpected, and walk up to the front door. All we need is the passode. Each type of Keep soldier has a section of it. *Persuade* the Knight, Pikemen and Watch and search the trapped knights until you have all 5 pieces of the passcode.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Hidden in Plain Sight
quests.description: Alright. You look like like a Keep Guard. You've got a passcode like a Keep Guard. How all you have to do is walk past the final line of guard, right up to the door. Remember to greet each of your fwllow guards as you go by them, or they'll be suspicious (Walk up to guards to greet them.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Stay Strong, Keep Steady
quests.description: You made it! Lynaria is already deeper inside the Keep, talking out the Knights in the dining hall. You need to take out this last round of Knights and Pikemen in the hall before you face the Captain.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Final Fight
quests.description: This Captain is all that stands between us and victory! Once he's down. we'll be able to move the rest of our army in and secure the Keep. It will make the perfect launch padfot the assault on Dreadhaven.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Arm the Army
quests.description: You know how the saying goes… an army marches on its stomach. Truer words were never spoken. If we're going to feed the men and women fighting with us, we're going to need food. And to get food, we need gold. I see the latest wave of Keep patrols returning home. Slay them and take their gold so we can feed the troops.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mind Control
quests.description: Dethrix has a horde of Mind Con-Trolls guarding his fortress! You'd better take them down first, before they mind con-troll your army!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Choose Your Path ' quest.

quests.name: Sp-Eye on You
quests.description: If you don't want Dethrix tracking your every move, you'd better take care of these Sp-Eyes, too. Make sure you smash their eyes, or they'll still be able to watch from where they lay.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lower the Drawbridge
quests.description: You'll need to find a way across that chasm in order to get to Ebonslate Fortress. If you beat up these Ebonslate Guards, you'll be able to lower that drawbridge they're guarding.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get the Key
quests.description: Cross the drawbridge, and the fortress is right on the other side. The door is being guarded by two huge Lycan Brutes, so you'll need to get the key away from them in order to get inside.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Break Down the Door
quests.description: Oh no - the key broke off inside the lock! Looks like you're going to have to bust down the door. Hope you've been working on that core strength!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Question the Knights
quests.description: You don't know where Lynaria is being kept, but these knights will surely have the information you need.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Troll the Trolls
quests.description: Sounds like Lynaria is being held upstairs! But the staircases on the second floor are being blocked by some kind of… mental barrier! Those Mind Con-Trolls must be responsible! Fight them and take their Troll Gems away from them so you can destroy their hold on your mind!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get Through the Barrier
quests.description: Once you smash the pile of gems in the next room, the mental barrier will be destroyed. Do it quickly!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Disarm the Knights
quests.description: You're almost there! But you'll have to fight and disarm these Ebonslate Knights before you continue. You don't want them to sneak up and flank you from behind!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bruise the Bruiser
quests.description: The door to the throne room is being guarded by an Ebonslate Bruiser, but that won't stop the likes of you! Show him why you're known as the best swordsman in Lore!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Take Down Dethrix
quests.description: This is it. Your one chance. Defeat this terrible monster, and save the only woman you've ever loved!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Toil the Gargoyle (Daily)
quests.description: Gargoyles are supposed to scare off evil spirits… but the Swordhaven Gargoyles are scaring off everybody and destroying our kingdom! I could use your help everyday dismantling our resident Gargoyles that will go helping Swordhaven repair all the damage done by these granite giants.

quests.name: Boy Fiends and Ghoul Fiends
quests.description: Have you seen the Dungeon Fiends? Little is known about these creatures, and in an attempt to study the habits of Male and Female Dungeon Fiends, Swordhaven needs your help differentiating between the two genders. Find and bring back:

quests.name: Arachnid Eradication
quests.description: Nothing is more frightening than an eight-legged arachnid plotting his next attack-especially ones the size of Baby Dragons! Swordhaven is in need of an exterminator, and it looks like you fit that description nicely. Eradicate 10 Castle Spiders to transform Spiderhaven back into Swordhaven!

quests.name: Apparition Nation
quests.description: Swordhaven is a safe haven to all heroes… but the vile villains we've defeated throughout the ages come back as Castle Wraiths. With everything else going on, we need brave souls to defeat these undead souls! Defeat 10 Castle Wraiths and return to me with your good news!

quests.name: Time Beast
quests.description: One of the more interesting creatures we have encountered is Carnax in /aqlesson. It is said to be the creature that causes the end of time itself. Perhaps you could defeat it and prove that you are worthy of being an Infinity Knight!

quests.name: Raw Gems
quests.description: Diamonds, Emeralds, Rubies, and Sapphires are on our list. We're not looking for a mine, but special gems from the golems in /earthstorm. The resonation of an oscillator made from an elemental would be more precise than an inert gem.

quests.name: Rest in Riches
quests.description: Below Battleon in /BattleunderC, peridot gems are known to grow on the Green Crystalized Undead and Alexandrite typically clings on to the Crystallized Jellyfish deep within the caverns. We could use those jewels to make high-quality oscillators for Chronomancers born in the Summer.

quests.name: Overclocked and Timed
quests.description: With the gems collected, we'll be looking for more obscure materials. As ironic as it sounds, our current tools could be outdated. I heard that there were paladins and Elementals in /templesiege that found a way to break through their limits. Go there and see if they have anything we could copy.

quests.name: Jewel Bug
quests.description: The forgemaster believes that I'm intending to do something dangerous with the new equipment, and rejected my order! I'm not, trust me, but it's already shifted into offensive mode. Please, help me force it back into neutral so we can arm the Infinity Knights of tomorrow!

quests.name: Undead Champion Recruitment
quests.description: I suppose one of the benefits of being stationed here in Dreadrock is the variety of recruits to choose from. As a high-ranking Undead Champion, you are obligated to go and *convince* some of the citizens to join our cause.
quests.requirements_note: Must own Undead Champion (Armor) .

quests.name: Recruiting for the Undead Legion
quests.description: I suppose one of the benefits of being stationed here in Dreadrock is a plentiful source of recruits. Go around and defeat enough enemies until you've convinced them to join our ranks.

quests.name: Undead Champion Soul Trapping
quests.description: Persuasion is one way to recruit new members to the Legion; but personally, I am a fan of soul trapping. Retrieve the Corrupted Dragon Slayer from Undead Champion Exercise #4 and bind 14 Dreadrock souls to it. You can slay any monster here in the city. And to ensure that they STAY bound, I'll need the Soulseeker's Soul Scythe as well. You will be heavily rewarded for your efforts.
quests.requirements_note: Must own Undead Champion (Armor) .

quests.name: Soul Trapping
quests.description: Persuasion is one way to recruit new members to the Legion; however, I personally am a fan of soul trapping. Defeat 14 enemies here in Dreadrock and trap their souls with the Soulseeker's Soul Scythe. You will be rewarded for your service to the Undead Legion.

quests.name: Package Delivery
quests.description: Most of the Infernals here are clients of mine - all of this fire and brimstone is terrible for your complexion! I've put together everyone's weekly packages of moisturizers, exfoliants and oils. I just need someone to deliver them. Oh, I know! YOU could to that for me! (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Gather the Ingredients
quests.description: How do I get brightly colored dye to last so long in my customers' hair? Shh! The secret is in the hair gel! A special kind of colored hair gel that I make from slimes! Please don't tell anyone. Help me restock and I'll do you up! I need green gel from the slimes in /greenguardwest, pink gel from the slimes in /extinction, and purple gel from the slime in Yulgar's /cellar.

quests.name: Scents-tastic
quests.description: I like to give my clients a nice dusting of brimstone after I finish up - it gives them that nice, Infernal scent! The best source of it, I've found, is the fire imps in /mobius. Be a dear and bring me some, would you?

quests.name: EEK!
quests.description: Look, if you're going to be in here, could you at least get rid of some of these rats? They keep trying to eat my toes.

quests.name: Warrior Claymore Blade Enchant
quests.description: Bring me one of these Warrior Claymore Blades and I'll enthrall it with new energy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract with the Abyss ' quest. | Rank 8 Evil .

quests.name: Iron Wing Helm Enchant
quests.description: If you can bring me an "Ordinary Iron Wing" Helm and Nulgath Rune 4, I'll curse it with dark energy. You'll strike fear in your enemies.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract with the Abyss ' quest. | Rank 6 Evil .

quests.name: Cursing of Spinal Tap
quests.description: Bring me a "Spinal Tap" dagger and I'll enchant it with the power of darkness to aid you in your fight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract with the Abyss ' quest. | Rank 8 Evil .

quests.name: Tainted Claw
quests.description: Bring me the Claw of Nulgath and I'll empower it for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract with the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Maw of the Void
quests.description: You again? Good timing. This sword I procured is out of control, and it's eating all of my Tainted Gems! Find something else for this thing to feed on, and I'll give you a nice reward!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract with the Abyss ' quest. | Rank 9 Evil .

quests.name: Eternal Rest
quests.description: Master's minion, I am granting you a chance to obtain the Void Avenger, a scythe enhanced by the magical powers from a well known Blood Knight from his army and a Tech Mage from another dimension. With proper reagents, we can stabilize the void energy that flows from it allowing us to shape the blade made by nothing but still capable to cut anything in half on a single blow, even the moon. So.. what are you waiting for? This is the time when I stop talking and you go hunt the reagents as my Master hates waiting!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Contract with the Abyss ' quest.

quests.name: Eternal Underworld Legacy Guards
quests.description: Slay a Legion Dreadmarch in /darkwarnation and a Void Fiend in /darkwarlegion to prove your worth once more to Dage the Evil and Nulgath the ArchFiend. You will be rewarded with house guards of your own! (This quest requires both the Dage and Nulgath 2022 birthday collection chests to unlock.)

quests.name: Legion Badges
quests.description: Those Legion members all carry Badges showing their allegiance to Dage. Defeat them and bring their Badges as proof of their demise.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Hebimaru ' quest.

quests.name: Mega Legion Badges
quests.description: Those Legion members all carry Mega Badges showing their allegiance to Dage. Defeat them and bring their Mega Badges as proof of their demise.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Hebimaru ' quest.

quests.name: Doomed Legion Warriors
quests.description: It looks like more Legion scum have found their way onto the battlefield! Let's show these Fiend Riders and DoomKnights what the Nation has waiting for them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Hebimaru ' quest. | Must have completed at least one the previous two quests. Note: This quest unlocked when the war meter reached 25%.

quests.name: Undead Legion Dread
quests.description: You are making splendid progress! These Legion Dread Knights don't stand a chance against Master Nulgath's Nation of warriors! Destroy them, so that he may know victory.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Hebimaru ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest unlocked when the war meter reached 50%.

quests.name: Defeat War
quests.description: The Horseman of War… how fitting! Let us show Dage the Evil that nothing will stop Master Nulgath's Nation from destroying his Undead Legion!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Hebimaru ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest unlocked when the war meter reached 75%.

quests.name: The Traitor
quests.description: With his Legion in shambles, he has nowhere to run! Your time is up, Dage! Let's finish this!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Hebimaru ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Plagued by Flames
quests.description: As a Water Healer in Embersea, I am often uncomfortable, but I bear it because sometimes one must suffer in order to achieve their goals. And right now, MINE is to stop the plague. Bring me 3 Shorewort plants and Firestorm gallbladders. (NOTE: can only be done once per log in)

quests.name: AquaPyrrus: FireWater of Life
quests.description: One of the most valuable treasures of the Embersea Water Temple is the AquaPyrrus elixir - a potion made from Embersea's water, a rare poison, and several secret ingredients. I have run out, and must make more. Bring me 5 vials of fresh water and 5 Pyradon venom sacs. (NOTE: can only be done once per log in)

quests.name: Tasty!
quests.description: These chaorrupted critters can be tricky to feed, but one thing I've noticed all of them will eat is egg yolks. Just outside the door, you'll find some chaos eggs. Can you collect their yolks for me so I can feed my pets?

quests.name: Field Work
quests.description: New assistant! I need some more data on a few species of chaorrupted creatures! I must stay here and mind the shop, but can you do the field work for me. right? I need info on the Chaotic Chinchilizards in /bloodtuskwar, the Chais Sp-Eyes in /mobius, and the Chaos Spiders in /chaosmarsh. Just fight them for awhile, and record how they respond.

quests.name: Making Gel
quests.description: These Chinchilizards can't take normal baths - it takes their fur ages to dry. So, what I do is give them dust baths, and then condition their fur with Chinchili-Gel! It's my own invention, made from Violet Slime. I'm running really low right now, and I need to make some more. Bring me 5 buckets of slime - that should be enough to keep them clean for awhile!

quests.name: Lycan Pirate Medal
quests.description: The Crimson Veil's crew be waltzing around like they've already won. Howl with the pack, and rip out their fangs. They'll be gumming at guppies when we're done with'em, harharhar!

quests.name: Mega Lycan Pirate Medal
quests.description: Those bloodsuckers be dressin' all noble-like, but they're leeches all the same. Even snakes 'ave our respect more, because at least none of them be pretending they ain't beasts. Stand up, pup. Show'em that the Full Moon sails fer blood!

quests.name: Bloodsong
quests.description: Get out of the water! Vampires be lurking in the depths, an' they reek worse than fly-infested corpses. Who are they? Was Bonnie's crew larger than we thought? Bring me their blood, and I'll have their scent.

quests.name: Key to the ShadowLord
quests.description: IF you are brave enough to face the Shadow Lord, collect the items required to unlock the Portal by slaying the guardians in the Shadow Realm. If you are a Legend in AQWorlds, you can go right to the boss!

quests.name: Silent Sentinel Medallion
quests.description: Bring back 5 Jus Divium Signet Rings and exchange them for 1 Silent Sentinel Medallion
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Agent Sloan's Quests .

quests.name: Sentinels Writ
quests.description: Gather 10 Strange Knight Helms and exchange them for 1 Sentinels Writ.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Agent Sloan's Quests .

quests.name: Sentinels Platinum Coin
quests.description: Return with Baxter's Broken Guardian Blade and exchange it for one hard to obtain Sentinels Platinum Coin!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Agent Sloan's Quests .

quests.name: Stone Cold Monster
quests.description: Just outside Battleon in Eastern Greenguard Forest, beneath a tree stump you'll you will find the Greenguard Basilisk. This creature has been turning Guardians to stone. We may be able to reverse the process if you bring me a Vial of Basilisk Venom. Please, help us!

quests.name: Chaos Forge Enchantment
quests.description: Bring the Sneevil Smith a Rune of Chaos Enchantment from a Chaos Lord and he will apply it to a random Chaos Forge weapon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Chaos Forge in your house inventory.

quests.name: Snowball Thinks You're the Best
quests.description: Snowball says you're awesome. Zoshi doesn't know how awesome you are, not yet. But he will. You just have to show him. Kill the worst bosses in the Tower of Doom… Slugbutter, Dread Fang, Dread Avatar, Dread Warrior, Dread Terror. Bring him their Dread Teeth as proof. Also… ALSO a Dread Talon from a Mutated Void Dragon. THEN he'll know. Maybe he'll even reward you for it!

quests.name: Seven Sisters
quests.description: Have you met the seven sisters yet? I owe each and every one of them my life. They all found me, and together they took care of me while my wounds healed. Why don't you go and introduce yourself to all seven of them, and come back to me when you're done.

quests.name: Warm and Furry
quests.description: After I escaped from Dwarfhold I had to make my way through the pine forest surroundin' the mountain. The area is SWARMIN' with all sorts of nasty beasties, but the bears are the worst of them. If you can bring me 5 Bear Skins, then I know that my axe will be in good hands.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shell Shock
quests.description: As much as I love it here in this tavern, it can get a bit dull sometimes. I have to come up with ways to entertain myself. One thing that I LOVE to do is gamble, but my gamblin' buddy, Donna Charmer the Ilama Farmer, got mad at our last game and stormed off with the cards. I can make some more out of turtle shell but I need you to go to the forest and bring me 5 Red Turtle Shells.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bear Facts
quests.description: In the pine forest, there is a chaorrupted grizzly that the locals have named Twistedtooth. None of the hunters who have gone after him have come back, and he's been scaring off all the usual customers in the Inn. No customers means no one to gamble with, and that means no GOLD. Get rid of Twistedtooth, will ya? Maybe then I can get back to my card games.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Give Snowbeard His Gold
quests.description: Is that my gold I see in those grubby little mitts? Give it here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Follow your Nose! ' quest.

quests.name: Creative Urge
quests.description: The Yew Mountain mines are temporarily closed, but a Dwarf's hands can't be kept still. We need materials to craft with. Here's a very easy favor. Bring back a Gemrald Shard from /Dwarfhold, and I'll forge you something nice.

quests.name: A Little Generosity
quests.description: One of Thelima's guards owes me gold, but they seem to be avoiding me. Problem is, I can't remember who they were! A lot of folks ask for a little generosity from old Snowbeard! Sniff 'em out, and I'll share some of the interest with you.

quests.name: Fossil Find Fiend
quests.description: Aaah, Hero. I find my duties as a Troll Elder prevent me from the archeological excursions I found so fascinating in my youth! Please gather 10 Buried Fossils from the ground and split open 3 rocks to find Hidden Fossils, then bring your findings back to me!

quests.name: The Low Elvish Language
quests.description: I wish to share my knowledge with you, but i fear you will not able to learn all you can unless you have study aids. Bring me 10 Dictionary Page 1's, hidden inside The Trollola Plants, and 10 Translation Page 1's, stolen by Rhison. You will learn the language AND more of our culture at the same time!

quests.name: The High Trollic Language
quests.description: I wish to share my knowledge with you, but I fear you will not able to learn all you can unless you have study aids. Break 10 Rocks to find Dictionary Page 2's hidden under them and gather 10 Translation Page 2's, which can be found abandoned by Trollola Plants. Learn the language AND more of our culture at the same time!

quests.name: The Low Trollic Language
quests.description: I wish to share my knowledge with you, but I fear you will not able to learn all you can unless you have study aids. By combining 10 vivals of Vulture Spit with 5 Pulverized Ravine Rocks, I can make the potion to reveal the invisible ink Low Trollic texts are written in. Learn the language AND more of our culture at the same time!

quests.name: Philosophy of Mortality in Non-Trolls: A Study
quests.description: I am getting old, Hero. But I refuse to give up my studies! I would like, though, to know more about the nature of Death. It is a topic much on my mind. Please bring me back the notes after having slain 10 Vultures, 5 Boars, 5 Rhinson, and 1 Trollola Plant. I am interested in how each meets death. Especially the plant.

quests.name: The Time Grows Closer
quests.description: To summon the Twin Watchers, you must wait for the eclipse, which draws nigh. That is the only time this summons will work, if you want them to answer your questions truthfully. I will need to fix my eclipse predictor, though, and for that I'll need 5 Lemurphant Stones and 5 Koalion Down-fur.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Horcs Stink! ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Dregas' Mysterious Request
quests.description: Dregas will reward you well if you can bring 3 Eyes from Lemurphants, 5 Tentacles from Horcboars, and 3 Tusks from Koalions. I am not sure what he will do with them, and I do not want to know.

quests.name: Bachius' Disturbing Request
quests.description: Bachius is eager for trophies for slain Chaorrupted beasts. I… worry about this. But I cannot deny his request at time. Please bring back 5 Chaorrupted Tusks from Chinchilizards, 5 Chaorrupted Tentacles from Vultragon, and 3 Chaorrupted Eyes from Rhisons.

quests.name: Oishii's Disgusting Request
quests.description: … *sigh*. Oishii is requesting Chaorrupted meat. She wants to… experiment with it in kitchen. You're a Hero, you'll be brave enough to try her condictions, yes? Bring back 5 Chaorrupted Tentacles from Horcboars, 5 Chaorrupted Tusks from Rhison, and 3 Chaorrupted Eys from Chaorrupted Trigriff!

quests.name: Guarded Secrets, Hidden Treasures
quests.description: Please, Hero, make your way to the Temple and venture down the furthest reaches of the mine below it. There you will find — I hope — our store of Ore. Return to me with proof that all is well and I will be most reassured!
quests.requirements_note: Must have defeated Chaotic Troll in Bloodtusk War (Location) Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Evidence of Chaos
quests.description: It is true, then! The Ore is gone! But was it the Chaos Lord, or mere bandits and mauraders? Were it the latter, we would have some hope of regaining it. Should my fears prove out, though… Please discover whether or not Chaos has defiled our Temple. Collect all of the Chaorrupted parts of the landscape that you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have defeated Chaotic Troll in Bloodtusk War (Location) Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Learn More of the Ore
quests.description: Thanks to you, Hero, we have proof that Chaos is involved. But we still do not know the identity of the Horc Chaos Lord! Perhaps… perhaps Kagg does not know which member of his tribe has betrayed him, either. Bring me 10 Monster Memories; I will try to extract from them any information they hold.
quests.requirements_note: Must have defeated Chaotic Troll in Bloodtusk War (Location) Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Too Little, Too Late. Still Needed.
quests.description: I know now that it is too late to protect our Temple from the defilement that it has already suffered, but we can prevent any more minions of Chaos from tainting this sacred space. Bring me 5 Sharpened Bone Stakes from any of the monsters and lay 10 traps throughout the Temple and it's mines. This shall not happen again!
quests.requirements_note: Must have defeated Chaotic Troll in Bloodtusk War (Location) Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Alliance Defiance
quests.description: It is, I see now, inevitable that we shall come into conflict with the Horc Chaos Lord whether the Alliance is here to protect us or not. Arm my kin, Hero, so that we may aid you in our own defense! The monsters in the area should have the parts to make weapons on them. Bring 6 of those resources back to me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have defeated Chaotic Troll in Bloodtusk War (Location) Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: In the Headquarters of Good and Evil
quests.description: Before we can speak of theese… Peacemakers… we must find FIND them! Hunt through the Alliance Headquarters and locate the representatives of Good and Evil.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Alliance Defiance ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Threat Nullification, Good and Bad
quests.description: The time for talk is done. The Alliance representatives will not listen to us, so we must use all of our wits, magic and bladework to force them out! Take out 2 squads – 6 soldiers – of both Good and Evil warriors to show them we will not bow before them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Alliance Defiance ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Trap the Keepers
quests.description: Soldiers are often narrow-minded. Their helms do not allow them to see in all directions… or all possibilities. Lay 10 traps for these Alliance soldiers and they will fail without injuring either you or my people!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Alliance Defiance ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find What is Hidden Inside
quests.description: I sense potentially important information hidden nearby. Objects with the taint of Chaos on them. It is vital we maintain any edge we can over Chaos. Find these items and bring them to me so we may see what they can tell us!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Alliance Defiance ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaorruption Annihillation
quests.description: Whatever is Chaorrupting the Alliance leaders has had an effect on their soldiers, too! They are even more dangerous than the unChaorrupted Good and Evil soldiers! Remove 15 of these foul beings from our home!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Alliance Defiance ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Alliance Demotion
quests.description: We cannot allow Chaorrupted Alliance leaders to threaten the peace of Bloodtusk Ravine. What little peace it has left, that is. If we detain Tibias and Cynari, perhaps we can save them. AFTER we take care of the threat of the Horc Chaos Lord!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Alliance Defiance ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Contain the Chaorruption
quests.description: Arashtiian lore holds that at one time, Trolls and Horcs lived here in peace. I can almost believe it… and I wish we could return to such a time! I would not see this sacred ground defiled by Chaorruption. Remove the purple stain from this land by killing 12 Chaorrupted beasts!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Alliance Demotion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Ancient Ointment
quests.description: It is undeniable truth that our ancestors produced items of great power here. It is possible that some of their blessed oil remains in the urns I see scattered around the temple grounds. I fear some of the Chaorrupted Beasts have stolen some, as well. Collect them so that I may test it to see if power remains.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Alliance Demotion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Anoint the Ancients
quests.description: Hero, let me anoint your weapon with this sacred oil. When you defeat the half-mad, Chaorrupted Guardian Spirits, the power of the oil should transfer to them. If the Singing Gods are with us, this will save them from the taint. Apply the cure to 12 Chaorrupted Guardian Spirits!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Alliance Demotion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Serpents Do No Harm
quests.description: Those wretched vermin infest only this region of BloodTusk Ravine. They have long been considered harbingers of death and disease. But perhaps we can make good use of their presence. Their venom would make a potent defoliant. Kill 5 Serpentresses to collect their venom!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Alliance Demotion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Though Nature Bars the Way
quests.description: The heart of the temple is in danger, Hero! I sense the forces of nature, spirit, and Chaorruption mingling inside it. Krellenos is there! Apply the snake-poison to the plant barring your way 3 times and the way to the temple center should be clear.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Alliance Demotion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Salvage Ancient Heritage
quests.description: Long have we refrained from entering these grounds. Now that we are here, I see it has fallen into complete disrepair. Our heritage is being ground into dust! Please, Hero, collect the ancient carvings you see laying on the ground and take them from the monsters who have stolen them.

quests.name: Serpentess Scourge
quests.description: Ancient tales tell of how the Serpentresses were once beautiful Troll maidens who grew bitter and spread lies, disrupting the community. The Singing Gods changed them into snake-women to punish them. Now they defile this temple! Remove 15 of them that we may show the Singing Gods that we uphold the fruits of their wisdom.

quests.name: Descent Into Darkness
quests.description: Hero, we fear that Krellenos has imprisoned the kidnapped Alliance leaders inside the heart of our land. We bear them ill will no longer. They are as much victims of Chaos as we. As great a threat, we believe he is searching for the last unspoiled cache of Arashtite Ore left in our land. Find him, and the leaders!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Though Nature Bars the Way ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Out of the Darkness
quests.description: If you are going to illuminate Krellenos' plans, you will need to see exactly what is in the cavern. Gather 5 Light Orbs from the Liassi Plants, and you should be able to take 10 more from the beasts there. Legend says they are drawn to bright, shiny things.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Though Nature Bars the Way ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shine a Light on Deception
quests.description: Reveal what remains to be seen by placing 5 Light Orbs around the cavern. Be wary, for there is no telling who - or what - could be waiting for you there!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Though Nature Bars the Way ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Save Yourself, Save the Soldiers
quests.description: Krellenos has Chaorrupted upright, loyal soldiers of the Alliance, Hero! I know they will want to attack you, but remember, they ARE still our Allies! Keep yourself from harm, but try to incapacitate 14 of the Soldiers so that we may save SOME of them from their Chaorruption in the future.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Though Nature Bars the Way ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle the Baas!
quests.description: It is a fearsome thing you face, Hero! Krellenos has Chaorrupted a despised creature, one no Troll willingly touches. They are unclean, unworthy. And now… he has harnessed its poisoned nature and rock magic to ensure that NO ONE can stop him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Though Nature Bars the Way ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Hierophant
quests.description: We are in the Fool's Realm? Unlike you and the others, I am not directly tethered to the Primordial's power. Not to mention, I was not trained in combat. I won't be of use to you if we need to fight, but I can assist in any area of study. The first issue I'd like to tackle is our lack of supplies and tools. Are there ways we would be able to procure them without leaving this realm? You can open dimensional rifts? That's incredible! Please demonstrate!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Emperor ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Lovers, Reversed
quests.description: To grow the clone you had in mind, I advise running trial tests first. I was not able to successfully create a full copy of a person while I was at the Academy. Since the rifts are open, there should be all manner of beasts available to us. I'll lure them in and have Aurola help you…You want her to rest instead? I see. Please, exercise caution when you fight the beasts. We don't fully know what your new body is capable of.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Emperor ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Chariot
quests.description: We require tools and materials to conduct trial runs. Acquiring them from Astravia is too risky, and Drago must have already confiscated the Capital's technology. I hesitated to ask this of you before. But, if you are determined to return to the First Observatory, we must do it now. With a body from the Primordial Fool, you won't be able to traverse Lore soon. We need to gather as many machine parts as we can. Or anything of possible use.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Emperor ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Strength
quests.description: Though the trial runs were a success, I hesitate to operate on Titania or Regulus until I am certain the process works with humans. Under normal circumstances, Astravians turn to dust when they perish. It would be difficult to conduct tests with the traitors. Aurola is uneasy about the idea as well. In that case, I have heard of supposed undead existing in Lore. Please open rifts to these locations and I will lure them in for Aurola's peace of mind.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Emperor ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Hermit
quests.description: The organs were compatible with Ti and Re. They are…as close to their original selves as we can manage. We're prepared to move on to cloning a copy of you. I created a larger tank and a gate similar to the First Observatory's. Our final problem is the massive amount of energy needed to power them both. To this end, we need a rift that leads to the generator under Astravia. Proceed with caution. Dismantling it may cause it to become hostile.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Emperor ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Fishy Frenzy
quests.description: Hero? Ah, good, you're there. I'm going to communicate with you telepathically as you make your way through. Remember: each psyche you visit is representative of the person it belongs to.

quests.name: Love You To DEATH
quests.description: Even love can become warped and twisted over time—until it becomes an obsession. Take care of that beast, so we can set things right.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Heart Token I in your inventory.

quests.name: Potion Commotion
quests.description: Potion bottles? Hmm…there are an awful lot of them around. Could this be Alina's psyche? You'll have to clear our these bottles before you can proceed. And some of them may have spilled back into the previous psyches—you'll need to retrieve those, as well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Heart Token II in your inventory.

quests.name: The Melancholy of Alina
quests.description: Even the strongest potions can't cure a heartbreak—and Alina knows that very well. Defeat her sorry to ease her pain and clear her mind of any doubts.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Heart Token III in your inventory.

quests.name: The Escapist
quests.description: Is that… Twilly? I suppose all that punting has gone to his head, literally. If you want to get him down from there, you'll need to do something about that cage. Go back to Alina's psyche and see if you can't find any corrosive potions lying around. Once you have a potion, you can use it to get Twilly out of that cage!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Heart Token IV in your inventory.

quests.name: A Wary Library
quests.description: Books? This must be Maya's psyche. I wonder if…hmm. She seems pretty happy. I think we should leave this one alone. But these flying books are a nuisance. We can't have them escaping into the next area, so take a few of them out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Heart Token V in your inventory.

quests.name: The More You Glow
quests.description: For this next psyche, you'll have to…wait, you can't see anything? *sigh* Good thing I slipped you that pouch of mana dust before you left. Spread it around and see if you can't light up the area. Let me know if you find any clues.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Heart Token VI in your inventory.

quests.name: Socktacular Slayhem
quests.description: So this is Cysero's psyche. I…can't really say I expected anything different. It looks like you'll have to clear out some of these sock wraiths before you can continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Heart Token VII in your inventory.

quests.name: Socktimus Prime
quests.description: Cysero's great fear is not being able to find his left sock? That's…surprisingly useful information. I should write this down… Er, right. In any case, we should defeat that sock monster. You know, to restore order and all.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Heart Token VIII in your inventory.

quests.name: Primordial Fear
quests.description: Wait…what's going on? This isn't Cysero's psyche… It's…so cold. Whose fear is this? Whoever this person is, they've been afflicted by one of the worst fears of all—the primordial fear of death. Defeat Thanatops to try and free this person from their torment.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Heart Token IX in your inventory.

quests.name: Bunnihilation
quests.description: And this is…? Oh. This must be Aria's psyche.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Heart Token X in your inventory.

quests.name: Bunnihilation, Vol. II
quests.description: This is it, Hero. The greatest emotional disturbance leads to here. Raw anger is dangerous. And Aria has plenty of it to back her up. Wait…is that a giant bunny?
quests.requirements_note: Must have Heart Token XI in your inventory.

quests.name: Unrequited Love
quests.description: Looks like I'm on my own for this one… That thing must have escaped from Sora's own psyche. And it's been twisted by everyone's residual emotions. If it escapes the timelock…Sora will die, Warlic will be destroyed, and all of Battleon will be in danger. For everyone's sake, I have to take it down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Heart Token XII in your inventory.

quests.name: Beautiful Creatures and their Uses
quests.description: If you ask me, the nicest masquerade masks always have feathers! For these, I'm thinking something long, downy, and purple. Like, say… the feathers from the Void Phoenixes in the /timevoid. Think you could get me some?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Every Party Needs Drinks ' quest.

quests.name: Ooh, Shiny!
quests.description: I have a strong vision here. And that vision involves a bunch of sparkling crystals to go with those pretty purple feathers! Head to /skytower, and break off some tiny crystals from the Moonstones, Sunstones, and Star Sapphires there. They'll be perfect!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Time to get Dressed Up!
quests.description: You're coming with us, right? Looks like we're all set… except for ONE IMPORTANT THING! Get Barb's Gilded bookmark back from the Grim Goblin that stole it. Then put on your Mystcroft Formalwear and Sheevra Offering, and then talk to Loremaster Barb when you're ready to go! You can put your mask on too, but you don't have to.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: EEEEK
quests.description: Aaah! What? He… he sicced a big, mean, infernal dog on us? They really ARE evil! Kill it with fire!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Memory #3 - Wraithing Away
quests.description: Quick! Help me get rid of these time wraiths before they unravel our very being!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Activate the Spacetimebobulator ' quest.

quests.name: Memory #3 - Echoes
quests.description: We'll have to get rid of these… these ECHOES of our past selves before we'll be able to move on. They're not us, not really - they're just artifacts that have been created from the timelines crashing into each other. So don't worry, it won't hurt us. Just… hurry up, ok?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Activate the Spacetimebobulator
quests.description: Activate the Spacetimebobulator to summon the next festive Frostval experience!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Sneak Out
quests.description: We'd better get out of here. Let's try to sneak out the back before anyone sees us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Nap Time for Barb quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once.

quests.name: Break Out
quests.description: This guy wants to block us from leaving, does he? Fine We'll just go through him, then.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Welcome to Dragonrune Hall
quests.description: Hi, Hero! Welcome to Dragonrune Hall, Lore's academy for aspiring spellcasters! I'm your Headmistress, Sora to Hoshi. Now that you're here, you'll want to introduce yourself to the heads of our four schools of magic! You'll be working closely with them in future.

quests.name: Into the Void
quests.description: The Planeshifter has sent its scouts ahead of itself, and some of them have already reached us. We've got to protect the band - and the audience - from them! Fight off as many as you can.

quests.name: The Show Must Go On
quests.description: We may be in trouble, but the show must go on! We have to make sure the audience is still having a great time. Get them some water to keep them hydrated - and some souvenirs from this ordeal! I bet the Shattered Rockers the show has attracted will have some of both.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can not be accessed after completing the 'One Big Kaboom' quest.

quests.name: One Big Kaboom
quests.description: We're going to try to use Breaking Benjamin's music to get us out of here and away from the Planeshifter. But we're going to need a lot of mana to power it! As you may have noticed, my “fireworks” plus this awesome music equaled one big kaboom! Gather up some of the stray mana from that, and we'll be good.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defensive Maneuvers
quests.description: The Planeshifter's void monsters are already here! Fight them off like you did before. We have to make sure they don't attack the band - or any of these fans!

quests.name: It's So Cold
quests.description: Brr- it's FREEZING here! We've gotta do something to keep these people warm. Gather up some coals - I think the eyes of those Snow Golems will work - and then use them to light a few campfires.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Hit the Lights
quests.description: These music fans need a distraction from all of this. I'm thinking some icy confetti, floating in the air under those stage lights, would look amazing! Scrape some off of the Ice Elementals.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can not be accessed after completing the 'Frozen' quest.

quests.name: Frozen
quests.description: We'd better start gathering up mana again if we don't want to be caught unprepared when the Planeshifter catches up with us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: System Failure!
quests.description: We'd better start gathering up mana again if we don't want to be caught unprepared when the Planeshifter catches up with us.

quests.name: Torn Apart
quests.description: Our presence here is tearing this world apart! We've got to slow down the damage as much as we can. See if you can contain some of those spinning vortexes, and put out the fires their sparking energy has caused.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get Us Out Of Here!
quests.description: I'm going to need to channel some mana to the band again, so they can get us out of here before the Planeshifter shows up. The mana here is a little unstable, though, so maybe you'd better bring back a little extra, just in case.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Plane: Shifted
quests.description: Come on - let's kick this thing's butt so we can get back home!

quests.name: Jingle Spells
quests.description: Have fun caroling, and be careful. If you run into any monsters, drive them away. We need to teach them that hunting carolers isn't going to get them an easy meal! Our neighbors will give you reagents as a gift for the song, and for getting rid of the unwelcome guests.

quests.name: Soul Eater Collection Badge
quests.description: [Gives character page badge] Bring me the soul of the ArchFiend Dragonlord in the Underlair, and my appetite — for a short time — will be sated
quests.requirements_note: Must have Soul Eater's Badge Pet in your inventory.

items.name: Devourer of Souls Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: The Soul Forge Hammer (Unlock Soul Forge)
quests.description: Check out my Soul Forge. Pretty epic, I know. And if you want to use it, you're going to need to make your own Soul Forge Hammer. Bring me an Iron Hammer from the Skeletal Warriors in BattleUnder, Zardman's Stonehammer from the Grunts in the Forest, and the Elemental Rock Hammer from that Rock boss in Bludrut.
quests.requirements_note: Must not have SoulForge Hammer in your inventory to access this quest.

quests.name: Activate the Spacetimebobulator
quests.description: Go ahead and activate the Spacetimebobulator, buddy! Let's find Warlic the holiday cheer he so desperately needs!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Memory #1 - Yeti or Not ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Activate the Spacetimebobulator
quests.description: Activate the Spacetimebobulator to summon the next festive Frostval experience!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Memory #2 - Xanta Claus Can't Come ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Activate the Spacetimebobulator
quests.description: Activate the Spacetimebobulator to summon the next festive Frostval experience!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Memory #3 - Echoes ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Bring the Cheer!
quests.description: *The spacetimebobulator beeps happily at you* You have averted catastrophe and saved Frostval! The Spacetimebobulator's light is green, and it will take you through time to unlock a very cheery gift from the moglins of Frostvale! Relive the adventure and recover the following: a Wrapped Parcel from Wargoth, a Burning Bow from Xanta Claus, a Time Ribbon from the Time Wraith, and Yeti Fur from IceMaster Yeti.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Memory #4 - The Frozen Warlock ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Guardian Spirit
quests.description: Although I was not able to retrieve the Celestial Horn of Balance, I know what needs to be done. For all Brightoak, you must defeat the Guardian spirit and restore balance to Elfhame!

quests.name: Corruption of Elfhame
quests.description: I'm thankful you've arrived, so much is at stake. The future of Birghtoak depends on us getting the Celestial Horn of Balance back and activating the Guardian Statue. The Queen has corrupted this region and Brightoak will be next if we don't work fast! Examine what's left of Elfhame and begin your extermination of the Ruin Stalkers.

quests.name: Restoring Nature
quests.description: There has been a dire disruption of peace between wildlife and Elfhame's people. In order to restore the balance of nature, I will need some ingredients to create a restoration potion. Purchase Bastet's Water of Life in /sandsea (Make sure to buy more than one… we will need multiple potions to save this land), recover four Herbal Remedies from Wolfwoods and three Bright Ores from Bright Treeants in /brightoak. This potion might just be what we need!

quests.name: Unlock the Guardian's First Rune
quests.description: The mouth of the Guardian Statue HAS to be opened or else we may NEVER stop the poison seeping into the World Tree! You will have to activate four runes located on various areas on the statue's legs. Once you've cleared the are and restored some of the nature in Elfhame, the rune will activate.

quests.name: Gnome Sweet Gnome
quests.description: The Ruin Dweller gnomes prevent us from getting what we need done! Eliminate this creature's threat in Elfhame, and then travel to /mudluk and speak with Paddylump - his elixir will help us clear the are of those wretched gnomes.

quests.name: Unlock the Guardian's Second Rune
quests.description: The second rune located on the statue's right arm is far more decayed than the 1st rune on the leg. We need a stronger restoration of nature to activate this rune. Be sure to rid the area Gnome Wolfriders in the area or they will never let you restore the arm in piece.

quests.name: I Know kaRATe
quests.description: Much like the gnomes, the Ratawampus pose the same threat to our efforts. Your task is simple - take them down.

quests.name: Unlock the Guardian's Third Rune
quests.description: Time is running out and we still have two more tunes to activate. Clear the Ratawampus' from the area so that the third runes, located on the statue's torso, can be unlocked. The corruption of the Queen of Monsters is even stronger here, so you'll need more Restoration of Nature potion than before.

quests.name: Unlock the Guardian's Fourth Rune
quests.description: The fourth and last rune will require the largest number of Restoration Potions, so get to work. Every minute we spend out here reduces our change of keeping Brightoak safe. You will have to put in your best effort to restore nature to unlock the fourth rune and clear the Ruin Stalkers that are preventing the rune's activation. We need more restoration of nature now than ever for a chance to break through Elfhame's corruption.

quests.name: Unlocking the Guardian's Mouth
quests.description: All four of the runes have been activated. The puzzle to open the Guardian's Mouth is the final obstacle. Solve it and we can confront the spirit!

quests.name: Defeat the Guardian Spirit
quests.description: Although I was not able to retrieve the Celestial Horn of Balance, I know what needs to be done. For all Brightoak, you must defeat the Guardian spirit and restore balance to Elfhame!

quests.name: Strengthen the Bond (Farming Quest)
quests.description: My spirit remains, but it's presence on Lore is weakening. Bring me what I need to reconnect to the earth - any form of physical life that would pin my spirit to Brightoak. I cannot move on and leave my people in their direst hour of need.

quests.name: The Path of the King
quests.description: If you wish to take up King Alteon's blade and ideals, you must prove yourself worthy by following in his footsteps. Battle Alden's greatest foes:
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Chaos Lord Alteon ' and ' Familial Blessing ' quests. | Must have Rank 10 Swordhaven .

quests.name: Plague of Zom-Bays
quests.description: Captain, hostile life forms are suspected. These creatures deviate from all known equine-adjacent species. We must proceed with all due caution as we investigate. Defeat 10 of these Zom-Bays so we can obtain samples to study.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' AFK Quest ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Foal of (Thorough) Dread
quests.description: Bones has examined Ensign Ash's remains, and is filled with concern. He fears the corpse may begin turning. He is stallion as long as he can while you gather more data. I require 10 more samples from another thoroughly dreadful species.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' AFK Quest ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Create a Stable Base
quests.description: The plague of ponies is nearly upon us. We will need a stable base with the ship at its centaur, to make sure the AI has enough time to repair all the damage. Bones reports a number of equines approaching at a fast prance. Slay them quickly, before the entire herd is upon us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' AFK Quest ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bonies & Bonies & Bonies
quests.description: Captain! The zombie pony herd just keeps coming. You must prevent them from overrunning the ship. We are in a race against time, the stakes are higher than any of us can imagine. Before you can take out their Lead Stallion, you'll need to slay the entire herd.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' AFK Quest ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Mr DED
quests.description: This race against time and zombie equines is neck-and-neck, and time has run out. Defeat Mr. DED, the DoomKnightmare, so that we can get off this moon and return home.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' AFK Quest ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Terrestrial Seasonings
quests.description: Sput need some flavorings for boar sausage and me has run out! You go collect things for I? Me need 5 Boar Bristles, 1 Boar's backbone and 10 Dyed feathers from vultures. Bring to I?

quests.name: Material Horc in a Material World
quests.description: You strong hero. Look for work? Trader come to K'thurr sometimes and want to trade things for rare spices. Me need you gather 10 Geodes from area and 10 Rhison Tusks. You do this thing for Sput?

quests.name: Boar Ears in Salted-Butter Sauce
quests.description: Want me show you how make old Horc recipe? Me need 7 Quarts of Rhison Milk, 1 vial of Rhison Tears, and 12 Boar Ears. bring to me and me will teach you how to do it RIGHT!

quests.name: Sput's Really Big Cleaver
quests.description: Horcs be hungry ALL the time. Good eaters need lots of food. Most of time me use this cleaver for breaking down meat but SOME BIG rhison out there. Sometimes me need to use me REALLY BIG CLEAVER. You want? You bring me 12 Rhison Steaks and maybe I give to you. Deal?

quests.name: Hunter Gatherers
quests.description: Horcs never get the knack of farming. Kagg plant few things but it never work well. Are you good hunter? Good gatherer? Sput need a LOT of food for tribe. Go slay 10 Vultures, 5 Boars, 5 Rhison, and 1 Trollola Plant then bring all food back to Sput!

quests.name: Facing Vath
quests.description: Vath is just up ahead! Please… for all the Dwarves, take him out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Rock Roc ' quest.

quests.name: The 3rd Proto-Chaos Beast
quests.description: The Crystal Dragonoid hunted the Shadowscythe, but is a lesson that even the most powerful creatures can become lost to time, wandering through space. Do not lose sight of who YOU are… or what your ultimate destiny is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mysterious! ' quest.

quests.name: Bullies
quests.description: These undead bullies have taken over the entire village! We have to get rid of them if we’re going to save its people. Come on, you’ve done this plenty of times! Just kill as many as you can find!

quests.name: Free the People
quests.description: Remember how I told you these guys have been converting everyone to drones, making their army even bigger? Well, that's what they're planning to do to all those people in cages. We've gotta let them out! The cages are locked, though, so you'll have to figure out where to get the keys.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sample It
quests.description: I don't know if we can save the people who have already been converted. But if we can, the secret is in that tech. If we can get some samples of it, then our allies can examine it and try to find a cure.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Swat the Flies
quests.description: Have you seen those flying techno-monsters roaming around? I'm pretty sure that's how the infection is spreading. They attach to people's heads, and then… BOOM! Another Deadtech minion. If we can dismantle them, then the people here will be safer… for now.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reclaim the Supplies
quests.description: These jerks have been stealing the villagers' food and water supplies to draw them out of hiding. We have to get them back! You'll help, right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Zyrus is Lost
quests.description: It's too late for poor Zyrus, but we can still save everyone else. Come on, hero, let’s fight! Defeat this monster he’s created so we can rescue the others.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Need a Distraction ' quest.

quests.name: Investigate the Tech
quests.description: Listen, hero… I've been thinking about how these Deadtech work. There must be something that drives them, right? We might be able to use it against them. Try and see if you can defeat a few, and pick them apart. See what makes them tick.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Zyrus is Lost ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Deadtech
quests.description: Looks like the Deadtech have figured out that we're after my father's axe! Slay as many as you can, hero, while I try to get my bearings in this forest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Zyrus is Lost ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Gather Spell Components
quests.description: The axe has been kept safe all these years by a cloaking spell that hides it from prying eyes. If we want to find it, we'll need to break the spell. Help me gather the components, won't you? I need a handful of acorns, and some pollen from the local treeants.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Zyrus is Lost ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Few Things More
quests.description: Just a couple more things, and I'll be able to break the spell! Bring me some marrow from the bones of the NecroDrones, and a pristine wishbone from a NecroMech.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Zyrus is Lost ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Search for the Axe
quests.description: The spell has been cast. Follow the trail of light magic, and it will lead us to the resting place of my father's axe. Go on ahead and I'll meet you there. I still have some Deadtech to defeat -- we can't let them follow us to the axe!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Zyrus is Lost ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Keys
quests.description: All of these prisoners… and we haven’t even gotten to the main cell block yet. Help me find the keycards to their cages so we can break them out. The guards will be the ones to have them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take the Axe! ' quest. Note: These quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Ew, Rats
quests.description: Six keys, six cages… we'll be able to release them all, now. Make sure you kill the rotting rats inside the cages, too -- I don't even want to think about what kind of disease they'll spread if you don't.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take the Axe! ' quest. Note: These quest can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Grab Their Gear
quests.description: You see that big, armored door back there? I think that's where they're keeping the rest of the prisoners. As you may have noticed, it's heavily guarded, so we'll have to find a way past. I bet if we can get some of the guards' armor, we can convince them to let us through.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take the Axe! ' quest. Note: These quest can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Talk to the Guard
quests.description: Okay… now go talk to the guards and see if they'll let us through!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take the Axe! ' quest. Note: These quest can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Let Them Out!
quests.description: Hey, would you look at that! They're not even giving us a second look! We can just walk back there and open the cage.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take the Axe! ' quest. Note: These quest can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Head on Out
quests.description: Hurry, hero - get the prisoners out of here! Leave through the back, I’ll fend them off the way we came in!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take the Axe! ' quest. Note: These quest can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Take Him Down
quests.description: You’ll have to hope Stellaria can hold her own against Asherion. It’s up to you to defeat Kalron… and free the prisoners.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take the Axe! ' quest. Note: These quest can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Solemn Favor
quests.description: Hey, Hero, do you have some time to do me a favor? Many of the battles so far before you came along haven't gone this smoothly. Many great paladins and knights have fallen in battle against the Deadtech. But I think their souls still wander around the battlefield, and I want to try and put them to rest. Do you think you can gather some of their gear, and some of their energy, so we can properly send them off?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Him Down ' quest.

quests.name: I CPU U!
quests.description: They're still sending out their Crypthackers by the dozen. Smash them up and bring back their CPUs… that way they can't be reused, and won't be able to hurt anyone else.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Never Give Up ' quest. Note: Disappears from Stellaria after completing the 'The Final Form' quest.

quests.name: Keep Droning On
quests.description: These NecroDrones do NOT want us near the fortress! If we're going to meet with Asherion, we'll need to clear them all out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Never Give Up ' quest. Note: Disappears from Stellaria after completing the 'The Final Form' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Can be begun from the 'Quests' button on Screens 1-3.

quests.name: Gathering Data
quests.description: Some of the CryptHacker CPUs you brought back have had data in them from inside the fortress. If you find any more, please bring it to me. The more we know, the better prepared we can be.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Never Give Up ' quest. Note: Disappears from Stellaria after completing the 'The Final Form' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Can be begun from the 'Quests' button on Screens 1-3.

quests.name: Signal Flare
quests.description: It's time. Get a flare from one of the NecroDrones, and set it off to signal Asherion. He's watching for it, so he'll know it's us, and he'll open the door. But to anyone else who sees, it will just be another DeadTech flare. No one will suspect a thing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Never Give Up ' quest. Note: Disappears from Stellaria after completing the 'The Final Form' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Medal Time
quests.description: Asherion has gotten us inside the fortress, but we'll have to get past these guards on our own! Kill as many as you can, and bring me the medals they carry as proof.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Never Give Up ' quest. Note: Disappears from Stellaria after completing the 'The Final Form' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Hidden Data
quests.description: The Time Machine is in this fortress somewhere, but only the High Technolich knows where it is. However, these NecroMechs carry data inside their minds that not even they fully understand. Bring me enough of it, and maybe it will give us a clue!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Never Give Up ' quest. Note: Disappears from Stellaria after completing the 'The Final Form' quest. | Must have completed the 'Signal Flare' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Pass the CPU
quests.description: We’ll have to get past the CPU if we want to access the High Technolich's time machine. But he doesn’t stand a chance against the three of us!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Never Give Up ' quest. Note: Disappears from Stellaria after completing the 'The Final Form' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: The Guards
quests.description: The guards know we're here, and they do NOT look happy about it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Never Give Up ' quest. Note: Disappears from Stellaria after completing the 'The Final Form' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Circui-try This
quests.description: Hmm… did you see this circuitry? It's from the DoomBorg Guards. I think I can use it to rewire the DeadTech time machine. Bring me some more if you can find it, okay?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Never Give Up ' quest. Note: Disappears from Stellaria after completing the 'The Final Form' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: The Thing
quests.description: How could they turn my father into… into this THING? We cannot allow it to continue to exist. Come on -- fight with me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Never Give Up ' quest. Note: Disappears from Stellaria after completing the 'The Final Form' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: The Final Form
quests.description: I knew it couldn't be that easy… they wouldn't have kept him that close to human… Keep fighting!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Never Give Up ' quest. Note: Disappears from Stellaria after completing the 'The Final Form' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Like Father, Like Son
quests.description: What, my little brother wields our father's axe but he's not assisting you in combat? He needs some more motivation. Take him to the battlefield and have him slay 50 Deadtech soldiers. After he's warmed up, find some more powerful foes for him to fight. Maybe Dark Sepulchure, Maximilian Lionfang and Ultra Vordred would be a good place to start.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Never Give Up ' quest.

quests.name: The Edge of Destiny
quests.description: That axe you have, how?! No, it may look like my father's but they're not one and the same; yours is depleted of all its spirit power. You were good friends with my father, so if you wish to restore the axe to its former undead slaying glory, you should know what to do better than anyone else. (This quest empowers the Blinding Edge of Obsidian with Blinding Light of Destiny's undead slaying boost.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Never Give Up ' quest. | Must have Blinding Edge of Obsidian (Non-AC) in your inventory.

quests.name: The Edge of Destiny (AC)
quests.description: That axe you have, how?! No, it may look like my father's but they're not one and the same; yours is depleted of all its spirit power. You were good friends with my father, so if you wish to restore the axe to its former undead slaying glory, you should know what to do better than anyone else. (This quest empowers the Blinding Edge of Obsidian with Blinding Light of Destiny's undead slaying boost.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Never Give Up ' quest. | Must have Blinding Edge of Obsidian (AC) in your inventory.

quests.name: Forging a Friendship
quests.description: I don't know what I could do to thank you after all that you've done for us here. Perhaps I could forge you a set of armor just like mine? Firstly, we'll need a bunch of power from the undead. Then, Beleen in /tower can get you some pink dye. Lastly, you'll have to go find something I can empower it with… perhaps check in /undergroundlabb?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Final Form ' quest. Note: The quest names 'This Little Light Of Mine' and 'I'm Gonna Let It Shine' are a direct reference to the song This Little Light of Mine .

quests.name: This Little Light Of Mine
quests.description: This Axe is already loaded with orbs and aura, so we need to use some relics to really make stand out. About that though…The texts I found mention things that sound.. Otherworldly. Like nothing I have ever heard of - but we can possibly make something close to it. That one area named The Span has all sorts of rifts. One of them is sure to have the reagents we need. I'm sure you've been there before too, why not go collect some things and we'll see if they work?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Final Form ' quest. Note: The quest names 'This Little Light Of Mine' and 'I'm Gonna Let It Shine' are a direct reference to the song This Little Light of Mine .

quests.name: I'm Gonna Let It Shine
quests.description: Alright now that we have some pieces of this… Orb? I can't really tell what it could have been shattered like this, but there's no denying the energy coming off it. The final piece of the text says we need to purify the elemental essence of an enormous dragon, and I think you and I both know exactly what that means. Good luck with that one, friend. I'm sure you'll be able to do it.
