quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Final Form ' quest. Note: The quest names 'This Little Light Of Mine' and 'I'm Gonna Let It Shine' are a direct reference to the song This Little Light of Mine .

quests.name: Legendary Quest of Adventure
quests.description: Salutations, brave hero! You have found a most secret area; a place rarely seen by the outside eye. It is luck that has brought you here, and it is luck that will keep you alive. Maybe. Why not put your luck to the test? Go forth, hero, and bring back to me 6 Lucky Jade Talismans that the heathens in this land harbor behind their unyielding power!

quests.name: Classic Hack-n-Slash
quests.description: Alright. Now on to bigger, and um, better things? Go back out into the wilderness and defeat 6 monsters. Naw, you don't have to bring me back anything. Just hack-n-slash your way through 'em until that 'Quest Complete' message thing appears.

quests.name: Yeah, another quest
quests.description: Ok ok ok. For this quest, what you're gonna do is: kill the boss guy. Oh yeah, that's good. So, like, there's this dragon that… ah well you can figure it out.

quests.name: Insert Quest Title Here
quests.description: Ok so for this quest..umm…uh, do..something…go kill monster. Which one? Meeeeh…. idk. Surprise me.

quests.name: Galvanize the Guardian
quests.description: AVAILABLE AFTER CLEARING THE CRYPT *Sadness fills your mind.* I… know it is a great request I ask of thee. But, should thee find a Basilisk's Scale and a Scroll of Magic Inversion of any of the Crypt monsters, please… bring them to me and merge them! Thou wilt have created a Scroll of Cure Petrification!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Reconstruct the Codex ' quest.

quests.name: EN GARDE!
quests.description: This is your chance to defeat the Doomknight, Asherion - the High Technolich's powerful ally! Boy, Stellaria will be so happy about this.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cat Ears? ' quest. Note: Can only be accessed from Screen 2.

quests.name: Get the Axe
quests.description: I guess we don't have to stick around here anymore. Maybe we should head back to my father's axe so I can get more practice.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lesson 6: Searching ' quest. Note: Can only be accessed from Screen 10.

quests.name: Defeat the BioKnight
quests.description: This guy wants a fight? You’ll give him a fight!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Search for the Axe ' quest.

quests.name: Take the Axe!
quests.description: The Blinding Light of Destiny lies before you, waiting to be claimed…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Search for the Axe ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Sweet Heat Summer Badge
quests.description: You'll want to head to the /sunlightzone in Sea Base Undine and defeat that Marine Snow. If you're lucky, you'll get the Marine Snowcone. You bring me that sweet treat and I'll give you a character page badge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Strawberry Twilly Quest Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Battle for Stryche
quests.description: It's time to prove you have what it takes to train with me! Defeat 5 monsters in the training room and return to me with the proof! Once you give me the proof, I will reward you with my armor set!

quests.name: Curse of the Moon
quests.description: Hurry! We must strike down Marchosias, the Mooncursed beast, before his monsters destroy the entire village! He was last spotted in the town square in the east. Go! I'll be right behind you!

quests.name: Put out the Fire
quests.description: My village is still on fire. Please help me put it out! Beat at the dark flame until you have extinguished it all.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Curse of the Moon ' quest.

quests.name: The Most Dire of Beasts
quests.description: My clan has always had a connection to wolves. But these beasts… These monsters are something new. Almost like a cursed version of what we are. And they are killing us! We have to stop them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Curse of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Elder
quests.description: I don't know how to stop this. We must find our clan's leader, Elder Xubo. He'll know what to do. Search the village until you find him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Curse of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Send them Home
quests.description: We can't leave all of our fallen brothers and sisters lying on the ground. Burn their bodies so they can be put to rest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Curse of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Who are the Blood Moon Clan?
quests.description: Some of those who attack our village are not monsters at all, but human! In fact, I could swear some of them look like our own villagers under those masks. They are calling themselves the Blood Moon Clan. Interrogate them, and find out why they are doing this.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Curse of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Light the Torches
quests.description: In order to break this curse, we need to recover the Skull of Voland. The Blood Moon Clan must have it, but I don't know where they're keeping it. Luckily, I know a ritual that can help us find out. First, bring me some of that Dark Fire. Take these torches, and light them with its flame.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Curse of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gather the Blood
quests.description: If this curse is related to the Skull of Voland, then I should be able to use the curse to find it. Bring me 6 vials of cursed blood from the Eclipsed Ones in the village.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Curse of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Skull!
quests.description: The ritual is finished - the Skull of Voland is in the possession of one of Marchosias' most loyal followers. Find him. and get it back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Curse of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tree of Wisdom
quests.description: Now that we have the Skull of Voland, there's one more ritual I'll need to perform. Meet me at the Tree of Wisdom, behind the village.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Curse of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

items_required.name: Meet Stryche at the Tree of Wisdom

quests.name: Shards of Moonlight
quests.description: Around the tree, you can find shards of moonlight that have fallen to the ground. Collect some for me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Curse of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Moon-Struck
quests.description: Gather me some Moon-Struck Souls from anyone who has been affected by the curse. This will help me break it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Curse of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Offer the Skull
quests.description: Well, are you ready? Place the skull on the mound in front of the Tree of Wisdom. I will do the rest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Curse of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Fighting Spirit
quests.description: Touch the skull to summon the Spirit of Voland. He won't be able to help us defeat Marchosias. but he can help us learn to fight him. When you can defeat him. come back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Curse of the Moon ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Moon Crystals
quests.description: The blades we want to craft will be forged from pure moonlight in the fire of the Tree of Wisdom. Naturally, that means we need some moonlight to use as raw material! You'll find shards of moonlight near the Tree. In some of them, it has formed into perfect crystals. That's the stuff you want.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Fighting Spirit ' quest.

quests.name: Eclipsed Blood
quests.description: A weapon like this always requires a blood sacrifice. We will each have to use some of our own, but because we are fighting such a powerful enemy, we will need the blood of his followers, too - the blood of the Eclipsed Ones.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Fighting Spirit ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Heart of the Bear
quests.description: I need just one last thing. To draw the attention of Voland, we will need the heart of a bear. There is one in the woods who still remains tainted by the curse. We'll use that one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Fighting Spirit ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Forge of the Moon
quests.description: And now, we go to the Tree of Wisdom and craft our moon-forged weapons. One for me, and one for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Fighting Spirit ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Bear-ly Alive
quests.description: Marchosias's corrupted power has spread to everything around him! These poor bears are beyond redemption. Please, put them out of their misery.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Fighting Spirit ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse the Filth
quests.description: Look how much sludge and filth there is in here. The way you described Marchosias, when you fought him in our future - didn't you say he looked like this? Oh, Marchosias, what have you DONE? Help me clean it up so it can do no further damage.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Fighting Spirit ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Search the Cave
quests.description: We've been in here for awhile, but I have not yet seen any sign of Marchosias himself. Explore the cave and see if you can find where he may be hiding.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Fighting Spirit ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Clear the Eclipse
quests.description: There are so many Eclipsed Ones around the Tree of Wisdom that it makes it hard to break through to this cave! As they have become permanently bestial, there is no hope for them. We must slay them so they cannot hurt anyone else.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Fighting Spirit ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Interrogation
quests.description: Some of Marchosias' minions still retain their sentience. They may be able to lead us to their master - but we will have to convince them. Interrogate them and see what you can find out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Fighting Spirit ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Search for Clues
quests.description: Do you see all of that…gross, matted fur laying around the cave? I bet it's hiding all kinds of things. Let's see what we can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Fighting Spirit ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Check the Nest
quests.description: What about that really big pile in the far cavern? Let's take a closer look at that.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Fighting Spirit ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat Marchosias!
quests.description: I can't help you now - you'll have to finish this fight yourself! Defeat Marchosias, and break the curse!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Fighting Spirit ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Free HeroPoints!
quests.description: Well hello, Hero! You've come to HeroMart, home of all Artix Entertainment-themed merchandise! Since we pack and ship all your gear right from here, we're always looking for more supplies. If you can bring me the items on this list, I'll give YOU two free HeroPoints to spend in my in-game shop!

quests.name: HeroMart Defender
quests.description: Heromart is built on boxes - supplies come IN packaged in boxes, and your gear goes OUT packaged in boxes! So it gets pretty tough with all these sneevil tribes in the Boxes area so close by, disguising themselves as delivery men to steal my boxes. Do me a favor, and convince them to stay away from my boxes? Be gentle, but firm. That's the best way to win an argument!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spend One HeroPoint
quests.description: Slay one sneevil invader (he's right over there!) and turn in 1 HeroPoint to choose from my list of gear.

quests.name: Spend Two HeroPoints
quests.description: Slay one sneevil invader (he's right over there!) and turn in 2 HeroPoints to choose from my list of gear.

quests.name: Spend Three HeroPoints
quests.description: Slay one sneevil invader (he's right over there!) and turn in 3 HeroPoints to choose from my list of gear.

quests.name: Spend Six HeroPoints
quests.description: Slay one sneevil invader (he's right over there!) and turn in 4 6 HeroPoints to to get your own Showcase Villa!

quests.name: Spend Ten HeroPoints
quests.description: Slay one sneevil invader (he's right over there!) and turn in 10 HeroPoints to to get your own Great Thief Class!

quests.name: Always Know Where Your Towel Is!
quests.description: No, no wait - I'm actually glad you're here. You see, after I got in the shower, I realized that I don't have a towel! Obviously I'm going to need one before I can get out. You should be able to get a towel from for me from one of the guards, but I doubt they'll hand it over without a fight.

quests.name: Echoes
quests.description: While we're on our way back to Eridani, mind lending a hand by finding a pair of glasses? I saw them in the cave. Not sure if it belongs to the kid but better safe than blind. Look out for bandits too. I knocked down their boss so they're running around like headless chickens. Whoops, you're looking green. Shouldn't have mentioned that. Working on the farm isn't just about petting animals y'know.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Troubadour ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Quest for the Bonebreaker
quests.description: My Pa told me tales of the Bonebreaker Cutlass. It's used by Undead Pirates and DoomKnight Commanders. Those who wield it gain great power. I'd LOVE to see what it looks like… and I'll give you a chance to get a prize! Bring me the cutlass… pretty please?

quests.name: Beach Picnic
quests.description: What if we had a picnic, but on the beach? That would be so cool. But first, can you get this stuff for me, while I invite my friends and grab some towels? Steal some beach balls from /LunaCove - and while you're there, invite some of the villagers… but only the cool ones. Also, can you stop off at /BurningBeach and get some cups from the Water Goblins there? I forgot to buy them in the store yesterday. I'm such a dork sometimes.

quests.name: Devil's Food
quests.description: We need to figure out what's going on and I think I know just where to start. Those Goons near the cafeteria are looking a little green…you better get some samples from them so we can narrow it down.

quests.name: Sample Processing
quests.description: Alright, now that we have some samples from the infected Goons, we are going to need some baseline readings. Go check the uninfected Ebil Goons for any symptoms, and make sure they stay away from the cafeteria! We don't need any more of them turning until we find the cause and the cure. Oh, and while you're at it, better check the Ebil Fishmen to make sure they haven't picked up any stray "food" crumbs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What's That Smell?
quests.description: Now that we have found out what happened to all those Ebil Goons we need to find what has caused the issue. *Sniff* *Sniff* What's that smell? AH! DID YOU SEE THAT!? That pile of mysterious meat just moved! GET IT, GET IT!!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mystery Solved
quests.description: Where's the flavor!? The spice!? THE TASTE!? It's worse than I imagined. They've taken all that makes food good out and replaced it with corporate jargon and datatables. Something went wrong in the process and that's where the Smorgasbord came from. It's time to shut this operation down! Go take out the Smorgasbord itself, when it falls so should its minions…oh…and the Ghouls! I'm sure they'll return to normal too…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ends Meat
quests.description: You had better get all this cleaned up quickly, the last thing we want is the smell of this mush seeping into the floors and walls!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mystery Solved ' quest.

quests.name: Dark Divide
quests.description: Have you been to /Camlan before? I heard its precise location was revealed recently. Please, confront the Elves there, and make them return what they took from the Drow of the past. I know they must have something of ours. All of the other Elven clans do.

quests.name: Drow Trust Exercise
quests.description: As part of the Yew Mountains' coalition, Drow Soldiers have been trusted with the protection of Thelima. Could I ask a favor? Sneak attack them. It'll keep them sharp. They should be in front of the Inn, and the gate to Castle Natalis on the west side.

quests.name: The Golden Heart
quests.description: All of our contestants have been dropped into the dungeon, each at a separate entrance. These Love Shrubs are covered in red candy hearts, but in order to progress to Stage 2, they'll need to ﬁnd the one who has the Golden Heart. But they'd better be careful - that Shrub won't give up his Heart without a good ﬁght!

quests.name: The Red Room
quests.description: Looks like our contestants have ended up in the Red Room - and it's full of burning lava! They'd better start putting out those ﬁres fast, or they might end up as the dinner instead of the date! (Get it? Cause they're gonna get coooked? Ah, nevermind!)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get Out of Here
quests.description: They're not out of danger yet, folks! Now that they've put out those ﬁres, they're gonna have to start some new ones! To move on to the next level of the dungeon, our contestants will need to collect Burning Embers of Love from those Lava Slimes, and then use them to light the torches on the wall! That will unlock the door to stage 3.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spooky Cupid
quests.description: Our remaining contestants are up against one spooky bunch of cupids! They're gonna need some of those little guys' arrows to progress to the next round. Whaddya think - will they make it? Or will those bony babies tum their faces into bull's eyes?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get a Bullseye
quests.description: There's only one way out of this purgatory of cherubs - you gotta hit the bullseye (that's 100 points for you non-archers)! Take those arrows, contestants, and shoot one of them right into the middle of that target at the end of the hall to continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: And They Called it Puppy Love
quests.description: These adorable pooches have devoured the hearts of their Valentines - metaphorically speaking, of course! Well, sort of. They really HAVE swallowed the heart-shaped lockets that are needed to get into the next room. Our contestants are gonna have to get 'em back if they want to move on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gotta Get the Keys
quests.description: Hey, you guys got all the Devoured Heart lockets! Now you just gotta unlock ‘em. Unfortunately, those keys have already gone through the whole system, if you know what I mean! You‘re gonna have to dig 'em back out of those Lil Poots.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: They Already Lost
quests.description: Oh. no! Looks like our ﬁnalists are going to have to go through all of Last Year's Contestants if they're gonna make it to the center! Of course, these are the guys who lost, so I‘m sure that won‘t be too hard.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Long Time Ago
quests.description: Whoof - the next room is ﬁlled with long-lost contestants from years past. These guys are looking pretty rough… man, we've gotta start cleaning this dungeon out more often!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Is His Name Herbie?
quests.description: Our ﬁnal two contestants are at the last stage! It's hero versus bug, and only one can emerge victorious! Who will be our lucky winner?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wheel of Love
quests.description: I'd love to just GIVE you all the prizes, but I am contractually bound by Grimskull Productions to say that, if you want any more gear, you'll need to complete this quest. Slay Undead Cherubs to get Unlove Darts. Turn in 13 for a chance to get a prize!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Is His Name Herbie? ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat 10 Viruses
quests.description: So you think you can help Old King Coal? I don't think so! We viruses are to powerful for you puny heroes! Muahahahah!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take a Chill Pill ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat 10 More
quests.description: Well, you defeated 10 of us, but there's no way you can defeat 10 more! We are too powerful for you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take a Chill Pill ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: 30? No way!
quests.description: You've defeated 20 of us? There's no way! You must be powerful, but we are VIRUSES! We constantly change and evolve! We will prevail!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take a Chill Pill ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Add 10 More
quests.description: How have you been able to keep up with us? We are constantly changing and evolving! We will not be defeated!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take a Chill Pill ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: 50 is RIGHT OUT!
quests.description: That's it, you'll never be able to defeat us now! We have learned and grown! WE ARE POWER!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take a Chill Pill ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Anything but Common
quests.description: So you think you're so powerful. You defeated all those germs… but you will NEVER defeat the Rhinovirus! There is no cure!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take a Chill Pill ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Supplies to spin The Wheel of Chance
quests.description: The Sneevils want unique items of power. Chaos infests the lands and chaorrupted items are what they seek. Find them a cursed Relic of Chaos, and you can spin their Wheel of Chance!
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 10.

quests.name: The Assistant
quests.description: Lore has had many revolutions and many wars. There are unique items from these wars to be found, and I'm interested. Bring me War-Torn Memorabilia from Yulgar's Armor Shop, and you can spin my wheel!

quests.name: Swindle's Return Policy
quests.description: Haha! You're not happy with your prizes? Well I'm not completely unreasonable. I'll buy back some of your unsatisfactory prizes with some of this surplus stock.

quests.name: Bloody Chaos
quests.description: Would you like to make some Blood Gems? Well, you'll have to work for them. Chaos is still a relatively unknown source of power so we would like to see just how dense it is. Go out and collect these items scattered around Lore so the Archfiend can study it more closely.

items_required.name: Shattered Legendary Sword of Dragon Control

quests.name: Swindle Bulk
quests.description: The boxconomy always has a demand for more cubes. If you can gather a bulk amount, you'll be rewarded squarely.

quests.name: Dirt-y Deeds Done Dirt Cheap
quests.description: What? You want to do some work for me? Why don't you grab a pickaxe and a shovel, dig some holes, and fill them up again? I bet you don't even know how, do you? Go learn from the experts: the Chaos Tunneler, Slugbutter, and that thing /downward, near the center of the planet. I bet they can give you some tips.

quests.name: Swindle's Bonus Deal
quests.description: Still getting too many dud prizes? Well, I guess since you're keeping me company, I'll buy a few more back for some other poor sap to win.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Swindle Bilk's To Go Hut in your inventory to access this quest. Note: This quest is only available from Swindle Bilk's To Go Hut .

quests.name: Frostspinner's Web
quests.description: Zastruga made a pact with the Nation, and broke it. I need some muscle to collect the Frostspinne Queen's debt. She's riding a spider we'll be repossessing. Do me this favor, and you'll get what the Queen could have had.

quests.name: Help Swindle Claws
quests.description: HO HO HAH! I, Swindle Claws. need my silver bell before I can set off delivering "gifts" and asking for "holiday donations".
quests.requirements_note: Must have the Swindle Claws in your inventory.

quests.name: Twisted Items of Nulgath
quests.description: If you prove your worth by bringing 3 Totems and the Rune 4 from a Skull Warrior, you will earn my most impressive works. True, most of my more powerful items from the past are now unavailable. Lets just say they caused a bit more trouble than I anticipated. But I'm in the process of creating more items of destruction. Patience is a virtue.

quests.name: Demanding Items Of Nulgath
quests.description: I have items of great power for you. Everything has a cost. Learn this… If you have the required reagents and have slain the Legion Fenrir, this sword is yours. You may only pick one though.

quests.name: Empowering Items
quests.description: What? Ahh… you have the Iron Scythe of Nulgath. Allow me to imbue it with my powers.

quests.name: NOT A QUEST
quests.description: This is not really a quest. I do not want you to go and bring me the head of sneevil. All of the above statements are a lie.

quests.name: Nulgath is Kind
quests.description: Hmmm… I sense a great beast has shown itself in the land of Lore. Such beasts retain great power…

quests.name: The Leery Contract
quests.description: Ahh… what do you have there mortal? One of my contracts? You must be a VERY lucky person. Care to make a deal? Good, Evil, Chaotic… your alignment doesn't matter to me. Just bring me a rune from an Undead Legend and sign the contract, and I'll give you a prize unlike anything you've seen before- and a sum of Gold for your troubles. What does the contract say, you ask? Does it really matter?

quests.name: Bone Dust Reagent
quests.description: Skew needs many ingredients to practice his magic. Bone Dust from the undead in /battleunderb is something he requires. Bring him enough of it, and he'll reward you accordingly.

quests.name: Cube Reagent
quests.description: Skew needs many ingredients to practice his magic. Cubes from the Sneevils in /boxes and Ice Cubes from the Snow Golems in /mountfrost are materials he requires. Bring him enough of each, and he'll fairly compensate you.

quests.name: Essence of Defeat Reagent
quests.description: Relics from defeated, powerful enemies can be used by Skew to create powerful magic. Bring him the remains of your defeated foes and he'll generously reward you with a much rarer gemstone.

quests.name: Ordinary Cape
quests.description: Nulgath tells you to bring him an "Ordinary Cape" and he'll give it the ability to change to the color of your desire. He says he'll also need x5 "Tainted Gems".

quests.name: Spinal Tap of Nulgath
quests.description: Mortal, bring me a "Spinal Tap" dagger and I'll twist it's energy, giving you full dominion over it's power.

quests.name: Void Knight Deal
quests.description: Void Knights are just one of my elite soldiers of war. I give them great power of my own to make them unstoppable. That's the sacrifice I make for my disciples. I'll give you the power of a Void Knight too. All I require is a small portion of your soul. Defeat Soulseeker and you'll be able to retrieve a transportable piece of your soul.

quests.name: Specialty Pizza
quests.description: I have an urgent delivery! … and our policy is 30 levels or less, or it is free! I guess we will just have to improvise. First we need a sauce substitute. Oh, I know, how about slime? Help me by defeating slimes and bringing me back 5 Yummy Slime Sauces!

quests.name: SwordMaster Class
quests.description: (For owners of the AC version of BladeMaster Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a BladeMaster. You have mastered your skills, and continued in your studies and for that you are to be rewarded.
quests.requirements_note: Must have BladeMaster (Class) (AC) with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory. Note: Click on the Catalogue of Oddities and find 'SwordMaster Class (AC)' to access this quest.

quests.name: SwordMaster Class
quests.description: (For owners of the Quest reward version of BladeMaster Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a BladeMaster. You have mastered your skills, and continued in your studies and for that you are to be rewarded.
quests.requirements_note: Must have BladeMaster (Class) (0 AC) with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory. Note: Click on the Catalogue of Oddities and find 'SwordMaster Class (Merge)' to access this quest.

quests.name: SwordMaster Assassin Class
quests.description: (For owners of the BladeMaster Assassin Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a BladeMaster Assassin. You have mastered your skills, and continued in your studies and for that you are to be rewarded.
quests.requirements_note: Must have BladeMaster Assassin with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory. Note: Click on the Catalogue of Oddities and find 'SwordMaster Assassin Class' to access this quest.

quests.name: Legion SwordMaster Assassin Class
quests.description: (For owners of the Legion BladeMaster Assassin Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a Legion BladeMaster Assassin. You have mastered your skills, and continued in your studies and for that you are to be rewarded.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Legion BladeMaster Assassin with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory. Note: Click on the Catalogue of Oddities and find 'Legion SwordMaster Assassin Class' to access this quest.

quests.name: Free Cabdury
quests.description: With the Grenwog colony's alphas out of the picture, the instinct in Cabdury's blood transformed him to fill that role. Help the poor critter out, and make him take a nap. We'll cart him somewhere safe when he stops throwing punches.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rapid Cycling ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: In the Forest of Good and Evil
quests.description: If we're going to find our sock monkey, we'll need your help to clear out this forest! Defeat the Bright and Evil Imps, and take out the Evil Elementals. Once that's done, we should have a better idea of where to start looking for our sock monkey!

quests.name: To Be or Not to Be... Expendable
quests.description: Did you see what I saw, Hero? A red string danglind out of one of the Expendable Rogues pockets! You know they only ever wear all black (it's a rogue thing). That string MUST have come from our sock monkey! Question the Expendable Rogues until one of them tells you where it is.

quests.name: Slay the Enemy Inside
quests.description: The Enemy Inside has made its lair in within the Cogito Sum Cavern, deep inside the Forest of Good and Evil. Please, Hero, slay the Enemy Inside and recover the Synderes Sock Monkey!

quests.name: Synderes Souvenir Shop
quests.description: When we go on tour, we bring a ton of merch for our fans to take home, and our stop at Yulgar's Inn is no different! Slay the denizens of the Forest of Good and Evil to earn Synderes Souvenir Tokens to buy gear from our shop!

quests.name: Building the Base
quests.description: In order to build a gate strong enough to withstand the magic it will contain, we must get 13 chunks of Asteroid Ore. Many pieces were spread across the island in the explosion that ripped this continent apart.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Rian's Quests .

quests.name: Refugee Roundup
quests.description: More and more refugees are flooding into the island, fleeing the chaos on the mainland and the recent destruction of our country. Frostwyrms and Ice Wolves threaten them all. Take out 7 of the beasts to ensure their safety!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Retrieve the Water Starstone
quests.description: In order to align the Moon with the Horologium Gate, and unlock the first Astral Key, you must retrieve the Water Starstone! It is kept by a FrostDeep Dweller under the ice on top of the mountain.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Magical Attraction
quests.description: You can feel the power of the Water Starstone yes? Yes. It will do much to power the gate, but we must set it properly. I need 13 samples of IceTen, an ore which I can process to create the magical field they will float in.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Frozen Blood
quests.description: In order to properly process the IceTen, I must create a solution to soak it in. Bring me 8 slabs of Frozen Blood from the Twisted Ice. I will melt it to create a powerful liquid.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Retrieve the Fire Starstone
quests.description: While the solution brews, I need you to recover the Fire Starstone! It will attract and hold the power of the sun… and THAT is a very powerful stone indeed! I sense it lies somewhere on the ice mountain. Go, search for it and return it to me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defend the Tower!
quests.description: Hero! I cannot divine the location of the next stone with the tower under constant attack! Defeat at least 6 of the Polar Elementals so that I may focus.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Refugee Rescue Run
quests.description: Please, go and save the 6 refugees who have just arrived on shore. I cannot focus until they are no longer threatened.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Retrieve the Earth Starstone
quests.description: The Earth Starstone, the one that will hold and align the planet Merkari… it is near! Search through the ruins and you may discover it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Polar Penetration and Progress
quests.description: Can you sense how WRONG the island feels? Ever since the explosion (and I still do not know WHAT caused it…), things have been… changing. Gather 6 Ice Cores and bring me 6 Ice Samples from Polar Elementals so I can track the change.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Save the Astronomer Apprentice
quests.description: Aaah, THERE he is. Listen, you can hear Lorentz's knees knocking from all the way up here. Defeat whatever monsters are threatening him, please, and bring him back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Glacial Elixir
quests.description: I must have Lorentz's help to continue on with the spell to activate the Horologium Gate! Please, bring me a vial of FrostDeep Dweller Venom and 5 Glacial Pearls. It will help me make a tonic to calm him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Retrieve the Energy Starstone
quests.description: Lorentz did not let his fear get the best of him. While he was in the ruins, he discovered the location of the Energy Starstone! It will draw and align the planet Saturnalia. A Polar Elemental found and is keeping it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Marking the Future
quests.description: In order to properly position the starstone, I must drill two nexus points into each. For that, I'll need a new drillbit. Bring me 5 spines from a Frostwyrm so I can craft it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Glacial Shift
quests.description: If the ice is moving as you say it is, that is very troubling. The land should not be responding like this… shrinking away from itself. Bring me 6 chunks of ice that I may test it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Divination Draft
quests.description: I have not had luck locating the Light Starstone. I must cast a stronger spell… and for that I will need 4 fronds of Iceweed, 4 bunches of Snowsage, 5 Frozen Scales from an Arctic Eel and 5 Frozen Tails from a FrostWyrm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Retrieve the Light StarStone
quests.description: I have seen the light… and it is trapped in darkness! Somewhere on this island, a treasure chest lies, and inside it is the starstone which will hold and align the planet Jutiparus. Bring it to me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Future is Bright
quests.description: I believe I can scry the identity of our mysterious mage with the light from the starstone. Gather Shattered Glass so I may build a mirror… then we shall see what we shall see!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bled Bone Dry
quests.description: The magic of the island IS changing, and I grow fearful of what it may mean for us all. Slay Arctic Eels and Fishbones to bring back bone samples. I would see if the changes extends to the monsters of our sea.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chill of Fear
quests.description: I fear what may come, my friend. There is certain property of the ice on this island which may tell me how much danger we humans are in. Bring me 6 BitterEdge Ice Cores.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Retrieve the Darkness Starstone
quests.description: In the glacial ice floes, there is both ice and darkness. I sense that the darkness Starstone, which will hold the planet Maras is trapped inside the walking glaciers, a Twisted Ice monster!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Web of Fear
quests.description: I have penetrated a web of lies obscuring my sight. There is dark, deadly magic nearby, an amulet if I guess right. I sense whymtaint mingled with it, so check the Frostwyrms first!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Frozen in Time
quests.description: We are so close to completing the Gate! The framework is done, now we just need to add FrozenFire to connect the heat of out world with the ice of his… Bring me 13 chunks of Frozen Fire so I can create the base.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Heart of the Matter
quests.description: We need to place the heartstone to anchor the aligned planets! Slay 5 Ice Wolves for the silver to make nails.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Retrieve the Wind Starstone
quests.description: Though my magic works through the stars, I also have an affinity for wind. I can send the Wind Starstone, that will align the planet Venice… guarded by the Rotten Ice beast that lives in the heart of the volcano! Bring it to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Create the Gate
quests.description: We have all 7 Starstones, but we need the Blood of an Ice Wolf to bind and activate the gate. Get 1 vial of blood from an Ice Wolf, and then place all 7 Starstones around the Gate so that we may open the portal and bring this Mage to our world.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Drive Back the Invaders
quests.description: This is NOT what we were promised! Drive the invader minions back through the gate, Hero… HURRY!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat the FrostSpawn Invaders
quests.description: We MUST stop these invaders, Hero… even if it takes all we have! Take out 15 of their Fangbeasts to buy us time to plan.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: LEGEND: Glacera Ice Token
quests.description: THIS QUEST IS FOR AQW LEGENDS ONLY! If you wish to gain access to the Cryomancer Shop you will need Glaceran Ice Tokens. If you bring me a piece of Dark Ice from the FrostSpawn Invader, then I will craft it into tokens for you.

quests.name: Glacera Ice Token
quests.description: If you wish to gain access to the Cryomancer Gear you will need Glaceran Ice Tokens.If you bring me a piece of Dark Ice from the FrostSpawn Invader, then I will craft it into tokens for you.

quests.name: Clear the Wolves
quests.description: You've defeated some monsters and warmed the shelter, but the Ice Wolves keep coming back! Slay 7 Ice Wolves to keep the Tower of Winds safe!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: FangBeast Bash-up
quests.description: We've got to take out the Fangbeasts, show them just what they're dealing with! You're the only one with the skill and strength to do this, Hero. My energies have been exhausted by creating the gate.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the FrostSpawn Invaders ' quest.

quests.name: Ravage the Reapers
quests.description: I can't STAND lizards and scaly things. Hate dragons. But these - these things go BEYOND anything I've seen before. Take out 6 of the Reapers they can get any closer!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Oh the Humanity
quests.description: I - I think there is something about these creatures… something OFF. They rage and roar like beasts, but stand and fight like men. We've seen hybrids before, but there's something… different about these. Bring me back 3 samples of FrostSpawn flesh.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Close the Gate
quests.description: Hero… we have GOT to shut the gate. We can't risk any more of the creatures coming here! They are not normal. They are part man, part beast, and entirely soulless abominations! Slay 13 of them to bring me their Whetu Wairua, the pieces of them that are made of starstuff.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Form the Lock
quests.description: Though you've brought me the Whetu Wairua, I must have ingredients from OUR world to ground the gate and strengthen the lock. Bring me 5 Frostbreath Weeds from Moglinsters and 10 piles of Snow Diamond Dust.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Glacera
quests.description: In creating the gate here, its twin was formed THERE. On Karok's planet. Glacera. You'll have to go there, and complete the mission I set for you. Then return. And TO return, you'll need to create a twin to my heartstone. For that, we need mercury. You can get it from a FrostSpawn Reaper.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rescue the Refugees
quests.description: More and more refugees pour in, fleeing the destruction caused by the Queen of All Monsters… but WE aren't safe HERE! We've got to do what we can though, so take out 10 of the Frostspawn monsters to help save them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Scythe of Vengeance ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Fangbeasts
quests.description: They just keep coming! I need uninterrupted time to cast the spell that will bind the scythe to the portal and break the gate!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Destroy the Frost Reapers
quests.description: They look so hungry. I can't imagine what Glacera was like… But if we don't hurry, our world won't be any better than theirs! I… think they are coming to take back the scythe. You've got to stop them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: FrostSpawn General Takedown
quests.description: Hero… the General… look at him! He's about to find where you stashed the scythe. You've got to stop him from getting it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Flame of Courage
quests.description: Gather a Spark of Courage to melt the ice around the scythe's blade.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FrostSpawn General Takedown ' quest.

quests.name: Quick as silver
quests.description: Quicker than a flash, the arctic eels flee our enemies. We must emulate them if we wish to survive… and thrive! Bring me 1 Quicker Silver droplet from an arctic eel and I'll create mercury and Frozen Tower merge tokens for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FrostSpawn General Takedown ' quest.

quests.name: Orb of Frozen Dreams
quests.description: I… think I am coming to understand the FrostSpawn a bit more. Their souls, their hopes, their DREAMS are frozen in time. Locked to when they lost their last pure drop of humanity. Bring me the FrostSpawn General's Frozen Orb, and I will craft merge tokens for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FrostSpawn General Takedown ' quest.

quests.name: LEGEND: Glacera Ice Token
quests.description: THIS QUEST IS FOR AQW LEGENDS ONLY! If you wish to gain access to the Cryomancer Shop you will need Glaceran Ice Tokens. If you bring me a piece of Dark Ice from the FrostSpawn Invader, then I will craft it into tokens for you.

quests.name: Glacera Ice Token
quests.description: If you wish to gain access to the Cryomancer Gear you will need Glaceran Ice Tokens.If you bring me a piece of Dark Ice from the FrostSpawn Invader, then I will craft it into tokens for you.

quests.name: From Refugee to Enemy
quests.description: The FrostSpawn or - or SOMETHING is changing the refugees. They are freezing and turning on us! Take out 5 of the Invaders and put 3 of the Monstrous Refugees out of their misery.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' FrostSpawn General Takedown ' quest.

quests.name: Fangs and Blades
quests.description: Take out 7 of the Fangbeasts and Invaders before they can corrupt any of our other refugees! These people are depending on us!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reaping the Refugees
quests.description: More and more of our people are falling… At this rate, they'll have an entirely NEW army made out of OUR people! Take out 10 of the Frost Reapers to slow them down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Saving Syrrus' Spirit
quests.description: I WANT to keep fighting, but it all looks so… hopeless. I don't want to give up, it's just hard to remember WHY we need to fight when so much has gone wrong. If you could bring me a Snowdrop blossom, a reminder of Lorentz, my Lodestone (stolen by one of those cursed Frostspawn), and some sign that the Refugees ARE still human… it would help.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: It's a Trap!
quests.description: There are too many FrostSpawn to slay with the few warriors we have left, so we'll need to trap some of them to even the odds. Place 10 traps around the area; the magic gem inside will shrink them so they fit within.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Feast or Famine
quests.description: Those of us who remain fighting must have SOMETHING to eat! Slay the FrostSpawn to bring us eat. I will make Frozen Dinners.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Decipher the Freezing
quests.description: I suspect… well… I do not want to go into details just yet. But something caught my eye with one of our latest prisoners. Bring me 10 FrostSpawn Spines and 10 FrostSpawn Scales for one final divination spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A New Frost Monster
quests.description: Look at this beast! It doesn't look like any of the others, but it certainly follows Karok's orders. Strange… there's a certain… familiarity to the creature.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Karok!
quests.description: The time has come for us to face Karok! We MUST defeat him, or we will have to face a war on TWO fronts!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Previously called "Takedown Karok the Fallen" .

quests.name: Where is Karok?
quests.description: The stars have led me to this area, but it's a dead end. I can’t figure out where Karok has gone! Take these tuning crystals and drive them into the ground in the snowy fields nearby. I'll use them to see if any powerful spells have been recently cast in this area.

quests.name: Cloaking Spell
quests.description: It’s as I suspected - Karok has used a cloaking spell to hide his trail! If I can disable the spell, we'll be able to see where he has gone. Since Karok is an ice mage, I'll need elemental ice to reveal his spell. You can get it from the Glacial Elementals in the area.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Splattered Mana
quests.description: My efforts have revealed the location of Karok's cloaking spell! Now, we just need to dispell it. Now, Karok's spell had a bit of a splatter zone, and the bits of scattered mana have frozen in the snow. Collect those frozen bits of mana for me. I can use them to help focus my antimagic on the cloaking spell. (Quest available once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dispell the Spell
quests.description: One last component I'll need is a good amount of Living Snow. You can get it from the nearby Snow Golems. Once I have it, I'll be able to dispell Karok's cloaking spell and reveal the path he took.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Catch Up to Karok
quests.description: Hurry! We have to catch Karok before he reaches Kezeroth! The newly-revealed path to the east leads into a ravine going up into the mountains. Head into the ravine, and try to find him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blast the Frostspawn Symbiote
quests.description: If you want to catch up to Karok, you're going to have to get past this thing first! But that's ok, you've fought worse. Right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Keep Going!
quests.description: That slowed you down a lot, but surely you've almost halfway up the mountain by now! If you can fight your way through the rest of these Frostspawn, you can still catch up to Karok before it's too late!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Keep the Frostspawn Away!
quests.description: With all-out war brewing between Karok and Kezeroth, it’s about to get messy here! For now, the least we can do is try to prevent it from spilling into Frostvale. Go into the ravine, and kill any Frostspawn that are still trying to make their way down the mountain.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take it Down ' quest.

quests.name: Fight For Kezeroth!
quests.description: Defeat 10 of Karok's Frostspawn minions to get Frostspawn Medals and raise the war meter!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take it Down ' quest.

quests.name: (Mega) Fight For Kezeroth!
quests.description: Defeat enough of Karok's Frostspawn minion to get 5 Mega Frostspawn Medals and raise the War Meter!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take it Down ' quest.

quests.name: What is THAT?
quests.description: Karok and Kezeroth are getting away! We'll have to defeat this beast quickly if we're to have a change of catching up to them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take it Down ' quest.

quests.name: Take a Look Around
quests.description: First, we'll need to scout out the area, and see what we're up against. Go in and explore the frozen cave, look at things on the ground, and slay some of the Ice Lords and Living Ice that are guarding it. (Quest available once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What is THAT? ' quest.

quests.name: The Stars Have Foretold
quests.description: I've consulted the stars, and I now believe that crystal you say laying on the ground could be our anwer. Go back and examine it. and see if you can find the place it fell from
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What is THAT? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Continue this Path
quests.description: The stars tell me we are on the right path! There are 5 more crystals missing from the walls. You will need to find them, and place them in the correct spots. Most likely. the Ice Lords and Living Ice are protecting them. Slay them, and collect the remaining crystals. (Quest available once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What is THAT? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cross the Ice Bridge
quests.description: That seems to have worked - the ice has crystallized and formed a bridge leading over that chasm! Cross the bridge, and let's see what we find on the other side!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What is THAT? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Free the Moglins
quests.description: Oh no! These moglins have been frozen in ice! The poor things - we have to free them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What is THAT? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get the Moglinsters
quests.description: Those moglins you freed - they've become moglinsters! Was that why they were being kept frozen? You'll have to defeat them if you want to keep going!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What is THAT? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Take the Crystal
quests.description: The stars have told me that the crystal is key! Examine the crystal to learn its story.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What is THAT? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: You have to Fight
quests.description: Looks like you're going to have to fight the Crystal of Glacera to earn the right to wield its power. How hard can it be? It's just a chunk of ice, right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What is THAT? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fight your way Clear
quests.description: You did it! You've got the crystal! Now, you've got to get out of there before you're overwhelmed by the Frostspawn! They've got the opening you entered from blocked off - you're going to have to head north and fight your way through them to get out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What is THAT? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Take down Kezeroth!
quests.description: You can do this! Kezeroth is not at full strength - Karok's spell of binding has weakened him - and you have the Crystal of Glacera at your side. Let's see what this thing can do!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What is THAT? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Karok still Stands
quests.description: Kezeroth is down, but Karok is still at full strength! I know that last fight had to have worn you out, but we can't give up yet! Use the Crystal of Glacera to destroy him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What is THAT? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clear Them Out (Farming Quest)
quests.description: Kezeroth may be down, and Karok some sort of ally, but the Frostspawn horde must still be thinned. We cannot allow them to get too comfortable. Show me your worth by defeating 3 Ice Lords and 3 Living Ices and I will reward you with Glacera Rep!

quests.name: Thin the Horde (Farming Quest)
quests.description: Kezeroth may be down, and Karok some sort of ally, but the Frostspawn horde must still be thinned. We cannot allow them to get too comfortable. Show me your worth by defeating 3 Frostspawn Trolls, 3 Frost Fangbeasts, and 3 Glacial Trolls and I will reward you with Glacera Rep!

quests.name: Somnic Energy
quests.description: The armor I make is infused with the same energy that Dreamweavers control with their magic. Bring me some, and I’ll reward you. Every creature in the dream world exudes it, but none more than the Nightspores. It shines out from them like a beacon.

quests.name: The Heptagonal Chest
quests.description: Ah, good. You’re here, hale, and whole. You smell like you’ve faced the motherwyrm. Good. Then you’ve proven your worth already, and earned a reward. You will want to search the treasure pile for the Heptagonal Chest. It is an incredibly important artifact… but can only be opened by YOU.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Poor Baby ' quest.

quests.name: Part the Veils of Time
quests.description: Recover the shards of my Molten Scrying Mirror from the Lava Mages and I will soon be able to share some of the secrets of your past… your present. And future.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Final Showdown! ' quest.

quests.name: Spell to See Beyond
quests.description: Excellent. With a whole mirror, now all I need are the ingredients for the vision spell. Bring me 5 Crystals from the Lava Mages, 2 globs of Gel from the Lavasites, and 5 drops of Molten Gold from the Lava Guards
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Final Showdown! ' quest.

quests.name: Atata
quests.description: What are those horrible hands reaching down from the sky? They're big enough to wrench a tower from the ground! The citizens are being snatched away. Most can run on their own but I see many frozen by fear. Please, help them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mnemosyne, the Tormentor ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Samghata
quests.description: The hands are probing the streets for us. I think they're getting impatient and smashing open buildings. If they get lucky, we'll be crushed to death. We have to swat them away. Take care not to be snatched yourself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mnemosyne, the Tormentor ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hahava
quests.description: There's an awful shrieking noise growing louder and louder. The other survivors are telling me they hear other sounds, like crying or maniacal laughing. I think it's from those flying trumpeters! Their music must be silenced before it causes harm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mnemosyne, the Tormentor ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sanjiva
quests.description: As more of the strange red liquid is floating into the sky, I'm noticing creatures leaking out of the cracks in the ground. They've gained form and I can't shake the feeling that they look like my former neighbors. I beg you, return them to rest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mnemosyne, the Tormentor ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kalasutra
quests.description: We noticed a melody playing, hidden in the cacophony of the Trumpeters. Even though it's barely louder than a whisper, it's lulling the young ones to sleep. The adults are slowly succumbing as well. We won't be able to protect ourselves this way. Destroy the Trumpeters to find the source of the song.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mnemosyne, the Tormentor ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lies in Peace
quests.description: Welcome to the Mana Core, er, the Plane of Mana. They're in the same spot so they might as well be the same thing. You can call it whichever one you want. C'mon, I'll show you around. We'll head straight down the path to the right until we reach the junction. Careful, we'll need to fight off some of those wyverns you'll recognize. They got dragged here because the patronizing voices up there thought they were you. But hey, go easy on them…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nigh Invincible ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: There Was an Attempt
quests.description: Before I got shunted into a leyline, I knew Planes existed but had no idea how they worked. Still don't. But this isn't even a completed Elemental Plane. It's attempting to follow the universe's rules and become a real Plane because it's overflowing with power. Check out those people-shaped blue things. They're attempts at creating elementals. The ones that can move aren't nice. They won't leave us be unless we re-liquefy them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nigh Invincible ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Scared Straight
quests.description: The problem with the Mana Core is that it shifts all the time. These paths change direction and it's easy to get completely lost. Let's go down the South route first, and hope for the best. Hey, would it be too much trouble for you to run ahead and scare away a few monsters? I hear them growling and flapping their wings. Those might look and sound like infernals but they're fake creations one of the voices made to keep me in line.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nigh Invincible ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Making Waves
quests.description: Today, the South path led us to the beach. The Core, or Plane, is the heart of Lore. It circulates Mana through the leylines. Some of the mana pools here but it'll flow down the waterfall, gather below in a bottomless ocean, and get pumped into the Leylines. Come and squint over the crest of the falls with me. You can see the leylines. And please shove any fake infernals you find off the edge of the cliff. I hate them soooo much.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nigh Invincible ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: In Circles
quests.description: The beach is a dead end, and our hosts can't be bothered to scoot over. We're going to have to hoof it back to the junction and try the path leading due East. If Drakath were a better person, I'd ask him to fly us into the air so we can get our bearings but I know he'll drop us. He could ditch if he wants, and get blasted to smithereens. No? Darn. Guess he'll be watching us fight off the freaky elementals on our way back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nigh Invincible ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nameless Remnants
quests.description: The Path East took us to what I call, the museum grove. When I'm not getting yelled at, I explore the Plane and find a bunch of old funky stuff. To pass the time, I gather them here. They look like they came from the surface but I also get the feeling that they don't belong anywhere. Wanna take a break to give these a look? You're going to have to race Gravelyn and Drakath. They're already getting their prints all over everything!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nigh Invincible ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dreams Unborn
quests.description: I hear heavy skulking footsteps. They're from the Crystalized Mana. I don't think they're like elementals. Their teeth chatter and gnash so angrily, and sometimes I can understand the noises. These might be the consciousness of the dormant Mana Avatar rising to the surface and taking solid form. Einsof is confused and angry that it can't be born. Gravelyn looks interested in them. If she wants to investigate, we should help her wrangle a few.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nigh Invincible ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Innocent Crafts
quests.description: There's only the North route left. That'll lead us to the hill where I speak to those cranky voices. Well, one of them is nice. They even showed me how to make pillows out of Mana. Let's stop by the pillows, and figure out how we're going to confront those awful masks. You'll know what I'm talking about when we meet them. The meanest of the bunch would've left fake infernals nearby to get to my head. Could you help me get rid of them?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nigh Invincible ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cold Bedrock
quests.description: The half-baked elementals are acting up. Umm, they'll bother us if we don't deal with them, so can we beat up a few? I know. I'm stalling us but this is a good warm up. You'll need it. From down here, I've listened to the voices discuss you and what's happening in Lore. They don't have anything good to say. Even the nicer one clams up when the others speak your name…When you're ready, we'll go meet them at the top of the hill.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nigh Invincible ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rippling Heartbeat
quests.description: It'll be four versus three, with you and me against the Mask of Tranquility. If we lose, The Law and Infamy said that you would need to 'go Silent' and that one of them would take your titles. To be honest, I don't think we can win but that won't be the point. We just need to prove that you can fight them off, and have the power to protect Lore! Let's show them what we're made of!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nigh Invincible ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tranquil Mediocrity
quests.description: Tranquility confessed to me that they're trying their best to be tough but fair. They're just not as confident as they used to be. Actually, Tranquility's worried that they were never confident at all. Their ‘other half' handled the tougher parts of being a deity. You know, Victoria and I felt better when we found ways to get our blood pumping. How about we fight some monsters and spar with Tranquility to clear the bad thoughts?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rippling Heartbeat ' quest.

quests.name: Stunted Growth
quests.description: It should be a straight shot down from here. Careful, it's steep and teeming with these Elemental Attempts. I guess we'd see more of them here. They want to be close to their big boss. Hm, the Elementals are acting a lot meaner too. They must have been disturbed by Malgor barging in, and are looking for him. I'll help you clear them out so we won't go rolling down the slope.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rippling Heartbeat ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Tossing and Turning
quests.description: The Crystalized Mana are here too! They're the solidified thoughts of the Avatar of Mana, stomping around the slope and making a mess. I'm sure they're extra agitated because of Malgor tearing through here. We can tell from all these broken trees and crushed bushes. We should clear them out of the way too. While we're at it, I can listen to their fragments to see how Einsof is doing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rippling Heartbeat ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dark Intruder
quests.description: Hold on a second, you see those glowing white lines on the ground? They're little leyline veins coming directly out of where Einsof is sleeping. But further down, there are these dark looking cracks in the ground. What are those? Did Malgor put them there? Let's take a look at both in case he's been messing around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rippling Heartbeat ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Doggy Paddle
quests.description: There's a whole throng of Crystalized Mana and Elemental Attempts gathering down at that shore! Malgor must have been here. He probably waded off into this big lake of Mana. That's definitely not a puddle. We're not going to be able to fight if you need to swim. How about you clear the Elementals and Crystalized Mana from the shore while I figure that out?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rippling Heartbeat ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Amethyst Memories
quests.description: One step at a time, I can't harden the mana fast enough if you walk ahead too quickly! And up ahead are…more Crystalized Mana? They look very purple, I've never seen them come in that color before. And of course they can walk on top of Mana. Huh, these ones seem more organized. They're moving to block us from going any further. It looks like they aren't going to let us pass without a fight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rippling Heartbeat ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Crawling Darkness
quests.description: There he is! Deeper into the center of the crater is Einsof's body! And crawling all over it are straight up Darkness Elementals. I have a lot of questions, but we know that Malgor can't just conjure Elementals out of nowhere- regular Darkness Elementals, at least. They had to have come from somewhere else. They're also pretty miffed that we're looking their way. Alright, time to put them up again!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rippling Heartbeat ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Raised Veins
quests.description: I've never seen Einsof myself before, but those veins on its body don't seem right. They're a very distinct type of purple. Nothing darkness related or your standard poison. You know…the type that my dad had when he was sick. Didn't you mention that Malgor had the Queen of Monsters' Heart? What if… no. Let's not jump to conclusions. We need to look closer at those veins to make sure.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rippling Heartbeat ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: In The Eye
quests.description: At first, I thought these Darkness creatures were eating off of Einsof, but no. They seem to be protecting the Mana Avatar. Thanks to Malgor's intrusion, they've lumped us in as threats. At least they slowed him down a bit, but we can't let them get in our way. We're so close to finding Malgor, I can feel Einsof struggling against whatever he's doing! Hurry!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rippling Heartbeat ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cognitive Dissonance
quests.description: Malgor doesn't see a way out for him or for you. The final solution is to poison Einsof with Shadowflame and Chaos from the Queen of Monster's Heart. The way he says it, a final and silent peace will fall on all of Lore. Not even other worlds, however many there are, will survive. We'll just stop existing. Life is hard, but death isn't the answer. You can do it! You can stop him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rippling Heartbeat ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Your Hero
quests.description: Einsof felt for Malgor's despair. They transformed him into the demigod he could have been if you had been there to teach him in the beginning. Despair makes Malgor stronger, and having a taste of this impossible dream is making that anguish burn. Both you and Malgor need to fight one last time. All I can do is stand back. You can defeat him, and convince him that you can live on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rippling Heartbeat ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Once Upon Another Time
quests.description: Malgor, the Mumblers, and the False Wyverns manifested without you knowing right? There's no one around to teach you the ropes of being an Eternal Dragon, so how could you control it? Imagine if we could make elementals ourselves. Why don't we check out the Elementals and look for anything left behind by Malgor? We're not going to make anyone new or anything crazy like that. We're just learning on our own.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Your Hero ' quest to access these quests.

items.name: Master of Fate Character Page Badge

quests.name: Build Malgor's Armor Set
quests.description: Malgor was formed by a wish - a villain the Alliance could continue to unite against instead of turning their ambitions against each other. His armor materialized to finalize that identity against his own wishes of becoming your savior. If you could create Malgor, do you think you can make just his armor out of what we have available? It could be useful practice for the future.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Your Hero ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Familiar Faces
quests.description: The Temple is officially under the ownership of Lady Celestia. She, the groundskeeper, and Warlic are going to keep the place running while we're on the road. They're just up ahead and inside the Temple. Why don't we go say hello? Lady Celestia recruited a few of her students to stand guard - these Termina Defenders are looking to spar and learn from you too. Looks like the name I came up with stuck!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Your Hero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Loaded Resume
quests.description: Grav…I guess I have to call her the Empress when we're out on official business. She sent her loyalists to help guard the Temple. I won't ever vouch for Evil, no way no how. Except, I really do like Empress Gravelyn which makes me trust the people that support her. Vic also sent those scholars, Muusa and Maya, to help us. Let's welcome them and test out the new Guards Shakaz brought with him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Your Hero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Big ol' Eyes
quests.description: I thought we could start looking for Aria and the others right away, but we can't let Maya walk into the village on her own. Ashray has a major dock crowding problem. I've heard of Shark Bait jumping on land to annoy sailors, but these seem different from the stories. Their eyes are huge, and they don't blink when they try to stab me. It's creepy. How about we shove them in a net to give Maya room to get to the village?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Loaded Resume ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Angry Angler
quests.description: Asking the locals for questions and Shark Bait cooking tips isn't working out. They're raising their fishing gear against the 'uninvited.' They don't seem actually mean- in fact, they seem more nervous than anything. Let's gently disarm them, and try to find anyone that's willing to talk. A person that looks like a doctor is standing at the end of the dock, and there's a calmer looking man minding his business in the village. That's a good start.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Loaded Resume ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slimy Scavenger
quests.description: While the Seaview Innkeeper prepares a room for all of us to talk somewhere safer, how about we stroll the beach? Haha! I do wish I could be with Victoria, but I don't miss the etiquette at all. This isn't an excuse to slack off and swim, by the way. I noticed some weird looking rocks on the shore. We can take a ladder down there from the dock. Just be careful, we'll need to clear out those freaky eels before we go sightseeing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Loaded Resume ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Troubled Waters
quests.description: Check out the Water Elementals. They don't look…clean. Not in a muddy or swampy sense, but their water is darker. Like they swam up from the bottom of the sea where all the dead things sink. They're gathering around those weird rocks in the rising tide. Can we clear them out? I have a bad feeling in my gut. It's making me sick, but pulling me towards the sea.
