quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Loaded Resume ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Washed Ink
quests.description: There's no sign of the other Champions. They either moved on or, with how secretive the villagers are being, are hidden somewhere. Then there's this torn journal page we found about Water Elves being in danger. But are they still in danger, or are they already…Maya should be at the inn. I need to ask her about this before I start panicking. We'll head to the inn, and keep the Fisherman from bothering us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Loaded Resume ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dead Sea
quests.description: The Avatar of Water, Neso, has left the Plane of Water to subsume Lore into her territory! She absorbed Kathool's abilities, and even though you stopped her from completely draining him, Neso's gone mad from it! Her body has transformed into a huge gelatinous jellyfish monster. It's up to you to duel Neso and force her to go back to the Plane of Water. The rest of us will keep her tide and Elementals from rising. Take care, I know you'll succeed!

npc.name: See You on the Other Side

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' See You on the Other Side ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Dry Spell
quests.description: Let me be honest for a second, and I know not everyone is going to agree with me, but I think Neso got what was coming. She made her bed, and has to lay in it just like anyone else. But I am completely against how the Old Worlds Order butted in like that! You had it under control, and the annoying majority voted to tug the rug out from under us. There has to be more to this. The both of us should take a deeper look into the Voice in the Sea.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dead Sea ' quest.

quests.name: Blooming Sea
quests.description: The Avatar of Water, Neso, has left the Plane of Water to subsume Lore into her territory! She absorbed Kathool's abilities, and even though you stopped her from completely draining him, Neso's gone mad from it! Her body has transformed into a huge gelatinous jellyfish monster. It's up to you to duel Neso and force her to go back to the Plane of Water. The rest of us will keep her tide and Elementals from rising. Take care, I know you'll succeed!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dead Sea ' quest.

quests.name: Voice in the Sea (Badge Quest)
quests.description: For helping defeat the Voice in the Sea World Boss, you've earned a rare character page badge! (LIMITED TIME CHARACTER PAGE BADGE: complete this quest by August 28th, 2023 to unlock the Voice in the Sea World Boss event character page badge)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dead Sea ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

items.name: Voice in the Sea World Boss Character Page Badge

quests.name: Mopping Up
quests.description: Dr. Rivale and even a representative from the Legion are moving into the Temple! I heard they're going to set up on the Temple's second floor. Let's head upstairs to check out the new rooms.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dead Sea ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Wet Pages
quests.description: Warlic gave us excerpts from a book about Champions, and Aria organized them into a scrapbook. Could you help us pick some Rimeblossoms to decorate it with while we search for the necromancers? Talk to Aria and she'll show you the book.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Water Intoxication ' quest.

quests.name: IceBox Break In
quests.description: Oh, I just noticed the seal on the ground came back! We broke it before you arrived, but it froze back over! Security's pretty tight. Faeries regularly sneak in and out of the tomb. Collect Faerie Dust, cover your hands with it, and punch through the seal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Necrocollege Rejects
quests.description: Necroproff Mueran went deeper into the tomb by himself! I think I see undead minions down there! Beat them up, and make Mueran show proof that he wasn't the one that summoned them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Estrangement
quests.description: Do you think we could get to see Victoria earlier if we just knock? It’s so weird, I've never been this nervous to talk to my sister. Sure, I’ve stomped over to her room to complain about things, but this is different…Let’s check with Nialla. She's Vic's new Lady in Waiting.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mopping Up ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Tell-Tale Heart
quests.description: I want to hear all about what happened in Skye from you and big sis, but we should get Felix and Illaria settled in first! They… have a lot to deal with, and so do we. Let's check go check on them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Storm Queen ' quest.

quests.name: Philosopher's Pumpkin
quests.description: I was growing a patch of pumpkins in Hans' vegetable garden, but my magic made them weird. Maybe if we squeeze all the bad juice out of them, we could use what's left over for pies? Ah, ask Oishii if she knows how to salvage this.

quests.name: Cosmic Surprise
quests.description: The eggs I was saving for making pumpkin pudding all started to hatch, and now they're running amok in the forest! Please, help me round them up! I hope they're just blue chickens.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Early Birds
quests.description: Zhoom arrived early! This is so embarrassing, he saw the entire mess! As the feast's host, I'm supposed to welcome him, but could you handle that for me? Warlic should be there, too. Ask him how long he thinks it'll take for me to fix everything.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Impossible Meat
quests.description: The original plan was to serve a hearty Chickencow meal, but I accidentally ordered a live batch. Now they're in the middle of ascending into another plane of existence. Let's corral them somewhere safe, and ask Hans if we can get fish instead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Forbidden Fruit
quests.description: I couldn't even get the fruit right, and all I had to do was wash them. We need to grab all the apples before they poison anyone, or awaken a second personality. Make sure you warn Lady Celestia. I saw her cutting them for her Dragon friend.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mananania
quests.description: Somewhere in the middle of baking banana bread, I got frustrated. Maybe went a little…bananas, which gave the actual bananas a case of murderous mania. They picked up knives, and we should peel them before they start taking lives.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: How the Cookie Crumbles
quests.description: I tried baking some dessert cookies. They looked really cute going into the oven, but came out nasty. Was it 'cause I decided on oatmeal instead of chocolate? Yeah, I wouldn't want to be an oatmeal cookie either. We'll crumble them and start over.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Everything Burger
quests.description: Do you know what a Burgoo is? It's like a stew made of whatever you find lying around. Oishii told me about it. I didn't mean to make a Burgoo. The burgers just turned out that way…They're embarrassing to look at, can we please bag and bury them?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pretend You Don't See Anything
quests.description: Oh no! Victoria and her Knight are already here! Please find them, and stall them for as long as possible! Big sis must be exhausted from working so much. I don't want to make this visit another headache for her to worry about.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Coiled Cornucopia
quests.description: Bad news - Warlic said we won't be able to fix the forest until tomorrow. Worse news, me hearing that manifested a monster made of mana and anxieties! Kay, let's take it out, and make sure no one eats it! Its fruit looks pretty, but that nightmare cornucopia came out of my brain!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Leftover Lunching
quests.description: Big sis hasn't noticed that there are still freaky food monsters hanging out in the forest. Guess they'll be lunch for the next few months. Hurry, we'll bag and store them before Vic notices anything weird.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Coiled Cornucopia ' quest.

quests.name: Left Arm Vein
quests.description: Did you see the apparitions outside? I don't want to jump to conclusions and call them ghosts yet. Could you do me a favor and take a few of them down. When you do, talk to my 'parents' while you're at it. I have a feeling we'll find similarities.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Foreign Body Aspiration ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Sour Notes
quests.description: Th-the fakes of m-my parents got sc-scary all of a s-sudden! They g-got the b-better of me. I-I'm s-sorry, but I n-need help with th-this one. D-Do you mind if I c-close my eyes?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Acid Reflux ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Tara and Celestia's Gifts
quests.description: Lady Celestia and I got you gifts, but a bunch of jerks mixed explosives in with them. Ugh, can't they leave you alone for just one day? Let's pick out the safe ones. Be careful! If you nudge the bad boxes, they'll blow up!

quests.name: Heroes' Gifts
quests.description: Artix, Galanoth, Nythera, and a bunch of other heroes from Battleon fought to get seats at your party. Their gifts are in the treasure chests, but it's the same deal. Explosives and poisons are mixed in with the good stuff. Let's open them carefully.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Nation's Gift' quest.

quests.name: Lorekeeper Gifts
quests.description: Maya and her mentor made it to the party. Oof, look at those eye bags. She must have been up for weeks writing your gifts. The story of your adventures had to be split into several volumes, so we'll search the Giftboxes and Treasure Chests.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Nation's Gift' quest.

quests.name: Legion's Gift
quests.description: We're being fake-invaded by the Legion. That's the story that'll let them through the door without getting the civilians outside suspicious, right? Before you grab your Evil friend's gifts, can we get his party crashers to chill? They're acting like this is a real attack.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Nation's Gift' quest.

quests.name: Nation's Gift
quests.description: Is the Archfiend the type that likes to joke around, or is he actually serious about slapping a bow on one of his guys and giving him to you? Carnage doesn't look happy about that at all. Better go convince him it's not that serious.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing it once.

quests.name: Kathool's Gift
quests.description: I would never ever say a kind word about Kathool, but…the prank he pulled on "Dr. Ganx" was a little funny. Still, Kathool's creepy gift is going to start mass hysteria if we let it inside the castle. We'll chop it up julienne style.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Sally's Gift' quest.

quests.name: Noxus' Gift
quests.description: Gravelyn's thicker-headed minions are treating this like a real invasion… but I don't get Noxus' gift. He's clearly trying to bait you into a big monster's mouth. Do you really like this stuff that much? We can check if any of his presents are real after filleting the Angler.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Sally's Gift' quest.

quests.name: Sally's Gift
quests.description: Oh no, did Sally bring…no, it's definitely a fake. Almost got me with how accurately she made the dress. We still don't want that anywhere near the throne room. Let's deal with Sally's gift, and go make sure everyone's okay.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing it once.

quests.name: Drakath's Gift
quests.description: That big purple coward sent his minions to ruin the party, but couldn't be bothered to come himself! His 'gift' is a giant Dragon that's already in the royal archives next to the throne room. We gotta get that thing outta there!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Xanthosis
quests.description: This should be where Fort Luma is. We need to find the entrance, and I bet we aren't far. Just like the other mountains, its Elementals are…in chains? Did the Lightguard do this? Come on. Let's take them down and scope the place out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Conscious Unconsciousness ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once.

quests.name: Golden Lead
quests.description: You saw those… things at the fort's entrance, right? They were just crying at first, and now they're getting angry. I feel bad about hurting them, but they aren't giving us a choice. We need to look for another way inside the fort without getting our throats torn out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Conscious Unconsciousness ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Luminary Vision
quests.description: There was a hole under that tarp you found! I think it leads directly into Fort Luma! It had to have been made by the Luminary Coalition. Maya should be with them. I hope they're alright. Let's crawl through and see if we can find any of the friendly Paladins.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Conscious Unconsciousness ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Premature Sunrise
quests.description: Yara and Arondight scouted out the Fort already, and know where Isiri and the others are being held. They just need a clear route to safely evacuate them. We'll start with the Lightguard Elites. Aleister and I are going to give those jerks another heaping dose of payback.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Conscious Unconsciousness ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blinded by the Light
quests.description: Fort Luma's employees of the month just showed up. I remember Rigaud. That liar told us he was with the Luminary Coalition. The survivors in the Sanctuary told me Cassie was the one who destroyed their homes, too. Wanna kick their teeth in?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Conscious Unconsciousness ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wayward Wisewoman
quests.description: Yara said that Fort Luma's holding cells are on the first floor down the eastern hall. There are a few stragglers left, some Elites and the Elementals they've… leashed. Get them out of the way, and we'll have a clear shot to Maya and the others.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Conscious Unconsciousness ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Incognizance
quests.description: Quick! Search the other holding cells! They're in the next room. Maybe Maya and the other captured civilians are trapped there! We need to rescue them! TH They should be guarded, but…what's that crackling sound?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Conscious Unconsciousness ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Flowers of Luma
quests.description: Don't treat Maya like she's already gone! It isn't too late! Hurry up the stairs to the second floor. I can smell…Dragonfire. Isiri told me about the twins, Clementine and Clemantis. We'll tie their necks into knots! You hear that? This is for Volg!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Conscious Unconsciousness ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Quid Pro Quo
quests.description: The door to the left on the second floor…There's lab equipment in here. The Lightguard must have stolen it from Forge Citrinitas. I think that broken screen over there is flickering. Check it out. Aleister and I will help you clear the room out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Conscious Unconsciousness ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Drowned King in Yellow
quests.description: Do you hear that cackling? Just like Maleno and Albedo, the Flame of Citrinitas is waiting for us. I was really hoping we wouldn't have to fight it until later. No choice now. Aleister and I can take the heat…I hope he can.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Conscious Unconsciousness ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Faith Without Hard Work
quests.description: Astero got away, but he left behind a ton of clues. If we investigate the Flame of Citrinitas, the Luma Dragon Twins, Cassie, and Rigaud … Itll be hard to come up with answers on our own, but we'll bring what we find back to Termina Temple.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Drowned King in Yellow ' quest.

quests.name: Faith Without Hard Work (Legend)
quests.description: Astero got away, but he left behind a ton of clues. If we investigate the Flame of Citrinitas, the Luma Dragon Twins, Cassie, and Rigaud … Itll be hard to come up with answers on our own, but we'll bring what we find back to Termina Temple.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Drowned King in Yellow ' quest.

quests.name: Quadrolithium
quests.description: The experimental ship contained a mineral called Quadrolithium that helped power the engine. When it crashed, bits of it were scattered everywhere. It's very radioactive and poisonous to the environment! Help me help the forest by collecting the Quadrolithium from the Dwakels! Bring me 8 pieces of it for a big reward!

quests.name: Dam Balloons
quests.description: If I tell you a secret, will you promise to keep it? ….Okay, here goes: When I was a little girl, I followed some Dwakel tracks into the woods to a secluded pond. I saw a Dwakel dressed in mage robes replenishing his mana from the pond! Guess what— that pond is connected to this artificial creek by an underground spring. We need to dam up this creek so that the pond doesn't run dry. The Dwakels carry Dam Balloons as part of their suits. Bring me 10 Dam Balloons so I can inflate them at a good spot to save the mana pond!

quests.name: Bumper Bolts
quests.description: Most of the Dwakel around here are carrying spare parts they need to fix the crashed ship! We can slow them down by taking the parts from them. Bring me 12 Bumper Bolts and we'll do just that! I think this Dwakel Spybot will be sufficient pay for your help.

quests.name: Mithril Man Batteries
quests.description: It looks like the Dwakel are guarding the crash site using their most advanced mecha-suit: the Mithril Man! You have to stop that big heap o' metal! Bring me their batteries to prove you did it! I'll give you this massive, mechanical polearm for your help.

quests.name: ProtoSartorium Parts
quests.description: The Dwakels haven't given up yet. They've deployed their strongest power suit: the Protosartorium. If you can bring me its spare parts, I'll use them and the Mithril Man batteries you collected earlier to create a power suit of your own!

quests.name: The Guardian Taro Blademaster
quests.description: Hello friend. My meditation is complete and my mind is clear. If your aura is untainted by evil, I will fight for you. Heroes that wield the Purified Claymore of Destiny are on the path of good. Do you have such a weapon in your possession?

quests.name: A Test of Temptation
quests.description: If you wish to pursue the path to clarity, then you must resist the temptations of evil. The ArchFiend's gems are valuable and have been tainted by darkness. Test your willpower by collecting a large quantity of them and then destroying them. If you can do that, then I'll know you can handle what's to come.

quests.name: Dog Gone
quests.description: You turn your back for just one minute, and suddenly half your hounds have escaped! It's the story of my life. Say, you look strong. You can catch them and bring them back to me!

quests.name: Worm Food
quests.description: Those giant worms that we used in the invasion of Swordhaven? They eat up to three times their own weight every day. This means we have to work hard keep that compost heap full. Strong hero! Gather meat from any source you can - I will not ask any questions! - and then deposit it into the compost heap behind me. (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Special Treats
quests.description: Much like vampires, Imps thrive on blood. Sometimes, when they've been good, we like to give them Blood Maggots as a special treat. Could I get you to pick some up for me? You can find them in the Darkovia Forest. Be careful, though - the Imps will only eat them if they're not all smushed-up.

quests.name: What You Treasure Most
quests.description: I'm glad you're excited, because the beginning is somewhat of a chore. We have to find pieces of gold in order to forge an artifact crucial for the rest of our adventure. The first is hidden in the hoard of a greedy Dragon. The second is at a famous convention. The third will be in the deepest layer of Battleon.

quests.name: Trial of the Heart
quests.description: The Compass's whispers will take you down the right path. Take the heart of the Shadow Lord, which he'll be loathe to part with. Don't be offended - the nature of this lifeforms is… different. Their voices can drive you mad, hahahaha!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Compass Rose Skull in your inventory.

quests.name: Blood-Dyed Stones
quests.description: If you want to craft more itms, we'll have to mimic the Duke of Sramol's crafting method. The Compass should whisper the way once more. Obtain a Suspicious Ruby from the Cursed Treasure in /greed. Then, gather the inner shadows from a human soul.he Vindicators in /trygve are a good pick for this. I'm sure you'll find a way to do it!

quests.name: Seal of Proof
quests.description: My father only respects those who break chains and build bridges. Prove your worth- no tricks.

quests.name: Cogs and Gears
quests.description: If I'm going to build you a weapon, I'm going to need PARTS! Bring me: 6 Cogs from the Ancient Chest in the Time Library, 3 vials of Sneak Oil, and the chassis from 6 broken Training Globes that have fallen to the ground.

quests.name: Flourishes and Furbelows
quests.description: As a golem, I do what my creator says. And he is telling me that I am going to create armors. Hunh. My implanted memories don't include directions for that, so I'll need to wing it. Bring me: 4 Metal Shards from the Training Globes, 4 Tog Claws for fabric fasteners, and 2 strips of Gorillaphant leather from Arcangrove.

quests.name: Target Practice
quests.description: Any purveyor of weapons knows that without testing, a weapon cannot be trusted. I don't want to send out any faulty equipment, so please bring me back 10 Chaos Shadowscythe Skins from the virtual MechQuest simulation and the head of an Undead Soldier so that I know it shoots straight!

quests.name: Majestic Mech Masterpiece
quests.description: I have some schematics to make some mechs. But I'm missing some parts. First, we'll need some knowledge on how to actually use a mech. We can try to ask the Shadowscythe here. I only partially remember how to. Then, we'll need some ZZZ Batteries from the Training Globes here. Finally, we'll need some cooling fans and some rockets from the mechs over in DeathOfGames. After that, I SHOULD be able to finish making one.

quests.name: An Ambitious Undertaking
quests.description: I have some more schematics in order to make even more MECHAS! To make these ones, I'll need more info on what they even look like. Can you ask the students in MQLesson? Next, I need some more wires. You should be able to get them from the Defense Turrets… in DreadSpace. And while you're there, can you beat up some of the Undead Star Rangers? One of them owes me money for some parts, but I forgot who.

quests.name: The Energy Blade of Awe
quests.description: I heard about this powerful weapon called the Blade of Awe. How about we try to make a LASER version of it? First, I'll need my wrench. I lost it somewhere. Next, I'll need some Laser Crystals. You can get those from the Chaos Shadowscythe in MQLesson. Then, we'll need to get an Energy Blade hilt that could work for a blade like this. The Supreme Shadowscythe in BossChallenge has a hoard of energy blade parts stashed away. Maybe it has one that could match? Finally, we'll need some Power Cells from the Ancient Mecha in GenesisGarden.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Blade of Awe in your inventory.

quests.name: Cannon Restoration
quests.description: Now this is something I haven't seen in a while, and it's in need of repairs you say? Well unfortunately I can't help you, not right now at least. You see, in the world I come from we have specialized tools for these kinds of weapons and with this one in particular, there are parts that I'm unable to reach on my own. If you can find someone small enough, like a Floozer, who could reach those parts, then it could be repaired. Except you'd need to find one first, and then it'd demand to be fed afterwards, I hear they like peanuts.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Valoth's Broken Cannon in your inventory to access this quest.

quests.name: Level 1
quests.description: *A thought whispers in your mind, the strength of a steel blade behind it.* Hero, undead vermin have stolen into the upper levels of the temple's crypt. Slimeskulls, Bonemunchers, and Shelletons are defiling our sacred ground. Bring back proof that thou hast slain 3 of each!

quests.name: Level 2
quests.description: *The sadness in the Guardian's mind is balanced by determination, and you can hear it resonate inside you.* Undead mages were crucial in bringing about the downfall of the temple. They corrupted holy runes and even now infest the Crypt. Remove 3 Mages and 3 Ectomancers, and salvage 6 of the runes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 3
quests.description: *A picture forms in your mind of ghouls and lichs desecrating this level of the once-proud temple.* My friend, avenge my brethren. Slay the ghouls and lichs that remain, and bring back proof of your success in the form of their armor!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 4
quests.description: *You feel the heat of phantom flames caressing your cheeks, and a chill runs down your spine* These most private halls were put to the torch. Fight fire with ethereal fire by placing Aether torches around the Crypt to clear the temple's aura and take revenge in my place against 6 of the Fire Mages.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 5
quests.description: *A shining Key, bathed in Light, hovers before your eyes. When you reach out to it, your fingers close on empty air.* Every five levels the Temple Superiors locked passage deeper into the Crypt. You will need to find the Auroral Key. Any of the Skeleton Fighters, Slimeskulls, or Ectomancers could have it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 6
quests.description: *Screams of terror echo in your ears, and a ghostly vision of gaping mouths filled with razor-sharp teeth assault your wide-open eyes.* The mouths, the horrid, gaping jaws! They rent our novices and ripped apart our warriors. Avenge our memories, Hero, by slaying 2 Bonemunchers and 4 Sanguine Souleaters.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 7
quests.description: *You close your eyes for a moment as you catch your breath , and a vision of the Temple as it once stood fills your inner eye.* My friend, you can see how far our fair halls have fallen. The detritus of the last battle still fills the rooms of the Crypt. Remove 12 of the cast-off armors of the invaders!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 8
quests.description: The Stone Paladin's thoughts, which have been a constant companion on your journey deeper into the Crypt, falls silent, and you can sense that it is his utter sorrow which has silenced him. Fury rises inside you, and you vow to take it out on mages. Two of them carry Orbs of power. Strip the undead of them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 9
quests.description: The Crypt is infested with Ghouls! You congratulate yourself on investing in Anti-Ghoulstones. Place them around the levels of the Crypt you have conquered so far. The stones do not work instantly, so you'll also need to take out 6 Ghouls to get the exodus started.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 10
quests.description: You have once more reached a level locked by one of the Temple's Keys of Light. One of the thieving Ectomancers, Skeletons, or Ghouls MUST have stolen it. Battle them until you find the Luminous Key, and your journey will be able to continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 11
quests.description: *You feel a pressure in your mind, as if someone is pressing on your shoulder to get your attention.* Time grows long, and the evil corrupting our Temple grows stronger. The souls that remain are awash in terror. Set out 10 Benevolence Beacons to soothe them and free 6 of those trapped by the Sanguine Souleaters.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 12
quests.description: *The feeling of slime running down your skin has you shuddering in disgust.* Yes… that is what that last of our defenders felt as they were attacked by Slimeskulls and Ectomancers. Kill as many of them as possible, and bring back a Slime-Soaked Skull and Ecto-Covered Core.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 13
quests.description: *Phantom sparkles fill your field of view. They swirl and float, and finally coalesce into the image of a violet Orb.* Those are Aether Orbs. We would place them in the halls to keep the Temple's atmospheric energy healthy. The undead removed them all. Put 12 of them back, and the Temple will be on its way to restoration!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 14
quests.description: *The clanging and scraping of steel on steel fills your mind. You put your hands over your ears, but there is no escaping the aural assault.* Yes… yes. That is what we heard when the Skeletons overran the Temple. They remain, much to my sorrow. Wipe out 6 of them, and perhaps the wounds in my soul will begin to heal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 15
quests.description: *The sight of the Incadescent Key floats before you, calling to you.* I know thee canst sense it. Feel the pull of the Key. It calls to thee, but its summons grows faint. I can only tell that the beacon comes from either a Lich, Ghoul, or Slimeskull.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 16
quests.description: *The image of an young girl trying on her first set of armor appears before you, and you feel a phantom tear trickle down your cheek.* My daughter, Anora. She was so young, during that last battle. I fought for her, and slaughtered many skeletons. Place 10 of their skulls around the Crypt to warn away the rest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 17
quests.description: *You feel as you are grinding phantom bones under your boots.* Thee knows what an undead swarm is like. And now that I am helpless to cleanse my Temple, I need thee! Take out the remaining Bonemunchers and Skeletons, and bring back a Spiky Collar and Vertebrae Trophy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 18
quests.description: *You feel your skin begin to grow hard, and your muscles tense, locking you in place. Your jaw clenches and your head grows heavy.* Yes… that is what I feel, my friend. It was magic that did this to me, and I fear only magic can undo it! In my name, slaughter 4 of the Undead Mages and 2 of the Fire Mages!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 19
quests.description: *A sense of the Stone Paladin's pride and anticipation fills you.* Sadly, our Crypt has not been cleansed since the invasion. Remove 6 of the piles of Bonemuncher bones and take down 10 of the Shelletons and 3 of the Skeletons who continue to defile my home!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 20
quests.description: *Ghostly cheers ring in your ears, and you feel a phantom hand grip your shoulder in a gesture of solidarity.* Thou wilt need the Radiant Key to pass beyond this chamber. It was stolen by a Lich, or perhaps either a Skeleton Fighter or Soldier. I KNOW thou canst find it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defy the Dracolich
quests.description: *A vision of two shining keys appears in your mind's eye. One shatters, and the shards fly outward.* Yes, two Keys exist, though only ONE is needed. One is on the Dracolich, and the 40 shards of the other have been stolen by Undead and Fire Mages, Lichs, and Ectomancers. Bring them to me and merge them into one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Restore the Tome
quests.description: 10 of the tome's pages have been scattered around the Crypt. Find them and return them to unlock the secrets of this ancient repository of knowledge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Recover the Pages
quests.description: 10 of the tome's pages have been stolen by the monsters invading the Crypt. The pages could be on any of them! Recover them and bring them back to unlock the secrets of this ancient repository of knowledge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reconstruct the Codex
quests.description: The last page was stolen by the CryptKeeper, a Lich who has aimed to make our fair halls his home. Show him that he cannot defile this sacred place! Retrieve the last of the Tome's pages and defeat the Cryptkeeper.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nulgath's Messenger
quests.description: Hehehe… it seems you finally discovered I've been Nulgath's messenger for centuries while Skew was his favorite minion. Skew and I had a lot of fun together while slaying Legion and betrayers even before when you first discovered Tercessuinotlim through Citadel's magic portal. If you want to have fun with me, reagents you must farm for and rewards shall be given in the name of Nulgath!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Unidentified 13: " The Contract of Nulgath " in your inventory.

quests.name: The Game of Gemstones
quests.description: So… You're not a very rich minion, are you? That's honestly a real shame. You are so broke, you can't even afford a lousy gem? AND are struggling a lot to get it back?! Wow, you're fortunate enough to have me around. There's some small luck. According with our ARS (Abyssal Revenue Services) you have no rights to claim a refund but I can aid you a bit to get part of your gold back, if you wish to hunt gemstones scattered around Lore, hahaha! You want to go into the /catacombs to find the crazed scorpion doctor, /lavarun to find the muscle head known as Mega Tyndarius, The PvP captains in where you humans go to fight one another in /bludrutbrawl, Wolfwing is his lair, and see if you can manage to find one from yourself in the insane Sneevil's lair /baconcatyou.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Unidentified 13: " The Contract of Nulgath " in your inventory.

quests.name: Assisting Drudgen
quests.description: Master's minion, it seems you are in possession of one of my master's assistant, the Sneevil we call Drudgen. In order to promote more assistance, I'm able to help you slightly better if you bring me things Drudgen do also seek and maybe you can spin his wheel with more luck.

quests.name: Assisting Crag and Bamboozle
quests.description: What now? Ooooh… it seems you do possess the double trouble guys, Crag the golem and Bamboozle the sneevil, they really like to be friends with each other. Let’s make a deal; If you bring me some reagents I can persuade Bamboozle to spin the wheel with more “luck” while you bring some snacks to feed the good boy Crag in the end.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Crag & Bamboozle in your inventory.

quests.name: Assisting Oblivion Blade
quests.description: Amazing! You do have in your possession the ancient Oblivion Blade of Nulgath, an assistant rarely seen throughout Lore. Very well Master's minion! In return, I'm giving you an exclusive mission of seek, hunt and destroy if you are capable to finish this task, otherwise you are NOT worthy of possessing this blade.

quests.name: Sole Blood Blade
quests.description: For a small price I'll give you a sword to cut through anyone.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Bloodletter of Nulgath in your inventory to access these quests.

quests.name: Sole Empowered Blood Blade
quests.description: For a small price I'll give you a sword to cut through anyone.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Bloodletter of Nulgath in your inventory to access these quests.

quests.name: Purifying Nature
quests.description: You did well to help the Champion of Nature, Hero. If you are willing, I would ask your assistance to aid the remaining creatures on this area. Subdue the Corrupted Zards and bring me Treant Blossom Nectar and Myconid Spores. We shall work together to purify them before the taint gets too strong.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Down Terrane ' quest to access this quest.

quests.name: Don't Drink!
quests.description: Don't drink, drink this prison ain't so great! You'll need to collect an alternate source of liquid. Try killing bunnies and moths for any liquid they may have!

quests.name: Flying...and Falling
quests.description: Birds fly into windshields, and if you're not careful, when you're flying through the air after leaving the catapult, you might, too! Kill 10 dust bunnies and collect 10 bits of fluffy padding to cushion your landing.

quests.name: Soul of a Dracolich
quests.description: You want tokens? Fine, but don't expect it to be a walk in the park. Dage has need of souls with VAST power to fuel his exploits. Dragons will have that kind of power. Bring me 20 Elemental Dragon Souls from the Zombie Dragon in /dragonheart, and he shall use it to reap the Dracolich of his spirit.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Thanatos the Destroyer
quests.description: If you would don the mantle of Death, you must BECOME Death. And the only way to do that is to defeat Death. Slay Death for a chance to get one of the Thanatos set items.

quests.name: Flame the Evil
quests.description: Glory in the name of Dage the Evil, Dark Lord of all the Undead! Bring him 10 Firestorm Knight Blades and he will reward you with gold… and more.

quests.name: Death-dealing Blows
quests.description: To truly fill Death's role, there's a lot you'll need to learn. Like how Death - you - experience the death of mortals. It can be quite overwhelming to feel another being's lifeforce extinguish. Kill 5 heroes in combat inside any of Lore's PvP grounds, then return here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Thief of Hours ' quest.

quests.name: Fear the Reaper
quests.description: I fear that the inhabitants of your Underworld have… sensed you are different, Death. They have risen up and are plotting to remove you and rule in your place. Foolish unmortals! You will need to neutralize the minions in revolt to prove you DO command this realm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Master Death's Realm
quests.description: If you are to be the TRUE Master of this realm, you will need to be able to summon its portals. Your realm is linked to you, so if YOU believe that you are strong enough, the realm will. Slay 10 of the underworld's creatures to prove your strength, then /cast the spell to raise the Portal near the arch.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Real Live Hero-Training
quests.description: Death, not YOU, the other one, is out of control. You'd better make sure he isn't making more trouble than he - or you - can handle. A slain mage brought word from the blacksmiths, at BattleOn's Forge, that Death and Thok are engaged in a fight to the… death. Hurry there to save Thok!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Living Library
quests.description: To learn how to best Death, you need to KNOW Death. For that, you'll need the Xhar Morghuil, the living library. It records the existences and histories of things which should not be named, but are best not forgotten. The Mana Golem, Mana Imp and Mana Falcon in /elemental hold the spell runes to unlock its pages.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Understanding Xhar Morghuil
quests.description: To understand how to best the former Death, you will need to know what the Xhar Morghuil has kept hidden for eons. Ask it 3 questions, and what it tells you will help you regain your mortality.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Door to Eternity
quests.description: You say the sarcophagus in this realm is actually a… doorway? To a plane where Death's daughters fill and store mortals' hourglasses? Then yes, I suggest you DO find it and open it, quickly. You should not leave such a resource unexplored! To think a stone coffin could hide so very much.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Death vs Death
quests.description: I have taken the liberty of summoning the now-mortal ex-Death. You will need to confront him if you hope to regain your mortal body.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Nation Needs YOU!
quests.description: You're here for the recruitment drive, eh? Well, thanks for the interest, but we're looking for STRONG heroes. Real tough fighters. We're going to be going up against the Queen's army, you know.

quests.name: Show Me More, Nation-Noob
quests.description: You did well, but that first round was just to weed out the weak. A real Nation champion can take on even the toughest Shadowscythe and Legion scum - I mean fighters. Right. We're working together now. Head into the arena and show me how good you are! Defeat Legion Fenrirs and Doombringers!

quests.name: For the Nation!
quests.description: We weren't expecting anyone to make it this far, but in the arena you will find Elite Shadowscythe and Legion volunteers. Go kick their butts. Take out Legion Cannons and Paragons, and Doomknight Prime and Draconic Doomknights!

quests.name: Nulgath Likes Your Style
quests.description: You're showing a lot of potential, Prospect – maybe you're even good enough to become Nulgath's right-hand Hero! Want to show him what you're made of? Then step on into the arena and defeat Grimlord!

quests.name: Nation Recruits: Seal Your Fate
quests.description: Nulgath imbued part of his essence into these Fiend Seals and Gems of Domination. The Legion warriors in this arena hold these seals, and the Shadowscythe warriors have his Gem of Domination. Your task, if you have the strength to complete it is this: Best them for a chance to recover 25 seals and 1 Gem, then return to me for your reward!

quests.name: Nation Loyalty Rewarded
quests.description: Loyal members of the Nation like you have proven themselves worthy of even greater rewards. Relics of defeated, powerful enemies can be used to create strong magic. Bring me the remains of your defeated foes and I'll reward you.

quests.name: Void Highlord Badge
quests.description: Only the strongest members of the Nulgath Nation survive the trials to become a Void Highlord. Bring me a Fiend Seal from any of the creatures in this arena, and I will reward you with a character page badge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have at least one class point on Void Highlord (Class) in your inventory.

quests.name: Hardly Suiting Armor
quests.description: I am forever bound to my cursed armor. The only way to break the curse is to find all four pieces of my armor and destroy them. You'll find them guarded by the 4 most powerful monsters in Greenguard… the Greenguard Dragon, the Greenguard Basilisk, the Deathgazer and the Gell Oh No. Where do these monsters lurk? Finding them is part of your challenge, as well.

quests.name: Clear A Path
quests.description: Toil: Thanks for helping us out. Normally we can handle Monglinsters on our own but these guys are getting out of hand. You'll never make it out alive unless you clear a path to the storage room where Myx is being held. Bring us 10 tufts of Moglinster Fur so that I know the way is safe.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Killer, Chiller, Thriller here Tonight ' quest.

quests.name: Kanathalite-D
quests.description: Bubble: Those Sugarrush Ghouls in there are pretty mean when they don't get enough sugar. They've found our stash of bars of Kanthalite-D, one of the rare magical substances that makes our candy so amazing! If they get ALL of the bars of Kanthalite-D then we'll be ruined for sure! Please stop the Sugarrush Ghouls and bring us 8 Kan-D bars!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Killer, Chiller, Thriller here Tonight ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Myx It Up
quests.description: Trouble: Myx is being guarded by some kind of Super Moglinster. He appears to be quite a bit tougher than the others. You might want to invite to some friends with you. If you can defeat the Super Moglinster before the rest of them show up then you should be able to sneak back here with Myx. Please hurry!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Killer, Chiller, Thriller here Tonight ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Candy Conundrum
quests.description: There has got to be a reason for the Moglinsters' violent behavior! You have helped us out so much, Hero, but can you do us another favor? Apparently the Moglinsters ate too much candy… but this candy was not a Cauldron Sisters' specialty. Who could be behind this Mogloween madness? Collect 10 Candy Samples from Moglinsters… and hurry!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Killer, Chiller, Thriller here Tonight ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Boos Clues
quests.description: Head through that portal and bravely face whatever is waiting on the other side! I am sure that whoever is responsible has set up defensive security precautions, so be careful! Collect 4 clues that the monsters drop and bring those items back to us. These clues just might be the answers that we are looking for!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Killer, Chiller, Thriller here Tonight ' quest.

quests.name: What's Up, Doc?
quests.description: Dr. Voltabolt must be stopped! Everyone knows he's a magic-hating mad scientist and all, but this time he's gone too far! Head back through the portal and confront Voltabolt. Bring us back his Monocle once you've had a few choice words with him! You are our only hope at saving Mogloween!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Killer, Chiller, Thriller here Tonight ' quest.

quests.name: Investigate the Farmhouse
quests.description: Something's just not right… and do you hear that ominous music playing off in the distance?! What is going on here?!? Please take a look around. Come back if you happen to come across anything too unusual, even for a Hero like yourself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What's Up, Doc? ' quest.

quests.name: Children of Chaos
quests.description: Where are these kids' parents anyway!? Don't they know it's a dangerous place out there? Well, I guess it's up to you to protect them. Make 10 of them take off that hideous Chaos getup and send them to bed…or wherever. And tell them NO video games either!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What's Up, Doc? ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Where is that Barn Key?
quests.description: You need to get into that barn. Maybe the kids' parents are trapped in there? We don't know of any barns that have locked doors… but regardless, you have to find that key. Maybe one of those rebellious Chaos kids have it? Come back to us when you find it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What's Up, Doc? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Investigate the Barn
quests.description: Alright. You got the Key. Now plow through those doors and find those parents… hopefully!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What's Up, Doc? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: Malik-EYE is so Grounded
quests.description: You know what you have to do. Go back to the barn and show that candy-crazed-chaos-kid who is boss around here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What's Up, Doc? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clearing the Candy Corn Field
quests.description: Behind the barn is where the fields of free range candy corn grow. But it wouldn't surprise us at all if the scarecrows there have been chaorrupted too! Clear the fields of 10 Field Guardians and head on back here so we know you're still alive.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What's Up, Doc? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: So Sick of EYE-sac
quests.description: Just like the chaos kids and Malik-EYE, EYE-Sac needs to be taught to respect his elders. I bet that little scoundrel is hiding somewhere in the candy corn fields. Go find him and free him of that chaos curse!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What's Up, Doc? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: She Who Walks Behind The Stalks
quests.description: We don't know who this Stalkwalker is, but she doesn't sound like a nice person. Defeating her is your only shot at freeing the kids from this chaos spell (maybe even finding out where their parents are) …and hopefully getting our most needed shipment of ultra-high fructose candy corn syrup…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What's Up, Doc? ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: Slay the Stalking Dead
quests.description: We'll need to gather reagents to make the Pumpkin Squashing Elixir, but we can't move freely until these zombies disperse. Can you go out there and knock a few of them out? Be sure not to hurt them too badly!

quests.name: Cauldron Spice Chaos
quests.description: Now that we've thinned the horde, we'll need to gather spicy reagents - after all, it takes a spice to counter a spice! If we can reverse engineer the formulla Gourdello used to create these larvae, we SHOULD be able to form the elixir. The zombies should have the items we're looking for.

quests.name: Sugar, Spice, and Everything Vice
quests.description: Now to gather the tougher ingredients… Let's search the local area to see if we can find some Leo-sporin. I know the plant usually grows around here during this season, but we're not usually awake to pick it ourselves!

quests.name: A (Pumpkin)-Smashing Success
quests.description: For this next reagent, do you think you can extract a Pumpkin Spice Larvae from one of the afflicted? It'll catalyze the potion-making process if we can just get our hands on one! Be careful out there!

quests.name: From Grande to Venti
quests.description: Oh! It looks like we'll need the CUPS the afflicted drank from, as well! Could you please go back and scour the area to see if any are still lating around? I'll bet those Spiced Draconians in Gourdello's lab are carrying a few, as well!

quests.name: Pumpkinectic Potential
quests.description: All right, now for the last ingredient! We've gathered everything else while you were away, but you'll still need to help us find a glowing Pumpkin seed! It's too dangerous to look for the Great Pumpkin King right now, but there's a small change that the zombies outside might have one. Just know them out until you can find one!

quests.name: Squash the OverGourd
quests.description: Unless we stop the OverGourd, the whole PLANET will be infected with pumpkin spice - and NO ONE will be able to resist! Rescue Myx and put an end to Gourdello's madness once and for all!

quests.name: Mysterious Chest
quests.description: This mysterious chest has SEVEN locks! You're going to need seven keys to open it. Once you've collected the keys from all Seven Deadly Dragons, you'll be able to open the chest and see what wonders it might contain!

quests.name: Sprig Cleaning
quests.description: I have become infested with these mad beasts infected by chaos magic, and their insanity gnaws at me like a plague of insects chewing away my leaves. Dispatch these beasts so that my faithful druids may return to their home. Your efforts will be rewarded.

quests.name: Bleak Despair
quests.description: For years and year, they've wandered the wheel, condemned to a life of bleak despair. Kill monsters to get John and John the free-running equipment so they can escape the trap of the hamster wheel! You'll need Running Shoes, a Track Suit, a Sweat Band, and a Water Bottle!

quests.name: An Apple Slice? Yum!
quests.description: If only you could eat half a circle of cheese, half a moon-pie, or an apple slice. But all you've got is pellets! If you want to eat at all, you'll need to take them from the monsters and find them around the cage!

quests.name: The Legion?
quests.description: What are these things? Some kind of experiment? They are different from Master Nulgath's Fiends but I sense a familiarity. Regardless, they are in my way!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Baelgar ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Dealing With Defectors
quests.description: What has become of these Fiends? I sense Master Dage's magic, twisting them. And yet, they are here of their own accord. These Defectors must be stopped.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Baelgar ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ward Destruction
quests.description: It seems that Master Dage has put up Wards to keep Master Nulgath's eyes off of this place. Regardless of what happens to me, I must take down these Wards so Master Nulgath can see what has happened here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Baelgar ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Traitor's Path
quests.description: I do not know what has led you down this path, Master Dage, but I will stop you before you can complete it. Your forces and defenses will fall before me and soon, you will too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Baelgar ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Dage the Lich
quests.description: Old friend, it pains me to face you like this. But I must. It has always been my duty to show you the right path. I will see my duty fulfilled.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Baelgar ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Choose Your Path
quests.description: Alteon, your king, has ordered you to Highwick, but the cost may well be Lynaria's life. Which path will you choose?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Gather the Shadows ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: With Every Wind
quests.description: You hear a soft voice coming from the Throne. "It appears someone's been tampering with the timelines. Yet, I feel a presence, oddly similar to the king's. Could it be… nevermind. I'm trapped here, and I'm willing to help you if my soul is freed from this throne. Gather the correct gear, and I'll tell you how to reforge the king's arsenal."
quests.requirements_note: Must have The Hollow Hail in your inventory.

quests.name: Hail To The King
quests.description: "You had no trouble handling the royal weaponry. I'll assume you're ready for the next step: crafting the king's armor itself! Bring something to catalyze Ice and Darkness, as well as Human Souls to feed the fusion."
quests.requirements_note: Must have The Hollow Hail , Hollowborn Frost King's Scepter , Hollowborn Frost Queen's Scythe , Hollowborn Frost King's Cowl and Hollowborn Frost Queen's Tiara in your inventory.

quests.name: Cold, Cold, COLD!
quests.description: "All Hollowborn are measured by their willpower. While wearing my armor, your body and will become mine. Before I spread my power across another timeline, we need a new minion. Go gather souls and bones so we can build a new one that suits our needs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Hollowborn Frost King , Hollowborn Frost Queen and The Hollow Hail in your inventory.

quests.name: Nothing There
quests.description: I remember the Oblivion that looked down on me as I fell into the abyss, but it's been a long time since then. Investigate the Empty Creatures, the Oblivion Magi, and the Herald. That would be more helpful than my stale old memories.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Allure of the Void ' quest.

quests.name: Indignant Stubbornness
quests.description: To the east, you'll find the cliff where Oblivion and I parted ways. Carnage is making his way there. He must have seen something that motivated him to stay awake. Find him, and fight off the Empty Creatures seeking to fill their husks with your viscera.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Allure of the Void ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Over the Edge
quests.description: Nulgath brazenly stepped over the edge of that cliff. You wouldn't be able to survive the fall. Not comfortably, at least. Gather the sinew from the bone spires sprouting from the snow. Take care not to stare at them for too long. You'll wake them up.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Allure of the Void ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Restless Pride
quests.description: Climb down that rope, and try not to vomit. At the bottom of this pit is a spatial tear that leads to the Fiend God's realm. You'll find all the bones Adimonde picked out of his teeth. Other Hushed, leftovers like me, will attack on sight. Put them out of their misery.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Allure of the Void ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Greywater
quests.description: You'll feel the bottom of your boots melt the closer you get to the bottom. We'll all flow down there eventually, like water getting sucked into a drain. The number of Empty Creatures and Hushed will be densest there. Get them out of your way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Allure of the Void ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Fiendish Waste
quests.description: At the very bottom of this pit, destroy what remains of a Withered Archfiend. Nulgath is nearby. I sense it, and he's waiting to see if you can push his predecessor back into the Fiend's Void. Take care not to fall in yourself. It'll make Adimonde laugh.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Allure of the Void ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Inevitable Departure
quests.description: You've gazed into the Fiend's Void, and decided to turn your back on it. That's right. Very good. It's time to leave. Head back west, and see if you can relight the Candles. Maybe that Lost Expeditioner can point you the right way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Allure of the Void ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Emptiness Embodied
quests.description: The Oblivion Magi are on the move. That means their Master is beginning to feel something other than melancholic nothing. Cut them down, and keep heading west. Don't let their emptiness seep into you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Allure of the Void ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ice Ages Past
quests.description: This is new. Oblivion's influence is pulling the remains of an extinct species out of the black snow. The Ettin have been mutated into Fiends by an Archfiend's power. Raise your weapon, and return them to their graves. Their time is over.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Allure of the Void ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stirring Darkness
quests.description: The black snow is rippling, and Oblivion's minions are gathering around us. Slay them where they stand, and continue on your way. If Oblivion wants to stop you, he'll have to get up and do it himself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Allure of the Void ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Remember to Breathe
quests.description: Archfiend Oblivion rises out of bitterness, envy, and rage. That's a far cry from emptiness. Haha, Nulgath acknowledged that I exist, and is petitioning me to hand over my student. Defeat Oblivion, and I'll be more than happy to watch him leave.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Allure of the Void ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Let's Get Started
quests.description: So the villagers weren't big on helping me get the items I need for my ritual. Surprising, right?? Perhaps you could "persuade" them to help out.

quests.name: A Ritual by any Other Name
quests.description: Almost halfway there! Just need some more supplies from in town, go into town and click on those blue arrows. Lunarmancers need to maintain a high saline content, so salt is important. Grab a bag of chips from one of the Cove Fishers by the beach!

quests.name: Fish'n'Chips on my Shoulder
quests.description: I know it's not really needed for the ritual but now I'm really hungry for chips, and those stale ones you got just aren't cutting it. Go see if any of those beach goers have some chips on them.

quests.name: Hex on the Beach(balls)
quests.description: I CANNOT have the villagers interrupting my rituals AGAIN. Every time they play with those braken-forsaken beachballs… it ruptures my nerves. And I need those steady1 Go tell 10 of those villagers to keep it down, and bring me back some deflated beach balls!

quests.name: Total Eclipse of the Heart
quests.description: Lunarmancy draws much power from nature, and most of THAT from the sea. With the full moon so close, the sea creatures' power is almost at its peak. Take the Shiny Stone underwater - it should attract the monsters that you need. Bring me 3 branches of coral from the Coral Merdraconians, and 2 scales from Plessie, to create a sheathe for its fang.

quests.name: Lycan this Next Task
quests.description: You're a hero, so presumably you like saving people. You sure didn't seem to like "persuading" them. Run around and rescue 7 of the villagers under threat.

quests.name: "Were" Did We Go Wrong?
quests.description: The villagers are saying that the Horde is trying to get to my HOUSE? NOWAI! They will destroy everything! Go get the Horde!

quests.name: Find the Lycanstone
quests.description: Gravefang's Horde members MUST have some way to locate him. Track down the Horde Knights and see if you can find a Lycanstone.. This way we will know where Gravefang is!

quests.name: Fur the Right Thing
quests.description: So looks like you've drawn out their leader with all of your "heroing". Might as well go ahead and take care of him as well…

quests.name: Dis-lycan What Happened
quests.description: Looks like Gravefang's Horde minions took more out of the villagers than we expected. I have a brew they can drink that will restore them.

quests.name: Time to Rock this Finale!
quests.description: Welp seems not only did I summon the wrong moon, but I accidentally turned that moon into a rock monster… Good luck with that.

quests.name: As Above, So Below
quests.description: A Chronomancer became trapped here because their abilities stopped working. Their body and sense of self were stripped away until only a 'thought' remained. The belief that Time will return for them. By your standards, it looks quite gruesome. Help save them from themselves. They've been waiting a long…time for it.

quests.name: Join My Dojo
quests.description: If you believe you have what it takes to become a Martial Artist, join my dojo and become my student. The challenges you'll face will be unlike anything you've experienced ever before! Few have the determination to see this journey to mastery through. Are you up for it?
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 65. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: 500 Punches and 500 Kicks
quests.description: My techniques harness the abilities of Frogzards, Gorillaphants, and Dragons- three creatures with a deep connection to Lore. You must familiarize yourself with these beasts before your training can truly begin. Let's start with 500 of each. The Frogzards in /nexus, Gorillaphants in /arcangrove, and Dragons in /etherwardes should be suitable foes for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 65. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Deathly Slow Start
quests.description: The trial of 500 you just completed? That was nothing. Let us see how you handle a whopping 500,000 of each! If you think this is too much, then you will never be ready to learn my techniques.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 65. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Discount Diploma
quests.description: That was just the beginning. Are you tired? Ha, I have bad news for you, because now you get to do it again! Remember this bitterness well. It'll make your punches and kicks hit harder than a coddled, silver spoon sucking, Ds-get-degrees layabout!
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 65. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: One Million Miles Searching
quests.description: What is a million more? Several years worth of training, that's what! I expect you to have a beard by the time you're back. It doesn't matter if you don't have the chin for it, you will have whiskers…unless you're up to something.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 65. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ughhhhhh
quests.description: This must be a fluke! Do it again! From the bottom Up! Bring me proof that you've defeated 2000000 Frogzards, 2000000 Gorillaphants, and 2000000 Dragons! I want them extinct!
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 65. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Work Smarter, Not Harder
quests.description: The only way to become a Master of the Martial Arts like me is to defeat 5999500 more Frogzards, 5999500 more Gorillaphants, and 5999500 more Dragons. Until then, I will be the only true Master in history.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 65. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cheater Cheater
quests.description: You didn't just cheat my training regimen. A lazy lout like you cheated yourself. I can't let you spread your methods. My reputation will plummet! Prepare yourself for the hardest lesson of your life! I'll show you what a real Master can do!
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 65. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Minimize the Maxmum Slugfit
quests.description: Maximum Slugfit is small but nasty — a tiny, purple, chitnous, chaorrupted imp. Don't underestimate him, or he may literally eat your face. (Suggested level 10+)
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 8.

quests.name: Defeat the Dire Groglurk
quests.description: First, you will be up against the Dire Groglurk! Stolen from Bludrut Keep, this giant worm will swallow you whole — provided he doesn't slash you to bits with his blade. (Suggested level 15+)
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 10.

quests.name: Devour the Evolved Fear Muncher
quests.description: Lets see if you can take on the Evolved Fear Muncher! This one's a real test of bravery — The feelings of dread it creates can be paralyzing. You won't be able to defeat it unless you can master your fear. (Suggested level 20+)
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 15.

quests.name: Oust the Grievous Inbunche
quests.description: Think you can take on the Grievous Inbunche? This horrifying monstruosity was found guarding the lair of an evil wizard which should teach you something about how terrifying an opponent it can be. (Suggested level 35+)
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 30.

quests.name: Smush the Hulking Castle Spider
quests.description: I'll warn you now: this is the biggest spider in Lore, made ten times worse. If you run from it screaming like a small child, no one will think less of you. (Suggested level 40+)
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 35.

quests.name: Subdue the Supreme Shadowscythe
quests.description: How can you make a Shadowscythe more deadly? How about encasing it in mechanical steel armor that can resist nearly any attack? Do you think you can handle it?. (Suggested level 45+)
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 40.

quests.name: Melt the Ancient Horror
quests.description: I never thought a snowman could ever be anything to fear… untill I laid eyes on this thing. Each of the icy spikes that covers its body is a weapon. Try not to get impaled. (Suggested level 45+)
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 45.

quests.name: Void the Mutated Dragon
quests.description: The Void Dragon was already lethal. After the mutation, it is absolutely devastating. Are you ready to find out of you can go toe to toe with a vicious beast like this… and survive? (Suggested level 55+)
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50.

quests.name: Crush the Colossal Primarch
quests.description: With skin as hard as stone, the former Darkblood Primarch is a though one to beat. The only thing more challenging than landing a damaging hit is stayin out of the way of his giant mace. Think you can handle it? (Suggested level 60+)
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 55.

quests.name: Destroy Graveclaw
quests.description: Remember Graveclaw? Of course you do, who can forget an undead minotaur wielding a huge axe? Well, now he's also venomous, and he's your next challenge in the Coliseum. Good luck! (Suggested level 60+)
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 60.

quests.name: The Story
quests.description: Back to Top

quests.name: Souls to Steal
quests.description: To overwhelm the ArchFiend, our Master must grow stronger! Slay the pathetic worms who follow Nulgath; bring back their souls to inrease his power! 13 of them will do…for now.

quests.name: Hunt for the Infinity Codex
quests.description: Vortex Mages trapped here have stolen the pages of the Infinity Codex. Slay them to recover its pages to learn what you'll need to do in order to pass through the wormhole.

quests.name: Sacrific and Survival
quests.description: To survive, you will need to prove your worth… and it doesn't hurt to come bearing a gift or two as you enter the gods' domain. Sacrific 3 Nagas and 3 Hawks to ask for their blessing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Cartouche of Isis
quests.description: If you would activate the Gate of Isis, you will need to recover the Balm Cartouche. Isis, the mother goddess, was known for her healing ways. Look closesly into the Goblins' pots, and you'll find balm… and the Balm of Cartouche.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Cartouche of Ma'at
quests.description: There are many gates ahead of you. Beyond Isis' Gate lies taht of Ma'at. To pass through it, you will need to recover the 5 pieces the Scale Cartouche. I fear it was stolen by the Vortex Walkers, who wander the wormhole seeking retribution for those who imprisoned them here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bound to Do Good
quests.description: The base of the vortex gate obelisks is made of a substance called "faience" -- to restore the shattered obelisks, you will need to make more. Slay Dimensional Crystals, Gate Goblins, and Vortex Matter to get the quartz, lime, and natron to make faience.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Honor the Goddess Isis
quests.description: We cannot know how this obelisk was shattered or when, but if you wish to pass through the gate and continue through the wormhole, you will need to restore it. Click on Obelisk rubble until you've reassembled it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Stick to the Task
quests.description: You created enough faience for ONE obelisk. Reset assured, you WILL need more before your journey is done. There is an alternate recipe we might try… Slay Dimensional Crystals, Gate Goblins, and Vortex Matter to get the quartz, lime, and ash to make faience.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Honor the Goddess Ma'at
quests.description: The Goddess of Justice was lucky. Whatever destroyed Isis' obelisk could not shatter hers. To unlock the gate, you need only activate the obelisk. The Infinity Codex instructs you to click on the panels. Once they are lit, touch Ma'at's obelisk.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Duty is light as a feather
quests.description: It is known that as one enters the Underworld, they are judged with Ma'at's scales. A feather is weighed against the heart of the hero. If one's heart is light, they pass into the paradise beyond. Your judgement waits… and you will need to bring your own feather. Slay Vortex Hawks until you recover a Feather of Ma'at.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Judgement... or Justice?
quests.description: You may passsed through Ma'at's gate, but she is not finished with you yet! The hour of your judgement is at hand, Hero. In this trial by combat, you must defeat the Hand of Ma'at to prove you are pure of heart. If you fail… you shall never leave this place.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Cartouche of Thoth
quests.description: It is said that if one could gather all the books and scrolls ever written, they would know the sum of all man's knowledge. But Thoth, god of wisdom, already knows. Recover the Scroll Cartouche from the Vortex Mages. Only then will you be able to activate his obelisk.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Make Your Mark
quests.description: We walk through a hall made of starstuff… built upon solidified solar winds and the remnants of stones present when this universe was formed. Honor the gods of the sun, moon, stars, and sky by inscribing their marks upon this place.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Cartouche of Kebechet
quests.description: Kebechet, mother of serpents and preserver of heroes - her cartouche is a snake. Take back the fragments of her cartouche from the Nagas who resemble her so much.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Honor the Goddess Kebechet
quests.description: It may be that another Hero… perhaps even another you?… attempted to pass by, and in doing so destroyed the obelisk. We may never know. But if you wish to pass through the gate and continue through the wormhole, you will need to restore Kebechet's obelisk. Click on the rubble until you've reassembled it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Destroy to Purify
quests.description: You are nearing the edge of the wormhole. I can sense it! But… more battles await, and you will want to prepare - and purify yourself - well for them. Slay Vortex Crystals to gather the natron needed to purify yourself before facing the Vortex Guardian.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Guardian of the Vortex
