quests.name: Elves of the OverSoul
quests.description: Hey! I heard some stories about the OverSoul recently. They have some unique weapons that I'd love to try to replicate for the museum. I'll help you find the resources to make them. First, we need to defeat Adimonde in /Fiendshard… just kidding! First, we need some wood to make the poles for the weapons. The Treeants in /Doomwood would be perfect for that. Next, we need some crystals for the weapons. We could see if the Crystal Mana Construct in /Downward is willing to lend us one. Finally we'll need some mana from Belrot the Fiend in /Citadel.

quests.name: Day of the Thread
quests.description: I've gotten into arts and crafts recently. You'll never know when it might become useful! I want to try to make a plushie, but I need some materials for it first. Can you get some fabric from Senna in Ashfall, some scissors from Yulgar, and some plastic pieces from a doll to fix the eye pieces. Maybe you can find a doll in a shop somewhere?

quests.name: Mug Me Some Dwakels
quests.description: Oh no! My time vortex energy scanner somehow got damaged on the way here! I should be able to fix it if I have the right supplies. These Dwakels should have some. I'll need… let's see… a pneumatic relay from the Flamethrower Dwakels, a sonic transducer from the Dwakel Blasters, and some solenoid helixes from any of them.

quests.name: Mug me One More
quests.description: Nope, still not working. There's one more thing I can try. The part I need is made of mithril, so there's only one Dwakel around here that might have one… the Mithril Man! Beat him up until he hands it over.

quests.name: Hot Spot
quests.description: Now that the scanner is working, I'll need you to use it to scan the entire area around the crash. Don't miss any spots! When you bring it back to me, I'll analyze the data to see where the most likely location of the crash would be. (Quest works once per login)

quests.name: Wibbly Wobbly
quests.description: Next step, we need to go to the crash ruins! The path should have opened up. Look around and see if you can find it. Now let's see where the highest concentration of time vortex energy is… I'll meet you there!

quests.name: Indiana Bones
quests.description: The ship looks pretty empty, but there's a locked room all the way to the back. I bet it's cargo hold - that must be where all the treasure is! Maybe one of these Unlucky Explorers has the key?

quests.name: Timey Wimey
quests.description: Time for Plan B! Maybe if I gather enough space-time energy I can use my scanning device to force the door open with a sonic blast! You should be able to harvest it from the remaining anomalies.

quests.name: These Flares Are The Bomb
quests.description: That sonic blast seems to have worked on the lock, but something is still holding that door closed. I'm going to try to blast it open. I just need a few things…

quests.name: Find My Rod!
quests.description: We made it in! Now, to find the Enchanted Rod of Greased Lightning! It's probably in one of these treasure chests. Help me check them!

quests.name: My Precious
quests.description: Where could this thing be hidden? There has to be something we're missing. Help me scan for time-vortex energy again; the entire ship will set off, but any significant artifacts from Lore's history will show up even brighter. (Quest available once per login)

quests.name: Fried Chicken
quests.description: What have we done? The idol of Cluckmoo, the ancient Chickencow god, has come to life! Kill it! Kill it!

quests.name: Explore the Tunnels
quests.description: Wow, there sure are a lot of monsters in here! I guess I can't be TOO surprised - we are in the tunnels underneath vampire's castle, after all! We need to fully explore these tunnels before we do anything else. And While we're at it, let's get rid of some of these bats and maggots!

quests.name: Find the Keys
quests.description: We need to find a way to get into those treasure chests! Hmm. What about that storage area we found? The one with all the furniture ang things? I bet there are some keys in the drawers and boxes in there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once.

quests.name: Open the Treasure Chests
quests.description: Ok, now that we've found those keys, let's get back into that treasure room and open those chests!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once.

quests.name: Gotta get that Blood
quests.description: "Give sustenance to the vampiric Shrine of Orlok*. Hmm. If it's a vampiric shrine, then its sustenance must be blood! I bet we can get some from the Blood Maggots or the Vampire Bats. Let's try to get enough to fill my spare canteen - 24 ounces.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Feed the Shrine
quests.description: So now I guess we have to… feed it… to the shrine. There seems to be an indentation in the top of it. Maybe we just need to pour it in there?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once.

quests.name: Beat those Ghouls
quests.description: Aaaaaah! Where did all these ghouls come from?! I can't be expected to treasure-hunt in these conditions! Kill 'em! Kill 'em with fire!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Activate the Golden Scepter
quests.description: This Bloodstone you found looks like it's just the right size to fit into the golden scepter we saw back at the entrance! We should go put it in there and see what happens!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once.

quests.name: Check out the Basement
quests.description: Haha, did we just get dropped in the basement's basement? Well, might as well scout this place out and see what we can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be complete once .

quests.name: Get those Symbiotes
quests.description: I'm betting that scepter is our ticket out of here. I don't know where we'll find anohter bloodstone, but… maybe the core from one of these Blood Symbiotes will fit? Fight them until you find one that's about the right size.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Activate the Basement Scepter
quests.description: Let's put that core in the basement scepter and see if it works!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once.

quests.name: Unlock that Chest!
quests.description: Finally! You've opened the way out of the basement so head back to the treasure room. You have the key - get that chest open!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once.

quests.name: Defeat the Blood Dragon!
quests.description: OMG! That treasure is being guarded by an undead dragon! After years of treasure hunting, you'd think I'd know a dragon hoard when I see one! We'll have to slay it if we want to get that Garnet!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bejeweled Blade
quests.description: I love to collect rare things! Battle the monsters in the Guru Forest, the Graveyard and in Lolosia to recover the 6 jewels of Zentaria: Red, Blue, Green, Clear, Yellow and Purple! Bring one of each to me and I will construct a Bejeweled Blade just for you!

quests.name: Open Treasure Chests!
quests.description: Maybe you found a treasure chest while you were adventuring. I can sell you a Magic Key that unlock these mysterious chests which contain EPIC PRIZES but you never know what you'll get. If you have a Treasure Chest and have bought a Magic key from me, I will open it for you!

quests.name: Free Member Magic Keys
quests.description: Do you have a membership to AQWorlds? If so then you get TWO FREE bonus Magic Treasure Chest Keys per month! You can get two more on the 1st of each new month anytime during the month. Just Accept and Complete this quest!

quests.name: The Dark Box
quests.description: I heard that Twilly got a message today about dark and shiny things have been hidden inside the Treasure Chests dropping from monsters around Lore. I do not know where you can find a Dark Gem. O_O If you find things like this, I will help you open it… If you are sure?
quests.requirements_note: Must have Dark Box and Dark Key in your inventory. Notes:

quests.name: Read the Design Notes!
quests.description: Hi! Valencia here, and I want to make sure you don't miss any news about what is happening in AQWorlds! Read the Design Notes and find out! All you have to do is click the Accept button, then the complete button, and the Design Notes will open in a new tab. Quest complete!

quests.name: Get the Costume!
quests.description: Go backstage and steal that Mr. Wubbles costume. But be careful not to make any noise! If anyone catches you, you'll get kicked out, and we won't get the suit.

quests.name: The Cult of WUB
quests.description: Ok, so, first we're going to have to get those cultists out of our way. They will do everything in their power to keep us from breaking the spell. We don't want to kill them - they're still our friends! So we'll just knock them out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feel the WUB! ' quest.

quests.name: Get the Wub Charms!
quests.description: Now, we're going to have to confiscate those Wub Charms! Remember, we gave out 7 of them - so you'll have to get all 7 of them back, one from each of the people you gave them to.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feel the WUB! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Squishies!
quests.description: Looks like we've got "Mr. Wubbles'" attention! The entire structure is sending pieces of itself after us to try and stop us. Squish them before they overwhelm us!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feel the WUB! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get on his Nerves!
quests.description: This entire formation is a manifestation of Mr. Wubbles. If we kill his connection to it, we will take away a lot of his power. Look for the formations on the walls that look like nerves. When you find them, destroy them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feel the WUB! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Take the Stone!
quests.description: It's working! Do you see? A new pathway has opened up. That must be where the heart of his power is - and that's where we'll find the Stone of Eternal Fiendship. Find the stone, and destroy it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feel the WUB! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Take out Mr. Wubbles!
quests.description: Boy, you sure got his attention! We have to put a stop to this - get that stone away from him before he brainwashes us all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Feel the WUB! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: 2020 Badge
quests.description: Through this unprecedented year of challenges, you never gave up battling. And now… 2021 is here. Accept, then turn in this quest to get your exclusive "Made it through 2020" character page badge.

items.name: You made it through 2020 Character Page Badge

quests.name: 2022 Holiday AC Gift
quests.description: Hello Hero! We've got ONE LAST PRESENT for you, a gift from the AdventureQuest Worlds development team. They want to say THANKS for playing through our 2022 holiday events! All you need to do is get back my Free AC Giftbox. The Zard in Battleontown stole it. AGAIN. >:(

quests.name: Weekly Power Gem Quest
quests.description: Information is one of a Hero's most important tools and powerful weapons. Confirm your email in the Account Manager to get details on the new game events… then get me back my News Scroll! It keeps getting stolen by the sneevils who live in the Boxes map. Bring it back and i'll show my thanks by giving you a Power Gem in return. (Quest requires a confirmed email to complete)
quests.requirements_note: Must have a confirmed email address on your account.

quests.name: Find the Rose Rapiers
quests.description: Hmm. The note says "To find the rose rapiers, you must first find the mossy guardian." Maybe we should try a location known for plants? What do you think, hero?

quests.name: A Thorn In Your Side
quests.description: The next clue we got is this: "Why did you come back? Did you come back to hurt me again? Fine. If you want the rose rapiers so bad, then you should check some bushes in a bowl near some crickets and bunnies." What does that even mean?

items_required.name: Found the Not the Bush Clue

quests.name: Looking Elsewhere
quests.description: Were we sent there to get trapped? Haha, you've made some enemies. But this won't set us back! I spoke to some treasure hunting friends and they told me that there is a powerful tree in a different plane guarded by some blue birds. It might be able to help us. But they didn't elaborate on it. Sigh…

items_required.name: Not the Bush You Were Looking For

quests.name: Follow the Compass Rose
quests.description: So, I did a BUNCH of traveling with this weird rose compass thing… but it kept pointing in different directions. But in these specific locations, the compass changed to a purple dragon head with a glow in its eye: the Northlands, the Darkovia Graveyard, Pinewood Forest, and Mythsong.

quests.name: Treasures of Aotearoa
quests.description: I usually send you off in search of ancient artifacts. But today, we seek to save a living treasure! The people of Aotearoa call this very rare creature, "the hidden bird of the Forest God." The water goblins of Burning Beach prize the eggs as a delicacy. Bring its eggs back to me and I'll reward you with something sweet… and maybe a pet of your very own.

quests.name: Cheep Chase
quests.description: I know you like hunting rare items, so I made a hunt just for you! I hid a bunch of Marshmellow Cheeps, and you can try to find them. For the first Cheep, here's your clue. "The Knights of the Pactagonal Table will protect you. Don't Sir Render after you've already crossed the bridge." Come back to me after you find all of the Cheeps!

quests.name: Evolve the Blade!
quests.description: Battle through Lore to find the toughest boss monsters. Slay them to gather 13 Evolutions of Awe!

quests.name: Evolve the Staff!
quests.description: Battle through Lore to find the toughest boss monsters. Slay them to gather 13 Evolutions of Awe!

quests.name: Evolve the Daggers!
quests.description: Battle through Lore to find the toughest boss monsters. Slay them to gather 13 Evolutions of Awe!

quests.name: Evolve the Spear!
quests.description: Battle through Lore to find the toughest boss monsters. Slay them to gather 13 Evolutions of Awe!

quests.name: Helping Hands for Armors
quests.description: Providing the highest quality armor is a Swordhaven standard. But I require the proper materials, all of which can be harvested within our kingdoms. Patrol our beautiful courtyards and retrieve:

quests.name: Missing Hand Towels
quests.description: What in the world? There used to be a plethora of gold knockers glittering on the walls of Swordhaven Castle. But now, there's just the pair on the pillars flanking the stairway to the roof! You're asking what they're supposed to be for? Are you daft? Of course they're meant to hold hand towels! So the royalty and nobles keep clean! Blimey, the hand towels went missing too! Don't just stand there! Find them!

quests.name: Blood Moon Badge
quests.description: Bring me the heart of a Dire Wolf from Darkovia's Forest. I dream, sometimes, of tasting blood. And that would be very, VERY satisfying.

quests.name: Simple Orphium Blade
quests.description: So, you're interested in learning to use psionic weapons, eh? I forge them from Orpheum ore. Bring me enough to make a simple blade, and I'll craft one for you to train with.

quests.name: Try the Blade
quests.description: Now that you've got a psionic blade, let's go try it out! Start out by using it to fight a few Nightmare Skulls. They're a major pest, but they're not so dangerous that you'll die if you mess up. Get out there and fight—and let me know how it goes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Simple Orphium Blade in your inventory.

quests.name: Get the Wyrms
quests.description: You up for trying something a little tougher now? Outside the city, there are Nightwyrms that hide in the ground and burst through when someone walks above them. They're a danger to our citizens, and the city would be grateful if you got rid of them for us. Now that you know how to use your new blade, I think you'll stand a chance.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Simple Orphium Blade in your inventory.

Vanta Shadow Knight's Dragon Quest Pet's.name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Dragon Quest Pet's Quest

location.name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Dragon Quest Pet

npc.name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Dragon Quest Pet

quests.name: Black Friday 2023 Collection
quests.description: As summer ends, the nights grow colder and longer. Experienced heroes know the night is dark and full of terror… but YOU can defy that. In honor of Black Friday, defeat the Stymphmalion Terror or Dread Phoenix in /towerofdoom8 and earn your Black Friday 2023 character page badge.

location.name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Dragon Quest Pet

npc.name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Dragon Quest Pet

quests.requirements_note: Must have Vanta Shadow Knight's Dragon Quest Pet and Black Friday 2023 Collection Chest in your inventory.

items.name: Black Friday 2023 Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Defeat the Minions
quests.description: We've blocked off the throne room, but it's crawling with the Shadowlord's minions down here, too! You will have to defeat them before we can move on.

quests.name: Gather the Gunpowder
quests.description: That cave in you found must have happened when we broke through the castle - I guess it shook up the castle a lot more than we realized. We'll have to find a way to get past it. If you had enough gunpowder, you could blast your way out. You could get some from the Shadow Gunners nearby.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Build a Bomb
quests.description: Now we'll need a fuse and some flame. The Shadow Mages carry torches, and all of the shadow minions are wearing cloth we could tear apart.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Light 'em Up!
quests.description: Now all that's left is to light the fuse.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Fight the Shadows
quests.description: It's not any safer past the cave-in - the area is crawling with feral shadow minions! Fight them back so that we can continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Magical Potion
quests.description: The portal is down here somewhere. I can feel it. It must be hidden within the shadows. Fight the Shadow Mages and take their potions of shadow sight. This will allow you to see where it's hidden.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Overload the Energy Field
quests.description: We've found the portal, but a dark energy field is blocking our path. If you collect some of the stray energy nearby, you may be able to overload it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the Portal Guards
quests.description: It looks like Malgor keeps the portal guarded - and its guards got trapped in here after the cave-in. Now they're angry, and they aren't going to let us through until we've defeated them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Go Through the Portal
quests.description: Now, go through the portal, and meet me on the other side.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Fuel for the Cell
quests.description: Your particular power is fueled by spacetime energy. The more you feed it, the more in tune with your abilities you will become. Currently, your fuel cell is dry - but if you gather enough spacetime energy, it will not be.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Open the Rift
quests.description: Find an open area so that you have room to concentrate. Focus through the energy. Picture in your head a place that is familiar to you. Close to your home. Safe. Keep that image in your mind, and open a rift.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the ShadowKnight
quests.description: Defeat this ShadowKnight quickly before more of his brothers join him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get A Disguise
quests.description: We'll start with a little reconnaissance - you're going to disguise yourself as a member of her crew and gather information. First, we'll need your disguise: a full set of Blasksea Armor. Where will you get it? Right off the backs of those Blacksea Pirates.

quests.name: Gear Up!
quests.description: Grab your disguise and put it on. Let me know when you're ready to move out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Gather Information
quests.description: We need to find out more about Teja so we can figure out how to get her on our side. Now that you look like one of her crew, you can sneak into her camp unnoticed. See what information you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Missing Pages
quests.description: We have to find the missing pages from Teja's alchemy book! With that information, we will be able to reverse her spell, and turn these statues back into her old crew. Anything on the island could have them, so check everywhere!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Collect the Beans
quests.description: According to the pages you found, the monkeys on this island love to eat coffee beans - and after they've, ah, been processed, they have some magical qualities. You'll need to collect enough for ten cups - unless you still want some for yourself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Smooth the Way
quests.description: The next thing we'll need is some coconut oil. Apparently it "helps it go down smooth." You'll get it from the Palm Treeants on the island.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sweeten the Pot
quests.description: This is going to taste awful without some sugar. There's no sugarcane here, but Teja's book says the crew keeps packets of the stuff in their pockets. Apparently, they like coffee, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wake the Statues
quests.description: According to Teja's book, all we need to do now is spread the mixture over the lips of those statues… and wait.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clear the Tattersail Pirates
quests.description: We have a new problem on our hands - the entire island is filled with angry, monstrous pirates! We'd better clean up the mess we made before things get any worse.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kill Bill
quests.description: You're not done yet. The biggest, nastiest pirate in her crew was in one of those statues - and he's pretty angry with us! Take care of him now so we won't have to worry about him later.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: The title of this quest is a parody of the movie Kill Bill.

quests.name: Defeat Teja!
quests.description: Looks like Teja's noticed what we've been up to, and she's really not happy with us! You must win this fight - you can't let her trap you again!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadefires of War
quests.description: Tyndarius's soldiers only knew conflict, even before the Shadowflame. That has given Malgor enough grief to amplify and make these men truly a force to be reckoned with. Practice your battles with these Simulated Shadefires and try to find a quick and easy way to defeat them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Fallen Friend ' quest.

quests.name: Extinguish the Shadowflame
quests.description: If your theory of the Shadowflame is true, then we should be able to dispel the Shadowflame I've simulated in the area. Use what we've learned and see if you can expel the corruption.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Fallen Friend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Major Pain in the Neck
quests.description: The higher the rank in Tyndarius's army, the bigger pain in the neck they are. Test your new skills against some of his higher ups!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Fallen Friend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Envoy of Fire
quests.description: Elius is strong but I know you and Galanoth are stronger. Prove me right and defeat his simulation!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Fallen Friend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Putting Out Small Fires
quests.description: Living Fires are the physical soldiers of the Elemental Fire army. If you can defeat them in their pure Fire forms, you can definitely beat them in their weakened Shadowflame form!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Fallen Friend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Element-ary
quests.description: The Fire Elementals are the magical force of the Fire Avatar's army. They may have less defense than their Living Fire counterparts, they hit much harder! Don't take them lightly!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Fallen Friend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Dragonslayer's Past
quests.description: Galanoth, your history with Fire is a troubled one. But know that your role as Fire Champion was no accident. You have a duty to fulfil and we must get you prepared. I know we can not help you overcome your past in these few moments we have, but we can at least begin the process.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Fallen Friend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Champion of Fire
quests.description: Galanoth is still not confident in his abilities as Fire Champion. Face him in combat and help him kindle his confidence!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Fallen Friend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: March of the Warfury
quests.description: My soldiers have faced Malgor's forces plenty of times. It would be wise of you to study their experience. Train with them and you will learn much.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Fallen Friend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Elite It to Beat It
quests.description: Only soldiers that have truly proven their prowess in battle are worthy of being called Elites, and it takes a lot to impress the Goddess of War! They will not be so easily beaten!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Fallen Friend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Warfury Training
quests.description: So you hope to even further your training? My Warfury Soldiers and Elites will be the only things in Justitica Per Belli strong enough to keep up with you now! Or, if you are feeling brave, you could always face me again!

quests.name: Zorbak's Hideout
quests.description: Locate Zorbak in his Hideout to get more information on Vordred!
quests.requirements_note: Must have spoken with Vayle in Lightguard Keep .

quests.name: Dark Armored Daimyo
quests.description: To make his Daimyo's Legion Armor, you will need: 15 Hearts of Darkness from the Dark Elemental in the ruins, and the Black Metal Armor item (battle the Black Knight in Greenguard), and 4 Shadow Serpent Essences. You will also need a Daimyo pet, (only available in Battleon on his birthday)! Once you have them, open my merge shop!

quests.name: Descent into Darkness
quests.description: To enter the depths of the Necropolis, blood, sweat and bones are required. For each Skeletal Bellhop you slay, you'll descend one floor lower. Kill 10 Bellhops on this first foray into the darkness.

quests.name: Legion Armored Daimyo
quests.description: May the Legion guide you, because I certainly won't. My price is far too high for a Hero like you.To make his Daimyo's Dark Armor, you will need: 15 Hearts of Darkness from the Dark Elementals in the ruins, and the Black Metal Armor item (battle the Black Knight in greenguard), and 4 Shadow Serpent Essences. You will also need a Daimyo pet (only available in Battleon on his birthday)! Once you have them, open my merge shop!

quests.name: Dark Armored Daimyo
quests.description: To make his Daimyo's Dark Armor, you will need: 15 Hearts of Darkness from the Dark Elementals in the ruins, and the Black Metal Armor item (battle the Black Knight in greenguard), and 4 Shadow Serpent Essences. You will also need a Daimyo pet (only available in Battleon on his birthday)! Once you have them, open my merge shop!

quests.name: Sepulchure's Armor
quests.description: Our beloved Empress, Gravelyn, wears her Father's DoomKnight armor. But it was damaged in the legendary battle between King Alteon and Sepulchure… when the Chaos Lord Drakath appeared and defeated them both. I think we can restore the DoomKnight armor to its full power… but first, I need a piece of DoomKnight armor to experiment on.

quests.name: The Doom that Looms
quests.description: Have you been trained in the dark ways of the DoomKnight? Only true DoomKnights may ever hope to restore full power to Sepulchure's legendary DoomKnight armor. Speak with Dusk in Shadowfall to obtain the DoomKnight class, and come back to me when you can proudly boast that you're a Rank 10 DoomKnight. Now go!

quests.name: The Doom that Looms (AC)
quests.description: Have you been trained in the dark ways of the DoomKnight? Only true DoomKnights may ever hope to restore full power to Sepulchure's legendary DoomKnight armor. Speak with Dusk in Shadowfall to obtain the DoomKnight class, and come back to me when you can proudly boast that you're a Rank 10 DoomKnight. Now go!

quests.name: Toiling with Terror
quests.description: We must continue the search for Dark Spirit Orbs. The power of the Shadow is not to be underestimated—it has consumed a great deal more than you think. Let us see how many Dark Spirit Orbs are trapped within the Shadow Terror Axe that the Bone Terror wields. Once you have this weapon, I will need a vial of Elders' Blood to pour upon it in order to unleash the Dark Spirit Orbs. An Arcangrove potion master should be able to get you the Elders' Blood.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the 'The Doom that Looms' or 'The Doom that Looms (AC)' quest.

quests.name: A Penny for your Foughts
quests.description: Throughout your travels in Doomwood, have you come across a DoomCoin? This is a very rare find, so it comes to no surprise if you have never seen one. Due to its rarity, the DoomCoin is seething with Dark Spirit Orbs. Find 20 DoomCoins, bring it back to me, and I will crack it open and see what's inside!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Dark Spirit Donation
quests.description: You have discovered a great deal of Dark Spirit Orbs. The time has come to send them to Empress Gravelyn so that they may further empower the almighty Shadowscythe army. Hand over 100 Dark Spirit Orbs and bring back a Dark Skull from the Shadow Imp. I must carry them in it, and then I will be sure to deliver them to Her Majesty.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: Completion of this quest allows Dark Energy (Misc) to drop.

quests.name: Dark Spirit Orbs
quests.description: Creatures from the Plane of Darkness hide within the dark depths of Bludrut Keep. They harness the very essence of this terrifying place, and we should be able to extract their Dark Spirit Orbs with the proper ingredients. Go forth and bring me the Shadow Creeper Enchant and the Shadow Serpent Scythe. Additionally, I will need 6 Shadow Whiskers from a black cat to complete the extraction. Return to me when you are ready… it should produce 5 to 20 Dark Spirit Orbs.

quests.name: Hard Core Metals
quests.description: Part of the DoomKnight's strength comes from the compilation of different metals used to create the armor and weapons. These metals are mined from Raw Ore deposits found on Lore's rocky, earthy, metallic, golem, and crystalline monsters. We are going to need 30 Raw Ore deposits in order to produce the necessary metals. Additionally, the Balboa's Axe of the Prospector is required to mine the metal. Find all of these items, bring them back to me, and we shall see what metal we can extract from the Raw Ore.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dark Spirit Donation ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Accursed Arsenic Hex
quests.description: Now that we have raw metal, we can begin to curse it with the dark powers of the Shadow. In order for the hex to work, we will need 26 Dark Energy from Lore's monsters affiliated with darkness and shadows. We will also need 6 Dark Spirit Orbs and 16 Deadly Knightshade flowers. These flowers bloom on plant and tree-like creatures such as Treeants, Seed Spitters, and Crashrooms, to name a few. When you have gathered everything, hand over the raw metal and the hex will take affect!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Hard Core Metals' quest.

When you have gathered everything, hand over the raw metal and the hex will take affect!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Hard Core Metals' quest.

quests.name: Accursed Arsenic of Doom
quests.description: Everything seems to be going according with the plan. Now that we've harnessed Dark Spirit Orbs and placed hexes on the raw metals, we can begin the forge process. By combining cursed metal with the power of the Shadow, we can begin crafting Doom items! There is only one forge in all Lore powerful enough: the Dwarfhold Forge. Seek out the Rock Dweller by the name of Geopetal and she will forge Metals of Doom!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed any of the previous ' ... Hex ' quests. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Baneful Beryllium of Doom
quests.description: Everything seems to be going according with the plan. Now that we've harnessed Dark Spirit Orbs and placed hexes on the raw metals, we can begin the forge process. By combining cursed metal with the power of the Shadow, we can begin crafting Doom items! There is only one forge in all Lore powerful enough: the Dwarfhold Forge. Seek out the Rock Dweller by the name of Geopetal and she will forge Metals of Doom!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed any of the previous ' ... Hex ' quests. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: DoomSquire Weapon Kit
quests.description: You can't expect to make a DoomKnight weapon without a DoomKnight Weapon Kit. The most basic of weapon kits is the DoomSquire edition—but don't expect this quest to be all that basic. The DoomSquire Weapon Kit calls for:
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed any of the previous ' ... of Doom ' quests.

quests.name: DoomSoldier Weapon Kit
quests.description: We seem to be missing something… we need more DOOM! Now that you've created some "basic" DoomKnight weapons, let's delve deeper into the dark shadows. With a DoomSoldier Weapon kit, we can create Tier 2 Necrotic weapons! Here's what we need:
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: DoomKnight Weapon Kit
quests.description: It shouldn…t be much longer now. Once we have a DoomKnight Weapon Kit, we can create Tier 3 Necrotic weapons…the ONLY items capable of summoning Sepulchure…s DoomKnight armor from the Plane of Darkness. Here…s what we need:
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Pinpoint the Pieces with Necrotic Bow
quests.description: Necrotic weapons harness the power to find the scattered pieces of Sepulchure…s DoomKnight Armor. Using your Necrotic Bow of the Shadow, destroy every dark and shadow monster inhabiting the world of Lore to find 10 pieces of His DoomKnight Armor. The more ferocious the beast, the greater chance at finding a piece. And maybe, just maybe, if the power of the Shadow chooses you, the ultra rare Doom Aura may appear! The Doom Aura is the last piece we need to restore Sepulchure…s DoomKnight Armor to its full glory…so let…s do this!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Necrotic Bow of the Shadow in your inventory. Note: Must have completed the ' DoomKnight Weapon Kit ' quest.

quests.name: Pinpoint the Pieces with Necrotic Mace
quests.description: Necrotic weapons harness the power to find the scattered pieces of Sepulchure…s DoomKnight Armor. The more ferocious the beast, the greater chance at finding a piece. And maybe, just maybe, if the power of the Shadow chooses you, the ultra rare Doom Aura may appear! The Doom Aura is the last piece we need to restore Sepulchure…s DoomKnight Armor to its full glory…so let…s do this!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Necrotic Mace of Misery in your inventory. Note: Must have completed the ' DoomKnight Weapon Kit ' quest.

quests.requirements_note: Must have Necrotic Shade Blade in your inventory. Note: Must have completed the ' DoomKnight Weapon Kit ' quest.

quests.name: Pinpoint the Pieces with Necrotic Daggers
quests.description: Necrotic weapons harness the power to find the scattered pieces of Sepulchure…s DoomKnight Armor. Using your Necrotic Daggers of Destruction, destroy every dark and shadow monster inhabiting the world of Lore to find 10 pieces of His DoomKnight Armor. The more ferocious the beast, the greater chance at finding a piece. And maybe, just maybe, if the power of the Shadow chooses you, the ultra rare Doom Aura may appear! The Doom Aura is the last piece we need to restore Sepulchure…s DoomKnight Armor to its full glory…so let…s do this!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Necrotic Daggers of Destruction in your inventory. Note: Must have completed the ' DoomKnight Weapon Kit ' quest.

quests.name: Summoning Sepulchure's Armor
quests.description: You have scoured the world for fragments of Sepulchure's DoomKnight Armor. But it's going to take a lot more than just metal shards to return His armor to its former supremacy. Only when you have gathered EVERYTHING from my list will you hope to restore the power of the shadow to Sepulchure's DoomKnight Armor. Good luck.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed one of the ' Pinpoint the Pieces ... ' quests.

quests.name: Lost Memories
quests.description: I need you to find my lost Journal. I've looked for it but I always get lost in that place. Maybe you'll have better luck in there. Bring it to me if you find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Remembering...
quests.description: There are several pages missing from my old journal. It's useless without them. I think something might be trying to keep me in the dark. Check the monsters on the first level of Bludrut for all 8 missing pages.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Personal Effect
quests.description: I can't believe I could have ever forgotten Veddris! I… left her. Now she's calling to me for help from beyond the grave. We need an anchor… a personal item of hers. Check the monsters of the 2nd FLOOR of Bludrut for Veddris's Ring. We can use that to make a connection.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Unintentional Tomb
quests.description: She is using her energy to direct us to her remains. Somewhere on the 2nd Floor there is a room that is not on the map. It should be easy to find because it has a Gold Frame around the door. Locate the room and return to me. I'll prepare the communication ritual.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Spirit Speaks
quests.description: I came a little unprepared for all of this. I need several materials for the ritual that I did not bring but I think you can find all of them on the monsters on the first and second floors of the Bludrut. Once you have them all please head back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Unseen Monsters
quests.description: Whatever is in there with my Veddris wants out. We have to find a way to free her without freeing It. You have to find It's lair. On the 3rd FLOOR there should be another room that's not on the map. It will probably look like a large crack in the wall. See if you can find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Stop IT!
quests.description: I've prepared a balm that will allow you to see It. That will enable you to destroy It. I will stay here and keep an energy chant going to keep it trapped. Head back to IT's lair and destroy that thing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Sad Farewells
quests.description: Now that IT is gone, my sister will be able to move on. Head back to the room on the 2ND FLOOR where my twin's remains can be found. I will meet you there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Ectoamber
quests.description: Most ghosts are made from Ectoplasm. It's normally very loose and gooey but it can be solidified into a substabce called Ectoamber that no ghost can pass through. Bring me 10 Ectoplasm Sample from Rattlebones' and I will give you some Ectoamber.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Sad Farewells' quest.

quests.name: Screamwave
quests.description: One of the weapons I can use to defend myself from spirits is called a Screamwave. I need 5 Bottled Siren Wails to adjust untill they can create a soundwave that can damage and repel ghosts. Bring me 5 Bottled Siren Wails and I'll use them to make a Screamwave.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Sad Farewells' quest.

quests.name: Spiril Ward Sigil
quests.description: I know an arcane method for creating a Spirit Ward Sigil which will drive most weak spirits away but I need one of Groglurk's Talons to create it. Bring me one and I'll craft it into a Spirit Ward Sigil for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Sad Farewells' quest.

quests.name: Makai's Anonymous
quests.description: To crush all anti-loyalty sentiments, we have to hit the Makai hard and then offer a hand once they're beat. Maybe even provide a new leader, one we are less likely to kill. Before anything, we must finally force the Makai off our backs, and establish Nulgath's dominance.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Verick's ID in your inventory.

quests.name: The Riches of Rebellion
quests.description: It never hurts to defend against another anarchy-induced uprising. Take a minute to beat up any menacing Makai and I'll grab you a worthy set of rewards from the underworld.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Verick's ID in your inventory.

quests.name: Uncontrollable Anarchy
quests.description: Any attempts at pleading with the Dark Makai that finding a new leader is more important than revenge have failed. I fear force is the only way to knock sense back to their brains. Restrain the 5 Makai faction leaders so I may reason with them and save our way of life.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Verick's ID in your inventory.

quests.name: Fighting with Fear
quests.description: This uprising has made the mourning Makai stubborn and simple headed. The only way to force the uprising out is to scare my people into submission. Since we lack the manpower to accomplish this, maybe a bluff is our key to victory. If you can swipe enough personal items from Lore's leaders, we can convince the Dark Makai others have allied against them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Verick's ID in your inventory. | Must have Makai Sceptre in your inventory.

quests.name: Dragon's Gauntlet
quests.description: The beasts here are chaorrupted by a powerful spirit. They've been attempting to charge at Akiba but I've managed to push them back here. We'll have to defeat them and hope that they come back to their senses. Are you ready?

quests.name: Nauthiz - Realized
quests.description: You'll help me out? Or do you get something out of this? Whatever the case, I want to learn more about Gramiel. Both when he was the Grandmaster, and when he was a Celestial. If you look into that and the Draconians, I'll pay you back. I always do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isa, Reversed - Realized ' quest.

quests.name: Nauthiz - Realized (Legend)
quests.description: You'll help me out? Or do you get something out of this? Whatever the case, I want to learn more about Gramiel. Both when he was the Grandmaster, and when he was a Celestial. If you look into that and the Draconians, I'll pay you back. I always do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isa, Reversed - Realized ' quest.

quests.name: Restless Roves
quests.description: Before I can allow you entry, the Fallen Darkbloods around us wish to test you. They loathe the idea of outsiders discovering their despised ancestor. Prove that your power is absolutely necessary by dueling them.

quests.name: Vile Valdostana
quests.description: The Darkdweller must not be allowed freedom. Escape will bring turmoil and bloodshed to both the Darkbloods and the Hollowborn. Help me reshackle the prisoner, and quell his ambitions once more.

quests.name: Sleeping Diana
quests.description: If we're actually going to Castle Bocklin, we need to do something about the knights guarding you. What!? Brittany's going to cover for us? She'll just rat us out if we talk to her! And what's this beef jerky for? Playfighting with the wolves? Huh…

quests.name: At the Edge of the Forest
quests.description: Brittany and the wolves have the Knights occupied. We'll run into the woods while she covers for us. Watch out for the spiders in there. They get hungry in spring, so try not to scream. Oh? Breaking out your hammer again? Special occasion, huh.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Freedom Helvetia
quests.description: Why are there Sp-eyes infesting the woods around the castle? Are these from the Shadowscythe? We need to shoot them down, and figure out where they came from before we go. Maybe they're connected to the blackmailer.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sacred Grove
quests.description: The carriage Brittany arranged for us is waiting in the woods. It'll take us to Castle Bocklin in Chiral Valley. I haven't been that far before, which will make it hard to find clues about who we're dealing with. There has to be something around…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chained Prometheus
quests.description: Castle Bocklin belongs to House Vaughn, but it was abandoned after the Rebellion. The Garde Grifs must have been their attack beasts before they were left behind. You fought them before, right? Hmph! I can handle them too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ride of Death
quests.description: Mom! Do you hear that shuffling? That's the sound of Undead dragging their feet through the grass. We walked right into a trap, and need to fight our way out of it! Get your hammer ready! I'll cover you with my arrows.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Fall and Death
quests.description: These Undead don't want to rest. We destroyed their physical bodies, but their ghosts are coming back for round two. I can keep up! You're the one they're after, mom. I think they recognize you from the days of the Rebellion.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ruins in Moonlight
quests.description: Wait a second, I just saw a kid run outside of Castle Bocklin's ruins. Did he get lost? Let's talk to him, and look around for more clues. Maybe we can learn more about the blackmailer, and if they're the ones who raised the dead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wandering Light
quests.description: The Undead and Wraiths are starting to gather again, and they're moving to deliberately surround us. Where's the Necromancer giving them orders? Unless…they're doing this on their own. We need to slay them, and protect that kid!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Death Plays the Fiddle
quests.description: Finally! The Necromancers show their faces. If we take them down, that'll make clearing the ruins a lot easier. It's just that…I don't know. My gut's telling me something's wrong.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Die Heimkehr - The Return
quests.description: Richard said it's still too dangerous to go inside Castle Bocklin's ruins. They're teeming with Undead, and so is the surrounding Grove. We should thin their numbers to at least make it easier to retreat if we have to.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Death Plays the Fiddle ' quest.

quests.name: Die Heimkehr - The Return (Legend)
quests.description: Richard said it's still too dangerous to go inside Castle Bocklin's ruins. It's teeming with Undead, and so is the surrounding Grove. We should thin their numbers to at least make it easier to retreat if we have to.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Death Plays the Fiddle ' quest.

quests.name: Roger and Angelica
quests.description: Richard went inside Castle Bocklin first. Said he'd scout it out for us to make sure it's safe. I hear the Undead shuffling around, so I'll help him clear the way. If that cough hasn't gotten to you, try to keep up with us, and…make sure Richard's doing okay.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Death Plays the Fiddle ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Way to Emmaus
quests.description: The Wraiths don't look like they answered directly to the Thronekeeper when they were alive. Still, we should check if they have a key to one of the other rooms. I'm still working on my lockpicking skills. Wait! Don't tell Dad!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Death Plays the Fiddle ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hermit
quests.description: The key we found unlocked some sort of archive, and…it's haunted. There's a ghost inside, but they don't seem to be hostile or under the control of the Necromancers. We should consult them for info, and look for other clues about the Vaughns.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Death Plays the Fiddle ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ruins Near Kehl
quests.description: We've learned all that we can here, so we'll follow Richard deeper into the castle. The Necromancers must have been paid by the cartload. Just look at all the Undead and Wraiths in here. It won't be safe to explore unless we clear them out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Death Plays the Fiddle ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Whistling Blackbird
quests.description: We can go deeper into the castle, but I stopped Richard from going ahead. There are strange warped, ghosts in the halls. They're not like the other spirits. They've lost their form and fused together. What are they? You'll investigate? Alright…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Death Plays the Fiddle ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Killer Pursued by Furies
quests.description: I checked the key you found on one of the warped ghosts. It opens a trophy room filled with mounted antlers. It's creepier than the Necromancer hiding out in there. We need to deal with them, and look for any other clues.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Death Plays the Fiddle ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Vestal
quests.description: What is it now? I just want to get this over with. It's too dangerous to go any further without placing protective runes in the hall? Fine. Whatever. I don't know anything about that junk, so just hurry up.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Death Plays the Fiddle ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Abandoned Venus
quests.description: Stop. Don't move. I spotted people outside in the courtyard. They don't look like they're Necromancers or the Undead. Those white robes? You could mistake them for Clerics, but…there's something wrong. We need to make the first move, and watch for anything suspicious.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Death Plays the Fiddle ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bacchanalia
quests.description: Richard doesn't recognize the Faceless Ritualists either, but they have something to do with the warped spirits. They know that we're here, and we'll be surrounded if we don't react fast enough. Take as many of them out as you can.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Death Plays the Fiddle ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Euterpe and Deer
quests.description: There are a lot of moving parts to this mystery. Ugh! There's no time to piece it together. A Knight, not those grunts stumbling around the entrance, but the real deal…it's coming down the stairs towards us. This won't be easy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Death Plays the Fiddle ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Anjou Fleur
quests.description: The castle's crawling with enemies, but we need to find somewhere mom can rest! The Warped Revenants, Faceless Ritualists, and that Headless Knight won't give up. Come on, whittle down their numbers so we can find a chance to escape!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Euterpe and Deer ' quest.

quests.name: Anjou Fleur (Legend)
quests.description: The castle's crawling with enemies, but we need to find somewhere mom can rest! The Warped Revenants, Faceless Ritualists, and that Headless Knight won't give up. Come on, whittle down their numbers so we can find a chance to escape!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Euterpe and Deer ' quest.

quests.name: Talk to Ravinos
quests.description: I've got your back, but Ravinos knows you better than he knows me. You have a history with him. You're the one who can convice him to help us, if anyone can. Talk to him, explain the situation, make him understand how dire it is. Get his help.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Make a Bed ' quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: Odd's 'n' Ends
quests.description: It takes a lot to stock an odds and ends shop. But one thing we always need is are locks and keys. Those sneevils are awful thieves. Bring me metal ore from the Sneevils in /boxes and I'll fabricate them myself.

Vindicator Naval Commander's Quest Pet's.name: Vindicator Naval Commander's Quest Pet's Quest

quests.name: Dark Seas Collection Quest Pet
quests.description: Th' Ghostly Eels have been after yer sailin' snacks. Everyone knows a stalwart sailor needs enough fuel to keep th' cannons booming. Hunt ye down some Unagi from the Eels in Twilight Slums or Lowtide and ye'll earn a character page badge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Dark Seas Collection Chest and Vindicator Naval Commander's Quest Pet in your inventory.

items.name: Dark Seas Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Canto IV
quests.description: The vanguard consists of the Limbo Guards, soldiers and warriors who had perished before there was any real structure to the Underworld. With no purpose in their unlives, they offer their services to guard the entrance of the Seven Circles. They won't be the strongest enemy you face here, but don't take them lightly.

quests.name: Canto V
quests.description: It appears that the Guards of Luxuria have fallen under their spell. All those that come in contact with Luxuria must have a strong will to overcome the urges that they breed. Whether it be a lust for power, happiness, or pleasure, they control it all. Those urges are like the wind that emanates from this circle. The urges may start as a gentle breeze, nice and pleasant, but can quickly turn into an overwhelming gale, tossing you off your intended path. Free these Guards from this wind, and grant them peace.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gone With the Wind
quests.description: Luxuria's winds are too strong for us to move forward. But the Guards aren't being blown away… They must possess certain auras that allow them to move freely. Looks like we will need to gain possession of these auras as well. The Limbo Guards seem to have an Aura of Power, the Luxuria Guards have an Aura of Pleasure, and both types of Guards have a faint Aura of Happiness. If we collect enough of each of them, it should be enough to get past these winds.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lest Ye Be Destroyed
quests.description: You have seen what Luxuria can do to those who are not fully aware of their strength. Do not underestimate them. Keep your guard up while you will come out victorious. Stay strong, Hero.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Canto VI
quests.description: The Guard of Gluttony is unlike any other guard in the Circles. It can not be defeated with just normal combat. You must also outsmart the creature, otherwise it will never stop hunting its prey down. I have a plan, however. Collect three large piles of mud from this Circle. I'll explain later.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Heckhound
quests.description: I have filled the Guard's mouth with the mud you collected. That should hinder it enough that once you defeat it, it will no longer pursue us. You must defeat it quickly before it is able to spit all of the mud out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Glutton for Punishment
quests.description: Gluttony is just up ahead. Be careful. He will not take kindly to visitors. He will attempt to exploit your urge to indulge in the fight and you will feel like you want it to last forever. Do not overindulge in your combat and end the fight quickly. There is no need to face him longer than required, regardless of what he may make you believe.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Canto VII
quests.description: You have made it to the last Circle of this section of the prison. Avarice resides here, and conquering him will be no easy task. First, we will have to take care of his Guards. Show them the strength you have shown all of their comrades that came before them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Greed the Room
quests.description: I can see Avarice's spell starting to take hold of you. We must lessen its effects before you face him. Take the spell's effects on you out on the Guards here. Fighting each type of Guard should satisfy the urge for now. Once you are done, then you should face Avarice immediately.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ava-risky Business
quests.description: Avarice will be the most deadly in combat that you have faced so far. He will trick you into getting greedy with your strikes, thinking you can get a few more in before you must go on the defensive. Do not let him fool you. Trust your initial instincts, and treat it like a normal fight. If you strike one too many, you will find yourself quickly defeated while your guard is down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Circles of Fate
quests.description: While the first few Circles have been defeated, their essence still lingers in the area, threatening to damage the seals. Go clear up the area once more, and then we can proceed more assuredly.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ava-risky Business ' quest.

quests.name: Guards of Wrath
quests.description: The Guards of Wrath are merciless in their assault. They do not tire, they do not feel pain. You will have to defeat many of them in order to get to Wrath himself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ava-risky Business ' quest.

quests.name: War Medals
quests.description: Collect War Medals by thinning the waves of the Circles' Guards to stop the Beast's escape.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ava-risky Business ' quest.

quests.name: Mega War Medals
quests.description: Collect Mega Medals by thinning the waves of the Circles' Guards to stop the Beast's escape.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ava-risky Business ' quest.

quests.name: Wrath Against the Machine
quests.description: Wrath will make you lose yourself in the fight, lose your humanity. Do not let it overtake you. Keep yourself calm and you will survive this fight. Good luck, Hero.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ava-risky Business ' quest. | Must have completed any of the previous quests. Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 25%.

quests.name: Blasphemy? Blasphe-you!
quests.description: These Guards have been corrupted by both Wrath and Violence. The Guards of Heresy are usually quite peaceful, but being tainted by both inmates have made them the most dangerous Guards yet. Be careful, Hero.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ava-risky Business ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Violence's Gatekeeper
quests.description: This Minotaur was specially created to attack any intruder on sight with great ferocity. Unfortunately, you will be on the receiving end of that ferocity, rather than the inmates' liberators. You won't have any sinful influences to worry about this time, only the creature's unnatural strength.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ava-risky Business ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest unlocked when the War Meter reached 50%.

quests.name: Meaningless Violence
quests.description: The Guards of Violence have always been a rowdy bunch, if you ask me. The only difference from how they acted before is their now malicious nature. Take them out so that we can leave this Circle.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ava-risky Business ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Geryon, Not Gary On!
quests.description: Geryon is a monster that destroys in a different way. It causes those around it to have hidden, nefarious intentions. Villages under its influence crumble by their own hands, not the creature's raw power. Don't be fooled, Hero. The creature is a force of nature in its own right.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ava-risky Business ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Violence
quests.description: This should be the last of inmates before you reach the Beast. Violence. He does not rely on cheap tricks to defeat his opponents. He will continue to strike until he is defeated. I only hope that you are able to vanquish him before he does you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ava-risky Business ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest unlocked when the War Meter reached 75%.

quests.name: Where the Trea-sun Don't Shine
quests.description: The Treachery Guards have to be powerful on their own, as they cannot trust one another. This makes that less dangerous in groups. We can use this to our advantage. Take them out, one by one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ava-risky Business ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hanged for Treason
quests.description: This… thing is giving off the power of the Beast, but it seems different. Could this truly be it? Regardless of what it is, it is in our way. Beast or not, it must be stopped!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ava-risky Business ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest unlocked when the War Meter reached 95%.

quests.name: The Beast
quests.description: This is it, Hero. The final battle. The Beast is still trapped by its original seal. There is still hope. If you weaken it enough. I should be able to restore its seal to full strength and Dage will be free from its influence. We have no other options. Anything less will result in the destruction of Lore.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ava-risky Business ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Prove Your Worth
quests.description: Fetch me the water of the Cactus Creeper and the meat of the Golden Scarab to prove you are worthy of this Kalestri Worshipper alliance.

quests.name: Still Not Impressed?
quests.description: Smash open these Kalestri vases, so you may see the true value of my people.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Prickly Situation
quests.description: It will take weeks to reach the pyramid's end if these Cacti and their thorns continue to block our path. De-thorn these vermin, peasant!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Beetle Battle Armor
quests.description: Even a four-handed Heroine needs a way to protect herself! Fetch me the armor of the Golden Scarab so we may continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pyramid Pilgrimage
quests.description: We must be prepared for a long journey, I demand more cactus water and scarab meat to keep my energy high.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blood in the Sand
quests.description: It appears your carnage on the last 5 floors has attracted unwanted guests. Wash away these wannabe sharks before they waste you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Tribal Traitors
quests.description: It appears even my own people have fallen to chaos' pull. Cleanse my sisters of this chaos before the disease spreads.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Marking The Territory
quests.description: Monsters respawn here as if they've been programmed to. Lay a beacon in each of the past rooms to preserve our terrifying presence
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Raiders of the Lost Artifact
quests.description: Even in the most sacred of realms, robbers still need to learn a lesson. Maybe I suggest the lyric: "Another One Bites the Dust" as a teaching tool?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Quest title is a parody of the movie Raiders of the Lost Ark , while the quest description is a reference to the song Another One Bites the Dust .

quests.name: Surviving the Swarms
quests.description: Those unsacred SandSharks seem to travel in packs just waiting for their prey to misstep. Place trackers on these monsters so we may avoid their next onslaught.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Legend of Eldo
quests.description: Hero, hearken to my words: The oldest of the Kalestri worshipers, Eldo, once found it good fortune to burst merchant pots. While these vases are the only thing available, we need all the fortune we can get.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: There's No Point
quests.description: This Pyramid was once a center of beauty, a home for all my tribe to enjoy. Now it reeks of monsters, and despair. Please banish these monsters, so this room will again be recognizable.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Trail of Naan Crumbs
quests.description: Unlike human fairytales, the brave warrior children Hanseif and Gretellia used Naan crumbs as a guide home after ferocious battles. I suggest we do the same.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tricky Trip Wires
quests.description: It seems that someone has remodeled all the pyramid's booty traps. No matter, bring me an updated map off a corrupted Worshipper. We must avoid these annoyances, regardless of the fun I had setting the originals up.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shooing Away Scarabs
quests.description: I can't tell if my next step will be sand or scarab. Please help keep my feet beetle free with a little pest control.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Humor is Close to the Heart
quests.description: Before we make it to the heart of this pyramid, I feel as if I need to teach you a lesson. Scarab riding was my favorite game as a child, watch and learn two-hander.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Purple is Not Your Color
quests.description: It seems treasure is not the only motive for these robbers, it's time to take part in this pyramid's buy one get one free deal by kicking out and cleansing these chaorrupted crooks.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: All Alone
quests.description: I fear I have not been entirely straightforward with you, friend. You see, I did not disobey traditions coming here as there was no one left to disobey. I am the last of the Kalestri Worshipers free of chaos's control. Maybe in the afterlife, their souls will be free once more. Unfortunately that is our only hope.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Beginning of the End
quests.description: I thank you, Hero for this entire journey. I began this expecting, no, hoping to hate you. Maybe if you despised me, the final chamber would not be so difficult. I'm afraid to say I can't hate you, friend, I apologize for what must come next. Please break these vases until you find a suitable Kalestri weapon.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Ultimate Sacrifice
quests.description: In order to break the lock of Kalestri's most sacred treasure, one of her own is needed in return. My life does not matter, no individual life does. As the last member capable of sacrifice, my survival means death to this world. Bring me the blade of one of Kalestri's Worshippers, and … it will be done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Champion Token Collection
quests.description: Battle the Heroes to get their tokens, then turn them in at the Tournament Merge Shop to unlock gear!

quests.name: Malgor, The First Speaker
quests.description: Malgor, your First Speaker, wishes to wipe Lore clean. Again. Would you be so kind as to talk some sense into him?
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 90. Note: This quest can only be completed once per week.

quests.name: The Goddess of War
quests.description: My sovereign, you have a divine piece of equipment with you. If you’d like, I can bring out its true power and potential.

quests.name: Radiant Goddess of War Badge
quests.description: You have silenced The First Speaker and forged a new age for Lore. Bring me a Licorice Scale from the Mainyu, and I will reward you with a character page badge.

items.name: Radiant Goddess Of War Character Page Badge

quests.name: Slain Children
quests.description: Shades of my Children stand in your way. Do you have what it takes to strike them down once more? Do it. Show me what kind of monster you are.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Portal of Chaos ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Guilt of the Past
quests.description: Do you have what it takes to overcome the Guilt of your past actions? Or will the weight of all that murder and destruction kill you? Only time will tell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Portal of Chaos II ' quest.

quests.name: A Giant of Chaos
quests.description: The Chaos Giants are some of the strongest monsters in my Domain. Let this serve as a warm up for our final battle.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Void Commander's Badge
quests.description: In the war to win eternity, the Void Commanders are one of pinnacles of Nulgath's creations. Display your skill by defeating one of the Lightguard Paladins in /Voidrefuge and you may be permitted to join them, and will earn the Void Commander character page badge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Void Commander's Collection and Void Commander Quest Pet in your inventory.

items.name: Void Commander Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Void HighLord's Challenge
quests.description: So. You've come to join MY ranks? Hah. Let's see what you've got, kid. IF you're up to it, you'll be able to craft a Void HighLord class without breaking a sweat. Get to it.

quests.name: A-Void-ing The Larva
quests.description: My Larva brethren will not understand my alliance with you. You are an outsider in this world, and the Void Larva will see you as a threat -- rather, a meal. If you wish to prove your worth to me, and ultimately save your friend, you must go forth and collect 10 Larva Tarsus from the Void Larva. I will be watching.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Searching For Splinters ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Spawn Point
quests.description: I want to further study your techniques. When Void Larva evolve, we become powerful Void Elementals. I will inform you on how to enter The Great's lair if you can defeat enough Void Elementals to obtain 8 Spawn Pronotums. Go now.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Searching For Splinters ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Null and Void Spheres
quests.description: Are you ready to unlock The Great Void Dragon's chamber door? As I stated before, the closest element to Void in your world is Chaos. The Great has entrusted the 4 Void Spheres with the most powerful Chaos beings in Lore. You will need to find the Red, Blue, Green, and Yellow Void Spheres that are hidden somewhere in Lore.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Searching For Splinters ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Enter the Great Void Dragon's Lair
quests.description: The time has come. Take these Void Spheres and head to the heart of The Void. If you can open the door to the Great Void Dragon's lair, you may be able to recover your beloved friend. But I cannot guarantee what you will find behind said door. It may already be too late.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Searching For Splinters ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Void Energy Needed
quests.description: Mariel is here, yes, but she keeps herself hidden. If you want to find her, you will have to traverse the Void as its inhabitants do. Collect Void Energy from the elementals here. Absorb enough of it, and the path forward will open to you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Void Larva ' quest.

quests.name: Go Find Mariel
quests.description: What? I didn't say that the path forward would suddenly have a big blue arrow above it, showing you where to go. I said it would open to you. And it will… IF you can find it. Remember: when you can no longer continue forward, look to the stars.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Void Larva ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Void Witch's Summoning Quest
quests.description: The power contained in this orb was brought forth from Darkness, and can only be renewed by Darkness. Once it is at full power, you will be able to call forth one of the darkest, most powerful creatures on this world… and others. Collect all of the Void Spheres to complete this spell:

quests.name: Void Shogun Farming Quest
quests.description: You fight fire with fire, and shadows with… even deadlier Shadows. I see you are a skilled warrior. Your victories against the Shogun of Shadows have caught my Master's interest. He has a gift for you… IF you are worthy enough to take it.

items.name: Void Shogun Katanas on your Hip

quests.name: Drowning in the Void
quests.description: Nulgath says: So I heard the Legion and Nation created a kind of havoc when I was sent to Oversoul and a forbidden love allowed a new breed to rise, the VoidCaster. Minion, the Legion's powers originated from MY CONTRACT and you shall forever deny the fact you think you are a Legion member from that pity we call Dage the Evil. Bring the reagents I need and maybe we can try out this new breed that was possible due to a common and logical source.
quests.requirements_note: Must have VoidCaster Orb Pet in your inventory.
