Voidfiend Symbiote Sword Quest Pet's Que.name: Voidfiend Symbiote Sword Quest Pet's Quest

quests.name: Void Symbiote Blade's Quest
quests.description: Tercessuinotlim is an evil place, full of shadowy energies. That must be what allows this blade to levitate. To keep it empowered, slay a Dark Makai to steal its energy, and you'll reap the rewards!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Voidfiend Symbiote Sword Quest Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Soul Dealer
quests.description: Welcome, Hero. I have a quest for you… if you're brave enough to accept it. Bring me 50 Undead Energy, the Warrior Claymore Blade, from the Undead Berserker, and the Dark Crown Axe from a Doomwood Treant. Do this, and I shall reward you well.

quests.name: Twisted Trust
quests.description: To create gear for you… I require resources. If you wish to earn my Unitas Fragments to purchase items, retrieve one of the Burn it Down staves and recover Escherion's Robes. Do this, and I will reward you well.

quests.name: Skull and Bones
quests.description: You've heard of secret societies and Legions of the undead? None of those here. But what I DO have for you is the promise of Unity. IF you can bring me 28 pirate skulls. Do not ask why.

quests.name: Legendary Unity
quests.description: I value loyalty and unity. There are two things every lord needs to rule. … Do you have them? Yes? Good. Prove it. Bring me a Bone Axe and a Helm of the Dark Lord and I will reward you well.

quests.name: Level 1
quests.description: Cruel Death, thief of days, takes the price you will not pay. Using what you hate the most in a neverending slaughter. What child of mine meets its end when it first encounters water?

quests.name: Level 2
quests.description: I am both hard and soft. I give heat and run from it. I am engaged in an all-consuming activity, living off my own energy and, when I am finished, I will die. What am I?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 3
quests.description: From stones comes fire. From fire, dust. Black is red, and red is white. Before taking, seek you must. I am gathered where you lack sight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 4
quests.description: I am that which will not burn nor drown.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 5
quests.description: The more you have of it, the less you see. Fire is its enemy. Tell me quick, what could it be?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 6
quests.description: All about, but cannot be seen, can be captured, cannot be held, turning candle into conflagration.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 7
quests.description: It cannot be seen, but weighs nothing, but when put into a barrel, it makes it lighter. Fire cannot consume me, but smoke will escape me. What is it?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 8
quests.description: A box without hinges, lock or key, yet golden treasure lies within. Fire will can cook its inside without leaving a mark on its outside. What is it?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 9
quests.description: One by one we fall from heaven down into the depths of past. And our world is ever upturned so that yet some time we'll last. Remove from our captivity, fire turn us into prison-glass.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 10
quests.description: What has root that nobody sees, is taller than trees, full of liquid inside, but have no doubt that all of it will become stone without.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 11
quests.description: People need me but they always give me away. They have to me to burn, but if they did, they would be left with nothing. What am I?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 12
quests.description: What goes round the house and in the house but never touches the house, is made of fire but will never burn the house?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 13
quests.description: What appears at night, burns with the light, but never catches on fire?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 14
quests.description: What goes round and round the wood but never goes into the wood, can be burned off and leaves its body unharmed?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 15
quests.description: What can live in a fire, then goes into water red and comes out black?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 16
quests.description: What kind of room has no windows or doors and when set on fire becomes food?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 17
quests.description: I can run but not walk. Wherever I go, thought follows close behind. I turn red in both heat and cold. What am I?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 18
quests.description: Iron roof, glass walls
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 19
quests.description: I'm the source of all emotion, but I'm caged in a white prison. It can burn or turn to ice depending on who you are talking to.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Level 20
quests.description: The heart of the volcano has come to life, magma solidified into a soldier's form. Servant of Xan, enemy to those who would extinguish his power.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hai Kyuute!! Collection
quests.description: Absolute Zero in /dragonkoi TOOK YOUR volleyball! Defeat him to get it back and you'll earn a character page badge and one of many house item prizes for your Bareboru house.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Volleyball Quest Pet in your inventory.

items.name: Hai Kyuute!! Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Survive Frankenwerepire
quests.description: If you think you can zurvive my latest creation, ze Frankenwerepire, zen you are zadly miztaken! He vill CRUZH you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What's Up, Doc? ' quest.

quests.name: Survive Ultra Frankenwerepire
quests.description: If you think you can zurvive my biggezt, baddezt, MOZT DEZTRUCTIVE creation, ze ULTRA Frakenwerepire, zen you are zadly mistaken! He vill CRUZH you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What's Up, Doc? ' quest.

quests.name: Pirate Hat
quests.description: Earn 5 cursed doubloons by battling monsters during the event. Turn them in for a Pirate hat!

quests.name: Pirate Cutlass
quests.description: Earn 15 cursed doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for an Undead Pirate Cutlass!

quests.name: Undead Pirate's Guitar
quests.description: Earn 25 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for an Undead Pirate's Guitar.

quests.name: Holy Scuba Gear
quests.description: Earn 35 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for the Holy Scuba Gear!

quests.name: Deep Diver Helmet
quests.description: Earn 20 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for a Deep Diver Helmet!

quests.name: Braken Bass
quests.description: Earn 25 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for a Braken Bass!

quests.name: Ghost Ship in a Bottle
quests.description: Earn 15 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for a Ghost Ship in a Bottle!

quests.name: Trident of Storms
quests.description: Earn 40 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for a Trident of Storms!

quests.name: Fishy Guitar
quests.description: Earn 25 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for a Fishy Guitar!

quests.name: Fishbone Head
quests.description: Earn 20 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for a Fishbone Head!

quests.name: Exit, Stage Right
quests.description: It's not stage-fighting these varmints are interested in! They are gunning for you, and they've got six-shooters in hand to finish the job! If you want to escape with your life, you'll need to find a escape route, pronto! Search the room for a way to exit that isn't rushing at them like a charging bull

quests.name: The Wedge
quests.description: You've got your escape route all planned out, but it looks like that bad-news boss is right in your way! What's worse, the gap is too small to squeeze through. Lets see if any of these old coots in this place are hanging onto something useful. Like a crowbar. Bring back one Rusty Crowbar
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Freedom?
quests.description: Whoever built this wall sure did a fine piece of work; I haven't seen such a sturdy build-job since… well… ever! But if you're going to get out of here, you'll have to use the crowbar to widen that crack enough so that your britches can slide on through.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Other Ideas?!
quests.description: Keep calm and battle on. The saloon just HAS to have another exit, and you're going to find it! I saw some boxes in the storage room. They might just have something you can use.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Got a Light
quests.description: Where there's a gleam, there's gold, and since those bullies were able to bulldoze them into giving you more help? See if one of them might happen to have a match on hand.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: BADABOOM!
quests.description: We'll give those blowhards cause to have a blow-up, and it's not a fit of anger I'm talking about! Drag that dynamite over to crack in the wall and let's let it fly!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Lack of Subtlety
quests.description: I'm going to need you to pony up and strong-arm that One-Armet Bandit while i sing shoddy-sallies out of the saloon.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Look Around
quests.description: I'm sure this ghost train is right as rain if you're a lost soul. But since you're still alive, you'll need to get the lay of the land before taking action. See what there is to see and report back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Lack of Subtlety' quest.

quests.name: Caboose Key
quests.description: You're going to need that caboose unlocked, because i don't know about you, but I don't plan on hanging around. All those ghost-conductors can do is rattle their watch-chains; take them down and see wich one holds the key!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Slow your Role
quests.description: The train's not just running on time, it's running too fast! Get into the engine room and turn the steam down from *boil* to *simmer*. We want to reach the lowest speed possible or when we jump off this iron horse, we'll get trampled!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Slow the Coal
quests.description: Looks like we haven't slowed things enough; if you keep the Coal Ghouls from fanning the flames with more fuel, we might just have a chance to make it off this freighter!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Laying Traps
quests.description: The first step in waging a successful war is knowing your enemy. And to REALLY get to know them, you've got to get closer than might be comfortable since your target have weapons. Trap the Necrid who are on board so that you can study them all and use to your advantage.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Slow the Coal' quest.

quests.name: Gathering Mats
quests.description: It seems Necrids don't do well in a confinement. Whoops. But no matter, we can use the Necrid parts from the traps so that we can put together a material for disguise.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Pirate Hats
quests.description: Those piratical piles of bone have exactly what we need to complete your outfit- pirate hats! Gather up enough for each of us from the Necrosian Soldiers and Walkers, plus a few spares… just in case
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: That's a Wrap
quests.description: You'll need to get closer to Lord Krom Vath, close enough to steal the Key Blade. You're the only one who can do this, Hero! Take down ANYthing thats stand in your way!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Gaining Trust
quests.description: These townspeople have never met you, but you're going to need their help! I heard rumors that the monsters looted their homes and stole valuable items. Kill Obsidian Golems, Fire Elementals, and Volcanic Ash Imps to recover them and maybe the villagers will talk to you!

quests.name: If You Can't Stand the Heat...
quests.description: Get out of the village! You know, Hero, things have really been heating up in this town since America mech'd out. It'd be a good thing to secure the town from monster-based mayhem so they can concentrate on the REALLY BIG problem at hand. Kill 15 Fire Elementals and Fire Spirits to help them out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Retrieving Recollections
quests.description: I chatted up that tinkerer over there while you were talking to the villagers. Seems he's a little absent-minded. I bet if you recovered some of those 10 scattered photographs, it would jog his memory about the girl-turned-robot.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Bound By Fire
quests.description: If I'm going to control a Unicorn bathed in the molten magic of Mount Etherstorm, we're going to need to bind it with something a little hotter than a regula bridle. Find me 10 Fiery Mohawk Hairs from those Volcanic Ash Imps.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Plans Fit for a King ' quest.

quests.name: Heart of Fire
quests.description: My Black Unicorn will need to be able to gallop over rivers of lava and dodge obsidian boulders if we're to attract Amira 2.0's attention. It will need to have a heart of flame. If you can acquire 10 Flame Gems, we can drain them of their Fire Magic and transfer them into my black beauty.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Spirit of a Dragon
quests.description: If my steed is to bathe in lava and ride down a volcano as I drink from my chalice(filled with laughter of small children, you know), then it needs to have the spirit and courage of a dragon! And it seems fitting that an Elder Magma Wyrm should provide that. If you can defeat one in battle, it will gift us what we need.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Initiate Shutdown Sequence
quests.description: Immobilize Amira 2.0 so we can determine how best to power her down. Don't short her circuits or Kierk will never forgive you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Spirit of a Dragon ' quest.

quests.name: Aura of Dragon's Flame
quests.description: A Commander of Unicorns must possess the intensity of a dragon's flame and the heart of a Elder Wyrm. Defeat 25 Magma Dragons to prove that you possess these traits.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Spirit of the Black Unicorn
quests.description: You might have helped create my Black Unicorn, but do you posses the spirit, the will, that burns in here eyes and in her heart? Defeat 5 Obsidian Golems, 5 Fire Spirits, and 5 Loup Garou to show you possess a Heart of Stone, a Fiery Will, and a Primal Spirit and MAYBE you'll be worthy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Tie a Black Ribbon 'Round on an Old Burnt Tree
quests.description: A Commander of Unicorns must display their badge with PRIDE. For that, you'll need a very special ribbon. One that can withstand the fires of time. If you can find a burning tree trunk which has a ribbon like that., we can hang your medal right.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Make Way
quests.description: Deady's got a plan. He wants to build disguises for both you. They won't be great so it would be a good idea to reduce the number of bunny minions guarding the entrance to the crash site. get rid of 10 of them and get back ASAP.

quests.name: Black Pelt Test
quests.description: Next, Deady says that he'll need some materials to make your disguises starting with some bunny minion pelts. Bring back 5 Unshredded Bunny Minion Pelts and he can get started.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Network Fiber Spool
quests.description: Next deady needs something to use to stich the pelts together. He said that Invasion Ships use a lot of Networking Fiber for inter-ship communication. See if you can scrounge up 6 Spools of Networking Fiber to use as thread.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Guess What in a Guess Where
quests.description: OK, the last thing that Deady will need to finish your disguises is a needle. He says that there should here. See if you can find the Needle in the Haystack
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Splitting Hares
quests.description: Now that you have free access in and out of the compound, you need to take put some of the guards inside the compound. Dispose 12 Bunny Minions and head back here when the coast is clear. Oh and TRY to do it quietly.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Sleezter Bunny's Quarters
quests.description: Sleezter Bunny will have his quarters set up inside the wreckage of the ship. I'm sure it will be the nicest area inside there and probably well guarded. First, just see if you can find the door then get back here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Sleezter Bunivinci Code
quests.description: It looks like Sleezter Bunny has his door electronically sealed with a 5 digit code. He probably spread the code several of his minions. See of you can find all five digits to his door code.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Take Sleezter Bunny Out!
quests.description: We might be able to stop this whole thing before it goes too far. Get inside Sleezter Bunny's quarters and take him out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Mantis Ray Repair
quests.description: While you guys try and stop timer on that egg, I will stay here and repair this Mantis Ray. Think you could bring me a few soare parts crates before you head in there? It shouldn't take long and it might take all the difference.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: A Map Wouldn't Hurt
quests.description: We don't want any more surprises. See if you can find a map of Sleezter Bunny's Complex. Honestly, we should have done this as soon as we got in. See if you can get a map on any of the Bunny Minions!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Endin' Minions
quests.description: All the Bunny Minions you took out earlier have already been replaced. These things are reproducing like… well… bunnies. Take out the Necrosian Clone-o-Mat 3,000 and put a stop to Sleezter Bunny's endless supply of hired help.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Breaking Bad Eggs
quests.description: This will be a hard one. You'll need to sneak past the search lights leading to the giant eggs. Once you have done that, you need to cut the power to the timer that should stop the hatchling. Remember, don't let the lights see you moving!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Shadow's Door
quests.description: We've got to get wherever Sleezter's Head. Chase that rabbit… hamster… thing, because there's no doubt he's headed home and we DON'T him to get there first!

quests.name: Slash the Shadows
quests.description: We've going to need to figure how to subdue these monsters and sway them to our side, but before we can figure out how to DO that, we're going to need to neutralize the threat if they present. Knock out - but DON'T kill - 10 of them to give us some time and space to plan.

quests.name: Deprogramming for Dummies
quests.description: Mad scientists like the Beast Maker ALWAYS keep a record of what they've done. Makes them feel smart to write a book. I bet there's a manual on how to brainwash his minions… if they HAVE brains. Find a copy of his manual. It'll be here somewhere… unless one of the creatures stole it. So check them, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Guardian of the Lab-rary
quests.description: I tried to enter big door down the hall. It's alive (of course) and thinks we're minions of the beast maker and we have to answer some silly riddle. I guess he doesn't trust his creatures much. Go talk to door and figure out what we need to do to get past it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Quick switch!
quests.description: There has GOT to be and off-switch and if I know crazy villains - and I do - then it'll be close by. But it's probable buried under all this science, so you may need to dig around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: We're BOOM-ed!
quests.description: We should PROBABLY unplug the generator right about now. That thing is making some seriously unpleasant noises. It's going to blow. The plug should be somewhere along the wall… probably across the room from the generator. Clear the furniture there to find it
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: De-Generation Situation
quests.description: Attack the generator, which uses electrical attacks. Upon death, it explodes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Shielded Against the Shadow's
quests.description: If your plan is going to work, we NEED to find my Commander of Unicorns Shield! it will be close by; it always is when I need it . it'll be in one of these cages.. unless one of these creatures took it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Making a Many-armed Army
quests.description: We can't leave these adhorrible creatures locked up. Look, their water is stagnant and they're eating straw. That's no fit meal for mutant. They need bones to chew on. Preferably their Master's. Smash the cage doors open and free the beasts!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Kreature Kibble Khaos
quests.description: Y'know, I doubt the Beast Maker feeds these pathetic pawns regularly. I bet we can lure them to the main room - by where we came in - with some of the Kreature Kibble I found in the closet. Just leave a trail of it leading to the main hall and I bet they'll follow.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Gang's Not All Here
quests.description: We don't have enough rejects to form our army just yet. Maybe some of them aren't as hungry as the ones drawn by the food. You'll need to bring the few more, but they may take some convincing. It's a good thing they're not too bright. Knock them out and when they wake up here, we should be good to go.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Farm for Parts
quests.description: These loose monsters body-parts will sell GREAT with mad scientists around lore. Gather them up and sell them for gold, but be careful. These beasties look ANGERY. Not like the ones in the Kennel at all. Gather up enough parts to sell for a good profit.

quests.name: Beefed Up Baddies
quests.description: Take on the BIG boys the Beast Maker's made. They are big, bad, and ready to bash your brains out. I imagine these are the Beast Maker's bullies. But I know you can handle them, Hero.

quests.name: Fishbones, Fishbones
quests.description: According to my sources, Captain Chumbeard lost his map while running for his life from a pack of angry Fishbones. One of them might still have the map! It's as good a place to start as any.

quests.name: Outlook Good
quests.description: I've consulted my magic 8 ball about where the rest of the map might be. When I asked about the fishbone nests scattered around town, it told me "outlook good". What? It's the best lead we've got.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Roly Poly Fishbones
quests.description: While you were gone, I noticed some of the Fishbones collecting scraps of paper - they're probably rebuilding those nests you just dug up. One of them might have the other half of our map! I'll wait here while you check!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: We Can't Stop Here!
quests.description: Those aren't cannonballs - they're albino vampire bats! Who shoots bats out of a cannon?! Help me fight them off before they overwhelm us!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: It's Bat Country!
quests.description: Get ready! Here comes another wave! Let's fire 'em back at that pirate ship - and make sure you don't let any of them bite you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Vampirates!
quests.description: Vampires? Pirates? Those are two of my favorite things - but not when they're attacking my ship! I'm not ready to be anyone's lunch, so let's slay some vampirates!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Oh Right, They're Vampires
quests.description: Oops, I forgot to mention - you have to stake a vampirate or it won't stay dead! Take these stakes and turn those vampires into dust! Take these little ones for the vampire bats, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Vampirate Captain
quests.description: So, the captain of the vampirate ship still hasn't shown his face? Alright, let's go see who this dastardly fellow is!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: How Are We Breathing Under Here!?
quests.description: It's lucky I had these air tanks aboard the ship! Unfortunately, it's been awhile since I filled them. If you get some air bladders from the angler fish swimming nearby, that should last us until we can get out of this mess.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Unsink This Ship!
quests.description: We won't be finding that buried treasure while we're stuck down here! I need you to hold off these Vampirates and Merdraconians while I try to fix my ship. And, ah… maybe one of them has some tools I can use?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Release the Kraken! Wait, no - Don't.
quests.description: There's one more thing I'm going to need before I can finish fixing my ship. I think you know what it is. No, no, don't ask any questions. I know what I'm doing. Bring me that kraken!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: I Didn't Know They Could Swarm!
quests.description: Oh, no - it looks like Captain Von Poach and his crew made it to the island before we did! We're going to have to fight our way inland. Help us clear out some of these vampirates and fishbones so we can move ahead!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Now Where Are Those Landmarks?
quests.description: If we're going to find the spot this X is marking, we'll have to identify all of the landmarks shown on the map. Search the island until you've found them all, then come back to me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: X Marks The Spot
quests.description: Now that we've found all the landmarks, we can use the map to find Captain Chumbeard's buried treasure chest! What are you waiting for? Let's go dig it up!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Captain Von Poach
quests.description: No! That ruthless vampirate captain has followed us! Well, he won't be poaching this treasure! Take that rotting freebooter down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: SPF 1000
quests.description: Who'd have thought so many vampirates would still be here after we got rid of Captain Poach? I thought vampires hated the sun! Stake a few of them, won't you, so we can lay out without getting bit!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Worse Than Seagulls
quests.description: I think I've earned a vacation, but how can I relax when these Fishbones keep stealing my snacks? I'll toss some gold your way if you steal them back. My lemonade needs something to wash down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Captain Von Poach' quest.

quests.name: Story Time!
quests.description: Search the bookcase for the perfect story by Edgar Allan Poe. You'll know when you see it!

quests.name: Creepy Monkey Quest
quests.description: Every dark carnival needs a terrifyingly adorable mascot. This little critter will bite the hand that feeds him… and then bite your face… He's so CUTE when he's hungry! If you think you can handle the horror of this hungry, hungry hominid, bring him creepy monkey treats to tempt him. Good luck!

quests.name: Defeat Macabre Sepulchure
quests.description: For our adventures to truly come to an end, Macabre Sepulchure must be defeated. Do you think you can do it? Or has the Wyvern made you craven? (Man, the original title works SO much better with that rhyme.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Bone Terror ' quest.

quests.name: Shadowy Reconnaissance
quests.description: We should begin our hunt for the Cursed Mirror as soon as possible. Let's clear out some of these shadows so we can get out of here!

quests.name: Slippery Shadows
quests.description: Looks like those shadows managed to get the jump on us while we weren't paying attention! We're missing some pages from the Necronomicon that tell us where the mirror fragments are located. Let's see if we can get them back from the shadow skeletons and shadow beasts.

quests.name: Through the Looking-Glass
quests.description: According to this… the first mirror fragment can be found somewhere around here! Defeat all the shadow monsters until you can find it!

quests.name: Necro-Polished
quests.description: Look alive, Hero! The next piece is located somewhere in the /necropolis. It'll probably save us the trouble if we ask someone who's already familiar with the territory. How 'bout that paladin friend of yours? In that case, we should probably get him a few undead souvenirs while we're at it. Take our some of these shadow skeletons so he'll gave something to look forward to.

quests.name: Cavernous Chaos
quests.description: It says here that a few of the shards were sealed away inside the /necrocavern. Let's see if we can't find them amongst all these monsters.

quests.name: Mirror, Mirror, Off the Wall
quests.description: Looks like the next mirror shard… is in the Mirror Realm! Let's head to /battleoff and ask around town to see if anyone knows where it's located. If not, we can just beat up some of these Evil Moglins until they tell us.

quests.name: To the Underworld!
quests.description: This one looks like it'll be a bit tougher, Hero. The Necronomicon says that some of the remaining shards can be found in the /Underworld. Looks like we'll have to take on that big, skeletal Undead Legend and the brown guy with the tree trunk.

quests.name: Shadow of Corruption
quests.description: The last mirror shard can be found in the /celestialrealm; and it looks like we weren't the first ones to get here. Find the shadow beast in /celestialrealm to see if we can't find the shard first!

quests.name: Hunt for Shadowglass Shards
quests.description: We can probably make some cool stuff with the Shadowglass Shards these monsters drop. Let's kill a few of them so we have something to work with.

quests.name: Legends' Hunt for Shadowglass Shards
quests.description: I've found a better way to get Shadowglass Shards from these monsters, but it'll take some skill to use this method. Do you think you have what it takes?

quests.name: Something In The Air
quests.description: As soon as we boarded this space station, the fans I brought with me started going insane! It seems to be something in the air. Good thing this mask is keeping me immune! Maybe if you knock 'em out and get some masks on them, we can keep them from hurting themselves…

quests.name: They're Not Red Shirts - They're Deadshirts!
quests.description: Whoa! Everyone in the barracks is dead! No - they're undead! We've got to find out what happened! Maybe if we search the room, we'll find some clues.

quests.name: Curses!
quests.description: Man, looks like whatever happened to those astronauts got these little alien dudes, too! It's too bad they're so hostile -- these tiny creepies would be great in my stage show!

quests.name: Computers Don't Lie
quests.description: We may be able salvage some data about what happened from the computer stations in the control room. Check them all and see what you can find.

quests.name: Beam Me Up!
quests.description: We should be able to use that teleporter to get to the engine room -- we just need to get the passcode! One of these astronauts should have it.

quests.name: Exotic Pets
quests.description: While we're here, what do you say we try to tame one of these xenodogs? Don't you think they'd make great pets? Don't worry, I'm sure we have time.

quests.name: Not Trobbles
quests.description: Gah! What are these things! They sort of look like trobbles, but… those mouths! You're going to have to get rid of them before we can fix the engine -- I think they've been eating it!

quests.name: System Failure!
quests.description: Alright, you're going to have to stop the engine from shutting down. There should be an override code, you just have to input it correctly. I know you can do it!

quests.name: I Think I Saw This Movie Once
quests.description: What?? It wasn't the breach causing the engine shutdown at all! It was THIS thing! It looks like HR Giger's love letter to Carl Sagan. I don't know how you fight something like that, but you'd better figure it out fast!

quests.name: I Have A Short Fuse
quests.description: The engine's running again, but the electricity still seems pretty janky. You'll have to go into the walls and take a look at the wiring, see if you can figure out what the problem is.

quests.name: More Trobboliers
quests.description: The Trobboliers are in the walls, too?! We have to stop them from eating the wiring -- otherwise all that work you just did will be for nothing!

quests.name: Maybe These Guys Know Something
quests.description: We've got to figure out what these things are! The Stormslashers and Undead Space Marines in the storage bay might have some clues -- see if they sent or received any transmissions with information about them!

quests.name: Look At That Awesome Armor!
quests.description: Before we continue… I MUST have a set of that Stormslasher armor. It would be the perfect cosplay set for this year's BattleCon! We'll have to make sure it actually fits me, though -- some of these guys look a little short.

quests.name: Guardians of the Warehouse
quests.description: What's up with these guys in the warehouse? Are they guarding that weird orb? Whatever they're doing, they're blocking our way to Bay 10! You'll have to fight them so we can get through.

quests.name: Undead Space
quests.description: Wow, this is spooky. Every living thing is gone, and nothing is left but ghosts, and space. We'll have to clear the hall of these …space ghosts… and singularities. Bay 19 is just on the other side.

quests.name: Trobbolegion!
quests.description: What the what?! All of the Trobboliers in Bay 10 have clustered together into a single mass, life a fluffy coral reef with a million teeth! They've become… Trobbolegion! You've got the Orb… you can do this!

quests.name: Those Bloody Maggots
quests.description: Alrighty, then! Let's get started. First, I'm going to need you to take measurements of each of the rooms in the castle. That will let me know exactly how much space I have to work with. Buuuut… first I will need to find my measuring tape. I think I dropped it on the way in - maybe one of those bloody maggots took it? (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Purple is the Best Color
quests.description: I'm thinking what this place needs is some good, atmosphere-creating curtains. Something dark and imposing. You got any vampires around here? Oh, right - in Darkovia! Everyone knows vampire bats and blood maggots like to chew on velvet, so how about you head to Safiria's castle and see if you can get some velvet scraps from them? And maybe some deep purple dye - you should be able to get that from Orlok.

quests.name: Get Some Candles
quests.description: While I'm working on the curtains, I'm going to send you off to get some candles. I'm thinking something spooky, ghostly, and magical. I bet you can get some from the skeletal fire mages in Darkovia's Graveyard!

quests.name: Time For a Break
quests.description: Whew! Working on such a big home is thirsty business! Can you see if you can find someone around here who'll sell you some kind of energy drink or something… and maybe some snacks? You can get your first Kraken Energy drink for FREE outside of Kraken's, and I'll bet the bats have some snacks! (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Call the Exterminator
quests.description: When Shub'hathrys burst out of that statue, some kind of weird parasites came out with her. A lot of them! I'd hate to see them ruin all our hard work, so we should probably consider doing a little pest control.

quests.name: Calm the Villagers
quests.description: One thing about these elder deities - they tend to have a really bad effect on people's sanity! The people out in the town are already in a panic. If you don't want a rioting mob on our hands, we'd better go calm them down!

quests.name: Clean up the Ooze
quests.description: Some kind of weird ooze has been grossing up the place ever since that statue blew open. We probably ought to get rid of it before it consumes the entire town. What do you say - kill it with fire?

quests.name: They Stole My Stuff!
quests.description: Augh! Those pesky Oozes and Parasites have been getting into my supply bag! My scissors - my measuring tape - my nontoxic acrylic paints - everything's gone! I can count on you to beat those monsters up and get my stuff back, can't I?

quests.name: Ia! Ia! Shub'hathrys Fhtagn!
quests.description: I guess it's time to go after the big boss, eh? Such a shame. I'd love to just let her rampage through the city forever, but all good things must come to an end.

quests.name: Home Decorating with Voltaire
quests.description: I've got style, kid. And I want to share it with the world! I'd be happy to share tips with you, and decorate your own home. There's so much inspiration around us, this will be our classroom. Go get the following resources, and I'll show you how to craft your own classy house items.

quests.name: Beat This
quests.description: It's hard to do ANYTHING in here wit all these franken-beasts running around, isn't it? I guess you'll probably need to slay a few of them so you can focus on the REAL task at hand.

quests.name: Insane in the Brain?
quests.description: Like I said before, this entire room is all part of the brain-sucker. If we're going to get it off of me, we'll have to find what it's got its brain stem disguised as. Go around the room, and poke at anything that looks unusual… until you find something that fights back.

quests.name: No Surprise
quests.description: Aw, no! It was the black unicorn? Well, all of this WAS coming out of my brain. I guess I can't be too surprised.

quests.name: Vordred Boss!
quests.description: Thanks to ShatteredReality.
quests.requirements_note: Must have defeated Noxus (Monster) in Shadowfall War (Location) . Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: LET'S PINKIFY
quests.description: WE MUST FIND A MAGE OR A WIZARD OR A SORCERESS WHO IS CAPABLE OF CRAFTING THE PINKIFYING SPELL THAT I REQUIRE. MANY SUCH BEINGS ARE RIGHT HERE IN THIS PARK. MAKE THEM SUBMIT TO MY WILL, HERO!

quests.name: HEART-SHAPED FRUIT
quests.description: THIS RECIPE THAT ALINA PROVIDED REQUIRES FRUIT, IN THE SHAPE OF A HEART, FROM THE DISTURBINGLY PINK TREEANTS THAT WANDER THIS PARK. BRING ME 8 OF THEM!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: CH-CH-CH-INCHILLA (AND SLIME)
quests.description: THE SORCERESS'S RECIPE REQUIRES MORE INGREDIENTS, HERO. BRING ME 5 FISTFULS OF PINK SLIME, AND A PINCH OF CHINCHILLA FUR.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: SKULLS
quests.description: YOU MUST GO TO A PLACE WHERE YOU CAN FIND LOTS OF SKULLS. HOW ABOUT YOU GO DESTROY AN UNDEAD ARMY AND BRING ME THE SKULLS OF ITS SOLDIERS. THAT SHOULD NOT BE TOO DIFFICULT.

quests.name: MORE SKULLS
quests.description: MANY WEAPONS HAVE BEEN CRAFTED FROM SKULLS. FIND SOME OF THEM AND BRING THEIR SKULLS TO ME.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: MORE SKULLS ON THE SKULLS
quests.description: MANY WEAR SKULLS AS… FASHION ACCESSORIES. IT IS PATHETIC, I COULD GET MORE USE FROM THOSE SKULLS THAN ANYONE ELSE EVER COULD. GO GET SOME OF THESE SKULLS, THEN I WILL BE ONE STEP CLOSER TO DESTROYING… THE UNDEAD.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: MORE SKULLS ON THOSE SKULLS
quests.description: WHAT BETTER SKULLS COULD THERE BE THAN THE ONES FROM THE STRONGEST UNDEAD THERE ARE? ONCE THESE SKULLS ARE IN YOUR POSSESSION, IT WILL BE TIME TO RECONSTRUCT MY BODY. HAHAHAHAHAHA!!!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: VOIDUMINANCE
quests.description: IN ORDER TO RECONSTRUCT MY BODY, YOU WILL NEED TO OBTAIN THE MAGICAL ITEMS THAT WERE FIRST USED TO CREATE IT. I HAVE NO IDEA WHERE THEY ARE NOW, SO YOU BETTER START LOOKING.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Empower Vordred's Armor
quests.description: If you have Sepulchure's DoomKnight Armor, you can share its empowered properties with your newly obtained Vordred Armor! Just beat up Ultra Vordred one more time (and wear his armor while doing it to add extra insult to injury)!

quests.name: UNBROKEN SKULLS
quests.description: THIS IS A VERY BASIC QUEST. EVEN ADVENTURERS COULD DO IT. BRING ME 100 UNBROKEN SKULLS FROM ANY MONSTER IN /WARUNDEAD AND AN ORB FROM THE SUMMON LICH.

quests.name: UNBROKEN SKULLS (Mem)
quests.description: THIS IS A VERY BASIC QUEST. EVEN ADVENTURERS COULD DO IT. BRING ME 100 UNBROKEN SKULLS FROM ANY MONSTER IN /WARUNDEAD AND AN ORB FROM THE SUMMON LICH.

quests.name: Berzerker Bunny Helm - Wooden Egg
quests.description: Turn in a Wooden Egg to receive the Berzerker Bunny Helm! The wooden egg is the easiest to obtain. Get clues on what monster drops it by clicking on backpacks of eggs.

quests.name: Transforming Bunny Spear - Egg Shell
quests.description: Turn in an Egg Shell to receive the Transforming Berzerker Bunny Spear! Egg Shell? If it is just the shell Sneevils must be involved! Get clues on what monsters drop it by clicking on backpacks of eggs.

quests.name: Bunny on your Back - Quacked Egg
quests.description: Turn in a Quacked Egg to get a Bunny on your Back! Quacked Egg? Maybe someone threw it and it quacked when I Ducked? Get clues on what monster drops it by clicking on backpacks of eggs.

quests.name: Bunny Berzerker Armor - Were Egg
quests.description: Turn in a Were Egg to receive the Bunny Berzerker Armor! This is the most challenging quest of all which requires that you have done, or do some previous quests. Get clues on what monster drops it by clicking on backpacks of eggs.

quests.name: Another One Bites the Dust!
quests.description: The Legion Bonfire cannot be crafted by any but the most skilled blacksmith, and one who has learned from Dage the Evil himself. The materials required to craft it are many, and will take much effort. If you survive your attempts to collect them, I will forge the Legion Bonefire for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 65.

quests.name: Chroma CRASH
quests.description: WAIT WAIT WAIT! What are you doing?! DON'T DESTROY MY MACHINE! I need that to make candy! NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Whacky Snacky ' quest.

quests.name: Color Farming
quests.description: Now, since you've beaten the curse out of that machine… mind gathering more of that delicious dye for me? I have orders to fill! So much time and so little candy to make. Wait a minute. Strike that. Reverse it. Thank you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Whacky Snacky ' quest.

quests.name: No Egrets Badge
quests.description: The Turking is a FOWL ruler. Defeating 1,000 of his minions will won't ruffle any of YOUR friends' feathers and will make Waddles feel safer. It will also show the TurKing that YOU are an opponent to be reckoned with.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Without Feather Ado ' quest.

quests.name: Ducks in a Row
quests.description: I do not have many things that I am proud of… except for my Rubber Ducky collection! That was until the Robber Duckies stole all my things… but what's a big blorb of feathers to do? Can you…would you help me find all my Rubber Duckies again? Pwease?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Without Feather Ado ' quest.

quests.name: Barbells and Biceps
quests.description: Those Swole Swans always make fun of me for being so weak… but then they go and steal my 1oz Barbells… so how can I ever get moar stronk? *sad duck sad* But you're really strong! You can get my Barbells back so I can work on my biceps… right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Without Feather Ado ' quest.

quests.name: Gobble This... Fist To Your Face
quests.description: The uh… RAWRgobble stole some of my seeds I was planning on eating for a snack. I'd like to tell him how I really feel about him being mean to me but he is a loon-atic and really mean. Can you… would you help me get the seeds back?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Without Feather Ado ' quest.

quests.name: A Grave Mission
quests.description: Darkovia is not the kind, friendly place that you are used to, traveler; hungry creatures are always watching… and waiting… beneath ever shadow. Your only hope at surviving an ambush is to know your surroundings as if it were second nature. Explore the entirety of the graveyard until you can walk the grounds with your eyes closed—more or less. When you are done exploring, head to the Mausoleum and pay homage to the first King of our kin. Return to me whenever you are ready for your next mission.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 20.

quests.name: Lending a Helping Hand
quests.description: Now that you have explored your surroundings, it is time to see what you are made of—other than flesh and bone, that is. These lands are flooded with many skeletons and scavengers, making any sort of trek in these parts tiresome and dangerous. If you wish to prove your worth, destroy the undead Skeletal Fire Mages. Bring me back 8 Scorched Metacarpals… if you do not meet their same fate, that is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bone Appetit
quests.description: Although weak, the Rattlebones in the area are pests to both the Vampires and Lycans alike; these scavengers steal the kill of anything and anyone close by. We have greater problems to deal with at the moment, which is why I am asking you for help. Hunt down the Rattlebones to help diminish their never-satisfied constantly-expanding population. Return to me when you have 10 Rattlebone Mandibles.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Batting Cage
quests.description: By now, you have seen the Albino Bats in the area, yes? These flying mammals are not native to the area—we have reason to believe they were introduced by Drow caravans as they made their way to the Dwarfhold Mountains. Regardless of how they got here, we need to remove them as soon as possible. Not kill them—just find them a new home. Bring me 6 Caged Albino Bats so that my people can relocate them to a safe place. You will have to knock them unconscious before you can cage these wild bats.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: His Bark is Worse Than His Blight
quests.description: Not much is known about the undead werewolf who calls himself Blightfang. He is a true brute to both the Vampires and Lycans, viciously attacking anything that moves, whether it his own kin or not. Blightfang must be stopped! Find the undead werewolf and show him just who the Alpha is—hopefully you, granted if you return in one piece. Bring me back Blightfang's Skull as indisputable proof of your success!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Willow Creek
quests.description: Thank you for answering my call! I have received an urgent message from the Church Elder of Willow Creek. There is a monster loose in the area, attacking their animals and crops. To show me that you are the right person for the job, please go to the Forest and bring me back 5 Zard Tails and (most importantly) the Zard Chieftain's Head. Once you have done that, I know that I can recommend you to Calafas with no reservations.

quests.name: Hideous Tail
quests.description: Well, you know what they say… eye of newt and toe of frog. I find that Zardmen tails work MUCH better for spellcrafting and potion making. I'm running a little low on supplies, though - can you go to the forest and bring me back 5 Hideous Tails from those Zardmen blocking the paths? (Return to Warlic in the Battleon Magic Shop once you have all 5 Hideous Tails.)

quests.name: Enchanted Inks for Spell Crafting
quests.description: Hmm, the Royal Alchemy Academy should have brought me another batch of Enchanted Ink by now. You wouldn't happen to be from the Alchemy Academy would you?

quests.name: Lesser Salves for Spell Crafting
quests.description: Have you brought me salves for making? I bet you didn't know these salves can be mixed into inks allowing the ink to gain magical properties. I bet you also didn't know that the better the salve the BETTER THE INK!

quests.name: Runic Salves for Spell Crafting
quests.description: Have you returned from the Alchemy Academy? I am expecting more Runic Salves for my scrolls. Properly mixed salves allowing us to capture powerful spell in mere ink and paper.

quests.name: Sending out a Stress-OS
quests.description: I have a most important message for Duchess Willa detailing my findings but i will need to attach the authentication token to assure her of its validity. In my searching trough the city, I must have dropped it. It could be in a gutter or some creature's gullet. Please hero, find the sigil and deliver the letter across the bridge. Time is of the essence!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Magic-flavored Misery ' quest. Note: Click Rowan (1) in Palace to complete the quest.

quests.name: Locate The Sealed Library
quests.description: These ruins are ancient but The name Shurpu rings a bell. I think there is a library here. We should be able to find whatever Xan is after in the Library. Once you've found it, come let us know where is it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Scoria's Quests

quests.name: A Powered Library Lock
quests.description: I've seen doors like that before. There is a code that will open the door but first you need topower the lock. Gather 10 fire gems from the local monsters and will be able to get the lock powered up.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Luminate the Library Lock
quests.description: Ok, the lock should be powered. Go find the sequence to light up all three gems above the door and come back once you have opened the library.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defend the Library!
quests.description: With all the fire monsters here in the ruins it will be pretty hard to get any studying done. Go clear the hallways near the library and by the time you get back we should know wht Xan is after.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Crossing Over
quests.description: According to this schematic you will need to cross that lava filled gorge to get to the Hall of the Shurpu Guardian. Go gather some Fire Wire and Lava Salts from the monsters, and pick up any boards you find lying around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Guardian Of Shurpu
quests.description: With the bridge in place you will be able to acess to the Hall of Shurpu Guardian. Be careful, with that ring, he will be far stronger than the other monsters in the ruins. We'll wait for you there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Face Xan
quests.description: With the Ring of Shurpu on my hand I can feel my fire magic dwarfing all my other magics! Xan won't be able to throw anything at us that I can't throw right back at him. Let's go face him in this throne room. It's beyond the Hall of Ring Guardian.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shurpu Blaze Token
quests.description: If you wish to gain access to the Pyromancer Shop you will need Shurpu Blaze Tokens. If you bring me a piece of Guardian Shale from the Ring Guardian, then I will craft it into tokens for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Face Xan ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: MEMBER: Shurpu Blaze Token
quests.description: THIS QUEST IS FOR AQW MEMBERS ONLY! If you wish to gain access to the Pyromancer Shop you will need Shurpu Blaze Tokens. If you bring me a piece of Guardian Shale from the Ring Guardian, then I will craft it into tokens for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Face Xan ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Chaos Investigation
quests.description: The smell of fear and pain lingers in the air. Chaos' taint is strong here. Gather 6 pieces of practice gear so I can recover clues. Slay 3 Chaos Wolves and 3 Chaorrupted Gorillaphants so you can enter the tower to search further.

quests.name: Hunt for Answers
quests.description: I'm sure Vormund will have hidden information to help us before he went back into battle. Smash open the boxes to find anything he might have left for us. And clear 5 of the spyders out of this room; their presence is an insult to his memory!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Decryption Hunt
quests.description: Uncover the text to decipher Vormund's message! It's got to be here amongst one of these books. Search through them to see which is the right one, then slay the 6 Chaorrupted Knights who have infested this place.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Prisoner Breakout!
quests.description: Whichever Chaorrupted creatures destroyed this room… they also freed the prisoners! Slay 10 of them before they escape the tower and attack the townspeople!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hidden Secrets
quests.description: We've got to continue climbing to the top of the tower. We must light the beacon and summon help! Clear the garbage preventing you from ascending. Make sure to find the 2nd page Vormund must have hidden, and defeat the Chaos creature guarding the room!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mage Mystery
quests.description: If we're going to light the beacon and summon help, we're going to need the power from those Corundum Crystals. Gather 4 of them, and blind the 13 Sp-Eyes to prevent Drakath from watching our next move.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Take Back Remains
quests.description: We cannot allow the Hall of Heroes to be tainted with Chaos! Slay the Chaorrupted Knights to recover the 7 stole Memorial Statue pieces.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Activate Teleport Rune
quests.description: It is worse than I feared. Chaos has ensnared some of King Alteon's Good Knights. They must have been on their patrol in the area. Take the Chaorrupted Blood they shed and bring it to me. Then go back downstairs to the Mage room and retrieve the Blue Orb to activate the portal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Knight Attacks
quests.description: We will never know the identity of this Chaos Knight. It might've been someone you fought in the past, or it might - as I fear - be Vormund. Whoever it is, he must be slain!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Warlic's Letter to Rayst
quests.description: Please deliver this letter to Rayst outside the Tower of magic. in /Arcangrove. I'd like to know if the Tower magi have clues to the source of they ley line disturbance.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 11 to access these quests in Battleon Town . Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Chat with Cysero
quests.description: Cysero is probably our only realiztic hope of finding a way to get to the centore of Lore. Go speak with him in his blacksmithy / bakery and tell him what we need.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 11 to access these quests in Battleon Town . Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the ' Rayst Rensponse ' quest. Note: Quest can only be completed by going to Cysero (NPC) in Battleon Town .

quests.name: Enter the Entrance
quests.description: Interesting. I did not expect to encounter so many subterranean creatures immediately. We won't be able to find the Jusgedonwifit until these monsters have been defeated. Please clear all these monsters out of this room before moving downward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return The Potion To Cysero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Can You Dig It?
quests.description: The soil is displaying some fascinating properties. I suspect that it has to do with the disturbance of the ley lines. I might not have another chance to examine it. Please, take soil samples from some of these monsters.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return The Potion To Cysero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Snip Snip
quests.description: Cysero has noticed some more interesting properties about the monsters themselves. He is asking for… for some reasons…. toe nail clippings. As long as your clearing monsters out of the way could you gather some for him?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return The Potion To Cysero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Resonations
quests.description: I would like to take the soil samples back to my magic shoppe but I can already see that the soil has become enriched with crystallized mana. That shouldn't happen this close to the surface. I need you to bring me any Crystal Samples that you can find!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return The Potion To Cysero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eureka!
quests.description: Ah, you have found the craft? Well done, but we won't be able to get it restarted with all the monsters swarming it. Please clear the monsters from the rear entrance, please.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return The Potion To Cysero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Push-Button Start
quests.description: Enter the Jusgedonswifit and see if you can restart the craft. If not, it may require refueling or repairs. Return and let us know how it goes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return The Potion To Cysero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Out Of Coal
quests.description: Cysero says that the stats hairball has become depleted and that we're going to have to use the secondary fuel system. First, you'll need some mana shards that formed on some of the monsters in this tunnel.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return The Potion To Cysero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Start The Reaction
quests.description: Cysero is asking for a number of Mana Catalyst that have formed in the tunnel. They are unstable enough to start the reaction we need to power the secondary fuel system.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return The Potion To Cysero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Start Her Up
quests.description: Cysero has provided the correct amount of each item to start up the reaction. All you need to do is walk back into the Jusgedonwifit and deposit these materials into the ship's fuel container and we can continue out the journey.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return The Potion To Cysero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: We Have Arrived!
quests.description: We made it! These crystal caves must surround the super-dense crystallized mana core of the planet. We can't drill further, but we can walk there if you clear the area around the ship of monsters.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return The Potion To Cysero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hardened Crystals
quests.description: The drill head has nearly been stripped. Cysero is working to fix it but says that some of the hardened crystals that you can find on the local monster population would ''come in handy''. See if you can find 6 Crystal Chunks.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return The Potion To Cysero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Quadtanium?
quests.description: Cysero is still effecting his repairs but has asked for some nuggets of an ore he has started calling Quadtanium. It's a very dense metal that neither of us have ever seen before, but there should be chunks lying all over the place. See if you can find 6.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return The Potion To Cysero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Capacitance
quests.description: Cysero is nearly done fixing the Jusgedonwifit, but he says that with a Perfect Capacitance Crystal, then she will never move. I can only hope that you can find one on one of these monsters.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return The Potion To Cysero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Heart Of The World
quests.description: Amazing! It appears that a creature has formed out of the crystallized mana itself! This is what is throwing off the core's balance. You must defeat this creature at all costs!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return The Potion To Cysero ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Help Professor Warlic
quests.description: To command the elementals, you must throw yourselves into battles with them again and again and again. Bring me 1 Ice Core, 1 Fire Core, 1 Air Core, 1 Earth Core, and 1 Mana Core from the following elementals: Ice, Fire, Air, Earth, and Mana.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Welcome to Dragonrune Hall ' quest.

quests.name: Elements of Research
quests.description: To truly study the elements, you will need to collect a LOT of source material! Bring me the following:
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Welcome to Dragonrune Hall ' quest.

quests.name: Elemental Mastery: Study Session
quests.description: To pass your Elemental Mastery tests, you will need to study a LOT and that means collecting even MORE resources: Bring me the following:
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Welcome to Dragonrune Hall ' quest.

quests.name: Fires of Progress
quests.description: The elements are dangerous and volatile, but those who have hamessed their power have grown. We are able to create and destroy, and even color the elements with our perceptions. Go to the /Embersea to retrieve cores from Living Lava and ash from the Pyroclash Cloud, and I will demonstrate spells created by those who no longer fear fire. They are young spells, but are as if not more dangerous than that of the ancients'.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Welcome to Dragonrune Hall ' quest.

quests.name: Hunt for Records
quests.description: Drakath has retreated to the Realm of Chaos, and if we're going to stop him from raising the final Lord, we'll have to follow. But… I'm not sure how.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed all other Chaos storylines . Note: Legends may skip this requirement and begin these quests immediately.

quests.name: Recover Family Jewels
quests.description: To enter the Chaos Realm, we'll need to create a Guidestone. I can form one with the gems from the lost Slugworth relics. A frostwyrm rider in the northlands has stolen their blade. A lava golem in a volcano holds their sigil. Their crown was lost in a forest of chaos, and the scepter was last seen in the airstorm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shatter the Chaos Crystals
quests.description: It looks like the path forward is blocked by crystals made of solidified chaos! Shatter them so we can pass - bring me their shards when you've done so.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Previously called "Shatter the Gemeralds" .

quests.name: Chaos Rogue Removal
quests.description: The rogues that Drakath has chaorrupted throughout Lore - they're all here blocking our way forward through the Chaos Realm! Slay them, hero, and bring their daggers to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Mage Massacre
quests.description: Looks like we're not finished yet - a cluster of chaorrupted mages is blocking the path forward. Defeat them, and bring me their weapons as proof.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Warrior Wasteland
quests.description: We've defeated his mages, and his rogues, and now he's got an army of chaorrupted warriors blocking our way? Slay them, and bring me their blades!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Vanquish the Chaos Virago
quests.description: It looks like Drakath saved the worst for last! The next part of the chaos realm is being guarded by his fiercest warrior - a virago of chaos! Defeat her, and we will know what she is protecting.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: One Lord Left
quests.description: The Virago was guarding… a room full of statues of previous Lords of Chaos? But why? Examine the statues, perhaps you'll find a clue that will tell us who the last Lord is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Recover Lost Mementos
quests.description: Battle Rogues, Warriors, Healers, and Mages to recover 5 Warrior Memento, 5 Mage Memento, 5 Rogue Memento, and 5 Healer Memento to bring back to their families.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Confront the Champion of Chaos
quests.description: You've fought your way through the hordes of chaos. Nothing remains in your way. Go, hero - confront Drakath and end his chaorruption for good.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse the Chaos Realm
quests.description: The chaorrupted heroes just won't stop coming! Go in and disarm some of them to help keep the path clear. 13 should be enough.

quests.name: Legendary Chaorruption Investigation
quests.description: Do you think you can destroy 13 Gemeralds without shattering them? Bring them to me if you can - they're made of Solid Chaos essence, and studying them will help us learn more about the nature of Chaos.

quests.name: Chaorruption Destruction
quests.description: Do you think you can destroy 13 Gemeralds without shattering them? Bring them to me if you can - they're made of Solid Chaos essence, and studying them will help us learn more about the nature of Chaos.

quests.name: Cleanse the Chaorruption
quests.description: The first step towards convincing Xan we want to help him is removing is the Chaos attackers here. Slay 10 Chaos Symbiotes and 10 Chaorruption monsters.

quests.name: Book of Chaos and Flames
quests.description: If Chaos IS affecting the way he says, we need to stop it. Slay 13 Chaos Mages and Chaorrupted Mages to nullify their magic. Find the Tempus Chaos Amulet and the Book of Chaos and Flames… with those powerful defensive objects, Xan would feel much safer.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Facets of Chaos
quests.description: Gems can amplify magical power. I believe the presence of the Chaos Gems here is causing Xan's fire magic to shift faster than normal. Take out 13 Chaos Gems to slow the change.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Eye Spy
quests.description: Xan's paranoia IS justified… for once. The last thing he should need to feel secure is for you to slay any chaos spies. Bringing him 3 imp ears, 3 mage noses, 3 choarrupted tongues, and 3 chaos eyes should do the trick.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Chaorrupted Xan Illusion
quests.description: I did not think the 13th Lord of Chaos would do THIS to Xan! Making it look like he is hunting himself… it's enough to drive ANYONE insane! Defeat the Xan Illusion… and FAST!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Meet the Za'narians
quests.description: Explore the Runedwoods and speak to the Za'narians that you find here. They each have a different specialty, learned on the far-away world of Za'nar. They will have much knowledge that can help us!

quests.name: Ruining the Dragonwood
quests.description: These creatures… they are so strange. Truly from a different plane entirely. But before we can take out the invaders in other countries, we need to secure the RuneWoods. Our base must be safe!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Catch the Ki'lks!
quests.description: Ki'lks have been sighted throughout the Northlands. They will have spread to many different parts of it by now. Go there and destroy them before they can harvest more of the Presence Jir'abin needs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Discover the Darkness
quests.description: Fae is fascinated by the Darkness in Doomwood. Bring back 8 Bonemuncher Fangs and an Ectomancer Orb from Doomwood. I believe that combining them with 3 Frask scales will make a potion to greatly increase her power!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shoot for Victory
quests.description: Daz's skill with the bow AND his magic will be doubly-useful. But we must make sure he does not run out of supplies. Bring back 6 bowstrings from the Dwarfhold Assassins in /uppercity, then slay the Frasks here to provide arrow-shafts.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Frasks!
quests.description: The Frasks have not only invaded the Runedwoods, but they are scattered across Lore! Hunt them down and return to me; we should have a better plan to battle Jir'abin by then!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Analogues for Rath
quests.description: Rath uses Void Stone and Void Crystal to hold large amounts of Void Energy. These items have numerous Magical applications, including devices that can disrupt the use of Magic or store Energy for later use. Arcangrove is such a magically charged place that there should be items within that can be used in the same manner!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Shades Grow Darker
quests.description: The army of Shades continues to grow; they are now scattered across the length and breadth of Lore! I suspect that as Jir'abin gathers the Chaotic Presence, his strength grows, and so does theirs. Clear them out before he arrives!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Discover the Void
quests.description: Before you face Jir'abin, I would like to see if there are any similarities between OUR Void creatures and Jir'abin. All knowledge is worth having; especially this.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Confront Jir'abin
quests.description: Jir'abin is here, and he rages at the loss of his minions. He would face Lore's Champion - you. Defeat him, and save our world… and prevent him from ravaging Za'nar, too!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Void Expands
quests.description: Thanks to Tristyn.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Quest for the Blade of De'ther
quests.description: Sael commissioned the Blade of De'ther to thank you, but Jir'abins Shades have stolen it. Slay them for a chance to find the blade!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Confront Jir'abin ' quest.

quests.name: Breakfast With... Brains?
quests.description: Cysero says he has a simple way to make the transference of your soul to the elemental plane, but…*sigh* he needs to finish his breakfast. Why don't you humor him a little while I think of another way in case we run out of time? He said that a smart brekfast requires…"brains"? Gross. Slay 10 of the Undead Treeants and Ectomancers in Doomwood Forest to get the Brains, then come back to me!

quests.name: Post-Elemental Apocalypse
quests.description: Now that Cysero is co-operating, he has opened a connection to the Sun's elemental core. Unfortunately, now creatures from the sun are pouring to the elemental plane! Hurry, hold back the waves of intruders while I try to figure out how to keep 'em from entering OUR realm and burning everything!

quests.name: Phoenix's First Birthday
quests.description: Oh great, Cysero and his eggs again…ah wait, he meant the PHOENIX's eggs…of course! Fire from a phoenix is harmful to "normal" fire from those elementals! Gather enough eggs so we can build a fiery barricade around the door. They will be too afraid to come closer, but you can make your way between the bonfires!

quests.name: Elementals Are From the Sun, We Are From Lore
quests.description: Now that you have gathered the eggs, you must spread them around. Be sure to place them evenly throughout the Mana plane. They will ignite once they have been placed correctly.

quests.name: Sssssmoking...
quests.description: Before we split your soul from your body, we need to clear the way on the elemental pathway. Get rid of more of those Elementals and Phoenixes!

quests.name: Green-Eyed Incantations
quests.description: To start the spell, we need the eyes of a Phoenix. A few of them have green eyes, which are not only rare, but carry more magic. Don't ask about the relation between color and magic. Its a long lecture we don't have time to…

quests.name: A Lonely Cysero
quests.description: Hurry, while he is distracted, do something to KEEP him that way….don't ask me, just…keep listening to his blabbing. That should keep him busy if you can keep your sanity!

quests.name: Body & Soul & The Hero
quests.description: The incantation is done. Once you step through the portal your body will stay and our souls will be linked. Please be careful - anything that happens to your soul will carry over to your body here!

quests.name: Abduction
quests.description: This wall of mana blocks our path, but certainly the elementals are able to pass through it. Perhaps one of them will talk. Yes, they can talk, if you can understand the language of mana, which I do. Bring me back one of the Mana Phoenixes so that I may learn their plans.

quests.name: Truth or De-Feathering
quests.description: According to the Phoenix I interrogated, the Great Solar Elemental knows how to pass through blockades. In fact, he was the one who put the blockade there to avoid more sun creatures from entering! We might agree on that, but now he won't allow us to pass. GO and find him - maybe we can convince him that we need to pass..

quests.name: The Art of Persuasion
quests.description: A few bolows in the right spot and even that big mana brute will spill the beans…and a few teeth. Yes, of course the Great Solar Elemental has teeth, will you stop asking silly questions?

quests.name: Frozen Mana
quests.description: Apparently, that blockade is not crystallized mana, but FROZEN-SOLID! There must be a way to melt it. Maybe Pheonix eggs will do it. Gather a few more and bring them back to me!

quests.name: Angry Elements
quests.description: Wonderful, it worked! But now we have someone veeery angry at us. Our good friend the Great Solar Elemental is NOT amused. Give him another… convincing argument.

quests.name: The Sunspots, They Are Changing!
quests.description: A sunspot is a patch of darkness on the sun - these shadowy paths around you. They move in a pattern that can say a lot about the sun's condition. So trace all the sunspots you can find and let me see the coordinates.

quests.name: I Enjoy Being a Soul
