quests.description: I hope your little astral trip isn't causing any odd feelings. To re-strengthen your corporeal connection, try to do what you do best. FIGHT! Bring me back 15 Embers from defeated Sun monsters!

quests.name: Burning Like Me!
quests.description: All that fighting surely got you all burning up! Oh, relax, I didn't mean literally. Take that energy and gather more information about the sun's activities. Fight some Sun Flares and Living Fires to see what they know.

quests.name: Assault With a Deadly Shadow
quests.description: Apparently, something cast a shadow in the center of the Sun, and it is siphoning the energy to itself! We must find more about it! There is a source of energy coming from somewhere that might pin-point this said "shadow".

quests.name: Mother Knows The Sun
quests.description: Oh dear, all this commotion has caused a huge mess of fire and mana to take living form. Apparently, it speaks for the sun and it is VERY enraged. But all the energy concentrated on it is EXACTLY what we need to give the Sun its life back! Defeat the Solar Incarnation to find the Heart of the Sun!

quests.name: Selfishness
quests.description: That looming shadow seems to be the center of power drainage! Brave the flames that block the way, if you dare, and whatever you do, do NOT drop that Heart!

quests.name: See the Hero Run
quests.description: Now that you have obtained the heard and discovered the identity of the shadow, return the Heart of the Sun to the Vortex of Flames! But be careful, and fast! The sun is still losing it's power!

quests.name: Gear Enchantment
quests.description: Welcome BACK to my magic shop… of the past in the present! I have learned some new tricks while you've been traveling. If you bring me the right reagents, I can enchant certain items to do more damage against all monsters. Pretty neat trick, huh?

quests.name: Warlic's Secret Quest
quests.description: You FOUND it! There can only be ONE reward for such a keen eye and intelligent mind such as yours. A color customizable version of my staff. It will not be too hard… so no grumbling.

quests.name: Portal Revealed
quests.description: There we go. If you go through that portal, I suspect it should lead you straight to this anomaly you're looking for.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Help from Warlic ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get the Poison
quests.description: If I can work with samples of the poison that's seeping out of the Rift, I might be able to craft something like a magical vaccine. This could allow us to get close enough to close it - or at least to drive these monsters back into it. Collect specimen samples from the Noxious Clouds and the Toxic Fumes on the outskirts of town. Come back to me when you have 5 of each.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What Happened to Baldric? ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Time to Recharge
quests.description: I've put up a magical ward around our camp to keep it safe from the monsters and toxins coming out of the Rift. But it takes a lot of arcane energy to keep a spell like that running full time! If you want to help me recharge, then sneak into /dreadfire and pilfer some Stray Mana and Arcane Crystals from our enemies. We'll weaken them, and strengthen ourselves at the same time.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What Happened to Baldric? ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Reactivate the Wards
quests.description: Some of the wards went down while you were collecting more arcane energy for me. Would you mind reactivating them? You'll find them on the outer edges of the camp. While you're there, make sure you slay any monsters who have wandered too close. (Quest works once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What Happened to Baldric? ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Get a Monitor
quests.description: You'll be staying far enough away from the Rift to keep yourself reasonably safe, but you're still going to be exposing yourself to a large dose of its toxin. Lim has developed a Personal Toin Monitor - PTM for short - that will track your eposure and let you know when you need to come back for a detox. Talk to Lim when you're ready to go, and he'll give you one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What Happened to Baldric ' quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: Rally the Mages
quests.description: I have a plan that, in theory, should let us get close enough to Extriki to fight and, hopefully, slay it. But I'll need a lot of magic power to pull it off. Head back to our camp near /therift, and rally all the mages you can find, then check the chests in camp to see if you can find any Mana Bombs for added power. Bring them back here to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Said Yes, Yes, Yes ' quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: Wisteria Hysteria
quests.description: If it wasn't already clear how close we are to Guru Forest, it surely is now. Extriki's toxin has reached as far as Wisteria, and it has made its way over here. The toxin actually seems to have made it stronger, and it's been doing a lot of damage to the remaining foliage and wildlife. Just… take care of it, please? And bring some friends with you. I expect it will be harder to defeat than it has been in the past.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Confront Extriki
quests.description: Alright… this is it. It's time to stop this monster from destroying Lore, once and for all. Move out to confront Extriki whenever you're ready. We've got your back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: Keeping Cool
quests.description: We need to restore some of the Ice that has been lost in the Claymore's destruction. Bring me back Ice Essences from any of the Ice Monsters on the mountain where you located the Claymore. Its energy should have transferred to the creatures guarding it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Claymore Shards ' quest.

quests.name: Cryogenic Decacrystals
quests.description: That mountain also has Cryogenic Decacrystals growing there! Bring me them so I can infuse their Ice-aligned energies into this new weapon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once .

quests.name: Fiamme's Blessing
quests.description: Fiamme's Blessing on the Claymore Shards appears to be losing energy! We must act fast! Defeat the nearby Fire Elementals and take their Fire Gems given to them by Fiamme. It should be enough to keep the blessing locked onto the weapon once it's forged!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Inferno Heart
quests.description: It is said that the heart of a Living Fire absorbs all heat from the area around it. Bring me one of their hearts and it will take all the heat away from the weapon, making it supercooled and returned to its former glory!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragonscale Powder
quests.description: The Shadowflame army's most powerful dragons are behind that wall of flame, and we can't get to them until we've put it out. The best way to extinguish dragonfire is with powdered Dragonscale. Bring me as much as you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragonlord Medals: Defend Arcangrove! ' quest.

quests.name: Dragon Oil
quests.description: Now that we have access to the more powerful dragons, I can start trying to break that spell that's shutting us off from the tower. I can make a counterspell, but I'll need oil from the dragons' glands to craft it. Please bring me some.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mega Dragonlord Medals ' quest.

quests.name: Mutant Dragon Oil
quests.description: The spell that's closing us off from the tower portal is stronger than the one outside was. If I can get some of the dragon oil from these mutated specimens, I think I'll be able to break it. Please bring me some.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Head of a Dragon ' quest.

quests.name: Titan Shadow Dragonlord
quests.description: The Titan Shadow Dragonlord stands no chance against us! Hurry - we've got to get to the top of the tower NOW. That vile beast and his shadowy master must be destroyed!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Head of a Dragon ' quest. Note: Was unlocked when the war meter reached 100%.

quests.name: Temporal Translation Tome
quests.description: In the Library and around our town, the ancient script used by Chronomancers can be seen. Our creator has crafted a dictionary for you, so that you may understand. Bring back 4 Minx Fairy Wings, 2 breaths from a Moglin Ghost, and 5 talons from the Future Shadowscythe in the Time Library, and I will create the mixture allowing you to see the runes.

quests.name: Restore Tibattleonia!
quests.description: Built from a shard of very special sand, this city is more solid than an illusion, but just as unreal. Taken from a vivid memory of one who was there, our city is as he left it…. and as broken. Restore our home! Bring me Pilot Fangs for nails, Sneak-skin to patch up walls, and Bolts from Ore Balboa in the mountainpath.

quests.name: Gen Ed Generator
quests.description: Collect the following parts to build our backup generator. The motor should be kept in an ancient chest in the Time Library, Sneak oil can be squeezed out of sneaks, and the Pilot Hearts, well, good luck finding them!

quests.name: Speak to the Blue Mage
quests.description: There is a mage to whom you must speak. Talk to Warlic, the Blue Mage. He will explain why you must begin this journey. The path begins here; they are roads you have never walked before. They are roads you should never walk again. Talk to Warlic. He will tell you. Bring him a token from the Shadowscythe so he knows where you've come from.

quests.name: Cull the Chaos Golems
quests.description: Slay 10 of the Chaos Lord's Chaorrupted Golem-creatures! If they are not going to help you save the Chaos Lord, they cannot allow to remain free in The Span!

quests.name: Destroy the ShadowScythe Golems
quests.description: My Master may have created the Shadowscythe Golems… too well. I do not want them to roam free while he is weak. Take down 10 of the ShadowScythe Golems to help ensure his security.

quests.name: Time to Learn the Truth
quests.description: If you are going to adventure through the places you must go, you will need to learn more about the lands, people, and creatures that make them up. Talk to all of the golems in TheSpan to understand where they originated.

quests.name: Gain Access to Doors
quests.description: Pass through the doors along these halls to be transported to… recreations of worlds you will never truly know. It is only proper for the creatures of those worlds to grant you access. Slay a Sneak, a Tog, and a Shadowscythe to gain the keys you need.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Adventures and Quests
quests.description: In a land where aliens walk, the gods battle alongside mortals, and a Hero is born every minute - YOU commanded the field. Or someone very like you. Slay the Sneaks and Moglin Ghosts to learn vital knowledge about life in a world I call AdventureQuest. To begin, go to the door with the yellow angel.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Fable of Dragons
quests.description: Elements are a part of everything you see or sense, a vital part of the world I call DragonFable. Slay the Togs and Ninjas to earn the information you will want to have. Gain knowledge of the Elemental Orbs, the Draconic Prophecy, and relics of this alternate world! To begin, go to the door with the aquarium.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mechas and Quests
quests.description: It's a good thing you've got mechs AND spaceships, because the you who lived in this past world had to fight an inter-galactic enemy. Slay the Shadowscythe constructs and training globes to learn what you must. And take a look at that mysterious mirror while you're there. To begin, go to the door with the mirror.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: After the Chaos
quests.description: This simulation IS your world… after YOU fail to achieve your destiny. Speak with the fallen Alteon's daughter, Queen Brittany, and see how the rigors of world-wide upheaval have twisted her into a much darker person. Speak with her knights, save Princesses Victoria and Tara, and see what your world faces if you fail! To begin, go to the door with the crown.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Trust is Not Ephemeral
quests.description: If you would have Vaxt Ahas' trust you, you will need to earn it. Kill 9 Ephemerites crawling over it. These Void mites burrow into his hide to breed, causing endless annoyance! (You wouldn't be able to bite mites if your tail were in YOUR mouth.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' After the Chaos ' quest.

quests.name: In a Split Exasecond
quests.description: Prove your worth to Vaxt Ahas: The Time Travel Fairies stole Vaxt Ahas' Exa-glasses. Return with 4 Exa-glasses, 8 drops of Fairy Plasma, and 12 Fallen Fairy Wings. Get them back and it will be closer to trusting you… and teaching you what you need to know.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Time to Prove Yourself
quests.description: The Unending One is pleased, but you are not finished. Return with 4 Vials of Fairy Plasma and 4 piles of Ephemerite Dust; the pests still plague him. Then collect 12 of the scales he has shed for you to prove you belong here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fill the Empty Hours
quests.description: Although you recovered Vaxt Ahas' exaglasses, the Time Travel Fairies also stole the sand! Kill Void Phoenixes and Fairies to collect Dried Phoenix tears and Fairy Wings. These will mix with the stardust to form the grains inside the Exaglasses.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clock of the Long Now
quests.description: Vaxt Ahas' cannot help those it does not recognize as its own. Prove to it that you belong in this realm, and it will finally agree to help you. Unlock each of the hours on Vaxt's eye by turning 1 of the Exaglasses.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unending Avatar
quests.description: To see what you must see to know what it is you need to know, become one with Vaxt Ahas. Battle the Unending Avatar - exchange blows and blood - and then, only then, will you be able to view the Beginning.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rescue the Innocent
quests.description: Conflicts do not only affect warriors; innocents often suffer at the hands of those who would harm you. The sister of your ally has been kidnapped by the Void Dragons of Dragonspine Mountain. Slay 3 of them and she will, I hope, be returned to safety.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Maintain Elemental Strength ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Board the Ship to Your Future
quests.description: If you're going to navigate space, you'll need a suitable transportation device. It is likely you'll find one on the Dropship Shuttle. Talk to Golem Worsh for more information about what the ship is used for, and locate your Rocket-fueled Transportation Device!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The 2nd Proto-Chaos Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Heal the Chaos Lord
quests.description: Iadoa's will and resistance shattered when the Chaorruption successfully finished infecting him. He anticipated this, linking some of his power to the shards you will collect. Bring back 3 of Iadoa's Mind Fragments.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The 2nd Proto-Chaos Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadowscythe Detection Beacons
quests.description: The ShadowScythe aliens are the most feared creatures in the MechQuest timeline. They ravage entire galaxies. Place 5 detection beacons, 1 on each portal you encounter, to protect your home from them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The 2nd Proto-Chaos Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Waits and Watches
quests.description: Always watching, never sleeping, Kathool's Chaotic Merdraconian attendants guard his deep, dark domain. Slay 8 of them before they report your presence to the Beast!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The 3rd Proto-Chaos Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Lure of Chaosanity
quests.description: Luring any who possess the seed of Chaorruption inside them, the Chaos Anglers lead the unwary closer and closer towards Kathool's tentacles. Slay 7 to protect any future travelers from drowning in misery.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The 3rd Proto-Chaos Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Music of Nightmares
quests.description: Prevent Kathool's Tube Organ Worms from piping their haunting songs throughout the ocean. Save the sailors from drowning by collecting 3 Nightmare Pipes!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The 3rd Proto-Chaos Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Beast Kathool
quests.description: You cannot resist! This battle has been foretold since the Lore was reborn. You MUST fight the Kraken, or your destiny will never be realized. Kathool has a tentacle in every age; he rises and falls with the tides of time.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The 3rd Proto-Chaos Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Starry, Starry Night
quests.description: Those who love are bound to lose, and the stars watch all who weep. Slay the Astral Ephermites to lead you along a trail of stars to the heart of spacetime, where the Chronomancer waits in the Metafold.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The 3rd Proto-Chaos Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Quest title is a direct reference to Vincent by Don McLean .

quests.name: Chaos Lord Iadoa
quests.description: The time has come to face the Chronomancer, but he asks that you fight the creature waiting in his stead. With all he has done for you, do not question his motives now. Battle what waits for you, Hero; your future depends on it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The 3rd Proto-Chaos Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Kathool
quests.description: Isolated pockets of spacetime may develop at random, and contain unknown dangers. This one allows you to go back in time and battle Ultra Chaos Beast Kathool. He is much stronger in this spacetime. Bring a full party, equip your potions, and Battle On!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chaos Lord Iadoa ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Iadoa
quests.description: Isolated pockets of spacetime may develop at random, and contain unknown dangers. This one allows you to go back in time and battle Ultra Chronomancer Iadoa. He is much stronger in this spacetime. Bring a full party, equip your potions, and Battle On!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

items.name: Master of Time Character Page Badge

quests.name: Don't Chicken Out!
quests.description: To fully understand the ChickenCow, we must understand both of its parts. Our bovine bestiary is almost complete, so we need to study some chickens. I've heard of three rare breeds- Red and Sabertoothed at the /Meateortown and Chaos chickens from /DFLesson- that could be good subjects. They may have found some Freggments, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Right Under Your Nose ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Ashville Hot
quests.description: The next Freggment reading is coming from the Dragonslayer camp at /Ashfallcamp - and we've gotten a distress call from Senna! It seems like she's developed an amazing new recipe for ChickenCow, but the local dragons attacked and tore it to pieces. The Freggments are located near the dragon's domains, too. Perhaps you'll get a free lunch if you slay them?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Right Under Your Nose ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Holy (Chicken)Cow!
quests.description: Did you know that some of the ancient Dwakels used to worship the ChickenCow? One of their deities, Cluckmoo, was the ancient guardian spirit of ranchers. Those old Dwakel are no more, but there are plenty of Freggments scattered throughout the /crashruins for truly unlucky explorers to find. Investigate the Idol of Cluckmoo as well - there's a large surge of Breakfast Energy near its chamber.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Right Under Your Nose ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chilling Tales of Chicken Cows
quests.description: A friend of Cysero's came to me with some interesting news. Apparently, a creature that smelled of meat attacked his brother in Guwio Village! He believes it is a special kind of ChickenCow that only emerges when it is twenty-five degrees below zero outside. I don't know if that's true, but there are definitely Freggments to be found in the Northlands.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Right Under Your Nose ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cowissa
quests.description: You're doing quite well, Hero. There's only one Freggment left I've been able to locate- at the far end of Lore, in the small kingdom of Astravia. Be on your guard, Hero- I'm detecting more surges of otherworldly energy there than just our target. There are rumors that at times, The Moon itself descends to walk the city streets…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Right Under Your Nose ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Little Light...
quests.description: The Titanic Paladins may have been corrupted by Drakath's Tincture, but not everything has changed within them. The original essence of the brave and noble Paladins who were mutated into those monstrosities is still trapped inside those hulks of flesh and armor. The light buried within would be a perfect ingredient for the potion. Set their souls free, and bring some of the essence back for me to use.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Titanic Terror Times Two ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Dose of Darkness...
quests.description: Where there is light, there must also be darkness, and with every Paladin, there is a DoomKnight to meet them on the battlefield. The DoomKnights, too, retain their essence even after their transformation. Umoving, dangerous and malicious… but also loyal and determined. Exactly what we need. Bring me the leftover energy from the Titanic Doomknights so I may merge it with our mixture.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Titanic Terror Times Two ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: And A Cup of Chaos
quests.description: Those Titanic Destroyers are Drakath's first and finest creations. His most loyal followers, who willingly submitted themselves to the Titan's Tincture, were rewarded with much higher doses than the average Titan. We'll need samples of their diluted chaos energy to use in our own solution. No member of the Anti-Titan Corps has ever survived an encounter with one. Let's hope you fare better!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Titanic Terror Times Two ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Topple some Titans!
quests.description: I'm almost finished with our own version of the Titanic Tincture, Hero, but we have one more problem to deal with first. Drakath has ordered the rest of the Titans to charge at the town in an all-out assault! If they breach the walls, the battle- and our progress - may as well be for naught. You must hold them off as long as possible while I complete the potion!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Titanic Terror Times Two ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tapping Into the Arcane
quests.description: The first step to mastering the magical arts is becoming attuned to the world of the Arcane. For this lesson, you will need to bring me several reagents.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 60.

quests.name: Aethereal Flow
quests.description: Your second lesson is about understanding the flow of mana throughout all beings and life. Understand some of the most magically bound beings, and their flow of mana.

quests.name: Tracing Ley Lines
quests.description: The next lesson is about understanding the flow of mana across Lore, and where it's densest. Understanding can be the first key to utilizing this dormant power. Visit the most magically dense sites on Lore.

quests.name: Thaumaturgy
quests.description: Next, you must understand how to connect the flow of power between different mediums. This will be the key to translating power between different forms, and your introduction to the different schools of magic. Observe the exchange of mana in powerful forms and use its teachings to create your first tome out of your reagents.

quests.name: Book of Magus: Incantation
quests.description: The school of Magus focuses on manipulation of phenomena to your will. In order to skew a natural force to act in your favor, you must exert an opposing force through mana. Learn about the ebb and flow of the world.

quests.name: Book of Fire: Immolation
quests.description: The school of Fire focuses on… well, fire. However, fire exists as much more than just a flame- it is the spark of life, the fuel of passion and desire, and the core of the living world. Fire is both the catalysis of form of being, and the all-consuming storm of the end. Learn about the forces behind the fire.

quests.name: Book of Ice: Glacial Impact
quests.description: As you may have guessed, the school of Ice focuses on ice. Like fire, ice exists in more forms than just frost. Ice is the body of the endless expanse of the cosmos and the essence of the glacial temporal flow. It controls the ever present yet constantly shifting form that life takes on. Learn about the forces behind ice.

quests.name: Book of Aether: Supernova
quests.description: The school of Aether focuses on the flow of the metaphysical world and its intersections across the physical one. The Aether exists as the universal flow of all collective conscience which directs phenomena. Learn about outside forces that act within our world.

quests.name: Book of Arcana: Arcane Sigil
quests.description: The school of Arcana focuses on the exertion of one's inner flow. It can be the impetuous force that moves the physical world, or the dividing force that separates them from it. Learn how the strongest beings impose their reality upon the world.

quests.name: Archmage's Ascension
quests.description: The limited lessons that we've had will have to serve as the basis of your spells. My last and final lesson to you will be one of holism and paradigm. The combination of all the aspects of magic that you've learned is not one of technique, but perspective. The final stage of power is achieved through unbending will, relentless effort, and the understanding of our place in the greater universe.

items.name: Master of Mana Character Page Badge

quests.name: Lumina Elementi
quests.description: Now that you’ve mastered the magical arts, I can offer you one service- to enchant your robes to grant you increased power. For this, I will need some rather rare components.

quests.name: Lost Connections
quests.description: Elementals are an elusive sort. In the current age, the most interaction one can expect is a…violent altercation. This was not always the case. At one time, Champions acted as intermediaries between the Elemental Planes and Lore. After the Avatars distanced themselves, communications ceased. That seems to be changing. Head to /dragonplane and interact with the Elementals. I will come with you.

quests.name: Restricted Potential
quests.description: Tara being the Champion of Mana has opened avenues of magical research that were once too dangerous to consider. In the safety of the Temple, under the protection of my barrier, I have offered to help her with her magic studies. The results are blindly walking around my workshop. Would you please capture them before they wander outside? Tara was very upset when they manifested during a practice session.

quests.name: PTA Meeting
quests.description: Orient yourself with the tomb's exterior by finding Professor Neveya and Professor Maedoc. They should be nearby securing the area.

quests.name: Bear Essentials
quests.description: Noble bears known as the Auberon roam the tomb's grounds with purpose. They shouldn't be aggressive towards those who intend no harm, but something seems to be agitating them. Please ward them away from the tomb so they won't interrupt our search.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Still Peace
quests.description: Kriomein invited the spirits to fight over the right to use Glace as a Vessel. An entity calling itself Fimbul took control, and a deadly frost is spreading from the tomb. See how it is affecting the creatures nearby. We could learn more about Fimbul this way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Academic Probation ' quest.

quests.name: Sister Statues
quests.description: Tara ran ahead. I'm glad she's still excited by the spark of adventure. It looks like she struck up a conversation with a familiar face in the city square. Why don't you join them, and learn about the Yew Mountain Chain?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tell-Tale Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Starstruck Chivalry
quests.description: Geopetal said that House Noelle's Knights - or perhaps I should be calling them House Rivale's - are eager to meet and spar with you. Tara is quite fond of Lady Song. She wants to see if her Knights are skilled enough to protect their liege.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tell-Tale Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Black Dahlia
quests.description: Hm, I'm a little curious about the northern gate. There are a number of sculptures there you might find interesting as well. While you're taking a look at the placards…allow that woman in the green dress to bother you. I sense something…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tell-Tale Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Talls and Stouts
quests.description: I'd like to get a better look at that obsidian monolith. Forgive me for slowing us down. While I'm there, why don't you and Tara entertain the Drow Soldiers and Dwarven Aegis with a spar? They seem jealous of the knights that received special treatment.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tell-Tale Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Lost Matchstick
quests.description: A messenger dropped by. The Knights are requesting aid for Lady Song at the west gate. One of her guards had to be sent to…the House of Ash. He had an important key that they're unable to retrieve on their own. Talk to Song…and retrieve the key from the Maleno Match.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tell-Tale Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Flash Fire
quests.description: Smoke and fire are flooding into Thelima, and I sense a terrifying presence approaching the north gate. We must evacuate the civilians before it arrives! Find them before the flames do!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tell-Tale Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unio Naturalis
quests.description: These dark flames are taking the shape of Elementals. Has Maleno come alive…or is the fire of that beast from the story regaining sentience? We won't be able to destroy them completely, but we can at the very least force them to disperse.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tell-Tale Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Friend's Distant Laugh
quests.description: The guards that were stationed at the north gate have caught fire…There's no way to save them. All we can do is retrieve the gate's key from one of them, and confront the monster that did this.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tell-Tale Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Putrefaction
quests.description: The north gate is open. I believe that this is a moment where neither of us can hold back. We must force the Maleno Elementals and the Maleno Matches they created away from Thelima.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tell-Tale Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Enatiodromia
quests.description: There. The source. Waiting at the gates to Mount Maleno is the source of its fire. The Flame of Maleno must be destroyed. My spells will do little to harm it, so I must rely on your blade again. If it is within my power, I will defend you with my magic.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tell-Tale Heart ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Iron Blooded
quests.description: Thelima is reeling from the sudden spread of flame. We must gather the Elementals, Matches, and any traces of the Maleno Flame that still linger. Please allow me and Tara to support you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Enatiodromia ' quest.

quests.name: Iron Blooded (Legend)
quests.description: Thelima is reeling from the sudden spread of flame. We must gather the Elementals, Matches, and any traces of the Maleno Flame that still linger. Please allow me and Tara to support you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Enatiodromia ' quest.

quests.name: Chaos Reigned
quests.description: Chaos is treated like a bad memory, but we need to stay on our guard. Lord Vaughn of Chiral Valley was forced to stand by when Escherion invaded, but now he's allowed to be proactive. He needs the Eldritch Stalkers and Terrasites of /DeepForest eliminated.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 70.

quests.name: Fireproofing
quests.description: Lady Reignolds of Swordhaven's noble court is also its agricultural advisor. She works tirelessly to prevent blight and famine. I hear she's looking for a way to fireproof crops. Take flames from the remaining Shadefire Onslaught in /FirePlaneWar. If her seeds can withstand their fire, they can take anything.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 70. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fishy-men Business
quests.description: Lady Noelle of the Yew Mountain Chain was welcomed back home by the Queen. I'm unsure of what to think of this. I hear she's operating in /Ashray. Would you mind investigating the Sharkbait and Fishermen there?
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 70. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Baleful Morals
quests.description: Lord Granville, the Protector of the Sea of Trees, manages the Alteon family's summer castle - /Balemorale. I hear the Lightguard and Noble Knights are misbehaving. Sort them out so that old war dog has less to worry about.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 70. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nainhdeil
quests.description: My liege has ordered the return of Lord Taylor, which is heartening news. I hear he was living in Skye. That place has history with Greenguard…Would you lay that to rest by exorcising the Undead Gardes and Garde Wraiths at /LiaTaraHill?
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 70. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Oxford Degree in Beatdowns
quests.description: I'm starting to get jealous of all the people who get to fight you. How about we step into the next room and have a spar? I have to warn you that despite letting Battleon's adventurers take the spotlight, I've fought in every war this town has ever faced.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 70. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Icewing Grunt!
quests.description: While you test your mettle against my army, they will also be testing themselves against you! Fight your way through the arena and battle my Icewing Grunts. Let us see who emerges victorious!

quests.name: Icewing Warrior!
quests.description: Are you ready for more? Fight your way to my Icewing Warriors. They are more seasoned than the grunts are… but perhaps you are even stronger!

quests.name: Icewing Elite!
quests.description: My Icewing Elite will not be so easily defeated! Battle him and show me your strength… if you can survive the icy monsters that stand in your path!

quests.name: Icewing General!
quests.description: Are you strong enough to face the General of my Icewing Raiders? Fight the monsters that stand between you and your victory… or defeat.

quests.name: WarSeeker Pet Quest
quests.description: Celebrate another year of dark victories for Dage the Evil by crossing swords with his strongest Blade Masters in the Underworld Arena (/legionarena). Please him, and he reward you with a character page badge and will assign guards to defend your house.
quests.requirements_note: Must have either WarSeeker's Skull Pet (AC) or WarSeeker's Skull Pet (Special) in your inventory.

quests.name: Water Endurance
quests.description: Wait… you're still here? You weren't scared off by my dire and ominous warning of eternal torment? Hmmm… you know, you may just be the person I need to help break this terrible curse. But I need to be sure. The fiendish Water Elemental who guards this level employs many beautiful but deadly Sirens to help him in his task. If you could slay twenty-five of them and return to me with their essences, I will have proof of your strength and will unlock the room which contains my watery tormentor. ( Bring back twenty-five Watery Essences to complete this quest.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Fire Thief Ghost's Quests .

quests.name: Liquid Soul
quests.description: I fear that I will not forget those final moments, as the Ice Elemental stood over me and cursed my soul for all eternity. As my vision grew dim, the last thing I saw was the bright glow emanating from a bracelet on his wrist. If you could bring this bracelet to me, I do believe that I can use its arcane power to the lift the curse and free myself from this accursed dungeon. (Bring back the Water Bracelet to complete this quest.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Fire Thief Ghost's Quests . | Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Gather the Spirits
quests.description: My Prince is responsible for maintaining the Celestial Herds. But we spent so much time gazing into each others' eyes that the herd wandered. Subdue the Roosterbull Spirits and gather in the Chickcalf Spirits so we may be together.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Seventh Wish ' quest. Note: These quests are unavailable after completing the final quest.

quests.name: Spiders and Dreamsilk
quests.description: My father set me the task of weaving cloth for the celestial handmaidens, but - I admit - I was too distracted by my Prince. There are spiders I use to help me when I fall behind schedule. If you capture them, we will be able to weave the dreamsilk I need.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Seventh Wish ' quest. Note: These quests are unavailable after completing the final quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dye-ing to Reunite
quests.description: The last thing I need is dye, to color the ceremonial kimono. I harvest the dye from fallen stars. And this night, they are in abundance!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Seventh Wish ' quest. Note: These quests are unavailable after completing the final quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slay Uji No Hashihime
quests.description: Uji No Hashihime used to be a woman who was scorned by her husband. She would do anything to prevent others from finding the love she's lost. Stop her from disrupting the ceremony!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Seventh Wish ' quest. Note: These quests are unavailable after completing the final quest. | Must have completed the ' 1,000 Cranes to 1,000 Wishes ' quest.

quests.name: Wells' Embargo
quests.description: I can't in good conscience condone allowing airships to dock on the Hover-base OR financing the Hover-base's next year of operation when there are Sky Pirate squadrons and those vile OctoSpies hanging about its decks. Do away with 7 Draconian Skypirates and 3 SteamOcto's before I'll part with any of the Exchequer's gold.

quests.name: Fullmetal Financier
quests.description: I'm addle-brained when it comes to alchemy, but when it comes to financial matters, I'm the Skyguard's golden boy. The recruits, they mock me. I know revenge is less than refined, but I'd really like to show them up ! Bring me golden nuggets from Guru Chests and Golden Draconians so I can find someone to craft me an armor all of gold.

quests.name: Fire and Ice
quests.description: Those dragons have really wreaked havoc on our village! The red dragons have set everything on fire, and the ice dragons have froze it all up! Head on down into town, all th' way east. Put out any fires that ya find, and thaw out any critters that are still frozen.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Talk to the Villager ' quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once per login.

quests.name: Round 'em Up
quests.description: Now that the fires are out and the ice is thawed, would ya mind rustlin' up the livestock that have gotten loose? Just smack 'em a few times 'til they calm down, and we'll get 'em back in their pens.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get Rockin'
quests.description: One last thing - in case you haven't noticed, all our homes have been smashed to bits! We'll need to build a sturdy temporary shelter we can stay in until the fighting stops. We just need some strong rock, and some sticky mud. You see those elementals down to the east? You can get it all from them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stop Fightin'
quests.description: Alright, you can tell those Drakel at the gate that we'll back off for now - but they've got to find a way to stop this fighting!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: The Sabbatia
quests.description: One of the marsh plants mentioned by Bal Gravestorm is the Sabbatia. According to my apothecary, it is a small plant with pinkish flowers. The spiders that have appeared seem to be oddly drawn to these flowers. Please bring back 20 specimens for us to study.

quests.name: Grasses
quests.description: There was a wolf spotted wandering from one patch of grass to another. Sometimes he stopped, and other times he seemed to be looking for something that wasn't there. Please gather 20 patches of marshgrass so that we can determine if there are any differences in them.

quests.name: The Spiders have changed...
quests.description: The spiders themselves have been changed by Chaos. We need to study how they may have been affected. Bring back 15 spiders so that we may examine them more closely.

quests.name: Things that go Bump in the Night
quests.description: There has been horrible growling heard from deep within the marsh. Has the Chaos come to life? Or has it brought something out of hiding that was best left undisturbed? Please go to the end of the Marsh - if you survive, bring me back the best description of the creature as you can.

quests.name: Wheel of Bacon
quests.description: Yay! You helped the Bacon Cat Force beat up that nasty Laser Shark Brigade, so now you deserve access to… our secret TREASURE ROOM! Also known as: the Wheel of Bacon! Spin it and see what you get! BUT FIRST! You'll need to deposit some tokens. Yes, Ziri's Wheel of Bacon takes tokens. It's a work in progress, ok? The Sharkies stole them all, so you'll have to steal some back. Any of the sharks in here might have them, but that nasty boss shark DEFITINELY does.

quests.name: Wheel of Love
quests.description: I'd love to just GIVE you all the prizes, but I am contractually bound by Grimskull Productions to say that, if you want any more gear, you'll need to complete this quest. Slay Undead Cherubs to get Unlove Darts. Turn in 13 for a chance to get a prize!

quests.name: The First Crumb
quests.description: He looked for a Hollowborn brother who slipped out of the Shadow Fiend's grasp, and returned to Death. Could this brother have joined in the indignity of those forced to guard a castle of bones? Find him, and find a piece of me.

quests.name: Return to Lifeblood
quests.description: If the brother was not among bones, perhaps he was drowning in blood. Vampires, in the face of eternity, are a young breed. They cling to aesthetics, and love using skulls as goblets. Find a Vampire that is named after his own food in the den of his nemesis, and retrieve a piece of me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nohairatu
quests.description: Piranhas are more civil to each other than Noble Vampires. The Hollowborn brother was in the hands of one of those night creatures, and stolen by another. Sanguine joked that the Vampiric thief was trying to resurrect their hair. Find this Vampire, and return with a piece of me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bony Hodgepodge
quests.description: Stolen bones disappear and lose their names. The Hollowborn brother was mistaken for a tool, and whisked away. Perhaps he was thrown into a conglomerate terror of bones under Battleon, right under our noses. Find this terror, and find another piece of me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Red Risk
quests.description: Where shadows were on the rise, my charge and I searched for an infernal menace. Some said it had the power to steal the Hollowborn brother, and keep him for its own. This was where a story was about to end. Find this menace, and bring back another piece of me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Knuckle Levity
quests.description: Could Dage the Evil need this Hollowborn brother? It was more likely that someone, or something, weaker than him committed the thievery instead. Look for a man connected to the Legion, who gallops, and spites freshwater, but thrives in the salty sea. Retrieve from them another piece of me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Grudge Ghost
quests.description: Dage the Evil is a member of a Dark Alliance of Evil, and many Hollowborn were loyal to him. Perhaps their power inspired jealousy from fiends in name and character only. This fiend lurks under the Alliance, and stole pieces of me. Find and return them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Inverted Expectation
quests.description: The Hollowborn brother was not found with the Undead. The Legionnaires instead pointed towards tombs where the sleeping dead tend to gather. My charge decided to investigate the photonegative guardians of the dead in an ethereal tomb. Find them, and find one more piece of me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Die Angry
quests.description: The final piece of me waits where my charge made a mistake. He looked for a Dragon, but trailed after one that was mired in death and rage. Near water, they sought the kind of immortality the Hollowborn are believed to have. Look in their bones, and complete me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Treasure Death
quests.description: You have completed me under the gaze of my charge's brethren, tracing his footsteps as he searched for his treasure. Find him in the lair of the Dragon that embodies selfish desire for meaningless wealth. The walls behind its gold nest will open for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kick Some Can
quests.description: First, I want to get a sense of how strong you truly are. There are some Warriors and Assassins roaming Aegis. I want you to find them and honorably challenge them to a duel. Show me how many you can defeat in a battle in order to prove your strength to me.

quests.name: Smashing!
quests.description: If you want to be a stronger Hero, you care are going to need to work on using your weapon with as much force as possible. The Gemstones here are some of the hardest throughout Lore. Find them, and hit them as hard as you can! There are Sunstones, Moonstones, and Star Sapphires. Bring me 4 of each as proof of your progress!

quests.name: Now You're A Pro
quests.description: Here's the real test of your skills! Travel to /bludrutbrawl and defeat any enemies you see! Bring back 50 Combat Trophies to prove that you were able to prevail.

quests.name: Test 1: Proving Ground
quests.description: I can't believe you've reached this point. You're so close to your Mark of Mastery… there are just a few tests left. And the first is to pass through the Shifting Planes Cavern, slaying 13 of any monster plus 13 Dark Makai specifically.

quests.name: Test 2: Nulgath's Disdain
quests.description: Are they… laughing at you? The spies, look at them. They're mocking you. The next test is to command respect, and there's only one way to do that. With VIOLENCE.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Test 3: Bonesaw Break
quests.description: This 3rd test sounds ominous: The Glowing Skull is the key. Get the Ultra Dark Mystery Stone Of Evil Animosity from the monsters in the Bonesaw Prison Cave fromany of the Dark Makai. I don't like the sound of that, but it DOES say the Mystery Stone will aid you. Still. You're on your own for this one!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

items.name: Ultra Dark Mystery Stone Of Evil Animosity

quests.name: Test 4: Dark Battleground
quests.description: We've come this far. I'm not leaving your side now! But… you should really get into the fortress quickly. Something tells me Nulgath's inside, waiting for you. According to the scroll, you'll need to slay 13 of his guards to enter.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Test 5: Shadows Within Shadows
quests.description: Hunh. To master the shadows, you must be able to merge them. Good thing you kept that "Ultra Dark Mystery Stone of Evil Animosity." You'll need to combine it with the Dark Elemental's "Darker Shadow Gem of Tenebrous Tenebration."
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

items_required.name: Ultra Dark Mystery Stone Of Evil Animosity
Darker Shadow Gem of Tenebrous Tenebration

quests.name: Test 6: Runed Fiends
quests.description: To enter Nulgath's Fortress, you must find the Rune Scroll and the… Fiend Scroll? This test seems meaningless. Unless he's just trying to wear you down. That makes sense. Says the scrolls must be taken from the monsters outside the fortress. How helpful.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Treasure that You Seek
quests.description: We've got to explore this prehistoric world but finding fossils can't be our aim. Not when we've got to get that Vigillete! It'd be a good idea to clear all those trees, Hero to make a path. For that, you'll need a axe. The armor from those dinos would make a good blade! Bring back 10 sharp armor segments!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Catapult Climb ' quest.

quests.name: These Trees
quests.description: It's a good thing these trees don't have houses at the top of them. It'd make cutting them down a LOT harder. I count 11 you're going to need to chop down before we can make a clear path to the top of the mountain and knowing your luck, thats exactly where the Vigilette is hidden!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ewwww... Totally Gross
quests.description: You're going to have to Hero-up and get ready to give it your all, because i think we're going to need… Dino-spit. Yeah. I know. It's gross. But I've got a cup for you, and a stick to scrape with. You'll just need to kill 8 'saurs and collect their spit.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Eggs, Exciting and New
quests.description: I usually do what I'm told, Hero, but I think you're going to have to trap the Mother TerrorDOOMKill by placing that sticky goo on her eggs. No cutting corners, either. You've GOT to put her at a disadvantage. We NEED to search her nest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Someday (Today) Their Mother Will Die
quests.description: Today's the day you're going to have to kill the mother TerrorDOOMKill. We NEED the Vigilette hiding in her nest. Don't think about her babies, Hero, or that she'll never again see the wings of her offspring making windmills as they try to fly. Just take her down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dino Destroyer
quests.description: All of the dinosaurs are going to extinct eventually. You might as well help them on their way. Take out 100 Dinosaurs and you'll be the Prince of Prehistory!

quests.name: More Aliens Than You Can Handle?
quests.description: It's imperative that we find the Vigilette pieces, Hero! But it looks like we've got a company AND we're under surveillance by those Shadow-Eyes. Take a pistol from one of those aliens buggers so we can shoot out the Spy-Eyes!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Someday (Today) Their Mother Will Die ' quest.

quests.name: Spy Eyes
quests.description: They see you from their spy-eyes, Hero. They see you walking on the ground. They see you killing minions. And they see you hunting for Vigilette pieces! Use the alien pistol to smash those Shadow Spy-Eyes!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Smashed to Pieces
quests.description: The Collector is in love with his broken Vigilette. It's been crushed, crashed and smashed to pieces. We've got to find the bits before The Collector does or he'll take over our lives. Again!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Tired of My Vigilette Dreams
quests.description: I looked around and John looked around, and now you're here to lead us all in one last sweep of this alien planet. We need to find 5 small fragments and 5 medium fragments; they're the last pieces of the Vigilette and I'm sure that the red-eyed aliens have them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: You're Not the Boss of Me Now
quests.description: The Collector may think he owns us, but you need to show him that we're NOT his playthings. He's not the boss of you now… but he IS pretty big. But you can take him down and knock him out, Hero!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Alien Annihilator
quests.description: Kill 100 aliens before they send you out of this world!

quests.name: Get me that Recipe!
quests.description: Alright, listen up: you want to know more about J6, and I want to know more about Yulgar's Famous Raspberry Smoothies. He is probably hiding the first half somewhere in his Cellar and check through the trash here for the second half of the recipe. Once you search high and low and find both parts of Yulgar's Secret Recipe, bring them back here and I'll let you in on what I know about J6… to the best of my knowledge, that is.

quests.name: A-MAZE-ing Race
quests.description: Welcome to William's Hedge Maze, I grew it myself! I've hidden 5 small pots of gold in this hedge maze! If you can find all 5, … and find your way out again, you'll win some Golden Tickets!

quests.name: Can you do it?
quests.description: Thank you for your kind offer to help us with this mystery. I need to know that I am entrusting the fate of my community into the hands of a competent person. To prove yourself to me, go forth and battle the frogdrakes and giant mosquitoes that are in the area. Bring me back 5 Frogdrake's Feet and 5 Mosquito Wings. Once you have completed this quest, the Church Seal will give you full authority to investigate these strange happenings.

quests.name: Backyard Zards
quests.description: G'day Mate! Say, you must be the bloke they sent to help us with our little problem. I'd love to help you, but I've got a problem of my own to worry about. My brother was here last week, and he left a bunch of his pets - Zards, he calls them, - loose in my backyard! The dang things are eating me out of house and home! If you could get rid of them for me, I'm sure I could remember something that could help you…

quests.name: Attic Spiders
quests.description: Thank goodness your here! Whatever has been attacking our town… I think it's in my attic! Listen, can't you hear them scuttling around up there? You're the hero, why don't you go up there and take care of it for me?

quests.name: Storage Speyeders
quests.description: Oh. Well, um. Hi. I have the same kind of problems as my neighbors. I really do. Can you go kill some spiders in my storage area? I need, oh, proof that you've killed at least 5. Thanks.

quests.name: Garden Snails
quests.description: Howdy, stranger! I bet you're here to investigate the attacks on our town. We're happy to help you out… but first, how about giving us a hand? We've got some giant snails out back wrecking the garden, and you look like just the right person to get rid of them. If you can, I'll be glad to tell you everything I know about what's happening around here…

quests.name: Tempestuous Times
quests.description: The Farmers are having a meeting. They plan to attack the Drakel Dwarves in the morning. Although, with the information you gave me I don't think the Dwakels have anything to do with it. Please - keep looking. I fear you are the only one who can avert this oncoming battle. Take this map of the Woods and expand your investigation. The answer may be found outside of town…

quests.name: The Bone?
quests.description: A… werewolf? A giant werewolf? My goodness, what could this mean? Please… go look for him again, if you can retrieve some fur, perhaps we will be able to cure this unfortunate individual in the future.

quests.name: Mystery Willow
quests.description: Saints be praised, our prayers have been answered at last! Welcome to Willow Creek my child. We are in dire need of assistance from a hero such as you. A mysterious evil has recently befallen our poor town. Every night, some strange beast descends upon our town, slaughters our livestock, and lays waste to our fields. Please, if you would, talk with the local farmers. Surely one of them must know something that can help you find this terrible evil.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Garden Snails' quest.

quests.name: Darkblood Life's Blood
quests.description: My People are dying in our own streets. I must look to providing for those that remain alive. Lionfang's troops have raided our stores and our homes and taken most of our food. Go out and retake our rations from these… things and make sure they do not get up.

quests.name: Make a Wish
quests.description: Wishes are important. They are expressions of your hopes, dreams, and goals. Get a coin from the Wishing Shop and "toss it in"… that is, turn it in here to make a wish and receive a few words of encouragement to take with you into battle each day!

quests.name: Use the Wishing Well
quests.description: Have you found a lucky coin? Why not toss it in and see what comes out?

quests.name: Needle in a Cedar Stack
quests.description: I suppose you'll want to get out of this cage first, won't you? Unfortunately, it's locked - but I saw one of the scientists drop a paperclip in here not long ago. If you can find it, you can use it to pick the lock and escape. It's somewhere in the cedar bedding.

quests.name: Pick the Lock
quests.description: Now, you can take the paperclip and use it to pick the lock. The cage door is just over there!

quests.name: Contain the Infection
quests.description: Oh no! Looks like some of the lab rodents have escaped, and became infected. I hate to say it, but we'll have to put them down so they can't spread it any further.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gather the Reagents
quests.description: The only way to destroy the slime mold is to burn it. We'll have to scavenge the lab - we'll need all the matches you can find, and some kind of flammable liquid. There's a chlorine trifluoride spill over in the corner - look for a yellow-green puddle. That's the most flammable chemical we have in the lab, so bring some of that back, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Flame On!
quests.description: Burn down as much of the slime mold as you can find! Torch the stuff on the walls! Beat up the wandering globs, and then set them on fire!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

items_required.name: Burn the Stuff on the Door!

quests.name: Open the Cages!
quests.description: In the hallway you've just opened up, you'll find the rest of the caged animals. The keys to their cages are still here - probably hidden in those engorged slime molds. Tear them apart until you've fond all the keys, then use them to open the cages.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get Rid of the Blockage!
quests.description: To reach the source of the blue mold, we're going to have to get down to the basement. The fastest way down there is through a hole we rodents chewed in one of the cages, long ago. Unfortunately, the occupant of that cage has succumbed to the infection, and it's currently blocking our path.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Keep on Going
quests.description: I know I had chewed a hole in this room when I escaped before, but the mold seems to be covering it. Burn it down until you find it, then follow it down into the basement.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find the Source
quests.description: Oh, my! It's even worse down here! You'll have to destroy those mutated slime molds - as many as you can! We have to keep this from spreading any further! And explore the basement while you do. See if you can find where the mold is original form.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find the Key
quests.description: That storage room is covered in mold, but that's a problem for later. The problem for NOW is that it's also locked. One of those mold-covered scientists you found must have the key!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clear More Mold
quests.description: Now, all we need to do is burn the mold covering the storage room door - and then, use the key we found to unlock it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the Escapee!
quests.description: The escaped experiment - it's here! You must defeat it quickly, or we'll never make it out of here alive!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nax-ty Beasts
quests.description: These Nax Beasts were created by Kolyaban from some of the local wildlife. If there is anything I know about those that are Reshapen, is that they are beyond saving. Take them out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Light Orb, Part II ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Children of the Night
quests.description: Just you being here has quelled the infighting between the Vampires and Lycans. If you could show them that we stand a chance against the Queen, perhaps we can muster some reinforcements for you! Go and overturn some fights and I'll ensure you have the reinforcements you need!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Light Orb, Part II ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: We've Woken The Hive
quests.description: It looks like Kolyaban has brought some of her Darkblood children with her. But something is wrong… The Darkblood have still managed to retain their humanity. These things… These are something else. We must stop them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Light Orb, Part II ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ritual Disruption
quests.description: With both races working together, I am confident we can stop Kolyaban! We have one more task before we face her. We must disrupt her ritual by destroying the Runes she has placed in the surrounding area. With them gone, we will be able to break her Ritual Circle. Her minions will try to stop you. Be careful!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Light Orb, Part II ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Darkness Orb
quests.description: Kolyaban has done so much damage. Caused so much pain. It is only fair that we return the favor. Let's take her down, and recover the Darkness Orb she holds!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Light Orb, Part II ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Training Globes
quests.description: Every hero has to start somewhere, and the earlier your training begins, the stronger you'll be in the final battle. Take on 10 of these training globes to see how strong you already are!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Test Potential Traitors ' quest.

quests.name: Take Flight into the Future
quests.description: Every new GEARS student rides with me, and we all like our practical jokes. But this latest crop has stolen a plaque from my console. I won't fly without it! Battle these practical jokers to get my motto back or we'll never land!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Roots of all Evil
quests.description: The forest is alive, evil and trying to eat you! Slay 10 Roots of Evil.

quests.name: Venus Hero Trap
quests.description: Drayko is watching you from above. Before you enter and fight your way up there, defeat Seed Spitters until you gather 6 seeds. Turn the quest in to make a health potion!

quests.name: Bark is worse than its bite
quests.description: You have entered Titan Hollow! But something is strange… you better search for clues. Battle the Evil Plant Horros and Titan Decay to collect 10 clues.

quests.name: Knot what you expected
quests.description: Most of the creatures roaming this dungeon were once heroes… now they want the same to happen to you. defeat 12 Weeping Widowmakers!

quests.name: Cha Cha Cha Chia!
quests.description: Chia Warrior… the Warrior that grows! (TM) Hmmm, I have a great idea for home decoration. Defeat Chia Warriors until you collect 5 Chia Seeds

quests.name: Leaf me alone!
quests.description: They say 'Good things come in Trees!" but I am stumped so… defeat 5 Seed Spitters, 5 Evil Plant Horrors, 5 Titan Decay, and then… we are going to do something dangerous.

quests.name: Evil Faerie Ambush!
quests.description: GAHHH! Evil Tree Fairies! They love curses and are will do anything to stop you from undoing it. Battle them and collect 10 Evil Faerie wings

quests.name: Check the Trunk
quests.description: Vulchurions!? HERE!? They are eating the dying bark on the Titan. Defeat 12 Vulchurions.

quests.name: Committing Tree-son
quests.description: Magic Scrolls made from Tree Titan Bark are extra powerful. Slay monsters and collect 10 magic tree bark to make a spell you can use against Drayko.

quests.name: Heartwood
quests.description: "Have a heart…." literally. One of the monsters stole the Titan's heart. Start breaking some hearts yourself until you find the Titan's Heart! (15% drop chance on Evil Plant Horrors, Vulcherions and Evil Tree Faeries)

quests.name: Drayko BOSS FIGHT!
quests.description: "Come at me Bro."

quests.name: Foilaged again!
quests.description: Drayko pulled a fast one on you… but there's still a way to beat him… if you put your MIND to it! Clear a path to the Titan's brain. Slay 15 Monsters.

quests.name: Mind Games
quests.description: OH NO! Parts of the brain are missing. Anyone with half a mind would know we need to find the missing bits… battle monsters and collect 10 Tree Titan Brain Chunks.

quests.name: DRAGON vs TITAN
quests.description: You are now controlling the giant Tree Titan! (How freaking awesome is that!?) Battle the Dragon and defeat him.

quests.name: Smells like trouble!
quests.description: There is a secret area that you can access by falling *coughs* under the Titan… you might want to hold your nose. Slay 30 Lil' Poots

quests.name: EPIC DROP!
quests.description: It's time for the big one… beware, he is flush with rage. It is going to be one intestin' battle! Defeat the Epic Drop

quests.name: Re-Run Titan Hollow
quests.description: Want a re-match? You can run the Titan Hollow dungeon again with these special bonus quests. But first you will need to construct a Wooden Ring! Defeat 5 Root of Evil monsters.

quests.name: Evil Plant Horrors
quests.description: They used to be adventurers… now they are evil vegetable overlords who are trying to eat you. Slay 6 Evil Plant Horrors.

quests.name: Weeping Widowmakers!
quests.description: Some adventurers like to travel while others like their feet firmly PLANTED in the ground. Defeat 5-ish Weeping Widowmakers.

quests.name: Chia Warriors
quests.description: Chia Warrior… the Warrior that grows! (TM) Hmmm, we really need to pick up a few of these for my house. Defeat 4 or 5 Chia Warriors… maybe 3. How about just 3 this time?

quests.name: Evil Tree Faeries!
quests.description: Evil Tree Faeries are distant relatives of the evil typo faeries who use time travel to make it look like Artix made typos in design notes posts and on social media… they must be stopped! Defeat 5 Evil Tree Faeries.

quests.name: Vulchurions
quests.description: Birds of the feather, attempt to peck you together. Slay 3 Vulchurions. Just three. Good things come in trees.

quests.name: Drayko Battle!
quests.description: "COME AT ME…AGAIN… BRO!"

quests.name: DRAGON vs TITAN Rematch!
quests.description: The main event… DRAGON vs TITAN! The highly anticipated heavyweight world championship match that everyone has been on the edge of their seats to see! Defeat Dakka the Crazy Dragon.

quests.name: BONUS An Inconvinient Tooth
quests.description: A rare GIANT DAKKA FANG fell during the battle. I saw a Chia Warrior pick it up. Battle Chia Warriors until you get the Fang!

quests.name: BONUS Do, do it!
quests.description: Rumor has it that a GIANT DAKKA FANG is somewhere within the horrific brown glob known as Epic Drop.

quests.name: BONUS Fang you very much!
quests.description: A mysterious robed figure offers you a GIANT DAKKA FANG if you bring him the tear of a Weeping Widowmaker. Seems legit. (Member only, 10% drop)

quests.name: Defender Armor (Guardians)
quests.description: As renowned protectors of alternate universes, Defenders understand the sacrifices one must make during combat. Defenders will see to it that what they start always ends in victory.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Classic Defender (2) with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory.

quests.name: Dau Go
quests.description: To perform the ritual, we must construct a wooden sculpture of Mother Dragon herself using wood from the island - you can get the best wood from the Dao Treeants. We'll also need to bring her an offering- the gold and jewels Blazebeard's troops here carry with them, and the clear spring water that the Water Goblins in /burningbeach carry. These would make excellent displays of our determination to bring her forth.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bãi Cháy
quests.description: The offerings are in place for Mother Dragon- but now we need a tribute for the Fire Plane itself. Lava from the creatures on /burningbeach would be an excellent catalyst for the summoning portal - and the golems deep in these caverns produce rare Flame Rubies that the plane's denizens are said to treasure. Bring me these samples, and we can continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sung Sot
quests.description: We have the supplies for the ritual, but there's nothing stopping Blazebeard from interrupting us. As such, the final step in our plan is to have a surprise to draw Blazebeard's attention from the summoning site. Perhaps you could lure him away by taking the storm core? Wrap the core in sharkskin to keep it intact, and I'll begin.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ha Long
quests.description: The summoning is almost complete… but it appears our Pyromancer allies have been forced back. Blazebeard has broken through our defenses and breached the sanctum, just as we expected- and looks quite ready to settle the score with you! Hold him off, so that Mother Dragon may answer our call!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Explore the DragonPlane
quests.description: To free my master you will need to enter the four elemental realms of the DragonPlane. Earth, Water, Air and Fire. Please go explore this part of the DragonPlane and find the portals to each realm, then find the DragonGate. It looks like a huge magic circle at the end of the path. Return to me when you are done.

quests.name: Lots Of Fiber
quests.description: To enter the different elemental realms I will need to prepare some things for you. Please hunt down elementals until you have collected 3 Earth Fibers, 3 Water Fibers, 3 Air Fibers and 3 Fire Fibers from the elementals here in the DragonPlane. Return to me when you have all of them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Carrying The Torches
quests.description: If you tried to enter the element realms without being attuned to that elements magic you would be ripped to shreds. Go place these attuning torches around the area, and it will start to synch your energy. Return to me when you have places them all.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Meet me in the Earth Realm
quests.description: Make your way to the Earth Realm. It is the closest portal to this place. I will meet you inside.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Breaking Chains
quests.description: To shatter the DragonMark you will need something from each of the four Prime Elemental Dragons, but you can't attack them until you weaken their connection to their realm. Go, destroy 5 Earth Elementals and 5 Living Earths. Return here when you are done.

npc.name: Meet me in the Earth Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Earth Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Soil Sprites
quests.description: There are many elemental creatures in these realms and each of them serve a function. Go find 5 Soil Sprites and capture them. They will not be able to restore Moganth's power to him.

npc.name: Meet me in the Earth Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Earth Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cripple The Earth Prime
quests.description: Moganth has sense our presence. We need to cripple his power before he considers us a threat, and I know how we are going to do it. Gather 10 Stone Sigils from the Elementals and living Earths and bring them to me.

npc.name: Meet me in the Earth Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Earth Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ward Of The Stone
quests.description: There, I have created 5 Stone Wards. If you place these in the correct locations around this realm then it will truly stifle Moganth's elemental power. Return once they are in place and I will gauge the energy levels.

npc.name: Meet me in the Earth Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Earth Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Moganth's Dracoscintilla
quests.description: Each of the Prime Elemental Dragons contain Dracoscintilla that we can use to break the DragonMark. Moganth will only drop his if you force him to submit. You MUST battle him. Return if you are able to obtain the Dracoscintilla Terra.
