npc.name: Meet me in the Earth Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Earth Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Meet me in the DragonPlane
quests.description: We are done here but we must consider out next steps carefully. Make your way back to the 11-11-11 portal and I will meet you there.

npc.name: Meet me in the Earth Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Earth Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Getting Your Feet Wet
quests.description: You have already obtained the first Dracoscintilla. Next we should head to the Water Realm and face Udaroth, the Water Prime. Go place the attuning torches around the DragonPlane. Let me know when this is done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the DragonPlane ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Meet me in the Water Realm
quests.description: We are now attuned to the Water Realm. Make your way there and meet back up with me once you are inside.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the DragonPlane ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Weaken The Bonds
quests.description: First we will need to weaken Udaroth as you did Moganth. Destroy 5 Water Elementals and 5 Living Waters. Return here when your task is complete.

npc.name: Meet me in the Water Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Water Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Udaroth Is Ready
quests.description: The Water prime must have sensed what happened to Moganth. She has had her minions set guard runes. Go and collect these runes and bring them to me. I will see what can be done about breaking them.

npc.name: Meet me in the Water Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Water Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Loophole
quests.description: As a Dravix I cannot use my power against any dragons magic directly but there may be a way around that. I can use the Water Prime's own energy to break these runes. Go and bring me 15 Water Souls from the creatures in this realm.

npc.name: Meet me in the Water Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Water Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Flipping The Script
quests.description: There, I have reversed the energy from the guard runes. Now rather than protecting her they will make her more vulnerable. Go place the runes back where you found them. Be precise but be fast.

npc.name: Meet me in the Water Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Water Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Udaroth, The Water Prime
quests.description: The Water Prime's protection spell has inverted. If you are going to face her, now is the time. Defeat Udaroth and bring me her Dracoscintilla Aqua. Be careful, she is stronger than Moganth is.

npc.name: Meet me in the Water Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Water Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Meet me in the DragonPlane
quests.description: You have defeated two of the Great Elemental Prime Dragons, and that is no simple task. Hurry, we must attune you to the next elemental realm! Meet me in the DragonPlane again.

npc.name: Meet me in the Water Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Water Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Up In The Air
quests.description: Every Prime Dragon is unthinkably powerful but in the DragonPlane their power is magnified. Each victory makes our task more difficult. Quickly, place the attuning torches in their places so we can enter the Air Realm!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Meet me in the Air Realm
quests.description: Hurry, the Realm of Air awaits us! Next you must face Cellot, The Air Prime.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Weak Wind
quests.description: Cellot has prepared for us. You will need to defeat even more of her soldiers than you have the other times. Destroy 8 Wind Elementals and 8 Living Airs. Return here when your task is complete.

npc.name: Meet me in the Air Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Air Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: An Ounce Of Prevention
quests.description: I have no doubt that Cellot will be waiting for our strike against her but I have prepared. Although it is unthinkable for me to have done it, I collected some of Moganth's power after his defeat. I can combine it with some gusts to muddy her power. Bring me 5 Gusts of Wind!

npc.name: Meet me in the Air Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Air Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: This Is A Breeze
quests.description: Adding Moganth's power to Cellot's isn't working as well as I hoped. We need to imbalance the elements further. Bring me 6 Air Cores to combine with the earth magic. You can find them on any of Cellot's soldiers.

npc.name: Meet me in the Air Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Air Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chime Time
quests.description: Ah I sense the balance becoming very shaky. Now we need to place the power I took from Moganth in key locations to shatter Cellot's protective wind wall. Place these wind chimes exactly where I tell you too. They will focus the energy at Cellot's weakest points. Let me know when you've finished.

npc.name: Meet me in the Air Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Air Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cellot, The Air Prime
quests.description: Her defenses are down! Quickly, find Cellot at the top of her whirlwind and defeat her if you can. We are so close to freeing Desoloth from his jailers!

npc.name: Meet me in the Air Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Air Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Meet me in the DragonPlane
quests.description: We are so close to freeing my poor master from the Primes. I just hope he has the strength to resist the DragonMark until we are done. Quickly, back to the DragonPlane!

npc.name: Meet me in the Air Realm

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Air Realm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hot Hot Heat
quests.description: Only one Prime left. Place the attuning torches and we will be on our way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the DragonPlane ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Meet me in the Fire Plane
quests.description: The final Dragon is Zellare, The Fire Prime. You may have noticed that many dragons can breathe fire. That is because Dragons are naturally attuned to this element. That makes Zellare the strongest of the primes. Meet me in the Fire Realm and we will set about our task.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the DragonPlane ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Putting Out Fires
quests.description: I can sense the heat of the Fire prime's anger. He has sensed the others fall and knows that we are here. You will need to defeat 10 Fire Elementals and 10 Living Fires to even begin to weaken him. Return once this task is complete.

npc.name: Meet me in the Fire Plane

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Fire Plane ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: At A Loss
quests.description: Hero, you must understand that as a Dravix I never imagined that I would oppose a Dragon. I have no idea what we might do to weaken Zellare's might. Go collect some Elemental Embers from this realm. I will research their power and see what I can find.

npc.name: Meet me in the Fire Plane

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Fire Plane ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Backburner
quests.description: I found something interesting. Fire is a dangerous and destructive element. It's causing cracks in itself, which we can use. We can redirect Zellare's own power at him, fighting fire with fire as it were. To set the magical back-burn we will need 8 Burning Crux from the monsters in this realm.

npc.name: Meet me in the Fire Plane

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Fire Plane ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Open Fire
quests.description: It's worked! Zellare's power is fighting against itself, consuming fuel faster than it can compensate for. Now, you just need to place the 8 Controlled Burns around his realm so Zellare's power can't find more fuel elsewhere.

npc.name: Meet me in the Fire Plane

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Fire Plane ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Zellare, The Fire Prime
quests.description: Zellare has cut himself off from any fuel for his power. The controlled burns are keeping him weak. You must strike NOW! Good luck. If you return then we will be able to break the DragonMark and rescue my master.

npc.name: Meet me in the Fire Plane

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Fire Plane ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Meet me in the DragonPlane
quests.description: I cannot believe my eyes. You were able to actually obtain ALL FOUR Elemental Dracoscintilla! This is all we need to unlock the DragonGate and free my master. Please, meet me back in the DragonPlane.

npc.name: Meet me in the Fire Plane

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the Fire Plane ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Open the DragonGate
quests.description: I don't know how to thank you for all that you've done for me… for my master. Quickly, let's go open the DragonGate! I'm sure that he will want to thank you himself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Meet me in the DragonPlane ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Dragon Sacrifice for Desoloth!
quests.description: My Master has grown strong, stronger than any of those Priests would believe. He is linked to each creature in Etherstorm now, by blood and breath. With every death of an elemental dragon, his power increases. Slay 3 dragons of each element that he may grow much, much stronger. In gratitude, you'll receive 24 warrior tokens of Desoloth.

quests.name: Defend Your Master!
quests.description: You have bent knee to my Master, and he is now yours, as well. To prove your loyalty, you must now slay those you once defended. With every elemental dragon death, you strike at the heart of the Primes, our Master's enemies. Slay 3 of each element's dragons and return to me. In gratitude, you'll receive 12 warrior tokens of Desoloth.

quests.name: Escape from the ChronoLords
quests.description: The ChronoLords aren't going to just let us walk out of here! We'll have to defeat them before we can escape!

quests.name: Vorefax
quests.description: Holy moly, this thing really is huge! I can't believe it… this is all because of me? We have to destroy it… before it destroys all of time!

quests.name: Endurance Tesssssst
quests.description: If you wisssssssh to prove your worttttttth, you must ssssshow me your dedicationnnnnn. Defeat the local weaklingsssssss, and bring me their headsssssss

quests.name: A Gesture of Evil
quests.description: It ssssssseemsss I require your … sssssssservicesssss. Bring me the following itemsssssss…and you will get your reward.

quests.name: Ghastly Blades
quests.description: Bring me 100 Ghassssstly Dreadrock Bladesssss from the local citizensssss, ssssso I may melt them down for my waressssssss. Do thisssss, and you will be greatly rrrrrewarded…

quests.name: Day of the Undead
quests.description: The Undead Primordial God, Desterrat Moya, was a particularly big inspiration to the founding of the Underworld Chronomancers. Perhaps you could be further inspired to join our Order by facing it.

quests.name: Tough On Crime Approach
quests.description: Fascinating! What a dreamy word. Don't you want to be fascinating? Whether they realize it or not, many of the Nation are fascinated by fanatics of justice. Even Master Nulgath. Justice taken to the extreme comes so close to being evil, and you can come up with easy excuses to cross the line. Go to /poisonforest and you'll find people like that. Bring back the medals awarded by the Good to their highest ranking fanatics.

quests.name: Fluffy Face Value
quests.description: There's more than enough Dark Makai to go around in Tercessuinotlim but they're not my style. Yuck, they're all skin and no fur like a wrinkly desert cat. Hmm, cats…When it comes to cats, you can't just have one. And they can't just be any cats. They have to have a cute face, and a sour personality. Bring me some cute black-hearted cats and I'll consider that a big favor! You can find them in /doomkitten and /nibbleon.

quests.name: Black Lights
quests.description: Glow stick accessories used to be such a big fad. Not anymore. That stuff makes me feel old, and that's saying something cause I'm immortal. Members of Nulgath's Nation scorn all Light in kind of the same way. It represents our goodie two shoes counterparts as a whole, but I'm curious. I've heard that the /blackholesun has different kinds of lights! Take a trip there and bring me souvenirs.

quests.name: Vindictive Minds
quests.description: 'Dawn' is a good way to explain what my name represents too. But the name seems to be taken. In /Trygve, there seems to be an organization out there that's taken the 'Dawn' for their own. It's just a word. People can make it out to mean anything, but I'm curious. Do me a favor and run over to that town. Bring me back some souvenirs from those Dawn Vendors or whatever. I want to know what their Dawn means.

quests.name: Soft and Sharp
quests.description: I've been hearing stories of people minding their own business, and suddenly they fall through the ground. Boom, gone. No one there, not even a sinkhole. It even happened here! And I managed to get a glimpse of this portal to a /garden. And in that garden were these cuuuute bunny critters. I'm going to ask you the huge favor of bringing me a fluffle of these bunbuns back! Especially the tentie ones.

quests.name: Ring Bearer
quests.description: As I started exploring these tunnels, I seemed to have lost something of great importance to me—a ring that my father had given me when I was a child. I am not sure where I could have lost it, but I am positive that one of those bone-heads found it! Go around and hunt the Undead until my ring drops from one of them!

quests.name: Skeletal Sabotage
quests.description: These tunnels are flooded with the Undead. And by the looks of things, they seem to be getting stronger as we speak! The only way we can weaken their defenses is by stealing their weapons and armor as soon as possible! If you're up for the challenge, go out and collect 6 Skeletal Claymores and 3 Bony ChestPlates from the wandering Undead!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tunnel of Terror
quests.description: There is something living down here that is rather different from the other Undead. It's big. It's nasty. And it wields massive bone weapons! It is none other than the Bone Terror, and even though I am a Paladin, I am too scared to confront it myself. If you happen to defeat it and bring me the Bone Terror's Head as proof, I will never doubt your abilities ever again!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Search for the Sword
quests.description: I didn't want to tell you at first, but you have done such a great job helping me out that I owe it to you. Some Paladins have a supernatural sense that allows them to find special weapons with untold magical properties. I came down into these tunnels in hopes of finding such a weapon. I know a super rare weapon is down here… somewhere. Hack and slash your way through the Undead until you find an Unidentified Weapon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Key of Life
quests.description: I know that SOME of the monsters down here have all 6 pieces to the Key of Life but I'm not sure which ones. You can tell because the key was carved out of some sort of glowing wood. Go find 6 Fragments of Glowing Wood to rebuild the key and bring them back here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Search for the Sword ' quest.

quests.name: Key of Dreams
quests.description: My first day down on this level, I saw a piece of the Key of Dreams. It's a beautiful crystal fragment with light coming from inside it, reflecting off its ever shifting facets. Go find the 6 Shining Crystal Fragments to the Key of Dreams and bring them back here to unlock the chest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Key of Thought
quests.description: There is another key called the Key of Thought. It's fragments look like rough, pitted stone like the kind you'll find in a volcano, and it's even still warm to the touch. Bring back the 6 Pitted Stone Fragments to reassemble the Key of Thought.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Key of the Void
quests.description: The final key is called the Key of the Void. I've tried to aVOID this key, so far but I've seen it. The purple-black metal seems to writhe and slither in your hand. If you bring 6 Writhing Metal Fragments back here, you can reassemble the Key of the Void. It is still whole and guarded by an Undead Champion. If you defeat it, you may get the Key of the Void.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Portal Puzzle
quests.description: Hero! I've got some great news! So warlic has finally found a way to open that portal at the end of thise cavern. Who knos what dangers lie on the other side?! Ready to find out? Go to the bottom of this cave and figure out how to solve the magical rune puzzle that will unlock the portal! Good Luck!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Best Fiends Forever
quests.description: New enemies await us! So let's go say "hi!" Go out and "make friends" with the Undead in the area. And bring me back whatever is left of them -- I want to study their bones to see how they survive in this strange new environment.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Portal Puzzle ' quest.

quests.name: Crystal Encores
quests.description: So there's more than just Crystallized Undead in these caves, huh? I wonder how these crystal creatures thrive in such a harsh environment…? It just doesn't make sense… so let's find out why! Bring me 12 Crystal Cores so I can further my research.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fishin' for Jellys
quests.description: BattleUnder just keeps getting stranger and stranger. There is a huge crystalline Jellyfish that lives at the bottom of this cave! I… really have NO idea what it's doing down here…let alone how it stays alive… But this Jellyfish is not a mean creature… it's just used to eating everything smaller than itself. Which includes us! Capture the Crystallized Jellyfish so I may study its habit.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Soul Searching
quests.description: Now that you have seen and experienced this cave's wonders, it's time to do a little farming. Most of the baddies in BattleUnder drop Undead Essences and some even drop Cavern Celestites. But I have a handful of both items if you wanna do some bartering..? If you get me the Souls of the Bone Terror, Undead Champion, and the big Crystallized, Jellyfish, then I'll give you my spare Undead Essences and Cavern Celestites!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dem bones, dem icy bones
quests.description: If we're going to find nymue, the water spirit, we're going to have to get past these Shivering Bones. Slay 10 of them to send a warning to the others to leave you alone!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Soul Searching ' quest.

quests.name: Icy Screams
quests.description: The screams of the Icy Banshees and the roars of monsters up ahead have shaken apart the stalactites overhead! Gather up the shards so you don't cut your feet and slay 7 of the Banshees to prevent more from being screamed down
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pick your Battles
quests.description: You're going to need to get though the ice up ahead, I am certainly of it. You'll need a pickaxe to do that. Slay the Skeletal Warrior here; one of them should be carrying one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Some Good Adv-ice
quests.description: Alright, Hero. It looks like the Glacial Horror has raised 4 Stalactite Columns to prevent you from passing. Knock those down, then take on that cold-hearted brute to pass beyond.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shatter It Just a Little Bit
quests.description: Oh no! Hero, Nymue must be trapped under that frozen lake! We cannot help her untill the ice is broken. Shatter the ice on the frozen lake to free her.

items_required.name: Shatter it, just a little bit

quests.name: Re-Animation Station
quests.description: I have these items that I want to add animations to, but the Lich in Battleundera stole my Crystals of Reanimation. I'd be happy to let you pick one of them if you can bring my crystals back to me! Keep slaying the Lich until he gives you my Crystals!

quests.name: Mind the Fumes
quests.description: We've got to find the source of whatever is causing these eathquakes. And you'd better take care — these sulfur fumes are making ME dizzy — try not to get lost while fighting your way through these caverns. If you come across any Lava Guards, question them. They may be able to give us more information about this place.

quests.name: Oooh, Mama
quests.description: Wow, that Mama really LAVAs her dragon babies! Looks like you’ll need to fight her if we want to get out of here alive. She doesn’t seem in the mood for explanations or excuses.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Trade for the Understone
quests.description: So, you want the Understone? I tell you what. You go get me 10 Fluorite Shards and I'll take those in trade.

quests.name: Going Going Is Bananas
quests.description: Observe. A lush forest environment created by Chairman Platinum. The fauna are just as realistic as the flora, with the Chairman's own… realism-based style. The GorillAIphants' aggression is quite realistic as well. Perhaps too much. I ask that you subdue them before we continue.

location.name: Chairman Platinum's Evolving Environmental Art Gallery

quests.name: Your FrAInds!
quests.description: Walking further to the right will take you to our urban shopping environment. Go on, have a chat with Robina and Artix. They're prepared to make you feel like you actually have friends. Don't mind the lack of a mall entrance. The Ebil AI will generate one once we obtain more "references."

location.name: Chairman Platinum's Evolving Environmental Art Gallery

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Green Soy Fodder
quests.description: We filled the mall with clones to refine our flat loiterer generation process. Unfortunately, they're packed too closely at the moment to simulate a real outside experience, and perceive a shoulder bump as a way to initiate a fight. How disgusting. Trash these failures. I can't have them damaging the landscape.

location.name: Chairman Platinum's Evolving Environmental Art Gallery

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: WIPs
quests.description: What in the… I see. It seems that someone fed Works-In-Progress to the Ebil AI. It must have confused mouse cursors for environmental fixtures, and scattered them across Chairman Platinum's masterpiece. You! Grab them, give them to me, and let us never speak of this again. I'll compensate you with a muffin basket.

location.name: Chairman Platinum's Evolving Environmental Art Gallery

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Anatomical Nightmare
quests.description: Moving past the mall, you will find yourself in *gasp* the midst of a Shadowscythe invasion. The horror. Experience what it's like to be a real adventurer by slaying these…skeletons. Their odd appearance is on purpose, of course. They're supposed to be strange because they're Evil.

location.name: Chairman Platinum's Evolving Environmental Art Gallery

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dead Eyed
quests.description: Well, would you look at that? It's the Empress of the Shadowscythe herself. It appears she wants to meet her new minion. Wait a minute… is that one of ours? I doubt it- she seems a tad too 'girly girl' to fit into the Invasion area's aesthetic. Occupy yourself by talking to both of them… I have to have a word with the General Manager.

location.name: Chairman Platinum's Evolving Environmental Art Gallery

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unspecified Seafood
quests.description: Now enter the Empress' fortress and look in awe at her…aquarium. Tsk, the Ebil AI strung the wrong locations together again. It even interpreted the "fish" prompt incorrectly, and made living filets. Argh, get rid of them before the Chairman finds out!

location.name: Chairman Platinum's Evolving Environmental Art Gallery

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Too Literal
quests.description: Ah, so the AI has placed Warlic and Cysero's interpretations underwater. Considering that Warlic is the Blue Mage, it only makes sense for him and his friend to be here. Why? Because water is blue, obviously. If you doubt our logic, perhaps a conversation will help you understand the quality of our designs.

location.name: Chairman Platinum's Evolving Environmental Art Gallery

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Oversaturation
quests.description: Ow! Did one of the fish just bite me? And why are the skeletons banging their heads on the walls? You! Destroy these malfunctioning specimens before they bring the entire gallery down! I need to make some calls, and figure out what's going on.

location.name: Chairman Platinum's Evolving Environmental Art Gallery

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pull the Plug
quests.description: Agh! One of my high heels snapped while we were escaping from the monsters. Enough of this! Go past the underwater cave, and pull the plug on that stupid Blender. Break your tacky friends out of the tank, too, for all I care! I'll pin the blame on someone else… just GO!

location.name: Chairman Platinum's Evolving Environmental Art Gallery

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gathering Evidence
quests.description: The Evolving Environment Art Gallery is still open, but it can't possibly impress potential investors in this state. As thanks for earlier, I'll extend a special offer to you: help me clean up, and you'll be reimbursed for your time. All you have to do is wrangle the skeletons and fish, and make sure that the Blender doesn't wake up again.

location.name: Chairman Platinum's Evolving Environmental Art Gallery

quests.name: Vendebils
quests.description: An ideal worker covers all their bases. Empty the Vending Machines in case any of them contain the Golden Mogugu. Don't insert any cards. We scan those to store your personal information. Just break the machines open.

quests.name: Bad Batch
quests.description: Some of our customers dumped their rare Mogugus in front of the fountain. 'Rare' is just an attractively marketable name. These reds and blues are the most common variety and have the least value. Do away with them. They're tripping hazards.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Deal Camper
quests.description: Tsk, you should have arrived earlier. The Deal Hunters camped outside the mall three days ago in preparation for the next Mogugu shipment. 'Gently convince' these fellows to give us their spots.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Questing Quencher
quests.description: The Manley Goblets from the last craze have spilled all over the floor. What a waste! We could melt them down to make more. I'll pay you to collect them for me. Obviously, I can't risk getting lead poisoning.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Free PR
quests.description: The Deal Hunters are causing a ruckus, attempting to sell each other blind boxes with common Mogugus. All this fuss over mutual scamming is getting loud enough to draw attention. We'll get caught up in it if you don't handle the situation.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Artificial Demand
quests.description: We've made it to the front of the line, but the Scalpers are crowding the entrance. EbilCorp hired them to artificially increase Mogugu demand. Inform them that their services aren't needed anymore. Do so with force. It's necessary.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Instant Euphoria
quests.description: We've cleared the line. Head inside the Mogugu Mania storefront, and capture the Super Rare Mogugus. Perhaps the golden model is among them. Do it quickly before security realizes we're here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Please Hold
quests.description: I've unlocked the back door. Head down the hall towards the manufacturing facilities. You'll run into our Customer Support representatives. They will shoot to kill on sight. I recommend striking first.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: De-unioned
quests.description: Allow me to reveal the source of all Mogugus. Nesting in our manufacturing facilities is the Mogugudra. Defeating it will halt Mogugu production, and give me the opportunity to find and destroy the Golden Mogugu. The craze ends here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Twillimination
quests.description: The asset's heads are growing back faster than our employees can harvest them. You. Snip one of its heads off, and we'll let you keep it as payment. It could grow into a Super Rare Mogugu, and auctioning it off could pay for a new house.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' De-unioned ' quest.

quests.name: Haku Medal
quests.description: Haku Village is being attacked from land and sea. The Yokai and Dragons have banded together for one purpose - to take the head of Empress Ai No Miko. Don't give them another inch, and wipe them off the face of the Isles. I'll be at your side, my friend.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Divine Derision ' quest.

quests.name: Mega Haku Medal
quests.description: The Yokai and Dragons want the Isles back in the claws of the beasts. We'll hack them to pieces. Be on the lookout for their stronger warriors, the Dai Tengu and the Long. They appear rarely, but defeating them cripples their forces, and bolsters ours with the riches they drop.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Divine Derision ' quest.

quests.name: Tall Tails
quests.description: The Kitsune Spies are trying to sow discord in our ranks by disguising themselves as hapless villagers. Lady Yue has singled them out, and needs us to banish them. I think that's a less gruesome way of asking us to slay them. We should go along with it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Divine Derision ' quest. | Must have completed either of the previous quests.

quests.name: Flightless
quests.description: The Draconic forces have joined up with the Yokai traitors. Interestingly, they don't need to communicate with each other to move in-sync. Let's round up a few, and probe at their cuts to see if they'd be more willing to communicate with us instead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Divine Derision ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: NorthEast Ushitora
quests.description: Of all the Yokai that would seek to drink Empress Ai No Miko's blood on a whim, Haruki and the others knew it'd be the Oni. They delight in mindless mayhem, and no one would argue against taking their heads. Come now, lets get them rolling.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Divine Derision ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 25%.

quests.name: Zmey Gorynich
quests.description: Where did these Dragons come from? Such a large army couldn't have been hovering above the ocean for so long without needing rest. How did no one notice them until Zakhavatchik sent the Empress his challenge? Capture the Zmey Warriors and see if they'll talk.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Divine Derision ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 25%.

quests.name: Head Kukol'nyy
quests.description: Masterful work! Zakhavatchik's armies on both fronts have been demolished. All that remains is to slay the Dragon himself. Take up your blade one last time, friend… we'll approach the Mikoto Shrine as partners, and rescue the Isles from that pompous lizard.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Divine Derision ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Our Love
quests.description: You must have seen the other shades from Ai No Miko's memories by now. This is the last group, and they seem to be based on the final moments of her mother. I need a minute, so go and listen to their parting words. The Yokai Realm has to be showing us these events for a reason.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Left Behind ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Amano Iwato
quests.description: After you picked off some of the Dragonlings, I began sensing a presence behind that rock. Ai is keeping it in place, but it weakens the more enemies are slain. Banish the Kistune Spirits, slay the Dragonlings, and help me roll that boulder out of the way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Left Behind ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Corrupted Protector
quests.description: Empress Ai No Miko was hiding in the cave, but something else got to her before we did. There is a dangerous shade, controlled by Koschei's red strings. You seem to be familiar with it. In that case, you'll know exactly how to defeat it. My blade will join yours, and we'll rescue the Empress.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Left Behind ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Feed the Greed
quests.description: Forget the Legion threat for now - our friends from Frostvale are tearing each other apart. We'll need to fight the White Stalkers and Blighted Moglins and reclaim the holiday gifts, decorations and food that they stole. Feeding our friends' greed may calm them down enough to stop the fighting.

quests.name: Sleet Samples
quests.description: We need to find a way to reverse the effects of this blight. See if you can get some samples of the black sleet for our clerics to study. You should be able to find good samples on either the White Stalkers or Blighted Moglins.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' Holiday Cheer? No Thank You. ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Blighted Deer
quests.description: It looks like this terrible blight is even affecting our wildlife. Unfortunate as it is, we will need to destroy the deer that have been affected. It's a mercy, but it will also help prevent them from spreading the affliction to anyone else.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' Not THIS blight! ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Frosty Hearts
quests.description: The Legion has found a way to control the Ice Golems in the area by inscribing runes on their heartstones. Kill the golems and take their heartstones - without them the Legion will no longer be able to use them as cannon fodder.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' And Your Little Deer, Too ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: On the Offensive
quests.description: We must have gotten the Legion’s attention - they're going on the offensive. We should do likewise. Slay as many Blighted Revenants and Skeletal Minions as you can find. If you can hold them off until our cure is ready, we may still have some hope.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' Recyclable! ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Inoculation
quests.description: The cure we've developed reverses the effects of the black sleet, but its abilities are limited. Those afflicted with the blight are beyond our help. Go and inoculate as many Angry Villagers and Angry Moglins as you can find. As for the Blighted… well, we'll have to take care of them a different way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' No Cure For You. ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Different Way
quests.description: We're safe from the black sleet, but our friends still need to be protected from these blighted abominations. We can't cure them, so for the safety of all, they will need to be destroyed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' Spread the Blight ' quest.

quests.name: Breaking In
quests.description: We've seen the cave leading to Dage's Mt. Bleakwind lair at the top of the mountain, but I know he's not scaling that peak every time he comes and goes. He must be using a second, lower entrance to get inside. Find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the 'Inoculation' quest or the ' Spread the Blight ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Break the barrier
quests.description: It looks like a barrier spell has been cast, preventing anyone but Dage from traveling further into the mountain. The ice golems are carrying stones that appear to be enchanted. If you get all of the stones, you should be able to break the spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' Breaking In ' quest given by Issik the Vile . Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Final Ward
quests.description: Looks like there's another barrier blocking access into the next chamber. The sounds emanating from it suggest that this is where you'll find Frostfang. Perhaps the stones carried by the frost golems will help you gain entrance.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' Break the barrier ' quest given by Issik the Vile . Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat Frostfang (Good)
quests.description: You found Frostfang's lair, and he's still inside! Take him down before he goes on the attack again! And if you find whatever might be giving him his energy, it may be wise to destroy that as well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' The Final Ward ' quest given by Issik the Vile .

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Frostfang (Good)
quests.description: You're still looking for a good fight? How about burning off that extra adrenaline on Ultra Frostfang? That should provide a challenge for you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Defeat Frostfang (Good)' quest (one time only).

quests.name: Icing the Golems - for Good!
quests.description: Now that all of the barriers have been broken, ice golems keep spilling out of I've got some gold for you if you'll go in and smash 10 of 'em so they'll stay put.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Defeat Frostfang (Good)' quest (one time only).

quests.name: Golems Really Frost Me Good
quests.description: The frost golems are becoming a problem, too, even though they're coming from deeper inside the mountain. Go inside and take them out before they infest the area.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Defeat Frostfang (Good)' quest (one time only).

quests.name: Guardians of Time
quests.description: Time itself is in danger from an ancient evil which approaches. Eienyuki warns me of this most insistently. Freeze time to ensure you have enough opportunities to gather the following: 1 Glacier Core and 3 Frozen Hearts from Polar Elementals, and 5 Frozen Fangs. If we can freeze the progress of the threat, we may yet be saved.
quests.requirements_note: 1 Class Point on Chronomancer , Rank 1

quests.name: Chronocorruptors on Ice
quests.description: Though I do not approve of what the Chronocorruptors have done, I cannot allow them to fall to this frigid land. They would taint its purity, and I cannot have that. Battle an ancient golem in Frostdeep for 1 Ancient Rune, 3 Ruby Eyes, and 7 Sands of Time. Then leave, quickly!
quests.requirements_note: 1 Class Point on ChronoCorruptor , Rank 1

quests.name: Death of Time
quests.description: Eienyuki will not let me hide this from you, Hero. Should the ancient evil approaching succeed, Lore will fall, it's true. And then he will try to take control of Time itself using the power you TimeKillers possess! To keep you safe, I will need the following: 1 Heart of Time and 7 Frozen Vortex Seeds from the Ancient Horror.
quests.requirements_note: 1 Class Point on TimeKiller , Rank 1

quests.name: You are a Unique Snowflake
quests.description: I know this, because for as long as Eienyuki and I have warded this land, we have never seen a hero as mighty as you. If you bring me 13 diamond snowflakes from the Polar Golems, I will craft a reward worthy of your greatness!

quests.name: Sever the Link
quests.description: We need you to aid the heroes questing to defeat Kezeroth, and you will have to do it now. Leap back in time and slay the monsters linked in the padlocks securing the World-Enders chests. Slay the arctic direwolves, polar elementals and golems. They are linked to the padlocks securing the World-Enders chests. By slaying them, you will ensure your allies can retrieve the keys they are looking for once all is ready.
quests.requirements_note: 1 Class Point on TimeKiller , Rank 1

quests.name: Patch the Fabric of Spacetime
quests.description: We need more time for time for our units to prepare! It is vital that you slow time down. The Ancient Maggots in FrostDeep dungeon are boring holes in the fabric of spacetime, speeding it up considerably. Slay them and to help your friends!
quests.requirements_note: 1 Class Point on Chronomancer , Rank 1

quests.name: Passing Past Chaos
quests.description: Return to the past and knock some senselessness into the polar elementals near the ballista, archer, and mage units. This way, by the time our units arrive, their enemies will already be dazed and confused… perfect targets!
quests.requirements_note: 1 Class Point on ChronoCorruptor , Rank 1

quests.name: Serving Up HP Helper
quests.description: Though the mages are already being assisted, we need someone to gather ingredients for HP potions to aid the warriors confronting Kezeroth! Slay Arctic Direwolf and Polar Golems for Hollyberry Vines and Icebreaker Seeds .Return to me so I may create the draughts they need!

quests.name: Yoshino's Limited Time Event (Daily Quest)
quests.description: Sooo, you're telling me that Yoshino has the power to summon random monsters from lore and we just kill what she says? WHO GAVE THE OK ON THIS?!?

quests.name: Yoshino's Heroic Quest
quests.description: Oh, one last thing! This must be done in one session.. no logging out or going off track! Otherwise the enemies will take their items back… Now off you go, I got some stories to tell Twilly.

quests.name: Vitamoon
quests.description: The legends of the moon differ between Yokai and my ancestral homeland, but they all involve a rabbit. No matter where you go, bunnies and the moon just click. Though my day job is designing clothes, I have some skills in medicine making just like the moon's companion. I have most of the ingredients, but I'm missing fish oil. I heard you can get ahold of some special fish from /natatorium.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Etokoun Captured ' quest.

quests.name: Fill'er Up
quests.description: In Yokai legend, the rabbit accompanying the moon makes rice cakes with their mortar and pestle instead of medicine. That's exactly what we need for the Lunar New Year Celebrations - snacks! Ai no Miko said she'd handle the rice cakes, and would like for us to make something too. For that, we'll need filling. That's lotus seeds in /wanders and egg yolks from /battlefowl.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Etokoun Captured ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mirror Flowers
quests.description: Have you ever heard of the proverb "like flowers in a mirror, and the moon reflected on the lake's surface?" When Ai no Miko approached me and my cousins to release us from secrecy, we talked for a while, and this proverb came up. With that in mind, would you go to /guardiantree to pick blossoms and harvest seeds? I'd like to make another gift for you and the Empress of Yokai.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Etokoun Captured ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Moon's Reflection
quests.description: Right, I didn't explain what the ‘like flowers in a mirror, and the moon reflected on the lake's surface' proverb meant yet. Both the flowers and the moon are beautiful, but you can never touch them. They're not real, just mirages. If your dreams are like those things…Well, huge mood shift. How about going to /beachparty and collecting water from the elementals? I have another magic trick to show you and Ai no Miko.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Etokoun Captured ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shifting Faces
quests.description: I hear that the moon holds special significance to the people of Darkovia too. Hmm, is there time for us to go over there for a peek? I know it's a long way… but I'm so curious. It's eternally night there, but it isn't pitch black. The moon shines on beings that supposedly shun the light. Oh? Going to /Safiria would be safest? Then if I put on a disguise and cover my ears, could we look for souvenirs?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Etokoun Captured ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eto... Bleh
quests.description: You've won the Etokoun hunt before. I heard the stories and maybe, I wanted to try petting it myself. It seems that, as one of the main branch descendants of the Rabbit Princess, my inherent aura spurred a great energy in it! As in, I think I made it mad. Super sorry about that! Could you please help calm it down before Ai no Miko notices?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Etokoun Captured ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Elixir of the Moon
quests.description: Uh oh. I turned around for a moment and the Etokoun got a lot more…wet. Because I touched it, the Etokoun became imbalanced, and now resembles a Water Rabbit in full. Its body became fluid, and the bugs wriggling in the ground it walked on became immortal. A few bugs is fine, but if anything else partakes in its bodily elixir, we will literally never hear the end of it. It's all good, just defeat it and I'll take care of the rest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Etokoun Captured ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Yokai's Ark
quests.description: You set one foot inside the cabins and everyone started talking! I don't want to hog you so chat up the other passengers. Go chat with them first and pfft, spar with the Serpent Warriors. They want to tussle with the Empress' Honored One.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Shanty Sha-N-Ti ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Fashion Fathoms
quests.description: Great, you're free to help me out! I really want to touch up the pirate costumes so they're more convincing. Can you gently persuade the crew to hand over their outfits for a moment? And by gently persuade, I mean twist their arm until they cry uncle.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Shanty Sha-N-Ti ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hoo Wants a Cracker
quests.description: While I was up on deck, I saw birds up in the masts. Would you please climb up and bum a few feathers off of them? I think a feather in a tricorn would be fetching!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Shanty Sha-N-Ti ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Childish Nostalgia
quests.description: I'm seeing the same type of memory shade Haruki saw near that copy of Mikoto Shrine. There are two kids next to the small house. They're calling out to…Ai No Miko? Come on, let's listen in on what they're talking about. They sound familiar…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Hoshi no Tama ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Simple Wishes
quests.description: Take a peek inside the house. I recognize it from Akiba, but the inside looks like a room from the royal palace. Investigate every corner, talk to the shades, and - eek! Get rid of the snakes slithering on the floor! They're hissing and spitting…mercury?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Hoshi no Tama ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

items_required.name: Talk to Princess Ai No Miko

quests.name: Left Behind
quests.description: We've learned a lot, but there's still no sign of the real Miko. Up ahead, past this house, is a cliff Yiren was exploring. Head over there, and help him clear out the Dragons left over from Koschei's invasion. Oh…that's really sad. They're little Dragonlings.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Hoshi no Tama ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Porkon's Pride
quests.description: If you're looking for new weapons, I've run into a bit of a problem. General Porkon at the Horc Fort sold me a shipment of substandard ore, and it's not usable for weapons. If you want pots? Fine. But a sword? Nope. He says that no Adventurer has ever beat him - go over there and show him he's wrong! Then bring me back his pride…I'll be out the ore, but that'll go a long way to making me feel better. (Return to Yulgar in the Battleon Inn with Porkon's Pride.)

quests.name: Zorbak's Reward
quests.description: Well met, Adventurer! I need some very special things to forge a weapon that I've been working on for some time. Zorbak has been hoarding the miniature Skulls that I need to forge the blade of the Bone Sword. If you bring me 8 Small Skulls, I'll reward you with the Bone Sword. (Get Small Skulls from Zorbak in Battleon for doing his quests. Bring 8 to Yulgar in the Battleon Inn.)

quests.name: Rats off To ya!
quests.description: Well met adventurer! Looking for some work? The inn basement needs a little cleaning before the Swordhaven health inspector gets here. Bring me 8 rat ears to prove the basement is clear and I will give you a nice tip. Let's keep this on the down low, alright? (Return to Yulgar in the Battleon Inn with the Rat Ears.)

quests.name: Yulgar's Daily Hero Challenge
quests.description: Yulgar needs a LOT to keep this inn up and running: weapons to defend it, food to feed hungry heroes, drinks for all, and wood to keep expanding! (What, you didn't notice it was bigger on the inside?) Bring me: 10 hunks of Horc Boar meat, 15 jugs of Doomwood Tree sap, 5 Sandsea Horc blades, and 3 Treeant boards, and the gold hoard from Trigoras.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50 or higher. Note: This quest can only be completed once per day.

quests.name: Yulgar Needs to Hydra-te!
quests.description: There's a TON of thirsty heroes on their way, and we've got to have enough for them ALL to drink! Bring me the following: 13 Styx Hydra and 1 Fire Leech head. I make a MEAN hydra-leech smoothie!
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 40 or higher.

quests.name: Yulgar's Worst Nightmare
quests.description: The horse… the terror… when the night is dark and the inn is silent, sometimes I feel his eyes upon me. Binky… Binky haunts my nightmares! Slay him and return my scythe to me so I know he is dead… once and for all!
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 53 or higher.

quests.name: Advertiser Ally
quests.description: Greetings, Hero! Would you like an opportunity to make some gold? I'm looking for someone who would be willing to advertise Yulgar's Inn across /Battleon, but the monsters around Greenguard have been acting up and hurting my other advertisers and my customers. If you'd be willing to help scare away some of the monsters, I'd be willing to give you a job advertising the Inn.

quests.name: Bandits are Bad News
quests.description: I've heard rumors of a new brigade of bandits in Greenguard, Hero! You'd best find out where they're camped to make sure they don't have Grams!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chaorrupted Captain Encounter ' quest.

quests.name: Creatures Serving Chaos
quests.description: I know my Ma would not approve, but if we're going to get her back safely, you're going to have to take down those wild animals she's trained to defend her! If I know my Ma, she's got at least 15 of them on patrol at all times.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bandit Battles
quests.description: Her rag-tag crew of bandits will never let you take Ma! Not now that she's gotten them organized and increased the amount of loot they can take! You'll have to take out the 13 bandits she's brought together, or we'll never get her home!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Can You Regain Grams?
quests.description: I know you don't want to do this, Hero… but if you're going to get Grams back here so we can try to treat her Chaorruption, you're going to have to battle her. Just be gentle; try not to hurt her! She's my ma, but I know she's a tough old bird. She can handle herself in battle.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Where Shall I Sleep Tonight?
quests.description: I would love to offer you a room here at the inn but there are to many foul beasts plauging the land. The worst part is that this is the high season for tourism! I'm loosing so much money! Can you please clear the inner /templeb of DoomWood of 10 skeletons so that folks will be willing to stay here again and not have to spend their vacation on the shores of Hydra Lake?

quests.name: Fight Fire With Fire!
quests.description: OH NO! I thought that killing those beasts would rid the land and help business but all it did was make the evil ones mad. I've received word of a Dark Dracozombie is leading a group of skeletons in /battleunderb to wreak havoc. Its time for us to fight fire with fire and use their magic against them. First we need to find the Dark Tower sword from one of his minions. Good luck on your quest.

quests.name: No One Said It Would Be Easy
quests.description: Now that you have the Dark Tower Sword, we need to infuse it with the spirits of the Dracozombie's followers. Please bring me 13 Bronze Dracozombies' spirits. With them I should be able to forge a weapon powerful enough to vanquish their leader. You'll find them near Zombie Galanoth.

quests.name: Free Us, Oh Brave One!
quests.description: You should now be ready to take on the Dark Dracozombie. Please bring me back it's bone. I feel they would make a lovely arm chair. I wish you luck and my the light shine on you in your darkest moments!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Light Tower Sword in your inventory.

quests.name: Dual Wield Forge
quests.description: I've levelled up my crafting skill! I can now forge dual wield versions of select items… with the proper resources. Bring me "Reflected Glory" from the Skeletal Vikings and Divided Light from the Skeletal Warriors in the graveyard just past Zorbak.

quests.name: Gathering the Pieces
quests.description: If we are going to forge this weapon, I'm going to need to get my forge white hot, even for an Ice weapon! Gather Lava Nuggets around the area that were dropped by Drakonnan's minions. Be careful picking them up. They're hot!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Akriloth ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: This Weapon Scales
quests.description: As you may have learned, dragon scales are an extremely strong material, and great for reforging weapons! Get me a 4 pristine scales to help make reforging a little easier.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Reinforced Lava Steel
quests.description: The nearby Living Lavas have a special type of steel in their bodies. Defeat some and mine the metal out of them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Claymore Shards
quests.description: The enemies has stolen the Shards of the Frozen Claymore you have entrusted to me! You have to get them back or I can't make you the new weapon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Beef Up
quests.description: I don't normally serve burgers, so first I'm going to need some meat. There's a meat factory over in /extinction. You can get ground beef from the Freezer Drones there. While you're at it, grab me some lard to cook it in.

quests.name: Creamy!
quests.description: Looks like I'll be learning to make ice cream, too. The recipe I found calls for heavy cream, but I don't have any. But you know who would? A chickencow! I hear you can find one if you find the secret cow level. Or just go to /battlefowl.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sacchar-Imp
quests.description: Cream and sugar are the most important ingredients when making ice cream, so I'll need some sugar too. Get some from the Sugar Imps in /freakitiki.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Salty Balboa
quests.description: You may not realize this, but to make a good ice cream, you don't just need sugar. You need rock salt, too! Can you get it from rocks? I don't know, but you're going to try. Specifically, you're going to try with the Balboas in /mountainpath.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Filet o' Fishwing
quests.description: So… sigh… I guess this is the part where I send you out for fish. I have to tell you, friend, I'm not sold on this recipe. But if it's what our winner wants… Anyway. I guess fishwing goes as well with ice cream as any fish does. You can find some in Lolosia on the /pirates ship.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Potion Master
quests.description: There’s got to be SOMEONE who knows a cure for Twig’s condition. Visit Reens at the Tower of Magic in /arcangrove. She’s a Potion Master. If there’s anyone who would have an answer, it would be her - she'll tell you what to do next.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Burglinster's Revenge
quests.description: Hurry and give the Burglinster your cure before he destroys Yulgar's Inn!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' An Aspiring Burgermonger ' quest.

quests.name: Octotree
quests.description: Aria wants me to build a wheelchair out of a tree she's grown with her Nature abilities. I worry this could strain her injuries, but I need to trust her judgment. She knows more about her powers than I do. She doesn't want to materialize the tree out of thin air, she wants to grow one. However, the artificial gardens are at a point where they can't support another tree. We'd need more fertile soil and clean water. Would you mind heading back to the Twilight Zone to gather some Lamprey that we can use for fertilizer?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sea's Commitment ' quest.

quests.name: Thirsty Roots
quests.description: Seabase Undine relies on shipment of fresh water from Ashray. Dr. Rivale handles resource management, and prioritizes having enough drinking water. It was a major problem, and sometimes our drinking water was too…green, but Cleric Dawn's Sisterhood has made progress with purifying and removing the salt from ocean water. If you find Blighted Water on this floor, bring it here and she'll demonstrate.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sea's Commitment ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dollar Store Mogloween Costume
quests.description: I'm hammering at the wheelchair, but Aria's fidgeting over there. That's good, it means she has enough energy to get restless. I think she wanted to see Tara, Mi, and Fa again. It would be too noticeable if all of us were up in the Sunlight Zone while travel between floors is suspended, but one at a time shouldn't catch any attention. But for them to be comfortable, we should get rid of those Infernal and Astravian Illusions.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sea's Commitment ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sea Snow Angels
quests.description: Dr. Rivale and the staff are doing everything they can to make our stay comfortable, so this isn't a complaint against them. Aria and I are going to keep our distance from the beach when we're ready to go home. We've had too much fish, too much salt, and will skip swimming for a while, knowing something like that Marine Snow is out there. Instead of sounding the alarm over another appearing, could you quietly get rid of it?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sea's Commitment ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ten Klicks
quests.description: This could be my mind playing tricks on me…I can hear clicking or whistling noises when we're down in the Twilight Zone. Aria and I will eventually have to return, and wait for the suspension on traveling between floors to be lifted. What if that Leviathan creature comes back? That would be a guaranteed mood spoiler after how much progress we've made on the gardens and wheelchair. Would you do me another favor and make sure that Leviathan won't come knocking?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sea's Commitment ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stalking Prey
quests.description: First things first! We gotta secure the perimeter. We were doing well until the hunters got in our way. I'm ashamed to admit it, but the horde has made a resurgence during our infight. I'd like to recruit your strength to help manage our defenses.

quests.name: Super Creeps
quests.description: Ghouls are common fare in this neck of Darkovia. They lack individual will, and feed on the flesh of the living. Individually they're easy work, but Mr. K tells me they're dangerous in hordes. Let's take care of them before they get to any residents.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sleepless Villagers
quests.description: I don't know how much Mr. K told you, but things aren't looking too hot. Apparently, a band of hunters were previously employed by the village when the monsters first started attacking. I think it's worth asking the villagers about the details. We should also investigate the premises while we're at it. We might just learn something important.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Suspicious Minds
quests.description: I see, these hunters are the contracted guards of this village. Makes sense why they're so territorial about it. Nothing we can do about that. There's just a couple of things I'd like to confirm. Collect a few samples of the monsters. I know it's more busy work for you, but I have my reasons.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Zappy's Legendary Quest
quests.description: Oh! Zappy is so glad to see you, Hero! My Legendary Pet Orb was stolen by the Endless Maw when the undead attacked. If you defeat him and bring it back to me, I will give you a pet to bring with you on your adventures.

quests.name: Harness the Elemental Fire
quests.description: We'll need to find the Elemental Fire; a sacred flame that any may seek, but only those worthy of being a Crypto Knight will find. You must gaze upon death, and defeat the monster with fourteen eyes if you wish to harness its true power. Once you have the Fire, bring it back to me.

quests.name: Recover the Crafter's Palladium
quests.description: To forge the armor we need what's left of our sacred Crafters Palladium. A precious alloy only commissioned for Crypto Knights by the Grand Inquisitor. Unfortunately due to the turn of the Inquisitor, he will not let go of the remaining pieces without a fight. Defeat the Grand Inquisitor and bring our precious Palladium home. I'm counting on you, hero.

quests.name: Salvage the Portal Key
quests.description: Find Revontheus, salvage what is ours and bring it to me.

quests.name: Find the Code, Become a Knight
quests.description: During my stay at Sleuthhound Inn many years ago, I hid a very important hard drive containing the code in an old bookcase for safekeeping. Go there, find it and return it to me. Do this and I will grant you our full arsenal. Be quick, hero. The longer we wait, the more chance the code will become corrupted.

quests.name: Juicy Yummies
quests.description: Hey! Hey you! You the one Bixx got beating up all the Makai, and stealing back his Moglinberry kegs! Not cool! We Makai deserve some juicy yummies, too! You go back there and steal some back for us! Smash on that BIG keg until it gives up the goods!

quests.name: Make Makai Strong
quests.description: You help Makai? Ok, good! You know all those Void Mages that hang around here trying to prey on the Moglins? We need their Void Magic. Make us strong. You get for us?

quests.name: Purgatorio Charade
quests.description: Life is a masquerade, but it's not until you die that you REALLY get to see the Divine Comedy that is existence. I've got a gift for you - several, in fact - if you prove that you can battle where others fear to tread.

quests.name: Dead Ringer... Master
quests.description: So. You've been to the underworld and back, and you STILL want more? You're a dead ringer for a tenacious terror I know well… ME. I want ONE thing from you. And one thing only: A copy of Dante's Divine Tragedy. You'll have to face death and return unscathed, but if you do… there's a chance I'll give you something near and dear to my heart.

quests.name: Void Spartan
quests.description: Long ago, there was an ancient civilization with fearsome warriors. A single warrior from their army could wipe out a group of elite assassins alone.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 20.

quests.name: Catering to Craftsmanship
quests.description: Business is booming, but I'll be cut right back down to size the minute my products run out. Gather up enough enchanted wood for me to restock the shelves. It's worth your while I guarantee, the products this lumber will help create would look great in whatever palace you reside.

quests.name: Some Disassembly Required
quests.description: We enchanted the Brightpool to protect Brightoak a few years ago after the risks of serving in our militia become too great. These guys are great at keeping creepy crawlies at bay but alas have taken a special liking to teething on my furniture. I can't sell something that's been slobbered on!

quests.name: Lend a Helping Handkerchief
quests.description: Restless, are we? Well, since you're already up, wanna make yourself useful?

quests.name: Two Eyes
quests.description: What are you looking at!?! No seriously, I can barely see you. Someone must have stolen my glasses when I dozed off. Fall asleep for 5 minutes and you get your prescription lenses stolen… classic. This man over here insists that a Vulture Man took 'em right off my face. Find my Square-framed Glasses, and I'll toss you some gold.

quests.name: Beards Rule!
quests.description: I saw you admiring my beard. Rules, doesn't it? But the only way to keep it in pristine condition is with an Epic Beard Comb. Unfortunately, I left my EBC in my suitcase which is currently under attack by Vulture Men. If you could bring me back my EBC from those Vultures, I'll show you a beard that is even cooler than Zazul's!

quests.name: Fancied Feather
quests.description: Enjoying the trip so far? You know, I've seen some big birds flying past these windows. I wish I could bring home one of their feathers to show my mother! If you happen to find a Vulture Man feather, I'll totally pay you for it. Promise!

quests.name: Requesting a Request
quests.description: When I was boarding the Zephyrus, I saw a dreamy guy walk past. I wanted to ask him for a Friend Request, but I was too shy at the time! Would be willing to deliver it for me? Alright, alright, *takes a breath* the guy was wearing a blue Gears University suit and had blonde spikey hair. Anyway, yeah, if you could just hand him my Friends Request… tehehehe Oh, and please bring me a Patience Elixir from a Vulture Man… stat!

quests.name: Watch Out!
quests.description: How much longer? I left my watch in my suitcase and MoreHawk over here won't stop gossiping long enough to actually tell me the time. You think you could help me out?

quests.name: Darkness is Energy
quests.description: Void is not only what you see. Hidden paths lie everywhere. Zep find you the one you need. Feeling SO tired, though. Might need a pick-me-up. The darkness is very tasty. What you get from the elementals is best.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' We Need a Guide ' quest.

quests.name: Reach the Vault
quests.description: Zep has shown you the path to Nulgath's vault of souls. Go down, down, down, until you find it. Zep will meet you there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Open the Vault
quests.description: Yes, OF COURSE vault is locked. Can't have just anyone rummaging round, stealing souls! Must slay Void Makai, summon vault guardian with their shadows. Slay guardian, and you will get the key.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find Another Path
quests.description: Now, you seek the contract, yes? Go back out the way you came. Meet Zep where you found him. He will show you another path.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Examine the Souls ' quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: More Energy for Zep
quests.description: Needs more energy from the darkness of the void before Zep can show you the way forward. Find me some. Get it from any Void monsters you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pass Through the Shadows
quests.description: To know the way into the Library, you need both shadow and light. Gather shadows from the Void Makai in the area. We will allow them to coagulate in the darkness. Then, collect the glowing eyes from the Void Elementals. Place them on the ground where Zep directs. Their dark light will illuminate the shadows, and allow them to be *seen*.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Find Contract
quests.description: Path here, in the library, is broken. Must find the correct contract. Where is it? Zep has no idea. How to get to the correct shelf? Couldn't tell ya. Careful not to fall - who knows what might would happen to you then?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Secret Map
quests.description: I am Zhoom, the Ranger. I was resting overnight here in the Inn, and there was a break in. Some Zardmen broke in and stole the chest containing the only map showing the safe pathways back to the Sandsea Desert! And they ALSO stole the key. I need you to go to the forest and get back that map! I'm sure they've given the key to their boss - so be careful! (Return to Zhoom in the Battleon Inn once you have obtained the Secret Map)

quests.name: Dissertations Bupers Camel
quests.description: Hero, have you heard about the elusive Bupers Camel? They were once though to only be a myth… a legend… but they are real AND have been spotted near the oasis. As a Ranger, it is my job to document such findings. I will pay you handsomely if you can write up a dissertation about Bupers Camels for me. Find these majestic beasts, defeat them, and document your discoveries.

quests.name: Crafty Creepers: A Favorite of Mine
quests.description: A strange new threat has presented itself to the Sandsea. Half cacti and half…something else… the Cactus Creepers have the uncanny knack of running towards unsuspecting victims and blowing up. We need to study them . Collect 8 Cactus Creeper heads and 2 Camel skulls or whatever is left… and bring them back to me. Good luck, hero.

quests.name: Sandport and Starboard
quests.description: The most imperative skill of a Ranger is familiarizing oneself with the surroundings. The Sandsea Port is a new uncharted area to you… so get an idea of the scenery before taking any others course of action. Scout the Sandsea Port and return to me with your findings.

quests.name: Shark Diving
quests.description: Before the unnatural sandstorm consumed the entire Sandsea, a massive river once ran through the land, providing the inhabitants with fresh water, a convenient trade-route, and thriving marine life. Now all that is left in this barren place are dangerously mutated Sandsharks. We must cut down their numbers before they migrate to the Oasis and cause serious damage. Bring back 8 Sandshark Teeth and I will award you with more than just my thanks.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Thieving Cut Throats
quests.description: This once wealthy port is now overrun with Tomb Robbers who are looking to steal anything they can get their grubby hands on. I think it's only fair we give them a taste of their own medicine.. or in this case, steal from the stealers. Confront the Tomb Robbers and take back what's neither ours nor theirs!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lost and Found
quests.description: It is a shame to think some people (… and sharks) stoop so low for a little extra jingle in their gold purses. Tomb Robbers and Sandsharks have stolen precious Sandsea treasures from the ancient Sek Duat pyramids. It's not right and beyond damaging to the Sandsea history! Bring back the 14 missing Sandsea Relics and I will be sure to return them to their proper resting ground.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sell-Sword Sell-Outs
quests.description: A group of Horc Sell-Swords are mingling at the far reaches of the Sandsea Port. Sell-swords are hired mercenaries and I suspect Zahart hired them as his personal guard. Defeat ALL FOUR Horc Sell Swords and maybe we will get our answers -- act first, ask questions later, I always say!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sacred Scarabs
quests.description: Scarab beetles are depicted throughout the Sek-Duat's Pyramids as a symbol of worship. But it appears that more than just their likeliness floods the passageways now! If we hope to reach the chamber of Sek-Duat, we must first thin the Scarab numbers or face an all-out swarm. Collect 8 Golden Scarab Shells and bring them to me. They will also fetch a nice price at the Oasis market…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sell-Sword Sell-Outs ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Noob is Guard
quests.description: You must have encountered the Anubis Deathguards by now. With such high numbers, these guards made up Sek-Duat's army, offering their servitude to the god-king of the Sandsea. Little did the Deathguards know that serving an immortal king would have such… permanent… consequences. Free the spirits of 10 Anubis Deathguards so that they can finally be at rest with their loved ones.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sell-Sword Sell-Outs ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bandaged Aids
