quests.description: Sek-Duat's most trusted servants and right-hand aids were his mummies. Seeing as to how they were already dead, his mummies made the best bodyguards any god-king could hope for. If we tried to break into Sek-Duat's chamber right now, there would be no end to their mummified onslaught. Defeat enough mummies to collect their wraps so that they cannot respawn a new army of undead servants!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sell-Sword Sell-Outs ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Keys to the Royal Chamber
quests.description: It is now time to enter Sek-Duat's royal chamber. Only problem is… we need a key. And if I was an immortal god-king, I would have broken the key apart and hidden the pieces throughout my palace. And I bet Sek-Duat did the same thing. I don't know who (or what) he entrusted the key pieces with… but it's time we find out. See if any pyramid inhabitants can "help" us out…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sell-Sword Sell-Outs ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Confront Duat
quests.description: We have the keys. Now it is time to confront Sek-Duat. I cannot promise what will happen once we enter the chamber… so be on your guard. I know I will be.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sell-Sword Sell-Outs ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dreamsand
quests.description: Sek-Duat has played us for fools. I know we can beat him to the lamp if we hurry but we will need something first. The Lotus Spiders make a rare substance called Dreamsand. Get me some as fast as you can.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Seek The Treasure ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: I Dream Of...
quests.description: Quickly, we must hurry to the treasure room before Sek-Duat gets the lamp!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Seek The Treasure ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sandsational Castle
quests.description: On the edge of the Oasis stands what appears to be a deserted castle. It's not buried in the sands of time, it's MADE from them! Before we go charging through the halls of this house of sandstone and light, it'd be a good idea for you to explore its layout and see what information you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Dream Of... ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Furry Fury
quests.description: I have heard of ancient Sandsea rulers keeping hyenas in menageries, wild animal parks kept to awe visitors. It does not surprise me that Adofo realized how useful such dangerous beasts would be as guards, OR that Zahart has conscripted them. Neutralize the threat they present by clearing 10 War Hyenas out of the Castle.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Dream Of... ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Keeping Secrets Under Wraps
quests.description: Adofo's War Mummies were his most trusted servants and guards, and now it's likely they're working for Zahart. See if they know anything about what we can expect when we find that maniacal magician and his ingenius djinn!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Dream Of... ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gem Jam
quests.description: I've just scouted the menagerie gate out. It seems the gate was opened by five gems, but they appear to have been pried from their settings. See if you can find them on the Mummy Minions and War Hyenas. Collect 5 Gate Gems and return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Dream Of... ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Enter the Sphinx
quests.description: There is only one explanation for this. Zahart is here. And if he has enchanted a Sphinx-one of the most mysterious and powerful of the mythical guardians… there's no telling what he'll be able to do if we don't stop him! You MUST remove this weapon from Zahart's arsenal!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Dream Of... ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Beta Berserker: Secret Map Quest
quests.description: Can you believe it? While I was gone, the Zardmen stole my map… AGAIN! I am in need of a Beta Berserker to recover it for me. You'll find them in the forest to the right of the Guardian Tower. Bring it back to me and I will give you an armor version of the Beta Berserker Class!
quests.requirements_note: Must have at least 1 Class Point on Beta Berserker in your inventory.

quests.name: Dark Ranger Corps
quests.description: Look, Hero. Rangers are the elite - they move fast, kill cleanly, and make LOTS of gold. But it's hard to find a good, dark ranger armor these days. But I've got you covered. Bring me 6 rolls of grunt leather from the Zardmen Grunts and 2 vials of Black Dye from Big Jack Sprat and I'll help you out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 10 Sandsea .

quests.name: Anqa al-Mughrib
quests.description: Anqa has risen from the ashes, burning hotter than ever. Can you quell her flames once again?

quests.name: The Immortal Firebird
quests.description: The immortal Firebird Anqa has become a plague that spreads destruction, enraged that Sek-Duat has ruled the Sandsea unjustly for fifteen generations. He is not here to answer for his actions, so we will. Fight Anqa, and Crulon and I will purify her rage when she falls.

quests.name: A Herd of Black Sheep
quests.description: The guards I sent ahead of us to the Tomb encountered familiar trouble. It's the infamous Camlan Elves that gave themselves to the Shadows. They're already here. I assume that you, Gravelyn, and Tara wouldn't mind helping me capture them?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Lost in Me ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Apep's Minders
quests.description: The Elves were accompanied by suits of living armor possessed by Shadows: the same kind that were present at the attack on Battleon. They're purple as opposed to the usual edgy red. Let's get them out of the way, and see if the Empress has any idea why they changed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Lost in Me ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Primeval Discord
quests.description: The situation may have taken the most foul turn possible, so much so that my initial offer to Gravelyn could be back on the table. Take down as many Elves and suits of Armor as you can. The poison…no, the corruption tainting the river has to be stopped.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Lost in Me ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hissing Hatchlings
quests.description: Deeper into the Tomb is more proof that the Shadows and Chaos are intermingling. Umbral Serpents, similar to the shadowy snakes that attacked Battleon and infested Camlan, are poisoning the waters. Cut them down, and cast their bodies out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Lost in Me ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: How the Mighty Have Fallen
quests.description: You don't look very happy to see that artifact hunter over there. Do you know her? I feel bad about putting you in this situation, but we do need to get as much information about the Tomb's infestation as we can.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Lost in Me ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dog Water
quests.description: The Hounds were the original protectors of this tomb, but they've been Chaorrupted. We'll need to destroy them to purge the poison, and keep them from swiping at Ginx and her exploration partner. She won't be able to get the doors open if she's injured.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Lost in Me ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Poor Costume Choice
quests.description: Ginx's exploration partner's finally awake, and should probably be made aware that wearing that kind of cowl would get him killed by a mob these days. He seems… unwell. Talk to him, and gather Blue Lotuses from inside the tomb. I can make a simple poultice out of them to soothe his pain.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Lost in Me ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaotic Little Joys
quests.description: Ginx is satisfied that her companion is conscious. She'll be able to force the inner chamber's doors open, so long as we don't arrest them for trespassing. To make that happen, she's asked us to slay more of the Serpents and Hounds.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Lost in Me ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rite of Apophis
quests.description: A serpent, larger and more deadlier than the worms that followed her into this tomb, is using magic to corrupt the healing waters. It seems this Chantress is serving a higher power. We need to stop her!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Lost in Me ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slithering Chaos
quests.description: Before we leave, I want to see if we can learn more about the Chaorruption. Where did it come from, and is it infecting the Shadows too? Let's investigate the Serpents, the Hounds, and the Chantress.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rite of Apophis ' quest.

quests.name: Shadow Duat Medal
quests.description: Duat, the capital city of the Sandsea, is being invaded by Shadows empowered by a force we haven't seen since Chaos Lord Tibicenas' defeat. The Lightguard and Shadowscythe are defending the walls. We'll hunt down anything that slips through.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rite of Apophis ' quest.

quests.name: Mega Shadow Duat Medal
quests.description: The people look to me for leadership, but I look to you for support. We need to keep the invaders from seeping further into the city of Duat. They've suffered in the shadow of Sek-Duat's reign for long enough. I won't let literal Shadows terrorize them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rite of Apophis ' quest.

quests.name: Funerary Shesepankh
quests.description: Umbral Sphinxes are appearing inside the palace, hunting everyone that was taking shelter there. They're prowling the halls in packs, and their screeches are driving everyone mad! I'll shoot them down, and you'll finish them off.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rite of Apophis ' quest. | Must have completed either of the previous quests. Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 25%.

quests.name: Old Guarde
quests.description: Warriors adorned in violet armor are appearing inside the palace. They resemble my Royal Guards, but they're attacking everyone that was taking shelter from the battle outside. We'll take them down. I need to know who's under those helmets.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rite of Apophis ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 25%.

quests.name: Enemy of the Sun
quests.description: The Chantress from the Lotus Tomb is back, or is this a sister of hers that was freed from the tomb? Regardless, she is a powerful priestess and we can't let her welcome the Shadows back into the palace.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rite of Apophis ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 50%.

quests.name: Doomed Heir
quests.description: The Condemned Shadows' greatest warrior has arrived, and he's surging towards the royal mummies hidden beneath the throne! That's Dryden? The Doom Triad's Champion? He's…practically a child in Elven terms. I see. Then our clash is inevitable.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rite of Apophis ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 100%.

quests.name: Eclipsed Memory
quests.description: There's no time to waste. Tara and Gravelyn are in danger, and the Chaotic haze outside grows thicker. We'll venture into this tomb, and defeat the Sphinx guarding the way. If possible, ask Sek-Duat about this place. He must know it well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Doomed Heir ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Sons in Spirit
quests.description: While my guards have been tasked with protecting the people, Apophis and Neith's Royal Guards dutifully guard this tomb. Don't expect to get past them without a fight. I'll join you, though it might be hard to aim arrows while keeping an eye on Sek-Duat and the frail hooded man.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Doomed Heir ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cleopatra's Asp
quests.description: I found scraps of what I thought were old scrolls, but they were something else. When I touched them, I could see and feel events from the past. Be on the lookout for shed snakes kin. We could learn more about the enemy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Doomed Heir ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Canopic Guardians
quests.description: We've gleaned all that we can from here. Take down the rest of the Guards and the Sphinxes. They're fiercely loyal to their Pharaoh and her Shadow, willingly being entombed with them. We'll give them a Sandsea warrior's burial.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Doomed Heir ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lum'ah
quests.description: Deeper into the tomb are the mummies that belong to Neith's predecessors - forgotten royalty. They need to be put back to rest, but there's a bigger concern. Astero's here, and he wants to talk to us. Come. I already have an answer.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Doomed Heir ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Asyut's Hounds
quests.description: Look! Stairs made of floating crystals, and atop them are Anubian Overseers. They're mythical beings said to be incarnations of Death, risen to preserve order and serve a worthy Pharaoh. Perhaps they've been chaorrupted. In that case, we'll free them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Doomed Heir ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaotic Magnetism
quests.description: Notice the giant inverted pyramid above our head? It's a bit hard to miss. There's a hole in it, and I think Apophis 'hatched' out of there. Let's look around. Maybe we can find more of those Scales, and they'll help us understand what Apophis is up to.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Doomed Heir ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Warrior's Death
quests.description: Your hooded companion said that if we gather the chaotic essence of the Anubians and Mummies, he can use them to eavesdrop on their masters. We can do better than that if we can find another piece of Apophis' scales, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Doomed Heir ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Uraeus
quests.description: I'm ready whenever you are, friend. Like Pharaoh Neith said, Apophis needs more time to gather his power. She'll try to stop us, or stall for as long as possible. I'll face her with you, Ruler to Ruler.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Doomed Heir ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragon of Duat
quests.description: Apophis had taken a new form, or rather…he returned to his original form. The Umbral Chaos, a Shadow hated and loved. I've made my choice, and your hooded companion has agreed to work with me. All that's left is to face Apophis head on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Doomed Heir ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Whims of Man and Beast
quests.description: I still need time to recover, but the Lectors and Lorekeepers are eager to explore the tomb. Would you mind helping them gather materials for their research? They're interested in the Anubian Overseers, Neith, and Apophis.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragon of Duat ' quest.

quests.name: A Gift of Plums
quests.description: I remember being in the grove outside of Akiba. I wanted to bring a gift of plums to the Empress. I strapped a basket to my back, and picked the nicest ones from the plum trees.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Smell that Smell ' quest.

quests.name: A Taste of Truffles
quests.description: All this had made me so hungry! I had accomplished what I set out to do, so I decided to reward myself with some of the truffles I found nearby.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Om Nom Nom
quests.description: And then, shuffling through the grass, I saw it! The biggest truffle I'd ever seen! It ran from me, and I tracked it, following its spores.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Follow the Tracks
quests.description: I had followed that monster truffle right into a pit! I knew it was dangerous for me to stay underground, where all manner of evil spirits reside. But I saw some tracks leading away from where I'd fallen in. If I followed them, I might find my way out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get out of Here!
quests.description: The tracks led me to what looked like a dead end. But at the end of the tunnel was a pile of rocks, and the tracks stopped dead. Could there have been a cave in? I rammed the rocks with all my strength, and broke free.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Smackdown!
quests.description: I finally made it to the surface! I was just outside of Akiba City. But I was so tired. I had time to take a short nap, and I laid down under a tree. But the Xingzhi wouldn't stop pestering me. I had to smack them away.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Acorn
quests.description: Then, under the biggest tree, I saw the biggest acorn I'd ever seen. Its smell, earthy and nutty, was so tempting. As soon as I'd eaten it, my mind started to feel cloudy, and I felt so tired I could hardly stand. I down under the tree and fell asleep.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Let Me Out!
quests.description: What a jerk! I don't like hurting people, but if that's the only way she'll let me out of here, she's going to find out what these tusks feel like! You've got my back, right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Reagents for Zifwin
quests.description: Friend! I need some help restocking my reagents. Bring me some, and I'll pay you in gold… and maybe even in magic! I'll need 3 batches of Moglinberries, 2 vials of Trollola Nectar, and a handful of Nimblestem.

quests.name: How Rude!
quests.description: Ziri waited and waited at Yulgar's Inn for the Hero to arrive - apparently heroes take their sweet time when meeting with a sneevil. How rude! So, Ziri was left to amuse himself. Had a little too much moglinberry juice, knocked over all the candles in the inn. But Hero was not amused. Hero totally ignored Ziri's attempsts at conversation and stated putting out ALL the fires Ziri had made!

quests.name: Bar Fight!
quests.description: While the Hero was putting out Ziri's fires, Ziri took out his frustration on the other patrons at the Inn. You've never seen a bar fight so big! Everyone was hitting everyone! But, Hero wanted to rain on that parade too. Started knocking everyone out so they couldn't fight anymore.

quests.name: Number Two
quests.description: While Hero was busy breaking up the fight, Ziri was busy breaking up the bathroom! Actually, this one was unintentional - Ziri did not MEAN to clog up the toilet like that. Ziri DID mean to lock the bathroom door and hide the key in a regular's pocket, though. Thought it would be better if this mess went unnoticed for a while.

quests.name: Forget the Mess
quests.description: Ziri started to panic, and wished for a bunch of monsters to appear! What better way to distract the Hero and make everyone forget all about that mess in the bathroom?

quests.name: The Chosen One!
quests.description: That's right, Ziri had transported the Hero to the Fabled Flying Bacon Cat Cloud Palace! First, Hero had to prove worthiness to enter its golden halls! How, you ask? Hero had to guess the secret password!

quests.name: BACON PIZZA!
quests.description: Obviously, the Hero could not be allowed to leave until he had gathered enough bacon and pizza for Ziri's favorite snack - BACON PIZZA!

quests.name: No More Clowns!
quests.description: The Hero was the one spoken of in the Bacon Cat prophecy - which means Hero is the one who will finally fight off the Endless Army of Infinite Clowns! Go, Hero, go! Save the Flying Bacon Cat Cloud Palace from their greasepaint onslaught!

quests.name: Life's a Beach
quests.description: Then, the Hero found out beautiful beach - Litter Beach! Where all of the flying Bacon Cats bury their brown nugget of joy! Some of them were starting to peek out of the "sand", so Hero decided to scroop them all. Not sure why, they don't smell THAT bad. Maybe Hero mistook them for tootsie rolls?

quests.name: Not all Sand is Cat Litter
quests.description: Oh, no! Ziri sees the problem, now! Too much unscooped Bacon Cat poop causes stinky elementals to form! Ziri feeling highly disturbed. Ziri WISHED for Hero to fight those gross elementals and make them GONE!

quests.name: King Strong
quests.description: Ziri WISHED the Hero into his favorite video game: King Strong! Ziri smashed boxes, defeated the evil King Strong and saved the beautiful Princess Mogline! Well, technically Hero did it, but Ziri was in control!

quests.name: Snack Man!
quests.description: Next, Ziri wanted to play a new game! Here, Hero had to navigate a maze of edible dots, eating all 4 POWER UPS!

quests.name: Ghost Busting
quests.description: After Hero ate all the big dots, ghosts got SO EASY to defeat! Hero mopped the FLOOR with them!

quests.name: Super Ziri Brothers
quests.description: Ziri really wished to play a sidescroller after that, so he WISHED the Hero into Super Ziri Brothers! Hero had to beat up all the evil turtles and collect all the Power Flowers! Only then could we face… Horcio!

quests.name: It's-A-Me
quests.description: Finally, Hero was able to face this game's surprising boss - HORCIO! Ber honest, you were expecting a bigger turtle, weren't you?

quests.name: Massive Corn-fusion
quests.description: Ziri got bored with games, dropped Hero back in the Palace. Where Hero had to fight… giant… CORN MONSTERS! Yeah! SO MANY CORN MONSTERS!

quests.name: Organic Victory
quests.description: The Hero kept fighting all the Corn Minions, and… it summoned their master! Can you guess who it is? COME ON, GUESS! NO! You're WRONG! It was… Non-GMO Brutalcorn!!!

quests.name: Make a Wish
quests.description: After defeating Non-GMO Brutalcorn, Hero found what he had been guarding - a wishing well! Hero picked up a gold on to make a wish on. and then jumped into the well with it.

quests.name: Smell This!
quests.description: Hero LEFT the flying Bacon Cat Cloud Palace! That isn't how a member of the legendary BACON CAT FORCE behaves! Ziri wished Hero into a room full of DARK. A worthy adventurer would be able to find their way out by using sense of smell alone. Was Hero worthy?? Ziri watched as Hero battled the invisivle scent trail so he could find out!

quests.name: Trial of being SMALL
quests.description: Ok, so maybe Hero doesn't need to see to win. But, does Hero understand the plight of a small, misunderstood Sneevil like Ziri? Ziri WISHED Hero was tiny like a mouse! Challenged Hero to fight anthropomorphized food, had to make Ziri a snack of buttered mashed potatoes before this trial could end.

quests.name: King of the Unbread
quests.description: Ugh! Hero managed to beat this trial TOO. So Ziri extended it. Made Hero fight… the King of the Unbread!

quests.name: Evil Undead!
quests.description: FINE. Hero may be undead, but Ziri will still get this movie made! Ziri sent hordes of TOUGHT GUYS WITH CHAINSAWS after the Hero! That is to say… Ziri sent actors. Hero took all their chainsaw props away.

quests.name: Pala-dinner
quests.description: Fine! You know what? Ziri didn't like this set ANYWAY. Ziri sent the Hero into a set of… Yulgar's Inn! Yulgar is a dangerous place for an undead hero - especially when there are all these PALADINS!

quests.name: Kitty Boo Boo, Overlord of the Catverse
quests.description: Oh, that's right! It's ON! Ziri's pulling out the big guns now! It's time for the hero to fight… KITTY BOO BOO: OVERLORD OF THE CATVERSE!

items_required.name: Kitty Boo Boo Put Back In The Carrier

quests.name: Stop Hitting Yourself!
quests.description: Who would have thought? The Hero's most worthy opponent was… the Hero? Ziri was really hoping it would be him. =(

quests.name: Cloud Sharks!
quests.description: Do you see those fins sticking up from under the clouds? Those are… CLOUD SHARKS! Those are NOT supposed to be here! Our Bacon Cat Force Headquarters is supposed to be safe! Get rid of those toothy nasties - bring Ziri… let's see… bring him their cloudy hides as proof! (That's a good quest, right?)

quests.name: Get Those Waffle Cones Ready
quests.description: A problem has been brought to Ziri's attention! The sharks are eating all of his ice cream. Your mission is this: find the room with 5 doors in it. Go through the one with the ice cream cone drawn on it. And then GET ZIRI'S ICE CREAM BACK FROM THE SHARKS.

quests.name: Grody
quests.description: Ziri needs something to kill this fishy taste. Go back into the ice cream room and find Ziri some nice, big lemon drops. Lemon kills fishy taste, right? Also, beat up fishies again and get Ziri some cherries to go on top of his sundae!

quests.name: We're Gonna Need A Bigger Eraser
quests.description: Can you believe it? The Laser Shark Brigade has even invaded Ziri's Sketchy Room… with… Sketchy Sharks! We're going to need a REALLY BIG eraser for this one! If you go to /battleontown and talk to Loremaster Maya in the Librarium, maybe she'll sell you a really big pencil! Ziri hears that ALL the Loremasters use them.

quests.name: Second Draft
quests.description: Ok, ok SO! Now… you are gonna go into the door with the stick figure on it, and use that big pencil to ERASE all of these nasty, sketchy sharks! And then… hmm… we should draw other, nicer things in their place, right? Yeah! Do that! (Only available once per login)

quests.name: Game on!
quests.description: There are 8-bit sharks in the 8-bit room, too!?! Ok, here is what you do! Ziri has some secret cheat codes. Remember when Ziri put you in that Super Ziri Brothers game last week? Well, you have to go back there. Fight the turtles and flower-things. Make 'em cough up the codes.

quests.name: Game Sharks
quests.description: Ok, you ready for this? Now you have to go into Ziri's 8-bit room! It's the one with the on the door. And.. enter the cheat codes to POWER UP! Then, kick the snout out of those 8-bit sharks! (Only available once per login)

quests.name: Save the Kittarians
quests.description: Augh! What's happening in the Monorail Cat room? Those are not Kittarians! What have they done with Ziri's precious kitties?! Hero, you have to fix it! Beat up these sharks in cat's clothing! And take back the Kittarian's clothes, spoons, and pitchforks!

quests.name: Bacon Cat Force Needs YOU!
quests.description: Oh, you thought we were done here? No, no! Ziri isn't done! You want to impress Ziri, you keep on beating up those sharkies! Bring Ziri… hmmm…

quests.name: Ziri Is Also Tough
quests.description: Ziri wants to make some really big party streamers to decorate his lair, bu like… he wants to make them out of shark teeth. Because these sharkies need to SEE that the Bacon Cat Force won't be messed with! That's right, Ziri isn't all fun and games! Sometimes he's tough, just like his friend Pax! So, when you're out there beating up baddies, could you maybe nab some trophies for Ziri?

quests.name: Robo Sharks!
quests.description: Ok, so, to start with, Ziri would really like it if you would just take out some of these horrible, walking laser sharks that are clanging around all over his HQ, thank you. Sharks should not walk!

quests.name: Beat the Bushes
quests.description: Ziri thinks there are sharks hiding in the terrarium room! Smack some of these cardboard bushes around and see what comes out!

quests.name: Sharks Should Not Walk
quests.description: Eeeek! They're here, they're here! Make them go away!

quests.name: Grab those Quarters
quests.description: Argh! Sharks are in the arcade! You have to make sure nasty sharkie doesn't get the high score on any of Ziri's games! Beat them up and take their quarters!

quests.name: Shark Invaders!
quests.description: Noooo! One of them is ALREADY PLAYING! Quick, go into the game and make sure it doesn't win! That's right! Just… go right into the game!

quests.name: Sharks like Honey?
quests.description: Argh! The Laser Shark Brigade is in the Bee Room eating all our honey! You gotta get it back! Beat em up and take it from them! And then… put it back in the honeycomb! (Only available once per login)

quests.name: At Least They Like to Party
quests.description: These evil meanies are even tearing up the party room! Can you believe it?! Get our party hats and feather boas back from these party shark bullies! And then clean up the mess they made! (Only available once per login)

quests.name: Remora Brigade
quests.description: Red alert! Red alert! The Bacon Cat Force is fighting the Laser Remora Brigade on the bridge! Go in there and help them hold them off!

quests.name: Into the Whirlpool
quests.description: Oh hey! This is new. There didn't use to be a whirlpool in that room past the bridge. That must be where the sharks are getting in! Our treasure room is RIGHT THERE OFF TO THE SIDE BEHIND THOSE KITTY STATUES, so that must be what they're after! Quick, we gotta jump into that whirlpool and stop them!

quests.name: Giant, Huge Cyborg Shark!
quests.description: Holy poop! That is a huge shark! He must be the Laser Shark Brigade's leader! Take him down, and we take them all down!

quests.name: Dig Deep
quests.description: To craft your sword, Basklar Ore, you will need. The strongest metal on Lore, it is. Deep in /Dwarfhold in the belly of Glow Worms, the ore resides. 8 chunks, I will need.

quests.name: The Fire Within
quests.description: Something hot to smelt down the ore and mold it, we will need. In a /firestorm, far away, tales of living fires, there are. Burn so hot, melt anything, they will! Collect pure Fire Essence you must.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spare Parts
quests.description: All the hard parts, we have gathered. The innards, we may begin work on. Head over to /TheSpan, harvest parts from the Training Globes, you must. Smelt the ore in your absence, I will.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Diplomatic Solution
quests.description: Concentrate..look deep within yourself and clear your mind. Ommm…ommm..Gah! Working, this is not! Need a bigger, less cluttered space we do. Just the place, I know. For some aggressive negotiations with Zorba the Bakk, it is time. Enter his chamber, and clear him out. Clear your mind, then you must.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Path of Good
quests.description: A wise choice, you have made. Make the journey to stand against /Greed. Battle Goregold and resist the temptation of greed and stand bravely against its corruption you shall. Its defeat will mean your success and will empower your blade with its power.

quests.name: The Path of Evil
quests.description: A nefarious choice, your journey will be one of contempt and strength. Power will come from crushing those who stand in your way, it will. Only two may rule, go to his /Murdermoon and Defeat Fifth Sepulchure. Rise to unseen heights you will. Crushing him in battle will empower your blade.

quests.name: The Path of Chaos
quests.description: An inauspicious start to your path. A path full of twists, turns, and unpredictable outcomes. The power you seek within a powerful foe it leys. Travel to their plane to uproot /Ledgermayne. Your sword will absorb their stray power and awaken the power within.

quests.name: Search the Pit
quests.description: Take generations to digest whatever it consumes, Zorblatt's species can! Get really messy in there, what goodies you may find we know not. Enter his pit and beat him up you must!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either of the previous quests.

quests.name: Bandages Needed
quests.description: Pity poor Zognax! Soundly defeated by such a strong hero, and now he is far too weak to be any use to anyone. Help him become strong again, and he will help you in return!

quests.name: Shinies!
quests.description: Zognax is hurting a little less now, but feeling sad. If you made Zognax happy, he might trust you. Might open up. Bringing him shiny things might help.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Plushies
quests.description: Shinies are nice, but maybe Zognax really needs something to hug. Might be in more of a mood to help if he had something like that.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sleepies
quests.description: Zognax is much happier now, but *yaaaaaawn* -so - so sleepy! Find something to wake him up. Then maybe you talk.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What's Next?
quests.description: Zognax's Wounds will heal, but the air and earth of this world is choking him, sickening him. You'll need to get Some kind of concentrated toxin up herre to spread in his cage. But where would you get such a thing? Better check with Gravelyn - she might have some ideas.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Stink-tuary
quests.description: Mehehe. Pretty ripe, the last humans to use the mall were. My undead in an unmanageable frenzy are. Around the mall, my favorite incense, "Rotting Noses & Dying Roses," you should place. CLICK ON THE SPARKING ARROWS you must!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Zorbak's Hideout ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Infected
quests.description: Feh. The last time humans the swamp as sanctuary used, one of the heroes crazy went, and the ghouls bit, not around the other way. Backwards bonehead. Starting to turn… normal, the Undead are. Talking about golf and accounting, they are! Get rid of them or infect the rest they will!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Zorbak's Hideout ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chopping Spree
quests.description: In the middle of a highly complex experiment right now I am. Understand it you wouldn't, hmmm? But running out of parts I am. Time to go chopping at the Maul for parts I have not. In my place I need you to go. Some necrotized resources bring back. Fresh they must be!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Zorbak's Hideout ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: GraveStop The Creature
quests.description: What? No! Creation, stop you must! Command you I do! Your master I am! Stooooop! Hero! That demented pile of parts, subdue you must! Into the GraveStop Game Shop, it was headed…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Zorbak's Hideout ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Like T-shirts to a Flame
quests.description: Mehehe! I WANT MY GOLD! A T-shirt manufacturing plant put my face on a shirt… and I didn't get a cut! Any CEO dumb enough to do that gets fired! Gather 13 Matchsticks and 13 Cans of Oil from the Living Fires and Sulfur Imps in Firestorm. IF you succeed, I'll give YOU a share of the gold. Heh.

quests.name: I Bless the Rains Down in Lore
quests.description: Some numbskull just ran by screaming that Alteon's Knights are on the way. Something about a fire… Meh. YOU had better make sure we don't get caught. Go get 13 Water Bottles and 13 Spray Bottles from Waterstorm. I'll trick that bonehead into putting out the flames while we book it. Mehehe.

quests.name: The Wind Beneath My Moglin
quests.description: You think someone's going to blame me? Pffft. If anyone, they'll think it was you. Heroes are getting into trouble. Mehehe. But i don't want any trace pointing back at ME, so bring me back 24 Jars of Wind from the Wind Elementals and living Airs in Airstorm. We'll sweep away the evidence.

quests.name: 17th Anniversary Gifts
quests.description: You heroes love to eat cake, and I love a good /party crash. Let's make some magic, mehehehe!

items.name: Chaotic Birthday Hero Character Page Badge
Twilly's Birthday Hero Character Page Badge

quests.name: Out of Love
quests.description: I'm not really feeling the love here right now, especially with the Hopeless Romantics and the Baristas. They've become… a bit hostile. Can you calm them down pretty please? I can tell that they're all out of love, but I'm too afraid to get close to them in case they turn me into bacon.

quests.name: Conflagration Combo Badge
quests.description: Retrieve flames from the Skeletal Fire Mage in /PortalUndead to unlock the combination badge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have DeepSea Collection Companion and Molten Mayhem Collection Chest in your inventory.

items.name: Summer 2025 Conflagration Combo Character Page Badge

quests.name: Cursed Artifact Shop
quests.description: If you want more information about the artifact you've got in the box, you'll need to talk to the shopkeeper. He is an expert on this sort of thing! Just head to the right and go into the Cursed Artifact Shop.

quests.name: Lamps, Painting and Chairs, oh my!
quests.description: There is something very strange about this Antique shop. It's almost like the very contents are out to get you! Make your way (or BREAK your way..) through the shop and get rid of that Antique Chair that's blocking your way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The (Un)Dresser
quests.description: Everything in this shop is possessed! There are floating Opera Glasses, creepy walking dolls and lamps that attack when you walk near them, but the furniture is the worst! Defeat the UnDresser in order to go deeper into the shop!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ghost Stories
quests.description: Every time I sat down at the Writing Desk in there, my letters turn into ghost stories. Defeat the Writing Desk and move deeper into the shop. You must find out what is causing the haunting!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: You Can't Tell Time
quests.description: The curse has moved through the shop, letting nothing escape its path. Even the timepieces have been affected, but none worse than the Grandfather Clock. Defeat the Clock to move deeper into the shop.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Arcane Sentinel
quests.description: Uh oh - opening that dresser drawer seems to have gotten the attention of Darkwood's magical defense mechanism - it's sent something big after you! Better defeat it so that you can nab the robe and get the heck out of here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dr. Darkwood's Robe ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Loot the UnDresser (Farming Quest)
quests.description: There's a lot more in that UnDresser, it looks like! Go bash it up a bite and see what falls out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fuzzy Run Minigame
quests.description: This is a magical Rainbow that will lead us back to Chaos Beleen. But… we will need to harness the power of Chaos Fuzzies in order to cross it unscathed (and without falling through the rainbow upon our first step!). Help me collect 30 Chaos Fuzzies, and then the Rainbow will offer safe voyage to the other side.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Citadorable Plot ' quest.

quests.name: Train Evil's Army for the Alliance!
quests.description: If the Alliance is to prosper, Empress Gravelyn's undead army must be highly skilled. Head down the hall to the right and find the training room. Show 10 of them your combat moves so they may learn your techniques.

quests.name: Chaos in Hachiko
quests.description: Word has arrived of an underground movement in Hachiko. the Samurai there may have all been Chaoruppted! Hurry there and interrogate any you see to discern the truth. We MUST learn the truth.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Hounds of Good
quests.description: The Empress needs warrior drakhounds, and wants to turn Shadowfalls puppies undead to serve. That should not be! They have not had a chance to really live… and they look hungry. Quest all through Shadowfall to find 9 of the pups and slay 7 Fear Munchers to feed them. We can find other warriors for the empress.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Dragon Egg Savior!
quests.description: The Empress has heard of a new clutch of dragon eggs in /Lair. She does not want to take the chance that they may be turned to Chaos, but I cannot agree to destroying dragons. Save the 8 eggs to prevent Drakath from Chaorrupting the dragonets which will one day hatch.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Rescue Poisonforest Villagers
quests.description: All I know is that the Empress has staged a bandit attack on a nearby town. She will not tell me why. Rescue the 5 villagers in Poisonforest and slay the bandits attacking them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Swordhaven Candy Return
quests.description: Evil comes in all degrees, from lies to slaughter to simple theft… but I know your heart is Good. I hear some nefarious Evildoer has stolen the candy right out of Swordhaven citizens' hands. Give their candy back and return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Shadows of the Past
quests.description: If the Empress is to serve the Alliance to the best of her ability and reign over all of Lore, she needs to be free from doubt. She cannot be plagued by the shadows of the past. Head to her jail, uncover the hatch to Sepulchure's crypt, and slay the shadow of her past
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Slayer of Chaos?
quests.description: Are you a hand of the Alliance , or do you serve Chaos? Slay any of the Monsters infected by Chaos, retrieve the Chaos Gems they prossesess, and you will have a chance to get the Chaos Slayer Armor or Helm.

quests.name: Festive Festa Floats
quests.description: I need your help making Carnaval floats! This should be really fun-but challenging! I need 5 Festive Feathers from Cuco, 3 Float Thingumajigs from Terra da Festa monsters, 5 wood planks from Terra Trees and 2 White Streamers from the Lady in White. Bring everything back and Cysero and I can help make floats for Carnaval. Good luck, hero!

quests.name: Make a Muiraquitã
quests.description: Carnaval needs happiness and good luck! So let us make a Muiraquitã amulet! Collect Green Clay from the Lagoon and Boiúna, and then capture the fire from Mula Sem Cabe๺ to solidify the Muiraquitã amulet.

quests.name: Unknown Alloy for Blacksmithing
quests.description: There is no weapon that cannot be made better. Think of it like a smoothie, the more berries the better! I prefer to work with freshly blended alloys and keep the secret ingredients secret. Mysterious and unknown alloys just make for a more interesting result!

quests.name: Volatile Temper Agent for Blacksmithing
quests.description: Oh! You brought my spicy seasoning. Those will be great for my Spork of Immense PAIN, Blade of Insurmountable Turkey or even Steve!

quests.name: Glowing Temper Agent for Blacksmithing
quests.description: Well of course I can use more Glowing Temper Agent, how else do you expect my amazing work to be so amazing?

quests.name: Masterful Metallurgy
quests.description: Some light-enchanted metal would be useful to practice with. Maybe Artix in the Necropolis would know where to find some.

quests.name: Advanced Alloying
quests.description: Some darkness-enchanted metal would be useful to practice with. Maybe Vayle in the Necropolis would know where to find some.

quests.name: Monster Machining
quests.description: If only I had some strong materials to work with… Some monster parts and magical reagents should work. Some scales from Mobius Lake's Hydra, a few trophies from the various tenants of the Tower of Doom, and a necrotic Creature Shard from the Creature Creation in /maul would work wonders.

quests.name: Intrepid Investing
quests.description: I wonder if Cysero offers blacksmithing lessons…

quests.name: Forge Weapon Enhancement
quests.description: Maybe you could create a new type of enhancement for yourself to use! Gather some materials to smelt with, and Cysero will teach you how to use the Forge. First, take down the first Lord of Chaos to learn about the nature of magical enchantments. Then, the visages of the first four Chaos Lords should provide enough magical energy and solid materials.

quests.name: Lacerate
quests.description: This enhancement trait lacerates your opponent, reducing their ability to dodge your strikes and strike you back. Activated on your second ability. To create this blueprint, you'll first need to learn the basics of close quarters combat from Mazumi in /greenguardwest.

quests.name: Smite
quests.description: This enhancement trait strikes your opponent for massive damage. Activated on your fifth ability. To create this blueprint, you'll need to understand the basis of a strong dark power.

quests.name: Praxis
quests.description: (THIS TRAIT MAY CHANGE)

quests.name: Acheron
quests.description: This enhancement trait causes your third skill to deal guaranteed critical magic damage to up to two targets you hit and increase your damage and hit chance while rapidly draining your health.

quests.name: Hero's Valiance
quests.description: This enhancement trait greatly improves your base stats all around. Activated on Autoattack. To create this blueprint, you'll need to adventure across lore and accomplish the greatest tasks.

quests.name: Elysium
quests.description: This enhancement trait causes your third skill to deal magic damage to up to two targets you hit based on missing mana, slightly increase damage dealt, and rapidly regenerate your health and mana.

quests.name: Arcana's Concerto
quests.description: This enhancement makes your foe significantly more vulnerable to damage as the battle goes on. Activated on Autoattack. To create this blueprint, you'll need to complete the Elegy of Madness Saga, and battle its strongest foes.

quests.name: Dauntless
quests.description: This enhancement trait does more damage the closer to defeat you are, and drains health for you. It also makes you dauntless, increasing your haste and crit chance, decreasing your mana costs, and unable to receive normal healing. Activated on your second ability. To create this blueprint, you'll need to understand Malgor, and the struggles where was dauntless.

quests.name: Ravenous
quests.description: (THIS TRAIT MAY CHANGE)

quests.name: Forge Cape Enhancement
quests.description: Maybe you could create a new type of enhancement for yourself to use! Gather some materials to smelt with, and Cysero will teach you how to use the Forge. First, drive the Infernals out of the Celestial Realm and the infernal spire. The wings of the Infernal commanders should provide the necessary magic and materials.

quests.name: Absolution
quests.description: By studying holy craftsmanship, you think you can create an enhancement trait. Find and dismantle a set of Ascended Paladin gear from /therift. This enhancement trait grants you bonus healing output in exchange for reduced damage dealt.

quests.name: Vainglory
quests.description: You think you can extract power from the relics used to make the Armor of Awe. You can find them with the help of Valencia in /museum. The completed armor won't do, as it's already utilizing the relics' strength. With their power, you can create an enhancement trait that grants you increased damage dealt in exchange for receiving reduced healing and reduced dodge chance.

quests.name: Avarice
quests.description: You think you can extract power from the souls of those who spent their lives hoarding it. Gather Indulgence and Penance from the souls in the /sevencircles. This enhancement trait grants you increased haste in exchange for reduced defense and dodge chance.

quests.name: Penitence
quests.description: By observing some of the strongest foes in Lore, you think you can glean knowledge on how to better protect yourself. Obtain Sapphire Orbs from the liches in /frozenlair, Void Scales from the Archfiend Dragonlord in /underlair, a weapon from the Icewing Warlord in /icestormarena, and the Night Mare Scythe from Yulgar's quest to slay the grim unicorn. With these, you think you can create a trait that increases your defenses in exchange for lowering your Damage over Time output.

quests.name: Lament
quests.description: Studying the hearts of powerful beings can lead you to find power in their values and their regrets. You think you can find power in the Bloodless Heart of Cured Phlegnn in /sloth, the Doom Heart of Ultra Sepulchure in /sepulchurebattle, the Flame Heart of Smoldur in /ashfallcamp, and the Heart of the Sun from /thirdspell. With these, you can create a trait that increases your Crit Chance in exchange for lowering your Haste.

quests.name: Forge Helmet Enhancement
quests.description: Maybe you could create a new type of enhancement for yourself to use! Gather some materials to smelt with, and Cysero will teach you how to use the Forge. First, take down the Fifth Lord of Chaos to learn about the nature of the supernatural. Then, the weapons of the first four Chaos Lords should provide enough magical energy and solid materials.

quests.name: Vim, Ether
quests.description: You feel like a better grasp of the fundamentals can lead you to an epiphany. Master Rogue class, and retrieve 250 Ethereal Essence from the inhabitants of the lower levels of the Tower of Doom. Then, you think you can create an enhancement that grants a huge amount of Dexterity in exchange for Endurance, and reduces your Mana costs.

quests.name: Examen, Ether
quests.description: You feel like a better grasp of the fundamentals can lead you to an epiphany. Master Healer class, and retrieve 250 Ethereal Essence from the inhabitants of the lower levels of the Tower of Doom. Then, you think you can create an enhancement that grants a huge amount of Wisdom in exchange for Endurance, and reduces your Mana costs.

quests.name: Anima, Clairvoyance
quests.description: You feel like a better grasp of the fundamentals can lead you to an epiphany. Master Warrior class, and retrieve 650 Ethereal Essence from the inhabitants of the lower levels of the Tower of Doom. Then, you think you can create an enhancement that grants a huge amount of Strength in exchange for Endurance and Luck, and increases your Hit Chance.

quests.name: Pneuma, Clairvoyance
quests.description: You feel like a better grasp of the fundamentals can lead you to an epiphany. Master Mage class, and retrieve 650 Ethereal Essence from the inhabitants of the lower levels of the Tower of Doom. Then, you think you can create an enhancement that grants a huge amount of Intellect in exchange for Endurance and Luck, and increases your Hit Chance.

quests.name: Who Let The Togs Out?
quests.description: It's hard chasing pets when you have no limbs. But I've got a telepathic persuasion device which will make them WANT to come back. It's hard city out there, I don't want them to get hurt .I need you to get me: 1 Rubber Ducky from some guy called Porkon in a fort, 1 Tog Whistle, and 2 Uncured Harp Strings. I heard those're in some ravine.

quests.name: You Don't Want To Know...
quests.description: Look, here's the thing. I've got plans. BIG plans. Plans you don't want to know about. Just… bring me the things on this list: 3 Ghost Dreams, 4 Sneak Ambitions, 1 Pilot Hope, 2 Tog Goals, and 3 Tears from from the Dreadspiders in the marsh.

quests.name: If You Wanna Bake A Cake...
quests.description: This is going to be a pretty big cake so we're going to need some big eggs! A few Dragon Eggs should do. I'll need one from the Red Dragon and one from the GreenGuard Dragon! Try not to drop them on your way back here!

quests.name: Gimme Some Sugar, Baby!
quests.description: WE NEED MO' SUGAR! I had a few pounds of the stuff and I thought I had more but I forgot I traded them for some extra large tea bags. We'll need you to go get 10 Bags of Sugar from the Tanuki in Yokai's /bamboo forest. They LOVE THEM SOME SUGAR!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A-Salt and Batter-y
quests.description: For a normal cake you need a little salt. For a cake THIS special you need some very special salt. Fire Salt has the kick we need. Gather some Fire Salts from the fire monsters around /xantown.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Purissimo Aquae
quests.description: We need a lot of really pure water for this experime… I mean… cake. The water needs to be as pure as the happy couple's love and that means you need to get it from the source. The monsters in /waterstorm will have some very Pure Water.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: SPOOOOOOON!
quests.description: OK, we need one more thing. We've got a lot of batter to stir and Oishii's big spoon just won't cut it. We need a magic spoon. The Windigo who lives at the top of the /cloister in Arcangrove carves magic wooden spoons. See if you can get one from him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rubber Ducky
quests.description: Hiya, I'm Cysero and I'm in the bath with my clothes on. It saves me time doing laundry, and who doesn't enjoy a nice hot bath? It's a great way to wind down after a long, hard day of whatever it is that I do. There is only one thing that would make this better… Mr. Quackers, my dear rubber ducky. I must have left it in the Horc Fort when I was helping General Porkon move in. Could you go get him for me? (Return to Cysero in the Battleon Inn once you have found his Rubber Ducky.)

quests.name: Unknown Alloy for Blacksmithing
quests.description: There is no weapon that cannot be made better. Think of it like a smoothie, the more berries the better! I prefer to work with freshly blended alloys and keep the secret ingredients secret. Mysterious and unknown alloys just make for a more interesting result!

quests.name: Volatile Temper Agent for Blacksmithing
quests.description: Oh! You brought my spicy seasoning. Those will be great for my Spork of Immense PAIN, Blade of Insurmountable Turkey or even Steve!

quests.name: Glowing Temper Agent for Blacksmithing
quests.description: Well of course I can use more Glowing Temper Agent, how else do you expect my amazing work to be so amazing?

quests.name: Schnozzberry Delight
quests.description: You know who loves berries? Sneevils. Yogurt-loving sneevils, to be specific. Me and the sneevils, we bonded over our love for schnozzbery-flavored yogurt. I need to whip up a batch as a gift for Sneeviversary tomorrow. The berries grow on the Marsh Trees. Bring me 10, stat!

quests.name: Rubber Duck Rescue
quests.description: Cysero hatched a plan to help the platoon of rubber ducks living in the lake behind his shop evolve! But Zorbak keeps stealing them before he can perform the spell! Rescue 9 of Cysero's ducks from the River Fishmen in the River, Water Elemental in the Shallows, and Dark Witch in the Marsh!

quests.name: Magic Sock it To You
quests.description: The green band on the socks in my personal sock stash hold VERY strong magic. I need that magic for… things. Like painting talking mayonnaise portraits. The slimes and wolves in Greenguard Forest East and West might just know where they are! If they do, bring them back 5 Slimy Lost Socks and 2 Furry Lost Socks!

quests.name: Forge Your Free AC Gift
quests.description: YOU want free AdventureCoins, because free things are great…and who can't use some extra dough, right?! Which is a totally unplanned-but-topical segue (a specialty of mine). Here's the deal. I'll give you the 2026 New Year gift…if YOU bring ME cookie dough. Have you ever tried the ones the Burglinster bakes? Mmmmmmoglin-made goodness.

quests.name: Sweet 2024 AC Gift
quests.description: YOU want free AdventureCoins, because free things are great… and who can't use some extra dough, right?! Which is a totally unplanned-but-topical segue (a specialty of mine). Here's the deal. I'll give you the 2024 Holiday AC gift… if YOU bring ME cookie dough. Have you ever tried the ones the Burglinster bakes? Mmmmmmoglin-made goodness.

quests.name: Free 2024 ACs Gift
quests.description: Heeeeeey. Did you see the Eclipse last week? No? GOOD. You should never look directly at an eclipse. I sure didn't. I was working on a gift for you. Don't look so surprised. I give you things all the time. Weapons. Puns. Obscure trivia. But TODAY, I'm going to give you a birthday present. I hid it inside my Orb. He's a little glassy today, so be careful when you shatter him.

quests.name: Forge Your 2023 ACs Gift
quests.description: Heeeeeey. Did you see the Eclipse last week? No? GOOD. You should never look directly at an eclipse. I sure didn't. I was working on a gift for you. Don't look so surprised. I give you things all the time. Weapons. Puns. Obscure trivia. But TODAY I'm going to give you a birthday present. I hid it inside my Orb. He's a little glassy today, so be careful when you shatter him.

quests.name: Sweet 2023 AC Gift
quests.description: YOU want free AdventureCoins, because free things are great… and who can't use some extra dough, right?! Which is a totally unplanned-but-topical segue (a speciality of mine). Here's the deal. I'll give you the 2023 Holiday AC gift… if YOU bring ME cookie dough. Have you ever tried the ones the Burglinster bakes? Mmmmmmoglin-made goodness.

quests.name: The Ring's The Thing
quests.description: Ok, let's see. First I'm going to need a finger that is the same size as Nursey's so I can size the ring. The Greenguard Basilisk who lives in the stump in Greenguard East eats lots of folks. See if you can beat a Size S Finger out of it that thing.

quests.name: Optimus Slime
quests.description: Next thing I'll need is a Green Crystal from a Green Slime. You can find the Slimes all over, but the crystals are pretty rare so keep going until you find one!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ore Else...
quests.description: This is going better than I hoped! Next we're going to need some Ahzite Ore to forge the ring out of. There is a small vein of the stuff in the Pines near Dwarfhold Mountain. There is a monster there called Twistedtooth whose teeth are coated in the stuff. GET ME THOSE TEETH!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Softest Card
quests.description: Now we need something really soft to polish the finished product! It's a little known fact that the softest substance on this plane is a rare, 42 year old Quasidodo VonPookie rookie stickball card. Faust, over at the Orkestra Temple in Mythsong has a good collection. Go ask him if you can borrow it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Boil it, mash it, put it in a stew...
quests.description: Now all I need is a potato! Those two party-crashing trolls should have one on them. I was going to kick them out but how often do you get to see a troll in a tux? Anyway… bring me the potato as soon as you get it and we can get this party started.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Magic-flavored Misery
quests.description: Warlic needs to know what I've told you, AND I promised to send him a parcel of subrysa bits. Only thing is… the eels I was working with exploded. The bits in their stomach? BOOM. So I need more. Collect 10 scraps of Subrysa Flesh on your way to tell Warlic my findings. Thanks.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sounds Like Cysero ' quest. Note: Click on Warlic in Twilight Slums to finish this quest.

quests.name: Gal's Gift
quests.description: OK, hero. I've got a pretty big to-do list and there's almost no creamed corn involved. Which is good, I can't stand the stuff. First up, Galanoth accidentally dropped his wedding gift. Unfortunately he left it inside the belly of the Red Dragon in /lair. Have fun!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Your Pinks Whiter ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Chilly Reception
quests.description: Aw man! Galanoth's dragon melted the really cool ice sculpture that Yorumi made for the weeding. Looks like we're going to need some more ice! Can you gather some Ice Cubes, Icicles and Ice Pops from /blindingsnow. I'll make sure a warm blanket is waiting for you here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Your Pinks Whiter ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Best Paladin
quests.description: OKIDOKE! Now that you've warmed up,I've got a really challenging chore for you. The best man, Artix, is busy slaying undead in /DoomWood to make sure the ''wedding is safe from undead invasion''. I need you to go pull him away fro that… which will be a real challenge. You know how he is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Your Pinks Whiter ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: From the Soul
quests.description: Rolith and Alina agreed not to buy gifts for each other so he's being sneaky and making her something. Well, technically I am making her something… a very special ring! I will need you to go to /dwarfhold and get a Blue Gemerald from Geopetal then bring it back here. I'll get the other materials ready.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Your Pinks Whiter ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wedding Wrong
quests.description: Apparently Rolith wanted the OTHER kind of Ring of Invisibility ring. Picky, Picky. Oh well, I will need some stuff to fix this. Can you get me 1 Kuro scale from Kuro in the /river, 4 Strong Horc Hairs from General Porkon in /orctown and 6 Ghoul Shoelaces from the ghouls in /marsh2?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Your Pinks Whiter ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Missing Happy Couple
quests.description: Hmmm. Now that we've managed to make the ring I can't find Rolith. Samba is still looking for them both to give them dance lessons. They must be around here somewhere. See if you can find any clues to see where they might be.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Your Pinks Whiter ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tricks Trail Trackin'
quests.description: I don't know where Kimberly's gone, and it sounds like you don't, either. But she's been down a dark hall or two in her time, and knows to leave a trail. Pick up the dolls she's dropped to help us follow her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cyser-Oh Where Art Thou? ' quest.

quests.name: Cultivate Answers
quests.description: Cultists can be really close-mouthed sometimes. You're going to need answers from them, and you're going to need to use force.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: One Found Doll
quests.description: We can't blow this popstand until we find Kimberly. Luckily those Cultists gave us some super-useful information, isn't it?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lost Supplies
quests.description: Hey hero! I am glad to see you. I've dropped some of my enhancement's back there. If you help me recollect some of them, I'll certainly share with you!

quests.name: You'll Never Get Me, Copper!
quests.description: Allright, I'll get to work on design, while you go shopping! and By shopping I mean go get some Raw Copper ore from Bronze Draconians in /lair.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chat with Cysero ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Lode Me Up
quests.description: We're going to need some magnets to contain the propulsion system's mana drive matrix. We might also need a compass, but with no iron or redstone our best bet is using lodestones. Get a few Lodestones from the Gargoyles in /cornelis.
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Spark
quests.description: Almost done with the superstructure. We need a power source. Can't use magic so we will need another energy source and eletricity seems to be new, hip thing. Get a Static Charged Hailbar from the Kittarians in /noobshire and this baby will be ready to go!
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: GI-ANTS
quests.description: If you want this thing to be bigger then we need to make a Growth Potion. The ingredients will need to contain natural BIGNESS. Get some gian ant leg from Red Ants in /giant.
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: What Big Teeth You Have
quests.description: The next ingredient we will need is some giant Leech Teeth from some really big leeches. Get a few giant leech teeth from the Swamp Lurkers in /mudluk.
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Speak to Alina
quests.description: Ok, now we need a master potion-maker to brew the Growth Potion for us. Can you take this stuff to Alina and ask her to brew the potions for us? I'd do but I have no idea what I'm doing.
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest. Note: Quest can only be turned in at Alina (NPC) .

quests.name: Artifact Hunter Quest Legend
quests.description: Battle Gravefang's minions in Northpointe to see if you can recover any rare artifacts!

quests.name: Artifact Class Daily
quests.description: Battle Gravefang's minions in Northpointe to see if you can recover any rare artifacts!

quests.name: A Walking Nightmare
quests.description: The first of the stones should be in the Stables to the east. Go check out the stables and tell me if you see anything out of the ordinary for a creepy, run-down, haunted stable.

quests.name: A Ritual is Required
quests.description: You can beat the tar out of that horse all you want but unless your weapon is prepared with the right magical ritual, it will never drop the rock. We're going to need some Ectoplasm from the wraiths.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Spider's Finger
quests.description: The next reagent in the ritual is a Spider finger. That might be tough to find cause… you know, spiders don't have fingers. But THESE things are straight up mutants so one of them SHOULD have at least ONE finger.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Well Done
quests.description: The last thing that we need is some water from the well of a ghost town that was wiped out by a plague at least a century ago. Lucky for us, here we are. There's a well in town to north, go get some water from it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fighting A Horse
quests.description: Your weapon is ready. I hope you're all warmed up from the busy-work quests because it's mini-boss time. Go get us that first stone!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wake the Dead
quests.description: I'm sensing the power of the next stone coming from the Deadmoor Graveyard to the southwest of here. Go take a nice, pleasant walk through the Graveyard and see if you can find the stone's Guardian.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bone Breaking Bonds
quests.description: Geist has cursed himself for getting Mallora killed when he was Mayor Proditione. The stone ties him to his guilt. You need to break that bond if he's going to cough up the stone. We're going to need his bones. They should be scattered around here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Last Shreds of Humanity
quests.description: His bones tie him to this location but now we need something else that ties him to the deed that cursed him. You're going to need to find the shreds of his shattered humanity INSIDE the monsters in this area. They're easy to spot. They look like lima beans. Good luck.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Consecrated Ground
quests.description: I've bundled up his remains. All you need to do is bury them in consecrated ground. The graveyard is holy ground. Go find 7 gravesites and bury Geist's remains.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Geist
quests.description: Geist will drop the stone now, but he's still a hate-filled, jealous and very dangerous spirit. You have two options…beat the rock out of him let him beat you up until he drops it by accident. You call. Good luck.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Last Caretaker
quests.description: The town's last caretaker had the last stone. You'll find his house at the far end of town to the north. Look for whatever clues you can. Remember, you HAVE to find the last stone before Charlie or whatever his name is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Confrontation
quests.description: The Banshee was murdered by an entire town, and has been trapped voiceless for a century. She has been stewing in her own hatred all that time. You must defeat her!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nightmare Fire
quests.description: Nightmare fire is hard to come by but if you can gather some fro the Nightmare in the stables, I'd be your best friend.

quests.name: Naturally Unlucky
quests.description: Horseshoes are naturally lucky. That's why it's so hard to find unlucky ones, and what horse is unluckier than a dead one? If you find one, I'll take it off your hands.

quests.name: Links To The Past
quests.description: Geist is still hanging around the tomb. I could really use some of the links from his spectral chain to chain up my ghost bike. If you find one, can I have it?

quests.name: Spooky Lint
quests.description: I'm trying to see if there is a world beyond the spirit world. For that I need something fluffy and insubstantial, even to ghosts. POCKET LINT! If you get some pocket lint from Geist it would speed up my work.

quests.name: Find The Leak
quests.description: This place is CRAWLING with the Queen's Sages. If you defeated them all, more would just come in. Go question them until one of them tells you how they got in here.

quests.name: Locking The Door
quests.description: OK, I need to lock this place up. That's pretty obvious now that I think about it. I just like a breeze cutting through here. You must find the guardian of the key and bring it to me but he won't even give it to ME without a fight. You MUST get that key from Chris P. Bacon in the dining hall!

quests.name: Thin Their Ranks
quests.description: Next step, you need to get rid of some of those Sages. Now that the doors are all locked, I doubt more will get in. Go defeat… let's say… 6 of them.

quests.name: 1st Goose Bone
quests.description: Now it's time to find those ancient goose bones! You should find the first one being guarded by The Sock Ape. He's like a really beefy sock monkey. He'll be in protect mode so you'll need to defeat him to gain access to the bone.

quests.name: 2nd Goose Bone
quests.description: The Second one will be in the Room of Undiscovered Colors guarded by a fearsome guardian. At least I think it's fearsome but I've known it for a while. You might not find it so fearsome. Either way, GET THAT SECOND BONE!

quests.name: Last Goose Bone
quests.description: The last one will be in the Halls of Storage. It's like a closet of steroids. There's no guardian this time but enough places to look that it should take anyone a lifetime… unless I left it just sitting out. Sometimes I do that.

quests.name: Ancient Goose?
quests.description: The Queen's ArchSage will be doing the resurrection spell right now. I sense a lot of Fear Magic coming from the Golden Vault. Get in there and stop them before it's late!

quests.name: Raccoon Schematics
quests.description: I knew those giants, magic-powered, mechanical raccoon plans would come in handy some day! MAN, it feels so good being so right. I broke the plans up and hung them in 8 different places around the shop. See if you can find them.

quests.name: No Fur For You
quests.description: I really wish we had time to make this guy furry like the real deal but we're on the clock. I'm going to need some magical plating. We can probably salvage what we need from whatever is left of the Queen's Sages.

quests.name: Raccoon Heart
quests.description: The last thing we need is a powerful Core Dynamo Crystal. I happen to have hidden one inside A Bucket of Paint. It won't give it up without a fight and it's probably still mad at you from the last time you fought so… have fun with that.

quests.name: Shut It Down
quests.description: Got all the parts I need to make this thing but I need you to buy some time. You won't be able to destroy the ancient goose but maybe you can slow it down a little until I'm done. Head back to the vault and do what you do best!

quests.name: Get Those Points!
quests.description: Well, now that you've managed to finish cleaning up after the ArchSage (and thanks for that. PHEW, what a MESS!), it's time to battle for FUN! Defeat the ArchSage, the Ancient Goose AND the Ancient Mecha-Ragoose, and come back to me!

quests.name: Scan the Perimeter!
quests.description: First things first - we need to see how far this dimensional inflation has spread. The farther it goes, the harder it will be to fix. Here, take these beacons. Go out in every direction and find where the 3-D ends, and place one of the beacons right at the edge. That'll give us an idea of how hosed we are.

quests.name: Clackity Clackity
quests.description: How am I supposed to figure out how to fix this mess with all these 3-D monsters sashaying around, being all distracting? Hey, maybe YOU can solve that problem for me. You can go out and smack all the monsters around while I try to think. Especially the Clawgs. Man, that clackity-clacking is driving me crazy!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Fools Token I in your inventory.

quests.name: Calibrations
quests.description: Ok, I think I got this. My ADDING machine is going to need some samples from both the 3D world — to calibrate for the problems and 2D world — to calibrate for the desired result. your best bet is to go fight some monsters and, I dunno, pull out some fur or something.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Fools Token II in your inventory.

quests.name: Sp-Eye Power
quests.description: I'm goin to need a power source, too. Hmmmm… I've got it! We'll use the eye beams from the 3-D Sp-Eyes that are flapping around here. Make sure you don't pop the eyes when you're getting them, or they'll be useless.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Fools Token III in your inventory.

quests.name: It's All ADDING Up
quests.description: Now, we need to build the ADDING machine's cassing! if you get me some armored plating frome the Horc Warriors in the area, that should work nicely. And we'll need some nuts and bolts, too. I bet you can find some inside the slimes - those guys'll eat anything!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Fools Token IV in your inventory.

quests.name: Clawg Claws
quests.description: What I need from you now - and this is really important, so pay attention! - what I need now is some Clawg claws. Nice big ones, undamaged. If they get crushed when you're fighting, I can't use'em.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Fools Token V in your inventory.

quests.name: A Good Case Of Con Rot
