quests.description: Ok, this next part is tricky. I'm going to need some live and active bacteria. Where could we get that? Oh hey, I know! You could go to the /artistalley at BattleCon and pick up a good case of Con Rot! Don't look at me like that! It's a great idea!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Fools Token VI in your inventory.

quests.name: Voila!
quests.description: All our hard work has paid off! I have invented…. Clawgurt! That's right, it's like yogurt, but made out of Clawg! I cultured it with those bacteria you brought back. What? Oh, the ADDING machine? Yeah, yeah I finished that awhile back. But, Clawgurt! I made it at Yulgar's Inn, you HAVE to go try some!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Fools Token VII in your inventory.

quests.name: Trolluk!
quests.description: OH NO! Can you believe it? While I was making Clawgurt, some Trolluk came and stole my ADDING machine! He must have figured out that he'll be zapped back to AQ3G once we've used it. We've got to get it back!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Fools Token VII in your inventory.

quests.name: Snacktime
quests.description: EAT IT!!! Eat it so it will GO AWAY!!!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' My Greatest Foe ' quest.

quests.name: Enchanted Rubber Ducky
quests.description: Hiya, I'm Cysero and I'm in the bath with my clothes on. It saves me time doing laundry, and who doesn't enjoy a nice hot bath? It's a great way to wind down after a long, hard day of whatever it is that I do. There is only one thing that would make this better… Mr. Quackers, my dear rubber ducky. I fed him with the happy crackers to help him get over his stage fright, but then he wandered off sing in the forest and a Grunt snapped him up. Get him back for me, hey?

quests.name: Red Chicken Dance
quests.description: I’d brought a bunch of red chickens here with me to help summon Zeuster, but they’ve flown the coop! I need you to get them back. Subdue them so they’re easy to capture. Then, bring them back here and dump ‘em all in the cage right behind me. (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Year of Fire Fight
quests.description: I’m going to need some fire, too. Makes sense, right? Right. So, you see those paper lanterns that are floating around here? Fight them and capture the tiny flames they’re carrying.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: HolyCud Crooner
quests.description: The Secret Order of Sriracha Holycud made heavy use of reed pipes in their ceremonies. I’d like to sample some reed pipe sounds to use in my song, but… first I’ll need the pipes! I think the Xingshi carry some - you’ll need to head further into Akiba to find them. Make sure you bring me a few, for variety.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Summon the Spicy One
quests.description: Alright! I have everything I need, we’re all set up, and it is time to play the Ancient Hymn of Sriracha Holycud - faithfully reproduced on my vintage Cluckio keytar! Now is the moment of truth. Just let me know when you’re ready for it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Too Hot to Handle?
quests.description: Aaaah! This isn’t how it was supposed to be! Did I not play the right song? Was the red a bad idea? Make it stop! Make it stoooooop!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest..

quests.name: Cyser-Os!
quests.description: While I'm working on your sword, I need you to do something for me. It's nothing big, really - just go upstairs and smack that chickencow around until it gives up the boxes of Cyser-O's cereal that it's been hoarding. The dirty thief!
quests.requirements_note: Must have the ' A Golden Blade ' quest accepted in order to access this quest.

quests.name: Memory #1 - Yeti or Not
quests.description: Just head on into the cave and beat up on that yeti. The sooner you kick his butt, the sooner we can move on to the next awesome Frostval memory.

quests.name: Activate the Spacetimebobulator
quests.description: Go ahead and activate the Spacetimebobulator, buddy! Let's find Warlic the holiday cheer he so desperately needs!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Upgrade the Blinding Light of Destiny
quests.description: Thats a mighty powerful axe you've got there. If you want, I can add some shine to it. You can find the Purification Orbs and Shoelaces in /doomwood. Bright Tonics can be made in the Alchemy Academy. Sigrid Sunshield has the Medals of Justice, Plague Spreaders have the Slimed Sigils, and you should already know about the Undead Energy. Bring me all these and I'll polish it up. (This quest requires the Blinding Light of Destiny axe.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Blinding Light of Destiny (Axe) in your inventory.

quests.name: Upgrade the Plague Spear
quests.description: This spear just exudes poisonous fumes. It makes a smith dizzy in the best way. But it could be greener. Needs more toxic poisons. Bring me Botulinum from the Germs in /swallowed, Pufferfish Sushi from the Enchanted Sushi in ArtixPointe, and Dried Dreadroom from the Tower of Doom and I'll saturate the sucker. (This quest requires the Plague Spear from Big Jack Sprat in /graveyard)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Undead Plague Spear in your inventory.

quests.name: Upgrade the Phoenix Blade
quests.description: We live. We burn things. We die. The end. Well… for most of us. Unless you're a phoenix, and you come back hotter and better than ever.. So if you've got a Phoenix Blade, I'll do the same for you. I'll need a Crystallized Flame from any Draconian in the Lair, 13 Void Scales from the Archfiend Dragonlord in /underlair and 12 Wisps of Dragonspirit from any Dragon-type in /lair to make this red-hot. (This quest requires the Phoenix Blade from the Red Dragon.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Phoenix Blade in your inventory.

quests.name: Upgrade O-Dokuro Blade
quests.description: That's a pretty nice blade you've got there, but it's pretty beaten up. Looks like a few of the bones have been broken; Dropping out of a Chaos Beast will do that to a weapon. Bring me polish and cloth from Pyrewatch Peak and Bone Dust from the Skeletal Warrior in Battleunder B and I'll polish it up for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have O-dokuro Blade in your inventory.

quests.name: Upgrade Taro's Manslayer
quests.description: I was just talking with Taro the other day over a cup of Chai Tea and biscuits. (Horcs LOVE biscuits). Anywho, I told him what I'd do, if I could upgrade his blade, and he loved the idea. I'll do it for you, too, if you bring me Polished Rocks and Precious Gemstones from the Crystal Rocks in Bloodtusk and the Ultra Shifting Plane Gems from creatures in Dark Fortress. (This quest requires Taro's Manslayer from Taro Blademaster.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Taro's Manslayer in your inventory.

quests.name: Upgrade Sepulchure's Undead Blade
quests.description: The world needs both light and darknesss to thrive. Sepulchure is one of the darkest creatures I've had the dubious honor to know. I'll upgrade his blade for you, but the quest to do it won't be bright and sunny. Bring me Flaming Skulls from the Frozen Pyromancer in /underworld, Ultimate Darkness Gems from /shadowfallwar, a Darkness Shard from Vinara's Odd Shop and Necrotic Orbs from /frozenlair and I'll saturate the sucker. (This quest requires the Sepulchure's Undead Blade from Vayle's Doomwood Shop in /necropolis.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Sepulchure's Undead DoomBlade in your inventory.

quests.name: Upgrade Sepulchure's Original Helm
quests.description: Sepulchure wasn't always the creature of Darkness he is today. Sometimes, as I ponder the relationship between worms and worms, I wonder what lies behind his helm now. I've got no clue, but if you have his helm and want it polished, I can do that. Bring me Flaming Skulls, Ultimate Darkness Gems, Darkness Shards and Necrotic Orbs and I'll saturate the sucker. (This quest requires the Sepulchure's Original Helm.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Sepulchure's Original Helm in your inventory.

quests.name: Mad Weapon Crafting
quests.description: For me, the urge to create new weapons can strike at any time, especially when I see something that moves me… or makes me laugh. Like a tower turned into fish, or a waterslide of yogurt. But if you want a guaranteed recipe for a new weapon, bring me 2 Bear Feet from the Grizzly in /citadel, 1 Sushi!!! from the Enchanted Sushi in /artixpointe, and 15 Anti-Matter Gems from Sekt in the /fourdpyramid.

quests.name: Ubear Token
quests.description: Hello, hello! The first Ubear demo run is about to begin. Just purchase this Ubear token, which acts as a refillable monthly pass, and you'll be able to board.

quests.name: WHY ARE THERE BEES?!
quests.description: WHY ARE THERE BEES?! Giant bees! Aaaaaah! Get rid of them get rid of them get rid of them I hope I'm not allergic.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: That's How We'll Get Ants
quests.description: There is some kind of gunk all over the floor, it's all sticky. What is it, honey? Well, we can't just leave it there - that's how we'll get ants. Clean it up!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Door Jam
quests.description: For some reason the front door WON'T open. We're going to have to go out the back. That means we've got to unlock it. There's only one problem… I don't have a key. You think maybe some of those stingers…? You know, the ones on the bees. Some really strong ones.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Oh... gross
quests.description: Ugh. Um… hold your nose and clear the path forward, my friend.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blockage
quests.description: Well… it's gotten worse. We appear to have some, uhh, blockage at the end of the tunnel. You go ahead. I'll wait back here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the Giant ChickenCow
quests.description: Hooooo boy, she's a beauty! I bet we could make a LOT of yogurt with the milk she'd produce. You should tame her, so we can shift her to the /farm. We'll be safe, she'll get fed… and so will we.

quests.name: Mmmm, Meaty(or)
quests.description: I'll take any of the Meateor Shards the chickens and ChickenCows drop if you battle them. You give me shards, I'll give you gear. Deal? Deal!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Meat-eor (est) Surprise
quests.description: Get your dairy-arie in gear, because the meat-eor has landed! Find and defeat the Giant ChickenCow.

quests.name: THE FOWL BADGE
quests.description: For helping defeat this Legen-dairy event boss, you've unlocked the Mega Meateor Victor character page badge! (LIMITED TIME CHARACTER PAGE BADGE: complete this quest by May 1, 2022 to unlock the April Fowls 2022 event character page badge)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Flaming Feathers Quest
quests.description: WOAH! This world boss is MASSIVE! Each time you attack it, you have a chance to get a Flaming Feather. Collect 25 Flaming Feathers to complete the quest and unlock a Meateor Shard. Use Meateor Shards to craft boss rewards!

quests.name: A Meat-eor Surprise
quests.description: Get your dairy-arie in gear, because the meat-eor has landed! Explore the town to see the damage and find our fowl new friend ready to go beak-to-blade with you and all the other heroes of Lore. We've got to take it down before we can rebuild town!

quests.name: A FOWL BADGE
quests.description: For helping defeat this Legen-dairy world boss, you've unlocked the Mega Meateor Victor character page badge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Chick Your Surroundings
quests.description: You showed up at just the right time! We just saw a bunch of chicks run by with Freggments in their tiny beaks. I'm only well-versed in fully grown ridiculous magical birds… but if I had to guess, there's some bite-sized smells coming from West Greenguard, Mythsong, Earthstorm, Waterstorm, and the Darkovia Graveyard…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Giant ChickenCow ' quest.

quests.name: PainFowl Recollection
quests.description: Battleon's no stranger to fowl play. One time, a lunatic invaded the town with an entire ARMY of chickens… and several Chickencows too. We let a few of the chickens walk around town after the battle; perhaps some of them made off with a few Freggments? You'll find them in /battlefowl but fair warning: the area smells a little more of poultry than usual… and that's saying a lot.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Giant ChickenCow ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Empty Nest Syndrome
quests.description: You know, despite the smell and otherworldly glow, these Freggments look almost exactly like the Chaos Eggs I've seen in Dwarfhold's /Uppercity. I wouldn't be surprised if a few creatures mistook them for their own eggs and mixed ‘em in. There's a few local nests of Chaos Draconians that are smelling faintly of meat in the Dwarfhold Mountains. They could be worth checking out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Giant ChickenCow ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Comet-ted to Memory
quests.description: Come to think of it…. this isn't the first time a comet bearing strange creatures from outer space has crash-landed in town, has it? Many years ago, a creature known as the Vaderix landed outside Battleon. I'm getting whiffs of bacon over at the old /Comet impact site. Check it out- but be careful.The first Vaderix is gone, but its spawn are probably still out there…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Giant ChickenCow ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Right Under Your Nose
quests.description: I'm getting a REALLY smelly smell from my back room! The chickencow I keep back there must have found a Freggment too, and a HUGE one at that. If it's exposed to too much of the Meat-Eor's essence, there's a chance it could mutate into something even WORSE than the Giant Chickencow. Let's put a stop to that before it happens!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Giant ChickenCow ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Poultry Request
quests.description: If you've got the time, Hero, how would you feel about running one more quick errand? This Freggment stuff was cool, but I want to learn more about the stuff we've got nearby too. If you could travel back to Battlefowl and bring me samples of Lore's prime poultry, I can share some of my research… oh, and I'll have a 10-piece nugget meal too, thanks!

quests.name: Sock it to ya
quests.description: You know what the WORST THING is? Licorice. I can't look at it without wanting to scatter the molecules that make up its disgusting, plastic-y ingredients. But you know who wants some? Yeah. Trouble. I told her I'd trade her licorice pinwheels if she gets me what *I* need for the spell-gorithm. Wanna help a Bakesmith out?

quests.name: Forge Your 2025 ACs Gift
quests.description: Heeeeeey. Did you see the Eclipse last month? No? GOOD. You should never look directly at an eclipse. I sure didn't. I was working on a gift for you. Don't look so surprised. I give you things all the time. Weapons. Puns. Obscure trivia. But TODAY, I'm going to give you a birthday present. I hid it inside my Orb. He's a little glassy today, so be careful when you shatter him.

quests.name: Cyseroling
quests.description: I'm allergic to Chronomancy, so when I added a pinch to some focaccia, it gave me a literal splitting headache. Could you grab the other Cysero hiding in the oven's pocket dimension? It's important for Cyseros to stick together.

quests.name: Cyseroling (Legend)
quests.description: I'm allergic to Chronomancy, so when I added a pinch to some focaccia, it gave me a literal splitting headache. Could you grab the other Cysero hiding in the oven's pocket dimension? It's important for Cyseros to stick together.

quests.name: Cyseroling (Star Captain)
quests.description: I'm allergic to Chronomancy, so when I added a pinch to some focaccia, it gave me a literal splitting headache. Could you grab the other Cysero hiding in the oven's pocket dimension? It's important for Cyseros to stick together.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Star Captain in your inventory.

quests.name: High-Level Ancient Goose
quests.description: So, the Ancient Goose wasn't tough enough for you, huh? You really think you have what it takes to beat this nastier big brother? Go try it. I dare you.

quests.name: Legion Exercise Number 1
quests.description: Back for more I see. Well I guess I haven't worked you hard enough. That is fine. I will fix that.

quests.name: Legion Exercise Number 2
quests.description: Hey. I have this pretty evil axe. It's called the Executioners Judgment. You want it, don't you? Well you are going to have to prove your dedication to the legion first. And even then that might not be enough. But we will see.

quests.name: Legion Exercise Number 3
quests.description: You again. Have you not yet tired from my missions? …I see. You are almost as unpredictable as Chaos. Speaking of… I want to meddle in the stuff. Chaos, that is. Help me out with some chores and *maybe* I'll give you something cool in exchange. Go fetch 50 vials of Chaorrupted Essences from Chaos Sp-eyes and Chaos Spiders. And then 2 dozen Chaos Eggs. Do not forget the Darkness Core from the Dreadfiend of Nulgath, either.

quests.name: Legion Exercise Number 4
quests.description: I have an idea for a new weapon I want to try out. If it succeeds, then maybe you will get the weapon award. Or maybe not. I might just keep it for myself. So are you feeling lucky, "Champion"?

quests.name: Gateway to the Souls
quests.description: Some guy once told me that eyes are the gateway to the soul. But then I turned him Undead. And he never spoke to me again. So I don't know if this is true or not, but I'm on a hunt for more souls, and there's only one way to find out. If you want a shiny Legion Token, bring me some eyes! I want 15 Chaos Eyeballs from the Underworld's Chaorrupted beasties and 30 Plucked Eyeballs from others. Those are my orders. Go.

quests.name: Daily Exercise 1: Ultra Aeacus
quests.description: As a member of my elite, your tasks involve keeping other members of the Legion in top shape and subduing any potential threats that emerge. Spar with Ultra Aeacus in /judgement or /revenant, and I'll reward you accordingly.

quests.name: Daily Exercise 2: Legion Lich Lord
quests.description: As a member of my elite, your tasks involve keeping other members of the Legion in top shape and subduing any potential threats that emerge. Spar with the Legion Lich Lord in /frozenlair, and I'll reward you accordingly.

quests.name: Daily Exercise 3: The Beast
quests.description: As a member of my elite, your tasks involve keeping other members of the Legion in top shape and subduing any potential threats that emerge. A shade of The Beast has appeared in /sevencircleswar. I could deal with it myself, but are you really going to pass up an opportunity to earn Legion Tokens?

quests.name: Daily Exercise 4: Devastator Deimos
quests.description: As a member of my elite, your tasks involve keeping other members of the Legion in top shape and subduing any potential threats that emerge. Spar with Devastator Deimos in /deimos, and I'll reward you accordingly.

quests.name: Daily Exercise 5: God of the Depths
quests.description: As a member of my elite, your tasks involve keeping other members of the Legion in top shape and subduing any potential threats that emerge. The God of the Depths is stirring. Subdue it, and I'll reward you accordingly.

quests.name: Daily Exercise 6: Dage the Dark Lord
quests.description: As a member of my elite, your tasks involve keeping other members of the Legion in top shape and subduing any potential threats that emerge. I offer you a challenge. Spar with me in /ultradage, let's see how powerful you've become.

quests.name: Mercutio's Soul
quests.description: I want to recruit Mercutio to join the Undead Legion. But I need his soul. Multiple souls, actually. If you haven't already, go buy a Legion Soul Collector from my shop, and then go out and capture 25 souls from Mercutio. Bring them to when you've completed my mission, and I shall give you one Legion Token for your hard work. It's a more than fair deal.

quests.name: Ghostly Aracara Souls
quests.description: I want to recruit Ghostly Aracaras to join the Undead Legion. But I need their souls. A lot of souls. If you haven't already, go buy a Legion Soul Collector from my shop, and then go out and capture 50 Ghostly Aracara Souls. Bring me their souls when you've completed my mission, and I shall give you 1 Legion Token for your hard work. It's a more than fair deal.

quests.description: I want Ghostly Wisteria to recuit to join the Undead Legion. But I need their souls. If you haven't already, go buy a Legion Soul Collector from my shop, and then go out and capture 25 Ghostly Wisteria souls. Bring me their souls when you completed my mission, I shall give you one Legion Token for your hard work. It's more than a fair deal.

quests.description: I want to recruit Belrot the Ghosts to join the Undead Legion. But I need their souls. A lot of souls. If you haven't already, go buy a Legion Soul Collector from my shop, and then go out and capture 50 Belrot the Ghost Souls. Bring me their souls when you've completed my mission, and I shall give you 1 Legion Token for your hard work. It's a more than fair deal.

quests.description: I want to recruit Ghostly Deathgazers to join the Undead Legion. But I need their souls. A lot of souls. If you haven't already, go buy a Legion Soul Collector from my shop, and then go out and capture 50 Ghostly Deathgazer Souls. Bring me their souls when you've completed my mission, and I shall give you 1 Legion Token for your hard work. It's a more than fair deal.

quests.name: Escaped Dai Tenghost Souls
quests.description: I want to recruit Escaped Dai Tenghosts to join the Undead Legion. But I need their souls. A lot of souls. If you haven't already, go buy a Legion Soul Collector from my shop, and then go out and capture 50 Escaped Dai Tenghost Souls. Bring me their souls when you've completed my mission, and I shall give you 1 Legion Token for your hard work. It's a more than fair deal.

quests.name: Undead Champion Initiation
quests.description: This is your trial round, Hero. Fail this, and you fail at becoming an Undead Champion. Got it? Your first—and easiest—mission is to take down the Black Knight of Greenguard Forest. The Knight has been Undead for quite some time yet refuses to join the Undead Legion… so it's up to YOU to show the Black Knight the Legion's true power.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Undead Warrior (Armor) in your inventory.

quests.name: Mourn the Soldiers
quests.description: Undead Champions show no mercy. You must see to it that you do what you are told—no questions asked. Your next mission is to scout the entire world of Lore, destroying every dubbed Soldier you encounter. Hunt down the 4 specific Soldiers that the Legion has ordered to exterminate.

quests.name: Understanding Undead Champions
quests.description: The Legion does not tolerate failure. When one of our own kin betrays the Legion, the unfortunate gets stripped of his power and is sent to the deep caverns beneath Battleon to rot for eternity. If you do not wish meet the same fate, you simply must not fail. How hard of a demand is that to meet?

quests.name: Player vs Power
quests.description: The time has come for you to prove your power against fellow adventurers. Join /bludrutbrawl and show your might by defeating anyone you find there - monster or other player. True Undead Champions know they possess great power and will not hold anything back. Only when you have collected 200 Combat Trophies will you truly understand the power bestowed upon the Undead Legion.

quests.name: Fail to the King
quests.description: In Swordhaven, Good King Alteon is a symbol of all that is pure and good. He is well-guarded… and that must end! Go to him. /Join prison and slay 25 of his Knights so that one day soon… you will be able to slay HIM!

quests.name: The Soul Forge Hammer (Unlock Soul Forge)
quests.description: Check out my Soul Forge. Pretty epic, I know. And if you want to use it, you're going to need to make your own Soul Forge Hammer. Bring me an Iron Hammer from the Skeletal Warriors in BattleUnder, Zardman's Stonehammer from the Grunts in the Forest, and the Elemental Rock Hammer from that Rock boss in Bludrut.

quests.name: Obsidian Mining
quests.description: My Soul Forge craves Obsidian Rocks. Search all over the world for hot fire and lava monster that drop Obsidian Deposits. I need at least 10 Obsidian Deposits in hopes of making an Obsidian Rock. Go on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Soulforge Hammer in your inventory.

quests.name: Soul Forgery
quests.description: My Soul Forge hungers for Souls! By merging Souls with Obsidian Rocks, you can make awesome Undead Legion loot. Destroy Undead, zombie, and ghostly monsters throughout Lore in hopes of retrieving Shards of a Soul. When you collect 10 of them, I can try to make Solidified Souls.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Soulforge Hammer in your inventory.

quests.name: Undead Legion Member Special
quests.description: The only thing I dig more than death and destruction are Members. So I'm kindly giving you an advantage: bring me 6 Obsidian Deposits and 6 Shards of a Soul and in return I'll provide you with extra Obsidian Rocks and Solidified Souls to use in my Soul Forge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Soulforge Hammer in your inventory.

quests.name: Image of Dage
quests.description: Your loyalty to the Legion demands a reward, but there are a few souls that need purging first.

quests.name: Sword of the Legion Items
quests.description: To get either the Legion Drow Blade, Legion Blackwell's Axe, or Legion Skull Daggers, you will need to slay 1 Skeletal Warrior and give me 100 Legion Tokens, AND 1 Legion Sword Resource (bought from my shop in Shadowfall).
quests.requirements_note: Must have The Sword of the Legion in your inventory.

quests.name: Sword of the Legion Armor
quests.description: To get either the Undead Champion Prime Armor, you will need to slay 1 Skeletal Warrior here in Shadowfall and give me 200 Legion Tokens.
quests.requirements_note: Must have The Sword of the Legion in your inventory.

quests.name: Master the Infernal Caladbolg
quests.description: Forged in fire and bathed in blood, this blade will rip the hope, determination, and pride out of any wielding it… unless you become its master! Slay Cerberus in Styx to prove that you are skilled enough to wield it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Infernal Caladbolg in your inventory.

quests.name: Infernal Legion Betrayal
quests.description: The Undead Legion NEVER leaves betrayal unavenged. Slay Dreadfiends of Nulgath in the Underworld and Fotia Elementals on Fotia Island to send a message to all those who would cross me.

quests.name: Shadow Legion Vampire Scythe
quests.description: If you wish to create the Ultra Shadow Legion Vampire Scythe, you must gather the necessary ingredients. They are not difficult, but they must be prepared correctly. Bring me the heart of Northlands Ice Symbiote for 5 days. THEN I can create what you desire.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Evolved Legion Vampire (Armor) in your inventory. Notes:

quests.name: Obtain the Dark Caster Class
quests.description: Do you possess my very first Dark Caster armor? Ah, then you wish to serve my Legion as a Dark Caster. I will grant you this honor IF you bring what I crave. 200 Legion Tokens will prove your worthiness then obtain a Tasty Cookie from the Red Dragon in her lair…for my hunger knows no bounds.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Classic Dark Caster in your inventory.

quests.name: High Legion Champion
quests.description: If you would become the Legion's greatest Champion, you must slay Undead Champions to prove your battle prowess. Bring me the head of 13 Undead Champions in Battleunderb and 1 Undead Head from an Undead Giant.
quests.requirements_note: Must have High Legion Champion in your inventory.

quests.name: Exalted Legion Champion
quests.description: If you would become the Legion's greatest Champion, you must slay Undead Champions to prove your battle prowess. Bring me the head of 13 Undead Champions in Battleunderb and 1 Undead Head from an Undead Giant.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Exalted Legion Champion (Armor) in your inventory.

quests.name: Endurance Test
quests.description: Dance, puppet. I want to see you SWEAT. This quest WILL change at random. The more Evil you prove yourself to be, the better the rewards!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Fail to The King' quest.

quests.name: Dage's Black Box
quests.description: You want to know what's in the black box? Of course you do. You'll have to work for it. Slay the sneevils in the Boxes map until you find the note. Then follow the instructions.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Fail to The King' quest.

quests.name: Vampiric Essences
quests.description: Barely heard whispers are floating on the mists of the Underworld about a masquerade. Rumors are starting to rumble throughout Darkovia and the Underworld of vampires and fae, but nothing of substance has been discovered. We just cannot hear enough - the whispers are too soft… for now. (Must have completed Fail to the King to be able to access this quest.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Fail to The King' quest. Note: Previously called "Robed Legion Vampire" .

quests.name: Slay the Necromancer's Soldiers
quests.description: Blightbringer's solders remain in the village. Kill the 6 undead in this unit, and bring back any loot they find. We may discover useful information.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Hunt for the Amulet ' quest.

quests.name: The Book of Portals
quests.description: If the Book of Portals is in this village, THAT explains why Blightbringer attacked. Search the village and see if you can find the missing Spellbook!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle for a Lost Love
quests.description: Blightbringer's undead stole the picture of your lost love. Slay them to get the picture back, and I will be able to cast the spell we need… and you will have your revenge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Into the Blight
quests.description: We are almost at Blightbringer's lair. Slay the 3 undead blocking the path, and the final battle will be upon us!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gateway Guardian
quests.description: To travel into the Heart of Blightbringer's keep, you must slay the shadowman. Bring me the Gate Key he holds!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blightbringer's Doom
quests.description: To open the gateway, you must use the key… AND know the pattern. It will not open unless the skulls are pressed in the correct order.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Becoming A BladeMaster
quests.description: SO, you have chosen the more challenging path to becoming a BladeMaster for my Undead Legion. Your soul is not enough. I also require evidence of your devotion and dedication. Bring me 2000 Legion Tokens and I will grant your request.

quests.name: Legion Dreadmarch Armor
quests.description: I can appreciate your desire to become a member of my Dreadmarch, but nothing in this live comes easy… and the afterlife comes even harder. Bring me 500 Legion Tokens and I will allow this.

quests.name: Dreamarch Helm
quests.description: The head required protection, even for the undead. If zombies ever start wearing helms, they would be unstoppable. Bring me 90 Legion Tokens and I will provide you with a Legion Dreadmarch helm.

quests.name: Dreadmarch Cape
quests.description: My undead Legionnaires do not fell winter's bitter sting, but some protection from the elements is needed. Even corpses can freeze solid. Bring me 250 Legion Tokens and I will gift you with a Dreadmarch Cape to protect you.

quests.name: Dark, Deadly Warmup
quests.description: You should warm up before facing my four undead horsemen. Slaying 10 Dark Makai in the Underworld is a good way to begin.

quests.name: Destroy the Good
quests.description: Excellent, but you are not quite ready. Defeat 6 Good Soldiers to show you have what it takes to face my champions. You will find the Soldiers in the Alliance map.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Destroy Chaorrupted Evil
quests.description: Even better! Now I have a special task for you. Chaorrupted Evil offends me. Slay 10 Chaorrupted Evil Soldiers to earn my approval. You will find them in the Alliance map.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Legion Fenrir Gauntlet
quests.description: You are almost ready to face my Champions. For your last warm-up quest, defeat 13 Legion Fenrir in the Underworld.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Conquer Conquest
quests.description: Conquest embodies righteousness and victory. Those who hope to earn my rewards must be ever victorious! Defear Conquest to prove your skill.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Conquer War
quests.description: War revels in slaughter, and a bloodier victory than those Conquest seeks. Those who hope to earn my rewards must stop at NOTHING to win! Defeat War to prove your worth!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Conquer Famine
quests.description: Famine slays the poor and weak but spares the rich and strong. Those who emerge victorious must be ready to spare no one! Defeat Famine to prove your willingness to destroy whomever you must!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Conquer Death
quests.description: Death judges all, and decides who is worthy of an afterlife… or an eternity of suffering. Those who earn my rewards must be ready to defy even Death! Defeat Death to prove you are worthy of battling alongside my Legion!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dark Birthday Gift
quests.description: If you wish to pay for the rewards through blood, sweat, and tears, defeat 3 of my Blade Masters in the Underworld and receive my Dark Birthday Gifts! Use those in the Merge Shop.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Conquer Death ' quest.

quests.name: Dreadfiend Destruction (Legion)
quests.description: The Dreadfiends have been getting… cocky. Slaughter 20 of them to show them who just rules the Underworld!

quests.name: Undead Infantry Combat Training (Legion)
quests.description: My Undead Infantry soldiers have been getting sloppy. Defeat 13 Undead Infantry soldiers to help improve their skill.

quests.name: Undead Legendary Challenge (Legend)
quests.description: Take out the 13 Undead Legends to prove you're the best of the best. That's it. Simple as that. are you up to the challenge?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Conquer Death ' quest.

quests.name: Humiliation of Conquest Gauntlet (Daily)
quests.description: Defeat Conquest 7 times to unlock a character page badge to prove all how great a warrior you are!.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Conquer Death ' quest. Note: This quest can only be done once per day.

quests.name: Conquest Badge
quests.description: Complete the Humiliation of Conquest Gauntlet daily quest 7 times to earn the Conquest Badge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Slaughter of War Gauntlet (Daily)
quests.description: Defeat War 7 times to unlock a character page badge to prove all how great a warrior you are!.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once per day.

quests.name: War Badge
quests.description: Complete the Slaughter of War daily quest 7 times to earn the War Badge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Feast of Famine Gauntlet (Daily)
quests.description: Defeat Famine 7 times to unlock a character page badge to prove all how great a warrior you are!.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once per day.

quests.name: Famine Badge
quests.description: Complete the Feast of Famine daily quest 7 times to earn the Famine Badge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Mastery of Death Gauntlet (Daily)
quests.description: Defeat Death 7 times to unlock a character page badge to prove all how great a warrior you are!.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once per day.

quests.name: Death Badge
quests.description: Complete the Master of Death daily quest 7 times to earn the Death Badge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Survey the Damage
quests.description: This is the legendary lab of the Devs, Hero. Not how the ancient texts described it, is it? Explore the lab, familiarize yourself with it, and survey the damage.

quests.name: Defeat Chaorrupted Alina
quests.description: Alina has been chaorrupted in the next room. Maybe if you can weaken her enough, we can cleanse her of the chaos. Her knowledge of alchemy and the nature of chaos should help us restore order.
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest.

quests.name: Gather the Crystals
quests.description: Ok, so that didn't work. If we collect Chaorrupted Crystals from the Chaorrupted Moglins, we can use them to absorb and contain the chaotic essence that infects the devs! Two crystals per dev should do the trick.
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse Alina
quests.description: Now that you have the chaorrupted crystals, go and defeat Alina again. If I'm correct, you should now be able to cleanse her of the chaorruption.
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest.

quests.name: Gather More Crystals
quests.description: The devs have been affected more than I anticipated. It seems all your crystals were consumed by Alina alone. You'll need a lot more to cleanse the other devs. Collect 12 more chaorrupted crystals, then return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse Beleen
quests.description: Now that we have more crystals, we should cleanse Beleen next. Defeat her, and return to me with your results.
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse Cysero
quests.description: It's working! Quickly, defeat and cleanse Cysero!
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse Artix
quests.description: Just one dev left. Be very careful around him, Hero. He seems to have the power of a thousand more energy drinks than usual!
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest.

quests.name: Ficus Your Powers
quests.description: You fight fire with fire. You fight chaos with chaos. Focus the chaos which you have absorbed from the developers to destroy the Chaorrupted Ficus that stands between you and the greatest abomination that the chaos has unleashed.
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest.

quests.name: Face the Hamster
quests.description: A hamster? HAMSTER!? Who would've thought such a mild creature could become such an ugly beast?! I mean.. Look at it.. Right? It's just… Wow. You need to hurry and use those empty chaorrupted crystals to drain the massive amounts of chaotic energy flowing through it. Judging by how chaorrupted it is - and ugly - we don't have much time.
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest.

quests.name: Cleaning Up
quests.description: Thanks to you, the devs have been safely returned to their normal state. However, they were here long enough to leave a permanent imprint on this chaorrupted plane and so their doppelgangers will remain. You may fight them again to obtain a large amount of chaos energy. Collect their chaorrupted crystals, and I'll forge them into gear for you. Like I said, chaos fight chaos.
quests.requirements_note: Must complete previous quest.

quests.name: MORE HAMSTER?
quests.description: It seems the hamster was even more chaorrupted than we thought. It did not return to its own world but instead escape to another chaorrupted dimension of the lab! It has grown in power and if you do not stop it now it will continue to form new dimensions, amplifying the power of chaos through each and becoming unstoppable!
quests.requirements_note: Must complete " Face the Hamster " quest.

quests.name: Become the DoomKnight
quests.description: If you would give yourself over to Doom, to channel the power of the DoomKnight, then there is only one thing you must do: prove you are WORTHY! Slay Dark Sepulchure in the Sepulchure map for the Sepulchure's Dark Mark.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Sepulchure's DoomKnight Armor in your inventory.

quests.name: Invade the Overworld
quests.description: Slay Brightscythe Warriors, Reavers, and Shinobis to find the weak spots in Dage the Good's army!

quests.name: Reflections of Destruction
quests.description: We know where to hit them where it hurts. Shatter columns and take out 5 of the Shieldbearers. I sense they have a strong connection to the defense of this area.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Dark Seal I in your inventory to access this quest.

quests.name: Undercover in the Overworld
quests.description: I do not trust these bright ones. I sense they are hiding the information we need. Slay 7 Bright Shinobi to recover pages of the Fortress Map.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Dark Seal II in your inventory to access this quest.

quests.name: Shatter the Mirror Defenders
quests.description: Mirrors are so easy to shatter. Take out 13 of the Brightscythe Warriors defending the Mirror Realm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Dark Seal III in your inventory to access this quest.

quests.name: Time to Strengthen the Rift
quests.description: This world feels… unstable. That is unacceptable. Alteon's Chronomancer must be weak. Slay 9 Brightscythe Reavers and gather their spirits, then feed them into the Time Rift to keep it open.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Dark Seal IV in your inventory to access this quest.

quests.name: Grind down the Mirror
quests.description: The Mirror Realm's defenders are tenacious. I give them that. Destroy the second wave of defenders. Take out 12 of the Bright Shinobi and Brightscythe Warriors to reduce their defense capacity.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Dark Seal V in your inventory to access this quest.

quests.name: Shine a Light on Traitors
quests.description: There must be SOMEbody in this disgustingly bright realm that longs for brightness. Find me somebody willing to betray Dage the Good for great rewards.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Dark Seal VI in your inventory to access this quest.

quests.name: Destroy Nulgath the ArchAngel
quests.description: Nulgath the… ArchAngel? AHAHAHAA! Oh, if only my old mentor was here now. He would CRUSH him. Take out Nulgath the ArchAngel. Time IS running out. I can feel the world growing unsteady.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Dark Seal VII in your inventory to access this quest.

quests.name: Soul Fuel
quests.description: The Infernals that are infesting this fortress look like a good source of fuel for the soul forge to me! Bring me a good dozen of 'em - the ones from the mages and scryers will work best - and then throw them into the forge. (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Time To Fly
quests.description: Gravelyn is waiting for you in the throne room. Bring her the soul crystal we forged so she can get this fortress in the air again!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: Souls of the Future Legion
quests.description: For every soul I take, I become stronger, and the Future Legion becomes weaker. As you fight these Future Legion minions, collect their souls. Bring them to me. I must be at maximum strength if we are to emerge from this battle victorious.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take out the Legionator ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Robust Souls of the Future Legion
quests.description: All beings have a soul, but some are stronger, and more powerful, than others. A soul like this will imbue me with considerably more power. If you find any of these robust souls, bring them to me. They will greatly increase our chances of success.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take out the Legionator ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: SF3017 Shogun
quests.description: The time to strike is now! We have cleared a path to the SF3017 Shogun. If we take him out, Future Dage will have no choice but to face us himself!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take out the Legionator ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Future Dage
quests.description: My Legion scouts have found Future Dage's location. This is my moment of truth. Help me defeat him, and save Lore from destruction.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take out the Legionator ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Flowers for Joy
quests.description: Death? Souls? The Underworld? I am the master of those things. But an understanding of the traditionally romantic continues to elude me. Girls like ﬂowers, right? Get me some ﬂowers from these Hopeless Romantics so I can give them to Joy. But… don't let her see you beating them up, ok? I don't think she'd like it.

quests.name: Soul Energy
quests.description: If I'm going to rip open a portal to the Void, I'll need a lot of soul energy - specifically, I'll need the souls of Void creatures. The Dark Makai in this area should do nicely.

quests.name: Open the Portal
quests.description: I'll need one more reagent before I can open the portal to the Void - the burning coals from the eyes of Void Elementals. 5 should be enough. Bring them back to me here, and place them in a circle where I ask you to. This will complete the spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Go Through the Portal
quests.description: The portal has opened. Meet me on the other side, and we will continue my journey.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: We Need a Guide
quests.description: It's going to be tricky to find our way through the Void - it doesn't work the way our dimension does. We're going to need a guide. Gather Void Energy from the creatures nearby, and I'll use it to bind one of them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Examine the Souls
quests.description: So many souls in this vault, all wandering free. I'd have expected them to be organized in some way. Though, I suppose he doesn't often need to come looking for a particular one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Open the Vault ' quest.

quests.name: Bonus Quest: Soul Food
quests.description: With some leftover soul energy, I can easily make a gift for you for helping out in this endeavor. All I need are Void Energy from the Void Elementals, some pieces of the swords from the Void Knights, and some essence from the Void Wyrm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Contract ' quest.

quests.name: Battle the Void Army
quests.description: We'll fight our way out, if that's what it takes. Kill as many of these void creatures as you can, and we'll see what's on the other side!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Contract ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat Zeph'gorog
quests.description: He caught us off guard last time, but we won't let that happen again. I'm strong enough to defeat him on my own. With both of us working together, he doesn't stand a chance.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unlock the Immortal Dark Caster
quests.description: If you own the original Dark Caster Class, you can unlock it's 2019 variant for free! Turn in 1 Bone Sigil from the Underworld Arena to claim your class. (Must have the original Dark Caster CLASS item in your inventory.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Dark Caster (Class) with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory.

quests.name: Unlock the Infinite Dark Caster (Evolved)
quests.description: If you own the original Evolved Dark Caster Class, you can unlock it's 2019 variant for free! Turn in 1 Bone Sigil from the Underworld Arena to claim your class. (Must have the original Evolved Dark Caster CLASS item in your inventory.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Evolved Dark Caster with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory.

quests.name: Unlock the Infinite Dark Caster (Legion)
quests.description: If you own the original Legion Evolved Dark Caster Class, you can unlock it's 2019 variant for free! Turn in 1 Bone Sigil from the Underworld Arena to claim your class. (Must have the original Legion Evolved Dark Caster CLASS item in your inventory.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Legion Evolved Dark Caster (Class) with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory.

quests.name: Unlock the Timeless Dark Caster (Arcane)
quests.description: If you own the Arcane Dark Caster Class, you can unlock it's 2019 variant for free! Turn in 1 Bone Sigil from the Underworld Arena to claim your class. (Must have the Arcane Dark Caster CLASS item in your inventory.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Arcane Dark Caster with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory.

quests.name: Unlock the Timeless Dark Caster (Mystical)
quests.description: If you own the original Mystical Dark Caster Class, you can unlock it's 2019 variant for free! Turn in 1 Bone Sigil from the Underworld Arena to claim your class. (Must have the Mystical Dark Caster CLASS item in your inventory.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Mystical Dark Caster with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory.

quests.name: Shadows Encroach
quests.description: The shadows are already starting to find their way in. We have to get rid of them! Destroy as many as you can, and then light the torches to keep them at bay.

quests.name: Strongest Armor
quests.description: We must empower my Legion! Gather diamonds and ore that can be forged into new armor and weapons to fight off this invasion. Mine them from the wandering golems and bring them back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gear Up
quests.description: Take these raw materials to the Soul Forge and use it to create empowered armor and weapons. Then, pass the gear out to any Legion soldiers who need it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Souls for the Forge
quests.description: The Soul Forge will need to be replenished. Gather fresh souls for it. Not much is living down here, but you might find a few Dark Makai that have come in from below.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shred the Shadows
quests.description: The shadows are growing thicker! We must clear them out again. Destroy the Creeping Shadows coming in from the back, as well as any that are still left in the front. Bring me their shredded forms as proof… the ones that don't completely disintegrate, that is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Punish the Defectors
quests.description: It angers me to see how many of my former allies have turned against me! Slay them. collect their souls. Bring them back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Icy Hot
quests.description: The souls you recovered must be cleansed. There is a Pyromancer in the Underworld… his Frozen Fire will help us do this.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Infernal Coal
quests.description: And now we need something to keep it aflame. The Golems you fought before are powered by infernal coal. Fight them and bring their coals to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cleanse the Shadows
quests.description: Now, we light the bonfire and let its fire cleanse the shadow from those souls.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the Underfiend
quests.description: The Underfiend is still under Malgor's influence. Find him, and defeat him. We must show Malgor that the Legion won't be defeated so easily.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clear the Shadows
quests.description: The shadow grows thicker than ever. We cannot allow it to continue infesting the Underworld! Slay as many living ones as you can, and clear out the darkness growing on the walls.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest.

quests.name: Destroy the Swords
quests.description: What is it with all the swords??! Fight them until they stop moving, and then have them smelted down. We'll use the metal to create more gear for our own side.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Fuel for the Forge
quests.description: We can't smelt the rest of the intruders. Harvest their souls and bring them to me. I will use them as fuel for the forge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sever the Connection
quests.description: The Makai are tricky - they're allowing Nulgath to keep a connection open with the Void and bring in reinforcements as he needs them. Fight them and take the special stones they carry. This will prevent this from being so easily done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Armor Against the Shadow
quests.description: If we take the armor from those Shadow Voids, do you think it would give us more protection against their shadows? Bring me some and we'll find out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Aid from the Pyromancer
quests.description: Hmm. The last time we had to cleanse the shadows, we used the Frozen Pyromancer's fire. I don't think that will work again. But he may be able to help us find something more powerful. Go to him and ask for his help.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Remove the Shadows
quests.description: Go, clear out the shadowy minions wandering near the Soul Forge. Reclaiming it will go more smoothly if they are not there to fight us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest. | Must have completed the ' Take the Flame ' quest.

quests.name: Burn the Shadows
quests.description: Light the fire near the Soul Forge and watch the shadows burn.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat Shadow Nulgath
quests.description: The Underworld will never belong to anyone else! Defeat this would-be usurper and take the Soul Forge back for the Legion.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Path to Power
quests.description: You've already meditated on the techniques you've learned from my SwordMasters? Good. Go refine your techniques further by collecting some Legion Tokens. Then, combat Ultra Aeacus in /judgement, and challenge the Legion Lich Lord in /frozenlair for their Sapphire Orbs to prove your newfound power.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest.

quests.name: Legion Sword Training
quests.description: So, you wish to master the ways of the sword. If you aren't willing to train under my Legion's SwordMasters, you must develop techniques yourself. Defeat the Underfiend in /darkally, Oh'Garr in /shadowsong, and the Titan Shadow Dragonlord in /shadowgrove to start. Then, combat Ultra Aeacus in /judgement and challenge the Legion Lich Lord in /frozenlair for their Sapphire Orbs. Finally, prove your ability in head-to-head combat in /dagepvp, by challenging your peers, my Blademasters, and me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest.

quests.name: Embracing Darkness
quests.description: Though we temporarily pushed Malgor's forces back, we will need more power to continue our resistance. New power. Malgor possesses a dark energy different from my own, and his army seems to draw on its strength. Defeat enough of his troops and we may be able to use it ourselves.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest.

quests.name: Forge Your Steel, Steel Your Resolve
quests.description: A Ronin's blade never leaves their side. In order to truly master the ways of the Ronin, you must create a blade suitable for you. Collect a blueprint from Jaaku in /shadowfortress to guide you. Collect some weapon imprints from Raxgore in /doomvaultb to create a mold. Chanky in /underworld will help you procure some Flame-Forged metal. Collect an Eternity Flame from Amia in /fotia and Obsidian Rocks from the Soul Forge to work the metal and increase its capability one thousand-fold.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest.

quests.name: The Edge of an Era
quests.description: Now, we must construct your blade. Collect perfect scales from Orochi in /shadowfortress or /shogunwar to forge a hilt. Adorn the pommel with an Oni Skull charm from Mitsu Bishi. Finally, we’ll bind the blade and handle with Darkened Essence from the warriors in /shadowrealmpast.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest.

quests.name: Yami no Ronin
quests.description: The BladeMasters and SwordMasters of my Legion are among the strongest sword wielders, living or undead. But, there is another level of mastery— the Yami no Ronin. You will need to study their forgotten Yokai sword skills and learn to use elemental darkness. Are you up to the challenge?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest.

quests.name: Meditation, Inflection (BladeMaster AC)
quests.description: If you own the original BladeMaster Class and purchased it for ACs, train yourself in its sword techniques until you can claim mastery over them. Then, once you have fully ranked up your class, bring me a Bone Sigil from /legionarena and we will continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest. | Must have BladeMaster (Class) (AC) Rank 10 in your inventory.

quests.name: Meditation, Inflection (BladeMaster LT)
quests.description: If you own the original BladeMaster Class and purchased it for Legion Tokens, train yourself in its sword techniques until you can claim mastery over them. Then, once you have fully ranked up your class, bring me a Bone Sigil from /legionarena and we will continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest. | Must have BladeMaster (Class) (0 AC) Rank 10 in your inventory.

quests.name: Meditation, Inflection (SwordMaster AC)
quests.description: If you own the SwordMaster Class and purchased it for ACs, train yourself in its sword techniques until you can claim mastery over them. Then, once you have fully ranked up your class, bring me a Bone Sigil from /legionarena and we will continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest. | Must have SwordMaster (Class) (AC) Rank 10 in your inventory.

quests.name: Meditation, Inflection (SwordMaster LT)
quests.description: If you own the SwordMaster Class and purchased it for Legion Tokens, train yourself in its sword techniques until you can claim mastery over them. Then, once you have fully ranked up your class, bring me a Bone Sigil from /legionarena and we will continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Underfiend ' quest. | Must have SwordMaster (Class) (Merge) Rank 10 in your inventory.

quests.name: Budding Scolex
quests.description: The Shadowscythe has a pest problem. I have experience with rats, rodent or otherwise, but this type of infestation is rare. Or rather, rarely found before it's too late. I quash Doom the moment I find it lurking in my ranks, but why are these Doom Worms lurking in the foundations of the Shadowscythe fortress? Don't you share this domain? Hm, if you can't control them, then destroy these vermin.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Evil of Humanity ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Scuffling Shadows
quests.description: Sepulchure wears the Doom Knight armor, but the power that emanates from him differs from the aura that saturates this sealed room. You can sense it and so can I. Shadows from outside of the Shadowscythe were here. They left claw marks on the wall, scraps on the floor, and the remains of the last living occupant in the corner. Perhaps a closer look will provide the full picture, and a possible way out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Evil of Humanity ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Humans DNI
quests.description: I won't decipher the skeleton's book for free. You could waste time deciphering it by yourself, but you need every second you can get to save your father. Give the book to me, and in exchange, I will reforge the weapons sealed in this room. Those blades rest on an altar guarded by corrupted beasts stolen from the Plane of Darkness. We'll destroy the beasts, I'll rip apart the seals, and you will take the weapons.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Evil of Humanity ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Scion's Privilege
quests.description: The Shadows wanted to seal these blades away for a reason. I can sense that they once shone with powerful light magic. Flickers still linger, and with my strong affinity for Darkness, I won't be able to hold them without being harmed. But you're able to wield these weapons. Try striking the wall. If they're swathed in Shadow, Light will make them crumble and ward off the swarming Doom Worms.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Evil of Humanity ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Man-Cave and a Box of Scraps
quests.description: You're eager to ascend and destroy that Light Elemental. I see that and desire the same. But we will not stop at merely defeating our shared enemy. Strive instead to obliterate it, and make it an example of what happens to all that oppose you. To that end, find me a place that will pass for a forge. The elemental took a part of my soul, meaning we will likely cross my stolen Legionnaires.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Evil of Humanity ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Glare of the Light...
quests.description: The arrows have been forged. Considering its materials and the mastery of the forger, they could ironically be the strongest Light weapons on Lore. Think I'm blowing hot air? I'm Undead, that's impossible. We will be making our ascent up the stairs. I sense the sting of Light but…there is something off about the Elementals blocking the way forward. Test the arrows, and examine anything those Elementals drop.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Evil of Humanity ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: ...Pierces the Deepest Shadows
quests.description: The odd Elementals have been destroyed. They were arguably less of a nuisance than the egregiously long climb up the stairwell. It seems we fell extremely far. Ah, back to where we started. Hm, isn't that the doorstop I passed before? You say his name is Shakaz? Very well. We will talk to him and learn what transpired while we were down below - though we will need to fend off the odd Shadowscythe Warriors menacing him first.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Evil of Humanity ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lonely Supremacy
quests.description: General Rand took command of the Legion while I was indisposed. His position in the Legion is a special case…Few are allowed to question my orders, but from time to time, General Rand's opposing input and assessments have served my ambitions. Once we subdue the Light-enthralled Dreadmarch surrounding General Rand, I will need to speak to him and access our enemy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Evil of Humanity ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Condemner
quests.description: We are nearing the final confrontation with this Light Elemental. Its true power is emerging, and I can feel its brightness piercing into the stolen portion of my soul. Since it was brazen enough to use my own Legion against me, it would only be appropriate to destroy it with its own Light. We will tear the Light from the Enlightened Shadowscythe and lesser Elementals to add power to the arrows I forged.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Evil of Humanity ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lost Light, Astero
quests.description: Beyond this door, the greater Light Elemental has shed its disguise and is in fierce combat with your Father. It crawled out of the old body, one far larger than I had imagined. How it managed to fit itself in that cocoon, ha, must be a trick of the light. Prepare your arrows, Empress Gravelyn. I feel your Light necromancy spell taking effect. This creature, a mere maggot wriggling in your fortress, will be nothing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Evil of Humanity ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stained Glass
quests.description: In addition to our main agreement, I propose adding further terms. No one involved with this skirmish will mention the Elemental's trick on threat of death or eternal torture. Good, you were quick to accept. It isn't as if both of us find this debacle embarrassing. Far from it…though it would serve us well to investigate what remains of that Light to ensure this never happens again.

quests.name: Sparagmos Andromeda
quests.description: Kathool has awoken, but Sparagmos has focused all of the creature's psychic attacks on me. I am The Beast. An old squid's mind games barely tickle. Worry more about the conversation we'll have after you gather the fuel and tools we'll need to make a new A.I. Such a foreign concept, but you say you're familiar with a machine that acts human? J6… I may know him. Either way, Princess Brittany's A.I. needs to be replaced. Until a new one is installed, I will remain at the controls - and in control.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Roko's Royal Basilisk ' quest.

quests.name: Backroom Whispers
quests.description: The barracks by the Cocytus River is inhabited by those who follow Maleagant despite his lack of rank. The Evocators often strategize with him, and should know where he is. Make them tell you with force if necessary. They're stubborn about conversing with those outside of their circle.

quests.name: Cur Dolorem Sentis
quests.description: The Evocators have assumed your presence means I've found out that Maleagant was acting behind my back, and are willing to risk their lives to hide him. What a…happy coincidence. Explore the barracks and search for anything unusual. I sense familiar magic. There may be runes active.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Genuine Character
quests.description: It isn't just the Evocators plotting with Maleagant. The Legion Knights noticed you were investigating their runes, and are mobilizing to capture you. Cut them down, and keep my presence hidden. They may flee altogether if they know I'm here, and take their secrets with them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Seen the Light
quests.description: Continue your investigation. The Sullied Masters that reside in these barracks are exuding an aura similar to the Light runes. Defeat them, and retrieve their blindfolds- they're engraved with spells meant to heighten the rest of the wearer's senses. I suspect that they may have been tampered with somehow.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bad Beef
quests.description: I will give Maleagant a chance to explain himself. If the Legionnaires in these barracks aren't willing to tell us where he is, I'll give you permission to check their personal chambers. Start by interrogating Minos… his room is the first large one you'll see down the hall.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tomb of Memories
quests.description: Further down from Minos' room is…a former General's chambers. I stationed a Sullied Master there to guard it, and keep anything inside from being disturbed. Go there, relieve him of his duties, and bring me his blindfold.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reap What's Sown
quests.description: Evidently, Maleagant's collaborators have lost control of the souls they were intent on calling to the barracks. Go to the end of the hall, and banish the Overdriven Paladins before news of their rampage leaks. If there are any of my Legionnaires nearby, make them tell you what happened.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wails of Unrest
quests.description: The Evocators and Knights are organizing an all-or-nothing uprising. They believe that I'll destroy them now that you've discovered their activities. In the past, they wouldn't have been wrong. For now, cut them down at the knees, and keep them from getting between us and Maleagant.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lamenting Aestiua
quests.description: Rand made a discovery in a room at the end of the hall. Find him, and have him show you what he discovered. Apparently, a document from one of the Paladin Orders was tucked away there. It's a profile on Maleagant himself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unblemished Snow
quests.description: Subdue the Paladin Arondight. Find out why Maleagant smuggled him and the remains of other Paladins into my fortress. I'll read the notes you found. The way you said they were written sounds familiar to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slay the Unworthy
quests.description: The time has come for you to prove your power against less-worthy undead. /Join graveyard and prevent weak Undead from joining the legion. Bring back 50 Undead Un-Life Force will you truly understand the power bestowed upon the Undead Legion.

quests.name: Hail to The King
quests.description: In the Frozen Northlands, the struggle for survival is a constant endeavor. This is mission is the breaking points for many Undead Warriors. A great, Good noble King sits atop the Frozen Northlands. His power is unlike any other; Defeating him with a fully-armed party is only a fraction of the challenge. Bring me the Frost King's Surrender to complete your Undead Champion initiation.

quests.name: Rearm The Legion of Light
quests.description: The weapons that these pitiful undead carry are usually as flimsy as they are but a few have weapons of quality that we can use to give to the other members of the Legion in the field. Please find 5 Quality Weapons on the undead soldiers and bring them back to base camp.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Speak to Dage The Good ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Free Their Souls
quests.description: Alteon uses necromancy to capture lost souls and binds the souls to the bodies to animate them, but keeps them sundered from the physical forms so that he can control the bodies. It is a horrible crime. The Legion exists to free such lost souls by destroying their bodies. Please free the souls in the first room.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Speak to Dage The Good ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: One Ring
quests.description: A few days ago the soldiers captured one of my best couriers. I owe it to him to return his Legion of Light Signet Ring to his family. Please, see if you can locate the his Signet Ring on one of the undead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Speak to Dage The Good ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Severing Ties
quests.description: Before you proceed you must first cleanse this room of the enslaved souls being used to animate the undead. Free the souls of all the undead in that room.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Speak to Dage The Good ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Legion's Lifesblood
quests.description: Alteon's undead army has a few advantages over the Legion of Light. One of the biggest ones is that the undead do not eat but my comrades must have supplies to continue the battle. Please deliver supplies and place them in gathering points for the Legion Members.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Speak to Dage The Good ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Legion's Purpose
quests.description: You are making great headway beating back the undead army but our first priority is freeing the souls of our enemies. Cleanse that room of the undead's enslaved souls before moving on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Speak to Dage The Good ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What's His Endgame?
quests.description: This is going too well. I suspect that we might be walking into a trap. See if one of the undead have a clue to help us figure out Alteon's battle plans. Forewarned is forearmed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Speak to Dage The Good ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Stopping Block
quests.description: We still haven't translated the note that you found on the undead entirely but we know it has something to do with raising a very powerful undead. The fewer souls Alteon has to fuel his spell the better. It's never been more important to free the souls in that room before moving on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Speak to Dage The Good ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Boost Morale
quests.description: The Legion members must see how much of the Overworld that we've already taken back from Alteon. Please go plant these banners to show everyone how much ground you've already taken back in such a short about of time. it will boost their fighting spirits!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Speak to Dage The Good ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Alteon's Folly
quests.description: King Alteon should have known by now the price for using the souls of living beings as weapons is losing your own soul. Free the souls in that room to continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Speak to Dage The Good ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: DoomFire
quests.description: It seems that the imbalanced king has begun to experiment with even more dangerous ways of empowering his undead slaves. It seems that he has used DoomFire. See if you can gather DoomFire from some the undead attacking the Overworld.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Speak to Dage The Good ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spoiled Souls
quests.description: DoomFire is especially dangerous when the souls of the undead are captured as Alteon has done. Exposed to enough DoomFire can actually spoil the soul. You have to free the souls of these undead before they can be harmed!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Speak to Dage The Good ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Purity of Bone
quests.description: The Legion has been leaving small piles of purified bone dust around the battlefield as they have been fighting beside you to take back the Overworld. I need you to gather 10 piles of this dust so I can sanctify you before your final battle.
