quests.description: You gots to skitty! This Eight Track has some groovy beats on it, but it's bunk as a skunk if it's broken. Those Dwakels over in the Crash Site are total gearheads and should have the pieces needed to fix our funk. Loot me some 3 Eight Track Huvs and bring it back here to get our groove on!

quests.name: Boogie on!
quests.description: You got the funk? Prove it, emery! It's time to get groovy! Just try to bust me on the dance floor!

quests.name: Remnants of Apophis
quests.description: I believe your footing on the riverbank would be strengthened with magic-imbued hieroglyphs. To prepare for your duel with Sobekemsaph, Crulon suggests taking the hieroglyph-etched scales from the lamias of /djinnguard.

quests.name: Follower of Faiyum
quests.description: During Sobekemsaph's reign, his army spread the reach of the Sandsea's deserts. He entombed himself to let his successor rise, but one of his generals took residence in /Dream Palace. Spar with Golmoth and his harpies as practice for your real match.

quests.name: Lord of the Oasis
quests.description: I beseech you, the Hero chosen by acting Chief Lector Crulon, to duel the Pharaoh of Warfare, Sobekmsaph, in ritual combat. Your victory will earn the people of the Sandsea the right to drink from this newborn river.

quests.name: The Fool
quests.description: This is the start of your new journey. The Primordial Fool is not named so because they are foolish. A better way to describe it is that they are pure, brimming with the courage to face the challenges ahead. I feel that you are not ready to jump into the unknown. There are people who you do not wish to leave behind. They stood up for you, and paid the price. We must return to Astravia and gather them before we can continue onwards.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pisces Ishtar ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Magician
quests.description: The Astravian soldiers who swore loyalty to King Drago are roaming the streets. I believe they're ensuring that there are no survivors. You're still gathering remains and they'll impede your progress. Drago may learn that you survived if they catch sight of you and flee. I suppose now is the time to take direct action? You will have to fight the soldiers you once called your guardians.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pisces Ishtar ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The High Priestess
quests.description: Your friends are resilient. They were brought to the edge of death by the very people they promised to protect, but kept their vow. I feel them about to slip into the realm of the dead. You wish to save them? With the power of the Fool, it is possible to revive, at most, those three souls. Share the knowledge you received from the Primordials, and your friends will be tethered to its hidden mysteries.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pisces Ishtar ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Empress, Reversed
quests.description: More of Drago's soldiers are flooding into the streets. He means to have them scrub the remains of you and your supporters off the face of Astravia. It is time we make our return to the Fool's Realm to contemplate. You can't leave any witnesses to warn Drago. Like with the soldiers who came before, you understand we must silence them permanently.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pisces Ishtar ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Emperor
quests.description: The bodies of the Astravians who still have your love are now dust. You wish to create a grave for them? I see. They are, after all, the foundation for your vision of a perfect world. Regulus, Titania, and Aurola's hearts can't be mended, but having a place where they can remember what was lost would soothe them. You are their leader. A gravestone would be suitable, as something for them to lean on like how they'll lean on you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pisces Ishtar ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wheel of Fortune
quests.description: The longer you exist in the body crafted by the Fool, the more Lore will come to reject you. Soon, only young So will be able to travel between realms unless you find others who will aid your cause. She said she needs any bio-organic test subject we can procure. Replacement parts for the machinery would be welcome as well. Work diligently at this goal and the result will shine.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Hermit ' quest.

quests.name: Justice, Reversed
quests.description: The promise the First King made to Alprecha is on the cusp of being fulfilled. Basing his decision on ideas of fairness and justice, Darkon has accepted his reward - the ability to remake Lore. Venture into the emptiness for a glimpse of the new sky the Empress' child wishes to paint.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Hermit ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Hanged Man, Reversed
quests.description: The Nothingness is eating away at Lore. Do you know what true emptiness is? There is no light. Not even a space for the darkness to fill the sun's absence. This is what Darkon has decided that Lore deserves. If left alone, the Nothingness will envelop you as well. Fight them off, for your continued existence and your home.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Hermit ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Death
quests.description: Re, formerly General Regulus of Astravia, stands before you. She was one breath away from her death before Darkon rescued her. Even then, he could only rescue her body and not her mind. Re's personality transformed completely but still fights on Darkon's behalf because of her bonds. Or, there could be a chance that parts of Regulus remain. The only way to advance is to defeat her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Hermit ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Temperance, Reversed
quests.description: Fa, the most powerful member of the Scale yet the most disconnected from her family's sense of purpose. Though she is an Outsider who would be treated harshly for her cosmic origins, she fights solely for the purpose of extending her way of life. To keep the Scale, especially Re, as they are. Face Fa in combat, but let her down gently. Her current lack of balance will make her easier to duel.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Hermit ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Temptation, Reversed
quests.description: Ti, formerly General Titania of Astravia. His mindfulness and gentle nature have been completely overtaken by his rage and guilt. He will not let the past nor his own mistakes go. And he certainly won't let you pass without a fight. Ready yourself for a difficult battle. The ferocity of a real monster is nothing compared to the ferocity of a scapegoat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Hermit ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bully Birdies
quests.description: It's great to see a fellow human hoo has a deep moral code and the brawn to back it up. But are you as strong as your stomach is…? Time Travel is not for the faint of heart - or those prone to motion sickness - but if you're ready to travel across space and time, then the time has come! Go out the back door and step into the unknown as we fight back the bird bullies seeping through the seams of the universe. If you don't see what you are looking for, come back and try the teleporter again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Hoo Are You? ' quest.

quests.name: Early Bird or Knight Owl?
quests.description: They say the early bird catches the worm… but the night owl catches the mouse! *licks beak hungrily* I assume you don't eat mice, but I definitely do, and now I'm starving and can't stop thinking about my favorite food. I bet the only thing good about Knight Owls is their stash of free-range mice, so let's go get some while we save the world.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hoodini's Magic Act
quests.description: *Srrrrreeek, srrrreeeeek!* Well now I'm even more peeved: first BirdsWithHarms tryin' to take over the universe, now Hoodini Owls tryin' to take my schtick! Owl not stand for this - there can only be one great magic owl, and that's ME - so the Hoodinis must be defeated! Show them the REAL disappearing act, Human!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Owl Give You the Answer
quests.description: Upon closer inspection… it's confirmed without a doubt: this stunned parrot has ceased to exist due to the classic Minty Piethon sketch! I'd talk to John Geese just to make sure, and then register a complaint with that pet shop boutique that sold you this very dead bird!

quests.name: Jars of Slime
quests.description: Eating books good fiber, but need balance! Some slime will wash it down real good. You slay slimes and bring Dogear back 8 jars of slime.

quests.name: Sneevil Boxes
quests.description: Mmmm… dat was good! Book and slime go great just like peanut butter and jelly fish! Me want send some to friends back home in New Horkia but all dem little green Sneevils stole all da boxes. Slay Sneevils and bring back 4 Sneevil Boxes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Behind the bush?
quests.description: Um… why are there feet sticking out from behind that bush? Click on the feet to investigate.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Coal Hard Facts
quests.description: Thanks for helping out, hero. I really appreciate this. First, I will need some coal to get the furnace burning again. Can't forge a sword without fire. I'll make sure the furnace is in good working order. There should be large chances of coal just lying around Dwarfhold.

quests.name: Material World
quests.description: Next I will need some material. Normally I would start with raw pig iron but if you can gather weapon fragments from Drow and Draconians then it will help me get a head start crafting weapons. I'll stoke the fire while you gather 12 Weapon Fragments.

quests.name: You're A Gem
quests.description: Ok, now I need some large Gemstones. Dwarven tradition states that we decorate our weapons with the treasures of the earth. It's more than just for looks, it connects us to our roots. The Chaos Draconians have taken all of our gems for themselves. If you can just get me 4, it would be a great start!

quests.name: Ore Eaters
quests.description: Oh, the furnace is going and I have all the materials I need. One last thing. The Glow Worms tunnel all over our mountains eating all the good iron ore supplies. I need that iron. Get rid of 8 Glow Worms and that should help protect my supply line.

quests.name: Life Keeps Its Lemons
quests.description: I traveled all the way to Lore to sample lemon pie made by Oishii, but is it out of season? Waiting wouldn't be too bad…it's just that I was really looking forward to it. What if we made one together? Here's a list of ingredients! Hm? You've got a funny look on your face.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' SN.O.W. Fall ' quest.

quests.name: He Limed Me
quests.description: Now it's time to sample some key lime pie! I've heard the ingredients can be found in some sort of "Ecto Cave". Do you know of such a place?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' SN.O.W. Fall ' quest.

quests.name: Bad Moon Rising
quests.description: You have to get that contract back by the time the moon rises tonight. If not… I'm toast. We're going to need some things to destroy that contract and we should get those first. All the monsters in this area have Fire Fleas on them. That is the first ingredient. Bring me 15 Fire Fleas, quickly
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the /Dance Evolution Mini-game from Great Godfather of Souls . Note: Quest name is a parody of the song Bad Moon Rising by Creedence Clearwater Revival.

quests.name: Burning Down The House
quests.description: To burn that contract we will also need some Cannon Powder from the local Pachelbel's Cannons. The stuff is pretty powerful so we will only need one helping. Bring me 1 Charge of Cannon Powder. They are HARD TO FIND but Please hurry!

quests.name: Superstition
quests.description: The last thing that we're going to need is… a little luck. I know it's silly with the seconds melting away but I'm a strong believer in luck. The claws of the Mozard are considered one of the luckiest things in all of Mythsong valley. Please, bring me 5 Mozard Claws.

quests.name: Soul Man
quests.description: All that is left is the contract. Be careful, hero. Faust is a very dangerous creature and he will stop at nothing to make sure I fulfil my contract with him. Good luck and remember a lot more than my life is at stake here.

quests.name: Requiem in P
quests.description: Thank you for freeing me, hero! I will leave shortly, but first we need to dish out some major pain to the rest of these creatures. Think of it as their inspiration— show them how a true artist finds beauty in suffering.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Soul Man ' quest.

quests.name: Rejection of Gravity
quests.description: The Apocalyptic Entity I tried to summon is taking on my appearance, and twisting my wish. In the form of Trickster Duartaine, it will prove to the Dragonrune Professors that Apocalyptic magic is real by destroying the logic of Elemental Magic, Druidism, Necromancy, and Spell Craft. Please, you're the only one who can stop it.

quests.name: The Spittoon Saloon
quests.description: I hope you have a strong stomach, deary. You see, llamas are notorious for spitting, but my herd is out of control! Yesterday alone, I slipped eight times in puddles of llama saliva—gross! Would it be possible for you to find me 6 Spittoons? I'm sure that the Shells from the local Turtles will work nicely, but be careful… I hear that those reptiles will put up quite a fight!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bear Facts ' quest.

quests.name: Bear It All!
quests.description: Oh deary, thank goodness you're here… a few of my elder llamas have lost all their teeth! The poor things can't even eat the softest hay! Head out into the forest and collect 6 sets of Bear Teeth so I can make the first ever Llama Dentures!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Leather Feathers
quests.description: I have another favor to ask of you, deary. These pine forests are home to the LeatherWing, fabled on having the softest feathers in all of Lore! I was hoping you could gather 8 bundles of LeatherWing plumage so I could stuff the llamas' pillows with them. …What? You didn't know llamas slept on pillows?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Follow your Nose!
quests.description: Goodness gracious, do you smell that, deary? What…*sniff*…what is…*sniff sniff*…eww! My llamas have gotten into something *sniff sniff* really nasty! I am in desperate need of an air freshener! Can you search all the forest monsters for a remedy? One of them is bound to have a solution to this stinky situation!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Alarm a Llama!
quests.description: Goodness me, 5 of my Llamas have run away and a Pine Troll s made off my with my Llama Leash! Will you be a dear and find them for me? I would do it myself, but I have to finish making my llama-fur boots! They can't be too far… oh, I hope nothing bad has happened to any of them!

quests.name: Grizzly Situation
quests.description: Goodness gracious! Those troublesome Grizzly Bears are spooking my herd of llamas… again! I don't want to bear this burden on you… but can you help me out? Someone once told me that a Grizzly Bear is powered by the delicious Pastry Element, Bear Claw. Once removed from the bear, it makes them docile. Please gather 6 Bear Claws for me, and i shall reward you handsomely!

quests.name: The Coward
quests.description: So the noises I heard were a just a mess of rogues after the same thing we are? Strange. I thought I heard more than people. Figure out why they're here.

quests.name: Welcome Party
quests.description: You say he seemed scared? He should have; you attacked him. Oh, you mean he was running from something. Hm. If you can find his friends, interrogate them too. And don't concuss them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Scout Ahead
quests.description: Tell me if you encounter anything you might need my help with. As if you need it. You can handle some undead. That's all that's ever in these places, right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dinner Party
quests.description: Hero, I have some bad news. We have a gruesome explanation for the other Tomb Robbers disappearing.. You clear the way while I get the thieves' bite wounds treated.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Illumination Preparation
quests.description: I have no idea how long this is going to take us, but I'm not going to risk these.. things.. coming out of the woodwork and ambushing us. Bring me 8 planks of wood from the Sundered Darkblood. We can split them and use them to lighten this place up a bit should it get too dark.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bones Picked Clean
quests.description: I'm somehow relieved that we're back to fighting undead like I'm used to. But these ones seem.. abnormally fresh. I don't smell any decay from them..
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Biased Window
quests.description: We've hit a snag. There's no way to proceed because of a barrier. Past it I can see more Sundered Darkblood, and they can pass through barriers freely. Gather 8 armor pieces for me to put near the barrier, it should open up the barrier and keep it that way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Room For Seconds
quests.description: Oh no.. What are those?! They look like the other monsters, but they move even faster.. and they're drooling.. I can somehow feel it staring at us..
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Magic Doorstop
quests.description: Okay don't panic, but.. The barrier from before closed back up. Something removed the armor from the bones. I suggest we go back and take it down for good. If you get me more Darkblood Armor Pieces, I can figure out what enchantment lets them pass through, and put it right on the floor.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Silverware Cipher
quests.description: The next barrier isn't letting anything we've seen in this dungeon through. I can put a counterspell together, but I'm missing a spell component: Soft metal. Or at least softer metal than weapons or armor. We're going to need a lot of it to bust this barrier… You're gonna make me touch those gross forks from Ravenous Maws, aren't you?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dinner Bell
quests.description: Oh no. No, no, no.. Hero.. As the barrier fell, I heard everything go silent.. When I turned around they were all facing me, staring with their teeth! Please! I want to go home! I want to leave!!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Faceless Challengers
quests.description: As you walk the hall you begin to notice the suits of armor. You haven't been attacked by anything for a while so of course you expected it when one took a swing at you just now.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Doorway
quests.description: The hallway seemed endless, and featureless save for evidence of escape and carnage. You've finally come across a door that isn't locked or painted onto the wall. You pass through this part of the hall and..
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eternal Hunger
quests.description: The Maws return, climbing out of shadow, In their seemingly endless hunger, they have begun to attack the animated armors. But the foolish things soon learn that they cannot ingest these knights.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: You Weren't Invited
quests.description: A voice calls to you. "One of you thieves hasn't fled? What is the matter? You don't understand the endless struggle you drag your feet towards?"
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Teeth and Plates
quests.description: The voice warns you now. "I doubt you would come here just to deny my pets their meal. You're after the sword. Turn back. It's made up." You note that whoever is talking to you is a terrible liar.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Moment of Silence
quests.description: The mysterious voice has quieted down. You've seen enough torn books around here to realize that they seem to be journals. Maybe they hold more information about this place and the weapon you're after.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eternal Servitude
quests.description: "You." spits the voice. "I see that I cannot convince you to leave any longer. You've murdered my pets and broken too many of my toys. As the appointed guardian of this place, I will never let you remove the Gilded Blade of Eternity."
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Reanimated Dragon
quests.description: You see this Dracolich before you, unaccompanied by it's master. The voice you have heard is silent, as though waiting for something.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lonesome Twin Guardian
quests.description: The room is eerily quiet. This Dracolich is where the voice originates from. "You've taken all the company I've known since my brother and I were appointed to guard the Gilded Blade of Eternity. I understand that I have kept my brother's soul tethered to his corpse in vain. But that does not mean I will simply give up. If you want the sword… you will have to tear it from me."
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadow of Sepulchure's Quest
quests.description: I lived. I died. I became Darkness. But I was still of the world. But then that tentacled She-Beast Queen ripped my spirit out and cast it into the Void. But then I heard my daughter's voice… a piece of my spirit could still communicate with her. That is all that kept my mostly-sane… that and the task the She-Beast gave. To guard the puppy queen. But even the Darkness must feed. Slay 3 ShadowSprites in the ShadowVoid to renew my strength, and help me keep the connection to my daughter strong.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon I
quests.description: Slay 8 of the Grimmer Soldiers to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in the dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon II
quests.description: Slay 10 of the Grimmer Fighters to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in the dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon III
quests.description: Slay 13 of the Grimmer Lichs to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in the dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon IV
quests.description: Slay 30 of the Weeping Spyballs to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in the dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon V
quests.description: Avoid the saws and slay 8 of the Grimmer Ectomancers to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in the dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon VI
quests.description: Slay the Grimmer Shelletons until you get the Grim Key to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon VII
quests.description: Slay 9 of the Grimmer Fighters to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon VIII
quests.description: Slay 13of the Grimmer Fire Mages to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon IX
quests.description: Slay 8 of the Grimmer Lichs to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon X
quests.description: Don't pull the lever. Whatever you do… DO NOT pull the lever! (Do it… pull the lever!) Slay 15 Weeping Spyballs if you want to continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon XI
quests.description: Slay 10 of the Grimmer Fighters to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon XII
quests.description: Slay 13 of the Grimmer Lichs to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon XIII
quests.description: Slay 10 of the Grimmer Fighters to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon XIV
quests.description: Slay 35 of the Weeping Spyballs to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon XVI
quests.description: Slay 10 of the Grimmer Shelletons to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon XVII
quests.description: Slay 8 of the Grimmer Soldiers to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon XVIII
quests.description: Slay 6 of the Grimmer Lichs to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon XIX
quests.description: Slay 13 of the Grimmer Lichs to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon XXI
quests.description: Slay 12 of the Grimmer Fire Mages to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon XXII
quests.description: Slay 6 of the Grimmer Fighters to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon XXIII
quests.description: Slay 3 of the Grimmer Ectomancers to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon XXIV
quests.description: Slay 12 of the Grimmer Soldiers to pass this room before they kill you… and force you to join the legions of undead in this dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grim Underdungeon XXIX
quests.description: Slay Raxgore and escape from the dungeon alive! Equip your Hero's Blade to do extra damage!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest.

quests.name: Grimblight Challenge
quests.description: Slay Ultra Raxgore and escape from the dungeon alive! Equip your Hero's Blade to do extra damage!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' I Command You, Help Me! ' quest. | Must have GrimBlight of Destiny to access this quest.

quests.name: The Challenge Begins
quests.description: Welcome to your last adventure… EVER! Slay 5 Grim Soldiers if you agree to test your skills in my dungeon. Muahahaha!

quests.name: Fight to Survive
quests.description: IF you ever believe you're up to my challenge, slay 6 of my Grim Fighters.

quests.name: The Battle's Heating Up
quests.description: If you can't stand the heat, get out of my dungeon… IF you can slay 10 of my Fire Mages!

quests.name: A Close Shave
quests.description: Battle your way across the razor's edge, or you might find yourself short a head! If you want to continue, slay 8 Grim Shelletons!

quests.name: Eye Spy a Victim
quests.description: Go ahead, slay 6 of my Spyballs and I will let you continue further in my dungeon. But don't think you'll win, Hero. None of you ever do!

quests.name: Help Me!
quests.description: You're a Hero. A Hero saves the princess, right? There's nothing fishy about that…

quests.name: Get Your Hands Dirty
quests.description: Tired yet, Hero? Too bad! If you want to keep going, you will need to slay 10 of my Ectomancers!

quests.name: A Rocky Battle
quests.description: Slay my creatures to find the Stone Key This is going to be a rocky battle… are you hard-headed enough to survive?

quests.name: Soul-d on Defeat
quests.description: Gather 50 Souls IF you think you have enough stamina to continue.

quests.name: The Key to Help Me
quests.description: Find the Princess' Key and you might just survive another room.

quests.name: Help Me Again!
quests.description: Since you didn't save the first Princess, maybe you'll do better this time around…

quests.name: Overheated Hero
quests.description: This dungeon's a bit chilly. Slay 5 of my Fire Mages to heat things up.

quests.name: The Blade-breaker
quests.description: Slay 3 Grim Lich to pass into the next room. You are getting closer…

quests.name: Anti-Magic Warrior
quests.description: Magic will not help you here. Slay 7 Grim Fighters if you wish to meet your doom.

quests.name: Elemental Destroyer
quests.description: Neither wind, rain, fire or hail can stop Raxgore! Slay 3 Ectomancers to continue towards your fate.

quests.name: The Unkillable
quests.description: Slay 3 Grim Shelletons and hurry on, Hero. Raxgore is waiting!

quests.name: Key to Victory
quests.description: Find Raxgore's Key and you'll find the key to HIS victory! (You thought I'd give YOU a way to beat him… ?!)

quests.name: I Command You, Help Me!
quests.description: So you think you can Hero? Slay this final beast to exit Grimskull's dungeon… IF YOU CAN!

quests.name: Get Rid of the Imps
quests.description: Slay the imps that live in these tunnels. This will increase your power… and prevent them from sounding an alarm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Rid of Bolton ' quest.

quests.name: Get Into the Dungeon
quests.description: The door leading into the dungeon is locked. But that's not barrier for YOU. Smash it down so you'll be able to enter the dungeon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Destroy the Guards
quests.description: Kill these guards. They will only get in your way, and your sword demands blood.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get the Key
quests.description: You must get past that reinforced door. One of the elite guards has the key. Kill them and take it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find Lynaria
quests.description: Lynaria is somewhere in the cells beyond that door. Find her. Help her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Destroy Dethrix
quests.description: Kill him now. Make sure he can never harm her again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: He's Not Your Friend
quests.description: He is no longer your friend! He would take from you your home. He has already stolen the woman you love. Show him what happens to those who defy you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Siphon the Power (Farming) ' or Juice for a Tonic (Farming) ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the Dragon
quests.description: You could defeat this dragon with your blade and armor alone. But with the strength of your own dragon behind you, they stand no chance. Show him who is supreme!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Power Boost
quests.description: My power grows every moment we're here. It is still not enough. Slay the shadowy creatures that surround us so that they may empower me. Don't worry, the plane will replenish them soon enough.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Dragon ' quest.

quests.name: Take His Knights
quests.description: Alteon's remaining Guardian Knights attack us. Defeat them. Use the power you have taken from this Plane to turn them to our side.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Destroy the Light
quests.description: Lynaria summons light spirits to enhance her own strength. Destroy them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: More Power!
quests.description: We will need to draw more power from the Plane of Darkness to aid in our next attack. Slay the shadow creatures here, and grow our strength.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Destroy the Force Field
quests.description: Pound Lynaria's force field with the dark energy we have just taken. It must be destroyed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the Battalion
quests.description: Lynaria remains protected by a battalion of her knights and the spirits she summons. Fight your way through them. Destroy them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Destroy the Beast
quests.description: Slay the beast now! There is no time to wait!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get Alteon
quests.description: Find Alteon. Kill anyone who gets in your way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Test the Disguise quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Hammer Time
quests.description: He thinks he can stop you. He will die.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Doomed Vessel Forge
quests.description: To truly understand the nature of DOOM, you must be able to face the heart of Darkness unflinching, survive its shadowy gaze unscathed, and stare unblinking into the fiery inferno from which this blade was forged. Then do it again. And again. And again. If your will is strong enough to create your own Doomed Vessel Blade, face the Mysterious Stranger and return with 13 vials of Molten Darkness.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Enigmatic Entity ' quest. Note: Only available to owner.

quests.name: Nulgath 2023 Collection Badge Quest
quests.description: Tercessuinotlim is an evil place, full of shadow and tainted energy. Slay a Tainted Elemental to steal its energy to fuel my hunger.

quests.name: Classic DoomKnight Class
quests.description: (For owners of the 2000 AC version of Classic DoomKnight Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a DoomKnight. There are times, however, when the skills of a DoomKnight do not suit, however the look does. This is for those times.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Classic Doomknight (AC) with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory.

quests.name: Classic DoomKnight Class
quests.description: (For owners of the 0 AC Member version of Classic Doomknight Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a DoomKnight. There are times, however, when the skills of a DoomKnight do not suit, however the look does. This is for those times.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Classic Doomknight (0 AC) with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory.

quests.name: DoomKnight Class
quests.description: (For owners of the 0 AC Member version of Doomknight Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a DoomKnight. There are times, however, when the skills of a DoomKnight do not suit, however the look does. This is for those times.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Doomknight (0 AC) with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory.

quests.name: DoomKnight Class
quests.description: (For owners of the 2000 AC version of DoomKnight Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a DoomKnight. There are times, however, when the skills of a DoomKnight do not suit, however the look does. This is for those times.
quests.requirements_note: Must have DoomKnight (AC) with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory.

quests.name: Unlock the Spaceport
quests.description: The greatest teacher, failure is. To unlock the Spaceport, you must do one thing. Defeat Master Twang in combat. (Hint: type /join quibblehunt to begin your quest.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have DoomStar in your inventory.

quests.name: Scientific Accessories
quests.description: The One who created us has seen a spaceship in the sky, on a collision course from Venus! And we've been charged with gathering the bits and bolts to fix the ship after it crashes into your dome. He wants to make a spaceship-mobile; a giant rotating collection of intergalactic fliers! If you help us, we'll tell you one of His secrets!

quests.name: Exquisite Dead Guy
quests.description: Have you seen the rejection collection? We are supposed to watch it. Anything He failed at creating is stored in a special room. There is one specimen, though, which has failed at failing. It can't even stay dead properly! Help us gather the reagents to put t back to 'sleep' before our Creator finds out and topples us poor doppelgangers!

quests.name: Hall of Stolen Heads
quests.description: There's a SPECIAL hall we can show you, but not until you've been photographed to log all of your current imperfections. That way He can't blame us if you take any more damage. It's called the Hall of Heads! But it seems that the beasties in the lab have made of with them. Get them back for us and we'll share with you the secret of the Collection!

quests.name: I Want a Rock
quests.description: You know, we never really had a childhood. One day, we woke up in the Lab and He was looking down at us. He created us to serve a purpose, and that didn't include playing games or having fun. We only have each other. But there IS a game we made up. We'll teach you and our not-pelgangers, but we'll need 10 rocks and 5 pieces of string.

quests.name: Take Out the Trash
quests.description: We're supposed to keep the Lab clean for Him, whenever He decides to appear. He gets ANGRY when things are dirty. It's not good when He gets mad! But lately we've been watching our not-pelgangers. Trying to see makes them…MORE than us. Can you take out the trash while we work out why the little kid thinks they're better than we are?

quests.name: Fiend Zoned
quests.description: Listen up! If you really want this to end, you'll have to take down Scarletta for good! Go to the Fiend Zone, where all her rejected suitors wander endlessly. Take the tokens of their love - she may not want THEM, but she does want the attention! That'll tick her off enough to make her show her face.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kick His- Wait, Did We Already Use That Pun? ' quest.

quests.name: Find Scarletta
quests.description: Scarletta will surely have noticed our antics by now! You should be able to find her in her throne room. You'll now it when you see it - it has the biggest mirror in the entire tower.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Trade for the Songstone
quests.description: A Songstone? Yes, I can craft one for you. I will need some raw materials from you, however. Get me some Shards of Song from the crystals laying about and bring them back to me.

quests.name: Shadow Medal
quests.description: Malgor's army of shadowy rockers has proven hard to push back! Help us fight them off, and bring me their Shadow Medals as proof.

quests.name: Song of Fate
quests.description: Does the Song of Fate really exist? If it does, is it really here? We have to find out - before Oh-Garr does! Some of the local monsters may be able to give us a clue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Broken Strings
quests.description: All of our bards have been fighting so hard… they’re breaking all their guitar strings! Get them some more from the Beatles so they can keep playing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Unlocked when the War Meter progression reached 25%.

quests.name: Shattered Crystal
quests.description: So much music - and it’s all so loud! It’s been causing our Mythsong Crystals to shatter. See if you can collect all the fragments! It’s better if we keep all their energy here, even if they are broken.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Unlocked when the War Meter progression reached 25%.

quests.name: Mega Shadow Medals
quests.description: He's started to send in the big guns now! You can't tell them apart by the way they look, but you'll know them by the larger medals they carry.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Unlocked when the War Meter progression reached 50%.

quests.name: New Music
quests.description: Our bards need more ammunition to keep fighting back - and that means new compositions! The Mozards are incredibly prolific. They're sure to have something we can use.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Unlocked when the War Meter progression reached 50%.

quests.name: Listen to the Drums
quests.description: More percussion! We need more percussion! I'm thinking those Cannons will have what we seek.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Unlocked when the War Meter progression reached 75%.

quests.name: Strength in Music
quests.description: Our bards need something stronger to fight with. Sometimes the Mozards have a composition that is truly powerful - a rare thing indeed. Bring me any that you find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Unlocked when the War Meter progression reached 75%.

quests.name: Stop the Music
quests.description: Stop this concert, hero! If Oh'Garr finishes that song, there's no telling what horrors it will bring.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Unlocked when the War Meter progression reached 100%.

quests.name: Bolster the Elements
quests.description: If Lore's elements are to defend themselves, then they need resources to keep their strength up. Gather 3 Shadows for Nocturu, 3 Lights of Hope for Lucian, slay 3 Water Elementals for Nautilus, and smash 3 Eternite Ores to produce Timesparks for Dynami.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Not All Hope is Lost ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Maintain Elemental Strength
quests.description: If Lore's elements are to attack their opponents, then they need resources to fuel their warriors. Slay 3 Ice monsters for Glacius, 3 Fire Elementals for Igneus, and gather 3 each of the Adamantite Ore and Balanced Breezes for Geoto and Aerodu.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Not All Hope is Lost ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fishy Hospitality
quests.description: The villagers are as simple-minded as the fish they hunt. They may have been hostile to you at first, but a peek at my damaged papers is enough to open them up to conversation. They're the type to give everything away, and are burdened with guilt if a favor they receive goes unpaid. Get rid of the Kitefin Shark Bait plaguing the village, and its people will be hard pressed to refuse us further hospitality.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Washed Ink ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Doctoring Papers
quests.description: A villager is directing us to the beach to speak with another doctor who arrived earlier. They took a stroll there despite the sands being infested with Ghostly Eels. It isn't unheard of for a doctor to be armed and well-versed in combat. Not when there is danger lurking even in the shoals. Get rid of the Eels. They're annoyances that will get in the way when we speak to that doctor.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Washed Ink ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Psychic Pollution
quests.description: Dr. Ganx has offered to vouch for the validity of my invitation. Despite the obvious danger, there's use in allowing her to be around. She said that the meeting is in a couple of hours, which I'll need to reforge my papers. In that time, gather samples from the Water Elementals roaming the beach. There's something off about them, and it could be related to the rubble Dr. Ganx was standing next to. Examine it as well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Washed Ink ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Duck Dive
quests.description: The appointed time is here. Go to the end of the dock and speak with the Swordhaven Doctor. Is my sight failing me, or is she actually telling us to board a bright yellow sea vessel in the shape of a duck? I refuse to even consider the idea of using such a poorly made contraption. Why are you and the brat so eager? Do you want 'died in a duck' to be on your gravestone? Argh, the trip better be quick.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Washed Ink ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Faces in the Foam
quests.description: I count the Duck Vessel being riddled with as many leaks as this secret Swordhaven project to be yet another stroke of good fortune. A Seafoam Elemental has intruded on our trip, and it is affected by the same outside force as the Shark Bait and Water Elementals. Destroy it before it ravages the sea vessel, but be wary. The outside influence has a far heavier hold on this creature.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Washed Ink ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kalamari Kontamination
quests.description: The coast is being drawn into the influence of an outside force. According to Dr. Song, you are correct in believing that it could be Kathool, but apparently the effects of its presence are under control. She has the villagers on a diet of chiefly grain from Swordhaven as a protective measure. Put that claim to the test. Examine the Seafoam Elemental, Shark Bait, and the Ashray Fisherman for anything of note.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Faces in the Foam ' quest.

quests.name: Motivation Malady
quests.description: The Defense Division's Weapons Labs are divided in two. The first section handles 'defense projects and live trials.' I assume the latter two are euphemisms for developing weapons and testing them on prisoners. Scout this area and report back. Before you do, speak with the researcher and the…creature. Fa was her name? Make sure they both understand their tasks. I don't especially trust the competency of a construction worker in PJs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sea's Commitment ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Radical Renovation
quests.description: You found another cluster of dark stone engraved with blue runes while you were scouting? Take a closer examination. I imagine there's another journal hidden in its crevices. As you and the moth have discovered, these structures are attracting the local sea life. Lamprey, likely reared in these labs as live test subjects, have escaped and gathered around the obelisk. Dispatch those tripping hazards while you're there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sea's Commitment ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Graveyard Shift
quests.description: The question of what those blue runed obelisks are has been settled. Now, I want to see the weapons Swordhaven has been developing for myself. ShadowSlayers, in specific, were hired to patrol the Defence Division Labs at all hours. As for why, I believe the answer is in the locked Live Trials room behind the examination table. Subdue the ShadowSlayers and search them for a key card.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sea's Commitment ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Educational Execution
quests.description: The Live Trials Room is where the Defense Division researchers test their weapons on undead prisoners. Go inside and see for yourselves. I heard from General Rand that some of our foot soldiers, and the minions of the Empire and Nation went missing. Or, they were captured rather than slain. So this was where they were sent. Subdue them, and bring what remains of them to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sea's Commitment ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Vows For Ignorance
quests.description: Seabase Undine is the Temple of Water, taken by the Swordhaven Crown and used as a secret testing ground for weaponry. Its seclusion lends perfectly to said goal, but so could a cave or a Skyguard facility. Why would the Good Queen risk the lives of hundreds of her subjects in such hostile environs? There has to be more to this. Bring me bone samples from the feral prisoners and any documents you can find from the ShadowSlayers, and explore further into the Labs. According to the blueprints, a Conference Room separates the first and second sections of the Weapons Labs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sea's Commitment ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Protein Shake
quests.description: Beyond the Conference Room lies the second section of the Weapon's Labs. Sparagmos should be at the very end. According to the manual Noelle sent to me, the system runs on fuel that is stored in the Abyssal Zone below, and pumped into vats on this floor. Scout ahead and find these vats. We need to confirm if the fuel managed to 'escape' during the mayhem. If so, beat this visceral liquid until it stops moving.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sea's Commitment ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Duty Beyond Death
quests.description: In such a perilous environment, death is less common than I expected. That may be the result of your acquaintance Song's efforts. She arrived long after Seabase Undine took the lives of many. Their ghosts linger here, not out of spite or anger. They haunt the halls because they wish to continue protecting the Base, their peers, and their dream. Ha, they aren't taking my presence well. Calm them so we may move on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sea's Commitment ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Designated Taunters
quests.description: System Sparagmos is made of two components. In simple terms, there is an input where fuel is fed, and an output that causes an effect. In the manual, Noelle noted that blocking Kathool's influence was impossible. Research on the Temple would need to be halted unless these psychic attacks were directed at a designated target. Collect more of the escaped shadowy fuel and ward away the Wraiths. We're almost ready to see Sparagmos.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sea's Commitment ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Beloved Simulacrum
quests.description: At first, I theorized that Sparagmos was using the souls of the dead to absorb Kathool's attacks. But that wasn't the case. The GreenGuard Queen has forbidden necromancy in all forms. Instead, the Seabase sacrificed their own as brain shields until Song arrived with Astravian technology. Proceed further until you reach the end of the Midnight Zone to find the Sparagmos A.I. We need to figure out how they created it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sea's Commitment ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Roko's Royal Basilisk
quests.description: Sparagmos' A.I. is based on the memories of the former Princess' eldest sister. Tara's presence has caused it to frenzy. It refuses to be rebooted despite its suboptimal condition out of a misguided attempt to protect Tara. What an unreliable method of defense. Never rely on the good graces of another. This is why you'll have to fight this A.I. and force a reboot of the system to keep the base from devolving into chaos. With how distraught Tara is, she'll obviously be of no help.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Sea's Commitment ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dr. Darkwood's Robe
quests.description: So, about that robe that I need you to fetch. It's being stored in the cellar outside. Just go out the back door, and then head to the left until you see it. You'll need to unlock it - here, use this key! Then, just head downstairs and find my robe.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' You Can't Tell Time ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Popping Boba
quests.description: Boba Tea is one of my most popular sellers - which brings with it the problem of always being low on "boba"! But that's why I have friends like you. You see how those Violet Slimes have so many tiny eyeballs floating inside them? Bring me those. Enough to fill up this cup.

quests.name: Creeping Horror
quests.description: It's time to make a new batch of Creeping Horror! Might you have time to go fetch me some ingredients? Fill up this bucket with Purple Ooze, which is really just Crawling Ooze that's been tenderized by your weapon. Then, fill this other one with powdered chaos - you can get that by grinding up inert Chaos Crystals. It's what gives the dish its special fizz!

quests.name: Crawling Chaos
quests.description: Care to help me make my next batch of Crawling Chaos? I'll need a whole slew of tiny little tentacles - you'll find them growing inside Chaos Eggs. I'll also need a chaorrupted charge, from the Chaos Sprites - this is what gives the dish its protective effect!

quests.name: Hazardous Hybrid
quests.description: I didn't expect the Chaoroot itself to gain the will to survive. Even though they lack a central nervous system or any thought processes, the Chaoroot Compound I created will fight fiercely. A fine achievement! Except they've overrun my lab and are becoming a tripping hazard. Cull their numbers, and bring their inert remains to me. I'll find use for those.

quests.name: Experimental Cattle
quests.description: Module 005 is my current subject. This time, the fusion of Chaoroot Compound and a pre-existing lifeform was stable. Its temper is the opposite. My creation flew into a rage after a single prod from my shock stick, and escaped from its cell. Capture it and I will reward you. I don't mind if you can't bring them to me in one piece. The lab has enough wire to stitch them back together.

quests.name: Find Explosive Supplies
quests.description: We can't investigate what J6 has been doing without dynamite! I can assemble explosives from robot parts. Battle the Robo Dogs to bring me 5 spare parts and I should be alright.

quests.name: Robot Defense League
quests.description: The Robot Defense League took a wrong turn at asteroid 17.5G. But we've got YOU here and that even better! Slay 6 of the Robot Drones coming at us while I get my supplies in order.

quests.name: Battle the Space Raptor
quests.description: I don't know WHY J6 left this dinosaur guarding the moon, but if you slay it, I bet we'll find out! Defeat the Space Raptor and bring whatever you find.

quests.name: Detergent Shortage
quests.description: Let's get this tour over with. Welcome to the Sunlight Zone, where we receive new researchers and their visiting families. Please head to the room on the right. That's where we fit you with the right uniforms, safety equipment, and card key. Tsk, the Blighted Water Elementals slipped through again. Mop them up so Dr. Mostyma and Tara's equipment won't get soiled.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Faces in the Foam ' quest.

quests.name: Ghost in the Machine
quests.description: We need to take a detour. I just received a message about ghosts causing tech malfunctions. Return to the entrance and proceed left down the hallway. The Spectral Jellyfish can only be kept out using magic, which means I have to see to strengthening the spells keeping the barrier up. Fight off the Jellyfish, and ignore any strange messages on the screens. They're…hallucinations caused by the ghosts.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Efficient Division
quests.description: I-I see…clearing the hall of ghosts didn't fix the screen. Shh, take Tara to the lounge at the end of the hall. The "Help Me" message is disturbing her and the other researchers. Talk to Indradeep and Iseul. They should be there, and they can explain the different divisions of the Base while they make a treat to calm Tara's nerves. Stop the Blighted Water from leaking into the lounge while you're at it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tech Illiterate
quests.description: Caesar offered suggestions to reinforce our apparently 'abysmal' architecture. He's already ordered his peers to fetch him tools, and they've scampered off to do just that. Fine. Might as well. Exorcize the Jellyfish so they won't distract Caesar from his voluntary work. You're his assistant, aren't you? Get to it, and examine the screens for him. He seems to have less experience with wiring than with blueprints.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Plugging Leaks
quests.description: Dr. Caesar Mostyma should have taken up forging or engineering. He's made many improvements to the base's defenses in a short amount of time. I wish he wouldn't bark orders at the staff like a drill sergeant, but they're falling in line on the spot. Make yourself useful and get rid of any remaining Jellyfish and Elementals as Caesar seals the cracks in our defenses. We can continue the tour into the gardens afterwards.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shared History
quests.description: Don't just go out there blindly swinging your weapon. The monsters you see out there could be innocent people. Even asleep, Kathool's presence causes dreams and hallucinations that feel viscerally real. For now, go as far as you can down both the left and right pathways, and tell me what you see. Wait, there's something here too? Tara pointed out a torn page by the dark rocks. What the…Read it, quickly.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Flat Scares
quests.description: Based on your descriptions, the monsters you encountered are illusions targeted at specific individuals. Good. Rather than innocent people we're hallucinating as monsters, they're sea creatures or elementals that we're seeing as…old nightmares. Head left to the cabins first, and talk to Fa. Help her dispel the Astravian Illusions. Yes, I know my knees are shaking, but they're just images. Not what actually scares me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fishy Bully
quests.description: The illusions are targeting Princess Tara too, but she says she's just annoyed by them. I hope she isn't forcing herself to be strong. These Infernal Illusions resemble the creatures I've read about… but they're missing eyes. I see, they're based on Infernal Mockeries instead of the actual creatures. Dispel them, and rescue any Seabase Undine visitor you see in the cabins or gardens. Many aren't familiar with the drills or panic rooms.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Faint Howls
quests.description: Mi is in the gardens, looking out for any children hiding in the bushes, and using their music to help dispel the illusions. Talk to them, and make sure they aren't overexerting themselves. The remaining illusions near Mi are… they're dressed like my mother. Why are they here? Are these memories from me, or someone else? Get rid of them and hurry. They seem to be agitating Caesar.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Down the Digestive Tract
quests.description: We have a major issue. Caesar's adjustments to the Sunlight Zone's structure minimized the number of intrusions - so much so that it lessened the strain on Sparagmos. The hallucinations are subsiding, revealing a more dangerous elemental trying to break into the lower floors. I've allowed you access to the far end of the Sunlight Zone. Get over there and stop it before it gets any farther!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Suckers for Supper
quests.description: No, I don't deserve to…I don't need to rest. What you said about the twisted Elemental that broke into the Sunlight Zone stuck out to me. It does look like it swallowed the tentacles growing out of its face. If you're going to keep bothering me, then be of use. Help me examine samples of the Illusions and the evolved Seafoam Elemental… Actually, I'll call this new form Marine Snow.

quests.name: Shark Kiting
quests.description: Our most pressing objective is to reconnect the fuel lines to keep Sparagmos operational. Debrief and talk with Fa, she has the most experience doing maintenance in the Abyssal Zone. Once you're both ready, we need to clear out the Kitefin Shark Bait. It's strange. They've never gotten inside the base before or have shown that they've wanted to. The Shark Bait usually stick to the sea floor, or flee to Ashray.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Roko's Royal Basilisk ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Suckered Blockade
quests.description: Did you see the fuel lines running up the walls? Help me inspect them for damage. Fa will keep the hall quiet while we're busy. Go as far down the hall as you can. If we're lucky, we'll see what caused the fuel lines to disconnect. When you're done, we'll have to acknowledge the giant tentacled elephant in the room. Keep your distance, but examine the tentacles that snaked their way into the area. They likely belong to Kathool.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Roko's Royal Basilisk ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Digestive Fluids
quests.description: I fear the longer we dawdle, the faster Sparagmos runs out of fuel and leaves us vulnerable. We have no choice but to go down that tentacle ladder to make progress. Take the utmost amount of care. There's no electrical lighting down there, and I hear the sound of violently churning waves. It's the Blighted Water Elementals. They've infested these hidden chambers of the Abyssal Zone. We need to drain the rooms to be able to proceed safely!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Roko's Royal Basilisk ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sodden Secrets
quests.description: I've never seen these rooms before, and Fa said that there aren't any man-made exits or entrances. Just the new pathways Kathool made by breaking open the floors and walls. There are murals on the wall, and even if this is what Kathool wants, we should inspect them. Be careful, shadowy creatures are seeping into the room. I want you and Fa to collect samples. They're Sparagmos' fuel, but they resemble the description on one of the murals.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Roko's Royal Basilisk ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Hidden Corpse
quests.description: Please help Fa fight off and capture the Shadow Viscera and the Blighted Water Elementals. The longer we remain here, the more violent they become. Just hold them off for a little longer so they won't get near the murals. I'm uncovering the larger picture, the truth that Kathool wants us to see. It is absolutely intending for us to be harmed by the truth but we have to confront it. The Elves, Lady Neso, and perhaps even Swordhaven wanted this hidden for a reason.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Roko's Royal Basilisk ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Octo-Flake Fish Feed
quests.description: If the Queen and Dr. Noelle knew more about the Temple than they were willing to share, just what else were they hiding? I can't believe I was strung along…We need to get out of here as soon as possible. Just like before, more sealife infiltrated the Abyssal Zone because of the damage caused by Kathool. This time…they're smaller Elementals. Hurry, we'll exterminate these Foam Scavengers, and scout ahead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Roko's Royal Basilisk ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Completely Surrounded
quests.description: There's one more mural in this area. Even though Fa has passed it by every time she's done maintenance in the Abyssal zone, it could hold new meaning with what we've learned. Help me examine it, and the remaining fuel lines nearby. If you see any monsters nearby, no matter how alarming they look, ignore them. For now, they're distracted by Kathool's intrusion.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Roko's Royal Basilisk ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sea Salt Soap
quests.description: The larger monsters are on the move. Fa didn't see them the last time she visited the Abyssal zone. Orange antlers protrude from their body. They look like coral… or the same horns that the Water Elves in the mural had. I feel the Temple shifting from Kathool's tentacles. It's like the rumble of a chuckle. These monsters are here because of Kathool. Please, destroy them. They…they're wrong. These things shouldn't exist!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Roko's Royal Basilisk ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: In the Grip of Justice
quests.description: At the end of this corridor is an obelisk flanked by two doors. I couldn't fix the fuel lines, but at least I can repair the way back to the Midnight Zone. The door on the left leads back to Sparagmos, where we'll tell the others what we've learned. Clear the last of the monsters in the area while I work, and take a look at the obelisk. I imagine there will be a journal here, tucked away by Miss Aquella. You…I'm sorry that your search ended this way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Roko's Royal Basilisk ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Together as One
quests.description: Kathool created an amalgamation of Water Elf remains to speak and harm us through. Now that Kathool's awake, it only took a fraction of its power to throw us into complete disarray. I don't want to think about what could happen if you don't hold it off! Hurry! I can shoulder the weight of Kathool's attacks with Dage ,but argh! Not for long. Defeat The Ashray's remains! Hurry! Dage said he needed ten minutes, but we can't last!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Roko's Royal Basilisk ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Burial at Sea
quests.description: The A.I. needs some time to go over the Trench's blueprints to safely guide us. While they're working on that, I'm thinking of what we should do about The Ashray. This is all that remains of their people, and it feels wrong to leave them where they lay. If you would, please help me gather The Ashray's remains so we can store them somewhere safe. The base does have a morgue… When we're finally safe, I want to lay them to rest.

quests.name: Unsung Heroes
quests.description: Dr. Noelle has been working alone in the Trench Observation Deck, or so I thought. The ghosts of Sea Base Undine still believe in her and the greater good. They'll cause all sorts of problems if left alone, and I want them to move on from this terrible dark place. Talk with Fa and exorcize the wraiths how you usually do. If they still have their I.D. cards, give them to me. I want to know who else has been suckered into Dr. Noelle's promises.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Together as One ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Watertight Guarantee
quests.description: Sparagmos Lycegenes warned us about armed turrets in the Trench Observation Deck. Those weren't here the last time I visited Dr. Noelle. I brought them here from Astravia to protect the outer walls of Undine. She must have had them built into the Deck behind my back. You and Fa dismantle them, and scout as far as you can. If you hit a dead end, stop and come back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Together as One ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Core Electrolytes
quests.description: While I find a way to open the door to the outside as carefully as possible, go look at the dry leylines. You visited the Mana Core, yes? If you and Fa take this time to look closer, we could find more clues to help us figure out how it was tampered with. If it was Neso, how did she drain the leylines completely unnoticed? And what happens when something like an Avatar gets access to Core Mana?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Together as One ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Guardian Spirits
quests.description: I need more time to figure out how the door is being sealed, but our continued presence is agitating the ghosts haunting the Trench. How are there so many? Unless, they keep returning even after you've tried to appease them. Their devotion is pure, and I hate the idea that Dr. Noelle is weaponizing them for her own aims. Please help Fa continue to exorcize the wraiths and keep them from distracting me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Together as One ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Enemy in Need
quests.description: I've determined that the door is being held shut by a power source! Up the stairs is the First Observation Landing. It's where Dr. Ganx, or rather, Xang, is being held and drained by another pedestal fixture. We need to get up the stairs, disarm the turrets guarding her, and remove the wires from her body. There is a high chance she'll attack you the moment she's freed, so keep your guard up.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Together as One ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Here Lies Shadow
quests.description: With Xang unhooked from the wires, there's nothing powering the door mechanism to keep it sealed. We'll head outside and explore as far as we can. Talk to Xang to make sure she won't just touch anything that looks funny. We need to approach the bottom of the Trench carefully. If you see anything suspicious - which is likely to be everything - report back and let me know what you find so the Sparagmos A.I. can determine if it's safe to proceed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Together as One ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nature's White Noise
quests.description: We've been surrounded by ghosts. Not the wraiths that used to be Undine Researchers. These spirits floating outside are older and angrier, aiming to pull us into the depths and crush us with the full force of the sea. They aren't willing to pass on, so you need to wipe them out! We won't be able to proceed or even retreat with them yanking on our limbs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Together as One ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dreams Seep into Reality
quests.description: The Sea Spirits are swarming. We can't fight them all without risking the foundations of the Sea Base. There isn't any other choice. Climb down the tentacle at the edge of the cliff and descend into the trench. I looked down there and there were more of those waxy Adipocere creations waiting for us. You, Xang, and Fa need to fight them… and keep Xang from stealing the horns to use as accessories.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Together as One ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hadal Havoc
quests.description: The spirits and adipocere creatures twitch and jump erratically as we near the bottom of the Trench. That's where Kathool is, and it has to be where Neso and Dr. Noelle are… consuming it. This is the final stretch, the furthest anyone has gone into the ocean. Fight off the Sea Spirits, and the Necro Adipocere, and find Dr. Noelle. If there is anything human left of her, I want to try to talk Dr. Noelle out of this mistake.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Together as One ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: See You on the Other Side
quests.description: Dr. Noelle won't let me talk to her. She tries to use the abilities she gained from consuming Kathool's flesh to entice me to continue helping her. We can't let this go on. You, Fa, and Xang have to fight and remove her from the wall. While you have her distracted, I'm going to climb over and confront Kathool. I have no hope of defeating it on my own, but if you can keep its interest trained on the fight… I have a final solution ready.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Together as One ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Undine's Dredge
quests.description: The sea should have been left well alone, but Swordhaven has left its mark. While we're here, would you please help me collect Dr. Noelle's belongings? | will… bring them home when it's all over. The Sea Spirits and Necro Adipocere weren't meant to rest here either. Gather them together. This may not make much of a difference, but it won't make the seafloor worse than it is.

npc.name: See You on the Other Side

quests.name: Chrono Collector's House
quests.description: To stabilize the timestream around your new home, bring back an hourglass of Chrono Energy from the Time-Travel Fairies in /timevoid.

quests.name: Arm the Firestorm
quests.description: We need to create new armor to sell to the Firestorm Warriors. Bring me 5 Tigerskins, 3 Strips of Goblin Leather and 4 Lava Globules.

quests.name: Hottest Gear in Town
quests.description: We need to craft new weapons to help the people of the Firestorm Islands. Bring me a Stone Shard from a Gargrowl, a Crystal Pommel from a Pyrric Ursus and a Minotiger Horn from Cinderclaw!

quests.name: Dragon King Chest Pet
quests.description: Recover the stolen shards of Maloth's crown from the Sneevils in the boxes map. Turn the quest in to unlock the Dragon King badge on your character page!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Dragon King Chest 2017 in your inventory.

quests.name: Pockey Challenge
quests.description: How do you feel about taking on multiple Pockey Moglins at the same time? Interesting, right? Test your strength and endurance against 3 fully-charged Pockeychews! Collect a Piece of Pockey from each defeated monster and trade them in for Yokai Isle Reputation!

quests.name: Ninja Challenge
