quests.description: Taking on a Black Belt Ninja is no easy task. And taking on multiple Black Belt Ninjas… well, it was nice knowing you… This is the ultimate test of endurance. If you somehow survive, you can turn in their Black Belts for even more Yokai Rep!

quests.name: Best Challenge
quests.description: You have made it this far… your power is much greater than I had ever expected! One final challenge remains. It is the ultimate test of power, strength, skill, and endurance. Take on NOTruto, Ryoku, and NekoYasha in an all-out brawl. If you collect a Hidden Leaf, a Dragon Dodecahedron, and a Catnip Shard from their respected owners, you will be granted much Yokai Isle Reputation!!

quests.name: Lussi Langnatt
quests.description: Kall Haxa is too large to fight directly. I know you have experience fighting titans, but the damage it could cause may bring the whole castle down. Its hand is reaching in through the chimney. The creature may be scared away if you cut it off.

quests.name: DragonMaster Trial
quests.description: Slay 10 Ichor Draconians to prove you possess the skill necessary to aid the DragonMasters in our quest.

quests.name: Recovering the Scroll
quests.description: While I oversaw your trial, the Prophecy of the Chosen Ones has been stolen! The trails of sludge leading away from my camp point to a SludgeBeast as the thief. Recover the Prophecy for me!
quests.requirements_note: Must own DragonMaster Badge in your inventory.

quests.name: Deciphering the Prophecy
quests.description: This scroll was entrusted to me, and I give it to you. But it would take years of training to read what our Prophetess has written… unless you recover a Loquis Stone. To create one, I will need a Sleazoar stone from a Murk Lurker and 5 Venom Sacs from an Ichor Draconian.
quests.requirements_note: Must own Prophecy of the Chosen Ones in your inventory.

quests.name: Quest for the First Chosen One
quests.description: The Prophecy scroll says: It is said that Ektorax the Slime Dragon knows where the Egg of Ichorus is hidden. Battle him, and he may tell you where the egg is kept.
quests.requirements_note: Must own Deciphered Prophecy in your inventory.

quests.name: DragonMaster Gear
quests.description: If you would battle as a DragonMaster, you should possess the gear of one. Slay the proper creatures to gather the resources necessary.

quests.name: DragonMaster Hoard
quests.description: Collect 12 Ichor Pearls from Extorax and I will reward you from the Dragon's Hoard.

quests.name: Hatch the Ichorus Egg
quests.description: To hatch the Ichorus Egg, you must gather 50 Ichor Gems. Defeat the Ichor Draconians for a chance to recover them.

quests.name: Ichorus Defender Scythe
quests.description: You have vowed to protect this hatching as it grows into a Chosen One… if you succeed, one day the dragons descended from Ichorus will rule a new world. By taming it now, you can shape it as it grows. As a sign of your pledge and dedication, battle dracoliches and Ektorax to gather the resources to create the Scythe of Ichorus.

quests.name: DragonMaster Accoutrements
quests.description: I have heard that you are skilled when it comes to dealing with Dragons, and we are in dire need of help. Prove yourself worthy of the skills and knowledge of DragonMasters, and you can earn the armor and weapon of DragonMaster StoneScythe!
quests.requirements_note: Must own Dragonsbane Ore in your inventory.

quests.name: Hailstone Ore
quests.description: Warlic the ArchMage says we can harness the energy created by this storm and use it to power many of Lore's most important magical workings. To contain it, we will need to gather the Hailstone Ore the mountain is made of. You will find that the creatures here keep the ore close by, as it deflects lightning strikes. Bring me 10 pieces of Hailstone ore from Draconians and Wyverns!

quests.name: Scroll of Fury
quests.description: The Lightning Dragonsworn are an elite band of Storm Slayers - the best of the best, the fastest of the fastest… usually. But the one time they failed, they lost the Scroll of Fury, which contains a prophecy fortelling the mightest dragon this world will ever know - a beast called… Krenos. It was torn to shreds, but if we can recover them, perhaps we can reasseble them.

quests.name: Shards and Sparks
quests.description: Dragonslayers must brave these beasts in any weather, but our metal armor makes battling in stormy lands dangerous. The fangs and tears of the creatures here offer some protection. Bring me 5 Lightning Sparks and 3 Energy Gem Shards to help make sure my fellow Dragonslayers remain well-protected! You will find dragon scales on Lightning Orbs and Energy Elementals.

quests.name: Hunt for the Storm Cache
quests.description: Legend has it that Tonitrui has stored treasure throughout the Thunderfang Mountains, but I do know of one certain hoard. The Storm Cache should be close by; but you'll need the Tonitrus Rune and Spire Key to bypass the wards placed on it. Last I heard, the Energy Elementals were charged with protecting it.

quests.name: Lord of Thunderfang Spire
quests.description: Tonitrui has lives for centuries, but is not immortal. It is said that someday, one of his descendants will become the greatest Energy Dragon our world has ever known! Now, however… the terror he is spreading threatens villages for miles around! He must be stopped and I think you are the one to do it! Bring me Tonitrui's Head, and you may keep any rewards you find while battling him!

quests.name: Storm Strike Shards
quests.description: It is never wise to turn your back on the Spire… or its creatures. They're likely to strike at you when you least expect it! Defeat the Storm Draconians, Energy Elementals, and Thunder Wyverns for Storm Surge Shards; the runes I can make from them will come in handy if you locate the Storm Cache.

quests.name: Claim the Tempestas Egg
quests.description: To caim the Tempestas Egg, you must gather 50 Tonitrus Gems. Defeat the Storm Draconians for a chance to recover them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Tonitrus Rune in your inventory.

quests.name: Terpsichore, the Chained
quests.description: The Nine Muses are spirits of artistic inspiration from a legend I came across while abroad. Supposedly, what each muse represents changes depending on the merits of their invoker. Being an appreciator of the arts myself, I've named the key to my safe haven after them. The key was divided into nine pieces among the guards. I expect that they've turned into those unsightly creatures.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isolani ' quest.

quests.name: Calliope, the Arrogant
quests.description: What? Some of the pieces you brought were fake! I should have given my guards more credit. Check the displays and see if the missing pieces were hidden there. You'll see riches I've won during my grand campaigns. Try not to swoon over my achievements yet. And be sure to shoo away those creatures! I don't want them smudging the glass!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isolani ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Euterpe, the Spiteful
quests.description: You've already looked through the displays. That leaves my banana hobby room. I know quite a number of people who despise that room. If Darkon finds this room, he'd keep it in flames for eternity. All the more reason to expand my collection! Look there for key pieces, and put the transformed guards out of their misery. Such eyesores.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isolani ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Urania, the Origin
quests.description: There's one last hiding spot I can think of for key pieces. Look into the model of the capital city. I expect the more devout of my guards have hidden their key pieces in the miniatures of the observatories. Bah, the walls are shaking. Wipe out the creatures closing in on the throne room if you really are an Entity like our Progenitor.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isolani ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Polyhymnia, the Forgotten
quests.description: The key has been completed! That's a good dog. You're telling me you're not a dog? Then correct me on what you really are, Entity. Think about your reply when you get back. I'll be keeping the key while you clear the way. And you'll be thorough. Remember what'll happen to my subjects if you aren't.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isolani ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Vanity Project
quests.description: Save my art and sculptures! I don't care if the heat left from the Sun is hot enough to boil steel, get in there! While I'd love to retrieve the artifacts I won from my campaigns abroad, we must focus on the most important pieces. Why, the ones celebrating my perfect form of course.

quests.name: Minion of Drakath
quests.description: Do the unexpected! Slay 13 Chaos creatures in Mount DoomSkull to confuse the 13th Lord of Chaos! (And get a chance to win the "Winds of Chaos" blade!)
quests.requirements_note: Must own Drakath's Minion in your inventory. Note: Quests are available only to the owner.

quests.name: This Town in a Desktop Globe
quests.description: What?! Where are you?! This is you spawning in the cage and aquarium! Go explore this… prison… and see just what you've gotten yourself into.

quests.name: Dust Bunnies Can't Hide
quests.description: No matter how they try, try, try, you can't let those 8 dust bunnies hide your precious airholes! Shift 8 of them so you can breathe more freely.

quests.name: Au Contr-air holes
quests.description: You told the Collector you need air? He says *au contrarie!* Quite the opposite, in fact. But don't listen to him. Find the open air holes, quickly!

quests.name: Hero Eats Everything. Even Pellets
quests.description: You'll eat anything, you're so hungry. Even these pellets! Go find 12 caches of food laying around the cage.

quests.name: The Moth Defeats the Man?
quests.description: Not if you kill the moths and bug for food first! Kill 20 of these nasty little fliers an wrigglers for much needed protein while trapped inside this glass cage!

quests.name: Can you find them?
quests.description: Can you find the hidden catapul materials? Where are they hiding? Are they on the ground or in the sky, or part of something else? Do they fit somewhere inside?

quests.name: You've Been Looking Everywhere!
quests.description: Are the popsicle stick and bottle cap under the chair? Is the rubberband in your hair? Keep looking for catapult parts or you'll never get out of here!

quests.name: Go for Grease!
quests.description: But guts will definitely grease the catapult's mechanism! Gross, gut-ty goodness! Kill 12 monsters to get grease to make sure the catapult works!

quests.name: Doppelganger Wants to Hit You
quests.description: They say they know us, but we don't know those guys. They look kind of mad. Take out our doppelgangers so we can be free!

quests.name: Catapult Climb
quests.description: The catapult you built is our ticket to freedom. Lets get OUT OF HERE!

quests.name: For Science!
quests.description: Volunteers, he needed volunteers to use to make our doppelgangers. I shudder to think at what happened to them. Flowers die and so would I, except I won't because you're here to save us, Hero! Explore the Lab to see if there's any information about our doppelgangers you can bring back that will help!

quests.name: Tokens of Vindication
quests.description: John, John, and Drakath have been living with these beasts for years! But YOU don't have to put up with them; you're a Hero! Slay 2 of the monsters inhabiting the Collector's prison to earn 1 Token of Vindication! These tokens can be used to purchase epic rares from the Token Shop in the Collection map!

quests.name: Tokens of Collection
quests.description: Will, Fred, and Drakath have been living with these beasts for years! But YOU don't have to put up with them; you're a Hero! Slay 2 of the monsters inhabiting the Collector's prison to earn 1 Token of Collection! These tokens can be used to purchase epic rares from the Token Shop in the Collection map!

quests.name: Bugged By Rares!
quests.description: No wonder you're bugged by everything in this Collection, it's all trying to kill you! Take out 2 of those collectible critters for a Token of Collection!

quests.name: Rarely Defeated!
quests.description: Take these mint condition monsters and scuff, scar and beat down 2 beasties until they aren't even fit for garbage collection, let alone the Collector's dome!

quests.name: Get the List!
quests.description: Time is not on our side, hero. I will do my best to hold back Alteon's Undead Army while you figure out how to free the Lords of Order. While I stand here catching my breath, I need you to go into Warlic's Science Shoppe and obtain the list of magic items. Hurry, brave hero!

quests.name: Check their Teeth
quests.description: Humor me, hero. I want to see how well Xing and Xang have done for themselves. It almost feels like… they're laying claim to this part of the Realm. Impressive. You can tell some of the creatures are beginning to take on their traits. Catch some of those walking mouths and bring them here so I can look more closely.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Malgor! ' quest.

quests.name: More Investigation Needed
quests.description: Very interesting. You can tell they've been changed… But there's something else, too. A blending of BOTH the Twins' good and evil. I wonder if merging into Xiang is affecting their powers or personalities, as well. Bring me another type of creature so I can look more deeply.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Malgor! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find Xiang
quests.description: From what I'm seeing all around us, I think the twins aren't just growing stronger… they're growing more unstable. It's time to find the girls and bring them home, don't you think? They have to be around here somewhere. Go look around and see what you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Malgor! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Destroy her Creatures
quests.description: She thinks those terrifying creatures of hers will stop us, eh? Well, they won't! You and I are going to kick their butts! … At least I think they have butts… Hard to tell under the tentacles. Well, okay… YOU are. But I'll pay you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Malgor! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Time to un-decorate
quests.description: She's so proud of how she made this entire place look like her. She stole that from me, you know! Well, we'll TAKE all those batwings and horns. Let's see how she likes it then!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Malgor! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Interrogation Time
quests.description: Do you think I'm going about this the wrong way? You do, don't you. I can tell by the look on your face. You're judging me. Fine. We'll try this a different way. Why don't you go interrogate some of those skulking Droognaxs and see if you can find out… you know… what they want from me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Malgor! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get rid of it!
quests.description: That coward - letting her lackeys do all of her dirty work. Fight this beast for me, Hero. We'll have to get them out of our way before we can continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Malgor! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: "Convince" the Bruiser
quests.description: A mirror, she said. Turned in on itself… inverted. I've heard of something like this before. If I know Xing and Xang, they'll be keeping it somewhere in the mausoleum, so we'll have to find a way to unlock it. I'll bet her Bruiser can help us with that. Might have to convince him, though.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Malgor! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: They Never Learn
quests.description: Those lackeys of theirs don't like that we're in here! They're weak, though… if we beat enough of them up, one of them is sure to defect, and tell us what we need to know. Namely: where that mirror is being kept.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Malgor! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get the Mirror!
quests.description: That lackey we beat up said that the mirror is inside an iron coffin. Find it, unlock it, and retrieve the mirror.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Malgor! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get Her!
quests.description: You’ve fought Xiang before, haven’t you, Hero? Do it again. Now, while I try to figure out how to use this blasted mirror.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Malgor! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Shadow Medals
quests.description: This is how Malgor treats people who do not bow to him… he wages war. Help me fight off his forces. Bring me the shadowy medallions they carry as proof of their demise.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Her! ' quest.

quests.name: Mega Shadow Medals
quests.description: Some of these assailants are more powerful than the others. You can't tell by sight, but you will know them by the larger medals they carry. Bringing back these medals will raise the morale of our allies significantly.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Her! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Goldun
quests.description: It is time. Goldun, the general of the Shadowflame army, challenges us. Challenges ME. He plans to bring Malgor my head, and prove himself worthy of rising through the ranks. But that's not how this is going to play out. Come, let’s show him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Her! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Goldun Wants Revenge
quests.description: "FACE ME AGAIN, YOU FURLESS APE" is what Goldun keeps telling me. I don't have time for this. Hero, can you beat him and a few of his minions up a few times until he's satisfied?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Her! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadows and Chaos
quests.description: I no longer wield the Chaos Amulet, but I can still sense where its power is the strongest. That will be where we find this Captain Laguna. But this energy is different from my own. I'll need a few samples of it so I can familiarize myself with its resonance.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Slug 'em! ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Follow the Trail
quests.description: Follow me, "hero". I can now sense the direction that Laguna's chaos magic is coming from. All we have to do is follow its trail.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Clear the Tunnel
quests.description: The minions down here are much better armed. They must be protecting something. I knew we were headed in the right direction! Get them out of my way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Blow it up!
quests.description: I've found where we need to be… but, as with everything else, it's blocked off. She's GOOD. Or paranoid. But don't worry - I have a plan. Get me some of those grenades the Grenadiers carry and we'll blow it wide open.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Heart of the Matter
quests.description: This whole island is alive… and we’ve found its heart! Cut it out, and the island dies. We have to stop it before it reaches shore.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Closer Look
quests.description: If you want to stay on this sinking island any longer, be my guest, hero. Take what you can, and we should get out of here. You want samples? Just kill any monster and take some parts!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fight the Crew
quests.description: Some of their crew have already boarded our ship! Help me fight them off, or we may not have a ship to come back to when we’re done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Closer Look ' quest.

quests.name: Reach the Ship
quests.description: Teja can fight off any more that make it over here. You and I have to take the fight to the enemy ship. Come on, I’ll meet you over there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Closer Look ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get the Bombs
quests.description: That slimy mer-serpent has to be around here somewhere. If I had to guess, I'd say she's hiding below decks, letting her minions do the fighting for her. Coward. But I have an idea to flush her out! Some of those Gunners have some pretty large bombs. Bring me a few.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Closer Look ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Blow 'er Up!
quests.description: Hero… we are going to blow a hole in this ship. No, no… we're not going to sink it! We're just going to make a "door" to the lower level for ourselves. Just get a few matches from the Gunners, place the bombs, light the fuses, and watch what happens.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Closer Look ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the Captain
quests.description: Find Captain Laguna and kick her butt. I’ll be right behind you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Closer Look ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: More Pirates
quests.description: Looks like these pirates didn't get the memo - they're still coming after us. Get rid of them. We already have enough to worry about.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Closer Look ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Steal for Scouts
quests.description: I still have enough of a connection with Chaos that I may be able to guide some of these creatures in here. Capture some of those… what even ARE they? Flying Roe? Anyway. If I use them as scouts, they may be able to show us where the Amulet is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Closer Look ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Make them Work
quests.description: I think I've found where it is! The Amulet seems to be trapped deep inside… well, all of THIS. Now all we need is some kind of tunnel to get us there. Capture a few of those Burrowers for me. They should do the trick.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Closer Look ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find the Amulet
quests.description: Our path to the Chaos Amulet is open. All that stands in our way is… uh, well, a ton of monsters. But that's your specialty, isn't it? Fight your way through them, and find my amulet.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Closer Look ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Retrieve the Amulet
quests.description: We have to cut through Laguna’s nervous system to get to the Chaos Amulet. Be careful, hero… everything in this place is infused with that amulet’s energy. It WILL fight back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Closer Look ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Snack Time
quests.description: You want to stay here? What? You're… hungry? How can you be hungry after all this? Well, if you insist on staying, then you need to bring me a snack too. How about some caviar?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Closer Look ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Army of One
quests.description: The Queen's power is not to be trifled with. If you have no recollection of your battle with her then you'd better be sure you're ready for what's to come. Go slay a hundred of the Queen's followers, because if you can't even do that, then you won't stand a chance.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame the Queen ' quest.

quests.name: Worms of Earth
quests.description: Anka has created life—created monsters!—from the very earth around us! We'll have to go through them before we can stop her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame the Queen ' quest.

quests.name: Find the Trail
quests.description: I have no idea where Anka has gone. It's as if she just vanished. But we've seen how she controls the environment here. Study the Rumbling Rubble she's left behind and see if you can pick up her trail.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame the Queen ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Open the Way
quests.description: Do you see? To the north, the wall of thorny roots… that's where she's gone. She sealed the passage behind her so we would not follow. Cut it down. Burn it if you have to.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame the Queen ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Follow the Trail
quests.description: The path is clear. Follow Anka's trail. Kill anything in our way that seeks to stop us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame the Queen ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Tentarachnid Horde
quests.description: Anka has raised a new horde of monsters to slow us down. Dispatch them quickly.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame the Queen ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Shadows
quests.description: She's gone into the shadows. Follow her, and kill as much of the darkness as you can. This will help brighten the way forward for us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame the Queen ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Keep up the Search
quests.description: Chase after her, hero. We cannot let her escape!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame the Queen ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the Guardian
quests.description: Anka has summoned a guardian to slow us down. Send it back into the ground it emerged from.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame the Queen ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Wall of Rage
quests.description: Just beyond where we stand is a wall of flame… no, a wall of rage made solid. Made sentient. We must tear it down. Find the hope hidden underneath, and use it to soothe what remains.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame the Queen ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Through the Fire
quests.description: Follow her through the fire. We won't let her get away from us again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame the Queen ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Heart of the Power
quests.description: Anka will never give up the Queen's power without a fight. Defeat her, Hero, and take back my mother's heart. It is the only way to stop her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame the Queen ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Undying Rage
quests.description: "She returned, full of righteous anger, with an army of monsters." (Complete this quest to unlock the Chaos PuppetMaster set and character page badge!)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame the Queen ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Falling Apart
quests.description: Did you notice that even here the ground has split open? The rifts glow blue with Mana, just like the fissures that appeared in Crownsreach and the Shadowlord's Keep. But this is the Timestream. How is it possible that the effects of the Mana Core can reach a place so disconnected from reality? Well, this is your realm. You tell me what's going on. Examine the cracks that have appeared here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Middle Child ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Baby Steps
quests.description: Upon diving into the gray whirlpool, you'll find yourself in a clearing outside of what used to be the Queen of Monster's lair. You're saying this is where you first fought with Malgor? There's a Mumbler here instead. As well as frenzied mana leaking in from Lore. Further proof that the destabilized Mana Core is affecting the Timestream. We'll dispel the frenzied mana, and listen in on that Mumbler.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Middle Child ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eternal Flame
quests.description: The burning castle wasn't here when I was looking for Malgor on my own. It seems that your presence is causing these different scenes to order themselves in the correct sequence. And, turning them hostile. The Shadowfall Warriors from this dead timeline are noticing us. Defeat them so we can listen in on what that False Wyvern is talking to Victoria about, or rather the shade of Victoria.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Middle Child ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Wolf Cries
quests.description: We've come across Malgor, in the form of a False Wyvern, being attacked by Brentan and Victoria's knights. This must be his second attempt, which didn't pan out as well as the last. These Knights are behaving the same way as the Shadowfall Warriors in the previous room. Fight them off, so I can have another laugh listening in on the Wyvern's misfortune.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Middle Child ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Breaking Down
quests.description: We're in a chamber deep in the catacombs of the Shadowscythe Fortress. I remember this moldy rat hole. It seems that after multiple failed attempts at convincing the Good Queen to listen to him, Malgor tried to approach the Empress. Our Gravelyn is looking quite green in the face. We'll have to listen in on these shades and fight off the warriors in this room without her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Middle Child ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Growth Through Hardship
quests.description: Talking things out didn't last long. We've moved on to a scene where Malgor is giving Warlic the thrashing of his life. The shades of the Swordhaven Knights sent to protect the Blue Mage are coming after us instead. Get rid of them, I want to know what Malgor was interrogating Warlic about.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Middle Child ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Arteries
quests.description: Ah, the Ghost Nexus located in Akiba. I did hear about Malgor making an attempt to take control of it. Why would I bother coming to stop him when I have you to do that busy work? Save your grievances for later, there is Frenzied Mana here as well. I don't know if they're a part of this dead timeline or if they're leaking in from our timeline. Get rid of them and listen in on what Malgor and Gar's shades are whispering about.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Middle Child ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Paranoiac
quests.description: I've had my laugh. A full five minutes of straight laughter is good for the soul. So this is my throne room in Crownsreach, and the stain on the ground is what is most likely Malgor. There are Chaos Mages here, behaving similarly to the warriors and knights in previous scenes. You and Gravelyn can deal with them, I need another five minutes. Then, I want to know what this version of me from a past cycle has to say.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Middle Child ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Hard Swerve
quests.description: Malgor, the real one, can't be far off. We've reached an area that resembles the Queen's fortress…her remains are still here. The Malgor from this past cycle is rifling through the rubble like a vulture. What is he…Ugh, the frenzied mana around this area is far more unstable. We need to clear the air before looking into what Malgor was up to. And stop staring at me. I only feel loathing for that beast of a woman. Keep your pity to yourself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Middle Child ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nigh Invincible
quests.description: The truth behind the Queen of Monsters' death in Malgor's first cycle is ahead of us. It is simpler than I had hoped. That Dragon looming in the distance must have been you, engorged on the blood of the Queen. Was it that easy? There has to be something more going on. I have no issues bringing that Dragon to heel to find out. With how you and the Empress feel about Malgor, you shouldn't have any qualms either.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Middle Child ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fallen Branches
quests.description: I have a nagging suspicion about our location that I can't let go of. This should be something of your concern. We need to know if the cycles Malgor abandoned continue to grow on their own, or if they were left to rot here. Go back into those dead remnants and pick at the hostile inhabitants. Tell me what you find. Of course I can figure out the answer when you return. I had private tutors. What did you have? Public school? Heh.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nigh Invincible ' quest.

quests.name: Get Fired Up... or Shatter!
quests.description: If you are going to retrieve the Fire Orb for Akriloth, you'll need to find its shards first! Why are you recovering the Fire Orb for Akriloth? Because he asked for your help, and you're a Hero. It's what you do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rescue The Innocent ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Enemies on Ice
quests.description: So you've been double-crossed. That's a lesson, Hero. Can't always trust those who need you. But the situation's too heated to save right now. Go slay Ice Demons to recover the Ice Scythe. Once you have that, things may cool off.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rescue The Innocent ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tek-nical Forging Skill
quests.description: Speak to my friend Tek in The Span. She will forge the Ice Claymore from the Ice Scythe, which will allow you to defeat your fiery foe. Because my Master didn't see fit to construct a Yulgar Golem, she is the only Weaponsmith we have.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rescue The Innocent ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Akriloth Assault
quests.description: Defeat the enemy who made you doubt yourself. Recover confidence and you will see that as long as you believe in yourself and have the aid of your friends, you'll be able to overcome almost any obstacle!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Rescue The Innocent ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Talk to Hs'Sakar in Firestorm
quests.description: We have always been an insular community, and with the trouble we've had recently, we're hesitant to trust any outsider. But… you say Hs'Sakar will vouch for you? If you bring me his sigil ring, we can speak again. Go to Firestorm and talk to him, see if he will do you this favor.
quests.requirements_note: Must have defeated Desoloth the Final during the Etherstorm Wastes saga. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Bring Amulet to Drakor
quests.description: I'd be glad to help you, friend, but unfortunately the proof that Drakor is asking for is missing! A few days ago, a sulfur imp ran off with my sigil. Get it back from them, and then take it to Drakor as proof of my blessing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have defeated Desoloth the Final during the Etherstorm Wastes saga. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Complete this quest by talking to Drakor .

quests.name: Kill Us Some Zombies
quests.description: If Hs'Sakar trusts you, then I'm willing to give you a chance to prove your loyalty to Dragonhame. The undead of Shadowfall have noticed our weakness, and are trying to take advantage of the situation by attempting to claim our land for themselves. Take them out, and then we'll talk more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bring Amulet to Drakor ' quest.

quests.name: Put 'Em Through the Wringer
quests.description: Our biggest obstacle is that we have no idea where this sickness is coming from. However… there are those who would hurt the dragons. We've had troubles in the past with the cultists of Fotia. If you go to the cultists' homeland and "interrogate" some of them, we may gain some insight about the source of this plague.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Core of the Problem
quests.description: The plague isn't killing our elementals, but it does seem to be affecting them. If we compare elemental cores from another area to the corrupted ones found here, that may give us some insight. Bring me some elemental cores from the Ruins of Great Gilead in Arcangrove. I'll need samples of each kind.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Scroll of Salubris
quests.description: Interestingly, the plague does not seem to be affecting the Merdraconians of Natatorium, even though they are dragonkin. We've heard rumors of a scroll they possess which may be making them immune. Please recover this scroll for us. It may be the key to our survival.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Must Be All Those Limbs
quests.description: Ll'Ara and Phelan have told me that the scroll uses a different type of magic than we're used to. Go to the Cave of Wanders in Sandsea. Bring back a handful of Lotus Petals from the Lotus Spiders, and a few Talismans of Renewal from the Kalestri Worshippers. These items may also help us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What We Need Is More Mages
quests.description: Our priests and alchemists will study the materials you brought, but it couldn't hurt to ask for help elsewhere as well. Go to Dragonrune Hall and talk to all of the professors there. One of them may have seen something like this before.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Protect the Eggs
quests.description: You've done as much research as you can, and for that I thank you. The most important thing now is to protect our young. Gather as many eggs as you can find in Dragonhame, and bring them to the center of town. Our healers can look after them more easily if they are all together.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Very, Very Sad
quests.description: While you were gone, I received terrible news. One of our young dragons is very ill, and his feverish delirium, he's gone on an uncontrollable rampage. He's too far gone to cure, and we can't let him continue to destroy the city and spread the plague. Will you… handle the situation? None of us has the heart to do it ourselves.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ward the Hospital
quests.description: Slay 3 more infected dragons outside the hospital so we can build a ward to protect the rest of the town
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Recover samples in Lair
quests.description: Warlic is working with you? Good. Defeat the Water Draconians, Venom Draconians, Wyverns for samples of uninfected biological material. He will need them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Darkness to Calm Dragons
quests.description: Dark Draconian Essence calms Dragons. The DragonSlayers use it often to subdue them. Slay Dark Draconians to gather it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Quest for the Red Dragon's Scroll
quests.description: If there is any other dragon who would know more about any other plagues the dragons have suffered, it would be the Red Dragon. Defeat it, and you should be able to convince it to tell us more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Help Artix in Swordhavenundead
quests.description: I cannot leave the townspeople of Swordhaven undefended! Help me slay these last 13 undead and I will do everything I can to help you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kill Dracolich in Temple
quests.description: If dragons are dying, Warlic should have undead dragon bones to study. Help me slay this Dracolich, at the bottom of the Temple of Light, so we can give him the specimen he needs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Research in Gilead
quests.description: Before I can be sure about the plague's cause, I need pure elemental essences. Before I suggest the cause, I must be sure! Because if I am right… we have a VERY long battle ahead of us! Bring me 3 pure essences from each of the four elemental types.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fire and Ice in Battleundera
quests.description: I need bone marrow samples from both fire undead and ice undead. Slay 6 Skeletal Ice Mages and 6 Skeletal Fire Mages.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unlife's a Lich
quests.description: The Elemental Undead samples you gathered were perfect. But now, to be sure, I need a sample of purely necromantic magic. Slay the Lich and bring me 6 of his runes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragonhame Infirmary Invasion
quests.description: Zombie Dragons are in the hospital! You need to put these dragons out of their misery! They would not wish to exist in this state… and we cannot have them threatening the rest of us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Elemental Dracolich Destuction
quests.description: This is… an elemental dracolich?! I have never heard of something like this, though it DOES make sense! But how could a plague do THIS?! Subdue him; we must study what has become of this poor creature.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragonplane in Peril
quests.description: Travel to the Dragon Plane. /dragonheart
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ward the Heart
quests.description: If you're going to contain the infection in the Dragon Plane, you'll need to isolate the areas. Place Warlic's wards in all four elemental areas, and at the center of the Realm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Dragonplane in Peril' quest.

quests.name: Infection Rejection
quests.description: You might be able to save those who aren't too far gone. Knock out 6 infected dragons so you can treat them… and hopefully protect them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Purify the Plane
quests.description: The taint is EVERYWHERE! On the ground, on the columns… Start cleansing the plane by removing the infection from 7 columns.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Zombie Dragon Destruction
quests.description: The Zombiel Dragons cannot control themselves! Subdue 10 of them to ensure your own safety while you work to cleanse the realm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Water Realm Purification
quests.description: Sever Desolich's link to the Water Realm by slaying 5 Water Elemental Dracolichs. Purify the Water of the realm by removing the corruption.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Water Cleanses Fire
quests.description: Gather 7 drops of purified Water; you will need it in order to cleanse the Fire Realm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fire Realm Purification
quests.description: Sever Desolich's link to the Water Realm by slaying 6 Fire Elemental Dracolichs. Purify the Fire of the realm by removing the corruption.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fire Cleanses Earth
quests.description: Gather 7 purified flames; you will need it in order to cleanse the Earth Realm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Earth Realm Purification
quests.description: Sever Desolich's link to the Earth Realm by slaying 6 Earth Elemental Dracolichs. Purify the Earth of the realm by removing the corruption.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Earth Cleanses Air
quests.description: Gather 7 stones made of purified Earth; you will need it in order to cleanse the Air Realm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Air Realm Purification
quests.description: Sever Desolich's link to the Air Realm by slaying 8 Air Elemental Dracolichs. Purify the Air of the realm by removing the corruption.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dracolich Disconnection
quests.description: Slay the Deluge, Tempest, Inferno, and Granite Dracoliches to begin severing Desolich's link to the Heart of the Dragon Plane!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Heart-searing Pain
quests.description: Lavablast the Final is Desolich's last, strongest link to the Heart of the Dragon Plane. Slay him to sever the final connection… and free the dragonkin of Desolich's taint!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Legendary Elemental Reagant
quests.description: Now that Desolich's connection has been severed, there will not be anymore Elemental Dracoliches. Slay 13 of them while they are still here; we should not miss this opportunity to collect research materials for Warlic!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Heart-searing Pain' quest in order to access these quests (see above). Note: These quests can only be completed once per day.

quests.name: Elemental Reagant Hunt
quests.description: Now that Desolich's connection has been severed, there will not be anymore Elemental Dracoliches. Slay 13 of them while they are still here; we should not miss this opportunity to collect research materials for Warlic!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Heart-searing Pain' quest in order to access these quests (see above). Note: These quests can only be completed once per day.

quests.name: Class 101: Slaying for Dummies
quests.description: Mmmph. Good timing. I needed an assistant instructor to show these bonebrats what's what. Take out 6 of the DragonSlayer Dummies to show them what it means to HIT and hit HARD.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bling, Baby, Bling ' quest.

quests.name: Class 102: Breath of Fresh Fire
quests.description: Baby dracoliches CAN breathe fire, but they need a bit of help getting the flame going the first few times. A few sparks should do the trick. Slay the Wisps to bring back sparks for me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Class 103: Tog Eat Tog World
quests.description: Alright, assistant instructor! It's time for a field demonstration. Head out into the con and show these babies how to take out a zombie tog. Then do it again six more times. Once you've slain 7 zombie togs, return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Final Exam Demonstration
quests.description: Listen up, boneheads! Your Assistant Instructor Hero here is going to demonstrate how to tackle a BIG beast. This ain't no weaktail zombie tog. Hero… show'em!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

Dread Knight's Burning Skull Quest Pet's.name: Dread Knight's Burning Skull Quest Pet's Quest

location.name: Dread Knight's Burning Skull Quest Pet

npc.name: Dread Knight's Burning Skull Quest Pet

quests.name: Underworld Legacy Badge
quests.description: When the two darkest powers in the underworld go to war… only the strongest survive. And how do they do that? By taking out the competition. Slay a Skeletal Warrior to begin your quest to destroy those who would strike you first to unlock the Underworld Legacy badge.

location.name: Dread Knight's Burning Skull Quest Pet

npc.name: Dread Knight's Burning Skull Quest Pet

quests.requirements_note: Must have Dread Knight's Burning Skull Quest Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Dread Pirate King's Skull
quests.description: YARRR! If'n ye want to look like ME for eternity (an'lets be honest here, who wouldna?) then all ye need do is slay the Undead Pirates in /pirates until you get the following things: 1 Pirate Skull and 2 Rubies of DOOM. Bring me those, and I'll work my undead magic.

quests.name: Stealing Augold's Assets
quests.description: Ugh. I may be more successful and reliable than my brother, but I cannot deny his popularity. His success is stealing my customers! Therefore, I have a job for you: sabotage his bank. He keeps two treasure chests near his vault in /battleontown that contain a tremendous amount of gold. I want you to retrieve those chests for me, along with two Chest Keys to help unlock them. You should be able to get the keys from Warden Elfis in /dwarfprison.

quests.name: Extra Protection
quests.description: There's no place I'd rather do business than here in Dreadrock. However, I can't deny that it's a dangerous city. A strong hero such as yourself should be able to provide me with some extra security. *Persuade" some of the Crag and Bamboozles in /Shadowblast Arena to guard my bank vaults. Let them know that they still owe me quite a bit of money…though a little rough-housing wouldn't hurt.

quests.name: Make a Donation
quests.description: While I appreciate the help you've been giving me, nothing is more valuable than a generous donation of gold! You'll find a Donation Receipt in Deathgore's shop - and for a low price, at that. When you're ready to donate, bring it here.

quests.name: The Scythe's Edge
quests.description: There are newcomers to the city who are drunk on their power, causing all kinds of mayhem for our troops. If only they knew how fleeting power really is. Defeat the warriors that roam our cities…and show them the true strength of the Shadowscythe Empire.

quests.name: Forged in Blood
quests.description: Members of the Undead Legion have become …arrogant, ever since their victory against the Nation. I'm surprised the Empress didn't punish them for that unsanctioned squabble all those years ago. Losing the Abyssal General was a major blow to her morale…though I hear he stills assists her in backhanded ways. In any case: defeat 7 of the Legion Sentinels stationed around the city, and remind them who they truly work for.

quests.name: The Abyss Stares Back
quests.description: Hmm…Nulgath's Nation. With their leader gone, their units have fallen into disarray. And their contractors refuse to follow our orders. Defeat 10 Void Mercenaries and relinquish them from their contracts. They'll be much more useful to us once we bring them back from the dead.

quests.name: Undead Champion Recruitment
quests.description: I suppose one of the benefits of being stationed here in Dreadrock is the variety of recruits to choose from. As a high-ranking Undead Champion, you are obligated to go and *convince* some of the citizens to join our cause.
quests.requirements_note: Must own Undead Champion (Armor) .

quests.name: Recruiting for the Undead Legion
quests.description: I suppose one of the benefits of being stationed here in Dreadrock is a plentiful source of recruits. Go around and defeat enough enemies until you've convinced them to join our ranks.

quests.name: Undead Champion Soul Trapping
quests.description: Persuasion is one way to recruit new members to the Legion; but personally, I am a fan of soul trapping. Retrieve the Corrupted Dragon Slayer from Undead Champion Exercise #4 and bind 14 Dreadrock souls to it. You can slay any monster here in the city. And to ensure that they STAY bound, I'll need the Soulseeker's Soul Scythe as well. You will be heavily rewarded for your efforts.
quests.requirements_note: Must own Undead Champion (Armor) .

quests.name: Soul Trapping
quests.description: Persuasion is one way to recruit new members to the Legion; however, I personally am a fan of soul trapping. Defeat 14 enemies here in Dreadrock and trap their souls with the Soulseeker's Soul Scythe. You will be rewarded for your service to the Undead Legion.

quests.name: Dreadrock Gem Exchange
quests.description: Unless you serve my master, you have no business here. But your contract speaks volumes of your dedication. Provide me with three Shattered Dreadrock Gems, three Polishes Dreadrock Gems, and three Crystal Dreadrock Gems - and I will reward you with some of my master's finest reagents.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Unidentified 13 in inventory.

quests.name: Knife to the Back
quests.description: Allegiance to the Old One is sacred. And breaking that bond requires…compensation. The Shadowknights have been very loyal to my master; but two of them tried to escape from their contracts. Find the traitors…and execute them.

quests.name: A Tainted Deal
quests.description: In order to commune with the Old One, I require an…abundance…of Tainted Gems. If you can provide them for me, I will reward you favorably. Service to the Old One does not go unnoticed; and if you succeed, the rest of this city will know it as well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Unidentified 13 in inventory.

quests.name: Reap the Souls
quests.description: If your dedication to the Archfiend is absolute, then I have a suitable mission for you. Provide me with a Combat SoulReaper of Nulgath, and you will be duly rewarded. This deed will require the zenith of your ability.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Unidentified 13 in inventory.

quests.name: Phantasmic Guardian Blade
quests.description: I've heard that someone stole a Guardian Blade and infused it with dark energy, before returning it to the tower they stole it from. The result? A cursed sword that's slowly eating away at the Guardian Tower's defenses. We need to retrieve that sword as soon as possible - it's hanging on the wall next to the Verification Room in Battleon's Guardian Tower. You will also need 4 vials of Phantasmic Aura from the Hollow Wraiths and 4 vials of Evil Fusion Aura from the Fallen Heroes. Ironically, we'll need to purify whatever those thieves did to the blade.

quests.name: The Coast is Clear
quests.description: Over the past few months, Dreadrock's seen a rise in sinister activity. It's been difficult rescuing any lost individuals without blowing our cover, and it'll only get worse if something isn't done. I need to make a request: If you could quietly take out several of the local monsters, it would allow the refugees safer passage in-and-out of the city.

quests.name: Advanced Weaponry
quests.description: The product of Darkblood forging techniques and Dreadrock technology has yielded very interesting results. Retrieve 1 axe from the Primarch in /falguard and 12 axes from any of the local monsters to aid me in my metalworking experiments.

quests.name: Legion Sabotage
quests.description: The Undead Legion has a strong presence in this city…and I'm not a fan of it. Some of the Undead Champions have repeatedly stolen items from my shops. I want you to sabotage their operations here in the city by stealing 10 Legion Tokens and 12 Dreadrock Legion Blades from the Legion Sentinels.. Slowly but surely, the Legion will pay for the setbacks they've caused me!

quests.name: Free Advertising
quests.description: Ah, hello there! I'm not sure why, but my business hasn't exactly been booming as of late. Perhaps it's because people are always coming and going here in Dreadrock. I'll need to find a way to attract new clientele…would you mind going around and advertising my shop to the locals? A good place to start would be the faction recruiters on the other side of town. It wouldn't hurt to clear some of the monsters you see on the way back, either - they're bad for business.

quests.name: Supply Run
quests.description: It seems a few thieves have run off with my supplies. If you would, please get them back to me as soon as possible. You'll probably find them on some of the locals around here.

quests.name: Endurance Tesssssst
quests.description: If you wisssssssh to prove your worttttttth, you must ssssshow me your dedicationnnnnn. Defeat the local weaklingsssssss, and bring me their headsssssss.

quests.name: A Gesture of Evil
quests.description: It ssssssseemsss I require your … sssssssservicesssss. Bring me the following itemsssssss…and you will get your reward.

quests.name: Ghastly Blades
quests.description: Bring me 100 Ghassssstly Dreadrock Bladesssss from the local citizensssss, ssssso I may melt them down for my waressssssss. Do thisssss, and you will be greatly rrrrrewarded…

quests.name: Glub
quests.description: *glub* (Despite being an all-powerful being, I get kind of hungry from time-to-time. And no one ever feeds me. If you could bring me some Fishin' Chips from doing any of Faith's quests /greenguardwest, I'd be eternally grateful.)

quests.name: Glub, Glub
quests.description: *glub, glub* (I wonder…the Fallen Heroes that roam these parts are said to be quite powerful. I would fight them myself, but half the city might be destroyed as a result. Would you mind taking a few of them out, to see how good they are?)

quests.name: Glub, Glub, Glub
quests.description: *…glub* (I'm feeling a bit lonely here in my bowl. I'd invite you in, but…I don't think there's enough room. Would you mind finding a companion for me here in the city? People usually keep a goldfish in their pockets, right?)

quests.name: Ain't Gonna Paint, No Ingredients!
quests.description: Aaah, a new subject? No? You are the Hero? Excellent, and a vision of heroic beauty and helpfulness you are! I must supervise my students, but they are running out of paint. I must make more! Gather me 10 fallen Red Trollola Blossoms, 5 Blue Vulture Feathers, and 5 pieces of Canvas Leather.

quests.name: Gallery Gala: Opens Next Week!
quests.description: My show! It is opening so soon. I simply MUST get these invitations distributed to all the townspeople. But I must finish this piece! Please, Hero, deliver these Miniature Statue Invitations (aren't they clever?) to all of my friends. Oh, and please take care of the Boar problem around here; they always interrupt my Galas! 3 Rabid Boar's Teeth will earn you a free hour of sculpting lessons!

quests.name: Call from Deep Within
quests.description: Hero, the times are dire and we need to go deeper into the earth, deeper so you can understand more about this precious realm. The Core Crystal MUST be secured first. Kill 5 each of Fire, Water, Air and Earth Elemental and bring back 5 snuffed flames, 5 still wind, 5 toxic water and 5 shaken stones. Prove the Core is secure with this.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kill the Deep Dweller ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Chrysalis of Flames
quests.description: The earth, in an attempt to subdue fire, surrounded the wild flames in its own clothing, creating a fine, crystal shell. Now that the fire is tamed, I need you to free it so it may whisper its secrets to you!. Free 5 Crystallized Living Fire, kill 5 Sapphire Golems for water to cool the flames, and collect 3 Glowing Coals.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kill the Deep Dweller ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Glittering Secrets of Old
quests.description: When water and earth went to war, the secrets of water were stolen. The water acolytes faithfully retrieved them and hid them away in the matrix of Crystallized Water. I need you to destroy Jellyfish and Diamond Golems. Collect 6 Water Shell Matrix Decoders, 6 Diamond CrystalCutters and the Water Secrets.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kill the Deep Dweller ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Aria of Great Significance
quests.description: Air has secrets and they are locked away from all but those who know the proper song. If you want to hear Air's song, you have to be able to reproduce the tones the crystals play. Kill 8 Shard Spinners, 8 Emerald Golems and gather 8 Crystal Strikers and you will be able to reproduce the crystals' song!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kill the Deep Dweller ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rekindling a Pomegranate
quests.description: Unless we can kindle the Radia Terrix's life force, we will never have crystal pomegranates again. To be deprived of their beauty…Please, seek out the Ruby Golems and slay 12, bringing back to me 12 Crystalline Heat. If you can, we will have the heat necessary to grow the crystal pomegranates and you will see the secrets of earth in them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kill the Deep Dweller ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Legendary Crystal Skulls
quests.description: You have the secrets, Hero, which is more than we had hoped for. Now, you need to find a way to bring these secrets to life. Find the Amethites, as they are the key to this. Slay them and collect their skulls. They are made of the purest crystal, which is exactly what we need to give voice to Earth's secrets. Bring back 4 of them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kill the Deep Dweller ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Return of the Crystal Beauty
quests.description: Desoloth has turned earth power against the embodiment of my element, Arradia. It is unthinkable that we must attack her, to right the wrongs of Desoloth, but it is the only way. She's crystallized and is in such a frenzy that pain and desolation may result if you cannot subdue her. Please help restore her to her true form.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kill the Deep Dweller ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Taking back the Shards of Secrets
quests.description: Now that the core has exploded, the shards are scattered and hoarded by the elementals. Hunt the elemetals down and take the shards back. We must protect the secrets of the earth realm, securing them until the time comes that we can regrow them together. There are 50 shards. Please find them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Return of the Crystal Beauty ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per day.

quests.name: Slay the Ether-Creatures!
quests.description: Although I am reluctant to order it, and though I know my Priests will not agree, we must wipe out this thread of Chaorruption before it can take hold! The creatures are just too far gone. Slay the tainted Thunderbirds so that Choas cannot gain a greater foothold here. 3 of each, young one, and be be quick about it. In gratitude, you'll receive 6 defender tokens of each element.

quests.name: Investigate the Ether-Taint!
quests.description: We Priests are aghast to find the pure, glorius creatures of Etherstorm have been tainted by Chaos. It does not show… yet… but we can sense it. Desoloth's dissonance, his disruption of our land, has enabled Chaos to take hold. Capture 3 of each Thunderbird so we may study them to find a cure. In gratitude, you'll receive 3 defender tokens of each element.

quests.name: Trade for the Rainbow Moonstone
quests.description: A Rainbow Moonstone? Yes, I can craft one for you. I will need some raw materials from you, however. Some chipped bits of gemstone from the golems wandering the area. Bring them to me when you have them all.

quests.name: Contract Exchange
quests.description: You there, squirmy one. Is that a contract of the old one you have? I have wares for you if you're willing to part with it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Drudgen the Assistant in your inventory.

quests.name: Hire Nulgath Larvae
quests.description: That's right! Now you can make Nulgath, well a larval version of him, go running around working for you. … Just as soon as you bring me a Voucher of Nulgath AND a Rune of Nulgath 1 from an Undead Legend. Actually, he might be making you run around…

quests.name: Supplies to Spin The Wheel of Chance
quests.description: Lore has had many revolutions and many Wars. Wars require weapons and weapons require resources.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 10.

quests.name: The Assistant
quests.description: Lore has had many revolutions and many wars. There are unique items from these wars to be found, and I'm interested. Bring me War-Torn Memorabilia from Yulgar's Armor Shop, and you can spin my wheel!

quests.name: Voucher Item: Twin Blade of Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says your voucher will get you the "Twin Blade of Nulgath". This weapon is for blade masters. Your enemy will tremble at the mere sight of you dual wielding this weapon. Redeem your purchase here.

quests.name: Drudgen the Salesman
quests.description: Nulgath see me work hard so now I get promotion! I part-time salesman. He want me sell his items. I give good deal! Bring me "Voucher of Nulgath (non-mem)" and "Diamonds of Time".

quests.name: Secret Item
quests.description: Drudgen hear about hidden, secret item. Bring Drudgen the secret and Nulgath give you special items. Items I stash away from other wheel prizes.

quests.name: Voucher Item: Totem of Nulgath
quests.description: What's that you say? Gathering Gems and Totems is too difficult? You want a better deal? Oh, Minion, that's not how this works. Show me the Voucher of Nulgath(non-mem) as proof you are worthy of completing my task, and bring me 60 Essences of Nulgath. Then maybe you'll think twice about your delusional world of "easy tasks".
quests.requirements_note: Must have Voucher of Nulgath (non-mem) in your inventory.

quests.name: Horcs Stink!
quests.description: *sniff* You smell like a Horc. A dirty, stone-blooded Horc. I'm going to go stand upwind while you bathe. Get 5 Trollola Blossoms from in town and add them to some water you've gathered. Find 7 bottles of Scaly Skin Scrub from the Chinchilizards. You'll need that much.

quests.name: Like Calls to Like
quests.description: I will tell you what Sokrakiis told me when I learned of the spell. The mirror is vital: it represents duality. The sun and moon, sky and land, and the Twins themselves. In the reflection the two halves are bound together; like to like. Gather 3 crystals, 5 Leather Thongs, and 5 Pieces of Ivory to build the mirror.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Time Grows Closer ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Incense Makes Sense
quests.description: The Gods of Song and Color and the Goddesses of Knowledge and Arcana listen when we call them with incense. It signals to them that we require their attention. To make it, we will need 10 fallen Trollola Blossoms, 5 nuggets of Musk, 4 globs of Trollola plant resin, and 5 pieces of Koalion Fur.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Time Grows Closer ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Troll Inside
quests.description: She Who Answers is wise. All in the Ravine respect her; even those filthy Horcs. If she says you must find the Troll inside yourself, then you must. We believe that in beautifying our home, we become more beautiful Trolls. Build a statue that illustrates your respect for our people: I recommend 5 Trollola Blossoms, 3 Crystals, 5 Claws, 5 Tusks, and 10 Jungle Leaves.
quests.requirements_note: Must have answered She Who Answers questions. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Tainted Golden Soldiers
quests.description: Good Soldiers were made worse but the Chaos taint! Remove 75 of them from the battlefield and I will get our Troll Weaponsmith to make you an excellent trophy blade!

quests.name: Come to Light
quests.description: Follow me inside the temple! Sigrid should already be there. We'll meet with her and run the snakes out! Hmm, the Paladin seems to be reading an old letter she found. Let us speak with her and take a look.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Shadows of Aminion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: It's in the Blood
quests.description: The High Elves, my own people, willingly let the Shadows into Camlan? They've always been plotting to invade Greenguard? That's a lie! This can't be real! Even these Elven monsters must be fakes created by the invader! Cut them down and I'll show you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Shadows of Aminion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Parental Pressure
quests.description: Those two standing by the fountain are Bellonna and Sleih, my mother and father. They've been taken by the Shadows! Please, you must help me save them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Shadows of Aminion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get Lost in Me
quests.description: The Shadow infesting the walls of Camlan, Ouroboros the Metamorphosis Maw, lurks in the heart of the temple. We must banish this intruder and save my people!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Shadows of Aminion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What the Duck?
quests.description: Oh the irony: a weapon shop getting robbed is like a fire station burning down. Hopefully you're a better sleuthhound than Steven is a Seagull. Search my entire shop and see if you can find a clue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Literal Arms Dealer ' quest.

quests.name: Like Feather, Like Son
quests.description: Straight up: that's down. And I would know, because I'm clearly a bird and not some awesome internet meme. Well, we'll need to find a match to this feather — that means it's up to you to battle BirdsWithHarms and collect a feather from each fowl foe so we can find a perfect match.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Duck, Duck, Goose
quests.description: What the flock… not a single one of these feathers are a perfect match to the feather you found in my shop. But I know a down feather when I see one… it couldn't possibly belong to the silly walking Goose I saw waddling into the Pet Shop… or even the Gosling who owns that store? Go take a gander.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Meme Quest
quests.description: Some might call them Duck Norris Memes… but really they're FACTS. BirdsWithHarms know these quack facts to be true, but you're going to have to discover all of them for yourself. Go see if you can 'convince' any BirdsWithHarms to drop a totally true Duck Norris Meme for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Without Feather Ado ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per day.

quests.name: Testin' Yer Metal
quests.description: Ya wants to give ol' Dufar a hand, yeh? Good. if'n these attacks keep comin', and they WILL, the warrior refugees're gonna need more weapons. Bring me 5 hunks of Iron frum th' Grim Stalkers. They hoards it, belike. An' 3 Steel Ingots frum th' Goblins.

quests.name: Whet Your Appetite
quests.description: Yer gonna need some pretty sharp weapons if yer gonna take on th' creatures around here. If'n ya want the sharpest gear, ye'll need a whetstone and m' special polish. Here's a list, get to it.

quests.name: Sa Fire Away!
quests.description: One thing I know to be true, the Safire's of Northpointe are some of the most beautimous gems in all a' Lore. The Wyvern's love'em. They taste like blue sweets. Bring me 6 Safires an' I'll make it worth yer while.

quests.name: This Is Key
quests.description: There are so many halls, so many locked doors. You'll need all the keys you can get. The first Key is on one of the Hollowsoul Wraiths that haunt the castle. Once you find a Unknown Key from the Wraiths return to me. This might be the Simple Key.

quests.name: I Love The Keys
quests.description: You will find that this key unlocks the Red Door near here. Behind the door you'll find one of Hollowsoul's foul monsters that the castle uses to feed its insatiable hunger for souls. You must defeat Deathgazer Prime to find another Key. It might be the Complex Key you need to move forward!

quests.name: Off Key
quests.description: The Complex Key will allow you through the golden door. Once inside, you must do battle with the Jelly-like Cube. The last hero to possess the Golden Key was devoured by it some time ago. Return to me with the Key you find once you have it to see if it's indeed the Golden Key.

quests.name: We're Going To Need A Bigger Key
quests.description: This key unlocks the dread Black Door. That will grant you access to the lair of the Archwraith! I believe the Archwraith was once the castle's wizard… but he's been twisted by time and hatred. If you can defeat him, he may drop a Key! This could be the Hollowsoul Key which will unlock all the doors so far! Return when the deed is done!

quests.name: Skull Of A Lich!
quests.description: Ah! I sense a Hollowsoul Lich at the heart of the haunted halls. You can't destroy him but you can defeat him. Bring me his skull and I may reward you.

quests.name: Potion Surplus
quests.description: Of course it's a "surplus," you give me a Combat Badge… I give you one potion.

quests.name: Lightning Scrolls of Lightning
quests.description: Electric paper, I tell you! That is the secret to harnessing the power of lightning within a scroll. How about I just trade my pre-infused scrolls for a mere Combat Trophy each.

quests.name: Basic War Sword
quests.description: Going back to the basics of many common sword foundations. This Blade can be made into bigger better swords, too… so if you want it, I'll need 50 Combat Trophies.

quests.name: Steel Afterlife
quests.description: This helm would go well with that armor. Don't believe me? 50 Combat Trophies and you'll see, too.

quests.name: Behemoth Blade of Light
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! You really want this Blade, huh? Well this big bad boy comes with a hefty price. I need 500 Combat Trophies, a Basic War Sword, and a Steel Afterlife helm in order to craft one for you. Yeah. Good luck.

quests.name: Behemoth Blade of Shadow
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! You really think you can obtain this Behemoth Blade? The amount of requirements matches its mammoth size. 500 Combat Trophies, a Basic War Sword, and the Steel Afterlife helm is all I need

quests.name: Warden Of Light Armor
quests.description: Interested in obtaining the divine Warden of Light Armor? Show me 500 Combat Trophies, and it's yours.

quests.name: Conqueror of Shadow Armor
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! Ready to become a Conqueror of Shadow? All I need is 350 Combat Trophies.

quests.name: Light Warden Helm
quests.description: Light Wardens are often seen with this sort of helm. For 150 Combat Trophies, you will be seen, and noticed, too.

quests.name: Shadow Conqueror Helm
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! No Conqueror of Shadow would be caught dead-or alive- without this helm. 100 Combat Trophies will assure this.

quests.name: Infamous Revenge
quests.description: This polearm is so famous… that it's infamous! No that didn't really make sense, but if you want this polearm, you're going to have to give me 50 Combat Trophies.

quests.name: Legendary Retribution
