quests.description: Defeating the Karasu and Acornents have helped restore the balance… but now we must aid the tree herself. There are 3 supporting boughs throughout The Cloister that require a boost of magical energies. They stand out from the other branches in more ways than one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ewa the Treekeeper ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wendigo Whereabouts
quests.description: The Mother Tree has one more request from you. A horrible creature feared by all magi resides on The Cloister's canopy. It is a monster dubbed Wendigo. Once a druid himself, the Wendigo's constant craving of magical energies has exiled him to the Cloister's topmost branches. No one has been powerful enough to defeat him… but I have faith in you, Hero. Take down Wendigo, and The Cloister will flourish once more!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ewa the Treekeeper ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Scales and Tails
quests.description: All druids respect life. We understand the delicate balance between nature and uphold Her will. But we also know that there are times when sacrifice is necessary for the greater good. And The Cloister needs nourishment. The oils from Swamp Frogdrakes and Swamp Lurkers will help nourish our Mother Tree back to health. Go forth into the Mudluk swamp and bring back 10 Frogdrake Tails and 10 Lurker Scales so that we can begin restoring Her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Wendigo Whereabouts ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once a day.

quests.name: Exalted Drakath's Gift
quests.description: To acknowledge all of your victories and support, we have a gift for you. Click the button below to get your very own Golden Item of Awesomeness.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Exalted Spy Eye in your inventory. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Hoof it til it Beaks
quests.description: I MUST have 5 Subrysa skins, 5 Hootbear beaks, and yes, especially 5 Hootbear Pellets. Do not ask why, just GET THEM! The pellets you will need to collect. The foul Hootbears drop them after they eat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed General Zephis' Quests .

quests.name: Bind it with Twine
quests.description: Filthy creature, Emus and Koalions! But they are vital - VITAL - to my plan! Slay the Emus and Koalions in my bunker. That should give you the 3 Emu Spines and 6 Koalion Claws I need. You must also pick up 7 of the eggs and 3 balls of twine. Those are just as necessary. Now go!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed General Zephis' Quests .

quests.name: Hold it Together
quests.description: Gotta hold it together, just keep holding it together. Travel to Bloodtusk Ravine to bring me 10 Rhison Hooves. They must be FRESH! Return to me when you have 10 Rhison Hooves!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed General Zephis' Quests .

quests.name: Build a Beast!
quests.description: Kindness makes you weak. WEAK! And I must be STRONG if I am going to raise a Chaos beast! Bring me the corpses of 3 Subrysa, 3 Koalions, 3 Tainted Emus, and 3 Hootbears. Once I have that… stand back… Because I'm going to build a Chaos Beast!

quests.name: Break a Beast!
quests.description: No! Do not slay my Chaos Beast! How can I be a Chaos Lord if I do not raise a Chaos Beast! I don't care that it threatens me. NOOOOOOOOOOOOO! Don't kill him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

Eye of Astaroth Blade Pet's Quest.name: Eye of Astaroth Blade Pet's Quest

quests.name: Orbs of Astaroth
quests.description: Nulgath the ArchFiend knows all, and sees all. His eyes - and his spies - are everywhere. Few can be trusted. Test the loyalty of the Void Draconians to see if they are worthy of his attention.
quests.requirements_note: Must own Eye of Astaroth Blade Pet to access this quest.

quests.name: ID What You Did There
quests.description: You're going to need a Necro U Student ID if you want to enter the campus grounds! If you can't FIND one, why not make one? The first step is finding the right materials. Start with the basics - paper and ink. DoomWood Treants can usually be counted on for paper, and Undead Slimes produce toxic ink!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' GraveStop The Creature ' quest.

quests.name: The Ego and the ID
quests.description: Now, all good necromancers - and students - have a pretty big ego. That's why all IDs have pictures on them. For that, you'll need a camera. The soldiers should have one. And why not see if the case they keep their dead-tags in will hold your ID, too?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: An IDeal Seal
quests.description: Just having a Necro U Student ID isn't enough; it has to be an OFFICIAL Student ID! Otherwise, no one will believe you're really enrolled. You'll need to manufacture a Seal of Improvable if you want your disguise to be complete. You can make one from Bonemuncher spikes and leather.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Need for Speed (Reading)!
quests.description: Old tomes contain knowledge vital to necromancers. It is advised that you read through them and commit all of the knowledge to memory. Beware, though, time is of the essence! You had better read fast! The 11 tomes you'll find in the room must be read in one minute.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Quest for the Fabled Love
quests.description: WOOF WOOF ARF!!! (translation: Bring me a golden Bone from Bluddron the Betrayer in Beleen's Dream map! )

quests.name: Recycling is Good!
quests.description: Call me cheap if you want, but there's no reason to let scrap metal go to waste. I can melt it down and forge it into something beautiful! If you bring me any scraps you find, I'd be glad to pay you a finder's fee! (only works once per login)

quests.name: The Best You Can Buy
quests.description: I know my armor is the best money can buy, and my customers know it too. Still, it's good to periodically test its performance and see which areas could use improvement! All of the warriors in the city use my armor. Duel as many as you can find, and report back to me on how their armor held up!

quests.name: ...And Called It Macaroni
quests.description: You'd be surprised how much value people place on the way their armor looks. The more detailed and flashy it is, the more I can charge for it! Gemstones and feathers are what they seem to like the best. Bring me some tailfeathers from the birds of paradise you see flying around here, and some pretty gems from the gemstones floating near the Celestial district. I'll pay you well!

quests.name: SandCHIC
quests.description: Help Fabyo create looks modelled after some of Lore's most desirable -- and famous -- personalities! All Fabyo needs you to do is bring him the materials he -- and his little monkey friend -- require. The list is as follows! Camel Hides, Monkey Claws, and Frask Feathers. Bring these things, and Fabyo will make you look FABYOLOUS!

quests.name: Oasis Oeuvre
quests.description: Help Fabyo create looks modelled after some of Lore's most desirable -- and famous -- personalities! All Fabyo needs you to do is bring him the materials he -- and his little monkey friend -- require. The list is as follows! Camel Hides, Monkey Claws, and Frask Feathers. Bring these things, and Fabyo will make you look FABYOLOUS!

quests.name: Spooky Fabric Scraps
quests.description: Fabyo LOVES Voltaire's tall, dark, and handsome style. Quickly, fetch me some cloth from the shop attendees and I can turn YOU into a new man. The Cursed Curios and Gothic Chests have what Fabyo needs.

quests.name: Eerie Embellishments
quests.description: My friend, my model, my star. Fabyo needs some decorations to make you shine. You will get them for me, yes? Fabyo will make you look splendid. Cursed Doll's Heads and Opera Glasses have just the right sparkle that I need.

quests.name: Future Sight
quests.description: Fairy magic is vast and strong, and for better or worse, for right or wrong, glimpses of the future we can see. To tell you what may or may not be. But the time is a tricky, mysterious thing, and too much info will sorry bring. But if YOU would know more of fate, find the Runestone; inside it waits. Bring a Sylph Feather as a gift, and watch! The veils of Time will lift.

quests.name: Fight Fire with Fire Elementals
quests.description: The Guardian Tree has 4 nodes in it… and my instincts tell me Elemental Stones go in there! Search the area for Fire Elementals and collect the Fire Fragments that they drop. Aaa… ahhh… aaaCHOO!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Choppin' ' quest. Note: Previously Legend only.

quests.name: Man's Best Fiend
quests.description: Have you seen the Bloodwolves around here? I don't know why ANYONE would call these canines Man's Best Friend… unless they have something to glue these Fire Fragments together. Collect 4 Fire Fasteners from the Bloodwolves, and I should be able to make the Fire Elemental Stone! AaaaaCHOO!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Choppin' ' quest. Note: Previously Legend only. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Water Softener
quests.description: Water you standing here for? Those Water Elementals have Water Shards that we can use to create a Water Element Stone. Aaaaa…aaaCHOO!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Choppin' ' quest. Note: Previously Legend only. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the ' The Forest and Furious ' quest.

quests.name: Swimming with Sneevils
quests.description: Ok -- so we CAN'T glue water together. But we CAN use a Water Wrap! And the Aqueevils here totally have some. Collect 4 Water Wraps, but watch out -- those Aqueevils can be tricky! Aaaaaaa….. aaaa… oh, hehe, that was clos --- AACHHOO!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Choppin' ' quest. Note: Previously Legend only. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: 100% Natural
quests.description: You'd think the Earth Elementals would have Elemental Stones on them, but noooooo. They've got Nature Splinters, and I'll need 4 of them. Man, my allergies have been acting up like crazy ---- AAaaaaAAaAchhoooOOO!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Choppin' ' quest. Note: Previously Legend only. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the ' The Forest and Furious ' quest.

quests.name: Conquer the Satyr
quests.description: Did you know Satyr hooves make excellent glue? It's true! Defeat a few Undead Satyrs and collect their Nature Paste (it's 100% Organic, too!). Ahhh.. ahhh… ahhhh… tcheeeewww!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Choppin' ' quest. Note: Previously Legend only. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Air Heads
quests.description: Who you callin' an Air Head? It's the Wind Elementals who have their head in the clouds! And they just happen to have Wind Edges, which we will need 4 of. Did you know sneezes travel at 100 mph? Aahhahahahhhcooozooom!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Choppin' ' quest. Note: Previously Legend only. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the ' The Forest and Furious ' quest.

quests.name: The Forest & Furious
quests.description: Mother Nature had a bazillion daughters and named them all "Forest Fury."But OH MAN these ladies have a SERIOUS temper. But they also have Wind Wrappings, which will bind the Wind Wedges together. AAaaaaaaaaaAACHOO!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Choppin' ' quest. Note: Previously Legend only. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mystery Tree
quests.description: Let's go to the Guardian Tree and see what happens when we place the Elemental Stones in it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Choppin' ' quest. Note: Previously Legend only. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Guidance from the Guardian
quests.description: Ask the Forest Guardian for answers about my mysterious past. I sure hope he knows something… and I sure hope he's friendly!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Choppin' ' quest. Note: Previously Legend only. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get Fired Up
quests.description: It takes time to fully master the Elements. Study the Fire Elementals and Bloodwolves in this forest to better understand the Element of Fire. Bring me Fire Auras and Bloodwolf Pelts, and in exchange, I will award you with Fire Stones to use in the Merge Shop. Good luck! ACHHOOOOEEEY!!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guidance from the Guardian ' quest. Note: Previously Legend only.

quests.name: Marine Biology
quests.description: It takes time to fully master the Elements. Study the Water Elementals and Aqueevils in this forest to better understand the Element of Water. Bring me Waters Auras and Aqueevil Spirits, and in exchange, I will award you with Water Stones to use in the Merge Shop. Good luck! Aahahhchoo!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guidance from the Guardian ' quest. Note: Previously Legend only.

quests.name: Air Current Affairs
quests.description: It takes time to fully master the Elements. Study the Wind Elementals and the Forest Fury to better understand the Element of Wind. Bring me Wind Auras and Forest Fury Feathers, and in exchange, I will award you with Wind Stones to use in the Merge Shop. Good luuuuccccaaaahhhhcoooooo!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guidance from the Guardian ' quest. Note: Previously Legend only.

quests.name: Back to your Roots
quests.description: It takes time to fully master the Elements. Study the Earth Elementals and the Satyr to better understand Element of Earth. Bring back 5 Earth Auras and 5 Satyr Hooves, and in exchange, I will award you with Earth Stones to use in the Merge Shop. Best of luck, HerooAaaaCHOO!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guidance from the Guardian ' quest. Note: Previously Legend only.

quests.name: Classified Chaos
quests.description: Is Chaos an Element? I don't know! But there is one way to find out. Defeat the Chaotic Guardian Dragon and see if we can capture a Chaos Elemental Stone. Should be mighty useful for creating Chaos-infused items!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guidance from the Guardian ' quest. Note: Previously Legend only.

quests.name: Connect to the Earth
quests.description: Alrighty! Let's start by helping Aria work on her connection to plantlife. Gather some cuttings from the Treeants nearby. Then plant them in the green, so Aria can practice helping them grow!

quests.name: Help the Hedgies
quests.description: Aria can heal critters. too! And there are several around here who look like they need it. Gather them all up, and then bring them to Aria for healing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: The quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Cleanse the Corrupted Zards
quests.description: Sometimes, the corruption is so bad that a creature can't be healed. But here in the Plane of Nature, those creatures can be sent back into the Growth to be reconstructed by Nature itself. Subdue some of these Corrupted Zards, and let Aria send them back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Plant the Seed
quests.description: Ok! I think Aria is ready to take us to the next level of the Plane of Nature. But she's going to need something from us, first: a perfect seed that she'll grow into a tall vine. Find one on the Seed Spitters nearby, and then plant it where the Green dead-ends.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: The quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Reach the Top
quests.description: Wowie! She grew some SUPER tall vines! They might even he tall enough to reach all the way to the next level of the Plane of Nature. Let's find out! I'll meet you at the top.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: The quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: All Steamed Up
quests.description: I have a platoon of steamed skyguards all angry because their weapons are completely dysfunctional. I have a fire blazing, but I'll need water to boil and wind to drive the steam through the weapons. Kill 5 Water Elements to fill my buckets of water and slay 5 Wind Elementals to funnel the finished steam.

quests.name: Let's Get Magi-Technical
quests.description: I want to expand my stock beyond just steam-powered guns and ballistic blades. I'd like to incorporate… magic! Can you find me pure mana? I think Mana Imps drop it in Arcangrove. I'll also need something to drive the mana into the weapons, so find me some turbines. There should be extra laying around here.

quests.name: Propeller Seller
quests.description: Our airships might be in tip-top shape most of the time, but like all tech, it needs repairs. When the Skyguard is out on the hunt, though, there's not always time to come back to port for a fix-up. So we jury-rig replacements where we can. I'd like to make Propeller Blades from Sky Pirate weaponry. Bring me back 9 swords for three new propellers.

quests.name: Favor for Faith
quests.description: If ya want me to show ya the best fishing hole in all Green Guard, then you're gonna have to give me a hand first. I can't find my favorite fishin' pole. The strangest thing is, there was a trail of slime leaving my fishin' spot! If you can find ma pole, I'll teach ya how ta pro fishes in these parts.

quests.name: Fish Food
quests.description: I was hoping you could help me meet my quota for the day. I usually send a large bundle of the daily catch with some Slime Sauce to the orphanage. They are a hungry bunch over there. If you can catch me 30 fish, of any kind, and get 1 jar of Slime Sauce from a slime, I'm sure the orphans would appreciate it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Previously called "Fish food" .

quests.name: Catch of the Day
quests.description: The Fish Relocation Act v.24 section 8 requires us to bring any Blandfish, Undead Trout or Somean Lionfish to a safe habitat. If you find any while fishing please bring them back here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fins up!
quests.description: I know a guy who knows a guy who is simply crazy 'bout fins. That's right, Redfin, Willowfin, Wingfin, Sparklefin, Thumofin or Pillfin, pretty much any fin. If you could come back with 10 "fin" fish today, that'd do just fine!

quests.name: Rainbows All the Way
quests.description: I gotta personal favor to ask ya. I might be the most amazing fisher in Greenguard but I always have trouble catching the Rainbow Lakehorse and Rainbow Scooter. Do ya think ya could find me 3 of either?
quests.requirements_note: Requires Rank 6 Fishing . Note: This quest can only be completed once a day.

quests.name: Beat the Beasts
quests.description: If you're going to train beasts, first you'll have to TRAP them! Bring me 6 Beast Crates from Sneevils and 6 Fish Scales from the Fishwings in /pirates.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50.

quests.name: Secrets and Scrolls
quests.description: Studying the lore of BeastMasters is a good step, too. Bring me the Troll's Treatise on Beast Behavior from a Pine Troll in /pines. Afterwards, check the Tanuki in /bamboo for the 7 Secret Scrolls of Beast Commanding!
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. | Must have Rank 3 BeastMaster .

quests.name: Taming the Elementals
quests.description: When you want to harness the power of magic or the elements to help you tame creatures, it helps to have the right equipment! Find me 5 Orbs of Mana Manipulation from the Mana Imps in /elemental, and 5 Living Flame Cores from the Living Fire monsters in /mafic.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. | Must have Rank 4 BeastMaster .

quests.name: Dark Creature Demands
quests.description: Creatures of the darkness require special handling… and implements of light! Defeat Golden Scarabs in /pyramid to get 16 Gleaming Gems of Containment and Solar Phoenixes in /dreamnexus to get 16 Bright Bindings of Submission.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. | Must have Rank 6 BeastMaster .

quests.name: Chaos Beast Battle
quests.description: Some beasts can't be controlled, like the Chaos Beasts… which are wreaking havoc across Lore this very instant! Bring me 7 jars of Purple Goo from Rock Roc in /roc, Naga Baas in /orecavern, or Chaos Harpy in /mirrorportal. The stronger the Chaos Beast, the more goo it'll drop!
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. | Must have Rank 8 BeastMaster . Note: Previously called "Boss Beast Battle" .

quests.name: BeastMaster Challenge
quests.description: You work so hard at your training, hero, I want to reward you. So this quest is going to seem like a piece of cake… Purple SLIME CAKE! (My favorite!) Bring me 10 jars of purple slime, and I'll whip you up something worthy of your talents!
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. | Must be Level 5. Note: This quest can only be done once per day.

quests.name: Ahead of the Game
quests.description: Northpointe pets have a very hearty palate. They enjoy a wide variety of fodder from gristle to boneshards and even soft rock hunks. You look like you've got what it takes to help me feed them… I bet you will have no problem bringing back 3 Chimera Tongues and 2 Stalker Spleens!

quests.name: Even Higher
quests.description: There are so many foes to battle - please - keep going!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Higher Up ' quest. Note: Can only be accepted on Screen 3.

quests.name: Falconreach Tower
quests.description: You have arrived at the tower - now defeat the enemies to continue!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Can only be accepted on Screen 4.

quests.name: Climb the Tower
quests.description: You must get to the top of the tower! Please hurry!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Can only be accepted on Screen 5.

quests.name: To the Dragonlord
quests.description: Climb the stairs - you have to keep going!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Can only be accepted on Screens 6 and 7.

quests.name: Defeat the Dragonlord
quests.description: In order to get to Drakath and completely free Falconreach from his family, you must defeat the Dragonlord who is guarding him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Can only be accepted on Screen 8.

quests.name: Defeat Dragon Drakath
quests.description: You must defeat Drakath in his dragon form or Falconreach will be lost!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Can only be accepted on Screen 9.

quests.name: Defeat Sepulchure
quests.description: The time has come for you to battle Sepulchure!!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Can only be accepted on Screen 10.

quests.name: Defeat Alteon
quests.description: Now is the time to battle Prince Alteon! See how this part of Drakath's story ends!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Can only be accepted in Screen 11.

quests.name: Pet Shop Toys
quests.description: My pets are getting lonely! I'm only one man and could sure use an extra pair of hands around here. My pets love to gnaw on Beetle Appendages but I'm all out-and that's the 3rd time this week! Can you go out into the Canyon and get me more? I think 10 Beetle Appendages should do the trick… for now…

quests.name: REP Speedwagon
quests.description: I can't fight this feeling anymore… so that's why I'm askin' you now! For as long as I can remember, I have wanted a Plastic Walrus Toy. All my life I have tried getting that toy from the Beatle monsters, but luck has not favored me in the least. I am offering great rewards to anyone who can bring me a Plastic Walrus Toy… so are you up for the challenge?

quests.name: Glowworms not Glowsticks
quests.description: I can't see, but I know it's dark down here. It will be much easier for you to help me if you light it up a bit. And I know a secret - the worms in this dragon's glow when they feel threatened! So, that you do is attack a bunch of the worms, and then jam them into the crevices in the, ah… "walls". They'll be your torches. (once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Ossification Needed
quests.description: Alright, so, to start with, I'm going to need some help putting myself back together. I've been down here for quite some time, and the bile has started to dissolve my cartilage and carry off my bones. Fight the bile, and see if you can get my bones back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Eye Need Bones
quests.description: I'm still missing a few important bits. See if you can find any more of my bones scattered on the floor in here. And let's see if we can "borrow" some eyes for me from the Skeletal Slayers! They're not sentient like I am - they won't miss them at all! (once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Bile Burns
quests.description: Friends, even with your… slime-covered armor… it looks like being down here is starting to take a toll on you. Stave off the effects by killing bile slimes and bowel worms. Otherwise, you'll end up like me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Chest
quests.description: Alright! Now, all that's left to do is find the chest I brought the laxatives in. I don't actually SEE it, so it's probably buried in one of those piles of much. Help me find it!

quests.name: We Need the Key
quests.description: Argh! We have the chest, but it's locked! We'll have to find the key to get it open. If you go deep into Glutus' bowels, you'll find a huge tapeworm, bloated from all the food Glutus sends down. If the key isn't there, then it must have gone downward, and devoured by that worm. Get it back!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Cha Cha Cha
quests.description: In order to make these laxatives act as quickly as possible, we need to get them into Glutus' stomach and bowel lining. That way, the medicine will go straight into his bloodstream!

quests.name: Sink Your Teeth In
quests.description: Blood Maggots suck blood. Vampires suck blood. Blood Maggots connected with Vampires. Lycans no like Vampires. Human go out and get 8 Blood Maggot Fangs from Darkovia. Faopaw study Blood Maggot Fangs and find connection with Vampires.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sanguine ' quest.

quests.name: Grounded Bats
quests.description: Vampires turn into bats. Albino Bats are bats. Vampires connected with Albino Bats. Human go out into Darkovia and get Faopaw 6 Prestine Albino Bat Wings. Albino Bats cannot fly without wings!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sanguine ' quest.

quests.name: Bats of a Leather Flock Together
quests.description: Bats are flying mammals. Vampires transform into flying mammals. Human know of LEatherwings? Leatherwings are flying mammals too. Leatherwings might be part of Vampire kin. Leatherwings home is Guru Forest and Dwarfhold's Pine Forest. Human cage 8 Leatherwings and bring back to Darkovia.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sanguine ' quest.

quests.name: Pain in the Neck
quests.description: Human see Chaorrupted Vampire Knights? Human must fight them. Vampire Knights kill Lycans. Vampire Knights must be stopped. Slay many Chaorrupted Vampire Knights and bring Faopaw 5 Chaorrupted Vampire Fangs. Human must hurry to save more Lycans.

quests.name: Sanguine's Terrortory
quests.description: Human want to help Lycans a lot? Human go out and find Sanguine. Sanguine is Lycans worst enemy. Sanguine hurt many Werewolves. Human find Sanguine and bring Faopaw Sanguine's Chaorrupted Barb. Human must act quickly.

quests.name: Bone Roam
quests.description: Lycan pack love to chew on bone. Bones have much marrow in them. Marrow make lycan pack grow stronger. Human want to become part of Strongest Lycan pack in Lore? Human go out and fetch bones from enemies. Human bring bones from Skeletal Fire Mage, Blightfang, RattleBones, and Lich of the Stone. Enemies can be found in Darkovia. Human hurry unless Human want to give own bones to Lycan Pack.

quests.name: Farm Cleanup
quests.description: Hey there! C'mon over here. Can you help me with a little something? I have to guard this award-winning cornstalk from pests, and can't go and get a few things that I need for my horse. He's not feeling too well, so I need to make a poultice for him. Look at him! He thinks he's a chicken! Can you go onto the farmland and get 5 bundles of straw and 10 mosquito wings? That'll definitely do the trick. But don't go TOO far- I hear there's some straaange trees on that farm.

quests.name: Chaos Critters in the Crops
quests.description: Them mosquitoes and Chaorrupted Poultrygeists are crowding up mah fields! You'll need to clear them out if'n you're going to take care of the zombeh problem. Squash 7 Mosquitoes and pluck 6 of those birds.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Can You Regain Grams? ' quest.

quests.name: Zombehs Aren't So Smart
quests.description: Y'cain't trust a zombeh. Y'never know where they'll attack next! Best to use what they don't have - yer smarts! Trap'em in holes - an' keep them from fillin' the holes back in - an' maybe you'll have an easier time of getting them all out of mah crops!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: It's the Anti-Mall
quests.description: Y'cain't expect me to live next to a village where th' zombehs can just wander FREE, do ya? No, I think you'll have to keep them contained in thet there village. Build a barricade. Chop down 12 Treeant for logs and find 5 Supply Branches on th' ground.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: 28 Battles Later...
quests.description: Looks like most of them zombehs have fled or been trapped in th' holes. Take out the remainin' 13, but you should prob'ly just knock them out. Y'r friend Artix seems to be fond o'em for some reason.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest's name is a parody of 28 Days Later…

quests.name: Picking Flowers
quests.description: I promised a friend I would bring her a bouquet of flowers when I finish my shift. I forgot to go and pick some, though. Could you do it for me? Just pick some of the pretty red flowers you'll find growing on the mountain.

quests.name: Bunny Food
quests.description: I'm supposed to feed the bunnies - that's part of my job. But I've run out of rabbit food. They mostly eat the seeds and blossoms from the vicious plants wandering the area. Maybe you could find them some.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Feed the Bunnies
quests.description: But you didn't feed them yet, did you? You should do that now. Just put the food on the ground. They'll find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Control the Bunnies
quests.description: You might have noticed that there are a LOT of rabbits here. Lately, their population is getting out of control, and I just can't feed all of them while I'm busy with my games. Can you knock some of them out to make things easier for me? It will make your journey easier too. Definitely.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Time for Tea
quests.description: All this work is making me thirsty. We should have some tea, don't you think? Get some leaves from those plant-things and I'll brew them for us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Needs Something Else...
quests.description: This tea is fine by itself, but you know what really kicks it up a notch? Ink from those… bunny… squid things. The ones with the tentacles! It's better than caffeine, I swear.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Snacktime
quests.description: Ugh. Tea time is pointless without a snack, and those evil bunnies have stolen all of the cinnamon scones I brought! Get them back and I'll give you a couple.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Big, MEAN Bunnies
quests.description: So, uh… I don't know if you've noticed or not, but some of the bunnies here have gotten very large. You'll find them way up on top of the hill. Problem is, they get MEAN when they grow that big. You've gotta do something about it, or they'll eat all the OTHER bunnies. Bring me their mutated tongues as proof.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: What Crack?
quests.description: So, you found a weird crack in the ground, did ya? Maybe you should go check it out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: OMG What is THAT?
quests.description: Gah! What IS this thing? Surely it couldn't have been born like this… could it? You'll have to kill it… before it kills you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Un-decorate Yokai
quests.description: Calm down? I don't want to calm down! I want my rightful parade spot! I paid for it, after all! If you want my mood to improve, you can help me clear that interloper Lengjing out of here. Why don't you start by taking down some of those Yokai decorations, hmm?
quests.requirements_note: Must have Cool Lemonade in your inventory.

quests.name: Naughty Fairies
quests.description: These Xingzhi are driving me insane! They keep playing tricks on my dancers, and damaging my beautiful floats! Please, get rid of them. I can't work like this!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Parades Token I in your inventory.

quests.name: Dancers Love "Flours"
quests.description: Back to our primary task! We need to chase those Yokai parade dancers out of here. Take the bag of flour, and use it to douse the dancers! They'll have to go home and take showers, which means they won't be here to interfere with my parade.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Parades Token II in your inventory.

quests.name: Spooky Ghosties
quests.description: Well, the Xingshi have been keeping away from us, but now the Shushen have started to show up. They're scaring my crew! Make them go away!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Parades Token III in your inventory.

quests.name: Plan B
quests.description: It's time to pull out the big guns. The Yokai parade can't go on if its emcee is asleep! First, get me some feathers from the ravens in the streets. I'll fashion them into a feather boa, and then I'll douse it with Lingzhi spores. Those spores will put anyone who wears the boa to sleep! Naturally, I'll need you to get those for me too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Parades Token IV in your inventory.

quests.name: A Gift for Lengjing
quests.description: The feather boa is finished. Take it to Lengjing and tell her it's a peace offering from me. How can she resist wearing my gift of friendship? And once she puts it on… those spores will put her right to sleep, and the street will belong to me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Parades Token V in your inventory.

quests.name: Turn Off the Heat
quests.description: Oh the humanity! Everything is burning up in this place! Quickly, put down those flame before we are part of the new crispy decor!

quests.name: One Man's Trash...
quests.description: Ok, here is the plan: If we can't put it down, we will trap it! Pshh, of course this is possible - it's magic! First let's get the containers. Something made to hold fire and light…hmm…OH! I know! Lanterns! There are some paper lanterns left from last year's…uh…collaborative work between me and Lengjing. They were shoved at the back of the alley.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Some Fiddling and the Right Spells
quests.description: Now I'll need some ingredients. I can work with the soot and ashes, but I'll you to go to /terradefesta and gather fur from the Green rats, eggs from the Crows and (this one might be a little difficult) Baron Sunday's Pouch of Voodoo Dust. Be ready - he might need some strong argument to part with it!

quests.name: I Need More Time
quests.description: Will you just chill out? Sorry, sorry - I can't work under pressure, and this is a very delicate spell! And there are monsters everywhere spreading those flames! Go take out your frustration on them to help get things back on track.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Trapped Flames
quests.description: What I need you to do is simply spread those lanterns around the avenue. The flames will be attracted to it like a moth to a flame! And once they're in, they can't get out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: Get Inside!
quests.description: Things can never be easy with us, my friend! Some of the flames are resisting my spell, so you must weaken them! Put your back into it and show them the way out…I mean…IN!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Where There is Smoke..
quests.description: Now we need to track down poor Belo and find out where she's run off to. I sense a phenomenal amount of heat coming from the parlor. Go check it out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: Through the Flames
quests.description: Was it THAT hot? That's definitely where this conflagration is coming from. But we need to make you a little more fireproof. I need you to gather me a few more things. Go to /Carnaval and gather cloth from the Mulher de Branco and scales from the Boiuna.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battling the Inferno
quests.description: Belo Passaro, my poor thing! Is there any part of you left in there? It's painful to see such a majestic creature manipulated like a puppet. Please, tear that invading spirit out of her and bring her back to us!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ultra Belo Battle
quests.description: Belo Passaro NEVER wants to be used like that again! She wants to train against Lore's strongest warrior to hone her battle skills. Are you interested?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Face Fear
quests.description: Ayi has spent much time chasing Fear. But now the time has come to YOU to face the Fear!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Fear Death's Quests .

quests.name: Call of Doody
quests.description: It is up to us, friend! We must slay the Guanotaur, Colonicus, so that he can no longer terrorize and devour the Dragonslayers (and other sacrificial tributes) who are flushed down from above! It is our DUTY!

quests.name: Skye's Raindrops
quests.description: We need to make our escape as soon as possible. Though the door isn't locked, Indradeep's Warriors will be patrolling the halls. Would you please go easy on them? Maybe knock them out and drag them into our room? I may have been their prisoner, but they've always been kind to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Double Fianchetto ' quest. Note: : These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Doctor's Orders
quests.description: Ah, the storage room happened to be right across from ours! Iseul is in charge of Castle Eblana, and this is where she tucked away all of the research and technology she stole from Seabase Undine. Gather as much of it as you can.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Double Fianchetto ' quest. Note: : These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shockwave's Ripples
quests.description: The Executors caught wind of our escape. They were supposed to leave with Iseul, but she must have left a few behind to guard Castle Eblana. They won't be as accommodating as the Warriors. Please keep them from recapturing us. They'll break our legs to make sure we won't try again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Double Fianchetto ' quest. Note: : These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Caretaker's Shadow
quests.description: The castle's caretaker is a good friend of mine. Mabel will help us escape, and point us in the safest direction. Before she can help us, we'll need to clear the Warriors and Executors crowding the feasting hall. I don't want to implicate Mabel. She's already gone through so much already.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Double Fianchetto ' quest. Note: : These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Harbinger's Tears
quests.description: I don't want to leave Mabel and the other servants behind to face Iseul's wrath alone, but we need to go. Bananach Ravens are gathering outside of the castle. Would you mind bringing some back to me? I'd like to collect some medical reagents from them. Treat them gently. They're sacred.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Double Fianchetto ' quest. Note: : These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spectre of Hunger
quests.description: Keep your head down, and we'll sneak through the town. Careful, blight and starvation have plagued Skye's countryside for a while now. It's causing the Fear Gorta to appear in Eblana. Keep them from attacking us, and look for anyone who's willing to point us in the right direction.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Double Fianchetto ' quest. Note: : These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: InnJustice
quests.description: Talk to the Stormview Innkeeper, Aisling. She can help us escape from town unseen. It'll help if we collect reagents from the Bananach Ravens and Fear Gorta to create a magic charm. That can keep the Executors from wanting to knock on the Inn's door for a while.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Double Fianchetto ' quest. Note: : These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find Shelter in...
quests.description: Aisling says to leave out the back door of the inn, and use the forest to cover our escape. I'm ready to leave, but would you mind terribly if we could stop by a statue that's on the path? It was smashed a long time ago for being cursed, but I've always been curious.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Double Fianchetto ' quest. Note: : These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Heavy Handed
quests.description: Thanks to Tris.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Double Fianchetto ' quest. Note: : These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest. ﻿ Indradeep ordered his Warriors to apprehend us, but he won't join the fight just yet. Please, keep them at bay. I…I'll - ugh, my tongue keeps getting stuck. If worse comes to worst, I'll use my spells. I just need time to pull myself together.

quests.name: Miserable Monsoon
quests.description: Thanks to Tris.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Double Fianchetto ' quest. Note: : These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest. ﻿ The Warriors are parting to make a path. They're just as unsure as we are, but Indradeep won't budge. There's no way he'll step aside unless we make him…alright, we have to fight. I can't let myself cower and leave you stranded.

quests.name: Our Rain
quests.description: We'll need to move fast to get to the Ruins of Loughshine. Help me collect reagents so I can cast a spell that will summon a rainstorm. It'll look exactly like Indradeep's, so the clouds will cover our tracks without making the Queen and her daughters suspicious.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Miserable Monsoon ' quest.

quests.name: A Friend's Faith
quests.description: Though the Cold Thunder Avatar is immensely powerful, its ascension wasn't perfect. It has a clear weak spot that both you and Queen Victoria will aim for. Climb its body, and find its open core! Could those eyes on its chest be Iona's?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Vow of Misery ' quest. Note: : These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Storm Queen
quests.description: Lord Haeos has fallen, and the Avatar of Cold Thunder is on the rise. If it reaches the heavens, the storms will never end. Queen Iona is at the center of this Cold Thunder Avatar. Defeat her, and bring an end to centuries of Skye's suffering.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Vow of Misery ' quest. Note: : These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eilean a' Cheò
quests.description: Skye will face the future with hope, and the scars left by its occupation will heal. I imagine the story of your battle with the Cold Thunder Avatar being told for generations. So, for a moment, let's investigate the past and learn what we can from what's left of it. This could help you in the future.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Storm Queen ' quest.

quests.name: The Storm Queen (Badge Quest)
quests.description: Lord Haeos has fallen, and the Avatar of Cold Thunder is on the rise. If it reaches the heavens, the storms will never end. Queen Iona is at the center of the monstrous amalgam. Defeat her, and bring an end to centuries of Skye's suffering. (Badge Art will unlock once the World Boss Event is over.)

items.name: Cold Thunder World Boss Character Page Badge

quests.name: Liquid Hot Magma Maggots
quests.description: Just because Rayst sent you here to retrieve the Chaos Focus Gem doesn't mean I'm going to willingly let you take it. You're going to have to prove yourself to me and to Mount Mafic before I place my full trust in a mortal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Felsic the Magma Golem ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Scorched Serpents
quests.description: The Volcanic Maggots did not faze you. So let us see if the Scoria Serpents have better luck. Mount Mafic is home to flying winged snakes known as Scoria Serpents. Nowhere else in this world do these creatures reside. With this being said, I want you to capture 5 Alpha Serpents from the Scoria brood to see if I can expand their population. Oh and try not to get burned out there… or worse…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Felsic the Magma Golem ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Playing With Living Fire
quests.description: Let's turn up the heat… and the bad puns. The Living Fires are a fiery race that were once mortal like yourself. They devoted themselves to mastering the element of fire… and I suppose they succeeded in a most unfortunate way. Forever their souls have been trapped on Mount Mafic, and if you can extinguish 10 of them, they might find peace once more after respawning.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Felsic the Magma Golem ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kindling Relationship
quests.description: Deep within Mount Mafic resides the Chaos Focus Gem. I had said earlier that the mountain herself is the guardian of the last piece of the Supreme Arcane Staff… and this is only half true. The spirit of Mafic is inside a great Dragon who has guarded the Gem for ages. The only way to getting to the Dragon's nest is to solve the tricky bridge puzzle among the mountain path. Figure out the puzzle, defeat the great Mafic Dragon, and then the Chaos Focus Gem will be yours. Best of luck, mortal. You have proved yourself to me… and now it is time to prove yourself to Mount Mafic!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Felsic the Magma Golem ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Heat 'Em Up!
quests.description: Thank you. You have made the right decision, helping these eggs. They deserve a chance. The nest needs more heat but I must watch the eggs. Can you bring me 12 Blazing Coals? you can find them around the cavern.

quests.name: Baby Food
quests.description: The dragonlings will be hungry when they emerge. I want to be prepared. Can you go collect 6 Wyvern Meat from the wyverns around here? That will be a good start for them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Molting
quests.description: Once the hatchlings emerge they will need to begin molting right away. Normally I would have gathered a pile of shed draconian scales for them to roll around in by now but I haven't had time. Can you gather 10 Fresh Draconian Scales for me?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Fatherly Insanity
quests.description: Duncan has drivin the Onyx Lava Dragon into a fury by having you slay his mate. We need to calm him before the dragonlings hatch or he will accidentally hurt them. Dark Draconian Essense has a soothing effect on dragons. See if you can get some?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: What Needs To Be Done
quests.description: The essence did nothing. It's far worse than I though. I hate to ask you but for the hatchlings sake I must. I need you to defeat the Onyx Lava Dragon. He needs to be stopped before the hatchlings arrive!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: IceStorm Collection Chest Badge
quests.description: The magic of Frostval brought this snowball to life. The moglins of Frostvale put a hat on it. Defeat one of the Snow Golems in /northlands that hurl this little guy's brothers at heroes and he'll reward you with the Frostval 2018 collection character page badge.

quests.name: Evil Keeps Winter Alive
quests.description: Glory in the name of Dage the Evil, Dark Lord of all the Undead! The time of ice. cold and darkness is Dage's favorite time of year. Celebrate the darkness with him by bringing him 8 Frost Hearts From the ice monster in /frozenruins and /glacera and he will reward you with gold!

quests.name: Keep Winter here!
quests.description: Glory in the name of Dage the Evil, Dark Lord of all the Undead! Keep Winter here, and earn Legion tokens by bringing him 10 Frost Hearts from ice monster and he will reward you with gold… and more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Dage Loves Winter!
quests.description: Winter is Dage's Favorite time of year… it's the most uncomfortable for everyone else! Keep winter here by taking 6 Pails of Water, 6 Lights and 6 Blankets from the monster in /frozenruins and /glacera and bringing them to Dage!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Get Rid of the Guards
quests.description: Dr. Eisenbacke's lab is heavily guarded, so before you do anything else you'll want to make sure that problem is taken care of. And make sure you watch out for the dogs - they're augmented with cybernetic upgrades, and have a really nasty bite.

quests.name: Get the Data
quests.description: Remember, we wants as much information as you can find on the experiments they've been doing here. If you see any scientists roaming the halls, you might want to grab any data they're carrying.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Door Code
quests.description: Alright, my intelligence says that you'll need an entry code to get into Eisenbacke's main lab. You can probably get it from one of the scientists, or maybe even one of the guards. Only the highest ranking staff will have access to it, so you may need to try a few times before you find someone who has the code.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Lab
quests.description: The one thing we couldn't find out is where Eisenbacke's lab actually is, but we know it's somewhere in this main hall. You'll have to try that code out on different doors until you find the right one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Take out Dr. Eisenbacke
quests.description: There's only one thing left to do: go into that lab and bring Dr Eisenbacke to his knees
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find Ada
quests.description: Where's Ada? Is she hiding under the couch? (Quest available once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Keep Looking
quests.description: Where's Ada? Is she hiding in the closet? (Quest available once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gotcha!
quests.description: Where's Ada? Is she hiding behind the curtain?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Destroy the Barrier
quests.description: If we want to get to that portal, we need to get past this barrier. It looks like that Shadowfire Summoner is the one maintaining it. We are going to have to take him and his Shadow Wings out if we are going to make it out of here alive.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Awaken Lady Fiamme ' quest.

quests.name: Blaze a Path
quests.description: There are too many soldiers in our way for us to make meaningful progress. Go with Galanoth and take out as many Onslaught Knights and Corporals as you can!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Awaken Lady Fiamme ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Into the Tiger's Den
quests.description: They are sending Shadowfire Tigers after us now? What kind of savages are these? This is the kind of stuff you have to deal with as a Hero? This is annoying!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Awaken Lady Fiamme ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: One Final Push
quests.description: The portal should be just up ahead. We just need one final push. Clear us a path and we will be able to escape!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Awaken Lady Fiamme ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat Elius
quests.description: Be careful, Hero. Elius is able to wield Tyndarius's power in small quantities, but enough to be a very difficult opponent. Defeat him so that we can escape this Plane.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Awaken Lady Fiamme ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Catching Fire
quests.description: I still don't fully understand how Tyndarius's soldiers are able to survive in this Plane. If you can, defeat some of the soldiers nearby and collect their essence for me to study. I'll let you keep the Shade Sparks my research produces.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Elius ' quest.

quests.name: ArchFiend Companions
quests.description: One ArchFiend DragonLord can take down an army. But MANY fighting together can take over the WORLD! Prove your strength and your skill in battle against the Red Dragon and other ArchFiend DragonLords will join you.
quests.requirements_note: Must own Fiend Dragon's Companion to access this quest.

quests.name: Feed the Fiend Shard
quests.description: The Fiend Shard hungers. Feed it so that its power may grow alongside yours.

quests.name: Grow the Fiend Shard
quests.description: The Fiend Shard has grown, but so has its appetite.

quests.name: Evolve the Fiend Shard
quests.description: The Fiend Shard is nearing its evolution, but its hunger must be satisfied.

quests.name: The Fiend Shard's Demand
quests.description: The Fiend Shard's hunger is only matched by yours. This isn't about gaining more power anymore. Now, your only intention is to feed.

quests.name: The Fiend Shard's Finale
quests.description: The Fiend Shard is nearing its final form, but can its voracious appetite truly be sated?

quests.name: Fiendish Storm Orb Quest Pet
quests.description: The Storm Orb promises you an electrifying weapon… if you can supply it with energy.

quests.name: Fiendish Storm Orb Quest Pet (Member)
quests.description: The Storm Orb promises you an electrifying weapon… if you can supply it with energy.

quests.name: Dreamsilk Hair
quests.description: Are you interested in one of my wigs? I’ll make you one if you bring me the Dreamsilk I need. It comes from the Dream Larva you’ll find roaming the city.

quests.name: Defeat Drakath!
quests.description: Battle Drakath to proceed on your quest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Beat Death! ' quest. Note: This quest can only be accepted in Screen 2.

quests.name: Defeat Drakath... again!
quests.description: He's back again, and you need to defeat him in order to move further on your road to the Final Showdown!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be accepted in Screen 5.

quests.name: Defeat Drakath!
quests.description: Drakath has embraced the full power of Chaos - can you still defeat him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be accepted in Screen 10.

quests.name: The Final Showdown!
quests.description: All Lords of Chaos have been defeated… that just leaves Prince Drakath!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the 13th Lord of Chaos ' quest.

quests.name: Weaken his Powers
quests.description: Prime Dominus is too powerful to confront right now. You must defeat 15 of his minions so cannot tap into their power. That should slow him down!

quests.name: Light and Dark
quests.description: For some.. personal needs… I need you to get the magic essence from 7 Sprites. The big problem with that is they do not commonly drop their essence - it tends to burn up when they are defeated. Keep fighting until you've obtained 7 Sprite Magic essences for me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Nova Badge 1.0 to access this quest.

quests.name: Paintings Give Him Strength
quests.description: Look hero, those paintings are worth a lot… i mean they contribute to his overall power so they have to be worth SOMETHING! Bring them to me, and we will see if this lowers his strength!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Nova Badge 2.0 to access this quest.

quests.name: Learning the Land
quests.description: I know that there is a door further into the Fortress that Prime Dominus keeps locked. Go take a look at the door to see if we will be able to unlock it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Nova Badge 3.0 to access this quest.

quests.name: Slay the Light and Dark
quests.description: Good or evil, it does not matter here. To open that door we need some darkness and Light fragments. To get the fragments, you must defeat both Living Stars and Infernal Imps. You'll have to work hard - the fragments don't always survive after the monsters are gone!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Nova Badge 4.0 to access this quest.

quests.name: Chaos Fragments
quests.description: We have Darkness and Light now Chaos is required. Defeat chaorrupted monsters in /chaosmarsh or the /watchtower and bring me back some Chaos Fragments from them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Nova Badge 5.0 to access this quest.

quests.name: Kill Them All
quests.description: Kill any monster around here, I need Prime's life force weakened.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Nova Badge 6.0 to access this quest.

quests.name: Get Rid of Those Guards
quests.description: Prime Dominus has a special group of guards surrounding his fortress. Defeat 5 of them to really let him know that we are coming for him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Nova Badge 7.0 to access this quest.

quests.name: Breach the Gate
quests.description: Of course, it has a double-lock system. Nothing is ever that easy! I need you to get the key to the second lock off of one of the Guards.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Nova Badge 8.0 to access this quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Prime Dominus
quests.description: You must defeat Prime in order to get the Star Core. Best of luck, Hero. Be careful, this guy has been around since time itself began.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Nova Badge 9.0 to access this quest.

quests.name: Fire Endurance
quests.description: The fact that you have survived long enough to reach the second level of the Keep is a good omen for your success. However, before I trust my soul to you, I will need additional proof of your competence. This floor is inhabited by hordes of particulary nasty beasts known as Shadow Creepers, who serve the bidding of their fiery Master. If you can slay fifteen of them and bring me their essences, I will know you are worthy and will grant you access to the creature who cursed me. (Bring back fifteen Fiery Essences to complete this quest.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Earth Thief Ghost's Quests .

quests.name: Burning Heart
quests.description: I still remember the final moments of my life. As the Fire Elemental loomed over me to administer his terrible curse, my eyes were drawn to a luminous bracelet on his wrist. The way it glowed and shone in the darkness… I'm SURE that it must be the source of his power, and the key to breaking my curse. If you can defeat him and bring it to me, I'm sure I can end my fiery torment once and for all. (Bring back the Fire Bracelet to complete this quest.)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Earth Thief Ghost's Quests . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fire Dragon's House
quests.description: If you can't stand the heat, don't live inside a fire dragon's skull! But if you're one of those heroes who thrives the hotter and deadlier a battle gets, then slay 3 of the Fire Elementals in /dragonplane to unlock a new home just for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have FireLord's Summoning Scroll in your inventory.

quests.name: Fangs for Nothing
quests.description: You know, I LOATHE goblins. Messy beasts, at the best of times. But their fangs DO make the best fasteners for the silks the nobles love. Bring me 8 Goblin fangs.

quests.name: Lookin' Flashy
quests.description: Ever since the Queen of Monsters landed on our fair island, everyone's priorities have been turned upside down. Now everyone wants survival gear. Knives, flint, and mirrors. Well, I can make that happen! Bring. Me. SHINY THINGS!

quests.name: The New Swabbie
quests.description: Ye says ye're tough, eh? Well, put your money where your mouth is! Board me ship, and go down into the hold. There, ye'll find one of me men. We was going to make him walk the plank for attempted mutiny, but now he's yer test of mettle! If ye can beat him, then ye'll have earned the right teh… well, teh not be killed just yet.

quests.name: It's A Thankless Job
quests.description: Alright, new swabbie! There's work t'be done! Get back up there onto our ship. Shine our boots and mop the deck!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Gunpowder, Lots!
quests.description: We're not done yet! I need ye teh collect gunpowder from the scoundrels and rapscallions along the shore, and then come back here and load it into our blunderbusses! (Quest available once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per login.

quests.name: Boar-ed of Seafood
quests.description: Now that the other preparations be finished, we be needin' some grub for the celebratory feast we'll be havin' later tonight! Me men all be sick of fish, but there be some nice, meaty boars in the woods here! But try te keep 'em whole… if they be too damaged, they won't stay on a spit very well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: This Boar Is On Fire
quests.description: Now let's get that spit heated up! We be needin'…. Let's see…. charcoal, matches, and lighter fluid! Ye kin find some charcoal on the beach from last year's feast. The rest be on our ship.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Pirates Be Stealthy!
quests.description: Now that we be prepared for tonight… how would ye like a bit o' adventure, swabbie? Go to the other side o' the island, and see what Bonnie Blood and her crew are up to. Make sure they don't see ye, swabbie! They be a dangerous sort.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Bring Me the Bounty of the Black Veil!
quests.description: The winner o' the Midnight Crown be the captain what has the biggest pile o' treasure at the end o' the battle! If ye be wantin' to help me out, ye can fight the Black Veil Pirates, and bring me the bounties they carry!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Black Veil Courier Service ' quest. Note: Quests can still be turned-in using the corresponding buttons on the top-right corner.

quests.name: Bring Me HUGE Bounties of the Black Veil!
quests.description: Some o' those Black Veil pirates carry a larger bounty than usual - you might even say they have HUGH bounties! If ye find 3 o' these, bring 'em to me, and i'll add 'em to me pile!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Black Veil Courier Service ' quest. Note: Quests can still be turned-in using the corresponding buttons on the top-right corner.

quests.name: Faceless Moon
quests.description: Look, by the shore. What used to be members of the Full Moon's crew are prowling the sands. They don't be themselves no more, an' heel to a new Captain. Cut those wolves loose so we can find the one holdin' their leashes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bitterfang ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Apex Prey
quests.description: Are ye a fast swimmer? Harharhar, it be sink or swim fer a pirate, and the beasts below haven't stopped sinking. Drowned Werewolves are haunting the shallows. Send 'em to the other side so we can get further.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bitterfang ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: False Triton
quests.description: See that clam at the bottom o' the trench? That's where the glow's comin' from. It's beggin' for us to snoop, but make sure you defang the Lampreys crawling all over it. Looks like they've been turned into Vampires five times over.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bitterfang ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blood Moonglade
quests.description: Arrr! No time to linger! Drowned Vampires noticed us poking around that clam shell. They may look similar, but they ain't from the Crimson Veil's crew. Cut them down, and let the sea claim their fangs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bitterfang ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Aye Eye
quests.description: Now we know our quarry was hidin' underwater the whole time. It slithered away, but it left a trail o' red. You an' I are goin' to take a closer look, but keep yer weapon ready. The crazed Blood Veil Pirates be gettin' thirsty. Teach 'em not to mess with you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bitterfang ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fang Profile
quests.description: Keep following that red trail! We be gettin' close. Now Kurok Gravefang's Horde be stepping out of the shadows! They look waterlogged and drained… like somethin' fed on 'em. Clip their wings so I can get a better look.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bitterfang ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Necro-Putrefaction
quests.description: Gravefang never intended to give the winner of this war a prize! His Horde was lyin' in wait to feast on them while they were winded from battle, and the Vampiric Lampreys be helpin' them. What a fine mess. Clean them up and toss'em to the sharks!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bitterfang ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Counterpirate
quests.description: Would ye look at that? Bonnie Blood herself, goin' wild and splashin' around out in the water. Harharhar! Give 'er a wake-up call, and smack the blood craze out of her head. I wanna see what she has to say for herself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bitterfang ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Abyssal Alpha
quests.description: The Werepyre Lich that started it all is flying in to attack! This time, save a piece o' Kurok Gravefang fer me. Once we tear him apart, we'll go finish this OooOOooOOooOOoOOoo business fer good!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bitterfang ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nyx Oceana
quests.description: The creature behind our unchecked bloodlust is a hybrid like Kurok! A vampiric Siren with the sweet voice of a crooked tuba, harharhar! We'll put an end to her secret performance, and each 'ave our pound o' flesh!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bitterfang ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Petty Proposition
quests.description: The Blood Testament Isles would be a fine port to call me own, if it weren't fer the riffraff cluttering the beach. This time, take my side and I'll give ye treasure. I'll rename this island after me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Nyx Oceana ' quest.

quests.name: World Tree Wrangling
quests.description: My companions are great, but not high enough in skill to defend themselves from the beasts that inhabit these forests. If I want to keep my creatures free range, organic, and without preservatives (i.e. taxidermy) their main predator, the Hootbear, needs to be taught a lesson.

quests.name: Guardians Gone Bad
quests.description: It was on my suggestion Aven even allowed the Brightpool Guardians into our home. I meant for these creatures to serve as ferocious protectors against the outside world; to transform the misunderstood beasts into a docile friend. Until I break through to the Brightpool, make sure they aren't attacking any innocent bystanders by subduing 9 of the Brightpool Guardians. Pour 5 vials of Aven's "Soothing Solution" into the river; too. That should help..

Flying Necrotic Skull Quest Pet's Quest.name: Flying Necrotic Skull Quest Pet's Quest

quests.name: Necrotic Pirate Commander's Badge
quests.description: Yarrrr! If it be a ghostly pirate ship house ye be wantin', I've got just what ya need. Slay an Undead Pirate in the /pirates map fer a Ghostly Key, an th' house will be yers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Flying Necrotic Skull Quest Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Nineveh and Pyre
quests.description: Even Pyromancers should not just rely magic. The more mundane defenses are also important. Help me help the people of Embersea construct better defenses. Bring me 5 Burning Embers, 3 boards, and 3 pieces of Kindling from Fyresyns. (NOTE: can only be done once per log in)

quests.name: The Fire Within
quests.description: The Pyromancers who dwell in Embersea are know for their resilience… and their ability to rise up after defeat. But I say we will NOT fail! Help me construct some… messages… for our invader friends. Bring me 6 Fyresyn bones, 3 Living Lava Pyroclasts, and the helm from one Storm Sentry.

quests.name: Fotia's Only Hope
quests.description: … oh great hero… I can save the Isle of Fotia… take me to the volcano… sacrifice me into the lava core… I am Fotia's only hope… and do not allow anyone to stand in your way…!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' This Guy's on Her Side ' quest. Notes: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: The Hero's Doom
quests.description: Oh no - you're dying! If you can get to the sarcophagus, you'll be ok. Leave the throne room, and keep heading left until you've reached your salvation.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Black Plague ' quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Crashers and Moshers
quests.description: It's hard to concentrate with all these undead moaning and flailing. Defeat 7 of the undead in the Battle Concert Arena so you can focus on the show.

quests.name: Freak on a Leash
quests.description: Zombies, freaks, and undead beasts… three things that will RUIN the craziest virtual concert this arena's ever seen. Take out the Freak on the Leash ans keep the concert going strong!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Toxic Beast Takedown
quests.description: *cough* There's a lot of smoke and dust being stirred up by all of the toxic beasts flooding into the arena. It won't be long before we can't even see the band. Take out 7 of the Toxic Beasts to keep the show going strong.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Large Toxic Takedown
quests.description: *COUGH COUGH* If it gets much smoggier in here the band's going to start being affected, and THAT we cannot allow. Take out the Large Toxic Beast to make sure the band can keep rockin!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Zombie Redux
quests.description: These undead won't.. stay.. DEAD! Take out 7 of the Rotting Zombies so the show can continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dollageddon Destruction
quests.description: That is a creature out of a nightmare.. or an INSANELY AWESOME music video. But a creature that big cold drop a score of fans. Take it down to make sure everyone can enjoy the show.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Thrash's Finale
quests.description: Thrash, the God of Rock, Sultan of Songs, the Defiler of D minor… WAITS FOR YOU! Defeat him as you rock out to the band's final song.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

items.name: Dark Mosh Pit Champion Character Page Badge

quests.name: Frevo's Dancers Need Feathers!
quests.description: Hello! Welcome to Terra de Festa! I have a friend who is in need of some brightly colored Cuco feathers for the Carnaval celebration. Could you gather some and bring them to him? You can find him by heading down the ramp, and then to the left.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Party Like a BOSS! ' quest.

quests.name: Dancers Need Feathers!
quests.description: Ok, if these dolls are going to be my dancers, they'll need some festive feathers! You know where I've seen some pretty ones? Those Cuco on the beach - just head to the right to find them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Party Like a BOSS! ' quest.

quests.name: And Dolls Need Heads
quests.description: Now that I have these feathered plumes, I'll need some doll heads to attach them to! Large rat skulls would do nicely. Say, from the Green Rats on the city street?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Head Needs A Body
quests.description: Yes, good. Now we need some bodies. I could make them out of fabric and stuff them with straw if I had some. Check with the crows, perhaps? They collect plenty of both for their nests.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bind It All Together
quests.description: And now I'm realizing I don't have anything to sew these dolls together with! If you go back to the beach, you'll find Mulher de Branco. Her silvery hair should do the trick.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Take 'Em Apart
quests.description: I can't believe my beautiful dolls have turned against me! I'll have to dismantle them to break the enchantment. No - you will. Please? I can't bring myself to harm them. Bring me the pieces when you're done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Who Could It Be?
quests.description: If we're going to put a stop to this mayhem, we'll have to find out who's behind it! We'll find clues in the zombies he's sent. Kill them, and bring me any evidence you find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Bag For A Talisman
quests.description: Baron Sunday is bad news. He'll be a tough one to beat, but if I make us a special gris gris we may stand a chance. First I'll need to make a bag. I could craft it from green rat pelts… 6 should be enough. But make sure they're pristine.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Their... third eyes?
quests.description: You may have noticed the crows here have 4 eyes. The third ones are said to have special properties that offer protection from malevolent spirits. You can see why we'll need some, yes?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hexy Ladies
quests.description: The last thing we'll need are some hex fragments from a spell Baron Sunday cast. That will make the gris gris protect more strongly against him. The magic seems to be strongest on the dancing zombies, so you should collect the fragments from them.
