quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tracking Down A Baron
quests.description: Now, all that's left is to discover where Baron Sunday is hiding. The crows will know… and the rats. I can use them both to divine where he is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Baron Sunday
quests.description: If we don't take Baron Sunday down soon, there won't be a city left to party in! Terra de festa is counting on you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Heart of Ice
quests.description: Demolish the Polar Elementals and Polar Golems guarding this level of Kezeroth's temple by stripping them of the 4 Glacier Cores and 5 Frozen Snowballs that power them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Before the Darkest Hour ' quest.

quests.name: Absolute Zero Success
quests.description: Kezeroth was wise. As he slept, Temple Prowlers, Polar Elementals, and Polar Golems ventured deeper into the temple, attracted to his icy tomb, where he trapped them. Take back the 3 IceHeart Amulets, 3 Frozen Hearts, and 6 Diamond Snowflakes holding the creatures on this level and they will disperse.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Dirty Secret
quests.description: Until we confront him, we cannot know the secrets Kezeroth possesses… but we can try to make these creatures tell us! Convince them to share what they know by taking 10 Frozen Fangs and 5 Dirty Claws from the Temple Prowlers and Polar Moles.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Frozen Venom
quests.description: For those who make it to this level, it appears that Kezeroth has left a deadly trap. Destroy the Polar Wyrms and Polar Spiders, then take the 6 Tainted Wyrm Scales and 7 Poison Ice Spines from them so they cannot harm you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Rune-ing His Plan
quests.description: I had hoped to fine SOME kind of information to help us to defeat Kezeroth more handily. These Golems look like they may carry runes. Slay them and take 10 of the runes to see if they can tell us anything.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Deadly Beauty
quests.description: There is beauty in death, and danger makes the heart grow fonder. Do not forget what you are learning here, Hero. Slay the Polar Elementals and Polar Golems to collect 10 Crystalline Spines, 10 Crystal Snowflakes, and 6 Frozen Breaths so that you will always remember… at least, you will until they melt.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Cold-Hearted Trophies
quests.description: You are quickly learning the ways of these cold-natured creatures. claim some trophies of your conquests to continue. Slay Polar Moles and Temple Prowlers to complete your trophy collection and move on!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Warmth in the Cold
quests.description: The chill is beginning to seep into your bones. You need to slay Temple Maggots and Spider Guardians to continue to find warmth giving Maggot Spit and Spider Meat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Icy Prizes
quests.description: Temple Prowlers and Temple Maggots were both hunted to near extinction for their valuable Ice Whips and Poisoned Fangs. Earn a little cash on the side. Collect these prized items to continue to the next level of FrostDeep.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Fading Magic
quests.description: The Ancient Golems were placed here to protect the temples but their magic has begun to fade. They could turn on you at any second. You'd better destroy them and collect their magical remains before you continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: FrostDeep Dwellers
quests.description: The Polar Wyrm Riders have alerted the Polar Moles to your presence on this level. Demonstrate your might, eradicate these threats and carry proof of your victory with you to ward off future attacks.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: A Breather
quests.description: Might as well clear some Polar Moles, Temple Spiders, Polar Spiders while you're here. Once you have, rest, then move on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Raiders From FrostDeep
quests.description: Polar Draconians and Temple Maggots have been raiding villages near FrostDeep for a long time. You should take back some Deadly Defrosters and Larvae Silk before moving on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: 8 Legged Frost Freaks
quests.description: The Polar Spiders and Temple Spiders have become too common down here to ignore. Defeat some of these beasts and collect their treasures and eggs to continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Freezing the Stone
quests.description: The ancient golems in this layer of FrostDeep guard power. I am not sure how old, or what it would do to us, but we should recover it just in case. Recover 2 Ancient Runes and 3 Ruby Eyes. … Just in case.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Can You Feel the Chill Tonight?
quests.description: Take heart, Hero! We are approaching the bottom, I can feel it. I can SEE it, too, with the way my breath freezes in the air. The creatures here only make it colder. Slay the Prowlers and Polar Elementals for 7 Prowler Claws, 7 Frigid Femurs, and 4 Frost Breaths.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Shrouded in Ice
quests.description: I do not know why Kezeroth would have these Ancient Maggots in his lair. They make my skin crawl! And I worry why they would stockpile such items. Retrieve 10 Decayed Silk Shrouds and 9 Rotten Larva Shells so we know they can't be used on YOU.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Hard Fight for a Cold Truth
quests.description: Look at these Ancient Prowlers. You can tell by their battle scars that they have had a hard fight to survive. Vanquish them and you will be renowned for your courage and skill! Bring back 5 Prowler Tongues and 9 Scraps of Prowler Fur to prove you have defeated them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Sand and Shardin' Bones
quests.description: The ancient moles appear to be blind, but be wary. I can tell that these have become carnivorous, feeding off their kin. Collect 7 of the Bone Shards and 6 grains of Hourglass Sand. Someday, I will return them to the mole people so they may mourn properly.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Older and Colder
quests.description: The deeper you go into Kezeroth's dungeon, the colder you get. And the older creatures become. I am troubled by that. Slay Ancient Moles, Ancient Prowlers, and Ancient Maggots for 5 Dried Blood, 4 Wyrm Dirt, and 4 Temple Dust Mites. If they are put to rest, they will not trouble us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Sword Of Hope
quests.description: The Ancient Terror is the final guardian protecting the Sword of Hope. It regenerates but claim enough Hearts of Gold and Hears of Darkness and the Sword of Hope is yours!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Rays Of Hope
quests.description: You can find hope everywhere if you look hard enough, even here in FrostDeep Dungeon. Gather Sparks of Hope from any monster in FrostDeep and turn them in for Rays of Hope which you can use in the Sword of Hope Merge Shop to craft Kezeroth's Warhammers!

quests.name: Feed the Frostling Horror
quests.description: Mmm. Pet hungry. Pet a horror. Feed pet frozen meat chunk.

quests.name: Find the Underflame
quests.description: The Underworld you see here isn't all there is. Below where we stand, there is a pocket of intense, underworldly flame. The… Underflame, if you will. It holds the answer to your problem… IF you can find it. Ha, ha, ha.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Aid from the Pyromancer quest.

quests.name: Gather some Underlava
quests.description: As you may have noticed, the Underflame is so hot, much of it is molten. This lava… Underlava, I like to call it… is exactly what we need. Go and get me some.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Aid from the Pyromancer quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gather Sulfur
quests.description: Hey! Don't go anywhere. We're not done yet! I need some sulfur dust - it really spices up that flame. The imps will be your best source.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Aid from the Pyromancer quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Coal for Flame
quests.description: Just one more thing: some ghostly coal to keep the fire burning. You'll have to mine that yourself, from the walls of the Underflame.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Aid from the Pyromancer quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the Underflame Guardian
quests.description: WAIT! Don't go. Not yet. All of that mining and lava-collecting. Has awakened the Guardian of the Underflame. He's not happy, and if you leave he'll take it out on ME. You'll make sure he doesn't, right? Since I helped you?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Aid from the Pyromancer quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Take the Flame
quests.description: Okay, here you go. This flame should be hot enough and bright enough to clear out anything. You're welcome. Now, go back to Dage.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Aid from the Pyromancer quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Hound Down the Beast!
quests.description: After doing some research on these tracks, I found that they are from a Werewolf! We'll have to try to hunt one down somewhere and see if it took it. Do you know where we might be able to find a suspect? It likely won't give up my favorite bone without a tussle.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Third Who's Clue in your inventory.

quests.name: Fusion Avatar's Gift
quests.description: To acknowledge your victories and support, we have a gift for you. Click the button below to get your very own Golden Item of Donated Awesomeness.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Fusion Avatar's Lady in your inventory. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Shadow Spy Eye
quests.description: They're watching, staring, glaring, waiting for you to make a move. And once you do, they'll summon their alien guards to take you out! Better beat 10 ETs before you're the one thrown out of this world!

quests.name: Application for the Army
quests.description: Would you like to join our army? We're currently accepting applications for our army. Wait… you don't look like a dino…

quests.name: A Jarring Solution
quests.description: The spears carried by the Guardians of Anubyx are charged with tesseract energy. If you get a canopic jar from one of the mummies, you can use it to store that energy. When you have enough tesseract energy to fill the jar, activate the bridge by placing the canopic jar into the circular socket near the end of the walkway.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' De-Lever-ence ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Ra of Light
quests.description: Alright! You have used the energy you just collected to charge up the Hard Light Bridge by placing the canopic jar into the circular socket near the end of the walkway. Now you'll be able to cross the bridge and pull the third lever.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Sphynxes are Riddled With Gems
quests.description: On the other side of the bridge you'll find some stone sphynxes. You'll need to collect 4 gems from them - 2 white, and 2 black. Obviously you'll get the black gems from the black sphynxes, and the white gems from the white ones.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: 4th Dimensional Teleport
quests.description: Now, you're going to take those gems you just gathered, and place them into the device a little further down the hall. Black ones on top, white ones on the bottom. Then… well, just use it and see what happens, haha!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Find the Secret Brick
quests.description: Ok, soooo… first, we have to find the second lever. I remember having to press a brick into the wall to reveal it - like when you're reading a murder mystery and they go through a secret passageway in the walls! - but I don't remember where it was. I know you can find it though. Because I did!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Yo Mummy ' quest. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Gauze in 60 Seconds
quests.description: As you may have noticed, the second lever is way out of your reach. But we are problem-solvers! If you get enough gauze from those mummies, we can use it to lasso the lever from a distance. But you'll need to find some pretty strong gauze, otherwise it will break. 20 feet of the stuff should probably be enough.

quests.name: De-Lever-ence
quests.description: Now all you have to do is go back in there and lasso the lever with your gauze!

quests.name: I heard you like Gacha
quests.description: As you approach, a very large mechanical contraption covered in bright lights contains a lot of gear. Examining it, you see a coin is needed to be inserted to turn the dial. Maybe Kotaro has what you're looking for? There's also a slot that says to insert a green bone..? A Skello Kitty from the /yokaigrave should do.

quests.name: KotaPon II: Get'cha Gear
quests.description: As you approach, a very large mechanical contraption covered in bright lights contains a lot of gear. Examining it, you see you'll need to insert a x1 Klawaii Coin and x10 Eden Resident Tokens from the Anomalies to turn the dial.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Protect the Reactor! ' quest.

quests.name: Gather Spores
quests.description: In the garden, you'll find some pretty glowing mushrooms. Their spores have some very intresting magical properties. Bring me some.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Let 'em Loose ' quest.

quests.name: Getting Dusty
quests.description: Pixie dust acts as a universal reagemt. Any spell you add it to become stronger. Obviously, we're going to want some for this one. The sprites in the garden have it in abundance.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gather Moss
quests.description: Just one last thing: some of the moss growing on the treeants nearby. What does it do, you ask? I'll let that be a surprise
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Feed Bramblebite
quests.description: Here, go on. Take this over to Bramblebite and have him eat it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once.

quests.name: Flowers and Seeds
quests.description: First, I'll need you to gather a few herbs that have certain magical peoperties. A few seeds from the Glass Spitters, and some red flowers you'll find growing around the garden. I only need a few of each.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once.

quests.name: So Glamourous
quests.description: I'll be using sprite glamour to power the spell. Do I even need to tell you where to get this? Sigh. From the Garden Sprites, of course
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Likin' the Lichen
quests.description: A bit of blackened lichen will mask the favor of the herb I'm adding. You'll fing it glowing on the Treeants nearby.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: It's Wine Time
quests.description: One last thing: a glass of Feawine. Most of the guests will be drinking it. Steal a glass from one of them and bring it back to me. You'll have to fight for it, though - they REALLY don't want to give it up.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nap Time for Barb
quests.description: Now all you need to do is give this glass of wine to the Scriptkeeper - your friend Barb, that is - and she will fall into a deep sleep. It should last long enough for you to get her home.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can be completed only once.

quests.name: Crystallis Ship Quest
quests.description: Space-warriors and monks sponsored by the Crystallis administration travel in style, and so can you. All you need to create your ship is one orb of Crystallized Spacetime. Slay an Astral Ephemerite in the /timespace map to unlock your ship.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Galactic Space Shield in your inventory.

quests.name: Dragonfire Spice Cake
quests.description: Hero! I need 10 crystallized Dragon flames to grind up. They are the only spice hot enough to make my patented Dragonfire Spice Cake! Slay 10 Draconians for Crystallized Flames.

quests.name: DragonPepper Punch
quests.description: DragonSlaying is thirsty work, and so is birthday-parting! Bring me 10 vials of Draconian venom from the Lair Draconians and 3 Flame Peppers from the Fire Elementals in Gilead.

quests.name: DragonDoodle Cookies
quests.description: Some people - not DragonSlayers! - don't like cake. For them, I need you to bring back 1 box of DragonDoodle Cookies from the Green dragon in Greenguard, 3 boxes from the Sketchy Dragon in (/join j6) and 5 boxes from the Red Dragon in /Mafic.

quests.name: Dragon Tail Trophies
quests.description: I LOVE using dragon trophies to decorate, and tails are so versatile. Weave them into banners, curtains, rugs… I need as many as you can bring me! For every 10 Dragon Tails you bring, I'll give you a Dragon's Talon. Use those in my Birthday Merge shop.

quests.name: Dragon Head Trophies
quests.description: Displaying a Dragon Head is the sign of a devoted DragonSlayer, I KNOW you have the skill to gather as many as I need! Bring me 10 Dragon Heads so I can decorate the Lair. For every 10 Dragon Heads you bring, I'll give you TWO Dragon Talons. Use those in my Birthday Merge shop.

quests.name: Dragonslayer Veteran
quests.description: You have helped me, so now I will help you - to rank up into the Dragonslayer elite and earn your full place in the Order of Dragonslayers! You are, right now, officially a Dragonslayer Recruit. To rank up to Dragonslayer Veteran, bring me 8 Dragonslayer Veteran Medals. You can get them from Wyverns and Water Draconians!

quests.name: Dragonslayer Sergeant
quests.description: Congratulations! You are now a Dragonslayer Veteran. To rank up to Dragonslayer Sergeant, you must bring me 8 Dragonslayer Sergeant Medals. You can find them on Purple, Venom and Bronze Draconians.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragonslayer Captain
quests.description: As a Dragonslayer Sergeant, you now have quite a bit of experience fighting these creatures. To rank up to Dragonslayer Captain, bring me 8 Dragonslayer Captain's Medals that you can get from Dark and Golden Draconians!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragonslayer Marshal
quests.description: You have made it this far -- to the rank of Dragonslayer Captain! Now, your final test awaits! Bring me 8 Dragonslayer Marshal Medals by defeating the powerful fire dragon 8 times! Do this, and your rank as Dragonslayer Marshal is secure -- You will be one of my top-ranking slayers!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragonslayer Reward (Bonus Quest)
quests.description: With Vasalkar slain, most of his treasure will be donated to the towns he destroyed. But some items are too powerful to be in the hands of anyone but a Dragonslayer. Collect 12 Wisps of Dragonspirit for me and I will reward you with a piece from the Dragon's Hoard!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragonbane (Bonus Quest)
quests.description: Before we take on Vasalkar. I'm going to need enough Dragonbane for all of our Dragonslayers. We make it from Draconic Ore. The best way to get this ore is from the Wyverns and Draconians, who have mined it for their own uses. Plus. you'll be slaying some Dragonkin - two birds, one stone!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Dragonslayer Marshal' quest.

quests.name: Dragon Scales (Bonus Quest)
quests.description: Dragonslayers sometimes use dragon scales in their armor. It helps protect us from the fiery breath of the dragons we fight. Bring me scales from the Wyverns and Draconians in the area so I can keep us all well-protected.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Dragonslayer Marshal' quest.

quests.name: Dragon Souvenirs (Bonus Quest)
quests.description: Dragons take pride in killing Dragonslayers! They keep trophies from each of us that they slay - can you believe that?? We must defend the honor of the fallen. Slay the Dragonkin inside Vasalkar's lair, and bring back any trophies you find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Dragonslayer Marshal' quest.

quests.name: Dragonslayer (Bonus Quest)
quests.description: Vasalkar is a huge, old, and deadly Red Dragon that has destroyed many villages. He guards his treasure hoard ferociously! Defeat him so that we may carry word of vengeance back to the people who have suffered! Bring me his heart, and I'll reward you for it. You might also find rare and valuable treasures in his hoard!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Dragonslayer Marshal' quest.

quests.name: Bone Up on Battling
quests.description: These skeletons must be from the invading army! Slay 3 of them to clear the tower and reap the rewards: more gold and experience!

quests.name: Cryptbreaker Daily Challenge
quests.description: Take on Razorclaw the Cryptbreaker and steal one of his poisoned, razorsharp claws to earn extra gold and a chance for special rewards!

quests.name: Defeat the Dragon Thief
quests.description: Take on any of the Razorclaw dragons and steal one of their golden fangs to earn Gilded Claws to create special rewards!
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 10.

quests.name: Razorclaw Daily Challenge
quests.description: Take on Razorclaw and steal one of his poisoned, razorsharp claws to earn extra gold and a chance for special rewards!
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 20. Note: This quest can only be completed once a day.

quests.name: Slay the Greenguard Dragon
quests.description: Alright, to get you started, the first Dragon Gladiator I'd like to see you fight is the Greenguard Dragon. I expect him to be a challenge, but if you fight well I know you'll emerge victorious.

quests.name: Slay Ssikari
quests.description: Let's face it, most heroes have defeated the Greenguard Dragon before. Read for something a little more challenging? The next Dragon Gladiator you'll be facing is Ssikari! Get in there and impress me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slay Arradia
quests.description: You've done well against the Greenguard Dragon and Ssikari. Let's see how you'll fare against a dragon made entirely out of crystal. Be warned, his crystal skin is much harder to cut through than scales are.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slay the Void Dragon
quests.description: Next you'll be fighting a dragon that we brought back from the Void. Its terrifying appearance is enough to throw many heroes off their game, but if you can remain calm and focused I have no doubt you'll defeat it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slay the Shadow Dragon
quests.description: Next in line is a dragon who breathes shadow instead of fire. A solid shield, while useful against flame, may not help as much in this fight. My advice? Stay out of the way of its breath.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slay Razorclaw
quests.description: Razorclaw is beautiful in appearance, but makes a fierce adversary. What look like delicate feathers are sharp enough to cut. I recommend a very long blade for this battle.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slay Trigoras
quests.description: You knew this guy was going to show up eventually. How could I create the ultimate dragonslaying challenge without Trigoras? Show me what you can do against a dragon with three heads!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slay the Chaos Dragon
quests.description: I hope you enjoyed that 3-headed dragon fight, because I have another one ready for you. And this one is an incredibly powerful chaos beast, too!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slay Stalagbite
quests.description: Ready for something a little more complex? Your next adversary is Stalagbite. In there with him are a handful of chaorrupted dark elves. They'll attack you immediately, and if you don't take down Stalagbite fast enough, more will come.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slay Frost Fang
quests.description: Like Stalagbite, Frost Fang doesn't fight alone. His frozen minions will protect him fiercely. It would be an impossible battle for most, but you've quickly proven that you can handle anything.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slay Dreadmaw the Defiler
quests.description: Dreadmaw the Defiler waits for you, Hero… Galanoth once bested him and used his head as a trophy. Can YOU defeat him?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slay the Avatar of Desolich
quests.description: Looking to hone your skills even further? The Avatar of Desolich and his dracolich minions await you. Don't go alone to face this battle, hero.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per day.

quests.name: Slay Desoloth
quests.description: Still looking for a bigger challenge? Go into the coliseum to face Desoloth and the elemental dragons of the DragonPlane. You'll want to bring some friends along for this one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per day.

quests.name: DragonSlayer General Class
quests.description: If you wish to become a dragonslayer general, you'll need to put in the time and effort to prove yourself. Slay 12 of the dracoliches here to hone your skills.
quests.requirements_note: Rank 10 Dragonslayer (Class) .

quests.name: Dragon Slayer War Medal
quests.description: Aid the cause, Hero! Take out 5 dracoliches to help drive these beasts out of Battleon!

quests.name: Mega Dragon Slayer War Medal
quests.description: Aid the cause, Hero! Slay dracoliches until you've got 3 Mega Medals to help drive these beasts out of Battleon!

quests.name: DragonSlayer Farming Quest
quests.description: Aid the cause, Hero! Take out 1 of each Dracolich species to thin their ranks.

quests.name: Battleon DragonSlayer
quests.description: Bring me some trophies from defeating the dracoliches to show your help to the Order of DragonSlayers. Then, defeat Chaos Fluffy and bring me its head.

quests.name: Town On Fire
quests.description: This is a low blow, bounty hunter! Making me watch it all burn again - I can't do it. Would you help me, friends? Put the fires out, and maybe then I'll have the strength to face Akriloth again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sledge-a-tarian ' quest.

quests.name: My Greatest Foe
quests.description: This is a test of my resolve. In order to get out of here, I'm going to have to face Akriloth again. Maybe with you all by my side… this time we will win.

quests.name: Infernus the Eight-Eyed
quests.description: Infernus the Eight-Eyed is a terrible beast. He is responsible for devouring 5 entire flocks of sheep in the last week alone. If he keeps this up, the nearby villages will starve in less than half a year.

quests.name: Blackrawk Magebane
quests.description: 15 years ago, Blackrawk Magebane took over one of the only known caverns of FlameCrystals. These are prized by mages everywhere for their ability to create invisible heat and flames that do not burn. But Blackrawk has prevented ANY from harvesting the crystals for years.

quests.name: Smoldur Blastfang
quests.description: Smoldur Blastfang… this beast, I have encountered before. It has developed a special taste for DragonSlayers, and goes out of it's way to follow us as we move about Lore. Slay this Dragon and you will go down in DragonSlayer history!

quests.name: Guts for Glutes
quests.description: Now, friend! Gut this gargantuan horror while I block its flame!

quests.name: Mucus be Joking
quests.description: Before we go any further, we're going to want to protect ourselves from Glutus' stomach acid. What protects against stomach acid? That's right, mucus! Collect some from the Mucus in his mouth. We'll slather it on our armor to slow the corrosion
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Build a Bone-a-fied Ladder
quests.description: Glutus has a pretty long esophagus! Just dropping down into his stomach could be dangerous, so we'll need to build a ladder and climb down. Grab some of the rope stuck in his teeth - I guess he uses it to floss? - and get some nice, long arm and leg bones from the Skeletal Slayers. (Once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Talk About Reflux
quests.description: Now we can descend to Glutus' stomach! We don't want to wait for him to pass us naturally - we would be dissolved by his stomach acid by then. So we'll look around for something that might help us escape more quickly,
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: How'd HE get here?
quests.description: A lost Dragonslayer! He may have some valuable information that could help us solve our dragon problem! Talk to him, and hear what he has to say.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Glutus, Take 2
quests.description: Before, you said Glutus was too big for you to damage. That is no longer the case. Take him down. NOW, and we'll make sure this never happens to anyone else.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cha Cha Cha ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Drakel
quests.description: Do you see how far they're willing to go to keep these people in line? We must send a message that this village is now under our protection! Come back to me when you've slain 10 of the militant beasts. I'll be doing the same.

quests.name: Don't Get Zapped
quests.description: There's a lot of stray electrical energy in the village in the form of ball lightning, both from the storms and from the Drakel's electric prods. If any of it touches the wet ground, it could have deadly results! Get rid of the Ball Lightning, and keep the villagers safe.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get Grounded
quests.description: How do you protect against lightning and electricity? With grounding. And what's the best way to ground against electricity? With rubber. Luckily, Rubber Treeants are native to this area! Collect rubber from them, and bring itback to me. I have a plan.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get the Key
quests.description: You've noticed all the villagers are barefoot? They're telling me that the Drakel require it, so they'll be more vulnerable to their shock prods. Their boots are all kepy in a locked supply cellar. The Cellar Guard will have the key. Get it from him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get the Boots
quests.description: Now, all you need to do is use the key to open the cellar door. Then, go in and get the boots. As many as you can find. Bring them back to me, and I'll coat them in the rubber we collected earlier. That will make it harder for the Drakel to electrocute people.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Make Lightning Rods
quests.description: There's just one last thing we need to do before we free all of the villagers. Fight the Storm Drakel and take their electric prods. Then, embed them in the ground. They will act as lightning rods, drawing any electricity to themselves instead of the villagers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Free the Villagers
quests.description: It's time to act! Down the road a ways, you'll find holding pens where the villagers are held captive, guarded by Drakel. Get the keys to the pens from the Drakel Guards. Then, open the doors to free the captive villagers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Open the Gate
quests.description: They've locked the gate to stop us from following them up the mountain! We'll have to get the key from the Elite Guard if we're going to get it open!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fight Your Way Through
quests.description: Valsarian is at the top of this mountain! We'll have to fight our way to the peak to confront him! Slay any Storm Drakel who get in our way!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Valsarian
quests.description: This is our chance! Attack the beast now, and we free Darkmoor Village from his tyranny!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Looting is for Sneevils
quests.description: This area is overrun with Sneevils! Now that the dragon has been slain, they must be looting whatever was left behind. There can't be much be much value left, but maybe they'll have some sort of clue. Steal their boxes from them, and bring them back here.

quests.name: Jumping in Puddles
quests.description: Well, it's better than nothing, eh? Based on what that note says, I think that following the puddles of water will lead us to the treasure room. Let's go take a look!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Pick the Right Chest
quests.description: These aren't treasure chests - they're mimics! If there are any clues to be found here, it will surely be in one of these, but we'll have to be careful.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Gelatin is Nasty
quests.description: Gah! This cave is full of Jelly-like Cubes! We've got to take care of these things quickly, or they'll dissolve any evidence our culprit may have left behind!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Explore the Cave
quests.description: I'm not sure there will be much left that the Jelly-like Cubes haven't dissolved, but that doesn't mean we can't get a picture of what happened here. Explore the rest of the cave, and tell me what you see.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Disarm the Trap
quests.description: We've explored the entire cave, and those Cubes seem to have cleared it out pretty thoroughly - all that's left is whatever is past this corridor. But we'll have to disarm that trap before we can move past it! Once you've done that, go into the chamber beyond it, and see what you find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Crystal-eyes
quests.description: Just look at this cave - this has to be the place where the thief is stashing his hoard! It's covered in ice and gold! We'll have to get rid of some of these ice crystals before moving forward - they appear to be both enchanted and hostile.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Go-bolds?
quests.description: There is so much gold here, it's spilling out of the treasure room! It's drawing kobolds like flies. We can't let them take the gold - it's out responsibility to get it back to the towns it was stolen from. Grab as much as you can off the ground, and make sure these kobolds don't run off with the rest!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Follow the Trail
quests.description: I've found traces of what appear to be human footprints in this cave. They're not ours, so they must belong to our thief! Follow them, and I think we'll find the culprit.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get Rid of Greed
quests.description: I can't believe it - this dragon was so greedy it was actually killing its own kind for their treasure! That's a kind of evil that even most dragons can't accomplish. Help me cleanse this monster from Lore!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get rid of Phlegnn
quests.description: This dragon is deadly, but he's too lethargic to fight us both off! It shouldn't take us long to wear him out - then you'll be able to spray him down with Lim's cure.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Clean the Castellum ' quest.

quests.name: Cured is NOT GOOD
quests.description: We “cured” Phlegnn’s plague, but all it did was make him mad! Now we have a REAL fight on our hands. Help me slay him, and keep the people of this village safe.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Actual Sloth Dragon
quests.description: Phlegnn could be said to embody the concept of sloth - his plague made him so lethargic and sluggish. But have you ever heard of an actual sloth dragon? I hear the villagers have spotted one in the area, but I have no idea how to find it! If you're lucky, maybe YOU will.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hopelessly Devoted
quests.description: A lot of these guys actually seem to WANT to be here- and they're ready to fight to keep us out! They can't possibly be in their right minds, We don't want to hurt them, but we're going to have to knock them out if we're to continue this rescue mission!

quests.name: Fighting the Feeling
quests.description: Now that we can move around a little more freely, let's see about finding all of the missing princes - the ones who AREN'T trying to attack us! Hopefully, one of them will be able to tell us what exactly is going on here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Love Potion #9.1
quests.description: So, this dragon is keeping everyone here with a love spell? If we want them to come with us willingly, we might need to try to aim the spell at US! Enzio said the key is in her pheromones - and that she keeps some, in the form of perfume, in some of the vases scattered around her lair. So let's smash some vases, and find that perfume!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Leather is Better
quests.description: This will probably work best if we sort of look like dragons, too. You see those Drakel - her Enamored Guards? They look like a good source of Dragonscale Leather to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gird your Loins
quests.description: Ok, time to test this out! The perfume and leather are next to Enzio's cage - go back to him, and put them on. Then, confront some of Lasciva's Devoted Admirers and see if you can get them to start following you, instead! You might have to beat on them a little bit first… And… it might not work 100% of the time.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get the Keys
quests.description: We're ready to roll! if you remember, Lyona said that the enamored Drakel guards have the keys to the cages everyone is being kept in. There are 5 cages, so we're going to need to find 5 keys.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Open the Cages
quests.description: Alright! We've got all the keys, now we've just got to unlock all the cages. And since we smell like Lascivia, these captive princes (and princesses!) should be a lot more willing to follow us now!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get Past the Guards
quests.description: We're going to have to get past a lot of Elite Guards to get to the dragon's lair! Luckily, an amry of warrior princesses has got our back. Fight your way through them, and meet me on the other side!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Viscyra'lly Yours
quests.description: We're almost there, but one more obstacle is blocking our path. Viscyra was one of the first people Lascivia took, and she is a loyal as she is fierce! We'll have to get through her before we can confront the dragon. Defeat her, and then use her key to unlock the door leading to the center of Lascivia's lair.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lascivia'sness
quests.description: This is what we came here for! We've fought our way through her elite guards, we've defeated her loyal champion. Now, we slay the dragon and save the princes!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Confront the Dragon King
quests.description: We've made it through 4 stories of solid stone maze, and now all that's left is to confront Maloth, the Dragon King! I've got your back, friend.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Hand over the Entry Code ' quest.

quests.name: Slay Gorgorath
quests.description: The moment of our glory is upon us! Come on - if we fight this beast together, she will not stand a chance!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Unlock the Door ' quest.

quests.name: Clean the Bubbles
quests.description: My draconic friend here is really churning up the foam! It's great - when you're in the hot tub. But the stray foam that's splashed up onto the floor makes it awfully slippery when you get out. Mind cleaning it up so I don't end up breaking my back?

quests.name: Fire Dragon Scales
quests.description: While fighting these dragons, keep an eye out for their scales! They can be used to forge sturdy armor that would help any new hero!

quests.name: Fire Dragon Hearts
quests.description: The only part of a dragon that is stronger than their scales is their heart tissue! They are rare, but bring me any you find and I'll see what I can make you!

quests.name: Pyritium Shards
quests.description: Inferno Dragons are known for storing a rare gem known as Pyritium on their underbelly scales to make them stronger. When slaying the beasts, try to harvest as much Pyritium as you can!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fire Dragon Scales ' or ' Fire Dragon Hearts ' quest.

quests.name: Perfect Pyritium
quests.description: On very rare occasions, a Fire Dragon will stumble upon a Perfect Pyritium. A gen so beautiful and powerful that it fetches for colossal prices amongst gem traders. On the slim chance you find one, bring it to me and you'll be rewarded appropriately.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fire Dragon Scales ' or ' Fire Dragon Hearts ' quest.

quests.name: Uriax, Inferno of Akriloth
quests.description: Uriax, also known as the Inferno of Akriloth, has emerged on the battlefield! She is Akriloth's right-claw dragon, and highest 'ranked' general - or a dragon army's equivalent of a general. If we can take her out, it could turn the tide of this war!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pyritium Shards ' or ' Perfect Pyritium ' quests.

quests.name: Confront Akriloth
quests.description: The time has come. We must stop Akriloth here, or die trying!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Clear out the Dragons
quests.description: Demento has already gone to the Northlands to scout ahead for us. For now, we should remain here and clear out the rest of Akriloth army. Slay some dragons with me while we wait to hear from my brother!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Enchanted Ice Shards
quests.description: If you look closely, you'll see crystals of ice frozen into Izotz's fur. So near to him, it has absorbed some of his power. Collect the crystals that drop when you defeat him, and I can use it to make an enchanted version of the Frozen Claymore!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Akriloth ' quest.

quests.name: Dragons!
quests.description: Drakonnan appears to still be in control of Akriloth's dragons. Put them out of their misery.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Inferno Heart ' quest.

quests.name: No Lava For My Enemies
quests.description: Those Living Lavas make the heat in Drakonnan's fortress unbearable! Take them out and cool it down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clearing Out the Fodder
quests.description: There are too many guards protecting Drakonnan's throne room! Make a path, Hero!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unlocking the Door
quests.description: It appears the entrance to Drakonnan's throne room is protected by a constant ﬂow of lava. To keep intruders out, Drakonnan has shattered the key to the lava ﬂow into 4 pieces and given the pieces to his Fire Elementals. If we find all of the pieces, we can reconstruct the key and turn off the lava curtain to get inside.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Drakonnan
quests.description: The time has come, Hero! Fight your way through his guards and put an end to Drakonnan once and for all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ultra Drakonnan
quests.description: Drakonnan has absorbed the full power of the Fire Orb! We must keep fighting and put a stop to him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fire and Ice Tokens
quests.description: Drakonnan has been defeated, but his influence is still felt in the area. Continue defeating the fire monsters here to completely cleanse the area of his taint. Bring me some Dragon Scales, the gauntlet of a Fire Elemental, an ember of a Living Flame and some rock from a Living Lava. If you can do this, I will reward you with items that can be used in my shop.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Flamefang Medals
quests.description: Take out three of the dragon creatures to defend the Lair.

quests.name: Mega Flamefang Medals
quests.description: Battle the dragon creatures until they drop a Mega Flamefang Medal.

quests.name: SoulSucking Enemy
quests.description: The two-legged beasts look like wyverns. They fight like wyverns. But they don't FEEL like wyverns. There is a look in their eyes that even my hardiest slayers find troubling… I have dracomancers on standby, ready to examine them to learn what we can of our opponents. Getting them here… that's where you come in.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed one of the previous quests.

quests.name: The Dragon Summoner
quests.description: We've found the mage who opened the portal into our world… He's fallen back deep into the heart of the Lair, and is driving back all my slayers. His dragon companion is attack from the OverSoul, reaching through portals. He needs to know just who he is dealing with.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Flame Dragon
quests.description: The Fangs of Flame have blasted us, but we will NOT go down without a fight. Vasumar is still in the Lair, laughing at us. Take him out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragonlord Medals: Defend Arcangrove!
quests.description: These Dragonlords are no match for me - but there are so many of them! Defeat as many as you can and report back. Bring me the medals they carry as proof.

quests.name: Mega Dragonlord Medals
quests.description: The Dragonlords' elite forces are starting to appear on the battlefield. They don't look any different, but you will know them by the larger medals they carry. If you manage to kill any, bring their medals to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragonscale Powder ' quest.

quests.name: Head of a Dragon
quests.description: The dragons inside the tower - the shadow has mutated them!! Have you ever seen anything so vile? But they'll still fall, just like anything else. Slay them and bring me their heads.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dragon Oil ' quest.

quests.name: Titan Shadow Dragonlord
quests.description: The Titan Shadow Dragonlord stands no chance against us! Hurry - we've got to get to the top of the tower NOW. That vile beast and his shadowy master must be destroyed!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Was unlocked when the war meter reached 100%.

quests.name: War Medals
quests.description: Collect War Medals as proof of your thinning of Malgor and Tyndarius's forces.

quests.name: Mega War Medals
quests.description: Collect Mega War Medals as proof of your thinning of Malgor and Tyndarius's forces.

quests.name: Shadowflame Un-slaught
quests.description: If we are going to catch up to Malgor, we are going to have to take on his new allies. Take out the Shadefire Onslaught so we can advance.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' War Medals ' or ' Mega War Medals ' quests.

quests.name: Soldier On
quests.description: It seems that the Shadowflame Soldiers are the ones responsible for the Onslaughts immunity to the Plane's flames. If we take them out, we should see their numbers drop.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fanning the Flames
quests.description: The Fire Elementals struggle against this new enemy that appears to be immune to their Fire. Perhaps we should turn the tides of their battles!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Trailblazer
quests.description: With the Fire Elementals' help, we've already made great progress. For right now, all that is left is to continue to push ahead. Continue to take out the Shadowflame Onslaught's forces and we will make it to Fiamme in time!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: ShadowClaw
quests.description: It appears that a monster from your past has returned. Well, maybe not the exact same, more of a descendant. One that has succumbed to the Shadowflame. Regardless, we must strike it down and press on!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest unlocked when the War Meter reached 50%.

quests.name: In Their Element
quests.description: It looks as though Malgor has converted even Fire Elementals with his Shadowflame. The same Elementals we fought with have now been turned against us. We must remember they are our enemies now and we must treat them as such!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cure the Fire
quests.description: We are losing traction now that the Fire Elementals have been turned. Perhaps we can cure them. You say that people who have been tainted by the Shadowflame have come back to their senses before? Let us try your previous methods and hope it is enough to save them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Human Torch
quests.description: These beings of Living Shadowflame are stronger than the Elementals. They are built for combat. We must clear them out if we are going to be victorious.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: ShadowFlame Phedra
quests.description: This Plane's manifestation of the Fire Titan stands before us! We must slay it at all costs if we are to reach Lady Fiamme in time!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Gather Fuel
quests.description: If we are going to wake Lady Fiamme, we are going to need the innate elemental energy of the Plane. The Living Shadowflame in the area should still have a decent amount for what we need.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' ShadowFlame Phedra ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Attune to Play
quests.description: There are crystals nearby that will help us cleanse the Shadowflame left in the energies you collected. Unfortunately they have been covered with the area's corruption. Uncover the crystals and attune them to the energies.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' ShadowFlame Phedra ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sparks Will Fly
quests.description: In order to ignite the energies and wake Lady Fiamme, we need sparks of her original power. Tyndarius has empowered his soldiers in the area with fragments of the Fire Avatar's power. Collect them from his Onslaught and we can awaken Lady Fiamme!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' ShadowFlame Phedra ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Awaken Lady Fiamme
quests.description: Take all the ingredients we have collected and awaken Lady Fiamme!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' ShadowFlame Phedra ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Elementary Defense
quests.description: Tyndarius's forces have already made their way to Battleon! We are going to have to push forward take out his forces before we can reach their leader. Slay 10 of the Onslaught Knights to clear the area, then we'll move out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Elius ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Tiger Burning Bright
quests.description: In the jungles of Bloodtusk, I heard they will dig pits to trap tigers; it's an effective way to take them by surprise. Place 3 pit traps, and then take out 10 more Shadowfire Tigers to ensure they don't attack anyone else.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Elius ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Crush the Cavalry
quests.description: Ah! And there is Tyndarius' surrogate, the one directing these local forces. Take out the Shadefire Cavalry rider. Once he's down, the elementals in the area can finish cleaning up here while we move forward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Elius ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Fallen Friend
quests.description: This… this is the centaur you've told me about? I can't believe he's become so corrupted. But don't worry! You've freed people from the ShadowFlame corruption before, you said. You can do it again! We just need to… pacify… him first.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' General Dismay ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: The Goddess of War
quests.description: We must face the Goddess of War? Very well. Let us put what we have learned to good use!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Elite It to Beat It ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Colonel Vanguard
quests.description: It looks like Elius has brought in his men to flank us. We have no choice but to deal with them if we are going to continue. Take out the Colonels first. They are the vanguard.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Goddess of War ' quest.

quests.name: In a Major Way
quests.description: They are bringing all their heavy hitters to this fight. They know how climactic this fight is. We mustn't stop fighting. Take out those Majors!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Goddess of War ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Elemental Backup
quests.description: The Avatars are still assisting us in this fight! Call on their Elementals and we can destroy their line and break through their defenses.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Goddess of War ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Cavalry's Here
quests.description: With Elementals on our side, we can push forward. Take out those Cavalry and let's keep moving!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Goddess of War ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Path of Flame
quests.description: Elius is just up ahead! We have to keep going and stop him! Then, on to Tyndarius!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Goddess of War ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Envoy of Fire
quests.description: If we want to get to Tyndarius, we will have to go through Elius. It looks like we have no choice.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Goddess of War ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Living in Shadowflame
quests.description: These Living Shadowflames are the main force of Tyndarius's army. We will have to get through as many of them as possible if we are going to reach him. Don't stop until they are all dead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Goddess of War ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Elemental of Surprise
quests.description: The Shadefire Elementals aren't as strong as their counterparts, but there are much more of them. We can't let them overwhelm us. Take out as many as you can!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Goddess of War ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Well That's New
quests.description: Tyndarius has created stronger Elementals to fight in his army! This Shadow Lavas must be his last line of defense! Push through and take them out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Goddess of War ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Thermal Energy
quests.description: I have used much of my power fighting our way to this point. Before we face Tyndarius, I need to restore my power. Defeat the Elemental enemies in the area and bring me their power to help me recharge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Goddess of War ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Avatar of Fire
quests.description: This is our final battle with Tyndarius! Make it count!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Goddess of War ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Avatar's Rage
quests.description: There will be much for us to do in our future fight against Malgor. For now, let us gather power and the Avatar's favor. Defeat the Onslaught Members and Elementals in the area to gather both of those things.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Avatar of Fire ' quest.

quests.name: Ultra Avatar Tyndarius
quests.description: This is what our fight against Tyndarius was truly like! Can you surpass the challenge?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Avatar of Fire ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per day.

quests.name: Timestream Medals
quests.description: The creatures spawned by the Timestream follow no master and those corrupted by the Shadowflame are rampaging out of Malgor's control. Somewhere in this sea of monsters, Malgor is attempting to escape into the past. We won't be able to find and stop him unless we deal with the obstacles. Defeat as many of them as you can. I'll be right next to you, my friend.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dog Bites Back ' quest.

quests.name: Mega Timestream Medals
quests.description: The lives of the Champions are dwindling with every passing second. In any other war, I would ask that you remember to rest. There's no time for it here. We must push ourselves to our very limits to eliminate the monsters infesting the Timestream. We're worried that if left alone, the mayhem from the clashing creatures will unravel the fabric of time itself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dog Bites Back ' quest.

quests.name: Teary Components
quests.description: You can't tell that the creatures spawned from the Timestream have your voice. Or, they do in a manner of speaking. I've never heard you sound this upset before. No one understands the noises they're making either. It's just a jumble of noise. Still, for anyone that has stood shoulder to shoulder with you…fighting them is demoralizing. It could settle their minds if we grab some Mumblers and found out more about them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either of the previous quests. Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 25%.

quests.name: Proportional Retaliation
quests.description: The monsters corrupted by Shadowflame are being affected by the Mana Affliction, supposedly because Malgor lost control of the Mana Core. They're in the late stages, which means they can explode at any moment. That's not doing our morale any favors. Our allies are worried for their loved ones in the early stages of Mana Affliction. We should learn more about the Shadowflame monsters' conditions.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 25%.

quests.name: Growing Pains
quests.description: We're beginning to see the Mumblers transform. They're growing wings, draconian features, and their speech is becoming intelligible. Our discomfort with their voices aside, these False Wyverns are sturdier and more hostile. They lash out blindly, and pose a serious threat if left alone. It hurts my pride but I will dearly need your help putting these Wyverns down. This isn't anything like hunting dragons.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Middle Child
quests.description: The monsters have been scattered, leaving a lone beast to approach. It's one of the Mumblers that have grown past the False Wyvern stage. They're draconian in appearance, stand on their hind legs, and are calling your name. Whatever they are, it's hostile and blocking our way. We have to defeat them before we can find Malgor. Be careful.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Save the Princess
quests.description: Head up to the Tower and defeat the Dragon! As it falls, we'll catch the Princess and then finish it off

quests.name: BATTLE: Broccoli vs Hero
quests.description: Broccoli has vowed to steal the Enchanted Dragon Orbz. Defeat him or he will make sure your death is slow and painful. Show your fighting spirit. Let the battle… BEGIN!

quests.name: BATTLE: Radish vs Hero
quests.description: Radish blah blah blah Let the battle… BEGIN!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: BATTLE: Karrot vs Hero
quests.description: Power comes in response to a need, and Karrot NEEDS those Enchanted Dragon Orbz. If he wins, he promises he will not destroy the world. Let the battle… BEGIN!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: BATTLE: Vegetable Prince vs Hero
quests.description: Next up… Vegetable Prince BATTLE! Today will be the day he finally settles things. And steals your Enchanted Dragon Orbz. Let the battle… BEGIN!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: BATTLE: SUPER Vegetable Prince vs Hero
quests.description: Do you really think you can beat him in this form? He won't go easy on you just because you're a hero. Let the battle… BEGIN!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Demanding Approval from Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says: Minion! Agree with the contract you must to proceed on your progress of your needs. Go talk to me at Tercessuinotlim and you will be able to carve and forge my Gemstones but don't think it is going to be that easy. You brought me so many resources and I am granting you a chance to forge your own gemstones. Keep in mind that forging isn't that simple when creating underworld gemstones.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Gemstone of Nulgath in your inventory.

quests.name: Forge Gemstones for Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says: So… are you looking for a way to get more of my gemstones? There is a reason why I need you to hunt the resources throughout Lore, and you need to stay strong no matter what takes you to accomplish your goal. Whining is NOT a choice. We can start a chain of deals if you have my contract, otherwise stop wasting my time.

quests.name: Forge Tainted Gems for Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says: Tainted Gems are marginally valuable and I am actually providing you a chance to forge them by yourself, minion. Bring me the reagents I need and I can teach you how to forge them.

quests.name: Forge Dark Crystal Shards for Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says: Now my rare and fragile Dark Crystal Shard is the one that is the most precious to me. My Shards are embedded with Dark Energy and something more, minion. It is not that hard to create them but not everybody has the will and patience to forge them for me. Now show me the reason in why you wasted my time on you for my ARS (Abyssal Revenue Services).

quests.name: Forge Diamonds for Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says: Diamonds are marginally valuable outside the underworld and I am actually providing you a chance to forge them by yourself, minion. Diamonds of Nulgath were brought from the void so in the void shall you hunt for the main resource. Bring me the reagents I need and I can teach you how to forge them.

quests.name: Forge Blood Gems for Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says: Blood Gems of the Archfiends aren't the most valuable gemstone from the underworld but they are REALLY RARE to be seen, minion. Blood Gems are connected with the Void and not every minion of mine comes back alive with the reagents. Now, if you want to keep forging for me this won't be a challenge at all, right minion?

quests.name: Carve the Unidentified Gemstone
quests.description: Nulgath says: Minion, you forged an unknown Gemstone with a void shape? Isn't it beautiful? The Unidentified Gemstone of Nulgath was created by my own life force through the Contract of Nulgath and you were actually lucky to get it when you were forging gemstones. This is one of the RAREST of underworld Gemstones and it chose YOU as worthy to see the reward that lies within it. Are you ready for it?

quests.name: Those Who Remain
quests.description: The two of us are glad to see you here, and I know that many other people will be too. Why not go around and speak to the survivors? This attack has been difficult for all of us, and I am sure many would be delighted to see a friendly face again.

quests.name: Who Helps the Healer?
quests.description: So few people managed to make it to town, and most of them were injured or ill. Twilly is doing his best to heal everyone, but I fear he may be overworking himself. A few potions could help speed recovery! The chitin of the Corrosive Crawlers can be used to brew particularly effective tonics, and forest bandits always have a few extra power potions.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Supply in Demand
quests.description: Battleon has always been a town that seems to have everything a Hero needs- but with how many new residents we have and outside trade being impossible, our supplies have been dwindling quickly. If we are to have any chance at being prepared for anything, we will need more. Drakath's Supply Caravans are nearby. Raiding them may provide us with what we require!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Creature Comforts
quests.description: I intend to use the supplies from Drakath's troops to bolster the AntiTitan Corps. The weapons and armor will greatly assist our defense, but we must make sure the townsfolk are able to keep their strength up as well. Meat rations from the wild game and insects, once purified, will be excellent meals for our starving survivors.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Infernal Investigation
quests.description: I'm starting to hear troubling reports that some of the AntiTitan Corps may not be… entirely trustworthy. Add in all of the Chaorrupted Bandits outside the wall, and there are far too many ways for Drakath to gain access to our plans. Check in with the members of the Corps, and take out as many bandits as you can to prevent Drakath from gaining intel.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Another Brick in the Wall
quests.description: The walls surrounding Battleon have done well to stave off past Titan attacks, but have weathered over time. They won't hold up to another attack in their current state. If you gather bricks from the Supply Caravans, chitin from the Corrosive Crawlers, and the saliva of the Chaos Critters, we can begin to rebuild. With your assistance, there's a chance we can have them complete by the next attack.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Gauntlet of Monsters
quests.description: Hello, tufted mammal! Are you looking to increase your standing with Warlord Twilly? Go into the Death Pit Arena, do battle with all the monsters there - the sneevils, the slimes, and the salamanders. Collect their battle tokens to show you have won, and bring them to me. I'll update the ledger with your victories!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Flex for Hun'Gar ' quest.

quests.name: Gauntlet of Drakels
quests.description: Furless ape! How do you feel about taking on a bigger challenge? Go into the Death Pit Arena, and challenge the Drakel Brawlers, Gladiators, and Battlemasters. Bring me their battle tokens to prove that you prevailed, and I'll update the ledger with your victories!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pummel for Hun'Gar ' quest.

quests.name: Gauntlet of Generals
quests.description: Tiny creature! Your combat skills are beyond compare. All of the Warlord's Generals want to spar with you - would you do us the honor? Meet us in the Death Pit Arena. If you win, we'll each give you one of our battle tokens, and I'll gladly update the ledger with your new victories!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy for Hun'Gar ' quest.

quests.name: Rotten to the Corps
quests.description: The more we track the movement of the chaorrupted members of the AntiTitan Corps, the more suspicious I become. I don't believe we've eradicated ALL of the spies in our midst. Interrogate the remaining members of the Corps you find in town. I have no mercy for traitors, especially at a time like this.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Another Brick in the Wall ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Fighting Chance
quests.description: Now that we've weeded out the bad eggs, let's get planning. If we want to fight back against the Titans, we have to be creative. Our smiths have developed a revolutionary system that could help- but we'll need some weapons to help us use it. The sharp stingers of Corrosive Crawlers and sturdy wires from their supply wagons should fit the designs in their blueprints perfectly.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Another Brick in the Wall ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Flash of the Titans
quests.description: The new systems give our fighters a huge increase in mobility, but with how many Titans there are, we'll need some way of startling them before swinging into action. The Supply Caravans carry Shine Powder and casings that can be used to create bombs, and the Chaotic Beholders have evolved built-in smoke glands to hide when a Titan gets too close. Those will serve our needs nicely.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Another Brick in the Wall ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Vein Ambition
quests.description: The first tests of the wire-gliders are working perfectly, but it's going to take more than some fancy movement to actually take these Titans down. Thankfully, I've got a plan for that, too. The power of their blows has increased, but not the power of their immune systems. If you can extract the venom of the nearby Corrosive Crawlers and bring it to the forge, we can use that to our advantage…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Another Brick in the Wall ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Asset Acquisition
quests.description: With so many survivors, we're rapidly running out of… well… everything. Food, medicine, fabric, weapons… We've got the knowledge we need to put up a fight, but not the raw materials. I need you to go on a resource raid – hit up the Chaorrupted Bandits and their Supply Caravans for the materials we need.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Another Brick in the Wall ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Enemy at the Gate
quests.description: We'll need to put the preparations aside for a moment…. I just received an urgent message from one of our scouting parties. Something is rapidly making its way towards Battleon's walls, and has already reached Greenguard Forest. If it's what we think it is, we'll need your help. Meet us outside the gate, and we'll try to take it out without alerting too many of the survivors.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Another Brick in the Wall ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Titanic Terror
quests.description: That armor looks familiar… It seems like even the secret orders of Lore who didn't make it into Battleon also became test subjects for the Titan's Tincture. Even if we stop it in town, seeing a twisted version of something so mythical would send the camp into an even greater state of panic. We've got to stop the Titan before it breaches the gate!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Another Brick in the Wall ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Titanic Terror Times Two
quests.description: Another group of Titans, so soon? We aren't prepared to hold off one of those monsters yet, much less two. If we are to have any hope for the future, we must show our people that with you by our side, Battleon has a chance of fighting back – and as you said, there is no better way to do so than bringing those behemoths down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Another Brick in the Wall ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Do You Even Brawl
quests.description: Small, fleshy mammal! Do you have what it takes to fight in Hun'Gar's Arena? Enter the fray and defeat one of the other combatants. Show me a Death Pit Token as proof of your triumph, and I will reward you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pax Defeated ' quest.

quests.name: Flex For Hun'Gar
quests.description: Small, fleshy mammal! Do you have what it takes to fight in Hun'Gar's Arena? Enter the fray and defeat one of the other combatants. Show me a Death Pit Token as proof of your triumph, and I will reward you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pax Defeated ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pummel For Hun'Gar
quests.description: Don't forget, puny human! When you are in the arena, you're not just fighting the other humans. You're fighting Drakel, too! Defeat the opposing Drakel leader's Brawlers and Restorers. Show me proof of your victory, and you will be rewarded.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pax Defeated ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Destroy For Hun'Gar
quests.description: You can fight, tiny warrior - but can you win? Defeat the opposing team's Captain to win the brawl!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Pax Defeated ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Round 1: Firestorm Scouts
quests.description: Defeat 10 Firestorm Scouts to prove your worth as a warrior and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Cinderclaw ' quest.

quests.name: Round 2: Firestorm Soldiers
quests.description: Defeat 9 Firestorm Soldiers to prove your worth as a warrior and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Cinderclaw ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Round 3: Firestorm Pikemen
