quests.description: Defeat 8 Firestorm Soldiers to prove your ability to dodge steel and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Cinderclaw ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Round 4: Firestorm Knights
quests.description: Defeat 7 Firestorm Knights to prove your ability to overcome danger and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Cinderclaw ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Round 5: Firestorm Corporals
quests.description: Defeat 6 Firestorm Corporal to prove you have the power of command and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Cinderclaw ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Round 6: Firestorm Tigers
quests.description: Defeat 5 Firestorm Tigers to prove your lack of fear and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Cinderclaw ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Round 7: Firestorm Cavalry
quests.description: Defeat 4 Firestorm Tiger Riders to prove your dexterity and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Cinderclaw ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Round 8: Firestorm Majors
quests.description: Defeat 3 Firestorm Majors to prove you can take damage as well as deal it and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Cinderclaw ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Round 9: Firestorm Blazebinders
quests.description: Defeat 2 Firestorm Blazeinders to prove youcan withstand the heat and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Cinderclaw ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Round 10: Firestorm General
quests.description: Defeat 1 Firestorm General. IF you can, you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught. But it won't be easy. They are best of the best.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Cinderclaw ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bonus Round: Flamewing the Bright
quests.description: Defeat Flamewing the Bright, one of the Risen One's attendants, to prove your worth. That is all
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Cinderclaw ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Final Round: Tyndarius Tigermaster
quests.description: Defeat Tyndarius in single combat to prove your value to the Onslaught. This is the final test. There is no way you'll be able to defeat him, but… you can always try.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Cinderclaw ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wolf Cub's Footprints
quests.description: I wasn't there the last time the Fortress was invaded, and I realized the blindspots in our security were never fixed. While I search for Lord Dage, I need you to trawl the halls for clues about the intruder. Interrogate Arondight, the Paladins, and the Legion turncoats to see if they're hiding any more information.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Unblemished Snow ' quest.

quests.name: Cocytus Wails
quests.description: Lord Dage wandered off to do who knows what. Command would naturally fall to one of his Generals, but you understand the situation better. First, like you said, we'll round up the Evocators and Knights that were colluding with Maleagant to stifle the spread of this parasitic Light.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Unblemished Snow ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Light Up Ice Cube
quests.description: While we were rounding up Maleagant's accomplices, I noticed a strange group of ice floes in the river. Help me fish them out but take care not to fall in yourself. The Cocytus isn't just cold… its miserable waters are haunted. The screams and wails of traitors will echo in your ears for decades.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Unblemished Snow ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blessed Blind
quests.description: If the Cocytus River itself is saturated with Light, the Legionnaires that tampered with it wouldn't have gotten away unscathed. Search the rooms for the Overdriven Evocators. If this magic ravaged the dead Paladins so badly, I'm sure it would do far worse to them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Unblemished Snow ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Falsified Hope
quests.description: Search the rest of the rooms. If the Evocators were affected, then there must be Overdriven Knights hidden away too. With how Lord Dage raised most of the Undead Legion, they'd melt our ranks if left unchecked. We can't let a single one slip through our fingers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Unblemished Snow ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Saint of the Battlefield
quests.description: That took care of the Legionnaires working with Maleagant, and uncovered a bevy of other problems I'll have to deal with later. For now, find Arondight. He's still trying to heal the souls of those dead Paladins. If his efforts accidentally raised Overdriven Paladins, put them back down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Unblemished Snow ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: River Bends
quests.description: We need to get to the nexus of portals leading to the other rivers. It should be the final room at the end of the corridor. Cut down the Evocators and Knights trying to get in our way, and talk to the Legionnaire that can open the portals. According to my records… Vaughn has authorization.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Unblemished Snow ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Styx and Stones
quests.description: The portal on the far left leads to the Styx. It seems Maleagant already flooded it with Light. Take down the Overdriven Knights and Evocators occupying the riverside. I'll search for any sign of Maleagant.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Unblemished Snow ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cry Me a River
quests.description: The portal beside the Styx's leads to the Lethe. I allow Moumers access to the river to rid themselves of memories keeping them from serving the Legion to the best of their capabilities. Light has already contaminated the water. Restrain the Mourners before they get too close!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Unblemished Snow ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Boiling Blood
quests.description: The portal to the right of the Lethe's is the Phlegethon's. It's hard to tell because it's a river of boiling blood on fire, but Maleagant has already tainted it with Light. Keep the Cerberus Pups from drinking from it, or else they'll be transformed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Unblemished Snow ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Knight of Summer Set
quests.description: Through the final portal on the far right of the nexus is the source of the River Acheron. Maleagant is there, finalizing the last stage of his plans to flood the Underworld with Light. His despair has driven him to madness. Defeat him…and if possible, bring him back to his senses.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Unblemished Snow ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: River Run
quests.description: The most pressing matter has been settled, but Light still lingers in the Underworld. Lord Dage's Generals are already working to cleanse their rivers, but things would go a lot faster if you helped out. Take out any tainted Mourners or Cerberus Pups you see, and check on Maleagant to see how he's adapting to his new role. We'll reward you for your time.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Knight of Summer Set ' quest.

quests.name: Legion Traditions
quests.description: Before battle, it is customary for Legionnaires to spar with each other. It tempers our blades and our minds. If 'you' would partake of this ritual with our Warriors in this…form 'you' chose to take, it would give the Legion a stronger sense of purpose.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Two-Faced Reflection
quests.description: I noticed that the two of 'you' called on Virgil, and tasked him with procuring an odd mirror. He arrived from the Seven Circles, and is waiting around the corner. There are…others who want an audience with 'you', but it's 'your' time and 'your' choice.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Past Disturbed
quests.description: The Wraiths of the Lethe are some of the oldest warriors of the Legion. They threw themselves into the River of Forgetfulness to finally find sleep, but seem to have awoken sensing what 'you've' done. Lay them back to rest with 'your' resolve.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Atlas Lies in Wait
quests.description: Maleagant is arranging for multiple portals to open near Atlas. He's waiting nearby with matters to report, and will guide 'you' through to the other side after discussing Lord Dage's armor.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Preparedness Next to Godliness
quests.description: There were Atlas Knights patrolling the area right outside the portal. We can't allow them to warn their King. I noticed a woman nearby, but she doesn't seem to be one of them. Slay the witnesses, and talk to that foreign diplomat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Golden Youth
quests.description: Now that Atlas has been safely infiltrated, the souls of their denizens are of interest. Please humor me, and retrieve the souls of the Light Mages. Talk to one of the scholars, too. Something about them is…wrong.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Old Souls
quests.description: I'm sure 'you' are more than aware of what the people of Atlas are up to, but I need to see it for myself. Bring me their bodies, and show me what they've done to stay so young when some of their souls are as old as me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Digging Too Deep
quests.description: There's that straggler the diplomat from Swordhaven was talking about. She's deeper into the city, wearing a wedding dress. Best warn her to throw her ring away and leave. Oh? Do 'you' know her?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dis-graces
quests.description: What…What are Wrath Guards doing in the city? No one gave the signal to attack yet! Argh! Slice their heads off before they blow your cover! It'll get a lot worse when I bring them back to the Underworld for discipline.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lord of Scars
quests.description: Argh! Slaine slipped his chain! News of 'your' request must have spread, and he doesn't believe 'you'd' actually go through with slaughtering the people of Atlas. Slaine is hunting 'you,' and won't stop until 'you' snap his neck.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Beast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: You and Your Chain
quests.description: I apologize for allowing Slaine to escape like that. I doubt King Zedek will overlook this, and is already suspicious. The best we can do is eliminate the Atlas Knights and Mages who witnessed Slaine's flight, and continue disciplining him and the Wrath Guards.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lord of Scars ' quest.

quests.name: Knight's Honor
quests.description: If 'you' plan to introduce me and that Paladin woman to someone, we should get rid of the Atlas Knights surrounding the arena. Allow me the honor of helping 'you' collect their heads. That'll make searching the streets far less tedious.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lord of Scars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Drawn Light
quests.description: That Paladin woman is trying to convince her fiance's son and his friend to leave. The King already knows the Legion is preparing to advance. That'll make the war more interesting, but if 'you' want Yara to survive, best tell her and those brats to get moving.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lord of Scars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sterile Life
quests.description: Why would I bother with a disguise when the King already knows we're here? My chains rattled the Mages, and now they're scurrying over. I prefer this. It's not every day I get to battle alongside a real Beast.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lord of Scars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lost Generations
quests.description: The streets lack the stench of death, and I sense that it's been this way for many years. Ah. There's a hint of it wafting from beneath the ground. The person 'you' are looking for must be there. We'll find a way down, and any other hint of their presence.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lord of Scars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Snitch
quests.description: That Paladin woman's fiance came looking for his runaway bride and his mousey son. I've never seen a desk rat frothing at the mouth to kill. Coelho won't let Yara go unless he's dead. Shall I crush him, or would it please 'you' to?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lord of Scars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Atlantides' Eve
quests.description: My blade yearns to carve death into the cowards of Atlas. Talk to Misaru so she can guide us to the throne. She said the castle's gates will open for us, or rather, 'you.' The Kingdom's best will be waiting. I wonder what nonsense they'll have to say.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lord of Scars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lowly Form
quests.description: I see that the King allows his favorite pets to freely roam the castle grounds. They also lack the scent of death. In fact…none of them have a beast's soul. Why don't we take our blades, and see for ourselves?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lord of Scars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Enduring Sacrilege
quests.description: Atlas Elites guard the throne. They're souls from ages past, inhabiting the bodies of their descendants. A fight that lacks the exhilaration of true death is infuriatingly dull. We'll make them suffer before we have an audience with their King.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lord of Scars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blood of the Hesperides
quests.description: The Elites and their pet beasts are being commanded to take formation outside the throne room. It seems that their King isn't ready for 'you,' so his kindred are taking charge. We'll show them that we're less than impressed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lord of Scars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Prota Sparasso
quests.description: Rather than the King, we've arrived to find Atlas' Head Executioner watching the throne. How dull. Zedek's late. At least this creature calling itself Ladon will entertain us while we wait. It's hardly a worthy offering, but it'll keep our blood pumping.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lord of Scars ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Inhuman Children of Man
quests.description: The citizens of Atlas believe that they beheaded the Legion. Ha! Let them cheer and sing. It'll make their fall that much sweeter, but my patience can't be stretched that far. My teeth ache. Hunt the Atlas Leos, Elites, and their Executioner with me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Prota Sparasso ' quest.

quests.name: Dog Nights of Summer
quests.description: If you'd please step through the entrance shaped like our mighty Lord's face, we can begin the tour. The Blood Moon's driving the wolves guarding the arena a little crazy, so get your weapons out. They're looking to treat themselves to your bones.

quests.name: Achilles Tendon
quests.description: The Legion Gladiators are training for the tournament, and look, they've noticed us. To be more precise, they've noticed me, and are so enraged that they don't even register you're here. Remember our deal. Get rid of the fodder so we can be on our way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Disciplinary Action
quests.description: I didn't expect this many wolves and Gladiators gunning for me. Oh, enough already. We have places to be. I'll help you cut off their heads. Getting squeamish? They're all Undead, so it's just an inconvenience.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Fun Police
quests.description: Check it out. Legion's biggest party pooper. Mind telling Rand we're just here for a tour? Looks like some of my Willbreakers are sniffing around for bribes, too. Help me get them to back off. We get first dibs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Despair-ity
quests.description: Famine got caught cheating, and it's going to cost him. Why don't we talk to him? Yknow, to rub it in, or take advantage of the situation. I'm sure Rand would appreciate it if you kicked those scheming Ritualists down, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bad Charms
quests.description: Famine and I have come to an understanding. Read between the lines later. We should get rid of all the ritual sigils his Mages drew all over the place. They'll hurt your Horseman's chances of winning if you leave them alone.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Self-Appointed Heel
quests.description: Do you hear that screeching? Those are Deathwings, and I think they're harassing the Horseman of War. They don't swoop in for no reason. Why don't we chase them out, and have a chat with the Crimson Rider?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Simple Delights
quests.description: Slaine grabbed Conquest's stolen bow. That lughead's either going around yelling for you to come pick it up, or already gotten distracted biting the other Legionnaires to undeath. We'd better go find him before Lord Dage notices us running around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Vultures of a Feather
quests.description: Conquest's getting cornered, but the Deathwings and Ritualists are crowding the arena. They know he's about to bite it, so why don't we take a page out of Slaine's book and bite them?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: All's Fair
quests.description: Your chosen Horseman's trapped on the east side of the colosseum. War sent one of his Forges to attack Conquest while he's disarmed. You rescue him, and I'll see to some other business.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Third Sign
quests.description: There's another WarForge hanging around. It looks like the Ritualists and Deathwings are doing something suspicious around it, too. Why don't you check them out? They're probably trying to mess with your Horseman again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' All's Fair ' quest.

quests.name: The Third Sign (Legend)
quests.description: There's another WarForge hanging around. It looks like the Ritualists and Deathwings are doing something suspicious around it, too. Why don't you check them out? They're probably trying to mess with your Horseman again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' All's Fair ' quest.

quests.name: Mingle
quests.description: What? Oh, uh no, we're not ready for you yet. Just… go talk to the other combatants for a little bit. I'll let you know when we're sending you in.

quests.name: Those Dummies
quests.description: Don't worry, we understand that you lesser creatures are small and weak, and we don't really expect that much out of you. But still, it IS more entertaining when you put up a fight! Come on, let's get you trained on some stationary dummies. Wouldn't it be cool if you could hold your own against one of those monsters for a few minutes before it destroys you?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Round 1: You vs Omar the Meek!
quests.description: Ok, small mamma!! It's time for your first real fight! We're going to put you up against Omar the Meek. He didn't do very well against the training dummies, so I feel like you have a pretty good chance here. Head into the Arena when you're ready.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Round 2: You vs a Bunch of Sneevils!
quests.description: Let's give you something a little more fun, what do you say? How about: you against a bunch of Sneevils? My money's on you this time, too. Even in a group, they are punier than you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle: You vs Hattori!
quests.description: Ready for your next battle, squishy creature? You're going up against another human this time - one that's been holding up as well as you have. Let's see which once of you makes it out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: Battle: You vs the Slime Horde!
quests.description: You're not tired yet, are you? We're sending you back in, fleshbag! I don't know if this will be fun for you, but trust me, you're creating some great entertainment here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle: You vs the Sludge Lord!
quests.description: Actually, don't hose yourself down just yet. We have another - heh - messy combatant for you to fight. You've come a long way, little thing! A defeat in this fight would be very respectable.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Battle: You vs Some Salamanders!
quests.description: You look like you still have some fight in you. Come on, let's see how you do against something large and scaly! Watch out for that flame breath!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle: You vs a Trobble!
quests.description: We're almost out of combatants for you to fight, little one - I apologize that I don't have a more worthy opponent for you, but we weren't sure what to do with this one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: Battle: You vs the Brawlers!
quests.description: Ok, we're sending you in for a fight in the real tournament now. No mroe squishy mammals - you're fighting Drakel now! Don't feel bad if you die in this round, little thing. There's no shame in it. Maybe you'll even take someone with you before you go!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle: You vs the Gladiators!
quests.description: Alright, well. As an undefeated arena champion, you do have the right to continue fighting. But frankly, that last round didn't go over as well as we'd hoped. Turns out the audience doesn't really like watching a lesser species slaughter our fighters… so, we don't be sending you in again. You are free to leave the tournament, and I encourage you to do so.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle: You vs the Battlemasters!
quests.description: Look, Pax is never going to ban you from continuing with the tournament, because it would make us look weak. But I strongly suggest bowing out here. The Warlord is getting angry, and that never ends well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle: You vs General Gall!
quests.description: Gall! This charade has gone on long enough! Come out here and show this insolent pest what a real Drakel can do!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Velm's Minions
quests.description: Velm! Send out your best Drakels and get rid of this hairless rat!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: General Velm
quests.description: This is unacceptable! Velm, get out there and slay this creature yourself!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chud's Minions
quests.description: Chud! You will succeed where Velm has failed me! Your Drakels are more unpredictable than his; they will grind this human into the dirt!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: General Chud
quests.description: Chud! Show me that you are better than your minions were! This insect can't stand against a general of your caliber!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hun'Gar's Minions
quests.description: Hun'Gar, your minions are large, and strong, like our ancestral Dragons themselves. Send them into the arena, so that this pathetic creature will bother us no more!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: Hun'Gar Defeated
quests.description: Hun'Gar! You are the biggest, the strongest of all of us! You will prevail over this insignificant bug!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pax Defeated
quests.description: Fine. I'll just have to take care of you myself!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Comm Module 4dX
quests.description: You there! Yes, you, the civilian. Some THIEF has infiltrated on our Control Room and stolen the Comm Module. We can't call in ANY way reinforcements to deal with this skyscum. Kill ALL the pirates untill you find that module! And… if you should find any *ahem* mildly useful electrical components, bring them there RIGHT AWAY! Now go! GO GO GO!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Tropos' Quests .

quests.name: Can You Hear Me Now?
quests.description: Since you're proven you can follow orders, I have new tasks for you. Return the Comm Module to its proper location. We'll re-write it. Then you can set up the satellites along the path so we can regain base-to-ship communication. And while you're out there, check the locked storage room. Take this key code. DON'T tough the thing you see in there. Just look for a small, rounded electrical component.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Back to Base-ics
quests.description: Alright, you. We NEED that powerpack for… Gearjerkers, I wasn't going to TELL you this, but you need to know. The powerpack is for our new battle tech. We've built ourselves a mechsuit, but SOMEONE has stolen the powercell it uses. Go to the /piratebase; Bring me 10 pirate trophies and the powerpack!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Secret Weapon Mecha-Death!
quests.description: Battle the betrayer who stole the SkyGuard's secret war weapon and is turning it against you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Rock Star
quests.description: Everything that I need to make a key can be found in the mines. The base material I require comes from rare, enchanted Limestone boulders. You can easily spot these rocks by their lime green color and half-moon shape. Return to me only when you have 7 Limestones in your possession.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Secret Weapons ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: All That Glitters...
quests.description: Raw gold is a soft, pliable metal that is the correct density for molding the key. It used to be everywhere in these mines, but that was before the Dwarves began prospecting, leaving every rock and vein dry. However, the Drow invaders in the mines sometimes carry Gold Deposits on their boots… if you could bring me 5 Gold Deposits, I would have enough to continue work on this key!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gemeralds
quests.description: Before Vath came to power, the mines were filled with precious Chaos stones known as Gemeralds. These gems, although small, contained massive amounts of Chaotic energy. This key is going to require 6 Gemeralds in order to open the door. I think the Chaos Draconians are using them to enhance their own magical potential. Find the Chaos Draconians, and you will find the Gemeralds.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Talc to Me
quests.description: The key is almost complete! But I need to cut the key blade to precisely match the tumblers in the keyhole. Only problem is, I don't have material soft enough to fit into the keyhole and cast an imprint! Talc is the softest mineral in all of Lore, and should do the trick nicely. Track down the Albino Bats in the mines. They bathe in Talc powder daily (which makes them even more white), so one of the bats should have a Block of Talc at their disposal!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rock Me Amadeus
quests.description: In the deepest, darkest depths of the mines, a Beast known as Amadeus slumbers. Aggressive by nature and chaorrupted by Vath, Amadeus is best left alone. However, he is our only shot at creating a spare key. Find Amadeus, and I will be able to create a new key for you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have taken the 'Upper City Key' to the Upper City Gates . Note: Quest name is a direct reference to the song Rock Me Amadeus by Falco.

quests.name: Thelima Training
quests.description: It's just about time for the Noelle Knights, Dwarven Aegis, and Drow Soldiers' training drills. They'd be thrilled if you joined them for a spar - or a hundred. Nope, that isn't a joke! I know you can handle it.

quests.name: Knights of Noelle
quests.description: House Noelle represents the human side of the three-way coalition in the Yew Mountains. Most of their knights are a little green, in the newbie sense. Could I ask an experienced warrior like yourself to help train them?

quests.name: Aureate Aegis
quests.description: The Dwarven Aegis are gold warriors who trained in the unforgiving darkness of the mountains' veins. Lord Vath's conquest spurred their formation, but are they prepared? You defeated Vath, so we can only get the answer if you test them.

quests.name: Quest to Unlock Jouster Class
quests.description: Journey to the Airstorm realm in Etherstorm Wastes. Destroy a Lightning Ball to gather the Energy Orb needed to create your MechaJouster Class!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Jouster in your inventory.

quests.name: Get Supplies
quests.description: One of the ways I've been enhancing my weaponry is by embedding small shards of chaos crystals into the metal. Help me replenish my supply, and I'll reward you.

quests.name: Oils and Essences
quests.description: I spoke earlier of infusing my weapons and armor with pure chaos. One of the best ways to do this is by collecting Essence of Chaos from the Chaos Sprites, and Oil of Chaos from the Crawling Ooze. These can be mixed into the metal while molten. Bring me some of each, and I'll show you how it's done.

quests.name: Test the Metal
quests.description: Once forged, a weapon must be tested! Go to the /Alliance, and test the weapon's effect on both good and evil soldiers. Then, report back to me with your findings.

quests.name: Eaters of Dreams
quests.description: Dreams, nightmares, it doesn't matter to the devourers. They roam the outskirts of the city looking for passage, but us MindBreakers keep them at bay for if they do get in, it can spell disaster. Interested in helping? You lack our abilities so you won't be able to destroy them outright, but you can still fend them off.

quests.name: Mind-Breaking It In
quests.description: Welcome fellow Mindbreaker, come to this city to hone your skills? Well I have just the task for you. The city outskirts are filled with Deorysa, Subrysa, and Devourax, use your psionic powers to tear them apart. Afterwards, hunt down a Nightwyrm, the last thing we need is one of those burrowing into the city.
quests.requirements_note: Must have MindBreaker in your inventory with at least 1 Class Point.

quests.name: Biting weapons
quests.description: Me glad you here! Ghaz can't leave forge right now but need some things from around here for this weapon.Pick 5 Blue Trollola Blossoms, whip the beaks 7 Vultures, and beat 7 Rhison until they teeth fall out. No worry, Rhison teeth grow back in a day. Bring me all things!

quests.name: You scratch me back...
quests.description: Yes, me have Invisible wheel. Paid for it fair and square. Me trade you, if you help me. First, me need you to collect 10 8 Boar Armor Sets from the Horc Boars. They put up fight but you look strong. Come back here when you done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' BLOODTUSK CATWALK ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: ...And me scratch yours
quests.description: Now me need large handful of Rhison fur to polish boar armor. You get me that and me give you cat people invisible wheel. Hate to see it go but a deal is a deal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' BLOODTUSK CATWALK ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sign here
quests.description: Ghaz has given you the Invisible Bike's Front Wheel. Please deliver it to Lowell Cat in Noobshire.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' BLOODTUSK CATWALK ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What's That I Hear?
quests.description: You hear someone crying in the bushes. You'd better see who it is and make sure they're ok!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Grandmother Hasu ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Trouble Clef
quests.description: I've always feared this day would come - the day I'd lose my ability to play music! I don't even know what to do! I have to find a way to destroy these awful notes. Maybe then they'll stop ruining my beautiful song!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Snacktime ' quest.

quests.name: Dravir Defense
quests.description: Dravir keep staging raids to test our defenses. Like they could take us out, right? Maybe the Avatars will help the brainless beast, because I sure won't. Take out 10 to show them we mean business.

quests.name: Gut the Guards
quests.description: Our camp threatens the dragon nests nearby. GOOD! That's the way I like it. But Draconian Guardians have been set to get the eggs and recently-hatched dragonlings to safety. Take out the guards and smash the eggs that they are trying to relocate

quests.name: Permafrost Collection Badge
quests.description: BRRRR! You MUST be cool, if you've unlocked this quest. Hah, get it? A winter pun… or is it more like a winter PUN-derland? *ba dum tish* … Nevermind. You're here for a badge, and a badge you'll unlock. Head to the /northlandlight map and take down Santy Claws to get your gift.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Giftbearers of Darkness (0 AC) in your inventory.

quests.name: Oh Sure, Why Not
quests.description: Before we leave, do you think you could find my… good friend… Emilia? She's the one thing I've truly missed since I've been in here, and I just can't go back home without her. I briefly got away from the Mirror Knights when they were taking me here, and I saw her reflected in a mirror - I remember it being off in its own little alcove. Will you find her? Please?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Drink Your Go-Go Juice ' quest.

quests.name: Scout It Out
quests.description: My intelligence leads me to believe my target is within this abandoned structure. We will need to know our surroundings before we continue to chase this bounty. Place these devices in and around the building so I can scan the area.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Liberty's Ghost ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: No Bot Unbeaten
quests.description: Scans have revealed this factory is fully operational. Someone must have reactivated these derelict droids to slow our progress. We must decommission some of them before we can dial in on our target.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Liberty's Ghost ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: If Memory Serves...
quests.description: Now that we have thinned the opposing forces, we need to focus our efforts on finding which room our target is holed up in. These Scout Droids look like they would not miss anything that happens here. Bring me back some of their memory drives - INTACT - so I may scan them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Liberty's Ghost ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Target Located
quests.description: Target Located. Obstacle Identified. Our target has locked themself in the control room and I do not have the necessary equipment to breach the blast doors so we will have to do this the old fashioned way. The good news is one of those Bodyguard Droids has the passkey. Dismantle them until you locate it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Liberty's Ghost ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bring Them In
quests.description: We have the passkey. It is time we end this and bring this fugitive to justice.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Liberty's Ghost ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shut It Down
quests.description: In your fight with the target you managed to disable the production line so it cannot restart, but that still leaves the already completed droids. You should terminate the rest of these droids. They will become very dangerous if left to their own devices.

quests.name: Find the Core
quests.description: Your first task is simple - just defeat the Spirits of Ice that are standing in your way. Collect their cores - the center of their power - and they will lend you their strength on your journey.

quests.name: Make a Bridge
quests.description: You're wondering where to go from here, aren't you? The path to the west is blocked, and the east leads to a deep, wide chasm. Collect Eternal Crystals from the Frozen Jellyfish nearby. Then, go to the edge of the frozen waterfall and set one down. See what happens! (Quest works once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Don't Fall
quests.description: Now, you can cross over the chasm by taking the icy path. Be careful not to fall! There's someone on the other side who'd like to speak to you. But be sure to bring an offering with you to demonstrate your good intentions. I'm sure you can find something suitable, if you just look around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Ice is Sharp
quests.description: These caves are guarded by Icy Blades, sharp enough to shatter the strongest metal. Fight them, and make them submit to you. Be aware, not all of them will. When 10 of them have done so, come back and talk with me again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Shade ' quest.

quests.name: Release the Energy
quests.description: Now that you have the Frostblades, use them to cut through the Animus of Ice and release the energy inside them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Enfield
quests.description: Abel must defeat the Enfield before he is allowed to pass. But you're here with him for a reason. Defeat it together, and see what is waiting on the other side.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Clean Up Clean Up Everybody Do Your Scare
quests.description: Seems you've made quite the mess. Well you'd better go clean it up. I'd help but I'm just a party decoration.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Why Can't I Sleep? ' quest.

quests.name: Quiet Down, Will Ya?
quests.description: I can't sleep with all this racket! The cyclones are too loud, the embers keep crackling, and the mermaid's banquet should've ended hours ago! Put a stop to this noise, please!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lighten the Despair ' quest.

quests.name: Goblin Forest Warrior Quest
quests.description: Darkovia Firest is a dangerous place to live. Dire Wolves carry the pelts we need to trade to buy food for our children. From Blood Maggots we take the Blood, Sweat, and Tears required to process the pelts. And the Legacy Vitae we need… best not ask.

quests.name: Goblin Wolf-rider Quest
quests.description: I stalk the forests of Greenguard East and the Forest of Chaos, too. Marsh Grass, Chaotic Fangs, Chaos Gems, and Wolf Pelts… townspeople pay well for them. The Wolves in Greenguard East and Chaorrupted Wolves in ForestChaos have what we need.

quests.name: Gather the Golden Hours
quests.description: The Timestream Riders in the Arena have stolen the pages of your 2016 calendar! Battle to get all 12 pages back, and you'll be able to choose one of the pieces of gear from the Golden or Chrono Infinity Knight sets!

quests.name: 20th Anniversary Collection Badge
quests.description: What better way to celebrate our in-game birthdayversary than by slaying one of the most iconic monsters in-game?! Slay the Zard in /battleontown to celebrate and unlock an all-new character page badge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Gold Twilly Pet Quester in your inventory.

quests.name: Golden DrAEgon Hunt
quests.description: You've discovered the hidden quest for the Golden Dragon Spear! Gather the following for a chance to obtain this rare reward: 3 fire-spore mushrooms from the Dracowerepyre, 5 golden draconian scales from /lair, 3 gold deposits from the Drow in Dwarfhold, 5 golden Koalion down-furs from the /crossroads, and 2 gold ore from the Balboas on the Dwarfhold mountainpath.

quests.name: Pocketed Moonlight
quests.description: Bro Nez and Ty Tanium have begun prospecting again. They'll have the mountain covered for mining materials, but there are many metals and gems out of our reach. I hear you can find Shards of Moonlight in a place called /mooncursedlair. The prospectors shouldn't be going on long trips yet, but getting rarer materials would help us get back on our feet faster. If you catch some moonlight, I'd be happy to trade for it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Dwarfhold Chaos Saga .

quests.name: Tunnel Vision
quests.description: The remnants of Vath's forces are giving Snowbeard and the others in /wardwarf a chance to get their pound of flesh. Pride can give us Dwarves a nasty case of tunnel vision. The remnants' leader, D'wain Jonsen, could catch them off guard if he gets a second wind. If he goes into some sort of Ultra mode, bring Jonsen down, and snap off that scorpion's tail to bring back with you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Dwarfhold Chaos Saga .

quests.name: The Empty Mountains Cold
quests.description: Recovering from dealing with Vath and his leftovers put the lot of us in a tight spot. All sorts of monsters and gremlins took this opportunity to steal our gold. The elders and I couldn't risk losing more dwarven lives over shiny stones. The prospectors took note of who stole from us. Toxic Grove Spiders, Tainted Earths, and Doomed Trolls swiped our Gold to fill their empty caverns with. Worse, Sneevil Looters and the Greedy Goregold from /Greed are hoarding the rest. If you bring our home's lifeblood back to us, we'll reward you in kind.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Dwarfhold Chaos Saga .

quests.name: The King's Armor
quests.description: My uncle lost the blueprint, and we don't have enough gold, but don't fret. If you could find me something resembling his armor, we'll build on top of it. Just using Dwarven gold won't cut it. Head to the neighboring Kingdoms to scrounge up some extra materials.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Familial Blessing ' quest.

quests.name: Twig's Frostval Collection
quests.description: Fwostval is Twig's FAVWITE HOWIDAY. Fwish and ice cweam and - and - PWESENTS! Bwing me a Fwosted Fwish Ice Cweam Sandwich fwom Frosty in the Ice Cave or Battleground C and Twig will give you a Fwostval Badge!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Good King QuibbleClaus Pet (0 AC) in your inventory.

quests.name: Slayer Medal Turn-in
quests.description: Slay the zombies/minions in Battleontown to save the harvest and drive back the legion.

quests.name: Mega Slayer Medal Turn-in
quests.description: Slay the zombies/minions in Battleontown to save the harvest and drive back the legion.

quests.name: Pumpkin Some Iron
quests.description: Do you want another challenge, hero? I have a powerful staff sitting around collecting dust. We'll see how well you do to see if YOU deserve the staff.

quests.name: United We Stand, Divided We Fowl
quests.description: When BirdsWithHarms stand together, we can accomplish great things - but when there's a bad egg in the bunch, it can ruin everything for everyone. I am hoping the TurKing is not the bird to blame, but we must make baste… erm, haste. You'll need to first get through the onslaught of his guards, though, since their job is to protect TurKing at all costs!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Down Feather Up to No Good ' quest.

quests.name: Race against the Cluck
quests.description: We haven't much more time left; the Turkonians are getting stronger, the Humans are getting hungrier, and it's almost time for Thanksgiving dinner! We have to hurry and find a way to enter Turking's castle - surely the legendary action hero, SchwarzenEgger, must have been entrusted with the key…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Without Feather Ado
quests.description: Hurry, hurry featherless friend! Take that TurKEY, enter Turking's caste, and put an end to whatever's behind these battling BirdsWithHarms before we run out of time AND im-peck-able bird puns!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Banditing Together
quests.description: Oh, dear me! It look like the Sky Pirates have banded together with those nasty Badland Bandits to ravage this town! All of the other townspeople are hiding. You've got to control the main Flood of invading sky-scum and their bandit cohorts, dearie, or we're done for!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Wreck the Warder ' quest.

quests.name: Booty Becomes Barrier
quests.description: You did a good job slowing down those sky pirates and their bandit buddies, duckie, but it'd better to get them all in one place and finish them off. Only them will this town to be able to return to it's former glory. Build barriers of junk at each end of Main Street. The sky Pirates have stolen some loot, too, so be sure to take it back!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: We Didn't Start The Fire (Oh, Wait...)
quests.description: It's getting hot in here, poppet, and I don't think those lousy lizard-men can stand it. But why no heat things up little more? It might take a little longer, but if you set those barriers on fire, the Bandits will be beaten before you know it! Just… borrow their fire-starting gear. They'll only torch the town with it, and you don't want that, now do you, my little Hero, hmm?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Granny's Final Request
quests.description: Go on my little muffin, go on! You're a big, brave Hero. Granny knows you can handle one itsy bitsy Bandit Boss. Take as much time you need, my dear. Granny is not going anywhere until this is all over.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Importance Of Staying Healthy
quests.description: When Twig gets like this, he just needs to get the sugar out of his system. Feed him something healthy to speed that process up. Like kale… and quinoa. You can actually steal some off of the knights and warriors around here. They know the importance of staying healthy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Health Nut ' quest.

quests.name: An Aspiring Burgermonger
quests.description: Looks like you're all set. Now just get this stuff back to Yulgar so he can fix my unfortunate counterpart.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Health Nut ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: You'll Poke Your Eye Out
quests.description: These Chaos Sp-Eyes have been here since Escherion arrived — after he was defeated, everyone figured they were safe to ignore. But with an invasion on the way, we can't afford to risk letting any intel leak. Find a big stick, and poke out those Sp-Eyes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Mobius Chaos Saga.

quests.name: Imp-roved Arrows
quests.description: Did you know Fire Imps have venomous claws? Not many people do, since they usually attack with fire. Anyways, if we gather some, we can use them to make venom-tipped arrows. It will give the villagers here an advantage when the war comes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Raiders of the Lost Armory
quests.description: Mobius used to have a vast armory, but it was lost when Escherion inverted the city. It looks like the Cyclops Raiders have managed to find it, based on the weapons they've got. Defeat them, and recover the weapons for the townspeople.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Subtle Persuasion
quests.description: We've recovered some of the weapons, but if we can find the location of the armory, Mobius can take control of it again. The Cyclops Warlord must know where it is. See if you can "persuade" him to tell you. With your fists.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Mobilize Mobius
quests.description: Now that we have the armory, all that's left to do is arm the citizens of Mobius. Go through the city, and give armor and weapons to everyone you see.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest at least once. Note: This quest can only be complete once .

quests.name: Like Fireflies
quests.description: Ever since the chaorruption started seeping into Arcangrove, Chaos Sprites have been appearing around the tower. They're hard to kill, but if you catch them in jars they can't escape.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Arcangrove Chaos Saga.

quests.name: Like Siege Engines
quests.description: Arcangrove is full of mages - what it really needs are some ground forces. Gorillaphants are easy to train - if you can subdue a few, we can use them as muscle.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Plants vs Chaos
quests.description: These seed spitters would also make a good extra layer of defense. Collect some seeds from them and we'll plant them around the perimeter.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Like Aloe... With Teeth
quests.description: Another thing seed splitters are good for - healing wounds! Well, their tendrils are. Gather a few and bring them back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Kinda Like a Giant Bubble
quests.description: Now to form our primary defense. Speak to the citizens of Arcangrove - Rayst, Reens, Blakk and Moonwrath. Together they can form a defensive ward around the tower
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest at least once. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: What's Worse Than Drow?
quests.description: Chaorrupted Drow! They're invading Dwarfhold! Take out as many as you can, and see if you can figure out their plan of attack!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the Dwarfhold Chaos Saga.

quests.name: We Can Replenish Our Armory Too!
quests.description: The Chaos Draconians have always been a problem, but now that the drow are chaorrupted too, they seem to be acting as their support. Take them out, and bring me their blades as proof.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Begemralded
quests.description: I've caught some of these drow trying to steal our Gemralds. We can't let their power fall into enemy hands. Collect as many as you can find, and bring them to me for safekeeping.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Natural Resources
quests.description: Drow have sensitive eyes! If you collect some bioluminescent glands from the glow worms the dwarves here can use them to create blinding light grenades.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Rally the Troops
quests.description: The time for battle is here. Rally the dwarves of Dwarfhold Keep, and make sure they are ready to fight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest at least once. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Wave After Wave
quests.description: Alteon's Undead Minions are everywhere in Brightfall. We've been doing what we can to defeat them but their numbers are just endless. Can you help my Lightscythe defeat this wave? It will give us a leg up on the next one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Filthy Creatures ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Take Out Their Firepower
quests.description: These undead were hastily created and they aren't very sturdy but the undead magi really pack a punch. If you can take out the magi in this wave then it will really cripple their attack.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Filthy Creatures ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Help Where It is Needed
quests.description: Before you came along the undead left a lot of injured DoomLight High Lords out in the field. They are powerful but not indestructible. Head out there and help the ones you can!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Filthy Creatures ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bring A Ward To A Swordfight
quests.description: Fighting these creatures one at a time is getting us nowhere. I have prepared some light wards that will drastically weaken the undead when they pass them. Then it will be like knocking down piles of sticks. Place them in these key locations.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Filthy Creatures ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cut Off The Head
quests.description: Reports have just come in that a Painadin Overlord is inside the walls of Brightfall giving direction to the minions. If you can find and defeat him the weaker undead will just fall over!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Filthy Creatures ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Speak to Dage The Good
quests.description: /join overworld and speak with Dage The Good. King Alteon has recently concentrated his forces there. If Xing and Xang have taken the egg anywhere, they have taken it there!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Filthy Creatures ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Recover Sepulchure's Cursed Armor! (New)
quests.description: You must travel to the Crypt in Swordhaven where the Knights are guarding my Father's cursed DoomKnight armor. Bring it back to me to earn my trust.
quests.requirements_note: Must have watched the cutscene in Swordhaven Castle - Undead . Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Unlife Insurance
quests.description: I found that my father had taken out an Unlife Insurance policy but it does not say for what amount. You have proven your worth by returning my father's armor, now go to the King's Tax Collector to get the gold!
quests.requirements_note: Must have watched the cutscene in Swordhaven Castle - Undead . Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gravelyn's Warrior
quests.description: To prove your worth to the Alliance, you will need to "train" 100 of Gravelyn's fighters. If you bring me back proof, you will get a badge! Don't hit them too hard, though, they tend to fall to pieces.

items.name: Gravelyn's Warrior Book of Lore Badge

quests.name: Snow Way to Know Where to Go
quests.description: I don't know where we are, so you'd better find out! Let me know if there's anything you'll need my help taking out. Once you've discovered the boundaries of the forest, come back and I'll tell you what to do next.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Lionfang ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Arming the Undead Army
quests.description: Those Glacier Moles have some WICKED sharp claws, don't you think? They would make PERFECT spear tips for Daddy's Soldiers! Bring me back 15 Perfectly Sharpened Mole Claws so we can arm Daddy's army!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cold As A Corpse
quests.description: You know, us Undead, we don't need to stay warm. But sometimes Daddy brings Humans to the Fortress. They have long meetings after I have to go to bed. They always seem so COLD! I bet they'd be able to plot Evil better if they had some fire. Gather 10 bundles of Deadwood so we can burn it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Pretty Pretty Undead Princess Decor
quests.description: My room is the Evillest, don't you think? But it doesn't have enough… SKULLS! But skeleton skulls are DUMB. I want EVIL Skulls… like DRAGON Skulls! I know there are Frost Dragons in this forest. So SOME of them must have died from heroes like you. Bring me 13 FrostDragon Skulls.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Deadifying Frost Lions
quests.description: Daddy's army doesn't have any mounts! I keep telling him that skeletons riding on top of monsters would be SOOOO COOL! But I guess he just doesn't have time to find creatures for them to ride. So WE will! Go knock out 13 Frost Lions so that Daddy can 'deadify them back home!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defiant Undead Deserters
quests.description: Daddy demands loyalty from his army, and he WILL have it! Those dumb skeletons! Only a couple are silly enough to try to run away, but we'll bring them back, won't we, New Friend? Recapture 15 Ice Skeletons so we can bring them home!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Forest Guardian Gauntlet
quests.description: While you were recapturing Daddy's Undead deserters, I spotted a GINORMOUS FEROCIOUS forest guardian! You have GOT to bring me its HEAD! … What are you waiting for? GO!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gravelyn's Dark Rewards
quests.description: We cannot rest until ALL of the Chaos Invaders in Shadowfall have been demolished! Some made it past my undead and into the heart of my fortress. Others linger here. Slay Skeletal Knights in Shadowfall to collect Infected Skulls and Chaos Warriors here to gather Chaorrupted Bones and I shall reward you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Bonebreak the Vile's Quests .

quests.name: The Empress' New Robes
quests.description: If the Queen of Monsters wants to throw her power towards us, maybe we should show her we're not afraid to get out hands just as dirty. There are Abyssal Mages out there, bring me their souls. I want a new cape.

quests.name: Show Of Strength
quests.description: Hero, once the siege begins, we'll likely not have much time on our hands for grandstanding, but for now? How about you just go wreck some faces. Fearmonger Faces. It'll be good for moral of the alliance, even better if you can make them cry.

quests.name: Strange Magics
quests.description: There is strange magic in the air. Gather 10 Vials of Shadow Blood by killing Nightmare Stalkers and Abyssal Mages to let our mages try to discover what's behind it.

quests.name: Northpointe Incursions
quests.description: Hero, the attack has begun. The brunt of the fight is being handled by the alliance forces, but there are some squads getting by. Take a look around town and kill Fear Mongers and Grimspawn Blades I want their Blood Fangs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Northpointe Key I in your inventory.

quests.name: Vash Nerada
quests.description: Unstopped, shadows can take form. Let's make sure we stop them first! Kill Nightmare stalkers and bring back 10 Shadow Tentacles as proof of your work.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Northpointe Key II in your inventory.

quests.name: Hit Them In The Face. Hard.
quests.description: The Pyromancer guild is telling us that they are running out of supplies. Luckily we can get more. Infernal Goblins are supposed to cry sulfur. Let's find out, if the rumors are false, at least there are fewer Infernal Goblins around. Try and bring in 10 Sulfur Tears to see if it can be done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Northpointe Key III in your inventory.

quests.name: Fear Itself
quests.description: Fear Imps have the ability to turn our troops into a fleeing stampede but there is a chance. If you can gather 7 Poisoned Claws, we can whip up enough Bravery Brew to give to our entire army.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Northpointe Key IV in your inventory.

quests.name: A Taste of their Own Poison
quests.description: Kill Nightmare Stalkers and Abyssal Mages to recover Intimidation Orbs. We should be able to turn their magic back on their own forces, use their own fear against them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Northpointe Key V in your inventory.

quests.name: The Name Of The Thing
quests.description: What's with Fear Imps and Fear Mongers? If they weren't named Fear whatever would they be as scary? Kill 10 of them while calling them Defenders and see what happens.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Northpointe Key VI in your inventory.

quests.name: Take out the Boss
quests.description: Thanks to all your work, and the alliance forces' defenses there is a chance. The leader of the attack, Goregrim stands relatively unguarded. He's daunting even on his own, but now's our chance. Bring him down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Northpointe Key VII in your inventory.

quests.name: A Loyal Servant: Necrotic Sword of Doom
quests.description: Hero, I sense a part of you is already connected and devoted to the darkness. You have my blessing, let this be a gift for your troubles
quests.requirements_note: Must have Necrotic Sword of Doom (Sword) in your inventory.

quests.name: A Loyal Servant: Sepulchure's DoomKnight
quests.description: Hero, I sense a part of you is already connected and devoted to the darkness. You have my blessing, let this be a gift for your troubles
quests.requirements_note: Must have Sepulchure's DoomKnight Armor in your inventory.

quests.name: Let Darkness Enter your Heart
quests.description: Hero, you want to prove to me you have it takes to begin this merciless task? The journey will not be easy, you will have struggles but you know that already, don't you? To begin this task, bring me the essence of a Doom Overlord in the /necrodungeon.

quests.name: Find me some Doom
quests.description: Are you back to continue your task? For this piece we need to have some doom stuffed into it. Doom, a powerless feeling inside you knowing nothing can be done to stop a tragic event from happening. All you can do is watch and feel helpless. Everyone has something that made them feel doomed and hopeless while there was nothing to be done. Let's look at yours. Return to where Swordhaven fell at /swordhavenfalls and face what you couldn't stop from happening. Go confront Alteon.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed any of the three previous quests.

quests.name: Abyssal
quests.description: DoomKnights usually have blackened hearts or in rare cases, none at all and and where their heart should be nothing is there. But all have something in common, An undying flame. A burning passion that won't go out. Hero, I want you to travel to /shadowstrike and gather an undying flame of darkness from Sepulchuroth.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Memories of The Past
quests.description: Did the last beast sound familiar? It should have… Hero, this last major piece is not where, but when. Back when my father was feared throughout the entire land of lore. Deep within shadowfall, there lies an undying, relentless, screaming and howling spirit of my father. It's NOT him exactly just…A memory. An imprint if you will of when he was at his darkest and angriest. Confront it and bring back what I need.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Summoning
quests.description: For this to work you must channel all the things that made you who you are today. All your sorrows, all your desires, all your difficult situations that you had to overcome. Let your anger and hatred collide with these experiences for once to create a physical manifestation of something dark. Something…Evil.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Commander Tibias
quests.description: You want to help? Get yourself to the top of the Wall of Shadowfall and find Commander Tibias. The Internal forces are starting to arrive. and he could use some help keeping them at bay.

quests.name: Clear the Tower
quests.description: Well, ﬁrst things ﬁrst. Go back up on top of the wall, head all the way to the right, and enter the tower. Then, clear a path through those rampant undead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Work Done! ' quest.

quests.name: Find the Passage
quests.description: My father thinks the soul fragment is located at the very top of the tower. In order to get there, you'll need to go to the library on the third ﬂoor. Somewhere in the library is a secret passage leading higher up. Find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Work Done! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: Go Through That Door
quests.description: Time to see where that secret passage leads! Go through the door you opened, and see if you can ﬁnd the soul fragment were looking for. Grab the fragment and ﬁght your way out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Work Done! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Infernal Attack
quests.description: We‘re going to have to focus on slaying these Infernals so that everyone else can work on getting this fortress airborne!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Work Done! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Here's A Hammer, Get To Work
quests.description: Since the Infernals breached the walls, they've caused a lot of damage to the inside of the fortress. We won't be able to leave until we repair it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Work Done! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: The Next Step
quests.description: That's all we can do on this end, for now. The next step is being handled by Dage the Evil. Go ﬁnd him and let him know it‘s time. See if there's anything you can do to help.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Work Done! ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

quests.name: YOU again!
quests.description: You've fought this Infernal Lord before? Glad to hear it. That means you should have no trouble taking him down again. Tear him apart!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Time To Fly ' quest.

quests.name: Remove the Bile
quests.description: Ugh. Well, you guys sure didn't improve the situation any when you attacked Extriki. The area is completely covered in his toxic bile. Get rid of as much of it as you can - both the bile itself, and the noxious clouds coming off of it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Confront Extriki ' quest.

quests.name: Get the Plague (Crystal)
quests.description: You see how the Plague Spreaders have those green crystals growing on their backs? I'd like to study them. They might give us some insight into how we can stop these creatures - and this toxin - for good.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Confront Extriki ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Grab the Growth
quests.description: I'd also like to have Lim run some tests on the wildlife out here. Specifically, on the growths that are appearing on the animals after exposure to the Rift toxin. Not all of the animals have them, but they seem to be fairly common in the Infected Hares.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Confront Extriki ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Destroy the Zognax
quests.description: A larger and more… unique-looking monster has appeared from the Rift in the wake of Extriki's destruction. If we capture it, we may be able to get information out of it that will help us defeat Extriki. If you can defeat it, it may prove to be the key to winning this fight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sand Sounds better than Litter... ' quest.

quests.name: Make a Bed
quests.description: You know that? Yeah. Make him his bed of toxic earth if it'll keep him talking. Another monster recently came out of the Rift that looks like it's made a toxic slime. Some kind of basilisk-looking… pustule thing. Pustulisk? Anyway. Slay it, and then carry its poison goop up to Zognax. We'll kill two birds with one stone.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed ' What's Next? ' quest. Note: Quest can only be completed through Zognax (NPC) .

quests.name: Youthanize
quests.description: Skeletons don't have an easy un-life. The constant battle against dry, brittle bones and splintered phalanges takes its toll on undead morale. And I hate to see them suffer… especially since I'm not the one causing the misery! With this being said, I need you to find the Youthanize Serum. This stuff is incredibly rare, but the Green Slimes of Lore are rumored to produce such a salve… on occasion. Return to me when you have 1 Youthanize Serum in your possession.

quests.name: Rattle Battle
quests.description: Although my father is gone, the Shadowscythe Empire continues to grow and prosper. But I would like to see more support from the Undead. Here is where you come in to play. I need you to head into Bludrut Keep and "convince" the rebellious RattleBones to join the Shadowscythe Empire. Use brute force if you have to. Return to me only when you have 8 Signed Contracts from RattleBones!

quests.name: Dangerous Decor
quests.description: As you can see, this place is in shambles. Thanks to Drakath, Shadowfall has become nothing more than a city of rubble. Not acceptable. If you wish to prove your devotion to the forces of Evil, you will accept the following quest: interior design. SleuthHound Inn is the perfect place for my furniture needs. Bring me 4 Chairs, 2 Tables, and 1 Bookcase to help me get a start with Shadowfall's remodeling!

quests.name: Bone-afide
quests.description: King Alteon despises the Undead. What a fool… he has no idea the potential that they possess! Not only do they make excellent minions, but they also offer what I like to call "constructive attributes." Break a leg? No problem; just take a spare femur from an unpopular Undead! What I need from you today is to gather 6 Replacement Tibias and 3 Spare Phalanges from the wild Skeletons in Swordhaven Graveyard.

quests.name: Sea No Evil
quests.description: Far, far away from here, there lies a cursed isle whose sandy shore is home to a rare species of Undead Fish… and I want to study their incredible power. I've heard that a Gothic Musician is leading an expedition to /voltaire and I want you to go with him. Bring me 5 Fish Heads from the native FishBones and I will reward you handsomely for your troubles, wounds, and potential seasickness.

quests.name: Inquisitor Inquiry
quests.description: The Inquisitors in Citadel are extremely vicious individuals, attacking anyone who crosses their path. Some people— like that silly mage Murray— fear the Inquisitor Guards; I, however, admire their spunk and dedication! Shadowfall needs more minions like that. Head up to Citadel and see if you can *convince* the Inquisitors to join the Shadowscythe Empire. Bring me back 7 Inquisitor Contracts… and whatever you do, don't take *no* for an answer!

quests.name: Slithering Shadows
quests.description: Deep within Bludrut Keep resides a strange species that call themselves Shadow Serpents. They were once loyal to my father, Sepulchure, but suddenly turned once I became ruler of the Shadowscythe Empire. Those traitors! I will show them I am just as powerful as Father was! Go to the 4th floor in Bludrut Keep and collect 5 Shadow Scales from the slithering Shadow Serpents that roam the hallways. Make sure they know that Gravelyn sent you!

quests.name: Sepulchure's Helm
quests.description: My father would only honor the most skilled of his dark warriors. If you can prove to me that YOU are the most worthy, will give you a gift that many have sought, but none have yet received… the helm of the Dark Lord Sepulchure, Leader of the ShadowScythe.

quests.name: ShadowScythe Class Daily
quests.description: Battle Sigrid Sunshield's warriors in /lightguardwar and bring back their broken blades as you fight through the memories of my father's early years.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. Note: These quests can only completed once a day.

quests.name: ShadowScythe Quest Legend
quests.description: Battle Sigrid Sunshield's warriors in /lightguardwar and bring back their broken blades as you fight through the memories of my father's early years.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. Note: These quests can only completed once a day.

quests.name: Shadow Medals: Defend the Village!
quests.description: These soldiers are strong, and the people of this village don't stand a chance against them. Defeat as many as you can and report back. Bring me the medals they carry as proof.

quests.name: Seed Spitter Oil
quests.description: These villagers aren't trained for war, and a lot of them are wounded. If you bring me some Seed Spitter oil, our clerics can make a medicinal salve from it. It will help stabilize the wounds, and hopefully save some lives.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mega Shadow Medals
quests.description: The Shadowflame Army's elite forces are starting to appear on the battlefield. They don't look any different, but you will know them by the larger medals they carry. If you manage to kill any, bring their medals to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadow Samples
quests.description: Do you see those puddles of shadowy sludge that are forming on the ground where the Shadow Amy is fighting? I think that must be the key to figuring out what they are. Bring me some samples for our clerics to study.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadow Medals: Fight Them Back!
quests.description: We've taken control of the village and the surrounding lands. Now, we must push this army back toward the castle! Fight them back, and bring me the medals from any that you defeat.
