quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Interrogation
quests.description: We need to find out more information about the shadowy figure who's leading this army. Those Slashers are pure brawn - you won't be able to get anything out of them. But from the Scouts, you might. Interrogate them, and come back to me when you have some useful clues.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Malgor!
quests.description: We've got to stop this army, and now's our chance. Defeat Malgor and save the villagers from his Shadowflame Army.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pieces of Light
quests.description: It's dangerous for us here. The shadow can warp the minds of the living, and sometimes even the flesh. We'll need to ward off its effects. Luckily, we have a way to do that. There are pockets of light matter here. Find some and bring it back to me.

quests.name: Cloak of Silk
quests.description: We're going to stick out like a sore thumb if we don't make some kind of effort to blend in. Collect shadowsilk from the roaming Shadowsprites. We'll use them to cloak ourselves.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bridge of Shadows
quests.description: We're going to have to find a way up onto that ledge if we want to get any farther than this. But shadow can be shaped, and reshaped. Bright Oil can soften it and make it more malleable. Bring me some from the Light Matter, and I'll use it to create a pathway up to the upper level.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clear the Shadowfiends
quests.description: That ledge is crawling with Shadowfiends! Defeat them, quickly - we can't let them alert anyone else that we're here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Feed the Doomblade
quests.description: The Doomblade - and my fatheds spirit within it - is growing weak. It needs to feast on the energy of the shadows. Any kind of shadow creature should do. Just help me feed it so that it can continue to guide us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Build Another Bridge
quests.description: My father says Safiria is close, but not yet within our reach. She is on a platform some distance away from us. We will need to build a bridge to it. Bring me some Shadow Matter and some Bright Oil, and I will construct one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find Safiria
quests.description: Now, go and find Safiria! There's no telling how much damage has already been done. I'll wait here and guard your rear.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Dissolve the Chains
quests.description: Some of that light matter - the stronger stuff - is pretty acidic. Maybe you could use that to dissolve Safiria's shadowy chains.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Gather the Shadows
quests.description: Shadowfall has always been a fortress of Darkness, but these shadows are not on our side. Still - I have a use for them that Malgor won't have anticipated. Gather them for me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shadow Nulgath ' quest.

quests.name: Dusty Boost
quests.description: I need to boost my own power for what I'm about to do here. That means I'm going to need grave dust - a lot of it. Fight the skeletal minions roaming the area - only the infected ones, please! - and collect the driest of their bones. Then, bring them back here and grind them to dust.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shadow Nulgath ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat my Minions
quests.description: So many of my minions have been infected by the shadows. Slay them, hero. They're already undead - I'll raise them again when this is over.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shadow Nulgath ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Pass the Portal
quests.description: Go through the portal, hero. I will meet you on the other side.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shadow Nulgath ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: We Need to See
quests.description: It's so dark in here it's difficult to see! We'll ignite a handful of small fires in this new realm, so as to better find our way through it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shadow Nulgath ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Stop the Crows
quests.description: The shadowcrows follow us, watching our every move. We must stop them. They can't be allowed to report on our progress.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shadow Nulgath ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Convert the Shadowscythe
quests.description: These are the same shadows that trapped my father. There will be allies here. Find them, and convince them to join us. Be warned - they are Shadowscythe. You may have to fight them first.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shadow Nulgath ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Feed the Doomblade
quests.description: The Doomblade can keep us here for as long as we need to remain - but it needs sustenance. Kill any shadowy monster you can find and gather its Darkness for my blade.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shadow Nulgath ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Speak to the Ghosts
quests.description: Talk to the ghosts here. Speak to the skulls in these piles of shadowy bones. Some of them may know how we should proceed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shadow Nulgath ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Gather Spell Reagents
quests.description: Thanks to the ghosts, I know how to prepare a spell that will lead us to our quarry. But first, we'll need some reagents. Gather some blackened herbs from the Shadow Spitters and some shadowy feathers from the Shadowcrows.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shadow Nulgath ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Follow the Trail
quests.description: Follow the trail of shadowy fire and it will take us where we need to be.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shadow Nulgath ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat Krahen
quests.description: Come on! Help me take him down. He's all that stands in our way!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Shadow Nulgath ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Un-Lifeguard Quest
quests.description: I'm always looking to recruit a few good heroes, but not after they've been ripped apart by sharks. A giant, super-intelligent cyborg shark has been spotted in the area. Carnage like that would spoil the /party. I would be displeased if that were to happen. Go get rid of them. Bring me some shark teeth to prove it!

quests.name: Capture the Corporals
quests.description: My undead and I could handle these forces, but it will be nice having you here to help put an end to this quickly! Take out 10 of the Corporals, if you don't mind. WE will handle these others.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Crush the Cavalry ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Light up the Night
quests.description: Look at how the light reflects off of the Ice Elementals! It gives me an idea. Summon lights to blind the ShadowFlame forces, and it will make it easier to take them down. Then you take out 10 ShadeFire Elementals, and we'll take on the rest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Crush the Cavalry ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Major Malfunction
quests.description: Look at them all — the absolute arrogance, thinking they could come in and take over MY fortress! I won't stand for it. While I direct my minions to attack, you take down the ShadeFire Major.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Crush the Cavalry ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Princess Carry
quests.description: I'll climb the ladder on the right. It'll be faster if I give you a piggyback. Don't protest, and count the seconds it takes for me to get to the first platform. I want to see if my father can beat my time. If you feel bad about me carrying you, then catch some butterflies. I saw you do the same for Safiria. They're just bugs but you caught them for her. It's not that I want them too. It's only fair for the contest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Poincare Recurrence ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Flowers for a Crown
quests.description: Hold that thought about the butterflies. The Queen's minions have come to sabotage me. Did she actually think a cloud of vermin and a couple of fashion disasters could get between you and I? Don't bother raising your weapon. I'll deal with them while you go pick some flowers. That should be a proper Hero's Heart Day activity.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Poincare Recurrence ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tea Diffusion
quests.description: We'll be climbing the left ladder from here. Of course, more vampire minions to make my headache worse. You want to fight them for yourself to find out why they're so strange? Alright, if that's what you want. Then I'll work on a gift for you. Don't get too excited. I've never made something like this before so it'll take time. Read that book over there if I don't finish quick enough. I wonder if it's a guidebook or map.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Poincare Recurrence ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Road Not Taken
quests.description: Up the next ladder. What is this? Where did the sky and tower go? How did we suddenly get transported into someone's house? Not that I've ever personally spent that long a time inside of one. I was raised in my father's fortress so this sort of place is unfamiliar to me. Plain furniture, toys, family portraits…I'm getting dizzier, and the swarming butterflies aren't helping. We need to get rid of them and look closer at this strange home.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Poincare Recurrence ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadow Hunt Medal
quests.description: The forces of Swordhaven, the Lightguard, and my Empire fight to defend Battleon and destroy the invading Shadows. Join the fray and eradicate the enemy!

quests.name: Mega Shadow Hunt Medal
quests.description: I am using my Light to suppress the strength of the Shadowy invaders. Admittedly, I feel my stamina dwindling. I need you to continue to fight and grind our enemies into dust!

quests.name: Early Autopsy
quests.description: This isn't the first time we've fought these Doom-possessed creatures, but the Doom Spirit behind this invasion could have different properties. Bring back samples of flesh from monsters for our scholars to study.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either of the previous quests. Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 25%.

quests.name: Given Life and Purpose
quests.description: The Shadows spilling from the Eclipse have started to possess suits of armor, and are using them to attack us. Break them apart, and tear out whatever's hiding inside
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 25%.

quests.name: Adult Hatchling
quests.description: We've culled the weakest of the invaders' ranks, and now their strongest are spawning in East Battleon. Head to the residential district and clear the area of these serpents!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 50%.

quests.name: Solidified Light
quests.description: There must be Clerics buried nearby. The Shadows seeped into the soil and raised wraiths. They are far more powerful than the rest of the invaders. Destroy them. It's what they would want.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 75%.

quests.name: Enigmatic Entity
quests.description: The focal point of the invasion was The Mysterious Stranger. It seeks my throne and the destruction of Battleon on. Raise your weapon. We will destroy this treacherous Shadow!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Mouth of the Snake Den
quests.description: We need to find the Empress, but the snake men and malevolent armors are pressuring my knights. Please help us thin their numbers, and report to Gravelyn about our current status.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Equivalent Exchange ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Buried Human Pillars
quests.description: A pair of Wraiths are guarding the entrance to Camlan. They're wearing the same Clerical robes the other ghosts in Battleon did. Force them into the afterlife so we can pass through the city gates.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Equivalent Exchange ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Guileless Sneers
quests.description: Dryden and Sigrid ran off before I could get them to wait for you. Without Dryden, we'd waste time getting lost in the streets of Camlan. Find him, and any other Elf that's still sane. See if they know what the Shadows are after.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Equivalent Exchange ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadows of Aminion
quests.description: We need Dryden to pull himself together. The creatures that used to be his people are surrounding us, and worsening his mental state. Cut these Doomed Elves down and show no mercy. They're sound of mind, but beyond the point of return.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Equivalent Exchange ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Newbie Boom
quests.description: The Lightguard made it to Carcano's hideout first, and they have orders to smite anyone else in the area- including Ana. Clear them out, and don't bother going easy on them. These fools need to learn where they stand without the Alliance to lean on.

quests.name: Tears Like Honey
quests.description: Ana's fellow Paladin Ascendants are inside the ruins of her childhood home, looking to apprehend her and the Nation traitor. We need Ana to lead us to Carcano, so keep her compatriots from dragging her back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Work Fiends
quests.description: The Paladins have been forced to fall back and regroup- which just leaves Nulgath's forces to deal with. Confront the Nation casters, and see if you can have a word with their leader. I saw Loremaster Jadzia in the west wing of the building… perhaps she can help. I certainly hope that spending time in Termina Temple taught her a valuable lesson about friendship- or at least one about not selling out your allies.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rewritten Signatures
quests.description: Outriders are Fiends that left the Nation. Fighting on behalf of Lord Nulgath again may mean that he's extending forgiveness to those who have failed him in the past if they help capture Carcano. Confront these Outriders and see if my hunch is right. They should be in the east wing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Where the Heart is
quests.description: The Paladins are back in formation, flooding the building to look for Carcano…and Ana. It doesn't make sense for them to turn so readily on someone dedicated to doing Good. Destroy these reinforcements, and ask Ana about their violent behavior.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Carnage Delenda Est
quests.description: I'm going to speak with Jadzia and Ana. Lord Nulgath's intentions have become murky, and even his loyalists may not know what he's up to. We'll be back on the move soon. Until then, keep the Ascended Paladins and Outriders from destroying the place with their rampage.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Helix ' quest.

quests.name: Light Headed
quests.description: The Ascendants have regrouped, and are mounting another attempt to retrieve the "Dying Star." I don't care if they keep throwing warm bodies at the problem, but I'd rather not be tripping over their corpses while we're in a rush. Repel them. They're in over their heads.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Helix ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Forgiveness of Debt
quests.description: Jadzia called off her Casters, but the Outriders answer to Carnage. They're not willing to let us through. In fact, they're willing to look me in the face and tell me to turn around. That's gutsy. You don't need to be gentle about getting them out of the way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Helix ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hyperspace-Plasia
quests.description: Carcano took the Fiend Shard below ground, and its influence is ripping space. We're about to be swimming in the Shard's radiation, and I'll feel more at ease diving in if we test how smaller tears will affect us first. Keep the Paladins from tampering with them too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Helix ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tangled Aortas
quests.description: The Shard is beneath the room where we fought Carnage. It already transformed the cellar into what's basically a whole other dimension. Before we go, I need a word with Jadzia. While we talk, take that notebook from Ana's old bedroom. Don't let her see you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Helix ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nation Code
quests.description: We're ready to move. Enter the tear in space created by the stolen Shard, and find Ana. The Outriders are making a last ditch effort to stop us. Considering the fact that they're former traitors, I imagine they're willing to do anything they can to prove themselves worthy of this second chance.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Twisted Helix ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Uprooted Veins
quests.description: Now that the stolen Shard has been neutralized, the tears in space will repair themselves. Until then, do me a favor and help me snoop. We stand to learn more about Carcano, Carnage, and the Hushed specters haunting this Fiendish Void.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Famiglia di Carcano ' quest.

quests.name: Recover Sepulchure's Cursed Armor! (Old)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Robina's Quests , talked to King Alteon on Screen 5, and then watched through the cutscenes in Swordhaven Castle - Undead .

quests.name: Collect the Gold!
quests.description: My Tax Collector? He should be here shortly - he is busy counting the Royal Treasury so that we can make sure that all the citizens of Swordhaven will be well cared for during this time of uncertainty.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Staying Alive
quests.description: Lord Ovthedance has built his house at the top of this killer beehive. I can't get up there but maybe you can. He's hooked on Killer Queen honey, but you'll need to clear out some of her Stings before you can get to her. Bring me 8 Tattered Sting Sweaters so I know you can make it to the Queen alive.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed ' Knockin' on Haven's Door ' quest. Note: Quest name is a parody of the song Stayin' Alive by Bee Gees.

quests.name: Killer Queen
quests.description: You did a great job clearing the path to the Killer Queen Bee. Lord Ovthedance built his house at the top of this hive because he LOVES Killer Queen Royal Honey. If you can get a small jar of that for him he might let you close enough to teach him a lesson! Return to me with a Jar of Royal Honey.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Quest name is a parody of the song Killer Queen by Queen.

quests.name: Satisfaction
quests.description: I sent Lord Ovthedance the jar of Royal Honey as a "peace offering" and told him I would send a delivery of a lot more with a local messenger. He'll never know what hit him. When you take those enchained shoes from him, tell him I said "hi"!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Quest name is a parody of the song Satisfaction by Rolling Stones.

quests.name: Ticklish Zorbo Pet
quests.description: If you have a Ticklish Zorbo Ticket, would you like to redeem it for a Ticklish Zorbo pet?

quests.name: Ticklish Zorbo Sword
quests.description: If you have a Ticklish Zorbo Ticket, would you like to redeem it for a Ticklish Zorbo sword?

quests.name: Sugar, Sugar
quests.description: Oh, I need some honey honey to make myself one sweet candy girl. Go defeat 10 stingers and collect their honey and I might be able to create her!

quests.name: Slay the Chaotic Troll
quests.description: Defeat the Chaotic Troll in /bloodtuskwar and grab his Death Rattle. In return, you just may get the Great Daggers of the Horcs.

quests.name: Slay the Prime Dragons
quests.description: Find the Death Scales of all the prime dragons to see if you can get the Mighty Sword of the Dragons. You might be able to… but then again, maybe not!

quests.name: Slay the Sneeviltron
quests.description: If you can defeat the Sneeviltron and bring back to me his badge, I might just give you my cane!

quests.name: The Legion Needs YOU!
quests.description: You're here for the recruitment drive, eh? Well, thanks for the interest, but we're looking for STRONG heroes. Real tough fighters. We're going to be going up against the Queen's army, you know.

quests.name: Show Me More, Legion-Noob
quests.description: You did well, but that first round was just to weed out the weak. A real Legion champion can take on even the toughest Shadowscythe and Nation scum - I mean fighters. Right. We're working together now. Head into the arena and defeat Doombringers and Carnage!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Legion Round 1 Medal in your inventory.

quests.name: For the Legion!
quests.description: We weren't expecting anyone to make it this far, but we set up an arena full of the very best Shadowscythe and Nation volunteers we could find, just in case. Go defeat Doomknight Prime and Draconic Doomknights along with Minotaur of War and Crag and Bamboozle!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Legion Round 2 Medal in your inventory.

quests.name: Dage Likes Your Style
quests.description: You're showing a lot of potential, Prospect - maybe you're even good enough to become Dage's right-hand Hero! Want to show him what you're made of? Then step on into the arena and prove yourself by defeating Thanatos!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Legion Round 3 Medal in your inventory.

quests.name: Legion Recruits: The Dark Path Waits
quests.description: Dage forced Legion Seals and Gems of Mastery to test your worth. Each of the Shadowscythe warriors in this arena carries a Legion Seal, and each Nation Warrior possesses a Gem of Mastery. Your task, if you have the strength to complete it is this: Best them for a chance to recover 25 seals and 1 Gem, then return to me for your reward!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Legion Round 4 Medal in your inventory to see this quest. Note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Legion Loyalty Rewarded
quests.description: Loyal members of the Legion like you have proven themselves worthy of even greater rewards. Relics of defeated, powerful enemies can be used to create strong magic. Bring me the remains of your defeated foes and I'll reward you.

quests.name: Ode to the Walkers
quests.description: What perfect timing, I'm glad you're here! Of walkers, I don't have no fear - But I can't fight this horde alone, and I'm tryin' To keep Coral (and this weird red thing) from dyin'!

quests.name: Sonnet of the Undead
quests.description: Before you go, a favor, please These walkers stole our stuff, those mutts! Don't leave me beggin' on my knees Go get it back and kick their butts!

quests.name: Through the Zombie Portal!
quests.description: Finally, you're done! You have to catch up to Xeven! She went through that portal over there. But please… whatever you see in there… don't be mad at me for keeping it a secret. I swore I'd never tell!

quests.name: Back to Jail With You!
quests.description: What a disaster! Chaos energy from the sewers has seeped into a section of Swordhaven's dungeons and chaorrupted the prisoners there. Some of them have managed to defeat the guards and escape. They need to be taken down. Are you up to the task?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' That's One Big Sludgebeast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: We May Need A Militia
quests.description: Swordhaven is no longer safe, and our citizens will need a way to defend themselves. Recover the weapons that the Chaorrupted Prisoners stole from the guards, then distribute them to any peasants you see.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' That's One Big Sludgebeast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: An Ounce Of Prevention
quests.description: In response to the dungeon incident, the Sisterhood of the Dishpan Hands is trying to develop an inoculation against chaorruption. The local chaos monsters ooze a sticky liquid that they want to use as a base. Collect some from any chaos monsters in Swordhaven, and bring it back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' That's One Big Sludgebeast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: TLaPD 2023 Collection Badge Quest
quests.description: Master says this ship-shaped floating dungeon was the BEST idea he ever had. It is much easier for him to get new challengers to "test" his dungeons if WE go to THEM. He commands you to bring him an Ashray Fisherman. NO ONE HIDES FROM GRIMSKULL. They will learn.
quests.requirements_note: Must have GrimBlight's Spectre Quest Pet and Grim Sails Collection Chest in your inventory.

items.name: Grim Sails Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Doom Overlord Challenge
quests.description: Do you have what it takes to take down the Doom Overlord? Countless Heroes have banded together only to succumb to total annihilation. Will you meet the same fate? There is only one way to find out. Gather a team of your strongest friends to take on the Doom Overlord Challenge! Treasures of experience, glory, and gold await the victor!

quests.name: Executive Doom Overlord Challenge
quests.description: Calling all Members! Do you have what it takes to bring down the Doom Overlord? I have witnessed the fall of many great Heroes as they attempted to slain this horrendous monster. You too will meet the same fate if you go in unprepared. Gather a party of your strongest friends and heed the call of the Doom Overlord Challenge! An unfathomable amount of grandeur, gold, glory, and experience await the victor. Come and claim your prize-if you've got what it takes, Member!

quests.name: SO MANY SKULLS
quests.description: Noxus: As if the skulls from our armies weren't enough, now Vordred wants ours! Put a stop to him before we become a fashion accessory!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'It Takes Two to Tango' quest from Grimskull or Noxus .

quests.name: SO MANY SKULLS (Badge Quest)
quests.description: Noxus: As if the skulls from our armies weren't enough, now Vordred wants ours! Put a stop to him before we become a fashion accessory!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'It Takes Two to Tango' quest from Grimskull or Noxus .

items.name: SO MANY SKULLS! Character Page Badge
Mort + Binky Jr BFF House Guard

quests.name: We Will Rebuild
quests.description: Grimskull: We need our skulls back! What's with the look? How else are we supposed to rebuild our armies, ehehehehe? Head on back over to Vordred and retrieve a few skulls for us, and we'll make it worth your while.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' SO MANY SKULLS ' quest.

quests.name: We Will Rebuild (Legend)
quests.description: Grimskull: We need our skulls back! What's with the look? How else are we supposed to rebuild our armies, ehehehehe? Head on back over to Vordred and retrieve a few skulls for us, and we'll make it worth your while.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' SO MANY SKULLS ' quest.

quests.name: Lich Class
quests.description: Grimskull: At a glance, Liches may seem similar to Necromancers, but they're much more powerful (and handsome). To become one, you'll need the Necronomicons of three ancient Lich Lords, each containing a part of the spell required for he transformation. These Necronomicons are in short print, but luckily for you, Noxus and I keep a collection.
quests.requirements_note: Requires Rank 10 DoomWood .

quests.name: Battle Through the Dungeon
quests.description: You've got to rescue that girl crying for help! Defeat all the Grim Fighters in the room to pass.
quests.requirements_note: Must have been to Artix's Wedding .

quests.name: The Way is Blocked
quests.description: You cannot let these creatures prevent you from saving somebody who needs help!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Just a FEW More Monsters...
quests.description: The screams are getting louder. You are almost there! Slay all the Grim Soldiers in the room to pass.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Grimskull War Medal
quests.description: I'm flattered you want to fight for me. Knock a few skulls off a of Noxus' minions, and I might just have a reward ready for you.

quests.name: Mega Grimskull War Medal
quests.description: Hmm… I suppose Noxus' skeletons are pretty tough, but they're no match for mine. Just keep doing what you're doing, and his army will be gone in no time!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous or the ' Noxus War Medal ' quest.

quests.name: Undead Giants
quests.description: Now THOSE are some big skeletons! But all the more satisfying when they fall… ehehehehehe!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous or the ' Mega Noxus War Medal ' quest. Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 25%.

quests.name: It Takes Two to Tango
quests.description: This is an unexpected turn. Only the war bosses remain, but which side will prevail?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous or the ' Undead Tech ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Find the Path
quests.description: You must reach the war room where the maps are kept! They are our most prized possessions!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Brentan's Battle ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Scout the Area
quests.description: These woods can be very dangerous to newcomers. I suggest you scout the area to get yourself acquainted. Be careful, the local wildlife is on high alert thanks to the beast. They will most likely lash out at you.

quests.name: Deer?
quests.description: The Zweinichthirsch is known for disguising and manipulating its prey. There are some Deer nearby and any one of them could be the beast. Let's attempt to finish this right here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Comparing Claws
quests.description: These claw marks that cover the area… Could they belong to the beast? We won't know unless we compare it to the local wildlife. Collect Claw and Talon Samples from the Wolves and Owls in the area.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lair Investigated
quests.description: Because this beast isn't local, it must have set up a new lair nearby. Check that cave structure and see if you can confirm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fight or Flight or Freeze
quests.description: The Wolves and the Owls are getting frantic. The beast must be getting close. Clear them out of the way so they don't interrupt our hunt!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Not Deer Hunting
quests.description: It must be close. Hunt down every last Deer in the area until we find it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Monstrous Tracks
quests.description: There! These tracks! Follow them and they will lead us to the beast!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Final Blessing
quests.description: If we are going to survive this fight, we must make an offering to the Gods. Collect Deer Hides, Wolf Pelts, and Owl Feathers so that we may receive their blessing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Zweinichthirsch
quests.description: This thing… It is unlike anything I have ever seen. Even the legends don't do it justice. This thing is true terror. No matter, this thing took my little girl from me. I will put it in the ground.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cries Investigated
quests.description: Those cries! It can't be! Search the forest for their source!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Drive Back the Wildlife
quests.description: The Zweinichthirsch is slain, but the wildlife remain frightened and aggressive. Help me drive them back so they don't attack the villagers in their frenzies.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cries Investigated ' quest.

quests.name: The Beast Twitches
quests.description: Hello again, Hero. I recently traveled back to where the vile Zweinichthirsch lays and I saw its body move. I called for you as soon as I could. Will you fight with me to slay it again? I won't leave your side until it takes its last breath. We can't let this thing hurt anyone again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cries Investigated ' quest.

quests.name: Dage's Locked Box
quests.description: Many centuries ago, Dage crafted a very special blade. He was saving it for a special occasion… until it was stolen. We know where it is, and if you want a chance to claim it, you'll need to get the following items: the Box Guardian's locked box, the Green Dragon's Chimeran Pick, and the Cyclops Warlord's Serpent Claw.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Scavengers
quests.description: Those small green fellows have been scavenging our platforms for parts. We need those for the post-feast celebration! You can get them back for us, yes?

quests.name: Wired
quests.description: Your feathered bipeds have been taking our wiring and using it for their nests. We must get it back! If even one piece is missing, the feast will be ruined.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Turdraken Tremor
quests.description: Our instruments detected that a biologically-improbable creature stole the Fluctuating Appetite Realignment Transducer. We need that to… *cough* make sure the meal is properly appreciated. Find our device inside the 'Mini Turdraken'.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Meat and Eggs
quests.description: Oishii tells me the 'Sneevils… are stealing our meat, too. I am small, friend, and can't fight them. But YOU can! She has asked for a few eggs from the 'turkeys', too. You'll handle it, won't you?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Golden Shrooms
quests.description: Hi there Traveler! Can I ask you for some help? I came to the Great Guru Forest in search of some wild mushrooms; they say that the Ultimate Elixir can be created with them. I need to collect at least 10 of these magical mushrooms… can you possibly help me find them? You'll be able to identify them easily by their bright golden glow. (Bring back 10 Golden Mushrooms to complete this quest)

quests.name: Blue Feathers
quests.description: I'm sorry to bother you again Traveler, but it seems the mushrooms were only the first step in creating the Ultimate Elixir… I'm going to need some other ingredients as well. The second ingredient I will need is wild Trobble feathers. I believe that 5 of them should be enough; would you be so kind to collect them for me? (Return to her with five Trobble feathers to complete the quest).
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Flying Tails
quests.description: Wow, you really are something else! The third ingredient I will need is five Leather Wing tails. Be careful when you're fighting the Leather Wings though; I hear they pack a really nasty punch! (Return to her with 5 Leather Wing tails to complete the quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Mixing Pot
quests.description: Arrrgh! This is preposterous! The cauldron I was planning to mix all these ingredients and brew the Ultimate Elixir has broken! Now I'm going to need a new one before I can continue. Can you see if there is something around here I might be able to use as a replacement cauldron? (Bring back a Cauldron to complete the quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Recipe Needed
quests.description: Something is wrong with the Ultimate Elixir… it isn't working! I must be missing something, but I was so sure I had all the ingredients. Hmm… I hear a great Potions Master lives in this forest; perhaps he knows the correct recipe! If you can find him for me and obtain that recipe, I can double-check my ingredients to find out what I'm missing! (Return to her with the recipe to complete the quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Missing Ingredient
quests.description: Excellent, you have returned with the recipe! Just as I thought, I'm missing an ingredient. I still need two petals from the Wisteria to finish the Elixir. Would you be so kind as to retrieve them for me? Be careful if you agree: Those plants actually eat humans! (Bring back 2 petals to complete this quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Delicious Ingredient
quests.description: Thanks to you, I have finally been able to brew the Ultimate Elixir! But if you still want to give me a hand, I have one more job for you. In my various attempts, I discovered that the spores of the carnivorous Wisteria plant actually make a very tasty soup. If you can bring me back 3 spores, we can celebrate with a victory feast! (Bring back 3 spores to complete this quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Me Knickers Got a Big Hole Across th' Bum
quests.description: Me clothes got a wee bit torn up when I escaped me sinking ship. Maybe ye can get me some scraps o' fabric from the vampirates on the island? And maybe a thin bone from one o' those fish beasties so's I can sew meself up.

quests.name: Where'd Me Ship's Cargo?
quests.description: Now I'm all sewed up, I can worry about more important things. Like the "cargo" me ship was carryin'! If I can at least recover some of it, maybe this trip be not a total loss. If anythin' washed ashore, ye can bet some vampirate or fishbone carried it off!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Most Important Package
quests.description: Listen… there be another very precious bit of cargo that still be missin'. It be highly important that I find it! Ye be lookin' fer a burlap sack of medium size. The bad news is, I be seein' a lot of burlap on this island, so anyone or anythin' could have it. Vampirates, Fishbones… maybe even a Shelleton!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Comfort Food
quests.description: Oh no - it wasn't there! Oh, what a dark day this be! I need somethin' to calm me nerves. Like… turtle stew, perhaps? Those shelletons out on th' beach might have some passable meat, and some fish oil from the Fishwings be helpin' it go down easy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Full o' Holes
quests.description: Now that I be calmed down, I be feelin' some rage for that kraken! But when me boat came ashore, it landed on a rocky spot, and now it be full o' holes. That will have to be fixed before we can do any kraken-huntin'! Find me a few good shell chunks from the Shelletons on the beach, and we can use them to patch me boat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Keelhaulin' a Kraken!
quests.description: Me boat be fixed and I be ready to take my revenge on that bilge rat of a kraken! Are ye with me, Hero?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest. Note: This quest can also be accessed at Chaos Kraken (Location) .

quests.name: Pet Shop and Drops
quests.description: Do you know how hard it is running a pet store? Want to find out? All my critters require constant attention, housing, food, and * shudder * clean up! I could really use your help getting:

quests.name: Sparring Practice
quests.description: Our Nethermagi are getting plenty of theoretical practice, but they've not had much in the way of combat practice lately. Spar with them - this will help them keep their skills honed, and may also help you develop your own.

quests.name: Fill the Vials
quests.description: With all of the wild magic being performed here, often some bits of mana will go astray. We can collect that energy and use it to power new magic. Or, more to the point, *you* can. Fill these 8 vials with Mystic Energy collected from Stray Mana in the area, and I will reward you.

quests.name: Gather Crystals
quests.description: On occasion, our Scryers will need to replace the Orbs we use, as their power is depleted through use. Inside Balax'el's Fortress, you will find a room in which large chunks of Arcane Crystal are kept. Carve away at the crystals with your weapon until you find one which yields a perfect Orb. Then, bring it back to me.

quests.name: Housing Hachiko
quests.description: As you start to pet Hachiko, Ai No Miko walks over and says, "I appreciate you taking the time to greet Hachiko, but I think it's time that he finds a home. He might enjoy staying with you, but he likely doesn't trust you yet. Maybe if you give him some food and play with him, he'll trust you more?"

quests.name: Mission1
quests.description: Incoming message from planet Tipulidae: Bzzz…Urgent need of help! Lizard man creating chaos! Eating soliders. Sugar reserves down! Last seen wearing armor, may have club. Find him and return proof. We pay! Bzzzz.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed VR Mission Chapter 6: Grand Theft Locomotive . Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Mission2
quests.description: Telegraph from the people of Xenophobiac: Help us! We've been invaded! Aliens! We've seen aliens! Little green men riding giant metal robots! Help us please! Find the aliens and get rid of them! In the meantime we'll be wrapping our cows in tin foil, heard that keeps the implants out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed VR Mission Chapter 6: Grand Theft Locomotive . Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mission 3
quests.description: Request from Milania: I have an upcoming fashion show. I need your help to hunt a rare item for me. I need some snake scales to decorate a purse. Luckily, I found a breed that drops without the need to kill them. The purse should match the theme of the show. "Obsidian Chic", so get some nice and dark.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Intruder Alert! Intruder Alert! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Mission 4
quests.description: Transmission from Prison 955 from Omega Prime: *ckckckck* Call to all bounty hunters, fugitive on the loose. Extremely dangerous. *kssssshhh* Records show the Gr-*message garbled* broke from the hand restraints but there is no indication of leg shackles left behind. He may be armed with a weapon, proceed with caution.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Intruder Alert! Intruder Alert! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mission 5
quests.description: Call to all. Call to all. Tribequian Emissary requests assistance with exotic material. In search for one elaborate feather. Found on a large cerulean snatcher. Reward for the first hunter who finds one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the J6 in Space minigame. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Mission 6
quests.description: *ckckck* Calling all Bounty Hunters. Wanted: Hot headed humanoid with equally hot monster minions. *tssstss*—wreaking havoc in the volcanic town of Basa—*tsstsstss* Return with Flare Artifact to receive Reward—*ckckck*
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the J6 in Space minigame. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: That Is The Way
quests.description: If we are going to stop this evil Fifth Lord, we are going to have to fight our way through those Tempest Soldiers. Their guns might scare you but don't worry, their aim is notoriously terrible.

quests.name: Murder Moon Plans
quests.description: Even if we defeat Fifth Lord Sepulchure, we can't leave the Murder Moon up and running. One of these Tempest Soldiers has to know how this place runs. Find the Plans for the Murder Moon and find a way to shut it down for good!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Revenge of the Fifth
quests.description: It's time to take on Fifth Lord Sepulchure. Be careful, he is strong with the Fourth, has cybernetic upgrades, and that weapon of his has cut down countless good people. There is a good reason he is feared throughout the galaxy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Too Dangerous to be Left Alive!
quests.description: You did great in defeating Fifth Lord Sepulchure, but some of his soldiers still remain ever loyal, even after his defeat. Make sure to take care of them swiftly so the likes of them cannot spread.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Revenge of the Fifth ' quest.

quests.name: Grocery Run
quests.description: Serenity taught me how to manage a vegetable garden, but I'm not at a level where I can keep a whole temple self-sufficient. Would you mind doing a secret grocery run? Head to /ravinetemple and take down a couple of Lemurphants and Jungle Tigriffs. I made a deal with the trolls and the orcs to clean their temple in exchange for them giving food and supplies to ours.

quests.name: Hans the Builder
quests.description: Back in Battleon, Yulgar taught me how to fix furniture. After getting the basics down, I graduated to making chairs, tables and bed frames. With so many people living here, we're going to need a lot of new furniture. Granted, I can't order supplies because our location's supposed to be a secret. Would you mind heading to /beachparty to chop down a few Palm Treeants? That should be out of the way enough.

quests.name: A Single Rib
quests.description: I have a true challenge for you, minion. Bring me a Dark Unicorn Rib from the beastly monster unicorn known as Binky. In return I will reward you with Legion Tokens. I might possibly offer you an even more rare reward if I find your performance pleasing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Hardcore Paragon Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Chaorrupted Dark Fire
quests.description: The Ultra Chaos Warrior is a very interesting creature. Its head is wreathed in Dark Fire that has been chaorrupted. I might have a use for this material. Fetch me 20 Dark Fire Samples and I will reward you with 100 of my Legion Tokens.

quests.name: The Tools and the Talent
quests.description: There is a LOT of rubble blocking the path to the old market. I'd clean it up but all the Drow and Draconians took our tools from us. If you go and recover some Digging Tools then I will start clearing the entrance.

quests.name: The Shining
quests.description: I've decided that I'm not just going to clean out the entrance but I'm going to update it too. I'm thinking a golden entry way. I'll need something to polish the gold. Gather some Bile Ducts from the Albino Bats and Glow Worms so I can make the gold polish. I'll keep working on the door.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Quest name is a parody of The Shining by Steven King .

quests.name: Your Ad Here
quests.description: Ok, I'm nearly done. Go plant these 12 signs around Dwarfhold to tell the dwarves that the market will be opening again today. The Drow can't usually ready old Dwarvish so we'll be safe. By the time you're done I'll have the new entry cleaned up. Head into the market and talk to Domi.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: More Tools? Really?
quests.description: Thanks for helping Domi but now I need your assistance. I can't work armor with Domi's tools and mine were left in a tunnel when the attack came. The great mole Amadeus now has them. I need those tools before I can start my work.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Domi Coldsteel's Quests . Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Strapping Hero
quests.description: Now I need some leather straps to help me connect the armors. I could use steel rings but Albino Bat Wing Leather makes a good sturdy hinge. Think you can get me 8 Albino Bat Wings that I can use for leather straps?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Domi Coldsteel's Quests . Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The UnderHammers
quests.description: I may be the only living dwarf who knows the secrets of making the elite Underhammers. Long ago they were a group of highly skills dwarven warriors. I want to try and start the UnderHammer Corps anew. There should still be crates of UnderHammer supplies stored in the Great Forge. I'll need all of those.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Domi Coldsteel's Quests . Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fighting Back
quests.description: Ok, I'm ready to start working. Thank you. I need one last thing. I need you to get rid some of the Drow Soldiers patrolling Dwarfhold. We can't let them know that we've started making weapons and armors again. Please defeat 12 Drow Soldiers while Domi and I work.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Domi Coldsteel's Quests . Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shrine of Love
quests.description: This copy of the Mikoto Shrine wasn't in the Yokai Realm when we first arrived. I think this place might be reacting to Ai No Miko's presence. See those two shades? They're her mom and dad- Empress Yuhuan and Emperor Daisho back when they were alive. Why don't you listen in on them for a bit?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kimon ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Hoshi no Tama
quests.description: Yue's nearby to guide you to the next section of the Yokai Realm we scouted. There are Kitsune Spirits roaming in her area. Careful - they're smarter than the Oni. Ward them off to keep them from possessing us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kimon ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat O-Dokuro's Head
quests.description: You may have defeated O-dokuro on the roof, but his head fell onto the top of this pile of bones… and it's still ALIVE (or undead?). Battle your way through the Yokai that are flooding through the rift and TAKE HIM OUT! Until the head is inanimate, we CANNOT pass to confront Kitsune!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat O-dokuro ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat Kitsune
quests.description: You have closed the rift, now the time has come to defeat Chaos Lord Kitsune. Go confront him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat O-Dokuro's Head ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Hung Jury
quests.description: Okay, they're not actually jurors, but they stand in your way nonetheless. Defeat them if you want access to the Judge's chamber.

quests.name: Contempt of Court
quests.description: To defy the Judge is to defy your judgement. If you aren't guilty, prove your innocence in a trial by combat.

quests.name: Drakath, Champion of Chaos
quests.description: Can you defeat Drakath at his full strength, without the use of your powers?
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 80. Note: This quest can only be completed once per week.

quests.name: Chaos Avenger Class
quests.description: It seems you've come across a Chaos Amulet of your own. Drained of its power, you say? That shouldn't be an issue, the Amulet just needs to take back what it has given. The Chaos Lords, the Chaos armies, everything that Drakath touched contains a fragment of the Amulet's power. But most importantly, the Amulet is useless without the source of its power, the Queen of Monsters herself.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 80. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The First
quests.description: In the beginning, there was the first reflection of Drakath where he was a human prince in a kingdom whose name has been lost to time. In circumstances unknown to this day, he became a dragon of Shadow. Defeat this foe and you may well start learning just how powerful your enemy is.

quests.name: The Second
quests.description: Dragonfable is where you will meet the Second reflection, another Drakath, son of King Slugwrath. After being defeated by Alteon, he was banished and became but a simple bandit.

quests.name: The One You Know
quests.description: And now we visit your reflection, the Drakath you are most familiar with. It must have been quite a shock, seeing him rip out the undead soul of Sepulchure knowing what he was like in the other reflections.

quests.name: What Could Have Been
quests.description: A fun little question for you. For us. What would happen if Drakath actually did manage to go unopposed but also learned the power of the Chronomancers? Here you will face your adversary in a way you dare hope to never see in your own time.

quests.name: A Learning Experience
quests.description: Just like a butterfly, the flap of a Chaos Time Fairy's wings can cause ripples of unstable magic to move across all dimensions. Bring me some of their wings, so we can stop this from happening, and keep this bubble secure.

quests.name: Eternal Drakath Set
quests.description: Hero, if I may have a minute of yo-, well, our time, I may have something that may be of interest to you. I see you have in your possession Drakath's original armor in your inventory. I would like to offer you, what we can call an "upgrade" to it. All I require is the armor itself and a few bits and pieces of essences and energies scattered across Lore. I believe you know how to return here so return once you have collected everything.

quests.name: Goated Accessories
quests.description: Oh, are you not ready to become a goat yet? Perhaps these amazing, goat themed rewards will convince you otherwise? All you need to do is /join j6cruise and defeat the Mega-Goat there. Oh and hey, you also need to defeat the Chaos Goats in that map for my transformation quest, so why don't you just go ahead and accept that one as well?

quests.name: Extended Vacation
quests.description: To become a goat, I'll first need to give up all of my Lorely possessions, because a goat doesn't need any!
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50. Notes:

quests.name: Cheeseburger Lover
quests.description: Oh, I forgot we had this. Well, if we're already a goat, I guess we can skip the above quest. Let's just grab a Goat Bone from the Chaos Goats in /j6cruise first for good luck.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Undead Goat in your inventory. Notes:

quests.name: Eat Grass
quests.description: Maa. Maaaah.

quests.name: Run Around
quests.description: Baa. Baaaah.

quests.name: Rescue the Quoklets
quests.description: All the tiny baby quoklets! They've been stolen - by the trees! But YOU'LL get them back. You'll chop them ALL down.

quests.name: Kill the Firestorm Tigers
quests.description: The Firestorm Tigers are very important to the Onslaught. They provide us with transportation, help us in battle, and can even be used as cavalry. Defeat the Tigers; Armored, regular and Cavalry to obtain pieces of armor that we can reforge into new items for you!

quests.name: Slay the Blazebinders
quests.description: Try and prove your worth to the Firestorm Onslaught and the caste of Blazebinders by finding and defeating the Blazebinder within the Forge. You will have to win at least 5 times to prove your worth.

quests.name: Take out the Firestorm Knights
quests.description: The Knights of the Onslaught are tough, disciplined and difficult to defeat. If you think you are tough enough, go ahead and defeat the Knights 10 times.

quests.name: The First Task
quests.description: I walked through an endless, Time(less) Void… and when I stared into the face of Unending eternity itself… I could not look away.

quests.name: The Second Task
quests.description: As Twilight fell, the hairs on the back of my neck stood on Edge. All I could see was Chaos, woven webs, Warriors. And terror.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Third Task
quests.description: It was a swampy place in Arcangrove. The Mud stank, and I felt my Luk run out right before I sank into the muck. A frog-like creature passing by saved my life from a striped beast about to snack on me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Fourth Task
quests.description: Only a true hero can meet Death, wander through his Realm, and live to tell the tale. It was a true test of my strength and skill, leaving that dark land.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Fifth Task
quests.description: I stared into a deep abyss, into the heart of darkness. I never knew The endless Void could be so intimidating. Or so… purple. And the creatures… do not get me started on the GIGANTIC EYELESS ALIEN BOSSES. O_O
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Sixth Task
quests.description: Where does a hero go when they've lost all hope, are turned away from every door? When they're Banished from all they know? Look around you. I found the place, and made it my home. But I am not alone…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Short of Reach
quests.description: The Diabolicals prioritize cleansing this plane from these vile creatures. However, The eldritch entity I'm having trouble with has a particularly long reach. It leaves me quite outmatched. Think you could travel to the Cave of Transformation and exterminate it for me?

quests.name: Stringing Along
quests.description: Since I'm in need of a bow I could use some spider webbing for the string to make sure it's nice and sturdy, and I know just the place to get it. The Blackhorn Tomb is plagued with a plethora of arachnids, but the Bonefeeder is the best source of string I'm looking for. Mind bringing me back some twine?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Review the Reanimated
quests.description: I've been needing to do some reading, you see. I'm looking into some necromancy techniques as I've recently ran into a necromancer with quite the odd quirk. Think you could get some material for me in Noxus' tower?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Resting Place
quests.description: You think you could help with a small errand? I'm looking to pay some respects soon, you think you could get me something that would help me speak to them one last time? A spirit in the Aozora Hills should have something that can help with that.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Health is Wealth
quests.description: Being healthy is extremely valuable, it's all that life really requires to keep going. Medicine is important for maintaining that precious health. If you can brew or purchase some antitoxins from the PotionMistress in the Alchemy Academy, it'd be much appreciated."
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Guilty Conscience
quests.description: I can't say I'm pleased with my choices, but with how things are playing out, I think some reflection would do me some good, mind coming with me? I'm thinking of paying the Ghost Nexus a visit, there's some emotional manifestations that might help me think clearly.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Insomniacs
quests.description: That's enough reminiscing on my part. Let's get back to business, shall we? There's some Dream Larvae in the City of Dreams. They're rather disgusting, leeching off the life of people in deep slumbers. It's of utmost importance that they're purged from this plane. Do this for me, will you?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clingy Creatures
quests.description: Ugh, more of these disgusting abominations. I hate them- really. It would be in best interest to cleanse this place of their presence while we look for what remains of Ira. Being near them gives me a headache as is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Peculiar Feast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Disfigured Aristocrat
quests.description: This is quite troubling.. Ira consumed the heart of the monstrosity you hunted for him, and has taken upon a new form himself. His actions bring great shame on the council. Purging him is necessary, and you're the type that finishes what you've started.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Peculiar Feast ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Villa Eviction
quests.description: Do you have time to do one last round-up? We can't let the remaining Wyrms and Parasites propagate. I also learned, just now actually, that mimics reproduce by laying eggs that look like coins. Explorers would unknowingly take them, and spread them around. Those have to go too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Disfigured Aristocrat ' quest.

quests.name: Hit List
quests.description: You desire to do more for the greater will of the court? Excellent. There are several bounties out for the vermin that plague this plane. Exterminate them, and you'll be rewarded with the uniform our cleansers wear. Frankly, I'm not enough to vanquish the sheer amount of pests inhabiting the area.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Disfigured Aristocrat ' quest.

quests.name: Recover and Recycle
quests.description: Glad you decided to give me a hand! To start off, we'll need to get an adhesive to prepare for what's to come. Fortunately for us (and by us I mean you), the resin from those filth puddles will do perfectly! Think you could grab a few samples?

quests.name: Tormented Fang Uncleansed Grove
quests.description: While I prep the resin, you can take a nice trip to the wilderness known as the /deepforest! It's not that nice you say? Worry not, it'll be a relaxing time for sure! When you get there, grab some branches off a special tree for me, you'll know which one it is when you see it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slice of Life
quests.description: Everything's been going well in grabbing the materials we need so far, but this next one will be a bit more difficult. You're going to be racing with roaches! Sort of gross, I know, but you'll need to take a knife from their table for me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Null and Void
quests.description: The Dark Djinn, a powerful magi from /thevoid, has just what we need - the Spirit Fire enchantment. This is the last thing in order to create our main goal, a sacred knife. Challenge the conjuror and obtain the charm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Summoning and Sealing
quests.description: I've heard from my attendant that you've faced this creature's sibling before, the Eldritch Abomination. That thing was formidable, all right, but the Amalgamation you're about to face is much stronger. Be careful out there!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blood for Darkblood
quests.description: If you wish to gain reputation with the Darkblood and Thunderforge then I can help you… if you help me. I cannot be out in the streets destroying our foes like I wish. Take my place. Destroy 3 type of each invader and I will spread word of your deeds.

quests.name: The Missing Vault
quests.description: To find the Title we must first find my family vault. My grandfather's journal tells where it was but that was before Escherion distorted everything. Scout the area and get the lay of Cornelis.

quests.name: The Shattered Lens
quests.description: If we want to find the hidden vault, we'll have to repair the shattered Lens of Cornelis. then the vault's location will be plain as day. The Len's shattered remains should be scattered around Cornelis. Find all of them and bring them to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Frame Up
quests.description: The Lens of Cornelis won't function without its frame, which is also in pieces. Anise tells me that the Gargoyles have been seen carrying parts of the frame. Destroy the Gargoyles until you've found all 5 parts of the frame.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Lenscrafter
quests.description: Now that you've found all of the pieces, it needs to be reassembled and very few people on Lore have the crafting knowledge and magic ability to do that. You'll need to take them to Cysero in Yulgar's Inn in the town of Battleon. Return to me once you have the completed Lens.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Hidden Vault
quests.description: Now that we have the Lens of Cornelis, finding the vault should be simple enough. Explore the ruins once more - find a golden door with my family seal on it. That is the vault. Enter it and come back to tell me what you find!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Guardian
quests.description: I have no doubt that you will need to defeat the Gargantugoyle before you can enter enter the inner sanctum of the vault and find the Title. Let me know when the Gargantugoyle has been destroyed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: The Family Jewels
quests.description: Only one task remains. To enter the Inner Sanctum of the vault you will need to solve a puzzle. CLICK ON THE DOOR to try the puzzle. Solve it, enter the inner sanctum and bring me the Title, then the rest of the treasures is yours!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Evil Free for All
quests.description: Glory in the name of Dage the Evil, Dark Lord of all the Undead! Bring him 8 frost hearts and he will reward you with gold… and more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Holiday Paragon Pet .

quests.name: Legion Free for All
quests.description: Glory in the name of Dage the Evil, Dark Lord of all the Undead! Bring him 10 frost hearts and he will reward you with gold… and more.

quests.name: Dage's Winter is Coming
quests.description: The day will come when Dage rules all… will you help that day come sooner? Hurry it along by bringing 6 Spirits of Good Will from the Lycan Knights or War Lycan Knights, 6 Spirits of Love from the Silver Knights, and 6 Spirits of Loyalty from King Alteon's Knights.

quests.name: Feed the Yeti
quests.description: GRAWR! Me hungry, want meat. WOLF MEAT! Bring me haunch of Ice Wolf from Frozen Tower and maybe me give you a shiny treasure.

quests.name: Hollowborn Evoker Badge
quests.description: It is darkest just before the dawn. Call forth the light… if you dare. Defeat a dark imp in the dreamforest to complete the quest for an exclusive character page badge.

quests.name: Taking a Boat Trip
quests.description: Do you require a new piece of equipment to use? Is your blade getting dull? Or do you just prefer to have something finely made for once? Let us travel these lands. I will need Sullen and wrathful sounds found in the river /styx. Do not ask questions, retrieve these for me.

quests.name: Clear a Path
quests.description: I have heard in these lands named Fotia there is a resistance here against your Dage. It matters not which Dage, I will hear none of it. Take out some of the local creatures.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Time for Some Spring Cleaning
quests.description: It's still noisy in this particular area. Why is it that your Dage allowed this area to exist in the first place? Take them all out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Fail to the King ' quest.

quests.name: Hollowborn Mansion
quests.description: Want to live in the shadows? Kill the Hollowborn Shadow Raptor Rider to get the key to your new house.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Hollowborn Trainer's Companion in your inventory.

quests.name: Frenzy Feast
quests.description: A manifestation of the new God of the Depths has appeared on sacred ground. This is where Kathool was reborn, and it is where your will to survive will be tested. Dive into the coldest and darkest corner of the sea floor, and ready your hands and teeth. Triumph over Kathool's challenge and enjoy the feast. If you bring back a morsel, I would be willing to share Adeptus relics of great interest.

location.name: God of the Depths Bonus Zone

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mopping Up ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per day.

quests.name: Amensalism
quests.description: You recognize the Necro Adipocere that Kathool sent to the sunken city. I can sense it through our connection to the depths. They stir fascinating emotions within you. Please, feel free to partake in them or destroy them. All visitors are welcome to.

quests.name: Mutualism
quests.description: We're surprised that Merdraconians set aside their pride, and asked to partake in the feast. They've fused with my brethren, transforming into Merdrathoolians. Hmm, they wish to fuse with you as well. I imagine you'll reject them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Symbiogenesis
quests.description: A mollusk and a lamprey feasted on the remains of the sunken city's princess. They fused, becoming the Nereid Princess. She's anxiously preparing herself for an audience with you. Do survive this encounter, or you'll become a part of her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hear the Clatter
quests.description: The master's progeny has opened a bunch of doors downstairs and let a clatter of skeletal minions loose. Kill them, please. The Master will reanimate them at his convenience.

quests.name: Tidy Up
quests.description: Such a mischievous girl. She's been taking the skeletons apart! Clean up all the spare parts, won't you? We don't want anyone to trip over them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Snackies
quests.description: Little Gravelyn must be hungry — she's gotten into the pantry and. Well. She's done something to the pablum. You're going to have quite a mess to clean up.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Progeny
quests.description: New nanny! I have found the master's spawn. She is in the kitchen, and… oh, it's bad.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Houston, We Have A Pablum
quests.description: Giant pablum monster! Fight it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rattle the Bones
quests.description: Kill the Rattlebones! We can't risk them hurting the master's progeny. You'll need to property dismantle them, get their bony little hearts out, so they can't come back to unlife until the master wants them to.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Boost Time
quests.description: There's no sign of Gravelyn anywhere! Unless you want this to be your last day on the job, we must find her soon. I can expand my range and try to detect her whereabouts, but I'll need a little boost. In the form of Doom Energy. Gather some for me from any of the undead monsters around here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Conduction Function
quests.description: Alright. Next I'll need you to help me set up some conducting rods. I'm just a skull — can't do it myself. First, get some nice long femurs from the Skeletal Minions inside. Then, set them up around the perimeter. My range will expand to anywhere there's a "rod".
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Gross
quests.description: Our girl has somehow set a bunch of flesh golems loose, and they've ransacked the necromancers' supply cabinet. You'll have to get everything back before they start raising heck with her father. Also, please kill the flesh golems.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Time to Clean
quests.description: Now, clean up the rest of the tower while I try to determine where she's gone. This place is a disaster..
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Find the Progeny (Again)
quests.description: It appears the master's progeny has locked herself in the top of the tower. You'd better get up there quickly. And take me with you! Wherever the child is, I must be there, too!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Gleeble the Garble!
quests.description: Wow, New Nanny. You've really stepped in it, haven't you? There may still be time to salvage your career, but you're going to have to put an end to that monstrosity. Right. Now.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: One Final Task
quests.description: The master's little princess is VERY good at getting the things she wants. And then hiding them so no new nannies can take them away. Unfortunately, she's gained access to the master's treasure room, and "shared" several of his pieces with the minions. Talk to the Skeletal Minions and Flesh Golems to find out where she's hidden them, and l'll let you keep something as a prize.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Till the Ground
quests.description: The garden out back has gone to slush. The soil needs to be tilled. It's so frozen now that nothing can come through. You'll have to fight your way through the monsters that have appeared in the garden.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Key ' quest. Note: These quests can be only completed once .

quests.name: Beautiful Blossoms
quests.description: Now that the garden has been tilled, we can't leave it empty. Gather some asphodel flowers for me. Did you know that their roots can feed the dead? That's what I've been told. That's why the Chillybones sometimes carry them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Key ' quest. Note: These quests can be only completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Moldy Trees
quests.description: Bring me some grave mold. It grows on the Frozen Treeants that wander the mountains. Not for the garden, but for an elixir. An elixir that will make the pain of my loss less acute.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Key ' quest. Note: These quests can be only completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ichor for Elixir
