quests.description: This elixir is complex. It will take more than just the grave mold to complete it. Frozen Ichor is what I need… the lifeblood that animates the icy monsters nearby. Anything with a heart will have it flowing through its veins.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Key ' quest. Note: These quests can be only completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Frozen Tears
quests.description: There is one more thing I'll need before I can begin to heal my pain: the Tears of the Dead. They are formed like icy crystals when the Chillybones cry. Bring me some.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Key ' quest. Note: These quests can be only completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Keep them Away
quests.description: Please, while I am brewing this elixir, would you chase these monsters away from our house? It would upset my wife so much to see them haunting it like this. Our home should be as peaceful as she was.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Key ' quest. Note: These quests can be only completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Light up the Darkness
quests.description: My wife always liked to keep the house well lit. A beacon to carry us home, she said. Gather some rimecoals from the Frozen Wisps so I can light a fire and give her a beacon.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Key ' quest. Note: These quests can be only completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Return to Blizzy
quests.description: That's everything I need. You can go now, hero. Please… go back to your moglin friends and leave me to my grief.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Key ' quest. Note: These quests can be only completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Something Smells Rotten in EtherStorm
quests.description: The rising fumes of sulfur leaking from the newly opened volcano vents are clouding our air. But the imps which live near the vents contain cores which we can use to construct a suit which is vital if you're going to enter the heart of the volcano where my altar lies. Kill Sulfur Imps for 8 sulfur cores and an Enchanted Lava Bucket.

quests.name: Play With Fire
quests.description: Your suit of flame must be alive if it is to keep YOU alive. The heart of the volcano, while it was dormant, could still see into a Priest's soul, and WE have mental barriers. For a human, and with the volcano awakened by Zellare's death… you will need at least, hmm, yes, 9 Flame Essences from Living Fires.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Set Me On Fire
quests.description: The Essences of Flame you gathered were not suitable for the final coat. For THAT, we will need lava, but you'll need to gather it outside the volcano. You have the Enchanted Lava Bucket, yes? Good. You will gather 8 Bucketfuls of Lava, and I will construct your suit.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Walk Through Fire
quests.description: If you are to walk the path of a Hero, you must journey this next distance alone. One must approach the heart of the volcano with peace in their mind and heart. Find my altar so that I know the volcano accepts you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Everything's On Fire
quests.description: It may be that you will need to recruit help from more than the other two I have called here. Should that be the case, gather 10 Sacred Flame Seeds. We will plant them in the hearts of your cohorts and kindle the flames of battlefire inside them. Go now!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Baby's On Fire
quests.description: I did not think it would come to this.But it appears the enraged dragons which live in our realm have turned on their own. And worse, they threaten the next generation. You must save the young dragons, but they will not go willingly. Be gentle as you bring the 10 of this clutch to me, or I will deal harshly with you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fire In My Heart
quests.description: One of the strongest of our dragon denizens, a brave warrior and clever wielder of the magics, has been particularly susceptible to Desoloth's plan. You must subdue but NOT kill Ssikari, one of our most promising dragons. You will find him inside the volcano.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Something Stinks!
quests.description: Those Sulfur Imps are making the quests in this place REALLY hard to complete. It's hard to battle when you have to hold your nose! Kill 15 Sulfur Imps to reduce the odor a bit.

quests.name: Redeem the Ether-Creatures!
quests.description: Desoloth has spoiled our land. His disruption has allowed Chaos to creep in and taint our creatures. The beautiful thunderbirds of Etherstorm – each aligned with an element – have become twisted, filthy. Bring me 3 of each and we will work to slowly cure them all. In gratitude, you'll receive 6 defender tokens of each element.

quests.name: Investigate the Ether-Taint!
quests.description: We Priests are aghast to find the pure, glorious creatures of Etherstorm have been tainted by Chaos. It does not show… yet… but we can sense it. Desoloth's dissonance, his disruption of our land, has enabled Chaos to take hold. Capture 3 of each Thunderbird so we may study them to find a cure. In gratitude, you'll receive 3 defender tokens of each element.

quests.name: Wolves For Hire
quests.description: Every time we build one of our study and economical homes for a client, the Big Bad Boar has to tear it down his slimes come and demolish it. He's been running the hut industry in this forest for years and his cheap, shoddy huts are worthless! Well, if he wants to play hardball he better bring his A-game! Bring us his Contracts and we'll make it worth your while! Beat up the slimes he hired, and bring me their contracts!

quests.name: Blue Green Prints
quests.description: The Big Bad Boar is at it again. He's His Frogzards have stolen the blueprints to our newest economy homes. We can't really blame him, If we were talentless hacks like he is we might do the same thing. It's no way to run a business. We really need those blueprints back from that filthy pig, would you get them for us? - could you go beat up those hired Frogzards and get them back?

quests.name: Brick Head
quests.description: Oh, thank goodness. We really need your help. The Big Bad Boar has ambushed our latest shipment of bricks . - and time he's done it HIMSELF! It's not our fault that he's too cheap to pay for quality materials but he doesn't need to take ours! We paid for those bricks fair and square and would like them back.

quests.name: Building Supplies
quests.description: To build your house, we're going to need a lot of material. Bring me wooden planks from the Treeant in farm, glue from the Rhison in Bloodtusk, and metal nails from the Protosartrorium in the Crash Site.

quests.name: Cover Your Bases
quests.description: To build your house, we're going to need a strong foundation, and a lot of heat. Bring me river stones from the Zardmen Fishers in River, boulders from Balboa in the Mountainpath, marble from the Earth Elemental in Gilead, and flames from the Fire Elemental in Gilead.

quests.name: Decor
quests.description: Every hero needs a well-decorated home. We won't provide trophies or pictures of your smiling face, but we can take care of the basics. Bring me fabric from the Scarecrow in Farm, paint from the Can of paint in Goose, and glass from the Windows in the Underground Lab.

quests.name: Lascivia Stunk Pretty
quests.description: Hwuargh still miss Lascivia. Sadface. Maybe you can help him feel better? Some gold vases still have Lascivia's smell-good in them. Find some, and bring back to Hwuargh? Being a vase, too, so he have something to keep in.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Talk to the Guards ' quest.

quests.name: You Broke It, You Fix It
quests.description: Fleshy monkey messed up Hwuargh's armor, when fought him earlier. Help Hwuargh fix it now. Bring him leather scraps from other guards and admirers. They jerks, anyway. Hwuargh use it to patch up holes and tears you made.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Elite Energy
quests.description: Hwuargh tell you secret now: Killek cage hidden behind big boulder. Will need a lot of strength to move it - even more than Hwuargh has. Bring Killek Boom Shroom - they grow all over the cave, and they make you more powerful. Also bring some Special Energy Drinks. Only Elite Guards were allowed to have them, but now Hwuargh can, too!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: No Pillow Unturned
quests.description: Now all we need is key to Killek's cage. Hwuargh know it kept under one of the pillows Lascivia lay on. That way, no one else could get to it unless Lascivia say so! She gone now, though, so if we find it, we can take it. Check all the pillows in her lair until you find key. Once you have it, go to big boulder in front of the door near (whatever J puts it by) , wait for Hwuargh.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Elemental Orb Awareness
quests.description: One of the most vital tasks your OtherSelf, from the DragonFable time, needed to accomplish, was to gather all 8 Elemental Orbs. They had to travel far and fight many enemies to do so. All I ask is that you find them in your travels through the dungeon.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Proto-Chaos Beast Battle! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Fight Chaos with Fire!
quests.description: Sometimes one must fight fire with fire… and others you fight Chaos with fire! I believe I can burn the Chaorruption out of my veins, but I will need the flames from 8 Fire Elementals and Shards from 4 Chaos Gemeralds to create the potion. Slay them an bring them to me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Proto-Chaos Beast Battle! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Save Aria
quests.description: Aria was one of the sweetest children, and her golem mirrored that. I created that and her pet, but Chaos freed her from my control, and now she is gone. Interrogate 6 Fire elementals and 5 slimes to see where she has gone. If we are lucky, you may find a clue to her location.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Proto-Chaos Beast Battle! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Time to Travel
quests.description: If you're going to discover the truths about life, the universe, and everything related to timetravel and your destiny, you're going to need more information. Cysero's workshop makes creatures… smarter. Gather clues about Life and the Universe, Everything, AND get your Towel.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Proto-Chaos Beast Battle! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragon Egg... or Junk?
quests.description: Sneevils stole the box your OtherSelf's Dragon Egg was hidden in. To learn the persistence and purity of heart one needs to find their destiny, search through the garbage in their junkyard, as they did. Use the doors to find the right path to reach the monsters, then slay the vultragons until you find the egg!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Proto-Chaos Beast Battle! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dracolich Fortress Detected
quests.description: Do not let the Sp-Eyes placed around the Flying Dracolich Fortress see you. Even if Sepulchure is not here, dire things await you if you are spotted. Kill 4 Sp-Eyes to prevent your detection.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Proto-Chaos Beast Battle! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bone up on the Boss
quests.description: I cannot show you what it is you face in the final test for this lesson, but I believe you will learn the skills you need by slaying 8 of the skeletons in the fortress.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Proto-Chaos Beast Battle! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defend the Town!
quests.description: When your home comes under fire, whether from an insane pyromancer or an undead invasion, a Hero must defend those who look to them for protection. Save Falconreach from 6 Lava Golems and 3 Fire Elementals!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Proto-Chaos Beast Battle! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: ChickenCows, Bacon, and Battle!
quests.description: Bacon… the Void… Element X… however your OtherSelf called it, the element had powers the more mundane one did not. You cannot recreate the journey your OtherSelf in DragonFable took, but you CAN experience what it is like to work with Zeuster. Slay Horcboars for Protein to keep up your strength, and get the 8 spell runes from Chaotic Chickens.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Proto-Chaos Beast Battle! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The 2nd Proto-Chaos Beast
quests.description: Take on one of the DragonFable Hero's most memorable challenges. Face Fluffy, Sepulchure's Dracolich. The beast would have been great, IF it had been allowed to follow its own path!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Proto-Chaos Beast Battle! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Goblin Down Water
quests.description: These Water Goblins have been enlisted by the Queen to assist Sa-Laatan in its destruction of farm lands. Take them out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Earth Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Spawn of the Salt Sower
quests.description: Sa-Laatan is known for creating forces by breaking pieces off of its own body. Slay these Spawn so that we may reach the lake where Sa-Laatan dwells.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Earth Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Faerie in Danger
quests.description: Sa-Laatan's forces are attempting to capture the Faeries from the wood! We must save them! Without them, Mobius will not be able to grow crops, regardless if Sa-Laatan is stopped!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Earth Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fertility Ward
quests.description: With the help of the Faeries you rescued, Escherion and I were able to create Wards that will reverse and nullify the effects of Sa-Laatan and its forces' Salt Sowing. Place them throughout town and put a stop to its plague.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Earth Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Path to Sa-Laatan
quests.description: The Wards have weakened Sa-Laatan's forces. Now all that is left is to clear a path to the lake! Cut down those Goblins and Spawns and let us retrieve that Orb!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Earth Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Water Orb
quests.description: Sa-Laatan stands between us and the Water Orb. Let us defeat this beast and secure the fourth Elemental Orb!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Earth Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Water. Earth. Energy? Air.
quests.description: The Queen's disciples are causing an imbalance in the elements. Only you can defeat them and restore balance to Lore.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Water Orb ' quest.

quests.name: A Hymn of Ice and Fire, and Light and Dark
quests.description: The Queen's disciples continue to wreak havoc upon Lore. If you have the time, they could be taught another lesson.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Ice Orb ' quest.

quests.name: Forces of Chaorruption
quests.description: It seems like the Queen has unleashed the full power of her Chaos army. We must not stop here! Face the Chaorruption, and we will press on!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Ice Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Phantom Chaos
quests.description: Even the ghosts of the fallen have been twisted by the Queen's magic! We mustn't let them stop us! Lay those Chaos Ghosts to rest!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Ice Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Spies of the Queen
quests.description: Even now, the Queen watches our every move, studying us. We must not allow her any further insight! Destroy her Chaos Sp-eyes!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Ice Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Portal of Chaos
quests.description: The Queen has made it almost impossible to move forward. You know what they say! "The only way out is through!" And that means we need to go "through" the Plane of Chaos! Collect Weak Chaotic Energy from the Chaos enemies in the area and I can construct you a portal to the Plane!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Ice Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragons Felled By Chaos
quests.description: Even the Dragonkin were not safe from the Queen's reign. It seems the Queen has taken advantage of the corpses that she has created to expand her army. Defeat these Chaos Dracoliches so we may continue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Slain Children ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Queen's Generals
quests.description: The Queen has unleashed her Chaos Generals, beings of immense Chaos magic. They will not be easy to overcome, but we must if we wish to move forward!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Slain Children ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Portal of Chaos II
quests.description: You must once again travel to the Plane of Chaos if we are going to move forward. This time, the Portal will require even more Potent Chaotic Energy. Face the Queen's Chaos Dracoliches and Generals to collect the Energy we will need and construct the portal!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Slain Children ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The First Champion of Chaos
quests.description: The very first Champion of Chaos, the paragon of Chaotic magic. If we are going to stop the Queen, we are going to have to go through that thing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Giant of Chaos ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Queen of Monsters
quests.description: This is it. The final battle. Even with all the Elemental Orbs, this will not be an easy battle. Do not worry, my friend. The Heroes of Balance are at your side! We will not be defeated today! For all those we lost, it is time to end this!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Giant of Chaos ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mommy Was Very Bad
quests.description: The Proto Chaos Champion is helping the Queen escape her prison! Defeat them both so that Lore can once again be at ease.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Queen of Monsters ' quest.

quests.name: All-Seeing Argus
quests.description: I won't be able to catch up on lost history efficiently while I'm…distracted by a grudge. When I was an inmate in the Phlegethon's Prison, one of the jailers treated me particularly cruelly. Bring me the eye of Argus Panoptes to make up for my pain and suffering. You'll find him through the door to the fiery river of blood.

quests.name: Catch-Up Work
quests.description: Do me a favor and investigate the Legionnaires in /DageFortress to help me catch up on current affairs. Then, I'll give you access to my scroll on Legion Lorekeepers and Soothsayers. Perhaps you'll find a prophecy about you.

quests.name: Underworld Judicial System
quests.description: Do you know of Aeacus, Minos, and Rhadamanthys in /Judgement? Perhaps you've already encountered the Judges of the Underworld. I was…sentenced to imprisonment by them, and I'd like some compensation. If you help me with this, I'll provide access to another scroll.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dry Dog Food
quests.description: Would you round up the Cerberus Pups guarding the banks of the Phlegethon? I just want to make their handlers' jobs harder. If you do, I'll give you access to a scroll about the Legion's darkest dungeons.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hydra-olics
quests.description: Would you mind culling the Styx Hydra numbers in /Styx? It'll let Charon's ship sail faster, and put us in better standing with General Lachesis. If you do, I'll give you access to a scroll about the Styx's Legionnaires.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Temptation of Oblivion
quests.description: The Mourners wander the shores of the Lethe, weeping until they pass out. It's quite distracting. I can hear them through the door. Get them to be quiet, and I'll give you a scroll about the Lethe. Don't go swimming. Really. It's more tempting than it looks.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Don't Look Back
quests.description: Do me a favor. I'm a scholar, not a warrior. I can't observe Oizys up close with my skills. If you could get up close and draw a sketch of them, I'll give you a scroll about the General of the Lethe.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Miseria
quests.description: Our efforts to update the Legion's archives are going well, but I have a feeling we lost memories in the Lethe. We could gather them ourselves, if the miserable Daemon known as Oizys wasn't waiting for us. It can't be permanently expelled, but destroying its current form will give us time to work.

quests.name: Sparring with Chaos
quests.description: To stay well-practiced, all members of Drakath's militia spar against each other regularly. You should do this too, if you want to join us. Make your way up to the training room, and fight against any combatants you find. If you're not sure where the training room is, well… figuring that out is part of your challenge

quests.name: Expect the Inquisitors
quests.description: Now, more than ever, the forces of order outnumber the Chaos to a vast degree. One of our missions, then, is to cut down their numbers and allow Chaos to thrive. Go to the /Citadel. There, you will find members of a magic-loathing Inquisition. Defeat 10 of their Guards, and then return to me. Bring me their tabards as proof.

quests.name: A Bounty on Evil
quests.description: Evil, too, is the enemy of Chaos - it is just as much a force of Order as Good is. Travel to /Doomwood and defeat 10 Doomwood Soldiers. Return to me when you have finished, and bring me their tabards as proof. I will pay you a bounty for each one.

quests.name: Impress the Militia
quests.description: There's a clan of dragons near the Lair Crossroads that are some of the most dangerous in all of Lore, the Razorclaws. For your training, I'd like for you to try to slay one. Bring me its horn as proof of your victory.

quests.name: Digging for Recruits
quests.description: Haven't embraced your chaos yet? That's fine, as long as you're alright with working for a little less. Recently, a Chaos Tunneler breached the perimeter but escaped before our recruits were able to finish it off. Your mission, find where it retreated to and take it down.

quests.name: Gather Snowman Pieces
quests.description: Ok, so first we're going to build a snowman. We'll need a bunch of tightly packed snow - get some from the Snow Golems off to the right. Get a couple of nice, big branches for the arms, too. (Available once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bait the Trap ' quest.

quests.name: Gather Snowman Decorations
quests.description: Ok, now we'll need some things to decorate the snowman with. I'm thinking coal - there are some coal imps nearby, so that's an easy one. And also a carrot, for the nose. Maybe you'll find something in the village? (Available once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bait the Trap ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Grab some Garb
quests.description: And now we just need to dress you like a kid. All the kids are gone, so you can't borrow THEIR clothes. But you know… those Frost Goblin outfits have just the right look…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bait the Trap ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Bait and Gifts
quests.description: Ready to be bait? Blizzy has built your snowman - err, well, really it's more of a snowmoglin - just up the hill to the right. Just get your disguise on, and go sit by it and wait.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bait the Trap ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest at least once. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Check out the Cave
quests.description: What's in the cave? Could it be the lost kids? You'd better go in and find out! But stay on your toes - he probably hasn't left them unguarded!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bait the Trap ' quest. | Must have completed previous quest at least once. Note: This quest can be only completed once .

quests.name: Memory #2 - Who Started the Fire
quests.description: Xan's fire spells are setting everything on fire! We have to stop the village from burning. Destroy as much Arcane Fire as you can find. Save the moglins!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Activate the Spacetimebobulator ' quest.

quests.name: Memory #2 - Moglins on Ice
quests.description: Xan is using his newfound powers of cryomancy to FREEZE my poor moglin friends! Please, you gotta help me chip them out of those ice blocks!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Memory #2 - Ice Ice Golems
quests.description: Xan - sorry, "Xanta Claus" - has made the very ice come to life! He's set a horde of animated ice minions upon the village. We have to stop them! Fight them, and take their Ice Golem Cores. That will prevent them from coming back to life.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Memory #2 - Xanta Claus Can't Come
quests.description: We're safe out here for the moment. There's only one thing left to do - stop Xanta Claus! He's hiding out in the ice cave to the north. I'll just wait here. Good luck!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Activate the Spacetimebobulator
quests.description: Activate the Spacetimebobulator to summon the next festive Frostval experience!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Endless Winter Collection Quest
quests.description: Icicle Imps and Ice Ki'lks have been feuding for millennia. Bring the Icy Heart of one of those frostbitten glacier suckers and I'll give you a cool new character page badge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Icicle Imp Quest Pet and Endless Winter Collection Chest in your inventory.

Icy Treasure Chest and Quest's Quest.name: Icy Treasure Chest and Quest's Quest

quests.name: Ice Treasure Chest Quest
quests.description: To open this chest, you must find the Ice Chest key. Defeat a Frostspawn Fangbeast for a chance to get the key.

quests.name: Impress the Arachnomancer
quests.description: …Hey! You want to be an Arachnomancer, Legendary Hero? Bring me that 8 Weaver Medallions from a Chaos Weaver Mage , Dreadspider, and DreadArysa, and I'll see to it that Ravenloss hears of your bravery! Why? Cause I like ya!

quests.name: Too Hot To Handle
quests.description: Dragon's armor can't be forged normally, it must use metals that can withstand extreme heat. That, of course, means it has to be forged in even more extreme heat. Living Magma comes close, but it only gets hot enough if we use imp embers as a catalyst. You can get Living Magma from the Living Fire in Firestorm. You'll find imp embers there too, as they are produced by sulfur imps.

quests.name: Too Cold To Hold
quests.description: Of course, not just anything can withstand the extreme temperatures that we use to forge our armor. Elemental Stone does not burn at any temperature, which makes it ideal for creating the cauldrons and casting molds we use. If you'd like to help me collect some, you can find Earth Elementals in Earthstorm and in the Dragonplane.

Immortal Lich King Quest Pet's Quest.name: Immortal Lich King Quest Pet's Quest

quests.name: Immortal Lich King Collection Badge
quests.description: Legion Paladins have long refused to bow down to me. The arrogance will NOT be tolerated. Venture into the Legion Arena and bring me the dry, shriveled bones of a Dark Legion. Now.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Immortal Lich King's Collection and Immortal Lich King Quest Pet in your inventory.

Immortal Sacrificial Skull Quest Pet's Q.name: Immortal Sacrificial Skull Quest Pet's Quest

quests.name: Immortal Sacrificial Skull's Gift
quests.description: Nothing is wasted in the underworld. Flesh feeds beasts. Spirits feed Dage's Forge. Go. Slay one of the Dark Makai in the /Dagerecruit zone. Its life force will enrich the realm.

quests.name: warm MILK!
quests.description: Hey, ya know what always worked for me as a kid? Warm milk did the trick, I'm pretty sure that there are some…some… oh, you know…some jimmyjohns….those, uh.. COWS… over at the Farm. If you look around the farm you should be able to find it. Milk I mean… not cows. Look for four Milk Bottles. If you bring me some maybe I can get to sleep.

quests.name: COLD MEDICINE!
quests.description: COLD MEDICINE! Sorry, that was loud, wasn't it? Cold medicine usually has something that knocks me right out. I know I should wait until I have a…ya know… a cold, but I really need to get some rest. I heard that those guys… sorry, those uh… River Fishermen Fishmen by the…uh… the river, they captured a crate of the stuff not too long ago. Could you get me some, please?

quests.name: Cup of Tea, please!
quests.description: I know what would help. A nice hot tup of key… er… I mean cup of tea. I've heard that the Kittairans of Noobshire over to the west carry on them a very strong tea. It's so relaxing, tea, don't you think? I think so. See if you can get me a pouch of tea, would you?

quests.name: Music Box for the Sleepless
quests.description: Ok, ok ok, check it out. ok So, like…..what was I going to say? OH, right. I've heard that some people fall asleep to music. I know that the Dwakels in the Willow Creek caves sometimes carry… um… music boxes on them. I used to have a music box that played my favorite lullaby, but a green slime came along and ATE it! I'm be ever so grateful if you could find one it for me.

quests.name: Qualifying Quest
quests.description: Time to see if you are ready to be a Spellword Artifact Hunter! Find me this super specific rock… From a being made of rock!

items.name: A Rock Inanitas Is Making You Keep

quests.name: Rest for the Not Very Wicked
quests.description: To start off this hunt, go talk to the woman of dreams! She has a necklace artifact that puts the wearer to sleep! However, it'd be rude to just take it from her! Make her a Necklace of Awakeness with some materials near her! I heard that if you take a turtle shell and put some coffee beans from a bear it, it makes an Orb of Awakeness! Then all you need is a few pieces of string from some trolls and you'll be able to make the Orb for her!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pisces Pieces
quests.description: Not all Artifacts are in one piece! Like this Shield from a big river fish! Gather all of the pieces for me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Be Ebil
quests.description: Weird. This artifact hilt says something about "beat" and "ebil" and "dropping" and "limbs"? Also something about a "Secret G-Rave Key"? Not sure what any of this means!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eternal, Never-Ending Darkness and Death Lance
quests.description: Something tells me that a true lord of the shadows would be hiding this weapon, that's just a really specific guess.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: It Takes a Special Brand of Glory
quests.description: Huh, I just got a report about a sword from another timeline called "the Brand of Glory"! I heard that a Chaotic version of the undead dragon it is made from *that* timeline is has it here in *this* timeline!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: 1st Trial
quests.description: I have a friend, well more of a person I know and they tolerate me, anyway, he's always stumbling, and I mean *literally* stumbling on these artifacts. I call him Lucky David!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: 2nd Trial
quests.description: I heard of this wyvern that lives on the new continent and it's said to hold a special artifact. Try fighting it a bunch of times and see the rumors are true.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: 3rd Trial
quests.description: Sometimes to get an artifact, it's going to cost you a bit of gold for tips, buying it off someone, or for transportation. I know this one girl who would happily take all your money. Also, remember the word: sirbuh.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: 4th Trial
quests.description: There is a dragon that I'm very fond of. Really awesome looking! Anyway, I heard from his friend Stalagbite that if you give him a good sparring match, he'll give you a shard of an artifact! But I'm just warning you, he can be really sharp sometimes!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hubris
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: The Morse code decoded is "1 DRAGON OF THE TRIANGLE 100 ENDLESS UNDEAD 50 REGROWN HEADS".

quests.name: Fortitude
quests.description: Hero, I made a weird ciphered text for you to figure out as your test for Fortitude! Good luck!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Text decoded with Caesar cipher is "one ice plane guardian/one hundred (1 1) endless wraps/fifty banished gods".

quests.name: Dual Wielding
quests.description: Congrats! You have forged replicas of Fortitude and Hubris! While separated, they are exTremely powerful weapons. However, their trUe power unleashed when they aRe wielded together! This fInal task will allow you to make seNse of an eniGma that has existed on Lore for millenia. This will allow you to control both of their powers at once! C'est magnifique!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Inanitas' Birthday Quest
quests.description: Hello there, friend! Good to see you today. I brough some cake but a tiny blue Moglin ate it all before we could get to it… But that doesn't mean we dont have surprises in store for you! There's one area in particular that feels like home to me. The /timeinn. Have you been? The challenges, the rewards, it all feels so…familiar. Could you gather me something from there? I wish to take a closer look.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Death, Taxes, and Tentacles
quests.description: Across every possibility and dream, what is constant? What remains the same no matter how much we struggle? Part of my studies was to peer through the windows of our observatory and ponder this question. But there are countless windows, and I am only mortal. To this end, will you please bring me pieces of the Death you know from /underrealm and the Kathool you know from /deepchaos?

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Guiding Transience
quests.description: Your young world, as well as its many parallels, follow the grooves and ruts of the timelines that came before. That means, many of the same events happen over and over. That too, I have observed and contemplated. But in your young world, there are sights never before seen. Will you please bring me pieces of the Manticore from /venomvaults and pieces of the Elemental Attempts in /worldscore?

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Infinity Titan's Rewards
quests.description: Your charge is to protect the universe. No matter what it costs. You can control space and time — and reality - with a snap of your fingers. That much power requires energy. Gather more from the Spacetime Energy in /timestream to regain your energy and get even more rewards.

quests.name: Sweet Dreamlands are Made Like This
quests.description: I do not like this Dream we are in, Hero. This maze of your mind. It feels… deadly. We need to get to the Command Post as fast as possible! There must be something that would help us find our destination. Find it, Hero! We cannot delay, not when this realm is crawling with twisted SkyPirates!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Granny's Final Request ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Steamed Punks
quests.description: One of those rotten recruits has played a prank on me, and gotten all of my punks wet! I can't light fuses with wet, limp tinder! Can you gather cannonballs? The only place I know to get them right now is from the Sky Pirate Dragons still infesting my ship while I wait for my punks to dry out?

quests.name: The Mind Goggles
quests.description: Why yes, these are amazing googles. I need a back-up pair, though, in case anything should happen to them. Can you find me the material to make the glass for the lenses? We've got bags of sand lying around to mop up oil spills and I'll also need SteamOcto Tentacles to provide suction to hold the glass in, so bring me 7 of those.

quests.name: SkyPirates Slaying Strategies
quests.description: Hero! We need time in order to plan how best to take out this Pirate trash completely! Kill 15 of the closest invaders so that we can regroup and plot our next move.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Through the Gates of the Silver Portal ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Strategic Alarm Sequence
quests.description: These wicked Pirates have stolen the alarm codes! If we can't find the codes and turn the alarms on in the right order, the rest of the Fleet will never know we've been invaded! Kill the Pirates, find the codes (Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta, Epsilon), and turn the alarms from white to red in the right order!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: SkyPirate Shot-caller Neutralized
quests.description: Hero! The Dravir SkyPirate Sergeant is up on the roof! If you can take him out, maybe all the rest of these SkyTrash will falter without direction! Show him that the Department of Strategization is NOT easily invaded!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: SkyPirate Map Hunt
quests.description: Oh, Hero! I wonder if any of these SkyPirates are carrying directions to their Hideout! Defeat and loot them! I've heard tales that they tear up their maps into 5 pieces so that no one Pirate can betray the location!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: SkyShip Chase Scene
quests.description: Quick Hero! They've stolen vial, secret documents! There's a skeleton crew in Phereless! Go after them and get those documents back! Avoid the bombs these dastarly Pirates will toss at your ship and make it back before they completely take over!

quests.name: SkyPirate Annihilator!
quests.description: You are a famous Hero; everyone knows that! This swarm of SkyPirates will give you an opportunity to show off your battle prowess! Kill 100 SkyPirates and reap the rewards of fame (and all that gold and exp)!

quests.name: Deserter in the Ranks
quests.description: Seek out the Gold Draconian, Hero. In a final act of preservation, he abandoned his crew when he learned that he was to be Chaorrupted. He has hidden in the lair, and possesses the key we need to get inside the gates. Kill him and bring back the key.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' SkyPirate Map Hunt ' quest.

quests.name: Secure the Ship
quests.description: We need to get inside, but their security is vigilant. You need to take out the Security Pirate, and do it quickly. Once you get him out of the way, seek out all the red alarms and disable them so we can move in. Once you locate the Headquarters, check back in so we can proceed with our plans.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Infiltration is a Go
quests.description: It's a disgrace! I hear that the SkyPirates have the information I need, but they've let it fall by the wayside, mingling with the discarded refuse on the floor. Search through those items to find some very important papers. One of the Skypirates has a code we need. Do what it takes, even killing, to get that code.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Elluding Capture is not an Option
quests.description: The alarm has sounded, despite the lengths we went through to make this as quiet and efficient as possible. The SkyPirates are coming, Hero, bent on our destruction. Do not, under any circumstances, get captured. It looks as if you have about 20 of them to fight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Don't Get Caught Weak in the Knees
quests.description: The Skypirate General is dangerous, so dangerous that if he succeeds in beating you, the SkyGuard will be annihilated. If you succeed in weakening him to where he as only a little health left, he will be empowered by Chaos and attack you with double the strength. Be careful!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Master Exos' Keep
quests.description: Exos is determined to keep you from reaching him. He fears attacks from all sides. The path to his keep is lined with SkyPirate Guards and Spy-Eyes. Slay them all and reach his inner fortress!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Break a Beast! ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Break the Chains
quests.description: Breaking the chain of command will ensure that Exos cannot focus his attention on you… or his attacks against Swordhaven. Defeat 2 SkyLords and 5 Commanders to accomplish your goal.

quests.name: Eye Spy Victory
quests.description: Exos' sp-eyes are one way he keeps track of every creature in his keep. He trusts no one and nothing anymore. Defeat 8 Sp-Eyes so that he cannot follow your movements.

quests.name: Discover the Passage
quests.description: You cannot pass while the SkyWatcher still stands. Slay him and progress into Exos' Keep.

quests.name: Defeat Exos
quests.description: Now is the time! Avenge your sister's death and show Drakath what is Chaos is caused when brother is turned against brother!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Master Exos' Keep ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Exos
quests.description: Now is the time! Avenge your sister's death and show Drakath what Chaos is caused when brother is turned against brother!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Scout Ahead
quests.description: Being aware of your surroundings is key for any situation - but in this case, you're doing my grunt work. Scout out the area and come back to me when you're done. I would suggest you try to avoid being devoured by the creatures that infest it as you do so.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Summoning and Sealing ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Gluttonous Slithering
quests.description: You saw Gorewyrms inside the villa, did you not? Those damnable beasts rot all life around them with their mere presence. They are a plague on the environment, and are reviled even among the creatures we Diabolicals typically encounter. Exterminate any you see, and bring some of their slime back to me. Perhaps an in-depth study could help us understand their 'unique' abilities.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Summoning and Sealing ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Relics of Bygone Days
quests.description: The armory holds many Diabolical heirlooms. Removing revolting parasites and Gorewyrm guards is necessary to preserve the history of the Great Court. Extermination is the only answer.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Summoning and Sealing ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rapacious Desires
quests.description: The Lord of this villa amassed a large amount of the local reserves, divided it among the people, and claims to have kept a coin or two for himself. This land has been long abandoned, and devoured by the impure. Their gold has more value in our pockets than it does sitting in untouched vaults.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Summoning and Sealing ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Uninvited Guests
quests.description: The filth that squats in this long deserted estate is long overdue for an eviction. There is no need to give them notice, nor to squander our precious time doing so. Take the Parasites and Gorewyrms out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Summoning and Sealing ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Key of Life
quests.description: I'm almost certain of it. What lays past the cellar door are great horrors. Backtrack to the treasury, the key HAS to be in the hoards of greed coveted by the previous lord of this villa.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Summoning and Sealing ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Proper Procedures
quests.description: The Lord here was careful about making sure no one could access this chamber. It appears they've also used a sealing spell in addition to the physical lock. Retrieve a Necrotic Tome from a Lightguard Caster in /noxustower so that we may dispel this incantation.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Summoning and Sealing ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Peculiar Feast
quests.description: By the Great Court! It appears that the foul beast lurking in the cellar is at the center of some sort of perpetual ritual. How long has it been here? Eons? Oh, well… it matters not. Cleanse this place of its presence at once!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Summoning and Sealing ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Pick of Destiny
quests.description: Madra needs help. If you wish to pick your destiny and GET the pick of Destiny I've been given for you, use the portal to journey to her and give her this vial.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Twisted Land Burns ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Bad Memory
quests.description: Freeing my people is my fondest wish, and if you defeat Vath, we will be free to reclaim our city once more… but if you try to defeat him, you will fail. It's important to know the enemy that you are up against. You must find the Stone of Memory. It keeps a magical record of our city and its people. It will show you what Vath is capable of. Find the Stone of Memory and see what it must show you, then return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Give Snowbeard His Gold ' quest.

quests.name: Squeeze Water from Stone
quests.description: We want to see Vath gone as much as you do, but I have to care for my people. If you help make things easier for us, then I will tell you how to get into the Upper City and to Vath. First, my people need water. On the mountain path leading here, you must have seen some Balboas. These stone creatures hold within them stones that magically store water. Bring me 3 Water Stones.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Give Snowbeard His Gold ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Carrion Carrying On
quests.description: My fellow Dwarves and I have been treated worse than animals since Vath took over. Many of us have been worked until fatigue and illness overcomes us. The beaks of the Vultragons on the mountain path can be used to make powerful medicine. Bring me 6 Vultragon Beaks so that I may heal our sick.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Give Snowbeard His Gold ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bagged Lunches
quests.description: Hero, we need food. Dragonlord Vath's Drow make us work endlessly with almost no food, and our strength is giving out. Each of the Drow soldiers carries a small pouch of food on them, and they eat in front of us just to be cruel. Teach these monsters a lesson and bring me 8 Food Pouches to help feed the hungry.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Give Snowbeard His Gold ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Radiant Lamps
quests.description: Dwarves have excellent eyesight, but even we cannot work in the pitch black mines of Dwarfhold. Here in the mountain, there are burrowing Glow Worms who feed on a mineral called uranium. For some reason, their steady diet of this mineral makes them glow in the dark. Slay a few of these beasts and gather 3 Vials of Glow Ichor from them, so that we may make lamps.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Give Snowbeard His Gold ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Having a Blast
quests.description: Chaos Dragonlord Vath does not give us many tools to dig with. We do not want to work for him, but until you take him out, we must keep delivering gold and gems to save our skins. To make our task easier, we normally use small amounts of blasting powder that we make out of bat droppings. Explore Dwarfhold and gather 8 Piles of Bat Guano, then return to me with your… findings.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Give Snowbeard His Gold ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Secret Weapons
quests.description: I have one last favor to ask of you, Hero. We need weapons. We will not try and free ourselves until Vath is gone from Dwarfhold, but when the time comes, we want to be ready to fight. Gather 8 Weapons from the Draconians or Drow and bring them back to me, so that I may hide them in a secret location.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Give Snowbeard His Gold ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Balance the Scales
quests.description: Vath will barely allow us to use tools to dig with, and the tools that we get are second rate at best. We get no gloves. We get no helmets. But there is a simple solution for all these problems… Draconian Scales. We can use the tough scales to reinforce our tools as well as make scale mail gloves and helmets. Please, I need you to bring me 6 DRACONIAN SCALES.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 4 Dwarfhold .

quests.name: Beachin' Summer Collection Quest Pet
quests.description: You'll want to head to the /baconcatlair to slay one of them super-fancy cloud sharks. They swim up in the sky all year 'round. Not like the sharks on this here beach.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Islander Quibble Quest Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: Holiday Cheer? No Thank You.
quests.description: So everyone's angry and tearing each other apart. Everything still LOOKS far too happy, and that just will not do! Confiscate as many Frostval gifts, decorations and desserts you can find. We've got to get this place looking worthy of Dage!

quests.name: Not THIS blight!
quests.description: Word has it, Yorumi has a team of clerics working on a cure for the black sleet. That means we'll have to step up our game! Take this concentrated mixture, and dump it on all the moglins, humans, and animals that you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' Feed the Greed ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: And Your Little Deer, Too
quests.description: Frostvale is full of adorable deer that people have long held up as a symbol of the holiday season. Want to strike a heavy blow to their morale? Slay the deer. We'll follow behind you and raise them as blighted minions.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' Sleet Samples ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Recyclable!
quests.description: Let's be honest, all of our troops are expendable. But golems can be used again and again! Kill 10 Ice Golems and bring me their heartstones. If we inscribe the right runes on them, not only can we control them, we can reanimate them when they fall in battle.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' Blighted Deer ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: No Cure For You.
quests.description: I have some bad news for you. That cure I mentioned earlier? They actually managed to make one. But never fear, we haven't lost yet! They've been handing it out to the villagers and moglins. All you have to do is go out and take it from them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' Frosty Hearts ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Spread the Blight
quests.description: Now, all that's left is to keep churning out White Stalkers! Attack the local villagers — either human or moglin will do. Once they have fallen, we'll raise them as blighted minions to do Dage's bidding.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' On the Offensive ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Souls For Dage
quests.description: So, you want to help Dage? Just keep battling! Fight every villager you see, human or moglin, and bring their pure, untainted souls to me, and I'll let you exchange them for a reward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' Inoculation ' quest.

quests.name: Breaking In
quests.description: We've seen the cave leading to Dage's Mt. Bleakwind lair at the top of the mountain, but I know he's not scaling the peak every time he comes and goes. He must be using a second, lower entrance to get inside. Find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the 'Spread the Blight' quest or the ' Inoculation ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Break the barrier
quests.description: It looks like a barrier spell has been cast, preventing anyone but Dage from traveling further into the mountain. The ice golems are carrying stones that appear to be enchanted. If you get all of the stones, you should be able to break the spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' Breaking In ' quest given by Yorumi & Eienyuki . Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Final Ward
quests.description: Looks like there's another barrier blocking access to the next chamber. The sounds emanating from it suggest that this is where you'll fine Frostfang. Perhaps the stones carried by the frost golems will help you gain entrance.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' Break the barrier ' quest given by Yorumi & Eienyuki . Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat Frostfang (Evil)
quests.description: You found Frostfang's lair, and he's still inside! Take him down before he goes on the attack again! And if you find whatever might be giving him his energy, it may be wise to destroy that as well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the previous quest or the ' The Final Ward ' quest given by Yorumi & Eienyuki .

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Frostfang (Evil)
quests.description: You're still looking for a good fight? How about burning off that extra adrenaline on Ultra Frostfang? That should provide a challenge for you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Defeat Frostfang (Evil)' quest (one time only).

quests.name: Icing the Golems - for Evil!
quests.description: Now that all of the barriers have been broken, ice golems keep spilling out of I've got some gold for you if you'll go in and smash 10 of 'em so they'll stay put.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Defeat Frostfang (Evil)' quest (one time only).

quests.name: Golems Really Frost Me Bad
quests.description: The frost golems are becoming a problem, too, even though they're coming from deeper inside the mountain. Same deal, kid - go in and smash a few, and I'll reward your efforts!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Defeat Frostfang (Evil)' quest (one time only).

quests.name: Celestial Stones
quests.description: Did you know that we Celestials sometimes use crystals to channel our energy? We harvest them from the Celestial Moonstones, Celestial Sunstones, and Star Sapphires that you see hovering nearby. But we can't use them unless they're completely pure, and often they are not. If you can find me some perfect stones, I'll gladly reward you them.

quests.name: The Celestial Realm
quests.description: I may be staying in Aegis now, but I haven't forgotten my home, the Celestial Realm. Would you mind checking in on it for me? I've heard they still have a bad Infernal problem, and I'm worried. If the rumors are true, please destroy any infernals you find. I, and the other Celestials, would be eternally grateful.

quests.name: Find the rest of J6
quests.description: Hero, my chassis and external motor units have been misappropriated by ectoplasmic ex-life forms. Hypothesis is that they engage in an exodus from the Underworld. Recover 2 Cyborg Arms, 2 Cyborg Legs, and 1 Cyborg Chassis from the creatures in the immediate area.

quests.name: Mer'Angel Hunting
quests.description: You willl need to locate target 0719 and take her into custody. The Client wishes to meet with her. Motive: undisclosed. Your purpose is to secure her person. I will give you further instructions then. The first step is to locate her and engage in dialogue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Captain Kirkland's Shoes
quests.description: Thanks to Peachii.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Recover J6's Head ' quest. | Must have completed the J6's Extreme Bounty quest. Note: Quest title is a parody of Captain Kirk .

quests.name: Vulcanize the Spork
quests.description: If you think about it, Vulcans are just ultra serious space elves. Space elves that their food SERIOUSLY. So I need you to search the mess hall for the legendary GOLDEN SPORK OF JUSTICE.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Recover J6's Head ' quest.

quests.name: Master Chef's Spatula
quests.description: Thanks to Peachii.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Recover J6's Head ' quest.

quests.name: Commander Jane's Away
quests.description: Thanks to Peachii.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Recover J6's Head ' quest.

quests.name: Alien
quests.description: Thanks to Peachii.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Recover J6's Head ' quest.

quests.name: J6's Extreme Bounty
quests.description: J6 is a cybernetic bounty hunter who has a score to settle with the creatures aboard the Skylab Z Space Station. Unfortunatley… he only has a head right now, which you can find on the Bridge of the S.S. Paladin next to Artix. So, he was hoping you would do the Bounty Hunting for him. These are optional and extremely challenging bonus missions for crazy people only.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Recover J6's Head ' quest.

quests.name: Space 'Dragon' Ballz
quests.description: Gather the 7 Space Dragon Balls to summon the Eternal Dragon to get a wish!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Recover J6's Head ' quest.

quests.name: Crush The Crashers
quests.description: Filthy McGee's gang have started closing in on the wedding. We've got to take care of them QUIETLY. Remember, this is Cinazul's special day. She can't know any of this is happening! Take care of 13 Bulletless Bandits. I'll keep my honey-lumpkins distracted.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' MEGA-GOAT! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Marriage Is Full Of Pitfalls
quests.description: Those bandits keep coming. You're going to need to dig some pitfalls to trap these goons. Just make sure that the holes aren't too close to the dancefloor.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' MEGA-GOAT! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Favorable Outcome
quests.description: These guys might be doing us a favor. The Bandits Guns aren't only out of bullets, they're totally sealed up. We might as well collect a few of their guns to give away as wedding favors. See if you can bring back 15 Wedding Favors.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' MEGA-GOAT! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Let's Get Filthy
quests.description: I just got a note from Filthy McGee. he says he wants to have a showdown just outside the wedding venue. If I don't come, he's going to wreck the wedding so I have to go. Will you back me up? Meet me in front of Filthy McGee as soon as you can.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' MEGA-GOAT! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Slay the Red Dragon
quests.description: A dragon is a fearsome beast, one even the best Bountyhunter *cough* plans their attack ahead of time. Grab your guild mates and bring me back the Red Dragon's head. You'll find him in the Vasalkar/lair area. My contact in the Thieves Guild will pay VERY well for it!

quests.name: Defeat Capt. #00000Beard
quests.description: I don't like them pirates. They interfere with my bountyhunting. But this time it's not ME who has to deal with them. I'm sure you and your Guild-mates can take down Capt. #00000Beard and bring me back his Golden Pirate Loot. Head to /Lolosia and take the boat over to his ship to confront him.

quests.name: Defeat Nulgath
quests.description: Every good bountyhunter keeps an eye on a world's most dangerous opponents, and Nulgath definitely qualifies. Bring your Guild to take him down… if you CAN! If you can wrest away his Seal of Approval, the Master Thief will pay VERY well.

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Tibicenas
quests.description: I hope you've got an in-djinn-ious solution for this next mission, Hero, because you and your Guild crew are going to face down Ultra-Tibicenas in the /djinn realm. He's got a spare wish to grant, and my thief contact wants it.

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Carnax
quests.description: Time is on your side, Hero, but not for long, The Thief Master is impatient, and he desires the Eye of Ultra Carnax NOW! You'll find the beast in the /ultracarnax area, but you're going to need ALL your Guild-mates to take this create down!

quests.name: Slay Ultra Epic Vordred
quests.description: The ultimate trophy is… the shadow of Ultra Epic Vordred! (Doesn't sound like he's trying to compensate for something at all.) Battle this dark foe in the /vordredboss arena and rip off his shade. Return to me and you will be rewarded once I am.

quests.name: Fuel For Flight
quests.description: Yup. The Hyperium needs fuel for our long trip. And it takes all kinds of oil. Because it's a spaceship.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mission 6 ' quest.

quests.name: Food For Flight
quests.description: Now that I'm thinking about food, we are going to need to stock up on some munchies.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Vomit Comet
quests.description: Ever been to space? You will probably get sick. All over the place. You should gather some motion sickness remedies…and a mop just in case.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Sweet Dreams for a Safe Flight
quests.description: We are just about ready -- but where IS my pillow?! I'm not going ANYWHERE without my Comfy Pillow. I'm sure it's been lost in The Span of time since I travel all over the place. As soon as you find my Comfy Pillow, we can leave.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: An Enviable Army
quests.description: Looks like Envy has already gathered a sizeable army of followers. It might not be a bad idea to clear some of them out before we go too deep.

quests.name: Where's Darkon?
quests.description: Now that the halls are a little emptier, why don't you go inside and scout the area. See if you can find where Darkon is being held.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Envy Token I in your inventory.

quests.name: Her Biggest Fans
quests.description: Couldn't get very far, eh? Ok, clearly we won't be able to find our way to the top of the tower without help. Here's what we're going to do. First, you'll beat up those fawning sycophants and take their clothes until you have enough to make a costume for yourself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Envy Token II in your inventory.

quests.name: Squee for Envy
quests.description: Now! While you're disguised as one of Envy's sycophants, go and talk to the others. See what kind of info you can coax out of them. As long as you sufficiently gush over how fabulous Envy is, they probably won't suspect a thing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Envy Token III in your inventory.

quests.name: Higher Up the Totem Pole
quests.description: Aha! Now we're getting somewhere. Envy's sycophants got us close, but I bet her disciples can get us even closer. Beat them up and make yourself a Disciple disguise.

quests.name: Fight for Envy
quests.description: You don't really look as pale and wihtered as the other Disciples do, so we'll have to do work to convince them that you're the real deal. Go defeat some Legion Spies to earn their respect and show your …fake loyalty. Do it where they can see you
quests.requirements_note: Must have Envy Token IV in your inventory.

quests.name: Where's That Employee Lounge, Again?
quests.description: Good! The disciples seem to be recognizing you as one of their own. Now, go talk to them. See if you can figure out how they're getting to the top of the tower.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Envy Token V in your inventory.

quests.name: Group Effort
quests.description: Envy's more paranoid than I realized! It looks like, in order to reach the highest part of the tower, we'll need a key that has 3 parts. The Legion Defectors have the first part, the Fawning Sycophants have the second, and the Disciples of Envy have the third. Once we have all 3 parts of the key, we'll be able to get inside.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Squee for Envy ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat Envy
quests.description: We've made it to the top of the tower, and all that remains is to confront Envy!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Queen of Envy
quests.description: Confront the Queen of Envy!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can also be found from Ada (NPC) in Envy (Location) (1) .

quests.name: Brainscan
quests.description: If you can manage to put me onto our friends' heads, I should be able to quickly scan their thoughts and extract their greatest fears. It will probably work best if you sneak up behind them and just jam me on there. Artix is right over there, and I bet that guy has some interesting fears. Let's start with him, and see if this works!

quests.name: Technophobia
quests.description: Now that we know this will work, we can try it with everyone else. Haven't you ever wondered what an evil undead lord would fear? Or a ghost? Or… Cysero? Now THAT should be an interesting one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: J6: Fears!
quests.description: J6 has given you an invitation to his new haunted house, J6's House of Horrors! You should head to /fearhouse to see what he's created with the data you helped him collect.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Artix's Fears
quests.description: J6 wants you to check out Artix's special fear room! Go into the Bloodhound Inn, and choose Artix from the digital menu. Then, enter the Holodeck.

quests.name: Legion Medals
quests.description: If we're going to save Laken, we'll have to keep the Legion away from him. For every one of them you kill, bring their Medals back to me.

quests.name: Mega Legion Medals
quests.description: Some of these Legion soldiers are particularly powerful, and you won't always be able to tell who they are just by looking. They'll be carrying larger medals, though. Bring them back to me if you find any.

quests.name: Legion Sergeants
quests.description: They're sending in the big guns, now! Those Legion Sergeants pose a greater threat than the normal Guards do. We'll need to focus them down first. Take down any that you find, and report back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed ' Legion Medals ' or ' Mega Legion Medals ' quest to access this quest.

quests.name: Defeat Rayce
quests.description: We've pushed back the bulk of the Legion forces, but now we have a new threat to contend with. Rayce, the Legion Soulstealer, is moving in. Stop him before he reaches Laken. I've got your back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Discerning Threats
quests.description: As expected, Albedo Elementals have infested the Forge. You won't notice you've been burned until it's too late, and you start hearing unwanted voices from the past. Needless to say, we should put out their flames.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ipsissimus ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Model Students
quests.description: Tara and the suspicious woman hanging on to her shadow found a guestbook. Read it, and ask our companions for their insight. Forge Albedo isn't anything like Maleno…though I have to admit that the architecture appeals to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ipsissimus ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: System Delusion
quests.description: I hear someone calling for help down the western hall. It's a Paladin, and he's being shot at by Forge Albedo's Defensive Turrets. Defend him, and ask him if there are others in danger. I'll find a way to disable the alarm.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ipsissimus ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Leap that Never Landed
quests.description: The Paladin, Riguad, said that his team was separated and being hunted down by faceless humanoids. You and the others check the open rooms for those in need of rescue, and I'll work on unlocking the other doors.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ipsissimus ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Insistent Existence
quests.description: I unlocked the room next to the one you were just in. More of Rigaud's Paladins are inside. Rescue them from the Collapsed Husks trying to assimilate them. Try not to look at them directly. There's no coming back from that.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ipsissimus ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Failed Reflection
quests.description: This is as far as we can go down the west hall. Tara scouted the east wing, and found Albedo Matches. They're using what's left of their scorched minds to spread the flames. Please, stop them here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ipsissimus ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Technically Aware
quests.description: I hear gunfire and metal scraping further into the eastern wing. The Defense Droids are hunting the remaining Paladins. We need to hurry and destroy them, or there'll be no one left to rescue.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ipsissimus ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mental Barrier
quests.description: I think it's easy to tell where the Paladins broke into Forge Albedo. They were mowed down by the Defensive Turrets. Destroy the turrets, and rescue the last of the survivors. One of them might have the key to the main center of the Forge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Ipsissimus ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Floor 1
quests.description: You have to start somewhere! Why not floor one? Munch 12 Dire Munchers.

quests.name: Floor 2
quests.description: How did Hulking Dire Wolves get down here? Get rid of them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Floor 3
quests.description: Undead. Are they dead? Are they not? I never knew for sure. Just… get them out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Floor 4
quests.description: Doesn't look like you got all of those *ACHOO* wolves.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Floor 5
quests.description: Look at all these Draugr. I don't want them crawling around my dungeon. Go… do something with them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per log-in.

quests.name: Floor 6
quests.description: It's getting kinda dark. Go place these torches all over and then empty out the next room.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per log-in.

quests.name: Floor 7
quests.description: Ew. Those Spyballs are really grossing me out. The way they blink, and the sound the blink makes and I can't help but play it in slow motion and EWWWWwwww. Please just go poke them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Floor 8
quests.description: You know what? I enjoyed watching you munch those Munchers. Do it again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Floor 9
quests.description: Okay, I can't keep looking at those Spyballs. Just go knock them out. If they keep their eyes closed maybe it won't be as nasty.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Floor 10
quests.description: Floor 10. Sounds ominous. Do I even want to see what's in there? Awwwww, it's a kitty!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per log-in.

quests.name: Floor 11
quests.description: Eh. More Draugr. Just… Umm… You know what to do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per log-in.

quests.name: Floor 12
quests.description: Is that a …. spider?! I HATE spiders! KILL THEM WITH FIRE!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Floor 13
quests.description: Oh. Yay. The undead are back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Floor 14
quests.description: EEEEEEeeeeee!! I mean… Oh No! More spiders!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Floor 15
quests.description: As I was running from those spiders… I mean… jogging this morning, I dropped my… thing. One of the monsters may have it. Go get it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Floor 16
quests.description: My thing is broken. I think it's missing a piece. Go find it… you'll still have to fight your way through the room, thought.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Floor 17
quests.description: I enjoyed watching you beat up that kitty. Go do it again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per log-in.

quests.name: Floor 18
quests.description: Just… kill everything in here! WITH YOUR MIND! Or weapon. Whatever. Just make it dead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Floor 19
quests.description: You're pretty close. Good think you'll never get past this level!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Floor 20
quests.description: AHAHAHHA! Come and get it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Property Appraiser
