quests.description: The Desterrat Moya needs to be weaker. The fastest way is to take out a large number of his followers, and the quickest way to do THAT is to slay the Necromancer that controls them. Take down 13 of Arasat's Ectomancers in Doomwood. He will be so drained, his followers will perish, and the Moya will lose strength. Then return to the Void. You may even receive a token of my appreciation.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Banish the Banished One
quests.description: It is time to send the Desterrat Moya home. It cannot be left this close to us and our home. Not to mention that its presence could cause ALL of the undead to rise up in rebellion! Take down the Desterrat Moya; if we can't finish him for good, we can at least send it home!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Become the Desterrat Moya (Daily)
quests.description: Kill 10 Cruor and 10 Crux to steal his ichor and aether. In time, you may become as strong as the Desterrat Moya is!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per day.

quests.name: Prevent the Return (Daily)
quests.description: The Desterrat Moya may be gone for now, but undead minions will continue to beseech it no matter where it is imprisoned. Keep reducing the Moya's strength by eliminating its supporters. Slay 15 Doomwood Soldiers, 10 Ectomancers, and 1 Cryptkeeper Lich, all found in Doomwood.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per day.

quests.name: Knave1's Route to the Void
quests.description: My sources tell me that… thing the undead have been petitioning is waiting for them in the Void. The quickest route to the Void lies in the hands of an acquaintance of mine. You might know her, a Void Mage named Nythera. Find her in Guwio Village, talk to her, secure her assistance whatever it takes, and return to me.

quests.name: Koofu Rider Twilly's Gift
quests.description: Greetings, Hero! To thank you for your loyal support of AdventureQuest Worlds, Twillies has a present for you. Click the button below to get your very own Golden Item of Donated Awesomeness

quests.name: Koofu Rider Zorbak's Gift
quests.description: Meheheh! To thank you for your loyal support of AdventureQuest Worlds, I've got a gift for you, and you know I don't give those often. Click the button below to get your very own Golden Item of Donated Awesomeness

quests.name: Defender Armor (StarLords)
quests.description: As renowned protectors of alternate universes, Defenders understandthe sacrifices one must make during combat. Defenders will see to it that what they start always ends in victory.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Classic Defender (1) with at least 1 Class Point in your inventory.

quests.name: Strange Creatures
quests.description: Ever since the fighting started, more and more of these Abumi Guchi have been showing up - creatures formed from the stirrups of fallen soldiers. Slay as many as you can, and come back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Battle for the Shinrin Do ' quest.

quests.name: Arm the Militia
quests.description: We have a small militia who are expected to fight alongside Jaaku's Shadow Samurai. If we could arm the rest of the village, the militia could fight against the Shadow Samurai rather than with them. Defeat the samurai, and take their weapons and armor for my people.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Battle for the Shinrin Do ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Burn the Bones
quests.description: Many of the spirits that haunt this valley are the restless ghosts of fallen soldiers. We can keep this at bay, to some extent, by cremating their bones. Use the flames from the Kosenjobi to do this.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Battle for the Shinrin Do ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Sometimes Losing is Winning
quests.description: Too bad! I really would have liked to show you around Akiba. Oh well, as is said, those who chase two hares won't even catch one. Well, I can't exactly collect items from you this way, so… can you do me some favors instead? Either clean up some trash in the area, or slow down some of the Crystallis for me!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Twin Saints ' quest.

quests.name: Decorate Your Space
quests.description: Isn't this place just so…peaceful? Hey traveller, wouldn't you like to take home some souvenirs? I have some things you can have but…you need to help out the citizens in Akiba first. I heard that the locals would like to visit their loved ones but the graveyard is always overrun by local creatures. We should head to /yokaigrave to help them out to make them feel safe!

quests.name: Snack Run
quests.description: The store is just up ahead! Grab some snacks and let's get going! Be careful though! Your eyes might be bigger than your stomach! Kick any Temptations you may have to grab more than what we need!

quests.name: Clean Up Crew
quests.description: People miss the garbage cans all the time! Check the trash on the floor for some recyclables! If you find enough, you should be able to turn those in for Credits!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Get a Ticket' quest.

quests.name: Asking "Nicely"
quests.description: If we need credits fast, we could always "ask" some civilians. Don't worry, they'll be fine! You just have to find some that have enough Credits for what we need!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'Snack Run' quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Get a Ticket' quest.

quests.name: Get a Ticket
quests.description: Take those Credits to the Ticket Dispenser and we'll be on our way!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed either the 'Clean Up Crew' or 'Asking "Nicely"' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the Soldiers
quests.description: We can't be captured by those Soldiers! Hold them off until we reach the city!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Shinkansen Key
quests.description: Dang it! The front of the train is locked! I bet one of these Soldiers has the Key! Find out which one has it so we can take out their leader!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Twin Saints
quests.description: Those Twin Saints are the ones in charge of all the Soldiers on the Shinkansen! If we don't stop them, we will never escape! Plus they are just downright creepy! We're going to have to fight them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Kotaro's Birthday Quest
quests.description: Hey again, Friend! So, uh, here's the deal. I kinda had gifts for you lined up too for all the times you helped me out, but Saint Eta kinda stoooooolleeeee them…yeeeaahh… Good news is you're free to go "collect" your gifts. Go to /shinkansen and get their gauntlet as a way of showing you did and you can feel free to have one of your choice!

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Acquiring Ancient Secrets
quests.description: If you are to tap into a portion of the Eternal Dragon of Time's power, you must first know more about its strength.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Time to Train Yourself
quests.description: Now that you've recovered more knowledge of the Eternal Dragon of Time, you should learn more about the powers that all dragons possess. Cross swords with Desoloth in /dragonchallenge, Goregold in /greed, Victorious in /darkplane, and the adult Trigoras in /trigoras to understand the ferocity you possess. You'll need plenty of patience if you're to continue this journey too— I hear Nythera in /blindingsnow knows a thing or two about that, but good luck finding her!

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Do You Have the Time?
quests.description: The next step in your training is to harness the power of time travel.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Through the Wormhole
quests.description: You must now use your strength to defend existing timelines from those who would alter it.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Rend
quests.description: The time has come for you to learn the skills that grant a dragon formidable strength in combat. Their simplest weapons are among the most deadly: powerful, dimension-ripping claws.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Confluence of Fates
quests.description: You learned how claws can rend flesh. Now apply the same technique to rend the fabric of space.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Dragon's Will
quests.description: Take what you have learned by studying the power of dragons, time, and space and assert your will over your enemies. Absorb their essence into yours.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Burning Fates
quests.description: You may be a mortal… maybe… but I sense a fire burning inside you. To control your fate, you must learn to control that fire. The best way for you to do that is by studying how other fire elementals do it!

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Hero's Heartbeat
quests.description: You've learned all that is necessary to battle as the Eternal Dragon of Time does. But now you must build your legacy as the Hero this world needs.

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

items.name: Dragon of Time Character Page Badge

quests.name: I'm Loving It My Way
quests.description: Phew, that was a lot of work, I'm starving! I could really go for a…

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Shadow Embargo
quests.description: I tailor all of my gear with the highest-quality materials in all of Lore. I used to get shipments of Shadow Canvas imported from Skullholme every week, but as of late, the shipments have just stopped. I do not have the time to travel there myself to pick up the material… so perhaps you could go instead? Head to Bludrut Keep and get me 5 yards of Shadow Canvas from the Shadow Creepers in the 2nd Floor Basement. In exchange, I will award you every day you bring me more Shadow Canvas.

quests.name: Vote for Gravefang
quests.description: Slay 10 minions of the Cor Mortis to show that you know *I* am the strongest, BEST ruler of Darkovia's vampires. Even if I AM a Werepyre.

quests.name: Give Solani a Message
quests.description: There is NO power stronger than mine! And that she-bat thinks to charm and sway with her poisoned honey and poisoned blades. Defeat her to show that I cannot be overcome!

quests.name: Who's That?
quests.description: Stellaria has asked you to protect the town. Maybe you should see if that scared-looking kid is okay.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Reclaim the Supplies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find my Stuff
quests.description: I've lost track of some of my stuff since the monsters attacked. One of them stole my pet bunny, and I dropped my journal and the medallion my dad left me while I was running away. Can you help me find them?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Reclaim the Supplies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Save my Friends
quests.description: Please, can you save my friends? I haven't seen them since the monsters attacked, and I'm worried about them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Reclaim the Supplies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pull the Wires
quests.description: So, I've been watching those CryptHackers. You see the wires that hang down from them? I think that's how they get you. Those things go into your brain and take control of it. Maybe if you could get some of those wires, someone could figure out how to reverse it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Reclaim the Supplies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dress-up Time!
quests.description: I wish there was more I could do to help, but I'm still pretty small. Not like you and Stellaria.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Reclaim the Supplies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: I Need a Distraction
quests.description: I think I'm ready. I just need you to cause a really big distraction for me, okay? Like… maybe just go fight a bunch of them so they're paying attention to you and not me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Reclaim the Supplies ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Light Of Destiny
quests.description: So, I guess you're gonna want to train me in front of my father's axe, huh? That's how you did it with Stellaria and Asherion. Nothing inspires greatness like the Blinding Light of Destiny. I'll meet you there!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' EN GARDE! ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Extinguished Eridanus
quests.description: Constellations that are not part of the Zodiac hold their own sort of power, but are out of my specialty. No time like the present but to learn! I'm currently studying the constellation Eridanus. I'll tell you about its legend after we hunt for starshards. There's a town with a name very similar to the constellation. Head to /Eridani and find any animal-like creatures to search for star shards.

quests.name: Mourning Cygnus
quests.description: Cygnus, found in legends studied by Arcangrove, is related to the story of Eridanus. Before I tell you the constellation's story, we should be looking for a pristine white city. It was where the titicular Cygnus was born, and the closest match I could find was /astravia. I skimmed through the books we have on Astravia because I was short on time, but the pictures look nice! Go there and see any of the local Creatures have star shards.

quests.name: Karkinos Mnimi
quests.description: Cancer is a cardinal water sign, so think streams and rivers! They're in touch with their own emotions and others…which is a downside sometimes, but only for everyone else. They know how to reach out and pinch where it hurts most. Very fitting of a crab constellation. Now where could we find crabs with star shards connected to Cancer? Ah! I visited Mythsong once and saw Rock Lobsters in /palooza.

quests.name: Pisces Venaris Mater
quests.description: Pisces is a mutable water sign. Those born under the constellation are compassionate and artistic …and they tend to have savior complexes. Fights are so dramatic with them but I digress. Pisces is represented by fish, but it could also be a shark. Since it's nearby, hop into /natatorium. Anglerfish and Merdraconians, fishy species swimming in magic, may have star shards connecting them to Pisces.

quests.name: Aries Chrysomallus
quests.description: Aries is a cardinal fire sign. Those born under the constellation are fiery, adventurous, honest…and sometimes that's a nice way of saying that they have a temper, are super impulsive, and have no filter. Ah well, if you ever get in a fight with an Aries, they cool off as quickly as they spark up. Anyways, the darkbloods may have star shards connecting them to Aries. You can find some lingering in /kolyaban.

quests.name: Leonine Regalia
quests.description: ﻿Leo is a fire sign, and is represented by the Lion. Ruled by the Sun, heroes who battle under this sign are recognized everywhere as passionate and creative. But much like the lion that represents them, they can be fiercely prideful. Very fitting for a constellation centered around the King of the Beasts. If we had to look for star shards drawn to Leos… I bet we'll find what we seek in Onslaught Tower.

quests.name: Harmonic Savant
quests.description: Balance, harmony, and justice… Lore needs heroes who uphold these virtues, because there is much injustice in our world. Which is why Heroes who battle under the sign of the Libra are so widely respected. Go, seek out shards of Good and Evil in the Skytower, and test the judgement of jurors in Astraviajudge to ensure their commitment to justice.

quests.name: Verdant Virgo
quests.description: Do you know about Changelings? Fairies have a penchant for swapping human babies with one of their own. In certain situations, both gain a unique connection to Nature and the Virgo constellation. Seek out Tree Nymphs and Forest Spirits in /Underglade for Star Shards. Fae with roots in Nature like them tend to create changeling situations.

quests.name: Starfield Badge
quests.description: I've got a challenge for you. It's one that's going to give me and my peers research material for the rest of our lives. For the rest of our student's lives, too! Head to /Starfield and bring me a million of them! That's right, one full million! There's a shiny badge with your name on it if you commit.

quests.name: Epsilon Tau
quests.description: A star was separated from its constellation! It's lost in the /StarField, stuck to one of the Nova Seeds. We need to find it before the elements and seasons are thrown into disarray. Not only that, but my divinations would turn bogus! My reputation as a professor would be ruined!

quests.name: Fixed Earth
quests.description: I called Amefuri by their other name earlier. Epsilon Tau. They identify with the constellation of Byakko more, but they're also a segment of Taurus. Maybe the other stars sought out Minotaurs thinking their friend became confused. Know any mazes?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fable Fall
quests.description: Amefuri said that autumn would be shortened if the constellation it belongs to stays shattered. Are there any forests out there where the leaves are orange year-round? The other stars could have gotten lost there. Does Aria know one?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Delta Andromedae
quests.description: Tokaki, also known as Delta Andromedae, is a cluster of stars from the same constellation as Amefuri. They're the legs of the White Tiger. I think they might be out hunting fish somewhere, but only Shark Bait would interest that big of a cat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Beta Arietis
quests.description: Tatara, or Beta Arietis, is another segment of the constellation Amefuri's from, but they're also a part of Aries. Remember when you helped me collect Starshards for my research on Aries? Let's do the same thing here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: 35 Arietis
quests.description: I was hoping Ekie, or 35 Arietis, would be found with the other Darkbloods. Hmm, did you know constellations can die? Ekie is the stomach of the White Tiger, but it also used to be in the Musca Borealis. A fly…Know any bugs related to space? I think one crash-landed on Lore somewhere…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fractured Pleiades
quests.description: Now Subaru is an interesting one. They're a part of the White Tiger, but are also known as the Pleiades - a very important asterism of seven sisters. Hm, there are Mages who studied these stars in a city named after their supposed father. I just can't recall the name…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lambda Ori
quests.description: Toroko is a trio of stars in the White Tiger's constellation, and one of them is named Meissa. It means "The Shining One," which is somewhat redundant for a star, but they're twice as bright as their kin. With how it's choosing to emphasize an identity with close ties to the Yokai Isle's traditions…know any sunny Yokai?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Delta Ori
quests.description: Kagasuki's an easy group to spot. While they are part of the White Tiger, many amateur stargazers can point them out because they're part of Orion's belt. The Great Hunter, hm. Tiger…Hunter…What would a tiger hunt for? Well, in Yokai tradition, only one beast can rival a tiger, but we should be looking for a long one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Western Moon Mansions
quests.description: We've gathered all of the stars that make up the White Tiger constellation! Now it comes down to finding the best place to return them to the sky. Valencia and Aria found that spot while you were busy. We just need some Spirit Energy to get there. Know a place where Yokai Spirits return to when they expire?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Heat of Battle
quests.description: The Firestorm Onslaught sentries have been spotted on our shores. They MUST be stopped before they can report back to their squad leader. Take out 3 Flame Soldiers and 3 Storm Scouts. Report back to me.

quests.name: Light the Flame
quests.description: Embersea was once a bright, happy place, full of light and laughter. Now, residents are scared to walk the streets. But we still need to keep the city lit. Light all the torches, then take out 4 of the Living Lava beasts; their heat will fuel our fires. (NOTE: can only be done once per log in)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kill It With Fire
quests.description: As the Tyndarius' Onslaught advances through the Ring of Fires, creatures flee from their army… and into OUR home! Take out 5 Coal Creepers, 2 Pyradons, and 1 Firesyn to keep our streets safe.

quests.name: The Hard Way
quests.description: The marauders function as a unit because of a mutual respect and loyalty. Since I betrayed that, talking them down is no longer an option. We need information on why they've come here, and it looks like the only way to get it is through force. The Brimstone Marauders play for keeps, so I won't ask you to be gentle. Go listen in on the Marauders, Looters, and Bandits, and tell me what they have to say.

quests.name: Encrpyt Keepers
quests.description: Alright, according to the information you've gathered, we can safely say that the Marauders aren't here by choice. Of course, this begs the question of what excatly made them come to this heavily policed area. Any sort of letters exchanged between the new Chieftain and his subordinates might tell us why, but anything you find will be in code. If there are nay couriers among this bunch, they should at least know the pieces of the cipher we need. Back to the field - the Marauders, Looters and Bandits will have what we need!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Catching Couriers
quests.description: I believe that I've constructed a halfway decent cipher out of what you were able to learn. With this, you should be able to translate any correspondance you snatch off each type of courier. Make sure to actually read them instead dof just letting them rot in your backpack, It's more important that we do this as quickly as possible, so you'll have to translate in the field.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Steppe Quickly
quests.description: This appears to be the heart of the camp. I know I have asked much of you, but I'm afraid there is still much more to be done. The resistance here is stiff. Some of these people recognize me from before. There Is nothing for us to do but quell them, however much we can.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reclamation
quests.description: There is so much pain here, Hero. We must not forget why we are here in the first place, thought. My own past aside, these bandits have been pillaging the roads for long enough to have collected quite a bit of ill gotten goods. We should be returning these goods to the people who it was taken from. perhaps that will take my mind off of this ceaseless battle.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bad Press
quests.description: We may have been bandits, Hero, but we never used to be so fanatically savage. Say what you will about the Brimstone Marauders, I didn't train them to throw their lives away like this. Talmin must have whipped them into a frenzy, likely using my departure as a catalyst to change our ways. Find the manifestations of his cruel doctrine and bring them to me. I have to see what he's been filling their heads with.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Good Hunting
quests.description: When we were in out old territory, we cultivated a deep connection to the land. We belonged to it, and we treated the Steppe with the respect it warrants. The beasts of the land would often come to our encampments, and we would train them to serve us. Now it seems these beasts have been trained to maim and kill on Talmin's behalf. Dealing with them will greatly limit the clan's ability to counter attack.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: One Last Push
quests.description: It is well past time this lunacy ended. I don't want to fight them anymore, Hero, but they won't back down. They stand strong before Talmin, not knowing that he has played them like a song. They will not let us through, and the puppet master will not relinquish his strings. The only thing they understand now is brutality, and so we will give the brutality. Why? Why is there no other way? Why must I kill!?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Redemption
quests.description: All the suffering that has happened under Talmin's watch must be repaid. I once called him my friend, brother, even. But I can never forgive him for what he has done to this once proud clan. It is time.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Heated Defense
quests.description: Before you go and investigate the attack on Feverfew Falls, we must learn most about what the Queen AND the Empress are planning for Embersea. Take out Fireguardian Dragons, Shadow Warriors, and members of the Firestorm army to learn more!

quests.name: Shadows Burn
quests.description: I don't like this… the Queen of Monsters is acting even MORE suspiciously than before. She's got something planned. We need to learn more! Take out ANY of the Firestorm army to see what you can find. And any of this villagers, too. They might have overheard something.

quests.name: Fear the Firestorm
quests.description: Aaah, the villagers have begun to flee the Feverfew, and are running right into our hands! Slay them all! Either their families will learn to fear the Queen, or they'll want to join us. Either way, we win!

quests.name: Endless Aisle of Chaos
quests.description: Fight the monsters in each frame of the endless aisle to reach Princess Tara. Cannot pass to next frame until all monsters in current frame are dead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chaos Kills! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Save the Princess... Again!
quests.description: Battle the Chaos Dragon in Princess Tara's ring.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Chaos Kills! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Dragon Confrontation
quests.description: Defeat the Chaos Dragon or Swordhaven WILL fall!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Save the Princess... Again!' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: To Catch a King
quests.description: Slay each of the Chaorrupted Peasants preventing you from catching up to Chaos Lord Alteon, or all is lost!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Save the Princess... Again!' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Chaos Lord Alteon
quests.description: You must battle Chaos Lord Alteon. I leave his fate up to you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Save the Princess... Again!' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Chaos Lord Alteon
quests.description: King Alteon's power has grown so strong. I fear for Lore if he is not defeated.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Chaos Lord Alteon ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Chaos Dragon
quests.description: Go, hero, and defeat the beast that has attacked our town. The fate of Swordhaven depends on you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Chaos Lord Alteon ' quest.

quests.name: Up the Mountain
quests.description: You have arrived - thank you for getting here so quickly! You must get to the Tower!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Dreadhaven .

quests.name: Higher Up
quests.description: Keep going - be sure to kill all monsters on your way up!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Seal of Light
quests.description: Defeat Alteon in /AlteonBattle to earn a Seal of Light. Combine 50 seals with 50 Seals of Darkness to create the Bright Knight's Armor.

quests.name: Seal of Darkness
quests.description: Defeat Sepulchure in /SepulchureBattle to earn a Seal of Darkness. Combine 50 seals with 50 Seals of Light to create the Bright Knight's Armor.

quests.name: Good Company
quests.description: While you're occupied with travel, the Temple won't be left unguarded. I have called upon aspiring knights and promising adventurers. They have not taken any vows or have sworn allegiances yet. In exchange for offering their swords, I agreed to teach them personally. Would you spar with them as well? You're a well-known name and the young ones are excited to meet you.

quests.name: The Sky Opens
quests.description: I imagine your attention is being tugged at from all directions. If you have a moment, would you deliver letters to /etherwardes? Earth, Water, Fire, and Air Dragons still linger there, and one must wonder if they're bored having nothing to do. You may have to twist their arms to convince them to read the letters, but they'll behave themselves after they read my signature.

quests.name: Sanity Filter
quests.description: The Water Elementals in Ashray cold be tainted with the same influence as the sinkhole. Please disperse them before the villagers begin lining up to dive into the abyss.

quests.name: Canned Ashray Delicacies
quests.description: The pirate ship Nerites destroyed when they hatched attracted Ghostly Eels en masse. We should exorcize these scavengers. The villagers have been menaced by enough voices, and I could make dragon treats out of seafood…

quests.name: Dragon of the Depths
quests.description: The newborn dragon, Nerites, has eaten and fused with a pirate captain and her crew. Please, put them all to rest, and prevent the coast from seeing another catastrophe.

quests.name: Secure the Egg
quests.description: It might not be safe anymore for even the egg shell to continue to be here. I've noticed some pirates patrolling around here recently. They might try to steal the egg. Even though it has already hatched, dragon eggs still sell for a lot of money. We don't need the pirates snooping around here, especially with what happened.

quests.name: Light of Youth
quests.description: Lightguard Paladins are stationed at Castle Balemorale, likely to defend the Queen's guests from a potential attack from the Shadows. They are being very pushy with Tara, Muusa, and myself. Would you please make them give us space? Using elbow grease is perfectly acceptable.

quests.name: Competitive Spark
quests.description: I see that the Queen is receiving guests from Skye. Their warriors are exploring Castle Balemorale's beach. The Emissary from Skye asked if you would like to spar with them. I see no reason to turn them down. It would be a good way to learn about them.

quests.name: Deadly Muse
quests.description: A dangerous fairy has emerged from the woods, stalking our entourage. This Leanan Sidhe will give us blessings in exchange for our souls. I doubt any of us will accept, but she may force the issue. Defeat her, and we'll bury her wings beneath a rowan tree.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Miserable Monsoon ' quest.

quests.name: Twilight of Winter
quests.description: One of the Northlands' marvels is nearby. This Dracolich is frozen in time, a remnant of an extinct bloodline of Dragons. He's getting a little too close to our camp. It'd be a shame if Skade ruined our field trip. Duel the Permafrost Dragon to turn him around.

quests.name: Twilight of Winter (Legend)
quests.description: One of the Northlands' marvels is nearby. This Dracolich is frozen in time, a remnant of an extinct bloodline of Dragons. He's getting a little too close to our camp. It'd be a shame if Skade ruined our field trip. Duel the Permafrost Dragon to turn him around.

quests.name: Reishi, Lingzhi, and Shroom
quests.description: The Yokai Isles used to be a misty mystery just off the coast, but now they've become free to welcome travelers and open up trade. They're generous about souvenirs too! I hate to admit this, but on the boat ride back, I ruined the bamboo and mushrooms I was gifted while trying to make tea. Could do me a favor and head to the site of the /shogunwar to get me Bamboo Treeant and Reishi replacements?

quests.name: Infinity Sand Pool
quests.description: Greenguard, in the time of the old Kings, feared that the desert of the Sandsea would one day spill into Greenguard Territory. The fighting used to be fierce, but those days are long gone, taking the old tyrannical royal families with them. The people of the Sandsea had been nothing but kind to me, and I noticed there was trouble in /sandport. Would you please help them by warding off the Sandsharks and Robbers?

quests.name: Beware of Rock Dog
quests.description: I would love for more adventurers like you to feel more comfortable coming to the nobles with your worries, but there are an oddly high amount of monsters roaming the castle grounds. The nobles are protected by their knights or their own combat skills, but a farmer or craftsman would be in a lot of trouble. Would you please clear some of the gargoyles and castle spiders to make it safer for the common folk to visit?

quests.name: Frogzard Wellington
quests.description: Have you been inside the castle? Then you might have met my Father, Lord Leofric Cavendish. He's here to speak with the King on my mother's behalf. Father is also looking to make friends with other nobles. That will prove to be difficult. But he's a wonderful chef. Would you please travel to /greenguardwest and bring back some frogzard tails? He could cook his signature dish and invite nobles to a meal.

quests.name: Pest Proof
quests.description: Many nobles are visiting Swordhaven Castle to have an audience with the royal family. A friend of mine is a noblewoman from the Surewood area, and an expert in agriculture. Unfortunately, some of the crop samples she took with her were tampered with when she was occupied with her travel papers. Would you please help her get replacements from Seed Stalkers and Fungal Lords in /twistedcavern?

quests.name: Deadly Hobbies
quests.description: Though my family protects the plateaus outside of Darkovia, my knowledge of spirits and ghosts is a work in progress. In that regard, coming to Swordhaven castle has helped. The nobles here are fascinated with ghost stories, and the wraiths that roam the towers. But what of spirits from farther away? I have heard that there are wraiths in a place called /deadmoor. If it's possible, would you travel there to find them?

quests.name: Stained Steel
quests.description: I saw Lord Henry Vaughn in the castle. His house protects the Western Valleys near the Sandsea. Chiral Valley is under Lord Vaughn's jurisdiction, but he and his knights were forbidden by King Alteon from participating in wars or battles. There's a place called /horde where Horde Knights lurk. Would you retrieve their weapons so I could send them to the Valley's people? That way, they can protect themselves.

quests.name: Security Plushies
quests.description: I use my spare time to make toys for the children living in my family's domain. Problem is, I don't have the right material. Do you happen to know any Shadowslayers? Ah, you can find them in a place called the /MidnightZone? Would you please bring me any spare clothes they have?

quests.name: Earning Your Stripes
quests.description: With the tiger being seen as a destroyer of evil in Chinese myth, many parents will clothe their children in clothing featuring tigers, or tiger patterns, to ward off misfortune. If we wear tiger patterns, it would both honor Umitora and hopefully prevent a disaster. The spiders and their kin who dwell in Ravenloss have supplies we can use to sew some.

quests.name: A New Year in Bloom
quests.description: Even tigers appreciate a little beauty sometimes, and the king here is no exception. His favorites, of course, are Tiger Lilies, but he's also partial to the flowers of the Tiger Sign. The local Bamboo Treants, Lingzhi fungi and Xingzhi will usually have plenty of flora growing on them. Bring back the most terrific, astounding and complimentary around!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Eye(s) of the Tiger
quests.description: The excitement here is rising up, but Umitora is unamused. He will not be satisfied until ALL of Lore's eyes are gazing upon him. Get back on the street and bring us some! There are plenty near Mobius and the Ebonslate Fortress, and I hear of thousand-eyed creatures in Greenguard Forest. One such beast even crashed a Battle Wedding!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Royal Feast
quests.description: The most important thing to any tiger is a good meal. Unfortunately, Umitora is a picky eater. He will only accept the highest quality meat… and prefers it directly from other Zodiac Creatures in Akiba! He is partial to Boar and Ox meat, but his favorite is Rat (he says it tastes like lean pork.. still gross), so get plenty of that. If you carve it, we'll cook it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Winning Streak
quests.description: Tigers rarely form groups, but when they do, they're called ‘streaks'.There are some strong tigers that Umitora sees as members of his. Defeating them- the White Tigers in /creatures, Cinderclaw and his tigers at /phoenixrise, and Shadowclaw (who fought in the /fireplanewar) will prove that you are more worth his time than they are.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Yin and Yang
quests.description: The traditional depiction of the Taiji, often called the Yin-Yang symbol, is often accompanied by images of a Dragon and a Tiger. They are seen as the avatars of Yin and Yang, forever in conflict. I hear of a seven-headed dragon that lurks at the /shadowfortress… slaying it would show both your strength and loyalty to the Yang itself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Tyger, Tyger, Burning Bright
quests.description: Umitora is almost done with his dinner, and just in time! The performance and celebration will begin shortly as well. But there's one last thing we need: fireworks! We can make a truly grand entrance by lighting some of the bombs carried around by the Lin Kuei assassins using the flames of Fiery Lanterns. Go get us some and we'll be all set.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Tame That Tiger!
quests.description: I'm sorry to put a damper on the New Year's celebration, Hero, but if Umitora continues lashing out, there won't BE a New Year for this island. I hate to keep asking for your help, but it's up to you to show this tiger what happens to spoiled brats. Just be careful: he wouldn't be a ruler if he didn't have the strength to back that title up!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Entertain Us!
quests.description: It's not an Akiba New Year without a display of combat prowess. You've proved your strength to Umitora, but now he wishes to face you again- this time with a clear head, and a desire to please his subjects. Feel free to battle to your heart's content, so long as you can make it entertaining. We ARE putting on a show, after all.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame That Tiger! ' quest.

quests.name: Fisticuff Tourney
quests.description: The Nobles' Knights are quarreling again! All this noise they're making is going to disturb the Queen! May I ask that you keep them from squabbling? I'll give you a free snip the next time you're at my salon.

quests.name: Local Seafare
quests.description: Queen Victoria trusted me with handling matters of hospitality, and I severely underestimated the amount of food the nobles would gorge on. Oh, where to get more Seafood…Ah! You know a place? The /TwilightZone for Lamprey? Would you mind delivering some to us?

quests.name: Vote for Solani
quests.description: Slay Ensis 10 times in a row to prove that the Cor Mortis is the strongest faction… and that I am the right ruler for Darkovia's vampires! Show that his endurance and strength are the greatest!

quests.name: Give Kurok a Message
quests.description: Ah, my friend, I greet you! I would ask a favor of you, if I may. Kurok Gravefang, he thinks to rule the Darkovian vampires, but has neither the finesse nor the skill to do so. Defeat him. Show him it takes more than brute strength and growling to rule US!

quests.name: Won't Someone Think Of The Minions?
quests.description: As the leader of my people. I must make sure no one is left behind I am glad to hear that Orlok and Brysin escaped, but a lot of our minions are still in the castle! Please, ﬁnd them and make sure they all get to safety.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Trapped! ' quest. Note : This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Here, Doggy Doggy
quests.description: There's still one more that needs to be rescued - my late aunt‘s beloved pet, Phaedra, She is terriﬁed of the Infernals, and has been hiding since they arrived. But she might come out for her favorite snack! Collect blood from the Blood Maggots in the castle. Then. go to my bedroom, and set a bowl of the maggot blood down by her doggie bed. When she comes out for her snack, grab her and bring her back to me. (Quest available once per login)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ma'alech
quests.description: I can't say for sure that the Lycans are behind this invasion, but I do think it‘s telling that the path into Lycan Ridge is being blocked by a huge demon. I can count on you to destroy that monster… can‘t I?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: I'm Not Lycan This Situation
quests.description: Now that the path is clear, why don‘t you head into Lycan Ridge and see what Constantin has to say about all of this? If the Lycans aren't responsible for this destruction, then they may be under attack, as well. Either way, it‘s good information to have.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Notes:

quests.name: Sticking it to the Undead
quests.description: The women of Lightguard Keep are FAR from helpless! But many of them need more formal lessons in self-defense. I'd like to teach them bow-fighting. But for that, I need more staves! Can you harvest wood from Doomwood Treants and leather for handgrips from the Undead Soldiers?

quests.name: Walking Wounded
quests.description: It's hard to keep a good Soldier down. They're either fighting wounded or wounding other fighters! "Resting" isn't in their vocabulary! So to keep the walking wounded fighting as comfortably as possible, I need more bandages! Gather cloth from 10 Ectomancers so I can rip them into new wound-dressings.

quests.name: Dead-forestation
quests.description: DoomWood treants have infested the woods, crowding out healthier, green trees. To make matters worse, the DoomWood Soldiers have been chopping down the healthy trees. You've set out to save the people of DoomWood, but we can't forget the flora of DoomWood!

quests.name: Ecto-Skeleton Armor-Enabler
quests.description: Most creepy-crawlies you find here in DoomWood have a hard exoskeleton which protects them. We've modeled some of our armors on it. But with the appearance of these Ectomancers, we're wondering if we can improve the magical properties of our soldiers gear. Bring back 10 Ectomancer Ecto-Orbs so that we can experiment.

quests.name: Prove your Worth (Healer Rare)
quests.description: If you can prove to me that you are a rank 10 Healer and are Rank 5 good, then I will grant you the Rank 10 Healer Medal!

quests.name: Prove your Worth (Warrior Rare)
quests.description: If you can prove to me that you are a rank 10 Warrior and are Rank 5 good, then I will grant you the Rank 10 Warrior Medal!

quests.name: Prove your Worth (Healer)
quests.description: If you can prove to me that you are a rank 10 Healer and are Rank 5 good, then I will grant you the Rank 10 Healer Medal!

quests.name: Prove your Worth (Warrior)
quests.description: If you can prove to me that you are a rank 10 Warrior and are Rank 5 good, then I will grant you the Rank 10 Warrior Medal!

quests.name: Let's Make a Deal
quests.description: This is how I work: you want the thing, I give you the thing, but like any good deal, we need a contract! Bring me 10 Fresh Souls from any of the Guards or Inquisitors in the /citadel, then we can discuss about prices. More power, means more work, which means more souls! Easy, huh? Then go get some! Oh, don't forget you need to do it in my name. It will make sure the Soul will come right to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50.

quests.name: Summoning and Stuff
quests.description: A powerful and handy weapon you say? I have something in mind! but let me think… summoning… paradox… space manipulation… some good extra sauce… yep, it won't be cheap at all. Bring me these ingredients AND the payment, don't forget about it. Ugh… our ''Archfriend" won't be happy about it, but whatever. Just go!

quests.name: Trading and Stuff (Single)
quests.description: Oh, you own the Oblivion Blade of Nulgath sword? Well then, let's make this a little easier for you. A powerful and handy weapon you say? I have something in mind, but- oh? you have the thing already. Great! Bring me just some ingredients AND the payment, don't forget about it. Ugh… our ''Archfriend" won't be happy about it, but whatever. Just go!

quests.name: Trading and Stuff (Dual)
quests.description: Oh, you own the Dual Oblivion Blades of Nulgath sword? Well then, let's make this a little easier for you. A powerful and handy weapon you say? I have something in mind, but- oh? you have the thing already. Great! Bring me just some ingredients AND the payment, don't forget about it. Ugh… our ''Archfriend" won't be happy about it, but whatever. Just go!

quests.name: ArchFiend Dragon Egg
quests.description: Oh my, what do we have here? I would recognize this egg from miles. It is said the Archfiend Dragons were savage, loyal and unstoppable. Which doesn't make sense since there aren't any of them left now. If you don't have a grown up Archfiend Dragon to hatch your egg, you would probably need a powerful being to do it for you. Where would you find such a being in a place like this? Ha! You got it. All I need is these ingredients, and a little help from an old friend of mine… good luck with that and DON'T forget the souls!
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 40.

quests.name: Now We're Talking!
quests.description: Heard you're into some hardcore tasks. I've got something here and there for you, but FIRST, let's make a deal. There is some stuff I will need you to bring in order to summon this big guy here, and I need to make sure you agree with all the terms and so on. First I'll need Human Souls from any human in /noxustower, Fallen Souls from the Undead Paladin in /doomwood, and just one Soul Potion from /alchemy. Oh, don't forget you need to do it in my name. It will make sure the Souls will come right to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 65.

quests.name: Let's Get You a Suit
quests.description: This won't be easy. I may need to focus on one thing in order to find the other thingies and… you know how this works. I need you to bring some more ingredients. This might be the toughest of these tasks to be honest… or is it?

quests.name: I Got your Back (and your Top)
quests.description: Ok, this might be easy for you. With the Armor in hand, it's going to be kinda simple to focus on the other items. I'll try to bring them here, while you wait, bring me some more ingredients for the next step.

quests.name: The Dark Sacrifice
quests.description: Good news! We're almost there, and I've got one more FUN task for you. Look, I know what you've been through, but it's just right there. I'll need a few more ingredients and then we're done!

quests.name: The Post Summoning
quests.description: Oh, look! It seems like there were more than we thought there. The summoning was so good it's offering you more than we asked. I mean… the gear is there, but we still need some more of those, uh… incentive…

quests.name: A Dark Knight
quests.description: Just like you can bring the shadow out of a paladin, you can pull it out of a weapon of darkness. If you'd like to see what happens when we pull on the Shadowscythe's weapons, bring me some of their gear and we'll see what happens.

quests.name: A Dark Knight Rises
quests.description: Next up, we'll take the armor of a DoomKnight and pull the shadow out of that. Plunge the armor into total darkness, and see what we get.

quests.name: A Dark Knight Falls
quests.description: Even the Empress's own weapon can have its shadow taken. Empower the result with an Essence of the Shadow Fiend, and we're good to go.

quests.name: A Dark Knight Returns
quests.description: You're already this far in, wouldn't you rather see things through to the end? If you can gather the reagents, we can pull the shadows out of the Shadowscythe's most precious artifacts to create versions just as powerful as they are. We'll also have to go back to the source of these items if we wish to use them. Precision is key, so you'll need the Hollowborn Shadow of Fate to guide the process.

quests.name: Stirring Discord
quests.description: The shadows of Chaos are…complicated. I heard that its nature changes depending on who's holding the reins. Ironically, the person in question is possessive of his thralls, seeking to use Chaos as a method of control. What would happen if we were to pull the shadows from items infected by Chaos? Bring some to me and we'll find out.

quests.name: In the Beasts' Shadow
quests.description: I wish I could have tested my skills against the Beasts of Chaos themselves. Don't take it as me looking to hunt them. I would never interfere with your quarry. That'd just be plain rude. But, taking the next step up means pulling the shadows out of those Beasts. When you fight them, remember to bring mementos back for me. Let's see what we get.

quests.name: Unique Quarry
quests.description: We're crossing into territory many Hollowborn could only dream of. Oh? Chaos has ruined and ended its fair share of lives. I imagine that destroying Chaos could be a big motivator for potential Hollowborn. But, you're the only one capable of grappling with the fiercest of Chaos' Beasts one on one. Bring me mementos from the remainder of the Beasts so I can pull their shadows. I can't ask anyone else.

quests.name: Wavering Illusions
quests.description: Personal effects tend to have deeper shadows. Not sure what I mean? Then let me demonstrate by pulling the shadows out of the Chaos Lord's close belongings. Other similar items would help bring my message across. Pry them out of Chaos' hands and bring them back here. In the meantime, I'll mentally prepare myself. Chaos is possessive about its shadows, like how it is with everything else.

quests.name: Shadows of Disdain
quests.description: We've reached the breaking point in our study of Chaos' shadows. To go any further, you'll need to confront the Champion of Chaos himself and obtain traces of Chaos. Either take on /ultradrakath or acquire them from an alternate version of yourself in /championdrakath. Sounds easy enough, right? Besides, I bet you like beating up that pest.

items.name: Hollowborn Envoy of Chaos Character Page Badge

quests.name: Persisting Mayhem
quests.description: How about a few extra prizes? Chaos shadows have a lot to offer and I have time to pass. Save that heavy sigh for later. You've got Chaos to slay, and I have a lot of standing to do. It's to limber up, of course. Yanking those shadows out takes a lot of energy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Draftless
quests.description: For a number of reasons, Hollowborn Legionnaires are rare, so having you study their habits and shadows will be a boon. Collect some of their more mundane items and bring them here.

quests.name: Flow Stress
quests.description: The Legion revolves around their Lord's forge - where souls are smelted into a grand number of armaments. Seek out Vulcar, and return here with samples of his dastardly work.

quests.name: Heat Treatment
quests.description: Now we're getting into the realm of exclusivity. Even the Hollowborn Legionnaires I know of can't get access to what I'm about to ask you for. Bring me 1 Soul Essence, and a few Soul Fragments from the Legion's most powerful warriors.

quests.name: Counterblow
quests.description: Thanks to you, we've gotten incredibly far with our study of the Legion's shadows. You must be held in high esteem down in the Underworld. Now, for our last challenge: retrieving Crowns, Wreathes, and Scrolls from Dage The Evil's private reserve. Have fun!

items.name: Hollowborn Lich King Character Page Badge

quests.name: Wunjo, Reversed
quests.description: Look at how those folks are setting up a tourist trap right outside the town's gates. They don't even live here and they're dragging travelers over to make them listen to their sermon. On our way to town, we might need to gently tell them we're not buying what they're selling. Too bad for them if they try to bully and throw the first punch. We'll throw the last punch.

quests.name: Berkana
quests.description: What a warm welcome. All these flowers everywhere to celebrate so soon after a tragedy? I don't get that sort of thing but I haven't been invited to many funerals either. Ask that old man Waelc about the customs. We're sight-seeing after all. Oh right, I meant investigating. Care to ask why they let these pests run around too?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Algiz, Reversed
quests.description: The rumors have been causing quite a bit of trouble for the townsfolk. Their Liberator is a bogey man to folks like the trooper outside the town's shrine. She's shaking mad, like she's about to throw a rock at the window. Shall we hit her and her compatriots up for conversation before it comes to that?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gebo
quests.description: It isn't fair to take without giving back. Even when it's something as simple as knowledge. Before we dive deeper into the heart of things, I think the town would appreciate some gifts for Alvi's siblings. Get me some materials, I think I can stitch together a stuffy.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eihwaz
quests.description: Lovely! A bunch of those Vindicators ran inside the Shrine to cause trouble. We can't let them vandalize the building, especially not that extremely handsome statue over there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hagalaz
quests.description: Here's the wake-up call. The Vindicators' tempers have boiled over. They set fire to the Shrine and surrounding buildings. We could let the townsfolk take care of it on their own, but you want to help in case it gets out of control? If you want to, then I'll join.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mannaz
quests.description: Those monsters around town have been whipped into a violent frenzy by the sudden attack. The townsfolk are too preoccupied defending each other from them to go after the Vindicators. Guess that means we'll help take a bit of weight off their shoulders?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Thurisaz
quests.description: Before, we were just dealing with the Vindicators as annoying visitors. This time, I want to see you bring the hammer on them. Both I and the townsfolk want to see the fury of a 'Glorybringer' in action.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Othala
quests.description: A good home stays warm even in mourning. That's hard to come by. I don't think I had a home until I became Hollowborn. As a token of Trygve's dedication to my brethren, I'll do my part in expelling its invaders.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Isa, Reversed
quests.description: Should we be honoured that the Vindicator's Grand Master showed up himself? Alvi's quite popular. Since we didn't bring flowers or toys, how about we actually have that brawl on the child's grave? I'm sure she'd appreciate us beating up her bully.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Nauthiz
quests.description: The people of Trygve approached us for help with making a strengthening tincture. After that mess at the graves, I suppose they're bracing themselves for what's to come. They'll need a lot to go around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isa, Reversed ' quest.

quests.name: Nauthiz (Legend)
quests.description: The people of Trygve approached us for help with making a strengthening tincture. After that mess at the graves, I suppose they're bracing themselves for what's to come. They'll need a lot to go around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isa, Reversed ' quest.

quests.name: Watch the Light
quests.description: While you are concealed with shadows, it might be hard to stay hidden with all these lights. Try taking out a couple before we proceed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isa, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Uprootment Recruitment
quests.description: There are even more recruits here than I expected. How are they drawing so many people to their cause? Oh well. Time to dissuade them from their career choice.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isa, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Endless Hounding
quests.description: These Vindicator Hounds are new. And like you said, this concealment spell is a little smelly. Smelly enough that these hounds are picking it up. If they give up our position, the mission is over.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isa, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mystery Creature
quests.description: There are some weird creatures in that dungeon we just unlocked. We really should check them out before we move forward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isa, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Retrieve the Keys
quests.description: They have Trygve's civilians locked in those dungeons with those monsters. Let's find the keys to get them out of there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isa, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Free the Prisoners
quests.description: With those creatures in those dungeons, we need to get those villagers out of there. Sneak down there and get them out with those keys.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isa, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Vindicator General
quests.description: This is it. The one responsible for turning those civilians into those monsters! We have to put a stop to this!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isa, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: De-dicated
quests.description: If we're going to find out what Gramiel is planning, we'll have to make a path to his chambers. Clear out the Fortress's defenders, and we'll have a straight shot at him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isa, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get into the Chambers
quests.description: Without a doubt, those are Gramiel's chambers. We need to get in there and see what the Dawn Vindicators are planning. The General from earlier most likely has a key. We have to get it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isa, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tales from the Past
quests.description: Look for anything that might give us insight into what Gramiel is planning. Check everywhere, especially the desk.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isa, Reversed ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Grace Extraction
quests.description: Now that we know the nature of Gramiel's power, we should study its properties. Collect some of Gramiel's Grace that he has bestowed to his followers. The stronger the user, the more Grace you should be able to extract.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tales from the Past ' quest.

quests.name: Grace Extraction (Legend)
quests.description: Now that we know the nature of Gramiel's power, we should study its properties. Collect some of Gramiel's Grace that he has bestowed to his followers. The stronger the user, the more Grace you should be able to extract.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tales from the Past ' quest.

quests.name: 24 Hour Graveyard Shift
quests.description: The way to Gramiel's throne room is heavily guarded. I want our arrival to be a surprise, so let's knock down a few of his soldiers. They should have notes on who's patrolling and when.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tales from the Past ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Unwanted Wings
quests.description: Now that we know what happened to the villagers, I'll leave how we'll be dealing with the Vindicator Beasts to you. We don't have a way to contain them. They'll wake up and attack us again if we knock them out. Regardless, we need them out of the way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tales from the Past ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Noble Dragonkin
quests.description: The Draconians are new. Do you think they're actual Draconians, or humans that were transformed like the Beasts? Only one way to find out. Let's pry off some scales to see if there's anything human underneath.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tales from the Past ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Dire Horcdeal
quests.description: We can't go beyond the locked door, but there's an interesting fellow banging his fists on it. Looks like an incredibly angry Horc. Let's have a chat, and find a key to get that door open. I think one of the Draconians nearby would have it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tales from the Past ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Outclassin' the Assassin
quests.description: Behind locked door number one is lovely locked door number two! And a Vindicator Assassin. Seems like we caught them just as they were going to go hunting for the intruders, i.e. us. Let's throw down, and shake the next key out of them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tales from the Past ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mean Dog Walker
quests.description: The Beast Tamer and his hounds are blocking the way to Gramiel. Lucky us, he's also the one Zlar's looking for. I'll help you take him down. Don't hold back. The Beast Tamer's hide is thicker than his hounds'.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tales from the Past ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Safe Keeping
quests.description: We should take Zlar up on his offer, and round up the Vindicator Beasts so he can take them somewhere safe. It'll make the next flight of stairs somewhat more bearable.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tales from the Past ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Seeds to be Reaped
quests.description: How many Vindicator Soldiers got stuffed into this tower? Don't they have places to go vindicate or something? Unless…they're here to support another high ranking member of Gramiel's flock. Lets kick them down the stairs, and find out who they answer to.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tales from the Past ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ceremonies and Rituals
quests.description: This is the last stretch, so bear with it for just a little longer. It'll be safer to confront the Soldiers' commander if we disarm them and the Beasts. I also want to take a closer look at them. Whatever's going on is affecting their bodies.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tales from the Past ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Selective Acknowledgement
quests.description: At the very end of this tower, the Vindicator Priest blocks the way to Gramiel. We'll beat him like all the rest, but be careful. The room's all prepped for a ritual, and really, have you ever been in a ritual you've liked?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tales from the Past ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mutual Friends
quests.description: Before we move on, we should take another look at the Vindicator Assassin, Beast Tamer, and Priest. There could be worse waiting around the corner, and I…want to know if I'd recognize anyone else.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Selective Acknowledgement ' quest.

quests.name: Mutual Friends (Legend)
quests.description: Before we move on, we should take another look at the Vindicator Assassin, Beast Tamer, and Priest. There could be worse waiting around the corner, and I…want to know if I'd recognize anyone else.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Selective Acknowledgement ' quest.

quests.name: Wedding Reception
quests.description: Before you dive headfirst into pest control, why don't you chat with Thay and Snow for a while? Thay was really looking forward to meeting you, and Snow can get you up to speed with the dire housekeeping needs.

quests.name: Rats in the Walls
quests.description: Thay's terrified of rats, so we should take care of them first. Snow needs a break. She's been telling me about how the rats burrowed into the walls, started floating, and to put it politely, tossing up their green cookies at her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blissfully Unaware
quests.description: It's your turn to take a break. Teka and Aciel just arrived, and they've already gone upstairs to explore Thay's mansion. They don't know about the rats, ghosts, and spiders yet. Right, I forgot to mention the spiders, but let's worry about that later.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Caspar's Web
quests.description: I suppose you, Aciel, and Teka noticed the giant spiders while you were chatting. It's safe to say they're just as possessed as the rats. Would you mind getting rid of them too? Sorry, I don't have any sanctified water to spray them with.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Terrorized Tailors
quests.description: Uh-oh, I hear trouble inside our bedroom. That's where Hikari and NCS are doing last-minute adjustments to my suit and Thay's wedding dress. Would you mind checking to see if they're alright? Maybe the rats and spiders are biting them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Occult Objection
quests.description: Would you mind banishing all the spirits in the bedroom? I have no idea why they're so mad. Thay's a Hollowborn Witch, but she's not out there boiling kids. Why are the ghosts so angry? Is it me? If you can, look for any clue that could give us answers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Wraithful
quests.description: The door to the basement is under the rug in the foyer. Let's take a peek down there. Expect to find the worst of the hauntings. Statistically, one in five Hollowborn lose their first life in a basement. Haha, you can't tell if I'm joking?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Old, Blue, and...?
quests.description: Interesting. The spirits are gathering around an old closet all the way at the back of the basement. It looks like…it's also possessed. The source of the haunting may be inside the closet, and it's not going to open its doors without a fight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Aisle Rampage
quests.description: The spirits are swarming around us! They're trying to get inside the tent. Thay and I will help you exorcize them before they trash all of our hard work - or kill us. I've been swamped with wedding work. I need to get my priorities straight.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Blood-Soaked Witchery
quests.description: The source of the rampage was another Witch. They were the one who killed my grandmother-in-law, and now they're after my fiance too. We Hollowborn don't die easy, but I won't hold back. This Witch made Thay cry, and we'll return the favor.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Boo-quet Toss
quests.description: Don't sneak off yet. You need to be there for the bouquet toss, and we're in need of a fitting bouquet. The last one got ripped up by the spirits and the Blood Witch. Maybe we can salvage the petals and make something special out of them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Blood-Soaked Witchery ' quest.

quests.name: Wunjo, Reversed - Realized
quests.description: We have some familiar faces coming our way - Vindicator Soldiers. The door to their inner sanctum is locked, so one of them must have the key. Let's politely go through their pockets, and by that I mean dangle them by the ankles and shake them down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Selective Acknowledgement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Berkana - Realized
quests.description: Through the door is another batch of familiar faces. This time, I recognize them from home. Hollowborn Soldiers were hiding in the ranks of the Vindicators the entire time. They don't look happy with us, so there's no need to be polite. Let's run them over.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Selective Acknowledgement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Algiz, Reversed - Realized
quests.description: Further ahead, the remaining members of the Dawn Vindicators are making their last stand. They're fighting the Hollowborn, but they'll lash out at us, too. Take down the recruits, and try to talk some sense into their Flag Bearer, Genevieve.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Selective Acknowledgement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gebo - Realized
quests.description: Remember the Beast Tamer in the tower? Looks like he sent his Hounds to protect the area. They're likely a gift to the person he's actually loyal to. Be prepared for a fight, and don't hold back, even if you're a dog lover. Don't worry. The pups will be fine.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Selective Acknowledgement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eihwaz - Realized
quests.description: All of the Hounds are actually Hollowborn, and it'll be hard to read that letter left on the statue of Veronika if they keep getting in the way. Go on and take a look. I think you're going to have a lot to say to me afterwards.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Selective Acknowledgement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hagalaz - Realized
quests.description: It's all going to end soon, and the Vindicators can sense it. That's why only their Draconians are left standing. Gramiel's fate has to be decided, and we can't let a couple of lizards get in the way of that.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Selective Acknowledgement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mannaz - Realized
quests.description: Even some of the Draconians were Hollowborn! That's a surprise! Veronika and the others were up to a lot more than I was aware of. These Hollowborn Draconians won't go down easy, but we need to forge ahead.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Selective Acknowledgement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Thurisaz - Realized
quests.description: The Vindicator and Hollowborn Draconians are putting their differences aside, and working together to stop you. That's honorable, but we'll have to teach them a hard lesson. Some things aren't meant to be.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Selective Acknowledgement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Othala - Realized
quests.description: We caught Gramiel right before he completed the ritual to become a Celestial again. This is all on you, friend. We came here to defeat him before he can ascend, and I'll be there to support that choice.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Selective Acknowledgement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Isa, Reversed - Realized
quests.description: The other Hollowborn cut down too many of the Vindicators. Their Grace allowed Gramiel to ascend. We're going to have to fight him at the peak of his strength. When we strike him down, you'll have a choice to make.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Selective Acknowledgement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Resuscitated Hope
quests.description: In this alternate timeline, you and I never met. Gramiel reascended, and his creator took full control of him. Most life on this Lore has been wiped out. Even if this is a dead end timeline, we want to go down swinging. Defeat Gramiel, and give us a little hope.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Isa, Reversed - Realized ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per week.

quests.name: Lullaby
quests.description: "War has finally found us. We won't let any greedy King turn you into their weapon. For all that you have done for us - sleep now, great Deva, and one day may you rise in peace." Will you help us grant their wish? It would be the perfect finish to a wondrous Mogloween spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' All Fall Down ' quest.

quests.name: Scare Uniforms
quests.description: Because he's a necromancer, do you think these are costumes or actual uniforms? Either way, you probably want that smell cleaned out right? Give us some treats and we'll give them a wash in the water he was using to make cherry lemonade.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lullaby ' quest.

quests.name: The Lake Hydra
quests.description: The Hydra has risen! It's heads just grow back so you can't defeat it, but maybe you can recapture it! Some runestones have appeared around the lake. You will need 9 Hydra Fangs to shatter the runes, and toss the remains in the bonfire we have set up to destroy them forever! I hope this works….
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find the Key! (Part Three) ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Examine the Area
quests.description: This land has seen a lot of carnage, and I'm not sure what is left of the city it used to be. Before we do anything else, we have to explore the area. Let me know what you find, and then we'll consider our next move. (Quest completeable once per login session)

quests.name: Get the Key
quests.description: Dage has that teleporter locked down tight - it has to be activated by 4 of his Commanders simultaneously. There are usually 2 Commanders stationed inside that bunker we found, but first we'll have to get it open. One of the Gunners out here should have the key.
