quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Obtain Agravh's Soul
quests.description: Now that you have the key, you'll be able to go to the bunker you found and unlock its hatch. Inside you'll find a Legion Commander named Agravh. Defeat him, and collect his sou. Dage - your Dage - can use it to activate Agravh's part of the teleporter.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Obtain Uslaw's Soul
quests.description: You should be able to use that same key to unlock the bunker's inner door. In that second room, there will be another Legion Commander named Uslaw. Find him, and obtain his soul.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest

quests.name: Access the Control Room
quests.description: Next you're going to head into those ruins you found. There's a door leading into a control room - it'll be locked, but it's not very sturdy. You should be able to break it down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Destory the Force Field
quests.description: I guess they have realized that door wasn't very sturdy if they've got a force field set up, too. But that's ok - it's just a minor setback. The Force Field Generator will be in the hands of one of the UW3017 Blasters. Find that, and you'll be able to shut it down. (Quest completeable once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Can only be completed once per login.

quests.name: Obtain Ozar's Soul
quests.description: With the force field down, there is nothing standing in between you and Commander Ozar. Find him, defeat him, and bring back his soul.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Obtain Pavon's Soul
quests.description: The last soul you'll need is that of Commander Pavon. Go back into the ruins, and look for the ladder leading up to the roof. That's where you'll find him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Activate the Teleporter
quests.description: Now that we have all 4 souls, we can turn on the teleporter. The teleporter is surrounded by 4 pillars - each soul activates one of them. They must be activated in the right order! If you get the order wrong, you'll have to start over.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Keep It Grounded
quests.description: We're going to need to make sure this ship doesn't leave before we can get to Future Dage. See those fuel cells along the walls? Smash as many as you can find. That will buy us some time. While you're at it, clear out some of the Future Legion numbers inside the ship, too. Later on, we'll be glad we did. (Quest completeable once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Quest can only be completed once per login.

quests.name: Get the Code
quests.description: See the big door at the end of the hall? We'll have to get through to find Future Dage. Trouble is, we're going to need the access code to get in. You'll need to get 6 fragments of code from the SF3017 Gunners, and then decrypt it using the code keys that the SF3017 Blades carry.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Open the Door
quests.description: Now that you have the decrypted access code, you can use it to get into the Captain's Chamber. You'll need to interact with the keypad on the door, and input the correct data to complete the circuit.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Take out the Legionator
quests.description: He sent the Legionator after us?! After all I've done for the Legion, he doesn't even think I'm worth dealing with himself? How insulting! Come on, we'll show him he can't get rid of us that easily!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Souls of the Future Legion
quests.description: For every soul I take, I become stronger, and the Future Legion becomes weaker. As you fight these Future Legion minions, collect their souls. Bring them to me. I must be at maximum strength if we are to emerge from this battle victorious.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take out the Legionator ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Robust Souls of the Future Legion
quests.description: All beings have a soul, but some are stronger, and more powerful, than others. A soul like this will imbue me with considerably more power. If you find any of these robust souls, bring them to me. They will greatly increase our chances of success.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take out the Legionator ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: SF3017 Shogun
quests.description: The time to strike is now! We have cleared a path to the SF3017 Shogun. If we take him out, Future Dage will have no choice but to face us himself!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take out the Legionator ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Future Dage
quests.description: My Legion scouts have found Future Dage's location. This is my moment of truth. Help me defeat him, and save Lore lore from destruction.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take out the Legionator ' quest to access these quests.

quests.name: Get the Parts
quests.description: Our engineers still need to do some work on the weaponized Dark Shard. Unfortunately, the parts they need were kept in a storage facility that was abandoned long ago… and has been overrun with Dwakel. You're going to have that parts back from them. Bring them to me once you have them.

quests.name: Get the Water
quests.description: Now we'll need to get the elements that will power the weapon. The first is Divine Water, which you can get for the Divine Water Elementals outside, near the lake.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get the Fire
quests.description: That water you just collected will only do its job when combined with Divine Fire. You'll get that from Divine Fire Elementals near the fire pit, outside and to the left.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gather Armaments
quests.description: While we're here, we'll pick some extra weapons and shields for the army we'll be bringing with us. You'll probably need to take the swords - our Iron Lightblades - back from the skeletons that have infested the area. The Celestial Shields should be hanging on the wall.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Plutonium For Power
quests.description: There's just one more thing we need before we can head out - a Plutonium Core. Apparently, the hydra living near the lake has swallowed it, and become radioactive. Slay the hydra, and bring back the core.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat the Undead
quests.description: The only thing standing between us and our destination is, well… the army of the undead. Fight your way through them, and meet me on the other side.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Remove the Ward
quests.description: The chamber of the World's Soul has a ward around it preventing anyone from entering. In order to have made it to this side of the chamber, some of these Legion soldiers will be wearing amulets that allow them to temporarily shatter the barrier. Find the amulets, and then use them near the door to take the barrier down and allow the Seraphs to pass through.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Defeat the Guardian
quests.description: Right. I'd forgotten about this. If a living being tries to enter this chamber, some of its energy coalesces into a guardian to keep them away from the World's Soul. We can dissipate the energy by fighting the guardian and defeating it. It won't be easy. But it CAN be done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Original Time Killer
quests.description: You know, Vorefax in /portalmazec is the original Time Killer! It eats up dead timelines like it's nobody's business! You could learn a lot from it!

quests.name: That's So Lapis
quests.description: Since I could gaze into the future, you might think life would be a breeze. I can see trouble from a distance (Yeah, Go Lap!), but then it's not that easy. Without the calming agents found in Monstrous Spores I have no control over my transient state. Grab me some spores, but be careful because THEY NASTY!

quests.name: Guts for a Greater Mind
quests.description: You know how carrots improve eyesight? Goblin guts do the same thing, but for your future sight seeing. I've felt a little low on the prophecy side and I hope a batch of Goblin Gut cookies could fix me right up. Gather me the main ingredient and there's a cookie with your name on it!

quests.name: Better Than A Magic 8-Ball
quests.description: Ravinos' anger is making him reckless, with some help from the toxic blight that's infecting his system. We can't attack Nevanna without first divining insight into the upcoming battle. Bring me what I need, and I will read your fortune in the sticks.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Talk to Lapis ' quest.

quests.name: Outside Assistance
quests.description: The bad news is that fortune is heavily favoring Nevanna. We are unlikely to win this war. But there is something that could turn the tide in our favor. Travel to Arcangrove, and speak to Reens. Convince her to craft a Sparrow's Blood potion for you. We will coat your weapon with it, and fate will bless you

quests.name: Even a Noob Can Do It
quests.description: Since I don't have hands. I'm going to need you to perform this spell for me. Don't worry, I'll walk you through it! You just need to light the incense there… and then read from the scroll… and then spread the potion on your weapon.

quests.name: Return to Ravinos
quests.description: I'm still not convinced that you can prevail over Nevanna, but I've offered all the help that I can. Go back to Ravinos now, and tell him you're ready to confront our former friend

quests.name: Chicken War Medal Quest
quests.description: You think you can take on my 10 million chicken army? TRY IT! If you can defeat 10 of my super-chickens, I'll raise the war meter.

quests.name: Chicken War Mega Medal
quests.description: You think you can take on my 10 million chicken army? TRY IT! If you can gather 5 Mega Chicken Medals off my super-chickens, I'll raise the war meter.

quests.name: Desperado
quests.description: Before the monsters, Drago, everything, the walk back to the Capital always felt so short. Desperation makes the journey agonizingly long. Time is cruel like that. Better hurry and knock out a few of those monsters. They'll eat up the precious seconds we have left.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dead Position ' quest.

quests.name: Isolani
quests.description: What you find when you return won't be pretty. If you feel fear, embrace it. That means your mind is sound. The Moon will not break you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dead Position ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Let Sleeping Dogs Lie
quests.description: The monsters running rampant shouldn't be left alone. Take them down and return their dog tags to me for proof. In the meantime, I'll be making a few beds somewhere sunny for them.

quests.name: Clio, the Liar
quests.description: Dismantling the summoning chamber is going to take a good chunk of elbow grease, even with you and me. There should be tools to help us in the storage. The guards stationed in the Menagerie Display area also take care of storage. They switch out decorations throughout the seasons. One of the creatures in that room should have the storage key, assuming they weren't able to escape.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Polyhymnia, the Forgotten ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Melpomene, the Inevitable
quests.description: I hate to do this to my former compatriots but they won't let us into the storage room if they're awake. Mind helping me knock them out with the dull side of your blade? I know it's a lot more effort than it looks like its worth, what with the destruction happening around us. But impending doom doesn't mean we should give up.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Polyhymnia, the Forgotten ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Erato, the Inconsolable
quests.description: We're in the storage room…Apologies, I was caught up in old memories. My voice sounds funny? Don't tease me like that! Come now, the tools we need are in the boxes. Grab them, stomp the spiders biting your ankles, and we'll get moving. How do spiders get so big? There's nothing to catch but dust bunnies.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Polyhymnia, the Forgotten ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Thalia, the Truth
quests.description: Darkon! This isn't how I wanted to see him return. I know why he's here. His focus will be all on taking you out of the castle. I'm going to need you to stall him for as long as possible while I try to damage the magical nodes in the summoning chamber. Talk to him… see if he'll give you any information, and then return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Polyhymnia, the Forgotten ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Darkon, the Conductor
quests.description: With the gate opening, we have roughly four and a half minutes before The World crosses over. Please knock Darkon out before that happens.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The World ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once per week.

quests.name: The Past and the Present
quests.description: You have both the past and present versions of Astravia Castle? I don't know how that is possible, but I should expect nothing less from the Dragon of Time! With some help, I might be able to combine them. And by that I mean Darkon's help of course.

quests.name: Lazure's Reawakening
quests.description: Has death truly taken the Hollowborn Lazure, or did his will merely go dormant? It may be possible to patch what was broken if you reinvigorate his remains with reagents from the shadow creatures in /ShadowRealm, and the Chaoroots and the Judge's Minions in /HBChallenge.

quests.name: Target Practice
quests.description: Well, you survived your journey here, so you might as well make yourself useful. See those rough-looking warriors over there? They are also Hollowborn. Tamers. They need to practice their skills. YOU'LL make a fine target. I think you already know what you need to do.

quests.name: Double Crossed
quests.description: No, don't look at me like that. I won't interfere in another's test. This isn't a trap either, we just need to make sure you are ready for the challenges the future will bring. This is a test of your resolve and strength. If you fail to pass, well, I did promise one of the nicer body bags.

quests.name: Plant Stalk-ers
quests.description: Chamat's meddling with the tower's wards has disturbed the wildlife in the area. While we don't want to bring harm to these innocent creatures, they block our progress toward entering the tower. Knock them out so that we can proceed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Water Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Rage Against the Mach-Wing
quests.description: The Queen has twisted the wildlife to her will. These once peaceful owls have turned into rage filled beasts. Put them out of their misery.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Water Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tower Wards
quests.description: Chamat has reactivated the Wards protecting the Tower. This form can assist you in removing them, but we require the appropriate amount of Mana. Collect the Wells of Mana in the area and we shall use them to dispel the Wards.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Water Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Final Barrier
quests.description: Unfortunately for you, non-Mana construct, the final barrier will sap away your lifeforce if you try to enter through it. Chamat must have used the Queen to get through it, but we don't have that luxury. Instead, we must create a coat of lifeforce around you in order to enter the tower alive. Acquire the lifeforce from the local wildlife and we will stop Chamat before he breaches the Fire Orb's containment field.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Water Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Fire Orb
quests.description: Chamat must pay for what he has done to our Mana-kin. Show him no mercy and retrieve the Fire Orb.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Water Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Legion Beast Quest
quests.description: Display your skill to the Legion Beast by defeating the Legion Arena Guard Dark Legion Arena Guard and he may be willing to guard your house.

quests.name: Head of the Legion Beast
quests.description: Truly great warriors of the Undead Legion can earn a character page badge to display to the entire world. All you must do is defeat The Beast in the /sevencircleswar zone to complete this quest and unlock your badge.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Head of the Legion Beast in your inventory.

items.name: Head of the Legion Beast Character Page Badge

quests.name: Let it Burn
quests.description: (Flame noises)

quests.name: Legion Castle Quest
quests.description: From warriors, to guards, to the generals that serve directly under Dage… the Undead Legion cannot continue to expand without a continual stream of new souls. And with war always on the horizon, we need them. Fast. Bring me the best new recruits you can find from the Underworld Arena, and test your might against the Legion Fiend Rider.

items.name: Blades of the Loyal Legion Warrior

quests.name: The Castle's Crown
quests.description: As the ruler of this exceptional castle, it is customary that you have an exceptional crown. Bring me the crowns of other sovereigns, and I'll use them to forge one unlike any you have ever seen.

quests.name: Legion Pirate Caster's Pet Merge
quests.description: There are many dark paths to explore surrounding the river Styx in the Underworld, and a Pirate Caster must be ready to journey down all of them. For those who journey far enough, you'll find the dreaded guard, Cerberus. Defeat him for a chance to get one my Legion Pirate Lieutenant prizes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Underworld Pirate Caster's Pet (Merge) in inventory.

items.name: Pirate Caster's Mask Hat Morph + Locks

quests.name: The Story of Tyrnjal
quests.description: Let me tell you of Tyrnjal's greatest exploits…
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50.

quests.name: Tyrnjal's Iron Fist
quests.description: Many years ago on this exact day, Tynjal went to Dage to ask for a force of legionnaires to invade Dwarfhold. Tyrnjal stated that there's an artifact hidden in Dwarfhold, the Orb of Vitiate. The Orb could destroy stones with just a wave of a hand. Our enemies would never be able to sleep well in their castles.
quests.requirements_note: Must be Level 50.

items.name: Woven Iron Blade of the North

quests.name: Legion Fealty 1
quests.description: Every member of the Legion is undead to some degree, either through losing their physical life or forfeiting their souls. As Dage’s most loyal servants, Legion Revenants bask in death and dutifully spread unlife in the name of the Legion. Kill and re-kill Ultra Aeacus 50 times to further his strength in death, tether 300 forgotten souls to the Undead Legion, darken the essence of 500 Shadow Warriors in /shadowrealmpast, and return with contracts from 1,000 dracolich heads. The cost is high, but your reward will be great.
quests.requirements_note: Requires Rank 10 Evil .

quests.name: Legion Fealty 2
quests.description: The Legion is vast, and our influence is among the strongest in Lore. However, the existence of other undead factions means that our control over unlife is not yet ubiquitous. Prove your loyalty to the Legion by slaying one legion's worth of undead not yet pledged to Dage— perhaps in their next unlife, they will bend to our will. The cost is high, but your reward will be great.

quests.name: Legion Fealty 3
quests.description: You have shown your loyalty through tasks expected from Legion Revenants, but have yet to stand out among other members of the Undead Legion. If you want to join the Legion's most elite, then you must show your willingness to work harder than every other soldier. This is the price you must pay before you can accept you final task. The cost is high, but your reward will be great.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Legion Fealty 4
quests.description: Your previous displays of loyalty were impressive, but not enough. For your final task, you must prove that you are worthy to command the power granted to Legion Revenants. For all the death you will spread, all the legions you will conquer, all the currency you will donate, the Legion will grow stronger. A task fit for an army assigned to but a single soldier -- should you complete it, you will be deemed worthy of the strength you seek.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Legion Sigil Pet Quest
quests.description: The day of Darkness is upon us! The Undead Legion celebrates the anniversary of Dage the Evil's birthday. The Legion Fiend Rider in the /legionarena holds Dark Gift Boxes. Get one and you'll be able to choose your reward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Legion Sigil Pet in your inventory.

items.name: Wrath of the Legion Ultra Cape
Wrath of the Legion Blade Pet
Wrath of the Legion Ultra Blade Pet

quests.name: Seek the Souls
quests.description: You have taken another step towards proving your loyalty. Now, Legion Member, prove your worth in battle by gathering the souls of the living. Bring me 20 stolen souls from street criminals. /join alley to find many of them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Legion SoulSeeker Pet .

quests.name: Legion Weaponscrafter
quests.description: To craft the finest gear, one needs the best materials. Bring me the following items and you will have a chance to get one of my best weapons.

quests.name: I'm Not That Stupid
quests.description: A peace offering? Really? Nice try, but I've seen the things Fausto has been having you do. I don't know what he's told you, but I booked this event months ago. I have every right to be here. I'm willing to forgive everything you've done, but only if you make things right. You can start by removing Fausto's Carnaval décor. If he can't play nice, then neither will I.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Sleepytime Necklace in your inventory.

quests.name: Why Did It Have To Be Snakes
quests.description: He said the Shushen were scaring his crew, did he? Well, those snakes are scaring mine. I think we could use a few less of them don't you?
quests.requirements_note: Must have Parades Token VI in your inventory.

quests.name: Flash! Bang!
quests.description: And now you can run HIS crew off like he did mine. Take these fireworks… they're harmless, but they make a loud noise and a bright flash. If you start setting them off near Carnaval dancers, they won't want to stick around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Parades Token VII in your inventory.

quests.name: I Don't Retaliate, I Escalate
quests.description: I notice Fausto is still here. That's ok - I have a plan. I am going to summon an Oni to chase Fausto and his crew off the street. Collect spectral essence from the Shushen, and some vials of blood from the ravens. They will power my spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Parades Token VIII in your inventory.

quests.name: One Last Thing
quests.description: Now all I need is the spell itself. Go to /hachiko, and find the Ninja Nopperabo. Some of them carry scrolls of summoning. Fight them until you find one, and then bring it back to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Parades Token IX in your inventory.

quests.name: Defeat the Oni
quests.description: I can't control the Oni! He's attacking Fausto and his crew, but… he's destroying my parade, too! We have to stop him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Parades Token X in your inventory.

quests.name: Muck and Feather
quests.description: The Stymphalian that made its nest in the marsh is a terrible neighbird! Their droppings are poisonous, and they just dump them anywhere! Pluck them bald and run them out of town!

quests.name: A Light Ssssssnack
quests.description: I ssssee you'd like sssome power. Defeat sssome sssstarsss in the eclipsssed land of Ssstarssinc. Bring me ssssome dussst, and I'll enchant it sso you can make ssssome powerful gear.

quests.name: Blinded by the Black Light
quests.description: *ssss* You're back? Hmmm… Bring me sssome Ssstar Sssscrap Metal from /Dreadssssspace, sssome Vortex Essssence from the Vortex Guardian in /Whitehole, and ssssome Black Light Aura from the Elementalssss in /Blackholesssssssun.

quests.name: Cold Reception
quests.description: The Knights and Paladins were quite hospitable, until they realized that our guards were Elven. I understand that other Elves have caused them trouble, but that's no reason to shove my troops around. Would you mind teaching those bad eggs to keep their hands to themselves?

quests.name: Long Walk on the Beach
quests.description: This beach is beautiful, but I was hoping there'd be more fish than the guppies flitting about in the tide. Say, have you been to /Ashray? Mind heading there to grab a few of the Kitefin Shark Bait? I've never seen them before, but I heard they have deepsea pearls in their stomachs.

quests.name: Last Bastion of Light
quests.description: I am plagued by the Shadow Creatures who keep invading my park! Juanita Park is MY home… my only home, and the last place left where Light holds sway. Please, Hero, I would be so grateful if you could remove 4 of the imps and 3 of the Shadowstone creatures. I - I fear for the Light I have left!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Doom Outside the Dome ' quest.

quests.name: Shadowy Corruption
quests.description: I must keep eternal watch over the shadow creatures who would destroy my home. If you would help me defend my home, I would be grateful! Pour these 5 vials of elixir around the perimeter of my dome, and I am certain that the darkness will find no refuge here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest.

quests.name: Gather the Goods
quests.description: Lim: Ok, I'm going to need a lot of small parts for this. I'll gather some, you get the rest, ok? Find me a fully charged battery, some hinges, and some small screws. You can probably find some of them laying around from the broken robots, but you might have to… well, break some MORE to get the rest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Stop the Hurting ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Spooky Casings
quests.description: Lim: Now I just need something for the casing. You know what would work really well? One of these robotic heads! Bring me a few - I think we're going to need a lot of ghost boxes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Do a Goo-d Job
quests.description: Cysero: My turn! I'm going to make a concoction that will help make Lim's ghost boxes actually catch ghosts. The ghosts have been leaving snotty globs of ectoplasm behind. Bring me a few of those to start.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Plop Plop Fizz Fizz
quests.description: Cysero: Now I need something to activate it. Something… fizzy. A good, fizzy soda would do the trick, but every cup that I've tasted has been flat. See if you can find me a fizzy one!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Test the Ghost box
quests.description: Lim: Time to see if this thing works! Cysero: Beat up some mascots and we'll catch the ghosts that come out!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cranky Spirits
quests.description: Lim: I'm going to have to upgrade my Ghost Boxes if we're going to catch this ghost! Look inside the storage - you can see all the residue it left behind. If you bring me some strong samples of its residue, I can use it to attune my traps to that ghost.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get Wid of CWEEPY TWIG ' quest.

quests.name: It's Too S-Warm
quests.description: Cysero: Alright, now we just have to get past this swarm of… tiny… creepy… robot moglins. You know what to do! You smash 'em, we'll trap 'em!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get into the Panic Room
quests.description: Cysero: The control room also functions as a panic room, and Zorbak and Sally have locked themselves in. That's the bad news. The good news is, these Twilly bots are probably strong enough to break through the wall. See if you can take control of one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Smash the Wall
quests.description: Lim: Alright. We have control of one of the robots. Now we need to smash through the wall. Go over there and give it a shot!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Circuit Breakers
quests.description: Wire circuits just don't break by themselves—it's scientifically impossible. Someone, or something, must have eaten through the wires down below. And yeah, you're gonna have to go investigate if you want there to be a New Year celebration. See that Old Well over there? Jump down it and check the wiring for any flaws or breaks in the caves below. Bring me back any variables you may find to deduce the system failure at hand.

quests.name: Current Affairs
quests.description: Before we can proceed with the necessary repairs, we (meaning YOU) need to retrieve Spare Fuses and some Electrical Tape that I left down there. Why don't I just go and get it, you say? Darnit Hero, I'm a scientist, not an adventurer! Go back to the caves and bring back 3 Spare Fuses and 1 roll of Electrical Tape so I can fix the circuits. Unless you don't want a happy new year? Quickly I say!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Not Finished Yet-i
quests.description: I can get those circuits fixed in no time at all. 10 milliseconds, tops. But I refuse to go down there if that accursed Yeti has not yet *hibernated,* if you know what I mean. In the furthest depths of the cave, you will find Grand Master Yeti. Using deductive reasoning, he is the catalyst responsible for the majority of the damage. Confront and defeat the Yeti in order to induce him in a long winter's nap. Bring me back a tuft of his Faux Foe Fur so I know the deed has been done. Go!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Is the Area as Big Inside as Outside?
quests.description: If Lim was right, this situation is SERIOUS! You'd better see just what you have to work with, and where you have to work it in. Explore the area to make sure there are no untimely surprises.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Not Finished Yet-i ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Final Hour?
quests.description: It looks like that hourglass is the SHUTDOWN apparatus. You'll need a chainsaw to sever the tubing conducting the steam to it. I bet one of those Sneevils will be happy to lend this!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: See-Sawing Through Time
quests.description: Thankfully cutting tubing is a lot less complicated than time travel. If this works, you shouldn't need to enter the timestream. I hope. I think 6 cuts in the tubing should be enough to permanently displace the steam conduction. Without that, the apparatus will have insufficient energy to function!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: A Crack in Time Saves More Than Nine
quests.description: Those Chaorrupted Albino Rhino Beetles have some pretty sharp horns! I bet we can use one to puncture the class when we hit it with my mallet. Bring me a Sharpened Albino Horn for the job! Any dull ones you find I will put to good use in… other things. Don't ask. You wouldn't understand. SCIENCE!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Time Bashes On
quests.description: *SLAM* *WHAM* Did you feel that, Hero!? Iadoa's Chaorrupted Polar Bears must have been sent to attack us. He'll want to prevent our success while he's gone. Slay 18 of the Polar Bears, and then we should be able to finish our task!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: SHUTDOWN Sequence
quests.description: Those buttons and dials have got to be related to the SHUTDOWN sequence! Try to find the right combination and maybe you can just… turn it off. That Temporal Key note you got might have a clue. Looks like the first part of each sequence refers to a time. Looks like the rest is about… colors?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Chronomancy and Chaos
quests.description: Iadoa's back, and he's right on time! Of course. You're going to have to squinch him, or he'll cause no end of trouble! And there's no telling how much of your Time he'll take up if Drakath decides to use him as an agent of Chaos.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mogzard
quests.description: Take this Pockey Puck and head into the forest - /greenguardwest. One of the Pockey-Mogs ran off in that direction, so you'll probably find it there. It looked like some kind of horrible mutation between a moglin and a frogzard. I'll just call it a… Mogzard.

quests.name: Fishlin
quests.description: Here's another Pockey Puck - this time you're heading down to the /river. We lost a Fishwing-Moglin hybrid, and that's where it's most likely to have ended up. Go get 'em!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Groglin
quests.description: This next one is pretty weird. It looked like it got mashed up with some sort of monster… Groglurk, maybe? It ran off toward Swordhaven, so I'd check in all the dark places… maybe start in the /sewer.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mogdrake
quests.description: Back to catching Pockey-Mogs while I try to figure out a new way to cure these mutations. I saw a frogdrake hybrid - a Mogdrake, if you will - run off toward /willowcreek. You know what to do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mucklin
quests.description: The next one that escaped was a hybrid of a moglin and… a slime. I call it: Mucklin. I didn't actually see where it went, but I'm betting it's hanging out with the slimes in /swordhaven. Grab yourself a Pockey Puck and go nab it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Linix
quests.description: Next, I'm sending you after the Linix. No, it is NOT a moglin-based operating system! It's a moglin that partially mutated into a Phoenix. It looked like it was flying toward the Tower of Magic in /arcangrove.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pockey-Chew
quests.description: This next one's a cutie… it's almost a shame to turn him back into a normal moglin! I call him Pockey-Chew because, well, it's what he keeps saying. I guess he wants more Pockey to nibble on. When he ate the last of it, he ran off toward Aria's pet shop here in Battleon.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Medicinal Salves
quests.description: As you might expect, we get a lot of burns here in the Alchemy Academy. If you happen to accidentally create any medicinal salves while you are brewing your mixtures, I'd gladly take them off your hands and even give you a little extra Alchemy Reputation!

quests.name: Vial Of Antitoxins
quests.description: Just the other day I was asking myself why we don't keep more vials of antitoxins on hand, considering half the student in the infirmary are there due to accidentally poisoning themselves. If you happen to create some I'll buy them off of you and give you some extra credit Reputation too!

quests.name: Scan the Area
quests.description: Here, take these scanners! I've made some adjustments based on how I think this time-data should theoretically work. Place them around the area - try to get them evenly spaced. They should be able to detect any anomalies nearby. Find the anomaly, you'll find your virus.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get some Help ' quest.

quests.name: Get Help from Warlic
quests.description: Looks like your anomaly is right by where Warlic's been hovering. I should have known - I'm not surprised he can sense that something is out whack over there! Now that we know exactly where it is, I bet his magic can help us reveal it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Follow the Pattern.. He Ne Ar Kr
quests.description: Unfortunately, the PTMs aren't QUITE ready yet. They weren't registering toxin levels correctly in my last test. If you can get me some more supplies while I work on it, I'll be able to get it fixed much faster. I'll need some Purified Xenon - the Dwakels at the /crashsite use it in their own technology, so you should be able to get it from them. While you're there, see if you can find me a miniature pressure chamber, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get a Monitor ' quest.

quests.name: The PTM is Ready!
quests.description: Ok, let's do a test run of this thing. Go ahead and grab a PTM from the box next to me. Then head east of here and get rid of some of the noxious clouds and toxic fumes that are starting to gather. I'll make sure the meter is working properly, based on the amount of exposure you've had, when you come back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Save the Creatures
quests.description: Alright! Now that your PTM is fully functional, let's get you out there! There are a lot of forest creatures who have been sickened by Extriki's toxin. Try to save as many as you can. The flying ones… try to knock out, but not kill. And remember - keep an eye on your PTM! When it turns black, go back! In the meantime, I'll keep in contact with you through the PTM's com channel.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Clear the Treeants
quests.description: If you head out a bit farther, you'll see some Toxic Treeants and fallen trees that are preventing us from going any further. Burn them down, destroy them any way you can. Clear a path for yourself, and the rest of the troops.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Save the Creatures ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Excise the Infection
quests.description: Based on what Brentan's troops are telling me, there is a lot of infected wildlife out there that's too far gone to save. Put them out of their misery, and collect tissue samples from them. We may be able to use them to create an inoculation.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Root out the Plague
quests.description: The toxin is still spreading! Do what you can to keep it at bay. Burn as much of the blackened foliage as you can find - that should destroy any toxin that's still inside it. And take down some more of the Plague Spreaders, too. They can't continue spreading plague if they're not breathing.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: I Said Yes, Yes, Yes
quests.description: Uh-oh! Looks like you've hit your limit on toxin exposure! Better come on back and let Warlic and Twilly take care of you! Talk to Twilly when you get here to detox.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Protective Gear Required
quests.description: First things first: grab a hazmat suit and headgear from the box next to me. The town's under quarantine, so you won't be able to go in without one.

quests.name: Are There Any Survivors?
quests.description: As we mentioned earlier, this entire village is swarming zombies. You're going to have to fight your way through them, and see if you can find any survivors. We might have to just turn this into a rescue mission and then burn the whole thing down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gathering Samples
quests.description: Boy, do I have some fun in store for you! I'm going to need some samples of this Dragon Plague, and also some samples of the snot he's been sneezing out. Luckily, the town is crawling with copious amounts of both! Just beat up on the Wandering Plague and Snotgoblins until you can gloop some into a jar. Chop-chop, time's a wasting!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find a 'Volunteer'
quests.description: Now, I just need a test subject. You know, to test my cure on, before I mass produce it to… uh, the masses! Just go catch me a Plague Zombie - pick one, and keep hitting it until you wear it out enough to tie it up. You might have to try a few times before you find one who'll cooperate.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cure the Volunteer
quests.description: Time to help me mix up a cure! I've altered the samples you brought me - with SCIENCE! - and now, they should neutralize the virus when they come into contact with it. Start with a glob of the… well, the snot. And then slowly mix 3 drops of the altered plague into it. Once you have it mixed, give it to our test subject here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Herbal Help
quests.description: I'm going to try adding some restorative herbs to the formula. You know what's one of the best herbal remedies around? Marsh Kelp. Luckily, there's a Marsh Monster lurking just outside of town. Beat him up, and take his kelp!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Re-heal
quests.description: Before I mix up a new test cure, I need you to go out and get me some fungus. But not just any fungus! What I need are Re-Shrooms! They rejuvenate, revive, and restore! You'll recognize them by their distinctive coloring: light green, with large white spots.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Let's Try That Again
quests.description: Alright, let's try this again. Remember: Start with a glob of snot, then mix in 3 drops of Plague. Then add a handful of kelp, and exactly 2 of the mushrooms. As before, once you have it mixed, give it to our test subject.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: One More Time
quests.description: Maybe we need to shore up this science with a bit of alchemy - that's right, I'm taking potions! i don't have any with me, so I'll need you to get fetch some. Bring me a standard Health Potion, and and Airther Vitae. You can get the former from Reens in /arcangrove, and the latter from Phelan in /dragonhame.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Who's Up for Round 3
quests.description: Third time's a charm? Well, let's hope so. DO you remember the formula? Glob of snot, 3 drops of Plague, handful of kelp, exactly 2 mushrooms. Then, add a dose of healing potion, and a dash of airther vitae, and give it to the test subject. And keep your fingers crossed!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Cure the Villagers
quests.description: First, let's get to work on curing the villagers. Fight them until you can get them sprayed down nice and good, and then send them outside to me. That way, we'll make sure they don't get re-infected before we can destroy the rest of the Dragon Plague!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gotta Clean Up
quests.description: Alright, next you're going to go back in and spray down all of those… globs of snot that Phlegnn has sneezed everywhere.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Clear the Castellum
quests.description: Now, you're going to go spray down the castellum - that's the big pool of water in center of town. It acts as the town's main source of water, so until it's disinfected, the Dragon Plague will continue to spread. Make sure you clear ALL the slime, without it, the SnotGoblin Prime will never leave.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Mutated Plague
quests.description: So, after you killed Phlegnn, I decided to stick around and run some experiments on plague samples I still had. I HAVE MADE A TERRIBLE MISTAKE. I mutated the plague, and then I lost it! I'll sleep earlier if you tell me you've found and destroyed it.
quests.requirements_note: Must complete ' Cured is NOT GOOD ' quest.

quests.name: Bottle Time
quests.description: I wasn't expecting to work while I was here. No, of course I don't mind! But I don't have my supplies. Mind helping me out? I just need something I can use as a vial… maybe the perfume bottles some of the dancers carry?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Lim ' quest.

quests.name: Get Some Fur
quests.description: I'm going to need some zombie-related samples to test for chemical reactions. Some of the slime they've spread around the city, and maybe ah… some rat fur? Just to see if it's contagious.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Go Tell Beleen
quests.description: Well, that's it, I guess. Go on back to Beleen and let her know what we found! She's outside the palace doors!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: LIMft Token
quests.description: Once you purchase your LIMFT token, our transportation system will take you the rest of the way to your destination.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Blockage ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: FIRE!
quests.description: The crash has really done a number on the LIMFT! We've got a lot of electrical fires to deal with, and I can't focus on fixing the vehicle and worry about those at the same time. Please put them out for me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Smoke!
quests.description: It's still really smoky in here. I can't see what I'm doing, and it's probably not great for our lungs, either. Clear out as much smoke as you can, and get rid of those elementals so they can't keep generating more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Scavengers
quests.description: I'm going to need to do a lot of repairs, friend. Unfortunately, a lot of the parts I need have been blown all over the place. They've been picked up by the smoke elementals, or scavenged by the… sigh… by the sock golems. Please get everything back for me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Repair Time
quests.description: A hand with the repairs, please? Only the easy parts, I promise.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get Proof
quests.description: It's obvious who's behind this mishap, right? But it will still be good to have some evidence of his misdeeds when I confront him. Fight the sock golems that have invaded the LIMFT, and bring back the largest socks from them as our proof.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stop the (U)bear!
quests.description: Sigh. Come on. Let's help him stop his weird rampaging bear-bus.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Collection Dejection
quests.description: If we're looking at interstellar irregularities, one name comes to mind: The Collector. That being has always been devoted to hoarding the most bizarre objects that come his way. And if my satellites are anything to go by, he and his cronies in the /future have quite a few Freggments in their collections. Shall we pay him a visit?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cowissa ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Poached Eggs
quests.description: Oh… this is bad. I've picked up another Freggment, and this one isn't just adrift - it's actually been picked up and is being transported by a group of smugglers… the infamous /Byrodax! Find out what they're up to, and no matter what it is, stop it; we cannot allow any pieces of the Meat-Eor to fall into the wrong hands!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cowissa ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dumpster Diving
quests.description: If I was a piece of Meat-Eor endlessly floating through space, where would I eventually drift to? Of course… the Junk Hoard! Almost anything and everything ends up there eventually - and it wouldn't surprise me if some of our targets managed to drop in too. Take a hike around the hoard and rustle through whatever junk you see. They've got to be there somewhere!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cowissa ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Dreadful Dinner
quests.description: I've head back from satellite #4: one of the Freggments has been found in the abandoned Dread Space Station! Thank goodness the former inhabitants are gone. Try and go pick it up, but tread lightly: the robotic alien beasts may be cleared out, but something is still destroying all the scout probes I send up there. Something HUGE, powerful, and….fluffy?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cowissa ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Succeed, or Fry Trying
quests.description: It looks like the Meat-Eor had one last surprise for us. The remaining Freggments are drifting directly towards the sun! They're acting as lenses, magnifying the sun's rays and its elementals. If we don't grab them, Lore will be literally fried! Catch them at the /thirdspell, and be quick about it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Cowissa ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: SlimeZ
quests.description: Let's start with an easy task. Slimes have been a constant in Swordhaven, even when it was on fire. Their boiling point is higher than water, they're a strong adhesive, and the Pizza Shop Owner advertises how nutritious they are. Would you collect some in these cans for our emergency storage? There are slimes lurking East by the cemetery gates. There is a curious visitor there too. You should speak to them as well.

quests.name: Innvasive
quests.description: Many of Swordhaven's buildings need constant renovations to keep up with frequent invasions. We have substantial funding from generous donors but merchants don't have the means to get the best materials. The Capital View Inn was built out of rare Spirit Wood from Blossoming Treeants. Oh? There are Blossoming Treeants in /guardiantree? If you would be so kind, would you procure us a few bundles?

quests.name: Milk Bones
quests.description: The Crown is encouraging new businesses to move in, including the pet shoppe. It's owned by a beastmaster sponsored by the crown to popularize the rearing of more dangerous companions. They advised that in a place called /necrodungeon, there are lich bones that would be ground up and fed to the hatchlings to make them stronger. Collect some and…chat with the beastmaster if you have time. Lich bone kibble is… questionable.

quests.name: Phoenix Down
quests.description: Sigrid Sunshield, an ArchPaladin that once fought alongside the previous Queen, has opened a base of operations in a building up the path from here. She is fitting it with modifications of her own, but has not asked for any help. I happened to overhear that they were using feathers from a place called /lavarun to fireproof the wood. Gifting her a few bundles would surely ease some of her stress.

quests.name: The Nibbles
quests.description: In addition to warriors from across Greenguard, Lorekeepers are being called to Swordhaven as well. One of them, a Dragonslayer Lorekeeper named Dedara, is just outside of the castle by the drawbridge. I think she would be eager to chat with you, but a hospitality gift would bring her a smile. You know of a unique dragon specimen from a place called /nibbleon? Then go on and wrangle it!

quests.name: Letters in Henvelopes
quests.description: I don't have the best handwriting - arguably, it's chicken scratch - but I've written up some Tender promo letters that need to be hand-delivered to my peeps. Some might've already received my letter, so don't be discouraged if they turn you away; there's still plenty of chickens who need to hear about my Tender app!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Without Feather Ado ' quest.

quests.name: Final Rest
quests.description: Blackhorn Tomb is crawling with the restless undead who have died here in Thunderforge. Searching them for clues to the scroll's location would be the smartest move. Put 5 of the Restless undead to rest and search the remains for the Darkblood Scroll.

quests.name: Disturbing The Peace
quests.description: Perhaps the scroll can be found in one of the tombs. If these were the resting places of good people I would never allow this but considering they are Darkblood tombs… shatter the tomb doors and search the tombs for the scroll.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sampling Silk
quests.description: These Tomb Spiders seem to have infested Blackhorn and even blocked off one of the passages. You cannot explore the tomb further until the wall of web is destroyed… but how? Blades have no effect of that wall. Gather 6 samples of Spider Silk from Tombs Spiders so that I might find a weakness.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fire Is The Thing
quests.description: Ah HA! Fire can destroy The Tomb Spiders webbing. We will need material for a fire bomb. Gather 3 Gas Bladders from the Tomb Spiders, 3 Scraps of Cloth from the Restless Undead and find a bottle lying on the ground somewhere inside Blackhorn Tomb. Bring them all to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Wall Comes Down
quests.description: The wall of Tomb Spider webbing should simply vanish when you go drop this fire bomb on it. Make sure not to stand too close. Let me know how it works.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Bonefeeder
quests.description: Tomb Spiders are a species of carrion spider. That is, they eat the remains from a larger predator which is usually a large Bonefeeder Spider. Find this monster and slay it. The tomb will not be safe until you do. Let me know when the Bonefeeder has fallen.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What Lies Beyond?
quests.description: Now that the Bonefeeder has been slain, the Tomb Spiders will lose interest in this place. Explore the rest of Blackhorn beyond the room where you found the Bonefeeder and let me know what you find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Toxic
quests.description: The Bonefeeder species gathers lost items and weaves them into their cocoons. The Scroll MUST be in one of them but we can't search them just yet. The contents are highly toxic. We will have to brew an anti-toxin just to open them. Start by bringing me 4 vials of Spider Venom from the Tomb Spiders!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Very Toxic
quests.description: The Tomb Spider venom is particularly weak. Perhaps we can augment it with some of the poisonous Thunderforge fungus that grows on the bones of the Restless Undead. Bring me 6 patches of Undead Fungus so I can complete the anti-toxin.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Really, VERY VERY TOXIC!
quests.description: Here, drink this. The anti-toxin is now coursing through your blood but the cocoons will STILL poison you quite badly. Try not to die while you're searching them. Now go and bring back the Darkblood Scroll then, together, we will begin our quest to END Chaos on Lore!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Super Spreaders
quests.description: The Plague Spreaders that Extriki released have been releasing sickness and death to the Darkblood that live nearby. We must take them out and keep those people safe!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Wind Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Sample Size
quests.description: I may be able to create a cure for Extriki's toxins. Collect some samples of the poisonous growths in the area for me to study.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Wind Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Moss You Be This Nasty
quests.description: It appears Extriki uses the Plaguemoss creatures to distribute its toxin over a wider range. Take them out and we shall see how they dispense their poison.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Wind Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Infected With The Cure
quests.description: Mixing Extiki's toxin with some of my Manticore's antitoxin has yielded some great results! I think it is safe to test this cure on the monsters in the area first. Once they seem cleared of the toxin, we can apply the cure to the clouds and it should rain down to the Darkblood below, curing them as well!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Wind Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hurtful Healing
quests.description: With this cure, we should be able to heal the monsters in the area as well. Face off against as many as you can and heal them of Extriki's toxin.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Wind Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Energy Orb
quests.description: Extriki stands between us and the Energy Orb. We must strike it down and bring peace to the Darkblood!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Wind Orb ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What's Mine is Yours
quests.description: The tracks in front of you lead to rare Gems that are incredibly valuable to the Dwarves. However, the multiple breaks and fallen debris on the tracks make for a completely unsafe work environment. If you want to prove yourself, here is your chance. Collect a Bag of Gems (30 Gems) and 1 Chaotic Draconian Scale and bring them here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 4 Dwarfhold .

quests.name: Animated Elementals
quests.description: The life force from the various elements plays an important role Dravix healing. This is a technique I am trying to teach my apprentice, Shi'Nah, but our supplies are running low. Will you help us replenish? Since most elements are not technically alive, you'll need to harvest these from the Living Fire, Water, Earth and Air in the Dragonplane.

quests.name: Eggcellent Hunt
quests.description: If you would learn to CARE for the undead, you must also concern yourself with the living… Collect 13 Dragon Eggs that have gotten lost amid the shuffle of the Con.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Zorbak's Legion: Tiny Terrors ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: "Fresh" Dragon Chow
quests.description: Dracoliches can eat almost anything a living dragon can… and they eat a LOT. I am low on supplies, and you look big and strong. Slay Zombie Warriors to find 8 meaty bones to feed the dracs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bling, Baby, Bling
quests.description: You realize, Hero, that it is neither EASY nor CHEAP to keep a pet dracolich? You will need a great deal of treasure and bring me back some of those Battle Gems to help support this brood. (Quest available once per login)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: So, something washed up on the beach...
quests.description: A walk on the beach should bring peace. But today, I came across a mysterious beached tentacle that caused me great concern. I do not THINK it is an Old One rising… But… Hero, we need you to become familiar with our islands and find the Water Temple. Please explore, and if you come across the tentacle, approach with caution.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Burning Question ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Dilution Solution
quests.description: We MUST weaken the water-earth spell bond. In order to do that, we need a solution that is both made of water and earth. The Marsh Lurkers have blood that is, indeed, exactly what we are looking for. Kill 12 Marsh Lurkers and bring me their blood. Once we link their blood to the spell and dilute it, the bond will weaken.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Burning Question ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Frogdrake's Love Story
quests.description: The flames of passion cannot be quenched, even in the wetlands. Did you know that female Frogdrakes only accept a mate with the most flamboyant flame? No? Then you must go and see them! If the conditions are right, the flames will crystallize. Gather 12 crystallized Frogdrake flames so I can break the fire-water bond.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Burning Question ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Little Bit of Bubbly Never Hurt
quests.description: Bubbles are a wonder of nature. So very fragile, yet beautiful and powerful in their own way. I must attend to the water-water bond of the spell. In order to do that I need you to destroy 12 Living Waters and gather 10 Bubbles of Water magic plus 10 Burst Water Bubbles. With these components, we will weaken the spell further.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Burning Question ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Flight of the Fishwings
quests.description: Fishwings are such interesting creatures, a magical melding of air and water. We need their wings in order to move forward, Hero. I know, their sacrifice will not go unnoticed. Please bring back 12 fish wings and be on the lookout for the very rare Fishwings venom. I will need one vial of that to complete this vital step.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Burning Question ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hunt for the Greater Good
quests.description: It's time, Hero, to create a spiritual trident to break the spell. I need a great number of items to do this and you are the only one who can get them. Kill Fishman Soldiers to obtain a Fishman Trident. Kill Marsh Lurkers to get a Marsh Tribal Totem. Kill Frogdrakes to get Powdered Drake's Horn. Finally, please get 3 Effervescent Ocean Spirit.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Burning Question ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kill the Deep Dweller
quests.description: We need those eggs, Hero. All is for naught if we cannot obtain them. We have no choice but to kill the Deep Dweller in order to succeed. Please take care and remember that everything depends on you. No pressure, no pressure at all.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Burning Question ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Make Marsh-mallows out of them!
quests.description: Hmmm, Hero. You would not have tasted my specialty, would you? No, of course not. You must! I treat my acolytes with them when they have been especially brilliant. If I'm to make them for you, I'll need the eyes from 10 Marsh Lurkers and the Beaten Air stirred by 5 Fishwings!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Burning Question ' quest.

quests.name: Firewater in your Veins
quests.description: I am adept in more than just the manipulation of pure Water, Hero. I have concocted a drink made from the 7 sacs of Frogdrake Venom and 7 Pools of Death from Living Waters! Bring them to me and I'll serve you a drink that will heat your blood - perfect before battle!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Burning Question ' quest.

quests.name: Remains
quests.description: The Slavers that once controlled the Death Pits committed great sins against their own people. The spirits of the Darkblood who died are still angry and insane. First, Destroy 3 Rotting Darkblood and clear their spirits from this level of the pits. Use my amulet to summon me again when you are done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Open Temple ' quest. Note: These quests can only be done once .

quests.name: Thriving In Rot
quests.description: We must begin to work of protecting you from the Rotstone's dangerous effects before you can go lower. First gather 5 of the Glowing Mushrooms that grow near the surface of the Death Pits. Summon my spirit again when you are done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Open Temple ' quest. Note: These quests can only be done once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rotting Ribs
quests.description: Next you will need to gather some bones from the Rotting Darkblood that are rich in the poison from the Rotstone. Summon my spirit again once you have gathered 10 Rotten Rib Bones.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Open Temple ' quest. Note: These quests can only be done once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Perfect Skull
quests.description: Lastly, you will need to find one large, perfect skull in which to mix the marking paint that we will use to create the protection runes. It must be absolutely perfect, so you may look for some time before you find the one you need.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Open Temple ' quest. Note: These quests can only be done once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Deeper Into Death
quests.description: The rune paint needs to rest for a short time, while it rests you can clear the next level of the Death Pits. This far down the Ghastly Darkblood roam. They are more dangerous than the Rotting Darkblood so beware. Destroy 4 of them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Open Temple ' quest. Note: These quests can only be done once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Precise Placement
quests.description: The protection runes have to be placed in very exact locations, but I don't know where those might be. One of these Ghastly Darkblood must be one of the old Slavers. Destroy Ghastly Darkblood until you find the rune map.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Open Temple ' quest. Note: These quests can only be done once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Painted Protection
quests.description: Now that you have the map you should be able to find where all 6 runes of protection were once placed. You will need to use the rune paint to refresh all the runes to protect yourself from further exposure to the Rotstone's poison.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Open Temple ' quest. Note: These quests can only be done once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: They Sense You
quests.description: The undead in the Death Pits have begun to stir since you activated the new runes. Go back and destroy 3 more Rotting Darkblood to thin their numbers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Open Temple ' quest. Note: These quests can only be done once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: They Hate You
quests.description: Your work is not yet done. The spirits of the undead you have slain are calling out to the Ghastly Darkblood to repel the living intruder. You must destroy 3 more Ghastly Darkblood.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Open Temple ' quest. Note: These quests can only be done once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Sundered
quests.description: This far down some of the oldest and most powerful undead walk the darkness and bones. Attack and destroy 5 of the Sundered Darkblood before they mass and overtake you!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Open Temple ' quest. Note: These quests can only be done once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rotstone
quests.description: The runes of protection are holding but they won't for long if you go too much deeper. You need to gather some of the loose piles of Raw Rotstone Ore dispose of them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Open Temple ' quest. Note: These quests can only be done once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Honor The Dead
quests.description: Once a tribe of Darkblood gained control over the Death Pits they would use rival tribe captives as slaves… even the honored Primarchs. Its time to put the sins of the past to rest. Slay the Darkblood until you find 3 Ancient Primarch Weapons so we can honor them, as befits a Primarch.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Open Temple ' quest. Note: These quests can only be done once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ties to Life
quests.description: The undead Darkblood keep coming from the walls and shadows. You will need to destroy several piles of bones and put their spirits to rest or the will just keep coming after you. Find and burn 12 Piles of Bones.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Open Temple ' quest. Note: These quests can only be done once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears
quests.description: The remains of the warlord Wrathful Vestis are on this lowest level of the Death Pits. The Primarch thought this would be the safest location to hide the tears but Lionfang is close behind. Defeat Vestis then take the Tears!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Open Temple ' quest. Note: These quests can only be done once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Chaos Eye of Vestis
quests.description: Wrathful Vestis was once a great Darkblood warlord before he was defeated and thrown down here where he died. To see him chaorrupted is an insult to his great power. Pluck out the Chaos Eye on his chest.

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest.

quests.name: Bone Ladders
quests.description: You did quite a bit of damage fighting down here. These ladders were only bone and ligament to begin with. Gather 15 femurs to repair the ladders that you destroyed.

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest.

quests.name: Rotstone Daggers
quests.description: Many of the slaves would make daggers out of the Rotstone and try to escape the pits before the Rotstone poisoned them. They tied their hopes to these daggers and many lost their lives. Find one of the Rotstone daggers on the undead and free the spirit tied to it.

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest.

quests.name: Logash's Line
quests.description: Many of my ancestors were thrown into the Death Pits by the warring tribes who owned the pits at the time. Since I died I can feel their bones wandering the depths. Find my family seal on one of them and free my ancestor to his rest.

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest.

quests.name: The Drums Of The Dead
quests.description: The slavers once used drums to keep the slaves working at pace. Destroying one of those drums would free many frustrated Darkblood from their eternal torment. Find and destroy a set of Slaver Drums on one of the undead here.

npc.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears ' quest.

quests.name: Cryptbreaker Bounty
quests.description: There's a note on the board that says:

quests.name: Jon S'Nooooooo Bounty
quests.description: There's a note on the board that says:

quests.name: Ultra Drakonnan Bounty
quests.description: There's a note on the board that says:

quests.name: Module 005 Bounty
quests.description: There's a note on the board that says:

quests.name: Very Trobblesome
quests.description: There's a note on the board that says:

quests.name: Secret Treasure
quests.description: There's a note that says:

quests.name: Deep Trobble Treasure Chest
quests.description: Lucia says… "This chest washed up on shore last Summer. It's passed from sailor to dock-worker, from merchant to mage… until that scurvy spell-sucker tried to slip out without paying. I kept the chest instead. Never got a chance to open it, but if you're up for the challenge, let's see what you can do!

items.name: Grim First Mort on Yer Back

quests.name: Victory Blade Enchantment
quests.description: The undead in the Graveyard will have the items you need to create the Enchantment Rune. Bring back 1 Ravenwing Scroll from the Skeletal Vikings, 3 Unseeing Eyes from the Skeletal Warriors, and 5 Shards of Diamond Blade from Big Jack Sprat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Silver Victory Blade to access this quest.

quests.name: Alignment Quest: Light... or Dark?
quests.description: You have a choice to make, young one. Your blade can channel dark powers, or bright ones. You can build dreams, or destroy them. Bring me 10 Shattered Dream Sticks from the Skeletal Warriors, and we'll see what type of blade you really want to wield.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Enchanted Victory Blade to access this quest.

quests.name: Choose: Despair... or Glory?
quests.description: Your legendary weapon creation quest is almost complete, Hero. Bring me the 12 shards of the Nornir Triad from the Skeletal Vikings, and I will let you choose the amulet you desire - Despair or Glory.

quests.name: Ghoul Fungi
quests.description: Let's start our tour by entering the foyer. Ah, years of neglect have led to a bit of a shroom problem. Bless that young fellow Hans for helping the sisters clean. Have a chat with him and give him a hand harvesting the fungus.

quests.name: Grotesque Guardian
quests.description: The banquet that took the lives of Alnswick ghosts happened in the Ballroom. Take a left from the stairs and you'll run into some grotesque gargoyles. A young lady is there fighting them. Talk to her and help her turn the gargoyles into rubble!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dragon Instinct
quests.description: Miss Tara mentioned that her chaperone Nythera sensed something dangerous near the kitchens. Make a right from the stairway to talk to her about what could be going on. If my painted eyes weren't playing tricks on me, you'll find a bundle of my pen pal letters there too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Uninvited
quests.description: According to Lady Nythera, she feels a sense of foreboding from the Kitchen. Ah, the doors are locked. Perhaps we will make more progress upstairs. If anyone's up there, see if they have an idea. Be wary! Noble Ghosts are snooping around the upper floor as well.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Room Service
quests.description: Gah! This is the Master Bedroom? There isn't even a bed, just a frightening mess! Oh…I forgot I left it like this! It seems that the Dumbwaiter is broken. Let's fix it up, and see if I left more letters around here. My personal chambers should be the right place to find them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Newborn's Teething
