quests.description: Head down the dumbwaiter to the kitchens, and we'll unlock the main doors for ease of entry. Andr - er, I spent a lot of time here. The rest of the letters should be in the corner, if we can get past these undead creatures! What are they? Dogs?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sadistic Solicitations
quests.description: I can feel it- a terrible sense of dream, emanating from that locked trapdoor at the back of the kitchen. Backtrack to the Bedroom. The key has to be there, surrounded by the ghosts. While you're there, see if you can retrieve the Nobles' banquet invitations. I need to know if they were aware…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stomping on Eggshells
quests.description: We have the key to the cellar beneath the kitchen, where the warden of these poor baby Dragons was held captive. Come now, let's see if his spirit needs rest. I imagine the last of the letters are there with him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stone Clad Clan
quests.description: The Dragonlord released his seal on the Ballroom. We should get there as soon as possible. Don't let the Gargoyles stop you. They're protecting something that needs to be freed.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Stomping on Eggshells ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Restless Waltz
quests.description: The restless spirits of the wronged dragonlings are hoarding ghosts in the Ballroom. Their suffering twisted their souls into a single hydra. Please, we must lay them to rest, and release them from Andrew's sins.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Stomping on Eggshells ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadow Medals: Defend the Village!
quests.description: These soldiers are strong, and the people of this village don't stand a chance against them. Defeat as many as you can and report back. Bring me the medals they carry as proof.

quests.name: Seed Spitter Oil
quests.description: These villagers aren't trained for war, and a lot of them are wounded. If you bring me some Seed Spitter oil, our clerics can make a medicinal salve from it. It will help stabilize the wounds, and hopefully save some lives.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mega Shadow Medals
quests.description: The Shadowflame Army's elite forces are starting to appear on the battlefield. They don't look any different, but you will know them by the larger medals they carry. If you manage to kill any, bring their medals to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadow Samples
quests.description: Do you see those puddles of shadowy sludge that are forming on the ground where the Shadow Amy is fighting? I think that must be the key to figuring out what they are. Bring me some samples for our clerics to study.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shadow Medals: Fight Them Back!
quests.description: We've taken control of the village and the surrounding lands. Now, we must push this army back toward the castle! Fight them back, and bring me the medals from any that you defeat.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Interrogation
quests.description: We need to find out more information about the shadowy figure who's leading this army. Those Slashers are pure brawn - you won't be able to get anything out of them. But from the Scouts, you might. Interrogate them, and come back to me when you have some useful clues.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Malgor!
quests.description: We've got to stop this army, and now's our chance. Defeat Malgor and save the villagers from his Shadowflame Army.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Brentan's Battle
quests.description: Ah, it's you. I expected you'd show up sooner or later. Your "friend" did, and gave me a long list of instructions I do NOT have time for. But if you can help me here, I'll hand the note over to you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' DragonPlane Destruction ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Stand for Swordhaven
quests.description: Hero, can I count on you to help Swordhaven stand against the Infernal army? Our first step is to make sure our own soldiers are protected. Go to /safiriainvasion, and collect armor pieces from Fallen Knights and Infernal Knights. I assume they will put up a fight, but that won't be a problem for you, will it?

quests.name: Use Their Energy Against Them
quests.description: We would be even better protected if we could find a way to make us of the Infernal energy of the Nethemages that attacked Shadowfall. If you travel to /shadowfallinvasion and gather some for me, I'll see that it gets to our own mages so they can try to figure out a way to use it defensively.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Scry this!
quests.description: We have learned that the Diabolical Scryers scout ahead of the rest of the army, and use their orbs to transmit images back to other Scryers who have stayed behind. If we get a few of those orbs, we could use that same technique ourselves. It would give us an advantage that the previously invaded cities didn't have.Go back to /shadowfallinvasion and get some for me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Recalibration
quests.description: The mages of Swordhaven are beginning to devise a plan. Here, take this ring. While wearing it, go to the areas that were previously invaded - /doompally, /darkoviainvasion and /shadowfallinvasion - and defeat as many Infernals as you can. The ring will absorb their energy, and then our mages will be able to recalibrate it to be used against them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Arm the Armored!
quests.description: All that's left to do now is arm ourselves and prepare for the inevitable attack. Deliver the armors you collected to our Pactagonal Knights, and take the Infernal Energy and Scryer's Orbs to Warlic.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Save the Citizens
quests.description: Our soldiers are armed and protected, but our citizens aren't! Please, get them all to safety. Go out into the courtyard, and see to it that anyone who is still out there is escorted into the castle.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Destroy the Infernals
quests.description: Now that the citizens are safe - well, as safe as they can be in a situation like this - we can focus on demolishing that Infernal army! Slay them anywhere you find them,and as many as you can!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What is THAT??
quests.description: Hero! Something massive has emerged from the ground in the courtyard off to the left! Some kind of… giant worm of… teeth! I'll help the Pactagonal Knights fend off the Infernals while you go take care of it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Arm the Civilians
quests.description: Hero, this is not going as smoothly as I'd hoped. I hate to say it, but our citizens may need to protect themselves, so we'll have to arm them, too. Go into the castle and give a sword and shield to any civilians you find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get Those Beasts
quests.description: The Infernals have begun to send in their beasts. We've got a decent defense against their weapons, but these imps and hounds have so much raw power, they're wearing us down! Help me get rid of them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: It's Baaaaack!
quests.description: Hero! That giant worm has emerged again, this time on the other side of the courtyard! We'll hold down the fort over here. Just get rid of it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

items_required.name: Giant Worm of Teeth Defeated… Again!

quests.name: Him Again???
quests.description: You've fought this one before? Good. I have no doubt you'll be able to defeat him again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: What Happened to Baldric?
quests.description: So, the scouts we sent out never came back. And then the warrior we sent to rescue them never came back, either. He was the best we had, which means there's only one person I know who's strong enough to rescue HIM - and that's YOU. Head out through the back of the camp, and keep moving toward the Rift until you find him.

quests.name: Slay the Strays
quests.description: We may not be able to get to close to the Rift, but we can slay anything that strays to close to our camp! Get out there and destroy every monster you see. We won't stop until we've driven them all back where they came from!

quests.name: Get Samples
quests.description: Some of our more foolhardy warriors are planning to try to inoculate themselves against the Rift's toxic fumes by exposing themselves to them in small amounts. I cannot deny they are taking a huge risk, but if it might work, then we have to try. Collect samples, in small vials, of both the Noxious Fumes and the Toxic Bile. I'll make sure they get to the right people.

quests.name: Defeat Extriki
quests.description: Extriki has been weakened by the Nature Bomb! If we're going to take him down for good, we'll have to do it now - before he can make it back into the Rift!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Heart of the Glade ' quest.

quests.name: Unmended Scars
quests.description: The Knights and Paladins were quite hospitable, until they realized that our guards were Elven. I understand that other Elves have caused them trouble, but that's no reason to shove my troops around. Would you mind teaching those bad eggs to keep their hands to themselves?

quests.name: No Pain, No Gain
quests.description: As catastrophic as Chaos and Shadowflame were, the Alliance of Good and Evil coddled our youth. The Empire fighting alongside our Knights and Paladins have made them weak and dependent. A real warrior like you should mentor them. Even one session would open their eyes.

quests.name: Searchlights
quests.description: ﻿I would have preferred to usher you to Balemorale's most important rooms of note, but we're already being tailed. The Lightguard's Paladins are following us. I would have included them if they weren't worshiping that overgrown candle. If you would, make them leave us be.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Estrangement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once.

quests.name: Queensmen
quests.description: There are more eyes on us than I thought there'd be, so let's cut to the chase. I want to investigate what's beneath this castle. One of the Nobles' Knights should have a key to the cellar. Ask each of them to spar, and shake the key out of them. They'll be too excited to notice.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Estrangement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cellar Secrets
quests.description: ﻿I managed to catch Lord Brentan before he slipped out of the castle. Find him, and let him know that there are secrets in the cellar. He'll believe your words over mine. I've asked him to meet us at the cellar's entrance. It's through the door near where Astero and his ilk are congregating.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Estrangement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaotic Roots
quests.description: ﻿The cellar is infested with spiders, but the items the Queen had her Court Mages store here have been…Chaorrupted. We need to eliminate them, and keep them from harming Lady Song and Lady Marigold. I've invited them to our investigation, and they have information to share with you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Estrangement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Eroding Era
quests.description: ﻿We can't get deeper or collect the books we need to further understand what the Queen is doing unless we secure the cellar. There are Chaos Crystals that could injure or even infect us if we're not careful. Shatter them and collect the shards.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Estrangement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Old Wolf
quests.description: Thanks to Tris.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Estrangement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest. ﻿ Lady Song and Lady Marigold can decipher the research records. I would feel more at ease if you knew exactly what the Queen is up to. Take a look at that book on the desk as well. It looks like it was penned by a commoner instead of a scholar.

quests.name: Abandoned Cradle
quests.description: ﻿﻿There's…something slumped against the wall at the far end of the cellar. It's been burned and crushed, but I can tell that it's made of flesh. You're saying it's a "Vessel?" The Spiders and Crystals are crawling all over it. We should clear them away, and investigate the "Vessel."
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Estrangement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shockwaves
quests.description: ﻿There are screams coming from above. There's a dumbwaiter at the back wall of the cellar. Use it to get up to the ground floor. If I'm hearing right, it's the Skye Warriors. They're fighting with the Knights and Paladins. Hurry and capture some. We need to find out what's going on.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Estrangement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sleight of Hand
quests.description: The castle has been thrown into utter disarray. For some reason, the Knights and Paladins couldn't stop the Queen from being taken. Skye's Warriors are trying to kidnap other Nobles to take as hostages. Save as many of the remaining nobles as you can, and locate the Queen!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Estrangement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Double Fianchetto
quests.description: ﻿﻿The Queen has been put under some sort of curse by the Emissary of Skye, Lieber. He has control of her movements, and promises to stop her heart if you attack him. Don't let Lieber have the satisfaction of seeing us give up. Try everything you can to free the Queen!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Estrangement ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Lucid Pigment
quests.description: A painting of my ancestor's adoptive father came to life. The King of the Dark walks the forests of Chiral Valley once more. Please, lay him to rest. His era never accepted him, and this world won't be able to either.

quests.name: The Dark Ages
quests.description: A painting of my ancestor's adoptive father came to life. The King of the Dark walks the forests of Chiral Valley once more. Please, lay him to rest. His era never accepted him, and this world won't be able to either.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Sp-Eyes
quests.description: Let's start at the beginning, shall we? Travel to Mobius and learn as much as you can about the Chaos Sp-Eyes you'll find there. They were an ever present part of the Chaos War.

quests.name: Chaos Lycans
quests.description: So much happened in Darkovia. Both sides fighting against Wolfwing, and both sides corrupted by Chaos. Travel to Safiria's Castle and see what you can learn about the Chaos Lycans there.

quests.name: Chaos Vampire Knights
quests.description: It was not only the Lycans who suffered Chaorruption. Safiria's Vampire Knights turned against their master as well. Travel to Lycan Ridge and see what you can learn about these Chaos Vampire Knights.

quests.name: Chaonslaught Casters
quests.description: Some Lords of Chaos chaorrupted not only their enemies, but their own armies as well. Such was the case for Lionfang. Travel to Falguard and learn what you can from the Chaonslaught Casters he left behind.

quests.name: Chaonslaught Warriors
quests.description: You learned such interesting things about Lionfang's Casters. But what happens when the same process is performed on one who cannot wield magic? Go back to Falguard and study the Chaonslaught Warriors so that I might compare notes.

quests.name: Chaotic Chinchillizards
quests.description: Such strange creatures, Chinchilizards. Even stranger when infected with Chaos. Go to where the Bloodtusk War took place and you will find some there that you can study.

quests.name: Chaotic Koalions
quests.description: I know I didn't specifically ask, but while you were there, I don't suppose you also studied the Chaotic Koalions? No…? Would you mind going back and gathering some data for me? I think the comparison could be useful.

quests.name: Violet Slime
quests.description: Violet slime! That's what we need to study next. It's so obvious, and yet I didn't think of it until now. You can find plenty of it here in Crownsreach.

quests.name: Chaos Crystals
quests.description: Writing that scroll on Violet Slime has got me thinking about Chaos Crystals. They used to be spread throughout Lore, but now they, like the Slime itself, are primarily found in Crownsreach.

quests.name: Chaos Sprites
quests.description: Have you ever seen Chaos Sprites? Beautiful little things. Filled to the brim with Chaos. They appear around the Tower of Magic in Arcangrove, and also right here in Crownsreach.

quests.name: Plague Spreaders
quests.description: Do you remember the arrival of Extriki? Doglike minions came with him, spreading his plague as far as they could reach. I want to learn more about them. Travel to the Rift, or to the Charred Path, and see what you can discover.

quests.name: Toxic Bile
quests.description: Potentially more interesting than the Plague Spreaders was Extriki's Toxic Bile. I want to know more. Travel to the Rift he emerged from and see if there is any still left for you to study.

quests.name: Extrikitis
quests.description: The Extrikitis survived long past Extriki's death, and were spotted all throughout the fight against the Reshaper. Find some to study… in the Broken Woods, or the Twisted Caverns, or in the place where the Darkblood held their Pilgrimage.

quests.name: Ravenous Parasites
quests.description: The Ravenous Parasites appeared alongside both Extriki and Kolyaban. I would like to know why. Find some and study them for me, please. They may be found at the Rift, or along the Charred Path, or at the site of the Darkblood Pilgrimage.

quests.name: Spiderwings
quests.description: Spiderwings fascinate me. Such frightening creatures, yet so functional and beautiful. Find some for me, in the Broken Woods, or the Twisted Caverns, or in the place where the Darkblood held their Pilgrimage. Bring me anything you learn.

quests.name: Seed Stalkers
quests.description: It may be worth studying Seed Stalkers, as well. They can only be found in the Twisted Caverns. Go there, find some, and see what you can learn from them.

quests.name: Tentacled Darkblood
quests.description: I am curious about the creatures that Kolyaban reshaped in her own image. Travel to the place where Kolyaban fell, and see what you can learn about the Tentacled Darkblood there.

quests.name: Poisonous Darkblood
quests.description: Let's take a look at some of the Reshaper's more exotic mutations. Go and study the Poisonous Darkblood where Kolyaban fell, and come back to me with your findings.

quests.name: Time to Study
quests.description: I don't know if you've noticed, but there are a lot of monsters roaming these woods! Mostly, they're what you'd expect to see: purple, tentacles, lots of eyes. But some of them have a very different feel. More monstrous than chaotic, if you know what I mean.

quests.name: Calm Them Down
quests.description: Ugh, these things just will not behave! I need something to calm them down. I see them hanging around the Chaos Spitters a lot. Maybe if you bring back some of their leaves, the scent will placate them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get the Reagents
quests.description: Now I'm going to need to do some testing. How long have these monsters been on Lore? From where did they originate? I can answer these questions… if I have the right reagents. Some Chaos Ichor from the flying monsters and a few Starblossoms should do the trick.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Samples for Comparison
quests.description: While I run my tests on our monster friends, why don't you go out and get me something to compare the results to? Samples from the local land would be ideal. Like… literally, get me some clumps of soil! And maybe some cuttings from the local plants.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: More Testing Required
quests.description: Hmm. Well, I have a theory… and so far, my findings are supporting it. But I'll need to run a few more tests to be sure. Capture a few of the EldritchWings and Chaos Sp-Eyes so I can compare.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tidy Up
quests.description: First things first! We're going to have to clean up the area. We don't want people to panic, so we can't have anyone thinking anything is amiss. Kill as many of the invading monsters as you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: We Need Neutralizer
quests.description: We're not quite done out here yet. There's still a lot of… for lack of a better term, monstrous energy that needs to be neutralized. Never fear, I know just what to do! I just need some Acidic Pollen from the Chaos Spitters, and some Eye Gunk from the Chaos Sp-Eyes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Neutralize 'Em
quests.description: I've turned those ingredients you found into a completely safe anti-monster toxin that I'm going to call…Mon-B-Gone! Oh, be quiet. As if you could come up with anything better! Anyway, just spread it around anywhere monsters have been sighted. It will neutralize any residue left behind, and repel any new monsters that might show up.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Vermin Clearing
quests.description: The book I need is kept in the very back of the Crownsreach library, where the city's most restricted tomes are stored. Usually, no one ever goes back there, so there are a lot of… well. What I'm saying is, you're going to need to clear out the vermin first.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Neutralize 'Em ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find the Book
quests.description: Now we just need to find the book. It's kind of a maze back there! There's not much of an organizational system, so you'll just have to comb through everything carefully.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Neutralize 'Em ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get the Key
quests.description: So, the book is in a locked cabinet, huh? Then I guess we're going to need to find the key. But if the Crownsreach Loremaster doesn't have it, who knows where it's gotten off to? Maybe one of the rats has stolen it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Neutralize 'Em ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get the Book
quests.description: Well? What are you waiting for? Go get me that book!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Neutralize 'Em ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: It's a Book Wyrm!
quests.description: Whoa! What the heck is that thing? I didn't expect this thing to be guarded by a literal monster! You can take it though, right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Neutralize 'Em ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: No Library Card Required
quests.description: The back of the library is so messy, disorganized, and infested with monsters! Go clean it up for me and I'll give you some copies of old books that are lying around.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It's a Book Wyrm! quest.

quests.name: The Eye of the Beholder
quests.description: This book is legendary. Contained within are many of the Queen's deepest secrets. There's only one problem: I can't read it! It's written in monstrous script, and that means we'll need a way to translate it first. That means we need to SEE and THINK like a monster. First, bring me 10 12 monstrous corneas.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It's a Book Wyrm! quest.

quests.name: The Double-Edged Sword
quests.description: We have the corneas to let us see. Now we need something to let us speak. Figuratively, of course. We're not actually talking to the book. But spells love to be symbolic, don't they? Anyway, for that, I'll need 10 monstrous tongues from the Eldritch Stalkers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It's a Book Wyrm! quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: So Ichor-y
quests.description: My understanding of the language expands in my head already. But I am still only human. Bring me some Monstrous Ichor from a Terrarsite to paint across the pages of the book. This will reveal the meaning of its words to us both.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It's a Book Wyrm! quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Reveal the Words
quests.description: Now, we paint the ichor across the pages of the book to reveal the words within. Begin whenever you are ready.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It's a Book Wyrm! quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Shining Time
quests.description: Hmm. Pierce the veil and light the way. That's what the passage says. Some of the creatures here in the woods are bioluminous. Maybe if we were to gather some of their glands…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It's a Book Wyrm! quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Light the Way
quests.description: Place the glands you've collected around the edges of the glade, and let's see what they reveal.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It's a Book Wyrm! quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Chaos Gathers
quests.description: "Order gives way to chaos, and the mist dissolves." Maybe we need some way to attune ourselves to the chaos of the Plane of Monsters. Elemental Chaos should do the trick.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It's a Book Wyrm! quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Hold your Breath
quests.description: Next, of course, we need a way to dissolve the mist. The venom of the Terrarsite is highly corrosive, able to cut through nearly any substance. Maybe it will cut through this mist, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It's a Book Wyrm! quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Disperse the Mist
quests.description: Spread the venom you've gathered near the edges of the mist. If all goes as planned, our path forward will be clear.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It's a Book Wyrm! quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Monsters in the Mist
quests.description: This part of the forest is so thick with monsters. I guess that's to be expected, but we will have to clear them out if we're going to get anything accomplished.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It's a Book Wyrm! quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Truffle Hunting
quests.description: "The way down is revealed, but not to all. Only the mother and her children." Are you thinking what I'm thinking? That's right! We'll have to get these monsters to show us the way. Gather some Deep Truffles. It's a favorite snack of monsters, and we'll need something to bribe them with.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It's a Book Wyrm! quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Bribe 'Em All
quests.description: And now, well… you're going to have to use those truffles to bribe a few monsters. Show them the yummy treats, and lure a few back to us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It's a Book Wyrm! quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Heading Back Home
quests.description: How cute! They're following you around like puppies! Give them the truffles, and then we'll follow them back home.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It's a Book Wyrm! quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Aberration
quests.description: Whoever this is, whatever they've summoned, they will NOT keep me from what I seek. Kill it, Hero.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' It's a Book Wyrm! quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Life Feeds on Death
quests.description: This forest has been tainted by the unworldly creatures that plague it. Put an end to them so it can start to heal.

quests.name: Crystal Tears
quests.description: You can see that this place is filled with crystals. This is what remains of the mother's tears, though unlike the original relic, their power is now gone. Collect them for me so that I might understand her better.

quests.name: That Which Grows
quests.description: I would like to study the plants that grew from the Queen's tears. These plants were the first of the monsters she gave life to. Bring me a few cuttings of the Chaos Spitter so I can take a closer look.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: That Which Flies
quests.description: Here, too, are monstrous insects the likes of which have never been seen on Lore. It is not clear whether they were drawn to this place and then changed, or whether they spontaneously came into being much like the plants did. With some study, perhaps we will learn.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: That Which Flames
quests.description: Some of the monsters here are still burning from the Queen's anger. Catch some of their flame from the Tentaflames for me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Caustic Oil
quests.description: These flames are still burning, but they won't grow on their own. The seeds of the Seedspitters contain a highly flammable oil. A bit of that, and this fire will burn as hot as the sun.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tools of the Trade
quests.description: I'll need something to crush the seeds with so I can collect the oil. Maybe if you can find me a piece of stone that could be used as a mortar… and one that could be used as a pestle.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Burn it!
quests.description: Now that you have a mortar and pestle, you can get busy creating what we need. First, grind the seeds to release the oil. Then, paint that oil on the walls… and light it. Watch it burn!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Tributes
quests.description: Fight some of the monsters near the Queen's discarded cocoon and collect the items they have brought as tribute. This will teach us about their methods of worship.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Compare the Crystal
quests.description: It looks like the tributes are all made of a certain kind of stone—it looks like the same kind of stone the body itself has become. It also looks like it may be the same as the Monstrite we've seen in this place. Gather some Monstrite samples so I can compare them to what you've found.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Acid and Scratch Test
quests.description: An acid test and a scratch test… two good ways to see if these minerals are actually the same, and we have the materials we need right here in this tunnel. Bring me some acidic venom from the Tentastrike, and the sharpest fang you can find from the Deep Tunnelers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Largest Monstrite
quests.description: I want to try something. If I'm right about the resonance, this could be the key to revealing what we seek. What we need is the biggest piece of Monstrite we can find. I saw a pretty massive Monster nearby; maybe that would do the trick.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tame the Queen
quests.description: The Queen's artifact will give us what we want. We just have to let her see that we're worthy of what she has to show us. Help me tame her, Hero.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tome of The Otherworld
quests.description: Oh no! Some of the pages in my book were loose - it's a very old book! - and when i got here, a gust of wind blew them away. I need those pages if we're going to find out what we need to do to get into this party! I'm pretty sure the ghosts and goblins out there grabbed them up, so if you fight them, maybe you can get them all back for me.

quests.name: Monster Data
quests.description: While i'm out here, I might as well get a little work done, right? This is a perfect opportunity to collect data on all the spooky creatures out here! Maybe you could help? Just go out and fight all the different types of monsters out here, and then come back and tell me everything you learned.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reclaim the Research
quests.description: Our scouts are gone, but we may not have to lose all of their research! The wind keeps blowing things toward our camp from the rift. See if you can find any journal pages it may have blown our way! …and while you're at it, keep an eye out for any that may have been eaten by the monsters. (Quest works once per login session)

quests.name: Collect Research Data
quests.description: Want to help me get some research data on the Rift, and everything it's brought with it? Yay! This will be fun. First, place these data readers around the perimeter. Each time you fight one of the Rift monsters in view of the meters, they will record what happens. So, you'll need to keep fighting monsters until the meters have all the data they need. Easy! (Quest works once per login session)

quests.name: Drakath Faced
quests.description: You must face Drakath now. Confront him in order to learn the identity of the 13th Lord of Chaos. All of Lore is counting on you!

quests.name: Embrace Your Chaos
quests.description: … I do not know what will happen next, but I know you will need to be stronger than ever, Hero! Train your ability as a Chaos Slayer as you embrace your new role as a Chaos Lord. Slay any Chaos monsters to gain more Chaos power!

quests.name: Embrace Your Chaos (Daily)
quests.description: …I do not know what will happen next, but I know you will need to be stronger than ever, Hero! Train your ability as a Chaos Slayer as you embrace your new role as a Chaos Lord. Slay any Chaos monsters on Mount Doomskull to gain more Chaos power!

quests.name: The Music of Fate
quests.description: The scroll says to collect these crystals… even I am not sure what they are for. But crystals DO store magic very well. Perhaps you'll find out once you reach your destination.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' The Pick of Destiny ' quest.

quests.name: Seek out the DreamDust
quests.description: The only one I know of who possesses DreamDust is the Emperor of the SandSea, Sek-Duat. I imagine he's been driven from his home, with all of the destruction. If you can get to him, you can take his DreamDust!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: DragonPlane Destruction
quests.description: The DragonPlane must fall, so the one true Dragon can rise… to rebuild it once more. But you must not be trapped here when it does. Battle your way out and back to your world!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Battle for Alliance in Willowcreek!
quests.description: The combined forces of Alteon and Gravelyn are fighting the Chaos army in Willowcreek. Kill 13 Chaos enemies to help save Willowcreek!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Drakath Faced ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Battle for Chaos in Willowcreek!
quests.description: The Chaos army is fighting the combined forces of Alteon and Gravelyn in Willowcreek. Kill 13 Alliance enemies to help save Willowcreek!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Drakath Faced ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Battle for Alliance in Doomwood!
quests.description: The combined forces of Alteon and Gravelyn are fighting the Chaos army in Doomwood. Kill 13 Chaos enemies to help save Lightguard Keep!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Chaos Challenger ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Battle for Chaos in Doomwood!
quests.description: The Chaos army is fighting the combined forces of Alteon and Gravelyn in Doomwood. Kill 13 Alliance enemies to help save Lightguard Keep!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Chaos Challenger ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Battle for Alliance in Darkovia!
quests.description: The combined forces of Alteon and Gravelyn are fighting the Chaos army in Darkovia. Kill 13 Chaos enemies to help save Darkovia!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Beat Chaorrupted Lycan Hunter ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Battle for Chaos in Darkovia!
quests.description: The Chaos army is fighting the combined forces of Alteon and Gravelyn in Darkovia. Kill 13 Alliance enemies to help save Darkovia!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Beat Chaorrupted Lycan Hunter ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Battle for Alliance in the Lair!
quests.description: Defeat 17 Chaos soldiers to try and keep the 13th Lord of Chaos from reaching their objective!

npc.name: Kill the Vamp boss in Darkovia zone

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kill the Vamp boss in Darkovia zone ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Battle for Chaos in the Lair!
quests.description: Defeat 17 Alliance soldiers to give the 13th Chaos Lord time to get into the Lair!

npc.name: Kill the Vamp boss in Darkovia zone

quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Kill the Vamp boss in Darkovia zone ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Battle the Champion of Chaos!
quests.description: The time has come again for you to battle Drakath! Be careful - he shows no mercy!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Battle for the Alliance in Battleon! ' or ' Battle for Chaos in Battleon! ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Shadows on the Move
quests.description: The shadows are acting VERY strangely! People at Con have been whispering about them all night. Go see if they will tell you anything… you may need to "convince" them. (Defeat any of the creatures in the Arena to find out rumous)

quests.name: Shadow Switch?!
quests.description: We cannot tell if any of the Con attendees are really human anymore… or actually shadows themselves! SLAY Switchers? to see if they are really Con-goers or… impostors.

quests.name: The Shadows are Rising
quests.description: The Shadows are solidifying and taking form… and attacking people! Defeat the Risen Shdadow to keep the Con Goers safe… even if some of them HAVE been possessed By shadows!

quests.name: War Medal: Repel the Scourge
quests.description: There doesn't seem to be any end to Vaxen's army of clones! We have to try to minimize their numbers somehow. Please defeat 10 of Vaxen's warriors to help turn the tide of the battle!

quests.name: War Mega Medal: Scour the Scourge
quests.description: Caxen's lieutenants are wreaking havoc on the battlefield. If we don't do something, they could cause some serious damage. Take 5 of them out in order to help the war effort!

quests.name: Chasing Shadows
quests.description: Strange…Vaxen's army seems to be exuding the same shadowy substance that possessed the Loremasters. I wonder if it can be useful? Please collect a few samples so we may analyze them.

quests.name: Ravenbreak Rush
quests.description: The shadows just keep increasing! Defeat more of Vaxen's troops to keep them at bay!

quests.name: The Imminent Darkness
quests.description: Vaxen may have been defeated, but echoes of his spirit still linger in this world. Defeat him again to make sure he can't pose a threat to Lore anymore!

quests.name: Ultra OmniKnight Tokens
quests.description: Manifestations of Vaxen's clones still roam the battlefield. Please defeat them in order to dispel the darkness in this land, and I will give you an Ultra Omniknight Token in return!

quests.name: Ultra OmniKnight Tokens for Legends
quests.description: As a Legend, I will require a bit more help from you in order to defeat Vaxen's remnants! But I'll reward you with more Ultra OmniKnight Tokens to make up for it!

quests.name: Attack Lair
quests.description: Slay the Lair's invaders to protect the dragons from Chaorruption! Defeat 30 invaders to raise the war meter, or collect 10 Mega Invader Medals to boost the war meter even more!

quests.name: Mega Attack Lair
quests.description: Slay the Lair's invaders to protect the dragons from Chaorruption! Defeat 30 invaders to raise the war meter, or collect 10 Mega Invader Medals to boost the war meter even more!

quests.name: Defend Battleon
quests.description: Slay the Lair's defenders to help the 13th Chaos Lord reach the heart of the Dragon's Lair! Defeat 30 defends to raise the war meter, or collect 10 Mega Defender Medals to boost the war meter even more!

quests.name: Mega Defend Battleon
quests.description: Slay the Lair's defenders to help the 13th Chaos Lord reach the heart of the Dragon's Lair! Defeat 30 defends to raise the war meter, or collect 10 Mega Defender Medals to boost the war meter even more!

quests.name: Feel the Heat
quests.description: Manticore eggs require a LOT of heat! We'll need to build a nest of heated rocks to keep the egg in. Go to the /volcano near /xantown in Basani and see if you can knock some chunks off the Lava Golems there. Elemental lava rock will stay hot for weeks.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Mysterious Egg (Pet) in your inventory to access these quests.

quests.name: Need Lava
quests.description: We'll also need something hot - like lava - to pour over the egg itself, since we can't really sit on it ourselves. Not with a nest that hot! Get it from the Living Lava in /embersea.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Mysterious Egg (Pet) in your inventory to access these quests. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Baby Food
quests.description: Baby Manticore is going to be hungry when they come out of the egg. According to my books, baby manticores don't drink milk - they are going to need dragon meat! Go back to /ashfallcamp, and gather it from the dragons there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Mysterious Egg (Pet) in your inventory to access these quests. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Thirsty!
quests.description: Baby Manticore will be thirsty, too. We're going to need a LOT of water! Or… a little bit of REALLY POTENT water. Elemental water, perhaps. Bring some back from the Water Elementals in /dragonplane.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Mysterious Egg (Pet) in your inventory to access these quests. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Dress Up Time
quests.description: Baby Manticore is going to be looking for their mother when they hatch. Obviously Mama is not here, but if we dress you up like a manticore, that may comfort her! First we will need a nice, shaggy mane. Perhaps from a Koalion, at the /crossroads or the /bunker.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Mysterious Egg (Pet) in your inventory to access these quests. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Complete your Costume
quests.description: We'll also need to strap a big scorpion tail onto you. There are some Giant Scorpions at the Mad Scientist's /Lab. Bring one back intact and we'll use that.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Mysterious Egg (Pet) in your inventory to access these quests. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find the Void Larva
quests.description: Mariel's home is in the /void, though I don't know exactly where. But there is a Void Larva who can help you find her. Go there, find him, and ask for his guidance.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Mysterious Egg (Pet) in your inventory to access these quests. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Cast the Spell!
quests.description: Alright! Let's cast the counterspell and bring this egg out of stasis!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Mysterious Egg (Pet) in your inventory to access these quests. | Must have completed the ' A Soul for a Spell ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: The Egg Hatches
quests.description: The Egg is out of stasis and… it's hatched!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Mysterious Egg (Pet) in your inventory to access these quests. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Supply and Demand
quests.description: A good education supplies the knowledge you need to prepare for the adventures ahead of you… but it's hard to learn without the proper tools! Gear up before class by looting the Supply Locker for a bookbag and note-taking supplies. Then get back your stolen books from the Grade A Bully.

quests.name: Tough Lessons
quests.description: Navigating class can be tough enough without the extra challenge of having to battle other students while trying to learn. Defeat the Grade A Bully and Meanest Girl to make sure your peers can focus on what matters: leveling up!

quests.name: Not a Fetch Quest
quests.description: If you're going to be the best, you've got to FOCUS! That means distractions are the enemy…. and until your homework is done, so is that videogame console. Practice your combat skills by smashing it five times, and maybe you'll earn some play-time after your lessons are done.

quests.name: Final Exam
quests.description: Your teachers want to make sure you're ready for the adventures ahead. Once you leave school, you've got to be prepared to face down any challenge and take down any enemy. Defeat Professor Dogear to show what you've learned.

quests.name: Attack the Lair
quests.description: You need to reach the heart of Vasalkar's Lair, but the Alliance is going to try to prevent you! If you're going to learn your TRUE nature… you've got to get into that Lair!

quests.name: Defend the Lair
quests.description: The 13th Chaos Lord needs to reach the heart of Vasalkar's Lair, but YOU have to try to prevent that! If the Chaos Lord learns their ultimate destiny… Lore will NEVER be the same!

quests.name: The First Confrontation
quests.description: You've fought your way through the hordes of chaos. Nothing remains in your way. Go, hero - confront Drakath and end his chaorruption for good.

quests.name: Investigate the Drakel
quests.description: I'm sure you've noticed all the Drakel in the surrounding area. They're here because they think we TASTE GOOD… if you can imagine that! But I think they're intelligent enough to be reasoned with. Help me learn more about them, so we can find out if my theory is correct.

quests.name: 'Talk' to Greenteeth
quests.description: Maybe what we really need to do is try to talk to the leader of the Drakel bandit gang, Greenteeth. As you know, Drakel love juice boxes. Gather some of their favorites and lay them in the forest, on the ﬂat rock just north of the Makai cave, as bait. When Greenteeth comes, see if you can talk some sense into him!

quests.name: Make a Shelter
quests.description: So cold… is it the chill of ice or fear? All of these monsters keep coming towards the Tower, and it just keeps getting colder. Slay the monsters to get furs and get 10 Hearts of Fire from a Twisted Ice monster so that we can try to heat the shelter.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the FrostSpawn Invaders ' quest.

quests.name: Clear the Wolves
quests.description: You've defeated some monsters and warmed the shelter, but the Ice Wolves keep coming back! Slay 7 Ice Wolves to keep the Tower of Winds safe!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the FrostSpawn Invaders ' quest.

quests.name: Pots for Water
quests.description: The Frostwyrms have come up from the depths of the ice volcano. Defeat 10 Frostwyrms and get 5 Rotten Ice cores from the Rotten Ice monster in the volcano!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the FrostSpawn Invaders ' quest.

quests.name: Key to the Fortress
quests.description: Um…. You're probably going to need to get in there. That would make sense. It's where I'd keep something important, if I were large and angry and wanted to steal other people's things. You're probably looking for a key.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Glacera ' quest.

quests.name: Breaking Boulders
quests.description: You're back! Oh. Not for long. Got it. Well… good luck clearing the boulders to explore deeper into the fortress. I'll just be here, freezing my belt off.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Scythe of Vengeance
quests.description: Ok, so if you find a vault and it's full of treasure plus a mystical floating ice scythe… Remember, take the SCYTHE. Gold can't help us get home. And I WANT to get home!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pony Gary Yellow
quests.description: It's time to introduce you to my little friend!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Lead Zepellin .

quests.name: Kimberly
quests.description: Defeat Kimberly!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Ergot Bread
quests.description: All that hag does is yell at her poor son, kick him out, and spend the day with the miller. Go to the mill and see for yourself. It's full of her garbage, and no one to clean it up. Why? Because the miller DIED. And now the rats have taken over, eating OUR grain. Would you clean them out? We still need the mill and his lazy daughter isn't going to get out of bed any time soon.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Dirty Laundry ' quest.

quests.name: Kids These Days
quests.description: I've never seen the miller's daughter work a day in her life. Her father broke his back doting on her, all for nothing. How'd he die? Who knows? Perhaps she became jealous of the attention he was giving Bursha and got rid of him in a fit of rage. Why not bribe the girl with some food? If she lets you in, you'll have a chance to look for bloodstains. But you'll need to slay those bat-things. We're all out of bread.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: PORKON RIPOFF
quests.description: GENERAL PORKON HAS BEEN SEEN WIF AN INVISABLE ITEM. I FINKZ HE STOILE TEH BIKE.TAEK TEH MONORAL KAT 2 ORCTOWN AN GIT TEH BIKE BAK FRUM GENERAL PORKON!

quests.name: GRILL THE LOCALS
quests.description: SUM OV TEH LOCAL HORCS MUTCH HAS SEEN SOMETHIN. QUESHUNS TEH HORCS HER IN NOOBSHIRE AN FIND OUT HOO TOOK TEH BIKE PLZ.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: DOGEAR THE CAT BURGLAR
quests.description: SO IT WUS DAWGEAR, DAT BOOK-EATIN BIKE THIEF. TAEK TEH MONORAIL KAT 2 BOOM WYRMS BOOKSTORE AN ASK HIM WER TEH REST OV TEH BIKE IZ!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: BLOODTUSK CATWALK
quests.description: U SHUD START WIF GHAZ, TEH HORC WEPON MAKR IN BLOODTUSK. HEZ PRITEE REASONABLE GUY. TAEK TEH MONORAIL KAT 2 BLOODTUSK AN TALK 2 GHAZ.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: THE FRAME UP
quests.description: NEXT IZ TEH FRAME. DOGEAR SED HE SOLD IT 2 SUM HORC SELLSWORDZ. TAEK TEH MONORAIL KAT 2 TEH SANDSEA PORT AN GIT TEH FRAME BAK FRUM DEM!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Sign here ' quest.

quests.name: THAT DARN CAT
quests.description: TEH LAST PART IZ TEH BAK WHEEL AN DAWGEAR SEZ DAT TEH HOOJ KAT HAS IT! HE WUZ ALWAYS WANTD TEH BIKE BUT I ALWAYS SAY IZ 2 HOOJ 4 HIM! TAEK TEH MONORAIL KAT 2 TEH HOOJS CASTLE AN GIT DAT WHEEL BAK!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: I Want to Be The Very Best Necromancer
quests.description: We all gotta start somewhere right? All Necromancers know where to go to get their very own personalized training. The Graveyard! Think you can come to the /graveyard with me and watch me try taming a few of the walking dead you catch?

quests.name: Like No One Ever Was
quests.description: Man, those undead are useless anyways. All they ever do is walk and make loud grunts. Good for a lair cleaner but not much else. Hmmph! Well I will make them pay attention to me whether they like it or not! Hero! Fetch me some bones from Doomwood Forest at /doomwood! Any will do as long as they are you know…bones.

items.name: Aspiring Necro Lantern on your back

quests.name: To Raise Them is my Real Quest
quests.description: HOW DARE THEY! THE NERVE OF THESE UNGRATEFUL UNDEAD. HERO! Do you know what they said!? Until I can get the bone of a ferocious undead monster, they refuse to even acknowledge me! HERO! Fetch me 3 heads of the Dracolich inside the Necropolis Dungeon in /necrodungeon and 5 fresh bandages from Agony itself in the /underrealm. That should show them to respect me.

quests.name: Red Dragon's Birthday Badge
quests.description: RAWR! To celebrate the 15th Birthday, there's only ONE monster worthy to give you such a special birthday badge. Go forth and slay the Red Dragon in /lair.

items.name: Doom & Glory Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Put out the Fire
quests.description: The Chrono-Phoenix is inside that temporal rift, but it's been spewing flame and energy into the Northlands. We've gotta make sure everyone here is safe! First things first - let's put out some of the fires that have sprung up before they grow out of control.

quests.name: Assist the Assistants
quests.description: My other chrono assistants have been going haywire too - I can't help but feel like this must be connected. Help me shut them off before they do any more damage.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Energy for Repairs
quests.description: I'm gonna have to fix those bots. If you go into the temporal rift… not too far… you should find some errant spacetime energy. Capture it for me, and I'll use it to make the needed repairs.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stabilize the Rift
quests.description: I had a little spacetime energy left over, so I used it to craft these tuning rods. Set them up in the area surrounding the temporal rift. They should help stabilize the area and keep it …well, as safe as it can be.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Freezies
quests.description: Alright, now that the area outside the rift is safe… let's talk about getting this phoenix under control! I'm thinking if we want to stop fire… we have to freeze it. Bring me some elemental frost from the local frost elementals.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Freeze the Energy
quests.description: Use the Elemental Frost you collected to freeze some of the stray Spacetime Energy. With it, we'll be able to neutralize the Chrono-Phoenix.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: More Flames!
quests.description: It looks like the Phoenix has had another explosive energy burst! This time, inside the temporal rift. Go inside and put out all the flames you find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find the Phoenix
quests.description: Now we just need to get to the phoenix. Go as deep into the rift as you can; that's where you'll find it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Close out the Year
quests.description: The year 2019 itself has been trying to stop our Chrono-Phoenix?! That's exciting. Of course, that means we're going to have to usher out the old year ourselves. You know what to do!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Freeze the Phoenix
quests.description: Nothing else is standing in our way. Go through the door, find the Chrono-Phoenix, and freeze it with the frozen spacetime energy we created. It's the only way to ensure that the old year was not the last one!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Head Outside
quests.description: Meet me outside! It's almost time for the new year to arrive.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Quest for the Bonebreaker
quests.description: My pa told me tales of the Bonebreaker Cutlass. It's used by Undead Pirates and DoomKnight Commanders. Those who wield it gain great power. I'd LOVE to see what it looks like… and I'll give you a chance to get a prize! Bring me the cutlass… pretty please?
quests.requirements_note: Must have Deep Terror Blade (Sword) in your inventory. Notes:

quests.name: Pressurized Weapon
quests.description: I found a weapon template for a powerful weapon. When compressed, it can create powerful pressure in water. It can move water easily just by pressing it down. I call it… "The Plunger." To make the weapon, we need:

quests.name: Here There Be Dragons
quests.description: This weapon template is more difficult to make but I have an ancient, enchanted parchment that describes the locations that we need to go to. We need specific materials from different parts of lore to make the weapon. We need:

quests.name: I Need More Luck
quests.description: Maybe if I was more lucky I'd be able to avoid all these accidents I seem to have. Can you get me some Lucky Clovers from the Sneevilchauns?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' You Feel Lucky? ' quest.

quests.name: I Don't Feel Safe
quests.description: I really don't feel safe around here any more. Every year I end up getting a little banged up at the carnival. Maybe I can make some armor out of some big leaves. Can you get me some?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' You Feel Lucky? ' quest.

quests.name: I Fell For It
quests.description: All that's left is to make myself a sign! I'll need some wood… Treeant wood! And a can of paint. I bet you can find one around here somewhere.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' You Feel Lucky? ' quest.

quests.name: Such a Mess
quests.description: We can't leave this portal open for long. The darkness is already seeping into the Plane of Light from Sepulchure's fortress. Get rid of the invasive shadows on the other side of the portal, and clean up the mess they've made.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy the Shield ' quest.

quests.name: Herbs Needed
quests.description: I have an idea for the herbal element of this spell we're trying. I'm thinking Glowmoss - it grows on the Treeants in the Plane of Light - and a few Lightshrooms. You'll find those there, too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy the Shield ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Shine a Light
quests.description: We will power your spell with pure elemental light. Obviously you'll get that from Light Elementals. But you knew that, right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy the Shield ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hapless?
quests.description: Let's try this out, shall we? Test your spell on the Hapless Skeleton held captive in the cell down the hall. If it works on him, we will move forward.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy the Shield ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: How 'bout them Apples
quests.description: Since Lightwing won't want to help, we'll need to get on his good side first. We'll bring him his favorite snack - Sun Apples. They grow on the Treeants of the Plane of Light. Gather some and return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy the Shield ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Make an Offering
quests.description: Find Lightwing's nest, and leave the sun apples as an offering to him. Hopefully this will persuade him to share one of his feathers with us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy the Shield ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Test the Spell Again!
quests.description: Hopefully this additional reagent will fill in the gaps of our spell, and give us the result we are hoping for. Test it again on the Hapless Skeleton, let's see how it goes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy the Shield ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Gather the Light
quests.description: As our champion, you are strong. You must become stronger. The power you are trying to disrupt is equal to your own, but corrupted and strengthened by the armor he wears. Gather Light Energy from any of the beings in the Plane of Light.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy the Shield ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Banish the Shadows
quests.description: This fortress is tied so strongly to the darkness. It will strengthen the armor's hold on Sepulchure, and diminish your chances of success. Banish as many shadows as you can. This decrease the resistance we'll face.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy the Shield ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: So Many Minions
quests.description: Some of Sepulchure's skeletal minions don't seem happy about all of this. Best to subdue them. Smash them if you have to. He can always bring them back later.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Destroy the Shield ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Come On, Get Ready!
quests.description: Come on, Valen! Put your armor on so we can go! Don't worry - you may have forgotten it, but i didn't. I've got it right here in this chest.

quests.name: Scout the Valley
quests.description: I'm not sure exactly where this "Cave of Doom" is, so we'll have to scout the valley and see if we can find it. Let's slay as many of these shadow creatures as we can while we do. It will make our lives much easier later on!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gather Energy
quests.description: Hmm. The Cave of Doom must be kept hidden by some sort of cloaking spell. Gather Infernal Energy from the Shadow Imps in the area, and I may be able to use it to reveal the spell.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Do I Have to Spell it Out?
quests.description: Alright, I've made a handful of counterspells from the energy you brought me. You know what to do with them, right? Spread them around the valley as evenly as you can. We don't know where the cloaking spell is, so we have to make sure we hit it!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Get Through the Shadows
quests.description: The Champion of Doom awaits us somewhere inside this cave! We'll have to fight our way past all these shadowy monsters to get to him. Don't leave any alive to flank us from behind!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get the Key
quests.description: The Champion of Darkness must be behind that door the Doom Guardian is blocking! He must also be the keeper of the key that unlocks it. Get it from him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Confront the Champion of Darkness
quests.description: The Champion of Darkness lies in wait just beyond that door! It is time to confront him, and end this once and for all.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Destroy the Arsenal
quests.description: He's not here! We must have gotten to the cave too soon. Well, we may not have found the Champion of Darkness, but we DID find his arsenal. If we destroy the weapons and armor, then no one will be able to use them to harm Lore.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Defeat the Armor
quests.description: There must be an insane amount of power in that armor! We can't destroy it - and as long as it's active, we can't destroy that blade, either.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Secure the Chest
quests.description: We'll keep the chest containing the Champion's sword and armor at the top of this Guardian tower. No one will suspect it's there, and even if someone does find out, the Guardians will protect it. Nowhere could be safer.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Armor ' quest. Notes:

quests.name: Get Some Goo
quests.description: It might not be a bad idea to craft a cloaking spell like the one that was hiding the Cave of Doom from us. I can use the green goo from local slimes as a reagent. Collect a few vials for me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Retrieve the Wand
quests.description: There is an orc near the tower who terrorizes anyone who comes too close, and has a particular hatred for mages. He recently stole powerful a wand from the wizard Mithrax. If we can recover it, we can ensure my spell is strong enough to resist detection.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Corrupted Light
quests.description: The energy that burst forth from Sepulchure was too much for Luma to handle, and it has corrupted him. I must defeat him!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' So Many Minions ' quest.

quests.name: Tacos > Pizza
quests.description: WHAT?!?! Why are they serving pizza here?!?! Why not tacos? Maybe we have to prove to them that tacos are superior to pizza. So… we have to make them some tacos! Of course! Get me some Hole-y Cheese from /Lightguard, a pack of tortillas from StealthyCupcake in the /HeroTournament, some beef from the ChickenCow in /BattleonTown Forge, and… uh… a lot of pineapple from the Spineapple in /Freakitiki, so that NOBODY can make pizza with it.

quests.name: Tacomancer Armor!
quests.description: Is it your life-long goal to become a Tacomancer? All you got to do is complete a little ingredient scavenger hunt for me! Find a Tortilla Shell from a Snail, some Grade A Meat Byproduct from a Wereboar, and a handful of Shredded Cheese from a GreenRat. I'd also like it if you could get me the Shadow Terror Axe. …well, no, it's not *exactly* part of the Armor… but it looks so cool and I've always wanted it but I've never been brave enough to fight for it… BUT you look brave AND strong enough! So whaddya say? Make this old Taco happy and I'll make you an honorary Tacomancer in exchange!

quests.name: Charging Up!
quests.description: A disembodied voice issues from the speaker: "You have entered Area 42. Energy-Mana Amalgamation Test Subjects 1-4 have been placed here to protect top-secret research projects. Clearance Diode #10-26BD not detected. Leave at once or you will be recycled." Kill each of the four Test Subjects to charge the atmosphere.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Upward Over the Mountain ' quest.

quests.name: Take Up The Cause
quests.description: So you want to prove your worth to my people? Very well. Start by defending those of us left and avenging those who have fallen. Destroy 8 of Lionfang's invaders. If you survive this test I will have more for you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame The Lion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Well Kept Secrets
quests.description: Lionfang is here looking for something very precious to the Darkblood. If you wish to keep it from him, go to the Falguard Library and destroy these 6 titles. I hate to destroy books but Lionfang cannot be allowed to find the… well, just do it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame The Lion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Feeding On The Fallen
quests.description: The Darkblood are not wasteful. We feed on our own fallen as well as our enemies… this even applies to their possessions. Our weaponsmith could use enemy sword and shields to reforge into Darkblood weapons. Go claim the shields from the Chaonslaught Warriors and swords from the Chaonslaught Cavalry.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame The Lion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Special Delivery
quests.description: Ralstis, the Falguard weaponsmith needs the items you have claimed from your victories. You must make your way to him and deliver them to him. He does not know you so he may kill you. Go, now.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame The Lion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Precious Scraps
quests.description: You did so well with your last mission that Saluk, our armorer, has asked that you gather armor scraps from the Chaonslaught Cavalry and Warriors. Gather 5 good scraps, not too battle-worn, and return here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame The Lion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Restocking
quests.description: Saluk is expecting you in the Armor Shop. it is next to the Falguard Inn. Deliver these to him so that he can continue his work repairing the Dreadwatch's armor. Return to me after he has received them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame The Lion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: An Innside Job
quests.description: The Dreadwatch has been instructed to regroup at the Falguard Inn, but first it needs to be cleared of intruders. Go to the inn located on the north-east side of town and slay anything that does not belong there. When it is clear return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame The Lion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Streets Run Red
quests.description: The Chaonslaught Casters have been using their empowered spells to slay my Dreadwatch on site. This will not stand. Go, avenge my brothers in arms. Bring swift but painful vengeance onto 10 Casters.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame The Lion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Open The Temple
quests.description: Lionfang's manticore was just spotted landing in the Open Temple where our Primarch guards our secrets. We must open the temple doors before and help the Primarch while we still have time. The opening rune was lost in the invasion. Find it and return to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame The Lion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Open Temple
quests.description: You found the rune?! Hurry, we must enter the Open Temple and help the Primarch defeat our thrice cursed enemy!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Tame The Lion ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Shocking Footwear
quests.description: The clouds seem solid enough up there, we should build you some lightning proof shoes just to be safe. First we will need a few samples of the lightning. Here, you can use my lightning rod and bell jar to hold it. I think 4 samples should do. Tread carefully.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Out The Chaos Manticore! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: New Shoes
quests.description: Hmm. This is chaos infused energy. I was hoping to enchant your footwear but we will need to get some from Lightning Boots from one of Lionfang's soldiers. One of them has to wear your size.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Out The Chaos Manticore! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mouth Of The Lion
quests.description: The guards must know what you're coming so might as well clear the gate to the Storm Temple of guards. Return once the gate has been cleared.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Out The Chaos Manticore! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Storm the Storm Temple
quests.description: Time to enter the mouth of the lion and storm the Storm Temple. The gates are sealed but lionfang has proven himself foolish enough to trust his guards with the key. Search through his soldiers and find the Lightning Key to the Storm Temple.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Out The Chaos Manticore! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A High Minded Matter
quests.description: This cloud matter seems to be held together with nothing more than his Chaotic will. If he has erected barriers of the stuff then we will need to find way to break them apart. Bring me 3 samples of Cloud Matter from the Storm Temple. I will examine it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Out The Chaos Manticore! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Storm Bottles
quests.description: I should be able to find a way to break the cloud matter apart but i will need to compress these samples. The Chaonslaught Casters should have Storm Bottles on them. Bring me 4. And be careful with them, you're quite rare.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Out The Chaos Manticore! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Breaching Defenses
quests.description: There, it's ready. You should be able to use this altered cloud matter to dissolve the first cloud barrier that you find. I will begin compressing more in case you find more barriers. Bring me any remnants of the busted barrier.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Out The Chaos Manticore! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chaos Lightning Rods
quests.description: I will need more energy but you have little time to waste collecting it with my lightning rod. Hmmm. I know. Take 5 Chaos lances from the Chaonslaught Calvary and I will convert them into lightning rods to conduct the chaos infused energy myself.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Out The Chaos Manticore! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Barrier Buster
quests.description: You found another barrier. I was able to make one more dose of the barrier buster cloud potion. I hope there are no more after this. Be careful with this.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Out The Chaos Manticore! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Face Chaos Lord Lionfang!
quests.description: Chaos Lord Lionfang is awaiting Drakath's arrival near his throne. It might give you the element of surprise. Hurry, you MUST stop him from wasting the tears of The Mother on Drakath!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Out The Chaos Manticore! ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Face Ultra Lionfang!
