quests.description: You thought Lionfang was a challenge before? Are you insane enough to face his Ultra form? Do you have the might? The will?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Face Chaos Lord Lionfang! ' quest.

quests.name: Smash the Hive
quests.description: What is this monstrosity?! How can they worship something that would mutilate us so? It pains me to harm one of my own people, but this is the fate they would wish on us all. We can't let them stand in the way of our efforts to prevent it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed ' Get the Final Ingredients ' quest.

quests.name: Acolyte's Medallions
quests.description: We must fight our way through this onslaught of Eremon's cult, his Acolytes of Kolyaban, in order to reach Aria! Each of the Acolytes carries a small medallion identifying them as a member of the cult. Bring them to me, and I will reward you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Smash the Hive ' quest.

quests.name: Acolyte's Mega Medallions
quests.description: Eremon's higher-ranking Acolytes carry a larger medallion, indicating their more prestigious status. When you have found 5 of these, bring them to me. I'll give you an additional reward for clearing out his higher ranks.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Smash the Hive ' quest.

quests.name: Let's Hope This Works
quests.description: Quickly! We have beaten back the hordes of reshapen Darkblood, and nothing is left standing between us and Aria! Go, now! Take the cure and dose her!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Smash the Hive ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat Kolyaban
quests.description: All that is left is to defeat Kolyaban. Defeat her and the Darkblood will be saved!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Smash the Hive ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Help Professor Maedoc
quests.description: To be one with the earth, you must know it inside and out. Break open the Balboas in /stalagbite and return with 25 Geodes. Do THAT, and you will understand the nature of my lessons better.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Welcome to Dragonrune Hall ' quest.

quests.name: Fungal Networking
quests.description: My druid brethren and I hear Nature's words rustling in the leaves. When I began to learn the ways of my forefathers, I expected a wise and motherly voice, but Nature's is full of playful youth. Just as I did, go harvest Myconids from /guardiantree and track down the Gurushroom from /greenguardeast. Gathering from Nature is how humanity came to stand on its own. We can learn much from returning to our roots.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Welcome to Dragonrune Hall ' quest.

quests.name: Powder Sugar Faeries
quests.description: Along with the Auberon, Snow Faeries protect and take shelter in Glace's tomb. They tend to keep to themselves, but now, they're attacking us unprovoked. Catch them before they damage the structure.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Bear Essentials ' quest.

quests.name: Water Intoxication
quests.description: Thanks to you, I was able to determine that the denizens of the glacier aren't attacking us with malice. They're lashing out because they're in pain from something within. Wrestle the remaining Auberon down, and bring me small samples of their blood.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Queen's Riddle
quests.description: My people have always respected your intelligence and wit. Your nature is one we recognize; that makes crafting a riddle YOU cannot answer even more of a challenge. "To win the favor of this Queen, give me what I've never seen…" (Hint: there is wisdom in adages, advice, and prophecies.)

quests.name: Natural Isomers
quests.description: The remnants of Chaos are still scattered across Dwarfhold, but they're nowhere near as dangerous as they used to be. I am curious about a theory Warlic and Tara were discussing back at the Temple. If you have some time, would you please retrieve Chaos Ether from the Draconians and Drow who still remain in Dwarfhold?

quests.name: Ore-riginal Material
quests.description: Thelima City's blacksmiths are offering to refine our armor in exchange for ore! Would you like to add another set to your collection too? Then, please! Join us! The Balboa on the /mountainpath are walking ore deposits. It'll be easy.

quests.name: In Your Dreams
quests.description: Thelima City's blacksmiths are interested in a material called Orpheum Ore. They said it would meld well with the Mana Solace Paladins' magic, but Orpheum is incredibly rare. Know any place you can find it?

quests.name: Brainwyrm
quests.description: The Mana Solace Paladins are having a hard time sleeping. They're experimenting with new techniques, but nightmares of some sort of Wyrm keep scattering their ideas and dreams. I wonder how we can fix this.

quests.name: Guardians of the North
quests.description: It is a great responsibility we have, we Guardians of the North. We must shepherd the refugees who arrive. Once they disperse, they become the problem of the other Guardians, but for now… I could use a hand defeating the monsters that threaten them!

quests.name: Defend the Weak
quests.description: The goblins have developed a taste for refugee flesh. As a Guardian, I CANNOT allow that. But Cleric Crystal must be guarded, as well. Please, help me keep the refugees safe. Take out 10 goblins, for the refugee's safety!

quests.name: Pest Control
quests.description: These Kijimuna pester me whenever I venture outside. Surely you can't expect an old man to deal with such nonsense. If you want me to leave my home, then you'll have to do some pest control for me. Come back when it is as peaceful outside as it is in here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Deliver the Gift ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Prove Your Worth
quests.description: You're asking a lot. Perhaps more than you even realize. For me to help you in this way would draw the attention of Malgor and put me in danger. If you want me to take that kind of risk, you'll have to prove you are capable of defending me. Find and kill Osanshouo, the giant salamander If you can survive his strong claws and venomous bite, then I will feel safe under your protection.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Deliver the Gift ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Light for the Lantern
quests.description: In order to do what you ask, I need the use of my lantern. Its flame has run low, and I will need to replenish it. Of course, a spirit lantern can only use spectral flame. Get some from the Kosenjobi and bring it to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Deliver the Gift ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Attune to Fuyurei
quests.description: In order to pinpoint the locations of the ley lines, I will need to attune my lantern to the various spirits in the area. First, collect the energy of the Fuyurei - their Ki - and bring it back to me here. Then, we will use it to attune my lantern to them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Deliver the Gift ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Follow the Path
quests.description: Now that my lantern is attuned to the Fuyurei, we can use it to see the roads they travel. Follow the path that my lantern reveals to you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Deliver the Gift ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Attune to Kijimuna
quests.description: Now we must map the path of the Kijimuna. Don't give me that look! My work requires much patience and much redundancy. Collect the Ki of the Kijimuna and bring it back to me. Then, as before, use it to attune mv lantern to those spirits.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Deliver the Gift ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Path of the Kijimuna
quests.description: My lantern will now reveal to you the road that the Kijimuna travel. Follow the path that it reveals to you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Deliver the Gift ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Attune to Reishi
quests.description: And now, finally, we map the path of the Reishi. This is the last one, so don't let me hear you complaining. Collect the Ki of the Reishi. Bring it back to me here, and we will attune my lantern to them.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Deliver the Gift ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Path of Reishi
quests.description: Yes, that's correct. You must divine the location of one final Spirit Road - that of the Reishi. My lantern will reveal it to you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Deliver the Gift ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Black Flames
quests.description: All of that work was NOT for nothing! Now that I have mapped three Spirit Roads, I can see where they currently intersect. This intersection is where we will speak to the ancestral spirits who guard these roads. But in order to do that, we must draw their attention. Only the brightest black flame will do. Get it from the Kosenjobi.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Deliver the Gift ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Defeat Grandmother Hasu
quests.description: Grandmother Hasu does not seem to want to listen to reason! If you are able to best her, then hopefully, one of the others will.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Deliver the Gift ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: So... Sad...
quests.description: I have been so lost in my grief. I've seen so much pain and loss, it became hard to see anything else. It became hard to see the good in the world. I must soothe my grief before I can move on from it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Nether Warlock ' quest.

quests.name: Release the Rage
quests.description: I have been so angry at the injustice of the world, I've been letting it consume me. But I know I can't go on this way. I must face my rage head on and release it from my mind.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Nether Warlock ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Anguish is the Worst
quests.description: I have been afraid to truly face my anguish. It is difficult to loo directly at the pain you're keeping inside yourself. Will you come with me? It may be easier if I am not alone.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Nether Warlock ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: 'Twas the night before Frostval
quests.description: The timeless classic story book, 'Twas the Night Before Frostval, has gone missing! Someone… or something… must have stolen it last night. Check all the monsters in the area and see if any of them have it! Hurry Hero, the book has to be close by… try checking in the Snow Path that leads to the village!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Shadow Figure ' quest.

quests.name: Find Page 2
quests.description: Free a Frozen Moglin to get a page detector, then click on my speech bubble and read the first page of the Frostval story. There should be hints that will clue you in on where the next page might be found.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Shadow Figure ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Previously called "Chapter 2" .

quests.name: Find Page 3
quests.description: We need to find the third page. Free a Frozen Moglin to get a page detector, then click on my speech bubble and read the first two pages of the Frostval story. There should be hints that will clue you in on where the next page might be found.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Shadow Figure ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Previously called "Chapter 3" .

quests.name: Find Page 4
quests.description: Three pages found… three pages to go! We need to find the fourth page. Click on my speech bubble and read the first three pages of the Frostval story. There should be hints that will clue you in on where the next page might be found.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Shadow Figure ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Previously called "Chapter 4" .

quests.name: Find Page 5
quests.description: Only two more pages left! We need to find the fifth page. Click on my speech bubble and read the four pages of the Frostval story. There should be hints that will clue you in on where the next page might be found.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Shadow Figure ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Previously called "Chapter 5" .

quests.name: Find Page 6
quests.description: The Frostval story book is almost complete! Only one more page to go! Free a Frozen Moglin to get a page detector, then then click on my speech bubble and read through the Frostval story. There should be hints that will clue you in on where the next page might be found.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Shadow Figure ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Previously called "Chapter 6" .

quests.name: Forged in Battle
quests.description: If I'm going to stay here to guard Skira, I might as well man the forge. The last smith was lost to the Firestrom. I need resources, and I'd appreciate your aid. Bring me 3 Coal Creeper Embers and 6 Pyradon Fangs.

quests.name: Where There's Smoke...
quests.description: Temple Guards are trained to watch for signs of fire, as they would destroy the temple. But here… fire is all around us. I will NEVER let my guard down, but I need your help to protect the city. Slay 2 Fyresyn and 5 Pyroclash so I can make a Blazebalm ward to shield us.

quests.name: A Grain of Dirt
quests.description: *A voice echoes from the blade.* From dirt comes a rare gemstone. You supply the dirt, and this blade will supply the gemstone.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Malakai's Katana Pet in your inventory. Note: This quest can only be completed once per day.

quests.name: The Enforcer's Adornments
quests.description: Master Nulgath doesn't give the title of Contract Enforcer to just anyone. However, he's generously made an exception and is offering you the opportunity to join their ranks. Complete this first task, and you'll be rewarded with one of the Contract Enforcer's Adornments.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Malakai's Katana Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: The Enforcer's Armaments
quests.description: Master Nulgath doesn't give the title of Contract Enforcer to just anyone. However, he's generously made an exception and is offering you the opportunity to join their ranks. Complete this next task, and you'll be rewarded with one of the Contract Enforcer's Armaments.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Malakai's Katana Pet in your inventory.

quests.name: The Contract Enforcer
quests.description: You're almost ready to become Master Nulgath's next Contract Enforcer. There's just one final, simple task for you to complete.

quests.name: Dwarfhold Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues for you if you trade with me. You will definitely gain some favor with the dwarfs.

quests.name: Good Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues for you if you trade with me. You will definitely gain some favor with those who battle against evil.

quests.name: Evil Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues for you if you trade with me. You will definitely gain some favor with the followers of evil.

quests.name: Yokai Membership Dues
