quests.name: Practice Time
quests.description: For some light practice, we'll set you up against the Living Brimstone, a type of combination rock and fire elemental found only in the Infernal Plane. Head to the Pit and we'll send one in.

quests.name: Get that Beetle
quests.description: If you want a tougher challenge, let's see how you fare against Megacerus! It's a species of giant, Infernal beetle, and it can be pretty deadly. Get in the pit if you want to fight it.

quests.name: Get In the Pit
quests.description: For a true test of your skills, you should go up against Nakhiir. Only the most skilled Infernal soldiers can hold their own against him. If you think you can handle him, get in the pit and I'll send him in.

quests.name: Twilight's Arcana Weapons
quests.description: Battle through the Mana Plane to gather the resources necessary to craft the Twilight's Arcana Staff or Greater Twilight Blade… IF you can gather them all, there's a chance we'll give one of the weapons to you. But *giggle* we might just keep them for ourselves. They are VERY shiny!

quests.name: C:\The Depths are a Harsh Mistress
quests.description: R-right! Let's bring some samples for when we return to the Panopticon! So we can check on your amnesia and… even perhaps help reduce any punishment we might get for getting lost. Um, let's see… AH! Those! They look oddly adorable! Subdue some of those squishy organic thingies in a container! You call them jie-lee… feesh, you say?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Guardian Spirits ' quest.

quests.name: Talk to the Guard
quests.description: Our plan is to get the guards to let us into the castle so we can take Maleth by surprise. Go and talk to them. Tell them you want to offer your support.

quests.name: Talk to the Villager
quests.description: So, Argo wants you to prove yourself by handling Maleth's problems for him? Looks like this is going to take longer than I hoped. Alright, let's start with the villagers. Exit east through the gate near the castle entrance, and see if you can find someone to talk to.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Argo's Not Stopping Us!
quests.description: So, Argo says that you're not getting into the castle without going through him, does he? Alright, self - I guess that's what we'll do! GET HIM!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat The Void Champion ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat Ukki, The 1st Sentinel
quests.description: Your first task is to make it through the first floor, and find the stairs leading up the second. Ukki, the first of 3 sentinels, will be guarding it. Defeat him, and Galanoth will map your path to the first checkpoint.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Argo's Not Stopping Us! ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat Kagan, The 2nd Guardian
quests.description: Now, you'll need to find your way through the second floor, and find the stairs leading up to the third. Kagan, the second Drakel sentinel, will be guarding it. Defeat him, and Galanoth will map your path the second checkpoint.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Argo's Not Stopping Us! ' quest.

quests.name: Defeat Golgar, The 3rd Guardian
quests.description: Now, you'll need to find your way through the third floor, and find the stairs leading up to the 4th. Golgar, the third Drakel sentinel, will be guarding it. Defeat him, and Galanoth will map your path the third checkpoint.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Argo's Not Stopping Us! ' quest.

quests.name: Hand over the Entry Code
quests.description: Halt! *sniff* You SMELL like Dragon but LOOK like human. I don't like you. And if I find out the serfs or the other castle staff told you… *grunt* Duty requires me to give you the opportunity to say the passcode before I split you in two. WELL?!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Argo's Not Stopping Us! ' quest.

quests.name: Void... Parchment?
quests.description: I can give you the means to break the spell yourself, but I will need to imbue it into a scroll. Since my magic comes from the Void, I will need to craft the scroll with materials from the Void as well. A husk from one of the creatures here - the bears or the larvae - will work. But you will need to make sure it stays intact.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Go Find Mariel ' quest.

quests.name: Magical Ink
quests.description: Next I will need to inscribe the spell onto the scroll, and for that I need ink infused with energy from the Void. I can make some from Condensed Void, which (of course) comes from Void Elementals.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Go Find Mariel ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Soul for a Spell
quests.description: Casting a spell of protective stasis requires a dragon of life - a Creatioux, such as myself. Breaking one requires a dragon of entropy - a Decadere. You don't have to go far in the void to find one; though you may know them simply as "void dragons". You will not be able to reason with them. However, if you slay one, its soul can be used for this same purpose.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Go Find Mariel ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Souvenirs for Bobby
quests.description: Voltaire said he was gonna be my mentor! He's teaching me to love slasher movies as much as he does. I'm starting out by building a souvenir collection - Shrade souvenirs! Only, I'm too little to fight him. Momma says so. If you fight him and bring me back a souvenir, maybe I'll give you something cool!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Him Out! ' quest.

quests.name: Droid For Sale
quests.description: Hello! Want droid? State of the art. I give you one for some items and gold.

quests.name: Get Me Parts
quests.description: I need parts! Get me parts. Then I'll give you something in return.

quests.name: Maxwell's Spare Parts
quests.description: Oh, my! Niteo absolutely MUST keep her animals better under control! Every time they escape, they somehow mange to get into my vault and steal my spare parts! This time, the birds have taken quite a bit of copper wiring, and the hounds have run off with my external hard drive! I really must get them back as soon as possible!

quests.name: Defeat Dogear!
quests.description: Dogear was an imposter! He is inside the bookstore. Defeat him and bring the book back to Maya!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Behind the bush? ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Monster 1: Zardman Grunt
quests.description: The Zardman Grunt was the first monster to ever walk on Lore! Such an ancient creature deserves to be studied. Hero, head deep into the forest and study the Zardman Grunt's environment, habits, and whatever items you may find on it. Return to me with your findings.

quests.name: Monster 2: Skeletal Soldier
quests.description: The Skeletal Soldier has a bone to pick with you! I believe this was the first Undead monster of Lore! Journey to Invasion, Bridge, and SwordhavenUndead to study the Skeletal Soldier's environment, habits, and whatever items you may find on it. Return to me with your findings.

quests.name: Monster 3: Skeletal Viking
quests.description: What's worse than a Skeletal Soldier? A Skeletal Viking! Study the environment, habits, and item drops from the Skeletal Vikings in the Graveyard, CastleUndead, and BattleUnderA, and report back to me with your findings.

quests.name: Monster 4: Skeletal Warrior
quests.description: For being Undead, the Skeletal Warriors sure are lively! What makes them tick? Study the Skeletal Warrior's environment, habits, and whatever items you may find on it. You can find Skeletal Warriors in the Graveyard, Shadowfall, CastleUndead, and BattleUnderA. Return to me with your findings, but be careful, okay?

quests.name: Monster 5: Skeletal Ice Mage
quests.description: Death is a bitter cold reality… especially in the case of Skeletal Ice Magi! Head to Invasion, SwordHavenUndead, and BattleUnderA to study the environment, habits, and the item collection of the Skeletal Ice Mage. Keep your cool and report back to me with your findings.

quests.name: Monster 6: Horc Warrior
quests.description: What are Horcs, anyways? Half Orc, half… ??? Let's find out! Study the Horc Warrior's environment. habits, and whatever items you may find on it. A whole Horc army patrols OrcTown and OrcPath. Good luck!

quests.name: Boss 1: Boss Zardman
quests.description: The world's first boss was the Boss Zardman! Such an ancient master justifies solid research. Head deep into the Forest and study the Boss Zardman's environment, habits, and whatever items you may find on it. Return to me with your findings.

quests.name: Boss 2: Big Jack Sprat
quests.description: Big Jack Sprat has a big bone…and an even bigger polearm… to pick with you! Travel to the Graveyard and study Big Jack Sprat's environment, habits, and his item drops. Come back with your findings, and good luck!

quests.name: Boss 3: General Porkon
quests.description: Even though this Horc is a pig, General Porkon has some serious beef with heroes! Maybe you can bring home the bacon by studying General Porkon's environment, habits, and his item drops? You can find Porkon in OrcTown.

quests.name: Strength
quests.description: So, you're interested in becoming a member of my intrepid team of Loremaster explorers? Fantastic! But we'll need to test your skills to make sure you're ready! First, bring me 5 sets of camel tusks from the Bupers Camels in the Sandsea Oasis. If you can do that, I'll know you're strong enough to do this kind of work without getting yourself killed.

quests.name: Persistence
quests.description: Right, so now we know you've got the strength. But Loremaster field work requires a lot of patience and persistence too! Go out and collect 20 intact Frogrdrake venom sacs. Bring them back, and I'll know you're not the type to give up too quickly.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cleverness
quests.description: As a Loremaster, you'll also need to be able to decipher clues to get what you need. To prove that you're capable, you'll need to fight an insane pyromancer and bring me a vial of his flame. That's all the information I can give you. (Remember — if you're having trouble, friends can be a valuable resource. Don't be afraid to ask your fellow heroes for help!)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tome Recovery: Final Light I
quests.description: The tome you're in search is a tale of light and dark, of Paladins and Necromancers. And it just so happens I have an idea about what took the tome! I heard a sad AROOOO and bone-rattling, then found a trail of dirt leading outside my Librarium. I bet if you take your battle underground, you'll find the pages on monsters in the area.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Only available via the 'Tome Recovery?' dialog option.

quests.name: Tome Recovery: Final Light II
quests.description: Oh… how unfortunate. We're missing almost all of the book. This looks to be only a third of the pages we SHOULD have. I have a sneaking suspicion about where the rest might be, and OOOOH, does it cause my temper to flare up. Those dwakels near the ruins are ALWAYS in search of my paper to use for tinder for their flamethrowers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Only available via the 'Tome Recovery?' dialog option.

quests.name: Tome Recovery: Final Light III
quests.description: I've got good news for you, my friend… from Quibble Coinbiter, surprisingly enough. An adventurer who stopped by for a scroll on Skeletons heard from him that a scorched section of an unknown tome was seen in Sleuthhound Inn. Mysterious! But lucky, just the same. It means we should soon be able to piece together all the pages and let you read the entire tale.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Only available via the 'Tome Recovery?' dialog option.

quests.name: Loremaster Hutch
quests.description: So, you want to upgrade your Loremaster Tent? I will need 1 piece of Fabric, 10 Boards, 20 Nails and 2 cans of Paint. Bring those to me - WHILE you own the Loremaster Tent, and I will be happy to make you a Loremaster Hutch.

quests.name: Loremaster Cottage
quests.description: So, you want to upgrade your Loremaster Hutch? I will need 1 piece of Fabric, 20 Boards, 30 Nails, 3 cans of Paint and 2 cans of Varnish. Bring those to me - WHILE you own the Loremaster Hutch, and I will be happy to make you a Loremaster Cottage.

quests.name: Loremaster Library
quests.description: So, you want to upgrade your Loremaster Cottage? I will need 2 pieces of Fabric, 30 Boards, 40 Nails, 6 cans of Paint and 4 cans of Varnish. Bring those to me - WHILE you own the Loremaster Cottage, and I will be happy to make you a Loremaster Library.

quests.name: Loremaster University
quests.description: So, you want to upgrade your Loremaster Library? I will need 5 pieces of Fabric, 40 Boards, 50 Nails, 96 cans of Paint and 6 cans of Varnish. Bring those to me - WHILE you own the Loremaster Library, and I will be happy to make you a Loremaster University.

quests.name: Toy Fabrication
quests.description: "By the north of the square, walking straight

quests.name: Snow in the Glass
quests.description: "The icy flakes swirling inside the glass

quests.name: Gilded Lions
quests.description: "A tumble of stones lie scattered through the snow. Blinding like a sun, it held a golden glow. A man and his beasts, who only revenge sow."

quests.name: Icy Eruption
quests.description: "By the depths where the earth should flow

quests.name: Deep Into the Cold
quests.description: "As the gears of time spin back and forth

quests.name: The Almost End
quests.description: "It all began close to the end

quests.name: How the End Started
quests.description: "He plays his song with icy delight,

quests.name: Mother's Care
quests.description: "After the world's greatest downfall

quests.name: Wrapping It All Up
quests.description: This is it, Hero, the final page that I was able to keep.

quests.name: ULTRA Bibliospectre
quests.description: Is your sword-arm itching for another round? There is a remnant of the Bibliospectre inside the book, just enough for another go, but beware, it's certainly angrier than before.

quests.name: Ninja Grudge
quests.description: Ninjas and Assassins must always keep a cool head when going about the business of taking out their opponents. With one exception: Pirates! Those noisy and crude boat-riders are everything we Ninjas are not. Bring me back 12 Pirate Medallions from Fishman Soldiers or Shark Bait from Lolosia to prove your worth! You can find Lolosia in the Yokai or Dwarfhold section of your map.

quests.name: Without a Trace
quests.description: We must practice our art in such a way that no one knows we are the true culprit! Sneak around the forest and pick the pockets (or "pockets" - try not to think about it too hard) of all of its residents. Show me just how good you are at stealth!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hit Job
quests.description: This is dirty work, but somebody has to do it! SOMEONE has offered to pay me — er, US— very well if I— er YOU— would bring back the helmet of Ogug Stoneaxe and the sword of Breken the Vile to prove that you have "dealt" with them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mazumi's Personal Armor
quests.description: You know what, Hero. I like your face. And the way you wield a weapon. I'll let you quest for my personal gear.

quests.name: Fond of Phoenix Gear
quests.description: You are? So am I. THIS quest, I think you can handle. IF you've got a Phoenix Blade. You… DO have a Phoenix Blade, don't you?
quests.requirements_note: Must have Phoenix Blade in your inventory.

quests.name: Beat the Dire Groglurk!
quests.description: Head to /bosschallenge and take on the Dire Groglurk! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Beat the Underbeast!
quests.description: Head to /ravenloss and take on the Underbeast! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Beat the Mutated Void Dragon!
quests.description: Head to /bosschallenge and take on the Mutated Void Dragon! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Beat the Manticore!
quests.description: Head to /venomvaults and take on the Manticore! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Beat Binky!
quests.description: Head to /doomvault and take on Binky the Unicorn! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Beat the Hulking Castle Spider!
quests.description: Head to /bosschallenge and take on the Hulking Castle Spider! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Help MechQuest!
quests.description: *bzzzt* Initiate message sequence:

quests.name: Slay the Sordid Shadowscythe
quests.description: *bzzzt* Initiate confidential message recording:

quests.name: Challenge SN.O.W.
quests.description: Challenge a stronger version of SN.O.W..
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Katnip Sneevilgreen's Quests .

quests.name: True Love
quests.description: I'm willing to come with you, but please - can you make sure you find my boyfriend, Andres? He disappeared a year before I was taken, and I saw his reflection in one of the mirrors here before I was trapped in this one. It will be easier to face the real world if he's with me. Please, find his mirrors, and rescue him! I think it was just a little further in than mine was.

quests.name: Find my Stuff
quests.description: When the Mysterious Stranger brought me here, his dungeon guards confiscated all my things, I'll need to get them back before I can leave. You'll help me, won't you?

quests.name: Nightmare Juice, Om Nom Nom
quests.description: Oh, did I say I'd help you? I did, didn't I? It's so hard to focus when I'm hungry, though. Maybe if I had a snack first? Nightmare essence would be lovely… let's say 8 of them. You can get them from any of the nightmare creatures here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Calling Frostmane ' quest.

quests.name: Gentle Persuasion
quests.description: Ok, ok. This nightmare's gotta be hiding somewhere. Nothing that happens here goes totally unnoticed, so some of the other nightmare creatures must know something. Beat 'em up, and see what clues you can find.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Breaking & Entering
quests.description: Geopetal! All the clues indicate SHE would know where Frostmane's nightmare is. Like your Geopetal, our nightmare Geo lives deep inside the mountain. To get inside, you'll need a key. 6 Rune Keys, to be exact. The Shadow People are the only ones who have them. I think you know what to do.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Hills Are Alive
quests.description: Being a nightmare, the mountain you're about to enter is, itself, alive. When you go inside, it will send tiny chunks of itself to attack you. You'll need to defeat these, um, nightmare rocks before Geopetal will be able to help you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: Quest title is a parody of the film The Hills Have Eyes.

quests.name: A Geode for Geo
quests.description: Geopetal's STILL not talking to you? Maybe we just need to butter her up. Pretty geodes are what she likes best. Break open any rocks left in the mountain until you find a perfect one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Bribery
quests.description: Now that you have a nice gift for her, I bet Geopetal will be a lot more helpful! Go take this to her and see what she has to say!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat Frostmane's Nightmare
quests.description: Frostmane's nightmare has been hiding in the cave just past Geopetal! If you defeat it, both Frostmane and his sister Embermane will be freed. Also I'll get a really nice dinner.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can also be accepted from Embermane on Screen 12 while it hasn't been completed. This quest can only be completed once from Memet, and from Ulfgar Geirsson thereafter.

quests.name: It's Snacktime!
quests.description: Hello again! Have you come to collect some more snacks for me? How sweet! You can get me some Minor Nightmares from the Night Terrors or Shadow people, and some Utter Terror from the Abandoned Dollies.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Frostmane's Nightmare ' quest.

quests.name: More Geodes for Geo
quests.description: You should do something nice for Geopetal too, while you're here. See if you can find her some more pretty geodes! Just break open the rocks until you find a few that are gorgeous inside.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat Frostmane's Nightmare ' quest.

quests.name: Frosthog
quests.description: My hedgehog, Hermes, keeps trying to hibernate. Do you think it's because it's too cold for a hedgehog, living in the nightmare realm? I have an idea. Bring me some yarn and knitting needles from Grams in /harvest - old ladies knit, right?

items.name: I Heard You Like Hermes Pet

quests.name: Fear of Clowns?
quests.description: You know what's nice? Clowns! Happy, funny, silly CLOWNS! And you know what Clowns have? CANDY! Slay 13 of the Bobble Clowns to get Carnival Candy
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Redemption ' quest.

quests.name: FEAR OF CLOWNS!!!
quests.description: Oooh, you don't look too good. Maybe the Carnival Candy didn't agree with you! Or MAYBE eating the candy lets you see the Clowns for what they REALLY are! Slay 13 of these horrifying clowns!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Redemption ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fear of Spiders
quests.description: Spiders are my FAVORITE… snacks! Fry'em up with some tearsauce and go! But maybe you don't like them so much? Let's see! You defeat 10 spider monsters; I'll watch and see how scared you get.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Redemption ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fear of Snakes?
quests.description: Snakes, am I right? You walk into their pits uninvited and they throw a HISS-y fit! *Giggle* But seriously, Kill the snakes in here until you get a grappling hook and a rope. If you don't, they'll probably eat you. I don't feed them much.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Redemption ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fear of Falling?
quests.description: Walk across the bridge without falling. Seriously. It's that simple. That's ALL you have to do! *Giggle* Of course, if you DO fall… well. You won't, right? Tee-hee!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Redemption ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fear of Germs?
quests.description: You don't like battling through sewage? Awww, but it makes the fear-sweat smell so much sweeter! *Giggle!* Ooooog weeeeeelllllll! I guess if you destroy 13 germs or Muck Elementals, I can let you go. But NO shower afterwards! Muahahaha!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Redemption ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fear of Needles?
quests.description: Needles are like baby-sized blades that are easy to lose and then stab you in the dark as you get ready for bed! I <3 them very much! But… probably you wont. These babies can pierce through the toughest armor like a sword through a Her - oh. *Giggle* Have fun fighting 15 of them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Redemption ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fear of Dolls?
quests.description: Dolls are cute. And I'm cute! But dolls are also evil. But not an EVIL NIGHTMARE like me! So I guess you're lucky that it's only dolls you need to battle here, right? Right! You only need to smash 10 of them to escape. Probably.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Redemption ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fear of Being Buried Alive?
quests.description: Head up high, Hero, and breathe deep! I can 100% guarantee that these walls will not come crashing down into you. But I can't say the same for these bad boys! Battle your fear of being buried alive AND the Skeletons and Rot Feeders!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Redemption ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fear of Burning?
quests.description: YOU'RE FIRED! *Giggle!* No, just kidding, But I won't be if you don't escape this room very very very fast! If I get my fur singed off because you haven't slain 13 Flame Elements fast enough, I will NOT be happy!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Redemption ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: FEAR OF BURNING!!!
quests.description: I wasn't kidding when I said you'd be fired if you don't hurry up! I bet one of these Flame Elementals knows how you can escape unsinged. Slay them until they tell you… then hurry! My fur is starting to smoke.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Redemption ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fear of Drowning?
quests.description: GLUB GLUB GLUB! *Giggle* If you don't want to be all washed up, you'd better find out how to get out of here! You don't want to be drowning your sorrows in the bottom of the deep blue sea, do you?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Redemption ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fear of Inadequacy?
quests.description: You can save ONE itsy bitsy teeny little puppy, can't you? A big strong Hero like you? *Giggle* Of COURSE you can! Take those skeletons down and SAVE. THAT. PUPPY!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Redemption ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fear of Loneliness?
quests.description: So what do you think, Hero? Could you stand an eternity by yourself? *Giggle* Things would start getting pretty dull… unless you began fighting the nothingness itself! In fact, that's a GREAT idea!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Redemption ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fear of Failure?
quests.description: This is the penultimate fear test, Hero! Twig is HUNGRY! Fish and Ice Cream aren't enough for him anymore, and it would be a TRUE nightmare if he didn't get enough food! *Giggle* Slay the Devourax to take their snacks for Twig!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Redemption ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Drink #1: the Blue Moglin
quests.description: Ok! For our ﬁrst drink, let's start off with some Moglinberry Juice. Nice and traditional, right? Unfortunately, I don't have any here, so you‘ll have to head to Yulgar's Inn and steal some.

quests.name: A Little Something Extra
quests.description: Next I'm thinking maybe some mint. But also that coppery taste you get in your mouth when you're in the time void. Oh hey, I know! That Nethermint stuff that the Minx Faeries in the Span put in their tea! Yeah, get me some of that!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mix A Blue Moglin
quests.description: So, I'm thinking this would taste best if it was cold and ﬁzzy. Don't you agree! Let's try it out! Go behind the bar, and mix the juice and mint with some carbonated water. Then, put some ice in it! When you're done, come back out here and feed it to the Tiki God so we can see what he thinks!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

items_required.name: Blue Moglin Mixed. The Tiki God Approve!

quests.name: Drink #2: the El Captain Rhubarb
quests.description: Next up, I think I want to make something inspired by my favorite pirate buddy: Captain Rhubarb! I'm thinking we'll start with some crushed Spineapple. Maybe some coconut milk - just ﬁght the Palm Treeants until the coconuts fall off. And some Yokai Lime - you can pick those from the citrus trees along the beach. (Quest available once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Needs a Little Kick
quests.description: This is still not quite piratey enough, though. I'm thinking a pirate spice blend… you should be able to get some from the undead pirates in Lolosia. You know what - while you're there, see if you can get any Bone Powder off 'em, too. That'll give it a unique taste!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mix an El Captain Rhubarb
quests.description: Ok, let's make this thing! I'm thinking frozen this time. So, go behind the bar, and get some ice… then blend it up with the drink mix… and what the heck, let's put some sugar on the rim off the glass this time, too! Just like before, come back out and feed it to the Tiki God when you're done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

items_required.name: El Captain Rhubarb Mixed. The Tiki God Approves!

quests.name: Drink #3: the Blazing Beard
quests.description: For our next drink, my inspiration is another pirate - that literal hottie, Blazebeard! Let's start with some bananas and Basani Orange - you can get em from the Palm Treeants and citrus trees along the beach. And then, to give it a little bite, let's add in some venom from the Tiki Sneaks that are slithering around here! (Quest available once per login session)
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Let's Give It Some HEAT
quests.description: We can't make a Blazebeard-themed drink without adding in something very, very HOT! Like, Fotia hot. In fact, that's a great idea! Go to Fotia, and get some Fotian Spices from the spirits there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Mix a Blazing Beard
quests.description: Time to do a test run on this baby! Go behind the bar, and… let's see. Mix it with some carbonated water. And then put it on ice. And then - let's get really crazy here - let's blend it too! Maybe some sugar on the rim to balance out the venom. And… let's get really creative with this, what do you say? Let's light it on ﬁre! As always, make sure you give the Tiki God a taste when you're done!
quests.requirements_note: Must gave completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be done once .

items_required.name: Blazing Beard Mixed. The Tiki God Approves!

quests.name: System Cleanse
quests.description: We're going to have to try to get this drink out of Memehano's system! After the sugar rush wears off, he should be ﬁne. You're gonna have to climb up to his head, and get rid of all the sugar, sneak venom and spicy fire that are affecting him. I'll meet you up there!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Down the, um, Ear Hole
quests.description: Well, that helped a little, but he's still pretty wired! There's only one thing left to do: go into his brain and ﬁx it in there! Go on, right through the ear canal!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Tire Him Out!
quests.description: Now that we're in his subconscious, you can try to calm Menehano down by ﬁghting his psyche. Head deeper in until you ﬁnd him. You should destroy any manifestations of his intense sugar on your way, no matter what form they take.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Chase Him Down!
quests.description: Quick, follow after him! I can tell that ﬁrst ﬁght weakened him, and he's getting weaker still every time you kill part of his sugar high! If you can catch up to him and ﬁght him again, I‘m sure this time it will work!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get Him CALM!
quests.description: We're almost there, I can feel it! Keep running deeper in until you ﬁnd him again! Destroy anything that stands in your way!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Reveal the Nightmare
quests.description: This is what Wistar-287 brought you here to do! Fulfill your destiny! Kick him into the next galaxy!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Defeat the Escapee!' ' quest.

quests.name: No More Tears
quests.description: What we really need for this project is some pure, extra-strength TEARS. We normally have plenty, but Calico has turned them all into happy rain clouds. So… beat up the clouds and steal the rain. It's literally the exact same thing. Go out the front door and you'll see them. Just remember - you have to "slide" your way back here when you are done.

quests.name: Everything on it is a Gas
quests.description: Next, we'll need some really spooky noises. You know what's almost as spooky as a theremin? Helium squeals! That's where they hid all of our sound FX - in those balloons! Get them back! Just remember - you have to "slide" your way back here when you are done.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gooooo-d Job
quests.description: Now we need some of the …well, the GOO that makes nightmares what they are. If you go down the stairs in the back, you'll find a small pocket of Nightmare that still exists. It's crawling with the stuff. Just collect some and bring it back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hiding in the Shade
quests.description: We'll need to gather up a lot of darkness, too. Snatch it from the Nightmare Shades out back.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: One Dream, One World
quests.description: Just one more thing and we'll be good to go: I need some dream dust! You can get it from anything in the dream world.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: A Nocturnal Vacation
quests.description: While I'm crafting this nightmare, I need YOU to go back outside and gather up any stray nightmares you find out there. We don't want them drawing attention to us before we get this finished.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Jailbreak!
quests.description: Oh no - you're in jail! You'd better break yourself out of here so you can find Memet!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' A Nocturnal Vacation ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Freedom!
quests.description: You'll have to find and free Memet if you're ever going to get out of this place. Be sure to defeat any guards you see along the way - otherwise they'll just capture you BOTH.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Make the Glitter Fade
quests.description: We are gonna tear this place down! Beat up those Sparkle Guards and take their Sparkle Throwers! We won't let them glitterfy anything else.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rama Llama Ding Dong!
quests.description: I made some adjustments to those Sparkle Throwers. Now, they shoot out the Nightmare Goo I had leftover from making that bad dream. Go out and use it on those guard llamas - make them OUR guards instead!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Got to get the Key
quests.description: It looks like these hallways contain all of the doors to everyone's dreams. One of them belongs to Criminy Thicket. We just need to find the right key to open it. One of those Sparkle Guards should have it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Open the Door
quests.description: We have the key to Criminy's dreams. Now, we just need to find the right door… open it… and locate Criminy Thicket!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once.

quests.name: Calico Dreams
quests.description: For the love of all things spooky, beat him up! Beat him up!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sweat-tastic
quests.description: First, let's try to get some of this SUN off the sand! And by sun, I mean Solar Elementals and those awful Sun Flares. Kill them all, please and thank you.

quests.name: Cool 'em Down
quests.description: Those Boiling Water Elementals need to COOL DOWN! They're making the ocean water super warm. Beat em up and bring em back to me. I'm gonna put em in my tiki bar's walk-in freezer for awhile.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Poor Trees, Pour Trees?
quests.description: It's so hot and so dry with all this SUN, the trees are PARCHED! Fight some water elementals - NOT the boiling ones - and get some nice, refreshing water from them. Then, maybe you could water the plants for me?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Put out the Flames
quests.description: OH NO! Those Sun Flares have set part of the beach on FIRE! Hurry and put out the flames! And kill some more of those dang Sun Flares while you're at it.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Sunscream
quests.description: I bet if I had some elemental sunlight, I could make a killer suntan oil out of it. How much do you think I could sell it for? Nevermind, I'll worry about that later, For now, just get me some of that nice, bright sunshine!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Whoops!
quests.description: Oops! We left the Water Elementals in the freezer for too long, and they, uh, froze. But that's ok! Go in and chip off some ice. I bet it'll keep my drinks REALLY cold!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Milk From Nuts?
quests.description: I'm running low on coconut milk, and I'm gonna need some more if I want to sell any drinks. Get it from the Palm Treeants. Obviously.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Free Drinks
quests.description: Alright, alright. I'm all set up and ready to go. Let's try to get some business gong here! Take these drink samples around to the people on the beach, and tell 'em where they can come to get more.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Ice, Ice Maybe?
quests.description: Everyone's having a good time, but the water's still too warm to swim. What do you think about using some more of that elemental ice to cool it down? The elementals in the freezer are STILL frozen solid, so I bet there's plenty. Just chunk some off, and toss it in!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Chill Out!
quests.description: Well, what are you waiting for? No one's gonna stay at the beach unless you do something about that steaming water dragon!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Find Tokens! Win A Prize!
quests.description: Hey there, friend! Want to have some fun? Why not play my new Tiki Tokens game? I've hidden Tiki Tokens on the monsters roaming the beach. Whoever finds 'em can trade 'em in for a fun prize! It's awesome, really.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Rhison Samples
quests.description: The progress I've made here is great! But it tastes a little bland, don't you think? Rhison meat has such a nice umami flavor. Bring me some samples, eh? You'll find a lot of them in Bloodtusk Ravine. We'll see if we can improve these little nuggets.

quests.name: Test Sample #1
quests.description: Now, what we're gonna do is infuse my meat with a little bit of Rhison DNA. Just chuck it into the MOGLN device, and the machine will take care of the rest. When it comes out, have a sample and tell me what you think!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note : This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Spice it Up
quests.description: What if we made it a little spicier, what do you think? I bet adding a pinch of dragon to the mix would do the trick. I'm thinking Firestorm Hatchlings. From Fire Storm, of course! Bring me a few samples and we'll see how it turns out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note : This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Test Sample #4' quest.

quests.name: Test Sample #2
quests.description: You know the drill! Feed those Firestorm samples to the MOGLN machine and then taste what comes out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note : This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Tenderize
quests.description: You know what's really tender? Fish! But we'd want to use something without any of that fishy flavor. Fishwing is pretty mild, though. I think that might work. There's plenty of 'em in Lolosia. Go grab some samples for me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note : This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Test Sample #4' quest.

quests.name: Test Sample #3
quests.description: You know the drill! Feed those Fishwing samples to the MOGLN machine and then taste what comes out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note : This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Meat Multiplication
quests.description: Trobbles! Those things grow really fast, and they multiply like crazy. I bet they'd make this stuff grow like crazy, too! You'll find them all over Guru Forest.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note : This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Test Sample #4' quest.

quests.name: Test Sample #4
quests.description: Oh, man, this is gonna be great! Come on, chuck those into the MOGLN machine and let's see what happens.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note : This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Time to Clean
quests.description: Augh! This meat is out of control! I'm gonna try to figure out how to fix this mess. In the meantime, you'll clean up all these… meat… nubbins, right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note : This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Shut it Down' quest.

quests.name: They're Eating the Wires
quests.description: These meat-things are getting into the wiring! We'd better put out these electrical fires fast, before the whole place burns down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note : This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Shut it Down' quest.

quests.name: Turn 'em off and on Again
quests.description: Ok, ok… I'm getting it under control. Maybe. It would help a lot if you could get some of these damaged repair bots fixed. Just give 'em a good smack. That should do the trick. And if it doesn't… smack 'em again.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note : This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Shut it Down' quest.

quests.name: So... Greasy
quests.description: The meat just KEEPS coming! Listen, hero. I'm gonna have the repair bots you fixed start working on the wiring. YOU handle the meat monsters and the grease they're smearing all over the place.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note : This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'Shut it Down' quest.

quests.name: Shut it Down
quests.description: Meat's cleaned up… wiring's been fixed. I just need to get this machine to shut off! Can you take a look at it and see if you can figure it out?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note : This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Kill it with Fire
quests.description: Kill it! Kill it! Kill it with fire!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note : This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Zombies!
quests.description: All our friends have turned into MEAT ZOMBIES! We gotta fix 'em! I have no idea how, so in the meantime we'll just knock 'em out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Gurk's Quests .

quests.name: Fight the Furbles
quests.description: Oops. Looks like the Furbles have noticed what we're doing. I guess we're gonna have to beat them up too! We sure can't let them stop us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Gurk's Quests . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'SMASH' quest.

quests.name: Pollinate
quests.description: From my time as their meat specialist, I know that these guys are SUPER allergic to treeant pollen. Weird, right? Get a bunch of treeant pollen and spread it around the area. Just the normal stuff from the /farm or the /poisonforest. We'll sneeze em right out of here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Gurk's Quests . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Mecha-Furbles
quests.description: Well, that didn't work the way I wanted it to. They're sending in more troops… and now they're in mech suits! Get 'em, hero!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Gurk's Quests . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'SMASH' quest.

quests.name: Sabotage
quests.description: Man! More of them just keep coming! They must be teleporting in from their spaceship. We're gonna have to sabotage those teleporters. Get some tools from the dwakels in /crashsite and /crashruins. Some we can smash stuff with, and some we can break stuff with.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Gurk's Quests . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest cannot be accessed after completing the 'SMASH' quest.

quests.name: SMASH
quests.description: Alright, now go take those dang teleporters apart! Make sure they can't send any more fuzznuggets down.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Gurk's Quests . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Take Him Out
quests.description: We can't let these jerkfaces capture us, hero! We're going to have to beat them up instead! Start with the really BIG one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed Gurk's Quests . | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get Outta Here
quests.description: We probably oughta find a way out of this cell. Maybe if you hit the bars? Really hard? With your fighty-stick?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Him Out ' quest.

quests.name: Level Up!
quests.description: We're gonna have to fight our way out of here, and - again - by "we" I mean "you". I'll meet you on the other side. Try not to beat up your friends TOO badly, eh?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Him Out ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Keep Climbing
quests.description: I'll meet you at the next checkpoint. We gotta figure out a way to fix this mess!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Him Out ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Up, Up, Up!
quests.description: Fight your way to the royal chambers, friend-o! I'll be skittering along right behind you.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Him Out ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get to the Queen
quests.description: The goal is in sight! We just need to fight our way past her guards! Go, go, go!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Him Out ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Kill the Queen
quests.description: Remember: Kill the queen, and we take this whole place down! Do it for the meat-zombies!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Him Out ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Furbapon
quests.description: Furbles CAN be tamed — or trained?! I am not really sure. But if we can get the young ones away from this ship before they grown into adults, we just might be able to give them a better life. Battle the Furborg Guards until you rescue one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Take Him Out ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get me a Drink
quests.description: Ok, so… what is there to drink around here, anyway? What about those cactus creepers? People drink cactus juice, right? Yeah! Go get me some of that!

quests.name: MonkeyButt Coffee
quests.description: You know what everyone loves? That's right - coffee! I heard the best stuff comes from monkeys. That's right. You feed them the beans and then, uhh, harvest them when they come back out. You'll harvest me some monkey beans, right?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Flyer Time
quests.description: Alright! The lemonade stand is open for business. Wanna do me a favor and pass out these flyers? Give one to everyone you see.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Stop the Enforcers
quests.description: Oh, no! Zorba's enforcers are already looking for me, and I haven't made even half the money he wants! Beat 'em up and buy me some more time!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: New Clothes
quests.description: I gotta find a way to protect myself, friend! I'm eyeing those Cactus Creepers… what do you think about trying to skin them? If I wrap myself up in spiky cactus leather, I bet that will keep people away.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get a Guard
quests.description: Maybe a guard dog too, hmm? No canines around here, but those Thwompcats will scratch your eyes out. See if you can tame me a few.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pickpocket the Pickpockets
quests.description: I've seen those oasis monkeys picking people's pockets. I'm not under any illusion you've got those kinds of skills, but I'm pretty sure you can beat up a few monkeys. Find me some coin!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Get more Enforcers
quests.description: I'm sure my cactus leather and thwompcats will be enough to hold off the enforcers. But man, there sure are a lot of them! Maybe you could go take care of a few more for me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Get the Lem-or
quests.description: Looks like this is where Memet ended up. You going in after her, or what?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Find Memet ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Kick Zorba's Butt!
quests.description: I can't believe that jerk! We can't let him get away with this, hero! Kick his butt for me! Kick it hard!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Hack the System
quests.description: Well, there’s no one here, hero, and we’re locked in this tiny room. We’re gonna have to break ourselves out if we want to find out what happened to Byro and Dax. Start by hacking into the computer system. See what you can find.

quests.name: Get the Code
quests.description: The system also says we'll need a code to get out of here, but …I couldn't find it anywhere. Do you think these Security Droids might have it?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Unlock the Door
quests.description: Now you just gotta unlock the door so we can get out of here.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Flora and Fauna
quests.description: Whoa! It's a madhouse out there! Looks like their cargo was a bunch of flora and fauna… and that space-gunk has been mutating it! Get rid of it, buddy! Get rid of it all!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Erasertime
quests.description: I have a plan, hero. How do you get rid of unwanted color? On a piece of paper, let's say. That's right - you erase it! Wanna see if it'll work for the colors on these walls, too? Bring me some rubber from the Mutated Treeants and some oil from the Security Droids. Imma make a giant eraser.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Erase it!
quests.description: Ok, buddy. You've got a giant eraser now. Go erase some colors.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Gather Samples
quests.description: It’s time to get to work on a solution to this space goop. First things first… bring me some samples of the mutations it causes. From the treeants or from the deer, either way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Parts for a Machine
quests.description: Nice work, buddy! I have a working theory already. Now I just need a machine that will help me properly assess this GUNK and see if it’s right. Take apart those droids and see if you can find any parts I could use to build one.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Test the Goop
quests.description: Alright! Now I just need some space goop samples. You know where to get those, I hope.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Goop-Be-Gone
quests.description: You ready to test this out? Yeah! Me too! Go pour some of my patented Goop-Be-Gone on the… well, on the goop, and see what happens.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Cleaning Time
quests.description: WA-HOO! Get out there and do it! CLEAN ALL THE THINGS! Go go go!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Chop Chop Fizz Fizz
quests.description: Say, friendo… when you were cleaning up all that stuff, did you happen to notice a really massive chunk of it? Looks like it might be covering up a doorway? Yeah, that thing. Let’s fizz it down and see where it goes.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: It's THEM!
quests.description: Aaaaaah! That’s them! That’s THEM! Keep them occupied so I can hose 'em down!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Pest Control
quests.description: So, Jana’s got a fairy problem, huh? Don’t worry, I know just how to fix it. Those skulls that are flying around out here? They EAT dream fairies. So what you’re gonna do is catch a bunch of them and then set ‘em loose inside the library. Trust me, she’ll thank us both.

quests.name: Why Can't I Sleep?
quests.description: Go on! You show that hag who's boss. I'll be cheering you on all the way.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' What's That Under my Bed? ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Cannibal Mermaids?
quests.description: YEAH! Cannibal mermaids, GO! I know how to defeat these nasty ladies, friendo! I read all about it in my book. All we gotta do is cover ourselves in Scuttlefish Ink. They'll think we're their friends… until we harpoon ‘em from behind! They hide out in the basement, go get 'em!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Stop the Storm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Infiltrate the Mermaids
quests.description: Now we can infiltrate their ranks without raising their suspicion! Come on, sneak into their lair with me. We're gonna get ‘em!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Stop the Storm ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Memet's Birthday Quest
quests.description: So Hero, all those times we been on adventures together, going through the most nightmare-ish areas we could find? Good times. Now that you're probably stuffed from all the food, lets work it off. If you want a gift from ME, you're gonna have to go into /ByroDax and bring me some fuel for Nightmares. I think you can figure out which monsters can cause that. Have fun!

quests.name: Find Memet
quests.description: Looks like Memet is gone. That's not good! She might be in trouble. You'd better go find her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Get more Enforcers ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Inquisite the Inquisitors
quests.description: The Inquisition's minions are no match for me! Time to strike them down!

quests.name: Captains Capped
quests.description: If I take out their Captains, their grunts will have to disperse. That's when I'll make my escape.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Grand Defeat
quests.description: The Grand Inquisitor is in my way. Looks like I have no choice but to take him out.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Portal Unlocked
quests.description: What is this portal? Could this be what the Inquisition is here for? It looks like it requires bones to power it… I know just the source!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Fiend Training
quests.description: Strength is the only thing a Fiend understands. I will show them my strength and hope they learn something in the process.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Failed Fiend Shards
quests.description: It appears some Fiends are attempting to commune with Adimonde and create Fiend Shards of their own. I will not tolerate this. I must destroy any attempts they make.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Executed Tasks
quests.description: There are those Fiends that chose to disobey me. Very well. I will have their heads for treason!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Champion Usurper
quests.description: A Fiend Champion dare challenge my authority? No matter. They will make a fine example to those who respect them over me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Break their Muti-kneecaps
quests.description: Those good-for-nothing Fiends! They think they can destroy my Fiend Shard while I was away? Foolish! Quickly, past the Fiend Champion and into the room where my Fiend Crystal is housed! I will show them my true power!!!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Controlling the Fiends
quests.description: While strength a fiend can recognize, I need to see how they process information. Some fiends are smarter than others. Is it because they have been around longer? Their essences need to be collected so I have some data to start with. Extracting it won't be so easy though, it might take a couple of attempts…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Break their Muti-kneecaps ' quest.

quests.name: Wrong Turn at Voidbuquerque
quests.description: This Void realm is unfamiliar to me, could it be somehow connected to the Abyss? Perhaps the essences of the locals will tell me what I need to know.

quests.name: Defeat the Minions
quests.description: Please help me! Defeat Sepulchure's minions before they destroy my tower. Defeat 2 Skeletal Minions and return to me to turn in your quest.

quests.name: Slay the Black Dragon
quests.description: Gather your strength and slay the black dragon at the top of Stonehand tower.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed previous quest at least once.

quests.name: Seek and Destroy
quests.description: We've got some party crashers wandering around Mythsong Canyon. They aren't doing anyone any good and it's time someone did something about it! …and that someone is YOU. Travel around Mythsong Canyon and bring me 3 Tune-a-Heads and 5 Beetle Wigs to assure that the job is done. Rock on and good luck!

quests.name: The Four Hoarsemen
quests.description: So ya think you have what it takes to bring down the Four Hoarsemen of Mythsong, huh? There is an abundance of tone-deaf baddies out there that are ruining the Lorestockapalooza atmosphere… and acoustics! Confront the Beatles, Grateful Undeads, and the Bruise Brothers (Elwood and Jake) and retrieve their Vocal Chords so that no one else may suffer through their horrid songs and vicious audio attacks.

quests.name: LEVItate not LAVItate
quests.description: Oh man, I am glad to see you! I was down here trying to get inspiration for my next song, and got trapped. I could use some Bubbly Lifting Drink to levitate out of here. I'll need Dragoat Milk, Lavasite Bubbles, A Spicy Japleno from the guards, and Sulfuric Gas (for lift).

quests.name: Ancient Mix it Up!
quests.description: The first thing any good Rogue needs to master is poisons. Whether it be a specially treated blade, or a few drops added to a glass, the proper application of poison can end a fight almost before it begins.The next best thing to Eye of Newt when it comes to making poisons? is Marsh Lurker's Eyes. Bring me 2 of them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rogue (Rare) in your inventory.

quests.name: Ancient Shadow Skills
quests.description: A Rogue needs to be able to blend in with their environment. These techniques allow them to surprise their enemy and strike them down without alerting anyone else to their presence. All Rogues learn their techniques imitating creatures in their wild state. Head to the Graveyard and find me 6 Shadow Fossils to prove you have studied the undead there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 2 Rogue (Rare) in your inventory.

quests.name: Ancient Evade and Counterstrike!
quests.description: Excellent work so far! You have demonstrated an aptitude for poisons, and a mastery of the techniques of stealth. Your final task involves demonstrating your prowess with the tools of our trade. Rogues often rely on quickness of foot to evade any traps. Go to Guru forest and face Wisteria. Bring me one of her tentacles if you survive!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 3 Rogue (Rare) in your inventory.

quests.name: Ancient Shadow Hour
quests.description: You have done well mastering the art of stealth, and have become a true shadow walker! However, you still have much to learn… and I know a perfect place for you to further your training. My sources tell me that a new evil that has emerged in nearby Bludrut Keep; exploring its depths will provide your stealth and quickness as you confront this new threat. If you can return with 10 fire essences, I will know that you have truly honored the skills of your craft. (Bring back 10 fire essences to complete this quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 5 Rogue (Rare) in your inventory.

quests.name: Mix it Up!
quests.description: The first thing any good Rogue needs to master is poisons. Whether it be a specially treated blade, or a few drops added to a glass, the proper application of poison can end a fight almost before it begins.The next best thing to Eye of Newt when it comes to making poisons? is Marsh Lurker's Eyes. Bring me 2 of them!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rogue in your inventory.

quests.description: A Rogue needs to be able to blend in with their environment. These techniques allow them to surprise their enemy and strike them down without alerting anyone else to their presence. All Rogues learn their techniques imitating creatures in their wild state. Head to the Graveyard and find me 6 Shadow Fossils to prove you have studied the undead there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 2 Rogue in your inventory.
