Your final task involves demonstrating your prowess with the tools of our trade. Rogues often rely on quickness of foot to evade any traps. Go to Guru forest and face Wisteria. Bring me one of her tentacles if you survive!
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 3 Rogue in your inventory.

quests.name: Shadow Hour
quests.description: You have done well mastering the art of stealth, and have become a true shadow walker! However, you still have much to learn… and I know a perfect place for you to further your training. My sources tell me that a new evil that has emerged in nearby Bludrut Keep; exploring its depths will provide your stealth and quickness as you confront this new threat. If you can return with 10 fire essences, I will know that you have truly honored the skills of your craft. (Bring back 10 fire essences to complete this quest)
quests.requirements_note: Must have Rank 5 Rogue in your inventory.

quests.name: Renegade Armor
quests.description: (For owners of the RenegadeClass) You have proven your worth - you are now a Renegade. Sometimes however, these skill are not what is called for, but the look always is.
quests.requirements_note: Must have Renegade in your inventory.

quests.name: Serious Stealth
quests.description: Anyone can use poison or stick a knife in someone's back, but it takes skill to get away with it. My companions said that we can't practice on people in Battleon, so how about pickpocketing the folks in /Orctown? As for the method - poisoning, stabbing, it's your choice.

quests.name: Shady Snooping
quests.description: A Rogue will find themselves sneaking and slinking through all sorts of places. If you snoop around Warlic's Magic Shoppe, you'll find a surprise under his rug. Bring me some finger bones from the creatures hiding down there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Stomping Grounds
quests.description: There's a favor I need to ask from one Rogue to another. Swordhaven /Castle is the only place I can't risk sneaking into. Find the Castle Wraiths, and see if they have any notes or keys. They died during the rebellion, so one should have what I'm looking for.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Swift Shadow
quests.description: Keys and locks don't necessarily need to be attached to a door. Magic's crazy like that. Head back to the caves under the Magic Shoppe and take a stab at the Bone Terror. Think of it as the penultimate test as a Rogue. I'll know when you've succeeded. Its defeat should lift a certain seal…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Robina's Rogue Requisition
quests.description: So… you're a fan of Rogues, yeah? Like Robina? Me, too. One of the best out there. If you want, I could make you an armor just like hers. I'll just need you to bring me the pieces to do it. Make sure when you stab the monsters for you, then cut quickly and cleanly, otherwise you'll ruin the goods.

quests.name: Malfunction Junction
quests.description: Prof. Broun has asked me to de-activate the rampaging beasts and bring the malfunctioning devices back to him. Unfortunately, my little claws cannot carry the devices.

quests.name: Missing Equipments
quests.description: Prof. Broun would like his equipment returned to him. I believe Biff hid them somewhere in these caves as a joke. No doubt they have been rummaged through and scattered around by the wildlife.

quests.name: Marshmallows With Bite
quests.description: Let's start the tour. There are a few rules we need to follow before we can enter the labs. Wash your hands, pinch yourself to make sure you're not heading into work half hallucinating, and keep you lunch in airtight baggies so you won't spread crumbs around. Uh oh, looks like a few of the researchers' lunches got away from them. Could you bag those marshmallows? That's a euphemism for the Whale Lice.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Down the Digestive Tract ' quest.

quests.name: Meaty Cold Spaghetti
quests.description: The doors to the labs lock when they detect non-human intruders. Which means they lock when I'm around. Dr. Noelle said that bug's been taken care of…I'm sure she meant well. It was a joke she wanted to make us laugh with. The sensors are detecting other lifeforms, likely more ready packed meals that escaped their baggies. This time, could you bag those slippery Lamprey?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Songs in the Seams
quests.description: Where did Dr. Caesar go? We were only getting started, but maybe I was boring him. O-oh well, that's alright. This area of the lab is safe, but you seem alarmed? If you're worried, then we'll find him right away! I think I saw him eyeing exposed patches of stone on the walls. We can check those, and look into Dr. Noelle's old office. He was interested in the Base's structure, and you can find a lot of building documents there.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Parched Throats
quests.description: Your friend, Dr. Caesar, got me thinking about the Base's security and structure. Song knows more about Sparagmos than I do, but I want to stop and listen for a moment. The exposed patches of stone are similar to the rocks you found those journal pages on. I need the hall to be quieter so I can really listen. Could you please capture more of the Lice and Lamprey? We need to decrease the noise as much as possible.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Morning Stretches
quests.description: I need to tell Song about what we discovered about the Base's structure. And maybe, it's safer to talk somewhere quiet in person instead of over the video channels where Dr. Noelle can hear us. She won't be back for a while, and you need to see the Champions first. Come with me, the lab's doors unlocked after you cleaned away the critters. We'll walk through and talk with Indradeep. He's been helping the Champions with their rehabilitation.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Natural Empathy
quests.description: Aria and Yulgar have been arguing a lot because of her injuries. The more you care about someone, the more upset you get when they're hurt. She must be really agitated. The Decay Spirits sent to guard her are acting aggressively. They're powerful Nature Elementals trusted with Aria's safety, and get rowdy when she's upset. Let's calm them down before they knock over any beakers.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Comfort Blanket of Snow
quests.description: Like with Aria, the Plane of Ice has sent Elementals to watch over Abel, their Envoy. He's stuck in that room, listening to Aria and Yulgar argue. Hopefully, Fa was nice enough to lend him earphones to block out the shouting, but his guards are as agitated as Aria's. Would you please calm the Ice Guardians too? Sorry I can't help much, but Indradeep's really fit! He can lift a few of them for you, and I'll treat you to a song later!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Whale Watching
quests.description: We can calm the Spirits and Guardians, but they don't stay that way for long. Actually, they're gathering by the windows. I know it's a bit of a walk, but could we take a look at the windows in Dr. Noelle's office, the medical labs, and the surgery room? If you see anything, point it out. Just be careful if you see a loved one outside. One time I hallucinated that Ti was outside, asking me to go for a stroll with him, but you know…
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Exhausted Spirits
quests.description: It wasn't just me! Tara has the same bad feeling, one that's really shaking her up. And she isn't the only one. The Spirits and Guardians are beginning to act even more violently. Would you please restrain them? I'll run and get Tara a glass of water in the meantime. Don't let her jump around too much. She's still hiding how tired she is. Tara shouldn't be ashamed. This environment really isn't meant for us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Singing to Whales
quests.description: We've never been attacked by a sea creature this big before! If we let it swim away, it'll ram us again! The Base will snap in two! Aria and Abel are doing everything they can to hold that big whale in place. Sparagmos hasn't sounded an alarm, and the whale destroyed the emergency escape pods. It's going to take Song a while, but please! Knock the whale out or stall it until the Base can be evacuated!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: The Sea's Commitment
quests.description: There! On the rock clusters, I see another torn page shoved in a crevice! Fa also helped with construction on this floor, and she didn't see the journal entry while she was out there. Someone had to have placed it there recently. We should grab the page before it gets swept away by the ocean currents and have a read. Tara's spells will keep the water pressure from crushing us.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Belly-Up
quests.description: What was written in the journal entry you found lines up with how the tentacled whale monster was pacified during your fight. If the rock cluster, and by extension, the stone covered up by the Base's metal plating, are engraved with the songs of the Water Elves…that was what distracted the Titan long enough for you to beat it down. But we need more proof to be sure. Let's check on the creatures on this floor for similar symptoms.

quests.name: Right Arm Vein
quests.description: I tried to get Fa away from the fakes, but she won't budge! Can you check on them to make sure she'll be okay? Fa's still working on being more open with her feelings, but those weird fakes are going to ruin all of her progress!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Left Arm Artery ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Right Arm Artery
quests.description: There are creatures out in the hallway that amble around without aim. Yulgar didn't bat an eye when he gave us a tour. He called them 'other hotel guests.' Would you mind checking if that's actually true?
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Left Arm Artery ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Cryophobia
quests.description: I heard noises next door. Yulgar said that was going to be your room, but didn't you just arrive? Maybe you should go see who's inside. They might be in trouble too.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Left Arm Artery ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Kleptothermy
quests.description: Please help us destroy the fake Re and La! I think the fakes should go down with one last hit! Song forced her eyes to open, too. She has something to show you. I think they're the notes she wrote before she blacked out the first time.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Phantom Pain ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: Fie Fie
quests.description: Song and I heard more noises coming from next door. It was really loud this time. There was the sound of snarls and glass shattering. I took a peek outside, and found strange red threads scattered on the ground. I think it's worth investigating.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Phantom Pain ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Search for the Cursed Lovers
quests.description: Hero, you must reach Jeluti! I can hear her cries, and they only grow louder. Please battle your way to her side and find a way to help her! I fear you will need to re-slay all of the creatures standing in your way. The curse will ensure they try to keep you from her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Mer'Angel Hunting ' quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Sing the Blues
quests.description: Brave Hero, to reunite these star-crossed lovers, you will need to talk to Moore directly, Once you meet with him, I am sure you will be able to save him. If you charge up J6’s hourglass by slaying the slain creatures here, I am sure you will find a way to pass through the curse and see him.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Land of the Red
quests.description: Hurry! Moore is a strong man… ghost… person… but I can hear his heart breaking even further! He longs to be with his love, Hero. Can you deny him that? Battle your way to where he stands and waits. His friendship will serve you well if you will only help reunite him with Jeluti!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Find the Source of the Curse
quests.description: Feel the rage, the all-consuming hate that emanates from behind that door! It frightens me! But Hero, I think you will have to get inside it. You will need 2 keys – the Key of True Love and the Key of Eternity. I am sure the infernal creature behind that door has given them to the monster for safe-keeping.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Defeat the CurseMaker
quests.description: This… this is the cause of the curse that keeps Moore and Jeluti apart! Re-slay him and perhaps the star-crossed, curse-suffering lovers can be together for eternity!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: One Moore Time
quests.description: One more time, Hero, you will need to battle your way to Moore – find him and learn what he has to tell you. Kill 4 monsters in each room to pass, one for each chamber of the 2 lovers’ hearts. You must be determined but, since it is you, I do not think that will be a problem!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: You Only Get One Shot at True Love
quests.description: We only have ONE chance to succeed at this, Hero! Battle your way back to the tomb in which you faced Mercutio. If we can successfully save Jeluti, then maybe we will ALL be saved.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Baucis's Pitcher
quests.description: When Zeus and Hermes, disguised as mortals, walked through Phrygia, they learned the people had forgotten hospitality. They knocked on every door and were turned away. Finally, they came to a rundown cottage where an older couple lived. Philemon and his wife Baucis invited the gods in and served what little they had. The gods watched as the coople served with a happy heart. If you are Good enough, seek out Earth Elementals to recreate this lovely pitcher, a symbol of service in love. Bride Pine Trolls and bring back the scared wood for Zeus' blessing.

quests.name: Oberon's Bouquet
quests.description: Wouldn't it be nice if all we had to do was wipe our true love's eyes with the dew of a flower and everything would be right in the world? That's precisely what Oberon, king of the Faeries thought. His queen, Titania, refused his requests and left him out in the cold. Unable to deal with this, he sent his faithful trickster, Puck, to retrieve for him what he needed to ensure her devotion. Journey throughout Lore and find all the materials needed to grow this flower. Seek out Seedspitters, Scarecrows, Cactus Creepers and Desert Vases to find these things.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'You Only Get One Shot at True Love' quest.

quests.name: Pygmalian's Ivory Lady
quests.description: Artists…they specialize in the perfection of their art and oftentimes forget that real life is not like a canvas or a pure block of ivory. Such was the life of Pygmalian. He was a talented sculptor who found the woman of his day imperfect and incomplete. He detested them and the way they behaved, swearing to never love one. So he dedicated his life and time to art. In time, he procured a flawless piece of ivory and began to sculpt it, a shape slowly coming to life. Please, Hero, go out and get the tools needed to complete this masterpiece from the Gorillaphant, Living Water and Spider.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'You Only Get One Shot at True Love' quest.

quests.name: The Ring of Shakuntala
quests.description: Shakuntala was a lovely woman that caught the eye of King Dushyanta while he was hunting in the forest. He fell in love with her and married her. They spent much time together, but he eventually had to return to his kingdom. He promised to come back for her and left. As she dreamt of him, a powerful rishi visited her home and she forgot to greet him properly. In his anger, he cursed her, saying the one she dreamt of would forget her unless he saw something special between them. You must gather materials from Ore Balboa, Crystal Rock, Fire Imps and Dark Witch to make the ring he gave her.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the 'You Only Get One Shot at True Love' quest.

quests.name: Love Letters of Solitude
quests.description: There was once two lovers, Abelard and Heloise, who lived a love that many only dream of. He was a teacher, her, his student. She was intelligent, her mind one of the best and he slowly fell in love with her, eventually marrying her. One day, her uncle and friends attacked Abelard, mutilating him. They thought he had abandoned Heloise. Now, only those with an Evil heart can fight the evil done. While I compose myself please gather ink from a Table, parchment from Box Guardians, incense from a Trollola plant and Essence of Solitude from a Soulseeker and return to me.

quests.name: Mer-Angel Fish Food?!
quests.description: Your boss wants you to serve me up as sushi? That's terrible! But also intriguing. While I ponder whether I'd taste more like tuna or salmon, would you mind taking out these necro minions he sent? They smell pretty rotten to me.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' S'KARIN WANT MERMAID SUSHI ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once .

quests.name: S'KARIN NO WANT GO VIRAL
quests.description: Wasn't that a good impression? Thanks! I thought so, too. But what did you call her? A… fake-bling-lovin', real-fur-wearin', secret-menu-sharin' S'karin? *giggle* I do not think she appreciated you calling her that. She looks ready to bite your head clean off. O_O
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' S'KARIN WANT MERMAID SUSHI ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Gore-Made for This
quests.description: Don't worry, my friend! You're too heroic to work at shady place like Scarbucks. You're gore-made for MUCH better things. Give Chef Die your two-minute notice and let's get out of here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' S'KARIN WANT MERMAID SUSHI ' quest. Note: These quests can only be completed once . | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Barely Made It
quests.description: Before you help me, Lightguard needs you. I was traveling by wagon when the undead attacked. I made it back here but the wagon carrying much needed food and supplies didn't. You must locate that wagon in DoomWood!

quests.name: Plant Food
quests.description: First, see if you can recover all 15 crates of rations. The undead don't need food so it only makes sense that the Doomwood Treeants have it. Come back when you've got all the rations.

quests.name: Supplies Party
quests.description: The refugees are grateful for the rations but there were building, medical and other supplies in the other crates, not to mention my pack with all my research. They are probably scattered all over DoomWood by now. See if you can recover all the supply crates and see if the undead have my pack. Anyone of them might have taken it!

quests.name: Copious Notes
quests.description: DRAT! My pack is here but the notes I brought from Swordhaven's Library are gone! this is disasterous! That means that the undead know about the KEYSTONE! Quickly, take back all 10 pages of notes From the undead of DoomWood!

quests.name: Lightguard Keystone
quests.description: Now you know what is at stake. Head into the secret passage, make yor way past the sprites set to guard the keystone. If they pass over you while you are moving you will be ejected from the catacombs so move carefully.

quests.name: Defend Lightguard Keep!
quests.description: Of course, it's the fastest way for the undead to get into the room… ghosts can pass through walls without passing the guardian sprites! You have to get back down there and do whatever you can to defeat that spirit before Lightguard Falls!

quests.name: LightGuard Defender Tokens
quests.description: I may be a spirit now but it is still my duty to guard Lightguard Keep from the undead of DoomWood. Bring me DoomWood Creature Trophies and I will provide a LightGuard Defender Token. Use can use those to buy some items from me and you MIGHT just earn my armor while you are at it!

quests.name: Mock the Lock
quests.description: Before we can begin, I first need to free my friends - but the only one who has a key is the prison warden just beyond that barred door. We will need to MELT the lock on that door to gain an advantage over him! 4 Balboa Cores will work nicely as an aluminum base, and I will need 3 Rusted Claws from the Albino Bats for proper oxidation. Lastly, get me 1 Magnesium Flare from a Drow Soldier and bring it back here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lizard Gizzard ' quest.

quests.name: Like Butter
quests.description: Here, take this Thermite, and go to the bars. Once you get there just use the Thermite on it and it SHOULD melt the lock. Try not to draw too much attention to yourself while you do it, and come back here as soon as you blow the lock.
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lizard Gizzard ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Jailhouse Rock
quests.description: Now that the Thermite has melted the lock, go through those barred doors and you will find the prison warden, Elfis. Some say he's the King of Rock! Regardless, he is the only Drow who has the key to our shackles, and the key to our freedom! Defeat him and bring me Elfis' Keyring. The sooner you do, the sooner we can get you out of here!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lizard Gizzard ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest name is a direct reference to the song Jailhouse Rock by Elvis Presley .

quests.name: Explosives 101
quests.description: Making an explosive is not too hard with the proper compounds! We will first need 3 NITRATE ELEMENTS from Albino Bats. These bats carry a lot of nitrates from the soil and their own… er.. waste. We need a long fuse as well, and 3 DROW SHOELACES should do the trick nicely. Finally, 2 FLINT STONES from the rocky Balboas will ignite the operation… literally!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lizard Gizzard ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest.

quests.name: Big Bada-Boom
quests.description: Now all you have to do is plant the bomb. Don't worry about lighting the fuse, it's already lit.. so… uh.. you might want to get a move on! Go blow up that Huge Boulder and the rest of the path should be open! Hurry!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Lizard Gizzard ' quest. | Must have completed the previous quest. Note: This quest can only be completed once .

quests.name: Hunger Pains
quests.description: You know, me and my Dwarven brothers have not had a decent meal in ages! Living off table scraps and gnawing on rocks is anything but fulfilling. But just look at the warden; I bet he has access to all the food in Dwarfhold with a gut that big! Do you think he has anything to eat? Come back to me if you happen to find a good meal!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Big Bada-Boom ' quest.

quests.name: Lodestone Locater
quests.description: We've been down here for so long that we seem to have lost our bearings. Even though we are quite familiar with our mines and tunnels, we do not know North from South or any other direction in-between. Some Balboas contain special magnetic rocks called Lodestones that would work perfectly as a crude compass! We're too weak to get one ourselves, but if you could get just 1 LODESTONE from the local Balboas, it would help us get our bearings back instantly!
quests.requirements_note: Must have completed the ' Big Bada-Boom ' quest.
